hadiths.arabic: خَرَجْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي سَفَرٍ وَكَانَ لَا يَأْتِي الْبَرَازَ حَتَّى يَتَغَيَّبَ فَلَا يُرَى فَنَزَلْنَا بِفَلَاةٍ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ لَيْسَ فِيهَا شَجَرَةٌ وَلَا عَلَمٌ فَقَالَ «يَا جَابِرُ اجْعَلْ فِي إِدَاوَتِكَ مَاءً ثُمَّ انْطَلِقْ بِنَا» قَالَ فَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى لَا نُرَى فَإِذَا هُوَ بِشَجَرَتَيْنِ بَيْنَهُمَا أَرْبَعُ أَذْرُعٍ فَقَالَ يَا جَابِرُ انْطَلِقْ إِلَى هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ فَقُلْ يُقُولُ لَكِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْحَقِي بِصَاحِبَتِكِ حَتَّى أَجْلِسَ خَلْفَكُمَا قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ فَرَجَعَتْ إِلَيْهَا فَجَلَسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَلْفَهُمَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَتَا إِلَى مَكَانِهِمَا فَرَكِبْنَا مَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ بَيْنَنَا كَأَنَّمَا عَلَيْنَا الطَّيْرُ تُظِلُّنَا فَعَرَضَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَةٌ مَعَهَا صَبِيٌّ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنِي هَذَا يَأْخُذُهُ الشَّيْطَانُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ثَلَاثَ مِرَارٍ قَالَ فَتَنَاوَلَ الصَّبِيَّ فَجَعَلَهُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ مُقَدَّمِ الرَّحْلِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «اخْسَأْ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ أَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ اخْسَأْ عَدُوَّ اللَّهِ أَنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلَاثًا» ثُمَّ دَفَعَهُ إِلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا مَرَرْنَا بِذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ فَعَرَضَتْ لَنَا الْمَرْأَةُ مَعَهَا صَبِيُّهَا وَمَعَهَا كَبْشَانِ تَسُوقُهُمَا فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اقْبَلْ مِنِّي هَدِيَّتِي فَوَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ مَا عَادَ إِلَيْهِ بَعْدُ فَقَالَ «خُذُوا مِنْهَا وَاحِدًا وَرُدُّوا عَلَيْهَا الْآخَرَ» قَالَ ثُمَّ سِرْنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَيْنَنَا كَأَنَّمَا عَلَيْنَا الطَّيْرُ تُظِلُّنَا فَإِذَا جَمَلٌ نَادٌّ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بَيْنَ سِمَاطَيْنِ خَرَّ سَاجِدًا فَجَلَسَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلَّى اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وسلَّمَ وَقَالَ عَلَيَّ النَّاسَ «مَنْ صَاحِبُ الْجَمَلِ؟» فَإِذَا فِتْيَةٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ قَالُوا هُوَ لَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «فَمَا شَأْنُهُ؟» قَالُوا اسْتَنَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ مُنْذُ عِشْرِينَ سَنَةً وَكَانَتْ بِهِ شُحَيْمَةٌ فَأَرَدْنَا أنْ نَنْحَرَهُ فَنَقْسِمَهُ بَيْنَ غِلْمَانِنَا فَانْفَلَتَ مِنَّا قَالَ «بِيعُونِيهِ» قَالُوا لَا بَلْ هُوَ لَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «أَمَّا لَا فَأَحْسِنُوا إِلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ أَجَلُهُ» قَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَحْنُ أَحَقُّ بِالسُّجُودِ لَكَ مِنَ الْبَهَائِمِ قَالَ «لَا يَنْبَغِي لِشَيْءٍ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ لِشَيْءٍ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ كَانَ النِّسَاءُ لِأَزْوَاجِهِنَّ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ismāʿīl b. ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir \u003e Kharajt Maʿ al-Nabī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 18

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِهِ نَبِيَّهُ ﷺ مِنْ إِيمَانِ الشَّجَرِ بِهِ، وَالْبَهَائِمِ، وَالْجِنِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah exalted His Prophet ﷺ with of the faith of trees, ani...

hadiths.englishRaw: We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until we reached a wall in the Tribe of Najjar. There was a camel there that no one could enter the wall except by pulling it aside. We mentioned this to the Prophet ﷺ , so he came and called it. It came and kneeled down in front of him until he patted its head. Then he said, "Bring me a rope." He tied it and handed it over to its owner. Then he turned and said, "There is no one from the heavens to the Earth who does not know that I am the Messenger of Allah, except for the rebellious among the jinn and humans."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until we reached a wall in the Tribe of Najjar. There was a camel there that no one could enter the wall except by pulling it aside. We mentioned this to the Prophet ﷺ , so he came and called it. It came and kneeled down in front of him until he patted its head. Then he said, "Bring me a rope." He tied it and handed it over to its owner. Then he turned and said, "There is no one from the heavens to the Earth who does not know that I am the Messenger of Allah, except for the rebellious among the jinn and humans."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى دُفِعْنَا إِلَى حَائِطٍ فِي بَنِي النَّجَّارِ فَإِذَا فِيهِ جَمَلٌ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْحَائِطَ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا شَدَّ عَلَيْهِ فَذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَأَتَاهُ فَدَعَاهُ فَجَاءَ وَاضِعًا مِشْفَرَهُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ حَتَّى بَرَكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ «هَاتُوا خِطَامًا» فَخَطَمَهُ وَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى صَاحِبِهِ ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ فَقَالَ «مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَّا عَاصِيَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنْسِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Ajlaḥ \u003e al-Dhayyāl b. Ḥarmalah \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَجْلَحُ عَنِ الذَّيَّالِ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 19

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِهِ نَبِيَّهُ ﷺ مِنْ إِيمَانِ الشَّجَرِ بِهِ، وَالْبَهَائِمِ، وَالْجِنِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah exalted His Prophet ﷺ with of the faith of trees, ani...

hadiths.englishRaw: that a woman came with her child to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, he has a madness and it comes to him while we're having lunch and dinner and he ruins them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiped over his chest and made duʿāʾ for him and he vomited and something similar to a black jirw/jarw (a predator or a young dog) came out of his abdomen and it hurried away.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: that a woman came with her child to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, he has a madness and it comes to him while we're having lunch and dinner and he ruins them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wiped over his chest and made duʿāʾ for him and he vomited and something similar to a black jirw/jarw (a predator or a young dog) came out of his abdomen and it hurried away.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً جَاءَتْ بِابْنٍ لَهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنِي بِهِ جُنُونٌ وَإِنَّهُ يَأْخُذُهُ عِنْدَ غَدَائِنَا وَعَشَائِنَا فَيُخَبَّثُ عَلَيْنَا فَمَسَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَدْرَهُ وَدَعَا فَثَعَّ ثَعَّةً وَخَرَجَ مِنْ جَوْفِهِ مِثْلُ الْجِرْوِ الْأَسْوَدِ فَسَعَى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Farqad al-Sabakhī \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ فَرْقَدٍ السَّبَخِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 20

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِهِ نَبِيَّهُ ﷺ مِنْ إِيمَانِ الشَّجَرِ بِهِ، وَالْبَهَائِمِ، وَالْجِنِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah exalted His Prophet ﷺ with of the faith of trees, ani...

hadiths.englishRaw: I recognise the stone in Mecca which used to pay me salutations before my advent as a Prophet and I recognise that even now.    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I recognise the stone in Mecca which used to pay me salutations before my advent as a Prophet and I recognise that even now.    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنِّي لَأَعْرِفُ حَجَرًا بِمَكَّةَ كَانَ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُبْعَثَ إِنِّي لَأَعْرِفُهُ الْآنَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Bukayr al-ʿAbdī \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Ṭahmān \u003e Simāk \u003e Jābir b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 21

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِهِ نَبِيَّهُ ﷺ مِنْ إِيمَانِ الشَّجَرِ بِهِ، وَالْبَهَائِمِ، وَالْجِنِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah exalted His Prophet ﷺ with of the faith of trees, ani...

hadiths.englishRaw: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ in Makkah, and we went out with him in some of its regions. We passed by mountains and trees, and we did not pass by a tree or a mountain except that he said, 'Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ in Makkah, and we went out with him in some of its regions. We passed by mountains and trees, and we did not pass by a tree or a mountain except that he said, 'Peace be upon you, O Messenger of Allah.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِمَكَّةَ فَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ فِي بَعْضِ نَوَاحِيهَا فَمَرَرْنَا بَيْنَ الْجِبَالِ وَالشَّجَرِ فَلَمْ نَمُرَّ بِشَجَرَةٍ وَلَا جَبَلٍ إِلَّا قَالَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Farwah \u003e al-Walīd b. Abū Thawr al-Hamdānī \u003e Ismāʿīl al-Suddī \u003e ʿAbbād Abū Yazīd \u003e ʿAlī b. Abū Ṭālib Riḍwān Allāh ʿAlayh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَوْرٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ السُّدِّيِّ عَنْ عَبَّادٍ أَبِي يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 22

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِهِ نَبِيَّهُ ﷺ مِنْ إِيمَانِ الشَّجَرِ بِهِ، وَالْبَهَائِمِ، وَالْجِنِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah exalted His Prophet ﷺ with of the faith of trees, ani...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Fajr prayer when suddenly he saw a pack of nearly a hundred wolves approaching. The wolves' fangs were bared and their eyes were red with hunger. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them, "Will you give up some of your food to satisfy them and ensure safety for everything else?" They complained about their need to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, "Give them permission." So they allowed the wolves to come forward, and the wolves left while howling.
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Fajr prayer when suddenly he saw a pack of nearly a hundred wolves approaching. The wolves' fangs were bared and their eyes were red with hunger. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them, "Will you give up some of your food to satisfy them and ensure safety for everything else?" They complained about their need to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, "Give them permission." So they allowed the wolves to come forward, and the wolves left while howling.
hadiths.arabic: صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْفَجْرَ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِقَرِيبٍ مِنْ مِائَةِ ذِئْبٍ قَدْ أَقْعَيْنَ وُفُودُ الذِّئَابِ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تَرَضَّخُونَ لَهُمْ شَيْئًا مِنْ طَعَامِكُمْ وَتَأْمَنُونَ عَلَى مَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ؟» فَشَكَوْا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْحَاجَةَ قَالَ «فَآذِنُوهُنَّ» قَالَ فَآذَنُوهُنَّ فَخَرَجْنَ وَلَهُنَّ عُوَاءٌ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Shimr b. ʿAṭiyyah \u003e a man from Muzaynah or Juhaynah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ شِمْرِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ مُزَيْنَةَ أَوْ جُهَيْنَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 23

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِهِ نَبِيَّهُ ﷺ مِنْ إِيمَانِ الشَّجَرِ بِهِ، وَالْبَهَائِمِ، وَالْجِنِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah exalted His Prophet ﷺ with of the faith of trees, ani...

hadiths.englishRaw: Gabriel came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was sitting in distress, with blood on him from the actions of the people of Mecca from the Quraysh. Gabriel, peace be upon him, said, "O Messenger of Allah, would you like me to show you a sign?" He said, "Yes." So he looked at a tree behind him and said, "Call it." So he called it and it came and stood in front of him. He said, "Turn it back." So he commanded it and it returned. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "That is enough for me, that is enough for me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Gabriel came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was sitting in distress, with blood on him from the actions of the people of Mecca from the Quraysh. Gabriel, peace be upon him, said, "O Messenger of Allah, would you like me to show you a sign?" He said, "Yes." So he looked at a tree behind him and said, "Call it." So he called it and it came and stood in front of him. He said, "Turn it back." So he commanded it and it returned. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "That is enough for me, that is enough for me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ جِبْرِيلُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ حَزِينٌ وَقَدْ تَخَضَّبَ بِالدَّمِ مِنْ فِعْلِ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ فَقَالَ جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ تُحِبُّ أَنْ أُرِيَكَ آيَةً؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَنَظَرَ إِلَى شَجَرَةٍ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ فَقَالَ ادْعُ بِهَا فَدَعَا بِهَا فَجَاءَتْ وَقَامَتْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ مُرْهَا فَلْتَرْجِعْ فَأَمَرَهَا فَرَجَعَتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «حَسْبِي حَسْبِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abū Muʿāwiyah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 24

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِهِ نَبِيَّهُ ﷺ مِنْ إِيمَانِ الشَّجَرِ بِهِ، وَالْبَهَائِمِ، وَالْجِنِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah exalted His Prophet ﷺ with of the faith of trees, ani...

hadiths.englishRaw: A man from the Banu Amr came to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) and the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Shall I show you a miracle?" He said, "Yes." He said, "Go and call that palm tree." So, he called it and it came hopping between his hands. He said, "Tell it to go back." Messenger of Allah (pbuh) told it, "Go back." So, it went back until it returned to its place. He said, "O Banu Amr, I have never seen a man more knowledgeable in magic than him today."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man from the Banu Amr came to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) and the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Shall I show you a miracle?" He said, "Yes." He said, "Go and call that palm tree." So, he called it and it came hopping between his hands. He said, "Tell it to go back." Messenger of Allah (pbuh) told it, "Go back." So, it went back until it returned to its place. He said, "O Banu Amr, I have never seen a man more knowledgeable in magic than him today."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَى رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عَامِرٍ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَلَا أُرِيكَ آيَةً؟» قَالَ بَلَى قَالَ «فَاذْهَبْ فَادْعُ تِلْكَ النَّخْلَةَ» فَدَعَاهَا فَجَاءَتْ تَنْقُزُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ قَالَ قُلْ لَهَا تَرْجِعْ قَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «ارْجِعِي» فَرَجَعَتْ حَتَّى عَادَتْ إِلَى مَكَانِهَا فَقَالَ يَا بَنِي عَامِرٍ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَجُلًا كَالْيَوْمِ أَسْحَرَ مِنْهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Jarīr And ʾAbū Muʿāwiyah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ẓabyān \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 25

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مِنْ تَفْجِيرِ الْمَاءِ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the given heading is: "How Allah honored the ...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet (ﷺ) called Bilal and asked him to fetch water. Bilal went to find water but returned saying, "No, by Allah, I did not find any water." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Then is there any container?" So, they brought a container and the Prophet (ﷺ) stretched out his hands in it, and water started flowing from underneath his palms. Ibn Mas'ud and others drank from it, and others performed ablution.
hadiths.body: The Prophet (ﷺ) called Bilal and asked him to fetch water. Bilal went to find water but returned saying, "No, by Allah, I did not find any water." The Prophet (ﷺ) asked, "Then is there any container?" So, they brought a container and the Prophet (ﷺ) stretched out his hands in it, and water started flowing from underneath his palms. Ibn Mas'ud and others drank from it, and others performed ablution.
hadiths.arabic: دَعَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِلَالًا فَطَلَبَ بِلَالٌ الْمَاءَ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ لَا وَاللَّهِ مَا وَجَدْتُ الْمَاءَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «فَهَلْ مِنْ شَنٍّ؟» فَأَتَاهُ بِشَنٍّ «فَبَسَطَ كَفَّيْهِ فِيهِ فَانْبَعَثَتْ تَحْتَ يَدَيْهِ عَيْنٌ» قَالَ فَكَانَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ يَشْرَبُ وَغَيْرُهُ يَتَوَضَّأُ
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Shuʿayb b. Ṣafwān \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Abū al-Ḍuḥá \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 26

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مِنْ تَفْجِيرِ الْمَاءِ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the given heading is: "How Allah honored the ...

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of Nubayh al-Anzi, he said: Jabir ibn Abdullah reported that we went on a military expedition or a journey with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while our group consisted of around twelve hundred people. The time for prayer arrived and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Is there anyone among you who has water for purification?" A man came running with a container in which there was some water that no one else among the group had. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the container and poured the water into a utensil. He then performed ablution excellently with that water and then left the utensil. The people gathered around that utensil and said, "Rub your faces with it! Rub your faces with it!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Use it on your hands." When he heard them saying that, he placed his palms into the water and the utensil and said, "In the name of Allah." Then he said, "Pour the water for purification." By the One who has control over my life, I saw water flowing between the fingers of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I swear that he did not lift his hands until all of us had performed ablution.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of Nubayh al-Anzi, he said: Jabir ibn Abdullah reported that we went on a military expedition or a journey with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while our group consisted of around twelve hundred people. The time for prayer arrived and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Is there anyone among you who has water for purification?" A man came running with a container in which there was some water that no one else among the group had. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the container and poured the water into a utensil. He then performed ablution excellently with that water and then left the utensil. The people gathered around that utensil and said, "Rub your faces with it! Rub your faces with it!" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Use it on your hands." When he heard them saying that, he placed his palms into the water and the utensil and said, "In the name of Allah." Then he said, "Pour the water for purification." By the One who has control over my life, I saw water flowing between the fingers of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I swear that he did not lift his hands until all of us had performed ablution.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نُبَيْحٍ الْعَنَزِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ غَزَوْنَا أَوْ سَافَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِضْعَةَ عَشَرَ وَمِائَتَانِ فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «هَلْ فِي الْقَوْمِ مِنْ طَهُورٍ؟» فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَى بِإِدَاوَةٍ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ مِنْ مَاءٍ لَيْسَ فِي الْقَوْمِ مَاءٌ غَيْرُهُ فَصَبَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي قَدَحٍ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ وَتَرَكَ الْقَدَحَ فَرَكِبَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ الْقَدَحَ وَقَالُوا تَمَسَّحُوا تَمَسَّحُوا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَى رِسْلِكُمْ» حِينَ سَمِعَهُمْ يَقُولُونَ ذَلِكَ «فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَفَّهُ فِي الْمَاءِ وَالْقَدَحِ» وَقَالَ «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَسْبِغُوا الطُّهُورَ» فَوَالَّذِي هُوَ ابْتَلَانِي بِبَصَرِي لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الْعُيُونَ عُيُونَ الْمَاءِ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ فَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهَا حَتَّى تَوَضَّئُوا أَجْمَعُونَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e al-Aswad b. Qays \u003e Nubayḥ al-ʿAnazī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 27

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مِنْ تَفْجِيرِ الْمَاءِ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the given heading is: "How Allah honored the ...

hadiths.englishRaw: We became thirsty, so we rushed and went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He placed his hand in a container and kept stirring it as if there were springs flowing from between his fingers. He said, "Mention the name of Allah." So we drank until we were satisfied and had enough. In the narration of Amr ibn Murrah, we asked Jabir, "How many of you were there?" He said, "We were fifteen hundred. And even if we were a hundred thousand, it would have sufficed us."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We became thirsty, so we rushed and went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He placed his hand in a container and kept stirring it as if there were springs flowing from between his fingers. He said, "Mention the name of Allah." So we drank until we were satisfied and had enough. In the narration of Amr ibn Murrah, we asked Jabir, "How many of you were there?" He said, "We were fifteen hundred. And even if we were a hundred thousand, it would have sufficed us."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَصَابَنَا عَطَشٌ فَجَهَشْنَا فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي تَوْرٍ فَجَعَلَ يَفُورُ كَأَنَّهُ عُيُونٌ مِنْ خَلَلِ أَصَابِعِهِ» وَقَالَ «اذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ» فَشَرِبْنَا حَتَّى وَسِعَنَا وَكَفَانَا وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ فَقُلْنَا لِجَابِرٍ كَمْ كُنْتُمْ؟ قَالَ كُنَّا أَلْفًا وَخَمْسَ مِائَةٍ وَلَوْ كُنَّا مِائَةَ أَلْفٍ لَكَفَانَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī And Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah Waḥuṣayn Samiʿā Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ وَحُصَيْنٍ سَمِعَا سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 28

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مِنْ تَفْجِيرِ الْمَاءِ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the given heading is: "How Allah honored the ...

hadiths.englishRaw: The companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ complained to him about their thirst. So he called for a 'uss' (a container made from skin or leather) and water was poured into it. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ then placed his hand in it and said, "I saw water gushing out between the fingers of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the people drank from it until all of them had their fill."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ complained to him about their thirst. So he called for a 'uss' (a container made from skin or leather) and water was poured into it. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ then placed his hand in it and said, "I saw water gushing out between the fingers of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the people drank from it until all of them had their fill."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: شَكَا أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْعَطَشَ فَدَعَا بِعُسٍّ فَصُبَّ فِيهِ مَاءٌ وَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَهُ فِيهِ قَالَ «فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْمَاءِ يَنْبُعُ عُيُونًا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَالنَّاسُ يَسْتَقُونَ حَتَّى اسْتَقَى النَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Jaʿfar b. Sulaymān \u003e al-Jaʿd Abū ʿUthmān \u003e Anas b. Mālik \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا الْجَعْدُ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 29

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مِنْ تَفْجِيرِ الْمَاءِ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the given heading is: "How Allah honored the ...

hadiths.englishRaw: We, the companions of Muhammad (pbuh), used to recite the verses as a blessed act, while you recite them with fear. One day, while we were with the Messenger of Allah (pbuh), we did not have any water. So the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Find someone who has water." So water was brought and poured into a vessel. Then he placed his hand in it, and water started flowing from between his fingers. Then he said, "Blessed and purified water, as a blessing from Allah the Almighty." Then we drank from it. Abdullah said, "We used to hear the praising of food while it was being eaten."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We, the companions of Muhammad (pbuh), used to recite the verses as a blessed act, while you recite them with fear. One day, while we were with the Messenger of Allah (pbuh), we did not have any water. So the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "Find someone who has water." So water was brought and poured into a vessel. Then he placed his hand in it, and water started flowing from between his fingers. Then he said, "Blessed and purified water, as a blessing from Allah the Almighty." Then we drank from it. Abdullah said, "We used to hear the praising of food while it was being eaten."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَعُدُّ الْآيَاتِ بَرَكَةً وَأَنْتُمْ تَعُدُّونَهَا تَخْوِيفًا إِنَّا بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ليْسَ مَعَنَا مَاءٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اطْلُبُوا مَنْ مَعَهُ فَضْلُ مَاءٍ» فَأُتِيَ بِمَاءٍ فَصَبَّهُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ ثُمَّ وَضَعَ كَفَّهُ فِيهِ فَجَعَلَ الْمَاءُ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «حَيَّ عَلَى الطَّهُورِ الْمُبَارَكِ وَالْبَرَكَةِ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى» فَشَرِبْنَا قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ تَسْبِيحَ الطَّعَامِ وَهُوَ يُؤْكَلُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbdullāh Bikhasf
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بِخَسْفٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 30

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَكْرَمَ اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مِنْ تَفْجِيرِ الْمَاءِ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the given heading is: "How Allah honored the ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The earth shook during the time of Abdullah, and it was reported to him. He said, 'Indeed, we, the companions of Muhammad ﷺ , used to see the signs as blessings, while you see them as terrifying.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "The earth shook during the time of Abdullah, and it was reported to him. He said, 'Indeed, we, the companions of Muhammad ﷺ , used to see the signs as blessings, while you see them as terrifying.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ عَلَى عَهْدِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّا كُنَّا أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَرَى الْآيَاتِ بَرَكَاتٍ وَأَنْتُمْ تَرَوْنَهَا تَخْوِيفًا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Numayr \u003e Abū al-Jawwāb \u003e ʿAmmār b. Ruzayq \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿLqmh \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zulzilat al-Arḍ \u003e ʿAhd ʿAbdullāh Faʾukhbir Bidhalik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْجَوَّابِ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ رُزَيْقٍ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ علقمةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 31

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver sermons while leaning against a trunk, and when he built the pulpit, the trunk longed for him until he came and touched it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver sermons while leaning against a trunk, and when he built the pulpit, the trunk longed for him until he came and touched it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يَخْطُبُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ فَلَمَّا اتَّخَذَ الْمِنْبَرَ حَنَّ الْجِذْعُ حَتَّى أَتَاهُ فَمَسَحَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Muʿādh b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 32

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to stand up and extend his standing when he would give a sermon. It was difficult for him to stand for long periods, so a tree trunk was brought for him and a hole was dug for it, and a stand was set up beside it for the Prophet ﷺ to lean on. So, when the Prophet ﷺ would give a sermon, he would lean on it and rest. Once, a man who had just arrived in Medina saw him standing next to that tree trunk, and he said to the people with him, "If I knew that Muhammad praises me for something that I do, I would make him a seat to sit on, and if he wants to, he can sit, and if he wants to, he can stand." When the Prophet ﷺ heard about this, he said, "Bring him to me." They brought the man to him, and he was told to make these three or four platforms, which are now in the pulpit of the mosque in Medina. The Prophet ﷺ found comfort in them. When the Prophet ﷺ left the trunk and turned towards the platforms that were made for him, the trunk moaned and groaned like a camel when it is separated from its young.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to stand up and extend his standing when he would give a sermon. It was difficult for him to stand for long periods, so a tree trunk was brought for him and a hole was dug for it, and a stand was set up beside it for the Prophet ﷺ to lean on. So, when the Prophet ﷺ would give a sermon, he would lean on it and rest. Once, a man who had just arrived in Medina saw him standing next to that tree trunk, and he said to the people with him, "If I knew that Muhammad praises me for something that I do, I would make him a seat to sit on, and if he wants to, he can sit, and if he wants to, he can stand." When the Prophet ﷺ heard about this, he said, "Bring him to me." They brought the man to him, and he was told to make these three or four platforms, which are now in the pulpit of the mosque in Medina. The Prophet ﷺ found comfort in them. When the Prophet ﷺ left the trunk and turned towards the platforms that were made for him, the trunk moaned and groaned like a camel when it is separated from its young.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا خَطَبَ قَامَ فَأَطَالَ الْقِيَامَ فَكَانَ يَشُقُّ عَلَيْهِ قِيَامُهُ فَأُتِيَ بِجِذْعِ نَخْلَةٍ فَحُفِرَ لَهُ وَأُقِيمَ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ قَائِمًا لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا خَطَبَ فَطَالَ الْقِيَامُ عَلَيْهِ اسْتَنَدَ إِلَيْهِ فَاتَّكَأَ عَلَيْهِ فَبَصُرَ بِهِ رَجُلٌ كَانَ وَرَدَ الْمَدِينَةَ فَرَآهُ قَائِمًا إِلَى جَنْبِ ذَلِكَ الْجِذْعِ فَقَالَ لِمَنْ يَلِيهِ مِنَ النَّاسِ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا يَحْمَدُنِي فِي شَيْءٍ يَرْفُقُ بِهِ لَصَنَعْتُ لَهُ مَجْلِسًا يَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنْ شَاءَ جَلَسَ مَا شَاءَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ قَامَ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «ائْتُونِي بِهِ» فَأَتَوْهُ بِهِ فَأُمِرَهُ أَنْ يَصْنَعَ لَهُ هَذِهِ الْمَرَاقِيَ الثَّلَاثَ أَوِ الْأَرْبَعَ هِيَ الْآنَ فِي مِنْبَرِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَوَجَدَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي ذَلِكَ رَاحَةً فَلَمَّا فَارَقَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ الْجِذْعَ وَعَمَدَ إِلَى هَذِهِ الَّتِي صُنِعَتْ لَهُ جَزِعَ الْجِذْعُ فَحَنَّ كَمَا تَحِنُّ النَّاقَةُ حِينَ فَارَقَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Tamīm b. ʿAbd al-Muʾmin \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Ḥayyān \u003e Ibn Buraydah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا تَمِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُؤْمِنِ حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 33

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) used to stand near a tree trunk before the pulpit was set up. When the pulpit was finally installed, he missed that tree trunk. We could hear his longing for it. The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) then placed his hand on it, and he became calm."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) used to stand near a tree trunk before the pulpit was set up. When the pulpit was finally installed, he missed that tree trunk. We could hear his longing for it. The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) then placed his hand on it, and he became calm."
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُومُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُجْعَلَ الْمِنْبَرُ فَلَمَّا جُعِلَ الْمِنْبَرُ حَنَّ ذَلِكَ الْجِذْعُ حَتَّى سَمِعْنَا حَنِينَهُ فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَسَكَنَ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Sulaymān b. Kathīr \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 34

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ used to deliver his sermons to a wooden platform, and when the pulpit was built, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat on it. Hanin al-Ashtar clung to it until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on her and she became calm."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ used to deliver his sermons to a wooden platform, and when the pulpit was built, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat on it. Hanin al-Ashtar clung to it until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on her and she became calm."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ إِلَى خَشَبَةٍ فَلَمَّا صُنِعَ الْمِنْبَرُ فَجَلَسَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَنَّتْ حَنِينَ الْعِشَارِ حَتَّى وَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَسَكَنَتْ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Sulaymān b. Kathīr \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Ḥafṣ b. ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 35

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: "The wooden crib misses the camel's calves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The wooden crib misses the camel's calves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «حَنَّتِ الْخَشَبَةُ حَنِينَ النَّاقَةِ الْخَلُوجِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Farwah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Zakariyyā from his father \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Karib \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي كَرِبٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 36

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray facing the trunk of a date- palm tree when the mosque was still a hut, and he used to deliver the sermon leaning on that trunk. A man from among his Companions said: ‘Would you like us to make you something upon which you can stand on Fridays so that the people will be able to see you and hear your sermon?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ So he made three steps for him, as a pulpit. When they put the pulpit in place, they put it in the place where it stands now. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wanted to stand on the pulpit, he passed by the tree trunk from which he used to deliver the sermon, and when he went beyond the trunk, it moaned and split and cracked. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came down when he heard the voice of the trunk, and rubbed it with his hand until it fell silent. Then he went back to the pulpit and when he prayed, he prayed facing it. When the mosque was knocked down (for renovation) and (the pillars, etc.) were changed, Ubayy bin Ka’b took that trunk and kept it in his house until it became very old and the termites consumed it and it became grains of dust.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray facing the trunk of a date- palm tree when the mosque was still a hut, and he used to deliver the sermon leaning on that trunk. A man from among his Companions said: ‘Would you like us to make you something upon which you can stand on Fridays so that the people will be able to see you and hear your sermon?’ He said: ‘Yes.’ So he made three steps for him, as a pulpit. When they put the pulpit in place, they put it in the place where it stands now. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wanted to stand on the pulpit, he passed by the tree trunk from which he used to deliver the sermon, and when he went beyond the trunk, it moaned and split and cracked. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came down when he heard the voice of the trunk, and rubbed it with his hand until it fell silent. Then he went back to the pulpit and when he prayed, he prayed facing it. When the mosque was knocked down (for renovation) and (the pillars, etc.) were changed, Ubayy bin Ka’b took that trunk and kept it in his house until it became very old and the termites consumed it and it became grains of dust.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي إِلَى جِذْعٍ وَيَخْطُبُ إِلَيْهِ إِذْ كَانَ الْمَسْجِدُ عَرِيشًا فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ أَلَا نَجْعَلُ لَكَ عَرِيشًا تَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ يَرَاكَ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَتُسْمِعُ مِنْ خُطْبَتِكَ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَصُنِعَ لَهُ الثَّلَاثُ دَرَجَاتٍ هُنَّ اللَّوَاتِي عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَلَمَّا صُنِعَ الْمِنْبَرُ وَوُضِعَ فِي مَوْضِعِهِ الَّذِي وَضَعَهُ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «فَلَمَّا جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُرِيدُ الْمِنْبَرَ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُ خَارَ الْجِذْعُ حَتَّى تَصَدَّعَ وَانْشَقَّ فَرَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَمَسَحَهُ بِيَدِهِ حَتَّى سَكَنَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى الْمِنْبَرِ» قَالَ فَكَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى صَلَّى إِلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا هُدِمَ الْمَسْجِدُ أَخَذَ ذَلِكَ الْجِذْعَ أُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ عِنْدَهُ حَتَّى بَلِيَ فأكلتْهُ الْأَرَضَةُ وَعَادَ رُفَاتًا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. ʿAqīl \u003e al-Ṭufayl b. Ubay b. Kaʿb from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ عَنِ الطُّفَيْلِ بْنِ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 37

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to give sermons on a wooden pulpit. Then a Roman man came to him and said, "I will make a pulpit for you to deliver sermons on." So he made a pulpit for him. When the Prophet ﷺ stood on it to deliver a sermon, the pulpit lamented like a mother camel missing her child. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came down from the pulpit and hugged it, and it then became quiet. He ordered that it be dug up and buried.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to give sermons on a wooden pulpit. Then a Roman man came to him and said, "I will make a pulpit for you to deliver sermons on." So he made a pulpit for him. When the Prophet ﷺ stood on it to deliver a sermon, the pulpit lamented like a mother camel missing her child. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came down from the pulpit and hugged it, and it then became quiet. He ordered that it be dug up and buried.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ إِلَى لِزْقِ جِذْعٍ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ رُومِيٌّ فَقَالَ أَصْنَعُ لَكَ مِنْبَرًا تَخْطُبُ عَلَيْهِ فَصَنَعَ لَهُ مِنْبَرًا هَذَا الَّذِي تَرَوْنَ قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَامَ عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ حَنَّ الْجِذْعُ حَنِينَ النَّاقَةِ إِلَى وَلَدِهَا فَنَزَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَضَمَّهُ إِلَيْهِ فَسَكَنَ فَأُمِرَ بِهِ أَنْ يُحْفَرَ لَهُ وَيُدْفَنَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Mujālid \u003e Abū al-Waddāk \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 38

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina, he leaned his back against a wooden board and started talking to the people. They gathered around him, so the Prophet ﷺ wanted them to hear him well. He said, "Build something for me to stand on." They asked, "O Prophet of Allah, how should we build it?" He said, "Build it like the Arish of Musa (Moses), so they built it for him." Al-Hasan said, "By Allah, the wooden board became honored." Al-Hasan said, "Glory be to Allah, is the seeking of the hearts of the people through hearing?" Abu Muhammad (Imam Malik) means this.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina, he leaned his back against a wooden board and started talking to the people. They gathered around him, so the Prophet ﷺ wanted them to hear him well. He said, "Build something for me to stand on." They asked, "O Prophet of Allah, how should we build it?" He said, "Build it like the Arish of Musa (Moses), so they built it for him." Al-Hasan said, "By Allah, the wooden board became honored." Al-Hasan said, "Glory be to Allah, is the seeking of the hearts of the people through hearing?" Abu Muhammad (Imam Malik) means this.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ جَعَلَ يُسْنِدُ ظَهْرَهُ إِلَى خَشَبَةٍ وَيُحَدِّثُ النَّاسَ فَكَثُرُوا حَوْلَهُ فَأَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ يُسْمِعَهُمْ فَقَالَ «ابْنُوا لِي شَيْئًا أَرْتَفِعُ عَلَيْهِ» قَالُوا كَيْفَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «عَرِيشٌ كَعَرِيشِ مُوسَى فَلَمَّا أَنْ بَنَوْا لَهُ» قَالَ الْحَسَنُ حَنَّتْ وَاللَّهِ الْخَشَبَةُ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ هَلْ تُبْتَغَى قُلُوبُ قَوْمٍ سَمِعُوا؟ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي هَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Ṣaʿq \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Lammā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا الصَّعْقُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ لَمَّا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 39

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: “If I had not embraced it, it would have continued to grieve until the Day of Resurrection.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “If I had not embraced it, it would have continued to grieve until the Day of Resurrection.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَخْطُبُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ الْمِنْبَرَ فَلَمَّا اتَّخَذَ الْمِنْبَرَ وَتَحَوَّلَ إِلَيْهِ حَنَّ الْجِذْعُ فَاحْتَضَنَهُ فَسَكَنَ وَقَالَ «لَوْ لَمْ أَحْتَضِنْهُ لَحَنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAmmār b. Abū ʿAmmār \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 40

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَنَسٍ بِمِثْلِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 41

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: "The wooden stick that was standing by it softened, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to it, placed his hand on it, and it became calm."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The wooden stick that was standing by it softened, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to it, placed his hand on it, and it became calm."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «حَنَّتِ الْخَشَبَةُ الَّتِي كَانَ يَقُومُ عِنْدَهَا فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَيْهَا وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَسَكَنَتْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 42

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ حَنِينِ الْمِنْبَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ honored more than the pulpit of Hunayn

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Prophet ﷺ used to stand on Fridays, leaning his back against the trunk of a palm tree in the mosque, and he would address the people. Once, a Roman came and said, "Shall I not make something for you to sit on, so it would appear as if you are standing?" So, he made a minbar (pulpit) with two steps, and the Prophet ﷺ sat on the third step. When the Prophet ﷺ sat on that pulpit, the palm tree trunk moaned like a grieving camel, to the extent that the mosque seemed to shake in sorrow ˹longing˺ for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ descended from the pulpit and embraced the trunk, which continued to moan. The Prophet ﷺ consoled it until it became still. Then he said, "By the One in Whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, if I had not embraced it, it would have continued moaning like this until the Day of Resurrection, out of longing for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." Then he ordered that it be removed, and it was buried.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ used to stand on Fridays, leaning his back against the trunk of a palm tree in the mosque, and he would address the people. Once, a Roman came and said, "Shall I not make something for you to sit on, so it would appear as if you are standing?" So, he made a minbar (pulpit) with two steps, and the Prophet ﷺ sat on the third step. When the Prophet ﷺ sat on that pulpit, the palm tree trunk moaned like a grieving camel, to the extent that the mosque seemed to shake in sorrow ˹longing˺ for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ descended from the pulpit and embraced the trunk, which continued to moan. The Prophet ﷺ consoled it until it became still. Then he said, "By the One in Whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, if I had not embraced it, it would have continued moaning like this until the Day of Resurrection, out of longing for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." Then he ordered that it be removed, and it was buried.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُومُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَيُسْنِدُ ظَهْرَهُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَيَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ فَجَاءَهُ رُومِيٌّ فَقَالَ: أَلَا أَصْنَعُ لَكَ شَيْئًا تَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهِ وَكَأَنَّكَ قَائِمٌ؟ فَصَنَعَ لَهُ مِنْبَرًا لَهُ دَرَجَتَانِ وَيَقْعُدُ عَلَى الثَّالِثَةِ۔ فَلَمَّا قَعَدَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهُ ﷺ عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْمِنْبَرِ خَارَ الْجِذْعُ كَخُوَارِ الثَّوْرِ حَتَّى ارْتَجَّ الْمَسْجِدُ حُزْنًا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ۔ فَنَزَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْمِنْبَرِ فَالْتَزَمَهُ وَهُوَ يَخُورُ۔ فَلَمَّا الْتَزَمَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَكَنَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَمَا وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوْ لَمْ أَلْتَزِمْهُ لَمَا زَالَ هَكَذَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ حُزْنًا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ» فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَدُفِنَ۔   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e ʿUmar b. Yūnus \u003e ʿIkrimah b. ʿAmmār \u003e Isḥāq b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 43

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي بَرَكَةِ طَعَامِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ was honored with in the blessing of his food

hadiths.englishRaw: "On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , I heard him say concerning you: Jabir reported that we were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during the Battle of the Trench and we were digging it. We stayed for three days without eating any food or being able to do so. A dish appeared in the Trench, so I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, a dish has appeared in the Trench.' He got up with his stomach swollen and tied up with a stone, took the wood or skewer, and then called it three times. It became full of cooked meat as a result. When I saw this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, allow me.' He granted me permission, so I came to my wife and said, 'May your mother lose you! The Messenger of Allah ﷺ with his companions has come to you.' She said, 'Did the Prophet ﷺ ask you how much food you have?' I said, 'Yes.' She said, 'Allah and His Messenger know best. You informed him about what we had.' Some of what I had became less, and I said, 'You have told the truth.' The Prophet ﷺ came, so I entered, stayed for a while, and then sought permission for the second time. He granted me permission, so I came and found that the dough had risen. I commanded her to bake bread while I placed the pot on the bed. Abu 'Abdur-Rahman said: 'It was called al-Athaafiyyah, but this is what he said.' Then I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, 'We have some dough, so if you see fit, you and one or two men with you may join us.' He said, 'How much is it?' I said, 'A saa' (a measure of volume) of barley and a lamb.' He said, 'Go back to your family and tell her not to remove the pot from the oven or take the bread out of the oven until I come.' Then he said to the people, 'Go to the house of Jabir.' I felt shy in a way that only Allah knew, so I said to my wife, 'May your mother lose you! The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has come with all his companions.' She said, 'Did the Prophet ﷺ ask you how much food you have?' I said, 'Yes.' She said, 'Allah and His Messenger know best. You informed him about what we had.' I said, 'You have told the truth.' The Prophet ﷺ came and then referred to the oven and the pot, making supplications for them. We started taking bread from the oven and meat from the pot and distributing it to the people. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Let seven or eight men sit around the plates.' When they finished eating, we uncovered the oven and the pot, and they were still full of food. We used to continue doing this every time we opened the oven and uncovered the pot, and we found them still full. All the Muslims were satiated, and there remained a portion of food. The Prophet ﷺ said to us, 'The people have been afflicted by famine. Eat and feed others.' We did not spend a day without eating and feeding (others). Ayman said: 'I do not know which of the two (number of people) he mentioned.'"   – Weak Chain

We stayed for three days without eating any food or being able to do so. A dish appeared in the Trench, so I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, a dish has appeared in the Trench.' He got up with his stomach swollen and tied up with a stone, took the wood or skewer, and then called it three times. It became full of cooked meat as a result. When I saw this from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, allow me.' He granted me permission, so I came to my wife and said, 'May your mother lose you! The Messenger of Allah ﷺ with his companions has come to you.' She said, 'Did the Prophet ﷺ ask you how much food you have?' I said, 'Yes.' She said, 'Allah and His Messenger know best. You informed him about what we had.' Some of what I had became less, and I said, 'You have told the truth.' The Prophet ﷺ came, so I entered, stayed for a while, and then sought permission for the second time. He granted me permission, so I came and found that the dough had risen. I commanded her to bake bread while I placed the pot on the bed. Abu 'Abdur-Rahman said: 'It was called al-Athaafiyyah, but this is what he said.' Then I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, 'We have some dough, so if you see fit, you and one or two men with you may join us.' He said, 'How much is it?' I said, 'A saa' (a measure of volume) of barley and a lamb.' He said, 'Go back to your family and tell her not to remove the pot from the oven or take the bread out of the oven until I come.' Then he said to the people, 'Go to the house of Jabir.' I felt shy in a way that only Allah knew, so I said to my wife, 'May your mother lose you! The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has come with all his companions.' She said, 'Did the Prophet ﷺ ask you how much food you have?' I said, 'Yes.' She said, 'Allah and His Messenger know best. You informed him about what we had.' I said, 'You have told the truth.' The Prophet ﷺ came and then referred to the oven and the pot, making supplications for them. We started taking bread from the oven and meat from the pot and distributing it to the people. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Let seven or eight men sit around the plates.' When they finished eating, we uncovered the oven and the pot, and they were still full of food. We used to continue doing this every time we opened the oven and uncovered the pot, and we found them still full. All the Muslims were satiated, and there remained a portion of food. The Prophet ﷺ said to us, 'The people have been afflicted by famine. Eat and feed others.' We did not spend a day without eating and feeding (others). Ayman said: 'I do not know which of the two (number of people) he mentioned.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْهُ أَرْوِيهِ عَنْكَ فَقَالَ جَابِرٌ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ نَحْفُرُهُ فَلَبِثْنَا ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ لَا نَطْعَمُ طَعَامًا وَلَا نَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَضَتْ فِي الْخَنْدَقِ كُدْيَةٌ فَجِئْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذِهِ كُدْيَةٌ قَدْ عَرَضَتْ فِي الْخَنْدَقِ فَرَشَشْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَبَطْنُهُ مَعْصُوبٌ بِحَجَرٍ فَأَخَذَ الْمِعْوَلَ أَوِ الْمِسْحَاةَ ثُمَّ سَمَّى ثَلَاثًا ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ فَعَادَتْ كَثِيبًا أَهْيَلَ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ائْذَنْ لِي قَالَ فَأَذِنَ لِي فَجِئْتُ امْرَأَتِي فَقُلْتُ ثَكِلَتْكِ أُمُّكِ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَيْئًا لَا صَبْرَ لِي عَلَيْهِ فَهَلْ عِنْدَكِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ؟ فَقَالَتْ عِنْدِي صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ وَعَنَاقٌ قَالَ فَطَحَنَّا الشَّعِيرَ وَذَبَحْنَا الْعَنَاقَ وَسَلَخْتُهَا وَجَعَلْتُهَا فِي الْبُرْمَةِ وَعَجَنْتُ الشَّعِيرَ قَالَ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَلَبِثْتُ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ الثَّانِيَةَ فَأَذِنَ لِي فَجِئْتُ فَإِذَا الْعَجِينُ قَدْ أَمْكَنَ فَأَمَرْتُهَا بِالْخَبْزِ وَجَعَلْتُ الْقِدْرَ عَلَى الْأَثَاثِيِّ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّمَا هِيَ الْأَثَافِيُّ وَلَكِنْ كَذَا قَالَ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ عِنْدَنَا طُعَيِّمًا لَنَا فَإِنْ رَأَيْتَ أَنْ تَقُومَ مَعِي أَنْتَ وَرَجُلٌ أَوْ رَجُلَانِ مَعَكَ فَقَالَ «وَكَمْ هُوَ؟» قُلْتُ صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ وَعَنَاقٌ فَقَالَ «ارْجِعْ إِلَى أَهْلِكَ وَقُلْ لَهَا لَا تَنْزِعِ الْقِدْرَ مِنَ الْأَثَافِيِّ وَلَا تُخْرِجِ الْخُبْزَ مِنَ التَّنُّورِ حَتَّى آتِيَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ «قُومُوا إِلَى بَيْتِ جَابِرٍ» قَالَ فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ حَيَاءً لَا يَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقُلْتُ لِامْرَأَتِي ثَكِلَتْكِ أُمُّكِ قَدْ جَاءَكِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِأَصْحَابِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ فَقَالَتْ أَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ سَأَلَكَ كَمِ الطَّعَامُ؟ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَتْ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ قَدْ أَخْبَرْتَهُ بِمَا كَانَ عِنْدَنَا قَالَ فَذَهَبَ عَنِّي بَعْضُ مَا كُنْتُ أَجِدُ وَقُلْتُ لَقَدْ صَدَقْتِ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَدَخَلَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ «لَا تَضَاغَطُوا» ثُمَّ بَرَّكَ عَلَى التَّنُّورِ وَعَلَى الْبُرْمَةِ قَالَ فَجَعَلْنَا نَأْخُذُ مِنَ التَّنُّورِ الْخُبْزَ وَنَأْخُذُ اللَّحْمَ مِنَ الْبُرْمَةِ فَنُثَرِّدُ وَنَغْرِفُ لَهُمْ وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لِيَجْلِسْ عَلَى الصَّحْفَةِ سَبْعَةٌ أَوْ ثَمَانِيَةٌ» فَإِذَا أَكَلُوا كَشَفْنَا عَنِ التَّنُّورِ وَكَشَفْنَا عَنِ الْبُرْمَةِ فَإِذَا هُمَا أَمْلَأُ ممَا كَانَا فَلَمْ نَزَلْ نَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّمَا فَتَحْنَا التَّنُّورَ وَكَشَفْنَا عَنِ الْبُرْمَةِ وَجَدْنَاهُمَا أَمْلَأَ مَا كَانَا حَتَّى شَبِعَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ كُلُّهُمْ وَبَقِيَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ أَصَابَتْهُمْ مَخْمَصَةٌ فَكُلُوا وَأَطْعِمُوا» فَلَمْ نَزَلْ يَوْمَنَا نَأْكُلُ وَنُطْعِمُ قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا ثَمَانِمِائَةٍ أَوْ قَالَ ثَلَاثَمِائَةٍ قَالَ أَيْمَنُ لَا أَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar b. Abān \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Muḥammad al-Muḥāribī \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ayman al-Makkī from his father \u003e Lijābir b. ʿAbdullāh Ḥaddithnī Biḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ أَيْمَنَ الْمَكِّيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِجَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدِّثْنِي بِحَدِيثٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 44

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي بَرَكَةِ طَعَامِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ was honored with in the blessing of his food

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Talha commanded Umm Sulaim to prepare food for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he could eat. Then Abu Talha sent me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so I went to him and said, "Abu Talha has sent me to you." He ordered the people to stand up, so they stood up and Abu Talha said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have made this food specifically for you." He replied, "No, go ahead." So I left and the people left with me. Abu Talha said, "Bring the food." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on it and invoked Allah's blessings upon it, then he said, "Give permission to ten people." He gave them permission and said, "Eat in the name of Allah." They ate until they were full and then they got up. He placed his hand on it as he had done previously, invoked Allah's blessings upon it, and then said, "Give permission to ten people." He gave them permission and said, "Eat in the name of Allah." They ate until they were full and then they got up. He did this with eighty men. He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ate, and the people of his household ate, and they left some food."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Talha commanded Umm Sulaim to prepare food for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he could eat. Then Abu Talha sent me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so I went to him and said, "Abu Talha has sent me to you." He ordered the people to stand up, so they stood up and Abu Talha said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have made this food specifically for you." He replied, "No, go ahead." So I left and the people left with me. Abu Talha said, "Bring the food." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on it and invoked Allah's blessings upon it, then he said, "Give permission to ten people." He gave them permission and said, "Eat in the name of Allah." They ate until they were full and then they got up. He placed his hand on it as he had done previously, invoked Allah's blessings upon it, and then said, "Give permission to ten people." He gave them permission and said, "Eat in the name of Allah." They ate until they were full and then they got up. He did this with eighty men. He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ate, and the people of his household ate, and they left some food."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَمَرَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ طَعَامًا يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ قَالَ ثُمَّ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ بَعَثَنِي إِلَيْكَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَقَالَ لِلْقَوْمِ «قُومُوا» فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقَ الْقَوْمُ مَعَهُ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا صَنَعْتُ طَعَامًا لِنَفْسِكَ خَاصَّةً؟ فَقَالَ «لَا عَلَيْكَ انْطَلِقْ» قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقَ الْقَوْمُ قَالَ فَجِيءَ بِالطَّعَامِ فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَهُ وَسَمَّى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ» قَالَ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَقَالَ «كُلُوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ» فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ قَامُوا ثُمَّ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ كَمَا صَنَعَ فِي الْمَرَّةِ الْأُولَى وَسَمَّى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ» فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَقَالَ «كُلُوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ» فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ قَامُوا حَتَّى فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ بِثَمَانِينَ رَجُلًا قَالَ وَأَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ وَتَرَكُوا سُؤْرًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e Anas b. Mālik \u003e Amar Abū Ṭalḥah Um Sulaym
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 45

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي بَرَكَةِ طَعَامِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ was honored with in the blessing of his food

hadiths.englishRaw: "He cooked a pot of food for the Prophet ﷺ and the Prophet said to him, 'Serve me a forearm (portion) of it.' He was fond of the forearm, so he served him a forearm. Then he said, 'Serve me the forearm,' so he served him another forearm. Then he said, 'Serve me the forearm,' so I said, 'O Prophet of Allah, how many forearms does a sheep have?' He said, 'By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, if you had remained silent, I would have given you forearms as many as you asked for.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "He cooked a pot of food for the Prophet ﷺ and the Prophet said to him, 'Serve me a forearm (portion) of it.' He was fond of the forearm, so he served him a forearm. Then he said, 'Serve me the forearm,' so he served him another forearm. Then he said, 'Serve me the forearm,' so I said, 'O Prophet of Allah, how many forearms does a sheep have?' He said, 'By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, if you had remained silent, I would have given you forearms as many as you asked for.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ طَبَخَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ قِدْرًا فَقَالَ لَهُ «نَاوِلْنِي ذِرَاعَهَا» وَكَانَ يُعْجِبُهُ الذِّرَاعُ فَنَاوَلَهُ الذِّرَاعَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «نَاوِلْنِي الذِّرَاعَ» فَنَاوَلَهُ ذِرَاعًا ثُمَّ قَالَ «نَاوِلْنِي الذِّرَاعَ» فَقُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ وَكَمْ لِلشَّاةِ مِنْ ذِرَاعٍ؟ فَقَالَ «وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ أَنْ لَوْ سَكَتَّ لَأُعْطِيتُ أَذْرُعًا مَا دَعَوْتُ بِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abān \u003e al-ʿAṭṭār \u003e Qatādah \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e Abū ʿUbayd \u003e Ṭabakh Lilnnabī ﷺ Qidr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ هُوَ الْعَطَّارُ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 46

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُكْرِمَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي بَرَكَةِ طَعَامِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet ﷺ was honored with in the blessing of his food

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by Nubayh Al-Anzi, who narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out to confront the polytheists in battle. My father, Abdullah, said to me, 'O Jabir, it's best for you to stay with the people of Medina to keep an eye on the situation until we know how things turn out. By Allah, if it weren't for leaving behind my daughters, I would have preferred for them to be killed in front of me.'While I was with the people of Medina, my paternal aunt came to me with my father and my uncle to bury them in our graves. Suddenly, a man approached and announced, 'The Prophet (peace be upon him) commands you to return the corpses and bury them in their own beds where they were killed.' So we exhumed their bodies and buried them in their beds where they were killed.During the caliphate of Muawiya ibn Abi Sufyan, a man came to me and said, 'O Jabir ibn Abdullah, your father has stirred up some trouble regarding the dues owed to Muawiya.' Some of them set out to come to me, so I went to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, my father was wounded on such-and-such a day, and he left a debt from dates. Some of his creditors are pressing me, and I would like you to help me with it so that perhaps some of his dates might be paid from it.'He replied, 'Yes, I will come to you, if Allah wills, close to midday.' He came later with his companions and sat down in the shade. The Prophet (peace be upon him) greeted us and sought permission to enter. After entering, he said, 'I had told my wife earlier not to disturb me when I came to you, and not to hurt the feelings of anyone in your house.' So she had spread a bed for him and put a pillow on it, and he lay down and slept.I said to my servant, 'Slaughter some camels from the camels for me and prepare them quickly before the Prophet (peace be upon him) wakes up.' We did not finish preparing the food until the Prophet (peace be upon him) woke up. I thought that he would order us to slaughter the camels again and that we would be rebuked, but he didn't ask for that. Instead, he asked, 'Bring me some water for ablution.' I brought it to him, and he performed ablution.When he wanted to wash his face, I thought he would go to a nearby water-skin, but he washed his face in the basin I had brought. Then he wiped over his head and said, 'Bring me the food you prepared.' We brought the food, and he placed his hand in the food saying, 'In the name of Allah, eat.' They all ate till they were fully satisfied, and the meat was more than before.He said, 'By Allah, for whom I have my life, I was about to leave with my companions but I thought that I should not go until I have eaten from the meal of my brothers.' He said, 'O Jabir! Invite all the people who are present with you.' So I invited them, and they ate of the meal and thanked Allah.The Prophet (peace be upon him) remained sitting with his companions, and they moved closer to him, and they surrounded him, and he said, 'I am your predecessor at the Lake-Fount (Kauthar) and some men amongst you will be brought to me, and when I will try to hand them some water, they will be pulled away from me by force whereupon I will say, 'O Lord, my companions!' Then the Almighty will say, 'You do not know what they did after you left, they introduced new things into the religion after you.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by Nubayh Al-Anzi, who narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out to confront the polytheists in battle. My father, Abdullah, said to me, 'O Jabir, it's best for you to stay with the people of Medina to keep an eye on the situation until we know how things turn out. By Allah, if it weren't for leaving behind my daughters, I would have preferred for them to be killed in front of me.'While I was with the people of Medina, my paternal aunt came to me with my father and my uncle to bury them in our graves. Suddenly, a man approached and announced, 'The Prophet (peace be upon him) commands you to return the corpses and bury them in their own beds where they were killed.' So we exhumed their bodies and buried them in their beds where they were killed.During the caliphate of Muawiya ibn Abi Sufyan, a man came to me and said, 'O Jabir ibn Abdullah, your father has stirred up some trouble regarding the dues owed to Muawiya.' Some of them set out to come to me, so I went to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, my father was wounded on such-and-such a day, and he left a debt from dates. Some of his creditors are pressing me, and I would like you to help me with it so that perhaps some of his dates might be paid from it.'He replied, 'Yes, I will come to you, if Allah wills, close to midday.' He came later with his companions and sat down in the shade. The Prophet (peace be upon him) greeted us and sought permission to enter. After entering, he said, 'I had told my wife earlier not to disturb me when I came to you, and not to hurt the feelings of anyone in your house.' So she had spread a bed for him and put a pillow on it, and he lay down and slept.I said to my servant, 'Slaughter some camels from the camels for me and prepare them quickly before the Prophet (peace be upon him) wakes up.' We did not finish preparing the food until the Prophet (peace be upon him) woke up. I thought that he would order us to slaughter the camels again and that we would be rebuked, but he didn't ask for that. Instead, he asked, 'Bring me some water for ablution.' I brought it to him, and he performed ablution.When he wanted to wash his face, I thought he would go to a nearby water-skin, but he washed his face in the basin I had brought. Then he wiped over his head and said, 'Bring me the food you prepared.' We brought the food, and he placed his hand in the food saying, 'In the name of Allah, eat.' They all ate till they were fully satisfied, and the meat was more than before.He said, 'By Allah, for whom I have my life, I was about to leave with my companions but I thought that I should not go until I have eaten from the meal of my brothers.' He said, 'O Jabir! Invite all the people who are present with you.' So I invited them, and they ate of the meal and thanked Allah.The Prophet (peace be upon him) remained sitting with his companions, and they moved closer to him, and they surrounded him, and he said, 'I am your predecessor at the Lake-Fount (Kauthar) and some men amongst you will be brought to me, and when I will try to hand them some water, they will be pulled away from me by force whereupon I will say, 'O Lord, my companions!' Then the Almighty will say, 'You do not know what they did after you left, they introduced new things into the religion after you.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نُبَيْحٍ الْعَنَزِيِّ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ لِيُقَاتِلَهُمْ فَقَالَ أَبِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَا جَابِرُ لَا عَلَيْكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ فِي نَظَّارِي أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ حَتَّى تَعْلَمَ إِلَى مَا يَصِيرُ أَمْرُنَا فَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لَوْلَا أَنِّي أَتْرُكُ بَنَاتٍ لِي بَعْدِي لَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ تُقْتَلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ قَالَ فَبَيْنَمَا أَنَا فِي النَّظَّارِينَ إِذْ جَاءَتْ عَمَّتِي بِأَبِي وَخَالِي لِتَدْفِنَهُمَا فِي مَقَابِرِنَا فَلَحِقَ رَجُلٌ يُنَادِي إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَنْ تَرُدُّوا الْقَتْلَى فَتَدْفِنُوهَا فِي مَضَاجِعِهَا حَيْثُ قُتِلَتْ» فَرَدَدْنَاهُمَا فَدَفَنَّاهُمَا فِي مَضْجَعِهِمَا حَيْثُ قُتِلَا فَبَيْنَا أَنَا فِي خِلَافَةِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ ؓ إِذْ جَاءَنِي رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا جَابِرُ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَثَارَ أَبَاكَ عُمَّالُ مُعَاوِيَةَ فَبَدَا فَخَرَجَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ عَلَى النَّحْوِ الَّذِي دَفَنْتُهُ لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ إِلَّا مَا لَمْ يَدَعِ الْقَتِيلَ قَالَ فَوَارَيْتُهُ وَتَرَكَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا مِنِ التَّمْرِ فَاشْتَدَّ عَلَيَّ بَعْضُ غُرَمَائِهِ فِي التَّقَاضِي فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبِي أُصِيبَ يَوْمَ كَذَا وَكَذَا وَإِنَّهُ تَرَكَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا مِنَ التَّمْرِ وَإِنَّهُ قَدِ اشْتَدَّ عَلَيَّ بَعْضُ غُرَمَائِهِ فِي الطَّلَبِ فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ تُعِينَنِي عَلَيْهِ لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يُنْظِرَنِي طَائِفَةً مِنْ تَمْرِهِ إِلَى هَذَا الصِّرَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ آتِيكَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ قَرِيبًا مِنْ وَسَطِ النَّهَارِ» قَالَ فَجَاءَ وَمَعَهُ حَوَارِيُّوهُ قَالَ فَجَلَسُوا فِي الظِّلِّ وَسَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَاسْتَأْذَنَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا قَالَ وَقَدْ قُلْتُ لِامْرَأَتِي إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَاءَنِيَّ الْيَوْمَ وَسَطَ النَّهَارِ فَلَا يَرَيَنَّكِ وَلَا تُؤْذِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَيْتِي بشيْءٍ وَلَا تُكَلِّمِيهِ فَفَرَشَتْ فِرَاشًا وَوِسَادَةً فَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَامَ فَقُلْتُ لِمَوْلًى لِي اذْبَحْ هَذِهِ الْعَنَاقَ وَهِيَ دَاجِنٌ سَمِينَةٌ فَالْوَحَا وَالْعَجَلَ افْرُغْ مِنْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْتَيْقِظَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا مَعَكَ فَلَمْ نَزَلْ فِيهَا حَتَّى فَرَغْنَا مِنْهَا وَهُوَ نَائِمٌ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ حِينَ يَسْتَيْقِظُ يَدْعُو بِطَهُورِهِ وَأَنَا أَخَافُ إِذَا فَرَغَ أَنْ يَقُومَ فَلَا يَفْرُغُ مِنْ طُهُورِهِ حَتَّى يُوضَعَ الْعَنَاقُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَالَ «يَا جَابِرُ ائْتِنِي بِطَهُورٍ» قَالَ نَعَمْ فَلَمْ يَفْرُغْ مِنْ وُضُوئِهِ حَتَّى وُضِعَتِ الْعَنَاقُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ قَالَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيَّ فَقَالَ «كَأَنَّكَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ حُبَّنَا اللَّحْمَ ادْعُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ» ثُمَّ دَعَا حَوَارِيِّيهِ قَالَ فَجِيءَ بِالطَّعَامِ فَوُضِعَ قَالَ فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ وَقَالَ «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ كُلُوا» فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا وَفَضَلَ مِنْهَا لَحْمٌ كَثِيرٌ وَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ مَجْلِسَ بَنِي سَلَمَةَ لَيَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ هُوَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَعْيُنِهِمْ مَا يَقْرَبُونَهُ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يُؤْذُوهُ ثُمَّ قَامَ وَقَامَ أَصْحَابُهُ فَخَرَجُوا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ «خَلُّوا ظَهْرِي لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ» قَالَ فَاتَّبَعْتُهُمْ حَتَّى بَلَغْتُ أسكفَّةَ الْبَابِ فَأَخْرَجَتِ امْرَأَتِي صَدْرَهَا وَكَانَتْ سَتِيرَةً فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلِّ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى زَوْجِي قَالَ «صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى زَوْجِكِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «ادْعُوا لِي فُلَانًا» لِلْغَرِيمِ الَّذِي اشْتَدَّ عَلَيَّ فِي الطَّلَبِ فَقَالَ «أَنْسِئْ جَابِرًا طَائِفَةً مِنْ دَيْنِكَ الَّذِي عَلَى أَبِيهِ إِلَى هَذَا الصِّرَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ» قَالَ مَا أَنَا بِفَاعِلٍ قَالَ وَاعْتَلَّ وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مَالُ يَتَامَى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَيْنَ جَابِرٌ؟» قَالَ قُلْتُ أَنَا ذَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «كِلْ لَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى سَوْفَ يُوَفِّيهِ» فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَإِذَا الشَّمْسُ قَدْ دَلَكَتْ قَالَ «الصَّلَاةُ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ» فَانْدَفَعُوا إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَقُلْتُ لِغَرِيمِي قَرِّبْ أَوْعِيَتَكَ فكِلْتُ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَجْوَةِ فَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ وَفَضَلَ لَنَا مِنَ التَّمْرِ كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ فَجِئْتُ أَسْعَى إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي مَسْجِدِهِ كَأَنِّي شَرَارَةٌ فَوَجَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَدْ صَلَّى فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ كِلْتُ لِغَرِيمِي تَمْرَهُ فَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ وَفَضَلَ لَنَا مِنَ التَّمْرِ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَيْنَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ؟» قَالَ فَجَاءَ يُهَرْوِلُ قَالَ «سَلْ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ غَرِيمِهِ وَتَمْرِهِ» قَالَ مَا أَنَا بِسَائِلِهِ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَوْفَ يُوَفِّيهِ إِذْ أَخْبَرْتَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَوْفَ يُوَفِّيهِ فَرَدَّدَ عَلَيْهِ وَرَدَّدَ عَلَيْهِ هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَةَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ مَا أَنَا بِسَائِلِهِ وَكَانَ لَا يُرَاجِعُ بَعْدَ الْمَرَّةِ الثَّالِثَةِ فَقَالَ مَا فَعَلَ غَرِيمُكَ وَتَمْرُكَ؟ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ وَفَضَلَ لَنَا مِنَ التَّمْرِ كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى امْرَأَتِي فَقُلْتُ أَلَمْ أَكُنْ نَهَيْتُكِ أَنْ تُكَلِّمِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَيْتِي؟ فَقَالَتْ تَظُنُّ أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يُورِدُ نَبِيَّهُ فِي بيْتي ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ وَلَا أَسْأَلُهُ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى زَوْجِي؟   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e al-Aswad \u003e Nubayḥ al-ʿAnazī \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 47

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُعْطِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنَ الْفَضْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was the Prophet ﷺ given in terms of grace?

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, Allah has preferred Muhammad ﷺ over the prophets, peace be upon them, and over the people of the heavens. They said, "O Ibn Abbas, in what way has Allah preferred him over the people of the heavens?" He said, "Indeed, Allah has said to the people of the heavens, 'And whoever says, "Indeed, I am a god other than Him," then that is the retribution for him, Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.'" [Surah Al-Anbiya, verse 29] And Allah, the Exalted, has said to Muhammad ﷺ , "Indeed, We have granted you a clear conquest that Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow." [Surah Al-Fath, verse 2] They said, "So what is his superiority over the prophets, peace be upon them?" He said, "Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has said, 'And We have not sent any messenger except in the language of his people to clarify for them.' [Surah Ibrahim, verse 4] And Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has said to Muhammad ﷺ , 'And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.'" [Surah Saba', verse 28] So, He sent him to the jinn and mankind.   – Sound Chain
