And those who are firmly grounded in knowledge say: 'We believe in it; the whole of it (clear and unclear Verses) are from our Lord.' And none receive admonition except men of understanding." (3:7) So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When you see those who follow what is not entirely clear thereof, beware of them.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited: 'It is He Who has sent down to you (Muhammad) the Book (this Qur'an). In it are Verses that are entirely clear, they are the foundations of the Book, and others not entirely clear. So, as for those in whose hearts there is a deviation (from the truth), they follow that which is not entirely clear thereof, seeking Al-Fitnah (polytheism and trials), and seeking for its hidden meanings, but none knows its hidden meanings save Allah. And those who are firmly grounded in knowledge say: 'We believe in it; the whole of it (clear and unclear Verses) are from our Lord.' And none receive admonition except men of understanding." (3:7) So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When you see those who follow what is not entirely clear thereof, beware of them.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: تَلَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ {هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُحْكَمَاتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ} [آل عمران 7] فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ الَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah And Yazīd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Mulaykah \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 148

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: "To make lawful for you something that Allah has made forbidden for you, or to make forbidden for you something that Allah has made lawful for you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To make lawful for you something that Allah has made forbidden for you, or to make forbidden for you something that Allah has made lawful for you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ أُحِلَّ لَكَ شَيْئًا حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ أَوْ أُحَرِّمَ مَا أَحَلَّهُ اللَّهُ لَكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Shaqīq \u003e Suʾil ʿAbdullāh \u003e Shayʾ \u003e Innī Laʾakrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ قَالَ سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَقَالَ «إِنِّي لَأَكْرَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 149

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: "To burden myself with what I do not know."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "To burden myself with what I do not know."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ أَتَكَلَّفَ لَهُ مَا لَا أَعْلَمُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Laʾan Aruddah Biʿiyyih Aḥab Ilay Min
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ «لَأَنْ أَرُدَّهُ بِعِيِّهِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 150

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: About some things from the Quran in the armies of the Muslims until he arrived in Egypt, and 'Amr ibn al-As sent it to 'Umar ibn al-Khattab. When the messenger came to him with the book and he read it, he said, "Where is the man?" He said, "He is on the journey." 'Umar said, "I fear that it might have been lost, and you will suffer a severe punishment from me because of it." So he brought it to him, and 'Umar said, "You are a liar." So 'Umar sent for a palm-stick and he beat him with it until he left his back bleeding, then he left him until he recovered. Then he called him to come back, and 'Umar said, "Will you ask for it again?" So 'Umar sent him to Rata'ib from Jarid, and he beat him with it until he left his back bleeding, then he left him until he recovered, then he beat him again until he left his back bleeding. Then 'Umar called him to come back, and he said, "Sabiqh, if you want to kill me, then kill me in an honorable manner. And if you want to treat me, then I swear by Allah that I have already recovered." So 'Umar permitted him to return to his land, and he wrote to Abu Musa al-Ash'ari that no one should sit with him from the Muslims. This intensified on the man, so Abu Musa wrote to 'Umar that his repentance was good. 'Umar wrote back, "Give permission for the people to sit with him."   – Weak Chain

hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ فِي أَجْنَادِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ حَتَّى قَدِمَ مِصْرَ فَبَعَثَ بِهِ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَلَمَّا أَتَاهُ الرَّسُولُ بِالْكِتَابِ فَقَرَأَهُ فَقَالَ أَيْنَ الرَّجُلُ؟ فَقَالَ فِي الرَّحْلِ قَالَ عُمَرُ «أَبْصِرْ أَنْ يكونَ ذَهَبَ فَتُصِيبَكَ مِنِّي بِهِ الْعُقُوبَةُ الْمُوجِعَةُ» فَأَتَاهُ بِهِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ «تَسْأَلُ مُحْدَثَةً» فأرْسلَ عُمَرُ إِلَى رَطَائِبَ مِنْ جَرِيدٍ فَضَرَبَهُ بِهَا حَتَّى تَرَكَ ظَهْرَهُ دَبِرَةً ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ حَتَّى بَرَأَ ثُمَّ عَادَ لَهُ ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ حَتَّى بَرَأَ فَدَعَا بِهِ لِيَعُودَ لَهُ قَالَ فقالَ صَبِيغٌ إِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ قَتْلِي فَاقْتُلْنِي قَتْلًا جَمِيلًا وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُدَاوِيَنِي فَقَدْ وَاللَّهِ بَرَأْتُ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ إِلَى أَرْضِهِ وَكَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ أَنْ لَا يُجَالِسَهُ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَاشْتَدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ فَكَتَبَ أَبُو مُوسَى إِلَى عُمَرَ أَنْ قَدْ حَسُنَتْ تَوْبَتُهُ فَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ أنِ ائْذَنْ لِلنَّاسِ بِمُجَالَسَتِهِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e Nāfiʿ a freed slave of ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ṣabīgh al-ʿIrāqī Jaʿal Yasʾal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ صَبِيغًا الْعِرَاقِيَّ جَعَلَ يَسْأَلُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 151

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: "Oh Abu Al-Mundhir, what do you say about this and that?" He said, "Oh my son, was it you who asked me about this?" He said, "No." He said, "Then postpone it until we find a solution and treat ourselves so we can inform you."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Oh Abu Al-Mundhir, what do you say about this and that?" He said, "Oh my son, was it you who asked me about this?" He said, "No." He said, "Then postpone it until we find a solution and treat ourselves so we can inform you."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا أَبَا الْمُنْذِرِ مَا تَقُولُ فِي كَذَا وَكَذَا؟ قَالَ «يَا بُنَيَّ أَكَانَ الَّذِي سَأَلْتَنِي عَنْهُ؟» قَالَ لَا قَالَ «أَمَّا لَا» «فَأَجِّلْنِي حَتَّى يَكُونَ فَنُعَالِجَ أَنْفُسَنَا حَتَّى نُخْبِرَكَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Āstaftá a man Ubay b. Kaʿb \u003e Yā Abū al-Mundhir Mā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَامِرًا يَقُولُ اسْتَفْتَى رَجُلٌ أُبَيَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 152

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do you really mean what you say, oh my uncle, like this and like that?" He said, "Oh son of my brother, was this the case?" He said, "No." He said, "Then forgive us until it becomes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do you really mean what you say, oh my uncle, like this and like that?" He said, "Oh son of my brother, was this the case?" He said, "No." He said, "Then forgive us until it becomes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فَتًى مَا تَقُولُ يَا عَمَّاهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا؟ قَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي أَكَانَ هَذَا؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ «فَأَعْفِنَا حَتَّى يَكُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Firās \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Masrūq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَنْ فِرَاسٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 153

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: "Regarding something for which only the answer to the question asked has been given."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Regarding something for which only the answer to the question asked has been given."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ شَيْءٍ لَمْ يُجِبْ فِيهِ إِلَّا جَوَابَ الَّذِي سُئِلَ عَنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e al-Aʿmash
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ قَالَ كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ «إِذَا سُئِلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 154

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: It means: "He used to not give a fatwa (religious ruling) regarding matters related to the private area in which there is disagreement."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It means: "He used to not give a fatwa (religious ruling) regarding matters related to the private area in which there is disagreement."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ «لَا يُفْتِي فِي الْفَرْجِ بِشَيْءٍ فِيهِ اخْتِلَافٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥusayn b. Manṣūr \u003e al-Ḥusayn b. al-Walīd \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ وُهَيْبٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 155

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "O people, do not hasten the affliction before its descent, causing you to suffer here and there. If you do not hasten the affliction before its descent, Muslims will continuously have someone among them who, when asked a question, answers correctly." And when he was asked to be successful, he was granted success.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "O people, do not hasten the affliction before its descent, causing you to suffer here and there. If you do not hasten the affliction before its descent, Muslims will continuously have someone among them who, when asked a question, answers correctly." And when he was asked to be successful, he was granted success.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ «لَا تَعْجَلُوا بِالْبَلَاءِ قَبْلَ نُزُولِهِ فَيُذْهَبُ بِكُمْ هَاهُنَا وَهَاهُنَا فَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ لَمْ تَعْجَلُوا بِالْبَلَاءِ قَبْلَ نُزُولِهِ لَمْ يَنْفَكَّ الْمُسْلِمُونَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيهِمْ مَنْ إِذَا سُئِلَ سُدِّدَ» وَإِذَا قَالَ وُفِّقَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e al-Ṣalt b. Rāshid \u003e Saʾalt Ṭāwus \u003e Masʾalah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الصَّلْتُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ طَاوُسًا عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ فَقَالَ لِي كَانَ هَذَا؟ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ آللَّهِ قُلْتُ آللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَنَا أَخْبَرُونَا عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 156

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: About the first of them, thirty poor people every day.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the first of them, thirty poor people every day.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْأَوَّلِ مِنْهُمَا ثَلَاثِينَ مِسْكِينًا لِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ مِسْكِينٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAmr b. Maymūn from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Saʾaltuh \u003e a man Adrakah Ramaḍānān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَدْرَكَهُ رَمَضَانَانِ فَقَالَ أَكَانَ أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ؟ قَالَ لَمْ يَكُنْ بَعْدُ قَالَ «اتْرُكْ بَلِيَّتَهُ حَتَّى تَنْزِلَ» قَالَ فَدَلَّسْنَا لَهُ رَجُلًا فَقَالَ قَدْ كَانَ فَقَالَ يُطْعِمُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 157

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: "I used to sit with Ibn Umar one day in Makkah and with Ibn Abbas another day. Whatever Ibn Umar would say in response to a question, I do not have knowledge of more than what he would give his verdict on."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I used to sit with Ibn Umar one day in Makkah and with Ibn Abbas another day. Whatever Ibn Umar would say in response to a question, I do not have knowledge of more than what he would give his verdict on."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ أَجْلِسُ بِمَكَّةَ إِلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ يَوْمًا وَإِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَوْمًا فَمَا يَقُولُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فِيمَا يُسْأَلُ لَا عِلْمَ لِي أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا يُفْتِي بِهِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿImrān \u003e Isḥāq b. Sulaymān \u003e al-ʿUmarī \u003e ʿUbayd b. Jurayj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا الْعُمَرِيُّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 158

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا وَكَرِهَ التَّنَطُّعَ وَالتَّبَدُّعَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who liked chivalry and disliked arrogance and ostentation

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah said, 'Learn, for surely none of you knows when knowledge will be sought from him.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah said, 'Learn, for surely none of you knows when knowledge will be sought from him.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «تَعَلَّمُوا فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَا يَدْرِي مَتَى يُخْتلَفُ إِلَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Wāʾil
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 159

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The bravest among you in battle is the bravest among you in facing the Fire."   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The bravest among you in battle is the bravest among you in facing the Fire."   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَجْرَؤُكُمْ عَلَى الْفُتْيَا أَجْرَؤُكُمْ عَلَى النَّارِ»   – ضعيف معضل
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Ayyūb \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Jaʿfar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 160

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever introduces a new opinion that is not in accordance with the Book of Allah and does not have the guidance of the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then he has not perceived what he is from when he meets Allah, the Almighty and Majestic."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever introduces a new opinion that is not in accordance with the Book of Allah and does not have the guidance of the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then he has not perceived what he is from when he meets Allah, the Almighty and Majestic."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَنْ أَحْدَثَ رَأْيًا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ تَمْضِ بِهِ سُنَّةٌ مَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَمْ يَدْرِ عَلَى مَا هُوَ مِنْهُ إِذَا لَقِيَ اللَّهَ ﷻ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAbdah b. Abū Lubābah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 161

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: From him, from the Prophet ﷺ : "Whoever is given a fatwa (religious ruling) by someone who is not firm (knowledgeable/qualified), then indeed his sin is upon the one who gave him the fatwa."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: From him, from the Prophet ﷺ : "Whoever is given a fatwa (religious ruling) by someone who is not firm (knowledgeable/qualified), then indeed his sin is upon the one who gave him the fatwa."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عنه عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «مَنْ أُفْتِيَ بِفُتْيَا مَنْ غَيْرِ ثَبْتٍ فَإِنَّمَا إِثْمُهُ عَلَى مِنْ أَفْتَاهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Ayyūb \u003e Bakr b. ʿAmr al-Maʿāfirī \u003e Abū ʿUthmān Muslim b. Yasār \u003e Abū Hurayrah Rḍy Allāh ʿNh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْمَعَافِرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ مُسْلِمِ بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رضي الله

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 162

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: "Her sin is upon him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Her sin is upon him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عنهَا فَإِثْمُهَا عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Sinān \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Rḍy Allāh ʿNh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سِنَانٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ؓ قَالَ «مَنْ أَفْتَى بِفُتْيَا يُعَمَّى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 163

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Bakr, when faced with an opponent, would look into the book of Allah. If he found in it something that would settle the matter between them, he would judge by it. And if it was not mentioned in the book, but he knew about it from the messenger of Allah ﷺ , he would judge by his knowledge. If it made him tired, he would come out and ask the Muslims, saying, "So and so has come to me with such and such matter. Did you know that the messenger of Allah ﷺ judged in it by a certain judgment?" Perhaps a group of people would gather to him, all of them mentioning a judgment from the messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding it. And Abu Bakr would say, "Praise be to Allah who has placed among us someone who preserves the teachings of our prophet ﷺ ." And if he found in it a sunnah from the messenger of Allah ﷺ , he would gather the heads of the people and their best ones, and consult them. When their opinions came together on a matter, he would judge by it.
hadiths.body: Abu Bakr, when faced with an opponent, would look into the book of Allah. If he found in it something that would settle the matter between them, he would judge by it. And if it was not mentioned in the book, but he knew about it from the messenger of Allah ﷺ , he would judge by his knowledge. If it made him tired, he would come out and ask the Muslims, saying, "So and so has come to me with such and such matter. Did you know that the messenger of Allah ﷺ judged in it by a certain judgment?" Perhaps a group of people would gather to him, all of them mentioning a judgment from the messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding it. And Abu Bakr would say, "Praise be to Allah who has placed among us someone who preserves the teachings of our prophet ﷺ ." And if he found in it a sunnah from the messenger of Allah ﷺ , he would gather the heads of the people and their best ones, and consult them. When their opinions came together on a matter, he would judge by it.
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ إِذَا وَرَدَ عَلَيْهِ الْخَصْمُ نَظَرَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ وَجَدَ فِيهِ مَا يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ قَضَى بِهِ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي الْكِتَابِ وَعَلِمَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي ذَلِكَ الْأَمْرِ سُنَّةً قَضَى بِهِ فَإِنْ أَعْيَاهُ خَرَجَ فَسَأَلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَقَالَ «أَتَانِي كَذَا وَكَذَا فَهَلْ عَلِمْتُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَضَى فِي ذَلِكَ بِقَضَاءٍ؟» فَرُبَّمَا اجْتَمَعَ إِلَيْهِ النَّفَرُ كُلُّهُمْ يَذْكُرُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِيهِ قَضَاءً فَيَقُولُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِينَا مَنْ يَحْفَظُ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا» ﷺ فَإِنْ أَعْيَاهُ أَنْ يَجِدَ فِيهِ سُنَّةً مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَمَعَ رُءُوسَ النَّاسِ وَخِيَارَهُمْ فَاسْتَشَارَهُمْ فَإِذَا اجْتَمَعَ رَأْيُهُمْ عَلَى أَمْرٍ قَضَى بِهِ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Jaʿfar b. Burqān \u003e Maymūn b. Mihrān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ حَدَّثَنَا مَيْمُونُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 164

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do you have any information about the Prophet ﷺ ? He said, 'No.' He asked, 'What about Abu Bakr?' He said, 'No.' He asked, 'What about Umar?' He said, 'No.' He asked, 'What about Uthman?' He said, 'No.' Umar said, 'I don't see her fasting, so I left and found Tawus and Ata' ibn Abi Rabah, and I asked them. Tawus said, 'She only fasts if she decides to do it herself.' Ata' also said, 'That is my opinion.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do you have any information about the Prophet ﷺ ? He said, 'No.' He asked, 'What about Abu Bakr?' He said, 'No.' He asked, 'What about Umar?' He said, 'No.' He asked, 'What about Uthman?' He said, 'No.' Umar said, 'I don't see her fasting, so I left and found Tawus and Ata' ibn Abi Rabah, and I asked them. Tawus said, 'She only fasts if she decides to do it herself.' Ata' also said, 'That is my opinion.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَعَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ فَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ؟ قَالَ لَا؟ قَالَ فَعَنْ عُمَرَ؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ فَعَنْ عُثْمَانَ؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ عُمَرُ مَا أَرَى عَلَيْهَا صِيَامًا فَخَرَجْتُ فَوَجَدْتُ طَاوُسًا وَعَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُمَا فَقَالَ طَاوُسٌ كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «لَا يَرَى عَلَيْهَا صِيَامًا إِلَّا أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهَا» قَالَ وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ ذَلِكَ رَأْيِي   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá And ʿAmrū b. Zurārah \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Abū Suhayl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى وَعَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي سُهَيْلٍ قَالَ كَانَ عَلَى امْرَأَتِي اعْتِكَافُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَسَأَلْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَعِنْدَهُ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ عَلَيْهَا صِيَامٌ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ لَا يَكُونُ اعْتِكَافٌ إِلَّا بِصِيَامٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 165

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: When Abu Salamah arrived in Basrah, both Hassan and I went to visit him. He said to Hassan, "Are you Hassan? No one in Basrah is dearer to me for a meeting than you. This is because I heard that you give fatwas based on your opinion, but do not give fatwas based on your opinion unless it is a Sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ or a revealed book."
hadiths.body: When Abu Salamah arrived in Basrah, both Hassan and I went to visit him. He said to Hassan, "Are you Hassan? No one in Basrah is dearer to me for a meeting than you. This is because I heard that you give fatwas based on your opinion, but do not give fatwas based on your opinion unless it is a Sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ or a revealed book."
hadiths.arabic: لَمَّا قَدِمَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْبَصْرَةَ أَتَيْتُهُ أَنَا وَالْحَسَنُ فَقَالَ لِلْحَسَنِ أَنْتَ الْحَسَنُ؟ «مَا كَانَ أَحَدٌ بِالْبَصْرَةِ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ لِقَاءً مِنْكَ وَذَلِكَ أَنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ تُفْتِي بِرَأْيِكَ فَلَا تُفْتِ بِرَأْيِكَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ سُنَّةٌ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَوْ كِتَابٌ مُنْزَلٌ»
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abū ʿAqīl \u003e Saʿīd al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū Naḍrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 166

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: He (said to him), "O Abu al-Sha'tha', indeed you are one of the knowledgeable people of Basra, so do not issue fatwas except with a clear Quranic verse or a established Sunnah, for if you do anything different from that, you will be ruined, and you will cause ruin."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: He (said to him), "O Abu al-Sha'tha', indeed you are one of the knowledgeable people of Basra, so do not issue fatwas except with a clear Quranic verse or a established Sunnah, for if you do anything different from that, you will be ruined, and you will cause ruin."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ «يَا أَبَا الشَّعْثَاءِ إِنَّكَ مِنْ فُقَهَاءِ الْبَصْرَةِ فَلَا تُفْتِ إِلَّا بِقُرْآنٍ نَاطِقٍ أَوْ سُنَّةٍ مَاضِيَةٍ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ فَعَلْتَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ هَلَكْتَ وَأَهْلَكْتَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿIṣmah b. al-Faḍl \u003e Zayd b. al-Ḥubāb \u003e Yazīd b. ʿUqbah \u003e al-Ḍaḥḥāk \u003e Jābir b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ لَقِيَهُ فِي الطَّوَافِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 167

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: "There was a time when we did not pass so many judgments, but now that time is over. Now Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has decreed that we reach a time when, as you see, (we are asked to pass many judgments). Whoever among you is asked to pass a judgment after this day, let him pass judgment according to what is in the Book of Allah. If he is faced with a matter that is not mentioned in the Book of Allah, let him pass judgment according to the way His Prophet [SAW] passed judgment. If he is faced with a matter that is not mentioned in the Book of Allah, and concerning which His Prophet did not pass judgment, then let him pass judgment according to the way the righteous passed judgment. And let him not say 'I am afraid, I am afraid.' For that which is lawful is clear and that which is unlawful is clear, and between them are matters which are not as clear. Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt."
hadiths.body: "There was a time when we did not pass so many judgments, but now that time is over. Now Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, has decreed that we reach a time when, as you see, (we are asked to pass many judgments). Whoever among you is asked to pass a judgment after this day, let him pass judgment according to what is in the Book of Allah. If he is faced with a matter that is not mentioned in the Book of Allah, let him pass judgment according to the way His Prophet [SAW] passed judgment. If he is faced with a matter that is not mentioned in the Book of Allah, and concerning which His Prophet did not pass judgment, then let him pass judgment according to the way the righteous passed judgment. And let him not say 'I am afraid, I am afraid.' For that which is lawful is clear and that which is unlawful is clear, and between them are matters which are not as clear. Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt."
hadiths.arabic: أَتَى عَلَيْنَا زَمَانٌ لَسْنَا نَقْضِي وَلَسْنَا هُنَالِكَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ قَدَّرَ مِنَ الْأَمْرِ أَنْ قَدْ بَلَغْنَا مَا تَرَوْنَ «فَمَنْ عَرَضَ لَهُ قَضَاءٌ بَعْدَ الْيَوْمِ فَلْيَقْضِ فِيهِ بِمَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ ﷻ فَإِنْ جَاءَهُ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَلْيَقْضِ بِمَا قَضَى بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَإِنْ جَاءَهُ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَقْضِ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلْيَقْضِ بِمَا قَضَى بِهِ الصَّالِحُونَ وَلَا يَقُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ وَإِنِّي أُرَى فَإِنَّ الْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌ وَبَيْنَ ذَلِكَ أُمُورٌ مُشْتَبِهَةٌ فَدَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿUmārah b. ʿUmayr \u003e Ḥurayth b. Ẓuhayr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd \u003e Atá ʿAlaynā Zamān Lasnā Naqḍī And Lasnā Hunālik Waʾin Allāh Qad Qaddar from al-Amr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حُرَيْثِ بْنِ ظُهَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 168

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding this matter, if it is mentioned in the Quran, then it is true. And if it is not mentioned in the Quran, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has mentioned it, then it is also true. And if it is not mentioned by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then it is conveyed from Abu Bakr and Umar. And if it is not mentioned by them, then it is his personal opinion.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding this matter, if it is mentioned in the Quran, then it is true. And if it is not mentioned in the Quran, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has mentioned it, then it is also true. And if it is not mentioned by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then it is conveyed from Abu Bakr and Umar. And if it is not mentioned by them, then it is his personal opinion.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْأَمْرِ فَكَانَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ أَخْبَرَ بِهِ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي الْقُرْآنِ وَكَانَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَخْبَرَ بِهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ قَالَ فِيهِ بِرَأْيِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «إِذَا سُئِلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 169

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding him (the Prophet), if something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah, then refer to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and follow it. If something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah and there is no Sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding it, then look at what the people have agreed upon and follow it. However, if something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah and there is no Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it, and no one before you has spoken about it, then choose whichever of the two options you wish: if you wish, you may exert your own effort and come to a conclusion, and proceed accordingly. If you wish, you may delay making a decision. And I do not see any delay in taking a decision except that it is better for you.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding him (the Prophet), if something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah, then refer to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and follow it. If something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah and there is no Sunnah from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding it, then look at what the people have agreed upon and follow it. However, if something comes to you that is not in the Book of Allah and there is no Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it, and no one before you has spoken about it, then choose whichever of the two options you wish: if you wish, you may exert your own effort and come to a conclusion, and proceed accordingly. If you wish, you may delay making a decision. And I do not see any delay in taking a decision except that it is better for you.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْهُ الرِّجَالُ فَإِنْ جَاءَكَ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَانْظُرْ سُنَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَاقْضِ بِهَا فَإِنْ جَاءَكَ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ سُنَّةٌ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَانْظُرْ مَا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ النَّاسُ فَخُذْ بِهِ فَإِنْ جَاءَكَ مَا لَيْسَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِي سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ قَبْلَكَ فَاخْتَرْ أَيَّ الْأَمْرَيْنِ شِئْتَ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تَجْتَهِدَ برأْيكَ ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ فَتَقَدَّمْ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تتأخَّرَ فَتَأَخَّرْ وَلَا أَرَى التَّأَخُّرَ إِلَّا خَيْرًا لَكَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Shurayḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ إِنْ جَاءَكَ شَيْءٌ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَاقْضِ بِهِ وَلَا تَلْفِتْكَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 170

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: From some people of the people of Hims, from the companions of Mu'adh, from Mu'adh, the Prophet ﷺ, when he sent him to Yemen, asked: "What would you do if you were faced with a legal matter?" He said, "I would judge according to the Book of Allah." The Prophet ﷺ said, "And if it is not in the Book of Allah?" He said, "Then I would judge according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah." The Prophet ﷺ said, "And if it is not in the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah?" He said, "I would strive to come to a conclusion based on my own reasoning." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Then you have done your best and Allah will reward the Messenger of the Messenger of Allah for what pleases the Messenger of Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From some people of the people of Hims, from the companions of Mu'adh, from Mu'adh, the Prophet ﷺ, when he sent him to Yemen, asked: "What would you do if you were faced with a legal matter?" He said, "I would judge according to the Book of Allah." The Prophet ﷺ said, "And if it is not in the Book of Allah?" He said, "Then I would judge according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah." The Prophet ﷺ said, "And if it is not in the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah?" He said, "I would strive to come to a conclusion based on my own reasoning." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Then you have done your best and Allah will reward the Messenger of the Messenger of Allah for what pleases the Messenger of Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نَاسٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ حِمْصٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ مُعَاذٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ لَمَّا بَعَثَهُ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ عَرَضَ لَكَ قَضَاءٌ كَيْفَ تَقْضِي؟ قَالَ أَقْضِي بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ قَالَ «فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ؟» قَالَ فَبِسُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ أَجْتَهِدُ رَأْيِي وَلَا آلُو قَالَ فَضَرَبَ صَدْرَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي وَفَّقَ رَسُولَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لِمَا يُرْضِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الثَّقَفِيِّ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَمْرِو ابْنِ أَخِي الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 171

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: A time has come upon us, and we are not asked, nor are we there. Indeed, Allah has ordained that I have conveyed what you see. So, if you are asked about something, refer to the Book of Allah. If you do not find it in the Book of Allah, then refer to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah. If you do not find it in the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah, then base your judgment on what the Muslims have unanimously agreed upon. If it is not found in what the Muslims have agreed upon, then exert your effort and do not say, "I am afraid and I fear." Indeed, that which is halal (permissible) is clear, and that which is haram (forbidden) is clear. Between the two are doubtful matters. Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt.
hadiths.body: A time has come upon us, and we are not asked, nor are we there. Indeed, Allah has ordained that I have conveyed what you see. So, if you are asked about something, refer to the Book of Allah. If you do not find it in the Book of Allah, then refer to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah. If you do not find it in the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah, then base your judgment on what the Muslims have unanimously agreed upon. If it is not found in what the Muslims have agreed upon, then exert your effort and do not say, "I am afraid and I fear." Indeed, that which is halal (permissible) is clear, and that which is haram (forbidden) is clear. Between the two are doubtful matters. Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt.
hadiths.arabic: قَدْ أَتَى عَلَيْنَا زَمَانٌ وَمَا نُسْأَلُ وَمَا نَحْنُ هُنَاكَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهِ قَدَّرَ أَنْ بَلَغْتُ مَا تَرَوْنَ فَإِذَا سُئِلْتُمْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَانْظُرُوا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوهُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ ﷻ فَفِي سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوهُ فِي سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ فَمَا أَجْمَعَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيمَا أَجْمَعَ عَلَيْهِ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فَاجْتَهِدْ رَأْيَكَ وَلَا تَقُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ وَأَخْشَى فَإِنَّ الْحَلَالَ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامَ بَيِّنٌ وَبَيْنَ ذَلِكَ أُمُورٌ مُشْتَبِهَةٌ فَدَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لَا يَرِيبُكَ
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e ʿUmārah b. ʿUmayr \u003e Ḥurayth b. Ẓuhayr \u003e Aḥsab \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Qad Atá ʿAlaynā Zamān And Mā Nusʾal Wamā Naḥn Hunāk Waʾin Allāh Qaddar \u003e Balaght Mā Tarawn Faʾidhā Suʾiltum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حُرَيْثِ بْنِ ظُهَيْرٍ قَالَ أَحْسَبُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 172

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard Ibrahim (narrate) from 'Alqamah and Al-Aswad from 'Abdullah," and he narrated something similar.
hadiths.body: "I heard Ibrahim (narrate) from 'Alqamah and Al-Aswad from 'Abdullah," and he narrated something similar.
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ نَحْوَهُ
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e ʿUmārah b. ʿUmayr \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 173

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: (Another chain) with similar meaning.
hadiths.body: (Another chain) with similar meaning.
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِنَحْوِهِ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Jarīr \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e al-Qāsim b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 174

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah said, "O people, surely you will speak and you will be spoken to. So when you see something new, adhere to the original command." Hafs said, "I used to receive narration from Habib, who received it from Abu Abdur Rahman, then doubt entered my heart."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah said, "O people, surely you will speak and you will be spoken to. So when you see something new, adhere to the original command." Hafs said, "I used to receive narration from Habib, who received it from Abu Abdur Rahman, then doubt entered my heart."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّكُمْ سَتُحْدِثُونَ وَيُحْدَثُ لَكُمْ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مُحْدَثَةً فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْأَمْرِ الْأَوَّلِ» قَالَ حَفْصٌ كُنْتُ أُسْنِدُ عَنْ حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ثُمَّ دَخَلَنِي مِنْهُ شَكٌّ   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿAbdullāh Ayyuhā al-Nās Innakum Satuḥdithūn And Yuḥdath Lakum Faʾidhā Raʾaytum Muḥdathah Faʿalaykum Bi-al-Amr al-Awwal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 175

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْفُتْيَا وَمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Futya and Its Intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: Omar said to Ibn Mas'ud, "Did I not inform or was I not informed that you give fatwas even though you are not a ruler? Beware of who you appoint as a ruler."
hadiths.body: Omar said to Ibn Mas'ud, "Did I not inform or was I not informed that you give fatwas even though you are not a ruler? Beware of who you appoint as a ruler."
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ لِابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ «أَلَمْ أُنْبَأْ أَوْ أُنْبِئْتُ أَنَّكَ تُفْتِي وَلَسْتَ بِأَمِيرٍ؟ وَلِّ حَارَّهَا مَنْ تَوَلَّى قَارَّهَا»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad \u003e ʿUmar Liāb. Masʿūd Alam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 176

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: "The one who gives fatwas to people in all matters that are asked is insane."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The one who gives fatwas to people in all matters that are asked is insane."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ الَّذِي يُفْتِي النَّاسَ فِي كُلِّ مَا يُسْتَفْتَى لَمَجْنُونٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 177

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: Only three types of people can issue religious judgements: an Imam (religious leader), a judge, or a person who knows abrogated verses of the Quran from the abrogating ones. The people asked Hudhayfah, "Who is he?" He replied, "Umar ibn Al-Khattab or someone foolish who pretends to be knowledgeable."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Only three types of people can issue religious judgements: an Imam (religious leader), a judge, or a person who knows abrogated verses of the Quran from the abrogating ones. The people asked Hudhayfah, "Who is he?" He replied, "Umar ibn Al-Khattab or someone foolish who pretends to be knowledgeable."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُفْتِي النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَةٌ رَجُلٌ إِمَامٌ أَوْ وَالٍ وَرَجُلٌ يَعْلَمُ نَاسِخَ الْقُرْآنِ مِنَ الْمَنْسُوخِ قَالُوا يَا حُذَيْفَةُ مِنْ ذَاكَ؟ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ أَوْ أَحْمَقُ مُتَكَلِّفٌ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 178

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: Hudhaifah, one of three people, is the one who issues fatwas (religious rulings) regarding the abrogated and abrogating verses of the Qur'an. They asked, "Who is that?" 'Umar ibn al-Khattab replied, "It is a knowledgeable person who understands the abrogated and abrogating verses," and he added, "And a ruler who finds no alternative or foolish person who pretends to be knowledgeable." Then Muhammad ﷺ said, "I am not one of these two, and I hope not to be the third."
hadiths.body: Hudhaifah, one of three people, is the one who issues fatwas (religious rulings) regarding the abrogated and abrogating verses of the Qur'an. They asked, "Who is that?" 'Umar ibn al-Khattab replied, "It is a knowledgeable person who understands the abrogated and abrogating verses," and he added, "And a ruler who finds no alternative or foolish person who pretends to be knowledgeable." Then Muhammad ﷺ said, "I am not one of these two, and I hope not to be the third."
hadiths.arabic: حُذَيْفَةُ إِنَّمَا يُفْتِي النَّاسَ أَحَدُ ثَلَاثَةٍ رَجُلٌ عَلِمَ نَاسِخَ الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ مَنْسُوخِهِ قَالُوا وَمَنْ ذَاكَ؟ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ «وَأَمِيرٌ لَا يَجِدُ بُدًّا أَوْ أَحْمَقُ مُتَكَلِّفٌ» ثُمَّ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ فَلَسْتُ بِوَاحِدٍ مِنْ هَذَيْنِ وَأَرْجُو أَنْ لَا أَكُونَ الثَّالِثَ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Abū ʿUbaydah b. Ḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنبَأَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ حُذَيْفَةَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 179

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever among you possesses knowledge, let them spread it, and whoever does not possess knowledge, let them say, 'I do not know, Allah knows best.' Indeed, when a learned person is asked about something they do not know, they will say, 'Allah knows best.' And Allah has said to his Messenger, 'Say, I do not ask you for any reward for this [Quran], nor am I a pretentious person.'" [Surah Al-An'am, 86]   – Sound
hadiths.body: "Whoever among you possesses knowledge, let them spread it, and whoever does not possess knowledge, let them say, 'I do not know, Allah knows best.' Indeed, when a learned person is asked about something they do not know, they will say, 'Allah knows best.' And Allah has said to his Messenger, 'Say, I do not ask you for any reward for this [Quran], nor am I a pretentious person.'" [Surah Al-An'am, 86]   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: مَنْ عَلِمَ مِنْكُمْ عِلْمًا فَلْيَقُلْ بِهِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ فَلْيَقُلْ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ فَإِنَّ الْعَالِمَ إِذَا سُئِلَ عَمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ قَالَ اللَّهُ ﷻ أَعْلَمُ وَقَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ لِرَسُولِهِ {قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ} [ص 86]   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Muslim \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 180

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: "In his sermon, he said: 'Whoever has knowledge should teach it to the people and himself, and should not speak about something he has no knowledge of, so as not to pass by the religion and be among the pretentious.'"
hadiths.body: "In his sermon, he said: 'Whoever has knowledge should teach it to the people and himself, and should not speak about something he has no knowledge of, so as not to pass by the religion and be among the pretentious.'"
hadiths.arabic: فِي خُطْبَتِهِ «مَنْ عَلِمَ عِلْمًا فَلْيُعَلِّمْهُ النَّاسَ وَإِيَّاهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ مَا لَا عِلْمَ لَهُ بِهِ فَيَمْرُقُ مِنَ الدِّينِ وَيَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ»
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Abū Rajāʾ \u003e Abū al-Muhallab \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 181

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: "May the blessings of Allah be upon him and may He cool their liver when I am asked about what I do not know and do not know what to say, Allah knows best."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "May the blessings of Allah be upon him and may He cool their liver when I am asked about what I do not know and do not know what to say, Allah knows best."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَلِيٌّ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَا بَرْدَهَا عَلَى الْكَبِدِ إِذَا سُئِلْتُ عَمَّا لَا أَعْلَمُ أَنْ أَقُولَ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Abū al-Bakhtarī And Zādhān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ وَزَاذَانَ قَالَا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 182

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: It is a sign of having knowledge that, when you do not know something, you say: 'Allah knows better.' Allah said to his Prophet: 'Say: No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I one of the pretenders (a person who pretends things which do not exist)' (38.86) When the Quraish troubled and stood against the Prophet ﷺ he said, "O Allah! Help me against them by afflicting them with seven years of famine like the seven years of Joseph." So they were stricken with a year of famine during which they ate bones and dead animals because of too much suffering, and one of them would see something like smoke between him and the sky because of hunger. Then they said: Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we are believers. (44.12) And then it was said to the Prophet (by Allah), "If we remove it from them. they will revert to their ways (of heathenism)." So the Prophet ﷺ invoked his Lord, who removed the punishment from them, but later they reverted (to heathenism), whereupon Allah punished them on the day of the Battle of Badr, and that is what Allah's Statement indicates: 'Then watch for the day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible...we will indeed (then) exact retribution.' (44.10).    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It is a sign of having knowledge that, when you do not know something, you say: 'Allah knows better.' Allah said to his Prophet: 'Say: No wage do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I one of the pretenders (a person who pretends things which do not exist)' (38.86) When the Quraish troubled and stood against the Prophet ﷺ he said, "O Allah! Help me against them by afflicting them with seven years of famine like the seven years of Joseph." So they were stricken with a year of famine during which they ate bones and dead animals because of too much suffering, and one of them would see something like smoke between him and the sky because of hunger. Then they said: Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we are believers. (44.12) And then it was said to the Prophet (by Allah), "If we remove it from them. they will revert to their ways (of heathenism)." So the Prophet ﷺ invoked his Lord, who removed the punishment from them, but later they reverted (to heathenism), whereupon Allah punished them on the day of the Battle of Badr, and that is what Allah's Statement indicates: 'Then watch for the day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke plainly visible...we will indeed (then) exact retribution.' (44.10).    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَقُولَ لِمَا لَا تَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Abū al-Bakhtarī \u003e ʿAlī Riḍwān Allāh ʿAlayh \u003e Yā Bardahā \u003e al-Kabid
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ يَا بَرْدَهَا عَلَى الْكَبِدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 183

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: "If you are asked about something you do not know, then flee." He said, "But how do we flee, O Commander of the Faithful?" He said, "You say Allah knows best."
hadiths.body: "If you are asked about something you do not know, then flee." He said, "But how do we flee, O Commander of the Faithful?" He said, "You say Allah knows best."
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا سُئِلْتُمْ عَمَّا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ فَاهْرُبُوا» قَالَ وَكَيْفَ الْهَرَبُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ؟ قَالَ تَقُولُونَ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e ʿUmayr b. ʿArfajah \u003e Razīn Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e ʿAlī b. Abū Ṭālib \u003e Idhā Suʾiltum ʿAmmā Lā Taʿlamūn Fāhrubūā \u003e And Kayf al-Harab Yā Amīr al-Muʾminīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَيْرُ بْنُ عَرْفَجَةَ حَدَّثَنَا رَزِينٌ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 184

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali placed it on the liver three times. They asked, "What does that mean, O Prince of the Believers?" He said, "It means that a person should not be asked about something they do not know, and they should say, 'Allah knows best.'"
hadiths.body: Ali placed it on the liver three times. They asked, "What does that mean, O Prince of the Believers?" He said, "It means that a person should not be asked about something they do not know, and they should say, 'Allah knows best.'"
hadiths.arabic: عَلِيٌّ وَا بَرْدَهَا عَلَى الْكَبِدِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ قَالُوا وَمَا ذَلِكَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ؟ قَالَ أَنْ يُسْأَلَ الرَّجُلُ عَمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Muslim al-Baṭīn \u003e ʿAzrah al-Tamīmī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْبَطِينِ عَنْ عَزْرَةَ التَّمِيمِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 185

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: "I have no knowledge of it. So, when the man turned away, Ibn Umar said, 'Yes, that's what Ibn Umar said when he was asked about something he didn't know. He would say, 'I have no knowledge of it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I have no knowledge of it. So, when the man turned away, Ibn Umar said, 'Yes, that's what Ibn Umar said when he was asked about something he didn't know. He would say, 'I have no knowledge of it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَا عِلْمَ لِي بِهَا فَلَمَّا أَدْبَرَ الرَّجُلُ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ نِعْمَ مَا قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ سُئِلَ عَمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ فَقَالَ لَا عِلْمَ لِي بِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Farwah b. Abū al-Maghrāʾ \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e a man Saʾalah \u003e Masʾalah \u003e Lā ʿIlm Lī Bihā Falammā Adbar al-a man \u003e Ibn ʿUmar Niʿm Mā \u003e Ibn ʿUmar Suʾil ʿAmmā Lā Yaʿlam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَهُ عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 186

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: "I do not know half of knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I do not know half of knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا أَدْرِي نِصْفُ الْعِلْمِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 187

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: "No knowledge for me, then the man turned around after the man stopped and said, 'Yes, what Ibn Umar said is true. He asks about what he does not know,' and he said, 'No knowledge for me,' meaning Ibn Umar himself."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "No knowledge for me, then the man turned around after the man stopped and said, 'Yes, what Ibn Umar said is true. He asks about what he does not know,' and he said, 'No knowledge for me,' meaning Ibn Umar himself."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَا عِلْمَ لِي ثُمَّ الْتَفَتَ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَفَّى الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ نِعْمَ مَا قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يسُألَ عَمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ فَقَالَ لَا عِلْمَ لِي يَعْنِي ابْنُ عُمَرَ نَفْسَهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh al-ʿUmarī \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e a man Atá Ibn ʿUmar Yasʾaluh \u003e Shayʾ \u003e Lā ʿIlm Lī Thum al-Tafat Baʿd \u003e Qaffá al-a man \u003e Niʿm Mā \u003e Ibn ʿUmar Ysuʾl ʿAmmā Lā Yaʿlam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْعُمَرِيُّ عَنْ نَافِعٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى ابْنَ عُمَرَ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 188

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: About something he says, "I don't know." If they respond to him, he says, "I swear to you by Allah, if I had knowledge of it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About something he says, "I don't know." If they respond to him, he says, "I swear to you by Allah, if I had knowledge of it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ شَيْءٍ يَقُولُ لَا أَدْرِي فَإِنْ رُدُّوا عَلَيْهِ قَالَ إِنْي حَلَفْتُ لَكَ بِاللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ ثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ قَالَ كَانَ عَامِرٌ إِذَا سُئِلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 189

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: I do not mind being asked about what I know or do not know, because when I am asked about what I know, I say what I know, and when I am asked about what I do not know, I say I do not know.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I do not mind being asked about what I know or do not know, because when I am asked about what I know, I say what I know, and when I am asked about what I do not know, I say I do not know.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا أُبَالِي سُئِلْتُ عَمَّا أَعْلَمُ أَوْ مَا لَا أَعْلَمُ لِأَنِّي إِذَا سُئِلْتُ عَمَّا أَعْلَمُ قُلْتُ مَا أَعْلَمُ وَإِذَا سُئِلْتُ عَمَّا لَا أَعْلَمُ قُلْتُ لَا أَعْلَمُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e Ashʿath \u003e Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 190

chapter.englishTitle: Section 21

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Ibrahim saying, "A cat is neither halal (permissible) nor haram (forbidden). He only used to say, 'They (the companions) used to dislike it while they used to prefer (keeping other animals).'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Ibrahim saying, "A cat is neither halal (permissible) nor haram (forbidden). He only used to say, 'They (the companions) used to dislike it while they used to prefer (keeping other animals).'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يَقُولُ قَطُّ حَلَالٌ وَلَا حَرَامٌ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَقُولُ «كَانُوا يتكْرهونَ وَكَانُوا يَسْتَحِبُّونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hārūn \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Mā \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ قَالَ مَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 191

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَغَيُّرِ الزَّمَانِ وَمَا يَحْدُثُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The changes of time and what happens in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah, how are you when you wear a temptation in which the great ones become disoriented and the small ones grow up and people take it as a tradition? And when it is changed, they say, 'The tradition has changed.' They say, 'And when will that be, O Abu Abdur Rahman?' He said, 'When your readers become numerous, your scholars become few, your leaders become many, and your trustworthy ones become few, and when the worldly life is sought through the actions of the Hereafter.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah, how are you when you wear a temptation in which the great ones become disoriented and the small ones grow up and people take it as a tradition? And when it is changed, they say, 'The tradition has changed.' They say, 'And when will that be, O Abu Abdur Rahman?' He said, 'When your readers become numerous, your scholars become few, your leaders become many, and your trustworthy ones become few, and when the worldly life is sought through the actions of the Hereafter.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا لَبِسَتْكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ يَهْرَمُ فِيهَا الْكَبِيرُ وَيَرْبُو فِيهَا الصَّغِيرُ وَيَتَّخِذُهَا النَّاسُ سُنَّةً فَإِذَا غُيِّرَتْ قَالُوا غُيِّرَتِ السُّنَّةُ قَالُوا وَمَتَى ذَلِكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ؟ قَالَ «إِذَا كَثُرَتْ قُرَّاؤُكُمْ وَقَلَّتْ فُقَهَاؤُكُمْ وَكَثُرَتْ أُمَرَاؤُكُمْ وَقَلَّتْ أُمَنَاؤُكُمْ وَالْتُمِسَتِ الدُّنْيَا بِعَمَلِ الْآخِرَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Shaqīq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 192

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَغَيُّرِ الزَّمَانِ وَمَا يَحْدُثُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The changes of time and what happens in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: "How are you when you are adorned with a temptation in which the elders grow feeble and the young ones flourish? When something is left from it, it is said, 'The sunnah has been abandoned.' They ask, 'When is that?' He said, 'When your scholars disappear, your ignorants increase, your reciters multiply, your jurists decrease, your leaders increase, your trustworthy individuals decrease, and worldly gains are sought through actions of the Hereafter and understanding of religion diminishes.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "How are you when you are adorned with a temptation in which the elders grow feeble and the young ones flourish? When something is left from it, it is said, 'The sunnah has been abandoned.' They ask, 'When is that?' He said, 'When your scholars disappear, your ignorants increase, your reciters multiply, your jurists decrease, your leaders increase, your trustworthy individuals decrease, and worldly gains are sought through actions of the Hereafter and understanding of religion diminishes.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ إِذَا لَبِسَتْكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ يَهْرَمُ فِيهَا الْكَبِيرُ وَيَرْبُو فِيهَا الصَّغِيرُ إِذَا تُرِكَ مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ قِيلَ تُرِكَتِ السُّنَّةُ قَالُوا وَمَتَى ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ «إِذَا ذَهَبَتْ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ وَكَثُرَتْ جُهَلَاؤُكُمْ وَكَثُرَتْ قُرَّاؤُكُمْ وَقَلَّتْ فُقَهَاؤُكُمْ وَكَثُرَتْ أُمَرَاؤُكُمْ وَقَلَّتْ أُمَنَاؤُكُمْ وَالْتُمِسَتِ الدُّنْيَا بِعَمَلِ الْآخِرَةِ وَتُفُقِّهَ لِغَيْرِ الدِّينِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ziyād \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 193

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَغَيُّرِ الزَّمَانِ وَمَا يَحْدُثُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The changes of time and what happens in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said, "Woe to those who indulge in matters other than worship and those who make the prohibited permissible by means of doubtful actions."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It is said, "Woe to those who indulge in matters other than worship and those who make the prohibited permissible by means of doubtful actions."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ «وَيْلٌ لِلْمُتَفَقِّهِينَ لِغَيْرِ الْعِبَادَةِ وَالْمُسْتَحِلِّينَ الحرماتِ بِالشُّبُهَاتِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Unbiʾt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ قَالَ أُنْبِئْتُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 194

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَغَيُّرِ الزَّمَانِ وَمَا يَحْدُثُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The changes of time and what happens in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Every year that comes to you is worse than the year before it. I do not mean by this that it brings more crops or a better leader, but your scholars, elites, and jurists will die, and you will not find their successors. Then a people will come who will judge matters according to their own opinions."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Every year that comes to you is worse than the year before it. I do not mean by this that it brings more crops or a better leader, but your scholars, elites, and jurists will die, and you will not find their successors. Then a people will come who will judge matters according to their own opinions."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَأْتِي عَلَيْكُمْ عَامٌ إِلَّا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ مِنَ الَّذِي كَانَ قَبْلَهُ أَمَا إِنِّي لَسْتُ أَعْنِي عَامًا أَخْصَبَ مِنْ عَامٍ وَلَا أَمِيرًا خَيْرًا مِنْ أَمِيرٍ وَلَكِنْ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ وَخِيَارُكُمْ وَفُقَهَاؤُكُمْ يَذْهَبُونَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُونَ مِنْهُمْ خَلَفًا وَيَجِيءُ قَوْمٌ يَقِيسُونَ الْأُمُورَ بِرَأْيِهِمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ṣāliḥ b. Suhayl a freed slave of Yaḥyá b. Abū Zāʾidah \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Mujālid \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ سُهَيْلٍ مَوْلَى يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ ثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 195

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَغَيُّرِ الزَّمَانِ وَمَا يَحْدُثُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The changes of time and what happens in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The first one who judged Iblis (Satan) and that the sun and moon are not to be worshipped except by measurements."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "The first one who judged Iblis (Satan) and that the sun and moon are not to be worshipped except by measurements."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَوَّلُ مَنْ قَاسَ إِبْلِيسُ وَمَا عُبِدَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ إِلَّا بِالْمَقَايِيسِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Yaḥyá b. Sulaym \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ دَاوُدَ بْنَ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 196

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَغَيُّرِ الزَّمَانِ وَمَا يَحْدُثُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The changes of time and what happens in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: He recited this verse: "You created me from fire, and You created him from clay." [Al-A'raf 12]. He said, "Iblees (Satan) was arrogant, and he was the first of those who were arrogant."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He recited this verse: "You created me from fire, and You created him from clay." [Al-A'raf 12]. He said, "Iblees (Satan) was arrogant, and he was the first of those who were arrogant."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ {خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ} [الأعراف 12] قَالَ «قَاسَ إِبْلِيسُ وَهُوَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ قَاسَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Ibn Shawdhab \u003e Maṭar \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شَوْذَبٍ عَنْ مَطَرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 197

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَغَيُّرِ الزَّمَانِ وَمَا يَحْدُثُ فِيهِ
