hadiths.arabic: «أَبُثُّ الْعِلْمَ فِي آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ حَتَّى يَعْلَمَهُ الرَّجُلُ وَالْمَرْأَةُ وَالْعَبْدُ وَالْحُرُّ وَالصَّغِيرُ وَالْكَبِيرُ فَإِذَا فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ بِهِمْ أَخَذْتُهُمْ بِحَقِّي عَلَيْهِمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Makhlad b. Mālik \u003e Ḥajjāj b. Muḥammad \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū al-Zāhiriyyah Yarfaʿ al-Ḥadīth n Allāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزَّاهِرِيَّةِ يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ أنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 260

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever seeks something from this knowledge and intends with it what is with Allah, he will attain it if Allah wills. And whoever intends with it worldly gain, then that is his portion from it by Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever seeks something from this knowledge and intends with it what is with Allah, he will attain it if Allah wills. And whoever intends with it worldly gain, then that is his portion from it by Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ طَلَبَ شَيْئًا مِنْ هَذَا الْعِلْمِ فَأَرَادَ بِهِ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ يُدْرِكْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ أَرَادَ بِهِ الدُّنْيَا فَذَاكَ وَاللَّهِ حَظُّهُ مِنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Makhlad b. Mālik \u003e Makhlad b. Ḥusayn \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 261

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Mas'ood said: "Do not seek knowledge for three reasons: to argue with fools, to debate with scholars, and to attract people's attention towards yourselves. Seek with your words what is with Allah, for it will endure and remain, while everything else will eventually perish."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Mas'ood said: "Do not seek knowledge for three reasons: to argue with fools, to debate with scholars, and to attract people's attention towards yourselves. Seek with your words what is with Allah, for it will endure and remain, while everything else will eventually perish."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ «لَا تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ لِثَلَاثٍ لِتُمَارُوا بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ وَتُجَادِلُوا بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ وَلِتَصْرِفُوا بِهِ وُجُوهَ النَّاسِ إِلَيْكُمْ وَابْتَغُوا بِقَوْلِكُمْ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُ يَدُومُ وَيَبْقَى وَيَنْفَدُ مَا سِوَاهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAwn \u003e Ibrāhīm b. ʿĪsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 262

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: "Be the springs of knowledge, the lamps of guidance, the abodes of houses, the lanterns of the night, the renewers of hearts, the creators of garments. You are known to the people of the heavens and hidden to the people of the earth."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Be the springs of knowledge, the lamps of guidance, the abodes of houses, the lanterns of the night, the renewers of hearts, the creators of garments. You are known to the people of the heavens and hidden to the people of the earth."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُونُوا يَنَابِيعَ الْعِلْمِ مَصَابِيحَ الْهُدَى أَحْلَاسَ الْبُيُوتِ سُرُجَ اللَّيْلِ جُدُدَ الْقُلُوبِ خُلْقَانَ الثِّيَابِ تُعْرَفُونَ فِي أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ وَتَخْفَوْنَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chainArabic: وَبِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 263

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one seeks this knowledge except for worldly gains, but Allah will prohibit them from entering Paradise on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one seeks this knowledge except for worldly gains, but Allah will prohibit them from entering Paradise on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَطْلُبُ هَذَا الْعِلْمَ أَحَدٌ لَا يُرِيدُ بِهِ إِلَّا الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرْفَ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿUmārah b. Ḥazm \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ حَزْمٍ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 264

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: "The knowledgeable one is the one who fears Allah, Mighty and Majestic."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The knowledgeable one is the one who fears Allah, Mighty and Majestic."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْعَالِمُ مَنْ يَخَافُ اللَّهَ» ﷻ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mujāhid b. Mūsá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Numayr \u003e Mālik b. Mighwal \u003e a man Lilshhaʿbī Aftinī Ayyuhā al-ʿĀlim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِلشَّعْبِيِّ أَفْتِنِي أَيُّهَا الْعَالِمُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 265

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: "Learn knowledge so that you may be recognized by it and act upon it so that you may be considered amongst its people. For surely, there will come a time after this where the people will not recognize their own nineteen attributes, and none will be safe from it except for every sleeper. Those are the leaders of guidance and the lanterns of knowledge, they are not the followers of mischief or the spreaders of lies." Abu Muhammad said, "A sleeper is oblivious to evil, and the spreaders of lies talk excessively, and the gossipers are those who pass on rumors."
hadiths.body: "Learn knowledge so that you may be recognized by it and act upon it so that you may be considered amongst its people. For surely, there will come a time after this where the people will not recognize their own nineteen attributes, and none will be safe from it except for every sleeper. Those are the leaders of guidance and the lanterns of knowledge, they are not the followers of mischief or the spreaders of lies." Abu Muhammad said, "A sleeper is oblivious to evil, and the spreaders of lies talk excessively, and the gossipers are those who pass on rumors."
hadiths.arabic: «تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ تُعْرَفُوا بِهِ وَاعْمَلُوا بِهِ تَكُونُوا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ فَإِنَّهُ سَيَأْتِي بَعْدَ هَذَا زَمَانٌ لَا يَعْرِفُ فِيهِ تِسْعَةُ عُشَرَائِهِمُ الْمَعْرُوفَ وَلَا يَنْجُو مِنْهُ إِلَّا كُلُّ نُوَمَةٍ فَأُولَئِكَ أَئِمَّةُ الْهُدَى وَمَصَابِيحُ الْعِلْمِ لَيْسُوا بِالْمَسَايِيحِ وَلَا الْمَذَايِيعِ الْبُذْرِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ نُوَمَةٌ غَافِلٌ عَنِ الشَّرِّ الْمَذَايِيعُ كَثِيرُ الْكَلَامِ وَالْبُذْرُ النَّمَّامُونَ
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿUmar b. Mazyad \u003e Awfá b. Dalham \u003e Balaghah \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ مَزْيَدٍ عَنْ أَوْفَى بْنِ دَلْهَمٍ أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 266

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: "To know that Allah will not reward you with knowledge until you act upon it."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "To know that Allah will not reward you with knowledge until you act upon it."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَعْلَمُوا فَلَنْ يَأْجُرَكُمُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى بِالْعِلْمِ حَتَّى تَعْمَلُوا»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Yazīd b. Jābir \u003e Muʿādh b. Jabal Āʿmalūā Mā Shiʾtum Baʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ قَالَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ «اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ بَعْدَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 267

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: "We speak or find in books that whoever Allah, the Almighty, bestows knowledge upon and acts upon it in a way of guidance, He will deprive him of his intellect until Allah takes it back."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "We speak or find in books that whoever Allah, the Almighty, bestows knowledge upon and acts upon it in a way of guidance, He will deprive him of his intellect until Allah takes it back."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّا لَنَتَحَدَّثُ أَوْ نَجِدُ فِي الْكُتُبِ أَنَّهُ مَا آتَى اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ عَبْدًا عِلْمًا فَعَمِلَ بِهِ عَلَى سَبِيلِ الْهُدَى فَيَسْلُبَهُ عَقْلَهُ حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Khālid b. Ḥāzim \u003e al-Walīd b. Mazyad \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd b. Jābir \u003e Saʿd \u003e Atá Ibn Munabbih Fasaʾalah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Lah Kayf ʿAqluh Faʾakhbarah Thum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مَزْيَدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعْدٍ أَنَّهُ أَتَى ابْنَ مُنَبِّهٍ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ وَقَالَ لَهُ كَيْفَ عَقْلُهُ؟ فَأَخْبَرَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 268

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Abu Darda say, "Indeed, from the worst of people in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a scholar who does not benefit from his knowledge."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Darda say, "Indeed, from the worst of people in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection is a scholar who does not benefit from his knowledge."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ يَقُولُ «إِنَّ مِنْ أَشَرِّ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مَنْزِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَالِمٌ لَا يَنْتَفِعُ بِعِلْمِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Ibn al-Qāsim b. Qays \u003e Yūnus b. Sayf al-Ḥimṣī \u003e Abū Kabshah al-Salūlī \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قال حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ سَيْفٍ الْحِمْصِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَبْشَةَ السَّلُولِيُّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 269

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Darda said, "Whoever increases in knowledge, increases in pain."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Darda said, "Whoever increases in knowledge, increases in pain."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ «مَنْ يَزْدَدْ عِلْمًا يَزْدَدْ وَجَعًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Abū Qudāmah \u003e Mālik b. Dīnār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا أَبُو قُدَامَةَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 270

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: I am not afraid to be told what I do not know, but I am afraid to be told what I have done.
hadiths.body: I am not afraid to be told what I do not know, but I am afraid to be told what I have done.
hadiths.arabic: مَا أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي أَنْ يُقَالَ لِي مَا عَلِمْتَ وَلَكِنْ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُقَالَ لِي مَاذَا عَمِلْتَ؟
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Dardā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وقالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 271

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: Studying knowledge for an hour during the night is better than reviving it.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Studying knowledge for an hour during the night is better than reviving it.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَدَارُسُ الْعِلْمِ سَاعَةً مِنَ اللَّيْلِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ إِحْيَائِهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAmman \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ يَذْكُرُ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 272

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: He informed us and Abu Huraira said, "Indeed, I divide the night into three parts. I sleep for one third, I stand in worship for one third, and I remember the sayings of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for one third."
hadiths.body: He informed us and Abu Huraira said, "Indeed, I divide the night into three parts. I sleep for one third, I stand in worship for one third, and I remember the sayings of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for one third."
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ إِنِّي لَأُجَزِّئُ اللَّيْلَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَجْزَاءٍ فَثُلُثٌ أَنَامُ وَثُلُثٌ أَقُومُ وَثُلُثٌ أَتَذَكَّرُ أَحَادِيثَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 273

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعَمَلِ بِالْعِلْمِ وَحُسْنِ النِّيَّةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Working with knowledge and good intentions in it

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever seeks something from knowledge, seeking thereby the Face of Allah, Exalted is He, Allah will grant him from it what is sufficient for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever seeks something from knowledge, seeking thereby the Face of Allah, Exalted is He, Allah will grant him from it what is sufficient for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنِ ابْتَغَى شَيْئًا مِنَ الْعِلْمِ يَبْتَغِي بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَهُ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ مَا يَكْفِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. ʿArafah \u003e Jarīr \u003e al-Ḥasan b. ʿAmr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 274

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: According to a narration that was narrated to me, I said, "Indeed, it is attributed to the Prophet ﷺ." He (the narrator) replied, "No, it is more beloved to us that if there is an increase or decrease [in the narration], it is attributed to someone other than the Prophet ﷺ."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: According to a narration that was narrated to me, I said, "Indeed, it is attributed to the Prophet ﷺ." He (the narrator) replied, "No, it is more beloved to us that if there is an increase or decrease [in the narration], it is attributed to someone other than the Prophet ﷺ."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ حَدِيثٍ فَحَدَّثَنِيهِ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّهُ يُرْفَعُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «لَا عَلَى مَنْ دُونَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْنَا فَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ زِيَادَةٌ أَوْ نُقْصَانٌ كَانَ عَلَى مَنْ دُونَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Thābit b. Yazīd \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Saʾalt al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 275

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ prohibited engaging in mukhaalah and muzabana. It was said to him, "Do you not preserve any other hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He replied, "Yes, but I say what Abdullah said, and Alqamah said it is more beloved to me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ prohibited engaging in mukhaalah and muzabana. It was said to him, "Do you not preserve any other hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He replied, "Yes, but I say what Abdullah said, and Alqamah said it is more beloved to me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ» فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَمَا تَحْفَظُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَدِيثًا غَيْرَ هَذَا قَالَ بَلَى وَلَكِنْ أَقُولُ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Abū Hāshim \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 276

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Darda used to say, when he spoke about a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "This is it, or similar to it, or resembling it, or bearing its form."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Darda used to say, when he spoke about a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, "This is it, or similar to it, or resembling it, or bearing its form."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ إِذَا حَدَّثَ بِحَدِيثٍ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ هَذَا أَوْ نَحْوَهُ أَوْ شِبْهَهُ أَوْ شَكْلَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ismāʿīl b. ʿUbaydullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 277

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Darda used to say, whenever he narrated a hadith: "O Allah, grant it (the hadith) to be in this manner or similar to it."
hadiths.body: Abu Darda used to say, whenever he narrated a hadith: "O Allah, grant it (the hadith) to be in this manner or similar to it."
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ إِذَا حَدَّثَ حَدِيثًا قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ إِلَّا هَكَذَا أَوْ كَشَكْلِهِ
hadiths.chain: Asad b. Mūsá \u003e Muʿāwiyah \u003e Rabīʿah b. Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 278

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said, "It was a dark night, and then the Messenger of Allah said, and his eyes bulged and his veins swelled, and I saw him as if his buttons were loosed and he said, 'Or like it, or similar to it, or something like it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said, "It was a dark night, and then the Messenger of Allah said, and his eyes bulged and his veins swelled, and I saw him as if his buttons were loosed and he said, 'Or like it, or similar to it, or something like it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَتَّى كَانَتْ ذَاتَ عَشِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ «قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ» قَالَ فَاغْرَوْرَقَتْ عَيْنَاهُ وَانْتَفَخَتْ أَوْدَاجُهُ فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُهُ مَحْلُولَةً أَزْرَارُهُ وَقَالَ «أَوْ مِثْلُهُ أَوْ نَحْوُهُ أَوْ شَبِيهٌ بِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muslim Abū ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibrāhīm al-Taymī from his father \u003e ʿAmr b. Maymūn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنبَأَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ لَا تَفُوتُنِي عَشِيَّةُ خَمِيسٍ إِلَّا وَآتِي فِيهَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ لِشَيْءٍ قَطُّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 279

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic text is: "About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , his face would show signs of concern during certain days, and he would say, 'Like this, or something similar to this, like this or something similar to this.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic text is: "About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , his face would show signs of concern during certain days, and he would say, 'Like this, or something similar to this, like this or something similar to this.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْأَيَّامِ تَرَبَّدَ وَجْهُهُ وَقَالَ «هَكَذَا أَوْ نَحْوَهُ هَكَذَا أَوْ نَحْوَهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī And Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا أَشْعَثُ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ وَابْنِ سِيرِينَ أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ كَانَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 280

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: For the people, have you seen so-and-so who says, "The Messenger of Allah said, the Messenger of Allah said?" I sat with Ibn Umar for two or two and a half years, and I did not hear him narrate anything from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ except for this hadith.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: For the people, have you seen so-and-so who says, "The Messenger of Allah said, the Messenger of Allah said?" I sat with Ibn Umar for two or two and a half years, and I did not hear him narrate anything from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ except for this hadith.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِي الشَّعْبِيُّ أَرَأَيْتَ فُلَانًا الَّذِي يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ قَعَدْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ سَنَةً وَنِصْفًا فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَيْئًا إِلَّا هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Tawbah al-ʿAnbarī \u003e Lī al-Shaʿbī Araʾayt Fulān al--Adhī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا تَوْبَةُ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 281

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: My nephew, leave him for he defended Messenger of Allah ﷺ.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: My nephew, leave him for he defended Messenger of Allah ﷺ.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Asad b. Mūsá \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū al-Safar \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Jālast Ibn ʿUmar Sanah Falam Asmaʿh \u003e Ḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي السَّفَرِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ «جَالَسْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ سَنَةً فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ يَذْكُرُ حَدِيثًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 282

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: "He updates us monthly with two or three news stories."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "He updates us monthly with two or three news stories."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يُحَدِّثُنَا فِي الشَّهْرِ بِالْحَدِيثَيْنِ أَوِ الثَّلَاثَةِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿĀṣim b. Yūsuf \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Abū Ḥaṣīn \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Thābit b. Quṭbah al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ قُطْبَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 283

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: Did you hear from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said, "And I am preparing for."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Did you hear from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said, "And I am preparing for."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟» فَقَالَ وَأَتَحَلَّلُ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Yūnus \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUbayd \u003e Mar Binā Anas b. Mālik Faqulnā Ḥaddithnā Bibaʿḍ Mā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنبَأَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ مَرَّ بِنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَقُلْنَا «حَدِّثْنَا بِبَعْضِ مَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 284

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and whenever he mentioned the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he would say: "Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.""   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and whenever he mentioned the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he would say: "Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.""   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَكَانَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالَ ثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ كَانَ أَنَسٌ قَلِيلَ الْحَدِيثِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 285

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whenever Anas bin Malik finished narrating a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would say, 'Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whenever Anas bin Malik finished narrating a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he would say, 'Or as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَدِيثًا قَالَ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Muḥammad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ كَانَ أَنَسٌ إِذَا حَدَّثَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 286

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I went out with Saad to Makkah, but I did not hear him narrating any hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until we returned to Madinah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I went out with Saad to Makkah, but I did not hear him narrating any hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until we returned to Madinah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «خَرَجْتُ مَعَ سَعْدٍ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ حَدِيثًا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e al-Sāʾib b. Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 287

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: "When Umar joined the Ansar as they were leaving the city, he said, 'Do you know why I have accompanied you?' We replied, 'For the sake of the Ansar.' He said, 'Indeed, you are going to meet a people whose tongues are fluent with the recitation of the Quran, like the shaking of palm trees. Do not argue with them by talking about the Prophet's ﷺ sayings, for I am a partner with you.' I refrained from talking about anything, while having heard as my companions heard."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When Umar joined the Ansar as they were leaving the city, he said, 'Do you know why I have accompanied you?' We replied, 'For the sake of the Ansar.' He said, 'Indeed, you are going to meet a people whose tongues are fluent with the recitation of the Quran, like the shaking of palm trees. Do not argue with them by talking about the Prophet's ﷺ sayings, for I am a partner with you.' I refrained from talking about anything, while having heard as my companions heard."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عُمَرَ شَيَّعَ الْأَنْصَارَ حِينَ خَرَجُوا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ «أَتَدْرُونَ لِمَ شَيَّعْتُكُمْ» قُلْنَا لِحَقِّ الْأَنْصَارِ قَالَ «إِنَّكُمْ تَأْتُونَ قَوْمًا تَهْتَزُّ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ اهْتِزَازَ النَّخْلِ فَلَا تَصُدُّوهُمْ بِالْحَدِيثِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا شَرِيكُكُمْ» قَالَ فَمَا حَدَّثْتُ بِشَيْءٍ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ كَمَا سَمِعَ أَصْحَابِي   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Bayān \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Qaraẓah b. Kaʿb \u003e ʿUmar Shayyaʿ al-Anṣār Ḥīn Kharajūā from al-Madīnah \u003e Atadrūn Lim Shayyaʿtukum Qulnā Liḥaq al-Anṣār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا بَيَانٌ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ قَرَظَةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 288

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, you come to Kufa, and you come to a people who have zeal for the Quran. They come to you and say, "The Companions of Muhammad have come, the Companions of Muhammad have come!" They come to you and ask you about the hadiths, so know that the best wudu consists of three and two. Then he said, "Indeed, you come to Kufa, and you come to a people who have zeal for the Quran. They come to you and say, 'The Companions of Muhammad have come, the Companions of Muhammad have come!' They come to you and ask you about the hadiths, so convey less narration from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I am your partner in it." Qarada said, "And I used to sit with the people while they mentioned the hadiths from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I used to memorize them for him. When I mentioned the will of Umar, he remained silent." Abu Muhammad said, "What he means is that I have the narration about the days of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , not the Sunnah and the obligations."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Indeed, you come to Kufa, and you come to a people who have zeal for the Quran. They come to you and say, "The Companions of Muhammad have come, the Companions of Muhammad have come!" They come to you and ask you about the hadiths, so know that the best wudu consists of three and two. Then he said, "Indeed, you come to Kufa, and you come to a people who have zeal for the Quran. They come to you and say, 'The Companions of Muhammad have come, the Companions of Muhammad have come!' They come to you and ask you about the hadiths, so convey less narration from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I am your partner in it." Qarada said, "And I used to sit with the people while they mentioned the hadiths from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I used to memorize them for him. When I mentioned the will of Umar, he remained silent." Abu Muhammad said, "What he means is that I have the narration about the days of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , not the Sunnah and the obligations."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ تَأْتُونَ الْكُوفَةَ فَتَأْتُونَ قَوْمًا لَهُمْ أَزِيزٌ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَيَأْتُونَكُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ فَيَأْتُونَكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُونَكُمْ عَنِ الْحَدِيثِ فَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ أَسْبَغَ الْوُضُوءِ ثَلَاثٌ وَثِنْتَانِ تُجْزِيَانِ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ تَأْتُونَ الْكُوفَةَ فَتَأْتُونَ قَوْمًا لَهُمْ أَزِيزٌ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَيَقُولُونَ قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَدِمَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ فَيَأْتُونَكُمْ فَيَسْأَلُونَكُمْ عَنِ الْحَدِيثِ فَأَقِلُّوا الرِّوَايَةَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا شَرِيكُكُمْ فِيهِ قَالَ قَرَظَةُ وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَجْلِسُ فِي الْقَوْمِ فَيَذْكُرُونَ الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وإِنِّي لَمِنْ أَحْفَظِهِمْ لَهُ فَإِذَا ذَكَرْتُ وَصِيَّةَ عُمَرَ سَكَتُّ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ مَعْنَاهُ عِنْدِي الْحَدِيثُ عَنْ أَيَّامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَيْسَ السُّنَنَ وَالْفَرَائِضَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ashʿath b. Sawwār \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Qaraẓah b. Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا أَشْعَثُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ قَرَظَةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ بَعَثَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رَهْطًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ فَبَعَثَنِي مَعَهُمْ فَجَعَلَ يَمْشِي مَعَنَا حَتَّى أَتَى صِرَارَ وَصِرَارُ مَاءٌ فِي طَرِيقِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَجَعَلَ يَنْفُضُ التُّرَابَ عَنْ رِجْلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 289

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, then he trembled, and then he said something along those lines or beyond that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, then he trembled, and then he said something along those lines or beyond that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ ارْتَعَدَ ثُمَّ قَالَ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ أَوْ فَوْقَ ذَاكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mujāhid b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Numayr \u003e Mālik b. Mighwal \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 290

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a hadith except that he said, "I was with the Prophet ﷺ , and a branch was brought to him and he said, 'From among the trees, there is a tree similar to a Muslim man.' I intended to say, 'It is the date-palm tree,' but then I looked and saw that I was the shortest among the people, so I remained silent." Umar said, "I wish you had said it, and upon me is this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a hadith except that he said, "I was with the Prophet ﷺ , and a branch was brought to him and he said, 'From among the trees, there is a tree similar to a Muslim man.' I intended to say, 'It is the date-palm tree,' but then I looked and saw that I was the shortest among the people, so I remained silent." Umar said, "I wish you had said it, and upon me is this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِحَدِيثٍ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَأُتِيَ بِجُمَّارٍ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ شَجَرًا مِثْلَ الرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ» فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَقُولَ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ فَنَظَرْتُ فَإِذَا أَنَا أَصْغَرُ الْقَوْمِ فَسَكَتُّ قَالَ عُمَرُ وَدِدْتُ أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَعَلَيَّ كَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Ṣaḥibt Ibn ʿUmar \u003e al-Madīnah Falam Asmaʿh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ يُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 291

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is a sign of a person's greatness and fear of God that he does not lie about others."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is a sign of a person's greatness and fear of God that he does not lie about others."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِعْظَامًا وَاتِّقَاءً أَنْ يَكْذِبَ عَلَيْهِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Khālid b. Yazīd al-Hadādī \u003e Ṣāliḥ al-Dahhān \u003e Mā \u003e Jābir b. Zayd \u003e Qaṭ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْهَدَادِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ الدَّهَّانُ قَالَ مَا سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ يَقُولُ قَطُّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 292

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Huraira came to Kaab to ask about him, and Kaab was among the people. Kaab asked, "What do you want from him?" Abu Huraira replied, "I do not know anyone among the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who has better memory of his statements than me." Kaab said, "Indeed, you will not find a seeker of something who does not become satisfied with it one day in his life, except for a seeker of knowledge or a seeker of the worldly life." Abu Huraira asked, "Are you Kaab?" He replied, "Yes." Abu Huraira then said, "I came for someone like you."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Huraira came to Kaab to ask about him, and Kaab was among the people. Kaab asked, "What do you want from him?" Abu Huraira replied, "I do not know anyone among the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who has better memory of his statements than me." Kaab said, "Indeed, you will not find a seeker of something who does not become satisfied with it one day in his life, except for a seeker of knowledge or a seeker of the worldly life." Abu Huraira asked, "Are you Kaab?" He replied, "Yes." Abu Huraira then said, "I came for someone like you."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ إِلَى كَعْبٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ وَكَعْبٌ فِي الْقَوْمِ فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ مَا تُرِيدُ مِنْهُ؟ فَقَالَ أَمَا إِنِّي لَا أَعْرِفُ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَحْفَظَ لِحَدِيثِهِ مِنِّي فَقَالَ كَعْبٌ أَمَا إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَجِدَ طَالِبَ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا سَيَشْبَعُ مِنْهُ يَوْمًا مِنَ الدَّهْرِ إِلَّا طَالِبَ عِلْمٍ أَوْ طَالِبَ دُنْيَا فَقَالَ أَنْتَ كَعْبٌ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ لِمِثْلِ هَذَا جِئْتُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Rawḥ \u003e Kahmas b. al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Shaqīq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنبَأَنَا رَوْحٌ عَنْ كَهْمَسِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 293

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, who is the most knowledgeable among the people?" He said, "The one who gathers the knowledge of the people to his own knowledge, and every seeker of knowledge is a branch extended towards knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, who is the most knowledgeable among the people?" He said, "The one who gathers the knowledge of the people to his own knowledge, and every seeker of knowledge is a branch extended towards knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَعْلَمُ؟ قَالَ «مَنْ جَمَعَ عِلْمَ النَّاسِ إِلَى عِلْمِهِ وَكُلُّ طَالِبِ عِلْمٍ غَرْثَانُ إِلَى عِلْمٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Bukayr \u003e Shibl \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Ṭāwus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شِبْلٌ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 294

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: A young man among the people said, "Overflow in the remembrance of Allah. May Allah bless you." Then the people looked at each other, wondering what they had seen. Then some of them asked, "Who commanded you to do this?" So, when you return, command us, and we will do the same."
hadiths.body: A young man among the people said, "Overflow in the remembrance of Allah. May Allah bless you." Then the people looked at each other, wondering what they had seen. Then some of them asked, "Who commanded you to do this?" So, when you return, command us, and we will do the same."
hadiths.arabic: شَابٌّ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْقَوْمِ أَفِيضُوا فِي ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيكُمْ فَنَظَرَ الْقَوْمُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ فِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ رَآنَا؟ ثُمَّ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ مَنْ أَمَرَكَ بِهَذَا؟ فَمُرْ لَئِنْ عُدْتَ لَنَفْعَلَنَّ وَلَنَفْعَلَنَّ
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e al-Khalīl b. Murrah \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Qurrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنِ الْخَلِيلِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ قَالَ كُنْتُ فِي حَلْقَةٍ فِيهَا الْمَشْيَخَةُ وَهُمْ يَتَرَاجَعُونَ فِيهِمْ عابدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 295

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ هَابَ الْفُتْيَا مَخَافَةَ السَّقَطِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fears danger?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah said, 'What a noble gathering it is, a gathering in which wisdom is spread and mercy is hoped for.'"
hadiths.body: "Abdullah said, 'What a noble gathering it is, a gathering in which wisdom is spread and mercy is hoped for.'"
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «نِعْمَ الْمَجْلِسُ مَجْلِسٌ تُنْشَرُ فِيهِ الْحِكْمَةُ وَتُرْجَى فِيهِ الرَّحْمَةُ»
hadiths.chain: Yūsuf b. Mūsá \u003e Abū ʿĀmir \u003e Qurrah b. Khālid \u003e ʿAwn b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَنبَأَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ أَنْبَأَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 296

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: from Abu Ad-Darda who said: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ when he raised his sight to the sky, then he said: 'This is the time when knowledge is to be taken from the people, until what remains of it shall not amount to anything." So Ziyad bin Labid Al-Ansari said: 'How will it be taken from us while we recite the Qur'an. By Allah we recite it, and our women and children recite it?' He ﷺ said: 'May you be bereaved of your mother O Ziyad! I used to consider you among the Fuqaha of the people of Al-Madinah. The Tawrah and Injil are with the Jews and Christians, but what do they avail of them?'" Jubair said: "So I met 'Ubadah bin As-Samit and said to him: 'Have you not heard what your brother Abu Ad-Darda said?' Then I informed him of what Abu Ad-Darda said. He said: 'Abu Ad-Darda spoke the truth. If you wish, we shall narrated to you about the first knowledge to be removed from the people: It is Khushu', soon you will enter the congregational Masjid, but not see any man in it with Khushu'.'"    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: from Abu Ad-Darda who said: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ when he raised his sight to the sky, then he said: 'This is the time when knowledge is to be taken from the people, until what remains of it shall not amount to anything." So Ziyad bin Labid Al-Ansari said: 'How will it be taken from us while we recite the Qur'an. By Allah we recite it, and our women and children recite it?' He ﷺ said: 'May you be bereaved of your mother O Ziyad! I used to consider you among the Fuqaha of the people of Al-Madinah. The Tawrah and Injil are with the Jews and Christians, but what do they avail of them?'" Jubair said: "So I met 'Ubadah bin As-Samit and said to him: 'Have you not heard what your brother Abu Ad-Darda said?' Then I informed him of what Abu Ad-Darda said. He said: 'Abu Ad-Darda spoke the truth. If you wish, we shall narrated to you about the first knowledge to be removed from the people: It is Khushu', soon you will enter the congregational Masjid, but not see any man in it with Khushu'.'"    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَشَخَصَ بِبَصَرِهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «هَذَا أَوَانُ يُخْتَلَسُ الْعِلْمُ مِنَ النَّاسِ حَتَّى لَا يَقْدِرُوا مِنْهُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ» فَقَالَ زِيَادُ بْنُ لَبِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَكَيْفَ يُخْتَلَسُ مِنَّا وَقَدْ قَرَأْنَا الْقُرْآنَ؟ فَوَاللَّهِ لَنَقْرَأَنَّهُ وَلَنُقْرِئَنَّهُ نِسَاءَنَا وَأَبْنَاءَنَا فَقَالَ «ثَكِلَتْكَ أُمُّكَ يَا زِيَادُ إِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَعُدُّكَ مِنْ فُقَهَاءِ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ هَذِهِ التَّوْرَاةُ وَالْإِنْجِيلُ عِنْدَ الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى فَمَاذَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ؟» قَالَ جُبَيْرٌ فَلَقِيتُ عُبَادَةَ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَلَا تَسْمَعُ مَا يَقُولُ أَخُوكَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ؟ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِالَّذِي قَالَ قَالَ صَدَقَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ إِنْ شِئْتَ لَأُحَدِّثَنَّكَ بِأَوَّلِ عِلْمٍ يُرْفَعُ مِنَ النَّاسِ الْخُشُوعُ يُوشِكُ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ مَسْجِدَ الْجَمَاعَةِ فَلَا تَرَى فِيهِ رَجُلًا خَاشِعًا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Muʿāwiyah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Jubayr b. Nufayr \u003e Abīh Jubyar b. Nufayr \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ جُبْيَرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 297

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The superiority of the scholar over the worshipper is like my superiority over the least among you." Then he recited this verse, "It is only those who have knowledge among His servants that fear Allah." [Fatir 28] Then he said, "Indeed, Allah and His angels, the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth, and even the fish in the sea pray for those who teach people goodness."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The superiority of the scholar over the worshipper is like my superiority over the least among you." Then he recited this verse, "It is only those who have knowledge among His servants that fear Allah." [Fatir 28] Then he said, "Indeed, Allah and His angels, the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth, and even the fish in the sea pray for those who teach people goodness."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَضْلُ الْعَالِمِ عَلَى الْعَابِدِ كَفَضْلِي عَلَى أَدْنَاكُمْ» ثُمَّ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ {إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ} [فاطر 28] ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ وَأَهْلَ سَمَاوَاتِهِ وَأَرَضِيهِ وَالنُّونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يُعَلِّمُونَ النَّاسَ الْخَيْرَ
hadiths.chain: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Walīd b. Jamīl al-Kinānī \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ الْكِنَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَكْحُولٌ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 298

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man is not considered knowledgeable until he does not envy those above him, does not belittle those below him, and does not seek a price for his knowledge."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "A man is not considered knowledgeable until he does not envy those above him, does not belittle those below him, and does not seek a price for his knowledge."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَكُونُ الرَّجُلُ عَالِمًا حَتَّى لَا يَحْسُدَ مَنْ فَوْقَهُ وَلَا يَحْقِرَ مَنْ دُونَهُ وَلَا يَبْتَغِيَ بِعِلْمِهِ ثَمَنًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Asad Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Yaḥyá b. Yamān \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth \u003e a man \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 299

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Abd al-A'la al-Taymi saying, "Whoever is given knowledge that does not make him cry, it is as if he has not been given knowledge at all, because Allah exalted the status of the scholars." Then he recited the verse from Surah Al-Isra (17:107) until the saying, "They will cry" (17:109).   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Abd al-A'la al-Taymi saying, "Whoever is given knowledge that does not make him cry, it is as if he has not been given knowledge at all, because Allah exalted the status of the scholars." Then he recited the verse from Surah Al-Isra (17:107) until the saying, "They will cry" (17:109).   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الْأَعْلَى التَّيْمِيَّ يَقُولُ مَنْ أُوتِيَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَا يُبْكِيهِ لَخَلِيقٌ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ أُوتِيَ عِلْمًا يَنْفَعُهُ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى نَعَتَ الْعُلَمَاءَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ {إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ} [الإسراء 107] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ {يَبْكُونَ} [الإسراء 109]   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Sulaymān \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Misʿar \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá al-Taymī \u003e Man Ūtī from al-ʿIlm Mā Lā Yubkīh Lakhalīq \u003e Lā Yakūn Ūtī ʿIlm Yanfaʿuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 300

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not be a scholar until you possess three qualities: do not seek superiority over others, do not belittle those beneath you, and do not use your knowledge for worldly gain."
hadiths.body: "Do not be a scholar until you possess three qualities: do not seek superiority over others, do not belittle those beneath you, and do not use your knowledge for worldly gain."
hadiths.arabic: لَا تَكُونُ عَالِمًا حَتَّى يَكُونَ فِيكَ ثَلَاثُ خِصَالٍ لَا تَبْغِي عَلَى مَنْ فَوْقَكَ وَلَا تَحْقِرُ مَنْ دُونَكَ وَلَا تَأْخُذُ عَلَى عِلْمِكَ دُنْيَا
hadiths.chain: ʿIṣmah b. al-Faḍl \u003e Zayd b. Ḥubāb \u003e Mubārak b. Faḍālah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar al-ʿUmarī \u003e Abū Ḥāzim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابٍ عَنْ مُبَارَكِ بْنِ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ الْعُمَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 301

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not consider yourself knowledgeable until you become a learner, and do not consider yourself knowledgeable in a subject until you apply it. It is enough sin for you to continue being argumentative. It is enough sin for you to continue being lazy. It is enough sin for you to continue being a liar by speaking about matters other than Allah Almighty."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not consider yourself knowledgeable until you become a learner, and do not consider yourself knowledgeable in a subject until you apply it. It is enough sin for you to continue being argumentative. It is enough sin for you to continue being lazy. It is enough sin for you to continue being a liar by speaking about matters other than Allah Almighty."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَكُونُ عَالِمًا حَتَّى تَكُونَ مُتَعَلِّمًا وَلَا تَكُونُ بِالْعِلْمِ عَالِمًا حَتَّى تَكُونَ بِهِ عَامِلًا وَكَفَى بِكَ إِثْمًا أَنْ لَا تَزَالَ مُخَاصِمًا وَكَفَى بِكَ إِثْمًا أَنْ لَا تَزَالَ مُمَارِيًا وَكَفَى بِكَ كَاذِبًا أَنْ لَا تَزَالَ مُحَدِّثًا فِي غَيْرِ ذَاتِ اللَّهِ ﷻ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Asad \u003e ʿAbthar \u003e Burd b. Sinān \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá al-Dimashqī \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْثَرٌ عَنْ بُرْدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى الدِّمَشْقِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 302

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: I once said to Al-Hasan regarding something he said, "O Abu Sa'id, this is not how jurists speak." He replied, "Woe onto you! Haven't you seen that a jurist is merely an ascetic in this world, desiring the hereafter, knowledgeable in religious affairs, and continuously dedicated to worshipping his Lord?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I once said to Al-Hasan regarding something he said, "O Abu Sa'id, this is not how jurists speak." He replied, "Woe onto you! Haven't you seen that a jurist is merely an ascetic in this world, desiring the hereafter, knowledgeable in religious affairs, and continuously dedicated to worshipping his Lord?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِلْحَسَنِ يَوْمًا فِي شَيْءٍ قَالَهُ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ لَيْسَ هَكَذَا يَقُولُ الْفُقَهَاءُ فَقَالَ «وَيْحَكَ وَرَأَيْتَ أَنْتَ فَقِيهًا قَطُّ إِنَّمَا الْفَقِيهُ الزَّاهِدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا الرَّاغِبُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ الْبَصِيرُ بِأَمْرِ دِينِهِ الْمُدَاوِمُ عَلَى عِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. ʿArafah \u003e al-Mubārak b. Saʿīd \u003e Akhīh Sufyān al-Thawrī \u003e ʿImrān al-Minqarī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ الْمِنْقَرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 303

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: He was asked, "Who is the most knowledgeable among the people of Medina?" He replied, "The one who fears his Lord the most, the Almighty and the Exalted."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He was asked, "Who is the most knowledgeable among the people of Medina?" He replied, "The one who fears his Lord the most, the Almighty and the Exalted."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قِيلَ لَهُ مَنْ أَفْقَهُ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ؟ قَالَ أَتْقَاهُمْ لِرَبِّهِ ﷻ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. ʿArafah \u003e al-Naḍr b. Ismāʿīl al-Bajalī \u003e Misʿar \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Qīl Lah Man Afqah Ahl al-Madīnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ الْبَجَلِيُّ عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 304

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The true scholar is the one who fears Allah the Almighty."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The true scholar is the one who fears Allah the Almighty."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّمَا الْفَقِيهُ مَنْ يَخَافُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. ʿArafah \u003e al-Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī \u003e Layth b. Abū Sulaym \u003e Mujāhid
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 305

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The true scholar is the one who does not despair people from the mercy of Allah, does not give them permission in committing sins, does not make them feel safe from the punishment of Allah, and does not divert them away from the Quran to other sources. Indeed, there is no goodness in worship that lacks knowledge and understanding, and there is no knowledge that lacks comprehension, and there is no recitation without reflection."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The true scholar is the one who does not despair people from the mercy of Allah, does not give them permission in committing sins, does not make them feel safe from the punishment of Allah, and does not divert them away from the Quran to other sources. Indeed, there is no goodness in worship that lacks knowledge and understanding, and there is no knowledge that lacks comprehension, and there is no recitation without reflection."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ الْفَقِيهَ حَقَّ الْفَقِيهِ مَنْ لَمْ يُقَنِّطِ النَّاسَ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يُرَخِّصْ لَهُمْ فِي مَعَاصِي اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يُؤَمِّنْهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَدَعِ الْقُرْآنَ رَغْبَةً عنْهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ إِنَّهُ لَا خَيْرَ فِي عِبَادَةٍ لَا عِلْمَ فِيهَا وَلَا عِلْمٍ لَا فَهْمَ فِيهِ وَلَا قِرَاءَةٍ لَا تَدَبُّرَ فِيهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Yaʿqūb al-Qummī \u003e Layth b. Abū Sulaym \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ibn ʿAbbād \u003e ʿAlī b. Abū Ṭālib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ الْقُمِّيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي لَيْثُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ عَبَّادٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 306

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ali is a scholar who is truly knowledgeable, and does not make people lose hope in the mercy of Allah, nor does he reassure them about the punishment of Allah. He does not permit them to commit sins against Allah. Indeed, there is no goodness in worship that lacks knowledge, and no goodness in knowledge that lacks understanding, and no goodness in recitation that lacks reflection."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Ali is a scholar who is truly knowledgeable, and does not make people lose hope in the mercy of Allah, nor does he reassure them about the punishment of Allah. He does not permit them to commit sins against Allah. Indeed, there is no goodness in worship that lacks knowledge, and no goodness in knowledge that lacks understanding, and no goodness in recitation that lacks reflection."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَلِيٌّ «الْفَقِيهُ حَقُّ الْفَقِيهِ الَّذِي لَا يُقَنِّطُ النَّاسَ مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ وَلَا يُؤَمِّنُهُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَا يُرَخِّصُ لَهُمْ فِي مَعَاصِي اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَا خَيْرَ فِي عِبَادَةٍ لَا عِلْمَ فِيهَا وَلَا خَيْرَ فِي عِلْمٍ لَا فَهْمَ فِيهِ وَلَا خَيْرَ فِي قِرَاءَةٍ لَا تَدَبُّرَ فِيهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. ʿArafah \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Layth \u003e Yaḥyá b. ʿAbbād
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَرَفَةَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 307

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I find a people who learn for other than action, and understand for other than worship, and seek the dunya (worldly life) through the actions of the hereafter, and wear the skins of sheep while their hearts are harder than stone. They deceive through me or they deceive me?" So, I swore by me I will make available to them a trial that will leave the patient confused in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I find a people who learn for other than action, and understand for other than worship, and seek the dunya (worldly life) through the actions of the hereafter, and wear the skins of sheep while their hearts are harder than stone. They deceive through me or they deceive me?" So, I swore by me I will make available to them a trial that will leave the patient confused in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنِّي لَأَجِدُ نَعْتَ قَوْمٍ يَتَعَلَّمُونَ لِغَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ وَيَتَفَقَّهُونَ لِغَيْرِ الْعِبَادَةِ وَيَطْلُبُونَ الدُّنْيَا بِعَمَلِ الْآخِرَةِ وَيَلْبَسُونَ جُلُودَ الضَّأْنِ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ أَمَرُّ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ فَبِي يَغْتَرُّونَ أَوْ إِيَّايَ يُخَادِعُونَ؟ فَحَلَفْتُ بِي لَأُتِيحَنَّ لَهُمْ فِتْنَةً تَتْرُكُ الْحَلِيمَ فِيهَا حَيْرَانَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yazīd b. Ḥāzim \u003e ʿAmmī Jarīr b. Zayd \u003e Tubayʿ \u003e Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَازِمٍ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي جَرِيرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ تُبَيْعًا يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ كَعْبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 308

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: He wrote to him, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, I swear by Allah that I intended nothing but good with it, for it to be an imam who speaks with knowledge and acts with immorality, so that he misleads people and leads them astray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He wrote to him, "O Amir al-Mu'minin, I swear by Allah that I intended nothing but good with it, for it to be an imam who speaks with knowledge and acts with immorality, so that he misleads people and leads them astray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ هَرِمٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَرَدْتُ بِهِ إِلَّا الْخَيْرَ يَكُونُ إِمَامٌ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِالْعِلْمِ وَيَعْمَلُ بِالْفِسْقِ فَيُشَبِّهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَيَضِلُّوا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿAbd al-Ṣamad al-ʿAmmī \u003e Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī \u003e Harim b. Ḥayyān \u003e Iyyākum And al-ʿĀlim al-Fāsiq Fabalagh ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb Fakatab Ilayh Waʾashfaq Minhā Mā al-ʿĀlim al-Fāsiq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ الْعَمِّيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ عَنْ هَرِمِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْعَالِمَ الْفَاسِقَ» فَبَلَغَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ وَأَشْفَقَ مِنْهَا مَا الْعَالِمُ الْفَاسِقُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 309

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever wants his religion to be honored, should not enter the presence of the ruler, should not spend time with women, and should not argue with people of desires."
hadiths.body: "Whoever wants his religion to be honored, should not enter the presence of the ruler, should not spend time with women, and should not argue with people of desires."
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُكْرَمَ دِينُهُ فَلَا يَدْخُلْ عَلَى السُّلْطَانِ وَلَا يَخْلُوَنَّ بِالنِّسْوَانِ وَلَا يُخَاصِمَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْأَهْوَاءِ»
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Walīd b. Muslim \u003e Muḥammad b. Muṭarrif And ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Ismāʿīl b. ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū al-Muhājir \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُطَرِّفٍ وَعَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُهَاجِرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 310

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: Maymun ibn Mihran wrote to me, "Beware of disputes and arguing about religion, and do not argue with a knowledgeable person or an ignorant person. As for the knowledgeable person, he will withhold his knowledge from you and not care about your actions. And as for the ignorant person, he will intimidate you and not obey you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Maymun ibn Mihran wrote to me, "Beware of disputes and arguing about religion, and do not argue with a knowledgeable person or an ignorant person. As for the knowledgeable person, he will withhold his knowledge from you and not care about your actions. And as for the ignorant person, he will intimidate you and not obey you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ مَيْمُونُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ إِيَّاكَ وَالْخُصُومَةَ وَالْجِدَالَ فِي الدِّينِ وَلَا تُجَادِلَنَّ عَالِمًا وَلَا جَاهِلًا أَمَّا الْعَالِمُ فَإِنَّهُ يَخْزُنُ عَنْكَ عِلْمَهُ وَلَا يُبَالِي مَا صَنَعْتَ وَأَمَّا الْجَاهِلُ فَإِنَّهُ يُخَشِّنُ بِصَدْرِكَ وَلَا يُطِيعُكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 311

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Solomon, son of David, peace be upon him, said to his son: 'Avoid disputes, for their benefits are little and they only ignite animosity among siblings.'"   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.body: "Solomon, son of David, peace be upon him, said to his son: 'Avoid disputes, for their benefits are little and they only ignite animosity among siblings.'"   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.arabic: سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ لِابْنِهِ «دَعِ الْمِرَاءَ فَإِنَّ نَفْعَهُ قَلِيلٌ وَهُوَ يُهَيِّجُ الْعَدَاوَةَ بَيْنَ الْإِخْوَانِ»   – ضعيف معضل
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 312

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Umar ibn Abdul Aziz saying, "Whoever makes their religion a subject of disputes, they will move frequently."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Umar ibn Abdul Aziz saying, "Whoever makes their religion a subject of disputes, they will move frequently."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ «يَقُولُ مَنْ جَعَلَ دِينَهُ غَرَضًا لِلْخُصُومَاتِ أَكْثَرَ التَّنَقُّلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Abū Ḥakīm \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 313

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "He who worships without knowledge, his actions will cause more harm than benefit. Whoever judges his words based on his actions, his words will be minimal except for what he means. And whoever uses his religion for disputes, his movements will be plentiful."
hadiths.body: "He who worships without knowledge, his actions will cause more harm than benefit. Whoever judges his words based on his actions, his words will be minimal except for what he means. And whoever uses his religion for disputes, his movements will be plentiful."
hadiths.arabic: أنَّهُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ كَانَ مَا يُفْسِدُ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا يُصْلِحُ وَمَنْ عَدَّ كَلَامَهُ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ قَلَّ كَلَامُهُ إِلَّا فِيمَا يَعْنِيهِ وَمَنْ جَعَلَ دِينَهُ غَرَضًا لِلْخُصُومَاتِ كَثُرَ تَنَقُّلُهُ»
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Katab ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Ahl al-Madīnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ قَالَ «كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 314

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الْعِلْمُ: الْخَشْيَةُ وَتَقْوَى اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Knowledge is fear and mindfulness of Allah"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Take the religion of the Bedouin and the young boy from the scholars, and keep away from anything else." Abu Muhammad said, "His movement (i.e. transferring of thoughts) is abundant, meaning he moves from one opinion to another."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: "Take the religion of the Bedouin and the young boy from the scholars, and keep away from anything else." Abu Muhammad said, "His movement (i.e. transferring of thoughts) is abundant, meaning he moves from one opinion to another."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: «عَلَيْكَ بِدِينِ الْأَعْرَابِيِّ وَالْغُلَامِ فِي الْكُتَّابِ وَالْهَ عَمَّا سِوَى ذَلِكَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ كَثُرَ تَنَقُّلُهُ أَيْ يَنْتَقِلُ مِنْ رَأْيٍ إِلَى رَأْيٍ   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Jaʿfar b. Burqān \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Saʾalah a man \u003e Shayʾ from al-Ahwāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ قَالَ سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنَ الْأَهْوَاءِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 315

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: "When you see a group of people producing something without consulting their leaders, they are laying the foundations of misguidance."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: "When you see a group of people producing something without consulting their leaders, they are laying the foundations of misguidance."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ «إِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا يُنْتِجُونَ بِأَمْرٍ دُونَ عَامَّتِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَلَى تَأْسِيسِ الضَّلَالَةِ»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 316

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: The English translation of the provided text is: "What do you tempt the children of Adam with, O Satan?" They replied, "We tempt them with everything." Satan said, "Do you tempt them with seeking forgiveness?" They said, "Never! That is something they associate with faith in God." Satan said, "I will stay among them and encourage them towards desires that they will not seek forgiveness for from Allah." So, he spread among them worldly desires.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The English translation of the provided text is: "What do you tempt the children of Adam with, O Satan?" They replied, "We tempt them with everything." Satan said, "Do you tempt them with seeking forgiveness?" They said, "Never! That is something they associate with faith in God." Satan said, "I will stay among them and encourage them towards desires that they will not seek forgiveness for from Allah." So, he spread among them worldly desires.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِبْلِيسُ لِأَوْلِيَائِهِ مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ تَأْتُونَ بَنِي آدَمَ؟ فَقَالُوا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَالَ فَهَلْ تَأْتُونَهُمْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ؟ فَقَالُوا هَيْهَاتَ ذَاكَ شَيْءٌ قُرِنَ بِالتَّوْحِيدِ قَالَ لَأَبُثَّنَّ فِيهِمْ شَيْئًا لَا يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ مِنْهُ قَالَ فَبَثَّ فِيهِمُ الْأَهْوَاءَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e al-Awzāʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 317

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: I do not know which of the two blessings is greater upon me, whether it is being guided to Islam or being protected from these desires.
hadiths.body: I do not know which of the two blessings is greater upon me, whether it is being guided to Islam or being protected from these desires.
hadiths.arabic: مَا أَدْرِي أَيُّ النِّعْمَتَيْنِ عَلَيَّ أَعْظَمُ أَنْ هَدَانِي لِلْإِسْلَامِ أَوْ عَافَانِي مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأَهْوَاءِ
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Muḥāribī \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Mā Adrī Ay al-Niʿmatayn ʿAlay Aʿẓam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 318

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: A man who fasted all his life and spent his whole life in worship, then was killed between the corner (of the Ka'bah) and the Station (of Ibrahim). Allah will gather him on the Day of Resurrection with those whom it is perceived were upon guidance."
hadiths.body: A man who fasted all his life and spent his whole life in worship, then was killed between the corner (of the Ka'bah) and the Station (of Ibrahim). Allah will gather him on the Day of Resurrection with those whom it is perceived were upon guidance."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا صَامَ الدَّهْرَ كُلَّهُ وَقَامَ الدَّهْرَ كُلَّهُ ثُمَّ قُتِلَ بَيْنَ الرُّكْنِ وَالْمَقَامِ لَحَشَرَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ مَنْ يُرَى أَنَّهُ كَانَ عَلَى هُدًى»
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Muslim al-Aʿwar \u003e Ḥabbah b. Jūwayn \u003e ʿAlī or \u003e ʿAlī Law
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ الْأَعْوَرِ عَنْ حَبَّةَ بْنِ جُوَيْنٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا أَوْ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ «لَوْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 319

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: Salman said, "If a man places his head on the Black Stone and fasts during the day and stands in prayer at night, Allah will raise him up on the Day of Resurrection with his desire."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Salman said, "If a man places his head on the Black Stone and fasts during the day and stands in prayer at night, Allah will raise him up on the Day of Resurrection with his desire."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَلْمَانُ «لَوْ وَضَعَ رَجُلٌ رَأْسَهُ عَلَى الْحَجَرِ الْأَسْوَدِ فَصَامَ النَّهَارَ وَقَامَ اللَّيْلَ لَبَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ هَوَاهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Hārūn \u003e Ibn al-Mughīrah \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e Abū Ṣādiq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَادِقٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 320

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali, be like the bee among people, for there is nothing in birds that does not belittle it. If birds knew the blessings within their innards, they would not do this to it. Mix with people with your tongues, bodies, and enrich them with your actions and hearts. Indeed, a person will have what he has earned, and he will be on the Day of Judgment with those whom he loves.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ali, be like the bee among people, for there is nothing in birds that does not belittle it. If birds knew the blessings within their innards, they would not do this to it. Mix with people with your tongues, bodies, and enrich them with your actions and hearts. Indeed, a person will have what he has earned, and he will be on the Day of Judgment with those whom he loves.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَلِيٌّ كُونُوا فِي النَّاسِ كَالنَّحْلَةِ فِي الطَّيْرِ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ شَيْءٌ إِلَّا وَهُوَ يَسْتَضْعِفُهَا وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُ الطَّيْرُ مَا فِي أَجْوَافِهَا مِنَ الْبَرَكَةِ لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا ذَلِكَ بِهَا خَالِطُوا النَّاسَ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَجْسَادِكُمْ وَزَايِلُوهُمْ بِأَعْمَالِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِكُمْ فَإِنَّ لِلْمَرْءِ مَا اكْتَسَبَ وَهُوَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ مَنْ أَحَبَّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibn Abū al-Aswad \u003e al-Ḥārith b. Ḥaṣīrah \u003e Abū Ṣādiq al-Azdī \u003e Rabīʿah b. Nājidh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ حَصِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي صَادِقٍ الْأَزْدِيِّ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ نَاجِذٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 321

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: "Yes, the Minister of Knowledge is a good opinion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Yes, the Minister of Knowledge is a good opinion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نِعْمَ وَزِيرُ الْعِلْمِ الرَّأْيُ الْحَسَنُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنِي بَقِيَّةُ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 322

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: "To be pleased with his knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To be pleased with his knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُعْجَبَ بِعِلْمِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Muslim \u003e Masrūq \u003e Kafá Bi-al-Marʾ ʿIlm \u003e Yakhshá Allāh And Kafá Bi-al-Marʾ Jahl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ قَالَ «كَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ عِلْمًا أَنْ يَخْشَى اللَّهَ وَكَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ جَهْلًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 323

chapter.englishTitle: In the vicinity of desires

hadiths.englishRaw: "To have private gatherings where he mentions his sins and seeks forgiveness from Allah Almighty for them."
hadiths.body: "To have private gatherings where he mentions his sins and seeks forgiveness from Allah Almighty for them."
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ مَجَالِسُ يَخْلُو فِيهَا فَيَذْكُرُ ذُنُوبَهُ فَيَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى مِنْهَا»
hadiths.chain: Masrūq al-Marʾ Ḥaqīq
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ وَقَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ «الْمَرْءُ حَقِيقٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 324

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ إِذَا أَصَابَ الْمَعْنَى
chapter.englishTitle: Who permitted speaking when the meaning is understood

hadiths.englishRaw: "When we inform you about the meaning of the event, it is sufficient for you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When we inform you about the meaning of the event, it is sufficient for you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا حَدَّثْنَاكُمْ بِالْحَدِيثِ عَلَى مَعْنَاهُ فَحَسْبُكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Maʿn \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Makḥūl \u003e Wāthilah b. al-Asqaʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنِي مَعْنٌ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الْأَسْقَعِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 325

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ إِذَا أَصَابَ الْمَعْنَى
chapter.englishTitle: Who permitted speaking when the meaning is understood

hadiths.englishRaw: "He would neither hasten nor delay when he spoke, and Al-Hasan would both precede and postpone when he spoke."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He would neither hasten nor delay when he spoke, and Al-Hasan would both precede and postpone when he spoke."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا حَدَّثَ لَمْ يُقَدِّمْ وَلَمْ يُؤَخِّرْ وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ إِذَا حَدَّثَ قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿĀṣim b. Yūsuf \u003e Fuḍayl b. ʿIyāḍ \u003e Hishām \u003e Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 326

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ إِذَا أَصَابَ الْمَعْنَى
chapter.englishTitle: Who permitted speaking when the meaning is understood

hadiths.englishRaw: Al-Hasan used to speak with one original saying, while conversations differed.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Al-Hasan used to speak with one original saying, while conversations differed.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ الْحَسَنُ يُحَدِّثُ بِالْحَدِيثِ الْأَصْلُ وَاحِدٌ وَالْكَلَامُ مُخْتَلِفٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Jarīr b. Ḥāzim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 327
