chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ إِذَا أَصَابَ الْمَعْنَى
chapter.englishTitle: Who permitted speaking when the meaning is understood

hadiths.englishRaw: He (Ibn Umar) said the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The example of the hypocrite is like a sheep between two Rabad (pasture) or between two flocks." So Ibn Umar said, "No, he said this and that," and whenever he heard the Prophet ﷺ , he did not add or subtract anything from it, nor did he exceed it or fall short of it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He (Ibn Umar) said the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The example of the hypocrite is like a sheep between two Rabad (pasture) or between two flocks." So Ibn Umar said, "No, he said this and that," and whenever he heard the Prophet ﷺ , he did not add or subtract anything from it, nor did he exceed it or fall short of it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عنه قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ مَثَلُ الشَّاةِ بَيْنَ الرَّبْضَيْنِ أَوْ بَيْنَ الْغَنَمَيْنِ» فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَا إِنَّمَا قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ إِذَا سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ لَمْ يَزِدْ فِيهِ وَلَمْ يُنْقِصْ مِنْهُ وَلَمْ يُجَاوِزْهُ وَلَمْ يُقَصِّرْ عَنْهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥammad b. Sūqah \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn \u003e Ḥaddath ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar Rḍy Allāh ʿNh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَ عُبَيْدُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 328

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ إِذَا أَصَابَ الْمَعْنَى
chapter.englishTitle: Who permitted speaking when the meaning is understood

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, if they spoke of it as they heard it, it would have been better for them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, if they spoke of it as they heard it, it would have been better for them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَمَا إِنَّهُمْ لَوْ حَدَّثُوا بِهِ كَمَا سَمِعُوهُ كَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Ibn ʿAwn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ قَالَ كَانَ الشَّعْبِيُّ وَالنَّخَعِيُّ وَالْحَسَنُ يُحَدِّثُونَ بِالْحَدِيثِ مَرَّةً هَكَذَا وَمَرَّةً هَكَذَا فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 329

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ إِذَا أَصَابَ الْمَعْنَى
chapter.englishTitle: Who permitted speaking when the meaning is understood

hadiths.englishRaw: "I do not listen to the conversation musically, so I insist on following what I have heard."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I do not listen to the conversation musically, so I insist on following what I have heard."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَأَسْمَعُ الْحَدِيثَ لَحْنًا فَأَلْحَنُ اتِّبَاعًا لِمَا سَمِعْتُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e ʿAthhām \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿUmārah b. ʿUmayr \u003e Abū Maʿmar \u003e Innī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا عَثَّامٌ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ قَالَ «إِنِّي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 330

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: Mujahid saw a peacock in his dream, as if he was praying in the Kaaba, and the Prophet ﷺ was at the door of the Kaaba. He said to him, "O Abdullah, remove your mask and show your recitation." He said, "So it seemed that he understood this as a sign that he expanded in the conversation afterward."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Mujahid saw a peacock in his dream, as if he was praying in the Kaaba, and the Prophet ﷺ was at the door of the Kaaba. He said to him, "O Abdullah, remove your mask and show your recitation." He said, "So it seemed that he understood this as a sign that he expanded in the conversation afterward."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَى مُجَاهِدٌ طاوُوسًا فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّهُ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ يُصَلِّي مُتَقَنِّعًا وَالنَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَلَى بَابِ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ «يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اكْشِفْ قِنَاعَكَ وَأَظْهِرْ قِرَاءَتَكَ» قَالَ «فَكَأَنَّهُ عَبَّرَهُ عَلَى الْعِلْمِ فَانْبَسَطَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Maysarah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 331

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "The world is cursed, cursed except for a person who learns good or teaches it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The world is cursed, cursed except for a person who learns good or teaches it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الدُّنْيَا مَلْعُونَةٌ مَلْعُونٌ مَا فِيهَا إِلَّا مُتَعَلِّمَ خَيْرٍ أَوْ مُعَلِّمَهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Yamān \u003e Ibn Thawbān from his father \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Ḍamrah \u003e Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ يَمَانٍ عَنِ ابْنِ ثَوْبَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ عَنْ كَعْبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 332

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: People are ˹of two types˺: the scholar and the student, and between that is ignorance, with no goodness in it.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: People are ˹of two types˺: the scholar and the student, and between that is ignorance, with no goodness in it.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «النَّاسُ عَالِمٌ وَمُتَعَلِّمٌ وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ هَمَجٌ لَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Baḥīr b. Saʿd \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ بَحِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 333

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: They used to say, "The death of a scholar is a gap in Islam that cannot be filled. No matter the difference between night and day,".   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: They used to say, "The death of a scholar is a gap in Islam that cannot be filled. No matter the difference between night and day,".   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ «مَوْتُ الْعَالِمِ ثُلْمَةٌ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ لَا يَسُدُّهَا شَيْءٌ مَا اخْتَلَفَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Rajāʾ \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 334

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "A gathering in which knowledge is disputed is more beloved to me than the amount of salah (prayer) I can perform. Perhaps someone will hear a word and benefit from it for a year or for the rest of their life."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A gathering in which knowledge is disputed is more beloved to me than the amount of salah (prayer) I can perform. Perhaps someone will hear a word and benefit from it for a year or for the rest of their life."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَجْلِسٌ يُتَنَازَعُ فِيهِ الْعِلْمُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ قَدْرِهِ صَلَاةً لَعَلَّ أَحَدَهُمْ يَسْمَعُ الْكَلِمَةَ فَيَنْتَفِعُ بِهَا سَنَةً أَوْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yūsuf b. Mūsá \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṣanʿānī \u003e Mundhir \u003e Ibn al-Nuʿmān \u003e Wahbb. Munabbih
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَنبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُنْذِرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 335

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: Sufyan said, "I do not know of a better action than seeking knowledge and preserving it for those whom Allah wishes good for."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Sufyan said, "I do not know of a better action than seeking knowledge and preserving it for those whom Allah wishes good for."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ «مَا أَعْلَمُ عَمَلًا أَفْضَلَ مِنْ طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ وَحِفْظِهِ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بِهِ خَيْرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wakīʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنبَأَنَا وَكِيعٌ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 336

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: And (he) said, Hasan ibn Salih said, "Indeed, people are in need of this knowledge in their religion, as they are in need of food and drink in their worldly life."
hadiths.body: And (he) said, Hasan ibn Salih said, "Indeed, people are in need of this knowledge in their religion, as they are in need of food and drink in their worldly life."
hadiths.arabic: وقَالَ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ «إِنَّ النَّاسَ لَيَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَى هَذَا الْعِلْمِ فِي دِينِهِمْ كَمَا يَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَى الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ فِي دُنْيَاهُمْ»
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. Ṣāliḥ In

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 337

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Darda said, "Learn before knowledge is taken away, because the taking away of knowledge is the taking away of scholars. And the scholar and the learner are equal in reward."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Darda said, "Learn before knowledge is taken away, because the taking away of knowledge is the taking away of scholars. And the scholar and the learner are equal in reward."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ «تَعَلَّمُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْبَضَ الْعِلْمُ فَإِنَّ قَبْضَ الْعِلْمِ قَبْضُ الْعُلَمَاءِ وَإِنَّ الْعَالِمَ وَالْمُتَعَلِّمَ فِي الْأَجْرِ سَوَاءٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym And Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Misʿar \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ Taʿallamūā Qabl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 338

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: About Dahhak, he said, "But be scholars of the divine law because of what you have been teaching from the scripture." [Al-Imran 79]. He said, "It is obligatory upon everyone who reads the Qur'an to be knowledgeable."
hadiths.body: About Dahhak, he said, "But be scholars of the divine law because of what you have been teaching from the scripture." [Al-Imran 79]. He said, "It is obligatory upon everyone who reads the Qur'an to be knowledgeable."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ {وَلَكِنْ كُونُوا رَبَّانِيِّينَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ الْكِتَابَ} [آل عمران 79] قَالَ «حَقٌّ عَلَى كُلِّ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فَقِيهًا»
hadiths.chain: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e Abū ʿAbdullāh al-Khurāsānī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 339

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Hasan, if it weren't for the religious scholars and the scribes prohibiting them [the people], Al-Hasan said, "The wise scholars."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Hasan, if it weren't for the religious scholars and the scribes prohibiting them [the people], Al-Hasan said, "The wise scholars."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ {لَوْلَا يَنْهَاهُمُ الرَّبَّانِيُّونَ وَالْأَحْبَارُ} [المائدة 63] قَالَ «الْحُكَمَاءُ الْعُلَمَاءُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e Ashʿath b. Sawwār \u003e al-Ḥasan Lawlā Yanhāhum al-Rabbāniyyūn And al-Aḥbār al-Māʾdh 63
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سَوَّارٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 340

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: Sa'id ibn Jubayr said, "{Be devoutly obedient to Allah}" [Surah Al-Imran 79]. He further stated, "Scholars of jurisprudence."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Sa'id ibn Jubayr said, "{Be devoutly obedient to Allah}" [Surah Al-Imran 79]. He further stated, "Scholars of jurisprudence."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ {كُونُوا رَبَّانِيِّينَ} [آل عمران 79] قَالَ «عُلَمَاءُ فُقَهَاءُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 341

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah say, "Knowledge requires preservation, action, listening, attentiveness, and dissemination."
hadiths.body: I heard Sufyan ibn 'Uyaynah say, "Knowledge requires preservation, action, listening, attentiveness, and dissemination."
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عُيَيْنَةَ يَقُولُ «يُرَادُ لِلْعِلْمِ الْحِفْظُ وَالْعَمَلُ وَالِاسْتِمَاعُ وَالْإِنْصَاتُ وَالنَّشْرُ»
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 342

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "The most ignorant of people are those who abandon what they know, and the most knowledgeable of people are those who act upon what they know, and the best of people are those who are most humble before Allah, the Almighty."
hadiths.body: "The most ignorant of people are those who abandon what they know, and the most knowledgeable of people are those who act upon what they know, and the best of people are those who are most humble before Allah, the Almighty."
hadiths.arabic: «أَجْهَلُ النَّاسِ مَنْ تَرَكَ مَا يَعْلَمُ وَأَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِمَا يَعْلَمُ وَأَفْضَلُ النَّاسِ أَخْشَعَهُمْ لِلَّهِ ﷻ»
hadiths.chain: Wʾkhbrny Muḥammad Abū ʿAbdullāh \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ وأخْبرني مُحَمَّدٌ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 343

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: Those who are obsessed are never satisfied: (1) those who are obsessed with ˹sacred and salvific˺ knowledge are never satisfied with it, and (2) those who are obsessed with worldly possessions are never satisfied with them. So, whoever makes the hereafter his concern, and devotes himself to it and focuses on it, Allah will take care of his worldly affairs, and He will put contentment in his heart. But whoever makes this world his concern, and devotes himself to it and focuses on it, Allah will expose his ruin, and He will make him ˹obsess over˺ his needs: such that he will not wake up except as a needy person, and he will not reach evening ˹while having pursued his needs˺ except as a needy person ˹anxious, feeling unfulfilled˺.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Those who are obsessed are never satisfied: (1) those who are obsessed with ˹sacred and salvific˺ knowledge are never satisfied with it, and (2) those who are obsessed with worldly possessions are never satisfied with them. So, whoever makes the hereafter his concern, and devotes himself to it and focuses on it, Allah will take care of his worldly affairs, and He will put contentment in his heart. But whoever makes this world his concern, and devotes himself to it and focuses on it, Allah will expose his ruin, and He will make him ˹obsess over˺ his needs: such that he will not wake up except as a needy person, and he will not reach evening ˹while having pursued his needs˺ except as a needy person ˹anxious, feeling unfulfilled˺.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَنْهُومَانِ لَا يَشْبَعَانِ مَنْهُومٌ فِي الْعِلْمِ لَا يَشْبَعُ مِنْهُ وَمَنْهُومٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَا يَشْبَعُ مِنْهَا فَمَنْ تَكُنِ الْآخِرَةُ هَمَّهُ وَبَثَّهُ وَسَدَمَهُ يَكْفِي اللَّهُ ضَيْعَتَهُ وَيَجْعَلُ غِنَاهُ فِي قَلْبِهِ وَمَنْ تَكُنِ الدُّنْيَا هَمَّهُ وَبَثَّهُ وَسَدَمَهُ يُفْشِي اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ضَيْعَتَهُ وَيَجْعَلُ فَقْرَهُ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ ثُمَّ لَا يُصْبِحُ إِلَّا فَقِيرًا وَلَا يُمْسِي إِلَّا فَقِيرًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar al-Raqqī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Zayd \u003e Ibn Abū Unaysah \u003e Sayyār \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ زَيْدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ عَنْ سَيَّارٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 344

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: The one who possesses knowledge and the one who possesses worldly possessions are not equal, and both of them cannot be satisfied. As for the person of knowledge, their contentment with the Merciful (Allah) increases. But as for the person of the world, they indulge in transgression. Then Abdullah recited, "No! Indeed, man transgresses because he sees himself self-sufficient." (Quran, Surah Al-Alaq: 7) Someone else said, "Indeed, only the scholars fear Allah among His servants." (Quran, Surah Fatir: 28)   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: The one who possesses knowledge and the one who possesses worldly possessions are not equal, and both of them cannot be satisfied. As for the person of knowledge, their contentment with the Merciful (Allah) increases. But as for the person of the world, they indulge in transgression. Then Abdullah recited, "No! Indeed, man transgresses because he sees himself self-sufficient." (Quran, Surah Al-Alaq: 7) Someone else said, "Indeed, only the scholars fear Allah among His servants." (Quran, Surah Fatir: 28)   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَنْهُومَانِ لَا يَشْبَعَانِ صَاحِبُ الْعِلْمِ وَصَاحِبُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَسْتَوِيَانِ أَمَّا صَاحِبُ الْعِلْمِ فَيَزْدَادُ رِضًا لِلرَّحْمَنِ وَأَمَّا صَاحِبُ الدُّنْيَا فَيَتَمَادَى فِي الطُّغْيَانِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ {كَلَّا إِنَّ الْإِنْسَانَ لَيَطْغَى أَنْ رَآهُ اسْتَغْنَى} [العلق 7] قَالَ وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ {إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ} [فاطر 28]   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Abū ʿUmays \u003e ʿAwn \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا أَبُو عُمَيْسٍ عَنْ عَوْنٍ قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 345

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "Who fears Allah is knowledgeable."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Who fears Allah is knowledgeable."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: {إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ} [فاطر 28] قَالَ «مَنْ خَشِيَ اللَّهَ فَهُوَ عَالِمٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Mukhtār \u003e ʿAnbasah b. al-Azhar \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Innamā Yakhshá Allāh from ʿIbādih al-ʿUlamāʾ Fāṭr 28
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْبَسَةُ بْنُ الْأَزْهَرِ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 346

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: They are both never satisfied, the student of knowledge and the student of worldly affairs.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: They are both never satisfied, the student of knowledge and the student of worldly affairs.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَنْهُومَانِ لَا يَشْبَعَانِ طَالِبُ عِلْمٍ وَطَالِبُ دُنْيَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs \u003e Layth \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 347

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever seeks knowledge and attains it, will have a specific portion of reward. And if he does not attain it, he will have a portion of reward."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever seeks knowledge and attains it, will have a specific portion of reward. And if he does not attain it, he will have a portion of reward."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ فَأَدْرَكَهُ كَانَ لَهُ كِفْلَانِ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكْهُ كَانَ لَهُ كِفْلٌ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Yazīd b. Rabīʿah al-Ṣanʿānī \u003e Rabīʿah b. Yazīd \u003e Wāthilah b. al-Asqaʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ وَاثِلَةَ بْنَ الْأَسْقَعِ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 348

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet Dawud (pbuh) used to say in his supplication, 'Glory be to You, O Allah, You are my Lord, the Most Exalted above Your Throne, and You have made Your awe upon everyone in the heavens and the earth, and Your closest creation to You is the one who fears You the most, and what knowledge does one have who does not fear You? And what wisdom does one have who does not obey Your command?'"
hadiths.body: "The Prophet Dawud (pbuh) used to say in his supplication, 'Glory be to You, O Allah, You are my Lord, the Most Exalted above Your Throne, and You have made Your awe upon everyone in the heavens and the earth, and Your closest creation to You is the one who fears You the most, and what knowledge does one have who does not fear You? And what wisdom does one have who does not obey Your command?'"
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ دَاوُدَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُعَائِهِ «سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي تَعَالَيْتَ فَوْقَ عَرْشِكَ وَجَعَلْتَ خَشْيَتَكَ عَلَى مَنْ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَأَقْرَبُ خَلْقِكَ مِنْكَ مَنْزِلَةً أَشَدُّهُمْ لَكَ خَشْيَةً وَمَا عِلْمُ مَنْ لَمْ يَخْشَكَ؟ وَمَا حِكْمَةُ مَنْ لَمْ يُطِعْ أَمْرَكَ؟»
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Marwān b. Muʿāwiyah \u003e ʿAwf \u003e ʿAbbās al-ʿAmmī \u003e Balaghanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْعَمِّيِّ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 349

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah bin Mas'ud said, 'Tomorrow, be either a scholar or a student, for there is no good in anything else.'"   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah bin Mas'ud said, 'Tomorrow, be either a scholar or a student, for there is no good in anything else.'"   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ «اغْدُ عَالِمًا أَوْ مُتَعَلِّمًا وَلَا خَيْرَ فِيمَا سِوَاهُمَا»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Sallām \u003e Ibn Abū Muṭīʿ \u003e Abū al-Hazhāz \u003e al-Ḍaḥḥāk
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْهَزْهَازِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 350

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: “There will be tribulation in which a man will be a believer in the morning and a disbeliever by evening, except the one to whom Allah grants knowledge.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: “There will be tribulation in which a man will be a believer in the morning and a disbeliever by evening, except the one to whom Allah grants knowledge.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «سَتَكُونُ فِتَنٌ يُصْبِحُ الرَّجُلُ فِيهَا مُؤْمِنًا وَيُمْسِي كَافِرًا إِلَّا مَنْ أَحْيَاهُ اللَّهُ بِالْعِلْمِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd b. Muslim \u003e al-Walīd b. Sulaymān \u003e ʿAlī b. Yazīd \u003e al-Qāsim Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Umāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ أَنبَأَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 351

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "He used to say, 'Seek knowledge, whether you are a scholar or a student. Do not seek knowledge in between these two, for that is ignorance. Indeed, the angels spread their wings for the person seeking knowledge out of contentment with what they do.'"
hadiths.body: "He used to say, 'Seek knowledge, whether you are a scholar or a student. Do not seek knowledge in between these two, for that is ignorance. Indeed, the angels spread their wings for the person seeking knowledge out of contentment with what they do.'"
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «اغْدُ عَالِمًا أَوْ مُتَعَلِّمًا وَلَا تَغْدُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّ مَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ جَاهِلٌ وَإِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَبْسُطُ أَجْنِحَتَهَا لِلرَّجُلِ غَدَا يَبْتَغِي الْعِلْمَ مِنَ الرِّضَا بِمَا يَصْنَعُ»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Hārūn b. Rʾāb \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ رئَابٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 352

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about two men from the Children of Israel. One of them was a scholar who would pray the obligatory prayers and then sit and teach people goodness. The other would fast during the day and stand in prayer during the night. Which of them is better? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The superiority of the scholar who prays the obligatory prayers and then sits teaching people goodness over the worshipper who fasts during the day and stands in prayer during the night is like my superiority over the most inferior among you."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about two men from the Children of Israel. One of them was a scholar who would pray the obligatory prayers and then sit and teach people goodness. The other would fast during the day and stand in prayer during the night. Which of them is better? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The superiority of the scholar who prays the obligatory prayers and then sits teaching people goodness over the worshipper who fasts during the day and stands in prayer during the night is like my superiority over the most inferior among you."
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ رَجُلَيْنِ كَانَا فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَحَدُهُمَا كَانَ عَالِمًا يُصَلِّي الْمَكْتُوبَةَ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فَيُعَلِّمُ النَّاسَ الْخَيْرَ وَالْآخَرُ يَصُومُ النَّهَارَ وَيَقُومُ اللَّيْلَ أَيُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَضْلُ هَذَا الْعَالِمِ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي الْمَكْتُوبَةَ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فَيُعَلِّمُ النَّاسَ الْخَيْرَ عَلَى الْعَابِدِ الَّذِي يَصُومُ النَّهَارَ وَيَقُومُ اللَّيْلَ كَفَضْلِي عَلَى أَدْنَاكُمْ رَجُلًا»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 353

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: I entered the mosque and saw Al-Aswad bin Suray' narrating and Humaid bin Abdul Rahman mentioning knowledge in one corner of the mosque. So, I inclined towards which of them should I sit with. I felt sleepy, then someone approached me and said, "Towards which of them did you incline to sit? If you wish, I can show you the place where Gabriel ﷺ used to sit from Humaid bin Abdul Rahman."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I entered the mosque and saw Al-Aswad bin Suray' narrating and Humaid bin Abdul Rahman mentioning knowledge in one corner of the mosque. So, I inclined towards which of them should I sit with. I felt sleepy, then someone approached me and said, "Towards which of them did you incline to sit? If you wish, I can show you the place where Gabriel ﷺ used to sit from Humaid bin Abdul Rahman."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَإِذَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ سُرَيْعٍ يَقُصُّ وَحُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَذْكُرُ الْعِلْمَ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَمَيَّلْتُ إِلَى أَيِّهِمَا أَجْلِسُ فَنَعَسْتُ فَأَتَانِي آتٍ فَقَالَ مَيَّلْتَ إِلَى أَيِّهِمَا تَجْلِسُ؟ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَرَيْتُكَ مَكَانَ جِبْرَائِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ مِنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbaydullāh \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Dhakwān \u003e Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 354

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was sitting with Abu Darda' in the mosque of Damascus when a man came to him and said: 'O Abu Darda', I have come to you from Al-Madinah, the city of the Messenger of Allah, for a Hadith which I have heard that you narrate from the Prophet.' He said: 'Did you not come for trade?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'Did you not come for anything else?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah say: "Whoever follows a path in the pursuit of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise. The angels lower their wings in approval of the seeker of knowledge, and everyone in the heavens and on earth prays for forgiveness for the seeker of knowledge, even the fish in the sea. The superiority of the scholar over the worshipper is like the superiority of the moon above all other heavenly bodies. The scholars are the heirs of the Prophets, for the Prophets did not leave behind a Dinar or Dirham, rather they left behind knowledge, so whoever takes it has taken a great share.'"    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I was sitting with Abu Darda' in the mosque of Damascus when a man came to him and said: 'O Abu Darda', I have come to you from Al-Madinah, the city of the Messenger of Allah, for a Hadith which I have heard that you narrate from the Prophet.' He said: 'Did you not come for trade?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'Did you not come for anything else?' He said: 'No.' He said: 'I heard the Messenger of Allah say: "Whoever follows a path in the pursuit of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise. The angels lower their wings in approval of the seeker of knowledge, and everyone in the heavens and on earth prays for forgiveness for the seeker of knowledge, even the fish in the sea. The superiority of the scholar over the worshipper is like the superiority of the moon above all other heavenly bodies. The scholars are the heirs of the Prophets, for the Prophets did not leave behind a Dinar or Dirham, rather they left behind knowledge, so whoever takes it has taken a great share.'"    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي مَسْجِدِ دِمَشْقَ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُكَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ مَدِينَةِ الرَّسُولِ ﷺ لِحَدِيثٍ بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ تُحَدِّثُهُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فَمَا جَاءَ بِكَ تِجَارَةٌ؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ وَلَا جَاءَ بِكَ غَيْرُهُ؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ بِهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا مِنْ طُرُقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَتَضَعُ أَجْنِحَتَهَا رِضًا لِطَالِبِ الْعِلْمِ وَإِنَّ طَالِبَ الْعِلْمِ لَيَسْتَغْفِرُ لَهُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ حَتَّى الْحِيتَانُ فِي الْمَاءِ وَإِنَّ فَضْلَ الْعَالِمِ عَلَى الْعَابِدِ كَفَضْلِ الْقَمَرِ عَلَى سَائِرِ النُّجُومِ إِنَّ الْعُلَمَاءَ هُمْ وَرَثَةُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ إِنَّ الْأَنْبِيَاءَ لَمْ يُوَرِّثُوا دِينَارًا وَلَا دِرْهَمًا وَإِنَّمَا وَرَّثُوا الْعِلْمَ فَمَنْ أَخَذَ بِهِ أَخَذَ بِحَظِّهِ أَوْ بِحَظٍّ وَافِرٍ »   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Naṣr b. ʿAlī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dāwud \u003e ʿĀṣim b. Rajāʾ b. Ḥaywah \u003e Dāwud b. Jamīl \u003e Kathīr b. Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ رَجَاءِ بْنِ حَيْوَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 355

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "The teacher of goodness is forgiven by everything, even the whale in the sea."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "The teacher of goodness is forgiven by everything, even the whale in the sea."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مُعَلِّمُ الْخَيْرِ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لَهُ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى الْحُوتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Shimr b. ʿAṭiyyah \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ شِمْرِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 356

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: If anyone pursues a path in search of knowledge, Allah will thereby make easy for him a path to paradise; and he who is made slow by his actions will not be speeded by his genealogy.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: If anyone pursues a path in search of knowledge, Allah will thereby make easy for him a path to paradise; and he who is made slow by his actions will not be speeded by his genealogy.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا مِنْ رَجُلٍ يَسْلُكُ طَرِيقًا يَطْلُبُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا إِلَّا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ أَبْطَأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 357

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: A man who traverses a road seeking knowledge, Allah will make it easy for him to reach Paradise through it. And whoever hinders his efforts, his lineage will not make him hasten.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man who traverses a road seeking knowledge, Allah will make it easy for him to reach Paradise through it. And whoever hinders his efforts, his lineage will not make him hasten.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا سَلَكَ رَجُلٌ طَرِيقًا يَبْتَغِي فِيهِ الْعِلْمَ إِلَّا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ يُبْطِئْ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Yaʿqūb \u003e al-Qqummī \u003e Hārūn b. ʿAntarah from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ هُوَ الْقُّمِّيُّ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ عَنْتَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 358

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: About rain, "And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?" [Al-Qamar 17] He said, "Is there anyone who seeks goodness that I may guide him towards it?"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About rain, "And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?" [Al-Qamar 17] He said, "Is there anyone who seeks goodness that I may guide him towards it?"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: {وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ} [القمر 17] قَالَ «هَلْ مِنْ طَالِبِ خَيْرٍ فَيُعَانَ عَلَيْهِ؟»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Ibn Shawdhab \u003e Maṭar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شَوْذَبٍ عَنْ مَطَرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 359

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "Student of knowledge"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Student of knowledge"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «طالبُ عِلمٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Ḍmrh
hadiths.chainArabic: وأخْبرنا مرْوانُ عنْ ضمْرةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 360

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Darda used to say "Welcome to the students of knowledge" when he saw them, and he used to say, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ advised and encouraged you."
hadiths.body: Abu Darda used to say "Welcome to the students of knowledge" when he saw them, and he used to say, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ advised and encouraged you."
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ إِذَا رَأَى طَلَبَةَ الْعِلْمِ قَالَ مَرْحَبًا بِطَلَبَةِ الْعِلْمِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَوْصَى بِكُمْ
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Yaʿqūb \u003e al-Qummī \u003e ʿĀmir b. Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ هُوَ الْقُمِّيُّ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 361

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by two gatherings in his mosque and said, 'Both of them are good, and one of them is better than the other. As for these people, they supplicate to Allah and seek His blessings. If He wills, He grants their requests, and if He wills, He withholds them. As for these people, they learn jurisprudence and knowledge, and they teach the ignorant. They are the best, as I have been sent as a teacher.' Then he sat among them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by two gatherings in his mosque and said, 'Both of them are good, and one of them is better than the other. As for these people, they supplicate to Allah and seek His blessings. If He wills, He grants their requests, and if He wills, He withholds them. As for these people, they learn jurisprudence and knowledge, and they teach the ignorant. They are the best, as I have been sent as a teacher.' Then he sat among them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَرَّ بِمَجْلِسَيْنِ فِي مَسْجِدِهِ فَقَالَ «كِلَاهُمَا عَلَى خَيْرٍ وَأَحَدُهُمَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ أَمَّا هَؤُلَاءِ فَيَدْعُونَ اللَّهَ وَيَرْغَبُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَإِنْ شَاءَ أَعْطَاهُمْ وَإِنْ شَاءَ مَنَعَهُمْ وَأَمَّا هَؤُلَاءِ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ الْفِقْهَ والعلمَ وَيُعَلِّمُونَ الْجَاهِلَ فَهُمْ أَفْضَلُ وَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ مُعَلِّمًا» قَالَ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ فِيهِمْ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ziyād b. Anʿum \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Rāfiʿ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَنْعُمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 362

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: He said to his son, "O my son, indeed knowledge is better than action."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He said to his son, "O my son, indeed knowledge is better than action."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِابْنِهِ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنَّ «الْعِلْمَ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e ʿAwn b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Muṭarrif b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Shikhhīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 363

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard Aba Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli say, "There is no better gift than a word of wisdom that you give to your brother."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard Aba Abd al-Rahman al-Hubuli say, "There is no better gift than a word of wisdom that you give to your brother."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيَّ يَقُولُ «لَيْسَ هَدِيَّةٌ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ كَلِمَةِ حِكْمَةٍ تُهْدِيهَا لِأَخِيكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah \u003e Shuraḥbīl b. Sharīk \u003e Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Ḥubulī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا شُرَحْبِيلُ بْنُ شَرِيكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 364

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "The superiority of a knowledgeable person over a diligent person is one hundred degrees, which is equivalent to five hundred years of the presence of an illuminated Persian stallion."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "The superiority of a knowledgeable person over a diligent person is one hundred degrees, which is equivalent to five hundred years of the presence of an illuminated Persian stallion."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «فَضْلُ الْعَالِمِ عَلَى الْمُجْتَهِدِ مِائَةُ دَرَجَةٍ مَا بَيْنَ الدَّرَجَتَيْنِ خَمْسُ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ حُضْرُ الْفَرَسِ الْمُضَمَّرِ السَّرِيعِ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿImrān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Yamān \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAjlān \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 365

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: Allah raises those who have been given knowledge above those who believe by degrees.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Allah raises those who have been given knowledge above those who believe by degrees.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: {يَرْفَعُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنْكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ} [المجادلة 11] قَالَ يَرْفَعُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِدَرَجَاتٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah \u003e al-Sakan b. Abū Karīmah \u003e ʿIkrimah a freed slave of Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Yarfaʿ Allāh al--Adhīn Āmanūā Minkum And al--Adhīn Ūtūā al-ʿIlm Darajāt al-Mjādlh 11
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي السَّكَنُ بْنُ أَبِي كَرِيمَةَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 366

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “When death comes while ones in seeking knowledge to revive Islam there is but one rank between him and the Prophets in Jannah.”   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “When death comes while ones in seeking knowledge to revive Islam there is but one rank between him and the Prophets in Jannah.”   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ جَاءَهُ الْمَوْتُ وَهُوَ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِيُحْيِيَ بِهِ الْإِسْلَامَ فَبَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ النَّبِيِّينَ دَرَجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. Thābit al-Bazzār \u003e Naṣr b. al-Qāsim \u003e Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿAmr b. Kathīr \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْبَزَّارُ حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 367

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umar's knowledge decreased by two thirds," I said to Ibrahim. He replied, "Umar's knowledge decreased by nine tenths."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Umar's knowledge decreased by two thirds," I said to Ibrahim. He replied, "Umar's knowledge decreased by nine tenths."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ذَهَبَ عُمَرُ بِثُلُثَيِ الْعِلْمِ» قَالَ فَذَكَرْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ فَقَالَ «ذَهَبَ عُمَرُ بِتِسْعَةِ أَعْشَارِ الْعِلْمِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Mihrān \u003e Abū Sinān \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAmr b. Maymūn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مِهْرَانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 368

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whenever a group of people gather in one of the houses of Allah to study and discuss the Book of Allah among themselves, the angels lower their wings in humility and tranquility. They encompass them with their wings until they are immersed in their discussions. If someone traverses a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes their path to Paradise easy. And those whose actions are slow in progressing, their lineage will not hasten them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whenever a group of people gather in one of the houses of Allah to study and discuss the Book of Allah among themselves, the angels lower their wings in humility and tranquility. They encompass them with their wings until they are immersed in their discussions. If someone traverses a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes their path to Paradise easy. And those whose actions are slow in progressing, their lineage will not hasten them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتَذَاكَرُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلَّا أَظَلَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا حَتَّى يَخُوضُوا فِي حَدِيثٍ غَيْرِهِ وَمَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَبْتَغِي بِهِ الْعِلْمَ سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ طَرِيقَهُ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ أَبْطَأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. Thābit \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yazīd Abū Khālid \u003e Hārūn from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ أَنبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 369

chapter.englishTitle: Virtue of Knowledge and the Scholar

hadiths.englishRaw: "What brought you here?" I said, "The pursuit of knowledge." He said, "Should I not give you glad tidings?" I said, "Yes." So he raised the conversation to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and said, "Indeed, the angels lower their wings for the seeker of knowledge, pleased with what he seeks."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "What brought you here?" I said, "The pursuit of knowledge." He said, "Should I not give you glad tidings?" I said, "Yes." So he raised the conversation to the Prophet, peace be upon him, and said, "Indeed, the angels lower their wings for the seeker of knowledge, pleased with what he seeks."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا جَاءَ بِكَ؟ قُلْتُ ابْتِغَاءُ الْعِلْمِ قَالَ أَلَا أُبَشِّرُكَ؟ قُلْتُ بَلَى فَقَالَ رَفَعَ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَالَ «إِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَتَضَعُ أَجْنِحَتَهَا لِطَالِبِ الْعِلْمِ رِضًا بِمَا يَطْلُبُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibn Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Zir \u003e Ghadawt \u003e Ṣafwān b. ʿAssāl al-Murādī \u003e Urīd \u003e Asʾalah \u003e al-Masḥ \u003e al-Khuffayn \u003e Mā Jāʾ Bik Qult Ābtighāʾ al-ʿIlm \u003e Alā Ubashhiruk Qult Balá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ زِرٍّ قَالَ غَدَوْتُ عَلَى صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَسَّالٍ الْمُرَادِيِّ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَهُ عَنِ الْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 370

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ بِغَيْرِ نِيَّةٍ فَرَدَّهُ الْعِلْمُ إِلَى النِّيَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever seeks knowledge without intention, knowledge returns to ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The request for conversation today was not better than it. They (the people) said to Sufyan, 'Indeed, they seek it without intent?' He said, 'Their seeking it is with intent.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The request for conversation today was not better than it. They (the people) said to Sufyan, 'Indeed, they seek it without intent?' He said, 'Their seeking it is with intent.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا كَانَ طَلَبُ الْحَدِيثِ أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ الْيَوْمَ» قَالُوا لِسُفْيَانَ إِنَّهُمْ يَطْلُبُونَهُ بِغَيْرِ نِيَّةٍ؟ قَالَ «طَلَبُهُمْ إِيَّاهُ نِيَّةٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿImrān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Yamān \u003e Sufyān Mundh Arbaʿīn Sanah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ مُنْذُ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 371

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ بِغَيْرِ نِيَّةٍ فَرَدَّهُ الْعِلْمُ إِلَى النِّيَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever seeks knowledge without intention, knowledge returns to ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "We have sought this knowledge, and we do not have a great intention in it. Then Allah provided us with the intention."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "We have sought this knowledge, and we do not have a great intention in it. Then Allah provided us with the intention."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «طَلَبْنَا هَذَا الْعِلْمَ وَمَا لَنَا فِيهِ كَبِيرُ نِيَّةٍ ثُمَّ رَزَقَ اللَّهُ بَعْدُ فِيهِ النِّيَّةَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ajlaḥ from my father \u003e Mujāhid
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْأَجْلَحِ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 372

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ بِغَيْرِ نِيَّةٍ فَرَدَّهُ الْعِلْمُ إِلَى النِّيَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever seeks knowledge without intention, knowledge returns to ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "People have sought knowledge for the sake of Allah and not for what they can gain from it. He (the Prophet) said, 'Knowledge has remained with them until they sought it for the sake of Allah and not for what they can gain from it.'"
hadiths.body: "People have sought knowledge for the sake of Allah and not for what they can gain from it. He (the Prophet) said, 'Knowledge has remained with them until they sought it for the sake of Allah and not for what they can gain from it.'"
hadiths.arabic: «لَقَدْ طَلَبَ أَقْوَامٌ الْعِلْمَ مَا أَرَادُوا بِهِ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى وَلَا مَا عِنْدَهُ» قَالَ «فَمَا زَالَ بِهِمُ الْعِلْمُ حَتَّى أَرَادُوا بِهِ اللَّهَ وَمَا عِنْدَهُ»
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. Thābit al-Bazzār \u003e Ḥassān b. Muslim \u003e Yūnus b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْبَزَّارُ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 373

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Muslim al-Khawlanī said, "The scholars are of three types: a man who lived in his knowledge and the people lived with him in it, a man who lived in his knowledge and no one lived with him in it, and a man who people lived in his knowledge and he was confused by it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Muslim al-Khawlanī said, "The scholars are of three types: a man who lived in his knowledge and the people lived with him in it, a man who lived in his knowledge and no one lived with him in it, and a man who people lived in his knowledge and he was confused by it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيُّ «الْعُلَمَاءُ ثَلَاثَةٌ فَرَجُلٌ عَاشَ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَعَاشَ مَعَهُ النَّاسُ فِيهِ وَرَجُلٌ عَاشَ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَلَمْ يَعِشْ مَعَهُ فِيهِ أَحَدٌ وَرَجُلٌ عَاشَ النَّاسُ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَكَانَ وَبَالًا عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 374

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Prophet Musa ﷺ asked his Lord, "O Lord, who among your servants is the most fair in judgment?" He replied, "The one who judges people as he judges himself." Musa ﷺ asked, "O Lord, who among your servants is the richest?" He replied, "Those whom I have satisfied with what I have given them." Musa ﷺ asked, "O Lord, who among your servants is the most fearful of you?" He replied, "Those who know me the best."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Prophet Musa ﷺ asked his Lord, "O Lord, who among your servants is the most fair in judgment?" He replied, "The one who judges people as he judges himself." Musa ﷺ asked, "O Lord, who among your servants is the richest?" He replied, "Those whom I have satisfied with what I have given them." Musa ﷺ asked, "O Lord, who among your servants is the most fearful of you?" He replied, "Those who know me the best."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَا رَبِّ أَيُّ عِبَادِكَ أَحْكَمُ؟ قَالَ الَّذِي يَحْكُمُ لِلنَّاسِ كَمَا يَحْكُمُ لِنَفْسِهِ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ أَيُّ عِبَادِكَ أَغْنَى؟ قَالَ أَرْضَاهُمْ بِمَا قَسَمْتُ لَهُ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ أَيُّ عِبَادِكَ أَخْشَى لَكَ؟ قَالَ أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِي   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Mūsá ʿAlayh al-Salām Yā Rab Ay ʿIbādik Aḥkam \u003e al--Adhī Yaḥkum Lilnnās Kamā Yaḥkum Linafsih \u003e Yā Rab Ay ʿIbādik Aghná \u003e Arḍāhum Bimā Qasamt Lah \u003e Yā Rab Ay ʿIbādik Akhshá Lak
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 375

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said that there are three types of scholars: a scholar who fears Allah but is not well-versed in His commands, a scholar who fears Allah and is knowledgeable about His commands, and that is the perfect scholar, and a scholar who is knowledgeable about His commands but does not fear Allah, and that is the corrupt scholar.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said that there are three types of scholars: a scholar who fears Allah but is not well-versed in His commands, a scholar who fears Allah and is knowledgeable about His commands, and that is the perfect scholar, and a scholar who is knowledgeable about His commands but does not fear Allah, and that is the corrupt scholar.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ الْعُلَمَاءُ ثَلَاثَةٌ عَالِمٌ بِاللَّهِ يَخْشَى اللَّهَ لَيْسَ بِعَالِمٍ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ وَعَالِمٌ بِاللَّهِ عَالِمٌ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ يَخْشَى اللَّهَ فَذَاكَ الْعَالِمُ الْكَامِلُ وَعَالِمٌ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ لَيْسَ بِعَالِمٍ بِاللَّهِ لَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ فَذَلِكَ الْعَالِمُ الْفَاجِرُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ قَالَ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 376

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Knowledge is of two types: knowledge in the heart, and knowledge on the tongue. Knowledge in the heart is beneficial knowledge, and knowledge on the tongue is the evidence of Allah over the son of Adam.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Knowledge is of two types: knowledge in the heart, and knowledge on the tongue. Knowledge in the heart is beneficial knowledge, and knowledge on the tongue is the evidence of Allah over the son of Adam.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: الْعِلْمُ عِلْمَانِ فَعِلْمٌ فِي الْقَلْبِ فَذَلِكَ الْعِلْمُ النَّافِعُ وَعِلْمٌ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ فَذَلِكَ حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Makkī b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 377

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: This hadith has been narrated oif the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This hadith has been narrated oif the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿĀṣim b. Yūsuf \u003e Fuḍayl b. ʿIyāḍ \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عِيَاضٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 378

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "Learn, learn, and when you have learned, act."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Learn, learn, and when you have learned, act."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَعَلَّمُوا تَعَلَّمُوا فَإِذَا عَلِمْتُمْ فَاعْمَلُوا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ziyād \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 379

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Whoever seeks knowledge for four purposes: to enter into Hell, to boast to scholars, to mock fools, to turn people's faces towards him, or to manipulate rulers.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Whoever seeks knowledge for four purposes: to enter into Hell, to boast to scholars, to mock fools, to turn people's faces towards him, or to manipulate rulers.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ لِأَرْبَعٍ دَخَلَ النَّارَ أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَةِ لِيُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ أَوْ لِيُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ أَوْ لِيَصْرِفَ بِهِ وُجُوهَ النَّاسِ إِلَيْهِ أَوْ لِيَأْخُذَ بِهِ مِنَ الْأُمَرَاءِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿUbayd al-Qāsim b. Sallām \u003e Abū Ismāʿīl \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Sulaymān al-Muʾaddib \u003e ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal \u003e Man \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْمَاعِيلَ هُوَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْمُؤَدِّبُ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ مَنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 380

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the words of Jesus, peace be upon him, you work for the world and you are provided for in it without any effort, and you do not work for the hereafter and you are not provided for in it except by your deeds! Woe to you, evil scholars who take rewards and waste deeds! The Lord of deeds is about to demand his own work, and you are about to leave this vast world for the darkness of the grave and its narrowness. Allah forbids you from sins as He commanded you to pray and fast. How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they become angry with their sustenance and belittle their position, knowing that it is from the knowledge and power of Allah? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they accuse Allah of what He has decreed for them and is not pleased with what afflictions have befallen them? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they prioritize their worldly life over their hereafter, when they are in this world with a greater desire? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if their destination is towards their hereafter, while they are inclined towards their worldly life and what harms them is more delicious or beloved to them than what benefits them? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they seek knowledge only to inform others of it, and not to act upon it?"   – Weak, Problematic

How can someone be considered knowledgeable if their destination is towards their hereafter, while they are inclined towards their worldly life and what harms them is more delicious or beloved to them than what benefits them? How can someone be considered knowledgeable if they seek knowledge only to inform others of it, and not to act upon it?"   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ مِنْ كَلَامِ عِيسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ تَعْمَلُونَ لِلدُّنْيَا وَأَنْتُمْ تُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ عَمَلٍ وَلَا تَعْمَلُونَ لِلْآخِرَةِ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا إِلَّا بِالْعَمَلِ ويلَّكمْ عُلَمَاءَ السَّوْءِ الْأَجْرَ تَأْخُذُونَ وَالْعَمَلَ تُضَيِّعُونَ يُوشِكُ رَبُّ الْعَمَلِ أَنْ يَطْلُبَ عَمَلَهُ وَتُوشِكُونَ أَنْ تَخْرُجُوا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا الْعَرِيضَةِ إِلَى ظُلْمَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَضِيقِهِ اللَّهُ ينهاكمْ عَنِ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا أَمَرَكُمْ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالصِّيَامِ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنْ سَخِطَ رِزْقَهُ وَاحْتَقَرَ مَنْزِلَتَهُ وَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمِ اللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ؟ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنِ اتَّهَمَ اللَّهَ فِيمَا قَضَى لَهُ فَلَيْسَ يَرْضَى شَيْئًا أَصَابَهُ؟ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنْ دُنْيَاهُ آثَرُ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ آخِرَتِهِ وَهُوَ فِي الدُّنْيَا أَفْضَلُ رَغْبَةً؟ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنْ مَصِيرُهُ إِلَى آخِرَتِهِ وَهُوَ مُقْبِلٌ عَلَى دُنْيَاهُ وَمَا يَضُرُّهُ أَشْهَى إِلَيْهِ أَوْ قَالَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا يَنْفَعُهُ؟ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْكَلَامَ لِيُخْبِرَ بِهِ وَلَا يَطْلُبُهُ لِيَعْمَلَ بِهِ؟   – ضعيف معضل
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hishām Ṣāḥib al-Dastawāʾī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ قَالَ قَرَأْتُ فِي كِتَابٍ بَلَغَنِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 381

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said, "Learn knowledge and benefit from it, and do not learn it for the purpose of showing off, for it is very likely that if your life span is prolonged, the person with knowledge will show off with his knowledge just as the person with a fine garment shows off with his garment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said, "Learn knowledge and benefit from it, and do not learn it for the purpose of showing off, for it is very likely that if your life span is prolonged, the person with knowledge will show off with his knowledge just as the person with a fine garment shows off with his garment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ «تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ وَانْتَفِعُوا بِهِ وَلَا تَعَلَّمُوهُ لِتَتَجَمَّلُوا بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُوشِكُ إِنْ طَالَ بِكُمْ عُمُرٌ أَنْ يَتَجَمَّلَ ذُو الْعِلْمِ بِعِلْمِهِ كَمَا يَتَجَمَّلُ ذُو الْبِزَّةِ بِبِزَّتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Ḥarīz \u003e Ḥabīb b. ʿUbayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيزٌ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 382

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ about evil, and he replied "Do not ask me about evil, but ask me about goodness" and he repeated this three times. Then he said, "Indeed, the worst of evil is the evil of scholars, and the best of goodness is the goodness of scholars."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ about evil, and he replied "Do not ask me about evil, but ask me about goodness" and he repeated this three times. Then he said, "Indeed, the worst of evil is the evil of scholars, and the best of goodness is the goodness of scholars."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنِ الشَّرِّ فَقَالَ «لَا تَسْأَلُونِي عَنِ الشَّرِّ وَاسْأَلُونِي عَنِ الْخَيْرِ يَقُولُهَا ثَلَاثًا» ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَلَا إِنَّ شَرَّ الشَّرِّ شِرَارُ الْعُلَمَاءِ وَإِنَّ خَيْرَ الْخَيْرِ خِيَارُ الْعُلَمَاءِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e al-Aḥwaṣ b. Ḥakīm from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ عَنِ الْأَحْوَصِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 383

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Sha'abi saying that the seeking of this knowledge was only for those who possess two qualities: intellect and devotion. If someone is devoted but lacks intellect, he would say, "This is a matter that only the wise pursue," and he would not seek it. And if someone is intelligent but lacks devotion, he would say, "This is a matter that only the devout pursue," and he would not seek it. Then Sha'abi said, "I was afraid that today someone who possesses neither of these qualities would seek it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Sha'abi saying that the seeking of this knowledge was only for those who possess two qualities: intellect and devotion. If someone is devoted but lacks intellect, he would say, "This is a matter that only the wise pursue," and he would not seek it. And if someone is intelligent but lacks devotion, he would say, "This is a matter that only the devout pursue," and he would not seek it. Then Sha'abi said, "I was afraid that today someone who possesses neither of these qualities would seek it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَطْلُبُ هَذَا الْعِلْمَ مَنِ اجْتَمَعَتْ فِيهِ خَصْلَتَانِ الْعَقْلُ وَالنُّسُكُ فَإِنْ كَانَ نَاسِكًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ عَاقِلًا قَالَ هَذَا أَمْرٌ لَا يَنَالُهُ إِلَّا الْعُقَلَاءُ فَلَمْ يَطْلُبْهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَاقِلًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ نَاسِكًا قَالَ هَذَا أَمْرٌ لَا يَنَالُهُ إِلَّا النُّسَّاكُ فَلَمْ يَطْلُبْهُ فَقَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ وَلَقَدْ رَهِبْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ يَطْلُبُهُ الْيَوْمَ مَنْ لَيْسَتْ فِيهِ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْهُمَا لَا عَقْلٌ وَلَا نُسُكٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Ḥumayd b. al-Aswad \u003e ʿĪsá \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عِيسَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 384

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: The sentence translates to: "The man did not seek knowledge until he had worshipped for forty years before that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The sentence translates to: "The man did not seek knowledge until he had worshipped for forty years before that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ الرَّجُلُ لَا يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ حَتَّى يَتَعَبَّدَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Zaʿam Lī Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ قَالَ زَعَمَ لِي سُفْيَانُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 385

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever seeks knowledge in order to argue with the foolish, or to show off before the scholars, or to attract people's attention, will be in Hell."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever seeks knowledge in order to argue with the foolish, or to show off before the scholars, or to attract people's attention, will be in Hell."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ لِيُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ وَلِيُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ أَوْ لِيَصْرِفَ بِهِ وُجُوهَ النَّاسِ إِلَيْهِ فَهُوَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Burd b. Sinān Abū al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ بُرْدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 386

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever seeks knowledge in order to argue with the foolish, or to show off before the scholars, or to attract people's attention, Allah will admit him to Hell.'"
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever seeks knowledge in order to argue with the foolish, or to show off before the scholars, or to attract people's attention, Allah will admit him to Hell.'"
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ لِيُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ أَوْ لِيُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ أَوْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُقْبِلَ بِوُجُوهِ النَّاسِ إِلَيْهِ أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ جَهَنَّمَ»
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Bisṭām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e al-Nuʿmān \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنِي النُّعْمَانُ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 387

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "The speech of a person is guarded according to his intention."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The speech of a person is guarded according to his intention."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّمَا يُحْفَظُ حَدِيثُ الرَّجُلِ عَلَى قَدْرِ نِيَّتِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Yamān \u003e al-Minhāl b. Khalīfah \u003e Maṭar al-Warrāq \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَمَانٍ عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ عَنْ مَطَرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 388

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: To me, Abdullah says,"Verily, I reckon that a man forgetting knowledge that he knew is a sin that he commits."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: To me, Abdullah says,"Verily, I reckon that a man forgetting knowledge that he knew is a sin that he commits."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «إِنِّي لَأَحْسَبُ الرَّجُلَ يَنْسَى الْعِلْمَ كَانَ يَعْلَمُهُ لِلْخَطِيئَةِ كَانَ يَعْمَلُهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e al-Qāsim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 389

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Luqman the wise used to say to his son, "Oh my son, do not seek knowledge in order to show off to the scholars, to challenge the foolish, or to impress people in gatherings. And do not abandon knowledge out of arrogance and desire for ignorance. Oh my son, choose your companions wisely. If you see a group of people remembering God, then sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will teach you. Perhaps Allah will bless you with His mercy through them and grant you their righteousness. But if you see a group of people who do not remember God, then do not sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will not benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will increase you in ignorance. Perhaps Allah will expose them to punishment, and you will befall the same fate."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Luqman the wise used to say to his son, "Oh my son, do not seek knowledge in order to show off to the scholars, to challenge the foolish, or to impress people in gatherings. And do not abandon knowledge out of arrogance and desire for ignorance. Oh my son, choose your companions wisely. If you see a group of people remembering God, then sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will teach you. Perhaps Allah will bless you with His mercy through them and grant you their righteousness. But if you see a group of people who do not remember God, then do not sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will not benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will increase you in ignorance. Perhaps Allah will expose them to punishment, and you will befall the same fate."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ لُقْمَانَ الْحَكِيمَ كَانَ يَقُولُ لِابْنِهِ «يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَعَلَّمِ الْعِلْمَ لِتُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ أَوْ لِتُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ أَوْ تُرَائِيَ بِهِ فِي الْمَجَالِسِ وَلَا تَتْرُكِ الْعِلْمَ زُهْدًا فِيهِ وَرَغْبَةً فِي الْجَهَالَةِ يَا بُنَيَّ اخْتَرِ الْمَجَالِسَ عَلَى عَيْنِكَ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَاجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تَكُنْ عَالِمًا يَنْفَعْكَ عِلْمُكَ وَإِنْ تَكُنْ جَاهِلًا يُعَلِّمُوكَ وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ فَيُصِيبَكَ بِهَا مَعَهُمْ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَلَا تَجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ تَكُنْ عَالِمًا لَا يَنْفَعْكَ عِلْمُكَ وَإِنْ تَكُنْ جَاهِلًا زَادُوكَ غَيًّا وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِعَذَابٍ فَيُصِيبَكَ مَعَهُمْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah \u003e Ibn Abū Ḥusayn \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e Balaghanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 390

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not speak falsehood in front of the wise, as they will despise you. Do not speak wisdom to the foolish, as they will deny you. Do not prevent knowledge from those who deserve it, for you would commit a sin. And do not place it in the hands of those who are not qualified, as you would be disregarded. Know that you have a responsibility towards your knowledge, just as you have a responsibility towards your wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not speak falsehood in front of the wise, as they will despise you. Do not speak wisdom to the foolish, as they will deny you. Do not prevent knowledge from those who deserve it, for you would commit a sin. And do not place it in the hands of those who are not qualified, as you would be disregarded. Know that you have a responsibility towards your knowledge, just as you have a responsibility towards your wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تُحَدِّثِ الْبَاطِلَ الْحُكَمَاءَ فَيَمْقُتُوكَ وَلَا تُحَدِّثِ الْحِكْمَةَ لِلسُّفَهَاءِ فَيُكَذِّبُوكَ وَلَا تَمْنَعِ الْعِلْمَ أَهْلَهُ فَتَأْثَمَ وَلَا تَضَعْهُ فِي غَيْرِ أَهْلِهِ فَتُجَهَّلَ إِنَّ عَلَيْكَ فِي عِلْمِكَ حَقًّا كَمَا أَنَّ عَلَيْكَ فِي مَالِكَ حَقًّا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yūsuf b. Mūsá \u003e Isḥāq b. Sulaymān \u003e Ḥarīz \u003e Salmān b. Sumayr \u003e Kathīr b. Murrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَرِيزٌ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ سُمَيْرٍ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 391

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "It benefits."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "It benefits."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ يَنْفَعُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Muʿāwiyah \u003e Abū Farwah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ أَنَّ أَبَا فَرْوَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «لَا تَمْنَعِ الْعِلْمَ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ فَتَأْثَمَ وَلَا تَنْشُرْهُ عِنْدَ غَيْرِ أَهْلِهِ فَتُجَهَّلَ وَكُنْ طَبِيبًا رَفِيقًا يَضَعُ دَوَاءَهُ حَيْثُ يَعْلَمُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 392

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not feed your food to those who do not desire it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not feed your food to those who do not desire it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تُطْعِمْ طَعَامَكَ مَنْ لَا يَشْتَهِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Mahdī \u003e Ghaylān \u003e Muṭarrif
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيٌّ عَنْ غَيْلَانَ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 393

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "Luqman said to his son: 'O my son, do not seek knowledge to boast to the scholars, argue with the ignorant, show off in gatherings, or abandon knowledge in arrogance and desire for ignorance. And when you see people who do not remember Allah, sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will teach you. Perhaps Allah will guide them through His mercy and you will be blessed with it too. And when you see people who do not remember Allah, do not sit with them. If you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will not benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will increase you in deviation and heedlessness. Perhaps Allah will reveal His displeasure upon them and you will be affected with them.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Luqman said to his son: 'O my son, do not seek knowledge to boast to the scholars, argue with the ignorant, show off in gatherings, or abandon knowledge in arrogance and desire for ignorance. And when you see people who do not remember Allah, sit with them, for if you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will teach you. Perhaps Allah will guide them through His mercy and you will be blessed with it too. And when you see people who do not remember Allah, do not sit with them. If you are knowledgeable, your knowledge will not benefit you, and if you are ignorant, they will increase you in deviation and heedlessness. Perhaps Allah will reveal His displeasure upon them and you will be affected with them.'"   – Sound Chain
