hadiths.arabic: لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ «يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَعَلَّمِ الْعِلْمَ لِتُبَاهِيَ بِهِ الْعُلَمَاءَ وتُمَارِيَ بِهِ السُّفَهَاءَ وَتُرَائِيَ بِهِ فِي الْمَجَالِسِ وَلَا تَتْرُكِ الْعِلْمَ زَهَادَةً فِيهِ وَرَغْبَةً فِي الْجَهَالَةِ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا لا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَاجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ إِنْ تَكُ عَالِمًا يَنْفَعْكَ عِلْمُكَ وَإِنْ تَكُ جَاهِلًا عَلَّمُوكَ وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِرَحْمَتِهِ فَيُصِيبَكَ بِهَا مَعَهُمْ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ قَوْمًا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ فَلَا تَجْلِسْ مَعَهُمْ إِنْ تَكُ عَالِمًا لَمْ يَنْفَعْكَ عِلْمُكَ وَإِنْ تَكُ جَاهِلًا زَادُوكَ غَيًّا أَوْ عِيًّا وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِسَخَطٍ فَيُصِيبَكَ بِهِ مَعَهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Dāwud b. Shābūr \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ شَابُورَ سَمِعَ شَهْرَ بْنَ حَوْشَبٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 394

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "O holders of knowledge, act upon it, for true scholars are those who act upon what they know and align their actions with their knowledge. There will be people who possess knowledge but their actions do not reach the level of their knowledge. Their behavior contradicts their knowledge and their true intentions differ from what they display. They sit in gatherings to show off, competing with one another, to the extent that a person might get angry if their companion sits with someone else. Those individuals' deeds do not ascend to the heavens, rather they are presented to Allah the Almighty."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "O holders of knowledge, act upon it, for true scholars are those who act upon what they know and align their actions with their knowledge. There will be people who possess knowledge but their actions do not reach the level of their knowledge. Their behavior contradicts their knowledge and their true intentions differ from what they display. They sit in gatherings to show off, competing with one another, to the extent that a person might get angry if their companion sits with someone else. Those individuals' deeds do not ascend to the heavens, rather they are presented to Allah the Almighty."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَا حَمَلَةَ الْعِلْمِ اعْمَلُوا بِهِ فَإِنَّمَا الْعَالِمُ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِمَا عَلِمَ وَوَافَقَ عِلْمُهُ عَمَلَهُ وَسَيَكُونُ أَقْوَامٌ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعِلْمَ لَا يُجَاوِزُ تَرَاقِيَهُمْ يُخَالِفُ عَمَلُهُمْ عِلْمَهُمْ وَتُخَالِفُ سَرِيرَتُهُمْ عَلَانِيَتَهُمْ يَجْلِسُونَ حِلَقًا فَيُبَاهِيَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا حَتَّى إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَغْضَبُ عَلَى جَلِيسِهِ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ وَيَدَعَهُ أُولَئِكَ لَا تَصْعَدُ أَعْمَالُهُمْ فِي مَجَالِسِهِمْ تِلْكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. Bishr from my father \u003e Sufyān \u003e Thūwayr \u003e Yaḥyá b. Jaʿdah \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ ثُوَيْرٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ جَعْدَةَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 395

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "To admire his knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To admire his knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُعْجَبَ بِعِلْمِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Muslim \u003e Masrūq \u003e Kafá Bi-al-Marʾ ʿIlm \u003e Yakhshá Allāh And Kafá Bi-al-Marʾ Jahl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ قَالَ «كَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ عِلْمًا أَنْ يَخْشَى اللَّهَ وَكَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ جَهْلًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 396

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the least knowledgeable nation of this nation has taken a nation from the nations by its knowledge, so that nation became righteous."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "That the least knowledgeable nation of this nation has taken a nation from the nations by its knowledge, so that nation became righteous."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَدْنَى هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ عِلْمًا أَخَذَتْ أُمَّةٌ مِنَ الْأُمَمِ بِعِلْمِهِ لَرَشَدَتْ تِلْكَ الْأُمَّةُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Bujayr \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Qurrah \u003e Law
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُجَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ قَالَ «لَوْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 397

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a man seeks knowledge and acts upon it, it will be better for him than the whole world and everything in it, even if he possessed it, and he will have it in the Hereafter."
hadiths.body: "If a man seeks knowledge and acts upon it, it will be better for him than the whole world and everything in it, even if he possessed it, and he will have it in the Hereafter."
hadiths.arabic: «إِنْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ لَيُصِيبُ الْبَابَ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ فَيَعْمَلُ بِهِ فَيَكُونُ خَيْرًا لَهُ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا لَوْ كَانَتْ لَهُ فَجَعَلَهَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ»
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 398

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: To see that in his sight and in his humility, and in his tongue and in his hands and in his prayers and in his asceticism.
hadiths.body: To see that in his sight and in his humility, and in his tongue and in his hands and in his prayers and in his asceticism.
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُرَى ذَلِكَ فِي بَصَرِهِ وَتَخَشُّعِهِ وَلِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ وَصَلَاتِهِ وَزُهْدِهِ
hadiths.chain: Qāl al-Ḥasan Kān al-Rajul Idhā Ṭalab al-ʿIlm Lam Yalbath
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ لَمْ يَلْبَثْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 399

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Muhammad said, "Look carefully at the source from whom you take this hadith, for it represents your religion."
hadiths.body: Muhammad said, "Look carefully at the source from whom you take this hadith, for it represents your religion."
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ «انْظُرُوا عَمَّنْ تَأْخُذُونَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ دِينُكُمْ»
hadiths.chain: And Qāl
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 400

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Sufyan say, "No servant increases in knowledge without increasing in desire for the world, except that it increases their distance from Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Sufyan say, "No servant increases in knowledge without increasing in desire for the world, except that it increases their distance from Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ يَقُولُ «مَا ازْدَادَ عَبْدٌ عِلْمًا فَازْدَادَ فِي الدُّنْيَا رَغْبَةً إِلَّا ازْدَادَ مِنَ اللَّهِ بُعْدًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 401

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "No servant increases in knowledge of Allah except that people get closer to the mercy of Allah because of him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "No servant increases in knowledge of Allah except that people get closer to the mercy of Allah because of him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا ازْدَادَ عَبْدٌ بِاللَّهِ عِلْمًا إِلَّا ازْدَادَ النَّاسُ مِنْهُ قُرْبًا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ḥassān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ حَسَّانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 402

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: And he said in another narration, "A servant does not gain knowledge except that he gains determination, and Allah does not bestow upon a servant a gift better than serenity."
hadiths.body: And he said in another narration, "A servant does not gain knowledge except that he gains determination, and Allah does not bestow upon a servant a gift better than serenity."
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثٍ آخَرَ مَا ازْدَادَ عَبْدٌ عِلْمًا إِلَّا ازْدَادَ قَصْدًا وَلَا قَلَّدَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا قِلَادَةً خَيْرًا مِنْ سَكِينَةٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 403

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Wahb ibn Munabbih say, "O my son, seek wisdom for indeed all goodness is in wisdom. It elevates the small over the great, the slave over the free, and it increases a leader's strength, while it enables the poor to sit in the company of kings."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Wahb ibn Munabbih say, "O my son, seek wisdom for indeed all goodness is in wisdom. It elevates the small over the great, the slave over the free, and it increases a leader's strength, while it enables the poor to sit in the company of kings."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ وَهْبَ بْنَ مُنَبِّهٍ يَقُولُ يَا بُنَيَّ عَلَيْكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ فَإِنَّ الْخَيْرَ فِي الْحِكْمَةِ كُلَّهُ وَتُشَرِّفُ الصَّغِيرَ عَلَى الْكَبِيرِ وَالْعَبْدَ عَلَى الْحُرِّ وَتُزِيدُ السَّيِّدَ سُؤْدُدًا وَتُجْلِسُ الْفَقِيرَ مَجَالِسَ الْمُلُوكِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e al-Sakan b. ʿUmayr \u003e Wahbb. Munabbih \u003e Yā Bunay ʿAlayk Bi-al-Ḥikmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا بَقِيَّةُ عَنِ السَّكَنِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 404

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: التَّوْبيخِ لِمَنْ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهَ
chapter.englishTitle: The Blame for Seeking Knowledge for Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "And what would we be without the words of the scholars?"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "And what would we be without the words of the scholars?"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «وَمَا نَحْنُ لَوْلَا كَلِمَاتُ الْعُلَمَاءِ؟»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e ʿUtbah b. Abū Ḥakīm \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي بَقِيَّهُ سَمِعْتُ عُتْبَةَ بْنَ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 405

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Qilabah said, "Do not associate with the people of desires (those who follow their own whims and desires) and do not argue with them, for I fear that they may lead you astray and confuse you with what you already know."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Qilabah said, "Do not associate with the people of desires (those who follow their own whims and desires) and do not argue with them, for I fear that they may lead you astray and confuse you with what you already know."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو قِلَابَةَ «لَا تُجَالِسُوا أَهْلَ الْأَهْوَاءِ وَلَا تُجَادِلُوهُمْ فَإِنِّي لَا آمَنُ أَنْ يَغْمِسُوكُمْ فِي ضَلَالَتِهِمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسُوا عَلَيْكُمْ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْرِفُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 406

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: I have not seen you. Did you sit with Talq ibn Habib? Do not sit with him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I have not seen you. Did you sit with Talq ibn Habib? Do not sit with him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِي أَلَمْ أَرَكَ جَلَسْتَ إِلَى طَلْقِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ؟ لَا تُجَالِسَنَّهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Rānī Saʿīd b. Jubayr Jalast \u003e Ṭalq b. Ḥabīb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ رَآنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ جَلَسْتُ إِلَى طَلْقِ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 407

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: "He has made a new thing, so if he has made a new thing, do not recite the blessings upon him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He has made a new thing, so if he has made a new thing, do not recite the blessings upon him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَحْدَثَ فَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ أَحْدَثَ فَلَا تَقْرَأْ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥaywah b. Shurayḥ \u003e Abū Ṣakhr \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Jāʾah a man \u003e In Fulān Yaqraʾ ʿAlayk al-Salām \u003e Balaghanī \u003e Qad Aḥdath
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ أَنبَأَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّ فُلَانًا يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامَ قَالَ «بَلَغَنِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 408

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ibrahim did not see any innovation (in religion)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Ibrahim did not see any innovation (in religion)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَا يَرَى غِيبَةً لِلْمُبْتَدِعِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Makhlad b. Mālik \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Maghrāʾ \u003e al-Aʿmash
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَغْرَاءَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 409

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: "Because he loves his friend."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Because he loves his friend."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِأَنَّهُ يَهْوِي بِصَاحِبِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e Ibn Shubrumah \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Innamā Summī al-Hawá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا سُمِّيَ الْهَوَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 410

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: Muslim ibn Yasār used to say, "Beware of disputes, as they are the moments of ignorance of the knowledgeable, and through them, Satan seeks to make you slip."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Muslim ibn Yasār used to say, "Beware of disputes, as they are the moments of ignorance of the knowledgeable, and through them, Satan seeks to make you slip."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ يَقُولُ «إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْمِرَاءَ فَإِنَّهَا سَاعَةُ جَهْلِ الْعَالِمِ وَبِهَا يَبْتَغِي الشَّيْطَانُ زَلَّتَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Muḥammad b. Wāsiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ وَاسِعٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 411

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: Two men from the followers of whims entered upon Ibn Seerin and said, "O Abu Bakr, shall we narrate a hadith to you?" He replied, "No." They said, "Then shall we recite a verse from the Book of Allah to you?" He replied, "No, so that you may not distort it and have that remain in my heart." Some people among them said, "O Abu Bakr, why was it upon you not to let them recite a verse from the Book of Allah, the Exalted?" He said, "I feared that they would recite a verse upon me and then distort it, and that would remain in my heart."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Two men from the followers of whims entered upon Ibn Seerin and said, "O Abu Bakr, shall we narrate a hadith to you?" He replied, "No." They said, "Then shall we recite a verse from the Book of Allah to you?" He replied, "No, so that you may not distort it and have that remain in my heart." Some people among them said, "O Abu Bakr, why was it upon you not to let them recite a verse from the Book of Allah, the Exalted?" He said, "I feared that they would recite a verse upon me and then distort it, and that would remain in my heart."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَ رَجُلَانِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْأَهْوَاءِ عَلَى ابْنِ سِيرِينَ فَقَالَا يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ نُحَدِّثُكَ بِحَدِيثٍ؟ قَالَ «لَا» قَالَا فَنَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكَ آيَةً مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «لَا لِتَقُومَانِ عَنِّي أَوْ لَأَقُومَنَّ» قَالَ فَخَرَجَا فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَمَا كَانَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ يَقْرَآ عَلَيْكَ آيَةً مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى؟ قَالَ «إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَنْ يَقْرَآ عَلَيَّ آيَةً فَيُحَرِّفَانِهَا فَيَقِرُّ ذَلِكَ فِي قَلْبِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Asmāʾ b. ʿUbayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 412

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: "He turned and pointed with his finger, not even uttering a word." Said pointed to us with his right pinky finger.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He turned and pointed with his finger, not even uttering a word." Said pointed to us with his right pinky finger.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فَوَلَّى وَهُوَ يُشِيرُ بِأُصْبُعِهِ وَلَا نِصْفَ كَلِمَةٍ» وَأَشَارَ لَنَا سَعِيدٌ بِخِنْصِرِهِ الْيُمْنَى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd \u003e Sallām b. Abū Muṭīʿ \u003e a man from Ahl al-Ahwāʾ \u003e Liʾayyūb Yā Abū Bakr Asʾaluk \u003e Kalimah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ سَلَّامِ بْنِ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ قَالَ لِأَيُّوبَ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْ كَلِمَةٍ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 413

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: Azichan   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Azichan   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَزِيشَانْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Kulthūm b. Jabr \u003e a man Saʾal Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Shayʾ Falam Yujibh Faqīl Lah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ كُلْثُومِ بْنِ جَبْرٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 414

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not sit with the people of disputes, for they are the ones who engage in the signs of Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not sit with the people of disputes, for they are the ones who engage in the signs of Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تُجَالِسُوا أَصْحَابَ الْخُصُومَاتِ فَإِنَّهُمُ الَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Fuḍayl \u003e Layth \u003e Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad b. ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 415

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Hasan and Ibn Seerin, they said: "Do not sit with people of desires, do not argue with them, and do not listen to them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Hasan and Ibn Seerin, they said: "Do not sit with people of desires, do not argue with them, and do not listen to them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ وَابْنِ سِيرِينَ أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا «لَا تُجَالِسُوا أَصْحَابَ الْأَهْوَاءِ وَلَا تُجَادِلُوهُمْ وَلَا تَسْمَعُوا مِنْهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan And Ibn Sīrīn Annahumā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 416

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اجْتِنَابِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ، وَالْبِدَعِ، وَالْخُصُومَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Avoiding People of Desires, Innovations, and Disputes

hadiths.englishRaw: "They are called the followers of desires because they will be slanting towards the fire."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "They are called the followers of desires because they will be slanting towards the fire."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّمَا سُمُّوا أَصْحَابَ الْأَهْوَاءِ لِأَنَّهُمْ يَهْوُونَ فِي النَّارِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad \u003e Sharīk \u003e Umay \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ أُمَيٍّ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 417

chapter.englishTitle: Equity in Science

hadiths.englishRaw: "I have never seen anyone among the people, whether noble or lowly, except for a peacock, on which they all agree."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I have never seen anyone among the people, whether noble or lowly, except for a peacock, on which they all agree."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا مِنَ النَّاسِ الشَّرِيفُ وَالْوَضِيعُ عِنْدَهُ سَوَاءٌ غَيْرَ طَاوُسٍ وَهُوَ يَحْلِفُ عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Maysarah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 418

chapter.englishTitle: Equity in Science

hadiths.englishRaw: "We used to hate writing knowledge until the Sultan imposed it on us, so we hated to prevent anyone from acquiring it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We used to hate writing knowledge until the Sultan imposed it on us, so we hated to prevent anyone from acquiring it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نَكْرَهُ كِتَابَةَ الْعِلْمِ حَتَّى أَكْرَهَنَا عَلَيْهِ السُّلْطَانُ فَكَرِهْنَا أَنْ نَمْنَعَهُ أَحَدًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 419

chapter.englishTitle: Equity in Science

hadiths.englishRaw: He talked to him, so he said, "If there was a man from the Zanj, I would have Abdullah bin Muhammad with me on equal terms."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He talked to him, so he said, "If there was a man from the Zanj, I would have Abdullah bin Muhammad with me on equal terms."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُحَدِّثُهُ فَقَالَ «لَوْ كَانَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الزِّنْجِ لَكَانَ عِنْدِي وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ فِي هَذَا سَوَاءً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yūsuf b. Mūsá \u003e Muʿādh b. Muʿādh \u003e Ibn ʿAwn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ قَالَ كَلَّمُوا مُحَمَّدًا فِي رَجُلٍ يَعْنِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 420

chapter.englishTitle: Equity in Science

hadiths.englishRaw: "That is easier for him than for me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That is easier for him than for me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ذَلِكَ أَهْوَنُ لَهُ عَلَيَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e al-Ṣalt b. Rāshid
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنِ الصَّلْتِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ سَأَلَ سَلْمُ بْنُ قُتَيْبَةَ طاووسًا عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ هَذَا سَلْمُ بْنُ قُتَيْبَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 421

chapter.englishTitle: In the honor of the scholars.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I have never feared anyone from the people like I fear Khalid ibn Ma'dan."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I have never feared anyone from the people like I fear Khalid ibn Ma'dan."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا خِفْتُ أَحَدًا مِنَ النَّاسِ مَخَافَتِي خَالِدَ بْنَ مَعْدَانَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e Ḥabīb b. Ṣāliḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ بَقِيَّةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حَبِيبُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 422

chapter.englishTitle: In the honor of the scholars.

hadiths.englishRaw: "We used to fear the authority of Ibrahim, the prince."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We used to fear the authority of Ibrahim, the prince."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نَهَابُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ هَيْبَةَ الْأَمِيرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 423

chapter.englishTitle: In the honor of the scholars.

hadiths.englishRaw: Not every hour do I milk, and then I drink.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Not every hour do I milk, and then I drink.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا كُلَّ سَاعَةٍ أَحْلُبُ فَأُشْرَبُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Ḥaddath Saʿīd b. Jubayr Yawm Biḥadīth Faqumt Ilayh Fāstaʿadtuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ يَوْمًا بِحَدِيثٍ فَقُمْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَاسْتَعَدْتُهُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 424

chapter.englishTitle: In the honor of the scholars.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdul Rahman disliked talking on the way."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdul Rahman disliked talking on the way."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ كَرِهَ الْحَدِيثَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Hārūn \u003e Ibn al-Mughīrah And Yaḥyá b. Ḍurays \u003e ʿAmr b. Abū Qays \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ ضُرَيْسٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي قَيْسٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 425

chapter.englishTitle: In the honor of the scholars.

hadiths.englishRaw: Does he have a person who told you this or from whom you have heard this? So, he became angry and prevented us from speaking until he left.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Does he have a person who told you this or from whom you have heard this? So, he became angry and prevented us from speaking until he left.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ رَجُلٌ مَنْ حَدَّثَكَ هَذَا أَوْ مِمَّنْ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا؟ فَغَضِبَ وَمَنَعَنَا حَدِيثَهُ حَتَّى قَامَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿImrān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḍurays \u003e Abū Sinān \u003e Ḥabīb b. Abū Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ ضُرَيْسٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سِنَانٍ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فَحَدَّثَ بِحَدِيثٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 426

chapter.englishTitle: In the honor of the scholars.

hadiths.englishRaw: "If I had befriended Ibn Abbas, I would have gained much knowledge from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If I had befriended Ibn Abbas, I would have gained much knowledge from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَوْ رَفَقْتُ بِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ لَأَصَبْتُ مِنْهُ عِلْمًا كَثِيرًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Maʿmar Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 427

chapter.englishTitle: In the honor of the scholars.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I have never seen anyone more honorable for knowledge than my father."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I have never seen anyone more honorable for knowledge than my father."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا أَكْرَمَ لِلْعِلْمِ مِنْ أَبِي»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e Um ʿAbdullāh b. Khālid
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا بَقِيَّةُ عَنْ أُمِّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِنْتِ خَالِدٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 428

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘I came across Tāwus and said: ‘So-and-so narrated to me such-and-such’. Then he said: ‘If your companion is trustworthy, then take from him.’    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: ‘I came across Tāwus and said: ‘So-and-so narrated to me such-and-such’. Then he said: ‘If your companion is trustworthy, then take from him.’    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنْ كَانَ صَاحِبُكَ مَلِيًّا فَخُذْ عَنْهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e Liṭāwus In Fulān \u003e Bikadhā And Kadhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى قَالَ قُلْتُ لِطَاوُسٍ إِنَّ فُلَانًا حَدَّثَنِي بِكَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 429

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘There is to be no narrating on authority of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah send blessings and peace upon him, except by trustworthy narrators (Thiqāt)’.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ‘There is to be no narrating on authority of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah send blessings and peace upon him, except by trustworthy narrators (Thiqāt)’.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَّا الثِّقَاتُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Misʿar \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm Lā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ قَالَ قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ «لَا يُحَدِّثْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 430

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the Isnad (the chain of narrators), then they asked afterwards to know who was the companion of the Sunnah from whom they took, and who was not the companion of the Sunnah from whom they did not take. Abu Muhammad said, "I do not think he heard it from Asim."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the Isnad (the chain of narrators), then they asked afterwards to know who was the companion of the Sunnah from whom they took, and who was not the companion of the Sunnah from whom they did not take. Abu Muhammad said, "I do not think he heard it from Asim."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْإِسْنَادِ ثُمَّ سَأَلُوا بَعْدُ لِيَعْرِفُوا مَنْ كَانَ صَاحِبَ سُنَّةٍ أَخَذُوا عَنْهُ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ صَاحِبَ سُنَّةٍ لَمْ يَأْخُذُوا عَنْهُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «مَا أَظُنُّهُ سَمِعَهُ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Kānūā Lā Yasʾalūn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ «كَانُوا لَا يَسْأَلُونَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 431

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: "Tell me about two men who do not care about whoever takes their conversation," said Abu Muhammad Abdullah. "I don't think he heard it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Tell me about two men who do not care about whoever takes their conversation," said Abu Muhammad Abdullah. "I don't think he heard it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: تُحَدِّثْنِي عَنْ رَجُلَيْنِ فَإِنَّهُمَا لَا يُبَالِيَانِ عَمَّنْ أَخَذَا حَدِيثَهُمَا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «لَا أَظُنُّهُ سَمِعَهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn Mā Ḥaddathtanī Falā Tuḥaddithnī \u003e a manayn Faʾinnahumā Lā Yubālīān ʿAmman Akhadhā Ḥadīthahumā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ قَالَ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ «مَا حَدَّثْتَنِي فَلَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 432

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim said, "If you speak to me, then tell me about Abu Zur'ah; he narrated to me a story. Then after that, I asked him about a year, but not a single word was omitted from it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim said, "If you speak to me, then tell me about Abu Zur'ah; he narrated to me a story. Then after that, I asked him about a year, but not a single word was omitted from it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ «إِذَا حَدَّثْتَنِي فَحَدِّثْنِي عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ فَإِنَّهُ حَدَّثَنِي بِحَدِيثٍ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِسَنَةٍ فَمَا خَرمَ مِنْهُا حَرْفًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Jarīr \u003e ʿUmārah b. al-Qaʿqāʿ \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 433

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: This knowledge is a religion, so let the person consider from whom they take their religion.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This knowledge is a religion, so let the person consider from whom they take their religion.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ هَذَا الْعِلْمَ دِينٌ فَلْيَنْظُرِ الرَّجُلُ عَمَّنْ يَأْخُذُ دِينَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 434

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: "They look at him, his prayer, his direction, and his appearance."
hadiths.body: "They look at him, his prayer, his direction, and his appearance."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْهُ نَظَرُوا إِلَى صَلَاتِهِ وَإِلَى سَمْتِهِ وَإِلَى هَيْئَتِهِ»
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hushaym \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ «كَانُوا إِذَا أَتَوْا الرَّجُلَ لِيَأْخُذُوا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 435

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: "They sought knowledge from him, observed his prayer, his direction, and his appearance, and then they took from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "They sought knowledge from him, observed his prayer, his direction, and his appearance, and then they took from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْهُ الْعِلْمَ نَظَرُوا إِلَى صَلَاتِهِ وَإِلَى سَمْتِهِ وَإِلَى هَيْئَتِهِ ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُونَ عَنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. Zurārah \u003e Hushaym \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ أَنبَأَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَنبَأَنَا مُغِيرَةُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ «كَانُوا إِذَا أَتَوْا الرَّجُلَ يَأْخُذُونَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 436

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Hasan, it is similar to the hadith of Ibrahim.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Hasan, it is similar to the hadith of Ibrahim.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Rawḥ \u003e Hishām
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ رَوْحٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 437

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: From him, we observe when he prays. If he performs it excellently, we sit with him and say, "He performs it better than others." And if he performs it poorly, we stand away from him and say, "He performs it worse than others." Abu Ma'mar said that his statement is like this.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: From him, we observe when he prays. If he performs it excellently, we sit with him and say, "He performs it better than others." And if he performs it poorly, we stand away from him and say, "He performs it worse than others." Abu Ma'mar said that his statement is like this.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْهُ فَنَنْظُرُ إِذَا صَلَّى فَإِنْ أَحْسَنَهَا جَلَسْنَا إِلَيْهِ وَقُلْنَا هُوَ لِغَيْرِهَا أَحْسَنُ وَإِنْ أَسَاءَهَا قُمْنَا عَنْهُ وَقُلْنَا هُوَ لِغَيْرِهَا أسْوأُ قَالَ أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ لَفْظُهُ نَحْوُ هَذَا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Maʿmar Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Jaʿfar al-Rāzī from his father \u003e al-Rabīʿ \u003e Abū al-ʿĀliyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الرَّازِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ قَالَ كُنَّا نَأْتِي الرَّجُلَ لِنَأْخُذَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 438

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: "I do not know if I heard it from him or from Ibn 'Awn about Muhammad, 'Indeed, this knowledge is a religion, so be careful who you take your religion from.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "I do not know if I heard it from him or from Ibn 'Awn about Muhammad, 'Indeed, this knowledge is a religion, so be careful who you take your religion from.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: لَا أَدْرِي سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ أَوْ لابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ «إِنَّ هَذَا الْعِلْمَ دِينٌ فَانْظُرُوا عَمَّنْ تَأْخُذُونَ دِينَكُمْ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Lā Adrī Samiʿtuh Minh or Lāb. ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 439

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘I came across Tāwus and said: ‘So-and-so narrated to me such-and-such’. Then he said: ‘If your companion is trustworthy, then take from him.’    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: ‘I came across Tāwus and said: ‘So-and-so narrated to me such-and-such’. Then he said: ‘If your companion is trustworthy, then take from him.’    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فَإِنْ كَانَ صَاحِبُكَ مَلِيًّا فَخُذْ عَنْهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e Liṭāwus In Fulān \u003e Bikadhā And Kadhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى قَالَ قُلْتُ لِطَاوُسٍ إِنَّ فُلَانًا حَدَّثَنِي بِكَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 440

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: Do you know my entire conversation and deny it, or do you know this and deny my entire conversation? Ibn Abbas said, "We used to relate from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was not accused of lying. But when people faced difficulties and humiliation, we stopped narrating from him."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: Do you know my entire conversation and deny it, or do you know this and deny my entire conversation? Ibn Abbas said, "We used to relate from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he was not accused of lying. But when people faced difficulties and humiliation, we stopped narrating from him."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ بُشَيْرٌ مَا أَدْرِي عَرَفْتَ حَدِيثِي كُلَّهُ وَأَنْكَرْتَ هَذَا أَوْ عَرَفْتَ هَذَا وَأَنْكَرْتَ حَدِيثِي كُلَّهُ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «إِنَّا كُنَّا نُحَدِّثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذْ لَمْ يَكُنْ يُكْذَبُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا رَكِبَ النَّاسُ الصَّعْبَ وَالذَّلُولَ تَرَكْنَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْهُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām b. Ḥujayr \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Jāʾ Bushayr b. Kaʿb \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Fajaʿal Yuḥaddithuh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Aʿid ʿAlay al-Ḥadīth al-Awwal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حُجَيْرٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ قَالَ جَاءَ بُشَيْرُ بْنُ كَعْبٍ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَجَعَلَ يُحَدِّثُهُ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «أَعِدْ عَلَيَّ الْحَدِيثَ الْأَوَّلَ» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 441

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , until you bear hardship and humiliation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , until you bear hardship and humiliation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى رَكِبْتُمُ الصَّعْبَةَ وَالذَّلُولَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar \u003e Ibn Ṭāwus from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ «كُنَّا نَحْفَظُ الْحَدِيثَ وَالْحَدِيثُ يُحْفَظُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 442

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: "That demons appear, which Solomon ﷺ has bound, to teach people about religion."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "That demons appear, which Solomon ﷺ has bound, to teach people about religion."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَظْهَرَ شَيَاطِينُ قَدْ أَوْثَقَهَا سُلَيْمَانُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يُفَقِّهُونَ النَّاسَ فِي الدِّينِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Yūshik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ «يُوشِكُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 443

chapter.englishTitle: In the narration about trustworthy individuals

hadiths.englishRaw: "Consider from whom you take this narration, for it is your religion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Consider from whom you take this narration, for it is your religion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «انْظُرُوا عَمَّنْ تَأْخُذُونَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ فَإِنَّهُ دِينُكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 444

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ and the Words o...

hadiths.englishRaw: "So that the interpretation of the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is based on the same caution as the interpretation of the Quran."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "So that the interpretation of the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is based on the same caution as the interpretation of the Quran."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لِيُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَمَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ الْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Muʿtamir from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 445

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ and the Words o...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and so and so said?   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, and so and so said?   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَقَالَ فُلَانٌ؟   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ṣadaqah b. al-Faḍl \u003e Muʿtamir from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Amā Takhāfūn \u003e Tuʿadhhabūā or Yukhsaf Bikum \u003e Ūā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَمَا تَخَافُونَ أَنْ تُعَذَّبُوا أَوْ يُخْسَفَ بِكُمْ أَنْ تَقُولُوا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 446

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ and the Words o...

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no opinion for anyone in the Book of Allah. Rather, the only opinion is that of the Imams regarding matters for which there is no book revealed, nor has a sunnah been passed down from the Messenger of Allah. And there is no opinion for anyone in a sunnah established by the Messenger of Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no opinion for anyone in the Book of Allah. Rather, the only opinion is that of the Imams regarding matters for which there is no book revealed, nor has a sunnah been passed down from the Messenger of Allah. And there is no opinion for anyone in a sunnah established by the Messenger of Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ لَا رَأْيَ لِأَحَدٍ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا رَأْيُ الْأَئِمَّةِ فِيمَا لَمْ يَنْزِلْ فِيهِ كِتَابٌ وَلَمْ تَمْضِ بِهِ سُنَّةٌ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلَا رَأْيَ لِأَحَدٍ فِي سُنَّةٍ سَنَّهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. Bishr \u003e al-Muʿāfá \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Katab ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ؒ Taʿālá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَافَى عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ «كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 447

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ and the Words o...

hadiths.englishRaw: "O people, Allah has not sent a prophet after your prophet, nor has He revealed any book after this book that He has sent down upon him. What Allah has made lawful on the tongue of His prophet is lawful until the Day of Resurrection, and what He has made forbidden on the tongue of His prophet is forbidden until the Day of Resurrection. Know that I am not a judge, but rather a conveyor. I am not an innovator, but a follower. I am not better than you except that I bear a heavier burden. Indeed, no one from the creation of Allah should be obeyed in disobeying Allah. Have you heard?"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "O people, Allah has not sent a prophet after your prophet, nor has He revealed any book after this book that He has sent down upon him. What Allah has made lawful on the tongue of His prophet is lawful until the Day of Resurrection, and what He has made forbidden on the tongue of His prophet is forbidden until the Day of Resurrection. Know that I am not a judge, but rather a conveyor. I am not an innovator, but a follower. I am not better than you except that I bear a heavier burden. Indeed, no one from the creation of Allah should be obeyed in disobeying Allah. Have you heard?"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَبْعَثْ بَعْدَ نَبِيِّكُمْ نَبِيًّا وَلَمْ يُنْزِلْ بَعْدَ هَذَا الْكِتَابِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ كِتَابًا فَمَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ فَهُوَ حَلَالٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ أَلَا وَإِنِّي لَسْتُ بِقاضٍّ وَلَكِنِّي مُنَفِّذٌ وَلَسْتُ بِمُبْتَدِعٍ وَلَكِنِّي مُتَّبِعٌ وَلَسْتُ بِخَيْرٍ مِنْكُمْ غَيْرَ أَنِّي أَثْقَلُكُمْ حِمْلًا أَلَا وَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ أَنْ يُطَاعَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ أَلَا هَلْ أَسْمَعْتُ؟؟»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Muʿtamir b. Sulaymān \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ؒ Khaṭab
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 448

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ and the Words o...

hadiths.englishRaw: There was a peacock praying two units after Asr prayer, so Ibn Abbas said to him, "Leave them." He said, "It was only forbidden to perform them on a ladder." Ibn Abbas said, "Indeed, prayer after Asr has been forbidden, so I do not know whether you will be punished for it or rewarded, for Allah says, 'It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.'" (Quran 33:36) Sufyan said, "He considers it to be on a ladder, meaning he prays from after Asr until the night."
hadiths.body: There was a peacock praying two units after Asr prayer, so Ibn Abbas said to him, "Leave them." He said, "It was only forbidden to perform them on a ladder." Ibn Abbas said, "Indeed, prayer after Asr has been forbidden, so I do not know whether you will be punished for it or rewarded, for Allah says, 'It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.'" (Quran 33:36) Sufyan said, "He considers it to be on a ladder, meaning he prays from after Asr until the night."
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ طاووسٌ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «اتْرُكْهُمَا» قَالَ «إِنَّمَا نُهِيَ عَنْهَا أَنْ تُتَّخَذُ سُلَّمًا» قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ نُهِيَ عَنْ صَلَاةٍ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَلَا أَدْرِي أَتُعَذَّبُ عَلَيْهَا أَمْ تُؤْجَرُ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ {وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ وَمَنْ يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقْدَ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُبِينًا} [الأحزاب 36] قَالَ سُفْيَانُ تُتَّخَذَ سُلَّمًا يَقُولُ يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Hishām b. Ḥujayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حُجَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 449

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ and the Words o...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a copy of the Torah, and he said: 'O Messenger of Allah, this is a copy of the Torah.' Then he remained silent and started reading. The face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed. Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, said: 'May you be sacrificed for this moment! Why do you not see the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?' So Umar looked at the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'I seek refuge in Allah from the anger of Allah and the anger of His Messenger. We are pleased with Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion, and Muhammad as our Prophet.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'We are pleased with Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion, and Muhammad as our Prophet.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'By the One in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, if Moses were to appear to you and you were to follow him and abandon me, you would be led astray from the right path. And if he were alive during my prophethood, he would have followed me.'"
hadiths.body: "Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a copy of the Torah, and he said: 'O Messenger of Allah, this is a copy of the Torah.' Then he remained silent and started reading. The face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ changed. Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, said: 'May you be sacrificed for this moment! Why do you not see the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?' So Umar looked at the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'I seek refuge in Allah from the anger of Allah and the anger of His Messenger. We are pleased with Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion, and Muhammad as our Prophet.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'We are pleased with Allah as our Lord, Islam as our religion, and Muhammad as our Prophet.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'By the One in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, if Moses were to appear to you and you were to follow him and abandon me, you would be led astray from the right path. And if he were alive during my prophethood, he would have followed me.'"
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِنُسْخَةٍ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذِهِ نُسْخَةٌ مِنَ التَّوْرَاةِ فَسَكَتَ فَجَعَلَ يَقْرَأُ وَوَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ يَتَغَيَّرُ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ثَكِلَتْكَ الثَّوَاكِلُ مَا تَرَى بِوَجْهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ فَنَظَرَ عُمَرُ إِلَى وَجْهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ غَضَبِ اللَّهِ وَغَضَبِ رَسُولِهِ رَضِينَا بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَضِينَا بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَوْ بَدَا لَكُمْ مُوسَى فَاتَّبَعْتُمُوهُ وَتَرَكْتُمُونِي لَضَلَلْتُمْ عَنْ سَوَاءِ السَّبِيلِ وَلَوْ كَانَ حَيًّا وَأَدْرَكَ نُبُوَّتِي لَاتَّبَعَنِي»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Ibn Numayr \u003e Mujālid \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 450

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَوْلِ غَيْرِهِ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Explanation of the Hadith of the Prophet ﷺ and the Words o...

hadiths.englishRaw: From Abu Rabah, a sheikh from the family of Umar, he said: Sa'id bin al-Musayyib saw a man praying two rak'ahs after Asr and making takbir (saying Allah is the greatest). Sa'id said to him, "O Abu Muhammad, does Allah punish me for praying?" He said, "No, but Allah punishes you for going against the sunnah."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: From Abu Rabah, a sheikh from the family of Umar, he said: Sa'id bin al-Musayyib saw a man praying two rak'ahs after Asr and making takbir (saying Allah is the greatest). Sa'id said to him, "O Abu Muhammad, does Allah punish me for praying?" He said, "No, but Allah punishes you for going against the sunnah."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ شَيْخٌ مِنْ آلِ عُمَرَ قَالَ رَأَى سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ يُكَبِّرُ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَيُعَذِّبُنِي اللَّهُ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ؟ قَالَ «لَا وَلَكِنْ يُعَذِّبُكَ اللَّهُ بِخِلَافِ السُّنَّةِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Rabāḥ Shaykh from Āl ʿUmar \u003e Raʾá Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib a man Yuṣallī Baʿd al-ʿAṣr al-Rakʿatayn Yukabbir \u003e Lah Yā Abū Muḥammad Ayuʿadhhibunī Allāh \u003e al-Ṣalāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 451

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who said, "While a man was admiring his two garments, Allah caused the earth to swallow him up, and he will continue to be swallowed by it until the Day of Resurrection." A young boy, whose name he mentioned and who was with him, said, "O Abu Hurayrah, was this the way the boy who was swallowed up used to walk?" Then he struck his hand and stumbled and almost broke it. Abu Hurayrah said to his two collarbones and to his mouth, "Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers" [Quran 15:95].   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who said, "While a man was admiring his two garments, Allah caused the earth to swallow him up, and he will continue to be swallowed by it until the Day of Resurrection." A young boy, whose name he mentioned and who was with him, said, "O Abu Hurayrah, was this the way the boy who was swallowed up used to walk?" Then he struck his hand and stumbled and almost broke it. Abu Hurayrah said to his two collarbones and to his mouth, "Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers" [Quran 15:95].   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَتَبَخْتَرُ فِي بُرْدَيْنِ خَسَفَ اللَّهُ بِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَهُوَ يَتَجَلْجَلُ فِيهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ» فَقَالَ لَهُ فَتًى قَدْ سَمَّاهُ وَهُوَ فِي حُلَّةٍ لَهُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَهَكَذَا كَانَ يَمْشِي ذَلِكَ الْفَتَى الَّذِي خُسِفَ بِهِ؟ ثُمَّ ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ فَعَثَرَ عَثْرَةً كَادَ يَتَكَسَّرُ مِنْهَا فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ لِلْمَنْخَرَيْنِ وَلِلْفَمِ {إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ} [الحجر 95]   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e al-ʿAjlān \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنِ الْعَجْلَانِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 452

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding stone-throwing. A young man neglected this and thought that the elderly Shaykh was not paying attention to him, so he threw a stone. The Shaykh then said to him, 'Did I not tell you that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding stone-throwing, and yet you still do it? By Allah, I will not witness your funeral, nor will I visit you when you are sick, and I will never speak to you again.' So I said to my companion who was known as Muhajir, 'Go to Khirash and ask him about it.' He went to him and asked him, and he narrated the incident to him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding stone-throwing. A young man neglected this and thought that the elderly Shaykh was not paying attention to him, so he threw a stone. The Shaykh then said to him, 'Did I not tell you that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding stone-throwing, and yet you still do it? By Allah, I will not witness your funeral, nor will I visit you when you are sick, and I will never speak to you again.' So I said to my companion who was known as Muhajir, 'Go to Khirash and ask him about it.' He went to him and asked him, and he narrated the incident to him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ» فَغَفَلَ الْفَتَى وَظَنَّ أَنَّ الشَّيْخَ لَا يَفْطِنُ لَهُ فَخَذَفَ فَقَالَ لَهُ الشَّيْخُ أُحَدِّثُكَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ ثُمَّ تَخْذِفُ؟ وَاللَّهِ لَا أَشْهَدُ لَكَ جَنَازَةً وَلَا أَعُودُكَ فِي مَرَضٍ وَلَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا فَقُلْتُ لِصَاحِبٍ لِي يُقَالُ لَهُ مُهَاجِرٌ انْطَلِقْ إِلَى خِرَاشٍ فَاسْأَلْهُ فَأَتَاهُ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْهُ فَحَدَّثَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Hārūn \u003e Ibn al-Mughīrah \u003e ʿAmr b. Abū Qays \u003e al-Zubayr b. ʿAdī \u003e Khirāsh b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي قَيْسٍ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ عَنْ خِرَاشِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَتًى يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ شَيْخٌ لَا تَخْذِفْ «فَإِنِّي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 453

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade throwing stones and said, "It does not catch prey, nor does it injure an enemy. Rather, it breaks teeth and gouges eyes." So a man raised something between him and Sa'id, close to the ground, and asked, "Is this it? What is this?" Sa'id replied, "Shouldn't you see that I am telling you about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , then you belittle it and I will never speak to you again."   – Sound Chain

So a man raised something between him and Sa'id, close to the ground, and asked, "Is this it? What is this?" Sa'id replied, "Shouldn't you see that I am telling you about the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , then you belittle it and I will never speak to you again."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْخَذْفِ وَقَالَ «إِنَّهَا لَا تَصْطَادُ صَيْدًا وَلَا تَنْكَأُ عَدُوًّا وَلَكِنَّهَا تَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَتَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ» فَرَفَعَ رَجُلٌ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ سَعِيدٍ قَرَابَةٌ شَيْئًا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَقَالَ هَذِهِ؟ وَمَا تَكُونُ هَذِهِ؟ فَقَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَلَا أُرَانِي أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ تَهَاوَنُ بِهِ لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 454

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah ibn Mughaffal saw a man from his companions throwing stones, so he said to him: "Do not throw stones, for indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid it or dislike it. And he said, 'It does not cause harm to the enemy nor does it bring food as prey, but it can cause damage to the eye and break the tooth.'" Then he saw him afterwards still throwing stones, so he said to him: "Did I not inform you that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid it, and here I see you still throwing stones? By Allah, I will never speak to you again."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah ibn Mughaffal saw a man from his companions throwing stones, so he said to him: "Do not throw stones, for indeed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid it or dislike it. And he said, 'It does not cause harm to the enemy nor does it bring food as prey, but it can cause damage to the eye and break the tooth.'" Then he saw him afterwards still throwing stones, so he said to him: "Did I not inform you that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid it, and here I see you still throwing stones? By Allah, I will never speak to you again."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُغَفَّلٍ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَا تَخْذِفْ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ أَوْ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ الْخَذْفَ وَقَالَ «إنَّهُ لَا يُنْكَأُ بِهِ عَدُوٌّ وَلَا يُصَادُ بِهِ صَيْدٌ وَلَكِنَّهُ قَدْ يَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ وَيَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ» ثُمَّ رَآهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَلَمْ أُخْبِرْكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كانَ يَنْهَى عنْهُ ثُمَّ أَرَاكَ تَخْذِفُ وَاللَّهِ لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Kahmas b. al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Buraydah \u003e Raʾá ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal a man from Aṣḥābih Yakhdhif
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ؛ حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ؛ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 455

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ , a man said: "So-and-so said this and that." Ibn Sirin said, "Let me tell you about the Prophet ﷺ . When I say something, I say it on his authority. I do not mention anyone else's words. I will never speak to you again."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ , a man said: "So-and-so said this and that." Ibn Sirin said, "Let me tell you about the Prophet ﷺ . When I say something, I say it on his authority. I do not mention anyone else's words. I will never speak to you again."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ قَالَ فُلَانٌ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَقَالَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَتَقُولُ قَالَ فُلَانٌ وَفُلَانٌ كَذَا وَكَذَا لَا أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʿīd b. Bashīr \u003e Qatādah \u003e Ḥaddath Ibn Sīrīn a man Biḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ رَجُلًا بِحَدِيثٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 456

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: When women ask permission for going to the mosque, do not prevent them.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: When women ask permission for going to the mosque, do not prevent them.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْ أَحَدَكُمُ امْرَأَتُهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَا يَمْنَعْهَا» فَقَالَ فُلَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِذًا وَاللَّهِ أَمْنَعُهَا فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فَشَتَمَهُ شتمةً لَمْ أَرَهُ شْتمها أَحَدًا قَبْلَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَقُولُ إِذًا وَاللَّهِ أَمْنَعُهَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 457

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ forbade the exchange of two dirhams for one dirham. So-and-so said, 'I do not see anything wrong with this, exchanging one by one.' 'Ubadah said, 'I say what the Prophet ﷺ said, and I do not see any harm in it. By Allah, it will never darken me, nor you, saqf (roof).'"
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ forbade the exchange of two dirhams for one dirham. So-and-so said, 'I do not see anything wrong with this, exchanging one by one.' 'Ubadah said, 'I say what the Prophet ﷺ said, and I do not see any harm in it. By Allah, it will never darken me, nor you, saqf (roof).'"
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «نَهَى عَنْ دِرْهَمَيْنِ بِدِرْهَمٍ» فَقَالَ فُلَانٌ مَا أَرَى بِهَذَا بَأْسًا يَدًا بِيَدٍ فَقَالَ عُبَادَةُ أَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَتَقُولُ لَا أَرَى بِهِ بَأْسًا وَاللَّهِ لَا يُظِلُّنِي وَإِيَّاكَ سَقْفٌ أَبَدًا
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Hārūn b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Maʿrūf \u003e Abū al-Mukhāriq \u003e Dhakar ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُخَارِقِ قَالَ ذَكَرَ عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 458

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Do not approach women at night." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ faced a caravan and two men hurried to their families and both found other men with their wives.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Do not approach women at night." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ faced a caravan and two men hurried to their families and both found other men with their wives.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَطْرُقُوا النِّسَاءَ لَيْلًا» قَالَ وَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَافِلًا فانْسلَ رَجُلَانِ إِلَى أَهْلَيْهِمَا فَكِلَاهُمَا وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Rifāʿī \u003e Abū ʿĀmir al-ʿAqadī \u003e Zamʿah \u003e Salamah b. And Hrām \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ عَنْ زَمْعَةَ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ وَهْرَامٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 459

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned from a journey, he would stop at the mosque and then say, 'Do not engage with women at night.' Two men who had heard his statement then went to their respective homes and found each of their wives with another man."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ returned from a journey, he would stop at the mosque and then say, 'Do not engage with women at night.' Two men who had heard his statement then went to their respective homes and found each of their wives with another man."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ نَزَلَ الْمُعَرَّسَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «لَا تَطْرُقُوا النِّسَاءَ لَيْلًا» فَخَرَجَ رَجُلَانِ مِمَّنْ سَمِعَ مَقَالَتَهُ فَطَرَقَا أهْلْهما فَوَجَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ḥarmalah al-Aslamī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 460

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَعْجِيلِ عُقُوبَةِ مَنْ بَلَغَهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَدِيثٌ فَلَمْ يُعَظِّمْهُ وَلَمْ يُوَقِّرْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Expediting the punishment for those who receive a hadith from th...

hadiths.englishRaw: "He does not leave (the mosque) until he prays, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'No one should leave the mosque after the call to prayer except a hypocrite, except for a man who has a valid excuse and intends to come back to the mosque.' He said, 'My companions in Al-Harra said: 'So he (the man with a valid excuse) left (the mosque).' He said, 'He (the man with a valid excuse) continued to keep the remembrance of Allah in his heart until it was reported that he fell from his mount and his thigh was broken.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "He does not leave (the mosque) until he prays, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'No one should leave the mosque after the call to prayer except a hypocrite, except for a man who has a valid excuse and intends to come back to the mosque.' He said, 'My companions in Al-Harra said: 'So he (the man with a valid excuse) left (the mosque).' He said, 'He (the man with a valid excuse) continued to keep the remembrance of Allah in his heart until it was reported that he fell from his mount and his thigh was broken.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ لَا تَبْرَحْ حَتَّى تُصَلِّيَ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَخْرُجُ بَعْدَ النِّدَاءِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ إِلَّا مُنَافِقٌ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ أَخْرَجَتْهُ حاجةُ وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ الرَّجْعَةَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ» فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَصْحَابِي بِالْحَرَّةِ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ قَالَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ سَعِيدٌ يَوْلَعُ بِذِكْرِهِ حَتَّى أُخْبِرَ أَنَّهُ وَقَعَ مِنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَانْكَسَرَتْ فَخِذُهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ḥarmalah \u003e Jāʾ a man \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib Yuwaddiʿuh Biḥaj or ʿUmrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حَرْمَلَةَ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ يُوَدِّعُهُ بِحَجٍّ أَوْ عُمْرَةٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 461

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُمِلَّ النَّاسَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who doesn't want to bore people?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not tire people."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not tire people."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تُمِلُّوا النَّاسَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad b. ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 462

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُمِلَّ النَّاسَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who doesn't want to bore people?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, hearts have their own vitality and affinity, and indeed, they have inclination and aversion. So, speak to people according to their reception of you."
hadiths.body: "Indeed, hearts have their own vitality and affinity, and indeed, they have inclination and aversion. So, speak to people according to their reception of you."
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ لِلْقُلُوبِ لَنَشَاطًا وَإِقْبَالًا وَإِنَّ لَهَا تَوْلِيَةً وَإِدْبَارًا فَحَدِّثُوا النَّاسَ مَا أَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْكُمْ»
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ashʿath \u003e Kurdūs \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَشْعَثُ عَنْ كُرْدُوسٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 463

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُمِلَّ النَّاسَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who doesn't want to bore people?

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said, "Tell the people what they did not bring to you with their faces, and when they turn away, know that they have needs."   – Weak
hadiths.body: It is said, "Tell the people what they did not bring to you with their faces, and when they turn away, know that they have needs."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ «حَدِّثِ الْقَوْمَ مَا أَقْبَلُوا عَلَيْكَ بِوُجُوهِهِمْ فَإِذَا الْتَفَتُوا فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّ لَهُمْ حَاجَاتٍ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Abū Hilāl \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 464

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not write anything about me except the Quran. Whoever writes anything about me other than the Quran should erase it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not write anything about me except the Quran. Whoever writes anything about me other than the Quran should erase it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَكْتُبُوا عَنِّي شَيْئًا إِلَّا الْقُرْآنَ فَمَنْ كَتَبَ عَنِّي شَيْئًا غَيْرَ الْقُرْآنِ فَلْيَمْحُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hammām \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 465

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: From Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri, they sought permission from the Prophet ﷺ to write about him, but he did not permit them.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri, they sought permission from the Prophet ﷺ to write about him, but he did not permit them.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ «أَنَّهُمْ اسْتَأْذَنُوا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فِي أَنْ يَكْتُبُوا عنْهُ فَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Maʿmar \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 466

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to say, "Oh window, should I respond to you, meaning should I engage in conversation? I never intended for any conversation to be responded to me before."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He used to say, "Oh window, should I respond to you, meaning should I engage in conversation? I never intended for any conversation to be responded to me before."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ يَا شِبَاكُ أَرُدُّ عَلَيْكَ يَعْنِي الْحَدِيثَ؟ مَا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ يُرَدَّ عَلَيَّ حَدِيثٌ قَطُّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Ibn Shubrumah \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 467

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: Muhammad bin Ja'far narrated to us, from Shu'bah, from Amr bin Murrah who said: "I asked Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah: 'Did you remember anything from Abdullah?' He said, 'No'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Muhammad bin Ja'far narrated to us, from Shu'bah, from Amr bin Murrah who said: "I asked Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah: 'Did you remember anything from Abdullah?' He said, 'No'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Mahdī \u003e Mālik b. Anas
