hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ يَقُولُ جَاءَ الزُّهْرِيُّ بِحَدِيثٍ فَلَقِيتُهُ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ فَأَخَذْتُ بِلِجَامِهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ «أَعِدْ عَلَيَّ الْحَدِيثَ الَّذِي حَدَّثْتَنَا بِهِ» قَالَ وَتَسْتَعِيدُ الْحَدِيثَ؟ قَالَ قُلْتُ «وَمَا كُنْتَ تَسْتَعِيدُ الْحَدِيثَ؟» قَالَ لَا قُلْتُ «وَلَا تَكْتُبُ؟» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 468

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard the sound of the book, denied it, and reached out for it with his hand.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He heard the sound of the book, denied it, and reached out for it with his hand.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَ وَقْعَ الْكِتَابِ أَنْكَرَهُ وَالْتَمَسَهُ بِيَدِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ كَانَ قَتَادَةُ «يَكْرَهُ الْكِتَابَةَ فَإِذَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 469

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: The 'Awza'i used to "dislike it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The 'Awza'i used to "dislike it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ «يَكْرَهُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 470

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim used to dislike reading, meaning knowledge.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim used to dislike reading, meaning knowledge.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ «كَانَ يَكْرَهُ الْكِتَابَ يَعْنِي الْعِلْمَ »   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 471

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "If I were to take a book, I would not have taken the Prophet's messages ﷺ."
hadiths.body: "If I were to take a book, I would not have taken the Prophet's messages ﷺ."
hadiths.arabic: «لَوْ كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذًا كِتَابًا لَاتَّخَذْتُ رَسَائِلَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ»
hadiths.chain: Yūsuf b. Mūsá \u003e Azhar \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَنبَأَنَا أَزْهَرُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 472

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: It is only edges.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is only edges.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَطْرَافٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Raʾayt Ḥammād Yaktub ʿInd Ibrāhīm \u003e Lah Ibrāhīm Alam Anhak
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ حَمَّادًا يَكْتُبُ عِنْدَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَقَالَ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ أَلَمْ أَنْهَكَ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 473

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "To my Abdah, 'Do not make a book immortal within me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To my Abdah, 'Do not make a book immortal within me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِي عَبِيْدَةُ «لَا تُخَلِّدَنَّ بِي كِتَابًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 474

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "Except for the depths of Muhammad, I have retained no other account; and when I memorized it, I erased it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Except for the depths of Muhammad, I have retained no other account; and when I memorized it, I erased it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ إِلَّا حَدِيثَ الْأَعْمَاقِ فَلَمَّا حَفِظْتُهُ مَحَوْتُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hishām \u003e Mā Katabt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ قَالَ «مَا كَتَبْتُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 475

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz say, "I have never written a hadith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Sa'id ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz say, "I have never written a hadith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ يَقُولُ «مَا كَتَبْتُ حَدِيثًا قَطُّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 476

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "I did not write anything ever."
hadiths.body: "I did not write anything ever."
hadiths.arabic: «مَا كَتَبْتُ شَيْئًا قَطُّ»
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿImrān \u003e Abū Dāwud \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 477

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked Ubaydah for a piece of leather to write on it, so he said, "Oh Ibrahim, do not make me immortalize a book from me."
hadiths.body: I asked Ubaydah for a piece of leather to write on it, so he said, "Oh Ibrahim, do not make me immortalize a book from me."
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ عَبِيدَةَ قِطْعَةَ جِلْدٍ أَكْتُبُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ «لَا تُخَلِّدَنَّ عَنِّي كِتَابًا»
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿImrān \u003e Abū Dāwud \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Rajāʾ \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Saʾalt ʿAbīdah Qiṭʿah Jild Aktub Fīh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ رَجَاءٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 478

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Ubaydah, similar to him."
hadiths.body: "About Ubaydah, similar to him."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ مِثْلَهُ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Dāwud \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 479

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "To write the Hadith in books and say it resembles the Qur'an."
hadiths.body: "To write the Hadith in books and say it resembles the Qur'an."
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُكْتَبَ الْحَدِيثُ فِي الْكَرَارِيسِ وَيَقُولُ يُشَبَّهُ بِالْمَصَاحِفِ
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Sulaymān b. Abū ʿAtīk \u003e Abū Maʿshar \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي عَتِيكٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 480

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: From Abu Ma'shar, so write it as you wish.   – Sound
hadiths.body: From Abu Ma'shar, so write it as you wish.   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ فَاكْتُبْ كَيْفَ شِئْتَ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá And Wajadt Fī Kitābī \u003e Ziyād al-Kātib
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ يَحْيَى وَوَجَدْتُ فِي كِتَابِي عَنْ زِيَادٍ الْكَاتِبِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 481

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "That Ubeida called for his books and then erased them before his death, and he said: 'I fear that some people may come after me and not place them in their proper places.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That Ubeida called for his books and then erased them before his death, and he said: 'I fear that some people may come after me and not place them in their proper places.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَبِيدَةَ دَعَا بِكُتُبِهِ فَمَحَاهَا عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَقَالَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَلِيَهَا قَوْمٌ فَلَا يَضَعُونَهَا مَوَاضِعَهَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf And ʿUbayd Allāh \u003e Sufyān \u003e Nuʿmān b. Qays \u003e ʿAbīdah Daʿā Bikutubih Famaḥāhā ʿInd al-Mawt \u003e Innī Akhāf
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ نُعْمَانَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 482

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "To write knowledge in notebooks."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "To write knowledge in notebooks."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُكْتَبَ الْعِلْمُ فِي الْكَرَارِيسِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak And Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād \u003e Layth \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Karih
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ وَزَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ أَنَّهُ «كَرِهَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 483

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: This knowledge remained valuable as men continued to receive it until it was published in newspapers, then carried or entered by people who were not qualified to do so.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This knowledge remained valuable as men continued to receive it until it was published in newspapers, then carried or entered by people who were not qualified to do so.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا زَالَ هَذَا الْعِلْمُ عَزِيزًا يَتَلَقَّاهُ الرِّجَالُ حَتَّى وَقَعَ فِي الصُّحُفِ فَحَمَلَهُ أَوْ دَخَلَ فِيهِ غَيْرُ أَهْلِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e al-Awzāʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 484

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: Al-Hasan used to write and dictate, while Ibn Sirin neither used to write nor dictate.
hadiths.body: Al-Hasan used to write and dictate, while Ibn Sirin neither used to write nor dictate.
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ الْحَسَنُ يَكْتُبُ وَيُكْتِبُ» وَكَانَ ابْنُ سِيرِينَ لَا يَكْتُبُ وَلَا يُكْتِبُ
hadiths.chain: Yūsuf b. Mūsá \u003e Abū Dāwud al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 485

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, there are people who have a book that they admire, and they have not ceased with it until they brought it to me, and I have erased it. Then, he said, "The people of the book before you were destroyed because they embraced the books of their scholars and abandoned the book of their Lord."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Indeed, there are people who have a book that they admire, and they have not ceased with it until they brought it to me, and I have erased it. Then, he said, "The people of the book before you were destroyed because they embraced the books of their scholars and abandoned the book of their Lord."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عِنْدَ نَاسٍ كِتَابًا يُعْجَبُونَ بِهِ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ بِهِمْ حَتَّى أَتَوْهُ بِهِ فَمَحَاهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا هَلَكَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ قَبْلَكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ أَقْبَلُوا عَلَى كُتُبِ عُلَمَائِهِمْ وَتَرَكُوا كِتَابَ رَبِّهِمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd \u003e al-ʿAwwām \u003e Ibrāhīm al-Taymī \u003e Balagh Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ أَنبَأَنَا الْعَوَّامُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ قَالَ بَلَغَ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 486

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: I said, "No". If I find a book to read, he said, "No".   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said, "No". If I find a book to read, he said, "No".   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتُ كِتَابًا أَقْرَؤُهُ قَالَ «لَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Liʿabīdah Aktub Mā Asmaʿ Mink \u003e Lā \u003e Faʾin And Jadt Kitāb Aqraʾuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبِيدَةَ أَكْتُبُ مَا أَسْمَعُ مِنْكَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 487

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, "Why don't you write us something, as we cannot memorize?" He replied, "No, we will not write for you, nor will we make it into a Quran. Rather, keep it from us just as we have kept it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, "Why don't you write us something, as we cannot memorize?" He replied, "No, we will not write for you, nor will we make it into a Quran. Rather, keep it from us just as we have kept it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ أَلَا تُكْتِبُنَا فَإِنَّا لَا نَحْفَظُ؟ فَقَالَ «لَا إِنَّا لَنْ نُكْتِبَكُمْ وَلَنْ نَجْعَلَهُ قُرْآنًا وَلَكِنِ احْفَظُوا عَنَّا كَمَا حَفِظْنَا نَحْنُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū Naḍrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 488

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, "Indeed, Abu Hurairah does not write nor is he written about."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Hurairah saying, "Indeed, Abu Hurairah does not write nor is he written about."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ «إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ لَا يَكْتُبُ وَلَا يُكْتِبُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا كَثِيرٍ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 489

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "He used to write down his father's saying, then Abu Musa saw it and erased it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He used to write down his father's saying, then Abu Musa saw it and erased it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْتُبُ حَدِيثَ أَبِيهِ «فَرَآهُ أَبُو مُوسَى فَمَحَاهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Asad b. Mūsá \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Mūsá \u003e Ḥumayd b. Hilāl \u003e Abū Burdah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 490

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Sirin said, "No, by Allah, I have never written a hadith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Sirin said, "No, by Allah, I have never written a hadith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وقال ابْنُ سِيرِينَ لَا وَاللَّهِ مَا كَتَبْتُ حَدِيثًا قَطُّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e Quraysh b. Anas \u003e Lī Ibn ʿAwn And al-Lah Mā Katabt Ḥadīth Qaṭ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنِي قُرَيْشُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ عَوْنٍ وَاللَّهِ مَا كَتَبْتُ حَدِيثًا قَطُّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 491

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "So he set up a curtain between his council and the rest of his house." They said, "Therefore, his companions used to enter upon him and discuss matters in that place. Then Marwan came to his companions and said, 'I see nothing except that we have been deceived.' Then he approached me and I said, 'And what is that?' He said, 'I see nothing except that we have deceived you.' I said, 'And what is that?' He said, 'We have appointed a man who sits behind this curtain and writes down what you dictate and what you say.'"
hadiths.body: "So he set up a curtain between his council and the rest of his house." They said, "Therefore, his companions used to enter upon him and discuss matters in that place. Then Marwan came to his companions and said, 'I see nothing except that we have been deceived.' Then he approached me and I said, 'And what is that?' He said, 'I see nothing except that we have deceived you.' I said, 'And what is that?' He said, 'We have appointed a man who sits behind this curtain and writes down what you dictate and what you say.'"
hadiths.arabic: «فَجَعَلَ سِتْرًا بَيْنَ مَجْلِسِهِ وَبَيْنَ بَقِيَّةِ دَارِهِ» قَالَ فَكَانَ أَصْحَابُهُ يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِ وَيَتَحَدَّثُونَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَوْضِعِ فَأَقْبَلَ مَرْوَانُ عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ مَا أُرَانَا إِلَّا قَدْ خُنَّاهُ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيَّ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَمَا ذَاكَ؟ قَالَ مَا أُرَانَا إِلَّا قَدْ خُنَّاكَ قَالَ قُلتُ وَمَا ذَاكَ؟ قَالَ إِنَّا أَمَرْناَ رَجُلًا يَقْعُدُ خَلْفَ هَذَا السِّتْرِ فَيَكْتُبَ مَا تُفْتِي هَؤُلَاءِ وَمَا تَقُولُ
hadiths.chain: Ibn ʿWn \u003e Lī Ibn Sīryn \u003e Zyd b. Thābt Arādinī Mrwān b. al-Ḥakam / Amīr \u003e al-Madīnah n Uktibah Shayʾ \u003e Falam Afʿal \u003e Fajaʿal Sitr Bayn Majlisih Wabayn Baqiyyah Dārih
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ ابْنُ عوْنٍ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ سِيرينَ عنْ زيْدِ بْنِ ثابتٍ أَرَادِنِي مرْوانُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ وَهُوَ أَمِيرٌ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ أنْ أُكْتِبَهُ شَيْئًا قَالَ «فَلَمْ أَفْعَلْ» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 492

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to Ibrahim, "Indeed, Salim, are you more knowledgeable than you?" He said, "Indeed, Salim used to write."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to Ibrahim, "Indeed, Salim, are you more knowledgeable than you?" He said, "Indeed, Salim used to write."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّ سَالِمًا أَتَمُّ مِنْكَ حَدِيثًا؟ قَالَ إِنَّ سَالِمًا كَانَ يَكْتُبُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Liʾibrāhīm In Sālim Atam Mink Ḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 493

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the evildoers will be raised and the righteous will be placed. Behold! Among the signs of the Hour is that speech will be abundant, while actions will be hidden. Behold! Among the signs of the Hour is that the 'mathnawa' will be recited and no one will be able to change it." It was asked, "What is the 'mathnawa'?" He said, "Whatever is written in a book other than the Quran. So adhere to the Quran, for it will guide you and for it you will be rewarded, and from it you will be asked." I did not know who the man was, so I narrated this hadith afterwards in Hims, and a man from the people said to me, "Do you not know who he is?" I said, "No." He said, "That is Abdullah bin Umar."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "That the evildoers will be raised and the righteous will be placed. Behold! Among the signs of the Hour is that speech will be abundant, while actions will be hidden. Behold! Among the signs of the Hour is that the 'mathnawa' will be recited and no one will be able to change it." It was asked, "What is the 'mathnawa'?" He said, "Whatever is written in a book other than the Quran. So adhere to the Quran, for it will guide you and for it you will be rewarded, and from it you will be asked." I did not know who the man was, so I narrated this hadith afterwards in Hims, and a man from the people said to me, "Do you not know who he is?" I said, "No." He said, "That is Abdullah bin Umar."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُرْفَعَ الْأَشْرَارُ وَيُوضَعَ الْأَخْيَارُ أَلَا إِنَّ «مِنْ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ أَنْ يَظْهَرَ الْقَوْلُ وَيُخْزَنَ الْعَمَلُ أَلَا إِنَّ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ أَنْ تُتْلَى الْمَثْنَاةُ فَلَا يُوجَدُ مَنْ يُغَيِّرُهَا» قِيلَ لَهُ وَمَا الْمَثْنَاةُ؟ قَالَ «مَا اسْتُكْتِبَ مِنْ كِتَابٍ غَيْرِ الْقُرْآنِ فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالْقُرْآنِ فَبِهِ هُدِيتُمْ وَبِهِ تُجْزَوْنَ وَعَنْهُ تُسْأَلُونَ» فَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَنِ الرَّجُلُ فَحَدَّثْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِحِمْصَ فَقَالَ لِي رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَوَ مَا تَعْرِفُهُ؟ قُلْتُ لَا قَالَ ذَلِكَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو ؓ    – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Hishām \u003e al-Ḥārith b. Yazīd al-Ḥimṣī \u003e ʿAmr b. Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَارِثُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِمْصِيُّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ وَفَدْتُ مَعَ أَبِي إِلَى يَزِيدَ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بِحُوَّارَيْنَ حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ مُعَاوِيَةُ نُعَزِّيهِ وَنُهَنِّيهِ بِالْخِلَافَةِ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ فِي مَسْجِدِهَا يَقُولُ أَلَا إِنَّ مِنْ أَشْرَاطِ السَّاعَةِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 494

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: And he said, "Verily, those before you perished by following their books and neglecting their own book." Husayn said, "Indeed, if it was from the Quran or the Sunnah, he would not have erased it, but it was from the books of the People of the Book."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: And he said, "Verily, those before you perished by following their books and neglecting their own book." Husayn said, "Indeed, if it was from the Quran or the Sunnah, he would not have erased it, but it was from the books of the People of the Book."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ بِاتِّبَاعِهِمُ الْكُتُبَ وَتَرْكِهِمْ كِتَابَهُمْ» قَالَ حُصَيْنٌ فَقَالَ مُرَّةُ أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَوْ كَانَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ أَوِ السُّنَّةِ لَمْ يَمْحُهُ وَلَكِنْ كَانَ مِنْ كُتُبِ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Abū Zubayd \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e Murrah al-Hamdānī \u003e Jāʾ Abū Qurrah al-Kindī Bikitāb from al-Shām Faḥamalah Fadafaʿah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd Fanaẓar Fīh Fadaʿā Biṭast Thum Daʿā Bimāʾ Famarasah Fīh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ عَنْ مُرَّةَ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ قَالَ جَاءَ أَبُو قُرَّةَ الْكِنْدِيُّ بِكِتَابٍ مِنَ الشَّامِ فَحَمَلَهُ فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَنَظَرَ فِيهِ فَدَعَا بِطَسْتٍ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَمَرَسَهُ فِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 495

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ came with a shoulder carrying a book and said, "It is sufficient for a people to go astray that they desire what their Prophet came with over what another Prophet came with or what their book came with." Then Allah, the Almighty, revealed the verse {Is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.} [Al-Ankabut 51].
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ came with a shoulder carrying a book and said, "It is sufficient for a people to go astray that they desire what their Prophet came with over what another Prophet came with or what their book came with." Then Allah, the Almighty, revealed the verse {Is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.} [Al-Ankabut 51].
hadiths.arabic: أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِكَتِفٍ فِيهِ كِتَابٌ فَقَالَ كَفَى بِقَوْمٍ ضَلَالًا أَنْ يَرْغَبُوا عَمَّا جَاءَ بِهِ نَبِيُّهُمْ إِلَى مَا جَاءَ بِهِ نَبِيٌّ غَيْرُ نَبِيِّهِمْ أَوْ كِتَابٌ غَيْرُ كِتَابِهِمْ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ﷻ {أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِهِمْ أَنَّا أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ يُتْلَى عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَرَحْمَةً وَذِكْرَى لِقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ} [العنكبوت 51] الْآيَةَ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr \u003e Yaḥyá b. Jaʿdah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ جَعْدَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 496

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: About his father, Abdullah said, "I saw a man with a paper in which it was written: Subhan Allah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illa Allah, Allahu Akbar. I asked him to give it to me, but he refused. Then, he promised to give it to me later. So, I came to Abdullah and found it with him. He said, 'What is in this book is innovation, temptation, and misguidance. Indeed, those who came before you were destroyed because of things like this. They wrote it and their tongues enjoyed it, and their hearts were filled with it. Therefore, I am determined that whoever knows the whereabouts of this book, except if he indicates it, I will take an oath by Allah.' Shu'bah asked, 'Did he take an oath by Allah?' He said, 'I think he did, for if it were mentioned to him at the monastery of Hind, we would see him coming even if it was far away in Kufa, even on foot.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About his father, Abdullah said, "I saw a man with a paper in which it was written: Subhan Allah, Alhamdulillah, La ilaha illa Allah, Allahu Akbar. I asked him to give it to me, but he refused. Then, he promised to give it to me later. So, I came to Abdullah and found it with him. He said, 'What is in this book is innovation, temptation, and misguidance. Indeed, those who came before you were destroyed because of things like this. They wrote it and their tongues enjoyed it, and their hearts were filled with it. Therefore, I am determined that whoever knows the whereabouts of this book, except if he indicates it, I will take an oath by Allah.' Shu'bah asked, 'Did he take an oath by Allah?' He said, 'I think he did, for if it were mentioned to him at the monastery of Hind, we would see him coming even if it was far away in Kufa, even on foot.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ مَعَ رَجُلٍ صَحِيفَةً فِيهَا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَنْسِخْنِيهَا فَكَأَنَّهُ بَخِلَ بِهَا ثُمَّ وَعَدَنِي أَنْ يُعْطِيَنِيهَا فَأَتَيْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْكِتَابِ بِدْعَةٌ وَفِتْنَةٌ وَضَلَالَةٌ وَإِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ هَذَا وَأَشْبَاهُ هَذَا إِنَّهُمْ كَتَبُوهَا فَاسْتَلَذَّتْهَا أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأُشْرِبَتْهَا قُلُوبُهُمْ فَأَعْزِمُ عَلَى كُلِّ امْرِئٍ يَعْلَمُ مكانِ كِتَابٍ إِلَّا دَلَّ عَلَيْهِ وَأُقْسِمُ بِاللَّهِ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَأَقْسَمَ بِاللَّهِ؟ قَالَ أَحْسَبُهُ أَقْسَمَ لَوْ أَنَّهَا ذُكِرَتْ لهُ بِديرِ لهنْدِ نُراهُ يَعْنِي مَكَانًا بِالْكُوفَةِ بَعِيدًا لأتيْتهُ وَلَوْ مَشْيًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ashʿath
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْأَشْعَثِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 497

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "The children of Israel wrote a book, so they followed it and left the Torah."
hadiths.body: "The children of Israel wrote a book, so they followed it and left the Torah."
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَتَبُوا كِتَابًا فَتَبِعُوهُ وَتَرَكُوا التَّوْرَاةَ»
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Abū Burdah \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 498

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: "To write nothing but the Book of Allah, Almighty and Glorious."
hadiths.body: "To write nothing but the Book of Allah, Almighty and Glorious."
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَكْتُبَ إِلَّا كِتَابَ اللَّهِ ﷻ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e ʿUthmān b. Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e ʿAffāq al-Muḥāribī from his father \u003e Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَفَّاقٍ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ يَقُولُ «إِنَّ نَاسًا يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَامِي ثُمَّ يَنْطَلِقُونَ فَيَكْتُبُونَهُ وَإِنِّي لَا أُحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 499

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ كِتَابَةَ الْحَدِيثِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who did not see the writing of the Hadith

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the poet say, "I never wrote black on white, nor did I borrow a word from any person."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the poet say, "I never wrote black on white, nor did I borrow a word from any person."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ يَقُولُ «مَا كَتَبْتُ سَوْدَاءَ فِي بَيْضَاءَ وَلَا اسْتَعَدْتُ حَدِيثًا مِنْ إِنْسَانٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mālik b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Muḥammad b. Fuḍayl \u003e Ibn Shubrumah \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 500

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: that the heard Abu Hurairah say: "None of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated more Ahadith from him than me, except 'Abdullah bin 'Amr. For he used to write them down and I did not write."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the heard Abu Hurairah say: "None of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ narrated more Ahadith from him than me, except 'Abdullah bin 'Amr. For he used to write them down and I did not write."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ «لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَكْثَرَ حَدِيثًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِنِّي إِلَّا مَا كَانَ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَكْتُبُ وَلَا أَكْتُبُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr \u003e Wahbb. Munabbih \u003e Akhīh \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 501

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: I used to write everything which I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I intended (by it) to memorise it. The Quraysh prohibited me saying: Do you write everything that you hear from him while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is a human being: he speaks in anger and pleasure? So I stopped writing, and mentioned it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He signalled with his finger to him mouth and said: Write, by Him in Whose hand my soul lies, only right comes out from it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I used to write everything which I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. I intended (by it) to memorise it. The Quraysh prohibited me saying: Do you write everything that you hear from him while the Messenger of Allah ﷺ is a human being: he speaks in anger and pleasure? So I stopped writing, and mentioned it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He signalled with his finger to him mouth and said: Write, by Him in Whose hand my soul lies, only right comes out from it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ أَكْتُبُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَسْمَعُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُرِيدُ حِفْظَهُ فَنَهَتْنِي قُرَيْشٌ وَقَالُوا تَكْتُبُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَشَرٌ يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي الْغَضَبِ وَالرِّضَا؟ فَأَمْسَكْتُ عَنِ الْكِتَابِ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَوْمَأَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ إِلَى فِيهِ وَقَالَ «اكْتُبْ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا خَرَجَ مِنْهُ إِلَّا حَقٌّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. al-Akhnas \u003e al-Walīd b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Yūsuf b. Māhak \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَخْنَسِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 502

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: He (the speaker) came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I want to learn from your teachings, so I intended to seek assistance through writing with my hand and keeping it close to my heart. If you agree to that." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "If you want, learn my teachings and seek assistance through your hand and keep it close to your heart."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He (the speaker) came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I want to learn from your teachings, so I intended to seek assistance through writing with my hand and keeping it close to my heart. If you agree to that." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "If you want, learn my teachings and seek assistance through your hand and keep it close to your heart."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَرْوِيَ مِنْ حَدِيثِكَ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَسْتَعِينَ بِكِتَابِ يَدِي مَعَ قَلْبِي إِنْ رَأَيْتَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنْ كَانَ قَالَهُ «عِ حَدِيثِي ثُمَّ اسْتَعِنْ بِيَدِكَ مَعَ قَلْبِكَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Khālid b. Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Hilāl \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Qays \u003e Mukhbir \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُخْبِرٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 503

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "While we were around the Messenger of Allah ﷺ writing, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked, 'Which two cities will be opened first, Constantinople or Rome?' The Prophet ﷺ replied, 'No, the city of Heraclius will be opened first.'"   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "While we were around the Messenger of Allah ﷺ writing, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked, 'Which two cities will be opened first, Constantinople or Rome?' The Prophet ﷺ replied, 'No, the city of Heraclius will be opened first.'"   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ حَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَكْتُبُ إِذْ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَيُّ الْمَدِينَتَيْنِ تُفْتَحُ أَوَّلًا قُسْطَنْطِينِيَّةُ أَوْ رُومِيَّةُ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَا بَلْ مَدِينَةُ هِرَقْلَ أَوَّلًا»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Isḥāq \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qabīl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قَبِيلٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 504

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Please write to me about what you have confirmed from the Hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and about the Hadith of 'Umrah, as I have feared the loss of knowledge and its disappearance."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Please write to me about what you have confirmed from the Hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and about the Hadith of 'Umrah, as I have feared the loss of knowledge and its disappearance."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ اكْتُبْ إِلَيَّ بِمَا ثَبَتَ عِنْدَكَ مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَبِحَدِيثِ عَمْرَةَ فَإِنِّي قَدْ خَشِيتُ دُرُوسَ الْعِلْمِ وَذَهَابَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm Abū Maʿmar \u003e Abū Ḍamrah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Katab ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ؒ \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm \u003e Āktub Ilay Bimā Thabat ʿIndak from al-Ḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي ضَمْرَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ «كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 505

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Look at the sayings of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and write them down, as I fear the loss of knowledge and the departure of its people."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Look at the sayings of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and write them down, as I fear the loss of knowledge and the departure of its people."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ انْظُرُوا حَدِيثَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَاكْتُبُوهُ فَإِنِّي قَدْ خِفْتُ دُرُوسَ الْعِلْمِ وَذَهَابَ أَهْلِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muslim \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Katab ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Ahl al-Madīnah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ «كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 506

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Allah, the Exalted, is the All-Knower of it with my Lord in a Record." [Surah Taha 52]   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Allah, the Exalted, is the All-Knower of it with my Lord in a Record." [Surah Taha 52]   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَابٍ} [طه 52]   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū al-Malīḥ \u003e Yaʿībūn ʿAlaynā al-Kitāb And Qad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ قَالَ يَعِيبُونَ عَلَيْنَا الْكِتَابَ وَقَدْ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 507

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said, "Whoever does not write their knowledge, their knowledge is not considered knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said, "Whoever does not write their knowledge, their knowledge is not considered knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ «مَنْ لَمْ يَكْتُبْ عِلْمَهُ لَمْ يُعَدَّ عِلْمُهُ عِلْمًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Sawādah b. Ḥayyān \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Qurrah Abū Iyās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا سَوَادَةُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ قُرَّةَ أَبَا إِيَاسٍ يَقُولُ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 508

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: Anas used to say to his sons, "O my sons, document this knowledge."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Anas used to say to his sons, "O my sons, document this knowledge."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَنَسًا كَانَ يَقُولُ لِبَنِيهِ «يَا بَنِيَّ قَيِّدُوا هَذَا الْعِلْمَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Muthanná \u003e Thumāmah b. ʿAbdullāh b. Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنِي ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 509

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw Aban writing on Anas' blackboard."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw Aban writing on Anas' blackboard."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُ أَبَانَ يَكْتُبُ عِنْدَ أَنَسٍ فِي سَبُّورَةٍ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e Mahdī b. Maymūn \u003e Salm al-ʿAlawī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مَهْدِيِّ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ سَلْمٍ الْعَلَوِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 510

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: There is no harm in that.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: There is no harm in that.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn Wahb \u003e Muʿāwiyah \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيَّ عَنْ كِتَابِ الْعِلْمِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 511

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "That I should leave him and I came to him with his book, I read it to him and said to him, 'Did I hear this from you?' He said, 'Yes'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That I should leave him and I came to him with his book, I read it to him and said to him, 'Did I hear this from you?' He said, 'Yes'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ أُفَارِقَهُ أَتَيْتُهُ بِكِتَابِهِ فَقَرَأْتُهُ عَلَيْهِ وَقُلْتُ لَهُ هَذَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْكَ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Makhlad b. Mālik \u003e Muʿādh \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥudayr \u003e Abū Mijlaz \u003e Bashīr b. Nahīk
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُدَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَكْتُبُ مَا أَسْمَعُ مِنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 512

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I hear the hadith from Ibn Umar and Ibn Abbas at night, then I write it in a notebook."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I hear the hadith from Ibn Umar and Ibn Abbas at night, then I write it in a notebook."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَسْمَعُ مِنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ الْحَدِيثَ بِاللَّيْلِ فَأَكْتُبُهُ فِي وَاسِطَةِ الرَّحْلِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Sharīk \u003e Ṭāriq b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ «كُنْتُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 513

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: I am not interested in anything in life except honesty and generosity. As for honesty, it is a book written by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . And as for generosity, it is a land on which 'Amr ibn al-'As used to give charity and maintain.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I am not interested in anything in life except honesty and generosity. As for honesty, it is a book written by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . And as for generosity, it is a land on which 'Amr ibn al-'As used to give charity and maintain.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا يُرَغِّبُنِي فِي الْحَيَاةِ إِلَّا الصَّادِقَةُ وَالْوَهْطُ فَأَمَّا الصَّادِقَةُ فَصَحِيفَةٌ كَتَبْتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَمَّا الْوَهْطُ فَأَرْضٌ تَصَدَّقَ بِهَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ كَانَ يَقُومُ عَلَيْهَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Sharīk \u003e Layth \u003e Mujāhid \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 514

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "He heard Umar ibn Al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, saying, 'Restrain knowledge with the book.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He heard Umar ibn Al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, saying, 'Restrain knowledge with the book.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ يَقُولُ «قَيِّدُوا الْعِلْمَ بِالْكِتَابِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Sufyān from his uncle ʿAmr b. Abū Sufyān \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb Riḍwān Allāh ʿAlayh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 515

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "Document this knowledge in the book."
hadiths.body: He said, "Document this knowledge in the book."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «قَيِّدُوا هَذَا الْعِلْمَ بِالْكِتَابِ»
hadiths.chain: Makhlad b. Mālik \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Jurayj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ الثَّقَفِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 516

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "He tells me the story and I write it down in the notebook until morning, then I write it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He tells me the story and I write it down in the notebook until morning, then I write it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُحَدِّثُنِي بِالْحَدِيثِ فَأَكْتُبُهُ فِي وَاسِطَةِ الرَّحْلِ حَتَّى أُصْبِحَ فَأَكْتُبَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid \u003e ʿUthmān b. Ḥakīm \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ يَقُولُ «كُنْتُ أَسِيرُ مَعَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ لَيْلًا وَكَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 517

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I used to write next to Ibn Abbas in a notebook, and I would also write on my sandals."
hadiths.body: "I used to write next to Ibn Abbas in a notebook, and I would also write on my sandals."
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ أَكْتُبُ عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي صَحِيفَةٍ وَأَكْتُبُ فِي نَعْلَيَّ»
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Yaʿqūb al-Qummī \u003e Jaʿfar b. Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ الْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 518

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: I used to sit with Ibn Abbas and write in the manuscript until it was filled, then I would turn my sandal and write on its back.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I used to sit with Ibn Abbas and write in the manuscript until it was filled, then I would turn my sandal and write on its back.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ أَجْلِسُ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَأَكْتُبُ فِي الصَّحِيفَةِ حَتَّى تَمْتَلِئَ ثُمَّ أَقْلِبُ نَعْلَيَّ فَأَكْتُبُ فِي ظُهُورِهِمَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Mālik b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Mandal b. ʿAlī al-ʿAnazī \u003e Jaʿfar b. Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْدَلُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْعَنَزِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 519

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw them writing the explanation at Mujahid's."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw them writing the explanation at Mujahid's."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ التَّفْسِيرَ عِنْدَ مُجَاهِدٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Fuḍayl \u003e ʿUbayd al-Muktib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا فُضَيْلٌ عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ الْمُكْتِبِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 520

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw them writing with the tips of their fingers on the bamboo poles."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw them writing with the tips of their fingers on the bamboo poles."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ عِنْدَ الْبَرَاءِ بِأَطْرَافِ الْقَصَبِ عَلَى أَكُفِّهِمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Wakīʿ \u003e By \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Ḥanash
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنبَأَنَا وَكِيعٍ حَدَّثَنَا أبي عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَنَشٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 521

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "He explained to me and barely."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He explained to me and barely."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فَرَخَّصَ لِي وَلَمْ يَكَدْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e Hārūn b. \u003e Tarah from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Biḥadīth Faqult Aktubuh \u003e k
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ عَنْتَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِحَدِيثٍ فَقُلْتُ أَكْتُبُهُ عَنْكَ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 522

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "It was written with me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It was written with me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ عِنْدِي مَكْتُوبًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Shuʿayb b. Shābūr \u003e al-Walīd b. Sulaymān b. Abū al-Sāʾib \u003e Rajāʾ b. Ḥaywah \u003e Katab Hishām b. ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿĀmilih \u003e Yasʾalanī \u003e Ḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ شَابُورٍ أَنبَأَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي السَّائِبِ عَنْ رَجَاءِ بْنِ حَيْوَةَ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ كَتَبَ هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ إِلَى عَامِلِهِ أَنْ يَسْأَلَنِي عَنْ حَدِيثٍ؟ قَالَ رَجَاءٌ فَكُنْتُ قَدْ نَسِيتُهُ لَوْلَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 523

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: Ata Ibn Abi Rabah used to be asked about things and he would write down what he would answer with in front of him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ata Ibn Abi Rabah used to be asked about things and he would write down what he would answer with in front of him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ «يُسْأَلُ عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ وَيُكْتَبُ مَا يُجِيبَ فِيهِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Shuʿayb \u003e Hishām b. al-Ghāz
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ الْغَازِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 524

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: He saw Nafi', a student of Ibn 'Umar, dictating his knowledge and writing in front of him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He saw Nafi', a student of Ibn 'Umar, dictating his knowledge and writing in front of him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ «رَأَى نَافِعًا مَوْلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ يُمْلِي عِلْمَهُ وَيُكْتَبُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Shuʿayb b. Shābūr \u003e al-Walīd b. Sulaymān b. Abū al-Sāʾib \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ شَابُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي السَّائِبِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 525

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: Sufyan used to write the hadith at night on the wall, then he would erase it in the morning.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Sufyan used to write the hadith at night on the wall, then he would erase it in the morning.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ سُفْيَانُ يَكْتُبُ الْحَدِيثَ بِاللَّيْلِ فِي الْحَائِطِ فَإِذَا أَصْبَحَ نَسَخَهُ ثُمَّ حَكَّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e al-Mubārak b. Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 526

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: Fulan, a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , narrated to me that Umar recognized him. I said, "Tell me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Indeed, modesty, chastity, and the control of the tongue are not qualities of the heart, but rather they are part of faith, and they increase in the hereafter and decrease in this worldly life. And what increases in the hereafter is greater. Verily, foul language, arrogance, and greed are qualities of hypocrisy, and they increase in this worldly life and decrease in the hereafter. And what decreases in the hereafter is greater.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Fulan, a man from the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , narrated to me that Umar recognized him. I said, "Tell me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Indeed, modesty, chastity, and the control of the tongue are not qualities of the heart, but rather they are part of faith, and they increase in the hereafter and decrease in this worldly life. And what increases in the hereafter is greater. Verily, foul language, arrogance, and greed are qualities of hypocrisy, and they increase in this worldly life and decrease in the hereafter. And what decreases in the hereafter is greater.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي فُلَانٌ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَعَرَفَهُ عُمَرُ قُلْتُ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ الْحَيَاءَ وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْعِيَّ عِيَّ اللِّسَانِ لَا عِيَّ الْقَلْبِ وَالْفِقْهَ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ وَهُنَّ مِمَّا يَزِدْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَيُنْقِصْنَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا يَزِدْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ أَكْثَرُ وَإِنَّ الْبَذَاءَ وَالْجَفَاءَ وَالشُّحَّ مِنَ النِّفَاقِ وَهُنَّ مِمَّا يَزِدْنَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَيُنْقِصْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ وَمَا يُنْقِصْنَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ أَكْثَرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥusayn b. Manṣūr \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Abū Ghifār al-Muthanná b. Saʿd al-Ṭāʾī \u003e ʿAwn b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Liʿumar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غِفَارٍ الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعْدٍ الطَّائِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي عَوْنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 527

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: Awun ibn Abdullah told me about it, and I found it fascinating, so I wrote it down. And here is the narration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Awun ibn Abdullah told me about it, and I found it fascinating, so I wrote it down. And here is the narration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ عَوْنُ بْنُ عبْدِ اللَّهِ فَأَعْجَبَنِي فَكَتَبْتُهُ فَإِذَا فِيهِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. al-Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثنا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ قَالَ أُبُو قِلَابَةَ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ لِصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ وَمَعَهُ قِرْطَاسٌ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا لِصَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ وَهُوَ مَعَهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا هَذَا الْكِتَابُ؟ قَالَ هَذَا حَدِيثٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 528

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَخَّصَ فِي كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has been authorized to write about knowledge?

hadiths.englishRaw: "O my sons and the sons of my brother, you are young people of a nation who are about to become elders like others, so seek knowledge. Whoever among you is unable to learn or teach it, let him write it and place it in his home."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "O my sons and the sons of my brother, you are young people of a nation who are about to become elders like others, so seek knowledge. Whoever among you is unable to learn or teach it, let him write it and place it in his home."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا بَنِيَّ وَبَنِي أَخِي إِنَّكُمْ صِغَارُ قَوْمٍ يُوشِكُ أَنْ تَكُونُوا كِبَارَ آخَرِينَ فَتَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَرْوِيَهُ أَوْ قَالَ يَحْفَظَهُ فَلْيَكْتُبْهُ وَلْيَضَعْهُ فِي بَيْتِهِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Masʿūd \u003e Yūnus b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Farwah \u003e Shuraḥbīl Abū Saʿd \u003e Daʿā al-Ḥasan Banīh And Banī Akhīh \u003e Yā Banī Wabanī Akhī Innakum Ṣighār Qawm Yūshik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا مَسْعُودٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ أَبِي سَعْدٍ قَالَ دَعَا الْحَسَنُ بَنِيهِ وَبَنِي أَخِيهِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 529

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً أَوْ سَيِّئَةً
chapter.englishTitle: Who establishes a good or bad sunnah?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever introduces a good practice that is followed, he will receive its reward and a reward equivalent to that of those who follow it, without that detracting from their reward in their slightest. And whoever introduces a bad practice that is followed, he will receive its sin and a burden of sin equivalent to that of those who follow it, without that detracting from their burden in the slightest.'"     – Sound
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever introduces a good practice that is followed, he will receive its reward and a reward equivalent to that of those who follow it, without that detracting from their reward in their slightest. And whoever introduces a bad practice that is followed, he will receive its sin and a burden of sin equivalent to that of those who follow it, without that detracting from their burden in the slightest.'"     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً عُمِلَ بِهَا بَعْدَهُ كَانَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أَجْرِهِ شَيْءٌ وَمَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً سَيِّئَةً كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلُ وِزْرِ مَنْ يعَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أَوْزَارِهِم شَيْءٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Shaqīq \u003e Jarīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ جَرِيرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 530

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً أَوْ سَيِّئَةً
chapter.englishTitle: Who establishes a good or bad sunnah?

hadiths.englishRaw: If anyone summons other to follow right guidance, his reward will be equivalent to that of the people who follow him, without their rewards being diminished in any respect on that account; and if anyone summons others to follow error the sin of which sins being diminished in any respect on that account.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: If anyone summons other to follow right guidance, his reward will be equivalent to that of the people who follow him, without their rewards being diminished in any respect on that account; and if anyone summons others to follow error the sin of which sins being diminished in any respect on that account.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى هُدًى كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ مِثْلُ أُجُورِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَهُ لَا يَنْقُصُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ أُجُورِهِمْ شَيْئًا وَمَنْ دَعَا إِلَى ضَلَالَةٍ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْإِثْمِ مِثْلُ آثَامِ مَنْ تَبِعَهُ لَا يَنْقُصُ ذَلِكَ مِنْ آثَامِهِمْ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yaʿqūb a freed slave of al-Ḥuraqah from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ مَوْلَى الْحُرَقَةِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 531

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً أَوْ سَيِّئَةً
chapter.englishTitle: Who establishes a good or bad sunnah?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon and exhorted the people to give charity. They were slow to respond until anger became apparent on his face. Then, a man from the Ansar came with a bag filled with items, and the people began to follow suit until it was seen on his face that he was delighted. He said, "Whoever starts a good practice will receive its reward and the reward of those who follow it, without reducing anything from their rewards. And whoever initiates an evil practice shall carry its burden and the burden of those who act upon it, without diminishing anything from their burdens."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon and exhorted the people to give charity. They were slow to respond until anger became apparent on his face. Then, a man from the Ansar came with a bag filled with items, and the people began to follow suit until it was seen on his face that he was delighted. He said, "Whoever starts a good practice will receive its reward and the reward of those who follow it, without reducing anything from their rewards. And whoever initiates an evil practice shall carry its burden and the burden of those who act upon it, without diminishing anything from their burdens."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَحَثَّ النَّاسَ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ فَأَبْطَئُوا حَتَّى بَانَ فِي وَجْهِهِ الْغَضَبُ ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ بِصُرَّةٍ فَتَتَابَعَ النَّاسُ حَتَّى رُئِيَ فِي وَجْهِهِ السُّرُورُ فَقَالَ «مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً كَانَ لَهُ أَجْرُهُ وَمِثْلُ أَجْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أُجُورِهِمْ شَيْءٌ وَمَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً سَيِّئَةً كَانَ عَلَيْهِ وِزْرُهُ وَمِثْلُ وِزْرِ مَنْ عَمِلَ بِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يُنْقَصَ مِنْ أَوْزَارِهِمْ شَيْءٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ \u003e Abū Muʿāwiyah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Muslim / Ibn Ṣubayḥ \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Hilāl al-ʿAbsī \u003e Jarīr b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ صُبَيْحٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ الْعَبْسِيِّ عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 532

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً أَوْ سَيِّئَةً
chapter.englishTitle: Who establishes a good or bad sunnah?

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'I am the greatest of you in terms of reward on the Day of Resurrection, for I have my own reward and the reward of those who follow me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'I am the greatest of you in terms of reward on the Day of Resurrection, for I have my own reward and the reward of those who follow me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «أَنَا أَعْظَمُكُمْ أَجْرًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لِأَنَّ لِي أَجْرِي وَمِثْلَ أَجْرِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَنِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb b. Saʿīd \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ḥassān b. ʿAṭiyyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي حَسَّانُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 533

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً أَوْ سَيِّئَةً
chapter.englishTitle: Who establishes a good or bad sunnah?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever invites others to a good deed, even if it is as small as inviting one person, he will be rewarded on the Day of Judgment as if he had done that deed himself, without any decrease in reward for either of them. Then he recited the verse: 'Stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned' [Quran 37:24]."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever invites others to a good deed, even if it is as small as inviting one person, he will be rewarded on the Day of Judgment as if he had done that deed himself, without any decrease in reward for either of them. Then he recited the verse: 'Stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned' [Quran 37:24]."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى أَمْرٍ وَلَوْ دَعَا رَجُلٌ رَجُلًا كَانَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَوْقُوفًا بِهِ لَازِمًا بِغَارِبِهِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ {وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ} [الصافات 24]   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Mālik b. Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām \u003e Layth \u003e Bishr \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ بِشْرٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 534

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً حَسَنَةً أَوْ سَيِّئَةً
chapter.englishTitle: Who establishes a good or bad sunnah?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Four things are given to a man after his death: one-third of his wealth if he had it before that and was obedient to Allah, righteous children who pray for him after his death, good deeds that the man practiced and are carried out after his death, and intercession if a hundred people intercede for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Four things are given to a man after his death: one-third of his wealth if he had it before that and was obedient to Allah, righteous children who pray for him after his death, good deeds that the man practiced and are carried out after his death, and intercession if a hundred people intercede for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَرْبَعٌ يُعْطَاهَا الرَّجُلُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ ثُلُثُ مَالِهِ إِذَا كَانَ فِيهِ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ لِلَّهِ مُطِيعًا وَالْوَلَدُ الصَّالِحُ يَدْعُو لَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَوْتِهِ وَالسُّنَّةُ الْحَسَنَةُ يَسُنُّهَا الرَّجُلُ فَيُعْمَلُ بِهَا بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ وَالْمِائَةُ إِذَا شَفَعُوا لِلرَّجُلِ شُفِّعُوا فِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 535

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "To make him sit on a chair, but he refused."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To make him sit on a chair, but he refused."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ نُجْلِسَهُ إِلَى سَارِيَةٍ فَأَبَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥajjāj \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Jahadnā Biʾibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ قَالَ «جَهَدْنَا بِإِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 536

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "To lean on the pillar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To lean on the pillar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَسْتَنِدَ إِلَى السَّارِيَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ «يَكْرَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 537

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim used to not start a conversation until he was asked.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim used to not start a conversation until he was asked.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ «لَا يَبْتَدِئُ الْحَدِيثَ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 538

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: Al-Harith ibn Qays al-Ju'fi was one of the companions of Abdullah who admired him, so he used to sit with him. When the men became numerous, he would stand up and leave them.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Al-Harith ibn Qays al-Ju'fi was one of the companions of Abdullah who admired him, so he used to sit with him. When the men became numerous, he would stand up and leave them.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَكَانُوا مُعْجَبِينَ بِهِ فَكَانَ» يَجْلِسُ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلُ وَالرَّجُلَانِ فَيُحَدِّثُهُمَا فَإِذَا كَثُرُوا قَامَ وَتَرَكَهُمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Yūnus b. Bukayr \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Khaythamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 539

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: It was said to him when Abdullah died, "If you stayed and taught the people the Sunnah?" So he said, "Do you want my back to be trampled upon?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was said to him when Abdullah died, "If you stayed and taught the people the Sunnah?" So he said, "Do you want my back to be trampled upon?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قِيلَ لَهُ حِينَ مَاتَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَوْ قَعَدْتَ فَعَلَّمْتَ النَّاسَ السُّنَّةَ؟ فَقَالَ «أَتُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُوطَأَ عَقِبِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 540

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do you not see? A trial for the guided, a humiliation for the follower?"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "Do you not see? A trial for the guided, a humiliation for the follower?"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَوَ مَا تَرَى؟ فِتْنَةً لِلْمَتْبُوعِ مَذَلَّةً لِلتَّابِعِ؟»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e Hārūn b. \u003e Tarah \u003e Sulaym b. Ḥanẓalah \u003e Ataynā Ubay b. Kaʿb Linataḥaddath Ilayh Falammā Qām Qumnā And Naḥn Namshī Khalfah Farahaqanā ʿUmar Riḍwān Allāh ʿAlayh Fatabiʿah Faḍarabah ʿUmar Bi-al-Ddirrah \u003e Fāttaqāh Bidhirāʿayh \u003e Yā Amīr al-Muʾminīn Mā Naṣnaʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ هَارُونَ بْنَ عَنْتَرَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ قَالَ أَتَيْنَا أُبَيَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ لِنَتَحَدَّثَ إِلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا قَامَ قُمْنَا وَنَحْنُ نَمْشِي خَلْفَهُ فَرَهَقَنَا عُمَرُ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ فَتَبِعَهُ فَضَرَبَهُ عُمَرُ بِالدِّرَّةِ قَالَ فَاتَّقَاهُ بِذِرَاعَيْهِ فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا نَصْنَعُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 541

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Their heels are to be stepped upon."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Their heels are to be stepped upon."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تُوطَأَ أَعْقَابُهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Jarīr \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Kānūā Yakrahūn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ «كَانُوا يَكْرَهُونَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 542

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: Do you have a need? If he had a need, he would fulfill it, but if he asks, he will leave. And he said, "Do you have a need?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Do you have a need? If he had a need, he would fulfill it, but if he asks, he will leave. And he said, "Do you have a need?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَلَكَ حَاجَةٌ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ قَضَاهَا وَإِنْ عَادَ يَمْشِي مَعَهُ قَامَ فَقَالَ أَلَكَ حَاجَةٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Bisṭām b. Muslim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ بِسْطَامِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ كَانَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ إِذَا مَشَى مَعَهُ الرَّجُلُ قَامَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 543

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "To have your feet stepped on."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "To have your feet stepped on."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تُوطَأَ أَعْقَابُكُمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Ḥamzah \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Iyyākum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ «إِيَّاكُمْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 544

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: And he said, "Indeed, your actions, this or your behavior, this, is humiliation for the follower and a trial for the follower."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: And he said, "Indeed, your actions, this or your behavior, this, is humiliation for the follower and a trial for the follower."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ «إِنَّ صَنِيعَكُمْ هَذَا أَوْ مَشْيَكُمْ هَذَا مَذَلَّةٌ لِلتَّابِعِ وَفِتْنَةٌ لِلْمَتْبُوعِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Makhlad b. Mālik \u003e Ḥajjāj b. Muḥammad \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Haytham \u003e ʿĀṣim b. Ḍamrah \u003e Raʾá Unās Yatbaʿūn Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Faʾurāh \u003e Nahāhum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْهَيْثَمِ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ أَنَّهُ رَأَى أُنَاسًا يَتْبَعُونَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ فَأُرَاهُ قَالَ نَهَاهُمْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 545

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "And he said, 'If you want the foundation of the building, then guide me until I come with you.' He said, 'So I went with him.' Then while we were walking, a man came and walked with him. He stood and said, 'Do you need something?' He said, 'No.' He said, 'Either you do not need, then go.' Then he turned to me and said, 'You also go.' So I went until I diverged from the path."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "And he said, 'If you want the foundation of the building, then guide me until I come with you.' He said, 'So I went with him.' Then while we were walking, a man came and walked with him. He stood and said, 'Do you need something?' He said, 'No.' He said, 'Either you do not need, then go.' Then he turned to me and said, 'You also go.' So I went until I diverged from the path."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَسَاسَ الْبِنَاءِ فَآذِنِّي حَتَّى أَجِيءَ مَعَكَ» قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ قَالَ فَبَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ نَمْشِي إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَمَشَى مَعَهُ فَقَامَ فَقَالَ «أَلَكَ حَاجَةٌ؟» قَالَ لَا قَالَ «إمَّا لَا فَاذْهَبْ» ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيَّ فَقَالَ «أَنْتَ أَيْضًا فَاذْهَبْ» قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ حَتَّى خَالَفْتُ الطَّرِيقَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Ḥumayd b. Aswad \u003e Ibn ʿAwn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْوَدَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ قَالَ شَاوَرْتُ مُحَمَّدًا فِي بِنَاءٍ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْنِيَهُ فِي الْكَلَّاءِ قَالَ فَأَشَارَ عَلَيَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 546

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "When spring would come, it would say, 'I seek refuge in Allah from your evil', meaning its companions."   – Sound Chain
