hadiths.body: "When spring would come, it would say, 'I seek refuge in Allah from your evil', meaning its companions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الرَّبِيعَ كَانَ إِذَا أَتَوْهُ يَقُولُ «أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّكُمْ» يَعْنِي أَصْحَابَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Mahdī \u003e Sufyān \u003e Nusayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ نُسَيْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 547

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "To say to them what I do not do."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "To say to them what I do not do."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ أَقُولَ لَهُمْ مَا لَا أَفْعَلُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Makhlad b. Mālik \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Rajāʾ al-Anṣārī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Bishr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ رَجَاءٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ خَبَّابِ بْنِ الْأَرَتِّ فَاجْتَمَعَ إِلَيْهِ أَصْحَابُهُ وَهُوَ سَاكِتٌ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَلَا تُحَدِّثُ أَصْحَابَكَ؟ قَالَ «أَخَافُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 548

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "I wished that I had safely escaped from this work, without any harm occurring to me or others."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I wished that I had safely escaped from this work, without any harm occurring to me or others."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «وَدِدْتُ أَنِّي نَجَوْتُ مِنْ عَمَلِي كَفَافًا لَا لِي وَلَا عَلَيَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ صَالِحٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 549

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not walk in my footsteps, for by Allah, if you knew what difficulties I have faced, no one among you would follow me."
hadiths.body: "Do not walk in my footsteps, for by Allah, if you knew what difficulties I have faced, no one among you would follow me."
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَطَئُوا عَقِبِي فَوَاللَّهِ لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أُغْلِقُ عَلَيْهِ بَابِي مَا تَبِعَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنْكُمْ»
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ كَانَ يَمْشِي وَنَاسٌ يَطَئُونَ عَقِبَهُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 550

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "A trial for the followed, a humiliation for the follower."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "A trial for the followed, a humiliation for the follower."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فِتْنَةٌ لِلْمَتْبُوعِ مَذَلَّةٌ لِلتَّابِعِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 551

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Be cautious about stepping on my heart, as it is detrimental to the hearts of wounded men."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Be cautious about stepping on my heart, as it is detrimental to the hearts of wounded men."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «عَنِّي خَفْقَ نِعَالِكُمْ فَإِنَّهَا مُفْسِدَةٌ لِقُلُوبِ نَوْكَى الرِّجَالِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Shihāb b. ʿAbbād \u003e Sufyān \u003e Umay \u003e Mashawā Khalf ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أُمَيٍّ قَالَ مَشَوْا خَلْفَ عَلِيٍّ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 552

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard al-Hasan saying, "Indeed, the sound of sandals behind men rarely delays fools."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard al-Hasan saying, "Indeed, the sound of sandals behind men rarely delays fools."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ «إِنَّ خَفْقَ النِّعَالِ خَلْفَ الرِّجَالِ قَلَّ مَا يُلَبِّثُ الْحَمْقَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yazīd b. Ḥāzim \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَازِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 553

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "He would get up and move aside when the man or the two men sat next to him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He would get up and move aside when the man or the two men sat next to him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ «إِذَا جَلَسَ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلُ أَوِ الرَّجُلَانِ قَامَ فَتَنَحَّى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥātim al-Muktib \u003e Qāsim \u003e Ibn Mālik \u003e Layth \u003e Ṭāwus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْمُكْتِبُ حَدَّثَنَا قَاسِمُ هُوَ ابْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 554

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The feet of a servant will not be able to move on the Day of Judgment until he is asked about his age and how he spent it, his knowledge and how he acted upon it, his wealth and how he earned it and how he spent it, and his body and how he wore it out."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The feet of a servant will not be able to move on the Day of Judgment until he is asked about his age and how he spent it, his knowledge and how he acted upon it, his wealth and how he earned it and how he spent it, and his body and how he wore it out."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَزُولُ قَدَمَا عَبْدٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ عَنْ عُمُرِهِ فِيمَا أَفْنَاهُ وَعَنْ عِلْمِهِ مَا فَعَلَ بِهِ وَعَنْ مَالِهِ مِنْ أَيْنَ اكْتَسَبَهُ وَفِيمَا أَنْفَقَهُ وَعَنْ جِسْمِهِ فِيمَا أَبْلَاهُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿAbdullāh b. Jurayj \u003e Abū Barzah al-Aslamī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 555

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Allah will not leave His servants on the Day of Judgment when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds, until He asks them about four things: how they spent their lives, what they endured in their bodies, what they earned and how they spent it, and what deeds they did with the knowledge they had."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Allah will not leave His servants on the Day of Judgment when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds, until He asks them about four things: how they spent their lives, what they endured in their bodies, what they earned and how they spent it, and what deeds they did with the knowledge they had."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَدَعُ اللَّهُ الْعِبَادَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ حَتَّى يَسْأَلَهُمْ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ عَمَّا أَفْنَوْا فِيهِ أَعْمَارَهُمْ وَعَمَّا أَبْلَوْا فِيهِ أَجْسَادَهُمْ وَعَمَّا كَسَبُوا وفِيما أَنْفَقُوا وَعَمَّا عَمِلُوا فِيمَا عَلِمُوا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Manṣūr \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿUmārah b. Ghaziyyah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Rāshid \u003e Fulān al-ʿUranī \u003e Muʿādh b. Jabal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ غَزِيَّةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ رَاشِدٍ حَدَّثَنِي فُلَانٌ الْعُرَنِيُّ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 556

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not depart from a servant on the Day of Judgment until he is asked about four things: his life, how he spent it, his body, how he wore it out, his wealth, how he earned it and how he spent it, and his knowledge, what he did with it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not depart from a servant on the Day of Judgment until he is asked about four things: his life, how he spent it, his body, how he wore it out, his wealth, how he earned it and how he spent it, and his knowledge, what he did with it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَا تَزُولُ قَدَمَا عَبْدٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ عَنْ عُمُرِهِ فِيمَا أَفْنَاهُ وَعَنْ جَسَدِهِ فِيمَا أَبْلَاهُ وَعَنْ مَالِهِ مِنْ أَيْنَ اكْتَسَبَهُ وَفِيمَا وَضَعَهُ وَعَنْ عِلْمِهِ مَاذَا عَمِلَ فِيهِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth \u003e ʿAdī b. ʿAdī \u003e Abū ʿAbdullāh al-Ṣunābiḥī \u003e Muʿādh b. Jabal \u003e Lā Tazūl Qadamā ʿAbd Yawm al-Qiyāmah Ḥattá Yusʾal \u003e Arbaʿ \u003e ʿUmurih Fīmā Afnāh \u003e Jasadih Fīmā Ablāh \u003e Mālih from Ayn Āktasabah And Fīmā Waḍaʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الصُّنَابِحِيّ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 557

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: I have a peacock, "If you have not learned, learn for yourself, for indeed people have lost their trustworthiness."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I have a peacock, "If you have not learned, learn for yourself, for indeed people have lost their trustworthiness."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِي طَاوُسٌ «مَا تَعَلَّمْتَ فَتَعَلَّمْ لِنَفْسِكَ فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ ذَهَبَتْ مِنْهُمُ الْأَمَانَةُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 558

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes fame and knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "I realized that people, and the persons who engage in acts of worship, are not recognized by their eloquence, but rather they are recognized by their actions. That is the beneficial knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I realized that people, and the persons who engage in acts of worship, are not recognized by their eloquence, but rather they are recognized by their actions. That is the beneficial knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَدْرَكْتُ النَّاسَ وَالنَّاسِكُ إِذَا نَسَكَ لَمْ يُعْرَفْ مِنْ قِبَلِ مَنْطِقِهِ وَلَكِنْ يُعْرَفُ مِنْ قِبَلِ عَمَلِهِ فَذَلِكَ الْعِلْمُ النَّافِعُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e ʿUmārah b. Mihrān \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 559

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Convey from me, even if it be an Ayah, and narrate from the Children of Isra'il, and there is no harm, And whoever lies upon me purposely, then let him take his seat in the Fire."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Convey from me, even if it be an Ayah, and narrate from the Children of Isra'il, and there is no harm, And whoever lies upon me purposely, then let him take his seat in the Fire."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «بَلِّغُوا عَنِّي وَلَوْ آيَةً وَحَدِّثُوا عَنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلَا حَرَجَ وَمَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ḥassān \u003e Abū Kabshah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ حَسَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي كَبْشَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 560

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ordered us not to be defeated in three matters: commanding good, forbidding evil, and teaching people the traditions (sunnah).   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ordered us not to be defeated in three matters: commanding good, forbidding evil, and teaching people the traditions (sunnah).   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ لَا يَغْلِبُونَا عَلَى ثَلَاثٍ أَنْ نَأْمُرَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَنْهَى عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَنُعَلِّمَ النَّاسَ السُّنَنَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAlī b. Ḥujr al-Saʿdī \u003e Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-ʿAwwām b. Ḥawshab Abū ʿĪsá al-Shaybānī \u003e al-Qāsim b. ʿAwf al-Shaybānī \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ أَنبَأَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا الْعَوَّامُ بْنُ حَوْشَبٍ أَبُو عِيسَى الشَّيْبَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 561

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Umaymah used to come to us with a great matter when we sat with him and would say to us, "Listen, comprehend, and convey to others what you hear from us." Sulaim said, "He is like someone who testifies to what he knows."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Umaymah used to come to us with a great matter when we sat with him and would say to us, "Listen, comprehend, and convey to others what you hear from us." Sulaim said, "He is like someone who testifies to what he knows."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ أَبُو أُمَامَةَ إِذَا قَعَدْنَا إِلَيْهِ يَجِيئُنَا مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ بِأَمْرٍ عَظِيمٍ وَيَقُولُ لَنَا «اسْمَعُوا وَاعْقِلُوا وَبَلِّغُوا عَنَّا مَا تَسْمَعُونَ» قَالَ سُلَيْمٌ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الَّذِي يُشْهِدُ عَلَى مَا عَلِمَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e Ṣafwān \u003e Sulaym b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 562

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I came to Aba Dhar while he was sitting by the middle Jamarah, and people had gathered around him seeking his advice. A man stood in front of him and said, 'Did you not forbid issuing religious rulings?' He raised his head towards him and said, 'Are you my supervisor? If you were to put a muzzle on this,' pointing to his mouth, 'and I thought that I could fulfill a word that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before you approve it, then I would fulfill it.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I came to Aba Dhar while he was sitting by the middle Jamarah, and people had gathered around him seeking his advice. A man stood in front of him and said, 'Did you not forbid issuing religious rulings?' He raised his head towards him and said, 'Are you my supervisor? If you were to put a muzzle on this,' pointing to his mouth, 'and I thought that I could fulfill a word that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before you approve it, then I would fulfill it.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْوُسْطَى وَقَدِ اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ يَسْتَفْتُونَهُ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَوَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَلَمْ تُنْهَ عَنِ الْفُتْيَا؟ فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «أَرَقِيبٌ أَنْتَ عَلَيَّ؟ لَوْ وَضَعْتُمُ الصَّمْصَامَةَ عَلَى هَذِهِ وَأَشَارَ إِلَى قَفَاهُ ثُمَّ ظَنَنْتُ أَنِّي أُنْفِذُ كَلِمَةً سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُجِيزُوا عَلَيَّ لَأَنْفَذْتُهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb b. Saʿīd \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Abū Kathīr from my father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 563

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: "To be a mufti?" So I said, "No, but I consider it unreliable for you to leave and we stay." Abu Al-Ala said, "Abu Al-Ala is right."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To be a mufti?" So I said, "No, but I consider it unreliable for you to leave and we stay." Abu Al-Ala said, "Abu Al-Ala is right."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَكُونَ مُفْتِيًا؟» فَقُلْتُ لَا وَلَكِنْ لَا آمَنُ أَنْ تَذْهَبُوا وَنَبْقَى فَقَالَ «صَدَقَ أَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbbād \u003e Ibn al-ʿAwwām \u003e ʿAwf \u003e Abū al-ʿĀliyah \u003e Saʾalt Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Shayʾ \u003e Yā Abū al-ʿĀliyah Aturīd \u003e Takūn Muftī Faqult Lā And Lakin Lā Āman \u003e Tadhhabūā Wanabqá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْعَوَّامِ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ شَيْءٍ فَقَالَ «يَا أَبَا الْعَالِيَةِ أَتُرِيدُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 564

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: 'Abidah used to come to 'Abdullah every Thursday and ask him about things he had missed. Generally, what 'Abidah asked 'Abdullah about was what 'Abdullah would keep from being asked about.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: 'Abidah used to come to 'Abdullah every Thursday and ask him about things he had missed. Generally, what 'Abidah asked 'Abdullah about was what 'Abdullah would keep from being asked about.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ عَبِيدَةُ «يَأْتِي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ كُلَّ خَمِيسٍ فَيَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ غَابَ عَنْهَا فَكَانَ عَامَّةُ مَا يُحْفَظُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مِمَّا يَسْأَلُهُ عَبِيدَةُ عَنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbbād \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 565

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Ikrimah say, "Why don't you ask me if you're bankrupt?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Ikrimah say, "Why don't you ask me if you're bankrupt?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ يَقُولُ «مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَسْأَلُونِي أَفْلَسْتُمْ؟»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Ghassān \u003e Ibn Muḍar \u003e Saʿīd b. Yazīd \u003e ʿIkrimah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا غَسَّانُ هُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 566

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Knowledge is a treasure, and questions unlock it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Knowledge is a treasure, and questions unlock it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْعِلْمُ خَزَائِنُ وَتَفْتَحُهَا الْمَسْأَلَةُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥātim al-Muktib \u003e ʿĀmir b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْمُكْتِبُ حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 567

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim, "Whoever humbles himself, his knowledge becomes enhanced."
hadiths.body: Ibrahim, "Whoever humbles himself, his knowledge becomes enhanced."
hadiths.arabic: إِبْرَاهِيمُ «مَنْ رَقَّ وَجْهُهُ رَقَّ عِلْمُهُ»
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq \u003e Jarīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ جَرِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 568

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever humbles himself, his knowledge will be raised."
hadiths.body: "Whoever humbles himself, his knowledge will be raised."
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ رَقَّ وَجْهُهُ رَقَّ عِلْمُهُ»
hadiths.chain: Wakīʿ from his father \u003e al-Shaʿby
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الشَّعْبيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 569

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umar ibn al-Khattab said: 'Whoever improves his conduct, improves his knowledge.'"
hadiths.body: "Umar ibn al-Khattab said: 'Whoever improves his conduct, improves his knowledge.'"
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ «مَنْ رَقَّ وَجْهُهُ رَقَّ عِلْمُهُ»
hadiths.chain: Ḍamrah \u003e Ḥafṣ b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: وَعَنْ ضَمْرَةَ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 570

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: "He who is too shy and arrogant does not learn."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He who is too shy and arrogant does not learn."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَتَعَلَّمُ مَنِ اسْتَحْيَى وَاسْتَكْبَرَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq \u003e Jarīr \u003e a man \u003e Mujāhid
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 571

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to gather his children and say, "O my children, learn, for if you are small among a people, perhaps you will be great among others. And how unfortunate it is for an elderly person to be asked when he has no knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He used to gather his children and say, "O my children, learn, for if you are small among a people, perhaps you will be great among others. And how unfortunate it is for an elderly person to be asked when he has no knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَجْمَعُ بَنِيهِ فَيَقُولُ «يَا بَنِيَّ تَعَلَّمُوا فَإِنْ تَكُونُوا صِغَارَ قَوْمٍ فَعَسَى أَنْ تَكُونُوا كِبَارَ آخَرِينَ وَمَا أَقْبَحَ عَلَى شَيْخٍ يُسْأَلُ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ عِلْمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Anas b. ʿIyāḍ \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 572

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Abbas used to put a cable on my legs and taught me the Quran and the Sunnah.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Abbas used to put a cable on my legs and taught me the Quran and the Sunnah.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «يَضَعُ فِي رِجْلَيَّ الْكَبْلَ وَيُعَلِّمُنِي الْقُرْآنَ وَالسُّنَنَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e al-Zubayr b. al-Khirrīt \u003e ʿIkrimah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْخِرِّيتِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 573

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Sufyan say, "Whoever is impatient will harm himself with a lot of knowledge, and whoever does not rush and seeks knowledge persistently until he attains it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Sufyan say, "Whoever is impatient will harm himself with a lot of knowledge, and whoever does not rush and seeks knowledge persistently until he attains it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ يَقُولُ «مَنْ تَرَأَّسَ سَرِيعًا أَضَرَّ بِكَثِيرٍ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَتَرَأَّسْ طَلَبَ وَطَلَبَ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḍurays \u003e Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الضُّرَيْسِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 574

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said to be like a treasure that is not spent from.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said to be like a treasure that is not spent from.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ بِهِ كَكَنْزٍ لَا يُنْفَقُ مِنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Khabbāb \u003e Ḥuṣayn b. ʿUqbah \u003e Salmān Qālah ʿIlm Lā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ قَالَهُ «عِلْمٌ لَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 575

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: "The example of knowledge that is not put into practice is like a treasure that is not spent in the way of Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: "The example of knowledge that is not put into practice is like a treasure that is not spent in the way of Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَثَلُ عِلْمٍ لَا يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ كَمَثَلِ كَنْزٍ لَا يُنْفَقُ مِنْهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Abū ʿIyāḍ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَنْ أَبِي عِيَاضٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 576

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, knowledge is like springs that people seek and strive for. It quenches the thirst of some and benefits others with God's guidance. Wisdom, however, cannot be expressed like a lifeless body without a soul. Similarly, knowledge should not be hoarded, unused like a treasure. Rather, the example of a knowledgeable person is like a person carrying a lantern in a dark path, illuminating the way for those who pass by. Everyone prays for their well-being."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, knowledge is like springs that people seek and strive for. It quenches the thirst of some and benefits others with God's guidance. Wisdom, however, cannot be expressed like a lifeless body without a soul. Similarly, knowledge should not be hoarded, unused like a treasure. Rather, the example of a knowledgeable person is like a person carrying a lantern in a dark path, illuminating the way for those who pass by. Everyone prays for their well-being."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أنَّ الْعِلْمَ كَالْيَنَابِيعِ يَغْشَاهُنَّ النَّاسُ فَيَخْتَلِجُهُ هَذَا وَهَذَا فَيَنْفَعُ اللَّهُ بِهِ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ وَإِنَّ حِكْمَةً لَا يُتَكَلَّمُ بِهَا كَجَسَدٍ لَا رُوحَ فِيهِ وَإِنَّ عِلْمًا لَا يُخْرَجُ كَكَنْزٍ لَا يُنْفَقُ مِنْهُ وَإِنَّمَا مَثَلُ الْعَالِمِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ حَمَلَ سِرَاجًا فِي طَرِيقٍ مُظْلِمٍ يَسْتَضِيءُ بِهِ مَنْ مَرَّ بِهِ وَكُلٌّ يَدْعُو لَهُ بِالْخَيْرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Mūsá b. Yasār from his uncle \u003e Balaghanī \u003e Salmān Katab \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَمِّهِ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ سَلْمَانَ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 577

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: After his death, a man is followed by three things: a continuous charity that is given after him, the prayers of his children upon him, and knowledge that he spread and is acted upon after him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: After his death, a man is followed by three things: a continuous charity that is given after him, the prayers of his children upon him, and knowledge that he spread and is acted upon after him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَتْبَعُ الرَّجُلَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ ثَلَاثُ خِلَالٍ صَدَقَةٌ تَجْرِي بَعْدَهُ وَصَلَاةُ وَلَدِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَعِلْمٌ أَفْشَاهُ يُعْمَلُ بِهِ بَعْدَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Manṣūr b. Abū al-Aswad \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Shaybānī \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 578

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: When a man dies, his action discontinues from him except three things, namely, perpetual sadaqah (charity), or the knowledge by which benefit is acquired, or a pious child who prays for him.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: When a man dies, his action discontinues from him except three things, namely, perpetual sadaqah (charity), or the knowledge by which benefit is acquired, or a pious child who prays for him.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ إِذَا مَاتَ الْإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ تَجْرِي لَهُ أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar al-Madanī \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 579

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: "He said when he arrived in Basra, 'Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, has sent me to you to teach you the book of your Lord and your Sunnah and purify your ways.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He said when he arrived in Basra, 'Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, has sent me to you to teach you the book of your Lord and your Sunnah and purify your ways.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ حِينَ قَدِمَ الْبَصْرَةَ «بَعَثَنِي إِلَيْكُمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ أُعَلِّمُكُمْ كِتَابَ رَبِّكُمْ وَسُنَّتَكُمْ وَأُنَظِّفُ طُرُقَكُمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbayd b. Yaʿīsh \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Rustum al-Muzanī \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ رُسْتُمَ الْمُزَنِيِّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 580

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَلَاغِ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتَعْلِيمِ السُّنَنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The reporting of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the teaching of Su...

hadiths.englishRaw: narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever seeks knowledge, he is atoning for what has passed (of sins while doing so)."
hadiths.body: narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever seeks knowledge, he is atoning for what has passed (of sins while doing so)."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ كَانَ كَفَّارَةً لِمَا مَضَى»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Muʿallá \u003e Ziyād b. Khaythamah \u003e Abū Dāwud \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Sakhbarah \u003e Sakhbarah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُعَلَّى حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ خَيْثَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَخْبَرَةَ عَنْ سَخْبَرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 581

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I stayed in the city for three times, and I had no need except that I had finished it, except that a man whom they were expecting was narrating a story, so I stayed until he arrived and asked him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I stayed in the city for three times, and I had no need except that I had finished it, except that a man whom they were expecting was narrating a story, so I stayed until he arrived and asked him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَقَدْ أَقَمْتُ بالمدينةِ ثَلَاثًا مَا لِي حَاجَةٌ إِلَّا وَقَدْ فَرَغْتُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانُوا يَتَوَقَّعُونَهُ كَانَ يَرْوِي حَدِيثًا فَأَقَمْتُ حَتَّى قَدِمَ فَسَأَلْتُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 582

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard Busar ibn Ubayd Allah saying, 'If I used to travel to Egypt from other cities, I would do so just to listen to a single Hadith.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard Busar ibn Ubayd Allah saying, 'If I used to travel to Egypt from other cities, I would do so just to listen to a single Hadith.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ بُسْرَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ «إِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَرْكَبُ إِلَى المِصْرٍ مِنَ الْأَمْصَارِ فِي الْحَدِيثِ الْوَاحِدِ لِأَسْمَعَهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd b. Muslim \u003e ʿBd al-Rḥmn b. Yzyd b. Jābir \u003e Busr b. ʿUbaydullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنِ عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 583

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: About the companions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, we were not satisfied until we traveled to the city and heard it directly from their mouths.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the companions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, we were not satisfied until we traveled to the city and heard it directly from their mouths.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَمْ نَرْضَ حَتَّى رَكِبْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَسَمِعْنَاهَا مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. Zurārah Nbʾnā Abū Qaṭan ʿAmr b. al-Haytham \u003e Abū Khaldah \u003e Abū al-ʿĀliyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ أنْبأنا أَبُو قَطَنٍ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ عَنْ أَبِي خَلْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ قَالَ «إِنْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ الرِّوَايَةَ بِالْبَصْرَةِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 584

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Prophet Dawud ﷺ said to the person of knowledge: 'Take a staff made of iron and sandals made of iron, and seek knowledge until the staff breaks and the sandals wear out.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Prophet Dawud ﷺ said to the person of knowledge: 'Take a staff made of iron and sandals made of iron, and seek knowledge until the staff breaks and the sandals wear out.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَاوُدُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ قُلْ لِصَاحِبِ الْعِلْمِ يَتَّخِذْ عَصًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ وَنَعْلَيْنِ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ وَيَطْلُبِ الْعِلْمَ حَتَّى تَنْكَسِرَ الْعَصَا وَتَنْخَرِقَ النَّعْلَانِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Tustarī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ التُّسْتَرِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 585

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: He sleeps and then I put my cloak under my head and lay down until midday. Then he says, "When did you come here, O cousin of the Messenger of Allah?" I say, "A long time ago." He says, "What a terrible thing you have done! Why didn't you inform me?" I say, "I wanted you to come to me after you had fulfilled your need."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He sleeps and then I put my cloak under my head and lay down until midday. Then he says, "When did you come here, O cousin of the Messenger of Allah?" I say, "A long time ago." He says, "What a terrible thing you have done! Why didn't you inform me?" I say, "I wanted you to come to me after you had fulfilled your need."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْهُ فَيُقَالُ لِي نَائِمٌ فَأَتَوَسَّدُ رِدَائِي ثُمَّ أَضْطَجِعُ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ فَيَقُولُ مَتَى كُنْتَ هَاهُنَا يَا ابْنَ عَمِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ فَأَقُولُ «مُنْذُ طَوِيلٍ» فَيَقُولُ بِئْسَ مَا صَنَعْتَ هَلَّا أَعْلَمْتَنِي؟ فَأَقُولُ «أَرَدْتُ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيَّ وَقَدْ قَضَيْتَ حَاجَتَكَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Makhlad b. Mālik \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd al-Umawī \u003e al-Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥuṣayn b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman from Āl Saʿd b. Muʿādh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأُمَوِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ مِنْ آلِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ طَلَبْتُ الْعِلْمَ فَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُ فِي الْأَنْصَارِ فَكُنْتُ آتِي الرَّجُلَ فَأَسْأَلُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 586

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: The following sentence translates to: "The majority of the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were narrated by the people of this neighborhood among the Ansar, and by Allah, if I came to a man from them and it was said that he was sleeping, I would leave him until he woke up to ask him about his hadith."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The following sentence translates to: "The majority of the hadith of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were narrated by the people of this neighborhood among the Ansar, and by Allah, if I came to a man from them and it was said that he was sleeping, I would leave him until he woke up to ask him about his hadith."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: وُجِدَ أَكْثَرُ حَدِيثِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عِنْدَ هَذَا الْحَيِّ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ وَاللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُ لَآتِي الرَّجُلَ مِنْهُمْ فَيُقَالُ هُوَ نَائِمٌ فَلَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ يُوقَظَ لِي فَأَدَعُهُ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ لِأَسْتَطِيبَ بِذَلِكَ حَدِيثَهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 587

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If I had accompanied Ibn Abbas, I would have acquired much knowledge from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If I had accompanied Ibn Abbas, I would have acquired much knowledge from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَوْ رَفَقْتُ بِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ لَأَصَبْتُ مِنْهُ عِلْمًا كَثِيرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Maʿmar Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 588

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: I used to come to the door of Uruwah and sit by the door. If I wanted to enter, I would have entered, but out of respect for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I used to come to the door of Uruwah and sit by the door. If I wanted to enter, I would have entered, but out of respect for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ آتِي بَابَ عُرْوَةَ فَأَجْلِسُ بِالْبَابِ وَلَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَدْخُلَ لَدَخَلْتُ وَلَكِنْ إِجْلَالًا لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbd al-Razzāq \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْحَكَمِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 590

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When the messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away, I said to a man from the Ansar, 'O so and so, come let us ask the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , for they are still numerous today.' He marveled at me and said, 'O Ibn Abbas, do you think people are in need of you? Among the people there are companions of the Prophet ﷺ , who do you see?' I left this matter and approached (the companions) to ask them. If there was a hadeeth from a person, I went to him while he was speaking, I leaned my cloak on his door, and the wind blew dust on my face. He would come out and see me, and say, 'O cousin of the Messenger of Allah, what brought you here? Did you not send for me so that I could come to you?' I would say, 'No, I am more deserving of coming to you, so I ask you about the hadeeth.' The man would then remain until he saw me, and the people had gathered around me, and he said, 'This boy was more intelligent than me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When the messenger of Allah ﷺ passed away, I said to a man from the Ansar, 'O so and so, come let us ask the companions of the Prophet ﷺ , for they are still numerous today.' He marveled at me and said, 'O Ibn Abbas, do you think people are in need of you? Among the people there are companions of the Prophet ﷺ , who do you see?' I left this matter and approached (the companions) to ask them. If there was a hadeeth from a person, I went to him while he was speaking, I leaned my cloak on his door, and the wind blew dust on my face. He would come out and see me, and say, 'O cousin of the Messenger of Allah, what brought you here? Did you not send for me so that I could come to you?' I would say, 'No, I am more deserving of coming to you, so I ask you about the hadeeth.' The man would then remain until he saw me, and the people had gathered around me, and he said, 'This boy was more intelligent than me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قُلْتُ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يَا فُلَانُ هَلُمَّ فَلْنَسْأَلْ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَإِنَّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ كَثِيرٌ» فَقَالَ واعجبًا لَكَ يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَتَرَى النَّاسَ يَحْتَاجُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَفِي النَّاسِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مَنْ تَرَى؟ فَتَرَكَ ذَلِكَ وَأَقْبَلْتُ عَلَى الْمَسْأَلَةِ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَبْلُغُنِي الْحَدِيثُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ فَآتِيهِ وَهُوَ قَائِلٌ فَأَتَوَسَّدُ رِدَائِي عَلَى بَابِهِ فَتَسْفِي الرِّيحُ عَلَى وَجْهِي التُّرَابَ فَيَخْرُجُ فَيَرَانِي فَيَقُولُ يَا ابْنَ عَمِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ مَا جَاءَ بِكَ؟ أَلَا أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيَّ فَآتِيَكَ؟ فَأَقُولُ لَا أَنَا أَحَقُّ أَنْ آتِيَكَ فَأَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ فَبَقِيَ الرَّجُلُ حَتَّى رَآنِي وَقَدِ اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيَّ فَقَالَ «كَانَ هَذَا الْفَتَى أَعْقَلَ مِنِّي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Jarīr b. Ḥāzim \u003e Yaʿlá b. Ḥakīm \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 591

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرِّحْلَةِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ، وَاحْتِمَالِ الْعَنَاءِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The journey in the pursuit of knowledge, and the possibility of ...

hadiths.englishRaw: A man from the companions of the Prophet ﷺ traveled to Fadalah ibn 'Ubayd while he was in Egypt. He came to him while he was tending to his camel and said, "Welcome!" The man replied, "Indeed, I did not come to visit you, but I heard that you and I have a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I hoped to acquire some knowledge from you." Fadalah replied, "This and that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man from the companions of the Prophet ﷺ traveled to Fadalah ibn 'Ubayd while he was in Egypt. He came to him while he was tending to his camel and said, "Welcome!" The man replied, "Indeed, I did not come to visit you, but I heard that you and I have a Hadith from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and I hoped to acquire some knowledge from you." Fadalah replied, "This and that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مَنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ رَحَلَ إِلَى فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ وَهُوَ بِمِصْرَ فَقَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَمُدُّ لِنَاقَةٍ لَهُ فَقَالَ مَرْحَبًا قَالَ أَمَا إِنِّي لَمْ آتِكَ زَائِرًا وَلَكِنْ سَمِعْتُ أَنَا وَأَنْتَ حَدِيثًا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَجَوْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ عِنْدَكَ مِنْهُ عِلْمٌ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Buraydah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 592

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "He said to you all this and if it was someone other than you, I wouldn't have given it to him." Then he said, "Did you do it?" After that, no one was seen buying from the market nor selling, until he met with Allah, the Almighty and the Glorious.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He said to you all this and if it was someone other than you, I wouldn't have given it to him." Then he said, "Did you do it?" After that, no one was seen buying from the market nor selling, until he met with Allah, the Almighty and the Glorious.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: هُوَ لَكَ بِكَذَا وَكَذَا وَاللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ غَيْرَكَ مَا أَعْطَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ فَعَلْتُمُوهَا؟ فَمَا رُئِيَ بَعْدَهَا مُشْتَرِيًا مِنَ السُّوقِ وَلَا بَائِعًا حَتَّى لَحِقَ بِاللَّهِ ﷻ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām b. Ḥarb \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى عَنِ الْحَسَنِ أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ السُّوقَ فَسَاوَمَ رَجُلًا بِثَوْبٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 593

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "He used to not buy from someone he knew."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He used to not buy from someone he knew."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يَشْتَرِي مِمَّنْ يَعْرِفُهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Haytham b. Jamīl \u003e Ḥusām \u003e Abū Maʿshar \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ حُسَامٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 594

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: And he said, "We have not read the Quran for this reason."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: And he said, "We have not read the Quran for this reason."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ لَمْ نَقْرَأِ الْقُرْآنَ لِهَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Walīd al-Muzanī \u003e ʿUbayd b. al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنبَأَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ الْمُزَنِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ قَسَمَ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ مَالًا فِي قُرَّاءِ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ حِينَ دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ فَبَعَثَ إِلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْقِلٍ بِأَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ اسْتَعِنْ بِهَا فِي شَهْرِكَ هَذَا فَرَدَّهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَعْقِلٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 595

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: Umar ibn Al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said to Abdullah ibn Salam, 'Who are the knowledgeable ones?' He replied, 'Those who act upon what they know.' Umar then asked, 'What removes knowledge from the hearts of men?' Abdullah ibn Salam replied, 'Greed.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Umar ibn Al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said to Abdullah ibn Salam, 'Who are the knowledgeable ones?' He replied, 'Those who act upon what they know.' Umar then asked, 'What removes knowledge from the hearts of men?' Abdullah ibn Salam replied, 'Greed.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ عَلَيْهِ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ: مَنْ أَرْبَابُ الْعِلْمِ؟ قَالَ الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ بِمَا يَعْلَمُونَ قَالَ: فَمَا يَنْفِي الْعِلْمَ مِنْ صُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ؟ قَالَ: الطَّمَعُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Anas b. ʿIyāḍ \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 596

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Nothing finds a more beautiful shelter than patience finds in knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Nothing finds a more beautiful shelter than patience finds in knowledge."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا أَوَى شَيْءٌ إِلَى شَيْءٍ أَزْيَنَ مِنْ حِلْمٍ إِلَى عِلْمٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Zayd \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 597

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "The beauty of knowledge is the patience of its people"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The beauty of knowledge is the patience of its people"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «زَيْنُ الْعِلْمِ حِلْمُ أَهْلِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah Anbʾanā ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal \u003e ʿĀmir al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ أَنبأَنَا عَاصِمٌ الْأَحْوَلُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 598

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Knowledge is not carried in the same way as a bag of dreams."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Knowledge is not carried in the same way as a bag of dreams."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا حُمِلَ الْعِلْمُ فِي مِثْلِ جِرَابِ حِلْمٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Zamʿah b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Salamah b. And Hrām \u003e Ṭāwus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَنَا زَمْعَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ وَهْرَامٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 599

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "The beauty of knowledge is the patience of its people."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The beauty of knowledge is the patience of its people."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «زَيْنُ الْعِلْمِ حِلْمُ أَهْلِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e Ibn Shubrumah \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 600

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, wisdom dwells in the tranquil heart."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, wisdom dwells in the tranquil heart."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ الْحِكْمَةَ تَسْكُنُ الْقَلْبَ الْوَادِعَ السَّاكِنَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak Anbʾanā Muṭarrif b. Māzin \u003e Yaʿlá b. Miqsam \u003e Wahbb. Munabbih
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبأَنَا مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ مَازِنٍ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 601

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ubaidullah, you have extinguished knowledge and removed its light. If Omar (may Allah be pleased with him) were alive, he would have punished us severely."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Ubaidullah, you have extinguished knowledge and removed its light. If Omar (may Allah be pleased with him) were alive, he would have punished us severely."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ «شِنْتُمُ الْعِلْمَ وَأَذْهَبْتُمْ نُورَهُ وَلَوْ أَدْرَكَنِي وَإِيَّاكُمْ عُمَرُ رضوان الله عليه لَأَوْجَعَنَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 602

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, said: 'Learn knowledge, and when you have learned it, keep it to yourself, and do not mix it with laughter or play, for it will corrupt the hearts.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, said: 'Learn knowledge, and when you have learned it, keep it to yourself, and do not mix it with laughter or play, for it will corrupt the hearts.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَلِيٌّ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ «تَعَلَّمُوا الْعِلْمَ فَإِذَا عَلِمْتُمُوهُ فَاكْظِمُوا عليْهِ وَلَا تَشُوبُوهُ بِضَحِكٍ وَلَا بِلَعِبٍ فَتَمُجَّهُ الْقُلُوبُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Shihāb b. ʿAbbād \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Umay al-Murādī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أُمَيٍّ الْمُرَادِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 603

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever laughs a laughter that is complete and full of knowledge."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever laughs a laughter that is complete and full of knowledge."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ ضَحِكَ ضَحْكَةً مَجَّ مَجَّةً مِنَ الْعِلْمِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e al-Fuḍayl b. Ghazwān \u003e ʿAlī b. Ḥusayn Raḥmah Allāh ʿAlayh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ غَزْوَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 604

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: So, what caused knowledge to be removed from the hearts of the scholars? He said, "Greed."   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.body: So, what caused knowledge to be removed from the hearts of the scholars? He said, "Greed."   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.arabic: فَمَا أَخْرَجَ الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قُلُوبِ الْعُلَمَاءِ؟ قَالَ «الطَّمَعُ»   – ضعيف معضل
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿUmar \u003e Likaʿb Man Arbāb al-ʿIlm \u003e al--Adhīn Yaʿmalūn Bimā Yaʿlamūn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ قَالَ لِكَعْبٍ مَنْ أَرْبَابُ الْعِلْمِ؟ قَالَ «الَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ بِمَا يَعْلَمُونَ» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 605

chapter.englishTitle: Maintenance of knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was going to 'Amr ibn Nu'man when the Messenger of Mus'ab ibn Zubayr came to him. It was during the month of Ramadan, and he had one thousand dirhams with him. The Messenger said, 'Indeed, the commander (Ali) sends you his greetings, and he said, 'We have not left a noble reciter except that we have sent him something good. So, rely on these two (dirhams) for your expenses this month.' He (Mus'ab) said, 'Convey my greetings to the commander, and tell him that by Allah, we have not recited the Qur'an seeking the worldly life and its wealth.'"
hadiths.body: "I was going to 'Amr ibn Nu'man when the Messenger of Mus'ab ibn Zubayr came to him. It was during the month of Ramadan, and he had one thousand dirhams with him. The Messenger said, 'Indeed, the commander (Ali) sends you his greetings, and he said, 'We have not left a noble reciter except that we have sent him something good. So, rely on these two (dirhams) for your expenses this month.' He (Mus'ab) said, 'Convey my greetings to the commander, and tell him that by Allah, we have not recited the Qur'an seeking the worldly life and its wealth.'"
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ نَازِلًا عَلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ فَأَتَاهُ رَسُولُ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ حِينَ حَضَرَهُ رَمَضَانُ بِأَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْأَمِيرَ يُقْرِئُكَ السَّلَامَ وَقَالَ إِنَّا لَمْ نَدَعْ قَارِئًا شَرِيفًا إِلَّا وَقَدْ وَصَلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنَّا مَعْرُوفٌ فَاسْتَعِنْ بِهَذَيْنِ عَلَى نَفَقَةِ شَهْرِكَ هَذَا فَقَالَ أَقْرِئِ الْأَمِيرَ السَّلَامَ وَقُلْ لَهُ إِنَّا وَاللَّهِ مَا قَرَأْنَا الْقُرْآنَ نُرِيدُ بِهِ الدُّنْيَا وَدِرْهَمَهَا
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Muḥammad b. Bishr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Walīd \u003e ʿUmar b. Ayyūb \u003e Abū Iyās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 606

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: السُّنَّةُ قَاضِيَةٌ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah is a definitive judge on the Book of Allah, exalted b...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Soon there will come a time that a man will be reclining on his pillow, and when one of my Ahadith is narrated he will say: 'The Book of Allah is (sufficient) between us and you. Whatever it states is permissible, we will take as permissible, and whatever it states is forbidden, we will take as forbidden.' Verily, whatever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has forbidden is like that which Allah has forbidden."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Soon there will come a time that a man will be reclining on his pillow, and when one of my Ahadith is narrated he will say: 'The Book of Allah is (sufficient) between us and you. Whatever it states is permissible, we will take as permissible, and whatever it states is forbidden, we will take as forbidden.' Verily, whatever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has forbidden is like that which Allah has forbidden."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَرَّمَ أَشْيَاءَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ الْحِمَارَ وَغَيْرَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَيُوشِكُ الرَّجلِ مُتَّكِئًا عَلَى أَرِيكَتِهِ يُحَدَّثُ بِحَدِيثِي فَيَقُولُ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ مَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَلَالٍ اسْتَحْلَلْنَاهُ وَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَرَامٍ حَرَّمْنَاهُ أَلَا وَإِنَّ مَا حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فهُوَ مِثْلُ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Asad b. Mūsá \u003e Muʿāwiyah \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Jābir \u003e al-Miqdām b. Maʿd Ykarib al-Kindī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِ يكَرِبَ الْكِنْدِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 607

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: السُّنَّةُ قَاضِيَةٌ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah is a definitive judge on the Book of Allah, exalted b...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Sunnah is a judge over the Quran, and the Quran is not a judge over the Sunnah."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "The Sunnah is a judge over the Quran, and the Quran is not a judge over the Sunnah."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «السُّنَّةُ قَاضِيَةٌ عَلَى الْقُرْآنِ وَلَيْسَ الْقُرْآنُ بِقَاضٍ عَلَى السُّنَّةِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 608

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: السُّنَّةُ قَاضِيَةٌ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah is a definitive judge on the Book of Allah, exalted b...

hadiths.englishRaw: Gabriel used to descend upon the Prophet with the Sunnah (traditions and teachings of the Prophet) just as he descends upon him with the Quran.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Gabriel used to descend upon the Prophet with the Sunnah (traditions and teachings of the Prophet) just as he descends upon him with the Quran.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ جِبْرِيلُ يَنْزِلُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِالسُّنَّةِ كَمَا يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ḥassān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ حَسَّانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 609

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: السُّنَّةُ قَاضِيَةٌ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah is a definitive judge on the Book of Allah, exalted b...

hadiths.englishRaw: In English, the translation of the given sentence is: "There are two types of Sunnah; a Sunnah that is obligatory to follow and leaving it is considered a sin, and a Sunnah that is recommended to follow but leaving it is not a matter of concern."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: In English, the translation of the given sentence is: "There are two types of Sunnah; a Sunnah that is obligatory to follow and leaving it is considered a sin, and a Sunnah that is recommended to follow but leaving it is not a matter of concern."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: السُّنَّةُ سُنَّتَانِ سُنَّةٌ الْأَخْذُ بِهَا فَرِيضَةٌ وَتَرْكُهَا كُفْرٌ وَسُنَّةٌ الْأَخْذُ بِهَا فَضِيلَةٌ وَتَرْكُهَا إِلَى غَيْرِ حَرَجٍ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 610

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: السُّنَّةُ قَاضِيَةٌ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah is a definitive judge on the Book of Allah, exalted b...

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ, a man said: "In the Book of Allah, what contradicts this?". He replied, "I do not see that I am narrating to you from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while presenting you with a verse from the Book of Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had more knowledge of the Book of Allah, the Most High, than you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ, a man said: "In the Book of Allah, what contradicts this?". He replied, "I do not see that I am narrating to you from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while presenting you with a verse from the Book of Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had more knowledge of the Book of Allah, the Most High, than you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مَا يُخَالِفُ هَذَا قَالَ «لَا أُرَانِي أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَتُعَرِّضُ فِيهِ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَعْلَمَ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى مِنْكَ»   – إسناده صحيح

hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَ يَوْمًا بِحَدِيثٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 611

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ تَأْوِيلِ حَدِيثِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: If you are told a hadeeth from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then think of it in the most guided, the best and the most pious manner.

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Whoever lies upon me intentionally, then let him take his seat in the Fire’.
hadiths.body: ‘Whoever lies upon me intentionally, then let him take his seat in the Fire’.
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مِنْ كَذَبَ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَمِّدًا فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مَنِ النَّارِ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Maʿmar Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿĀṣim b. Kulayb from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah

hadiths.body: About Sulaiman Al-Ahwal

hadiths.englishRaw: "The most ascetic of people are those who are most knowledgeable about its people."   – Sound Chain

hadiths.chain: ʿIkrimah

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 617

hadiths.body: "Study the Hadith, for indeed the Hadith arouses and inspires the Hadith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَذَاكَرُوا الْحَدِيثَ فَإِنَّ الْحَدِيثَ يُهَيِّجُ الْحَدِيثَ»   – إسناده صحيح

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 624

chapter.englishTitle: Study of Knowledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "Memorize this hadith, do not let it escape from you, for it is not like the Quran, which is collected and preserved. If you do not memorize this hadith, it will escape from you, and one of you may say, 'I narrated it yesterday, so I will not narrate it today, but I will narrate what I heard yesterday.' Instead, narrate it today and narrate it tomorrow."
hadiths.body: "Memorize this hadith, do not let it escape from you, for it is not like the Quran, which is collected and preserved. If you do not memorize this hadith, it will escape from you, and one of you may say, 'I narrated it yesterday, so I will not narrate it today, but I will narrate what I heard yesterday.' Instead, narrate it today and narrate it tomorrow."
hadiths.arabic: «تَذَاكَرُوا هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ لَا يَنْفَلِتْ مِنْكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِثْلَ الْقُرْآنِ مَجْمُوعٌ مَحْفُوظٌ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ لَمْ تَذَاكَرُوا هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ يَنْفَلِتْ مِنْكُمْ وَلَا يَقُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ حَدَّثْتُ أَمْسِ فَلَا أُحَدِّثُ الْيَوْمَ بَلْ حَدِّثْ أَمْسِ وَلْتُحَدِّثِ الْيَوْمَ وَلْتُحَدِّثْ غَدًا»
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Yaʿqūb b. ʿAbdullāh al-Qummī \u003e Jaʿfar b. Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْقُمِّيُّ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.englishRaw: I have told him once, for whoever hears it will increase in knowledge, and those who have not heard it will listen.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I have told him once, for whoever hears it will increase in knowledge, and those who have not heard it will listen.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَدْ حَدَّثْتُهُ مَرَّةً فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ كَانَ سَمِعَهُ يَزْدَادُ بِهِ عِلْمًا وَيَسْمَعُ مَنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ   – إسناده ضعيف

hadiths.body: "Review, for the revival of the discussion stems from its review."   – Weak Chain

hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ziyād \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e Tadhākarūā

hadiths.body: "Memorize the saying because its mention is its life."   – Sound Chain
