Then he recited, "And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember." [Hud 114]   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I was with Salman under a tree, and he took a dry branch from it and shook it until its leaves fell. He said, "Do you not ask me why I did this?" I said to him, "Why did you do it?" He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did the same to me." Then he said, "Verily, when a Muslim performs ablution well and prays the five prayers, his sins fall off just like these leaves." Then he recited, "And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember." [Hud 114]   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ مَعَ سَلْمَانَ تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ فَأَخَذَ مِنْهَا غُصْنًا يَابِسًا فَهَزَّهُ حَتَّى تَحَاتَّ وَرَقُهُ قَالَ أَمَا تَسْأَلُنِي لِمَ أَفْعَلُ هَذَا؟ قُلْتُ لَهُ لِمَ فَعَلْتَهُ؟ قَالَ هَكَذَا فَعَلَ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ وَصَلَّى الْخَمْسَ تَحَاتَّتْ ذُنُوبُهُ كَمَا تَحَاتَّ هَذَا الْوَرَقُ» ثُمَّ قَالَ {وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ} [هود 114] إِلَى قَوْلِهِ {ذَلِكَ ذِكْرَى لِلذَّاكِرِينَ} [هود 114]   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAlī b. Zayd \u003e Abū ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 747

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu for every prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The English translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) used to perform ablution for every prayer, and one of us would be sufficient with one ablution until he invalidated it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The English translation of the given Arabic sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) used to perform ablution for every prayer, and one of us would be sufficient with one ablution until he invalidated it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَتَوَضَّأُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَكَانَ أَحَدُنَا يَكْفِيهِ الْوُضُوءُ مَا لَمْ يُحْدِثْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr b. ʿĀmir al-Anṣārī \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 748

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ لَا وُضُوءَ إِلَّا مِنْ حَدَثٍ
chapter.englishTitle: There is no wudu except from a state of impurity.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: If any one of you offers prayer and feels a movement between his paddocks, but is doubtful whether or not his ablution broke, he should not cease praying unless he hears a sound or perceives a smell.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: If any one of you offers prayer and feels a movement between his paddocks, but is doubtful whether or not his ablution broke, he should not cease praying unless he hears a sound or perceives a smell.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا وَجَدَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي صَلَاتِهِ حَرَكَةً فِي دُبُرِهِ فَأَشْكَلَ عَلَيْهِ أَحْدَثَ أَوْ لَمْ يُحْدِثْ فَلَا يَنْصَرِفَنَّ حَتَّى يَسْمَعَ صَوْتًا أَوْ يَجِدَ رِيحًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Suhayl b. Abū Ṣāliḥ from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 749

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu from sleep

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, the eyes are the ropes of the mind. So when the eye sleeps, the mind is free." It was asked to Abu Muhammad Abdullah, do you say this? He said, "No, when one sleeps while standing, ablution is not required for him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, the eyes are the ropes of the mind. So when the eye sleeps, the mind is free." It was asked to Abu Muhammad Abdullah, do you say this? He said, "No, when one sleeps while standing, ablution is not required for him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا الْعَيْنَانِ وِكَاءُ السَّهِ فَإِذَا نَامَتِ الْعَيْنُ اسْتَطْلَقَ الْوِكَاءُ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ «لَا إِذَا نَامَ قَائِمًا لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ الْوُضُوءُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Baqiyyah b. al-Walīd \u003e Abū Bakr b. Abū Maryam \u003e ʿAṭiyyah b. Qays al-Kalāʿī \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Abū Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ حَدَّثَنِي عَطِيَّةُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ الْكَلَاعِيُّ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 750

chapter.englishTitle: In the fold

hadiths.englishRaw: "I suffered from a severe and troubling case of Al-Madhi. I was performing Ghusl often because of it. So I mentioned that to Messenger of Allah and asked him about it. He said: "You only need to perform Wudu for that." I said: "O Messenger of Allah! How about when it gets on my clothes?" He said: "It is sufficient for you to take a handful of water and sprinkle it n your garment wherever you see that it has touched it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I suffered from a severe and troubling case of Al-Madhi. I was performing Ghusl often because of it. So I mentioned that to Messenger of Allah and asked him about it. He said: "You only need to perform Wudu for that." I said: "O Messenger of Allah! How about when it gets on my clothes?" He said: "It is sufficient for you to take a handful of water and sprinkle it n your garment wherever you see that it has touched it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ أَلْقَى مِنَ الْمَذْيِ شِدَّةً فَكُنْتُ أُكْثِرُ الْغُسْلَ مِنْهُ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَسَأَلْتُهُ عنْهُ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا يُجْزِئُكَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْوُضُوءُ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ بِمَا يُصِيبُ ثَوْبِي مِنْهُ؟ قَالَ «خُذْ كَفًّا مِنْ مَاءٍ فَانْضَحْهُ حَيْثُ تَرَى أَنَّهُ أَصَابَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿUbayd b. al-Sabbāq from his father \u003e Sahl b. Ḥunayf
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ السَّبَّاقِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 751

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu from touching the male genitalia.

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah ibn AbuBakr reported that he heard Urwah say: I entered upon Marwan ibn al-Hakam. We mentioned things that render the ablution void. Marwan said: Does it become void by touching the penis? Urwah replied: This I do not know. Marwan said: Busrah daughter of Safwan reported to me that she heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: He who touches his penis should perform ablution.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah ibn AbuBakr reported that he heard Urwah say: I entered upon Marwan ibn al-Hakam. We mentioned things that render the ablution void. Marwan said: Does it become void by touching the penis? Urwah replied: This I do not know. Marwan said: Busrah daughter of Safwan reported to me that she heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: He who touches his penis should perform ablution.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «يَتَوَضَّأُ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَسِّ الذَّكَرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ibn Ḥazm \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e Busrah b. Ṣafwān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ حَزْمٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ بُسْرَةَ بِنْتِ صَفْوَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 752

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu from touching the male genitalia.

hadiths.englishRaw: She heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "Whoever touches his private parts should perform ablution." Abu Muhammad said, "This is more reliable in touching the private parts." And he said, "Ablution is more effective/strengthening."   – Sound
hadiths.body: She heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "Whoever touches his private parts should perform ablution." Abu Muhammad said, "This is more reliable in touching the private parts." And he said, "Ablution is more effective/strengthening."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ مَسَّ فَرْجَهُ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ» فَقَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ هَذَا أَوْثَقُ فِي مَسِّ الْفَرْجِ وَقَالَ الْوُضُوءُ أَثْبَتُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid al-Wahbī \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e Marwān b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Busrah b. Ṣafwān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْوَهْبِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ بُسْرَةَ بِنْتِ صَفْوَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 753

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu from what the fire has touched

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say this: Ablution is obligatory (for one who takes anything) touched by fire.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say this: Ablution is obligatory (for one who takes anything) touched by fire.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ «الْوُضُوءُ مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ تَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ لَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abū Bakr b. al-Ḥārith b. Hishām \u003e Khārijah b. Zayd al-Anṣārī \u003e Abāh Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ أَنَّ خَارِجَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 754

chapter.englishTitle: The license to break ablution.

hadiths.englishRaw: That he saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ cutting a piece of mutton from its shoulder part he was carrying in his hand. When he was called for prayer, he put it down and the knife with which he was cutting it. Then he stood up and offered the prayer without performing new ablution.    – Sound
hadiths.body: That he saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ cutting a piece of mutton from its shoulder part he was carrying in his hand. When he was called for prayer, he put it down and the knife with which he was cutting it. Then he stood up and offered the prayer without performing new ablution.    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَحْتَزُّ مِنْ كَتِفِ شَاةٍ فِي يَدِهِ ثُمَّ دُعِيَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَأَلْقَى السِّكِّينَ الَّتِي كَانَ يَحْتَزُّ بِهَا ثُمَّ قَامَ فَصَلَّى وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Jaʿfar b. ʿAmr b. Umayyah \u003e Abāh ʿAmr b. Umayyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ عَمْرَو بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 755

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu (Ablution) with seawater

hadiths.englishRaw: A group of men from the Banu Mudlij came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, we are the people of this sea who hunt with the spears. We spend the night and two nights, three nights, and four nights on this sea, and we carry fresh water with us to drink. If we perform ablution with it, we fear for ourselves. If we prioritize ourselves and perform ablution from the sea, we find something in ourselves as a result of that, and we fear that it is not pure." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Perform ablution from it, for its water is pure, its dead creatures are permissible."
hadiths.body: A group of men from the Banu Mudlij came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, we are the people of this sea who hunt with the spears. We spend the night and two nights, three nights, and four nights on this sea, and we carry fresh water with us to drink. If we perform ablution with it, we fear for ourselves. If we prioritize ourselves and perform ablution from the sea, we find something in ourselves as a result of that, and we fear that it is not pure." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Perform ablution from it, for its water is pure, its dead creatures are permissible."
hadiths.arabic: أَتَى رِجَالٌ مِنْ بَنِي مُدْلِجٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا أَصْحَابُ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ نُعَالِجُ الصَّيْدَ عَلَى رَمَثٍ فَنَعْزُبُ فِيهِ اللَّيْلَةَ وَاللَّيْلَتَيْنِ وَالثَّلَاثَ وَالْأَرْبَعَ وَنَحْمِلُ مَعَنَا مِنَ الْعَذْبِ لِشِفَاهِنَا فَإِنْ نَحْنُ تَوَضَّأْنَا بِهِ خَشِينَا عَلَى أَنْفُسِنَا وَإِنْ نَحْنُ آثَرْنَا بِأَنْفُسِنَا وَتَوَضَّأْنَا مِنَ الْبَحْرِ وَجَدْنَا فِي أَنْفُسِنَا مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَخَشِينَا أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ طَهُورًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تَوَضَّئُوا مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ الطَّاهِرُ مَاؤُهُ الْحَلَالُ مَيْتَتُهُ»
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. Aḥmad al-Ḥarrānī \u003e Muḥammad b. Salamah \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e al-Julāḥ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd al-Makhzūmī \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Abū Burdah from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ الْحَرَّانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنِ الْجُلَاحِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 756

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu (Ablution) with seawater

hadiths.englishRaw: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Messenger of Allah, we travel on the sea and take a small quantity of water with us. If we use this for ablution, we would suffer from thirst. Can we perform ablution with sea water? The Messenger ﷺ replied: Its water is pure and what dies in it is lawful food.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Messenger of Allah, we travel on the sea and take a small quantity of water with us. If we use this for ablution, we would suffer from thirst. Can we perform ablution with sea water? The Messenger ﷺ replied: Its water is pure and what dies in it is lawful food.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنَّا نَرْكَبُ الْبَحْرَ وَمَعَنَا الْقَلِيلُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأْنَا بِهِ عَطِشْنَا أَفَنَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْبَحْرِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «هُوَ الطَّهُورُ مَاؤُهُ الْحِلُّ مَيْتَتُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik Qirāʾah \u003e Ṣafwān b. Sulaym \u003e Saʿīd b. Salamah from Āl al-Azraq \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Abū Burdah / a man from Banī ʿAbd al-Dār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَالِكٍ قِرَاءَةً عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ مِنْ آلِ الْأَزْرَقِ أَنَّ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ وَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 757

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu from stagnant water

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ( sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam ) said : None amongst you should urinate in stagnant water , and then wash in it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ( sal Allaahu alayhi wa sallam ) said : None amongst you should urinate in stagnant water , and then wash in it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَبُولُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ ثُمَّ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 758

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ قَدْرِ الْمَاءِ الَّذِي لَا يَنْجُسُ
chapter.englishTitle: The Amount of Water That Does Not Become Impure

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ being asked about water that is in a ditch in the ground and is used by animals and beasts. He said, "When the water reaches the amount of two qullat (a unit of volume), it does not become impure."   – Sound
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ being asked about water that is in a ditch in the ground and is used by animals and beasts. He said, "When the water reaches the amount of two qullat (a unit of volume), it does not become impure."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ يُسْأَلُ عَنِ الْمَاءِ يَكُونُ بِالْفَلَاةِ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَنُوبُهُ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ وَالسِّبَاعِ؟ فَقَالَ «إِذَا بَلَغَ الْمَاءُ قُلَّتَيْنِ لَمْ يُنَجِّسْهُ شَيْءٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 759

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ قَدْرِ الْمَاءِ الَّذِي لَا يَنْجُسُ
chapter.englishTitle: The Amount of Water That Does Not Become Impure

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about water and how some animals and carnivorous beasts might drink from it. He said: 'If the water is more than two Qullahs, it will not carry filth.'"[1] [1]It comes with some explanation in Sunan At Timidhi 'Abdah (one of the narrators) said: "Muhammad bin Ishaq said: 'A Qullah refers to Jirar (These are two nouns describing large casks that are used to hold water), and a Qullah is the thing that drinking water is held in."' At-Tirmidhi said: "This is the saying of Ash Shafa'i, Ahmad and Ishaq. They say that when the water is two Qullahs then nothing makes it impure, as long as it does not change its smell, and its taste. And they say, it is approximately fifty Qirbahs (waterskins)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about water and how some animals and carnivorous beasts might drink from it. He said: 'If the water is more than two Qullahs, it will not carry filth.'"[1] [1]It comes with some explanation in Sunan At Timidhi 'Abdah (one of the narrators) said: "Muhammad bin Ishaq said: 'A Qullah refers to Jirar (These are two nouns describing large casks that are used to hold water), and a Qullah is the thing that drinking water is held in."' At-Tirmidhi said: "This is the saying of Ash Shafa'i, Ahmad and Ishaq. They say that when the water is two Qullahs then nothing makes it impure, as long as it does not change its smell, and its taste. And they say, it is approximately fifty Qirbahs (waterskins)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْمَاءِ وَمَا يَنُوبُهُ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ وَالسِّبَاعِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا كَانَ الْمَاءُ قُلَّتَيْنِ لَمْ يَحْمِلِ الْخَبَثَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e al-Walīd b. Kathīr \u003e Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 760

chapter.englishTitle: Wudu with used water

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Jabir saying, "The Prophet ﷺ came to visit me while I was sick and not conscious. He performed ablution (wudu) and poured some of his ablution water on me, and I became conscious."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Jabir saying, "The Prophet ﷺ came to visit me while I was sick and not conscious. He performed ablution (wudu) and poured some of his ablution water on me, and I became conscious."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا يَقُولُ جَاءَنِي النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَعُودُنِي وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ لَا أَعْقِلُ «فَتَوَضَّأَ وَصَبَّ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ عَلَيَّ فَعَقَلْتُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī And ʾAbū Zayd Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ وَأَبُو زَيْدٍ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 761

chapter.englishTitle: The superiority of ablution by the ablution of women

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman from the wives of the Prophet ﷺ performed ablution with a container of janabah (impurity) water. The Prophet ﷺ stood up to do ghusl (ritual bath) from the same water. She said, "I have already performed ablution with it before you." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, janabah does not affect the water."   – Sound
hadiths.body: A woman from the wives of the Prophet ﷺ performed ablution with a container of janabah (impurity) water. The Prophet ﷺ stood up to do ghusl (ritual bath) from the same water. She said, "I have already performed ablution with it before you." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, janabah does not affect the water."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ نِسَاءِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَاغْتَسَلَتْ فِي جَفْنَةٍ مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِلَى فَضْلِهَا يَسْتَحِمُّ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي قَدِ اغْتَسَلْتُ فِيهِ قَبْلَكَ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمَاءِ جَنَابَةٌ» ُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Simāk \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Qāmat
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ قَامَتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 762

chapter.englishTitle: The superiority of ablution by the ablution of women

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَه   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh \u003e Sufyān \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 763

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْهِرَّةِ إِذَا وَلَغَتْ فِي الْإِنَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: When the cat reaches the vessel

hadiths.englishRaw: Kabshah, daughter of Ka'b ibn Malik and wife of Ibn AbuQatadah, reported: AbuQatadah visited (me) and I poured out water for him for ablution. A cat came and drank some of it and he tilted the vessel for it until it drank some of it. Kabshah said: He saw me looking at him; he asked me: Are you surprised, my niece? I said: Yes. He then reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: It is not unclean; it is one of those (males or females) who go round among you.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Kabshah, daughter of Ka'b ibn Malik and wife of Ibn AbuQatadah, reported: AbuQatadah visited (me) and I poured out water for him for ablution. A cat came and drank some of it and he tilted the vessel for it until it drank some of it. Kabshah said: He saw me looking at him; he asked me: Are you surprised, my niece? I said: Yes. He then reported the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: It is not unclean; it is one of those (males or females) who go round among you.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا قَتَادَةَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَسَكَبَتْ لَهُ وَضُوءًا فَجَاءَتْ هِرَّةٌ تَشْرَبُ مِنْهُ فَأَصْغَى لَهَا أَبُو قَتَادَةَ الْإِنَاءَ حَتَّى شَرِبَتْ قَالَتْ كَبْشَةُ فَرَآنِي أَنْظُرُ فَقَالَ أَتَعْجَبِينَ يَا بِنْتَ أَخِي؟ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِنَجَسٍ إِنَّمَا هِيَ مِنَ الطَّوَّافِينَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَالطَّوَّافَاتِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Ḥumaydah b. ʿUbayd b. Rifāʿah \u003e Kabshah b. Kaʿb b. Mālik And Kānat Taḥt Ibn Abū Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدَةَ بِنْتِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ كَبْشَةَ بِنْتِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ ابْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 764

chapter.englishTitle: In the birth of a dog

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: 'If a dog licks a vessel, wash it seven times and rub it with dust the eight times."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: 'If a dog licks a vessel, wash it seven times and rub it with dust the eight times."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا وَلَغَ الْكَلْبُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ فَاغْسِلُوهُ سَبْعَ مِرَارٍ وَالثَّامِنَةَ عَفِّرُوهُ فِي التُّرَابِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū al-Tayyāḥ \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 765

chapter.englishTitle: The mouse falls into the butter

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the phrase "رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَلْقُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا وَكُلُوهُ»" into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Allah throws it and everything around it and devours it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the phrase "رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَلْقُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا وَكُلُوهُ»" into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Allah throws it and everything around it and devours it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَلْقُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا وَكُلُوهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Maymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ أَنَّ فَأْرَةً وَقَعَتْ فِي سَمْنٍ فَمَاتَتْ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 766

chapter.englishTitle: Protection from Urine.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by two graves and he said, "Verily, they are both being punished in their graves. And they are not being punished for something major. As for one of them, he used to walk around spreading gossip. And the other did not protect himself from urine or from urine splashes." Then he took a moist date palm leaf and broke it into pieces, and then inserted a piece at the head of each grave. Then he said, "Perhaps their punishment will be lightened until such time when this leaf dries up."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by two graves and he said, "Verily, they are both being punished in their graves. And they are not being punished for something major. As for one of them, he used to walk around spreading gossip. And the other did not protect himself from urine or from urine splashes." Then he took a moist date palm leaf and broke it into pieces, and then inserted a piece at the head of each grave. Then he said, "Perhaps their punishment will be lightened until such time when this leaf dries up."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِقَبْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ فِي قُبُورِهِمَا وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ كَانَ أَحَدُهُمَا يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ وَكَانَ الْآخَرُ لَا يَسْتَنْزِهُ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ أَوْ مِنَ الْبَوْلِ قَالَ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ جَرِيدَةً رَطْبَةً فَكَسَرَهَا فَغَرَزَ عِنْدَ رَأْسِ كُلِّ قَبْرٍ مِنْهُمَا قِطْعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ «عَسَى أَنْ يُخَفَّفَ عنْهما حَتَّى تَيْبَسَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 767

chapter.englishTitle: Urination in the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: An Arab man came to the Prophet ﷺ . When he stood to urinate in a corner of the mosque, the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ shouted at him. The Prophet ﷺ stopped them and then called for a bucket of water and poured it over his urine.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: An Arab man came to the Prophet ﷺ . When he stood to urinate in a corner of the mosque, the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ shouted at him. The Prophet ﷺ stopped them and then called for a bucket of water and poured it over his urine.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَلَمَّا قَامَ بَالَ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ فَصَاحَ بِهِ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَكَفَّهُمْ عنْهُ ثُمَّ «دَعَا بِدَلْوٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ فَصَبَّهُ عَلَى بَوْلِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 768

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ بَوْلِ الْغُلَامِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَطْعَمْ
chapter.englishTitle: The urine of the boy who hasn't eaten.

hadiths.englishRaw: She brought her son to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ who had not reached the age to eat food yet, so he made him sit in his lap. The child urinated on him, so the Prophet called for water and poured it on the area, but did not wash it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: She brought her son to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ who had not reached the age to eat food yet, so he made him sit in his lap. The child urinated on him, so the Prophet called for water and poured it on the area, but did not wash it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بِابْنٍ لَهَا لَمْ يَبْلُغْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الطَّعَامَ فَأَجْلَسَهُ فِي حِجْرِهِ فَبَالَ عَلَيْهِ «فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَنَضَحَهُ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Yūnus Ayḍ \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e Um Qays b. Miḥṣan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَنْ يُونُسَ أَيْضًا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 769

chapter.englishTitle: The earth purifies itself.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I am a woman whose hem is lengthy, and I may walk through a dirty place. The Messenger of Allah said: 'That which comes after it purifies it.'"     – Sound Due to External Factors
hadiths.body: "I am a woman whose hem is lengthy, and I may walk through a dirty place. The Messenger of Allah said: 'That which comes after it purifies it.'"     – Sound Due to External Factors
hadiths.arabic: إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُطِيلُ ذَيْلِي فَأَمْشِي فِي الْمَكَانِ الْقَذِرِ؟ قَالَتْ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يُطَهِّرُهُ مَا بَعْدَهُ» قُلْتُ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ تَأْخُذُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ لَا أَدْرِي   – صحيح لغيره
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿUmārah \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Taymī \u003e Um And Lad Liʾibrāhīm b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAwf \u003e Saʾalat Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أُمِّ وَلَدٍ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَنَّهَا سَأَلَتْ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ فَقَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 770

chapter.englishTitle: Tayammum

hadiths.englishRaw: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, then we camped. He called for ablution (wudu) and performed it. Then the call to prayer was announced and he led the people in prayer. When he finished his prayer, he saw a man who had not prayed with the people, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "What prevented you, O so-and-so, from praying with the people?" He replied, "O Messenger of Allah, I was in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) and had no water." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then perform dry ablution (tayammum) as it is sufficient for you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, then we camped. He called for ablution (wudu) and performed it. Then the call to prayer was announced and he led the people in prayer. When he finished his prayer, he saw a man who had not prayed with the people, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "What prevented you, O so-and-so, from praying with the people?" He replied, "O Messenger of Allah, I was in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) and had no water." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Then perform dry ablution (tayammum) as it is sufficient for you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي سَفَرٍ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَدَعَا بِوَضُوءٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ نُودِيَ بِالصَّلَاةِ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ فَلَمَّا انْفَتَلَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ إِذَا هُوَ بِرَجُلٍ مُعْتَزِلٍ لَمْ يُصَلِّ فِي الْقَوْمِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا مَنَعَكَ يَا فُلَانُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ فِي الْقَوْمِ؟» فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَابَتْنِي الجَنَابَةُ وَلَا مَاءَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَيْكَ بِالصَّعِيدِ فَإِنَّهُ يَكْفِيكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e ʿAwf \u003e Abū Rajāʾ al-ʿUṭāridī \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيُّ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 771

chapter.englishTitle: Tayammum

hadiths.englishRaw: Two men went on a journey. When prayer time came, they did not have water with them. So they performed Tayammum on clean ground and prayed. Later, they found water during the appropriate time. One of them repeated his prayer with ablution, while the other did not repeat it. Then they came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and narrated what had happened. He said to the one who did not repeat his prayer, "You have followed the Sunnah and your prayer is accepted." And he said to the one who performed ablution and repeated his prayer, "You will have double the reward."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Two men went on a journey. When prayer time came, they did not have water with them. So they performed Tayammum on clean ground and prayed. Later, they found water during the appropriate time. One of them repeated his prayer with ablution, while the other did not repeat it. Then they came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and narrated what had happened. He said to the one who did not repeat his prayer, "You have followed the Sunnah and your prayer is accepted." And he said to the one who performed ablution and repeated his prayer, "You will have double the reward."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَرَجَ رَجُلَانِ فِي سَفَرٍ فَحَضَرَتْهُمَا الصَّلَاةُ وَلَيْسَ مَعَهُمَا مَاءٌ فَتَيَمَّمَا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَصَلَّيَا ثُمَّ وَجَدَا الْمَاءَ بَعْدُ فِي الْوَقْتِ فَأَعَادَ أَحَدُهُمَا الصَّلَاةَ بِوُضُوءٍ وَلَمْ يُعِدِ الْآخَرُ ثُمَّ أَتَيَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَكَرَا ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لِلَّذِي لَمْ يُعِدْ «أَصَبْتَ السُّنَّةَ وَأَجْزَأتْكَ صَلَاتُكَ» وَقَالَ لِلَّذِي تَوَضَّأَ وَأَعَادَ «لَكَ الْأَجْرُ مَرَّتَيْنِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Nāfiʿ \u003e al-Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Bakr b. Sawādah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ سَوَادَةَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 772

chapter.englishTitle: Tayammum once

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to say about Tayammum, "Strike the face and hands." Abdullah confirmed the authenticity of this narration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to say about Tayammum, "Strike the face and hands." Abdullah confirmed the authenticity of this narration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي التَّيَمُّمِ «ضَرْبَةٌ لِلْوَجْهِ وَالْكَفَّيْنِ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ صَحَّ إِسْنَادُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Abān b. Yazīd al-ʿAṭṭār \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿAzrah \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abzá from his father \u003e ʿAmmār b. Yāsir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْعَطَّارُ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ عَزْرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 773

chapter.englishTitle: Tayammum once

hadiths.englishRaw: She borrowed a necklace from Asma', and she lost it. The Prophet sent some people to look for it, and the time for prayer came so they prayed without ablution. When they came to the Prophet they complained to him about that, then the Verse of dry ablution was revealed. Usaid bin Hudair said: "May Allah reward you with good, for by Allah, nothing ever happens to you but Allah grants you a way out and blesses the Muslims thereby."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: She borrowed a necklace from Asma', and she lost it. The Prophet sent some people to look for it, and the time for prayer came so they prayed without ablution. When they came to the Prophet they complained to him about that, then the Verse of dry ablution was revealed. Usaid bin Hudair said: "May Allah reward you with good, for by Allah, nothing ever happens to you but Allah grants you a way out and blesses the Muslims thereby."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا اسْتَعَارَتْ قِلَادَةً مِنْ أَسْمَاءَ فَهَلَكَتْ فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَاسًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِي طَلَبِهَا فَأَدْرَكَتْهُمُ الصَّلَاةُ فَصَلَّوْا مِنْ غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ فَلَمَّا أَتَوْا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ شَكَوْا ذَلِكَ إِلَيْهِ فَنَزَلَتْ «آيَةُ التَّيَمُّمِ» فَقَالَ أُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ جَزَاكِ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا فَوَاللَّهِ مَا نَزَلَ بِكِ أَمْرٌ قَطُّ إِلَّا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكِ مِنْهُ مَخْرَجًا وَجَعَلَ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ فِيهِ بَرَكَةً   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 774

chapter.englishTitle: In Ghusl from Janabah

hadiths.englishRaw: "I presented water to the Prophet ﷺ, and he poured it onto his hands, and he began washing his private parts. After he finished washing, he wiped his hands on the ground or on a wall. Sulaiman had doubts about this, then the Prophet ﷺ proceeded to rinse his mouth, inhale water, and wash his face, arms, and pour water over his head and body. After he finished, he stepped aside and washed his feet. I then gave him a towel, but he refused and instead shook his hands. I said, 'I will cover him until he finishes washing.' Sulaiman said that Salim had mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ washing himself in this manner was due to Janabah (state of impurity)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I presented water to the Prophet ﷺ, and he poured it onto his hands, and he began washing his private parts. After he finished washing, he wiped his hands on the ground or on a wall. Sulaiman had doubts about this, then the Prophet ﷺ proceeded to rinse his mouth, inhale water, and wash his face, arms, and pour water over his head and body. After he finished, he stepped aside and washed his feet. I then gave him a towel, but he refused and instead shook his hands. I said, 'I will cover him until he finishes washing.' Sulaiman said that Salim had mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ washing himself in this manner was due to Janabah (state of impurity)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَضَعْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ مَاءً فَأَفْرَغَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ فَجَعَلَ يَغْسِلُ بِهَا فَرْجَهُ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مَسَحَهَا بِالْأَرْضِ أَوْ بِحَائِطٍ شَكَّ سُلَيْمَانُ ثُمَّ تَمَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ فَغَسَلَ وَجْهَهُ وَذِرَاعَيْهِ وَصَبَّ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَجَسَدِهِ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ تَنَحَّى فَغَسَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ فَأَعْطَيْتُهُ مِلْحَفَةً فَأَبَى وَجَعَلَ يَنْفُضُ بِيَدِهِ قَالَتْ فَسَتَرْتُهُ حَتَّى اغْتَسَلَ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ فَذَكَرَ سَالِمٌ أَنَّ غُسْلَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ هَذَا كَانَ مِنْ الجَنَابَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Kurayb \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Maymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 775

chapter.englishTitle: In Ghusl from Janabah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to begin by washing his hands, then perform ablution for prayer. He would then dip his hand in water and pass it through the roots of his hair until he believed that his skin had been relieved from impurities. He would pour three handfuls of water over his head and then perform a full body wash. Abu Muhammad said, "This narration from Salim bin Abi Al-Jaad is dearer to me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to begin by washing his hands, then perform ablution for prayer. He would then dip his hand in water and pass it through the roots of his hair until he believed that his skin had been relieved from impurities. He would pour three handfuls of water over his head and then perform a full body wash. Abu Muhammad said, "This narration from Salim bin Abi Al-Jaad is dearer to me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَبْدَأُ فَيَغْسِلُ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَتَوَضَّأُ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ ثُمَّ يُدْخِلُ كَفَّهُ فِي الْمَاءِ فَيُخَلِّلُ بِهَا أُصُولَ شَعْرِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا خُيِّلَ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ قَدِ اسْتَبْرَأَ الْبَشَرَةَ غَرَفَ بِيَدِهِ ثَلَاثَ غَرَفَاتٍ فَصَبَّهَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثُمَّ اغْتَسَلَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ هَذَا أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 776

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَغْتَسِلَانِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The man and the woman wash from one vessel.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard Al-Qasim narrating that 'Aishah said: 'I used to perform Ghusl, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I from a single vessel, from Janabah.'"    – Sound
hadiths.body: "I heard Al-Qasim narrating that 'Aishah said: 'I used to perform Ghusl, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I from a single vessel, from Janabah.'"    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ «أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 777

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ يَغْتَسِلَانِ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The man and the woman wash from one vessel.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah and I would take a bath from a single vessel."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah and I would take a bath from a single vessel."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ «أَغْتَسِلُ أَنَا وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَهُوَ الْفَرَقُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Jaʿfar b. Burqān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 778

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ تَرَكَ مَوْضِعَ شَعْرَةٍ مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever leaves a place of a hair's breadth from impurity.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ʿWhoever leaves a space the size of a hair when doing ghusl for janabah and does not make water reach it, Allah will punish him with such and such in the Fire.” ‘Ali ؓ said: From that time I disliked my hair.
hadiths.body: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ʿWhoever leaves a space the size of a hair when doing ghusl for janabah and does not make water reach it, Allah will punish him with such and such in the Fire.” ‘Ali ؓ said: From that time I disliked my hair.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ تَرَكَ مَوْضِعَ شَعْرَةٍ مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ لَمْ يُصِبْهَا الْمَاءُ فُعِلَ بِهَا كَذَا وَكَذَا مِنَ النَّارِ» قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَمِنْ ثَمَّ عَادَيْتُ رَأْسِي وَكَانَ يَجُزُّ شَعْرَهُ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Faḍl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Zādhān \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ زَاذَانَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 779

chapter.englishTitle: The wounded person is affected by impurity

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard Ibn 'Abbas saying that a man was injured in the head at the time of the Messenger of Allah, then he had a wet dream. He was told to have a bath, so he took the bath, became rigid and stiff, and died. News of that reached the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'They have killed him, may Allah kill them! Is not the cure for a lack of knowledge to ask questions?'"'Ata' said: "We heard that the Messenger of Allah said: 'If only he had washed his body and left his head alone where the wound was.'"     – Sound
hadiths.body: "I heard Ibn 'Abbas saying that a man was injured in the head at the time of the Messenger of Allah, then he had a wet dream. He was told to have a bath, so he took the bath, became rigid and stiff, and died. News of that reached the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'They have killed him, may Allah kill them! Is not the cure for a lack of knowledge to ask questions?'"'Ata' said: "We heard that the Messenger of Allah said: 'If only he had washed his body and left his head alone where the wound was.'"     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَصَابَهُ جُرْحٌ فِي عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ثُمَّ أَصَابَهُ احْتِلَامٌ فَأُمِرَ بِالِاغْتِسَالِ فَمَاتَ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «قَتَلُوهُ قَتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَلَمْ يَكُنْ شِفَاءَ الْعِيِّ السُّؤَالُ؟» قَالَ عَطَاءٌ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سُئِلَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «لَوْ غَسَلَ جَسَدَهُ وَتَرَكَ رَأْسَهُ حَيْثُ أَصَابَهُ الْجُرْحُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Balaghanī \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Rabāḥ \u003e Innah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ قَالَ إِنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يُخْبِرُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 780

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي غُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the one who circumambulates his wives in one washing

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went around all his wives and only performed Ghusl once.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went around all his wives and only performed Ghusl once.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «طَافَ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 781

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَطُوفُ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي غُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the one who circumambulates his wives in one washing

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went around all his wives and only performed Ghusl once.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas bin Malik that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went around all his wives and only performed Ghusl once.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «طَافَ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ جُمَعَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 782

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ يُسْتَتَرَ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is it recommended to cover with?

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah b. Ja'far reported that one day Messenger of Allah ﷺ mounted me behind him and narrated to me something in secret which I would narrate to none amongst people.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah b. Ja'far reported that one day Messenger of Allah ﷺ mounted me behind him and narrated to me something in secret which I would narrate to none amongst people.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَرْدَفَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ خَلْفَهُ فَأَسَرَّ إِلَيَّ حَدِيثًا لَا أُحَدِّثُ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنَ النَّاسِ وَكَانَ «أَحَبَّ مَا اسْتَتَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِحَاجَتِهِ هَدَفٌ أَوْ حَائِشُ نَخْلٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Mahdī b. Maymūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Yaʿqūb \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Saʿd a freed slave of al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ مَوْلَى الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 783

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْجُنُبِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ
chapter.englishTitle: When the body wants to sleep

hadiths.englishRaw: Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, asked the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and said, "Can I experience sexual impurity (Janaba) during the night?" So he instructed him to "wash his private parts, perform ablution, and then go to sleep."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, asked the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and said, "Can I experience sexual impurity (Janaba) during the night?" So he instructed him to "wash his private parts, perform ablution, and then go to sleep."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلَ عُمَرُ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ تُصِيبُنِي الْجَنَابَةُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ؟ فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ «يَغْسِلَ ذَكَرَهُ وَيَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ يَرْقُدَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 784

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْجُنُبِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ
chapter.englishTitle: When the body wants to sleep

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked Aisha, "How did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ act when he wanted to sleep while in a state of sexual impurity?" She said, "He would perform ablution as he does for prayer, then he would sleep."   – Sound
hadiths.body: I asked Aisha, "How did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ act when he wanted to sleep while in a state of sexual impurity?" She said, "He would perform ablution as he does for prayer, then he would sleep."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ كَيْفَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَصْنَعُ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ؟ فَقَالَتْ كَانَ «يَتَوَضَّأُ وُضُوءَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Aswad from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 785

chapter.englishTitle: Water from Water

hadiths.englishRaw: "Water is for Water." [1] [1] That is, water for peforming Ghusl is obligatory when the ejaculation of water (semen) occurs.    – Sound
hadiths.body: "Water is for Water." [1] [1] That is, water for peforming Ghusl is obligatory when the ejaculation of water (semen) occurs.    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْمَاءُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Mūsá \u003e ʿAbd al-Razzāq \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Sāʾib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَنبَأَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سُعَادٍ وَكَانَ مَرْضِيًّا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 786

chapter.englishTitle: Water from Water

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of Sahl bin Saad Al-Saa'idi, who met and heard from the Prophet ﷺ when he was fifteen years old, at the time of the Prophet's death. He said, "Ubay bin Ka'b informed me that the fatwa they used to issue regarding the saying of Allah 'Water from water' was initially permitted by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the beginning of Islam. Then he commanded them to perform ablution after that." Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) said, and others also said, "Al-Zuhri narrated to me from some who were pleased with Sahl bin Saad."   – Sound
hadiths.body: On the authority of Sahl bin Saad Al-Saa'idi, who met and heard from the Prophet ﷺ when he was fifteen years old, at the time of the Prophet's death. He said, "Ubay bin Ka'b informed me that the fatwa they used to issue regarding the saying of Allah 'Water from water' was initially permitted by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the beginning of Islam. Then he commanded them to perform ablution after that." Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) said, and others also said, "Al-Zuhri narrated to me from some who were pleased with Sahl bin Saad."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ وَكَانَ قَدْ أَدْرَكَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَسَمِعَ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أُبَيُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ أَنَّ الْفُتْيَا الَّتِي كَانُوا يُفْتَوْنَ بِهَا فِي قَوْلِهِ «الْمَاءُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ» رُخْصَةٌ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَخَّصَ فِيهَا فِي أَوَّلِ الْإِسْلَامِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِالِاغْتِسَالِ بَعْدُ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وقالَ غَيْرُهُ قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ مَنْ أَرْضَى عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 787

chapter.englishTitle: Water from Water

hadiths.englishRaw: "The fatwa that they used to issue, regarding 'water from water', was a permission that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted in the early days of Islam or at that time, then he performed ablution afterwards."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The fatwa that they used to issue, regarding 'water from water', was a permission that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ granted in the early days of Islam or at that time, then he performed ablution afterwards."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الْفُتْيَا الَّتِي كَانُوا يُفْتَوْنَ بِهَا «الْمَاءُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ» كَانَتْ رُخْصَةً رَخَّصَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي أَوَّلِ الْإِسْلَامِ أَوِ الزَّمَانِ ثُمَّ اغْتَسَلَ بَعْدُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad b. Mihrān al-Jammāl \u003e Mubashhir al-Ḥalabī \u003e Muḥammad Abū Ghassān \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd \u003e Ubay
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الْجَمَّالُ حَدَّثَنَا مُبَشِّرٌ الْحَلَبِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ أَبِي غَسَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قال حَدَّثَنِي أُبَيٌّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 788

chapter.englishTitle: In the circumcision room.

hadiths.englishRaw: as the following Hadith 290. Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When a man sits in between the four parts of a woman and did the sexual intercourse with her, bath becomes compulsory."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: as the following Hadith 290. Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When a man sits in between the four parts of a woman and did the sexual intercourse with her, bath becomes compulsory."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا جَلَسَ بَيْنَ شُعَبِهَا الْأَرْبَعِ ثُمَّ جَهَدَهَا فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Hishām \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Abū Rāfiʿ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 789

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى فِي مَنَامِهَا مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ
chapter.englishTitle: In a woman, you can see in her dreams what a man sees.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib saying that my aunt Khawla bint Hakeem al-Sulamiyah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a woman who experiences nocturnal emission, and he commanded her to perform ghusl (ritual bath).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib saying that my aunt Khawla bint Hakeem al-Sulamiyah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about a woman who experiences nocturnal emission, and he commanded her to perform ghusl (ritual bath).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ يَقُولُ سَأَلَتْ خَالَتِي خَوْلَةُ بِنْتُ حَكِيمٍ الْسُلَمِيَّةُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَحْتَلِمُ «فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ al-Khurāsānī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 790

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى فِي مَنَامِهَا مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ
chapter.englishTitle: In a woman, you can see in her dreams what a man sees.

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah! Allah is not shy to tell the truth. Inform me: if a women sees in a dream what men see should she perform Ghusl from that?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: "Yes." 'Aishah said: "I expressed my displeasure and said: 'Does a woman see that?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to me and said: 'May your right hand be covered with dust! How else would (her child) resemble her?'"     – Sound
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah! Allah is not shy to tell the truth. Inform me: if a women sees in a dream what men see should she perform Ghusl from that?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: "Yes." 'Aishah said: "I expressed my displeasure and said: 'Does a woman see that?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to me and said: 'May your right hand be covered with dust! How else would (her child) resemble her?'"     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ أُمَّ بَنِي أَبِي طَلْحَةَ دَخَلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهِ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ أَرَأَيْتَ الْمَرْأَةَ تَرَى فِي النَّوْمِ مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ أَتَغْتَسِلُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ أُفٍّ لَكِ أَتَرَى الْمَرْأَةُ ذَلِكَ؟ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «تَرِبَتْ يَمِينُكِ فَمِنْ أَيْنَ يَكُونُ الشَّبَهُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 791

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى فِي مَنَامِهَا مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ
chapter.englishTitle: In a woman, you can see in her dreams what a man sees.

hadiths.englishRaw: Umm Salamah entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while Umm Salimah was with him. The woman said, "Do women see in their dreams what men see?" Umm Salamah said, "May your hands be covered in dust, O Umm Salimah. You have caused disturbance among women." The Prophet ﷺ replied, supporting Umm Salimah, "No, indeed it is your hands that should be covered in dust, for you have asked about what concerns you when you see water. Therefore, you should perform ablution." Umm Salimah asked, "Do women have water available?" He replied, "Yes, how can they resemble boys? They are the counterparts of men."   – Sound
hadiths.body: Umm Salamah entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while Umm Salimah was with him. The woman said, "Do women see in their dreams what men see?" Umm Salamah said, "May your hands be covered in dust, O Umm Salimah. You have caused disturbance among women." The Prophet ﷺ replied, supporting Umm Salimah, "No, indeed it is your hands that should be covered in dust, for you have asked about what concerns you when you see water. Therefore, you should perform ablution." Umm Salimah asked, "Do women have water available?" He replied, "Yes, how can they resemble boys? They are the counterparts of men."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ وَعِنْدَهُ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ فَقَالَتْ الْمَرْأَةُ تَرَى فِي مَنَامِهَا مَا يَرَى الرَّجُلُ؟ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكِ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ فَضَحْتِ النِّسَاءَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مُنْتَصِرًا لِأُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ «بَلْ أَنْتِ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكِ إِنَّ خَيْرَكُنَّ الَّتِي تَسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَعْنِيهَا إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَاءَ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ» قَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ وَلِلنِّسَاءِ مَاءٌ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ فَأَنَّى يُشْبِهُهُنَّ الْوَلَدُ؟ إِنَّمَا هُنَّ شَقَائِقُ الرِّجَالِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 792

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ يَرَى بَلَلًا، وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ احْتِلَامًا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever sees filth and does not mention a dream.

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, regarding a man who wakes up and sees wetness without remembering having a dream, he said, "Let him perform Ghusl (ritual bath) if he sees a wet dream but does not see any wetness, then there is no obligation for him to perform Ghusl."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, regarding a man who wakes up and sees wetness without remembering having a dream, he said, "Let him perform Ghusl (ritual bath) if he sees a wet dream but does not see any wetness, then there is no obligation for him to perform Ghusl."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَسْتَيْقِظُ فَيَرَى بَلَلًا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ احْتِلَامًا قَالَ «لِيَغْتَسِلْ فَإِنْ رَأَى احْتِلَامًا وَلَمْ يَرَ بَلَلًا فَلَا غُسْلَ عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Mūsá \u003e ʿAbd al-Razzāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 793

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ مَنَامِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: If one of you wakes up from their sleep

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "When anyone of you wakes up from sleep, he should not put his hand into the vessel until he has washed it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "When anyone of you wakes up from sleep, he should not put his hand into the vessel until he has washed it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ فَلَا يَغْمِسْ يَدَهُ فِي الْوَضُوءِ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَهَا ثَلَاثًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 794

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْخَلَاءِ فَيأْكُلُ
chapter.englishTitle: The man exits the restroom and eats.

hadiths.englishRaw: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ , and he went to the toilet and then came out. Food was brought, and it was said to him, 'Don't you perform ablution?' He replied, 'Shouldn't I pray and then perform ablution?'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We were with the Prophet ﷺ , and he went to the toilet and then came out. Food was brought, and it was said to him, 'Don't you perform ablution?' He replied, 'Shouldn't I pray and then perform ablution?'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَدَخَلَ الْغَائِطَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَأُتِيَ بِطَعَامٍ فَقِيلَ أَلَا تَتَوَضَّأُ؟ فَقَالَ «أُصَلِّي فَأَتَوَضَّأُ؟»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Ḥūwayrith \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 795

chapter.englishTitle: In the bathroom

hadiths.englishRaw: 'Aishah the wife of the Prophet said: "Umm Habibah Jahsh experienced prolonged non-menstrual bleeding for seven years when she was married to 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf. She complained about that to the Prophet and the Prophet said: 'That is not menstruation, rather it is a vein, so when the time of your period comes, leave the prayer, and when it is over, take a bath and perform prayer.'" 'Aishah said: "She used to bathe for every prayer and then perform the prayer. She used to sit in a washtub belonging to her sister Zainab bint Jahsh and the blood would turn the water red."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: 'Aishah the wife of the Prophet said: "Umm Habibah Jahsh experienced prolonged non-menstrual bleeding for seven years when she was married to 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf. She complained about that to the Prophet and the Prophet said: 'That is not menstruation, rather it is a vein, so when the time of your period comes, leave the prayer, and when it is over, take a bath and perform prayer.'" 'Aishah said: "She used to bathe for every prayer and then perform the prayer. She used to sit in a washtub belonging to her sister Zainab bint Jahsh and the blood would turn the water red."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ اسْتُحِيضَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ وَهِيَ تَحْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ فَشَكَتْ ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «إِنَّ هَذِهِ لَيْسَتْ بِالْحَيْضَةِ وَإِنَّمَا هُوَ عِرْقٌ فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلَاةَ وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْتَسِلِي ثُمَّ صَلِّي» قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَكَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي وَكَانَتْ تَقْعُدُ فِي مِرْكَنٍ لِأُخْتِهَا زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ حَتَّى إِنَّ حُمْرَةَ الدَّمِ لَتَعْلُو الْمَاءَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr And ʿAmrah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Saʿd b. Zurārah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ وَعَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 796

chapter.englishTitle: Initiation for the fasting person.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to engage in sexual intercourse while fasting.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to engage in sexual intercourse while fasting.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «يُبَاشِرُ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Hishām Ṣāḥib al-Dastawāʾī \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 797

chapter.englishTitle: Initiation for the fasting person.

hadiths.englishRaw: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to embrace (his wives) while fasting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to embrace (his wives) while fasting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يُبَاشِرُ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Ḥātim al-Baṣrī Rawḥ b. Aslam \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ رَوْحُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 798

chapter.englishTitle: The menstruating woman extends her stay.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said to her, "Pass me the hookah." She said, "I am on my period." He said, "It is not in your control."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said to her, "Pass me the hookah." She said, "I am on my period." He said, "It is not in your control."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهَا «نَاوِلِينِي الْخُمْرَةَ» قَالَتْ إِنِّي حَائِضٌ قَالَ «إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِكِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Thābit b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 799

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي دَمِ الْحَيْضِ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the blood of menstruation, the clothing is affected.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard a woman asking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ how she should deal with her garment if it is stained with blood when she becomes clean from her menstruation. He said, "If you see blood on it, scratch it off, then rub it, then wash it thoroughly with water and then pray in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard a woman asking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ how she should deal with her garment if it is stained with blood when she becomes clean from her menstruation. He said, "If you see blood on it, scratch it off, then rub it, then wash it thoroughly with water and then pray in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ امْرَأَةً وَهِيَ تَسْأَلُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَيْفَ تصْنعُ بِثوْبها إِذَا طَهُرَتْ مَنْ مَحِيضِهَا؟ قَالَ «إِنْ رَأَيْتِ فِيهِ دمًا فَحُكِّيهِ ثُمَّ اقْرُصِيهِ ثُمَّ انْضَحِي فِي سَائِرِ ثَوْبِكِ ثُمَّ صَلِّي فِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Fāṭimah b. al-Mundhir \u003e Jaddatihā Asmāʾ b. Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ جَدَّتِهَا أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 800

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman from the Ansar asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about menstruation. He said, "Take your water and your sidr (a type of tree) and then perform ghusl (ritual bath) and cleanse yourself. Then, pour water onto your head until the water reaches the roots of your hair. Then, take a piece of cotton or cloth soaked in musk and place it in your vagina." The woman asked, "How should I use it, O Messenger of Allah?" He remained silent. She asked again, "How should I use it, O Messenger of Allah?" He remained silent. Aisha said, "Take a piece of cotton or cloth soaked in musk and trace it along the traces of blood, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ can hear, and he did not object to her action."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman from the Ansar asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about menstruation. He said, "Take your water and your sidr (a type of tree) and then perform ghusl (ritual bath) and cleanse yourself. Then, pour water onto your head until the water reaches the roots of your hair. Then, take a piece of cotton or cloth soaked in musk and place it in your vagina." The woman asked, "How should I use it, O Messenger of Allah?" He remained silent. She asked again, "How should I use it, O Messenger of Allah?" He remained silent. Aisha said, "Take a piece of cotton or cloth soaked in musk and trace it along the traces of blood, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ can hear, and he did not object to her action."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْحَيْضِ؟ قَالَ «خُذِي مَاءَكِ وَسِدْرَكِ ثُمَّ اغْتَسِلِي وَأَنْقِي ثُمَّ صُبِّي عَلَى رَأْسِكِ حَتَّى تَبْلُغِي شُؤُونَ الرَّأْسِ ثُمَّ خُذِي فِرْصَةً مُمَسَّكَةً» قَالَتْ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ بِهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ فَسَكَتَ قَالَتْ فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ فَسَكَتَ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ خُذِي فِرْصَةً مُمَسَّكَةً فَتَتَبَّعِي بِهَا آثَارَ الدَّمِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْمَعُ فَمَا أَنْكَرَ عَلَيْهَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Muhājir \u003e Ṣafiyyah b. Shaybah b. ʿUthmān \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 801

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "Fatimah bint Abi Hubaish came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I am a woman who bleeds continuously and never becomes pure, should I give up the prayer?' He said: 'No, rather that is a vein and it is not menstruation. When the time of your period comes, leave off the prayer, and when it is over, take a bath and wash the blood from yourself and perform the prayer." This is the Hadith of Waki'.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Fatimah bint Abi Hubaish came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I am a woman who bleeds continuously and never becomes pure, should I give up the prayer?' He said: 'No, rather that is a vein and it is not menstruation. When the time of your period comes, leave off the prayer, and when it is over, take a bath and wash the blood from yourself and perform the prayer." This is the Hadith of Waki'.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلَا أَطْهُرُ أَفَأَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ؟ قَالَ «لَا إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلَاةَ وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ وَصَلِّي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 802

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: It is reported that the daughter of Ja'hsh informed the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ that she used to have irregular bleeding during her period. The Prophet ﷺ instructed her to perform a ritual purification (ghusl) for every prayer. If she noticed that blood was entering her vagina while inside the mosque, and she found water inside the mosque, she should submerge herself in it and then exit. If the blood was on top of the water, she should pray without repeating the purification.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It is reported that the daughter of Ja'hsh informed the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ that she used to have irregular bleeding during her period. The Prophet ﷺ instructed her to perform a ritual purification (ghusl) for every prayer. If she noticed that blood was entering her vagina while inside the mosque, and she found water inside the mosque, she should submerge herself in it and then exit. If the blood was on top of the water, she should pray without repeating the purification.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ ابْنَةَ جَحْشٍ «اسْتُحِيضَتْ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَمَرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْغُسْلِ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَتَدْخُلُ الْمِرْكَنَ وَإِنَّهُ لَمَمْلُوءٌ مَاءً فَتَنْغَمِسُ فِيهِ ثُمَّ تَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ وَإِنَّ الدَّمَ فَوْقَهُ لَغَالبُهُ فَتُصَلِّي»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 803

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "It is only Fulanah. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered her to perform ablution before every prayer. When that became difficult for her, he ordered her to combine the Dhuhr and Asr prayers with one ablution, and the Maghrib and Isha prayers with one ablution, and to perform ablution for Fajr prayer." Abu Muhammad said, "People say she was Sahlah bint Suhail." Yazid ibn Harun said, "She was Suhailah bint Sahl."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "It is only Fulanah. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered her to perform ablution before every prayer. When that became difficult for her, he ordered her to combine the Dhuhr and Asr prayers with one ablution, and the Maghrib and Isha prayers with one ablution, and to perform ablution for Fajr prayer." Abu Muhammad said, "People say she was Sahlah bint Suhail." Yazid ibn Harun said, "She was Suhailah bint Sahl."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّمَا هِيَ فُلَانَةُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «أَمَرَهَا بِالْغُسْلِ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ فَلَمَّا شَقَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَجْمَعَ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ بِغُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ وَبَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِغُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ وَتَغْتَسِلَ لِلْفَجْرِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ سَهْلَةُ بِنْتُ سُهَيْلٍ قَالَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ سُهَيْلَةُ بِنْتُ سَهْلٍ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Innamā Hī Fulānah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 804

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman had a prolonged flow of blood in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She was commanded to advance the afternoon prayer and delay the noon prayer, and to take a bath for them only once; and to delay the sunset prayer and advance the night prayer and to take a bath only once for them; and to take a bath separately for the dawn prayer. I (Shu'bah) asked AbdurRahman: (Is it) from the Prophet ﷺ? I do not report to you anything except from the Prophet ﷺ.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman had a prolonged flow of blood in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She was commanded to advance the afternoon prayer and delay the noon prayer, and to take a bath for them only once; and to delay the sunset prayer and advance the night prayer and to take a bath only once for them; and to take a bath separately for the dawn prayer.
