I (Shu'bah) asked AbdurRahman: (Is it) from the Prophet ﷺ? I do not report to you anything except from the Prophet ﷺ.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً اسْتُحِيضَتْ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأُمِرَتْ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَمَرَهَا؟ قَالَ لَا أُحَدِّثُكَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ شَيْئًا قَالَ فَأُمِرَتْ أَنْ «تُؤَخِّرَ الظُّهْرَ وَتُعَجِّلَ الْعَصْرَ وَتَغْتَسِلَ لَهُمَا غُسْلًا وَتُؤَخِّرَ الْمَغْرِبَ وَتُعَجِّلَ الْعِشَاءَ وَتَغْتَسِلَ لَهُمَا غُسْلًا وَتَغْتَسِلَ لِلصُّبْحِ غُسْلًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Saʾalt ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim \u003e al-Mustaḥāḍah Faʾakhbaranī from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ عَنِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ فَأَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 805

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: 'Aishah the wife of the Prophet said: "Umm Habibah Jahsh experienced prolonged non-menstrual bleeding for seven years when she was married to 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf. She complained about that to the Prophet and the Prophet said: 'That is not menstruation, rather it is a vein, so when the time of your period comes, leave the prayer, and when it is over, take a bath and perform prayer.'" 'Aishah said: "She used to bathe for every prayer and then perform the prayer. She used to sit in a washtub belonging to her sister Zainab bint Jahsh and the blood would turn the water red."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: 'Aishah the wife of the Prophet said: "Umm Habibah Jahsh experienced prolonged non-menstrual bleeding for seven years when she was married to 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf. She complained about that to the Prophet and the Prophet said: 'That is not menstruation, rather it is a vein, so when the time of your period comes, leave the prayer, and when it is over, take a bath and perform prayer.'" 'Aishah said: "She used to bathe for every prayer and then perform the prayer. She used to sit in a washtub belonging to her sister Zainab bint Jahsh and the blood would turn the water red."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: اسْتُحِيضَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ وَهِيَ تَحْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ فَاشْتَكَتْ ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ بِحِيضَةٍ إِنَّمَا هُوَ عِرْقٌ فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَدَعِي الصَّلَاةَ وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَاغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي» قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَكَانَتْ تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي قَالَتْ وَكَانَتْ تَقْعُدُ فِي مِرْكَنٍ لِأُخْتِهَا زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ حَتَّى إِنَّ حُمْرَةَ الدَّمِ لَتَعْلُو الْمَاءَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 806

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who experiences istihadah (continuous abnormal bleeding), should I stop praying?" He said: "No, this is just a vein and not menstruation. So when your period comes, then leave prayers. And when the period has ended, wash away the blood from yourself, perform ablution, and pray." Hisham said: "My father used to say that she should first perform the initial washing, and then whatever comes after that, she is considered pure and can pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah, I am a woman who experiences istihadah (continuous abnormal bleeding), should I stop praying?" He said: "No, this is just a vein and not menstruation. So when your period comes, then leave prayers. And when the period has ended, wash away the blood from yourself, perform ablution, and pray." Hisham said: "My father used to say that she should first perform the initial washing, and then whatever comes after that, she is considered pure and can pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ أَفَأَتْرُكُ الصَّلَاةَ؟ قَالَ «لَا إِنَّمَا ذَلِكِ عِرْقٌ وَلَيْسَتْ بِالْحِيضَةِ فَإِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَاتْرُكِي الصَّلَاةَ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ قَدْرُهَا فَاغْسِلِي عَنْكِ الدَّمَ وَتَوَضَّئِي وَصَلِّي» قَالَ هِشَامٌ فَكَانَ أَبِي يَقُولُ تَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلَ الْأَوَّلِ ثُمَّ مَا يَكُونُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَإِنَّهَا تَطَّهَّرُ وَتُصَلِّي   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Fāṭimah b. Abū Ḥubaysh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي حُبَيْشٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 807

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: In the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ there was a woman who had an issue of blood. So Umm Salamah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to give a decision about her. He said: She should consider the number of nights and days during which she used to menstruate each month before she was afflicted with this trouble and abandon prayer during that period each month. When those days and nights are over, she should take a bath, tie a cloth over her private parts and pray.     – Sound
hadiths.body: In the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ there was a woman who had an issue of blood. So Umm Salamah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to give a decision about her. He said: She should consider the number of nights and days during which she used to menstruate each month before she was afflicted with this trouble and abandon prayer during that period each month. When those days and nights are over, she should take a bath, tie a cloth over her private parts and pray.     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً كَانَتْ تُهَرَاقُ الدَّمَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَاسْتَفْتَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ لَهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لِتَنْظُرْ عَدَدَ اللَّيَالِي وَالْأَيَّامِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَحِيضُهُنَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَكُونَ بِهَا الَّذِي كَانَ وَقَدْرَهُنَّ مِنَ الشَّهْرِ فَتَتْرُكِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذَلِكَ فَإِذَا خَلَفَتْ ذَلِكَ وَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ وَلْتَسْتَثْفِرْ بِثَوْبٍ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e al-Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e a man
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 808

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah, blood has overwhelmed me." He said, "Take a bath and pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah, blood has overwhelmed me." He said, "Take a bath and pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ غَلَبَنِي الدَّمُ؟ قَالَ «اغْتَسِلِي وَصَلِّي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Um Ḥabībah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 809

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, heard Umm Habiba bint Jahsh say that she came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while she was experiencing istihada (non-menstrual bleeding) for seven years. She complained about it to him and sought his advice. He told her, "This is not menstruation; rather, it is a vein. So, perform ablution and then pray." Aisha said that Umm Habiba used to perform ablution for every prayer and pray. She would sit in a place of prayer, and the water mixed with blood would rise to her ankle, and then she would pray.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ, heard Umm Habiba bint Jahsh say that she came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while she was experiencing istihada (non-menstrual bleeding) for seven years. She complained about it to him and sought his advice. He told her, "This is not menstruation; rather, it is a vein. So, perform ablution and then pray." Aisha said that Umm Habiba used to perform ablution for every prayer and pray. She would sit in a place of prayer, and the water mixed with blood would rise to her ankle, and then she would pray.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ تَقُولُ جَاءَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَكَانَتْ اسْتُحِيضَتْ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ فَاشْتَكَتْ ذَلِكَ إِلَيْهِ وَاسْتَفْتَتْهُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ لَهَا «إِنَّ هَذَا لَيْسَ بِالْحَيْضَةِ إِنَّمَا هَذَا عِرْقٌ فَاغْتَسِلِي ثُمَّ صَلِّي» قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَكَانَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَتُصَلِّي وَكَانَتْ تَجْلِسُ فِي الْمِرْكَنِ فَتَعْلُو حُمْرَةُ الدَّمِ الْمَاءَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Dāwud al-Hāshimī \u003e Ibrāhīm / Ibn Saʿd \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAmrah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Saʿd b. Zurārah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 810

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: That Um Habibah, daughter of Jahsh, was in her menstrual period during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ instructed her to wash for every prayer. If she saw that blood was submerged in the vessel, even if it was filled with water, she would perform her prayer.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: That Um Habibah, daughter of Jahsh, was in her menstrual period during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Messenger of Allah ﷺ instructed her to wash for every prayer. If she saw that blood was submerged in the vessel, even if it was filled with water, she would perform her prayer.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ كَانَتْ اسْتُحِيضَتْ فِي عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَأَمَرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْغُسْلِ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَتَنْغَمِسُ فِي الْمِرْكَنِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمَمْلُوءٌ مَاءً ثُمَّ تَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ وَإِنَّ الدَّمَ لَعَالِيهِ فَتُصَلِّي»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 811

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: It was Badiyah, the daughter of Ghailan Althagafi.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It was Badiyah, the daughter of Ghailan Althagafi.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ بَادِيَةَ بِنْتَ غَيْلَانَ الثَّقَفِيَّةَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e al-Qāsim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 812

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her to perform ablution (washing) before every prayer. When that became difficult for her, he ordered her to combine the Dhuhr (noon) and Asr (afternoon) prayers in one ablution, and the Maghrib (evening) and Isha (night) prayers in one ablution. And she would perform ablution for Fajr (dawn) prayer."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her to perform ablution (washing) before every prayer. When that became difficult for her, he ordered her to combine the Dhuhr (noon) and Asr (afternoon) prayers in one ablution, and the Maghrib (evening) and Isha (night) prayers in one ablution. And she would perform ablution for Fajr (dawn) prayer."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «أَمَرَهَا بِالْغُسْلِ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ فَلَمَّا جَهَدَهَا ذَلِكَ أَمَرَ أَنْ تَجْمَعَ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ فِي غُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ فِي غُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ وَتَغْتَسِلَ لِلصُّبْحِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Innamā Hī Sahlh b. Suhyl b. ʿAmr Āstḥāḍat
hadiths.chainArabic: وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ إِنَّمَا هِيَ سَهْلةُ بِنْتُ سُهيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو اسْتحَاضَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 813

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: And some of them said, "She is Bint Suhail, the easy one."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: And some of them said, "She is Bint Suhail, the easy one."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ هِيَ سَهْلةُ بِنْتُ سُهيْلٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Innamā Jāʾ Ākhtilāfuhum \u003e Un Thalāthatahun ʿInd ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿWf \u003e Baʿḍuhum Hī Um Ḥbybh \u003e Baʿḍuhum Hī Bādiyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ إِنَّمَا جَاءَ اخْتِلَافُهُمْ أَنَّهُنَّ ثَلَاثَتَهُنَّ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عوْفٍ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ هِيَ أُمُّ حبيبةَ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ هِيَ بَادِيَةٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 814

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: Oh nephew, no one is more knowledgeable about this than me. "If the menstrual cycle begins, let her abandon prayer. And when it ends, let her perform the ritual ablution and pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Oh nephew, no one is more knowledgeable about this than me. "If the menstrual cycle begins, let her abandon prayer. And when it ends, let her perform the ritual ablution and pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا ابْنَ أَخِي مَا بَقِيَ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمُ بِهَذَا مِنِّي «إِذَا أَقْبَلَتِ الْحَيْضَةُ فَلْتَدَعِ الصَّلَاةَ وَإِذَا أَدْبَرَتْ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ وَلْتُصَلِّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e al-Qaʿqāʿ b. Ḥakīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى أَنَّ الْقَعْقَاعَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ سَعِيدًا عَنِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 815

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "And if it flows like this tributary."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "And if it flows like this tributary."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «وَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَسِيلُ مِثْلَ هَذَا الْمَثْعَبِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmmār a freed slave of Banī Hāshim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ «تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ ثُمَّ تَحْتَشِي وَتَسْتَثْفِرُ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي» فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَسِيلُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 816

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "Yes, even if you catch him with ease, enter then seek forgiveness, and then enter."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Yes, even if you catch him with ease, enter then seek forgiveness, and then enter."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَعَمْ وَإِنْ كُنْتِ تَثُجِّينَهُ ثَجًّا اسْتَدْخِلِي ثُمَّ اسْتَثْفِرِي ثُمَّ ادْخُلِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e ʿAmmār b. Abū ʿAmmār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «مِنْ أَشَدِّ النَّاسِ قَوْلًا فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ» ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ بَعْدُ أَتَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ أَدْخُلُ الْكَعْبَةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 817

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "She is waiting to read it, which she used to leave prayer in it before. So when it is the day of her purity, in which she used to purify herself, she washed and then performed ablution for every prayer and prayed."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "She is waiting to read it, which she used to leave prayer in it before. So when it is the day of her purity, in which she used to purify herself, she washed and then performed ablution for every prayer and prayed."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَنْتَظِرُ أَقْرَاءَهَا الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَتْرُكُ فِيهَا الصَّلَاةَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ طُهْرِهَا الَّذِي كَانَتْ تَطْهُرُ فِيهِ اغْتَسَلَتْ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَتْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَصَلَّتْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Muʿtamir \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid \u003e Mujālid \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Qamīr \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Saʾaltuhā \u003e al-Mustaḥāḍah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ قَمِيرَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُهَا عَنِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 818

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "Aisha"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Aisha"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَائِشَةُ ؓ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Muʿtamir \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e a man from Ḥayyih \u003e Abū Jaʿfar Mithl Mā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ حَيِّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 819

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: About Aisha in her menstruation period, she used to wait for her days in which she would leave out prayer. Then, when her purification day arrived, in which she would perform Ghusl (ritual bath), she would wash herself and perform ablution for every prayer and then pray.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Aisha in her menstruation period, she used to wait for her days in which she would leave out prayer. Then, when her purification day arrived, in which she would perform Ghusl (ritual bath), she would wash herself and perform ablution for every prayer and then pray.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ «تَنْتَظِرُ أَيَّامَهَا الَّتِي كَانَتْ تَتْرُكُ الصَّلَاةَ فِيهَا فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ طُهْرِهَا الَّذِي كَانَتْ تَطْهُرُ فِيهِ اغْتَسَلَتْ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَتْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَصَلَّتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Qamīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ قَمِيرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 820

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "A woman experiencing menstruation should refrain from praying for the duration of her period every month. And when her period ends, she should cleanse herself, pray, fast, and perform ablution for each prayer."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "A woman experiencing menstruation should refrain from praying for the duration of her period every month. And when her period ends, she should cleanse herself, pray, fast, and perform ablution for each prayer."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ انْقِضَائِهَا اغْتَسَلَتْ وَصَلَّتْ وَصَامَتْ وَتَوَضَّأَتْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Sharīk \u003e Abū al-Yaqẓān \u003e ʿAdī b. Thābit from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ أَبِي الْيَقْظَانِ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 821

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding menstruation, if a woman knows the days of her period and then gets divorced but the bleeding continues, she should count the length of her period as three menstrual cycles. When it comes to prayer, if the time of menstruation falls within each month, she should refrain from praying.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding menstruation, if a woman knows the days of her period and then gets divorced but the bleeding continues, she should count the length of her period as three menstrual cycles. When it comes to prayer, if the time of menstruation falls within each month, she should refrain from praying.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ «فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ الَّتِي تَعْرِفُ أَيَّامَ حَيْضَتِهَا إِذَا طُلِّقَتْ فَيَطُولُ بِهَا الدَّمُ فَإِنَّهَا تَعْتَدُّ قَدْرَ أَقْرَائِهَا ثَلَاثَ حِيَضٍ وَفِي الصَّلَاةِ إِذَا جَاءَ وَقْتُ الْحَيْضِ فِي كُلِّ شَهْرٍ أَمْسَكَتْ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Kathīr And Ḥafṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ وَحَفْصٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 822

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to Qatadah, "There was a woman whose menstrual period was known, but it increased by five days, or four days, or three days. He (Qatadah) said, 'She should pray.' I asked, 'What about two days?' He (Qatadah) said, 'That is part of her menstrual period.' And I asked Ibn Sireen, and he said, 'Women are more knowledgeable about that.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to Qatadah, "There was a woman whose menstrual period was known, but it increased by five days, or four days, or three days. He (Qatadah) said, 'She should pray.' I asked, 'What about two days?' He (Qatadah) said, 'That is part of her menstrual period.' And I asked Ibn Sireen, and he said, 'Women are more knowledgeable about that.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِقَتَادَةَ امْرَأَةٌ كَانَ حَيْضُهَا مَعْلُومًا فَزَادَتْ عَلَيْهِ خَمْسَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ أَرْبَعَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ قَالَ «تُصَلِّي» قُلْتُ يَوْمَيْنِ؟ قَالَ «ذَلكَ مِنْ حَيْضِهَا» وَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ سِيرِينَ قَالَ النِّسَاءُ أَعْلَمُ بِذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Muʿtamir from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 823

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: About women, you see blood during their pure days. He (meaning Hasan) said: "I see that she should wash herself and pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About women, you see blood during their pure days. He (meaning Hasan) said: "I see that she should wash herself and pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الدَّمَ أَيَّامَ طُهْرِهَا قَالَ «أَرَى أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُصَلِّيَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Muʿtamir from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 824

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: She should wait until the time of her menstruation comes and then she should abstain from prayer. After that, she should purify herself and perform the prayer. When the time of her menstruation comes, she should once again abstain from prayer and then purify herself. Indeed, this is from Satan who wants to cause harm to her.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: She should wait until the time of her menstruation comes and then she should abstain from prayer. After that, she should purify herself and perform the prayer. When the time of her menstruation comes, she should once again abstain from prayer and then purify herself. Indeed, this is from Satan who wants to cause harm to her.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَنْتَظِرُ قَدْرَ مَا كَانَتْ تَحِيضُ فَلْتُحَرِّمِ الصَّلَاةَ ثُمَّ لِتَغْتَسِلْ وَلْتُصَلِّ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ أَوَانُهَا الَّذِي تَحِيضُ فِيهِ فَلْتُحَرِّمِ الصَّلَاةَ ثُمَّ لِتَغْتَسِلْ فَإِنَّمَا ذَاكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُكْفِرَ إِحْدَاهُنَّ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Bahrām \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e Suʾil Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Marʾah Tustaḥāḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَهْرَامَ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ قَالَ سُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تُسْتَحَاضُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 825

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: the Prophet said about the Mustahadah that she should: "Leave the Salat for the days of her period which she menstruates in, then perform Ghusl, and perform Wudu for every Salat, and observe Saum and perform Salat."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Prophet said about the Mustahadah that she should: "Leave the Salat for the days of her period which she menstruates in, then perform Ghusl, and perform Wudu for every Salat, and observe Saum and perform Salat."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ وَتَحْتَشِي كُرْسُفًا وَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAlī Abū Jaʿfar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ أَنبَأَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 826

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "The woman experiencing istihadah sits for the duration of her menstrual bleeding, then she takes a single ritual bath and performs ablution for each prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The woman experiencing istihadah sits for the duration of her menstrual bleeding, then she takes a single ritual bath and performs ablution for each prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَجْلِسُ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا وَتَتَوَضَّأُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Firās \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Qamīr Āmraʾah Masrūq \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ فِرَاسٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ قَمِيرَ امْرَأَةِ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 827

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: As for what saw blood from a sea creature, then do not perform prayer. But when it sees purity, even if just for an hour during the day, then take a bath and perform prayer.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: As for what saw blood from a sea creature, then do not perform prayer. But when it sees purity, even if just for an hour during the day, then take a bath and perform prayer.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَمَّا مَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ الْبَحْرَانِيَّ فَلَا تُصَلِّي فَإِذَا رَأَتِ الطُّهْرَ وَلَوْ سَاعَةً مِنْ نَهَارٍ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ وَلْتُصَلِّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Khālid \u003e Anas b. Sīrīn \u003e Āstuḥīḍat Āmraʾah from Āl Anas Faʾamarūnī Fasaʾalt Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ أَنبَأَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ اسْتُحِيضَتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ آلِ أَنَسٍ فَأَمَرُونِي فَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 828

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "If you see menstrual blood, do not pray. But if you see purity, then cleanse yourself and pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If you see menstrual blood, do not pray. But if you see purity, then cleanse yourself and pray."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ الْبَحْرَانِيَّ فَلَا تُصَلِّي فَإِذَا رَأَتِ الطُّهْرَ فَلْتَغْتَسِلْ وَلْتُصَلِّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Khālid \u003e Anas b. Sīrīn \u003e Kānat Um And Lad Liʾanas b. Mālik Āstuḥīḍat Faʾamarūnī \u003e Astaftī Ibn ʿAbbās Fasaʾaltuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ كَانَتْ أُمُّ وَلَدٍ لِأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ اسْتُحِيضَتْ فَأَمَرُونِي أَنْ أَسْتَفْتِيَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 829

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "If you see foolish blood, then hold on to the days of your readings."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If you see foolish blood, then hold on to the days of your readings."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا رَأَيْتِ دَمًا عَبِيطًا فَأَمْسِكِي أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِكِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Nuṣayr \u003e Qurrah \u003e al-Ḍaḥḥāk \u003e Āmraʾah Saʾalath \u003e Innī Āmraʾah Ustaḥāḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ نُصَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْهُ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي امْرَأَةٌ أُسْتَحَاضُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 830

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: The woman experiencing istihadah sits for the days of her menstrual period, then she performs one washing for both the Dhuhr and Asr prayers. She delays Maghrib and hastens Isha, and this occurs during the time of Isha. For the Fajr prayer, she performs one washing. She does not fast, and her husband does not approach her, and she does not touch the Quran.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The woman experiencing istihadah sits for the days of her menstrual period, then she performs one washing for both the Dhuhr and Asr prayers. She delays Maghrib and hastens Isha, and this occurs during the time of Isha. For the Fajr prayer, she performs one washing. She does not fast, and her husband does not approach her, and she does not touch the Quran.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ «تَجْلِسُ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ لِلظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا وَتُؤَخِّرُ الْمَغْرِبَ وَتُعَجِّلُ الْعِشَاءَ وَذَلِكَ فِي وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ وَلِلْفَجْرِ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا وَلَا تَصُومُ وَلَا يَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا وَلَا تَمَسُّ الْمُصْحَفَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 831

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Abbas used to say about menstruation: "You should perform one washing for both Dhuhr and Asr prayers, and another washing for Maghrib and Isha prayers." He also used to say, "You delay Dhuhr prayer and perform it closer to Asr, and you delay Maghrib prayer and perform it closer to Isha."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Abbas used to say about menstruation: "You should perform one washing for both Dhuhr and Asr prayers, and another washing for Maghrib and Isha prayers." He also used to say, "You delay Dhuhr prayer and perform it closer to Asr, and you delay Maghrib prayer and perform it closer to Isha."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ تَغْتَسِلُ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا لِلظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَغُسْلًا لِلْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ تُؤَخِّرُ الظُّهْرَ وَتُعَجِّلُ الْعَصْرَ وَتُؤَخِّرُ الْمَغْرِبَ وَتُعَجِّلُ الْعِشَاءَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Rufayʿ \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 832

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "About a woman who experiences irregular bleeding during her menstrual period, when her period ends, she should perform a complete ablution (wudu) when it is time for Asr prayer. Then she should take a cloth and seek forgiveness with it. After that, she should pray both Dhuhr and Asr prayers together. Then she should do the same and pray Maghrib and Isha prayers together. Finally, she should do the same and pray Fajr prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "About a woman who experiences irregular bleeding during her menstrual period, when her period ends, she should perform a complete ablution (wudu) when it is time for Asr prayer. Then she should take a cloth and seek forgiveness with it. After that, she should pray both Dhuhr and Asr prayers together. Then she should do the same and pray Maghrib and Isha prayers together. Finally, she should do the same and pray Fajr prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ «إِذَا خَلَفَتْ قُرُوءَهَا فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الْعَصْرِ تَوَضَّأَتْ وُضُوءًا سَابِغًا ثُمَّ لِتَأْخُذْ ثَوْبًا فَلْتَسْتَثْفِرْ بِهِ ثُمَّ لِتُصَلِّ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لِتَفْعَلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ لِتُصَلِّ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ لِتَفْعَلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ لِتُصَلِّ الصُّبْحَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 833

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ata, Sa'id, and 'Ikrimah, they said regarding the woman in a state of postnatal bleeding, "She performs ablution every day for the Fajr and 'Asr prayers and prays them. Then she performs ablution for Maghrib and Isha prayers and prays them. And she performs ablution for the morning prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ata, Sa'id, and 'Ikrimah, they said regarding the woman in a state of postnatal bleeding, "She performs ablution every day for the Fajr and 'Asr prayers and prays them. Then she performs ablution for Maghrib and Isha prayers and prays them. And she performs ablution for the morning prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَسَعِيدٍ وَعِكْرِمَةَ قَالُوا فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ «تَغْتَسِلُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ لِصَلَاةِ الْأُولَى وَالْعَصْرِ فَتُصَلِّيهِمَا وَتَغْتَسِلُ لِلْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ فَتُصَلِّيهِمَا وَتَغْتَسِلُ لِصَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 834

chapter.englishTitle: In the washing of the menstruating woman

hadiths.englishRaw: "The woman experiencing istihadah (irregular uterine bleeding) washes herself, then she combines (her prayers) between Dhuhr and Asr. If she sees anything (of blood), she washes (again) and combines (her prayers) between Maghrib and Isha."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The woman experiencing istihadah (irregular uterine bleeding) washes herself, then she combines (her prayers) between Dhuhr and Asr. If she sees anything (of blood), she washes (again) and combines (her prayers) between Maghrib and Isha."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَغْتَسِلُ ثُمَّ تَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ فَإِنْ رَأَتْ شَيْئًا اغْتَسَلَتْ وَجَمَعَتْ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Abū Zubayd \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Shaddād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 835

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، وَتُجَامِعُ وَتَصُومُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said, 'She can perform ablution from Dhuhr to Dhuhr, have se...

hadiths.englishRaw: "She sits and recites her days, and she washes herself from noon till noon, and she seeks forgiveness in a gown and her husband comes to her, and she fasts." So I said, "Who is this?" He took pebbles."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "She sits and recites her days, and she washes herself from noon till noon, and she seeks forgiveness in a gown and her husband comes to her, and she fasts." So I said, "Who is this?" He took pebbles."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَجْلِسُ أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا وَتَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ وَتَسْتَذْفِرُ بِثَوْبٍ وَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا وَتَصُومُ» فَقُلْتُ عَمَّنْ هَذَا؟ «فَأَخَذَ الْحَصَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Sumay \u003e Saʾalt Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e al-Mustaḥāḍah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سُمَيٍّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 836

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، وَتُجَامِعُ وَتَصُومُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said, 'She can perform ablution from Dhuhr to Dhuhr, have se...

hadiths.englishRaw: "She washes from noon to noon and performs ablution for every prayer. If the blood overcomes her, she seeks forgiveness." And Al-Hasan used to say that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "She washes from noon to noon and performs ablution for every prayer. If the blood overcomes her, she seeks forgiveness." And Al-Hasan used to say that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ ظُهْرٍ إِلَى ظُهْرٍ وَتَتَوَضَّأُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ فَإِنْ غَلَبَهَا الدَّمُ اسْتَثْفَرَتْ» وَكَانَ الْحَسَنُ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 837

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، وَتُجَامِعُ وَتَصُومُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said, 'She can perform ablution from Dhuhr to Dhuhr, have se...

hadiths.englishRaw: Sa'id (a boy's name) "she washes herself from noon until the same time tomorrow for the Dhuhr prayer. If menstruation overcomes her, she seeks forgiveness and performs ablution for every prayer and prays."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Sa'id (a boy's name) "she washes herself from noon until the same time tomorrow for the Dhuhr prayer. If menstruation overcomes her, she seeks forgiveness and performs ablution for every prayer and prays."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَعِيدٌ «تَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى مِثْلِهَا مِنَ الْغَدِ لِصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ فَإِنْ غَلَبَهَا الدَّمُ اسْتَثْفَرَتْ وَتَوَضَّأَتْ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَصَلَّتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Sumay a freed slave of Abū Bakr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Ḥārith b. Hishām \u003e al-Qaʿqāʿ b. Ḥakīm And Zayd b. Aslam Arsalāh \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib Yasʾaluh Kayf Taghtasil al-Mustaḥāḍah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى أَنَّ سُمَيًّا مَوْلَى أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْقَعْقَاعَ بْنَ حَكِيمٍ وَزَيْدَ بْنَ أَسْلَمَ أَرْسَلَاهُ إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ يَسْأَلُهُ كَيْفَ تَغْتَسِلُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 838

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، وَتُجَامِعُ وَتَصُومُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said, 'She can perform ablution from Dhuhr to Dhuhr, have se...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding menstruating women, it is stated by Al-Hasan that "She should perform ablution (cleaning) from the time of Dhuhr prayer until the Dhuhr prayer of the next day."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding menstruating women, it is stated by Al-Hasan that "She should perform ablution (cleaning) from the time of Dhuhr prayer until the Dhuhr prayer of the next day."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ «تَغْتَسِلُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ مِنَ الْغَدِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Muʿtamir from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 839

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ، وَتُجَامِعُ وَتَصُومُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said, 'She can perform ablution from Dhuhr to Dhuhr, have se...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The woman experiencing menstruation abstains from prayer during her menstrual days of the month, then she performs ghusl (major ablution) from noon to noon. She also performs wudu (ablution) before every prayer and she fasts, prays, and her husband comes to her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The woman experiencing menstruation abstains from prayer during her menstrual days of the month, then she performs ghusl (major ablution) from noon to noon. She also performs wudu (ablution) before every prayer and she fasts, prays, and her husband comes to her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا مِنَ الشَّهْرِ ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ وَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَتَصُومُ وَتُصَلِّي وَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding prayer during menstruation, if a woman becomes clean before the seventh day, then she may perform the prayer, otherwise, she should refrain from praying until she becomes clean. However, if she becomes clean before the tenth day, then she may perform the prayer. If not, she should wash herself, perform ablution, and then pray while in a state of istihadah (minor ritual impurity).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding prayer during menstruation, if a woman becomes clean before the seventh day, then she may perform the prayer, otherwise, she should refrain from praying until she becomes clean. However, if she becomes clean before the tenth day, then she may perform the prayer. If not, she should wash herself, perform ablution, and then pray while in a state of istihadah (minor ritual impurity).   – Sound Chain

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 863

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْثَرِ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Menses is until thirteen, and if it exceeds that, then it is istihadah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Menses is until thirteen, and if it exceeds that, then it is istihadah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْحَيْضُ إِلَى ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ فَمَا زَادَ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAlī b. Thābit \u003e Muḥammad b. Zayd \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 864

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْثَرِ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The menstruation lasts for ten days, then she is considered clean."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The menstruation lasts for ten days, then she is considered clean."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْحَيْضُ عَشْرَةُ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ هِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e al-Jald b. Ayyūb \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Qurrah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنِ الْجَلْدِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 865

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْثَرِ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The menstrual period lasts up to thirteen days, anything beyond that is considered istihadah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The menstrual period lasts up to thirteen days, anything beyond that is considered istihadah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْحَيْضُ إِلَى ثَلَاثَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْمًا فَمَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAlī b. Thābit \u003e Muḥammad b. Zayd \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 866

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْثَرِ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding prayer, one's menstruation period is counted as either one day or two days, and after that, she is considered to be in a state of istihaadah (bleeding outside the menstrual period).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding prayer, one's menstruation period is counted as either one day or two days, and after that, she is considered to be in a state of istihaadah (bleeding outside the menstrual period).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ تَعُدُّ أَيَّامَ حَيْضِهَا يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ ثُمَّ هِيَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Idhā Raʾat al-Dam Faʾinnahā Tumsik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ «إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ فَإِنَّهَا تُمْسِكُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 867

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْثَرِ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The woman who is experiencing Istihadah waits for three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The woman who is experiencing Istihadah waits for three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَنْتَظِرُ ثَلَاثًا أَرْبَعًا خَمْسًا سِتًّا سَبْعًا ثَمَانِيًا تِسْعًا عَشْرًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e al-Jald b. Ayyūb \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Qurrah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنِ الْجَلْدِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 868

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْثَرِ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the menstruating woman awaits the end of her period by only a day."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "That the menstruating woman awaits the end of her period by only a day."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةَ تَنْتَظِرُ أَعْلَى أَقْرَائِهَا بِيَوْمٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Balaghanā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ بَلَغَنَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 869

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْثَرِ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: Anas ibn Malik heard saying, "What exceeds ten is excessive."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Anas ibn Malik heard saying, "What exceeds ten is excessive."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يَقُولُ «مَا زَادَ عَلَى الْعَشْرَةِ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e al-Rabīʿ b. Ṣabīḥ \u003e Man \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ صَبِيحٍ عَنْ مَنْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 870

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْثَرِ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the majority of menstruation?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The maximum limit of menstruation is fifteen days."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The maximum limit of menstruation is fifteen days."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَقْصَى الْحَيْضِ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs \u003e Mufaḍḍal b. Muhalhal \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُفَضَّلِ بْنِ مُهَلْهَلٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 871

chapter.englishTitle: In the shortest duration

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "The minimum duration of menstruation is three days." Abd Allah Al-Dārimī was asked if he agrees with this, to which he replied, "Yes, if that's her usual habit." I also asked him about this, and he said, "The shortest duration of menstruation is one day and night, and the longest is fifteen days."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "The minimum duration of menstruation is three days." Abd Allah Al-Dārimī was asked if he agrees with this, to which he replied, "Yes, if that's her usual habit." I also asked him about this, and he said, "The shortest duration of menstruation is one day and night, and the longest is fifteen days."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «أَدْنَى الْحَيْضِ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ» سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الدَّارِمِيُّ تَأْخُذُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا كَانَ عَادَتَهَا» وَسَأَلْتُهُ أَيْضًا عَنْ هَذَا؟ قَالَ «أَقَلُّ الْحَيْضِ يَوْمٌ وَلَيْلَةٌ وَأَكْثَرُهُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān Balaghanī \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ قَالَ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ بَلَغَنِي عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 872

chapter.englishTitle: In the shortest duration

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abu Muhammad is Abu Saad As-Saghani, reporting from Sufyan, who heard from Ar-Rabi' who said, 'The minimum duration of menstruation is three [days].'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Abu Muhammad is Abu Saad As-Saghani, reporting from Sufyan, who heard from Ar-Rabi' who said, 'The minimum duration of menstruation is three [days].'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ هُوَ أَبُو سَعْدٍ الصَّاغَانِيُّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ «أَدْنَى الْحَيْضِ ثَلَاثٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Muḥammad b. Abū Zakariyyā \u003e Abū Muḥammad \u003e Abū Saʿd al-Ṣāghānī \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Rabīʿ \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 873

chapter.englishTitle: In the shortest duration

hadiths.englishRaw: "The minimum menstruation is one day."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The minimum menstruation is one day."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَدْنَى الْحَيْضِ يَوْمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Makhlad b. Yazīd \u003e Maʿqil b. ʿUbaydullāh \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 874

chapter.englishTitle: In the shortest duration

hadiths.englishRaw: "If she sees blood before her menstruation for a day or two, then it is considered part of her menstruation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If she sees blood before her menstruation for a day or two, then it is considered part of her menstruation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ قَبْلَ حَيْضِهَا يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَهُوَ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 875

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْبِكْرِ يَسْتَمِرُّ بِهَا الدَّمُ
chapter.englishTitle: In Al-Bakr, the blood continues with it.

hadiths.englishRaw: About the issue of menstruation, they said concerning the pre-dawn prayer when one menstruates, she must perform ritual bathing and they said, "Abstain from prayer just as a woman abstains from intimate relations with her husband."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the issue of menstruation, they said concerning the pre-dawn prayer when one menstruates, she must perform ritual bathing and they said, "Abstain from prayer just as a woman abstains from intimate relations with her husband."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي الْبِكْرِ إِذَا نَفِسَتْ فَاسْتُحِيضَتْ قَالَا «تُمْسِكُ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ مِثْلَ مَا تُمْسِكُ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ نِسَائِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Qatādah And Qays b. Saʿd \u003e ʿAṭāʾ Annahumā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ وَقَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 876

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْبِكْرِ يَسْتَمِرُّ بِهَا الدَّمُ
chapter.englishTitle: In Al-Bakr, the blood continues with it.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Sufyan said, 'When a woman first starts her period, she sits during the period similar to how other women do.' Abdullah was asked about this, and he said, 'It is one of the most similar things.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Sufyan said, 'When a woman first starts her period, she sits during the period similar to how other women do.' Abdullah was asked about this, and he said, 'It is one of the most similar things.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُفْيَانُ «إِذَا كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ أَوَّلَ مَا تَحِيضُ تَجْلِسُ فِي الْحَيْضِ مِنْ نَحْوِ نِسَائِهَا» سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ هَذَا فَقَالَ هُوَ أَشْبَهُ الْأَشْيَاءِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 877

chapter.englishTitle: In the big one, you see blood.

hadiths.englishRaw: We don't see it menstruating.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: We don't see it menstruating.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَا نَرَاهُ حَيْضًا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْكَبِيرَةِ تَرَى الدَّمَ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 878

chapter.englishTitle: In the big one, you see blood.

hadiths.englishRaw: About the issue of Ata regarding a woman who had stopped menstruating for thirty years and then saw blood, so he instructed her in matters related to being in a state of menstruation.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About the issue of Ata regarding a woman who had stopped menstruating for thirty years and then saw blood, so he instructed her in matters related to being in a state of menstruation.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي «امْرَأَةٍ تَرَكَهَا الْحَيْضُ ثَلَاثِينَ سَنَةً ثُمَّ رَأَتِ الدَّمَ فَأَمَرَ فِيهَا بِشَأْنِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak Akhbaranīh Ibn Jurayj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَخْبَرَنِيهِ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 879

chapter.englishTitle: In the big one, you see blood.

hadiths.englishRaw: "She is in the position of an adult woman who is menstruating, doing as a menstruating woman does."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "She is in the position of an adult woman who is menstruating, doing as a menstruating woman does."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ تَفْعَلُ كَمَا تَفْعَلُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Jurayj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْكَبِيرَةِ تَرَى الدَّمَ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 880

chapter.englishTitle: In the big one, you see blood.

hadiths.englishRaw: Perform ablution, pray, and if divorced, observe the waiting period.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Perform ablution, pray, and if divorced, observe the waiting period.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: تَوَضَّأُ وَتُصَلِّي وَإِذَا طُلِّقَتْ تَعْتَدُّ بِالْأَشْهُرِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ḥajjāj
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَالْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ فِي «الَّتِي قَعَدَتْ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ وَلَا تَغْتَسِلُ» سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْكَبِيرَةِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 881

chapter.englishTitle: In the least purity

hadiths.englishRaw: Sufyan said, "Purity is fifty fifteen."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Sufyan said, "Purity is fifty fifteen."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُفْيَانُ «الطُّهْرُ خَمْسُ عَشْرَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 882

chapter.englishTitle: In the least purity

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a woman has her period for a month or forty nights, then three menstrual cycles, and reliable witnesses among women testify that she has seen what prohibits her from praying, which is the menstrual impurity that is known as menstruation, then her waiting period is complete. Abu Muhammad said, "I heard Yazid ibn Harun say, 'I prefer purity for fifteen days.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a woman has her period for a month or forty nights, then three menstrual cycles, and reliable witnesses among women testify that she has seen what prohibits her from praying, which is the menstrual impurity that is known as menstruation, then her waiting period is complete. Abu Muhammad said, "I heard Yazid ibn Harun say, 'I prefer purity for fifteen days.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِذَا حَاضَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي شَهْرٍ أَوْ فِي أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً ثَلَاثَ حِيَضٍ قَالَ فَإِذَا شَهِدَ لَهَا الشُّهُودُ الْعُدُولُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ أَنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَا يُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهَا الصَّلَاةَ مِنْ طُمُوثِ النِّسَاءِ الَّذِي هُوَ الطَّمْثُ الْمَعْرُوفُ فَقَدْ خَلَا أَجَلُهَا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ سَمِعْتُ يَزِيدَ بْنَ هَارُونَ يَقُولُ أَسْتَحِبُّ الطُّهْرَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 883

chapter.englishTitle: In the least purity

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman came to Ali arguing with her husband, so he divorced her. She said, "I have had three menstrual cycles in one month." Ali said to Shurayh, "Judge between them." Shurayh asked, "O Commander of the Faithful, are you here?" Ali replied, "Judge between them." Shurayh asked again, "O Commander of the Faithful, are you here?" Ali replied, "Judge between them." Then he said, "If she comes from a trustworthy family member who is known for his religion and honesty and claims that she had three menstrual cycles and she purifies herself after each cycle and offers prayers, then it is permissible for her. Otherwise, no." Ali said, "They said and they said in the language of the Romans, 'Well done.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman came to Ali arguing with her husband, so he divorced her. She said, "I have had three menstrual cycles in one month." Ali said to Shurayh, "Judge between them." Shurayh asked, "O Commander of the Faithful, are you here?" Ali replied, "Judge between them." Shurayh asked again, "O Commander of the Faithful, are you here?" Ali replied, "Judge between them." Then he said, "If she comes from a trustworthy family member who is known for his religion and honesty and claims that she had three menstrual cycles and she purifies herself after each cycle and offers prayers, then it is permissible for her. Otherwise, no." Ali said, "They said and they said in the language of the Romans, 'Well done.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ تُخَاصِمُ زَوْجَهَا طَلَّقَهَا فَقَالَتْ قَدْ حِضْتُ فِي شَهْرٍ ثَلَاثَ حِيَضٍ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ لِشُرَيْحٍ «اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا» قَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَنْتَ هَاهُنَا؟ قَالَ «اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا» قَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَنْتَ هَاهُنَا؟ قَالَ «اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا» فَقَالَ إِنْ جَاءَتْ مِنْ بِطَانَةِ أَهْلِهَا مِمَّنْ يُرْضَى دِينُهُ وَأَمَانَتُهُ تَزْعُمُ أَنَّهَا حَاضَتْ ثَلَاثَ حِيَضٍ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ قُرْءٍ وَتُصَلِّي جَازَ لَهَا وَإِلَّا فَلَا فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ قَالُونُ وَقَالُونُ بِلِسَانِ الرُّومِ أَحْسَنْتَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Jāʾat Āmraʾah \u003e ʿAlī Tukhāṣim Zawjahā Ṭallaqahā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 884

chapter.englishTitle: In the least purity

hadiths.englishRaw: "To conceal what Allah has created in their wombs" [Al-Baqarah 228]. It was said to Abu Muhammad, "Do you talk about this?" He said, "No." Abd Allah was asked about the narration of Shuraih, and she said, "No." And he said, "There are three menstrual periods in a month, how can that be?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To conceal what Allah has created in their wombs" [Al-Baqarah 228]. It was said to Abu Muhammad, "Do you talk about this?" He said, "No." Abd Allah was asked about the narration of Shuraih, and she said, "No." And he said, "There are three menstrual periods in a month, how can that be?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَكْتُمْنَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِي أَرْحَامِهِنَّ} [البقرة 228] قَالَ «الْحَيْضُ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ أَتَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ لَا وَسُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ حَدِيثِ شُرَيْحٍ تَقُولُ بِهِ قَالَ لَا وَقَالَ ثَلَاثُ حِيَضٍ فِي الشَّهْرِ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ؟   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e ʿIkrimah And Lā Yaḥil Lahun
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ {وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَهُنَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 885

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: To look at the blood at night during menstruation and say that it could be yellowness or darkness.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: To look at the blood at night during menstruation and say that it could be yellowness or darkness.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَنْظُرْنَ لَيْلًا فِي الْمَحِيضِ وَتَقُولُ إِنَّهُ قَدْ يَكُونُ الصُّفْرَةَ وَالْكُدْرَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿAmrah \u003e Kānat ʿĀʾishah Tanhá al-Nisāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ قَالَتْ كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ تَنْهَى النِّسَاءَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 886

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not wash until the cotton comes out white."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not wash until the cotton comes out white."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ لَا يَغْتَسِلْنَ حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ الْقُطْنَةُ بَيْضَاءَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Mawlāh ʿAmrah \u003e Kānat ʿAmrah Taʾmur al-Nisāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مَوْلَاةِ عَمْرَةَ قَالَتْ كَانَتْ عَمْرَةُ «تَأْمُرُ النِّسَاءَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 887

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: Sufyan said, "Black and yellow discharge during menstruation is considered menstruation. If a woman sees any blood, black discharge, or yellow discharge after her menstruation days, then she has to perform istihadah." Abdullah was asked if he follows Sufyan's opinion, and he replied, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Sufyan said, "Black and yellow discharge during menstruation is considered menstruation. If a woman sees any blood, black discharge, or yellow discharge after her menstruation days, then she has to perform istihadah." Abdullah was asked if he follows Sufyan's opinion, and he replied, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُفْيَانُ «الْكُدْرَةُ وَالصُّفْرَةُ فِي أَيَّامِ الْحَيْضِ حَيْضٌ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ رَأَتْهُ بَعْدَ أَيَّامِ الْحَيْضِ مِنْ دَمٍ أَوْ كُدْرَةٍ أَوْ صُفْرَةٍ فَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ» سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ تَأْخُذُ بِقَوْلِ سُفْيَانَ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 888

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: About his wife Fatima bint Muhammad, she was in the hut of Umrah. She said, "A woman from Quraysh sent to Umrah a camel with a piece of cotton in it, resembling a yellowish color, asking her, 'Do you see if a woman does not see anything of blood except for this, that she has become pure?' She said, 'No, not until she sees pure white.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About his wife Fatima bint Muhammad, she was in the hut of Umrah. She said, "A woman from Quraysh sent to Umrah a camel with a piece of cotton in it, resembling a yellowish color, asking her, 'Do you see if a woman does not see anything of blood except for this, that she has become pure?' She said, 'No, not until she sees pure white.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ صَاحِبَتِهِ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَكَانَتْ فِي حِجْرِ عَمْرَةَ قَالَتْ أَرْسَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ إِلَى عَمْرَةَ بِكُرْسُفَةِ قُطْنٍ فِيهَا كَالصُّفْرَةِ تَسْأَلُهَا هَلْ تَرَى إِذَا لَمْ تَرَ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الْحِيضَةِ إِلَّا هَذَا أَنْ قَدْ طَهُرَتْ؟ فَقَالَتْ «لَا حَتَّى تَرَى الْبَيَاضَ خَالِصًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 889

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: We used to be in her room, and one of us would menstruate, then become purified, and wash herself and pray, then she would have a slight yellow discharge. She would command us to refrain from prayers until we could only see pure whiteness.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We used to be in her room, and one of us would menstruate, then become purified, and wash herself and pray, then she would have a slight yellow discharge. She would command us to refrain from prayers until we could only see pure whiteness.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا نَكُونُ فِي حِجْرِهَا فَكَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ ثُمَّ تَطْهُرُ فَتَغْتَسِلُ وَتُصَلِّي ثُمَّ تَنْكُسُهَا الصُّفْرَةُ الْيَسِيرَةُ «فَتَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نَعْتَزِلَ الصَّلَاةَ حَتَّى لَا نَرَى إِلَّا الْبَيَاضَ خَالِصًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Fāṭimah \u003e Asmāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 890

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Al-Kudrah and as-Sufrat are considered equivalent to menstruation periods."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Al-Kudrah and as-Sufrat are considered equivalent to menstruation periods."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْكُدْرَةُ وَالصُّفْرَةُ فِي أَيَّامِ الْحَيْضِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْحَيْضِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 891

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the prayer until you see the purity, white like the stalk, then wash and pray."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "From the prayer until you see the purity, white like the stalk, then wash and pray."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ حَتَّى تَرَى الطُّهْرَ أَبْيَضَ كَالْقَصَّةِ ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلْ وَتُصَلِّي»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Zayd b. Yaḥyá b. ʿUbayd al-Dimashqī \u003e Muḥammad b. Rāshid \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Rabāḥ \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Idhā Raʾat al-Dam Faltumsik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ فَلْتُمْسِكْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 892

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: Al-Hasan used to consider neither yellow nor black, nor anything resembling a meat grinder as anything meaningful.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Al-Hasan used to consider neither yellow nor black, nor anything resembling a meat grinder as anything meaningful.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ الْحَسَنُ «لَا يَعُدُّ الصُّفْرَةَ وَالْكُدْرَةَ وَلَا مِثْلَ غُسَالَةِ اللَّحْمِ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 893

chapter.englishTitle: How is purity?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umm 'Atiyah said: 'We used not to regard yellowish and brownish discharge as anything important.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Umm 'Atiyah said: 'We used not to regard yellowish and brownish discharge as anything important.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا لَا نَعُدُّ الصُّفْرَةَ وَالْكُدْرَةَ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Um ʿAṭiyyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 894

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding women, you may see blood during her clean days. He said, "I believe she should take a bath and perform prayers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding women, you may see blood during her clean days. He said, "I believe she should take a bath and perform prayers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الدَّمَ فِي أَيَّامِ طُهْرِهَا قَالَ أَرَى أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُصَلِّيَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Muʿtamir from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 895

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Sirin said, "They did not consider seeing black or yellow to be a problem."
hadiths.body: Ibn Sirin said, "They did not consider seeing black or yellow to be a problem."
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ ابْنُ سِيرينَ «لمْ يَكُونُوا يَرَوْنَ بِالْكُدْرَةِ وَالصُّفْرَةِ بَأْسًا»

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 896

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: That person washes, purifies, and prays.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: That person washes, purifies, and prays.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: تِلْكَ التَّرِيَّةُ تَغْسِلُهُ وَتَوَضَّأُ وَتُصَلِّي   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الصُّفْرَةَ بَعْدَ الطُّهْرِ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 897

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: "In Tarriyah, there is nothing after washing except purity." Abdullah said, "Tarriyah includes yellow and black impurities."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "In Tarriyah, there is nothing after washing except purity." Abdullah said, "Tarriyah includes yellow and black impurities."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَيْسَ فِي التَّرِيَّةِ شَيْءٌ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ إِلَّا الطُّهُورُ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ التَّرِيَّةُ الصُّفْرَةُ وَالْكُدْرَةُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym And Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Yūnus Waḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ وَحَجَّاجٌ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ يُونُسَ وَحُمَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 898

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: He said: "If a woman sees the white discharge after completing her ritual bath, one or two days later, then she is deemed pure and can perform her prayers."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He said: "If a woman sees the white discharge after completing her ritual bath, one or two days later, then she is deemed pure and can perform her prayers."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «إِذَا رَأَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ التَّرِيَّةَ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ بِيَوْمٍ أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَإِنَّهَا تَطَهَّرُ وَتُصَلِّي»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj And ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād \u003e al-Ḥajjāj \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ وَعَفَّانُ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 899

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is nothing in Tarteeah after performing ablution except purity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "There is nothing in Tarteeah after performing ablution except purity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَيْسَ فِي التَّرِيَّةِ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ إِلَّا الطُّهُورُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Qays \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ قَيْسٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 900

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: We would not take into consideration brown and yellow (fluid) after purification.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We would not take into consideration brown and yellow (fluid) after purification.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ وَكَانَتْ قَدْ بَايَعَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «كُنَّا لَا نَعْتَدُّ بِالْكُدْرَةِ وَالصُّفْرَةِ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Qatādah \u003e Um al-Hudhayl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ الْهُذَيْلِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 901

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a menstruating woman sees excessive bleeding after performing ritual ablution for one or two days, then she should refrain from offering prayers for a day. After that, she is considered to be with irregular bleeding (istihada)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a menstruating woman sees excessive bleeding after performing ritual ablution for one or two days, then she should refrain from offering prayers for a day. After that, she is considered to be with irregular bleeding (istihada)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا رَأَتِ الْحَائِضُ دَمًا عَبِيطًا بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ بِيَوْمٍ أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَإِنَّهَا تُمْسِكُ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ يَوْمًا ثُمَّ هِيَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 902

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a woman has purified herself from menstruation and then she sees something after purification that makes her doubt, then it is only a transient discharge from Satan in the womb. So if she sees something like a nosebleed, a drop of blood, or a piece of flesh, she should perform ablution for prayer and then pray. But if the blood is excessive and cannot be hidden, then she should refrain from praying."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "If a woman has purified herself from menstruation and then she sees something after purification that makes her doubt, then it is only a transient discharge from Satan in the womb. So if she sees something like a nosebleed, a drop of blood, or a piece of flesh, she should perform ablution for prayer and then pray. But if the blood is excessive and cannot be hidden, then she should refrain from praying."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا تَطَهَّرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ ثُمَّ رَأَتْ بَعْدَ الطُّهْرِ مَا يَرِيبُهَا فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ رَكْضَةٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فِي الرَّحِمِ فَإِذَا رَأَتْ مِثْلَ الرُّعَافِ أَوْ قَطْرَةِ الدَّمِ أَوْ غُسَالَةِ اللَّحْمِ تَوَضَّأَتْ وُضُوءَهَا لِلصَّلَاةِ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي فَإِنْ كَانَ الدَمُ عَبِيطًا الَّذِي لَا خَفَاءَ بِهِ فَلْتَدَعِ الصَّلَاةَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 903

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding women, their menstrual period lasts six or seven days, then they may see brown or yellow discharge, or they may see a drop or two of blood. If this occurs, it does not invalidate their prayers and they are not harmed by it.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding women, their menstrual period lasts six or seven days, then they may see brown or yellow discharge, or they may see a drop or two of blood. If this occurs, it does not invalidate their prayers and they are not harmed by it.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ فِي «الْمَرْأَةِ يَكُونُ حَيْضُهَا سِتَّةَ أَيَّامٍ أَوْ سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ تَرَى كُدْرَةً أَوْ صُفْرَةً أَوْ تَرَى الْقَطْرَةَ أَوِ الْقَطْرَتَيْنِ مِنَ الدَّمِ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَاطِلٌ وَلَا يَضُرُّهَا شَيْءٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sharīk \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 904

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd
