hadiths.englishRaw: About a woman who cleanses herself from menstruation and then sees yellow discharge, he said, "Perform ablution and purify yourself."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About a woman who cleanses herself from menstruation and then sees yellow discharge, he said, "Perform ablution and purify yourself."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْمَرْأَةِ تَغْتَسِلُ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ ثُمَّ تَرَى الصُّفْرَةَ قَالَ تَوَضَّأُ وَتَنْضَحُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm \u003e Saʾalt ʿAṭāʾ \u003e al-Marʾah Taghtasil from al-Ḥayḍ Thum Tará al-Ṣufrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَطَاءً

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 905

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: She delays the prayer in its appointed time for a day or two, and then she performs ablution. If she still sees bleeding during the first prayer time, she looks again. If it is light bleeding, she performs ablution and prays. If it is still heavy bleeding, she delays the Zuhr prayer and hastens the Asr prayer, and then performs them both with one ablution. When the sun sets, she looks again. If she still sees bleeding, she performs ablution and prays. If it is still heavy bleeding, she delays the Maghrib prayer and hastens the Isha prayer, and then performs them both with one ablution. When dawn breaks, she looks again. If she still sees bleeding, she performs ablution and prays. If it is still heavy bleeding, she performs complete washing and prays the Fajr prayer. She repeats this process three times every day and night. Abu Muhammad Al-Aqra'i said: According to me, the menstrual period is considered in this case.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: She delays the prayer in its appointed time for a day or two, and then she performs ablution. If she still sees bleeding during the first prayer time, she looks again. If it is light bleeding, she performs ablution and prays. If it is still heavy bleeding, she delays the Zuhr prayer and hastens the Asr prayer, and then performs them both with one ablution. When the sun sets, she looks again. If she still sees bleeding, she performs ablution and prays. If it is still heavy bleeding, she delays the Maghrib prayer and hastens the Isha prayer, and then performs them both with one ablution. When dawn breaks, she looks again. If she still sees bleeding, she performs ablution and prays. If it is still heavy bleeding, she performs complete washing and prays the Fajr prayer. She repeats this process three times every day and night. Abu Muhammad Al-Aqra'i said: According to me, the menstrual period is considered in this case.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ فِي قُرُوئِهَا ذَلِكَ يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ ثُمَّ تَغْتَسِلُ فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الْأُولَى نَظَرَتْ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَرِيَّةً تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ وَإِنْ كَانَ دَمًا أَخَّرَتِ الظُّهْرَ وَعَجَّلَتِ الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ صَلَّتْهُمَا بِغُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ فَإِذَا غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ نَظَرَتْ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَرِيَّةً تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ وَإِنْ كَانَ دَمًا أَخَّرَتِ الْمَغْرِبَ وَعَجَّلَتِ الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ صَلَّتْهُمَا بِغُسْلٍ وَاحِدٍ فَإِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ نَظَرَتْ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ تَرِيَّةً تَوَضَّأَتْ وَصَلَّتْ وَإِنْ كَانَ دَمًا اغْتَسَلَتْ وَصَلَّتِ الْغَدَاةَ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَقْرَاءُ عِنْدِي الْحَيْضُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 906

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: Once one of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ did Iʿtikaf along with him and she was getting bleeding in between her periods. She used to see the blood (from her private parts) and she would perhaps put a dish under her for the blood. (The sub-narrator ʿIkrima added, ʿAisha once saw the liquid of safflower and said, "It looks like what so and so used to have.")    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Once one of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ did Iʿtikaf along with him and she was getting bleeding in between her periods. She used to see the blood (from her private parts) and she would perhaps put a dish under her for the blood. (The sub-narrator ʿIkrima added, ʿAisha once saw the liquid of safflower and said, "It looks like what so and so used to have.")    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «اعْتَكَفَ وَاعْتَكَفَ مَعَهُ بَعْضُ نِسَائِهِ وَهِيَ مُسْتَحَاضَةٌ تَرَى الدَّمَ» فَرُبَّمَا وَضَعَتِ الطَّسْتَ تَحْتَهَا مِنَ الدَّمِ وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ رَأَتْ مَاءَ الْعُصْفُرِ فَقَالَتْ كَانَ هَذَا شَيْئًا كَانَتْ فُلَانَةُ تَجِدُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Yaḥyá \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 907

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding a woman who becomes clean from her period and then sees yellow discharge, he said, "Perform ablution."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding a woman who becomes clean from her period and then sees yellow discharge, he said, "Perform ablution."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ ثُمَّ تَرَى الصُّفْرَةَ قَالَ «تَوَضَّأُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid \u003e al-Ḥajjāj \u003e Saʾalt ʿAṭāʾ \u003e al-Marʾah Taṭhur from al-Maḥīḍ Thum Tará al-Ṣufrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَطَاءً

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 908

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْكُدْرَةِ إِذَا كَانَتْ بَعْدَ الْحَيْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Istihadah when it occurs after Hayd

hadiths.englishRaw: Concerning women, her menstruation used to last for seven days, but her menstruation increased. He said, "She will observe purification for three days."
hadiths.body: Concerning women, her menstruation used to last for seven days, but her menstruation increased. He said, "She will observe purification for three days."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ كَانَ حَيْضُهَا سَبْعَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَزَادَتْ حَيْضَتُهَا قَالَ «تَسْتَظْهِرُ بِثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Muḥammad \u003e Zayd b. Yaḥyá \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Anas \u003e Saʾaltuh
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَالِكٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَنَسٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 909

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a woman becomes pure during the time of prayer, but does not perform ablution (washing) even though she is capable of doing so, then she must make up that prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a woman becomes pure during the time of prayer, but does not perform ablution (washing) even though she is capable of doing so, then she must make up that prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا طَهُرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ فَلَمْ تَغْتَسِلْ وَهِيَ قَادِرَةٌ عَلَى أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ قَضَتْ تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbbād b. ʿAwwām \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَوَّامٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 910

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a woman prays two units of prayer (rak'ahs) and then experiences menstruation, she should not complete them when she becomes pure."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a woman prays two units of prayer (rak'ahs) and then experiences menstruation, she should not complete them when she becomes pure."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا صَلَّتِ الْمَرْأَةُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ حَاضَتْ فَلَا تَقْضِي إِذَا طَهُرَتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e ʿAmr \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 911

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Qatadah, he said."
hadiths.body: "About Qatadah, he said."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e al-Maʿmarī Abū Sufyān Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Maʿmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا الْمَعْمَرِيُّ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 912

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Regarding the matter of a woman's impurity, it is purified at noon, so its washing is delayed until the time of Asr prayer." They said, "You should perform the Dhuhr prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Regarding the matter of a woman's impurity, it is purified at noon, so its washing is delayed until the time of Asr prayer." They said, "You should perform the Dhuhr prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الظُّهْرِ فَتُؤَخِّرُ غُسْلَهَا حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ وَقْتُ الْعَصْرِ قَالَا «تَقْضِي الظُّهْرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥajjāj
hadiths.chainArabic: وحدَّثنا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 913

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Al-Hassan"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "About Al-Hassan"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Hushaym Anbʾanā Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَنبأَنَا يُونُسُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 914

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Aamir"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "About Aamir"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَامِرٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chainArabic: وَمُغِيرَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 915

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, concerning women, he says that she should delay prayer until she finishes her period. They said, "Should she repeat the prayer she missed?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, concerning women, he says that she should delay prayer until she finishes her period. They said, "Should she repeat the prayer she missed?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُفَرِّطُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ حَتَّى يُدْرِكَهَا الْحَيْضُ قَالُوا «تُعِيدُ تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chainArabic: وَعُبَيْدَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 916

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Al-Hasan's opinion about a woman who attended the prayer but missed it until she menstruated, he said, "You can make up for that prayer once you have performed ablution."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Al-Hasan's opinion about a woman who attended the prayer but missed it until she menstruated, he said, "You can make up for that prayer once you have performed ablution."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ فِي امْرَأَةٍ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَفَرَّطَتْ حَتَّى حَاضَتْ قَالَا «تَقْضِي تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ḥammād b. Abū Sulaymān And Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ وَيُونُسَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 917

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Al-Hasan and Qatadah, they said, "If a woman misses her prayer until she enters her menstrual period, then she is obliged to make up for it once she becomes pure again."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Al-Hasan and Qatadah, they said, "If a woman misses her prayer until she enters her menstrual period, then she is obliged to make up for it once she becomes pure again."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ وَقَتَادَةَ قَالَا «إِذَا ضَيَّعَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ الصَّلَاةَ حَتَّى تَحِيضَ فَعَلَيْهَا الْقَضَاءُ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Dāwud al-Zahrānī \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan And Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 918

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When she missed, then menstruated, she made up for it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When she missed, then menstruated, she made up for it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا فَرَّطَتْ ثُمَّ حَاضَتْ قَضَتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Mughīrah \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 919

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a woman is menstruating during prayer time, she does not have to make up the missed prayers." Abu Muhammad said, "Yaqub is the son of Al-Qa'qa', a judge from Marw, and Abu Yusuf is a Meccan scholar."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "If a woman is menstruating during prayer time, she does not have to make up the missed prayers." Abu Muhammad said, "Yaqub is the son of Al-Qa'qa', a judge from Marw, and Abu Yusuf is a Meccan scholar."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا حَاضَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فِي وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا الْقَضَاءُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «يَعْقُوبُ هُوَ ابْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ قَاضِي مَرْوٍ وَأَبُو يُوسُفَ شَيْخٌ مَكِّيٌّ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Yaʿqūb \u003e Abū Yūsuf \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ عَنْ أَبِي يُوسُفَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 920

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If she becomes pure before sunset, she should perform the Dhuhr and Asr prayers. And if she becomes pure before dawn, she should perform the Maghrib and Isha prayers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If she becomes pure before sunset, she should perform the Dhuhr and Asr prayers. And if she becomes pure before dawn, she should perform the Maghrib and Isha prayers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ الْمَغْرِبِ صَلَّتِ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ وَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ صَلَّتِ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ḥajjāj And Qays \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ وَقَيْسٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 921

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, a similar one."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "From Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, a similar one."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e ʿAlī b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 922

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Ibn Abbas, something similar to it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "From Ibn Abbas, something similar to it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAyyāsh \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ziyād \u003e Miqsam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 923

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Al-Hasan, he said: "During menstruation, she should perform the prayer that has been purified within its designated time."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Al-Hasan, he said: "During menstruation, she should perform the prayer that has been purified within its designated time."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ فِي «الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي الصَّلَاةَ الَّتِي طَهُرَتْ فِي وَقْتِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Hushaym \u003e Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 924

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ata, Tawus, and Mujahid, they said, "If a menstruating woman becomes clean before dawn, she should pray Maghrib and Isha prayers. And if she becomes clean before sunset, she should pray Dhuhr and Asr prayers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ata, Tawus, and Mujahid, they said, "If a menstruating woman becomes clean before dawn, she should pray Maghrib and Isha prayers. And if she becomes clean before sunset, she should pray Dhuhr and Asr prayers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَطَاوُسٍ وَمُجَاهِدٍ قَالُوا «إِذَا طَهُرَتِ الْحَائِضُ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ صَلَّتِ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ وَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ صَلَّتِ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 925

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: About the ruling regarding a woman in her menstrual period, if she becomes pure at the end of the day, she should pray both Dhuhr and Asr. And if she becomes pure at the end of the night, she should pray both Maghrib and Isha.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the ruling regarding a woman in her menstrual period, if she becomes pure at the end of the day, she should pray both Dhuhr and Asr. And if she becomes pure at the end of the night, she should pray both Maghrib and Isha.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَكَمِ فِي «الْحَائِضِ إِذَا رَأَتِ الطُّهْرَ آخِرَ النَّهَارِ صَلَّتِ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ وَإِذَا طَهُرَتْ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ صَلَّتِ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 926

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Taous, like him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "About Taous, like him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ طَاوُسٍ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 927

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim used to say, "If one purifies themself at the time of 'Asr, they should pray Zuhr and 'Asr."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim used to say, "If one purifies themself at the time of 'Asr, they should pray Zuhr and 'Asr."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَقُولُ «إِذَا طَهُرَتْ عِنْدَ الْعَصْرِ صَلَّتِ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 928

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If she is pure during the time of prayer, she prays."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If she is pure during the time of prayer, she prays."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا طَهُرَتْ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ صَلَّتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Zayd \u003e Shuʿbah Saʾalt Ḥammād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ قَالَ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ سَأَلْتُ حَمَّادًا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 929

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If you become pure at the time of prayer, then pray that prayer and do not pray any other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If you become pure at the time of prayer, then pray that prayer and do not pray any other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا طَهُرَتْ فِي وَقْتِ صَلَاةٍ صَلَّتْ تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةَ وَلَا تُصَلِّي غَيْرَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Yūnus And Ḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ وَحُمَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 930

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ عِنْدَ الصَّلَاةِ أَوْ تَحِيضُ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "A woman purifies herself during prayer or menstrua...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet said, 'Pray the Dhuhr and Asr prayers.' I asked him, 'What if the time for purification (after impurity) is close to sunset?' He replied, 'In that case, perform the Asr prayer and do not pray Dhuhr. Even if one has not purified (from impurity) until sunset, there is no harm in that.' Abdullah was then asked if he followed this ruling, to which he replied, 'No.'"
hadiths.body: "The Prophet said, 'Pray the Dhuhr and Asr prayers.' I asked him, 'What if the time for purification (after impurity) is close to sunset?' He replied, 'In that case, perform the Asr prayer and do not pray Dhuhr. Even if one has not purified (from impurity) until sunset, there is no harm in that.' Abdullah was then asked if he followed this ruling, to which he replied, 'No.'"
hadiths.arabic: «تُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانَ طُهْرُهَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ مَغِيبِ الشَّمْسِ قَالَ «تُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَلَا تُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ وَلَوْ أَنَّهَا لَمْ تَطْهُرْ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا شَيْءٌ» سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ تَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ لَا
hadiths.chain: Abū Muḥammad \u003e Zayd b. Yaḥyá \u003e Mālik \u003e Saʾaltuh \u003e al-Marʾah Taṭhur Baʿd al-ʿAṣr
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مَالِكٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 931

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman wrote to him, "I have been experiencing menstruation since such and such days, and I have been informed that Ali said, 'One should perform ablution before every prayer.'" Ibn Abbas said, "We do not find anything contrary to what Ali said."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman wrote to him, "I have been experiencing menstruation since such and such days, and I have been informed that Ali said, 'One should perform ablution before every prayer.'" Ibn Abbas said, "We do not find anything contrary to what Ali said."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَتَبَتْ إِلَيْهِ امْرَأَةٌ إِنِّي قَدِ اسْتُحِضْتُ مُنْذُ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ عَلِيًّا قَالَ «تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ» قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مَا نَجِدُ لَهَا غَيْرَ مَا قَالَ عَلِيٌّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ashʿath b. Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ al-Muḥāribī \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 932

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: Zainab used to stay in seclusion with the Prophet ﷺ and during her menstrual period, she would bleed. So he instructed her to take a ritual bath after every prayer.   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: Zainab used to stay in seclusion with the Prophet ﷺ and during her menstrual period, she would bleed. So he instructed her to take a ritual bath after every prayer.   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَتْ زَيْنَبُ تَعْتَكِفُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهِيَ تُرِيقُ الدَّمَ «فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Salamah or ʿIkrimah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ أَوْ عِكْرِمَةُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 933

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali and Ibn Mas'ud used to say, "A woman experiencing Istihadah (continuous vaginal bleeding outside of menstruation) should perform Wudu (ablution) before every prayer."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: Ali and Ibn Mas'ud used to say, "A woman experiencing Istihadah (continuous vaginal bleeding outside of menstruation) should perform Wudu (ablution) before every prayer."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا وَابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ كَانَا يَقُولَانِ «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 934

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: Al-Awza'i, Al-Zuhri, and Mak'hul used to say, "One should perform ablution before every prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Al-Awza'i, Al-Zuhri, and Mak'hul used to say, "One should perform ablution before every prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ وَكَانَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَمَكْحُولٌ يَقُولَانِ تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Rabāḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ يَقُولُ «تَغْتَسِلُ بَيْنَ كُلِّ صَلَاتَيْنِ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا وَلِلْفَجْرِ غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 935

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "Wahb, the mother of Habiba bint Jahsh, had a condition where she experienced bleeding. She asked the Prophet ﷺ about it, so he instructed her to perform ablution (ritual purification) before each prayer and then pray."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Wahb, the mother of Habiba bint Jahsh, had a condition where she experienced bleeding. She asked the Prophet ﷺ about it, so he instructed her to perform ablution (ritual purification) before each prayer and then pray."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَهْبٌ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ كَانَتْ تُهَرَاقُ الدَّمَ وَإِنَّهَا سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنْ ذَاكَ «فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَتُصَلِّيَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn And Wahb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām Ṣāḥib al-Dastawāʾī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Um Ḥabībah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَوَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 936

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: About that, they said that Ali used to say, "You should wash for every prayer." So, I read and wrote the answer with my own hand, I couldn't find anything except what Ali said. It was said that Kufa is a cold land, so he said, "If Allah had willed, He would have tested it with something harsher than that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About that, they said that Ali used to say, "You should wash for every prayer." So, I read and wrote the answer with my own hand, I couldn't find anything except what Ali said. It was said that Kufa is a cold land, so he said, "If Allah had willed, He would have tested it with something harsher than that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالُوا كَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَقُولُ «تَغْتَسِلُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ» فَقَرَأْتُ وَكَتَبْتُ الْجَوَابَ بِيَدِي مَا أَجِدُ لَهَا إِلَّا مَا قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَقِيلَ إِنَّ الْكُوفَةَ أَرْضٌ بَارِدَةٌ فَقَالَ لَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَابْتَلَاهَا بِأَشَدَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad b. ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Katabat Āmraʾah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās And Ibn al-Zubayr Innī Ustaḥāḍ Falā Aṭhur And ʾInnī Udhakkirukumā Allāh Illā Aftaytumānī Waʾinnī Saʾalt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ يَقُولُ كَتَبَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ إِنِّي أُسْتَحَاضُ فَلَا أَطْهُرُ وَإِنِّي أُذَكِّرُكُمَا اللَّهُ إِلَّا أَفْتَيْتُمَانِي وَإِنِّي سَأَلْتُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 937

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: It was said to Ibn Abbas that indeed its land is a cold land, so he said, "It delays the noon and hastens the afternoon, and it washes (the body) with a wash and it delays the sunset and hastens the evening prayer, and it washes (the body) with a wash. And it washes (the body) with a wash before dawn."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was said to Ibn Abbas that indeed its land is a cold land, so he said, "It delays the noon and hastens the afternoon, and it washes (the body) with a wash and it delays the sunset and hastens the evening prayer, and it washes (the body) with a wash. And it washes (the body) with a wash before dawn."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قِيلَ لِابْنِ عبَّاسٍ إِنَّ أرْضها أرْضٌ باردةٌ فقالَ «تُؤخِّرُ الظُّهْرَ وتعجِّلُ العصْرَ وتغْتسلُ غُسْلًا وتؤخِّرُ المغْربَ وتعجِّلُ العشاءَ وتغْتسلُ غُسْلًا وتغْتسلُ لِلفجْرِ غُسْلًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥmmād \u003e Qys \u003e Mujāhd \u003e Qīl Liāb. ʿBbās In Rḍhā Rḍ Bārdh
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا حجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حمَّادٌ عنْ قيْسٍ عنْ مُجاهدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 938

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "The daughter of Jaheesh used to be under the care of Abdur Rahman ibn Awf, and she used to experience menstruation. She would leave her designated place of seclusion, and indeed she had a high menstrual flow, so she would perform prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The daughter of Jaheesh used to be under the care of Abdur Rahman ibn Awf, and she used to experience menstruation. She would leave her designated place of seclusion, and indeed she had a high menstrual flow, so she would perform prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ ابْنَةَ جَحْشٍ كَانَتْ تَحْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ «وَكَانَتْ تُسْتَحَاضُ فَكَانَتْ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ مِرْكَنِهَا وَإِنَّهُ لَعَالِيهِ الدَّمُ فَتُصَلِّي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e Zaynab b. Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 939

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "About someone like that, who is intoxicated."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "About someone like that, who is intoxicated."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Saʿīd al-Dimashqī \u003e Shuʿayb b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī Wayaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr Yaqūlān Tufrid Likul Ṣalāh Āghtisālah \u003e al-Awzāʿī Wabalaghanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ وَيَحْيَى بْنَ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ يَقُولَانِ «تُفْرِدُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ اغْتِسَالَةً» قَالَ الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ وَبَلَغَنِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 940

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Abbas used to say, "For every two prayers, there is a washing, and for the morning prayer, there is a special washing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Abbas used to say, "For every two prayers, there is a washing, and for the morning prayer, there is a special washing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ كَانَ يَقُولُ «لِكُلِّ صَلَاتَيْنِ اغْتِسَالَةٌ وَتُفْرِدُ لِصَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ اغْتِسَالَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Saʿīd \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 941

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "You should use water to slaughter it, as it cuts off the blood from you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "You should use water to slaughter it, as it cuts off the blood from you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «عَلَيْكِ بِالْمَاءِ فَانْضَحِيهِ فَإِنَّهُ يَقْطَعُ الدَّمَ عَنْكِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ الْكُوفِيِّ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي أُسْتَحَاضُ؟ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 942

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: About the waiting period (Iddah) of a divorced woman: If a woman experiences menstruation after the divorce, she should wait for one year. If she does not experience menstruation within that year, she should wait for three more months. If she still does not experience menstruation within that time, her waiting period is deemed complete.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About the waiting period (Iddah) of a divorced woman: If a woman experiences menstruation after the divorce, she should wait for one year. If she does not experience menstruation within that year, she should wait for three more months. If she still does not experience menstruation within that time, her waiting period is deemed complete.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ الَّتِي ارْتِيبَ بِهَا «تَرَبَّصُ سَنَةً فَإِنْ حَاضَتْ وَإِلَّا تَرَبَّصَتْ بَعْدَ انْقِضَاءِ السَّنَةِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ فَإِنْ حَاضَتْ وَإِلَّا فَقَدِ انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān b. Muslim \u003e Muḥammad b. Dīnār \u003e Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 943

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abu Muhammad is the statement of Malik."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Abu Muhammad is the statement of Malik."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ هُوَ قَوْلُ مَالِكٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Suʾil Mālik \u003e ʿIddah al-Mustaḥāḍah Idhā Ṭulliqat Faḥaddathanā Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e ʿIddatuhā Sanah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ قَالَ سُئِلَ مَالِكٌ عَنْ عِدَّةِ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ إِذَا طُلِّقَتْ فَحَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «عِدَّتُهَا سَنَةٌ» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 944

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: About a woman who gets divorced while she is young and her menstruation stops without reaching menopause? He asked, "Does she stop menstruating without having menopause?" And Tawus said, "For three months."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a woman who gets divorced while she is young and her menstruation stops without reaching menopause? He asked, "Does she stop menstruating without having menopause?" And Tawus said, "For three months."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تُطَلَّقُ وَهِيَ شَابَّةٌ فَتَرْتَفِعُ حِيضَتُهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ كِبَرٍ؟ قَالَ «مِنْ غَيْرِ حَيْضٍ تَحَيَّضُ؟» وَقَالَ طَاوُسٌ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Suʾil Jābir b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ قَالَ سُئِلَ جَابِرُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 945

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a man divorces his wife and she has her period once or twice and then her period stops, if this is due to old age, she must wait three months. But if she is young and uncertain, she must wait one year after her last menstrual cycle."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a man divorces his wife and she has her period once or twice and then her period stops, if this is due to old age, she must wait three months. But if she is young and uncertain, she must wait one year after her last menstrual cycle."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا طَلَّقَ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ فَحَاضَتْ حَيْضَةً أَوْ حَيْضَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ ارْتَفَعَتْ حَيْضَتُهَا إِنْ كَانَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ كِبَرٍ اعْتَدَّتْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ شَابَّةً وَارْتَابَتْ اعْتَدَّتْ سَنَةً بَعْدَ الرِّيبَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Naṣr b. ʿAlī \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 946

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "The istihadah (irregular bleeding) is a condition in which a woman does not have a regular menstrual cycle. Its purification (by performing ghusl) is required once a month if it occurs once, and twice a month if it occurs twice, and its waiting period is three months."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The istihadah (irregular bleeding) is a condition in which a woman does not have a regular menstrual cycle. Its purification (by performing ghusl) is required once a month if it occurs once, and twice a month if it occurs twice, and its waiting period is three months."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ وَالَّتِي لَا يَسْتَقِيمُ لَهَا حَيْضٌ فَتَحِيضُ فِي شَهْرٍ مَرَّةً وَفِي الشَّهْرِ مَرَّتَيْنِ عِدَّتُهَا ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ \u003e Ghundar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿIkrimah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 947

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "The person frequently reads"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The person frequently reads"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَعْتَدُّ بِالْأَقْرَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ \u003e Abū Dāwud \u003e Hishām \u003e Ḥammād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 948

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "The duration of impurity for a woman who experiences istihadah is a year."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "The duration of impurity for a woman who experiences istihadah is a year."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: «عِدَّةُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ سَنَةٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 949

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "The woman experiencing istihadah (abnormal bleeding outside of menstruation) can recite the Quran."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The woman experiencing istihadah (abnormal bleeding outside of menstruation) can recite the Quran."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَعْتَدُّ بِالْأَقْرَاءِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá Nbaʾanā Hushaym \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى أنبَأَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 950

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abu Muhammad, the people of the Hijaz say that al-Aqrā'u al-Aṭhār (referring to a specific tribe or group of individuals) are the purest. The people of Iraq said it is al-Hayd (menstruation). Abdullah said, and I say that it is al-Hayd."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Abu Muhammad, the people of the Hijaz say that al-Aqrā'u al-Aṭhār (referring to a specific tribe or group of individuals) are the purest. The people of Iraq said it is al-Hayd (menstruation). Abdullah said, and I say that it is al-Hayd."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ أَهْلُ الْحِجَازِ يَقُولُونَ الْأَقْرَاءُ الْأَطْهَارُ وَقَالَ أَهْلُ الْعِرَاقِ هُوَ الْحَيْضُ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَأَنَا أَقُولُ هُوَ الْحَيْضُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khalīfah \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Bi-al-Aqrāʾ \u003e Abū Muḥammad Ahl al-Ḥijāz Yaqūlūn al-Aqrāʾ al-Aṭhār \u003e Ahl al-ʿIrāq \u003e al-Ḥayḍ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ «بِالْأَقْرَاءِ» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 951

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "The woman experiencing istihaadah can make herself clean by using sanitary pads."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The woman experiencing istihaadah can make herself clean by using sanitary pads."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ تَعْتَدُّ بِالْأَقْرَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 952

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "About a man who divorced his wife while she was a young woman who was menstruating, and her menstrual cycle stopped when he divorced her, and she did not see any blood. How many days should she count?" He said, "Three months."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "About a man who divorced his wife while she was a young woman who was menstruating, and her menstrual cycle stopped when he divorced her, and she did not see any blood. How many days should she count?" He said, "Three months."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ شَابَّةٌ تَحِيضُ فَانْقَطَعَ عَنْهَا الْمَحِيضُ حِينَ طَلَّقَهَا فَلَمْ تَرَ دَمًا كَمْ تَعْتَدُّ؟ قَالَ «ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e al-Hiql b. Ziyād \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Saʾalt al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ الْهِقْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 953

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man who divorced his wife, then she had two menstruations, and then her menstruation ceased. How long should she wait before remarrying? He said, "Her waiting period is one year."
hadiths.body: About a man who divorced his wife, then she had two menstruations, and then her menstruation ceased. How long should she wait before remarrying? He said, "Her waiting period is one year."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ طلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَحَاضَتْ حَيْضَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ ارْتَفَعَتْ حَيْضَتُهَا كَمْ تَرَبَّصُ؟ قَالَ «عِدَّتُهَا سَنَةٌ»
hadiths.chain: And Saʾalt al-Zuhry
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ وَسَأَلْتُ الزُّهْريَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 954

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man who divorced his wife while she was menstruating, she stayed for three months then had another period, then her period was delayed, and she stayed for seven months and eight days, then she had another period that came earlier than expected and another one that was delayed. How should she count her waiting period? He said, "If her period differs from her regular cycle, then her waiting period shall be one year."
hadiths.body: About a man who divorced his wife while she was menstruating, she stayed for three months then had another period, then her period was delayed, and she stayed for seven months and eight days, then she had another period that came earlier than expected and another one that was delayed. How should she count her waiting period? He said, "If her period differs from her regular cycle, then her waiting period shall be one year."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ طلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ تَحِيضُ تَمْكُثُ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ ثُمَّ تَحِيضُ حَيْضَةً ثُمَّ يَتَأَخَّرُ عَنْهَا الْحَيْضُ ثُمَّ تَمْكُثُ السَّبْعَةَ الْأَشْهُرَ وَالثَّمَانِيَةَ ثُمَّ تَحِيضُ أُخْرَى تَسْتَعْجِلُ إِليْهَا مَرَّةً وَتَسْتَأْخِرُ أُخْرى كَيْفَ تَعْتَدُّ؟ قَالَ «إِذا اخْتَلَفَتْ حَيْضَتُهَا عَنْ أَقْرَائِهَا فَعِدَّتُهَا سَنَةٌ»
hadiths.chain: And Saʾalt al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ وَسَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 955

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "To recite it"
hadiths.body: "To recite it"
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَعْتَدَّ أَقْرَاءَهَا»
hadiths.chain: In Kānat Taḥīḍ Aqrāʾuhā Maʿlūmah Hī Aqrāʾuhā Faʾinnā Nará
hadiths.chainArabic: قُلتُ وَكَيْفَ إِنْ كَانَ طَلَّقَ وَهِيَ تَحِيضُ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ مَرَّةً كَمْ تَعْتَدُّ؟ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَتْ تَحِيضُ أَقْرَاؤُهَا مَعْلُومَةٌ هِيَ أَقْرَاؤُهَا فَإِنَّا نَرَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 956

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: About the man who buys a young girl who has not yet reached puberty or become pregnant, for how long can he keep her? He said, "For three months."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the man who buys a young girl who has not yet reached puberty or become pregnant, for how long can he keep her? He said, "For three months."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَبْتَاعُ الْجَارِيَةَ لَمْ تَبْلُغِ الْمَحِيضَ وَلَا تَحْمِلُ مِثْلُهَا بِكَمْ يَسْتَبْرِئُهَا؟ قَالَ «بِثَلَاثَةِ أَشْهُرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-Wāḥid \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Saʾalt al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 957

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "And Yahya bin Abi Kathir said, 'For forty-five days.'"
hadiths.body: "And Yahya bin Abi Kathir said, 'For forty-five days.'"
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ «بِخَمْسَةٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا»

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 958

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to say that a woman in a state of Istihadah should perform ablution before every prayer and then pray.
hadiths.body: He used to say that a woman in a state of Istihadah should perform ablution before every prayer and then pray.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ تَغْتَسِلُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَتُصَلِّي
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām al-Dastawāʾī \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 959

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: Not found
hadiths.body: Not found
hadiths.arabic: لا أوجد

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 960

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا اخْتَلَطَتْ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ أَيَّامُ حَيْضِهَا فِي أيَّامِ اسْتِحَاضَتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: If a woman's menstruation days coincide with her istihada days

hadiths.englishRaw: "Is it true that a woman who has missed her prayer for months should make up for them? It was asked, how should she make them up? He said, she should make them up in one day if she is able. It was asked of Abdullah, do you say this? He said, yes, by Allah."
hadiths.body: "Is it true that a woman who has missed her prayer for months should make up for them? It was asked, how should she make them up? He said, she should make them up in one day if she is able. It was asked of Abdullah, do you say this? He said, yes, by Allah."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ «مُسْتَحَاضَةً جَهِلَتْ فَتَرَكَتِ الصَّلَاةَ أَشْهُرًا فَإِنَّهَا تَقْضِي تِلْكَ الصَّلَوَاتِ؟» قِيلَ لهُ وَكَيْفَ تَقْضِيهَا؟ قَالَ «تَقْضِيهَا فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ إِنِ اسْتَطَاعَتْ» قِيلَ لِعبْدِ اللَّهِ تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ إِيْ وَاللَّهِ
hadiths.chain: Ḥammād Law
hadiths.chainArabic: وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ لَوْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 961

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ
chapter.englishTitle: When Al-Hubla sees blood

hadiths.englishRaw: "Let the prayer be given up."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Let the prayer be given up."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَدَعُ الصَّلَاةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Saʾalt al-Zuhrī \u003e al-Ḥāmil Tará al-Dam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ عَنِ الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 962

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ
chapter.englishTitle: When Al-Hubla sees blood

hadiths.englishRaw: My wife saw blood and I saw her pregnant. He said, "That is the shedding of the womb. Allah knows what every female carries, what the wombs shed, and what they increase. And everything has its extent" [Surah Ar-Ra'd, verse 8]. So, whatever she shed, it increased similarly in her pregnancy.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: My wife saw blood and I saw her pregnant. He said, "That is the shedding of the womb. Allah knows what every female carries, what the wombs shed, and what they increase. And everything has its extent" [Surah Ar-Ra'd, verse 8]. So, whatever she shed, it increased similarly in her pregnancy.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ امْرَأَتِي رَأَتْ دَمًا وَأَنَا أُرَاهَا حَامِلًا؟ قَالَ ذَلِكَ غَيْضُ الْأَرْحَامِ {اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنْثَى وَمَا تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ} [الرعد 8] فَمَا غَاضَتْ مِنْ شَيْءٍ زَادَتْ مِثْلَهُ فِي الْحَمْلِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad \u003e Saʾalt Mujāhid \u003e Āmraʾatī Raʾat Dam \u003e Urāhā Ḥāmil
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ مُجَاهِدًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 963

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ
chapter.englishTitle: When Al-Hubla sees blood

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding this verse {Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose] (Al-Ra'd 8), Ikrimah said, "This refers to the menstrual blood on the umbilical cord. It does not menstruate for a day on the cord unless it increases its purity in its cord."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding this verse {Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose] (Al-Ra'd 8), Ikrimah said, "This refers to the menstrual blood on the umbilical cord. It does not menstruate for a day on the cord unless it increases its purity in its cord."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ {اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنْثَى وَمَا تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ} [الرعد 8] قَالَ «ذَلِكَ الْحَيْضُ عَلَى الْحَبَلِ لَا تَحِيضُ يَوْمًا فِي الْحَبَلِ إِلَّا زَادَتْهُ طَاهِرًا فِي حَبَلِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 964

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ
chapter.englishTitle: When Al-Hubla sees blood

hadiths.englishRaw: About Aisha: "When a woman experiences the menstrual blood, she does not pray until she becomes clean."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About Aisha: "When a woman experiences the menstrual blood, she does not pray until she becomes clean."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ «الْمَرْأَةُ الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ أَنَّهَا لَا تُصَلِّي حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Amr Lā Yukhtalaf Fīh ʿIndanā \u003e ʿĀʾishah al-Marʾah al-Ḥublá Idhā Raʾat al-Dam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ أَمْرٌ لَا يُخْتَلَفُ فِيهِ عِنْدَنَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 965

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ
chapter.englishTitle: When Al-Hubla sees blood

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Ikrimah said, "And the uterus contracts" (Al-Ra'd 8). He said, "It is the menstrual period that occurs on a regular basis." (Al-Ra'd 8). He said, "So she continues to menstruate every month during her pregnancy, and her purity increases until she completes nine months free of impurity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ‘Ikrimah said, "And the uterus contracts" (Al-Ra'd 8). He said, "It is the menstrual period that occurs on a regular basis." (Al-Ra'd 8). He said, "So she continues to menstruate every month during her pregnancy, and her purity increases until she completes nine months free of impurity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ {وَمَا تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحَامُ} [الرعد 8] قَالَ «هُوَ الْحَيْضُ عَلَى الْحَبَلِ» {وَمَا تَزْدَادُ} [الرعد 8] قَالَ «فَلَهَا بِكُلِّ يَوْمٍ حَاضَتْ فِي حَمْلِهَا يَوْمًا تَزْدَادُ فِي طُهْرِهَا حَتَّى تَسْتَكْمِلَ تِسْعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ طَاهِرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Thābit b. Yazīd \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿIkrimah And Mā Taghīḍ al-Arḥām al-Rʿd 8 \u003e al-Ḥayḍ \u003e al-Ḥabal Wamā Tazdād al-Rʿd 8
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 966

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ
chapter.englishTitle: When Al-Hubla sees blood

hadiths.englishRaw: About Mujahid, "And (the) wombs do not lessen (the value)" [Ar-Ra'd: 8], he said, "When a woman menstruates while pregnant," he said, "It will result in a decrease in the child. But when it exceeds nine months, it will complete what was decreased from her child."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Mujahid, "And (the) wombs do not lessen (the value)" [Ar-Ra'd: 8], he said, "When a woman menstruates while pregnant," he said, "It will result in a decrease in the child. But when it exceeds nine months, it will complete what was decreased from her child."   – Sound Chain

hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الدِّمَشْقِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim regarding women when they see blood while giving birth? He said, "It is menstruation and they should leave prayer."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim regarding women when they see blood while giving birth? He said, "It is menstruation and they should leave prayer."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ وَهِيَ تَمَخَّضُ؟ قَالَ «هُوَ حَيْضٌ تَتْرُكُ الصَّلَاةَ»   – إسناده قوي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 987

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْحُبْلَى إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ

hadiths.englishRaw: About women in pregnancy, Hassan said, "If she is struck by labor pains and sees blood on the infant, she should refrain from praying." Abdullah said, "She should pray as long as she has not given birth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About women in pregnancy, Hassan said, "If she is struck by labor pains and sees blood on the infant, she should refrain from praying." Abdullah said, "She should pray as long as she has not given birth."   – Sound Chain

hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Hushaym \u003e Yūnus

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 989

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: وَقْتِ النُّفَسَاءِ وَمَا قِيلَ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The time of women and what is said about it

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding prayer, if a woman completes her menstrual cycle (and attains purity) within forty days, then she should resume praying. However, if her purity does not come before the end of the fifth or sixth day, then she must refrain from prayer for that many days. If she attains purity within this period, then she should resume praying. Otherwise, she must refrain from prayer until she attains purity or until fifty days pass. If she attains purity during this period, then she should resume praying; otherwise, she must perform ghusl (ritual bathing).   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding prayer, if a woman completes her menstrual cycle (and attains purity) within forty days, then she should resume praying. However, if her purity does not come before the end of the fifth or sixth day, then she must refrain from prayer for that many days. If she attains purity within this period, then she should resume praying. Otherwise, she must refrain from prayer until she attains purity or until fifty days pass. If she attains purity during this period, then she should resume praying; otherwise, she must perform ghusl (ritual bathing).   – Weak Chain
