hadiths.arabic: الْمَرْأَةُ تَنْتَظِرُ مِنَ الْغُلَامِ ثَلَاثِينَ يَوْمًا وَمِنَ الْجَارِيَةِ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا يَعْنِي النُّفَسَاءَ قَالَ مَرْوَانُ هُوَ قَوْلُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وقالَ الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ هُمَا سَوَاءٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Muḥammad b. Shuʿayb \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Sulaymān al-Afṭas \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَفْطَسُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلَاءَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1001

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: In the menstruating woman, she prays in her garment when she bec...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If blood is seen during labor for one or two days, then it is considered part of postpartum bleeding."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If blood is seen during labor for one or two days, then it is considered part of postpartum bleeding."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا رَأَتِ الدَّمَ عِنْدَ الطَّلْقِ يَوْمًا أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ فَهُوَ مِنَ النِّفَاسِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1002

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: In the menstruating woman, she prays in her garment when she bec...

hadiths.englishRaw: "About atta' in pregnancy, you see blood while she is releasing?" He said, "You do what the woman in menstruation does."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "About atta' in pregnancy, you see blood while she is releasing?" He said, "You do what the woman in menstruation does."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْحَامِلِ تَرَى الدَّمَ وَهِيَ تَطْلُقُ؟ قَالَ «تَصْنَعُ مَا تَصْنَعُ الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak \u003e Ibn Jurayj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1003

chapter.englishTitle: The woman avoids then menstruates.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim regarding women, he said, "She should avoid [intimacy] and then menstruate, and afterward, she should perform ritual bathing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim regarding women, he said, "She should avoid [intimacy] and then menstruate, and afterward, she should perform ritual bathing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُجْنِبُ ثُمَّ تَحِيضُ قَالَ «تَغْتَسِلُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1004

chapter.englishTitle: The woman avoids then menstruates.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Hasan, like him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Hasan, like him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1005

chapter.englishTitle: The woman avoids then menstruates.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The period is bigger."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The period is bigger."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْحَيْضُ أَكْبَرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Musayyab \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1006

chapter.englishTitle: The woman avoids then menstruates.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, there was a man who deceived his wife, causing her to menstruate. Ibrahim said, "I prefer that she performs ghusl (ritual purification)."   – Sound
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, there was a man who deceived his wife, causing her to menstruate. Ibrahim said, "I prefer that she performs ghusl (ritual purification)."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي رَجُلٍ غَشِيَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَحَاضَتْ فَقَالَ «تَغْتَسِلُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1007

chapter.englishTitle: The woman avoids then menstruates.

hadiths.englishRaw: From 'Ataa and Al-Nakha'i, they said, "Let her cleanse herself from impurity."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From 'Ataa and Al-Nakha'i, they said, "Let her cleanse herself from impurity."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَالنَّخَعِيِّ قَالَا «لِتَغْتَسِلْ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ And al-Nnakhaʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1008

chapter.englishTitle: The woman avoids then menstruates.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Hassan, like that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Hassan, like that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1009

chapter.englishTitle: The woman avoids then menstruates.

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim said, "She is bathing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim said, "She is bathing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ «تَغْتَسِلُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Musayyib \u003e Suʾil \u003e Hā Ḥammād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ ثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ سُئِلَ عَنْهَا حَمَّادٌ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1010

chapter.englishTitle: The woman avoids then menstruates.

hadiths.englishRaw: She washes.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: She washes.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَغْتَسِلُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Fuḍayl \u003e Muḥammad b. Sālim \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ ابْنِ فُضَيْلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1011

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الْحَائِضِ تَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The menstruating woman performs ablution at the time of prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: "To perform ablution for prayer, then glorify and magnify Allah at the time of prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To perform ablution for prayer, then glorify and magnify Allah at the time of prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءَهَا لِلصَّلَاةِ ثُمَّ تُسَبِّحَ اللَّهَ وَتُكَبِّرَهُ فِي وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ayyūb \u003e al-Ḥakam b. ʿUtaybah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَكَمَ بْنَ عُتَيْبَةَ يَقُولُ «كَانَ يُعْجِبُهُمْ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1012

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الْحَائِضِ تَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The menstruating woman performs ablution at the time of prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to my father, "Does a menstruating woman perform ablution at the time of every prayer and remember Allah?" He replied, "I did not find any basis for this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to my father, "Does a menstruating woman perform ablution at the time of every prayer and remember Allah?" He replied, "I did not find any basis for this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي قِلَابَةَ الْحَائِضُ تَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَتَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ؟ فَقَالَ «مَا وَجَدْتُ لِهَذَا أَصْلًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Sulaymān al-Taymī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1013

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الْحَائِضِ تَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The menstruating woman performs ablution at the time of prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to command the menstruating woman at the time of prayer to perform ablution and sit in the courtyard of her mosque, remember Allah, and glorify Him.
hadiths.body: He used to command the menstruating woman at the time of prayer to perform ablution and sit in the courtyard of her mosque, remember Allah, and glorify Him.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ «يَأْمُرُ الْمَرْأَةَ الْحَائِضَ عِنْدَ أَوَانِ الصَّلَاةِ أَنْ تَوَضَّأَ وَتَجْلِسَ بِفِنَاءِ مَسْجِدِهَا فَتَذْكُرَ اللَّهَ وَتُسَبِّحَ»
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Ayyūb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الصَّدَفِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1014

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الْحَائِضِ تَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The menstruating woman performs ablution at the time of prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no deity but the edge of the verse, but rather, cleanse yourself at the time of every prayer, then face the qibla, and glorify and magnify, and invoke Almighty God."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no deity but the edge of the verse, but rather, cleanse yourself at the time of every prayer, then face the qibla, and glorify and magnify, and invoke Almighty God."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا إِلَّا طَرَفَ الْآيَةِ وَلَكِنْ تَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثُمَّ تَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ وَتُسَبِّحُ وَتُكَبِّرُ وَتَدْعُو اللَّهَ ﷻ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ أَتَقْرَأُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1015

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الْحَائِضِ تَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The menstruating woman performs ablution at the time of prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The menstruating woman is instructed to perform ablution at prayer times, face the Qiblah (direction of prayer), and remember Allah the Almighty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The menstruating woman is instructed to perform ablution at prayer times, face the Qiblah (direction of prayer), and remember Allah the Almighty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تُؤْمَرُ الْحَائِضُ تَتَوَضَّأُ عِنْدَ مَوَاقِيتِ الصَّلَاةِ وَتَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ وَتَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd \u003e Ḍamrah \u003e al-Saybānī / Yaḥyá b. Abū ʿAmr from Ahl al-Ramlah \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا ضَمْرَةُ حَدَّثَنَا السَّيْبَانِيُّ وَهُوَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرٍو مِنْ أَهْلِ الرَّمْلَةِ حَدَّثَنَا مَكْحُولٌ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1016

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: The menstruating woman and the person in a state of ritual impurity (janabah) heard that one should perform ablution (ghusl) and prostrate during the sujood. However, the menstruating woman does not need to perform the prayer (salaah) because she cannot pray.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The menstruating woman and the person in a state of ritual impurity (janabah) heard that one should perform ablution (ghusl) and prostrate during the sujood. However, the menstruating woman does not need to perform the prayer (salaah) because she cannot pray.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَ الْحَائِضُ وَالْجُنُبُ السَّجْدَةَ يَغْتَسِلُ الْجُنُبُ وَيَسْجُدُ وَلَا تَقْضِي الْحَائِضُ لِأَنَّهَا لَا تُصَلِّي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Idhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ «إِذَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1017

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not spend."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not spend."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَقْضِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1018

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is nothing on it."
hadiths.body: "There is nothing on it."
hadiths.arabic: «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا شَيْءٌ»
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir And Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Abū Maʿshar \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1019

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: "We used to have our periods in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he did not command any of us to refrain from offering prayers."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "We used to have our periods in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he did not command any of us to refrain from offering prayers."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نَحِيضُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَمَا يَأْمُرُ امْرَأَةً مِنَّا بِرَدِّ الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿUbaydah b. Muʿattib \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدَةُ بْنُ مُعَتِّبٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1020

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: "A woman asked Aisha if one of us should perform prayers during her menstruation. Aisha replied, 'Are you from the Haruriyyah sect? One of us used to have menstruation during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and she was not ordered to make up the missed prayers.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "A woman asked Aisha if one of us should perform prayers during her menstruation. Aisha replied, 'Are you from the Haruriyyah sect? One of us used to have menstruation during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and she was not ordered to make up the missed prayers.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ أَتَقْضِي إِحْدَانَا صَلَاةَ أَيَّامِ حَيْضِهَا؟ فَقَالَتْ أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ؟ قَدْ «كَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَا تُؤْمَرُ بِقَضَاءٍ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Muʿādhah \u003e Āmraʾah Saʾalat ʿĀʾishah Ataqḍī Iḥdānā Ṣalāh Ayyām Ḥayḍihā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1021

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: It's as if Hammad parted with the story of Ayyub and brought forth this.
hadiths.body: It's as if Hammad parted with the story of Ayyub and brought forth this.
hadiths.arabic: كَأَنَّ حَمَّادًا فَرِقَ حَدِيثَ أَيُّوبَ فَجَاءَ بِهَذَا
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Yazīd al-Rishk \u003e Muʿādhah \u003e Abū al-Nuʿmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ قَالَ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1022

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the menstruating woman saying, "Do not prostrate."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the menstruating woman saying, "Do not prostrate."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَتِ الْحَائِضُ السَّجْدَةَ فَلَا تَسْجُدْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Idhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ «إِذَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1023

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the prostration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the prostration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَتِ السَّجْدَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Lā Tasjud al-Marʾah al-Ḥāʾiḍ Idhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ قَالَ «لَا تَسْجُدُ الْمَرْأَةُ الْحَائِضُ إِذَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1024

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the sujood.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the sujood.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَتِ السَّجْدَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e al-Ḥasan b. ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ «يَكْرَهُ لِلْحَائِضِ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ إِذَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1025

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding women on their periods and experiencing postnatal bleeding, do they have to make up for the missed prayers after they become clean? He said: He is the husband of the Prophet ﷺ. If they were to do so, our women would have been commanded to do the same.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding women on their periods and experiencing postnatal bleeding, do they have to make up for the missed prayers after they become clean? He said: He is the husband of the Prophet ﷺ. If they were to do so, our women would have been commanded to do the same.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النُّفَسَاءِ وَالْحَائِضِ هَلْ تَقْضِيَانِ الصَّلَاةَ إِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ؟ قَالَ هُوَ ذَا أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَلَوْ فَعَلْنَ ذَلِكَ أَمَرْنَا نِسَاءَنَا بِذَلِكَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAwn \u003e Abū Ghālib ʿAjlān \u003e Saʾalt Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Nufasāʾ And al-Ḥāʾiḍ Hal Taqḍiyān al-Ṣalāh Idhā Taṭahharn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ أَبِي غَالِبٍ عَجْلَانَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1026

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: Do I have to make up for the prayers that I missed during my menstruation when I become pure again? Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her, asked, "Are you a Hururiyyah?" We used to be with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , one of us would menstruate and then become pure, and he would not order us to make up for the missed prayers.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Do I have to make up for the prayers that I missed during my menstruation when I become pure again? Aisha, may Allah be pleased with her, asked, "Are you a Hururiyyah?" We used to be with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , one of us would menstruate and then become pure, and he would not order us to make up for the missed prayers.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَقْضِي مَا تَرَكْتُ مِنْ صَلََاتِي فِي الْحَيْضِ عِنْدَ الطُّهْرِ؟ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ؟ «كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَتْ إِحْدَانَا تَحِيضُ وَتَطْهُرُ فَلَا يَأْمُرُنَا بِالْقَضَاءِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Layth \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e Atat Āmraʾah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ أَتَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1027

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked Fatimah, the daughter of Ali, "Do you make up the prayers missed during your menstrual period?" She replied, "No."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I asked Fatimah, the daughter of Ali, "Do you make up the prayers missed during your menstrual period?" She replied, "No."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِفَاطِمَةَ يَعْنِي بِنْتَ عَلِيٍّ أَتَقْضِينَ صَلَاةَ أَيَّامِ حَيْضِكِ؟ قَالَتْ «لَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Sharīk \u003e Kathīr Abū Ismāʿīl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1028

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَقْضِي الصَّوْمَ وَلَا تَقْضِي الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: During menstruation, fasting is required but the prayers are not.

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman asked Aisha if a woman during her period has to pray. Aisha replied, "Evidently, the wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ menstruated, and he instructed them to make up for it." Abdullah said, which means that they do not have to fulfill the prayer.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman asked Aisha if a woman during her period has to pray. Aisha replied, "Evidently, the wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ menstruated, and he instructed them to make up for it." Abdullah said, which means that they do not have to fulfill the prayer.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ سَأَلَتْهَا امْرَأَةٌ أَتَقْضِي الْحَائِضُ الصَّلَاةَ؟ قَالَتْ أَحَرُورِيَّةٌ أَنْتِ «قَدْ حِضْنَ نِسَاءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَمَرَهُنَّ يَجْزِينَ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ مَعْنَاهُ أَنَّهُنَّ لَا يَقْضِينَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yazīd al-Rishk \u003e Muʿādhah \u003e ʿĀʾishah Saʾalathā Āmraʾah Ataqḍī al-Ḥāʾiḍ al-Ṣalāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاذَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1029

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "The menstruating woman and the person in a state of major impurity both remember Allah and utter His name."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The menstruating woman and the person in a state of major impurity both remember Allah and utter His name."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْحَائِضُ وَالْجُنُبُ يَذْكُرَانِ اللَّهَ وَيُسَمِّيَانِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1030

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "Neither the person in a state of major impurity (janabah) nor a menstruating woman can recite the Quran word by word (verse by verse)"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "Neither the person in a state of major impurity (janabah) nor a menstruating woman can recite the Quran word by word (verse by verse)"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَقْرَأِ الْجُنُبُ وَالْحَائِضُ آيَةً تَامَّةً يَقْرَآنِ الْحَرْفَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Balaghanī \u003e Ibrāhīm And Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1031

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Regarding 'Aamir, the sexually impure and menstruating women should not recite the Quran."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Regarding 'Aamir, the sexually impure and menstruating women should not recite the Quran."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَامِرٍ «الْجُنُبُ وَالْحَائِضُ لَا يَقْرَآنِ الْقُرْآنَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Bazzāz \u003e Sharīk \u003e Firās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ فِرَاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1032

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "The branch and menstruation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The branch and menstruation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: شُعْبَةُ وَجَدْتُ فِي الْكِتَابِ وَالْحَائِضُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ «يَكْرَهُ أَوْ يَنْهَى أَنْ يَقْرَأَ الْجُنُبُ» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1033

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Four people do not read the Quran: when alone, in the bathroom, while in a state of impurity (junub), and while menstruating (during their period). However, they are allowed to recite verses and the like for those who are junub or menstruating.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Four people do not read the Quran: when alone, in the bathroom, while in a state of impurity (junub), and while menstruating (during their period). However, they are allowed to recite verses and the like for those who are junub or menstruating.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَرْبَعَةٌ لَا يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ عِنْدَ الْخَلَاءِ وَفِي الْحَمَّامِ وَالْجُنُبُ وَالْحَائِضُ إِلَّا الْآيَةَ وَنَحْوَهَا لِلْجُنُبِ وَالْحَائِضِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām al-Dastawāʾī \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1034

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim and Saeed bin Jubair said, "Menstruating women and those in a state of sexual impurity (janaba) recite the verse but do not complete it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim and Saeed bin Jubair said, "Menstruating women and those in a state of sexual impurity (janaba) recite the verse but do not complete it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالُوا «الْحَائِضُ وَالْجُنُبُ يَسْتَفْتِحُونَ الْآيَةَ وَلَا يُتِمُّونَ آخِرَهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Khālid al-Aḥmar \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ And Ḥammād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الْأَحْمَرُ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَحَمَّادٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1035

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not read the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not read the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ فِي الْحَائِضِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1036

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Aisha was promoting Asma while she was competing.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Aisha was promoting Asma while she was competing.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ كَانَتْ «تَرْقِي أَسْمَاءَ وَهِيَ عَارِكٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá And ʾAbū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Sāʾib b. ʿUmar \u003e Ibn Abū Mulaykah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ قَالَا أَنبَأَنَا السَّائِبُ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1037

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "The person in a state of sexual impurity remembers the name of Allah the Almighty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The person in a state of sexual impurity remembers the name of Allah the Almighty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْجُنُبُ يَذْكُرُ اسْمَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e Hishām \u003e Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1038

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said that the one who is sexually impure (junub) or menstruating (hayid) should not recite, and one should not recite in the bathroom. And there are two situations in which a person should not mention Allah: when relieving oneself and during sexual intercourse. However, when a man comes to his family, he should start by saying "Bismillah" (In the name of Allah).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said that the one who is sexually impure (junub) or menstruating (hayid) should not recite, and one should not recite in the bathroom. And there are two situations in which a person should not mention Allah: when relieving oneself and during sexual intercourse. However, when a man comes to his family, he should start by saying "Bismillah" (In the name of Allah).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ لَا يَقْرَأُ الْجُنُبُ وَلَا الْحَائِضُ وَلَا يُقْرَأُ فِي الْحَمَّامِ وَحَالَانِ لَا يَذْكُرُ الْعَبْدُ فِيهِمَا اللَّهَ عِنْدَ الْخَلَاءِ وَعِنْدَ الْجِمَاعِ إِلَّا أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا أَتَى أَهْلَهُ بَدَأَ فَسَمَّى اللَّهَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sayyār \u003e Abū Wāʾil
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَيَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ قَالَ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1039

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no but the end of the verse."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no but the end of the verse."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا إِلَّا طَرَفَ الْآيَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَقْرَأُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1040

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ تَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَلَا تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ
chapter.englishTitle: Haidh Reminder: Remember Allah ﷻ and do not read the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Four phrases that can be said by someone in a state of ritual impurity (junub) or menstruation (haidh): "SubhanAllah" (Glory be to Allah), "Alhamdulillah" (All praise is due to Allah), "La ilaha illallah" (There is no deity but Allah), and "Allahu Akbar" (Allah is the Greatest).   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Four phrases that can be said by someone in a state of ritual impurity (junub) or menstruation (haidh): "SubhanAllah" (Glory be to Allah), "Alhamdulillah" (All praise is due to Allah), "La ilaha illallah" (There is no deity but Allah), and "Allahu Akbar" (Allah is the Greatest).   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَرْبَعٌ لَا يَحْرُمْنَ عَلَى جُنُبٍ وَلَا حَائِضٍ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū ʿAṭṭāf \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَطَّافٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1041

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابَ: الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدةَ فَلَا تَسْجُدُ
chapter.englishTitle: Chapter: The Menstruating Woman Can Hear the Sujood But Should N...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Because it is a prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Because it is a prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِأَنَّهَا صَلَاةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ḥumayd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥīm b. Sulaymān \u003e al-Ḥasan b. ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Muslim b. Ṣubayḥ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Suʾil \u003e al-Ḥāʾiḍ Tasmaʿ al-Sajdah \u003e Lā Tasjud
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدَةَ قَالَ «لَا تَسْجُدُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1042

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابَ: الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدةَ فَلَا تَسْجُدُ
chapter.englishTitle: Chapter: The Menstruating Woman Can Hear the Sujood But Should N...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim and Abu al-Dhuhay said, "Do not prostrate."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim and Abu al-Dhuhay said, "Do not prostrate."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَأَبِي الضُّحَى قَالَا «لَا تَسْجُدُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e al-Ḥasan b. ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibrāhīm And ʾAbī al-Ḍuḥá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1043

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابَ: الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدةَ فَلَا تَسْجُدُ
chapter.englishTitle: Chapter: The Menstruating Woman Can Hear the Sujood But Should N...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim and Saeed bin Jubair said, "She does not have a greater prayer than that."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim and Saeed bin Jubair said, "She does not have a greater prayer than that."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَا «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا ذَاكَ الصَّلَاةُ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Ibn Numayr \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm And Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1044

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابَ: الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدةَ فَلَا تَسْجُدُ
chapter.englishTitle: Chapter: The Menstruating Woman Can Hear the Sujood But Should N...

hadiths.englishRaw: It is better than the prescribed prayer was prohibited.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It is better than the prescribed prayer was prohibited.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: مُنِعَتْ خَيْرًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ الصَّلَاةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1045

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابَ: الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدةَ فَلَا تَسْجُدُ
chapter.englishTitle: Chapter: The Menstruating Woman Can Hear the Sujood But Should N...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not prostrate."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not prostrate."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَسْجُدُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Ghundar \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1046

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابَ: الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدةَ فَلَا تَسْجُدُ
chapter.englishTitle: Chapter: The Menstruating Woman Can Hear the Sujood But Should N...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not prostrate until you have washed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not prostrate until you have washed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَسْجُدُ حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الطُّهْرَ فَتَسْمَعُ السَّجْدَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1047

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابَ: الْحَائِضِ تَسْمَعُ السَّجْدةَ فَلَا تَسْجُدُ
chapter.englishTitle: Chapter: The Menstruating Woman Can Hear the Sujood But Should N...

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said to the women, "Give in charity, for you are the majority of the inhabitants of Hell." So a woman who was not from the elite women asked, "Why? For what reason or with what?" He said, "Because you frequently curse and are ungrateful to your husbands."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said to the women, "Give in charity, for you are the majority of the inhabitants of Hell." So a woman who was not from the elite women asked, "Why? For what reason or with what?" He said, "Because you frequently curse and are ungrateful to your husbands."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ لِلنِّسَاءِ «تَصَدَّقْنَ فَإِنَّكُنَّ أَكْثَرُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ» فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ لَيْسَتْ مِنْ عِلْيَةِ النِّسَاءِ لِمَ أَوْ بِمَ أَوْ فِيمَ؟ قَالَ «إِنَّكُنَّ تُكْثِرْنَ اللَّعْنَ وَتَكْفُرْنَ الْعَشِيرَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Dhar \u003e Wāʾil b. Muhānah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ذَرًّا عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ مُهَانَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1048

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a woman becomes pure from her menstrual cycle, she should follow her garment that touches her skin, wash what has come in contact with harm, and then she can pray in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When a woman becomes pure from her menstrual cycle, she should follow her garment that touches her skin, wash what has come in contact with harm, and then she can pray in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا طَهُرَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ فَلْتَتَّبِعْ ثَوْبَهَا الَّذِي يَلِي جِلْدَهَا فَلْتَغْسِلْ مَا أَصَابَهُ مِنَ الْأَذَى ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي فِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1049

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: One of us would have a shirt in which she would menstruate and in it she became sexually defiled. Then if she ever saw any drop of blood in it, she would rub it off by applying her saliva.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: One of us would have a shirt in which she would menstruate and in it she became sexually defiled. Then if she ever saw any drop of blood in it, she would rub it off by applying her saliva.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ «يَكُونُ لِإِحْدَانَا الدِّرْعُ فِيهِ تَحِيضُ وَفِيهِ تُجْنِبُ ثُمَّ تَرَى فِيهِ الْقَطْرَةَ مِنْ دَمِ حَيْضَتِهَا فَتَقْصَعُهُ بِرِيقِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1050

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: From Umm Salamah, she said, "If one of you starts her menstrual flow with a drop of blood, then when one of you experiences that, let her use a piece of cloth."
hadiths.body: From Umm Salamah, she said, "If one of you starts her menstrual flow with a drop of blood, then when one of you experiences that, let her use a piece of cloth."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ «إِنَّ إِحْدَاكُنَّ تَسْبِقُهَا الْقَطْرَةُ مِنَ الدَّمِ فَإِذَا أَصَابَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ ذَلِكَ فَلْتَقْصَعْهُ بِرِيقِهَا»
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū Bakr al-Hudhalī \u003e al-Ḥasan from his mother
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْهُذَلِيُّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أُمِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1051

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a woman washes off the blood, yet it does not go away, then she should change it with yellow dock root or saffron."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a woman washes off the blood, yet it does not go away, then she should change it with yellow dock root or saffron."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا غَسَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ الدَّمَ فَلَمْ يَذْهَبْ فَلْتُغَيِّرْهُ بِصُفْرَةِ وَرْسٍ أَوْ زَعْفَرَانٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Thābit b. Yazīd \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Muʿādhah al-ʿAdawiyyah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ثَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ الْعَدَوِيَّةِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1052

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Does a woman have blood on her garment, so should I wash it and not cut it?" She said, "Water is purifying."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Does a woman have blood on her garment, so should I wash it and not cut it?" She said, "Water is purifying."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهَا امْرَأَةٌ الدَّمُ يَكُونُ فِي الثَّوْبِ فَأَغْسِلُهُ فَلَا يَذْهَبُ فَأُقَطِّعُهُ؟ قَالَتْ «الْمَاءُ طَهُورٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yazīd al-Rishk \u003e Muʿādhah al-ʿAdawiyyah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ الرِّشْكِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاذَةَ الْعَدَوِيَّةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1053

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard Aisha (ra) say: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abii Al-Qbim, and I were beneath a single blanket, and I was menstruating. If something got on him from me, he would wash whatever had got on him and he did not wash anywhere else, and he prayed in it then came back to me.And if anything got on him from me,he would do exactly the same and he did not wash anywhere else."'     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard Aisha (ra) say: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ, Abii Al-Qbim, and I were beneath a single blanket, and I was menstruating. If something got on him from me, he would wash whatever had got on him and he did not wash anywhere else, and he prayed in it then came back to me.And if anything got on him from me,he would do exactly the same and he did not wash anywhere else."'     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ تَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ يَكُونُ مَعِي فِي الشِّعَارِ الْوَاحِدِ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ طَامِثٌ إِنْ أَصَابَهُ مِنِّي شَيْءٌ غَسَلَ مَا أَصَابَهُ لَمْ يَعْدُهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ وَصَلَّى فِيهِ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ وَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ مِنِّي شَيْءٌ فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ غَسَلَ مَكَانَهُ لَمْ يَعْدُهُ إِلَى غَيْرِهِ وَصَلَّى فِيهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān \u003e Jābir b. Ṣubḥ \u003e Khilās b. ʿAmr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرُ بْنُ صُبْحٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ خِلَاسَ بْنَ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1054

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, he said: "If a woman wears clothing while she is menstruating, and blood touches it, she should wash it. Otherwise, it is not necessary for her to wash it. And if she sweats in it, it is permissible for her to sprinkle water on it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, he said: "If a woman wears clothing while she is menstruating, and blood touches it, she should wash it. Otherwise, it is not necessary for her to wash it. And if she sweats in it, it is permissible for her to sprinkle water on it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ «فِيمَا تَلْبَسُ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ إِنْ أَصَابَهُ دَمٌ غَسَلَتْهُ وَإِلَّا فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهَا غَسْلُهُ وَإِنْ عَرِقَتْ فِيهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِئُهَا أَنْ تَنْضَحَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām al-Dastawāʾī \u003e Ḥammād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1055

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: The menstruating woman prays in the same clothes she menstruates in, except if any blood specifically touches the clothes, then she washes the spot where the blood is.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The menstruating woman prays in the same clothes she menstruates in, except if any blood specifically touches the clothes, then she washes the spot where the blood is.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: الْمَرْأَةُ «الْحَائِضُ تُصَلِّي فِي ثِيَابِهَا الَّتِي تَحِيضُ فِيهَا إِلَّا أَنْ يُصِيبَ شَيْئًا مِنْهَا دَمٌ فَتَغْسِلَ مَوْضِعَ الدَّمِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e ʿUthmān \u003e Mujāhid
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1056

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about menstrual blood that stains clothes. He said, "Scrape it off and then rinse it with water."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about menstrual blood that stains clothes. He said, "Scrape it off and then rinse it with water."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ دَمِ الْحَيْضِ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ قَالَ «حُتِّيهِ ثُمَّ رُشِّيهِ بِالْمَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e Fāṭimah b. al-Mundhir \u003e Asmāʾ b. Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1057

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The menstruating woman does not wash her garment if there is no blood on it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The menstruating woman does not wash her garment if there is no blood on it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْحَائِضُ لَا تَغْسِلُ ثَوْبَهَا إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ دَمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muʿādh b. Hāniʾ \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Ṭahmān \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1058

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard a woman asking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her garment after becoming clean from her menstrual cycle, asking what should she do with it. He said, "If you see any blood on it, then scrub it, then purify it with water, and then pour water over the rest of it. Then pray in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard a woman asking the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her garment after becoming clean from her menstrual cycle, asking what should she do with it. He said, "If you see any blood on it, then scrub it, then purify it with water, and then pour water over the rest of it. Then pray in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ امْرَأَةً تَسْأَلُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ مِنْ مَحِيضِهَا كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ «إِنْ رَأَيْتِ فِيهِ دَمًا فَحُكِّيهِ ثُمَّ اقْرُصِيهِ بِمَاءٍ ثُمَّ انْضَحِي فِي سَائِرِهِ فَصَلِّي فِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd \u003e Ibn Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Fāṭimah b. al-Mundhir \u003e Asmāʾ b. Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ هُوَ ابْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1059

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about the blood of menstruation on the clothe. He said: Erase it off with a piece of wood and then wash it away with water and the leaves of the lote-tree.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about the blood of menstruation on the clothe. He said: Erase it off with a piece of wood and then wash it away with water and the leaves of the lote-tree.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنْ دَمِ الْحِيضَ يَكُونُ فِي الثَّوْبِ قَالَ «اغْسِلِيهِ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَحُكِّيهِ بِضِلَعٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿUbayd al-Qāsim b. Sallām \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Mahdī \u003e Sufyān \u003e Thābit al-Ḥaddād \u003e ʿAdī b. Dīnār a freed slave of Um Qays b. Miḥṣan \u003e Um Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْحَدَّادِ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ دِينَارٍ مَوْلَى أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1060

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: The woman said, "Does her menstrual blood stain her dress?" She said, "Wash it with water." She said, "But won't its trace remain?" She said, "Indeed, water is purifying."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The woman said, "Does her menstrual blood stain her dress?" She said, "Wash it with water." She said, "But won't its trace remain?" She said, "Indeed, water is purifying."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: فَقَالَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ يُصِيبُ ثَوْبَهَا مِنْ دَمِ حِيضَتِهَا؟ قَالَتْ «لِتَغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ» قَالَتْ فَإِنَّا نَغْسِلُهُ فَيَبْقَى أَثَرُهُ؟ قَالَتْ «إِنَّما الْمَاءَ طَهُورٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e ʿAlī b. al-Mubārak \u003e Karīmah \u003e ʿĀʾishah And Saʾalathā Āmraʾah \u003e al-Marʾah Yuṣīb Thawbahā from Dam Ḥīḍatihā \u003e Litaghsilh Bi-al-Māʾ \u003e Faʾinnā Naghsiluh Fayabqá Atharuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَرِيمَةَ قالَتْ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ وَسَأَلَتْهَا امْرَأَةٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1061

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تُصَلِّي فِي ثَوْبِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: A menstruating woman prays in her garment when she becomes pure.

hadiths.englishRaw: Aisha used to see blood from menstruation on her garment, so she would open it with a stone or a stick or a horn, and then wash it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Aisha used to see blood from menstruation on her garment, so she would open it with a stone or a stick or a horn, and then wash it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ «تَرَى الشَّيْءَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ فِي ثَوْبِهَا فَتَحُتُّهُ بِالْحَجَرِ أَوْ بِالْعُودِ أَوْ بِالْقَرْنِ ثُمَّ تَرُشُّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1062

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "From semen, sweat can appear on a garment, then he wipes it with it, and he said, 'There is no harm in it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From semen, sweat can appear on a garment, then he wipes it with it, and he said, 'There is no harm in it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْجُنُبِ يَعْرَقُ فِي الثَّوْبِ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُهُ بِهِ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1063

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "It was seen that there is no hardship in having sweat stains on the clothes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It was seen that there is no hardship in having sweat stains on the clothes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ «لَا يَرَى بِعَرَقِ الْجُنُبِ فِي الثَّوْبِ بَأْسًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUthmān b. Khuthaym \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1064

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "He did not see any harm with it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He did not see any harm with it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ «لَا يَرَى بِهِ بَأْسًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1065

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: Not all of the Prophet's companions ﷺ used to find two garments and he said, "If you take a bath, don't you have something to wear? So, this is for that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Not all of the Prophet's companions ﷺ used to find two garments and he said, "If you take a bath, don't you have something to wear? So, this is for that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا كُلُّ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ كَانُوا يَجِدُونَ ثَوْبَيْنِ وقَالَ إِذَا اغْتَسَلْتَ أَلَسْتَ تَلْبَسُهُ؟ فَذَاكَ بِذَاكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1066

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: About the man who harms the woman and then wears the garment, and sweats in it, and she does not see any harm in it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the man who harms the woman and then wears the garment, and sweats in it, and she does not see any harm in it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ «الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُ الْمَرْأَةَ ثُمَّ يَلْبَسُ الثَّوْبَ فَيَعْرَقُ فِيهِ فَلَمْ تَرَ بِهِ بَأْسًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿĀʾishah Suʾilat
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ سُئِلَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1067

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "To pray in the clothes that have semen or menstrual blood stains."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "To pray in the clothes that have semen or menstrual blood stains."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَعْرَقَ الْجُنُبُ وَالْحَائِضُ فِي الثَّوْبِ يُصَلَّى فِيهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Yaḥyá b. Sulaym \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Lā Baʾs
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1068

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: Concerning Ibrahim in the desert, he was sweating in his garment and said, "Neither does it harm him, nor does it wet him with water."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Concerning Ibrahim in the desert, he was sweating in his garment and said, "Neither does it harm him, nor does it wet him with water."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْجُنُبِ يَعْرَقُ فِي ثَوْبِهِ قَالَ «لَا يَضُرُّهُ وَلَا يَنْضَحُهُ بِالْمَاءِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e Abū Ḥamzah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبَأَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1069

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, regarding menstruation, if she stains her clothes with sweat, then it is permissible for her to sprinkle water on it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, regarding menstruation, if she stains her clothes with sweat, then it is permissible for her to sprinkle water on it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْحَائِضِ إِذَا عَرِقَتْ فِي ثِيَابِهَا فَإِنَّهُ «يُجْزِئُهَا أَنْ تَنْضَحَهُ بِالْمَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām \u003e Ḥammād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1070

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Ibn Umar, he used to sweat while being in a state of janabah (major impurity), and then he would pray in the same clothing.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Ibn Umar, he used to sweat while being in a state of janabah (major impurity), and then he would pray in the same clothing.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ كَانَ «يَعْرَقُ فِي الثَّوْبِ وَهُوَ جُنُبٌ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1071

chapter.englishTitle: In the region of the south and during menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: He "did not see harm in the bleeding woman or the impure person."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He "did not see harm in the bleeding woman or the impure person."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ «لَمْ يَكُنْ يَرَى بَأْسًا بِعَرَقِ الْحَائِضِ وَالْجُنُبِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Yaḥyá \u003e Hushaym \u003e Hishām \u003e Ibn Ḥassān \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ هِشَامٍ هُوَ ابْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1072

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "What is permissible for me to do with my wife while she is menstruating?" He replied, "Cover her with a cloth and do whatever you would normally do with her except for intercourse."   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.body: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "What is permissible for me to do with my wife while she is menstruating?" He replied, "Cover her with a cloth and do whatever you would normally do with her except for intercourse."   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ مَا يَحِلُّ لِي مِنَ امْرَأَتِي وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟ قَالَ «لِتَشُدَّ عَلَيْهَا إِزَارَهَا ثُمَّ شَأْنَكَ بِأَعْلَاهَا»   – ضعيف معضل
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Zayd b. Aslam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1073

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "To tighten her belt around her waist and then to engage with her."
hadiths.body: "To tighten her belt around her waist and then to engage with her."
hadiths.arabic: «لِتَشُدَّ إِزَارَهَا عَلَى أَسْفَلِهَا ثُمَّ يُبَاشِرُهَا»
hadiths.chain: Khālid \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Arsal ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿĀʾishah Liyasʾalahā Hal Yubāshir al-a man Āmraʾatah And Hī Ḥāʾiḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ قَالَ أَرْسَلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ لِيَسْأَلَهَا هَلْ يُبَاشِرُ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ؟ فَقَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1074

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "The husband approaches his wife during her menstruation between her thighs. When he ejaculates, she washes off what has touched her, and he cleans himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The husband approaches his wife during her menstruation between her thighs. When he ejaculates, she washes off what has touched her, and he cleans himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْحَائِضُ يَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا فِي مَرَاقِّهَا وَبَيْنَ فَخِذَيْهَا فَإِذَا دَفَقَ غَسَلَتْ مَا أَصَابَهَا وَاغْتَسَلَ هُوَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn Abū Zāʾidah \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Musayyab \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1075

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim said, "Indeed, the mother of Imran knows that I intended to pierce her womb while she was menstruating."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim said, "Indeed, the mother of Imran knows that I intended to pierce her womb while she was menstruating."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَقَدْ عَلِمَتْ أُمُّ عِمْرَانَ أَنِّي أَطْعَنُ فِي أَلْيَتِهَا يَعْنِي وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Saʾalt ʿAbd al-Karīm \u003e al-Ḥāʾiḍ \u003e Ibrāhīm Laqad ʿAlimat Um ʿImrān Annī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ الْكَرِيمِ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1076

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding menstruation, "so she does not see harm in anything below the blood."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding menstruation, "so she does not see harm in anything below the blood."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَائِضِ «فَلَمْ يَرَ بِمَا دُونَ الدَّمِ بَأْسًا»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Mālik b. Mighwal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ عَطَاءً

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1077

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "When the Prophet ﷺ commanded me, I would hasten and he would engage with me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When the Prophet ﷺ commanded me, I would hasten and he would engage with me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ إِذَا حِضْتُ أَمَرَنِي النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَأَتَّزِرُ وَكَانَ يُبَاشِرُنِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1078

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: Aisha was asked what is permissible for a man from his wife while she is menstruating. She said, "Anything above the waistcloth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Aisha was asked what is permissible for a man from his wife while she is menstruating. She said, "Anything above the waistcloth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَتْ عَائِشَةُ مَا يَحِلُّ لِلرَّجُلِ مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَتْ «مَا فَوْقَ الْإِزَارِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Maymūn b. Mihrān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي مَيْمُونُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1079

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked Aisha, "What is permissible for a man with his wife if she is menstruating?" She said, "Everything except for sexual intercourse." I then asked, "What is prohibited for him regarding her when they are both in a state of ritual impurity?" She said, "Everything except for conversation."   – Sound Chain

I then asked, "What is prohibited for him regarding her when they are both in a state of ritual impurity?" She said, "Everything except for conversation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ مَا يَحِلُّ لِلرَّجُلِ مِنَ امْرَأَتِهِ إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا؟ قَالَتْ «كُلُّ شَيْءٍ غَيْرُ الْجِمَاعِ» قَالَ قَلْتُ فَمَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْهَا إِذَا كَانَا مُحْرِمَيْنِ؟ قَالَ «كُلُّ شَيْءٍ غَيْرُ كَلَامِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿUyaynah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Jawshan \u003e Marwān al-Aṣfar \u003e Masrūq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا عُيَيْنَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جَوْشَنٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ الْأَصْفَرِ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1084

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was with the Messenger of Allah under his blanket, then I felt that I was menstruating as women do, so I slipped out from under the cover. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Are you menstruating?' I said: 'I feel that I am menstruating as women do.' He said: 'That is what Allah has decreed for the daughters of Adam.' So I slipped out and sorted myself out, then I came back, and the Messenger of Allah said to me: 'Come under the cover with me,' so I went in with him.'"     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I was with the Messenger of Allah under his blanket, then I felt that I was menstruating as women do, so I slipped out from under the cover. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Are you menstruating?' I said: 'I feel that I am menstruating as women do.' He said: 'That is what Allah has decreed for the daughters of Adam.' So I slipped out and sorted myself out, then I came back, and the Messenger of Allah said to me: 'Come under the cover with me,' so I went in with him.'"     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي لِحَافٍ فَوَجَدْتُ مَا تَجِدُ النِّسَاءُ فَقُمْتُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا لَكِ أَنَفِسْتِ؟» قُلْتُ وَجَدْتُ مَا تَجِدُ النِّسَاءُ قَالَ «ذَاكَ مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى بَنَاتِ آدَمَ» قَالَتْ فَقُمْتُ فَأَصْلَحْتُ مِنْ شَأْنِي ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «ادْخُلِي فِي اللِّحَافِ» فَدَخَلْتُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd And Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1085

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: While I was laying with the Prophet ﷺ under a single woolen sheet, I got the menses. I slipped away and put on the clothes for menses. He said, "Have you got "Nifas" (menses)?" I replied, "Yes." He then called me and made me lie with him under the same sheet.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: While I was laying with the Prophet ﷺ under a single woolen sheet, I got the menses. I slipped away and put on the clothes for menses. He said, "Have you got "Nifas" (menses)?" I replied, "Yes." He then called me and made me lie with him under the same sheet.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مُضْطَجِعَةٌ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ إِذْ حِضْتُ فَانْسَلَلْتُ فَأَخَذْتُ ثِيَابَ حِيضَتِي فَقَالَ «أَنَفِسْتِ؟» قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَتْ «فدَعَانِي فَاضْطَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فِي الْخَمِيلَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām al-Dastawāʾī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Zaynab b. Um Salamah \u003e Um Salamah \u003e Baynā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to have sexual relations with his wives while they were wearing their waist wrappers during menstruation."   – Sound Chain

hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would tell one of us, if she was menstruating, to tie her Izar (waist wrap) tightly then he would fondle her."    – Sound Chain

hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to wrap me while I was menstruating, and a piece of cloth would come between his forehead and me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَتَوَشَّحُنِي وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ وَيُصِيبُ مِنْ رَأْسِي وَبَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ ثَوْبٌ»   – إسناده صحيح

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1093

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: Among the jews, when a women menstruated, they ejected her from the house, and they did not eat with her, nor did they drink with her, nor did they associate with her in (their houses) so the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) was questioned about that. Thereupon Allah revealed : “They question thee concerning menstruation. Say : I: is an illness, so let woman alone at such times” (ii 222). The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) then said: Associate with them in the houses and do everything except sexual intercourse. Thereupon the Jews said: This man does not want to leave anything we do without opposing us in it. Usaid b. Hudair and Abbad b. Bishr came and said: Messenger of Allah, the jews are saying such and such a thing. Shall we not then have intercourse with women during mensuration? The face of the Apostle Allah ﷺ underwent such a change that we thought he was angry with them; but when they went out they received a gift of milk which was being brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he sent after them and gave them a drink, whereupon we thought that he was not angry with them.     – Sound Chain

Bishr came and said: Messenger of Allah, the jews are saying such and such a thing. Shall we not then have intercourse with women during mensuration? The face of the Apostle Allah ﷺ underwent such a change that we thought he was angry with them; but when they went out they received a gift of milk which was being brought to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he sent after them and gave them a drink, whereupon we thought that he was not angry with them.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الْيَهُودُ كَانُوا إِذَا حَاضَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فِيهِمْ لَمْ يُؤَاكِلُوهَا وَلَمْ يُشَارِبُوهَا وَأَخْرَجُوهَا مِنَ الْبَيْتِ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ مَعَهُمْ فِي الْبُيُوتِ فَسُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى} [البقرة 222] «فَأَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّ يُؤَاكِلُوهُنَّ وَأَنْ يُشَارِبُوهُنَّ وَأَنْ يَكُنَّ مَعَهُمْ فِي الْبُيُوتِ وَأَنْ يَفْعَلُوا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ مَا خَلَا النِّكَاحَ» فَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودَ مَا يُرِيدُ هَذَا أَنْ يَدَعَ شَيْئًا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا إِلَّا خَالَفَنَا فِيهِ فَجَاءَ عَبَّادُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ وَأُسَيْدُ بْنُ حُضَيْرٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهُ ﷺ فَأَخْبَرَاهُ بِذَلِكَ وَقَالَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَلَا نَنْكِحُهُنَّ فِي الْمَحِيضِ؟ فَتَمَعَّرَ وَجْهُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَمَعُّرًا شَدِيدًا حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ قد وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِمَا فَقَامَا فَخَرَجَا فَاسْتَقْبَلَتْهُمَا هَدِيَّةُ لَبَنٍ فَبَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي آثَارِهِمَا فَرَدَّهُمَا فَسَقَاهُمَا فَعَلِمْنَا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَغْضَبْ عَلَيْهِمَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1094

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: About the man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating on the same blanket, he said, "As for us, the family of Umar, we avoid them when they are menstruating."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About the man who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating on the same blanket, he said, "As for us, the family of Umar, we avoid them when they are menstruating."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُضَاجِعُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ فِي لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ فَقَالَ «أَمَّا نَحْنُ آلَ عُمَرَ فَنَهْجُرُهُنَّ إِذَا كُنَّ حُيَّضًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Abū Hilāl \u003e Shaybah b. Hishām al-Rāsibī \u003e Saʾalt Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ حَدَّثَنِي شَيْبَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ الرَّاسِبِيُّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1095

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no harm in the grace and beauty of a woman as long as she is not in a state of janabah (impurity) or menstruating."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no harm in the grace and beauty of a woman as long as she is not in a state of janabah (impurity) or menstruating."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا بَأْسَ بِفَضْلِ وَضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ جُنُبًا أَوْ حَائِضًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1096

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: "She puts it in a place, which means on the vagina."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "She puts it in a place, which means on the vagina."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَضَعُهُ وَضْعًا يَعْنِي عَلَى الْفَرْجِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ghaylān \u003e al-Ḥakam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ غَيْلَانَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1097

chapter.englishTitle: The onset of menstruation

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ would contact and embrace any of his wives while she was menstruating. She would wear the wrapper up to half the the thighs or cover her knees with it.     – Sound
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ would contact and embrace any of his wives while she was menstruating. She would wear the wrapper up to half the the thighs or cover her knees with it.     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يُبَاشِرُ الْمَرْأَةَ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ إِذَا كَانَ عَلَيْهَا إِزَارٌ يَبْلُغُ أَنْصَافَ الْفَخِذَيْنِ أَوِ الرُّكْبَتَيْنِ مُحْتَجِزَةً بِهِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Ḥabīb a freed slave of ʿUrwah \u003e Nudbah Mawlāh Maymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ عَنْ حَبِيبٍ مَوْلَى عُرْوَةَ عَنْ نُدْبَةَ مَوْلَاةِ مَيْمُونَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1098

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I used to comb the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when I was menstruating."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I used to comb the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when I was menstruating."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ أُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1099

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I used to comb the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when I was menstruating."    – Sound
hadiths.body: "I used to comb the hair of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when I was menstruating."    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ أُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid \u003e Mālik \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
