hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1100

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Be the servants of Ibn Umar who, while they are menstruating, wash his feet and give him the wine."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "Be the servants of Ibn Umar who, while they are menstruating, wash his feet and give him the wine."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّ جَوَارِي ابْنِ عُمَرَ «يَغْسِلْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَهُنَّ حُيَّضٌ وَيُعْطِينَهُ الْخُمْرَةَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1101

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was given a cup, so I put it to my mouth and drank while I was menstruating. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his mouth on the same spot where I had placed mine and drank. I was given a piece of cloth, so I sniffed it, and then he placed his mouth on the same spot where I had placed mine and sniffed it. Then he commanded me to wear a garment even though I was menstruating, and he would have intimacy with me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I was given a cup, so I put it to my mouth and drank while I was menstruating. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his mouth on the same spot where I had placed mine and drank. I was given a piece of cloth, so I sniffed it, and then he placed his mouth on the same spot where I had placed mine and sniffed it. Then he commanded me to wear a garment even though I was menstruating, and he would have intimacy with me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ أُوتَى بِالْإِنَاءِ فَأَضَعُ فَمِي فَأَشْرَبُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ فَيَضَعُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَمَهُ عَلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتُ فَيَشْرَبُ وَأُوتَى بِالْعَرْقِ فَأَنْتَهِسُ فَيَضَعُ فَاهُ عَلَى الْمَكَانِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتُ فَيَنْتَهِسُ ثُمَّ يَأْمُرُنِي فَأَتَّزِرُ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ وَكَانَ يُبَاشِرُنِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Miqdām b. Shurayḥ b. Hāniʾ from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ هَانِئٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1102

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said, "The menstruating woman is not in control of her menstruation. She washes her hands, kneads, and discards."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said, "The menstruating woman is not in control of her menstruation. She washes her hands, kneads, and discards."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ «الْحَائِضُ لَيْسَتِ الْحِيضَةُ فِي يَدِهَا تَغْسِلُ يَدَهَا وَتَعْجِنُ وَتَنْبِذُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1103

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to say, "Indeed, the menstruation of a woman is not within her control." And he used to say, "Menstruation is a sign of life."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He used to say, "Indeed, the menstruation of a woman is not within her control." And he used to say, "Menstruation is a sign of life."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ يَقُولُ «إِنَّ الْحَائِضَ حِيضَتُهَا لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِهَا وَكَانَ يَقُولُ الْحَائِضُ حُبُّ الْحَيِّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Zayd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1104

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding shaking hands with a Jew, a Christian, a Zoroastrian, and a menstruating woman, "He did not see any impurity in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding shaking hands with a Jew, a Christian, a Zoroastrian, and a menstruating woman, "He did not see any impurity in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُصَافَحَةِ الْيَهُودِيِّ وَالنَّصْرَانِيِّ وَالْمَجُوسِيِّ وَالْحَائِضِ «فَلَمْ يَرَ فِيهِ وُضُوءًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Saʾalt Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1105

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in the mosque, so he said to the servant girl, "Pass me the khumrah (cloth)." She intended to spread it out and he would pray on it. She said, "Indeed, I am experiencing menstruation." He said, "Indeed, her menstruation is not in her hands."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in the mosque, so he said to the servant girl, "Pass me the khumrah (cloth)." She intended to spread it out and he would pray on it. She said, "Indeed, I am experiencing menstruation." He said, "Indeed, her menstruation is not in her hands."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ لِلْجَارِيَةِ «نَاوِلِينِي الْخُمْرَةَ» قَالَتْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْسُطَهَا وَيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهَا حَائِضٌ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ حِيضَهَا لَيْسَ فِي يَدِهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Ismāʿīl al-Suddī \u003e ʿAbdullāh al-Bahī \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ السُّدِّيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَهِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1106

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ would put his head out for me while he was performing I'tikaf [1] and I would wash it, when I was menstruating." [1] Mujawir ("next door") here means while performing I'tikaf.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ would put his head out for me while he was performing I'tikaf [1] and I would wash it, when I was menstruating." [1] Mujawir ("next door") here means while performing I'tikaf.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُخْرِجُ إِلَيَّ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَغْسِلُهُ يَعْنِي وَهُوَ مُعْتَكِفٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Fuḍayl b. ʿIyāḍ \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Tamīm b. Salamah \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1107

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: "To make ablution is the duty of a menstruating woman who is sick."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To make ablution is the duty of a menstruating woman who is sick."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تُوَضِّئَ الْحَائِضُ الْمَرِيضَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ كَانَ «لَا يَرَى بَأْسًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1108

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: I used to wash the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, while I was in a state of menstruation.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I used to wash the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, while I was in a state of menstruation.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُ رَأْسَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Jaʿfar b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1109

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: I used to wash the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while I was in a state of menstruation, and he was in I'tikaf.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I used to wash the head of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while I was in a state of menstruation, and he was in I'tikaf.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَغْسِلُ رَأْسَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ وَهُوَ عَاكِفٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Tamīm b. Salamah \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1110

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Dhabi sent a message to Ibrahim asking him about performing ablution (wudu) for a sick person. Ibrahim said, "Yes, and support him." Abu Dhabi said, "No." So I asked Al-Mughirah, "Did you hear this from Ibrahim?" He said, "No." Abu Abdullah said, "And support him?" Meaning in prayer.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Dhabi sent a message to Ibrahim asking him about performing ablution (wudu) for a sick person. Ibrahim said, "Yes, and support him." Abu Dhabi said, "No." So I asked Al-Mughirah, "Did you hear this from Ibrahim?" He said, "No." Abu Abdullah said, "And support him?" Meaning in prayer.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَرْسَلَ أَبُو ظَبْيَانَ إِلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الْحَائِضِ تُوَضِّئُ الْمَرِيضَ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَتُسْنِدُهُ» قَالَ لَا فَقُلْتُ لِلْمُغِيرَةِ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ؟ قَالَ لَا قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَتُسْنِدُهُ؟ يَعْنِي فِي الصَّلَاةِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Arsal Abū Ẓabyān \u003e Ibrāhīm Yasʾaluh \u003e al-Ḥāʾiḍ Tuwaḍḍiʾ al-Marīḍ \u003e Naʿam And Tusniduh \u003e Lā \u003e Lilmughīrah Samiʿtah from Ibrāhīm \u003e Lā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُغِيرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1111

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said to her, "Pass me the vessel." She said, "I am menstruating." He said, "Verily, it is not in your hands."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said to her, "Pass me the vessel." She said, "I am menstruating." He said, "Verily, it is not in your hands."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهَا «نَاوِلِينِي الْخُمْرَةَ» قَالَتْ «إِنِّي حَائِضٌ» قَالَ «إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ فِي يَدِكِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Thābit b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1112

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: About a menstruating woman drinking water to perform ablution? He laughed and said, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a menstruating woman drinking water to perform ablution? He laughed and said, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ حَائِضٍ شَرِبَتْ مِنْ مَاءٍ أَيُتَوَضَّأُ بِهِ؟ فَضَحِكَ وَقَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Kathīr b. Shinẓīr \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Suʾil \u003e Āmraʾah Ḥāʾiḍ Sharibat from Māʾ Ayutawaḍḍaʾ Bih Faḍaḥik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ شِنْظِيرٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1113

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about eating with a menstruating woman. He replied, "Eat with her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about eating with a menstruating woman. He replied, "Eat with her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنْ مُؤَاكَلَةِ الْحَائِضِ؟ قَالَ «وَاكِلْهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Mahdī \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Ḥarām b. Ḥakīm from his uncle ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ حَرَامِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1114

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: To drink wine from the mosque and then say "I am menstruating" and he says, "Indeed, your menstruation is not in your palm, so you can drink it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: To drink wine from the mosque and then say "I am menstruating" and he says, "Indeed, your menstruation is not in your palm, so you can drink it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تُنَاوِلَهُ الْخُمْرَةَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَتَقُولُ إِنِّي حَائِضٌ فَيَقُولُ «إِنَّ حِيضَتَكِ لَيْسَتْ فِي كَفِّكِ فَتُنَاوِلُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَأْمُرُ جَارِيَتَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1115

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about eating with a menstruating woman. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, some of my family members are menstruating, and we are a large group, God willing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about eating with a menstruating woman. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, some of my family members are menstruating, and we are a large group, God willing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ مُؤَاكَلَةِ الْحَائِضِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ بَعْضَ أَهْلِي لَحَائِضٌ وَإِنَّا لَمُتَعَشُّونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ جَمِيعًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e al-Haytham b. Ḥumayd \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Ḥarām b. Ḥakīm \u003e ʿAmmih
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ حَرَامِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1116

chapter.englishTitle: The wife combs her husband's hair.

hadiths.englishRaw: "To touch the menstruating woman with wine."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To touch the menstruating woman with wine."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَمَسَّ الْحَائِضُ الْخُمْرَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Kānat Lā Tará Baʾs
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ «لَا تَرَى بَأْسًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1117

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: About Mujahid's statement, "When a woman in her menstrual period becomes pure from the blood, her husband should not approach her until she has performed ablution."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Mujahid's statement, "When a woman in her menstrual period becomes pure from the blood, her husband should not approach her until she has performed ablution."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي «الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ مِنَ الدَّمِ لَا يَقْرَبُهَا زَوْجُهَا حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Hushaym \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm And Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan And ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُغِيرَةُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَيُونُسُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ وَعَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1118

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: About a Mujahid like him, equally.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a Mujahid like him, equally.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ مِثْلَهُ سَوَاءً   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1119

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: Sufyan was asked if a man should have intercourse with his wife when her period stops before she performs the ritual purification. He replied, "No." It was then asked, "What if she delays the ritual purification for two days or several days?" He said, "She should seek repentance."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Sufyan was asked if a man should have intercourse with his wife when her period stops before she performs the ritual purification. He replied, "No." It was then asked, "What if she delays the ritual purification for two days or several days?" He said, "She should seek repentance."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ سُفْيَانُ أَيُجَامِعُ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ إِذَا انْقَطَعَ عَنْهَا الدَّمُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ؟ فَقَالَ «لَا» فَقِيلَ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ تَرَكَتِ الْغُسْلَ يَوْمَيْنِ أَوْ أَيَّامًا قَالَ «تُسْتَتَابُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1120

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: From Mujahid, he said: "And do not approach them until they are pure." [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:222] He also said: "Until the bleeding stops." [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:222] He said: "Once they have performed ablution."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From Mujahid, he said: "And do not approach them until they are pure." [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:222] He also said: "Until the bleeding stops." [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:222] He said: "Once they have performed ablution."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ {وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «حَتَّى يَنْقَطِعَ الدَّمُ» {فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «إِذَا اغْتَسَلْنَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān ʿAmman \u003e Mujāhid And Lā Taqrabūhun Ḥattá Yaṭhurn al-Bqrh 222 \u003e Ḥattá Yanqaṭiʿ al-Dam Faʾidhā Taṭahharn al-Bqrh 222
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1121

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When blood ceases to flow" [then when you have purified yourselves] [Al-Baqarah 222] He said, "Wash yourselves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When blood ceases to flow" [then when you have purified yourselves] [Al-Baqarah 222] He said, "Wash yourselves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا انْقَطَعَ الدَّمُ» {فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «اغْتَسَلْنَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ \u003e Mujāhid Ḥattá Yaṭhurn al-Bqrh 222 \u003e Idhā Ānqaṭaʿ al-Dam Faʾidhā Taṭahharn al-Bqrh 222
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ {حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ} [البقرة 222] قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1122

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Until the prayer is established for it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Until the prayer is established for it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا حَتَّى تَحِلَّ لَهَا الصَّلَاةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad \u003e Saʾalt Mujāhid \u003e Āmraʾah Raʾat al-Ṭuhr Ayaḥil Lizawjihā \u003e Yaʾtīwahā Qabl \u003e Taghtasil
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ الْأَسْوَدِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ مُجَاهِدًا عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ رَأَتِ الطُّهْرَ أَيَحِلُّ لِزَوْجِهَا أَنْ يَأْتِيَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1123

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: "It does not cover her until she bathes."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "It does not cover her until she bathes."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَغْشَاهَا حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid \u003e Ibn Ziyād \u003e al-Ḥajjāj b. Arṭāh \u003e Saʾalt ʿAṭāʾ And Maymūn b. Mihrān \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ هُوَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَرْطَاةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَطَاءً وَمَيْمُونَ بْنَ مِهْرَانَ وَحَدَّثَنِي حَمَّادٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1124

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the man who steps on his wife while she has seen her period before she takes a ritual bath (ghusl), Al-Hasan said: "She is considered menstruating until she takes a bath, and he is required to perform the expiation (kaffarah), and he may not approach her until she takes a bath."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the man who steps on his wife while she has seen her period before she takes a ritual bath (ghusl), Al-Hasan said: "She is considered menstruating until she takes a bath, and he is required to perform the expiation (kaffarah), and he may not approach her until she takes a bath."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَطَأُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَقَدْ رَأَتِ الطُّهْرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ؟ قَالَ «هِيَ حَائِضٌ مَا لَمْ تَغْتَسِلْ وَعَلَيْهِ الْكَفَّارَةُ وَلَهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا مَا لَمْ تَغْتَسِلْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1125

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Her husband does not overshadow her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Her husband does not overshadow her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَغْشَاهَا زَوْجُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1126

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani saying, "By Allah, I do not have sexual intercourse with my wife on the day she becomes pure until a day passes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Uqbah ibn Amir al-Juhani saying, "By Allah, I do not have sexual intercourse with my wife on the day she becomes pure until a day passes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ يَقُولُ وَاللَّهِ «إِنِّي لَا أُجَامِعُ امْرَأَتِي فِي الْيَوْمِ الَّذِي تَطْهُرُ فِيهِ حَتَّى يَمُرَّ يَوْمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah b. Shurayḥ \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū al-Khayr Marthad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Yazanī \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir al-Juhanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَزِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو الْخَيْرِ مَرْثَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيُّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1127

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding generosity in a woman, you witness purity. Does her husband approach her before she has cleansed herself?" He replied, "No, until she has cleansed herself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding generosity in a woman, you witness purity. Does her husband approach her before she has cleansed herself?" He replied, "No, until she has cleansed herself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَرَى الطُّهْرَ أَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ قَالَ «لَا حَتَّى تَغْتَسِلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1128

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If hunger overtakes him, she will wash her private parts and then come to him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If hunger overtakes him, she will wash her private parts and then come to him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنْ أَدْرَكَهُ الشَّبَقُ غَسَلَتْ فَرْجَهَا ثُمَّ أَتَاهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Layth b. Abū Sulaym
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ لَيْثِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهَا الدَّمُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1129

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مُجَامَعَةِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ
chapter.englishTitle: The heading translates to: "The ruling of a menstruating woman i...

hadiths.englishRaw: "To be from the hadith of Layth, which I do not know from the hadith of Abdul Malik," said Abu Muhammad Al-Shabiq, who desires it.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "To be from the hadith of Layth, which I do not know from the hadith of Abdul Malik," said Abu Muhammad Al-Shabiq, who desires it.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَكُونَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ لَيْثٍ لَا أَعْرِفُهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الشَّبِقُ الَّذِي يَشْتَهِي   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Farwah b. Abū al-Maghrāʾ \u003e Sharīk And Saʾalah a man \u003e al-Marʾah Yanqaṭiʿ \u003e Hā al-Dam Ayaʾtīhā Zawjuhā Qabl \u003e Taghtasil \u003e Qāl ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ شَرِيكًا وَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ الْمَرْأَةُ يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْهَا الدَّمُ أَيَأْتِيهَا زَوْجُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ؟ فَقَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ أَنَّهُ «رَخَّصَ فِي ذَلِكَ لِلشَّبِقِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «أَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَخْطَأَ وأَخَافُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1130

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw women from the women of the city praying in khidab."
hadiths.body: "I saw women from the women of the city praying in khidab."
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُ نِسَاءً مِنْ نِسَاءِ الْمَدِينَةِ يُصَلِّينَ فِي الْخِضَابِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Zaʿam Lanā Hushaym \u003e Abū Ḥurrah Wāṣil b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى قَالَ زَعَمَ لَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ أَبِي حُرَّةَ وَاصِلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1131

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I would rather have my hand cut off with knives than that."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "I would rather have my hand cut off with knives than that."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «لَأَنْ تُقْطَعَ يَدِي بِالسَّكَاكِينِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ ʿAmman \u003e ʿĀʾishah Suʾilat \u003e al-Marʾah Tamsaḥ \u003e al-Khiḍāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ سُئِلَتْ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْخِضَابِ فَقَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1132

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays...

hadiths.englishRaw: "That a woman asked Aisha: Does the woman pray in her Khidab? She said, 'She should shorten it and widen it.' Abu Muhammad said, 'Abu Sa'id, he is the son of Abu Al-Anbas, and the name of Abu Al-Anbas is Sa'eed bin Kathir bin 'Ubayd.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "That a woman asked Aisha: Does the woman pray in her Khidab? She said, 'She should shorten it and widen it.' Abu Muhammad said, 'Abu Sa'id, he is the son of Abu Al-Anbas, and the name of Abu Al-Anbas is Sa'eed bin Kathir bin 'Ubayd.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتْ عَائِشَةَ تُصَلِّي الْمَرْأَةُ فِي الْخِضَابِ قَالَتْ «اسْلُتِيهِ وَرَغْمًا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «أَبُو سَعِيدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي الْعَنَبْسِ وَاسْمُ أَبِي الْعَنَبْسِ سَعِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1133

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Our women should wear cosmetics at night, and when they wake up, they should remove it, perform ablution, and pray. After the prayer, they should wear cosmetics again. If it is the time of Dhuhr prayer, they should remove it, perform ablution, and pray with perfect adornments. It should not prevent them from praying."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Our women should wear cosmetics at night, and when they wake up, they should remove it, perform ablution, and pray. After the prayer, they should wear cosmetics again. If it is the time of Dhuhr prayer, they should remove it, perform ablution, and pray with perfect adornments. It should not prevent them from praying."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّ نِسَاؤُنَا يَخْتَضِبْنَ بِاللَّيْلِ فَإِذَا أَصْبَحْنَ فَتَحْنَهُ فَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ ثُمَّ يَخْتَضِبْنَ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الظُّهْرِ فَتَحْنَهُ فَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ بِأَحْسَنِ خِضَابٍ وَلَا يَمْنَعُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū Mijlaz \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Kun Nisāʾunā Yakhtaḍib. Bi-al-Layl Faʾidhā Aṣbaḥn Fataḥnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1134

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays...

hadiths.englishRaw: That the wives of Ibn Umar used to wear their clothes tight and it was during their menstruation.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the wives of Ibn Umar used to wear their clothes tight and it was during their menstruation.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ نِسَاءَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «كُنَّ يَخْتَضِبْنَ وَهُنَّ حُيَّضٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1135

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَائِضِ تَخْتَضِبُ وَالْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي فِي الْخِضَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the woman's menstruation, she wears a pad and the woman prays...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Our women should wear their veils when they pray the last evening prayer. And when they wake up in the morning, they should remove it, perform ablution, pray. And when they pray the noon prayer, they should wear it, and when they intend to pray the afternoon prayer, they should remove it and make themselves beautiful and not neglect prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Our women should wear their veils when they pray the last evening prayer. And when they wake up in the morning, they should remove it, perform ablution, pray. And when they pray the noon prayer, they should wear it, and when they intend to pray the afternoon prayer, they should remove it and make themselves beautiful and not neglect prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّ نِسَاؤُنَا إِذَا صَلَّيْنَ الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ اخْتَضَبْنَ فَإِذَا أَصْبَحْنَ أَطْلَقْنَهُ وَتَوَضَّأْنَ وَصَلَّيْنَ وَإِذَا صَلَّيْنَ الظُّهْرَ اخْتَضَبْنَ فَإِذَا أَرَدْنَ أَنْ يُصَلِّينَ الْعَصْرَ أَطْلَقْنَهُ فَأَحْسَنَّ خِضَابَهُ وَلَا يَحْبِسنَ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hishām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū Mijlaz \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1136

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: From Aamer regarding someone who had relations with his wife while she was menstruating, they said, "It is a sin that has come upon him. He should seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him, and he should not repeat the act."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Aamer regarding someone who had relations with his wife while she was menstruating, they said, "It is a sin that has come upon him. He should seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him, and he should not repeat the act."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَامِرٍ فِيمَنْ أَتَى أَهْلَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَا «ذَنْبٌ أَتَاهُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَيَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ وَلَا يَعُودُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Hushaym \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm Wʾkhbrnā Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid \u003e ʿĀmir Fīman Atá Ahlah And Hī Ḥāʾiḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَنبَأَنَا مُغِيرَةُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وأخْبرنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1137

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: "About a person like him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "About a person like him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Abū Zāʾidah \u003e al-Muthanná
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1138

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: "The sin that came upon him, for which there is no atonement."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The sin that came upon him, for which there is no atonement."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ذَنْبٌ أَتَاهُ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ كَفَّارَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá And ʾAbū al-Nuʿmān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak \u003e Yaʿqūb b. al-Qaʿqāʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Zayd \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1139

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: "He apologizes to Allah and repents to Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He apologizes to Allah and repents to Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَعْتَذِرُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَيَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e Suʾil \u003e al--Adhī Yaʾtī Āmraʾatah And Hī Ḥāʾiḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1140

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: "You seek forgiveness from Allah and you have done nothing wrong." It means if something happens with your wife while she is menstruating.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "You seek forgiveness from Allah and you have done nothing wrong." It means if something happens with your wife while she is menstruating.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ شَيْءٌ» يَعْنِي إِذَا وَقَعَ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1141

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: "When An-Najashi died, the Prophet said: 'Pray for forgiveness for him."'     – Sound Due to External Factors
hadiths.body: "When An-Najashi died, the Prophet said: 'Pray for forgiveness for him."'     – Sound Due to External Factors
hadiths.arabic: «يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ»   – صحيح لغيره
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Bishr b. al-Mufaḍḍal \u003e Mālik b. al-Khaṭṭāb al-ʿAnbirī \u003e Ibn Abū Mulaykah \u003e Suʾil \u003e al-a man Yaʾtī Āmraʾatah And Hī Ḥāʾiḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ الْعَنْبِرِيِّ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ قَالَ سُئِلَ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1142

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw in my dream as if I urinated blood. He said, "Your wife comes to you while she is menstruating." He said, "Yes." He said, "Fear Allah and do not repeat it."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: I saw in my dream as if I urinated blood. He said, "Your wife comes to you while she is menstruating." He said, "Yes." He said, "Fear Allah and do not repeat it."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنِّي أَبُولُ دَمًا قَالَ «تَأْتِي امْرَأَتَكَ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلَا تَعُدْ»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e a man Atá Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1143

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: "Regarding the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he said, 'He seeks forgiveness from Allah.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Regarding the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he said, 'He seeks forgiveness from Allah.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَ «يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1144

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Al-Hasan say regarding the one who breaks their fast for one day during Ramadan, he said, "They must free a slave, or fast for two consecutive months, or feed twenty to forty needy people, and for the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, the same applies."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Al-Hasan say regarding the one who breaks their fast for one day during Ramadan, he said, "They must free a slave, or fast for two consecutive months, or feed twenty to forty needy people, and for the one who has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, the same applies."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ فِي الَّذِي يُفْطِرُ يَوْمًا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ «عَلَيْهِ عِتْقُ رَقَبَةٍ أَوْ بَدَنَةٌ أَوْ عِشْرِينَ صَاعًا لِأَرْبَعِينَ مِسْكِينًا وَفِي الَّذِي يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Yazīd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1145

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said about a man who has sexual intercourse with a menstruating woman: He should give one or half dinar as sadaqah.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said about a man who has sexual intercourse with a menstruating woman: He should give one or half dinar as sadaqah.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَ «يَتَصَدَّقُ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Sharīk \u003e Khuṣayf \u003e Miqsam \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1146

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: The judge hesitated, giving either a dinar or half a dinar as charity.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The judge hesitated, giving either a dinar or half a dinar as charity.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ أَوْ نِصْفِ دِينَارٍ» شَكَّ الْحَكَمُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd \u003e Miqsam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1147

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: Branches; as for my preservation, it is exalted. And as for so-and-so and so-and-so, they said it is not exalted. Some people said to me, inform us of your preservation and disregard what so-and-so and so-and-so said. He said, by Allah, I do not like that I live in this world for the length of Noah's lifespan ﷺ and I speak about this or remain silent about this. Abu Muhammad, Abdul Hamid bin Zaid bin Abdul Rahman bin Zaid bin Al-Khattab said, and he was the governor of Kufa during the reign of Umar ibn Abdul Aziz.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Branches; as for my preservation, it is exalted. And as for so-and-so and so-and-so, they said it is not exalted. Some people said to me, inform us of your preservation and disregard what so-and-so and so-and-so said. He said, by Allah, I do not like that I live in this world for the length of Noah's lifespan ﷺ and I speak about this or remain silent about this. Abu Muhammad, Abdul Hamid bin Zaid bin Abdul Rahman bin Zaid bin Al-Khattab said, and he was the governor of Kufa during the reign of Umar ibn Abdul Aziz.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: شُعْبَةُ أَمَّا حِفْظِي فَهُوَ مَرْفُوعٌ وَأَمَّا فُلَانٌ وَفُلَانٌ فَقَالَا غَيْرُ مَرْفُوعٍ قَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ حَدِّثْنَا بِحِفْظِكَ وَدَعْ مَا قَالَ فُلَانٌ وَفُلَانٌ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا أُحِبُّ أَنِّي عُمِّرْتُ فِي الدُّنْيَا عُمُرَ نُوحٍ ﷺ وَأَنِّي حَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا أَوْ سَكَتُّ عَنْ هَذَا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «عَبْدُ الحَمِيدِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحمَنِ بْنِ زَيدِ بْنِ الخَطَّابِ وَكَانَ وَالِيَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَلَى الْكُوفَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd \u003e Miqsam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الَّذِي يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ «يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ أَوْ نِصْفِ دِينَارٍ» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1148

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: "If she experiences it during menstruation, the compensation is a dinar, and if she experiences it after menstruation has stopped, the compensation is half a dinar."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "If she experiences it during menstruation, the compensation is a dinar, and if she experiences it after menstruation has stopped, the compensation is half a dinar."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَتَاهَا فِي دَمٍ فَدِينَارٌ وَإِذَا أَتَاهَا وَقَدِ انْقَطَعَ الدَّمُ فَنِصْفُ دِينَارٍ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm \u003e a man \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1149

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: the Prophet said about a man who had sexual intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating: "He should give half a Dinar in charity."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Prophet said about a man who had sexual intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating: "He should give half a Dinar in charity."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ «يَتَصَدَّقُ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Khuṣayf \u003e Miqsam \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ وَحَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1150

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: "That she experienced her menses before he approached her, then it happened to her, and she confirmed it to be true. So, she came to the Prophet ﷺ and he ordered (commanded) him to give charity with two fifth of a dinar."   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.body: "That she experienced her menses before he approached her, then it happened to her, and she confirmed it to be true. So, she came to the Prophet ﷺ and he ordered (commanded) him to give charity with two fifth of a dinar."   – Weak, Problematic
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَأْتِيَهَا اعْتَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ بِالْحَيْضِ فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ صَادِقَةٌ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَأَمَرَهُ «أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِخُمُسَيْ دِينَارٍ»   – ضعيف معضل
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Mālik \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Zayd b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ كَانَ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ امْرَأَةٌ تَكْرَهُ الْجِمَاعَ وَكَانَ إِذَا أَرَادَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1151

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "If a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating, and if the blood is abundant, he should give a dinar in charity. And if the blood is light, he should give half a dinar in charity."
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "If a man approaches his wife while she is menstruating, and if the blood is abundant, he should give a dinar in charity. And if the blood is light, he should give half a dinar in charity."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أَتَى الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ فَإِنْ كَانَ الدَّمُ عبيطًا فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِدِينَارٍ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ صُفْرَةً فَلْيَتَصَدَّقْ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ»
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Abū Jaʿfar al-Rāzī \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm \u003e Miqsam \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ الرَّازِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1152

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim said, "He seeks forgiveness from Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim said, "He seeks forgiveness from Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وقالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ «يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Miqsam \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Suʾil \u003e al--Adhī Yaʾtī Āmraʾatah And Hī Ḥāʾiḍ \u003e Yataṣaddaq Bidīnār or Biniṣf Dīnār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَ «يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ أَوْ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ»

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1153

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a man has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, then he must give a charity of one dinar."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If a man has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, then he must give a charity of one dinar."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا وَقَعَ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِدِينَارٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Idhā And Qaʿ \u003e Āmraʾatih Wahī Ḥāʾiḍ Faʿalayh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1154

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man named Ata who had intercourse with his wife while she was menstruating, he said, "He should give a charity of one dinar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man named Ata who had intercourse with his wife while she was menstruating, he said, "He should give a charity of one dinar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي رَجُلٍ جَامَعَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَ «يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1155

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: "He donates one dinar or half a dinar."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He donates one dinar or half a dinar."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ أَوْ نِصْفِ دِينَارٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e Miqsam \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1156

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Awza'i regarding a man who has sexual intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating or if she has seen purification and did not perform ritual purification, he said, "He should seek forgiveness from Allah and give charity of five dinars."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Awza'i regarding a man who has sexual intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating or if she has seen purification and did not perform ritual purification, he said, "He should seek forgiveness from Allah and give charity of five dinars."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ يَغْشَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ أَوْ رَأَتِ الطُّهْرَ وَلَمْ تَغْتَسِلْ قَالَ «يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَيَتَصَدَّقُ بِخُمُسِ دِينَارٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Saʿīd \u003e Shuʿayb b. Isḥāq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1157

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a man has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he should give half a dinar in charity." A man from the community said to him, "But Hasan (a narrator) said that one should just free a slave as atonement." He replied, "There is no restriction upon you in drawing closer to Allah to the best of your ability."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "When a man has intercourse with his wife while she is menstruating, he should give half a dinar in charity." A man from the community said to him, "But Hasan (a narrator) said that one should just free a slave as atonement." He replied, "There is no restriction upon you in drawing closer to Allah to the best of your ability."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا وَقَعَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِنِصْفِ دِينَارٍ» فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَإِنَّ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ يُعْتِقُ رَقَبَةً قَالَ «مَا أَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَقَرَّبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1158

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: He must perform the expiation

hadiths.englishRaw: "He is donating one dinar."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He is donating one dinar."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَتَصَدَّقُ بِدِينَارٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1159

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: The Ansar were not paying their dowries, while the Muhajirun were. A man from the Muhajirun married a woman from the Ansar, and he paid her dowry. However, the Ansari woman refused to accept it. She went to Umm Salamah and mentioned it to her. When the Prophet ﷺ arrived, the Ansari woman felt embarrassed and left. Umm Salamah then informed the Prophet about what had happened, and he said, "Call her to me." She was summoned and the Prophet said to her, "Your wives are like a cultivable land for you, so come to your land however you wish." [Quran 2:223] "Through one gate." And the gate signifies the only way.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Ansar were not paying their dowries, while the Muhajirun were. A man from the Muhajirun married a woman from the Ansar, and he paid her dowry. However, the Ansari woman refused to accept it. She went to Umm Salamah and mentioned it to her. When the Prophet ﷺ arrived, the Ansari woman felt embarrassed and left. Umm Salamah then informed the Prophet about what had happened, and he said, "Call her to me." She was summoned and the Prophet said to her, "Your wives are like a cultivable land for you, so come to your land however you wish." [Quran 2:223] "Through one gate." And the gate signifies the only way.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَتِ الْأَنْصَارُ لَا تُجَبِّي وَكَانَتِ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ تُجَبِّي فَتَزَوَّجَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فَجَبَّاهَا فَأَبَتِ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةُ فَأَتَتْ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهَا فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ اسْتَحْيَتِ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةُ وَخَرَجَتْ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «ادْعُوهَا لِي» فَدُعِيَتْ لَهُ فَقَالَ لَهَا {نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكَمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223] «صِمَامًا وَاحِدًا» وَالصِّمَامُ السَّبِيلُ الْوَاحِدُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUthmān b. Khuthaym \u003e Ibn Sābiṭ \u003e Saʾalt Ḥafṣah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Ibn Abū Bakr Qult Lahā Innī Urīd \u003e Asʾalak \u003e Shayʾ \u003e Astaḥyī \u003e Asʾalak \u003e h \u003e Sal Yā from my cousin ʿAmmā Badā Lak \u003e Asʾaluk
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سَابِطٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قُلْتُ لَهَا إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكِ عَنْ شَيْءٍ وَأَنَا أَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ أَسْأَلَكِ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَتْ سَلْ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي عَمَّا بَدَا لَكَ قَالَ أَسْأَلُكِ عَنْ إِتْيَانِ النِّسَاءِ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ فَقَالَتْ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1160

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: "To separate from them (feminine)"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To separate from them (feminine)"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَعْتَزِلُوهُنَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Muḥammad b. Salamah \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Abān b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Laqad ʿAraḍt al-Qurān \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Thalāth ʿAraḍāt Aqif ʿInd Kul Āyah Asʾaluh Fīm Unzilat And Fīm Kānat Faqult Yā Ibn ʿAbbās Araʾayt Qawl Allāh Taʿālá Faʾidhā Taṭahharn Faʾtūhun from Ḥayth Amarakum Allāh al-Bqrh 222 \u003e from Ḥayth Amarakum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ لَقَدْ عَرَضْتُ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ثَلَاثَ عَرَضَاتٍ أَقِفُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ آيَةٍ أَسْأَلُهُ فِيمَ أُنْزِلَتْ وَفِيمَ كَانَتْ؟ فَقُلْتُ يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَرَأَيْتَ قَوْلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1161

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Mujahid, "So come to them from where Allah has ordered you." He said, "We are commanded to come to them from where we have been forbidden." (Translation of Quran 2:222)   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Mujahid, "So come to them from where Allah has ordered you." He said, "We are commanded to come to them from where we have been forbidden." (Translation of Quran 2:222)   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ {فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «أُمِرُوا أَنْ يَأْتُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ نُهُوا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad \u003e Mujāhid Faʾtūhun from Ḥayth Amarakum Allāh al-Bqrh 222 \u003e Umirūā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1162

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: From Abu Razin: "So approach them from where Allah has commanded you." [Al-Baqarah 222]. He said, "From the front of purity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Abu Razin: "So approach them from where Allah has commanded you." [Al-Baqarah 222]. He said, "From the front of purity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ {فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «مِنْ قِبَلِ الطُّهْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1163

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: From Mujahid, he said "By Allah, it means the opposite."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: From Mujahid, he said "By Allah, it means the opposite."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ {وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ} [الشعراء 166] قَالَ «هُوَ وَاللَّهِ الْقُبُلُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Bazzāz \u003e Sharīk \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Muhājir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1164

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: From Ikrimah: "Your wives are a tilth for you, so approach your tilth when or how you will." [Surah Al-Baqarah 223]. He (Ikrimah) said: "Indeed, it refers to sexual intercourse."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Ikrimah: "Your wives are a tilth for you, so approach your tilth when or how you will." [Surah Al-Baqarah 223]. He (Ikrimah) said: "Indeed, it refers to sexual intercourse."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ {نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223] قَالَ «إِنَّمَا هُوَ الْفَرْجُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Khālid b. Rabāḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ رَبَاحٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1165

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Al-Hasan saying, "The Jews used to make it difficult for the Muslims by saying, 'O companions of Muhammad, it is not permissible for you to have relations with your wives except from one position.' Then Allah revealed, 'Your wives are a place of sowing of seed for you, so come to your place of cultivation however you wish' [Quran 2:223]. Thus, Allah made a distinction between the believers and their needs."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Al-Hasan saying, "The Jews used to make it difficult for the Muslims by saying, 'O companions of Muhammad, it is not permissible for you to have relations with your wives except from one position.' Then Allah revealed, 'Your wives are a place of sowing of seed for you, so come to your place of cultivation however you wish' [Quran 2:223]. Thus, Allah made a distinction between the believers and their needs."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ كَانَتِ الْيَهُودُ لَا تَأْلُو مَا شَدَّدَتْ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ يَا أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ إِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَأْتُوا نِسَاءَكُمْ إِلَّا مِنْ وَجْهٍ وَاحِدٍ قَالَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ {نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223] فَخَلَّى اللَّهُ بَيْنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَبَيْنَ حَاجَتِهِمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAlī b. ʿAlī al-Rifāʿī \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الرِّفَاعِيُّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1166

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: "Come to her from in front of her and from behind her, after he (someone) has been in the cemetery."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Come to her from in front of her and from behind her, after he (someone) has been in the cemetery."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ائْتِهَا مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهَا بَعْدَ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي الْمَأْتَى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Faʾtūā Ḥarthakum Anná Shiʾtum al-Bqrh 223 \u003e Āʾtihā from Bayn Yadayhā And from Khalfihā Baʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ {فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223] قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1167

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: During the time of pre-Islamic ignorance (jahiliyyah), the people used to create something similar to the practices of the Magi regarding menstruating women. When this was mentioned to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, the following verse was revealed: "And they ask you about menstruation. Say, 'It is harm, so keep away from wives during menstruation. And do not approach them until they are pure.' " [Quran 2:222] "So the matter regarding them did not increase except in severity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: During the time of pre-Islamic ignorance (jahiliyyah), the people used to create something similar to the practices of the Magi regarding menstruating women. When this was mentioned to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, the following verse was revealed: "And they ask you about menstruation. Say, 'It is harm, so keep away from wives during menstruation. And do not approach them until they are pure.' " [Quran 2:222] "So the matter regarding them did not increase except in severity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يَصْنَعُونَ فِي الْحَائِضِ نَحْوًا مِنْ صَنِيعِ الْمَجُوسِ فَذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَنَزَلَتْ {وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ} [البقرة 222] «فَلَمْ يَزْدَدِ الْأَمْرُ فِيهِنَّ إِلَّا شِدَّةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ \u003e ʿAbd al-Wahhāb \u003e Khālid \u003e ʿIkrimah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1168

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Mujahid, say "It is harmful." [Al-Baqarah 222]. He said, "It is blood."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Mujahid, say "It is harmful." [Al-Baqarah 222]. He said, "It is blood."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ {قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «هُوَ الدَّمُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Khalīfah \u003e Muʾammal \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ \u003e Mujāhid Qul \u003e Adhá al-Bqrh 222
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا مُؤَمَّلٌ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1169

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: About Qatada, he said about the verse "Say: It is a harm" [Al-Baqarah 222], "It means it is impure."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Qatada, he said about the verse "Say: It is a harm" [Al-Baqarah 222], "It means it is impure."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ قَتَادَةَ {قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «قَذَرٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar \u003e Qatādah Qul \u003e Adhá al-Bqrh 222
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1170

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: "If you want, stay away, and if you want, do not stay away."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If you want, stay away, and if you want, do not stay away."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنْ شِئْتَ فَاعْزِلْ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَلَا تَعْزِلْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Khalīfah b. Khayyāṭ \u003e al-Muʿtamir \u003e Layth \u003e ʿĪsá b. Qays \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib Nisāʾukum Ḥarth Lakum Faʾtūā Ḥarthakum Anná Shiʾtum al-Bqrh 223 \u003e In Shiʾt Fāʿzil
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ بْنُ خَيَّاطٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ لَيْثًا يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ {نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223] قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1171

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: How you please, meaning enter her in the vagina.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: How you please, meaning enter her in the vagina.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَيْفَ شِئْتَ يَعْنِي ائتهَا فِي الْفَرْجِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khalīfah \u003e ʿAbd al-Wahhāb \u003e ʿAwf \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَلِيفَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1172

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Jews said to the Muslims: Whoever goes to his wife while she is turned away, his child will be illegitimate. So Allah, the Most High, revealed: 'Your wives are a place of cultivation for you, so come to your cultivation however you wish.' (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:223)"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Jews said to the Muslims: Whoever goes to his wife while she is turned away, his child will be illegitimate. So Allah, the Most High, revealed: 'Your wives are a place of cultivation for you, so come to your cultivation however you wish.' (Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:223)"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ قَالُوا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ مُدْبِرَةٌ جَاءَ وَلَدُهُ أَحْوَلَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223]   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Mālik \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1173

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ikrimah, {so come to your tilth as you wish} [Al-Baqarah 223], he said, "He approaches his spouse however he desires, whether standing, sitting, in front of her or behind her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ikrimah, {so come to your tilth as you wish} [Al-Baqarah 223], he said, "He approaches his spouse however he desires, whether standing, sitting, in front of her or behind her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ {فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223] قَالَ «يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ كَيْفَ شَاءَ قَائِمًا وَقَاعِدًا وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e ʿIkrimah Faʾtūā Ḥarthakum Anná Shiʾtum al-Bqrh 223
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1174

chapter.englishTitle: The arrival of women in their backyards

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, Allah says, "So come to them from where Allah has ordered you." [Al-Baqarah 222]. He said, "In the vagina."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, Allah says, "So come to them from where Allah has ordered you." [Al-Baqarah 222]. He said, "In the vagina."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ {فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ} [البقرة 222] قَالَ «فِي الْفَرْجِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd al-Ashaj \u003e Ibn Idrīs from his father \u003e Yazīd b. al-Walīd \u003e Ibrāhīm Faʾtūhun from Ḥayth Amarakum Allāh al-Bqrh 222
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَشَجُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1175

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever has sexual intercourse with his wife from behind, then he is like his wife from among men. Then recite (And they ask you about menstruation) [Al-Baqarah 2:222]. Say, it is a harm, so keep away from women during menstruation and do not approach them until they are pure. And when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has commanded you. Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves. Then recite (Your wives are a place of sowing of seed for you, so come to your place of cultivation however you wish) [Al-Baqarah 2:223], standing, sitting, facing or from behind in the vagina."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever has sexual intercourse with his wife from behind, then he is like his wife from among men. Then recite (And they ask you about menstruation) [Al-Baqarah 2:222]. Say, it is a harm, so keep away from women during menstruation and do not approach them until they are pure. And when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has commanded you. Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves. Then recite (Your wives are a place of sowing of seed for you, so come to your place of cultivation however you wish) [Al-Baqarah 2:223], standing, sitting, facing or from behind in the vagina."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا فَهُوَ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ مِثْلُهُ مِنَ الرَّجُلِ ثُمَّ تَلَا {وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ} [البقرة 222] قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ أَنْ تَعْتَزِلُوهُنَّ فِي الْمَحِيضِ الْفَرْجَ ثُمَّ تَلَا {نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223] قَائِمَةً وَقَاعِدَةً وَمُقْبِلَةً وَمُدْبِرَةً فِي الْفَرْجِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad \u003e Mujāhid
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1176

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever has intercourse with a menstruating woman, or with a woman in her rear, or who goes to a fortuneteller and believes what he says, he has disbelieved in that which was revealed to Muhammad.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever has intercourse with a menstruating woman, or with a woman in her rear, or who goes to a fortuneteller and believes what he says, he has disbelieved in that which was revealed to Muhammad.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَتَى حَائِضًا أَوِ امْرَأَةً فِي دُبُرِهَا أَوْ كَاهِنًا فَصَدَّقَهُ بِمَا يَقُولُ فَقَدْ كَفَرَ بِمَا أُنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥakīm al-Athram \u003e Abū Tamīmah al-Hujaymī \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حَكِيمٍ الْأَثْرَمِ عَنْ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ الْهُجَيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1177

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Oh Abu Abdullah Al-Rahman, should I bring my wife to wherever you want?" He said, "Yes." He said, "From where do you want?" He said, "Yes." He said, "And how do you want?" He said, "Yes." So a man said to him, "Oh Abu Abdullah Al-Rahman, this person intends harm." He said, "No, may women be prohibited upon you." Abdullah was asked, "Do you say this?" He said, "Yes."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Oh Abu Abdullah Al-Rahman, should I bring my wife to wherever you want?" He said, "Yes." He said, "From where do you want?" He said, "Yes." He said, "And how do you want?" He said, "Yes." So a man said to him, "Oh Abu Abdullah Al-Rahman, this person intends harm." He said, "No, may women be prohibited upon you." Abdullah was asked, "Do you say this?" He said, "Yes."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ آتِي امْرَأَتِي حَيْثُ شِئْتُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ وَمِنْ أَيْنَ شِئْتُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قَالَ وَكَيْفَ شِئْتُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّ هَذَا يُرِيدُ السُّوءَ قَالَ «لَا مَحَاشُّ النِّسَاءِ عَلَيْكُمْ حَرَامٌ» سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Abū Hilāl \u003e Abū ʿAbdullāh al-Shaqarī \u003e Abū al-Qaʿqāʿ al-Jarmī \u003e Jāʾ a man \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd \u003e Yā Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman Ātī Āmraʾatī Ḥayth Shiʾt \u003e Naʿam \u003e And from Ayn Shiʾt \u003e Naʿam \u003e Wakayf Shiʾt \u003e Naʿam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الشَّقَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الْقَعْقَاعِ الْجَرْمِيِّ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1178

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to dislike his husband visiting his wife from behind and he strongly criticized him for it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He used to dislike his husband visiting his wife from behind and he strongly criticized him for it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ «كَانَ يَكْرَهُ إِتْيَانَ الرَّجُلِ امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا وَيَعِيبُهُ عَيْبًا شَدِيدًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Dāwud \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1179

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Never has there been a nation more inclined towards men than the people of Lot."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Never has there been a nation more inclined towards men than the people of Lot."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا نَزَا ذَكَرٌ عَلَى ذَكَرٍ حَتَّى كَانَ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Ismāʿīl Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār Innakum Lataʾtūn al-Fāḥishah Mā Sabaqakum Bihā from Aḥad from al-ʿĀlamīn al-ʿNkbwt 28
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ {إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُمْ بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ} [العنكبوت 28] قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1180

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
