chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Whoever approaches his wife from behind, Allah the Almighty will not look at him on the Day of Judgment."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Whoever approaches his wife from behind, Allah the Almighty will not look at him on the Day of Judgment."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا لَمْ يَنْظُرِ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Suhayl b. Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Ḥārith b. Mukhallad \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ مُخَلَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1181

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: When any of you breaks wind during the prayer, he should turn away and perform ablution and repeat the prayer.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: When any of you breaks wind during the prayer, he should turn away and perform ablution and repeat the prayer.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا أَحْدَثَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ وَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yaḥyá \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād \u003e ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal \u003e ʿĪsá b. Ḥiṭṭān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ حِطَّانَ عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ سَلَّامٍ الْحَنَفِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ طَلْقٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1182

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked Ibn Umar, "What do you say about the slave girls when I discipline them?" He replied, "What do you mean by disciplining?" So I mentioned striking them on the buttocks, and he said, "Does anyone among the Muslims do that?"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I asked Ibn Umar, "What do you say about the slave girls when I discipline them?" He replied, "What do you mean by disciplining?" So I mentioned striking them on the buttocks, and he said, "Does anyone among the Muslims do that?"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِابْنِ عُمَرَ مَا تَقُولُ فِي الْجَوَارِي حِينَ أُحَمِّضُ لَهِنَّ؟ قَالَ «وَمَا التَّحْمِيضُ؟» فَذَكَرْتُ الدُّبُرَ فَقَالَ «هَلْ يَفْعَلُ ذَلكَ أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ؟»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e al-Ḥārith b. Yaʿqūb \u003e Saʿīd b. Yasār Abū al-Ḥubāb \u003e Liāb. ʿUmar Mā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1183

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the provided Arabic text into English is: "Regarding the matter of women in the council of Bani Waqif and what is said about them, Khuzayma bin Thabit said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'O people, Allah is not ashamed of the truth. Do not underestimate the abilities of women.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the provided Arabic text into English is: "Regarding the matter of women in the council of Bani Waqif and what is said about them, Khuzayma bin Thabit said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'O people, Allah is not ashamed of the truth. Do not underestimate the abilities of women.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: شَأْنَ النِّسَاءِ فِي مَجْلِسِ بَنِي وَاقِفٍ وَمَا يُؤْتَى مِنْهُنَّ فَقَالَ خُزَيْمَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ لَا تَأْتُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي أَعْجَازِهِنَّ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. Ḥuṣayn al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَوْمِي وَكَانَ مِنْ أَسْنَانِي حَدَّثَنِي هَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ تَذَاكَرْنَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1184

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: "They used to avoid women during their menstruation and approach them after they had purified themselves. They asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about this, so Allah revealed, 'And they ask you about menstruation. Say, it is harm, so keep away from wives during menstruation and do not approach them until they are cleansed. And when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has ordained for you.'" [Quran 2:222] "In their private parts and do not approach them unlawfully."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "They used to avoid women during their menstruation and approach them after they had purified themselves. They asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about this, so Allah revealed, 'And they ask you about menstruation. Say, it is harm, so keep away from wives during menstruation and do not approach them until they are cleansed. And when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has ordained for you.'" [Quran 2:222] "In their private parts and do not approach them unlawfully."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانُوا يَجْتَنِبُونَ النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ وَيَأْتُونَهُنَّ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ فَسَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّى يَطْهُرْنَ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ} [البقرة 222] «فِي الْفَرْجِ وَلَا تَعْدُوهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid \u003e Khuṣayf \u003e Mujāhid
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ حَدَّثَنَا خُصَيْفٌ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1185

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي دُبُرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who visited his wife from behind?

hadiths.englishRaw: About Tawus, Saeed, Mujahid, and Ata, they used to reject women coming from behind them and say, "It is disbelief."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Tawus, Saeed, Mujahid, and Ata, they used to reject women coming from behind them and say, "It is disbelief."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ طَاوُسٍ وَسَعِيدٍ وَمُجَاهِدٍ وَعَطَاءٍ أَنَّهُمْ «كَانُوا يُنْكِرُونَ إِتْيَانَ النِّسَاءِ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ الْكُفْرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd \u003e Yūnus b. Bukayr \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Abān b. Ṣāliḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبَانُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1186

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding cleanliness from janabah and menstruation, Ata and Al-Zuhri said, "Ghusl (full body wash) for both situations is the same."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding cleanliness from janabah and menstruation, Ata and Al-Zuhri said, "Ghusl (full body wash) for both situations is the same."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَالزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَا «الْغُسْلُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ وَالْحَيْضِ وَاحِدٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAṭāʾ And al-Zzuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1187

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: "to be interspersed with a few remaining fires on it"
hadiths.body: "to be interspersed with a few remaining fires on it"
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَخَلَّلَهُ نَارٌ قَلِيلَةُ الْبُقْيَا عَلَيْهِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Ḥudhayfah \u003e Liāmraʾatih Khallilī Shaʿrak Bi-al-Māʾ Qabl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ قَالَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ «خَلِّلِي شَعْرَكِ بِالْمَاءِ قَبْلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1188

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: Jumay' ibn Umayr, one of the sons of Banu Taym Allah ibn Tha'labah, said: Accompanied by my mother and aunt I entered upon Aisha. One of them asked her: How did you do while taking a bath? Aisha replied: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution (in the beginning) as he did for prayer. He then poured (water) upon his head three times. But we poured water upon our heads five times due to plaits.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Jumay' ibn Umayr, one of the sons of Banu Taym Allah ibn Tha'labah, said: Accompanied by my mother and aunt I entered upon Aisha. One of them asked her: How did you do while taking a bath? Aisha replied: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ablution (in the beginning) as he did for prayer. He then poured (water) upon his head three times. But we poured water upon our heads five times due to plaits.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلْتُ مَعَ أُمِّي وَخَالَتِي عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَسَأَلَتْهَا إِحْدَاهُمَا كَيْفَ تَصْنَعِينَ عِنْدَ الْغُسْلِ؟ فَقَالَتْ «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَتَطَهَّرُ طُهُورَهُ لِلصَّلَاةِ وَيُفِيضُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَنَحْنُ نُفِيضُ عَلَى رُءُوسِنَا خَمْسًا مِنْ أَجْلِ الضَّفْرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Zāʾidah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ صَدَقَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْحَنَفِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي جُمَيْعُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ أَحَدُ بَنِي تَيْمِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ثَعْلَبَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1189

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If it is worth a valley, even if you spend a pitcher in it? Indeed, it is enough for it to be emptied on its head three times."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If it is worth a valley, even if you spend a pitcher in it? Indeed, it is enough for it to be emptied on its head three times."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «بَخٍ وَإِنْ أَنْفَقَتْ فِيهِ أُوقِيَّةً؟ إِنَّمَا يَكْفِيهَا أَنْ تُفْرِغَ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا ثَلَاثًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Yazīd b. Zādhī \u003e Abū Zurʿah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زَاذِي عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَغْتَسِلُ تَنْقُضُ شَعْرَهَا؟ فَقَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1190

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: "She pierces it with her fingers."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "She pierces it with her fingers."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تُخَلِّلُهُ بِأَصَابِعِهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Khālid \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e Fuḍayl b. ʿAmr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1191

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: From Jabir, regarding "The woman in menstrual or postnatal bleeding pours the water and does not invalidate her wudu or (the state of) purity."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From Jabir, regarding "The woman in menstrual or postnatal bleeding pours the water and does not invalidate her wudu or (the state of) purity."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ جَابِرٍ فِي «الْحَائِضِ وَالْجُنُبِ يَصُبَّانِ الْمَاءَ صَبًّا وَلَا يَنْقُضَانِ شُعُورَهُمَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Khālid \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1192

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: "About a person like him"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "About a person like him"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Khālid \u003e Ḥajjāj
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1193

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim, when his roots and extremities are afflicted, they do not break.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim, when his roots and extremities are afflicted, they do not break.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِبْرَاهِيمُ «إِذَا بَلَّتْ أُصُولَهُ وَأَطْرَافَهُ لَمْ تَنْقُضْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1194

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the wives of Ibn Umar and the mothers of his children, when they perform ghusl (ritual purification bath), they do not break their vow (i.e. remain in a state of menstruation or post-intercourse impurity)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the wives of Ibn Umar and the mothers of his children, when they perform ghusl (ritual purification bath), they do not break their vow (i.e. remain in a state of menstruation or post-intercourse impurity)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ نِسَاءَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَأُمَّهَاتِ أَوْلَادِهِ كُنَّ إِذَا اغْتَسَلْنَ لَمْ يَنْقُضْنَ عِقَصَهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْضٍ وَلَا مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Nāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1195

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: She said, "Do not break your vow of abstinence (from sexual relations) during menstruation or after sexual impurity (janabah)."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: She said, "Do not break your vow of abstinence (from sexual relations) during menstruation or after sexual impurity (janabah)."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «لَا تَنْقُضْنَ عِقَصَكُنَّ مِنْ حَيْضٍ وَلَا مِنْ جَنَابَةٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e ʿAlī b. Zayd \u003e Um Muḥammad \u003e Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أُمِّ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1196

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: From Umm Salamah, the Prophet's wife ﷺ, she said, "A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, 'I have intense dandruff in my hair or a knot in it.' He said, 'Rub onto your head three handfuls of water and then wink at the end of each handful.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Umm Salamah, the Prophet's wife ﷺ, she said, "A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, 'I have intense dandruff in my hair or a knot in it.' He said, 'Rub onto your head three handfuls of water and then wink at the end of each handful.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي أَشُدُّ ضَفْرَ رَأْسِي أَوْ عُقَدَهُ قَالَ «احْفِنِي عَلَى رَأْسِكِ ثَلَاثَ حَفَنَاتٍ ثُمَّ اغْمِزِي عَلَى إِثْرِ كُلِّ حَفْنَةٍ غَمْزَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Saʿīd al-Maqburī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1197

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: He said to his wife, "Remove the hair, do not let it remain, as there is little fire remaining on it." Mansour (meaning semen) refers to impurity.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He said to his wife, "Remove the hair, do not let it remain, as there is little fire remaining on it." Mansour (meaning semen) refers to impurity.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ «اسْتَأْصِلِي الشَّعْرَ لَا تَخَلَّلُهُ نَارٌ قَلِيلٌ بُقْيَاهَا عَلَيْهِ» قَالَ مَنْصُورٌ يَعْنِي الْجَنَابَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Hammām b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Ḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1198

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: He said to his wife, "Remove the hair with water, do not use a little fire that would leave any residue on it."
hadiths.body: He said to his wife, "Remove the hair with water, do not use a little fire that would leave any residue on it."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ «اسْتَأْصِلِي الشَّعْرَ بِالْمَاءِ لَا تَخَلَّلُهُ نَارٌ قَلِيلٌ بُقْيَاهَا عَلَيْهِ»
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Jaʿfar b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Hammām b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Ḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1199

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a woman purifies herself from impurity, she should not undo her hair but rather pour water over its roots and wet it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "When a woman purifies herself from impurity, she should not undo her hair but rather pour water over its roots and wet it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ فَلَا تَنْقُضْ شَعْرَهَا وَلَكِنْ تَصُبُّ الْمَاءَ عَلَى أُصُولِهِ وَتَبُلُّهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1200

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding a woman's generosity, she may experience sexual impurity and her hair is partly cut. Tahlul explained, "No, but pour water on her head continuously to moisturize the roots of her hair."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding a woman's generosity, she may experience sexual impurity and her hair is partly cut. Tahlul explained, "No, but pour water on her head continuously to moisturize the roots of her hair."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُصِيبُهَا الْجَنَابَةُ وَرَأْسُهَا مَعْقُوصٌ تَحُلُّهُ قَالَ «لَا وَلَكِنْ تَصُبُّ عَلَى رَأْسِهَا الْمَاءَ صَبًّا حَتَّى تُرَوِّيَ أُصُولَ الشَّعْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1201

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: Aisha, the mother of the believers, said to me, "Can't any one of you, after being purified from menstruation, find some piece of cloth and use it as a wick? If you do not find a wick, then use some cotton. If you do not find cotton, then use some flax. If you do not find flax, then use some salt."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Aisha, the mother of the believers, said to me, "Can't any one of you, after being purified from menstruation, find some piece of cloth and use it as a wick? If you do not find a wick, then use some cotton. If you do not find cotton, then use some flax. If you do not find flax, then use some salt."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَتْ لِي عَائِشَةُ أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ «أَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُ إِحْدَاكُنَّ إِذَا تطَهُرَتْ مِنْ حَيْضِهَا أَنْ تتدَخِّنَ بشَيْء مِنْ قُسْطٍ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ فَشَيْئًا مِنْ آسٍ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ فَشَيْئًا مِنْ نَوًى فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ فَشَيْئًا مِنْ مِلْحٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Minhāl \u003e Ḥabībah b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAmrah b. Ḥbbān al-Sahmiyyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ حَدَّثَتْنِي حَبِيبَةُ بِنْتُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَتْنِي عَمْرَةُ بِنْتُ حبَّانَ السَّهْمِيَّةُ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1202

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a woman cleanses herself from menstruation, she should seek the traces of blood with a clean material."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When a woman cleanses herself from menstruation, she should seek the traces of blood with a clean material."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ فَلْتُمِسَّ أَثَرَ الدَّمِ بِطِيبٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Thābit b. Yazīd \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Muʿādhah al-ʿAdawiyyah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ الْعَدَوِيَّةِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1203

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اغْتِسَالِ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا وَجَبَ الْغُسْلُ عَلَيْهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَحِيضَ
chapter.englishTitle: Ghusl for Menstruating Women When Ghusl is Required Before the S...

hadiths.englishRaw: "That his wives and the mothers of his children used to perform ritual ablution from menstruation and post-sex impurity, but they would not undo their braids, rather they would leave them as they are."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "That his wives and the mothers of his children used to perform ritual ablution from menstruation and post-sex impurity, but they would not undo their braids, rather they would leave them as they are."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ نِسَاءَهُ وَأُمَّهَاتِ أَوْلَادِهِ كُنَّ يَغْتَسِلْنَ مِنَ الْحِيضَةِ وَالْجَنَابَةِ ثُمَّ لَا يَنْقُضْنَ شُعُورَهُنَّ وَلَكِنْ يُبَالِغْنَ فِي بَلِّهَا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1204

chapter.englishTitle: Entry of menstruating women into the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the menstruating woman should not consume anything from the mosque."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the menstruating woman should not consume anything from the mosque."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَتَنَاوَلَ الْحَائِضُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الشَّيْءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Lā Baʾs
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1205

chapter.englishTitle: Entry of menstruating women into the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: "The menstruating woman does not consume anything from the mosque and does not enter it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The menstruating woman does not consume anything from the mosque and does not enter it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَتَنَاوَلُ الْحَائِضُ الشَّيْءَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ وَلَا تَدْخُلُهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Jaʿfar b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1206

chapter.englishTitle: Entry of menstruating women into the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: "The person who is in a state of janabah (major ritual impurity) takes from the mosque but does not place anything in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The person who is in a state of janabah (major ritual impurity) takes from the mosque but does not place anything in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْجُنُبُ يَأْخُذُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ وَلَا يَضَعُ فِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e Hishām \u003e Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1207

chapter.englishTitle: Entry of menstruating women into the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding donating during menstruation, if a woman takes something from the mosque, he said, "Yes, except for the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding donating during menstruation, if a woman takes something from the mosque, he said, "Yes, except for the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْحَائِضِ تَنَاوَلُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الشَّيْءَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِلَّا الْمُصْحَفَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1208

chapter.englishTitle: The passage is in Arabic and it translates to "The Movement of t...

hadiths.englishRaw: He is the traveler.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He is the traveler.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي قَوْلِهِ {وَلَا جُنُبًا} [النساء 43] إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ قَالَ «هُوَ الْمُسَافِرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hishām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū Mijlaz
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1209

chapter.englishTitle: The passage is in Arabic and it translates to "The Movement of t...

hadiths.englishRaw: Anas reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, "The person in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) may pass through the mosque but should not sit in it." (Surah An-Nisa 43)   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Anas reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, "The person in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) may pass through the mosque but should not sit in it." (Surah An-Nisa 43)   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَنَسٍ {وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ} [النساء 43] قَالَ «الْجُنُبُ يَجْتَازُ الْمَسْجِدَ وَلَا يَجْلِسُ فِيهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Abū Jaʿfar \u003e Salm al-ʿAlawī \u003e Anas And Lā Junub Illā ʿĀbirī Sabīl al-Nsāʾ 43
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَلْمٌ الْعَلَوِيُّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1210

chapter.englishTitle: The passage is in Arabic and it translates to "The Movement of t...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The junub (one in a state of major ritual impurity) passes through the mosque without sitting in it." Then, he recited this verse: "And (also forbidden to you are) those who are impure due to sexual impurity unless they are passing through a road" [Quran 4:43].   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The junub (one in a state of major ritual impurity) passes through the mosque without sitting in it." Then, he recited this verse: "And (also forbidden to you are) those who are impure due to sexual impurity unless they are passing through a road" [Quran 4:43].   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْجُنُبُ يَمُرُّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَلَا يَقْعُدُ فِيهِ» ثُمَّ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ {وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ} [النساء 43]   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak And ʾAbū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Jazarī \u003e Abū ʿUbaydah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1211

chapter.englishTitle: The passage is in Arabic and it translates to "The Movement of t...

hadiths.englishRaw: Sa'id and another person said, "He passes by without staying in it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Sa'id and another person said, "He passes by without staying in it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سَعِيدٍ قَالَا «يَمُرُّ وَلَا يَقْعُدُ فِيهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Sharīk \u003e Simāk \u003e ʿIkrimah And Sālim \u003e Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ وَسَالِمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1212

chapter.englishTitle: The passage is in Arabic and it translates to "The Movement of t...

hadiths.englishRaw: "We used to walk in the mosque while we were in a state of impurity, and we didn't see any harm in that."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "We used to walk in the mosque while we were in a state of impurity, and we didn't see any harm in that."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نَمْشِي فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَنَحْنُ جُنُبٌ لَا نَرَى بِذَلِكَ بَأْسًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1213

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ وَلَمْ تَجِدِ الْمَاءَ
chapter.englishTitle: When a menstruating woman becomes pure and does not find water

hadiths.englishRaw: About the man, his wife is with him on a journey. Then she experiences menstruation and becomes pure but cannot find water. They said, "Perform Tayammum (dry ablution) and pray." I said to them, "Does her husband touch her?" They said, "Yes, prayer is more important than that."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About the man, his wife is with him on a journey. Then she experiences menstruation and becomes pure but cannot find water. They said, "Perform Tayammum (dry ablution) and pray." I said to them, "Does her husband touch her?" They said, "Yes, prayer is more important than that."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ تَكُونُ مَعَهُ امْرَأَتُهُ فِي سَفَرٍ فَتَحِيضُ ثُمَّ تَطْهُرُ وَلَا تَجِدُ الْمَاءَ قَالَا «تَتَيَمَّمُ وَتُصَلِّي» قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُمَا يَطَؤُهَا زَوْجُهَا؟ قَالَا «نَعَمْ الصَّلَاةُ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd \u003e Ḍamrah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Shawdhab \u003e Maṭar \u003e Saʾalt al-Ḥasan And ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا ضَمْرَةُ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ شَوْذَبٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ مَطَرٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ وَعَطَاءً

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1214

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَائِضِ إِذَا طَهُرَتْ وَلَمْ تَجِدِ الْمَاءَ
chapter.englishTitle: When a menstruating woman becomes pure and does not find water

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the act of perfuming oneself, a woman can still be considered purified even if she cannot find water. It was asked to Abdullah, "Do you say this?" He replied, "Yes, by Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the act of perfuming oneself, a woman can still be considered purified even if she cannot find water. It was asked to Abdullah, "Do you say this?" He replied, "Yes, by Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْهُرُ وَلَا تَجِدُ الْمَاءَ قَالَ «يُصِيبُهَا زَوْجُهَا إِذَا تَيَمَّمَتْ» سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ «إِي وَاللَّهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Ibn Jurayj
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1215

chapter.englishTitle: The boasting of the nation.

hadiths.englishRaw: In the excuse of the nation, if you are not menstruating, he said, "Forty-five."
hadiths.body: In the excuse of the nation, if you are not menstruating, he said, "Forty-five."
hadiths.arabic: فِي اسْتِبْرَاءِ الْأَمَةِ إِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَحِيضُ قَالَ «خَمْسَةً وَأَرْبَعِينَ»
hadiths.chain: Yazīd \u003e Sharīk \u003e Layth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1216

chapter.englishTitle: The boasting of the nation.

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "Three months."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "Three months."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ «ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd \u003e Sharīk \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e Abū Qilābah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ أَنبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1217

chapter.englishTitle: The boasting of the nation.

hadiths.englishRaw: About the man who buys the girl, she has not reached puberty nor is she pregnant. How long is her waiting period? He said, "Three months."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the man who buys the girl, she has not reached puberty nor is she pregnant. How long is her waiting period? He said, "Three months."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَبْتَاعُ الْجَارِيَةَ لَمْ تَبْلُغِ الْمَحِيضَ وَلَا تَحْمِلُ مِثْلُهَا كَمْ يَسْتَبْرِئُهَا؟ قَالَ «ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْهُرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-Wāḥid \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Saʾalt al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1218

chapter.englishTitle: The boasting of the nation.

hadiths.englishRaw: Yahya ibn Abi Kathir said, "For forty-five days."
hadiths.body: Yahya ibn Abi Kathir said, "For forty-five days."
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ «بِخمْسةٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا»

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1219

chapter.englishTitle: The boasting of the nation.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Which one do you prefer - three months more secure or one month is sufficient?" Abdullah said, "Three months are more secure, but one month is sufficient."
hadiths.body: "Which one do you prefer - three months more secure or one month is sufficient?" Abdullah said, "Three months are more secure, but one month is sufficient."
hadiths.arabic: «بِشَهْرٍ» سُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بِأَيِّهِمَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ «ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ أَوْثَقُ وَشَهْرٌ يَكْفِي»
hadiths.chain: al-Haytham b. Jamīl \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Yaḥyá b. Bishr \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Bishahr Suʾil ʿAbdullāh Biʾayyihimā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ بِشْرٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1220

chapter.englishTitle: In the excellence of prayers

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The example of the prescribed prayers is like a river flowing fresh at the door of one of you, from which he washes five times a day."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The example of the prescribed prayers is like a river flowing fresh at the door of one of you, from which he washes five times a day."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَثَلُ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْمَكْتُوبَاتِ كَمَثَلِ نَهَرٍ جَارٍ عَذْبٍ عَلَى بَابِ أَحَدِكُمْ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1221

chapter.englishTitle: In the excellence of prayers

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do you think that is there was a river by the door of any one of you, and he bathed in it five times each day, would there be any trace of dirt left on him?" They said: "No trace of dirt would be left on him." He said: "That is the likeness of the five daily prayers. By means of them Allah erases sins."     – Sound
hadiths.body: "Do you think that is there was a river by the door of any one of you, and he bathed in it five times each day, would there be any trace of dirt left on him?" They said: "No trace of dirt would be left on him." He said: "That is the likeness of the five daily prayers. By means of them Allah erases sins."     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «أَرَأَيْتُمْ لَوْ أَنَّ نَهَرًا بِبَابِ أَحَدِكُمْ يَغْتَسِلُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ مَاذَا تَقُولُونَ ذَلِكَ مُبْقِيًا مِنْ دَرَنِهِ؟» قَالُوا لَا يُبْقِي مِنْ دَرَنِهِ قَالَ «كَذَلِكَ مَثَلُ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِهِنَّ الْخَطَايَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1222

chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer times

hadiths.englishRaw: Jabir, the Prophet ﷺ used to pray Dhuhr when the sun starts declining, 'Asr when it is still a yellow or white glow, Maghrib when the sun sets, 'Isha sometimes early and sometimes delayed depending on the gathering of people. If they gathered early, he would pray early, and if they gathered late, he would pray late. As for Fajr, sometimes he would delay it or pray it with slight brightness.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Jabir, the Prophet ﷺ used to pray Dhuhr when the sun starts declining, 'Asr when it is still a yellow or white glow, Maghrib when the sun sets, 'Isha sometimes early and sometimes delayed depending on the gathering of people. If they gathered early, he would pray early, and if they gathered late, he would pray late. As for Fajr, sometimes he would delay it or pray it with slight brightness.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَابِرٌ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ حِينَ تَزُولُ الشَّمْسُ وَالْعَصْرَ وَهِيَ حَيَّةٌ أَوْ نَقِيَّةٌ وَالْمَغْرِبَ حِينَ تَجِبُ الشَّمْسُ وَالْعِشَاءَ رُبَّمَا عَجَّلَ وَرُبَّمَا أَخَّرَ إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَجَّلَ وَإِذَا تَأَخَّرُوا أَخَّرَ وَالصُّبْحَ رُبَّمَا كَانُوا أَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّيهَا بِغَلَسٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī Riḍwān Allāh ʿAlayhimā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا قَالَ سَأَلْنَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي زَمَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ وَكَانَ يُؤَخِّرُ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1223

chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer times

hadiths.englishRaw: "What is this, O Mugheera? Did you not know that Jibreel descended upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed?" Then he said, "I know what you are talking about, O Urwah. Did Jibreel establish the prayer time for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He said, "That was how Bashir ibn Abi Mas'ood narrated it from his father." Urwah added, "Aisha told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray Asr and the sun sets in her chambers before it appeared."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "What is this, O Mugheera? Did you not know that Jibreel descended upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed?" Then he said, "I know what you are talking about, O Urwah. Did Jibreel establish the prayer time for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He said, "That was how Bashir ibn Abi Mas'ood narrated it from his father." Urwah added, "Aisha told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray Asr and the sun sets in her chambers before it appeared."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا هَذَا يَا مُغِيرَةُ؟ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ نَزَلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَصَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «بِهَذَا أُمِرْتَ» قَالَ أعْلمْ مَا تُحَدِّثُ يَا عُرْوَةُ أَوَ أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ أَقَامَ وَقْتَ الصَّلَاةِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قَالَ كَذَلِكَ كَانَ بَشِيرُ بْنُ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ عُرْوَةُ وَلَقَدْ حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ وَالشَّمْسُ فِي حُجْرَتِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَظْهَرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd al-Ḥanafī \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz Akhhar al-Ṣalāh Yawm Fadakhal ʿAlayh ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr Faʾakhbarah \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah Akhhar al-Ṣalāh Yawm Fadakhal ʿAlayh Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī \u003e Mā Hadhā Yā Mughīrah Alays Qad ʿAlimt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ أَخَّرَ الصَّلَاةَ يَوْمًا فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ فَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ أَخَّرَ الصَّلَاةَ يَوْمًا فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1224

chapter.englishTitle: At the beginning of the call to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered a bell to be made so that it might be struck to gather the people for prayer, a man carrying a bell in his hand appeared to me while I was asleep, and I said; servant of ‘abd Allah, will you sell the bell? He asked; what will you do with it? I replied; we shall use it to call the people to prayer. He said; should I not suggest you something better than that. I replied: certainly. Then he told me to say: Allah is most great, Allah is most great, Allah is most great, Allah is most great. I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to pray, come to pray; come to salvation; come to salvation. Allah is most great, Allah is most great. I testify that there is no god but Allah. He then moved backward a few steps and said: when you utter the IQAMAH, you should say: Allah is most great, Allah is most great. I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to prayer, come to salvation. The time for prayer has come, the time for prayer has come: Allah is most great, Allah is most great. There is no god but Allah. When the morning came, I came to the Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) and informed him of what I had seen in the dream. He said: it is a genuine vision, and he then should use it to call people to prayer, for he has a louder voice than you have. So I got up along with Bilal and began to teach it to him and he used it in making the call to prayer. ‘Umar b. al-khattab (Allah be pleased with him) heard it while he was in his house and came out trailing his cloak and said: Messenger of Allah. By him who has sent you with the truth, I have also seen the kind of thing as has been shown to him. The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) said: To Allah be the praise. Abu Dawud said; Al-Zuhri narrated this tradition in a similar way from Sa’id b. al-Musayyib on the authority of ‘Abd Allah b. Zaid. In this version Ibn Ishaq narrated from al-Zuhri: Allah is most great. Allah is most great, Allah is most great, Allah is most great. Ma;mar and yunus narrated from al-Zuhri; Allah is most great, Allah is most great. They did not report it twice again.     – Sound

hadiths.arabic: وَقَدْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حِينَ قَدِمَهَا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي الْمَدِينَةَ إِنَّمَا يُجْتَمَعُ إِلَيْهِ بِالصَّلَاةِ لِحِينِ مَوَاقِيتِهَا بِغَيْرِ دَعْوَةٍ فَهَمَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ بُوقًا كَبُوقِ الْيَهُودِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ بِهِ لِصَلَاتِهِمْ ثُمَّ كَرِهَهُ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِالنَّاقُوسِ فَنُحِتَ لِيُضْرَبَ بِهِ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِذْ رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ أَخُو اَلْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ فَأَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ طَافَ بِيَ اللَّيْلَةَ طَائِفٌ مَرَّ بِي رَجُلٌ عَلَيْهِ ثَوْبَانِ أَخْضَرَانِ يَحْمِلُ نَاقُوسًا فِي يَدِهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ أَتَبِيعُ هَذَا النَّاقُوسَ؟ فَقَالَ وَمَا تَصْنَعُ بِهِ؟ قُلْتُ نَدْعُو بِهِ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ أَفَلَا أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى خَيْرٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ؟ قُلْتُ وَمَا هُوَ؟ قَالَ تَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْخَرَ غَيْرَ كَثِيرٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ وَجَعَلَهَا وِتْرًا إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَلَمَّا أخُبِّرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّهَا لَرُؤْيَا حَقٌّ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَقُمْ مَعَ بِلَالٍ فَأَلْقِهَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّهُ أَنْدَى صَوْتًا مِنْكَ» فَلَمَّا أَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ سَمِعَهَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَجُرُّ إِزَارَهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ مِثْلَ مَا رَأَى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ فَذَاكَ أَثْبَتُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Salamah \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1225

chapter.englishTitle: At the beginning of the call to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah commanded the use of bells, he mentioned something similar.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah commanded the use of bells, he mentioned something similar.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَمَّا أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالنَّاقُوسِ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd from my father \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥārith al-Taymī \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Zayd b. ʿAbd Rabbih \u003e Abū ʿAbdullāh b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي عَنْ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ التَّيْمِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ زَيْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1226

chapter.englishTitle: At the time of the Fajr call to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "Bilal calls the Adhan during the night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktum calls (the Adhan)"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Bilal calls the Adhan during the night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktum calls (the Adhan)"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُؤَذِّنَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim \u003e Abīh Yarfaʿuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1227

chapter.englishTitle: At the time of the Fajr call to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ had two muadhins, Bilal and Ibn Umm Maktum. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If Bilal gives the adhan at night, then continue eating and drinking until you hear the adhan of Ibn Umm Maktum." Al-Qasim said, "There was nothing between them except this one would descend while the other ascends."
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ had two muadhins, Bilal and Ibn Umm Maktum. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If Bilal gives the adhan at night, then continue eating and drinking until you hear the adhan of Ibn Umm Maktum." Al-Qasim said, "There was nothing between them except this one would descend while the other ascends."
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ مُؤَذِّنَانِ بِلَالٌ وَابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ بِلَالًا يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى تَسْمَعُوا أَذَانَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ» فَقَالَ الْقَاسِمُ وَمَا كَانَ بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَنْزِلَ هَذَا وَيَرْقَى هَذَا
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ أَنْبَأَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَعَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1228

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation in the Dawn Call to Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: Saad used to give the call to prayer (adhan) in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Hafs narrated to me that my family told me that Bilal came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to give him the call to prayer for Fajr prayer, but they said that he was sleeping. So Bilal called out in a loud voice, "Prayer is better than sleep", and it was included in the adhan for Fajr prayer. Abu Muhammad said that Saad was called Al-Qaradh.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Saad used to give the call to prayer (adhan) in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . Hafs narrated to me that my family told me that Bilal came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to give him the call to prayer for Fajr prayer, but they said that he was sleeping. So Bilal called out in a loud voice, "Prayer is better than sleep", and it was included in the adhan for Fajr prayer. Abu Muhammad said that Saad was called Al-Qaradh.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ سَعْدًا كَانَ يُؤَذِّنُ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ حَفْصٌ حَدَّثَنِي أَهْلِي أَنَّ بِلَالًا أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُؤْذِنُهُ لِصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ فَقَالُوا إِنَّهُ نَائِمٌ فَنَادَى بِلَالٌ بِأَعْلَى صَوْتِهِ «الصَّلَاةُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ النَّوْمِ فَأُقِرَّتْ فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ يُقَالُ سَعْدٌ الْقَرَظُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar b. Fāris \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ḥafṣ b. ʿUmar b. Saʿd al-Muʾadhhin
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ فَارِسٍ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ الْمُؤَذِّنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1229

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْأَذَانِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، وَالْإِقَامَةِ مَرَّةً
chapter.englishTitle: The Adhan is repeated twice, and the Iqama is done once.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I asked Ibn 'Umar about the Adhan and he said: 'At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the phrases of the Adhan were recited twice and the phrases of Iqamah once, except that you should say (the phrase) Qad qamat is-salah (prayer is about to begin)twice. When we heard 'prayer is about to begin' we would perform Wudu' and go out to pray.'"     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "I asked Ibn 'Umar about the Adhan and he said: 'At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, the phrases of the Adhan were recited twice and the phrases of Iqamah once, except that you should say (the phrase) Qad qamat is-salah (prayer is about to begin)twice. When we heard 'prayer is about to begin' we would perform Wudu' and go out to pray.'"     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ الْأَذَانُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى وَالْإِقَامَةُ مَرَّةً غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَالَ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ قَالَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ فَإِذَا سَمِعْنَا الْإِقَامَةَ تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُنَا وَخَرَجَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Jaʿfar \u003e Muslim Abū al-Muthanná \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ أَبِي الْمُثَنَّى عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1230

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْأَذَانِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، وَالْإِقَامَةِ مَرَّةً
chapter.englishTitle: The Adhan is repeated twice, and the Iqama is done once.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Bilal was commanded to say the phrases of the Adhan twice and the phrases of the Iqamah once."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Bilal was commanded to say the phrases of the Adhan twice and the phrases of the Iqamah once."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أُمِرَ بِلَالٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ الْأَذَانَ وَيُوتِرَ الْإِقَامَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī And ʿAffān \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Anas \u003e Umir Bilāl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ وَعَفَّانُ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1231

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْأَذَانِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى، وَالْإِقَامَةِ مَرَّةً
chapter.englishTitle: The Adhan is repeated twice, and the Iqama is done once.

hadiths.englishRaw: Anas reported; Bilal was commanded to pronounce Adhan in double pairs and IQAMAH in single pairs. Hammam added in his version; “except IQAMAH”.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Anas reported; Bilal was commanded to pronounce Adhan in double pairs and IQAMAH in single pairs. Hammam added in his version; “except IQAMAH”.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أُمِرَ بِلَالٌ أَنْ يَشْفَعَ الْأَذَانَ وَيُوتِرَ الْإِقَامَةَ إِلَّا الْإِقَامَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Simāk b. ʿAṭiyyah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Anas \u003e Umir Bilāl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1232

chapter.englishTitle: The return in the Adhan

hadiths.englishRaw: I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Lowering your voice while saying them (these words). Then you must raise your voice in making the testimony: I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify there is no god but Allah; I testify Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I testify Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to salvation, come to salvation. If it is the morning prayer, you must pronounce; prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep, Allah is most great; there is no god but Allah.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify that there is no god but Allah; I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Lowering your voice while saying them (these words). Then you must raise your voice in making the testimony: I testify that there is no god but Allah, I testify there is no god but Allah; I testify Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I testify Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to salvation, come to salvation. If it is the morning prayer, you must pronounce; prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep, Allah is most great; there is no god but Allah.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَ نَحْوًا مِنْ عِشْرِينَ رَجُلًا فَأَذَّنُوا فَأَعْجَبَهُ صَوْتُ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ فَعَلَّمَهُ الْأَذَانَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَالْإِقَامَةَ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hammām \u003e ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal \u003e Makḥūl \u003e Ibn Muḥayrīz \u003e Abū Maḥdhūrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هَمَّامٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1233

chapter.englishTitle: The return in the Adhan

hadiths.englishRaw: the Prophet taught him the Adhan with nineteen phrases, and the Iqamah with seventeen phrases.
hadiths.body: the Prophet taught him the Adhan with nineteen phrases, and the Iqamah with seventeen phrases.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَّمَهُ الْأَذَانَ تِسْعَ عَشْرَةَ كَلِمَةً وَالْإِقَامَةَ سَبْعَ عَشْرَةَ كَلِمَةً»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī And Ḥajjāj b. al-Minhāl \u003e Hammām \u003e ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرٌ الْأَحْوَلُ قَالَ حَجَّاجٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَامِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَكْحُولٌ أَنَّ ابْنَ مُحَيْرِيزٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1234

chapter.englishTitle: The rotation in the Adhan

hadiths.englishRaw: "Thus, I made it a habit to follow his mouth movements here and there with the adhan."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Thus, I made it a habit to follow his mouth movements here and there with the adhan."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فَجَعَلْتُ أَتْبَعُ فَاهُ هَاهُنَا وَهَاهُنَا بِالْأَذَانِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAwn b. Abū Juḥayfah from his father \u003e Raʾá Bilāl Adhhan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّهُ رَأَى بِلَالًا أَذَّنَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1235

chapter.englishTitle: The rotation in the Adhan

hadiths.englishRaw: That Bilal saw a gazelle and then he called for prayer and placed his fingers in his ears, and I saw him turn his fingers in his ears. Abdullah said: This is the Hadith of Thawri and it is the most authentic.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: That Bilal saw a gazelle and then he called for prayer and placed his fingers in his ears, and I saw him turn his fingers in his ears. Abdullah said: This is the Hadith of Thawri and it is the most authentic.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ بِلَالًا «رَكَزَ الْعَنَزَةَ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ وَوَضَعَ أُصْبُعَيْهِ فِي أُذُنَيْهِ فَرَأَيْتُهُ يَدُورُ فِي أَذَانِهِ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ حَدِيثُ الثَّوْرِيِّ أَصَحُّ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbbād \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿAwn b. Abū Juḥayfah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1236

chapter.englishTitle: The supplication at the call to prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: There are two things that are not rejected or hardly rejected: supplication during the call to prayer and supplication during a battle when soldiers are engaged in fighting each other.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: There are two things that are not rejected or hardly rejected: supplication during the call to prayer and supplication during a battle when soldiers are engaged in fighting each other.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ ثِنْتَانِ لَا تُرَدَّانِ أَوْ قَلَّ مَا تُرَدَّانِ الدُّعَاءُ عِنْدَ النِّدَاءِ وَعِنْدَ الْبَأْسِ حِينَ يُلْحِمُ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Maryam \u003e Mūsá \u003e Ibn Yaʿqūb al-Zamʿī \u003e Abū Ḥāzim b. Dīnār \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى هُوَ ابْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الزَّمْعِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1237

chapter.englishTitle: What is said at the call to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: When you hear the Adhan, you should repeat the same words as the mu’adhdhin pronounces.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When you hear the Adhan, you should repeat the same words as the mu’adhdhin pronounces.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا سَمِعْتُمُ الْمُؤَذِّنَ فَقُولُوا مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar Anabʾnā Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yazīd \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنَبأنا يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1238

chapter.englishTitle: What is said at the call to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. He said, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Yahya informed me that some of our companions told him that when he said 'Come to prayer,' he said, 'There is no power or strength except with Allah.' Then Muawiya said, 'Thus I heard your Prophet say."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. He said, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Yahya informed me that some of our companions told him that when he said 'Come to prayer,' he said, 'There is no power or strength except with Allah.' Then Muawiya said, 'Thus I heard your Prophet say."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَالَ يَحْيَى وَأَخْبَرَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا أَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَالَ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ هكذا سَمِعْتُ نَبِيَّكُمْ يَقُولُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn Anabʾnā Hishām al-Dastawāʾī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿĪsá b. Ṭalḥah \u003e Dakhalnā \u003e Muʿāwiyah Fanādá al-Munādī \u003e Allāh Akbar Allāh Akbar \u003e Muʿāwiyah Allāh Akbar Allāh Akbar \u003e Ashhad \u003e Lā Ilah Illā Allāh \u003e Ashhad \u003e Lā Ilah Illā Allāh \u003e Ashhad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنَبأنا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ فَنَادَى الْمُنَادِي فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1239

chapter.englishTitle: What is said at the call to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me the Adhan and said: 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah (Allah is the Greatest,Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah,I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah)'. Then he repeated it and said: 'Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah; Hayya 'alas-salah, Hayya 'ala-salah; Hayya 'alal-falah Hayya 'alal-falah; Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; La ilaha ill-Allah (I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to prosperity, come to prosperity; Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there is none worthy of worship except Allah).'"     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me the Adhan and said: 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah (Allah is the Greatest,Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah,I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah)'. Then he repeated it and said: 'Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah; Hayya 'alas-salah, Hayya 'ala-salah; Hayya 'alal-falah Hayya 'alal-falah; Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; La ilaha ill-Allah (I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to prosperity, come to prosperity; Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there is none worthy of worship except Allah).'"     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَقَالَ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ فَقَالَ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ هَكَذَا فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr from his father from his grandfather \u003e Muʿāwiyah \u003e al-Muʾadhhin \u003e Allāh Akbar Allāh Akbar \u003e Muʿāwiyah Allāh Akbar Allāh Akbar \u003e al-Muʾadhhin Ashhad \u003e Lā Ilah Illā Allāh Ashhad \u003e Lā Ilah Illā Allāh \u003e Muʿāwiyah Ashhad \u003e Lā Ilah Illā Allāh Thum Ashhad \u003e Lā Ilah Illā Allāh \u003e al-Muʾadhhin Ashhad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ سَمِعَ الْمُؤَذِّنَ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ أَشْهَدُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1240

chapter.arabicTitle: بُابُ الشَّيْطَانِ إِذَا سَمِعَ النِّدَاءَ فَرَّ
chapter.englishTitle: The door of the Devil when it hears the call.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ said: When the call to prayer is announced, the devil runs away and is in a state of panic, to the point where he is unable to hear the call to prayer. But when the call to prayer is finished, he comes back. And when the iqama (second call to prayer) is announced, he runs away again. But when the iqama is finished, he comes back until he reaches between the person and his heart, and then he says: Remember to do this and that, which he did not remember before. Abu Muhammad said: "Thawb" means it is established."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ said: When the call to prayer is announced, the devil runs away and is in a state of panic, to the point where he is unable to hear the call to prayer. But when the call to prayer is finished, he comes back. And when the iqama (second call to prayer) is announced, he runs away again. But when the iqama is finished, he comes back until he reaches between the person and his heart, and then he says: Remember to do this and that, which he did not remember before. Abu Muhammad said: "Thawb" means it is established."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالصَّلَاةِ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لَا يَسْمَعَ الْأَذَانَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ الْأَذَانُ أَقْبَلَ وَإِذَا ثُوِّبَ أَدْبَرَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ التَّثْوِيبُ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى يَخْطِرَ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَنَفْسِهِ فَيَقُولُ اذْكُرْ كَذَا وَكَذَا لِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَذْكُرُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ ثُوِّبَ يَعْنِي أُقِيمَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1241

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْخُرُوجِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ بَعْدَ النِّدَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: The dislike of leaving the mosque after the call.

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man left the Masjid after the call to prayer had been given, and Abu Hurairah said: 'This man has indeed disobeyed Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A man left the Masjid after the call to prayer had been given, and Abu Hurairah said: 'This man has indeed disobeyed Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ رَأَى رَجُلًا خَرَجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ بَعْدَ مَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَقَالَ «أَمَّا هَذَا فَقَدْ عَصَى أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ibrāhīm b. al-Muhājir \u003e Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ al-Muḥāribī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ الْمُحَارِبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1242

chapter.englishTitle: At noon

hadiths.englishRaw: "Anas told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out when the sun had passed its zenith, and led them in Zuhr prayer."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Anas told me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out when the sun had passed its zenith, and led them in Zuhr prayer."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «خَرَجَ حِينَ زَاغَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ صَلَاةَ الظُّهْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ Nbʾanā Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أنْبأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1243

chapter.englishTitle: Extradition by day

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the heat becomes intense, cool yourselves down with prayer, for the intensity of the heat is from the breath of Hellfire." Abu Muhammad said, "I have this saying of delaying when they are affected by the heat."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the heat becomes intense, cool yourselves down with prayer, for the intensity of the heat is from the breath of Hellfire." Abu Muhammad said, "I have this saying of delaying when they are affected by the heat."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا اشْتَدَّ الْحَرُّ فَأَبْرِدُوا بِالصَّلَاةِ فَإِنَّ شِدَّةَ الْحَرِّ مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ هَذَا عِنْدِي مِن التَّأْخِيرِ إِذَا تَأَذَّوْا بِالْحَرِّ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʾAbī Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1244

chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "Time of Asr

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray Asr prayer, then the one who goes to Al-Awali comes to him while the sun is still high.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray Asr prayer, then the one who goes to Al-Awali comes to him while the sun is still high.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ يَذْهَبُ الذَّاهِبُ إِلَى الْعَوَالِي فَيَأْتِيهَا وَالشَّمْسُ مُرْتَفِعَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1245

chapter.englishTitle: The time of Maghrib.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to say the Maghrib prayer immediately after the sun had set when its upper side would disappear.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to say the Maghrib prayer immediately after the sun had set when its upper side would disappear.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «يُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ سَاعَةَ تَغْرُبُ الشَّمْسُ إِذَا غَابَ حَاجِبُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Ibn Ibrāhīm al-Ḥanẓalī \u003e Ṣafwān b. ʿĪsá \u003e Yazīd b. Abū ʿUbayd \u003e Salamah b. al-Akwaʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ هُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1246

chapter.englishTitle: Disliking the delay of Maghrib prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet (pbuh) said, "My Ummah (nation) will always remain in goodness as long as they do not expect the clash of the stars at Maghrib (sunset)."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet (pbuh) said, "My Ummah (nation) will always remain in goodness as long as they do not expect the clash of the stars at Maghrib (sunset)."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَزَالُ أُمَّتِي بِخَيْرٍ مَا لَمْ يَنْتَظِرُوا بِالْمَغْرِبِ اشْتِبَاكَ النُّجُومِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e ʿAbbād b. al-ʿAwwām \u003e ʿUmar b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e al-Aḥnaf b. Qays \u003e al-ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ الْأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1247

chapter.englishTitle: Time for dinner

hadiths.englishRaw: "By Allah, I certainly inform people of the time of this prayer, meaning the Isha prayer. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray it when the moon had set, around the third of the night." Yahya narrated to us from his book, from Bishr ibn Thabit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "By Allah, I certainly inform people of the time of this prayer, meaning the Isha prayer. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray it when the moon had set, around the third of the night." Yahya narrated to us from his book, from Bishr ibn Thabit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ بِوَقْتِ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ يَعْنِي صَلَاةَ الْعِشَاءِ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّيهَا لِسُقُوطِ الْقَمَرِ لِثَالِثَةٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَمَلَّاهُ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ كِتَابِهِ عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Bashīr b. Thābit \u003e Ḥabīb b. Sālim \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Bashīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1248

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended when delaying dinner?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed the Isha prayer on one night until almost one-third of the night had passed or close to it. He came (to the mosque) and found the people reclining and dozing off, some even sleeping. He became angry and said, "If a man among you calls the people for prayer and leads them in prayer, it would be better. And if a man among you were to lead the people in prayer and then go to his family and find them sleeping, he should set fire to their houses with fire."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed the Isha prayer on one night until almost one-third of the night had passed or close to it. He came (to the mosque) and found the people reclining and dozing off, some even sleeping. He became angry and said, "If a man among you calls the people for prayer and leads them in prayer, it would be better. And if a man among you were to lead the people in prayer and then go to his family and find them sleeping, he should set fire to their houses with fire."   – Sound
