hadiths.arabic: أَخَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَاةَ الْعِشَاءِ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ حَتَّى كَادَ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ قَرِيبُهُ فَجَاءَ وَفِي النَّاسُ رُقَّودٌ وَهُمْ عِزُونَ وَهُمْ حِلَقٌ فَغَضِبَ فَقَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلًا ناَدَى النَّاسَ وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو نَدَبَ النَّاسَ إِلَى عَرْقٍ أَوْ مِرْمَاتَيْنِ لَأَجَابُوا إِلَيْهِ وَهُمْ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنْ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ لَهَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ رَجُلًا يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ أَتَخَلَّفَ عَلَى أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الدُّورِ الَّذِينَ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنْ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ فَأُضْرِمَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ بِالنِّيرَانِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl And ʿAmrū b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim b. Bahdalah \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ وَعَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ بَهْدَلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1249

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended when delaying dinner?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed 'Isha' until 'Umar called him and said: 'The women and children have gone to sleep.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and said: 'There is no one who is offering this prayer but you.' And at that time no one used to pray except the people of Al-Madinah."     – Sound
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed 'Isha' until 'Umar called him and said: 'The women and children have gone to sleep.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and said: 'There is no one who is offering this prayer but you.' And at that time no one used to pray except the people of Al-Madinah."     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْعِشَاءِ حَتَّى نَادَاهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ قَدْ نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالصِّبْيَانُ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ يُصَلِّي هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ غَيْرَكُمْ» وَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَحَدٌ يُصَلِّي يَوْمَئِذٍ غَيْرَ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Naṣr b. ʿAlī \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1250

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended when delaying dinner?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ secluded himself one night until most of the night had passed and the people of the mosque had gone to sleep. Then he went out and prayed it and said, "It is its time, but I did not want to make it difficult for my Ummah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ secluded himself one night until most of the night had passed and the people of the mosque had gone to sleep. Then he went out and prayed it and said, "It is its time, but I did not want to make it difficult for my Ummah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَعْتَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ عَامَّةُ اللَّيْلِ وَرَقَدَ أَهْلُ الْمَسْجِدِ فَخَرَجَ فَصَلَّاهَا فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ لَوَقْتُهَا لَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Muḥammad b. Bakr \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Ḥakīm \u003e Um Kulthūm b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ أَنَّ أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1251

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ الْعِشَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended when delaying dinner?

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed the prayer one night. It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, the women and children have fallen asleep." He went out while wiping the water off his face and said, "It is time, if it were not for me inconveniencing my nation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delayed the prayer one night. It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, the women and children have fallen asleep." He went out while wiping the water off his face and said, "It is time, if it were not for me inconveniencing my nation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَخَّرَ الصَّلَاةَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الصَّلَاةَ نَامَ النِّسَاءُ وَالْوِلْدَانُ فَخَرَجَ وَهُوَ يَمْسَحُ الْمَاءَ عَنْ شِقِّهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ «هُوَ الْوَقْتُ لَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf Nbʾanā Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās And Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ أنْبأَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1252

chapter.englishTitle: Translation: At-Taghlis in the dawn.

hadiths.englishRaw: The wives of the Prophet ﷺ used to pray Fajr prayer with the Prophet ﷺ and then they would return home covered with their outer garments before being recognized.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The wives of the Prophet ﷺ used to pray Fajr prayer with the Prophet ﷺ and then they would return home covered with their outer garments before being recognized.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّ نِسَاءُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يُصَلِّينَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ الْفَجْرَ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعْنَ مُتَلَفِّعَاتٍ بِمُرُوطِهِنَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُعْرَفْنَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1253

chapter.englishTitle: Traveling at Dawn

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Set out for the Fajr prayer as it is the greatest reward."
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Set out for the Fajr prayer as it is the greatest reward."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَسْفِرُوا بِصَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْظَمُ لِلْأَجْرِ»
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿĀṣim b. ʿUmar b. Qatādah \u003e Maḥmūd b. Labīd \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1254

chapter.englishTitle: Traveling at Dawn

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Illuminate with the Fajr prayer, for it is the greatest in reward."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Illuminate with the Fajr prayer, for it is the greatest in reward."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَوِّرُوا بِصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْظَمُ لِلْأَجْرِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e ʿĀṣim b. ʿUmar b. Qatādah \u003e Maḥmūd b. Labīd \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1255

chapter.englishTitle: Traveling at Dawn

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Ibn Ajlan, about him, or "Asfiroo"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Ibn Ajlan, about him, or "Asfiroo"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ نَحْوَهُ أَوْ «أَسْفِرُوا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1256

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةٍ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever catches a unit of prayer has indeed caught+the rest

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever catches up with a rak'ah of Jumu'ah prayer has caught up with it."    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever catches up with a rak'ah of Jumu'ah prayer has caught up with it."    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1257

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةٍ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever catches a unit of prayer has indeed caught+the rest

hadiths.englishRaw: "About the Prophet peace be upon him with his likeness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "About the Prophet peace be upon him with his likeness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِمِثْلِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1258

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةٍ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever catches a unit of prayer has indeed caught+the rest

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever catches one Rak'ah of the 'Asr before the sun sets, then he has caught it, and whoever catches one Rak'ah of the Subh before the sun rises, then he has caught it."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever catches one Rak'ah of the 'Asr before the sun sets, then he has caught it, and whoever catches one Rak'ah of the Subh before the sun rises, then he has caught it."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصُّبْحِ رَكْعَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا وَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْعَصْرِ رَكْعَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Busr b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Aʿraj Yuḥaddithūnah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَعَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ يُحَدِّثُونَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1259

chapter.englishTitle: The preservation of prayers

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "If you see a man frequenting the mosques, then bear witness to his faith. Allah says: 'The mosques of Allah shall be maintained only by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day. [At-Taubah: 18]'"     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "If you see a man frequenting the mosques, then bear witness to his faith. Allah says: 'The mosques of Allah shall be maintained only by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day. [At-Taubah: 18]'"     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ الرَّجُلَ يَعْتَادُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَاشْهَدُوا لَهُ بِالْإِيمَانِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ {إِنَّمَا يَعْمُرُ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ مَنْ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ} [التوبة 18]   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr al-Ḥumaydī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Wahb \u003e ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Darrāj Abū al-Samḥ \u003e Abū al-Haytham \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ دَرَّاجٍ أَبِي السَّمْحِ عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1260

chapter.englishTitle: The preservation of prayers

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:Whoever prays ʿIshaʿ in congregation, it will be like spending half the night in prayer (qiyam) and whoever prays ʿIshaʿ and Fajr in congregation, it will be like spending the whole night in prayer.ʿ    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:Whoever prays ʿIshaʿ in congregation, it will be like spending half the night in prayer (qiyam) and whoever prays ʿIshaʿ and Fajr in congregation, it will be like spending the whole night in prayer.ʿ    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ كَانَ كَقِيَامِ نِصْفِ لَيْلَةٍ وَمَنْ صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ كَانَ كَقِيَامِ لَيْلَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Sahl \u003e Wʾnbʾanā Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿUthmān b. Ḥakīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū ʿAmrah \u003e ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ قَالَ وأنْبأَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1261

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اسْتحْبَابِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ
chapter.englishTitle: The recommendation of praying in the early time.

hadiths.englishRaw: The owner of this house told me and gestured with his hand towards the house of Abdullah that he asked the Prophet ﷺ which actions are better or more beloved to Allah. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Praying at its appointed time."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The owner of this house told me and gestured with his hand towards the house of Abdullah that he asked the Prophet ﷺ which actions are better or more beloved to Allah. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Praying at its appointed time."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي صَاحِبُ هَذِهِ الدَّارِ وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى دَارِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَيُّ الْأَعَمَالِ أَفْضَلُ أَوْ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ «الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى مِيقَاتِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Walīd b. ʿAyzār \u003e Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عَيْزَارٍ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيَّ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1262

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: اسْتحْبَابِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ
chapter.englishTitle: The recommendation of praying in the early time.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us while we were in the mosque, seven of us. Three of us were Arabs and four of us were non-Arabs, or four of us were Arabs and three of us were non-Arabs. The Prophet ﷺ came out from one of the corners of the mosque until he sat with us and asked, "What made you sit here?" We replied, "We are waiting for the prayer." He then tapped the ground with his finger and turned it over for a while, then raised his head and asked, "Do you know what your Lord says?" We replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "He says, 'Whoever performs the prayer at its prescribed time and observes its proper limits, it will be a guarantee for him to enter Paradise. And whoever does not perform the prayer at its prescribed time and does not observe its proper limits, he will not have any guarantee from me. If I will, I will admit him to Hell, and if I will, I will admit him to Paradise.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us while we were in the mosque, seven of us. Three of us were Arabs and four of us were non-Arabs, or four of us were Arabs and three of us were non-Arabs. The Prophet ﷺ came out from one of the corners of the mosque until he sat with us and asked, "What made you sit here?" We replied, "We are waiting for the prayer." He then tapped the ground with his finger and turned it over for a while, then raised his head and asked, "Do you know what your Lord says?" We replied, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "He says, 'Whoever performs the prayer at its prescribed time and observes its proper limits, it will be a guarantee for him to enter Paradise. And whoever does not perform the prayer at its prescribed time and does not observe its proper limits, he will not have any guarantee from me. If I will, I will admit him to Hell, and if I will, I will admit him to Paradise.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ سَبْعَةٌ مِنَّا ثَلَاثَةٌ مِنْ عَرَبِنَا وَأَرْبَعَةٌ مِنْ مَوَالِينَا أَوْ أَرْبَعَةٌ مِنْ عَرَبِنَا وَثَلَاثَةٌ مِنْ مَوَالِينَا قَالَ فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنْ بَعْضِ حُجَرِهِ حَتَّى جَلَسَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَالَ «مَا يُجْلِسُكُمْ هَاهُنَا؟» قُلْنَا انْتِظَارُ الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ فَنَكَتَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَنَكَسَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ رَفَعَ إِلَيْنَا رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ «هَلْ تَدْرُونَ مَا يَقُولُ رَبُّكُمْ؟» قَالَ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ قَالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ مَنْ صَلَّى الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا فَأَقَامَ حَدَّهَا كَانَ لَهُ بِهِ عَلَيَّ عَهْدٌ أُدْخِلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا وَلَمْ يُقِمْ حَدَّهَا لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عِنْدِي عَهْدٌ إِنْ شِئْتُ أَدْخَلْتُهُ النَّارَ وَإِنْ شِئْتُ أَدْخَلْتُهُ الْجَنَّةَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Ibn al-Nuʿmān al-Anṣārī \u003e Saʿd b. Isḥāq b. Kaʿb b. ʿUjrah al-Anṣārī from his father \u003e Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ ابْنُ النُّعْمَانِ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي سَعْدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ كَعْبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1263

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الصَّلَاةِ خَلْفَ مِنْ يُؤَخِّرُ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Praying behind someone who delays prayer beyond its appointed ti...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "What would you do if you were among people who delay the prayer from its time?" He said, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "Pray the prayer at its appointed time and then leave, for if the prayer is established while you are in the mosque, then pray with them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "What would you do if you were among people who delay the prayer from its time?" He said, "Allah and His Messenger know best." He said, "Pray the prayer at its appointed time and then leave, for if the prayer is established while you are in the mosque, then pray with them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهُ «كَيْفَ أَنْتَ إِذَا بَقِيتَ فِي قَوْمٍ يُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا؟» قَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ قَالَ «صَلِّ الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا وَاخْرُجْ فَإِنْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَأَنْتَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَصَلِّ مَعَهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Budayl \u003e Abū al-ʿĀliyah al-Barrāʾ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ الْبَرَّاءِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1264

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الصَّلَاةِ خَلْفَ مِنْ يُؤَخِّرُ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Praying behind someone who delays prayer beyond its appointed ti...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Abu Dhar, what would you do if you come across leaders who postpone the prayer from its time?" I asked, "What do you command me, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Pray the prayer in its proper time and make your prayer with them as optional prayers." Abu Muhammad ibn As-Samit, who is the son of the brother of Abu Dhar, said.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Abu Dhar, what would you do if you come across leaders who postpone the prayer from its time?" I asked, "What do you command me, O Messenger of Allah?" He said, "Pray the prayer in its proper time and make your prayer with them as optional prayers." Abu Muhammad ibn As-Samit, who is the son of the brother of Abu Dhar, said.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ إِذَا أَدْرَكْتَ أُمَرَاءَ يُؤَخِّرُونَ الصَّلَاةَ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا؟» قُلْتُ مَا تَأْمُرُنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «صَلِّ الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا وَاجْعَلْ صَلَاتَكَ مَعَهُمْ نَافِلَةً» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ ابْنُ الصَّامِتِ هُوَ ابْنُ أَخِي أَبِي ذَرٍّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hammām \u003e Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1265

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ نَامَ عَنْ صَلَاةٍ أَوْ نَسِيَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever sleeps through a prayer or forgets it.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it, for Allah says: and perform the Salah for My remembrance." [1] [1] Ta-Ha 20:14.     – Sound
hadiths.body: "Whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it, for Allah says: and perform the Salah for My remembrance." [1] [1] Ta-Ha 20:14.     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلَاةً أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا فَلْيُصَلِّهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ {وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي} [طه 14]   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1266

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذي تَفُوتُهُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Missing the Asr prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "The one who misses the 'Asr prayer, it is as if he has been cheated out of his family and wealth."     – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "The one who misses the 'Asr prayer, it is as if he has been cheated out of his family and wealth."     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِي تَفُوتُهُ الصَّلَاةُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ فَكَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim \u003e Abīh Yarfaʿuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1267

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذي تَفُوتُهُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Missing the Asr prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever misses the Asr prayer, it is as if he has lost his family and children." Abu Muhammad said, "Or his wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever misses the Asr prayer, it is as if he has lost his family and children." Abu Muhammad said, "Or his wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ فَاتَتْهُ صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ فَكَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَوَلَدَهُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ أَوْ مَالَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1268

chapter.englishTitle: In the Middle Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of al-Khandaq: ʿWhat is wrong with them? May Allah fill their houses and graves with fire as they distracted us from the middle prayer until the sun set.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said on the day of al-Khandaq: ʿWhat is wrong with them? May Allah fill their houses and graves with fire as they distracted us from the middle prayer until the sun set.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ «مَلَأَ اللَّهُ قُبُورَهُمْ وَبُيُوتَهُمْ نَارًا كَمَا حَبَسُونَا عَنْ صَلَاةِ الْوُسْطَى حَتَّى غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn Nbʾanā Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbīdah \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أنْبأَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1269

chapter.englishTitle: In the case of abandoning prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no difference between a servant and associating partners with Allah or disbelief, except abandoning prayer." Abu Muhammad Al-Abd said, "If a person abandons prayer without excuse or reason, it must be said that he is committing disbelief, and he should not be described as a disbeliever."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no difference between a servant and associating partners with Allah or disbelief, except abandoning prayer." Abu Muhammad Al-Abd said, "If a person abandons prayer without excuse or reason, it must be said that he is committing disbelief, and he should not be described as a disbeliever."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَيْسَ بَيْنَ الْعَبْدِ وَبَيْنَ الشِّرْكِ أَوْ بَيْنَ الْكُفْرِ إِلَّا تَرْكُ الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْعَبْدُ إِذَا تَرَكَهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ وَعِلَّةٍ لَا بُدَّ مِنْ أَنْ يُقَالَ بِهِ كُفْرٌ وَلَمْ يَصِفْ بِالْكُفْرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir \u003e or \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا يَقُولُ أَوْ قَالَ جَابِرٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1270

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَحْوِيلِ الْقِبْلَةِ مِنْ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the conversion of the qibla from Al-Masjid al-Aqsa to the Kaa...

hadiths.englishRaw: While people were performing the Fajr prayer in Quba, a man came to them and said, "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has been revealed the Quran and he has been commanded to face the Kaaba in prayer, so face towards it." The people's faces were initially directed towards Sham (Syria) but they turned and faced towards the Kaaba.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: While people were performing the Fajr prayer in Quba, a man came to them and said, "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has been revealed the Quran and he has been commanded to face the Kaaba in prayer, so face towards it." The people's faces were initially directed towards Sham (Syria) but they turned and faced towards the Kaaba.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَمَا النَّاسُ فِي صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ فِي قُبَاءٍ إذ جَاءَهُمْ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ وَأُمِرَ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ الْكَعْبَةَ فَاسْتَقْبِلُوهَا وَكَانَ وُجهُ النَّاسِ إِلَى الشَّامِ فَاسْتَدَارُوا فَوَجَّهُوا إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sulaymān b. Bilāl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1271

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَحْوِيلِ الْقِبْلَةِ مِنْ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the conversion of the qibla from Al-Masjid al-Aqsa to the Kaa...

hadiths.englishRaw: when the Prophet (May peace be upon him) turned towards the Ka’bah (in prayer), the people asked : Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him)! what will happen with those who died while they prayed with their faces towards Jerusalem ? Allah the Exalted, then revealed : “And never would Allah make your faith of no effect.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: when the Prophet (May peace be upon him) turned towards the Ka’bah (in prayer), the people asked : Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him)! what will happen with those who died while they prayed with their faces towards Jerusalem ? Allah the Exalted, then revealed : “And never would Allah make your faith of no effect.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِينَ مَاتُوا وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ إِلَى بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ؟ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَانَكُمْ} [البقرة 143]   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Simāk \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1272

chapter.englishTitle: In the opening of the prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to commence the prayer with the takbir (saying "Allahu Akbar") and commence the recitation with "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil 'alameen" (Praise be to Allah, Lord of all the worlds) [Al-Fatihah: 2]. And he concludes it with the tasleem (saying "Assalamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah")   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to commence the prayer with the takbir (saying "Allahu Akbar") and commence the recitation with "Alhamdulillahi Rabbil 'alameen" (Praise be to Allah, Lord of all the worlds) [Al-Fatihah: 2]. And he concludes it with the tasleem (saying "Assalamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullah")   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلَاةَ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ وَيَفْتَتِحُ الْقِرَاءَةَ بِ {الحمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} [الفاتحة 2] وَيَخْتِمُهَا بِالتَّسْلِيمِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah \u003e Budayl al-ʿUqaylī \u003e Abū al-Jawzāʾ \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا بُدَيْلٌ الْعُقَيْلِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَوْزَاءِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1273

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ عِنْدَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Raising the hands at the beginning of prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to raise his hands (in supplication) whenever he stood up for prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to raise his hands (in supplication) whenever he stood up for prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَمْ يَكُنْ يَقُومُ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ إِلَّا رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ مَدًّا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd al-Ḥanafī \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Thawbān \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1274

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُقَالُ بَعْدَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is said after the opening of the prayer?

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ started to pray, he would say Takbir, then say: "Wajahtu wajhi lilladhi fataras-samawatiwal-arda hanifan wa ma ana minal-mushrikin. Inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi rabbil-alamin, la sharika lahu, wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana min al-muslimin. Allahumma! Antal-maliku la ilaha illa ant, ana abduka zalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bidhanbi faghfirli dhunubi jami'an, la yaghfirudhunuba illa anta, wahdini lihasanil-ahklaqi, la yahdi li ahsaniha illa anta wasrif anni sayy'aha la yasrifu anni sayy'aha illa anta, labaika wa sa'daika, wal-khairu kulluhu fi yadaika wash-sharru laisa ilaika ana bika wa ilaika ana bika wa ilaika tabarkta wa ta'alaita astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik. (Verily, I have turned my face toward Him who created the Heavens and the Earth hanifa (worhsipping none but Allah Alone), and I am not of the idolaters. Verily, my salah, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the all that exists. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am one of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign and there is none worthy of worship but You. I am Your slave, I have wronged myself and I acknowledge my sin. Forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins but You. Guide me to the best of manners for none can guide to the best of them but You. Protect me from bad manners for none can protect against them but You. I am at Your service, all goodness is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You. I rely on You and turn to You, blessed and exalted are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ started to pray, he would say Takbir, then say: "Wajahtu wajhi lilladhi fataras-samawatiwal-arda hanifan wa ma ana minal-mushrikin. Inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi rabbil-alamin, la sharika lahu, wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana min al-muslimin. Allahumma! Antal-maliku la ilaha illa ant, ana abduka zalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bidhanbi faghfirli dhunubi jami'an, la yaghfirudhunuba illa anta, wahdini lihasanil-ahklaqi, la yahdi li ahsaniha illa anta wasrif anni sayy'aha la yasrifu anni sayy'aha illa anta, labaika wa sa'daika, wal-khairu kulluhu fi yadaika wash-sharru laisa ilaika ana bika wa ilaika ana bika wa ilaika tabarkta wa ta'alaita astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik. (Verily, I have turned my face toward Him who created the Heavens and the Earth hanifa (worhsipping none but Allah Alone), and I am not of the idolaters. Verily, my salah, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of the all that exists. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am one of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign and there is none worthy of worship but You. I am Your slave, I have wronged myself and I acknowledge my sin. Forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins but You. Guide me to the best of manners for none can guide to the best of them but You. Protect me from bad manners for none can protect against them but You. I am at Your service, all goodness is in Your hands, and evil is not attributed to You. I rely on You and turn to You, blessed and exalted are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ كَبَّرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الْمَلِكُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي جَمِيعًا لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الْأَخْلَاقِ لَا يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا لَا يَصْرِفُ سَيِّئَهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي يَدَيْكَ وَالشَّرُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْكَ أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ تَبَارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Salamah from his uncle al-Mājishūn \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Rāfiʿ \u003e ʿAlī b. Abū Ṭālib Raḍī Allāh Taʿālá ʿAnh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمِّهِ الْمَاجِشُونَ عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْهُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1275

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُقَالُ بَعْدَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is said after the opening of the prayer?

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the provided text in English is as follows: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would get up at night, he would say: 'Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name and exalted is Your Majesty. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan, the accursed, from his whispers, breaths, and blowing.' Then he would begin his prayer. Ja'far explained it as follows: 'His whispers refers to death, his breaths refers to poetry, and his blowing refers to arrogance.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the provided text in English is as follows: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would get up at night, he would say: 'Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise be to You. Blessed is Your name and exalted is Your Majesty. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from Satan, the accursed, from his whispers, breaths, and blowing.' Then he would begin his prayer. Ja'far explained it as follows: 'His whispers refers to death, his breaths refers to poetry, and his blowing refers to arrogance.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَكَبَّرَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَفْتِحُ صَلَاتَهُ قَالَ جَعْفَرٌ وَفَسَّرَهُ مَطَرٌ هَمْزُهُ الْمُوتَةُ وَنَفْثُهُ الشِّعْرُ وَنَفْخُهُ الْكِبْرُ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e Jaʿfar b. Sulaymān \u003e ʿAlī b. ʿAlī \u003e Abū al-Mutawakkil \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1276

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْجَهْرِ بِبِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Dislike of Uttering "In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet, Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman used to begin reciting by saying, 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds' [Al-Fatiha 2]." Abu Muhammad said, 'With this, we say, and I do not see the need to audibly say 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet, Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman used to begin reciting by saying, 'Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds' [Al-Fatiha 2]." Abu Muhammad said, 'With this, we say, and I do not see the need to audibly say 'In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَعُثْمَانَ كَانُوا يَفْتَتِحُونَ الْقِرَاءَةَ بِ {الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} [الفاتحة 2] قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ بِهَذَا نَقُولُ وَلَا أَرَى الْجَهْرَ بِبِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hishām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1277

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ قَبْضِ الْيَمِينِ عَلَى الشِّمِالِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Holding the right hand over the left in prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placing his right hand over his left hand, close to the wrist."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placing his right hand over his left hand, close to the wrist."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى الْيُسْرَى قَرِيبًا مِنَ الرُّسْغِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbd al-Jabbār b. Wāʾil from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ بْنِ وَائِلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1278

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: لَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: No prayer without reciting Al-Fatiha.

hadiths.englishRaw: The messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever does not recite from the mother of the book, then his prayer is not valid."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever does not recite from the mother of the book, then his prayer is not valid."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ لَمْ يَقْرَأْ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ فَلَا صَلَاةَ لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Maḥmūd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1279

chapter.englishTitle: In the two bags

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to remain silent when he entered prayer and when he finished reciting. Imran ibn Husayn disapproved of this and they wrote to Ubay ibn Ka'b. He replied to them saying that Samurah was telling the truth. Abu Muhammad says Qatadah used to say three silences, and in the raised narration, there are two silences.
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to remain silent when he entered prayer and when he finished reciting. Imran ibn Husayn disapproved of this and they wrote to Ubay ibn Ka'b. He replied to them saying that Samurah was telling the truth. Abu Muhammad says Qatadah used to say three silences, and in the raised narration, there are two silences.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَسْكُتُ سَكْتَتَيْنِ إِذَا دَخَلَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ فَكَتَبُوا إِلَى أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَنْ قَدْ صَدَقَ سَمُرَةُ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ كَانَ قَتَادَةُ يَقُولُ ثَلَاثُ سَكَتَاتٍ وَفِي الْحَدِيثِ الْمَرْفُوعِ سَكْتَتَانِ
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Samurah b. Jundub
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1280

chapter.englishTitle: In the two bags

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kept silence between the takbir and the recitation of Qur’an. So I asked him, for whom I would give my father and mother as ransom: What do you say during you period of silence between the takbir and the recitation? He replied (that he said): O Allah, purify me from sins as a white garment is purified from filth. O Allah, wash away my sings with snow, water and hail.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ kept silence between the takbir and the recitation of Qur’an. So I asked him, for whom I would give my father and mother as ransom: What do you say during you period of silence between the takbir and the recitation? He replied (that he said): O Allah, purify me from sins as a white garment is purified from filth. O Allah, wash away my sings with snow, water and hail.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْكُتُ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ إِسْكَاتَةً حَسِبْتُهُ قَالَ هُنَيَّةً فَقُلْتُ لَهُ بِأَبِي وَأُمِّي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِسْكَاتَتَكَ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ مَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ أَقُولُ «اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. Ādam \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād \u003e ʿUmārah b. al-Qaʿqāʿ \u003e Abū Zurʿah b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ آدَمَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1281

chapter.englishTitle: In the Benefits of Insurance.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the reciter says, 'not (the way) of those who have evoked (Your) anger, nor of those who have gone astray.' [Al-Fatiha 7], and those behind him say 'Ameen,' the angels in the heaven align with it and his previous sins are forgiven."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the reciter says, 'not (the way) of those who have evoked (Your) anger, nor of those who have gone astray.' [Al-Fatiha 7], and those behind him say 'Ameen,' the angels in the heaven align with it and his previous sins are forgiven."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَالَ الْقَارِئُ {غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ} [الفاتحة 7] فَقَالَ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ آمِينَ فَوَافَقَ ذَلِكَ أَهْلَ السَّمَاءِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn Anbʾnā Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبأنا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1282

chapter.englishTitle: In the Benefits of Insurance.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When the Imam says: Not (the way) of those who earned Your anger, nor of those who went astray, say: 'Amin' for the angels say Amin and the Imam says Amin, and if a person's Amin coincides with the Amin of the angels, his previous sins will be forgiven.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When the Imam says: Not (the way) of those who earned Your anger, nor of those who went astray, say: 'Amin' for the angels say Amin and the Imam says Amin, and if a person's Amin coincides with the Amin of the angels, his previous sins will be forgiven.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ إِذَا قَالَ الْإِمَامُ {غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ} [الفاتحة 7] فَقُولُوا آمِينَ فَإِنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَقُولُ آمِينَ وَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَقُولُ آمِينَ فَمَنْ وَافَقَ تَأْمِينُهُ تَأْمِينَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Naṣr b. ʿAlī \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʾAbī Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah \u003e Nabī Allāh ﷺ \u003e Idhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1283

chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the given heading "الْجَهْرِ بِالتَّأْمِينِ" ...

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited the verse "Nor of those who go astray" (Surah al-Fatihah, verse 7), he would say Amin; and raised his voice (while uttering this word).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited the verse "Nor of those who go astray" (Surah al-Fatihah, verse 7), he would say Amin; and raised his voice (while uttering this word).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَرَأَ {وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ} [الفاتحة 7] قَالَ «آمِينَ» وَيَرْفَعُ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr Nbʾanā Sufyān b. Saʿīd \u003e Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e Ḥujr b. al-ʿAnbas \u003e Wāʾil b. Ḥujr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ أنْبأَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ حُجْرِ بْنِ الْعَنْبَسِ عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1284

chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the given heading "الْجَهْرِ بِالتَّأْمِينِ" ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ making takbeer in every raising, placing, standing, and sitting."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ making takbeer in every raising, placing, standing, and sitting."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يُكَبِّرُ فِي كُلِّ رَفْعٍ وَوَضْعٍ وَقِيَامٍ وَقُعُودٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī Nbʾanā Abū Khaythamah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Aswad from his father \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ أنْبأَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَعَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1285

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ
chapter.englishTitle: In raising the hands during the bowing and prostration

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the provided sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to, when he entered into prayer, say takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar) and raise his hands level with his shoulders, and when he went into ruku' (bowing), he would say takbeer and raise his hands, and when he raised his head from ruku', he would do the same, and he did not raise his hands between the two prostrations or during prostration."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the provided sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to, when he entered into prayer, say takbeer (saying Allahu Akbar) and raise his hands level with his shoulders, and when he went into ruku' (bowing), he would say takbeer and raise his hands, and when he raised his head from ruku', he would do the same, and he did not raise his hands between the two prostrations or during prostration."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «إِذَا دَخَلَ الصَّلَاةَ كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَلَا يَرْفَعُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ أَوْ فِي السُّجُودِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1286

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ
chapter.englishTitle: In raising the hands during the bowing and prostration

hadiths.englishRaw: Certainly, the Prophet ﷺ used to "when he performed the takbeer, he would raise his hands until they were level with his ears, and when he intended to bow, and when he raised his head from bowing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Certainly, the Prophet ﷺ used to "when he performed the takbeer, he would raise his hands until they were level with his ears, and when he intended to bow, and when he raised his head from bowing."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «إِذَا كَبَّرَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ أُذُنَيْهِ وَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Naṣr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Mālik b. al-Ḥūwayrith
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ نَصْرِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1287

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ
chapter.englishTitle: In raising the hands during the bowing and prostration

hadiths.englishRaw: He prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he would say takbeer when he lowered himself and when he raised himself, and he would raise his hands during the takbeer and he would give salaam with his right and left hand. I said, "Until his face becomes apparent?" He said, "Yes."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: He prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he would say takbeer when he lowered himself and when he raised himself, and he would raise his hands during the takbeer and he would give salaam with his right and left hand. I said, "Until his face becomes apparent?" He said, "Yes."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَكَانَ «يُكَبِّرُ إِذَا خَفَضَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ وَيَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ عِنْدَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَيُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ وَضَحُ وَجْهِهِ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Abū al-Bakhtarī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Yaḥṣubī \u003e Wāʾil al-Ḥaḍramī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْيَحْصُبِيِّ عَنْ وَائِلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1288

chapter.englishTitle: Who is more deserving of the imamate?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a group of my people while we were young. We stayed with him for twenty nights, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was a companion to us. When he saw our yearning for our families, he said, 'Return to your families and be among them. Command them and teach them, and pray as you have seen me pray. When the time for prayer comes, let one of you give the call to prayer and then lead you in prayer, with the most knowledgeable among you leading."'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a group of my people while we were young. We stayed with him for twenty nights, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was a companion to us. When he saw our yearning for our families, he said, 'Return to your families and be among them. Command them and teach them, and pray as you have seen me pray. When the time for prayer comes, let one of you give the call to prayer and then lead you in prayer, with the most knowledgeable among you leading."'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنْ قَوْمِي وَنَحْنُ شَبَبَةٌ فَأَقَمْنَا عِنْدَهُ عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَفِيقًا فَلَمَّا رَأَى شَوْقَنَا إِلَى أَهْلِينَا قَالَ «ارْجِعُوا إِلَى أَهْلِيكُمْ فَكُونُوا فِيهِمْ فَمُرُوهُمْ وَعَلِّمُوهُمْ وَصَلُّوا كَمَا رَأَيْتُمُونِي أُصَلِّي فَإِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلْيُؤَذِّنْ لَكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ ثُمَّ لِيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَكْبَرُكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Wuhayb b. Khālid \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Mālik b. al-Ḥūwayrith
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1289

chapter.englishTitle: Who is more deserving of the imamate?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺsaid: 'If there are three people, let one of them lead the others in prayer, and the one who has the most right to lead the prayer is the one who recites (knows) the most (Qur'an)."'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺsaid: 'If there are three people, let one of them lead the others in prayer, and the one who has the most right to lead the prayer is the one who recites (knows) the most (Qur'an)."'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ ثَلَاثَةٌ فَلْيَؤُمَّهُمْ أَحَدُهُمْ وَأَحَقُّهُمْ بِالْإِمَامَةِ أَقْرَؤُهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1290

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: مَقَامُ مَنْ يُصَلِّي مَعَ الْإِمَامِ إِذَا كَانَ وَحْدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: The position of someone who is praying with the Imam when they a...

hadiths.englishRaw: I was at my aunt Maymuna's when the Prophet ﷺ came after the night prayer and performed four units of prayer. Then he stood up and said, "Did the spoiled one sleep?" or a similar word. Then he stood up and prayed. Then I came and stood on his left, and he took my hand and placed me on his right.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I was at my aunt Maymuna's when the Prophet ﷺ came after the night prayer and performed four units of prayer. Then he stood up and said, "Did the spoiled one sleep?" or a similar word. Then he stood up and prayed. Then I came and stood on his left, and he took my hand and placed me on his right.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ خَالَتِي مَيْمُونَةَ فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ فَصَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَالَ «أَنَامَ الْغُلَيِّمُ؟» أَوْ كَلِمَةً نَحْوَهَا فَقَامَ فَصَلَّى فَجِئْتُ فَقُمْتُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي فَجَعَلَنِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1291

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِيمَنْ يُصَلِّي خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ، وَالْإِمَامُ جَالِسٌ
chapter.englishTitle: Who prays behind the Imam while the Imam is sitting?

hadiths.englishRaw: the Imam is appointed only to be followed ; so when he prays standing, pray standing, and when he bows, bow; when he raises himself, raise yourselves; when he says “Allah listen to him who praises Him”, “Our Lord ! to Thee be the praise”: and when he prays sitting all of you pray sitting.    – Sound
hadiths.body: the Imam is appointed only to be followed ; so when he prays standing, pray standing, and when he bows, bow; when he raises himself, raise yourselves; when he says “Allah listen to him who praises Him”, “Our Lord ! to Thee be the praise”: and when he prays sitting all of you pray sitting.    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَكِبَ فَرَسًا فَصُرِعَ عَنْهُ فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الْأَيْمَنُ فَصَلَّى صَلَاةً مِنَ الصَّلَوَاتِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ جُلُوسًا فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الْإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ فَلَا تَخْتَلِفُوا عَلَيْهِ فَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَإِنْ صَلَّى قَاعِدًا فَصَلُّوا قُعُودًا أَجْمَعُونَ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1292

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِيمَنْ يُصَلِّي خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ، وَالْإِمَامُ جَالِسٌ
chapter.englishTitle: Who prays behind the Imam while the Imam is sitting?

hadiths.englishRaw: I went to ʿAisha and asked her to describe to me the illness of Messenger of Allah ﷺ. ʿAisha said, "Yes. The Prophet became seriously ill and asked whether the people had prayed. We replied, 'No. O Allah's Apostle! They are waiting for you.' He added, 'Put water for me in a trough." ʿAisha added, "We did so. He took a bath and tried to get up but fainted. When he recovered, he again asked whether the people had prayed. We said, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Messenger of Allah ﷺ,' He again said, 'Put water in a trough for me.' He sat down and took a bath and tried to get up but fainted again. Then he recovered and said, 'Have the people prayed?' We replied, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Allah's Apostle.' He said, 'Put water for me in the trough.' Then he sat down and washed himself and tried to get up but he fainted. When he recovered, he asked, 'Have the people prayed?' We said, 'No, they are waiting for you. O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! The people were in the mosque waiting for the Prophet ﷺ for the ʿIsha prayer. The Prophet ﷺ sent for Abu Bakr to lead the people in the prayer. The messenger went to Abu Bakr and said, 'Messenger of Allah ﷺ orders you to lead the people in the prayer.' Abu Bakr was a softhearted man, so he asked ʿUmar to lead the prayer but ʿUmar replied, 'You are more rightful.' So Abu Bakr led the prayer in those days. When the Prophet ﷺ felt a bit better, he came out for the Zuhr prayer with the help of two persons one of whom was Al-ʿAbbas. while Abu Bakr was leading the people in the prayer. When Abu Bakr saw him he wanted to retreat but the Prophet ﷺ beckoned him not to do so and asked them to make him sit beside Abu Bakr and they did so. Abu Bakr was following the Prophet (in the prayer) and the people were following Abu Bakr. The Prophet (prayed) sitting." 'Ubaidullah added "I went to ʿAbdullah bin ʿAbbas and asked him, Shall I tell you what Aisha has told me about the fatal illness of the Prophet?' Ibn ʿAbbas said, 'Go ahead. I told him her narration and he did not deny anything of it but asked whether ʿAisha told me the name of the second person (who helped the Prophet ﷺ ) along with Al-Abbas. I said. 'No.' He said, 'He was ʿAli (Ibn Abi Talib).    – Sound Chain

hadiths.arabic: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا أَلَا تُحَدِّثِينِي عَنْ مَرَضِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ فَقَالَتْ بَلَى ثَقُلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ؟» قُلْنَا لَا هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ «ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ» قَالَتْ فَفَعَلْنَا فَاغْتَسَلَ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَقَالَ «أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ؟» فَقُلْنَا لَا هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ «ضَعُوا لِي مَاءً فِي الْمِخْضَبِ» فَفَعَلْنَا ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ لِيَنُوءَ فَأُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَقَالَ «أَصَلَّى النَّاسُ؟» فَقُلْنَا لَا هُمْ يَنْتَظِرُونَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَتْ وَالنَّاسُ عُكُوفٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَنْتَظِرُونَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِصَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ قَالَتْ فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ قَالَتْ فَأَتَاهُ الرَّسُولُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْمُرُكَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ بِالنَّاسِ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَكَانَ رَجُلًا رَقِيقًا يَا عُمَرُ صَلِّ بِالنَّاسِ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ أَنْتَ أَحَقُّ بِذَلِكَ قَالَتْ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ تِلْكَ الْأَيَّامَ قَالَتْ ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَجَدَ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ خِفَّةً فَخَرَجَ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا الْعَبَّاسُ لِصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ذَهَبَ لِيَتَأَخَّرَ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ لَا يَتَأَخَّرَ وَقَالَ لَهُمَا «أَجْلِسَانِي إِلَى جَنْبِهِ» فَأَجْلَسَاهُ إِلَى جَنْبِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَتْ فَجَعَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ بِصَلَاةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَالنَّاسُ يُصَلُّونَ بِصَلَاةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَالنَّبِيُّ ﷺ قَاعِدٌ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَلَا أَعْرِضُ عَلَيْكَ مَا حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ عَنْ مَرَضِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ فَقَالَ هَاتِ فَعَرَضْتُ حَدِيثَهَا عَلَيْهِ فَمَا أَنْكَرَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَسَمَّتْ لَكَ الرَّجُلَ الَّذِي كَانَ مَعَ الْعَبَّاسِ؟ قُلْتُ لَا فَقَالَ هُوَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Yūnus \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Mūsá b. Abū ʿĀʾishah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1293

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْإِمَامِ يُصَلِّي بِالْقَوْمِ وَهُوَ أَنْشَزُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Imam prays with the people while he is shorter than his comp...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sitting on the pulpit. He made the takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) and the people behind him also made takbir. Then he bowed while still on the pulpit. Then he lifted his head and descended to the lower part of the pulpit and prostrated at the base of the pulpit. Then he returned until he completed his last prayer." Abu Muhammad said, "In this there is permission for the imam to be higher than his companions, and the same applies to this action in prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sitting on the pulpit. He made the takbir (saying Allahu Akbar) and the people behind him also made takbir. Then he bowed while still on the pulpit. Then he lifted his head and descended to the lower part of the pulpit and prostrated at the base of the pulpit. Then he returned until he completed his last prayer." Abu Muhammad said, "In this there is permission for the imam to be higher than his companions, and the same applies to this action in prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «جَلَسَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَكَبَّرَ فَكَبَّرَ النَّاسُ خَلْفَهُ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَزَلَ الْقَهْقَرَى فَسَجَدَ فِي أَصْلِ الْمِنْبَرِ ثُمَّ عَادَ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ آخِرِ صَلَاتِهِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «فِي ذَلِكَ رُخْصَةٌ لِلْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَرْفَعَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ وَقَدْرُ هَذَا الْعَمَلِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ أَيْضًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Maʿmar Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Abū Ḥāzim from his father \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1294

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُمِرَ الْإِمَامُ مِنَ التَّخْفِيفِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Imam has been ordered to do in terms of alleviating the...

hadiths.englishRaw: “A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah! I stay behind and do not perform the morning prayer (in congregation) because of so-and-so, for he makes it too long for us.’ I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ preaching with such anger as he did that day. He said; ‘O people! There are among you those who repel others. Whoever among you leads others in prayer, let him keep it short, for among them are those who are weak and elderly, and those who have pressing needs.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah! I stay behind and do not perform the morning prayer (in congregation) because of so-and-so, for he makes it too long for us.’ I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ preaching with such anger as he did that day. He said; ‘O people! There are among you those who repel others. Whoever among you leads others in prayer, let him keep it short, for among them are those who are weak and elderly, and those who have pressing needs.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَتَأَخَّرُ عَنْ صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ مِمَّا يُطِيلُ بِنَا فِيهَا فُلَانٌ فَمَا رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَشَدَّ غَضَبًا فِي مَوْعِظَةٍ مِنْهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَالَ «أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ مِنْكُمْ مُنَفِّرِينَ فَمَنْ صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ فَلْيَتَجَوَّزْ فَإِنَّ فِيهِمُ الْكَبِيرَ وَالضَّعِيفَ وَذَا الْحَاجَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn Nbʾanā Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid \u003e Qays \u003e Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أنْبأَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1295

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أُمِرَ الْإِمَامُ مِنَ التَّخْفِيفِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Imam has been ordered to do in terms of alleviating the...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Anas say that the Prophet ﷺ used to perform the most secretive and concealed prayers among the people.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Anas say that the Prophet ﷺ used to perform the most secretive and concealed prayers among the people.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «أَخَفَّ النَّاسِ صَلَاةً فِي تَمَامٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1296

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَتَى يَقُومُ النَّاسُ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ
chapter.englishTitle: When do people stand up when the prayer is established?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When the call to prayer is given, do not stand up until you see me.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When the call to prayer is given, do not stand up until you see me.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَاةِ فَلَا تَقُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْنِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Katab Ilay Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1297

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَتَى يَقُومُ النَّاسُ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ
chapter.englishTitle: When do people stand up when the prayer is established?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When the prayer is established, do not stand up until you see me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When the prayer is established, do not stand up until you see me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلَا تَقُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْنِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn Nbʾanā Hammām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أنْبأَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1298

chapter.englishTitle: In the establishment of the classes

hadiths.englishRaw: Straighten your rows for the straightening of the rows is part of perfecting the prayer.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Straighten your rows for the straightening of the rows is part of perfecting the prayer.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «سَوُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ فَإِنَّ تَسْوِيَةَ الصُّفُوفِ مِنْ تَمَامِ الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim And Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1299

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ مَنْ يَصِلُ الصَّفِّ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of One Who Joins the Row in Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Straighten your rows, for your hearts will not be united if your rows are not."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Straighten your rows, for your hearts will not be united if your rows are not."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قال «سَوُّوا صُفُوفَكُمْ لَا تَخْتَلِفُ قُلُوبُكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ṭalḥah b. Muṣarrif \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAwsajah \u003e al-Barāʾ b. ʿĀzib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ مُصَرِّفٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْسَجَةَ عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1300

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of the First Grade

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from ‘Irbad bin Sariyah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to ask for forgiveness for the first row three times and for the second row twice.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from ‘Irbad bin Sariyah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to ask for forgiveness for the first row three times and for the second row twice.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِلصَّفِّ الْأَوَّلِ ثَلَاثًا وَللثَّانِي مَرَّةً»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān \u003e ʿIrbāḍ b. Sāriyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ عَنْ عِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1301

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of the First Grade

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. Mūsá al-Ashyab \u003e Shaybān \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān \u003e Jubayr b. Nufayr \u003e ʿIrbāḍ b. Sāriyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْأَشْيَبُ عَنْ شَيْبَانَ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ عِرْبَاضِ بْنِ سَارِيَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1302

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ يَلِي الْإِمَامَ مِنَ النَّاسِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who follows the Imam among the people?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to touch our shoulders in prayer and say: Keep straight, don't be irregular, for there would be dissension in your hearts. Let those of you who are sedate and prudent be near me, then those who are next to them, then those who are next to them. Abu Mas'ud said: Now-a-days there is much dissension amongst you.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) used to touch our shoulders in prayer and say: Keep straight, don't be irregular, for there would be dissension in your hearts. Let those of you who are sedate and prudent be near me, then those who are next to them, then those who are next to them. Abu Mas'ud said: Now-a-days there is much dissension amongst you.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَمْسَحُ مَنَاكِبَنَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَيَقُولُ «لَا تَخْتَلِفُوا فَتَخْتَلِفَ قُلُوبُكُمْ لِيَلِيَنِّي مِنْكُمْ أُولُو الْأَحْلَامِ وَالنُّهَى ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ» قَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ فَأَنْتُمُ الْيَوْمَ أَشَدُّ اخْتِلَافًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿUmārah b. ʿUmayr \u003e Abū Maʿmar \u003e Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1303

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ يَلِي الْإِمَامَ مِنَ النَّاسِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who follows the Imam among the people?

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to gently pat our shoulders (to make sure the row was straight) at the time of prayer, saying: ‘Keep (the rows) straight, do not differ from one another lest your hearts should suffer from discord. Let those who are forbearing and wise stand closest to me, then those who are next to them, then those who are next to them.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to gently pat our shoulders (to make sure the row was straight) at the time of prayer, saying: ‘Keep (the rows) straight, do not differ from one another lest your hearts should suffer from discord. Let those who are forbearing and wise stand closest to me, then those who are next to them, then those who are next to them.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لِيَلِيَنِّي مِنْكُمْ أُولُو الْأَحْلَامِ وَالنُّهَى ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ وَلَا تَخْتَلِفُوا فَتَخْتَلِفَ قُلُوبُكُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَهَوْشَاتِ الْأَسْوَاقِ» قَالَ الْهَوْشَاتُ الِاجْتِمَاعُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Khālid \u003e Abū Maʿshar \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1304

chapter.englishTitle: Which rows of women are better?

hadiths.englishRaw: The best rows for men are the first rows, and the worst ones the last ones, and the best rows for women are the last ones and the worst ones for them are the first ones.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The best rows for men are the first rows, and the worst ones the last ones, and the best rows for women are the last ones and the worst ones for them are the first ones.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «خَيْرُ صُفُوفِ الرِّجَالِ أَوَّلُهَا وَشَرُّهَا آخِرُهَا وَخَيْرُ صُفُوفِ النِّسَاءِ آخِرُهَا وَشَرُّهَا أَوَّلُهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1305

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أيِّ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ أَثْقَلُ
chapter.englishTitle: Section 53

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Fajr prayer, then he turned towards us and said, "Is [so and so] present?" They replied, "No." He then asked, "Is [so and so] present?" They replied, "No." He asked this about some hypocrites who did not attend the prayer. He then said, "Indeed, these two prayers are the heaviest on the hypocrites. If they knew their reward, they would have surely come to them even if they had to crawl."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Fajr prayer, then he turned towards us and said, "Is [so and so] present?" They replied, "No." He then asked, "Is [so and so] present?" They replied, "No." He asked this about some hypocrites who did not attend the prayer. He then said, "Indeed, these two prayers are the heaviest on the hypocrites. If they knew their reward, they would have surely come to them even if they had to crawl."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَاةَ الصُّبْحِ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ «أَشَاهِدٌ فُلَانٌ؟» قَالُوا لَا فَقَالَ «أَشَاهِدٌ فُلَانٌ؟» فَقَالُوا لَا لِنَفَرٍ مِنَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَمْ يَشْهَدُوا الصَّلَاةَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ هَاتَيْنِ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ أَثْقَلُ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا لَأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Baṣīr \u003e Ubay b. Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1306

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أيِّ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ أَثْقَلُ
chapter.englishTitle: Section 53

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet (pbuh), and I heard it from Ubayy.
hadiths.body: About the Prophet (pbuh), and I heard it from Ubayy.
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَسَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ أُبَيٍّ
hadiths.chain: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Baṣīr from my father \u003e Ubay
hadiths.chainArabic: قالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ أُبَيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1307

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أيِّ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ أَثْقَلُ
chapter.englishTitle: Section 53

hadiths.englishRaw: This hadith has been narrated oif the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters.    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: This hadith has been narrated oif the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters.    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَ ذلكَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Zuhayr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Baṣīr from his father \u003e Ubay b. Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا أَبُو غَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1308

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أيِّ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ أَثْقَلُ
chapter.englishTitle: Section 53
