hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet, peace be upon him, something similar to him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet, peace be upon him, something similar to him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah \u003e Khālid b. Maymūn \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Baṣīr from his father \u003e Ubay b. Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1309

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أيِّ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ أَثْقَلُ
chapter.englishTitle: Section 53

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The most burdensome prayers for the hypocrites are the 'Isha' prayer and the Fajr prayer. If only they knew what (reward) there is in them, they would come to them even if they had to crawl.'"
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'The most burdensome prayers for the hypocrites are the 'Isha' prayer and the Fajr prayer. If only they knew what (reward) there is in them, they would come to them even if they had to crawl.'"
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ أَثْقَلُ عَلَى الْمُنَافِقِينَ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ وَصَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا لَأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا»
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1310

chapter.englishTitle: Regarding those who neglect prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I had the intention to command my young men to gather firewood, then command a man to lead the people in prayer. After that, I would differ to a group of people who have been lagging behind in performing this prayer. I would then set their homes on fire, even if they were thickened date-palm or al-murr trees. They would definitely come to witness it, and even if they knew what was inside, they would still come, even if they had to crawl."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I had the intention to command my young men to gather firewood, then command a man to lead the people in prayer. After that, I would differ to a group of people who have been lagging behind in performing this prayer. I would then set their homes on fire, even if they were thickened date-palm or al-murr trees. They would definitely come to witness it, and even if they knew what was inside, they would still come, even if they had to crawl."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آمُرَ فِتْيَانِي فَيَجْمَعُوا حَطَبًا فَآمُرَ رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ أُخَالِفَ إِلَى أَقْوَامٍ يَتَخَلَّفُونَ عَنْ هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةِ فَأُحَرِّقَ عَلَيْهِمْ بُيُوتَهُمْ لَوْ كَانَ عَرْقًا سَمِينًا أَوْ مُعَرَّقَيَنِ لَشَهِدُوهُمَا وَلَوْ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا فِيهِمَا لَأَتَوْهُمَا وَلَوْ حَبْوًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1311

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرُّخْصَةِ فِي تَرْكِ الْجَمَاعَةِ إِذَا كَانَ مَطَرٌ فِي السَّفَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Leaving the group during travel if it's raining.

hadiths.englishRaw: "It was in a cold night that he descended in Dajnan, then he ordered a caller who called for prayer in the camp. Then, he informed that the Prophet ﷺ used to, when he was on a journey on a cold or rainy night, order a caller who would call 'Prayer in the camps'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It was in a cold night that he descended in Dajnan, then he ordered a caller who called for prayer in the camp. Then, he informed that the Prophet ﷺ used to, when he was on a journey on a cold or rainy night, order a caller who would call 'Prayer in the camps'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ نَزَلَ بِضَجْنَانَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بَارِدَةٍ فَأَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى الصَّلَاةُ فِي الرِّحَالِ ثُمَّ أَخْبَرَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بَارِدَةٍ أَوِ ْمَطيَرِةٍ أَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى «الصَّلَاةُ فِي الرِّحَالِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1312

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of congregational prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "Pray behind the imam, for Abu Hurairah narrated to us that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The prayer of a man in congregation surpasses his individual prayer by twenty-five parts.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Pray behind the imam, for Abu Hurairah narrated to us that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The prayer of a man in congregation surpasses his individual prayer by twenty-five parts.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بِالَّتِي صَلَّى مَعَ الْإِمَامِ فَإِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي الْجَمِيعِ تَزِيدُ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِ وَحْدَهُ بِضْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ جُزْءًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَخْبَرَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ رَجُلٌ صَلَّى فِي بَيْتِهِ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَ الْإِمَامَ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي أَيُصَلِّي مَعَهُ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ قُلْتُ بِأَيَّتِهِمَا يَحْتَسِبُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1313

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of congregational prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The prayer of a person in congregation is twenty-seven times in excess to the prayer said alone.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The prayer of a person in congregation is twenty-seven times in excess to the prayer said alone.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ تَزِيدُ عَلَى صَلَاتِهِ وَحْدَهُ سَبْعًا وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1314

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ عَنْ مَنْعِ النِّسَاءِ عَنِ الْمَسَاجِدِ وَكَيْفَ يَخْرُجْنَ إِذَا خَرَجْنَ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of preventing women from entering mosques and ho...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When the wife of any one of you asks for permission to go to the Masjid, do not stop her.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When the wife of any one of you asks for permission to go to the Masjid, do not stop her.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْ أَحَدَكُمْ زَوْجَتُهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَا يَمْنَعْهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1315

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ عَنْ مَنْعِ النِّسَاءِ عَنِ الْمَسَاجِدِ وَكَيْفَ يَخْرُجْنَ إِذَا خَرَجْنَ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of preventing women from entering mosques and ho...

hadiths.englishRaw: Do not prevent the female servants of Allah from visiting the mosques of Allah, but they may go out (to the mosque) having no perfumed themselves.     – Sound
hadiths.body: Do not prevent the female servants of Allah from visiting the mosques of Allah, but they may go out (to the mosque) having no perfumed themselves.     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَمْنَعُوا إِمَاءَ اللَّهِ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ وَلْيَخْرُجْنَ إِذَا خَرَجْنَ تَفِلَاتٍ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn Nbʾanā Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أنْبأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1316

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ عَنْ مَنْعِ النِّسَاءِ عَنِ الْمَسَاجِدِ وَكَيْفَ يَخْرُجْنَ إِذَا خَرَجْنَ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of preventing women from entering mosques and ho...

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of "سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ التَّفِلَةُ الَّتِي لَا طِيبَ لَهَا" in English is "Sa'eed bin Aamir, the fruit known for its lack of taste."
hadiths.body: The translation of "سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ التَّفِلَةُ الَّتِي لَا طِيبَ لَهَا" in English is "Sa'eed bin Aamir, the fruit known for its lack of taste."
hadiths.arabic: سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ التَّفِلَةُ الَّتِي لَا طِيبَ لَهَا
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAmr Biʾisnād Hadhā al-Ḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو بِإِسْنَادِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1317

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا حَضَرَ الْعَشَاءُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ
chapter.englishTitle: If dinner is served and prayer is performed

hadiths.englishRaw: “If food is served and the Iqamah for prayer is given, then start with the food.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “If food is served and the Iqamah for prayer is given, then start with the food.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا وُضِعَ الْعَشَاءُ وَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَابْدَءُوا بِالْعَشَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1318

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا حَضَرَ الْعَشَاءُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ
chapter.englishTitle: If dinner is served and prayer is performed

hadiths.englishRaw: “If food is served and the Iqamah for prayer is given, then start with the food.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “If food is served and the Iqamah for prayer is given, then start with the food.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا حَضَرَ الْعَشَاءُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَابْدَءُوا بِالْعَشَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah And Sulaymān b. Kathīr \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1319

chapter.englishTitle: How to walk to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "When the Iqamah is called for the prayer, do not come running. Come walking with tranquility. Whatever you catch up with, pray, and whatever you miss, complete it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "When the Iqamah is called for the prayer, do not come running. Come walking with tranquility. Whatever you catch up with, pray, and whatever you miss, complete it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أَتَيْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَلَا تَأْتُوهَا تَسْعَوْنَ وَأْتُوهَا تَمْشُونَ وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّكِينَةُ فَمَا أَدْرَكْتُمْ فَصَلُّوا وَمَا فَاتَكُمْ فَأَتِمُّوا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1320

chapter.englishTitle: How to walk to prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you come to the prayer, you must bring peace and tranquility. Whatever you catch, then perform the prayer, and whatever you miss, then complete it."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you come to the prayer, you must bring peace and tranquility. Whatever you catch, then perform the prayer, and whatever you miss, then complete it."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا أَتَيْتُمُ الصَّلَاةَ فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةِ فَمَا أَدْرَكْتُمْ فَصَلُّوا وَمَا سُبِقْتُمْ فَأَتِمُّوا»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Shaybān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1321

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Walking to the Mosques

hadiths.englishRaw: There was a man in the city whom I did not know in the city one of those who was farthest from the mosque and he used to pray the prayers with the Messenger of Allah. It was said to him, "If you bought a donkey to ride on during the hot and dark times?" He said, "By Allah, it does not please me that my place is closer to the mosque by clinging to it." So, the Prophet ﷺ was informed about that, and he asked him about it. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, my traces, sins, returning to my family, my approach, and my retreat, should they be written?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah will grant you all of that and give you what you expect."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: There was a man in the city whom I did not know in the city one of those who was farthest from the mosque and he used to pray the prayers with the Messenger of Allah. It was said to him, "If you bought a donkey to ride on during the hot and dark times?" He said, "By Allah, it does not please me that my place is closer to the mosque by clinging to it." So, the Prophet ﷺ was informed about that, and he asked him about it. He said, "O Messenger of Allah, my traces, sins, returning to my family, my approach, and my retreat, should they be written?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah will grant you all of that and give you what you expect."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَجُلٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ لَا أَعْلَمُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ ممَنْ يُصَلِّي الْقِبْلَةِ أَبْعَدَ مَنْزِلًا مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ مِنْهُ وَكَانَ يَصلي الصَّلَوَاتِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقِيلَ لَهُ لَوِ ابْتَعْتَ حِمَارًا تَرْكَبُهُ فِي الرَّمْضَاءِ وَالظَّلْمَاءِ؟ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنَّ مَنْزِلِي بِلِزْقِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَأُخْبِرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِذَلِكَ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْمَا يُكْتَبَ أَثَرِي وَخُطَايَ وَرُجُوعِي إِلَى أَهْلِي وَإِقْبَالِي وَإِدْبَارِي أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَنْطَاكَ اللَّهُ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ وَأَعْطَاكَ مَا احْتَسَبْتَ أَجْمَعَ» أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Taymī \u003e Abū ʿUthmān \u003e Ubay b. Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1322

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ خَلْفَ الصَّفِّ وَحْدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of the man behind the row by himself

hadiths.englishRaw: "He heard that he had seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while a man was praying behind him without joining the rows. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him to repeat the prayer. Abu Muhammad said, 'Ahmad ibn Hanbal used to confirm the hadith of Amr ibn Murrah, while I follow the hadith of Yazid ibn Ziyad ibn Abi Al-Ja'd.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "He heard that he had seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while a man was praying behind him without joining the rows. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded him to repeat the prayer. Abu Muhammad said, 'Ahmad ibn Hanbal used to confirm the hadith of Amr ibn Murrah, while I follow the hadith of Yazid ibn Ziyad ibn Abi Al-Ja'd.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: يَسْمَعُ أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَقَدْ صَلَّى خَلْفَهُ رَجُلٌ وَلَمْ يَتَّصِلْ بِالصُّفُوفِ «فَأَمَرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُعِيدَ الصَّلَاةَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «كَانَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ يُثْبِتُ حَدِيثَ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ وَأَنَا أَذْهَبُ إِلَى حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Zubayd \u003e ʿAbthar b. al-Qāsim \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e Hilāl b. Yasāf \u003e Akhadh Biyadī Ziyād b. Abū al-Jaʿd Faʾaqāmanī \u003e Shaykh from Banī Asad Yuqāl Lah Wābiṣah b. Maʿbad \u003e Hadhā And al-Rrajul
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ هُوَ عَبْثَرُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ قَالَ أَخَذَ بِيَدِي زِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ فَأَقَامَنِي عَلَى شَيْخٍ مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ وَابِصَةُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي هَذَا وَالرَّجُلُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1323

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ خَلْفَ الصَّفِّ وَحْدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of the man behind the row by himself

hadiths.englishRaw: “Ziyad bin Abu-Ja’d took me by the hand and made me stand near an old man at Raqqah, whose name was Wabisah bin Ma’bad. He said: ‘A man performed prayer behind the row on his own, and the Prophet ﷺ commanded him to repeat the prayer.’”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “Ziyad bin Abu-Ja’d took me by the hand and made me stand near an old man at Raqqah, whose name was Wabisah bin Ma’bad. He said: ‘A man performed prayer behind the row on his own, and the Prophet ﷺ commanded him to repeat the prayer.’”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا «صَلَّى خَلْفَ الصُّفُوفِ وَحْدَهُ فَأَمَرَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ يُعِيدَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ أَقُولُ بِهَذَا   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dāwud \u003e Yazīd b. Ziyād \u003e ʿUbayd b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Ziyād b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Wābiṣah b. Maʿbad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ وَابِصَةَ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1324

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ خَلْفَ الصَّفِّ وَحْدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of the man behind the row by himself

hadiths.englishRaw: Get up, I shall lead you in prayer. Anas said: I got up and took a mat which had become black on account of long use. I then washed it with water. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood upon it. I and the orphan (Ibn Abi Dumairah, the freed slave of the prophet) stood in a row behind him. The old women stood behind us. He then led us in two raka'at of prayer and left.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Get up, I shall lead you in prayer. Anas said: I got up and took a mat which had become black on account of long use. I then washed it with water. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood upon it. I and the orphan (Ibn Abi Dumairah, the freed slave of the prophet) stood in a row behind him. The old women stood behind us. He then led us in two raka'at of prayer and left.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ جَدَّتَهُ مُلَيْكَةَ دَعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِطَعَامٍ صَنَعَتْهُ فَأَكَلَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «قُومُوا فَلِأُصَلِّيَ بِكُمْ» قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى حَصِيرٍ لَنَا قَدِ اسْوَدَّ مِنْ طُولِ مَا لُبِسَ فَنَضَحْتُهُ بِمَاءٍ فَقَامَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَصَفَفْتُ أَنَا وَالْيَتِيمُ وَرَاءَهُ وَالْعَجُوزُ وَرَاءَنَا فَصَلَّى لَنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1325

chapter.englishTitle: The Importance of Reading in the Afternoon

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray with about thirty verses in the first two units of the noon prayer and in the last two units, he would recite about half of that. In the afternoon prayer, he would recite about two units' worth of verses from the noon prayer and in the last two units, he would recite about half of that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray with about thirty verses in the first two units of the noon prayer and in the last two units, he would recite about half of that. In the afternoon prayer, he would recite about two units' worth of verses from the noon prayer and in the last two units, he would recite about half of that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «يَقُومُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأُولَيَيْنِ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ قَدْرَ ثَلَاثِينَ آيَةً وَفِي الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ عَلَى قَدْرِ النِّصْفِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَفِي الْعَصْرِ عَلَى قَدْرِ الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ وَفِي الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ عَلَى قَدْرِ النِّصْفِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Manṣūr b. Zādhān \u003e al-Walīd Abū Bishr \u003e Abū al-Ṣiddīq al-Nājī \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ زَاذَانَ عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1326

chapter.englishTitle: The Importance of Reading in the Afternoon

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by Abu Sa'id, He added to it the measure of reading {Alif-Lam-Meem Tanzeel} [Surah As-Sajdah:2] in the Sajdah.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by Abu Sa'id, He added to it the measure of reading {Alif-Lam-Meem Tanzeel} [Surah As-Sajdah:2] in the Sajdah.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ بِنَحْوِهِ وَزَادَ فِيهِ قَدْرَ قِرَاءَةِ {الم تَنْزِيلُ} [السجدة 2] السَّجْدَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hushaym \u003e Manṣūr \u003e al-Walīd Abū Bishr \u003e Abū al-Ṣiddīq
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1327

chapter.englishTitle: The Importance of Reading in the Afternoon

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to recite "By the heaven holding the big stars" and: "By the heaven, and At-Tariq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star)" and similar surahs in Zuhr and 'Asr.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to recite "By the heaven holding the big stars" and: "By the heaven, and At-Tariq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star)" and similar surahs in Zuhr and 'Asr.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «يَقْرَأُ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ بِ السَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e Jābir b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1328

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ الْعَمَلُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: How to perform the reading in Dhuhr and Asr?

hadiths.englishRaw: My father said, "The Prophet ﷺ used to recite Al-Fatiha along with another Sura in the first two rakʿat of the Zuhr and ʿAsr prayers. A verse or so was audible at times and he used to prolong the first rakʿa."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: My father said, "The Prophet ﷺ used to recite Al-Fatiha along with another Sura in the first two rakʿat of the Zuhr and ʿAsr prayers. A verse or so was audible at times and he used to prolong the first rakʿa."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «يَقْرَأُ بِأُمِّ الْقُرْآنِ وَبِسُورَتَيْنِ مَعَهَا فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأُولَيَيْنِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ وَصَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ وَيُسْمِعُنَا الْآيَةَ أَحْيَانًا وَكَانَ يُطَوِّلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1329

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ الْعَمَلُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: How to perform the reading in Dhuhr and Asr?

hadiths.englishRaw: From Yahya through his chain of narration, similar to it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Yahya through his chain of narration, similar to it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ يَحْيَى بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Awzāʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1330

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ الْعَمَلُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: How to perform the reading in Dhuhr and Asr?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to read in the first two units of the Dhuhr prayer Surat Al-Fatiha and two other Surahs. In the last two units, he used to read Surat Al-Fatiha only and he would make us hear the verse. He would prolong the first unit more than the second unit, and he would do the same in the Asr and Fajr prayers.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to read in the first two units of the Dhuhr prayer Surat Al-Fatiha and two other Surahs. In the last two units, he used to read Surat Al-Fatiha only and he would make us hear the verse. He would prolong the first unit more than the second unit, and he would do the same in the Asr and Fajr prayers.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «يَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأُولَيَيْنِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ وَِسُورَتَيْنِ وَفِي الْأُخْرَيَيْنِ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ وَكَانَ يُسْمِعُنَا الْآيَةَ وَكَانَ يُطِيلُ الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى مَا لَا يُطِيلُ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ وَهَكَذَا فِي صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ وَهَكَذَا فِي صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hammām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1331

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي قَدْرِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the field of reading in Morocco

hadiths.englishRaw: She heard the Prophet ﷺ recite Al-Mursalat in Maghrib.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: She heard the Prophet ﷺ recite Al-Mursalat in Maghrib.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالْمُرْسَلَاتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar Nbʾnā Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Um al-Faḍl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أنبأنا يُونُسُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1332

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي قَدْرِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the field of reading in Morocco

hadiths.englishRaw: She heard the Prophet ﷺ recite Al-Mursalat in Maghrib.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: She heard the Prophet ﷺ recite Al-Mursalat in Maghrib.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «يَقْرَأُ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ بِالطُّورِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Muḥammad b. Jubayr b. Muṭʿim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1333

chapter.englishTitle: The value of reading in the evening.

hadiths.englishRaw: Muadh used to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and then go to his people and lead them in prayer. One night, he prayed the 'Isha prayer and recited Surah Al-Baqarah. A man from the Ansar came and prayed behind him, then left. The man heard that Muadh was complaining about him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he asked him about it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Muadh, "You are causing a fitna (trial) and a fitna." Then he ordered him to recite two middle Surahs from the Mufassal (the last part of the Qur'an). Abu Muhammad said, "We adhere to this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Muadh used to pray with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and then go to his people and lead them in prayer. One night, he prayed the 'Isha prayer and recited Surah Al-Baqarah. A man from the Ansar came and prayed behind him, then left. The man heard that Muadh was complaining about him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he asked him about it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Muadh, "You are causing a fitna (trial) and a fitna." Then he ordered him to recite two middle Surahs from the Mufassal (the last part of the Qur'an). Abu Muhammad said, "We adhere to this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ مُعَاذًا كَانَ يُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي قَوْمَهُ فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَجَاءَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَصَلَّى الْعَتَمَةَ وَقَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ فَبَلَغَهُ أَنَّ مُعَاذًا يَنَالُ مِنْهُ فَشَكَا ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِمُعَاذٍ «فَاتِنًا فَاتِنًا فَاتِنًا أَوْ فَتَّانًا فَتَّانًا فَتَّانًا » ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ بِسُورَتَيْنِ مِنْ وَسَطِ الْمُفَصَّلِ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ نَأْخُذُ بِهَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1334

chapter.englishTitle: The importance of reading at dawn. (Note: The translation provid...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard my uncle saying that he prayed with the Prophet ﷺ and he heard him reciting in one of the two Rak'ahs of Fajr prayer, "And by the date-palm" [Quran 20:10]. Shu'bah said, "I asked him again and he said, 'I heard him reciting it with "Ba" sound.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard my uncle saying that he prayed with the Prophet ﷺ and he heard him reciting in one of the two Rak'ahs of Fajr prayer, "And by the date-palm" [Quran 20:10]. Shu'bah said, "I asked him again and he said, 'I heard him reciting it with "Ba" sound.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عَمِّي يَقُولُ إِنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَسَمِعَهُ يَقْرَأُ فِي إِحْدَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ الصُّبْحِ {وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ} [ق 10] قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَسَأَلْتُهُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقْرَأُ بِ ق   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ziyād b. ʿIlāqah from my uncle
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1335

chapter.englishTitle: The importance of reading at dawn. (Note: The translation provid...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Prophet ﷺ reciting in the first rak'ah of Fajr, "{By the fig and the olive, And [by] Mount Sinai, And [by] this secure city [Makkah]. Indeed, We created man in the best of stature}" [Quran 95:1-4].   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Prophet ﷺ reciting in the first rak'ah of Fajr, "{By the fig and the olive, And [by] Mount Sinai, And [by] this secure city [Makkah]. Indeed, We created man in the best of stature}" [Quran 95:1-4].   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقْرَأُ فِي الْفَجْرِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى {وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ} [ق 10]   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ziyād b. ʿIlāqah \u003e Quṭbah b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ عَنْ قُطْبَةَ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1336

chapter.englishTitle: The importance of reading at dawn. (Note: The translation provid...

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reciting in the Fajr prayer, "When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up" [At-Takwir 1]. When he reached the verse, "And by the night when it covers with darkness" [At-Takwir 17], I said to myself, "What is the night when it covers with darkness?"
hadiths.body: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ reciting in the Fajr prayer, "When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up" [At-Takwir 1]. When he reached the verse, "And by the night when it covers with darkness" [At-Takwir 17], I said to myself, "What is the night when it covers with darkness?"
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقْرَأُ فِي صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ {إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ} [التكوير 1] فَلَمَّا انْتَهَى إِلَى هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ {وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ} [التكوير 17] جَعَلْتُ أَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي مَا اللَّيْلُ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ؟
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e al-Walīd b. Sarīʿ \u003e ʿAmr b. Ḥurayth
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1337

chapter.englishTitle: The importance of reading at dawn. (Note: The translation provid...

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Amr ibn Huraith, in his direction."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "About Amr ibn Huraith, in his direction."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ نَحْوِهِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Misʿar \u003e al-Walīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1338

chapter.englishTitle: The importance of reading at dawn. (Note: The translation provid...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I entered with my father to visit Abu Barza Al-Aslami, who was sitting on a high couch made of reeds. My father asked him about the time of the Prophet's ﷺ prayers. Abu Barza replied, 'He used to pray Dhuhr (midday) when the sun started to decline, then he would pray Asr (afternoon prayer). After that, one of us would go to his family in the farthest part of the city while the sun was still bright.' I forgot what he mentioned about Maghrib (evening prayer). 'It was preferable to delay Isha (night prayer) to the time you call darkness. The Prophet would leave from Fajr (dawn prayer), and a person would recognize his companion. Additionally, he would recite from around sixty to one hundred verses in it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I entered with my father to visit Abu Barza Al-Aslami, who was sitting on a high couch made of reeds. My father asked him about the time of the Prophet's ﷺ prayers. Abu Barza replied, 'He used to pray Dhuhr (midday) when the sun started to decline, then he would pray Asr (afternoon prayer). After that, one of us would go to his family in the farthest part of the city while the sun was still bright.' I forgot what he mentioned about Maghrib (evening prayer). 'It was preferable to delay Isha (night prayer) to the time you call darkness. The Prophet would leave from Fajr (dawn prayer), and a person would recognize his companion. Additionally, he would recite from around sixty to one hundred verses in it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلْتُ مَعَ أَبِي عَلَى أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ وَهُوَ عَلَى عِلْوٍيةٍ مِنْ قَصَبٍ فَسَأَلَهُ أَبِي عَنْ وَقْتِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي الْهَجِيرَ الَّتِي تَدْعُونَ الظُّهْيرةَ إِذَا دَحَضَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَكَانَ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ يَنْطَلِقُ أَحَدُنَا إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فِي أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ وَالشَّمْسُ حَيَّةٌ» قَالَ وَنَسِيتُ مَا ذَكَرَ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ وَكَانَ «يَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ يُؤَخِّرَ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الَّتِي تَدْعُونَ الْعَتَمَةَ وَكَانَ يَنْصَرِفُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ وَالرَّجُلُ يَعْرِفُ جَلِيسَهُ وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِيهَا مِنَ السِّتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAwf \u003e Sayyār b. Salāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ عَنْ سَيَّارِ بْنِ سَلَامَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1339

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: كَرَاهِيَةِ رَفْعِ الْبَصَرِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Detestability of looking upwards towards the sky in prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ entered the mosque and they raised their eyes towards the sky in prayer. He said, "You should lower your gazes, or your eyes will not return to you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ entered the mosque and they raised their eyes towards the sky in prayer. He said, "You should lower your gazes, or your eyes will not return to you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ الْمَسْجِدَ وَقَدْ رَفَعُوا أَبْصَارَهُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقَالَ «لَتَنْتَهُنَّ أَوْ لَا تَرْجِعُ إِلَيْكُمْ أَبْصَارُكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Khalīl \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e al-Musayyab b. Rāfiʿ \u003e Tamīm b. Ṭarafah \u003e Jābir b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ طَرَفَةَ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1340

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: كَرَاهِيَةِ رَفْعِ الْبَصَرِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Detestability of looking upwards towards the sky in prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What is the matter with people who lift their gaze to the sky when praying?" And he spoke sternly concerning that until he said: "They must stop that or they will certainly lose their eyesight."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "What is the matter with people who lift their gaze to the sky when praying?" And he spoke sternly concerning that until he said: "They must stop that or they will certainly lose their eyesight."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَرْفَعُونَ أَبْصَارَهُمْ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ؟» فَاشْتَدَّ قَوْلُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قَالَ «لَتَنْتَهُنَّ عَنْ ذَلِكَ أَوْ لَيَخْطَفَنَّ اللَّهُ أَبْصَارَكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Muḥammad b. Bishr \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1341

chapter.englishTitle: Working in Rukoo

hadiths.englishRaw: O my son, hit your knees with your hands then I did it again after that by a day, and I prayed towards it and he slapped my hands. When he left, he said, "We used to do this and we were commanded to hit with the palms on the knees."
hadiths.body: O my son, hit your knees with your hands then I did it again after that by a day, and I prayed towards it and he slapped my hands. When he left, he said, "We used to do this and we were commanded to hit with the palms on the knees."
hadiths.arabic: يَا بُنَيَّ اضْرِبْ بِيَدَيْكَ رُكْبَتَيْكَ ثُمَّ فَعَلْتُهُ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِيَوْمٍ فَصَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ فَضَرَبَ يَدِي فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ «كُنَّا نَفْعَلُ هَذَا وَأُمِرْنَا أَنْ نَضْرِبَ بِالْأَكُفِّ عَلَى الرُّكَبِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Yaʿfūr al-ʿAbdī \u003e Muṣʿab b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يَعْفُورٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ قَالَ كَانَ بَنُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ إِذَا رَكَعُوا جَعَلُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ بَيْنَ أَفْخَاذِهِمْ فَصَلَّيْتُ إِلَى جَنْبِ سَعْدٍ فَصَنَعْتُهُ فَضَرَبَ يَدِي فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1342

chapter.englishTitle: Working in Rukoo

hadiths.englishRaw: About Mus'ab with his chain of narration regarding it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Mus'ab with his chain of narration regarding it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُصْعَبٍ بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1343

chapter.englishTitle: Working in Rukoo

hadiths.englishRaw: We have Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari, who said, "Shall I not pray with you the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He then raised his voice, bowed, placed his hands on his knees, and spread his fingers until every part of him became still.   – Sound
hadiths.body: We have Abu Mas'ud Al-Ansari, who said, "Shall I not pray with you the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" He then raised his voice, bowed, placed his hands on his knees, and spread his fingers until every part of him became still.   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: لَنَا أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ أَلَا أُصَلِّي بِكُمْ صَلَاةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «فَكَبَّرَ وَرَكَعَ وَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَفَرَّجَ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ حَتَّى اسْتَقَرَّ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Hammām \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Sālim al-Barrād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ عَنْ سَالِمٍ الْبَرَّادِ قَالَ وَكَانَ عِنْدِي أَوْثَقَ مِنْ نَفْسِي قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1344

chapter.englishTitle: What is said in the bowing position

hadiths.englishRaw: When "Glorify the name of your mighty Lord" was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Use it when bowing, and when "Glorify the name of your most high Lord" was revealed, he said: Use it when prostrating yourself.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When "Glorify the name of your mighty Lord" was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Use it when bowing, and when "Glorify the name of your most high Lord" was revealed, he said: Use it when prostrating yourself.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اجْعَلُوهَا فِي رُكُوعِكُمْ» فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ {سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى} [الأعلى 1] قَالَ «اجْعَلُوهَا فِي سُجُودِكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd al-Muqriʾ \u003e Mūsá b. Ayyūb \u003e ʿAmmī Iyās b. ʿĀmir \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir \u003e Lammā Nazalat Fasabbiḥ Biāsm Rabbik al-ʿAẓīm al-Wāqʿh 74
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي إِيَاسُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ يَقُولُ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ {فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ} [الواقعة 74] قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1345

chapter.englishTitle: What is said in the bowing position

hadiths.englishRaw: he performed Salat with the Prophet, and that while he was bowing he would say: (Subhana Rabbiyal Azim); "Glorious is my Lord the Magnificent" and while prostrating: (Subhana Rabbiyal A'la) 'Glorious is my Lord the Most High.' And he would not recite an Ayah mentioning mercy, except that he would stop and ask (for mercy), and he would not recite an Ayah mentioning punishment, except that he would stop and seek refuge (with Allah from it).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: he performed Salat with the Prophet, and that while he was bowing he would say: (Subhana Rabbiyal Azim); "Glorious is my Lord the Magnificent" and while prostrating: (Subhana Rabbiyal A'la) 'Glorious is my Lord the Most High.' And he would not recite an Ayah mentioning mercy, except that he would stop and ask (for mercy), and he would not recite an Ayah mentioning punishment, except that he would stop and seek refuge (with Allah from it).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَكَانَ يَقُولُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ «سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ» وَفِي سُجُودِهِ «سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى» وَمَا أَتَى عَلَى آيَةِ رَحْمَةٍ إِلَّا وَقَفَ عِنْدَهَا فَسَأَلَ وَمَا أَتَى عَلَى آيَةِ عَذَابٍ إِلَّا تَعَوَّذَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e al-Mustawrid \u003e Ṣilah b. Zufar \u003e Ḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنِ الْمُسْتَوْرِدِ عَنْ صِلَةَ بْنِ زُفَرَ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1346

chapter.englishTitle: The Dryness in the Bowing Position

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, and Muhammad bin Maslamah were once together and they were mentioning the Salat of Messenger of Allah. Abu Humaid said: 'I am the most knowledgeable among you of the Salat of Messenger of Allah: Messenger of Allah would bow and place his hands on his knees as if he was grasping them, and he would draw his forearms to hold them away from his sides.'"     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Abu Humaid, Abu Usaid, Sahl bin Sa'd, and Muhammad bin Maslamah were once together and they were mentioning the Salat of Messenger of Allah. Abu Humaid said: 'I am the most knowledgeable among you of the Salat of Messenger of Allah: Messenger of Allah would bow and place his hands on his knees as if he was grasping them, and he would draw his forearms to hold them away from his sides.'"     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: اجْتَمَعَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ وَأَبُو أُسَيْدٍ وَأَبُو حُمَيْدٍ وَسَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ فَذَكَرُوا صَلَاةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ أَنَا أَعْلَمُكُمْ بِصَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «قَامَ فَكَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حِينَ كَبَّرَ لِلرُّكُوعِ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ وَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ كَأَنَّهُ قَابِضٌ عَلَيْهِمَا وَوَتَرَ يَدَيْهِ فَنَحَّاهُمَا عَنْ جَنْبَيْهِ وَلَمْ يُصَوِّبْ رَأْسَهُ وَلَمْ يُقْنِعْهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abū ʿĀmir al-ʿAqadī \u003e Fulayḥ b. Sulaymān \u003e ʿAbbās b. Sahl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1347

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: القوْلِ بَعْدِ رَفْعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement after raising the head from the bowing

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he said the opening Takbir of the prayer, raise his hands until they were level with his shoulders. When he said the Takbir before bowing he did likewise, and when he said: 'Sami Allahu liman hamidah (Allah hears those who praise Him),' he did likewise, then he said: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd (Our Lord, to You be praise).' But he did not do that when he prostrated or when he raised his head from prostration.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he said the opening Takbir of the prayer, raise his hands until they were level with his shoulders. When he said the Takbir before bowing he did likewise, and when he said: 'Sami Allahu liman hamidah (Allah hears those who praise Him),' he did likewise, then he said: 'Rabbana wa lakal-hamd (Our Lord, to You be praise).' But he did not do that when he prostrated or when he raised his head from prostration.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا افْتَتَحَ الصَّلَاةَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَذْوَ مَنْكِبَيْهِ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَعَلَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَقَالَ «سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ» وَلَا يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ فِي السُّجُودِ   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sālim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1348

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: القوْلِ بَعْدِ رَفْعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement after raising the head from the bowing

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Our Lord, to You be all praises." Note: The Arabic phrase "عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ" is a common phrase used before narrating a saying of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . It translates to "Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ ."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Our Lord, to You be all praises." Note: The Arabic phrase "عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ" is a common phrase used before narrating a saying of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . It translates to "Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ ."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ «رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mālik b. Anas \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1349

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: القوْلِ بَعْدِ رَفْعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement after raising the head from the bowing

hadiths.englishRaw: “When the Imam says: ‘Sami’ Allahu liman hamidah (Allah hears those who praise Him),’ say: ‘Rabbana wa lakal-hamd (O our Lord, to You is the praise).’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “When the Imam says: ‘Sami’ Allahu liman hamidah (Allah hears those who praise Him),’ say: ‘Rabbana wa lakal-hamd (O our Lord, to You is the praise).’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَإِذَا قَالَ الْإِمَامُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1350

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: القوْلِ بَعْدِ رَفْعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement after raising the head from the bowing

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The Imam is to be followed. Say the Takbir when he says it; bow if he bows; if he says 'Samiʿa l-lahu liman hamidah', say, ' Rabbana wa laka l-hamd', prostrate if he prostrates and pray sitting altogether if he prays sitting."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The Imam is to be followed. Say the Takbir when he says it; bow if he bows; if he says 'Samiʿa l-lahu liman hamidah', say, ' Rabbana wa laka l-hamd', prostrate if he prostrates and pray sitting altogether if he prays sitting."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الْإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَإِذَا صَلَّى قَائِمًا فَصَلُّوا قِيَامًا وَإِذَا صَلَّى جَالِسًا فَصَلُّوا جُلُوسًا أَجْمَعُونَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1351

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: القوْلِ بَعْدِ رَفْعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement after raising the head from the bowing

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us and taught us our prayers and Sunnah. He said, 'I reckon that he said, "When the prayer is established, one of you should lead the prayer. When he says 'Allahu Akbar' (Allah is the Greatest), then say 'Allahu Akbar' too. And when he recites 'Not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray' [Surah Al-Fatiha, verse 7], then say 'Ameen,' for Allah will respond to you. And when he says 'Allahu Akbar' and bows, then say 'Allahu Akbar' and bow too, for indeed, the Imam bows before you and raises before you." The Prophet ﷺ said, 'And this is like that.' And when he says 'Allah hears whoever praises Him,' then say 'Our Lord, to You is the praise.' Or he said, 'Our Lord, to You is the praise.' For indeed, Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, said on the tongue of His Prophet, 'Allah hears whoever praises Him.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: He said, "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us and taught us our prayers and Sunnah. He said, 'I reckon that he said, "When the prayer is established, one of you should lead the prayer. When he says 'Allahu Akbar' (Allah is the Greatest), then say 'Allahu Akbar' too. And when he recites 'Not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray' [Surah Al-Fatiha, verse 7], then say 'Ameen,' for Allah will respond to you. And when he says 'Allahu Akbar' and bows, then say 'Allahu Akbar' and bow too, for indeed, the Imam bows before you and raises before you." The Prophet ﷺ said, 'And this is like that.' And when he says 'Allah hears whoever praises Him,' then say 'Our Lord, to You is the praise.' Or he said, 'Our Lord, to You is the praise.' For indeed, Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, said on the tongue of His Prophet, 'Allah hears whoever praises Him.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَطَبَنَا فَعَلَّمَنَا صَلَاتَنَا وَسَنَّ لَنَا سُنَّتَنَا قَالَ أَحْسَبُهُ قَالَ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ {غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ} [الفاتحة 7] فَقُولُوا آمِينَ يُجِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ وَإِذَا كَبَّرَ وَرَكَعَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَارْكَعُوا فَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَرْكَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ وَيَرْفَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَتِلْكَ بِتِلْكَ وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَوْ قَالَ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ ﷻ قَالَ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Yūnus b. Jubayr \u003e Ḥiṭṭān b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1352

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: القوْلِ بَعْدِ رَفْعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement after raising the head from the bowing

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his head after bowing, he said: O Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill all the heavens and the earth, and all that it pleases Thee besides (them). O, thou art worthy of praise and glory, most worthy of what a servant says, and we all are Thy servants, no one can withhold what Thou givest or give what Thou withholdest, and riches cannot avail a wealthy person against Thee.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his head after bowing, he said: O Allah! our Lord, to Thee be the praise that would fill all the heavens and the earth, and all that it pleases Thee besides (them). O, thou art worthy of praise and glory, most worthy of what a servant says, and we all are Thy servants, no one can withhold what Thou givest or give what Thou withholdest, and riches cannot avail a wealthy person against Thee.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ «رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ أَهْلَ الثَّنَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e ʿAṭiyyah b. Qays \u003e Qazaʿah \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ قَزَعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1353

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: القوْلِ بَعْدِ رَفْعِ الرَّأْسِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement after raising the head from the bowing

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation into English is as follows: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would raise his head from bowing, he would say, 'Allah hears whoever praises Him. Our Lord, all praise is due to You, filling the heavens, filling the earth, filling whatever is between them, and filling whatever You will after that.' It was asked to Abdullah, 'Do you hold on to it?' He said, 'No.' And it was asked to him, 'Do you say this in obligatory prayers?' He said, 'Perhaps.' And he said, 'All of it is good.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation into English is as follows: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would raise his head from bowing, he would say, 'Allah hears whoever praises Him. Our Lord, all praise is due to You, filling the heavens, filling the earth, filling whatever is between them, and filling whatever You will after that.' It was asked to Abdullah, 'Do you hold on to it?' He said, 'No.' And it was asked to him, 'Do you say this in obligatory prayers?' He said, 'Perhaps.' And he said, 'All of it is good.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَالَ «سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ» قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ تَأْخُذُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ لَا وَقِيلَ لَهُ تَقُولُ هَذَا فِي الْفَرِيضَةِ؟ قَالَ عَسَى وَقَالَ كُلُّهُ طَيِّبٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Abū Salamah from his uncle al-Mājishūn \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Rāfiʿ \u003e ʿAlī b. Abū Ṭālib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمِّهِ الْمَاجِشُونَ عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1354

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ مُبَادَرَةِ الْأْئَمَّةِ بِالرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجودِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of the leaders' initiative in bowing and prostra...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, I have already begun, so do not precede me in the bowing or in the prostration. For indeed, no matter how much I precede you in the bowing, you will catch up with me when I rise, and no matter how much I precede you in the prostration, you will catch up with me when I rise."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, I have already begun, so do not precede me in the bowing or in the prostration. For indeed, no matter how much I precede you in the bowing, you will catch up with me when I rise, and no matter how much I precede you in the prostration, you will catch up with me when I rise."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنِّي قَدْ بَدَّنْتُ فَلَا تَسْبِقُونِي بِالرُّكُوعِ وَلَا بِالسُّجُودِ فَإِنِّي مَهْمَا أَسْبِقُكُمْ حِينَ أَرْكَعُ تُدْرِكُونِي حِينَ أَرْفَعُ وَمَهْمَا أَسْبِقُكُمْ حِينَ أَسْجُدُ تُدْرِكُونِي حِينَ أَرْفَعُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e al-Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAjlān \u003e Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá b. Ḥabbān \u003e Ibn Muḥayrīz \u003e Muʿāwiyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1355

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ مُبَادَرَةِ الْأْئَمَّةِ بِالرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجودِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of the leaders' initiative in bowing and prostra...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Isn't he who raises his head before the Imam afraid that Allah may transform his head into that of a donkey or his figure (face) into that of a donkey?"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Isn't he who raises his head before the Imam afraid that Allah may transform his head into that of a donkey or his figure (face) into that of a donkey?"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَمَا يَخْشَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَوْ أَلَا يَخْشَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ قَبْلَ الْإِمَامِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ رَأْسَهُ رَأْسَ حِمَارٍ أَوْ صُورَتَهُ صُورَةَ حِمَارٍ؟ »   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. Ziyād \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1356

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ مُبَادَرَةِ الْأْئَمَّةِ بِالرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجودِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of the leaders' initiative in bowing and prostra...

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ encouraged them to pray and forbade them from preceding him in the bowing and prostration when he was leading them in prayer. He also instructed them to not leave before he finishes his prayer and he said, "I see you from behind me and in front of me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ encouraged them to pray and forbade them from preceding him in the bowing and prostration when he was leading them in prayer. He also instructed them to not leave before he finishes his prayer and he said, "I see you from behind me and in front of me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ حَثَّهُمْ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ وَنَهَاهُمْ أَنْ يَسْبِقُوهُ إِذَا كَانَ يَؤُمُّهُمْ بِالرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ وَأَنْ يَنْصَرِفُوا قَبْلَ انْصِرَافِهِ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ وَقَالَ «إِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ مِنْ خَلْفِي وَأَمَامِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e al-Mukhtār b. Fulful \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُخْتَارُ بْنُ فُلْفُلٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1357

chapter.arabicTitle: بُابُ السُّجودِ عَلَى سبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ، وكيْفَ الْعَمَلُ فِي السُّجُودِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Door of Prostration to the Seven Great Ones, and How to Perf...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Your Prophet was commanded to prostrate on seven prominences and was commanded not to braid hair nor wear a garment," Shu'bah said. And he narrated to me another time, saying, "I was commanded to prostrate and not to braid hair nor wear a garment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Your Prophet was commanded to prostrate on seven prominences and was commanded not to braid hair nor wear a garment," Shu'bah said. And he narrated to me another time, saying, "I was commanded to prostrate and not to braid hair nor wear a garment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أُمِرَ نَبِيُّكُمْ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ وَأُمِرَ أَنْ لَا يَكُفَّ شَعَرًا وَلَا ثَوْبًا» قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى قَالَ أُمِرْتُ بِالسُّجُودِ وَلَا أَكُفَّ شَعَرًا وَلَا ثَوْبًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Naḍr Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Umir Nabiyyukum \u003e Yasjud \u003e Sabʿah Aʿẓum And ʾUmir \u003e Lā Yakuf Shaʿar Walā Thawb \u003e Shuʿbah Waḥaddathanīh Marrah Ukhrá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ طَاوُسًا يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1358

chapter.arabicTitle: بُابُ السُّجودِ عَلَى سبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ، وكيْفَ الْعَمَلُ فِي السُّجُودِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Door of Prostration to the Seven Great Ones, and How to Perf...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: "I have been commanded to prostrate on seven bones: on the forehead"- and he pointed with his hand- "on the nose, the hands, the knees and the ends of the feet."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "I have been commanded to prostrate on seven bones: on the forehead"- and he pointed with his hand- "on the nose, the hands, the knees and the ends of the feet."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَسْجُدَ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ الْجَبْهَةِ قَالَ وُهَيْبٌ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى أَنْفِهِ وَالْيَدَيْنِ وَالرُّكْبَتَيْنِ وَأَطْرَافِ الْقَدَمَيْنِ وَلَا نَكُفَّ الثِّيَابَ وَلَا الشَّعَرَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm And Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ibn Ṭāwus from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1359

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَوَّلِ مَا يَقَعُ مِنَ الْإِنْسَانِ عَلَى الْأَرْضَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أنْ يَسْجُدَ
chapter.englishTitle: The first thing that happens to a person when they want to prost...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he prostrated, he lowered his knees before his hands, and when he came up he raised his hands before his knees."    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he prostrated, he lowered his knees before his hands, and when he came up he raised his hands before his knees."    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا سَجَدَ يَضَعُ رُكْبَتَيْهِ قَبْلَ يَدَيْهِ وَإِذَا نَهَضَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ قَبْلَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sharīk \u003e ʿĀṣim b. Kulayb from his father \u003e Wāʾil b. Ḥujr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1360

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَوَّلِ مَا يَقَعُ مِنَ الْإِنْسَانِ عَلَى الْأَرْضَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أنْ يَسْجُدَ
chapter.englishTitle: The first thing that happens to a person when they want to prost...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you prays, let him not cross his legs like a camel does, and let him place his hands before his knees." Abdullah was asked, "What do you say?" He said, "It is all good." The people of Kufa preferred the first option."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you prays, let him not cross his legs like a camel does, and let him place his hands before his knees." Abdullah was asked, "What do you say?" He said, "It is all good." The people of Kufa preferred the first option."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمْ فَلَا يَبْرُكْ كَمَا يَبْرُكُ الْبَعِيرُ وَلْيَضَعْ يَدَيْهِ قَبْلَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ» قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ كُلُّهُ طَيِّبٌ وَقَالَ أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ يَخْتَارُونَ الْأَوَّلَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ḥasan \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1361

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْافْتِرَاشِ وَنَقْرَةِ الْغُرَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of spreading rumors and gossiping

hadiths.englishRaw: "Be moderate in bowing and prostration, and do not rest your forearms along the ground like a dog."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Be moderate in bowing and prostration, and do not rest your forearms along the ground like a dog."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اعْتَدِلُوا فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ وَلَا يَبْسُطْ أَحَدُكُمْ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِسَاطَ الْكَلْبِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim And Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1362

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْافْتِرَاشِ وَنَقْرَةِ الْغُرَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of spreading rumors and gossiping

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited to peck like a crow, and to spread (the forearms) like a wild beast, and to fix a place in the mosque like a camel which fixes its place. These are the wordings of Qutaybah.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited to peck like a crow, and to spread (the forearms) like a wild beast, and to fix a place in the mosque like a camel which fixes its place. These are the wordings of Qutaybah.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ افْتِرَاشِ السَّبُعِ وَنَقْرَةِ الْغُرَابِ وَأَنْ يُوطِنَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَكَانَ كَمَا يُوطِنُ الْبَعِيرُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jaʿfar from his father \u003e Tamīm b. Maḥmūd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Shibl al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ مَحْمُودٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شِبْلٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1363

chapter.englishTitle: The speech between the prostrations

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to say between the two prostrations "O Lord, forgive me." So it was said to Abdullah, "Do you say this?" He said, "Perhaps I say it, and perhaps I remain silent."
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to say between the two prostrations "O Lord, forgive me." So it was said to Abdullah, "Do you say this?" He said, "Perhaps I say it, and perhaps I remain silent."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ «رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي» فَقِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ تَقُولُ هَذَا؟ قَالَ رُبَّمَا قُلْتُ وَرُبَّمَا سَكَتُّ
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Musayyab \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Ṭalḥah b. Yazīd al-Anṣārī \u003e Ḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1364

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of reading during bowing and prostration

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ lifted the curtain (and saw that) the people were standing in rows(of prayers) behind Abu Bakr. He said: O people, there remained nothing that gives good tidings from prophethood except a true dream which a Muslim has himself or which another Muslim has for him. I have been prohibited to recite the Qur’an while bowing or prostration. As regards owing, exalt the Lord in it, and as to prostration, make supplication with exertion in it, that is worthy of being accepted.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ lifted the curtain (and saw that) the people were standing in rows(of prayers) behind Abu Bakr. He said: O people, there remained nothing that gives good tidings from prophethood except a true dream which a Muslim has himself or which another Muslim has for him. I have been prohibited to recite the Qur’an while bowing or prostration. As regards owing, exalt the Lord in it, and as to prostration, make supplication with exertion in it, that is worthy of being accepted.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَشَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ السِّتَارَةَ وَالنَّاسُ صُفُوفٌ خَلْفَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْ مُبَشِّرَاتِ النُّبُوَّةِ إِلَّا الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ يَرَاهَا الْمُسْلِمُ أَوْ تُرَى لَهُ أَلَا إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ رَاكِعًا أَوْ سَاجِدًا فَأَمَّا الرُّكُوعُ فَعَظِّمُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَأَمَّا السُّجُودُ فَاجْتَهِدُوا فِي الدُّعَاءِ فَقَمِنٌ أَنْ يُسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Sulaymān b. Suḥaym \u003e Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbdullāh b. Maʿbad from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1365

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of reading during bowing and prostration

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I have been prohibited from reciting while in a state of bowing or prostration. As for the bowing, glorify your Lord in it, and as for the prostration, strive in supplication, as it is most likely that you will be answered."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I have been prohibited from reciting while in a state of bowing or prostration. As for the bowing, glorify your Lord in it, and as for the prostration, strive in supplication, as it is most likely that you will be answered."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنِّي نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ وَأَنَا رَاكِعٌ أَوْ سَاجِدٌ فَأَمَّا الرُّكُوعُ فَعَظِّمُوا فِيهِ الرَّبَّ وَأَمَّا السُّجُودُ فَاجْتَهِدُوا فِي الدُّعَاءِ فَقَمِنٌ أَنْ يُسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah And ʾIsmāʿīl b. Jaʿfar \u003e Sulaymān b. Suḥaym \u003e Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbdullāh b. Maʿbad b. ʿAbbās from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1366

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذي لَا يُتمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the one that does not complete the bowing and prostration

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘No prayer is acceptable in which a man does not settle his spine when bowing and when prostrating.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘No prayer is acceptable in which a man does not settle his spine when bowing and when prostrating.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تُجْزِئُ صَلَاةٌ لَا يُقِيمُ الرَّجُلُ فِيهَا صُلْبَهُ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿUmārah \u003e Ibn ʿUmayr \u003e Abū Maʿmar \u003e Abū Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ هُوَ ابْنُ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1367

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذي لَا يُتمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the one that does not complete the bowing and prostration

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The worst of people in theft is the one who steals his own prayer." They asked, "O Messenger of Allah, how does one steal his own prayer?" He said, "He does not complete its bowing and prostration."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The worst of people in theft is the one who steals his own prayer." They asked, "O Messenger of Allah, how does one steal his own prayer?" He said, "He does not complete its bowing and prostration."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَسْوَأُ النَّاسِ سَرِقَةً الَّذِي يَسْرِقُ صَلَاتَهُ» قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَكَيْفَ يَسْرِقُ صَلَاتَهُ؟ قَالَ «لَا يُتِمُّ رُكُوعَهَا وَلَا سُجُودَهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e al-Walīd b. Muslim \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1368

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذي لَا يُتمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the one that does not complete the bowing and prostration

hadiths.englishRaw: "While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sitting with us around him, a man came in, turned towards the Qiblah and prayed. When he had finished his prayer, he came and greeted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people with Salam. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'And also to you. Go and pray, for you have not prayed.' So he went and prayed, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ started watching him, and he (the man) did not know what was wrong with it. When he had finished the prayer, he came and greeted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people with salam. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'And also to you. Go and pray, for you have not prayed.' He repeated it two or three times, then the man said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what is wrong with my prayer?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The prayer of any of you is not complete unless he performs wudu properly as enjoined by Allah, the Mighty and Sublime. So he should wash his face, his arms up to the elbows, and wipe his head, and (wash) his feet up to the ankles. Then he should magnify Allah (SWT) and praise Him and glorify Him.'" - (One of the narrators) Hammam said: "I heard him say: 'He should praise Allah and glorify Him and magnify Him." He said: "I heard both of them." -"He (the Prophet ﷺ) said: 'He should recite whatever is easy for him of the Quran that Allah has taught him and permitted him in it (the prayer). Then he should say the Takbir and bow until his joints settle and he is relaxed. Then he should say: 'Sami Allahu liman hamidah (Allah hears the one who praises Him)' and stand up straight until his backbone is straight (and at ease). Then he should say Takbir and prostrate until he has placed his face firmly on the ground." "I heard him say: his forehead, until his joints settle and he is relaxed. Then he should say the Takbir and sit up until his backbone is straight (and at ease). Then he should prostrate until he has placed his face firmly on the ground and he is relaxed. If he does not do that then he has not completed his prayer."     – Sound Chain

When he had finished his prayer, he came and greeted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and the people with Salam. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: 'And also to you. Go and pray, for you have not prayed.' He repeated it two or three times, then the man said: 'O Messenger of Allah, what is wrong with my prayer?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The prayer of any of you is not complete unless he performs wudu properly as enjoined by Allah, the Mighty and Sublime. So he should wash his face, his arms up to the elbows, and wipe his head, and (wash) his feet up to the ankles. Then he should magnify Allah (SWT) and praise Him and glorify Him.'" - (One of the narrators) Hammam said: "I heard him say: 'He should praise Allah and glorify Him and magnify Him." He said: "I heard both of them." -"He (the Prophet ﷺ) said: 'He should recite whatever is easy for him of the Quran that Allah has taught him and permitted him in it (the prayer). Then he should say the Takbir and bow until his joints settle and he is relaxed.
