Then he should say the Takbir and sit up until his backbone is straight (and at ease). Then he should prostrate until he has placed his face firmly on the ground and he is relaxed. If he does not do that then he has not completed his prayer."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَمِّهِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ وَكَانَ رِفَاعَةُ وَمَالِكُ ابْنَيْ رَافِعٍ أَخَوَيْنِ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ قَالُوا بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ جُلُوسٌ حَوْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَوْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَالِسٌ وَنَحْنُ حَوْلَهُ شَكَّ هَمَّامٌ إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ فَصَلَّى فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعَلَى الْقَوْمِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «وَعَلَيْكَ ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ» فَرَجَعَ الرَّجُلُ فَصَلَّى وَجَعَلْنَا نَرْمُقُ صَلَاتَهُ لَا نَدْرِي مَا يَعِيبُ مِنْهَا فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ جَاءَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعَلَى الْقَوْمِ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «وَعَلَيْكَ ارْجِعْ فَصَلِّ فَإِنَّكَ لَمْ تُصَلِّ» قَالَ هَمَّامٌ فَلَا أَدْرِي أَمَرَهُ بِذَلِكَ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ مَا أَلَوْتُ فَلَا أَدْرِي مَا عِبْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ صَلَاتِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّهَا لَا تَتِمُّ صَلَاةُ أَحَدِكُمْ حَتَّى يُسْبِغَ الْوُضُوءَ كَمَا أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ ﷻ فَيَغْسِلُ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ إِلَى الْمِرْفَقَيْنِ وَيَمْسَحُ بِرَأْسِهِ وَرِجْلَيْهِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ اللَّهَ وَيَحْمَدُهُ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ ﷻ لَهُ فِيهِ ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ فَيَرْكَعُ فَيَضَعُ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ مَفَاصِلُهُ وَتَسْتَرْخِيَ وَيَقُولُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ فَيَسْتَوِي قَائِمًا حَتَّى يُقِيمَ صُلْبَهُ فَيَأْخُذَ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ مَأْخَذَهُ ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ فَيَسْجُدُ فَيُمَكِّنُ وَجْهَهُ قَالَ هَمَّامٌ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ حَتَّى تَطْمَئِنَّ مَفَاصِلُهُ وَتَسْتَرْخِيَ ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ فَيَسْتَوِي قَاعِدًا عَلَى مَقْعَدِهِ وَيُقِيمُ صُلْبَهُ «فَوَصَفَ الصَّلَاةَ هَكَذَا أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ حَتَّى فَرَغَ» لَا تَتِمُّ صَلَاةُ أَحَدِكُمْ حَتَّى يَفْعَلَ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Hammām \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAlī b. Yaḥyá b. Khallād from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَلَّادٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1369

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Tajafi fi as-Sujoodi

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to straighten up in sujood (prostration) until he could see the one behind him and his armpits became visible.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to straighten up in sujood (prostration) until he could see the one behind him and his armpits became visible.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «إِذَا سَجَدَ جَافَى حَتَّى يَرَى مَنْ خَلْفَهُ وَضَحَ إِبِطَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Jaʿfar b. Burqān \u003e Yazīd b. al-Aṣam \u003e Maymūnah b. al-Ḥārith
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ الْأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1370

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Tajafi fi as-Sujoodi

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given sentence is as follows: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to be so humble in his prostration that if she (a camel) wanted to pass beneath him, it could."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given sentence is as follows: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to be so humble in his prostration that if she (a camel) wanted to pass beneath him, it could."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا سَجَدَ جَافَى حَتَّى لَوْ شَاءَتْ بَهْمَةٌ تَمُرُّ تَحْتَهُ لَمَرَّتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah And ʾIsmāʿīl b. Zakariyyā \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Aṣam from his uncle Yazīd b. al-Aṣam \u003e Maymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ عَنْ عَمِّهِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1371

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Tajafi fi as-Sujoodi

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated himself, he spread his arms, i. e. he separated them so much that the whiteness of his armpits became visible from behind and when he sat (for Jalsa) he rested on his left thigh.
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrated himself, he spread his arms, i. e. he separated them so much that the whiteness of his armpits became visible from behind and when he sat (for Jalsa) he rested on his left thigh.
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا سَجَدَ خَوَّى بِيَدَيْهِ يَعْنِي جَنَّحَ حَتَّى يُرَى وَضَحُ إِبْطَيْهِ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ وَإِذَا قَعَدَ اطْمَأَنَّ عَلَى فَخِذِهِ الْيُسْرَى
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Marwān \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Aṣam \u003e Yazīd b. al-Aṣam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1372

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: كَمْ قدْرُِ مَا كَانَ يَمْكُثُ النَّبيُّ ﷺ بَعْدَ مَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: How long did the Prophet ﷺ remain after he raised his head?

hadiths.englishRaw: The bowing of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and when he raised his head from bowing, and his prostration, and the time between the two prostration, were almost equal in length.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The bowing of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and when he raised his head from bowing, and his prostration, and the time between the two prostration, were almost equal in length.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «رُكُوعُهُ إِذَا رَكَعَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَسُجُودُهُ وَبَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ قَرِيبًا مِنَ السَّوَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e al-Barāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1373

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: كَمْ قدْرُِ مَا كَانَ يَمْكُثُ النَّبيُّ ﷺ بَعْدَ مَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: How long did the Prophet ﷺ remain after he raised his head?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I watched the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he prayed, and I noticed that his standing, his bowing, his standing up after bowing, his prostration, his sitting between the two prostrations and his sitting between the taslim and departing were almost the same in length."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I watched the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he prayed, and I noticed that his standing, his bowing, his standing up after bowing, his prostration, his sitting between the two prostrations and his sitting between the taslim and departing were almost the same in length."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَمَقْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي صَلَاتِهِ فَوَجَدْتُ «قِيَامَهُ وَرَكْعَتَهُ وَاعْتِدَالَهُ بَعْدَ الرَّكْعَةِ فَسَجْدَتَهُ فَجِلْسَتَهُ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ فَسَجْدَتَهُ وجِلْسَتَهُ بَيْنَ التَّسْلِيمِ وَالِانْصِرَافِ قَرِيبًا مِنَ السَّوَاءِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ هِلَالُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ أُرَى أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ الْوَزَّانُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Hilāl b. Ḥumayd al-Wazzān \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e al-Barāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ الْوَزَّانِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1374

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ السُّنَّةِ فِيمَنْ سُبِقَ بِبعْضِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah for those who preceded with some prayers

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived, and with him was Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, until they found the people had already established the Fajr prayer and had appointed Abdul Rahman ibn Awf to lead them in prayer. So Abdul Rahman performed one Rak'ah of the Fajr prayer before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and stood with the people behind Abdul Rahman in the second Rak'ah. When Abdul Rahman finished the prayer, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and performed his own prayer. The people were surprised by this and increased in their glorification of Allah. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished his prayer, he said to the people, "You have achieved or done well."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived, and with him was Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah, until they found the people had already established the Fajr prayer and had appointed Abdul Rahman ibn Awf to lead them in prayer. So Abdul Rahman performed one Rak'ah of the Fajr prayer before the Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and stood with the people behind Abdul Rahman in the second Rak'ah. When Abdul Rahman finished the prayer, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and performed his own prayer. The people were surprised by this and increased in their glorification of Allah. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished his prayer, he said to the people, "You have achieved or done well."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَقْبَلَ وَأَقْبَلَ مَعَهُ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ حَتَّى وَجَدُوا النَّاسَ قَدْ أَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ صَلَاةَ الْفَجْرِ وَقَدَّمُوا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَصَلَّى بِهِمْ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَصَفَّ مَعَ النَّاسِ وَرَاءَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَفَزِعَ النَّاسُ لِذَلِكَ وَأَكْثَرُوا التَّسْبِيحَ فَلَمَّا قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَاتَهُ قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ «قَدْ أَصَبْتُمْ أَوْ قَدْ أَحْسَنْتُمْ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth b. Saʿd \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿAbbād b. Ziyād \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Mughīrah And Ḥamzah b. al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ وَحَمْزَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ يُخْبِرُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1375

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ السُّنَّةِ فِيمَنْ سُبِقَ بِبعْضِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah for those who preceded with some prayers

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "So we reached the people, and they had already stood up for prayer. 'Abdul Rahman ibn 'Awf began to lead them in prayer. He joined them in their prayer, and when he felt that the Prophet ﷺ was there, he began to delay his prostration. The Prophet ﷺ gestured to him with his hand to continue leading the prayer. When the Prophet ﷺ finished, I stood up and we performed the prostration that we missed. Abu Muhammad said, 'I say in regards to making up missed prayers that the people of Kufa say it should be made up.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "So we reached the people, and they had already stood up for prayer. 'Abdul Rahman ibn 'Awf began to lead them in prayer. He joined them in their prayer, and when he felt that the Prophet ﷺ was there, he began to delay his prostration. The Prophet ﷺ gestured to him with his hand to continue leading the prayer. When the Prophet ﷺ finished, I stood up and we performed the prostration that we missed. Abu Muhammad said, 'I say in regards to making up missed prayers that the people of Kufa say it should be made up.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَانْتَهَيْنَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ وَقَدْ قَامُوا إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ وَقَدْ رَكَعَ بِهِمْ فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ بِالنَّبِيِّ ﷺ ذَهَبَ يَتَأَخَّرُ فَأَوْمأ إِلَيْهِ بِيَدِهِ يَصَلَّى بِهِمْ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ «قَامَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَقُمْتُ فَرَكَعْنَا الرَّكْعَةَ الَّتِي سُبِقْنَا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ أَقُولُ فِي الْقَضَاءِ بِقَوْلِ أَهْلِ الْكُوفَةِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ مَا فَاتَهُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ قَضَاءً   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl \u003e Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh al-Muzanī \u003e Ḥamzah b. al-Mughīrah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيُّ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1376

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرُّخْصَةِ فِي السُّجودِ عَلَى الثَّوْبِ فِي الْحَرِّ وَالْبَرْدِ
chapter.englishTitle: License to Prostrate on a Cloth in Heat and Cold

hadiths.englishRaw: We used to say (the noonprayer) with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the intense heat, but when someone amongst us found it hard to place his forehead on the ground, he spread his cloth and prostrated on it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We used to say (the noonprayer) with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the intense heat, but when someone amongst us found it hard to place his forehead on the ground, he spread his cloth and prostrated on it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ فَإِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَحَدُنَا أَنْ يُمَكِّنَ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ بَسَطَ ثَوْبَهُ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Bishr b. al-Mufaḍḍal \u003e Ghālib al-Qaṭṭān \u003e Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ حَدَّثَنَا غَالِبٌ الْقَطَّانُ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1377

chapter.englishTitle: The indication in the Tashahhud.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ praying like this," Ibn Uyaynah pointed with his finger and Abu al-Walid pointed with the tasbeeh."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw the Prophet ﷺ praying like this," Ibn Uyaynah pointed with his finger and Abu al-Walid pointed with the tasbeeh."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «يَدْعُو هَكَذَا فِي الصَّلَاةِ» وَأَشَارَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ بِأُصْبُعِهِ وَأَشَارَ أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ بِالسَّبَّاحَةِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e ʿĀmir b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1378

chapter.englishTitle: The indication in the Tashahhud.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to sit at the end of the prayer and place his left hand on his left knee and his right hand on his right knee and raise his index finger.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to sit at the end of the prayer and place his left hand on his left knee and his right hand on his right knee and raise his index finger.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «إِذَا قَعَدَ فِي آخِرِ الصَّلَاةِ وَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ الْيُسْرَى وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى رُكْبَتِهِ الْيُمْنَى وَنَصَبَ إِصْبَعَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1379

chapter.englishTitle: In the Tashahhud

hadiths.englishRaw: when we (prayed and) sat up during prayer along the Messenger of Allah (may peach be upon him), we said: “Peace be to Allah before it is supplicated for His servants; peace be to so and so. “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Do not say “Peace be to Allah ,”for Allah Himself is peace. When one of you sits(during the prayer), he should say: The adoration of the tongue are due to Allah, and acts of worship and all good things. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah’s upright servants. When you say that, it reaches every upright servant in heavens and earth or between heavens and earth. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and apostle. Then he may choose any supplication which pleases him and offer it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: when we (prayed and) sat up during prayer along the Messenger of Allah (may peach be upon him), we said: “Peace be to Allah before it is supplicated for His servants; peace be to so and so. “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Do not say “Peace be to Allah ,”for Allah Himself is peace. When one of you sits(during the prayer), he should say: The adoration of the tongue are due to Allah, and acts of worship and all good things. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah’s mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah’s upright servants. When you say that, it reaches every upright servant in heavens and earth or between heavens and earth. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and apostle. Then he may choose any supplication which pleases him and offer it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا إِذَا صَلَّيْنَا خَلْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قُلْنَا السَّلَامُ عَلَى اللَّهِ قَبْلَ عِبَادِهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَى جِبْرِيلَ السَّلَامُ عَلَى مِيكَائِيلَ السَّلَامُ عَلَى إِسْرَافِيلَ السَّلَامُ عَلَى فُلَانٍ وَفُلَانٍ قَالَ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى هُوَ السَّلَامُ فَإِذَا جَلَسْتُمْ فِي الصَّلَاةِ فَقُولُوا التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ فَإِنَّكُمْ إِذَا قُلْتُمُوهَا أَصَابَتْ كُلَّ عَبْدٍ صَالِحٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ثُمَّ لِيَتَخَيَّرْ مَا شَاءَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Shaqīq \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1380

chapter.englishTitle: In the Tashahhud

hadiths.englishRaw: "And indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the hand of Abdullah and taught him the Tashahhud in prayer, which is: 'All greetings, prayers, and good deeds are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.' Zuhayr said, 'I think he said: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.' He hesitated in these two statements; if you do this or finish it, then you have completed your prayer. If you wish to stand, then stand, and if you wish to sit, then sit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "And indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took the hand of Abdullah and taught him the Tashahhud in prayer, which is: 'All greetings, prayers, and good deeds are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.' Zuhayr said, 'I think he said: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.' He hesitated in these two statements; if you do this or finish it, then you have completed your prayer. If you wish to stand, then stand, and if you wish to sit, then sit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَخَذَ بِيَدِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَعَلَّمَهُ التَّشَهُّدَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ «التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ» قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ أُرَاهُ قَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَيْضًا شَكَّ فِي هَاتَيْنِ الْكَلِمَتَيْنِ إِذَا فَعَلْتَ هَذَا أَوْ قَضَيْتَ فَقَدْ قَضَيْتَ صَلَاتَكَ إِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تَقُومَ فَقُمْ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تَقْعُدَ فَاقْعُدْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Ḥur \u003e al-Qāsim b. Mukhaymirah \u003e Akhadh ʿAlqamah Biyadī Faḥaddathanī \u003e ʿAbdullāh Akhadh Biyadih
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ حُرٍّ حَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مُخَيْمِرَةَ قَالَ أَخَذَ عَلْقَمَةُ بِيَدِي فَحَدَّثَنِي أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1381

chapter.englishTitle: Sending blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard Ibn Abi Laila say: ‘Ka’b bin ‘Ujrah met me and said: “Shall I not give you a gift? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us and we said: ‘We know what it means to send greetings on you, but what does it mean to send peace and blessings upon you?’ He said: ‘Say: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta ‘ala Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid; Allahumma barik ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta ‘ala Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid (O Allah, send your grace, honour and mercy upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your grace, honour and mercy upon Ibrahim, You are indeed Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your blessings upon Ibrahim, You are indeed Praiseworthy, Most Glorious).’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard Ibn Abi Laila say: ‘Ka’b bin ‘Ujrah met me and said: “Shall I not give you a gift? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to us and we said: ‘We know what it means to send greetings on you, but what does it mean to send peace and blessings upon you?’ He said: ‘Say: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammadin, kama sallayta ‘ala Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid; Allahumma barik ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammadin, kama barakta ‘ala Ibrahima, innaka Hamidun Majid (O Allah, send your grace, honour and mercy upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your grace, honour and mercy upon Ibrahim, You are indeed Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent Your blessings upon Ibrahim, You are indeed Praiseworthy, Most Glorious).’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَلَا أُهْدِي إلَيكَ هَدِيَّةً؟ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا فَقُلْنَا قَدْ عَلِمْنَا كَيْفَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ فَكَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ؟ قَالَ قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e Laqiyanī Kaʿb b. ʿUjrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ الْحَكَمُ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى يَقُولُ لَقِيَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1382

chapter.englishTitle: Sending blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us in the Majlis of Sa'd bin 'Ubadah and Bashir bin Sa'd said to him: 'Allah has commanded us to send Salah upon you, O Messenger of Allah; so how should we send salah upon you?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained silent until we wished that he had not asked him. Then he said: 'Say: 'Alahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama sallaita 'ala Ibrahima wa barik 'ala Muhammad kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahim fil-'alamin, innaka hamidun majid (O Allah, send salah upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent salah upon the family of Ibrahim, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim among the nations. You are indeed Worthy of praise, Full of glory.)" And the salam is as you know.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us in the Majlis of Sa'd bin 'Ubadah and Bashir bin Sa'd said to him: 'Allah has commanded us to send Salah upon you, O Messenger of Allah; so how should we send salah upon you?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ remained silent until we wished that he had not asked him. Then he said: 'Say: 'Alahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama sallaita 'ala Ibrahima wa barik 'ala Muhammad kama barakta 'ala ali Ibrahim fil-'alamin, innaka hamidun majid (O Allah, send salah upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent salah upon the family of Ibrahim, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibrahim among the nations. You are indeed Worthy of praise, Full of glory.)" And the salam is as you know.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ الَّذِي كَانَ أُرِيَ النِّدَاءَ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ قَالَ أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَجَلَسَ مَعَنَا فِي مَجْلِسِ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ بَشِيرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ وَهُوَ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ أَمَرَنَا اللَّهُ أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَكَيْفَ نُصَلِّي عَلَيْكَ؟ قَالَ فَصَمَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْنَا أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْأَلْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ قُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ وَالسَّلَامُ كَمَا قَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Nuʿaym al-Mujmir a freed slave of ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نُعَيْمٍ الْمُجْمِرِ مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1383

chapter.englishTitle: Invocation after At-Tashahud

hadiths.englishRaw: When one of you finishes the last tashahhud, he should seek refuge in Allah from four things: the punishment in Hell, the punishment in the grave, the trail of life and death, and the evil of Antichrist.
hadiths.body: When one of you finishes the last tashahhud, he should seek refuge in Allah from four things: the punishment in Hell, the punishment in the grave, the trail of life and death, and the evil of Antichrist.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا فَرَغَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ فَلْيَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ أَرْبَعٍ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ وَشَرِّ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ḥassān \u003e Muḥammad b. Abū ʿĀʾishah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1384

chapter.englishTitle: Invocation after At-Tashahud

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Al-Azai and his direction."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "About Al-Azai and his direction."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1385

chapter.englishTitle: Submission in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say the salam to his right so that the whiteness of his cheek could be seen, and to his left so that the whiteness of his cheek could be seen."     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say the salam to his right so that the whiteness of his cheek could be seen, and to his left so that the whiteness of his cheek could be seen."     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ خَدِّهِ ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ حَتَّى يُرَى بَيَاضُ خَدِّهِ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Muḥammad b. Saʿd \u003e ʿĀmir b. Saʿd from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1386

chapter.englishTitle: Submission in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: I prayed behind a man in Mecca and he performed two salaams. I mentioned that to Abdullah, and he said, "How did he end it?" The judge said, "The Prophet ﷺ used to do that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I prayed behind a man in Mecca and he performed two salaams. I mentioned that to Abdullah, and he said, "How did he end it?" The judge said, "The Prophet ﷺ used to do that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ رَجُلٍ بِمَكَّةَ فَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمَتَيْنِ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ «أَنَّى عَلِقَهَا؟» وَقَالَ الْحَكَمُ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam And Manṣūr \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Abū Maʿmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ وَمَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1387

chapter.englishTitle: The statement after peace

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to sit after prayer as much as he would say, "O Allah, You are the Peace, and from You is the Peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to sit after prayer as much as he would say, "O Allah, You are the Peace, and from You is the Peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَجْلِسُ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ إِلَّا قَدْرَ مَا يَقُولُ «اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Abū al-Walīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1388

chapter.englishTitle: The statement after peace

hadiths.englishRaw: “Allahumma Antas-Salam wa minkas-salam tabarakta ya Dhal-jalali wal- ikram” (O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, Blessed are You O Possessor of majesty and honour).”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Allahumma Antas-Salam wa minkas-salam tabarakta ya Dhal-jalali wal- ikram” (O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, Blessed are You O Possessor of majesty and honour).”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنْصَرِفَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ اسْتَغْفَرَ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Shaddād Abū ʿAmmār \u003e Abū Asmāʾ al-Raḥabī \u003e Thawbān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ شَدَّادٍ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1389

chapter.englishTitle: The statement after peace

hadiths.englishRaw: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah wrote to Mu'awiyah (Saying) that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say following every prayer, after the taslim: 'La Ilaha Illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamd wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani' lima a'taita wa la mu'tia lima mana'ta wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minka al-jadd. (There is none worthy of worship except Allah ﷺ alone with no partner or associate. He is the Dominion and to Him be all praise, and He is able to do all things. O Allah, one can withhold what You have given and none can give what You have withheld, and no wealth or fortune can benefit anyone for from You comes all wealth and fortune.)'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah wrote to Mu'awiyah (Saying) that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say following every prayer, after the taslim: 'La Ilaha Illallah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulk wa lahul-hamd wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Allahumma la mani' lima a'taita wa la mu'tia lima mana'ta wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minka al-jadd. (There is none worthy of worship except Allah ﷺ alone with no partner or associate. He is the Dominion and to Him be all praise, and He is able to do all things. O Allah, one can withhold what You have given and none can give what You have withheld, and no wealth or fortune can benefit anyone for from You comes all wealth and fortune.)'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e And Rrād Kātib al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ وَرَّادٍ كَاتِبِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ أَمْلَى عَلَيَّ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ فِي كِتَابٍ إِلَى مُعَاوِيَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1390

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ عَلَى أَيِّ شِقَّيْهِ يَنْصَرِفُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: On which side does one turn away from prayer?

hadiths.englishRaw: You should not give away a part of your prayer to Satan by thinking that it is necessary to depart (after finishing the prayer) from one's right side only; I have seen the Prophet ﷺ often leave from the left side.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: You should not give away a part of your prayer to Satan by thinking that it is necessary to depart (after finishing the prayer) from one's right side only; I have seen the Prophet ﷺ often leave from the left side.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَا يَجْعَلْ أَحَدُكُمْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ نَصِيبًا مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ يَرَى أَنَّ حَقًّا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لَا يَنْصَرِفَ إِلَّا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ لَقَدْ «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَثِيرًا يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿUmārah \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Lā Yajʿal Aḥadukum Lilshhayṭān Naṣīb from Ṣalātih Yará \u003e Ḥaq ʿAlayh \u003e Lā Yanṣarif Illā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1391

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ عَلَى أَيِّ شِقَّيْهِ يَنْصَرِفُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: On which side does one turn away from prayer?

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Anas saying, "I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) turning away from his right side."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Anas saying, "I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) turning away from his right side."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْصَرِفُ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e al-Suddī \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1392

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ عَلَى أَيِّ شِقَّيْهِ يَنْصَرِفُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: On which side does one turn away from prayer?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet, peace be upon him, turned his attention away from his right side, meaning during prayer."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet, peace be upon him, turned his attention away from his right side, meaning during prayer."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «انْصَرَفَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ يَعْنِي فِي الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Suddī \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1393

chapter.englishTitle: The Remembrance (Tasbeeh) after Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: AbuDharr said: Prophet of Allah. The wealthy people have all the rewards; they pray as we pray; they fast as we fast; and they have surplus wealth which they give in charity; but we have no wealth which we may give in charity. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: AbuDharr, should I not teach you phrases by which you acquire the rank of those who excel you? No one can acquire your rank except one who acts like you. He said: Why not, Messenger of Allah? He said: Exalt Allah (say: Allah is Most Great) after each prayer thirty-three times; and praise Him (say: Praise be to Allah) thirty-three times; and glorify Him (say: Glory be to Allah) thirty-three times, and end it by saying, "There is no god but Allah alone, there is no partner, to Him belongs the Kingdom, to Him praise is due and He has power over everything". His sins will be forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: AbuDharr said: Prophet of Allah. The wealthy people have all the rewards; they pray as we pray; they fast as we fast; and they have surplus wealth which they give in charity; but we have no wealth which we may give in charity. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: AbuDharr, should I not teach you phrases by which you acquire the rank of those who excel you? No one can acquire your rank except one who acts like you. He said: Why not, Messenger of Allah? He said: Exalt Allah (say: Allah is Most Great) after each prayer thirty-three times; and praise Him (say: Praise be to Allah) thirty-three times; and glorify Him (say: Glory be to Allah) thirty-three times, and end it by saying, "There is no god but Allah alone, there is no partner, to Him belongs the Kingdom, to Him praise is due and He has power over everything". His sins will be forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو ذَرٍّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ذَهَبَ أَصْحَابُ الدُّثُورِ بِالْأُجُورِ يُصَلُّونَ كَمَا نُصَلِّي وَيَصُومُونَ كَمَا نَصُومُ وَلَهُمْ فُضُولُ أَمْوَالٍ يَتَصَدَّقُونَ بِهَا وَلَيْسَ لَنَا مَا نَتَصَدَّقُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَفَلَا أُعَلِّمُكَ كَلِمَاتٍ إِذَا أَنْتَ قُلْتَهُنَّ أَدْرَكْتَ مَنْ سَبَقَكَ وَلَمْ يَلْحَقْكَ مَنْ خَلَفَكَ إِلَّا مَنْ عَمِلَ بِمِثْلِ عَمَلِكَ؟» قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «تُسَبِّحُ دُبُرَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَتَحْمَدُهُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَتُكَبِّرُهُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَتَخْتِمُهَا بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Hiql \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ḥassān b. ʿAṭiyyah \u003e Muḥammad b. Abū ʿĀʾishah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا هِقْلٌ عَنِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حَسَّانُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَائِشَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1394

chapter.englishTitle: The Remembrance (Tasbeeh) after Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "They were commanded to say the tasbih thirty-three times following the prayer, and to say the tahmid thirty-three times, and to say the takbir thirty-four times, then a man from among the Ansar was told in a dream: 'Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ command you to say the tasbih thirty-three times following the prayer, and to say the tahmid thirty-three times, and to say the takbir thirty-four times?' He said: 'Yes.' 'Instead of that, say each one twenty-five times, and include the tahlil among them.' The next morning he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and told him about that, and he said: 'Do that.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "They were commanded to say the tasbih thirty-three times following the prayer, and to say the tahmid thirty-three times, and to say the takbir thirty-four times, then a man from among the Ansar was told in a dream: 'Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ command you to say the tasbih thirty-three times following the prayer, and to say the tahmid thirty-three times, and to say the takbir thirty-four times?' He said: 'Yes.' 'Instead of that, say each one twenty-five times, and include the tahlil among them.' The next morning he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and told him about that, and he said: 'Do that.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ نُسَبِّحَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَنَحْمَدَهُ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَنُكَبِّرَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ فَأُتِيَ رَجُلٌ أَوْ أُرِيَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فِي الْمَنَامِ فَقِيلَ «أَمَرَكُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ تُسَبِّحُوا اللَّهَ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَتَحْمَدُوا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ وَتُكَبِّرُوا أَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَاجْعَلُوهَا خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ خَمْسًا وَعِشْرِينَ وَاجْعَلُوا مَعَهَا التَّهْلِيلَ فَأُخْبِرَ بِذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «افْعَلُوهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn \u003e Kathīr b. Aflaḥ \u003e Zayd b. Thābit \u003e Umirnā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ أُمِرْنَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1395

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَوَّلُ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The first thing for which a servant will be held accountable on ...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, the first thing for which a servant will be held accountable is prayer. If his prayer is complete, it will be recorded as complete; and if there is any deficiency in it, Allah the Almighty will say to the angels: 'Look for voluntary prayers of My servant to complete what is deficient in his obligatory prayer.' Then, the Zakah (obligatory charity) will be accounted for, followed by the rest of the deeds according to the same rule." Abu Muhammad said: "I don't know anyone who narrated this except Hammad." He was asked: "Is this narration authentic?" He replied: "No."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, the first thing for which a servant will be held accountable is prayer. If his prayer is complete, it will be recorded as complete; and if there is any deficiency in it, Allah the Almighty will say to the angels: 'Look for voluntary prayers of My servant to complete what is deficient in his obligatory prayer.' Then, the Zakah (obligatory charity) will be accounted for, followed by the rest of the deeds according to the same rule." Abu Muhammad said: "I don't know anyone who narrated this except Hammad." He was asked: "Is this narration authentic?" He replied: "No."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا يُحَاسَبُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ الصَّلَاةُ فَإِنْ وَجَدَ صَلَاتَهُ كَامِلَةً كُتِبَتْ لَهُ كَامِلَةً وَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهَا نُقْصَانٌ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى للِمَلَائِكِهِ انْظُرُوا هَلْ لِعَبْدِي مِنْ تَطَوُّعٍ فَأَكْمِلُوا لَهُ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ فَرِيضَتِهِ ثُمَّ الزَّكَاةُ ثُمَّ الْأَعْمَالُ عَلَى حَسَبِ ذَلِكَ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ لَا أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا رَفَعَهُ غَيْرَ حَمَّادٍ قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ صَحَّ هَذَا؟ قَالَ لَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e Zurārah b. Awfá \u003e Tamīm al-Dārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1396

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صِفَةِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The description of the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: I am one among you who is more informed of the way the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed. They said: Why, By Allah, you did not follow him more than us, nor did you remain in his company longer than us? He said: Yes. They said: Then describe (how the Prophet prayed). He said: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up to pray, he raised his hands so as to bring them opposite his shoulders, and uttered the takbir (Allah is the most great), until every bone rested in its place properly: then re recited (some verses from the Quran); then he uttered the takbir (Allah is most great), raising his hands so as to bring them opposite his shoulders; then he bowed; placing the palms of his hands on his knees and keeping himself straight, neither raising nor lowering his head; then raised his head saying: “Allah listens to him who praise Him”; then raised his hands so as to bring them exactly opposite to his shoulders; then uttered: “Allah is most great”; then lowered himself to the ground (in prostration), keeping his arms away from his sides; then raised his head, bent his left foot and sat on it, and opened the toes when he prostrated: then he uttered: “Allah is most great”; then raised his head, bent his left foot and sat on it so that every bone returned to its place properly; then he did the same in the second (rak’ah). At the end of the two Rak’ahs he stood up and uttered the takbir (Allah is most great), raising his hands so as to bring them opposite to his shoulders; then he bowed, placing the palms of his hands on his knees and keeping himself straight, neither raising or lowering his head: then raised his head saying: “Allah listens to him who praises Him”; then raised his hands so as to bring them exactly opposite his shoulders; then uttered: “Allah is most great”; then lowered himself to the ground (in prostration), keeping his arms away from his sides; then raised his head, bent his left foot and sat on it, and opened the toes when he prostrated himself; then he prostrated; then uttered: “Allah is most great”; then raised his head, bent his left foot and sat on it so that every bone returned to its place properly; then he did the same in the second (rak’ah). At the end of two rak’ahs he stood up and uttered the takbir (Allah is most great), raising his hands so as to bring them opposite to his shoulders in the way he had uttered the Takbir (Allah is most great) at the beginning of the prayer; then he did that in the remainder of his prayer; and after prostration which if followed by the taslim (salutation) he out his left foot and sat on his left hip. They said: You have spoken the truth. This is how he(peace be upon him) used to pray.     – Sound Chain

At the end of two rak’ahs he stood up and uttered the takbir (Allah is most great), raising his hands so as to bring them opposite to his shoulders in the way he had uttered the Takbir (Allah is most great) at the beginning of the prayer; then he did that in the remainder of his prayer; and after prostration which if followed by the taslim (salutation) he out his left foot and sat on his left hip. They said: You have spoken the truth. This is how he(peace be upon him) used to pray.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ فِي عَشَرَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَحَدُهُمْ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ قَالَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُكُمْ بِصَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالُوا لِمَ؟ فَمَا كُنْتَ أَكْثَرَنَا لَهُ تَبَعَةً وَلَا أَقْدَمَنَا لَهُ صُحْبَةً؟ قَالَ بَلَى قَالُوا فَاعْرِضْ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ بِهِمَا مَنْكِبَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ حَتَّى يَقَرَّ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ فِي مَوْضِعِهِ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ ثُمَّ يُكَبِّرُ وَيَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ بِهِمَا مَنْكِبَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَرْكَعُ وَيَضَعُ رَاحَتَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِ وَلَا يُصَوِّبُ رَأْسَهُ وَلَا يُقْنِعُ ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ فَيَقُولُ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ بِهِمَا مَنْكِبَيْهِ يَظُنُّ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِ مُعْتَدِلًا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ثُمَّ يَهْوِي إِلَى الْأَرْضِ فَيُجَافِي يَدَيْهِ عَنْ جَنْبَيْهِ ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُ ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ فَيَثْنِي رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى فَيَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهَا وَيَفْتَحُ أَصَابِعَ رِجْلَيْهِ إِذَا سَجَدَ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ فَيَسْجُدُ ثُمَّ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ فَيَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَيَثْنِي رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى فَيَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهَا مُعْتَدِلًا حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ كُلُّ عَظْمٍ إِلَى مَوْضِعِهِ مُعْتَدِلًا ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيَصْنَعُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُخْرَى مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَإِذَا قَامَ مِنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ كَبَّرَ وَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى يُحَاذِيَ بِهِمَا مَنْكِبَيْهِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عِنْدَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ ثُمَّ يَصْنَعُ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فِي بَقِيَّةِ صَلَاتِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَتِ السَّجْدَةُ أَوِ الْقَعْدَةُ الَّتِي يَكُونُ فِيهَا التَّسْلِيمُ أَخَّرَ رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى وَجَلَسَ مُتَوَرِّكًا عَلَى شِقِّهِ الْأَيْسَرِ قَالَ قَالُوا صَدَقْتَ هَكَذَا كَانَتْ صَلَاةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jaʿfar \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1397

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صِفَةِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The description of the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: "I said: 'I am going to watch how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prays.' So I watched him and he stood and said the takbir, and raised his hands until they were in the level with his ears, then he placed his right hand over his left hand, wrist and lower forearm. When he wanted to bow he raised his hands likewise. Then he prostrated and placed his hands in level with his ears. Then he sat up and placed his left leg under him; he put his left hand on his left thigh and knee, and he put the edge of his right elbow on his right thigh, then he held two of his fingers together and made a circle, and raised his forefinger, and I saw him moving it and supplicating with it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I said: 'I am going to watch how the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prays.' So I watched him and he stood and said the takbir, and raised his hands until they were in the level with his ears, then he placed his right hand over his left hand, wrist and lower forearm. When he wanted to bow he raised his hands likewise. Then he prostrated and placed his hands in level with his ears. hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَأَنْظُرَنَّ إِلَى صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي؟ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَامَ فَكَبَّرَ فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ حَتَّى حَاذَتَا بِأُذُنَيْهِ وَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى ظَهْرِ كَفِّهِ الْيُسْرَى قَالَ ثُمَّ لَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ رَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ مِثْلَهَا فَوَضَعَ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ مِثْلَهَا ثُمَّ سَجَدَ فَجَعَلَ كَفَّيْهِ بِحِذَاءِ أُذُنَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَعَدَ فَافْتَرَشَ رِجْلَهُ الْيُسْرَى وَوَضَعَ كَفَّهُ الْيُسْرَى عَلَى فَخِذِهِ وَرُكْبَتِهِ الْيُسْرَى وَجَعَلَ مِرْفَقَهُ الْأَيْمَنَ عَلَى فَخْذِهِ الْيُمْنَى ثُمَّ قَبَضَ ثِنْتَيْنِ فَحَلَّقَ حَلْقَةً ثُمَّ رَفَعَ أُصْبُعَهُ فَرَأَيْتُهُ يُحَرِّكُهَا يَدْعُو بِهَا قَالَ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي زَمَانٍ فِيهِ بَرْدٌ فَرَأَيْتُ عَلَى النَّاسِ جُلَّ الثِّيَابِ يُحَرِّكُونَ أَيْدِيَهُمْ مِنْ تَحْتِ الثِّيَابِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muʿāwiyah b. ʿAmr \u003e Zāʾidah b. Qudāmah \u003e ʿĀṣim b. Kulayb from my father \u003e Wāʾil b. Ḥujr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ كُلَيْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي أَنَّ وَائِلَ بْنَ حُجْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1398

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صِفَةِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The description of the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: Hittan ibn Abdullah ar-Ruqashi said: AbuMusa al-Ash'ari led us in prayer. When he sat at the end of his prayer, one of the people said: Prayer has been established by virtue and purity. When AbuMusa returned (from his prayer or finished his prayer), he gave his attention to the people, and said: Which of you is the speaker of such and such words? The people remained silent. Which of you is the speaker of such and such words? The people remained silent. He said: You might have said them, Hittan. He replied: I did not say them. I was afraid you might punish me. One of the people said: I said them and I did not intend by them (anything) except good. AbuMusa said: Do you not know how you utter (them) in your prayer? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ addressed us, and taught us and explained to us our way of doing and taught us our prayer. He said: When you pray a (congregational) prayer, straighten your rows, then one of you should lead you in prayer. When he says the takbir (Allah is Most Great), say the takbir, and when he recites verses "Not of those upon whom is Thy anger, nor of those who err" (i.e. the end of Surah i.), say Amin; Allah will favour you. When he says "Allah is most great," and bows, say "Allah is most great" and bow, for the imam will bow before you, and will raise (his head) before you. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: This is for that. When he says "Allah listens to the one who praises Him," say: "O Allah, our Lord, to Thee be praise, Allah be praised," Allah will listen to you, for Allah, the Exalted, said by the tongue of His Prophet ﷺ: "Allah listens to the one who praises Him." When he says "Allah is most great" and prostrates, say: "Allah is most great" and prostrate, for the imam prostrates before you and raises his head before you. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: This is for that. When he sits, each one of you should say "The adorations of the tongue, all good things, and acts of worship are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and Allah's mercy and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon Allah's upright servants. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Apostle." This version of Ahmad does not mention the words "and His blessings" nor the phrase "and I testify"; instead, it has the words "that Muhammad."     – Sound

hadiths.arabic: صَلَّى بِنَا أَبُو مُوسَى إِحْدَى صَلَاتَيِ الْعَشِيِّ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أُقِرَّتِ الصَّلَاةُ بِالْبِرِّ وَالزَّكَاةِ فَلَمَّا قَضَى أَبُو مُوسَى الصَّلَاةَ قَالَ أَيُّكُمُ الْقَائِلُ كَلِمَةَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَأَرَمَّ الْقَوْمُ فَقَالَ لَعَلَّكَ يَا حِطَّانُ قُلْتَهَا؟ قَالَ مَا أَنَا قُلْتُهَا وَقَدْ خِفْتُ أَنْ تَبْكَعَنِي بِهَا فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَنَا قُلْتُهَا وَمَا أَرَدْتُ بِهَا إِلَّا الْخَيْرَ فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى أَوَ مَا تَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَقُولُونَ فِي صَلَاتِكُمْ؟ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَطَبَنَا فَعَلَّمَنَا صَلَاتَنَا وَبَيَّنَ لَنَا سُنَّتَنَا قَالَ أَحْسَبُهُ قَالَ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَإِذَا قَالَ {غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ} [الفاتحة 7] فَقُولُوا آمِينَ يُجِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ وَرَكَعَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَارْكَعُوا فَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَرْكَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ وَيَرْفَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَتِلْكَ بِتِلْكَ فَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ فَقُولُوا اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَوْ قَالَ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَالَ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ وَسَجَدَ فَكَبِّرُوا وَاسْجُدُوا فَإِنَّ الْإِمَامَ يَسْجُدُ قَبْلَكُمْ وَيَرْفَعُ قَبْلَكُمْ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ فَتِلْكَ بِتِلْكَ فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الْقَعْدَةِ فَلْيَكُنْ مِنْ أَوَّلِ قَوْلِ أَحَدِكُمْ التَّحِيَّاتُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ الصَّلَوَاتُ لِلَّهِ السَّلَامُ أَوْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ السَّلَامُ أَوْ سَلَامٌ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Yūnus b. Jubayr \u003e Ḥiṭṭān b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Ṣallá Binā Abū Mūsá Iḥdá Ṣalātay al-ʿAshī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1399

chapter.englishTitle: Working in Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abu Asim informed us that Al-Nabil narrated from Ibn Ajlan from Al-Maqburi from Amr ibn Sulaim from Abu Qatadah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out to pray with a shawl hanging on his neck or shoulders, which belonged to Ummamah bint Zainab. Whenever he went down into a bowing position, he placed it down, and when he stood up, he would carry it again."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Abu Asim informed us that Al-Nabil narrated from Ibn Ajlan from Al-Maqburi from Amr ibn Sulaim from Abu Qatadah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out to pray with a shawl hanging on his neck or shoulders, which belonged to Ummamah bint Zainab. Whenever he went down into a bowing position, he placed it down, and when he stood up, he would carry it again."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ هُوَ النَّبِيلُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «خَرَجَ يُصَلِّي وَقَدْ حَمَلَ عَلَى عُنُقِهِ أَوْ عَاتِقِهِ أُمَامَةَ بِنْتَ زَيْنَبَ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ وَضَعَهَا وَإِذَا قَامَ حَمَلَهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e al-Nabīl \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e al-Maqburī \u003e ʿAmr b. Sulaym \u003e Abū Qatādah

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1400

chapter.englishTitle: Working in Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was leading the people in prayer with Umamah daughter of Zainab daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (in his lap). When he prostrated, he put her down and when he got up(after prostration) he lifted her up.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was leading the people in prayer with Umamah daughter of Zainab daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (in his lap). When he prostrated, he put her down and when he got up(after prostration) he lifted her up.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «حَمَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُمَامَةَ بِنْتَ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ فَإِذَا سَجَدَ وَضَعَهَا وَإِذَا قَامَ حَمَلَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿĀmir b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿAmr b. Sulaym al-Zuraqī \u003e Abū Qatādah al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1401

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ يُرَدُّ السَّلَامُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: How is peace returned in prayer?

hadiths.englishRaw: I passed by the messenger of Allah ﷺ and greeted him while he was praying, and he responded to me with a gesture. Laith said, "I think he responded with his finger."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I passed by the messenger of Allah ﷺ and greeted him while he was praying, and he responded to me with a gesture. Laith said, "I think he responded with his finger."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَرَرْتُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَرَدَّ إِلَيَّ إِشَارَةً» قَالَ لَيْثٌ أَحْسَبُهُ قَالَ بِأُصْبُعِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Bukayr \u003e Ibn al-Ashaj \u003e Nābil Ṣāḥib al-ʿAbāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Ṣuhayb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ أَخْبَرَنِي بُكَيْرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ نَابِلٍ صَاحِبِ الْعَبَاءِ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1402

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ يُرَدُّ السَّلَامُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: How is peace returned in prayer?

hadiths.englishRaw: I'm sorry, but I'm unable to generate a translation without a proper sentence structure.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I'm sorry, but I'm unable to generate a translation without a proper sentence structure.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ مَسْجِدَ بَنِي عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ فَدَخَلَ النَّاسُ يُسَلِّمُونَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ قَالَ فَسَأَلْتُ صُهَيْبًا كَيْفَ كَانَ يَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ؟ قَالَ هَكَذَا وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ   – إسناده صحيح

hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1403

chapter.englishTitle: Glorification for Men and Applauding for Women

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Tasbih (saying Subhan-Allah) is for men and clapping is for women.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Tasbih (saying Subhan-Allah) is for men and clapping is for women.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «التَّسْبِيحُ لِلرِّجَالِ وَالتَّصْفِيقُ لِلنِّسَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1404

chapter.englishTitle: Glorification for Men and Applauding for Women

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If something bothers you in your prayer, let the men glorify (subhan Allah) and let the women clap."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If something bothers you in your prayer, let the men glorify (subhan Allah) and let the women clap."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا نَابَكُمْ شَيْءٌ فِي صَلَاتِكُمْ فَلْيُسَبِّحِ الرِّجَالُ وَلْتُصَفِّحِ النِّسَاءُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1405

chapter.englishTitle: Glorification for Men and Applauding for Women

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ, someone like him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ, someone like him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Jumaḥī And ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad And ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Abū Ḥāzim And Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجُمَحِيُّ وَعَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ وَسُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1406

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صَلَاةِ التَّطوُّعِ فِي أَيِّ مَوْضِعٍ أَفْضَلُ
chapter.englishTitle: What is the best place for voluntary prayers?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You should pray in your homes, for the best prayer of a person is the one performed at home, except for the congregational prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You should pray in your homes, for the best prayer of a person is the one performed at home, except for the congregational prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «عَلَيْكُمْ بِالصَّلَاةِ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ صَلَاةِ الْمَرْءِ فِي بَيْتِهِ إِلَّا الْجَمَاعَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Makkī b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd b. Abū Hind \u003e Abū al-Naḍr \u003e Busr b. Saʿīd \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1407

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِعَادَةِ الصَّلَوَاتِ فِي الْجَمَاعَةِ بَعْدَ مَا يُصَلِّي فِي بَيْتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Reestablishment of Prayers in Congregation after Praying at ...

hadiths.englishRaw: He prayed the Fajr prayer with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . He said, "There were two men sitting on the side who did not pray." So, the Prophet called them and they were brought to him trembling. He said, "What prevented you from praying?" They replied, "We already prayed in our journey." He said, "Do not do that when you pray in your journey and then catch up with the Imam and pray, as it will be an additional voluntary prayer for you.” Then, the people stood and took hold of his hand, wiping their faces with it. He said, "So, I took his hand and wiped my face with it, and it was cooler than ice and more fragrant than musk."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He prayed the Fajr prayer with the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . He said, "There were two men sitting on the side who did not pray." So, the Prophet called them and they were brought to him trembling. He said, "What prevented you from praying?" They replied, "We already prayed in our journey." He said, "Do not do that when you pray in your journey and then catch up with the Imam and pray, as it will be an additional voluntary prayer for you.” Then, the people stood and took hold of his hand, wiping their faces with it. He said, "So, I took his hand and wiped my face with it, and it was cooler than ice and more fragrant than musk."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ صَلَاةَ الصُّبْحِ قَالَ فَإِذَا رَجُلَانِ حِينَ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ قَاعِدَانِ فِي نَاحِيَةٍ لَمْ يُصَلِّيَا قَالَ فَدَعَا بِهِمَا فَجِيءَ بِهِمَا تُرْعَدُ فَرَائِصُهُمَا قَالَ «مَا مَنَعَكُمَا أَنْ تُصَلِّيَا؟» قَالَا صَلَّيْنَا فِي رِحَالِنَا قَالَ «فَلَا تَفْعَلَا إِذَا صَلَّيْتُمَا فِي رِحَالِكُمَا ثُمَّ أَدْرَكْتُمَا الْإِمَامَ فَصَلِّيَا فَإِنَّهَا لَكُمَا نَافِلَةٌ» قَالَ فَقَامَ النَّاسُ يَأْخُذُونَ بِيَدِهِ يَمْسَحُونَ بِهَا وُجُوهَهُمْ قَالَ فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهِ فَمَسَحْتُ بِهَا وَجْهِي فَإِذَا هِيَ أَبْرَدُ مِنَ الثَّلْجِ وَأَطْيَبُ رِيحًا مِنَ الْمِسْكِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Jābir b. Yazīd b. al-Aswad al-Suwāʾī from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ السُّوَائِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1408

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَلَاةِ الْجَمَاعَةِ فِي مَسْجِدٍ قَدْ صُلِّيَ فِيهِ مَرَّةً
chapter.englishTitle: In Congregational Prayer in a Mosque that Has Been Prayed in Once

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a person praying alone. He said: Is there any man who may do good with this (man) and pray along with him.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a person praying alone. He said: Is there any man who may do good with this (man) and pray along with him.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ رَأَى رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي وَحْدَهُ فَقَالَ «أَلَا رَجُلٌ يَتَصَدَّقُ عَلَى هَذَا فَيُصَلِّي مَعَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Sulaymān al-Aswad \u003e Abū al-Mutawakkil al-Nājī \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الْأَسْوَدُ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1409

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَلَاةِ الْجَمَاعَةِ فِي مَسْجِدٍ قَدْ صُلِّيَ فِيهِ مَرَّةً
chapter.englishTitle: In Congregational Prayer in a Mosque that Has Been Prayed in Once

hadiths.englishRaw: A man entered the mosque after the Prophet ﷺ had prayed and said, "Is there not a man who will give charity to him so that he can pray with him?" Abdullah said, "He prays the afternoon prayer and the sunset prayer, but he intercedes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man entered the mosque after the Prophet ﷺ had prayed and said, "Is there not a man who will give charity to him so that he can pray with him?" Abdullah said, "He prays the afternoon prayer and the sunset prayer, but he intercedes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَقَدْ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «أَلَا رَجُلٌ يَتَصَدَّقُ عَلَى هَذَا فَيُصَلِّي مَعَهُ؟» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُصَلِّي صَلَاةَ الْعَصْرِ وَيُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ وَلَكِنْ يَشْفَعُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Sulaymān al-Aswad \u003e Abū al-Mutawakkil al-Nājī \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الْأَسْوَدُ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1410

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in One Garment

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah, should a man pray in a single garment?" He said, "Does every one of you have two garments or do you all have two garments?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah, should a man pray in a single garment?" He said, "Does every one of you have two garments or do you all have two garments?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ؟ قَالَ «أَوَ كُلُّكُمْ يَجِدُ ثَوْبَيْنِ أَوْ لِكُلِّكُمْ ثَوْبَانِ ؟»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Abū Hurayrah \u003e a man
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1411

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in One Garment

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺsaid: 'No one of you should pray in a single garment with no part of it on his shoulder.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺsaid: 'No one of you should pray in a single garment with no part of it on his shoulder.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يُصَلِّيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ لَيْسَ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá And Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1412

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of the Inclusion of Sama'

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, forbade wearing two garments at once, so that there is nothing between one's private parts and the sky. He also forbade wearing the saummah, which was a specific type of garment worn by Jewish people.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, forbade wearing two garments at once, so that there is nothing between one's private parts and the sky. He also forbade wearing the saummah, which was a specific type of garment worn by Jewish people.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ أَنْ يَحْتَبِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ لَيْسَ بَيْنَ فَرْجِهِ وَبَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ شَيْءٌ وَعَنِ الصَّمَّاءِ اشْتِمَالِ الْيَهُودِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1413
hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Maimunah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on a mat.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Maimunah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray on a mat.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي عَلَى الْخُمْرَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir And ʾAbū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sulaymān al-Shaybānī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Shaddād \u003e Maymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ وَأَبُو الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1414
hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ prayed on a mat.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ prayed on a mat.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «صَلَّى عَلَى حَصِيرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd And ʿAbd Allāh b. Maslamah \u003e Mālik \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1415

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in Women's Clothing

hadiths.englishRaw: Mu'awiyah ibn AbuSufyan asked his sister Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ: Would the apostle of Allah ﷺ pray in the clothe in which he had an intercourse? She said: Yes, when he would not see any impurity in it.
hadiths.body: Mu'awiyah ibn AbuSufyan asked his sister Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ: Would the apostle of Allah ﷺ pray in the clothe in which he had an intercourse? She said: Yes, when he would not see any impurity in it.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ هَلْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي فِي الثَّوْبِ الَّذِي يُضَاجِعُكِ فِيهِ؟ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ إِذَا لَمْ يَرَ فِيهِ أَذًى
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jaʿfar \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Ḥudayj \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Abū Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُدَيْجٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1416

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in Women's Clothing

hadiths.englishRaw: Mu'awiyah ibn AbuSufyan asked his sister Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ: Would the apostle of Allah ﷺ pray in the clothe in which he had an intercourse? She said: Yes, when he would not see any impurity in it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Mu'awiyah ibn AbuSufyan asked his sister Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ: Would the apostle of Allah ﷺ pray in the clothe in which he had an intercourse? She said: Yes, when he would not see any impurity in it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُخْتِهِ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهَا هَلْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُصَلِّي فِي الثَّوْبِ الَّذِي يُجَامِعُهَا فِيهِ؟ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ إِذَا لَمْ يَرَ فِيهِ أَذًى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Sūwayd b. Qays \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Ḥudayj \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Abū Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُدَيْجٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1417

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in Al-Na'lin

hadiths.englishRaw: "I asked Anas bin Malik: 'Did the Prophet ﷺ pray in sandals?' He said: 'Yes.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I asked Anas bin Malik: 'Did the Prophet ﷺ pray in sandals?' He said: 'Yes.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي فِي نَعْلَيْهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar Anbʾanā Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Maslamah \u003e Saʿīd b. Yazīd al-Azdī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ هُوَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْأَزْدِيُّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1418

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in Al-Na'lin

hadiths.englishRaw: While the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was praying with his companions, he took off his sandals and placed them on his left side. So, they also took off their sandals. When he finished his prayer, he asked them, "What made you take off your sandals?" They replied, "We saw you taking off yours, so we took off ours too." He said, "Verily, Gabriel came to me or someone else came and informed me that there was something harmful or impure on them. So, when any of you come to the mosque, let him flip his sandals. If he sees something harmful, he should shake them off and pray in them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: While the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was praying with his companions, he took off his sandals and placed them on his left side. So, they also took off their sandals. When he finished his prayer, he asked them, "What made you take off your sandals?" They replied, "We saw you taking off yours, so we took off ours too." He said, "Verily, Gabriel came to me or someone else came and informed me that there was something harmful or impure on them. So, when any of you come to the mosque, let him flip his sandals. If he sees something harmful, he should shake them off and pray in them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَمَا كان رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي بِأَصْحَابِهِ إِذْ خَلَعَ نَعْلَيْهِ فَوَضَعَهُمَا عَنْ يَسَارِهِ فَخَلَعُوا نِعَالَهُمْ فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ قَالَ «مَا حَمَلَكُمْ عَلَى إِلْقَائِكُمْ نِعَالَكُمْ؟» قَالُوا رَأَيْنَاكَ خَلَعْتَ فَخَلَعْنَا قَالَ «إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ أَتَانِي أَوْ أَتَى فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ فِيهِمَا أَذًى أَوْ قَذَرًا فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيُقَلِّبْ نَعْلَيْهِ فَإِنْ رَأَى فِيهِمَا أَذًى فَلْيُمِطْ وَلْيُصَلِّ فِيهِمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl And ʾAbū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū Naʿāmah al-Saʿdī \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ وَأَبُو النُّعْمَانِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي نَعَامَةَ السَّعْدِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1419

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ السَّدْلِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of slouching in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: He "disliked lying" and he presented it to the Prophet peace be upon him.
hadiths.body: He "disliked lying" and he presented it to the Prophet peace be upon him.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ «كَرِهَ السَّدْلَ» وَرَفَعَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah \u003e ʿIsl \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ عِسْلٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1420

chapter.englishTitle: In the Mire of Poetry

hadiths.englishRaw: "Rasul Allah ﷺ saw me while I was in prostration, and I had braided my hair or tied it up, so I released it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Rasul Allah ﷺ saw me while I was in prostration, and I had braided my hair or tied it up, so I released it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَآنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا سَاجِدٌ وَقَدْ عَقَصْتُ شَعْرِي أَوْ قَالَ عَقَدْتُ «فَأَطْلَقَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Mikhwal \u003e Abū Saʿīd \u003e Abū Rāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مِخْوَلٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1421

chapter.englishTitle: In the Mire of Poetry
