hadiths.englishRaw: Kurayb the freed slave of Ibn Abbas reported: Abdullah ibn Abbas saw Abdullah ibn al-Harith praying having the back knot of the hair. He stood behind him and began to untie it. He remained standing unmoved (stationary). When he finished his prayer he came to Ibn Abbas and said to him: What were you doing with my head? He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: A man who prays with the black knot of hair tied is the one praying pinioned.    – Sound
hadiths.body: Kurayb the freed slave of Ibn Abbas reported: Abdullah ibn Abbas saw Abdullah ibn al-Harith praying having the back knot of the hair. He stood behind him and began to untie it. He remained standing unmoved (stationary). When he finished his prayer he came to Ibn Abbas and said to him: What were you doing with my head? He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: A man who prays with the black knot of hair tied is the one praying pinioned.    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «إِنَّمَا مَثَلُ هَذَا كَمَثَلِ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي وَهُوَ مَكْتُوفٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Bakr \u003e Ibn Muḍar \u003e ʿAmr / Ibn al-Ḥārith \u003e Bukayr \u003e Kurayb a freed slave of Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Raʾá ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ḥārith Yuṣallī And Raʾsuh Maʿqūṣ from Warāʾih Faqām Warāʾah Fajaʿal Yaḥulluh Waʾaqar Lah al-Ākhar Thum Ānṣaraf \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Mā Lak Waraʾsī \u003e Innī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ أَنَّ كُرَيْبًا مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ رَأَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ يُصَلِّي وَرَأْسُهُ مَعْقُوصٌ مِنْ وَرَائِهِ فَقَامَ وَرَاءَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَحُلُّهُ وَأَقَرَّ لَهُ الْآخَرُ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ مَا لَكَ وَرَأْسِي؟ قَالَ إِنِّي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1422

chapter.englishTitle: Yawning in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ said, "When one of you yawns, let him cover his mouth, for indeed, Satan enters." Abu Muhammad said, "He means by 'cover his mouth'."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ said, "When one of you yawns, let him cover his mouth, for indeed, Satan enters." Abu Muhammad said, "He means by 'cover his mouth'."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا تَثَاءَبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَشُدَّ يَدَهُ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَدْخُلُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي عَلَى فِيهِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Ibn Muḥammad \u003e Suhayl \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Saʿīd from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1423

chapter.englishTitle: The Dislike of Prayer for the Impure

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ who said, "If one of you feels drowsy while praying, let him sleep until his sleep is gone, for he may be seeking to ask for forgiveness and then end up cursing himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ who said, "If one of you feels drowsy while praying, let him sleep until his sleep is gone, for he may be seeking to ask for forgiveness and then end up cursing himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا وَجَدَ أَحَدُكُمُ النَّوْمَ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَلْيَنَمْ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ نَوْمُهُ فَإِنَّهُ عَسَى يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرَ فَيَسُبَّ نَفْسَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1424

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صَلَاةِ الْقَاعِدِ عَلَى النِّصْفِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْقَائِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prayer of the sitting (person) is half of the prayer of the stan...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The prayer of a person who prays sitting down is equal to half of the prayer." So, I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying sitting down, and I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I heard that you said, 'The prayer of a person who prays sitting down is equal to half of the prayer,' and yet you are praying sitting down?" He replied, "Yes, but I am not like any one of you."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The prayer of a person who prays sitting down is equal to half of the prayer." So, I entered upon the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying sitting down, and I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I heard that you said, 'The prayer of a person who prays sitting down is equal to half of the prayer,' and yet you are praying sitting down?" He replied, "Yes, but I am not like any one of you."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ جَالِسًا نِصْفُ الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي جَالِسًا فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ قُلْتَ «صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ جَالِسًا نِصْفُ الصَّلَاةِ» وَأَنْتَ تُصَلِّي جَالِسًا؟ قَالَ «أَجَلْ وَلَكِنِّي لَسْتُ كَأَحَدٍ مِنْكُمْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Jaʿfar \u003e Ibn al-Ḥārith \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Hilāl \u003e Abū Yaḥyá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Balaghanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ هِلَالٍ عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ بَلَغَنِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1425

chapter.englishTitle: The voluntary prayer while seated

hadiths.englishRaw: "Hafsah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , said, 'I have never seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying while sitting until close to the time of his passing, which was about a year or two before his death. I saw him praying while sitting, reciting the Surah until it became longer than any other Surah.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "Hafsah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , said, 'I have never seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ praying while sitting until close to the time of his passing, which was about a year or two before his death. I saw him praying while sitting, reciting the Surah until it became longer than any other Surah.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ حَفْصَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ «لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي فِي سُبْحَتِهِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ حَتَّى كَانَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُتَوَفَّى بِعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ أَوْ عَامَيْنِ فَرَأَيْتُهُ يُصَلِّي فِي سُبْحَتِهِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فَيُرَتِّلُ السُّورَةَ حَتَّى تَكُونَ أَطْوَلَ مِنْ أَطْوَلَ مِنْهَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e al-Sāʾib b. Yazīd \u003e al-Muṭṭalib b. Abū And Dāʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ أَبِي وَدَاعَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1426

chapter.englishTitle: The voluntary prayer while seated

hadiths.englishRaw: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Rukanah bin Yazid from the Prophet ﷺ through a different chain of narrators.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Rukanah bin Yazid from the Prophet ﷺ through a different chain of narrators.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e al-Sāʾib b. Yazīd \u003e al-Muṭṭalib b. Abū And Dāʿah \u003e Ḥafṣah
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ أَبِي وَدَاعَةَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1427

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of wiping pebbles

hadiths.englishRaw: It was said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about wiping in the mosque, he said, "If you must do it, then do it only once." Hisham said, "I think he meant wiping over the footwear."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about wiping in the mosque, he said, "If you must do it, then do it only once." Hisham said, "I think he meant wiping over the footwear."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قِيلَ لَهُ فِي الْمَسْحِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ «إِنْ كُنْتَ لَا بُدَّ فَاعِلًا فَوَاحِدَةً» قَالَ هِشَامٌ أُرَاهُ قَالَ يَعْنِي مَسْحَ الْحَصَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Muʿayqīb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَيْقِيبٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1428

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of wiping pebbles

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘When anyone of you gets up to perform prayer, then indeed mercy is facing him, so he should not smooth the pebbles.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘When anyone of you gets up to perform prayer, then indeed mercy is facing him, so he should not smooth the pebbles.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَإِنَّ الرَّحْمَةَ تُوَاجِهُهُ فَلَا يَمْسَحِ الْحَصَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1429

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: الْأَرْضُ كُلُّها طَاهِرَةٌ مَا خَلَا الْمَقْبَرَةَ وَالْحَمَّامَ
chapter.englishTitle: All the land is clean except for the cemetery and the bathroom

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I have been given five things that no prophet before me was given. Firstly, the prophet was sent specifically to his own people, whereas I have been sent to all people. Secondly, the spoils of war have been made lawful for me, while they were prohibited for those before me. Thirdly, the earth has been made pure and a place of worship for me, so any place can be used as a mosque or a place of purification. Fourthly, the distance that our enemy fears from us is a month's journey. And finally, I have been given the privilege of intercession.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: I have been given five things that no prophet before me was given. Firstly, the prophet was sent specifically to his own people, whereas I have been sent to all people. Secondly, the spoils of war have been made lawful for me, while they were prohibited for those before me. Thirdly, the earth has been made pure and a place of worship for me, so any place can be used as a mosque or a place of purification. Fourthly, the distance that our enemy fears from us is a month's journey. And finally, I have been given the privilege of intercession.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُعْطِيتُ خَمْسًا لَمْ يُعْطَهُنَّ نَبِيٌّ قَبْلِي كَانَ النَّبِيُّ يُبْعَثُ إِلَى قَوْمِهِ خَاصَّةً وَبُعِثْتُ إِلَى النَّاسِ كَافَّةً وَأُحِلَّتْ لِيَ الْمَغَانِمُ وَحُرِّمَتْ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلِي وَجُعِلَتْ لِيَ الْأَرْضُ طَيِّبَةً مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا وَيَرْعَبُ مِنَّا عَدُوُّنَا مَسِيرَةَ شَهْرٍ وَأُعْطِيتُ الشَّفَاعَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Hushaym \u003e Sayyār \u003e Yazīd al-Faqīr \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَزِيدَ الْفَقِيرَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1430

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: الْأَرْضُ كُلُّها طَاهِرَةٌ مَا خَلَا الْمَقْبَرَةَ وَالْحَمَّامَ
chapter.englishTitle: All the land is clean except for the cemetery and the bathroom

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The whole earth is a mosque except for the graveyard and the bathroom." It was asked to Abu Muhammad, "Is prayer allowed in the graveyard?" He said, "Yes, if it is not on the grave." And the narration says that most of them transmitted it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The whole earth is a mosque except for the graveyard and the bathroom." It was asked to Abu Muhammad, "Is prayer allowed in the graveyard?" He said, "Yes, if it is not on the grave." And the narration says that most of them transmitted it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْأَرْضُ كُلُّهَا مَسْجِدٌ إِلَّا الْمَقْبَرَةَ وَالْحَمَّامَ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ تُجْزِئُ الصَّلَاةُ فِي الْمَقْبَرَةِ؟ قَالَ إِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ عَلَى الْقَبْرِ فَنَعَمْ وَقَالَ الْحَدِيثُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ أَرْسَلُوهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Manṣūr \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʾaltuh ʿAnh \u003e ʿAmr b. Yaḥyá from his father \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ أَنَا سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1431

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الصَّلَاةِ فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ وَمَعَاطِنِ الْإِبِلِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in Sheep Pens and Camel Enclosures

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "If you cannot find anywhere (for prayer) except sheep's resting-places and camels' resting-places, then perform prayer in the sheep's resting-places and do not perform prayer in the camels' resting-places."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "If you cannot find anywhere (for prayer) except sheep's resting-places and camels' resting-places, then perform prayer in the sheep's resting-places and do not perform prayer in the camels' resting-places."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا إِلَّا مَرَابِضَ الْغَنَمِ وَأَعْطَانَ الْإِبِلِ فَصَلُّوا فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ وَلَا تُصَلُّوا فِي أَعْطَانِ الْإِبِلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Minhāl \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1432

chapter.englishTitle: Who built a mosque for Allah?

hadiths.englishRaw: I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah will build a similar one for him in Paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, Allah will build a similar one for him in Paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ بَنَى لِلَّهِ مَسْجِدًا بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مِثْلَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jaʿfar from my father \u003e Maḥmūd b. Labīd \u003e ʿUthmān Lammā Arād \u003e Yab.ī al-Masjid Karih al-Nās Dhalik \u003e ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ لَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَبْنِيَ الْمَسْجِدَ كَرِهَ النَّاسُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1433

chapter.englishTitle: The Two Rak'ahs When Entering the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: "When any one of you enters the Masjid, let him pray two Rak'ahs before he sits down."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When any one of you enters the Masjid, let him pray two Rak'ahs before he sits down."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Mālik b. Anas And Fulayḥ b. Sulaymān \u003e ʿĀmir b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿAmr b. Sulaym al-Zuraqī \u003e Abū Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ وَفُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الزُّرَقِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1434

chapter.englishTitle: The saying upon entering the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: when any of you enters the mosque he should invoke blessing on the prophet ﷺ and then he should say: O Allah, open to me the gates of thy mercy. And when he goes out, he should say: O Allah, I ask thee out of Thine abundance.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: when any of you enters the mosque he should invoke blessing on the prophet ﷺ and then he should say: O Allah, open to me the gates of thy mercy. And when he goes out, he should say: O Allah, I ask thee out of Thine abundance.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حُمَيْدٍ أَوْ أَبَا أُسَيْدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ثُمَّ لِيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Rabīʿah b. Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. Saʿīd b. Sūwayd \u003e Abū Ḥumayd or Abū Usayd al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1435

chapter.englishTitle: The Repulsion of Saliva in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ, "Is spitting in the mosque a sin?" He said, "Yes, and its expiation is burying it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ, "Is spitting in the mosque a sin?" He said, "Yes, and its expiation is burying it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «الْبُزَاقُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ خَطِيئَةٌ؟» قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَكَفَّارَتُهَا دَفْنُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Liqatādah Asamiʿt Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِقَتَادَةَ أَسَمِعْتَ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1436

chapter.englishTitle: The Repulsion of Saliva in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a person prays, they are having a private conversation with their Lord, or their Lord is addressing them directly between them and the qibla (direction of prayer). So when one of you spits, let them spit to their left or under their foot, or say, 'Like this' and spit on their garment and rub it with some of it on the other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a person prays, they are having a private conversation with their Lord, or their Lord is addressing them directly between them and the qibla (direction of prayer). So when one of you spits, let them spit to their left or under their foot, or say, 'Like this' and spit on their garment and rub it with some of it on the other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا صَلَّى فَإِنَّمَا يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ أَوْ رَبُّهُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَإِذَا بَزَقَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَبْصُقْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَوْ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ أَوْ يَقُولُ هَكَذَا وَبَزَقَ فِي ثَوْبِهِ وَدَلَكَ بَعْضَهُ بِبَعْضٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1437

chapter.englishTitle: The Repulsion of Saliva in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: While the Prophet ﷺ was delivering a sermon, he saw some spit in the direction of the mosque's Qibla (prayer direction). This annoyed him and he reprimanded the people of the mosque, saying that Allah will accept a person's prayer when they are in it, so they should not spit there or he said, "do not blow your nose." He then ordered for it to be wiped and it was wiped. Hammad said, "I do not know of it except that it was done with saffron."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: While the Prophet ﷺ was delivering a sermon, he saw some spit in the direction of the mosque's Qibla (prayer direction). This annoyed him and he reprimanded the people of the mosque, saying that Allah will accept a person's prayer when they are in it, so they should not spit there or he said, "do not blow your nose." He then ordered for it to be wiped and it was wiped. Hammad said, "I do not know of it except that it was done with saffron."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ إِذْ رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَتَغَيَّظَ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قِبَلَ أَحَدِكُمْ إِذَا كَانَ فِي صَلَاتِهِ فَلَا يَبْزُقَنَّ أَوْ قَالَ لَا يَتَنَخَّعَنَّ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُكَّ مَكَانُهَا وَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَلُطِخَتْ قَالَ حَمَّادٌ وَلَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا قَالَ بِزَعْفَرَانٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1438

chapter.englishTitle: The Repulsion of Saliva in the Mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw some expectoration on the wall of the mosque; he took gravel and scraped it off and said, "If anyone of you wanted to spit he should neither spit in front of him nor on his right but he could spit either on his left or under his left foot."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw some expectoration on the wall of the mosque; he took gravel and scraped it off and said, "If anyone of you wanted to spit he should neither spit in front of him nor on his right but he could spit either on his left or under his left foot."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَأَى نُخَامَةً فِي جِدَارِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَتَنَاوَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَصَاةً وَحَتَّهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِذَا تَنَخَّمَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلَا يَتَنَخَّمَنَّ قِبَلَ وَجْهِهِ وَلَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَلْيَبْصُقْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَوْ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Saʿīd And ʾAbā Hurayrah Akhbarāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ وَأَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَخْبَرَاهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1439

chapter.englishTitle: Sleeping in the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ came to me while I was sleeping in the mosque and he hit me with his foot. He said, "Don't you see that you are sleeping here?" I said, "O Prophet of Allah, sleepiness overpowered my eyes."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ came to me while I was sleeping in the mosque and he hit me with his foot. He said, "Don't you see that you are sleeping here?" I said, "O Prophet of Allah, sleepiness overpowered my eyes."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَانِي نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا نَائِمٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَضَرَبَنِي بِرِجْلِهِ قَالَ «أَلَا أَرَاكَ نَائِمًا فِيهِ؟» قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ غَلَبَتْنِي عَيْنِي   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Muʿtamir \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e Abū Ḥarb b. Abū al-Aswad al-Diʾulī from his uncle \u003e Abū Dhar \u003e Atānī Nabī Allāh ﷺ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَرْبِ بْنِ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ الدِّؤُلِيِّ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1440

chapter.englishTitle: Sleeping in the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: "I used to spend the night in the mosque, and I didn't have any family members. So I saw in a dream as if I was being taken to a well where there were men hung. It was said, 'Take him to the right.' So I told Hafsah about the dream and asked her to narrate it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . She narrated it to him, and he said, 'Who saw this dream?' She replied, 'Ibn Umar.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'What an excellent young man, or what an excellent man he is if he were to perform the night prayer.' He (Ibn Umar) said, 'And when I slept, I wouldn't wake up until morning.' He (the Prophet) said, 'Then maintain the night prayer.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "I used to spend the night in the mosque, and I didn't have any family members. So I saw in a dream as if I was being taken to a well where there were men hung. It was said, 'Take him to the right.' So I told Hafsah about the dream and asked her to narrate it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . She narrated it to him, and he said, 'Who saw this dream?' She replied, 'Ibn Umar.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'What an excellent young man, or what an excellent man he is if he were to perform the night prayer.' He (Ibn Umar) said, 'And when I slept, I wouldn't wake up until morning.' He (the Prophet) said, 'Then maintain the night prayer.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ أَبِيتُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لِي أَهْلٌ فَرَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ كَأَنَّمَا انْطُلِقَ بِي إِلَى بِئْرٍ فِيهَا رِجَالٌ مُعَلَّقُونَ فَقِيلَ انْطَلِقُوا بِهِ إِلَى ذَاتِ الْيَمِينِ فَذَكَرْتُ الرُّؤْيَا لِحَفْصَةَ فَقُلْتُ قُصِّيهَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَصَّتْهَا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «مَنْ رَأَى هَذِهِ؟» قَالَتْ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ نِعْمَ الْفَتَى أَوْ قَالَ نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ لَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ وَكُنْتُ إِذَا نِمْتُ لَمْ أَقُمْ حَتَّى أُصْبِحَ قَالَ فَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُصَلِّي اللَّيْلَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1441

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عنِ اسْتنْشَادِ الضَّالَّةِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، وَالشِّراءِ، وَالْبَيْعِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of seeking misguidedness in the mosque, buying, and ...

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you see someone selling or buying in the Masjid then say: 'May Allah not profit your business.' And when you see someone announcing about something lost then say: 'May Allah not return it to you.'" The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Gharib. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. They dislike selling and buying in the Masjid. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge permitted selling and buying in the Masjid.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "When you see someone selling or buying in the Masjid then say: 'May Allah not profit your business.' And when you see someone announcing about something lost then say: 'May Allah not return it to you.'" The Hadith of Abu Hurairah is Hasan Gharib. This is acted upon according to some of the people of knowledge. They dislike selling and buying in the Masjid. This is the view of Ahmad and Ishaq. Some of the people of knowledge permitted selling and buying in the Masjid.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مَنْ يَبِيعُ أَوْ يَبْتَاعُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقُولُوا لَا أَرْبَحَ اللَّهُ تِجَارَتَكَ وَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ مَنْ يَنْشُدُ فِيهِ الضَّالَّةَ فَقُولُوا لَا رَدَّهَا اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي زَيْدٍ الْكُوفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ أَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ َ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1442

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ عَنْ حَمْلِ السِّلَاحِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of carrying weapons in the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to ʿAmr, "O Abu Muhammad! Did you hear Jabir bin ʿAbdullah saying, 'A man carrying arrows passed through the mosque and Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, 'Hold the arrows by their heads! "ʿAmr replied, "Yes."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to ʿAmr, "O Abu Muhammad! Did you hear Jabir bin ʿAbdullah saying, 'A man carrying arrows passed through the mosque and Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, 'Hold the arrows by their heads! "ʿAmr replied, "Yes."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «أَمْسِكْ نُصُولَهَا؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Liʿamriw b. Dīnār Asamiʿt Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Mar a man Yaḥmil Nabl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ أَسَمِعْتَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ يَحْمِلُ نَبْلًا فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1443

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ عَنِ اتِّخاذِ الْقُبُورِ مَسَاجِدَ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of using graves as mosques

hadiths.englishRaw: When the last moment of the life of Messenger of Allah ﷺ came he started putting his 'Khamisa' on his face and when he felt hot and short of breath he took it off his face and said, "May Allah curse the Jews and Christians for they built the places of worship at the graves of their Prophets." The Prophet ﷺ was warning (Muslims) of what those had done.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the last moment of the life of Messenger of Allah ﷺ came he started putting his 'Khamisa' on his face and when he felt hot and short of breath he took it off his face and said, "May Allah curse the Jews and Christians for they built the places of worship at the graves of their Prophets." The Prophet ﷺ was warning (Muslims) of what those had done.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَعَائِشَةَ قَالَا لَمَّا نُزِلَ بِالنَّبِيِّ ﷺ طَفِقَ يَطْرَحُ خَمِيصَةً لَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فَإِذَا اغْتَمَّ كَشَفَهَا عَنْ وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ «لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَى الْيَهُودِ وَالنَّصَارَى؛ اتَّخَذُوا قُبُورَ أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ مَسَاجِدَ» يُحَذِّرُ مِثْلَ مَا صَنَعُوا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās And ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1444

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْاشْتِبَاكِ إِذَا خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of engaging in conflict when going to the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you performs ablution and then goes intentionally to pray, he should not intertwine his fingers."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you performs ablution and then goes intentionally to pray, he should not intertwine his fingers."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا تَوَضَّأَ أَحَدُكُمْ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ عَامِدًا إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَلَا يُشَبِّكُ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Dāwud b. Qays al-Farrāʾ \u003e Saʿd b. Isḥāq \u003e Abū Thumāmah al-Ḥannāṭ \u003e Adrakanī Kaʿb b. ʿUjrah Bi-al-Balāṭ \u003e Mushabbik Bayn Aṣābiʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ الْفَرَّاءُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي ثُمَامَةَ الْحَنَّاطِ قَالَ أَدْرَكَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عُجْرَةَ بِالْبَلَاطِ وَأَنَا مُشَبِّكٌ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِي فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1445

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْاشْتِبَاكِ إِذَا خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of engaging in conflict when going to the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you perform ablution and head towards the mosque, do not interlock your fingers, for you are in a state of prayer."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When you perform ablution and head towards the mosque, do not interlock your fingers, for you are in a state of prayer."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا تَوَضَّأْتَ فَعَمَدْتَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَلَا تُشَبِّكَنَّ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِكَ فَإِنَّكَ فِي صَلَاةٍ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAjlān \u003e al-Maqburī \u003e Kaʿb b. ʿUjrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1446

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْاشْتِبَاكِ إِذَا خَرَجَ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of engaging in conflict when going to the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever performs ablution and then goes out intending to offer the prayer, he remains in a state of prayer until he returns to his house. So, do not say, 'Such and such happened to him,' meaning, he joined his fingers together."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever performs ablution and then goes out intending to offer the prayer, he remains in a state of prayer until he returns to his house. So, do not say, 'Such and such happened to him,' meaning, he joined his fingers together."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ يُرِيدُ الصَّلَاةَ فَهُوَ فِي صَلَاةٍ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى بَيْتِهِ فَلَا تَقُولُوا هَكَذَا» يَعْنِي يُشَبِّكُ بَيْنَ أَصَابِعِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Haytham b. Jamīl \u003e Muḥammad b. Muslim \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Umayyah \u003e al-Maqburī \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1447

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ مَنْ جَلَسَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of those who sit in the mosque waiting for prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: O Allah, forgives him; O Allah, have mercy on him.     – Sound
hadiths.body: O Allah, forgives him; O Allah, have mercy on him.     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا تَزَالُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ تُصَلِّي عَلَى الْعَبْدِ مَا دَامَ فِي مُصَلَّاهُ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي فِيهِ مَا لَمْ يَقُمْ أَوْ يُحْدِثْ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْهُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1448

chapter.englishTitle: In the decoration of mosques

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: The Last Hour will not come until people vie with one another about mosques.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: The Last Hour will not come until people vie with one another about mosques.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَتَبَاهَى النَّاسُ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1449

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer towards the Sutra

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard Abu Juhaifah say: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ set off at midday, during the time of intense heat' - (One of the narrators) Ibn Al-Muthanna said, to Al-Batha' - and he performed Wudu', and prayed Zuhr, two Rak'ahs, and 'Asr, two Rak'ahs, with a short spear ('Anzah) in front of him.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard Abu Juhaifah say: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ set off at midday, during the time of intense heat' - (One of the narrators) Ibn Al-Muthanna said, to Al-Batha' - and he performed Wudu', and prayed Zuhr, two Rak'ahs, and 'Asr, two Rak'ahs, with a short spear ('Anzah) in front of him.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جُحَيْفَةَ يَقُولُ «خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى الْبَطْحَاءِ بِالْهَاجِرَةِ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَالْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَبَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ عَنَزَةٌ وَإِنَّ الظُّعُنَ لَتَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam b. ʿUtaybah \u003e Abū Juḥayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1450

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer towards the Sutra

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to tie a goat for himself and pray towards it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to tie a goat for himself and pray towards it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَتْ «تُرْكَزُ لَهُ الْعَنَزَةُ يُصَلِّي إِلَيْهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1451

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي دُنُوِّ الْمُصَلِّي إِلَى السُّتْرَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the proximity of the worshipper to the curtain

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Abu Saeed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: " If anyone of you is praying, he should not let anyone pass in front of him, and if he insists (on passing) then let him fight him."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Abu Saeed that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: " If anyone of you is praying, he should not let anyone pass in front of him, and if he insists (on passing) then let him fight him."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ يُصَلِّي فَلَا يَدَعْ أَحَدًا يَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُقَاتِلْهُ فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْطَانٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Saʿīd \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1452

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer for the Departed

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray Witr while riding his mount.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ used to pray Witr while riding his mount.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي إِلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak And ʿAbd Allāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Khālid al-Aḥmar \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ الْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1453

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمَرْأَةِ تَكُونُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمُصَلِّي
chapter.englishTitle: The woman is in front of the worshipper

hadiths.englishRaw: Allah Apostle prayed while I was lying like a dead body on his family bed between him and his Qibla.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Allah Apostle prayed while I was lying like a dead body on his family bed between him and his Qibla.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي وَهِيَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْقِبْلَةِ عَلَى فِرَاشِ أَهْلِهِ اعْتِرَاضَ الْجَنَازَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1454

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَقْطَعُ الصَّلَاةَ، وَمَا لَا يَقْطَعُهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What interrupts prayer and what does not interrupt it.

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Dharr said (and not the Prophet): If there is not anything like the back of a saddle in front of a man who is praying, then a donkey, a black dog, and a woman cut off his prayer. I asked him: Why has the black dog been specified, distinguishing it from a red, a yellow and a white dog? He replied: My nephew, I also asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the same question as you asked me. He said: The black dog is a devil.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Dharr said (and not the Prophet): If there is not anything like the back of a saddle in front of a man who is praying, then a donkey, a black dog, and a woman cut off his prayer. I asked him: Why has the black dog been specified, distinguishing it from a red, a yellow and a white dog? He replied: My nephew, I also asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the same question as you asked me. He said: The black dog is a devil.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَقْطَعُ صَلَاةَ الرَّجُلِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ كَآخِرَةِ الرَّحْلِ الْحِمَارُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْأَسْوَدُ وَالْمَرْأَةُ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَمَا بَالُ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْأَحْمَرِ مِنَ الْأَصْفَرِ فَقَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَمَا سَأَلْتَنِي فَقَالَ «الْأَسْوَدُ شَيْطَانٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd And Ḥajjāj \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ḥumayd b. Hilāl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ وَحَجَّاجٌ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ هِلَالٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1455

chapter.englishTitle: Nothing cuts off prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Prophet ﷺ was performing prayer at ‘Arafat, and Fadl and I came riding a female donkey. We passed in front of part of the row, then we dismounted and left the donkey, and we came and joined the row.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ was performing prayer at ‘Arafat, and Fadl and I came riding a female donkey. We passed in front of part of the row, then we dismounted and left the donkey, and we came and joined the row.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جِئْتُ أَنَا وَالْفَضْلُ يَعْنِي عَلَى أَتَانٍ وَالنَّبِيُّ ﷺ «يُصَلِّي بِمِنًى أَوْ بِعَرَفَةَ» فَمَرَرْتُ عَلَى بَعْضِ الصَّفِّ فَنَزَلْتُ عَنْهَا وَتَرَكْتُهَا تَرْعَى وَدَخَلْتُ فِي الصَّفِّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Jiʾt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1456

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْمُرُورِ بَيْنَ يَدِيِ الْمُصَلِّي
chapter.englishTitle: Dislike of passing in front of the worshipper

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard from the Prophet ﷺ about the one who passes in front of the praying person and said, "Verily the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'It is better for one of you to stand forty (riyals) away from the praying person, than to pass in front of him.'" He said, "So I do not know if he meant a year, a month, or a day."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard from the Prophet ﷺ about the one who passes in front of the praying person and said, "Verily the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'It is better for one of you to stand forty (riyals) away from the praying person, than to pass in front of him.'" He said, "So I do not know if he meant a year, a month, or a day."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي الَّذِي يَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمُصَلِّي فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَأَنْ يَقُومَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَرْبَعِينَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمُرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمُصَلِّي» قَالَ فَلَا أَدْرِي سَنَةً أَوْ شَهْرًا أَوْ يَوْمًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Sālim Abū al-Naḍr \u003e Busr b. Saʿīd \u003e Arsalanī Abū Juhaym al-Anṣārī \u003e Zayd b. Khālid al-Juhanī Asʾaluh Mā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النَّضْرِ عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ أَرْسَلَنِي أَبُو جُهَيْمٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ إِلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ أَسْأَلُهُ مَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1457

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْمُرُورِ بَيْنَ يَدِيِ الْمُصَلِّي
chapter.englishTitle: Dislike of passing in front of the worshipper

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: "If one who passes in front of a man who is praying knew the responsibility he incurs, he would prefer to stand still for forty. . . rather than pass in front of him. Abu al-Nadr said: I do not know whether he said forty days, or months, or years." Abu Dawud: Sufyan al-Thawri said: If a man passes proudly in front of me while I am praying, I shall stop him, and if a weak man passes, I shall not stop him.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: "If one who passes in front of a man who is praying knew the responsibility he incurs, he would prefer to stand still for forty. . . rather than pass in front of him. Abu al-Nadr said: I do not know whether he said forty days, or months, or years." Abu Dawud: Sufyan al-Thawri said: If a man passes proudly in front of me while I am praying, I shall stop him, and if a weak man passes, I shall not stop him.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ فِي الْمَارِّ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمُصَلِّي فَقَالَ أَبُو جُهَيْمٍ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوْ يَعْلَمُ الْمَارُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمُصَلِّي مَاذَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ذَلِكَ لَكَانَ أَنْ يَقِفَ أَرْبَعِينَ خَيْر لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمُرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ» قَالَ أَبُو النَّضْرِ لَا أَدْرِي أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا أَوْ شَهْرًا أَوْ سَنَةً   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Naḍr a freed slave of ʿUmarw b. ʿUbaydullāh b. Maʿmar \u003e Busr b. Saʿīd \u003e Zayd b. Khālid al-Juhanī Arsalah \u003e Abū Juhaym Yasʾaluh Mādhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ مَوْلَى عُمَروَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ أَنَّ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيَّ أَرْسَلَهُ إِلَى أَبِي جُهَيْمٍ يَسْأَلُهُ مَاذَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1458

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي مَسْجِدِ النَّبيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Prayer in the Mosque of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: “One prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers in any other mosque except the Sacred Mosque.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “One prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers in any other mosque except the Sacred Mosque.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا كَأَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Aflaḥ \u003e Ibn Ḥumayd \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad \u003e Salmān al-Aghar \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ هُوَ ابْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنِي سَلْمَانُ الْأَغَرُّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1459

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي مَسْجِدِ النَّبيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Prayer in the Mosque of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: A prayer in my mosque is a thousand times more excellent than a prayer in any other mosque, except Masjid al-Haram (Mosque of the Ka'ba).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A prayer in my mosque is a thousand times more excellent than a prayer in any other mosque, except Masjid al-Haram (Mosque of the Ka'ba).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Bishr b. al-Mufaḍḍal \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1460

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي مَسْجِدِ النَّبيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Prayer in the Mosque of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: “One prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers in any other mosque except the Sacred Mosque.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “One prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers in any other mosque except the Sacred Mosque.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «صَلَاةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ إِلَّا الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1461

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلَّا إِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ
chapter.englishTitle: Do not set out on a journey except to three mosques

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah said: "A mount is not saddled (for a journey) except to three Masajid: Al-Masjid Al-Haram, this Masjid of mine, and Masjid Al-Aqsa." [Abu ʿEisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah said: "A mount is not saddled (for a journey) except to three Masajid: Al-Masjid Al-Haram, this Masjid of mine, and Masjid Al-Aqsa." [Abu ʿEisa said:] This Hadith is Hasan Sahih.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلَّا إِلَى ثَلَاثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ مَسْجِدِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَمَسْجِدِي هَذَا وَمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1462

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ الْمَشْيِ إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ فِي الظُّلَمِ
chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of walking to the mosques in darkness

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, 'Whoever walks in the darkness of the night to perform the prayer, Allah will grant him light on the Day of Resurrection.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, 'Whoever walks in the darkness of the night to perform the prayer, Allah will grant him light on the Day of Resurrection.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ مَشَى فِي ظُلْمَةِ لَيْلٍ إِلَى صَلَاةٍ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ نُورًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Zayd b. Abū Unaysah \u003e Junādah \u003e Makḥūl \u003e Abū Idrīs \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ عَنْ جُنَادَةَ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1463

chapter.englishTitle: The Disapproval of Diverting Attention in Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: Allah, the Most High, continues to turn favourably towards a servant while he is engaged in prayer as long as he does not look to the side (by turning the neck), but if he does so, He turns away from him.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: Allah, the Most High, continues to turn favourably towards a servant while he is engaged in prayer as long as he does not look to the side (by turning the neck), but if he does so, He turns away from him.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَزَالُ اللَّهُ مُقْبِلًا عَلَى الْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ فَإِذَا صَرَفَ وَجْهَهُ انْصَرَفَ عَنْهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e Ibn al-Musayyab \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْأَحْوَصِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ أَنَّ أَبَا ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1464

chapter.englishTitle: Which prayer is the best?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Which deed is best?" He said: "Faith in which there is no doubt, Jihad in which there is no stealing of the spoils of war, and Hjijatun Mabrurah."[1] It was said: "Which prayer is best? He said:"That in which there is ling Qunut (standing)." It was said: "Which charity is best?" He said: "The poor's night." It was said: "Which Hijrah (emigration) is best?" He said: "One who shuns (Hahara) that which Allah has forbidden." It was said: "One who strives against the idolaters with his life and his wealth. "It was said: "Which death is best?" He said: "One who sheds his blood while his horse's feet are cut with swords."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Which deed is best?" He said: "Faith in which there is no doubt, Jihad in which there is no stealing of the spoils of war, and Hjijatun Mabrurah."[1] It was said: "Which prayer is best? He said:"That in which there is ling Qunut (standing)." It was said: "Which charity is best?" He said: "The poor's night." It was said: "Which Hijrah (emigration) is best?" He said: "One who shuns (Hahara) that which Allah has forbidden." It was said: "One who strives against the idolaters with his life and his wealth. "It was said: "Which death is best?" He said: "One who sheds his blood while his horse's feet are cut with swords."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سُئِلَ أَيُّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «إِيمَانٌ لَا شَكَّ فِيهِ وَجِهَادٌ لَا غُلُولَ فِيهِ وَحَجَّةٌ مَبْرُورَةٌ» قِيلَ فَأَيُّ الصَّلَاةِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «طُولُ الْقِيَامِ» قِيلَ فَأَيُّ الصَّدَقَةِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «جُهْدُ مُقِلٍّ» قِيلَ فَأَيُّ الْهِجْرَةِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «أَنْ تَهْجُرَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ» قِيلَ فَأَيُّ الْجِهَادِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «مَنْ جَاهَدَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِمَالِهِ وَنَفْسِهِ» قِيلَ فَأَيُّ الْقَتْلِ أَشْرَفُ؟ قَالَ «مَنْ عُقِرَ جَوَادُهُ وَأُهْرِيقَ دَمُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ḥajjāj b. Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿUthmān b. Abū Sulaymān \u003e ʿAlī al-Azdī \u003e ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr al-Laythī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Ḥubshī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ الْأَزْدِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُبْشِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1465

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ وَصَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Importance of Fajr and Asr Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever prays the two cool prayers (Fajr and Asr) will enter Paradise." It was said to Abu Muhammad, what are the two cool prayers? He said: "The dawn (Fajr) and the afternoon (Asr)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever prays the two cool prayers (Fajr and Asr) will enter Paradise." It was said to Abu Muhammad, what are the two cool prayers? He said: "The dawn (Fajr) and the afternoon (Asr)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ صَلَّى الْبَرْدَيْنِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ مَا الْبَرْدَيْنِ؟ قَالَ «الْغَدَاةُ وَالْعَصْرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Hammām \u003e Abū Jamrah \u003e Abū Bakr b. Abū Mūsá from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1466

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ وَصَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Importance of Fajr and Asr Prayers

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever prays Fajr (the dawn prayer), he is in the protection of Allah, so do not betray Allah in His protection. And whoever prays Asr (the afternoon prayer), he is in the protection of Allah, so do not betray Allah in His protection." Abu Muhammad said: "If someone is trusted but does not fulfill his trust, then he has betrayed and deceived."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever prays Fajr (the dawn prayer), he is in the protection of Allah, so do not betray Allah in His protection. And whoever prays Asr (the afternoon prayer), he is in the protection of Allah, so do not betray Allah in His protection." Abu Muhammad said: "If someone is trusted but does not fulfill his trust, then he has betrayed and deceived."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ فَهُوَ فِي جِوَارِ اللَّهِ فَلَا تُخْفِرُوا اللَّهَ فِي جَارِهِ وَمَنْ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ فَهُوَ فِي جِوَارِ اللَّهِ فَلَا تُخْفِرُوا اللَّهَ فِي جَارِهِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ «إِذَا أُمِّنَ وَلَمْ يَفِ فَقَدْ غَدَرَ وَأَخْفَرَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sulaymān b. Bilāl \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Abū Usayd from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1467

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ دَفْعِ الْأَخْبَثَيْنِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of pushing away the two impurities during prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ who said, "When the prayer approaches and a man wishes to relieve himself, he should begin with relieving himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ who said, "When the prayer approaches and a man wishes to relieve himself, he should begin with relieving himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَأَرَادَ الرَّجُلُ الْخَلَاءَ فَليبْدَأْ بِالْخَلَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kunānh \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Arqam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كُنَانةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَرْقَمِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1468

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ عَنِ الِاخْتِصَارِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of abbreviation in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic phrase is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited a man from praying quickly."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic phrase is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited a man from praying quickly."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الرَّجُلُ مُخْتَصِرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Khālid \u003e Hishām \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1469

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ النَّوْمِ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ وَالْحَدِيثِ بَعْدَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of sleeping before dinner and talking after it

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ disliked to sleep before the ʿIsha' prayer and to talk after it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ disliked to sleep before the ʿIsha' prayer and to talk after it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «يَكْرَهُ النَّوْمَ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ وَالْحَدِيثَ بَعْدَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥafṣ b. ʿUmar al-Ḥawḍī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sayyār Abū al-Minhāl al-Riyāḥī \u003e Abū Barzah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَيَّارٍ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ الرِّيَاحِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1470

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ عَنْ دُخُولِ الْمُشْرِكِ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of an idolater entering the sacred mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: "I came with Ali bin Abi Talib when the Messenger of Allah sent him to the people of Makkah with news of the dissolution of treaty obligations." He said: "How did you announced that no one would enter Paradise but a believing soul, no one was to circumambulate the House naked: whoever had a treaty with the Messenger of Allah, then for its period, or, it extended to four months, and when four months had passed, and that Allah is free from (all) obligations to the idolaters and so is His Messenger. No idolater was to perform Hajj after this year. I kept on announcing it until my vice grew hoarse."     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "I came with Ali bin Abi Talib when the Messenger of Allah sent him to the people of Makkah with news of the dissolution of treaty obligations." He said: "How did you announced that no one would enter Paradise but a believing soul, no one was to circumambulate the House naked: whoever had a treaty with the Messenger of Allah, then for its period, or, it extended to four months, and when four months had passed, and that Allah is free from (all) obligations to the idolaters and so is His Messenger. No idolater was to perform Hajj after this year. I kept on announcing it until my vice grew hoarse."     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ مَعَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ لَمَّا بَعَثَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَنَادَى بِأَرْبَعٍ حَتَّى صَحَلَ صَوْتُهُ «أَلَا إِنَّهُ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا نَفْسٌ مُؤْمِنَةٌ وَلَا يَحُجَّنَّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ وَلَا يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ وَمَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَهْدٌ فَإِنَّ أَجَلَهُ إِلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ فَإِذَا مَضَتِ الْأَرْبَعَةُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. Thābit al-Bazzār \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e al-Muḥarrar b. Abū Hurayrah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْبَزَّارُ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنِ الْمُحَرَّرِ بْنِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1471

chapter.englishTitle: When is the boy commanded to pray?

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah (S) said: "Teach the boy Salat when he is seven years old, and beat him (if he does not pray) when he is ten."     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah (S) said: "Teach the boy Salat when he is seven years old, and beat him (if he does not pray) when he is ten."     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلِّمُوا الصَّبِيَّ الصَّلَاةَ ابْنَ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ وَاضْرِبُوهُ عَلَيْهَا ابْنَ عَشْرٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr al-Ḥumaydī \u003e Ḥarmalah b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. al-Rabīʿ b. Sabrah b. Maʿbad al-Juhanī \u003e ʿAmmī ʿAbd al-Malik b. al-Rabīʿ b. Sabrah from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ الْجُهَنِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1472

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أيِّ سَاعَةٍ تُكْرَهُ فِيهَا الصَّلَاةُ
chapter.englishTitle: What time is prayer hated?

hadiths.englishRaw: There were three times at which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid us to pray or bury our dead - when the sun begins to rise till it is fully up, when the sun is at its height midway till it passes the meridian, and when the sun draws near to setting till it sets, or as he said.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: There were three times at which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid us to pray or bury our dead - when the sun begins to rise till it is fully up, when the sun is at its height midway till it passes the meridian, and when the sun draws near to setting till it sets, or as he said.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ثَلَاثُ سَاعَاتٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَانَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ فِيهِنَّ أَوْ أَنْ نَقْبُرَ فِيهِنَّ مَوْتَانَا حِينَ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ بَازِغَةً حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ وَحِينَ يَقُومُ قَائِمُ الظَّهِيرَةِ حَتَّى تَمِيلَ الشَّمْسُ وَحِينَ تَضَيَّفُ الشَّمْسُ لِلْغُرُوبِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Mūsá b. ʿAlī from my father \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1473

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أيِّ سَاعَةٍ تُكْرَهُ فِيهَا الصَّلَاةُ
chapter.englishTitle: What time is prayer hated?

hadiths.englishRaw: Some reliable people testified before me, and among them was Umar ibn al-Khattab, and most reliable in my eyes was Umar: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: There is no prayer after the dawn prayer until the sun rises; and there is no prayer after the 'Asr prayer until the sun sets.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Some reliable people testified before me, and among them was Umar ibn al-Khattab, and most reliable in my eyes was Umar: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: There is no prayer after the dawn prayer until the sun rises; and there is no prayer after the 'Asr prayer until the sun sets.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ وَلَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū al-ʿĀliyah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Rijāl Marḍiyyūn Fīhim ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb And ʾArḍāhum ʿIndī ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي رِجَالٌ مَرْضِيُّونَ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَأَرْضَاهُمْ عِنْدِي عُمَرُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1474

chapter.englishTitle: In the two units after Asr

hadiths.englishRaw: "She testified concerning the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he never missed performing these two units of prayer except after Asr (afternoon prayer)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "She testified concerning the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that he never missed performing these two units of prayer except after Asr (afternoon prayer)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا شَهِدَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ «لَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهَا يَوْمًا إِلَّا صَلَّى هَاتَيْنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ تَعْنِي بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Aswad b. Yazīd And Masrūq Yashhadān \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْأَسْوَدَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ وَمَسْرُوقًا يَشْهَدَانِ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1475

chapter.englishTitle: In the two units after Asr

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never left the two Rak'ahs (units of prayer) after Asr (the afternoon prayer) ever."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never left the two Rak'ahs (units of prayer) after Asr (the afternoon prayer) ever."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا تَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ قَطُّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Farwah b. Abū al-Maghrāʾ \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1476

chapter.englishTitle: In the two units after Asr

hadiths.englishRaw: I along with 'Umar b. al-Khattab dissuaded people to do so (to observe two rak'ahs of prayer). Kuraib said: I went to her ('A'isha) and conveyed to her the message with which I was sent. She said: (Better) ask Umm Salama. So I went to them (those who had sent him to Hadrat 'A'isha) and informed them about what she had said. They sent me back to Umm Salama with that with which I was sent to 'A'isha. Umm Salama said: I beard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibiting them, and then afterwards I saw him observing them. And when he observed them (two rak'ahs) he had already observed the 'Asr prayer. Then he (the Holy Prophet) came, while there were with me ladies of Banu Haram, a tribe of the Ansar and he (the Holy Prophet) observed them (the two rak'ahs). I sent a slave-girl to him asking her to stand by his side and say to him that Umm Salama says: Messenger of Allah, I heard you prohibiting these two rak'ahs, whereas I saw you observing them; and if he (the Holy Prophet) points with his hand (to wait), then do wait. The slave-girl did like that. He (the Holy Prophet) pointed out with his hand and she got aside and waited, and when he had finished (the prayer) he said: Daughter of Abu Umayya. you have asked about the two rak'ahs after the 'Asr prayer. Some people of 'Abu al-Qais came to me for embracing Islam and hindered me from observing the two rak'ahs which come after the noon prayer. So those are the two I have been praying.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I along with 'Umar b. al-Khattab dissuaded people to do so (to observe two rak'ahs of prayer). Kuraib said: I went to her ('A'isha) and conveyed to her the message with which I was sent. She said: (Better) ask Umm Salama. So I went to them (those who had sent him to Hadrat 'A'isha) and informed them about what she had said. They sent me back to Umm Salama with that with which I was sent to 'A'isha. Umm Salama said: I beard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibiting them, and then afterwards I saw him observing them. And when he observed them (two rak'ahs) he had already observed the 'Asr prayer. Then he (the Holy Prophet) came, while there were with me ladies of Banu Haram, a tribe of the Ansar and he (the Holy Prophet) observed them (the two rak'ahs). I sent a slave-girl to him asking her to stand by his side and say to him that Umm Salama says: Messenger of Allah, I heard you prohibiting these two rak'ahs, whereas I saw you observing them; and if he (the Holy Prophet) points with his hand (to wait), then do wait. The slave-girl did like that. He (the Holy Prophet) pointed out with his hand and she got aside and waited, and when he had finished (the prayer) he said: Daughter of Abu Umayya. you have asked about the two rak'ahs after the 'Asr prayer. Some people of 'Abu al-Qais came to me for embracing Islam and hindered me from observing the two rak'ahs which come after the noon prayer. So those are the two I have been praying.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَزْهَرَ وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ أَرْسَلُوهُ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالُوا اقْرَأْ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامَ مِنَّا جَمِيعًا وَسَلْهَا عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ وَقُلْ إِنَّا أُخْبِرْنَا أَنَّكِ تُصَلِّينَهُمَا وَقَدْ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْهُمَا قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَكُنْتُ أَضْرِبُ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهِمَا قَالَ كُرَيْبٌ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهَا وَبَلَّغْتُهَا مَا أَرْسَلُونِي بِهِ فَقَالَتْ سَلْ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ فَخَرَجْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمْ بِقَوْلِهَا فَرَدُّونِي إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ بِمِثْلِ مَا أَرْسَلُونِي إِلَى عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَى عَنْهُمَا ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُهُ يُصَلِّيهِمَا أَمَّا حِينَ صَلَّاهُمَا فَإِنَّهُ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ وَعِنْدِي نِسْوَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي حَرَامٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فَصَلَّاهُمَا فَأَرْسَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ الْجَارِيَةَ فَقُلْتُ قُومِي بِجَنْبِهِ فَقُولِي أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ تَقُولُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَمْ أَسْمَعْكَ تَنْهَى عَنْ هَاتَيْنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ وَأَرَاكَ تُصَلِّيهِمَا؟ فَإِنْ أَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ فَاسْتَأْخِرِي عَنْهُ قَالَتْ فَفَعَلَتِ الْجَارِيَةُ فَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ فَاسْتَأْخَرَتْ عَنْهُ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ قَالَ «يَا ابْنَةَ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ سَأَلْتِ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ؟ إِنَّهُ أَتَانِي نَاسٌ مِنْ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ بِالْإِسْلَامِ مِنْ قَوْمِهِمْ فَشَغَلُونِي عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ فَهُمَا هَاتَانِ» سُئلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ فَقَالَ أَنَا أَقُولُ بِحَدِيثِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبيِّ ﷺ «لَا صَلَاةَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ وَلَا بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Wahb \u003e ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Bukayr b. al-Ashaj \u003e Kurayb a freed slave of Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1477

chapter.englishTitle: In the Sunnah prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would pray two rak'ahs before and two after the noon prayer, two after the sunset prayer in his house, and two after the night prayer. He would not pray after the Friday prayer till he departed. He would then pray two rak'ahs.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would pray two rak'ahs before and two after the noon prayer, two after the sunset prayer in his house, and two after the night prayer. He would not pray after the Friday prayer till he departed. He would then pray two rak'ahs.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَبَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَبَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَبَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَبَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1478

chapter.englishTitle: In the Sunnah prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: From Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , she narrated that she heard the Prophet ﷺ say, "There is no Muslim servant who prays twelve voluntary Rak'ahs every day, other than the obligatory prayers, except that Allah will build a house for him in Paradise or a palace in Paradise." Umm Habibah said, "I have never ceased praying them after I heard this." 'Amr ibn Salamah said the same, and Nu'man said the same.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , she narrated that she heard the Prophet ﷺ say, "There is no Muslim servant who prays twelve voluntary Rak'ahs every day, other than the obligatory prayers, except that Allah will build a house for him in Paradise or a palace in Paradise." Umm Habibah said, "I have never ceased praying them after I heard this." 'Amr ibn Salamah said the same, and Nu'man said the same.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ يُصَلِّي كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ثِنْتَيْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً تَطَوُّعًا غَيْرَ الْفَرِيضَةِ إِلَّا لَهُ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَوْ بُنِيَ لَهُ بَيْتٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ » قَالَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ فمَا بَرِحْتُ أُصَلِّيهِنَّ بَعْدُ وَقَالَ عَمْرٌو مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ النُّعْمَانُ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Sālim
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1479

chapter.englishTitle: In the Sunnah prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to not leave four (supererogatory units) before noon and two units before dawn.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to not leave four (supererogatory units) before noon and two units before dawn.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَدَعُ أَرْبَعًا قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ وَرَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad b. al-Muntashir from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1480

chapter.englishTitle: The Two Units of Prayer Before Maghrib.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Between each two Adhans [1] there is a prayer, between each two Adhans there is a prayer, between each two Adhans there is a prayer, for whoever wants to do it." [1]Meaning, between the Adhan and Iqamah.    – Sound
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Between each two Adhans [1] there is a prayer, between each two Adhans there is a prayer, between each two Adhans there is a prayer, for whoever wants to do it." [1]Meaning, between the Adhan and Iqamah.    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ صَلَاةٌ بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ صَلَاةٌ بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ صَلَاةٌ لِمَنْ شَاءَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Buraydah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1481

chapter.englishTitle: The Two Units of Prayer Before Maghrib.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The muezzin used to call the prayer for Maghrib during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would gather at the door. They would line up until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would come out, and they would be in that state." He said, and he did not stay for long.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The muezzin used to call the prayer for Maghrib during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would gather at the door. They would line up until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would come out, and they would be in that state." He said, and he did not stay for long.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ «الْمُؤَذِّنُ يُؤَذِّنُ لِصَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَيَقُومُ لُبَابُ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَيَبْتَدِرُونَ السَّوَارِيَ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُمْ كَذَلِكَ» قَالَ وَقَلَّ مَا كَانَ يَلْبَثُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. ʿĀmir \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1482

chapter.englishTitle: Reading in the two units of Fajr.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to hide what he would recite in them, and he mentioned, "Say, O disbelievers" [Surah Al-Kafirun 1] and "Say, He is Allah, [who is] One" [Surah Al-Ikhlas 1]. Sa'id said in the two units of Fajr prayer.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to hide what he would recite in them, and he mentioned, "Say, O disbelievers" [Surah Al-Kafirun 1] and "Say, He is Allah, [who is] One" [Surah Al-Ikhlas 1]. Sa'id said in the two units of Fajr prayer.   – Sound Chain
