hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُخْفِي مَا يَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا وَذَكَرَتْ {قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ} [الكافرون 1] وَ {قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ} [الإخلاص 1] قَالَ سَعِيدٌ فِي رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1483

chapter.englishTitle: Reading in the two units of Fajr.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray two quick prostrations after the break of dawn, which was a time when he would not enter upon the Prophet ﷺ.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray two quick prostrations after the break of dawn, which was a time when he would not enter upon the Prophet ﷺ.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ «يُصَلِّي سَجْدَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ بَعْدَمَا يَطْلُعُ الْفَجْرُ وَكَانَتْ سَاعَةً لَا أَدْخُلُ فِيهَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Ḥafṣah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1484

chapter.englishTitle: Reading in the two units of Fajr.

hadiths.englishRaw: that when the Muaddhin fell silent following the call to Subh prayer and dawn had broken, he would pray two brief rak'ahs before getting up to pray.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: that when the Muaddhin fell silent following the call to Subh prayer and dawn had broken, he would pray two brief rak'ahs before getting up to pray.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ حَفْصَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا سَكَتَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنْ أَذَانِ الصُّبْحِ وَبَدَا الصُّبْحُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُقَامَ الصَّلَاةُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1485

chapter.englishTitle: Reading in the two units of Fajr.

hadiths.englishRaw: Salim narrated on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to observe two rak'ahs after Jumu'a.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Salim narrated on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to observe two rak'ahs after Jumu'a.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «كَانَ يُصَلِّي بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ» وأخْبرتْهُ حفْصةُ أنَّهُ كانَ «يُصلِّي إِذَا أَضَاءَ الصُّبْحُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1486

chapter.englishTitle: The conversation after the two units of dawn prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "When Messenger of Allah (S) prayed the two Rak'ah (before) Fajr if he needed something from me he would talk to me, if not, he would go to Salat."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When Messenger of Allah (S) prayed the two Rak'ah (before) Fajr if he needed something from me he would talk to me, if not, he would go to Salat."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا صَلَّى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ كَلَّمَنِي بِهَا وَإِلَّا خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Sālim Abū al-Naḍr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَبِي النَّضْرِ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1487

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الِاضْطِجَاعِ بَعْدَ رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: In reclining after the two units of dawn prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray from the evening (Isha) prayer until the dawn (Fajr) prayer eleven voluntary units (raka'at), and he would conclude every two units with the Tasleem (saying Assalamu Alaikum). He would perform the Witr prayer with one unit. When the Mu'athin finished the Adhan, he would perform two light units (raka'at), then lie down until the Mu'athin comes to him and he would go out with him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray from the evening (Isha) prayer until the dawn (Fajr) prayer eleven voluntary units (raka'at), and he would conclude every two units with the Tasleem (saying Assalamu Alaikum). He would perform the Witr prayer with one unit. When the Mu'athin finished the Adhan, he would perform two light units (raka'at), then lie down until the Mu'athin comes to him and he would go out with him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «يُصَلِّي مَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً يُسَلِّمُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يُوتِرُ بِوَاحِدَةٍ فَإِذَا سَكَتَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنَ الْأَذَانِ رَكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَيَخْرُجُ مَعَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1488

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا الْمَكْتُوبَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: If the prayer is established, then there is no prayer except the...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺas saying: When the iqamah is pronounced for prayer, no prayer is valid except the obligatory prayer.
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺas saying: When the iqamah is pronounced for prayer, no prayer is valid except the obligatory prayer.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا الْمَكْتُوبَةُ»
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Zakariyyā b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1489

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا الْمَكْتُوبَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: If the prayer is established, then there is no prayer except the...

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ghundar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e And Rqāʾ \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أخْبرنا أَبُو حَفْصٍ عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْفَلَّاسُ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ وَرْقَاءَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1490

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا الْمَكْتُوبَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: If the prayer is established, then there is no prayer except the...

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation is: The prayer was established, and the Prophet ﷺ saw a man praying two units of prayer. When the Prophet ﷺ finished his prayer, the people approached him and said: "Do you pray four units for the Fajr prayer?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation is: The prayer was established, and the Prophet ﷺ saw a man praying two units of prayer. When the Prophet ﷺ finished his prayer, the people approached him and said: "Do you pray four units for the Fajr prayer?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَرَأَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ رَجُلًا يُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فَلَمَّا قَضَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ صَلَاتَهُ لَاثَ بِهِ النَّاسُ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «أَتُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ أَرْبَعًا؟»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Ḥafṣ b. ʿĀṣim b. ʿUmar \u003e Ibn Buḥaynah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1491

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ، فَلَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا الْمَكْتُوبَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: If the prayer is established, then there is no prayer except the...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "When the prayer is established, there is no prayer except the obligatory prayer." Abu Muhammad said, "If he is in his house, then the house is easier."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "When the prayer is established, there is no prayer except the obligatory prayer." Abu Muhammad said, "If he is in his house, then the house is easier."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلَا صَلَاةَ إِلَّا الْمَكْتُوبَةُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ إِذَا كَانَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَالْبَيْتُ أَهْوَنُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1492

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي أَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ فِي أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: In four units of prayer in the early morning

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet, peace be upon him, Allah the Most High said: "O son of Adam, pray four units of prayer for Me at the beginning of the day, and I will take care of your last."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet, peace be upon him, Allah the Most High said: "O son of Adam, pray four units of prayer for Me at the beginning of the day, and I will take care of your last."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ابْنَ آدَمَ صَلِّ لِي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ أَكْفِكَ آخِرَهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Muʿtamir b. Sulaymān \u003e Burd \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e Makḥūl \u003e Kathīr b. Murrah al-Ḥaḍramī \u003e Qays al-Judhāmī \u003e Nuʿaym b. Hammār al-Ghaṭafānī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ بُرْدٍ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ قَيْسٍ الْجُذَامِيِّ عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ هَمَّارٍ الْغَطَفَانِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1493

chapter.englishTitle: Salat ad-Duha

hadiths.englishRaw: None informed us that he saw the Prophet ﷺ offering the Duha (i.e. forenoon) prayer, except Um Hani who mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ took a bath in her house on the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) and then offered an eight rakʿat prayer. She added, "I never saw the Prophet ﷺ offering a lighter prayer than that prayer, but he was performing perfect bowing and prostrations."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: None informed us that he saw the Prophet ﷺ offering the Duha (i.e. forenoon) prayer, except Um Hani who mentioned that the Prophet ﷺ took a bath in her house on the day of the Conquest (of Mecca) and then offered an eight rakʿat prayer. She added, "I never saw the Prophet ﷺ offering a lighter prayer than that prayer, but he was performing perfect bowing and prostrations."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ رَأَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى غَيْرُ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ فَإِنَّهَا ذَكَرَتْ أَنَّهُ «يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ اغْتَسَلَ فِي بَيْتِهَا ثُمَّ صَلَّى ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ» قَالَتْ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ صَلَّى صَلَاةً أَخَفَّ مِنْهَا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يُتِمُّ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e Mā \u003e Aḥad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ أَنْبَأَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى يَقُولُ مَا أَخْبَرَنَا أَحَدٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1494

chapter.englishTitle: Salat ad-Duha

hadiths.englishRaw: He informed him that he heard Umm Haneen, the daughter of Abu Talib, saying that she went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the year of the conquest and found him performing ablution, and his daughter Fatimah covered him with a garment. Umm Haneen said, "I greeted him and it was in the morning." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Who is this?" I said, "I am Umm Haneen." When he finished his ablution, he stood up and prayed eight rak'ahs, wrapped in one garment, then he departed. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, my son claims that he killed a man who you had hired, Fulan bin Hubayrah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "We have indeed rewarded those whom you have rewarded, O Umm Haneen."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He informed him that he heard Umm Haneen, the daughter of Abu Talib, saying that she went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the year of the conquest and found him performing ablution, and his daughter Fatimah covered him with a garment. Umm Haneen said, "I greeted him and it was in the morning." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Who is this?" I said, "I am Umm Haneen." When he finished his ablution, he stood up and prayed eight rak'ahs, wrapped in one garment, then he departed. I said, "O Messenger of Allah, my son claims that he killed a man who you had hired, Fulan bin Hubayrah." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "We have indeed rewarded those whom you have rewarded, O Umm Haneen."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهَا ذَهَبَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ فَوَجَدَتْهُ يَغْتَسِلُ وَفَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُهُ تَسْتُرُهُ بِثَوْبٍ قَالَتْ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَذَلِكَ ضُحًى قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ هَذِهِ؟» فَقُلْتُ أَنَا أُمُّ هَانِئٍ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ غُسْلِهِ قَامَ فَصَلَّى ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ مُلْتَحِفًا فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ زَعَمَ ابْنُ أُمِّي أَنَّهُ قَاتِلٌ رَجُلًا أَجَرْتُهُ فُلَانَ بْنَ هُبَيْرَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «قَدْ أَجَرْنَا مَنْ أَجَرْتِ يَا أُمَّ هَانِئٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Naḍr \u003e Abū Murrah a freed slave of ʿAqīl b. Abū Ṭālib \u003e Um Hāniʾ b. Abū Ṭālib Tuḥaddith
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ أَنَّ أَبَا مُرَّةَ مَوْلَى عَقِيلِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1495

chapter.englishTitle: Salat ad-Duha

hadiths.englishRaw: My friend advised me of three things that I will not abandon until I die: praying the Witr prayer before I sleep, fasting three days every month, and performing two units of prayer before the Dhuha prayer.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: My friend advised me of three things that I will not abandon until I die: praying the Witr prayer before I sleep, fasting three days every month, and performing two units of prayer before the Dhuha prayer.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي بِثَلَاثٍ لَا أَدَعُهُنَّ حَتَّى أَمُوتَ الْوِتْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنَامَ وَصَوْمِ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَمِنَ الضُّحَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbbās al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū ʿUthmān \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1496

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي الْكَرَاهِيَةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the dislikeness of it

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not observe the Duha prayer during travel or at home."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not observe the Duha prayer during travel or at home."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ سُبْحَةَ الضُّحَى فِي سَفَرٍ وَلَا حَضَرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1497

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي الْكَرَاهِيَةِ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is mentioned in the dislikeness of it

hadiths.englishRaw: His father saw people praying the Duha prayer, so he said, "Indeed, they are praying a prayer that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray, and not many of his companions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: His father saw people praying the Duha prayer, so he said, "Indeed, they are praying a prayer that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray, and not many of his companions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَاهُ رَأَى نَاسًا يُصَلُّونَ صَلَاةَ الضُّحَى فَقَالَ «أَمَا إِنَّهُمْ لَيُصَلُّونَ صَلَاةً مَا صَلَّاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلَا عَامَّةُ أَصْحَابِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ṣadaqah b. al-Faḍl \u003e Muʿādh b. Muʿādh \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Fuḍayl b. Faḍālah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Bakrah \u003e Abāh Raʾá Nās Yuṣallūn Ṣalāh al-Ḍuḥá
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1498

chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of the returners

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to them while they were praying after the sunrise. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The prayer of the people of habit is when the camels are driven to the watering place."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out to them while they were praying after the sunrise. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The prayer of the people of habit is when the camels are driven to the watering place."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ يُصَلُّونَ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «صَلَاةُ الْأَوَّابِينَ إِذَا رَمِضَتْ الْفِصَالُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī \u003e al-Qāsim b. ʿAwf \u003e Zayd b. Arqam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1499

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the heading "صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ م...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The prayer of the night and the day is in pairs, in pairs." And one of them said, "Two units of prayer, two units of prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The prayer of the night and the day is in pairs, in pairs." And one of them said, "Two units of prayer, two units of prayer."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى» وَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا «رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Wakīʿ Waghundar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e ʿAlī al-Azdī \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ وَغُنْدَرٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ الْأَزْدِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1500

chapter.englishTitle: In the Night Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the prayer at night. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Prayer during the night should consist of pairs of rak'ahs, but if one of you fears the morning is near he should pray one rak'ah which will make his prayer an odd number for him.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the prayer at night. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Prayer during the night should consist of pairs of rak'ahs, but if one of you fears the morning is near he should pray one rak'ah which will make his prayer an odd number for him.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ صَلَاةِ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ «مَثْنَى مَثْنَى فَإِذَا خَشِيَ أَحَدُكُمُ الصُّبْحَ فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَةً وَاحِدَةً تُوتِرُ مَا قَدْ صَلَّى»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1501

chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of night prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, arrived in Medina, people gathered and said, "The Messenger of Allah has arrived, the Messenger of Allah has arrived." He said, "So I went out with those who went out, and when I saw his face, I recognized that his face was not the face of a liar. The first thing I heard him say was, 'O people, spread peace, feed the hungry, maintain family ties, and pray while people are asleep so that you may enter Paradise in peace.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, arrived in Medina, people gathered and said, "The Messenger of Allah has arrived, the Messenger of Allah has arrived." He said, "So I went out with those who went out, and when I saw his face, I recognized that his face was not the face of a liar. The first thing I heard him say was, 'O people, spread peace, feed the hungry, maintain family ties, and pray while people are asleep so that you may enter Paradise in peace.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ اسْتَشْرَفَهُ النَّاسُ فَقَالُوا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قال فَخَرَجْتُ فِيمَنْ خَرَجَ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ وَجْهَهُ عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ وَجْهَهُ لَيْسَ بِوَجْهِ كَذَّابٍ وَكَانَ أَوَّلُ مَا سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ وَصِلُوا الْأَرْحَامَ وَصَلُّوا وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلَامٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAwf \u003e Zurārah b. Awfá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Salām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1502

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ مَنْ سَجَدَ لِلَّهِ سَجْدَةً
chapter.englishTitle: The merit of those who prostrate to Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: I entered the mosque of Damascus and saw a man who was frequently performing bowing and prostration. I said to myself, "I will not leave until I see whether he moves to the next two cycles of prayer or continues with another one." When he finished, I said, "O Abdullah, did you move to the next two cycles of prayer or continue with another one?" He replied, "Truly, I do not know. But indeed, Allah knows." Then he said, "I have heard my beloved friend, Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ , say, 'Whenever a servant prostrates to Allah, Allah elevates him by a degree and removes a sin from him.'" I asked, "Who are you, may Allah have mercy on you?" He said, "I am Abu Dhar." At that moment, I lost consciousness.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I entered the mosque of Damascus and saw a man who was frequently performing bowing and prostration. I said to myself, "I will not leave until I see whether he moves to the next two cycles of prayer or continues with another one." When he finished, I said, "O Abdullah, did you move to the next two cycles of prayer or continue with another one?" He replied, "Truly, I do not know. But indeed, Allah knows." Then he said, "I have heard my beloved friend, Abu Al-Qasim ﷺ , say, 'Whenever a servant prostrates to Allah, Allah elevates him by a degree and removes a sin from him.'" I asked, "Who are you, may Allah have mercy on you?" He said, "I am Abu Dhar." At that moment, I lost consciousness.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلْتُ مَسْجِدَ دِمَشْقَ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ يُكْثِرُ الرُّكُوعَ وَالسُّجُودَ قُلْتُ لَا أَخْرُجُ حَتَّى أَنْظُرَ أَيَدْرِي هَذَا عَلَى شَفْعٍ يَنْصَرِفُ أَمْ عَلَى وِتْرٍ؟ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قُلْتُ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ أَعَلَى شَفْعٍ تَدْرِي انْصَرَفْتَ أَمْ عَلَى وِتْرٍ؟ فَقَالَ إِنْ أَكُ لَا أَدْرِي فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَدْرِي ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ خَلِيلِي أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَسْجُدُ لِلَّهِ سَجْدَةً إِلَّا رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً وَحَطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةً» قُلْتُ مَنْ أَنْتَ رَحِمَكَ اللَّهُ؟ قَالَ أَنَا أَبُو ذَرٍّ قَالَ فَتَقَاصَرَتْ إِلَيَّ نَفْسِي   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Hārūn b. Riʾāb \u003e al-Aḥnaf b. Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنِ الْأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1503

chapter.englishTitle: In Sujood of Gratitude

hadiths.englishRaw: And he said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray two units of Duha prayer when he was given glad tidings of victory or upon the death of Abu Jahl's father."
hadiths.body: And he said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray two units of Duha prayer when he was given glad tidings of victory or upon the death of Abu Jahl's father."
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ «صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الضُّحَى رَكْعَتَيْنِ حِينَ بُشِّرَ بِالْفَتْحِ أَوْ بِرَأْسِ أَبِي جَهْلٍ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Salamah b. Rajāʾ \u003e Shaʿthāʾ \u003e Raʾayt Ibn Abū Awfá Ṣallá Rakʿatayn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ حَدَّثَتْنَا شَعْثَاءُ قَالَتْ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1504

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of prostrating to anyone

hadiths.englishRaw: "I came to Hira and saw them prostrating to their idols, so I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, should we not prostrate to you?' He replied, 'If I were to command someone to prostrate to someone else, I would have commanded women to prostrate to their husbands, due to the right Allah has given them over them.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I came to Hira and saw them prostrating to their idols, so I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, should we not prostrate to you?' He replied, 'If I were to command someone to prostrate to someone else, I would have commanded women to prostrate to their husbands, due to the right Allah has given them over them.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ الْحِيرَةَ فَرَأَيْتُهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ لِمَرْزُبَانَ لَهُمْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَا نَسْجُدُ لَكَ؟ قَالَ «لَوْ أَمَرْتُ أَحَدًا أَنْ يَسْجُدَ لِأَحَدٍ لَأَمَرْتُ النِّسَاءَ أَنْ يَسْجُدْنَ لِأَزْوَاجِهِنَّ لِمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ حَقِّهِمْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Isḥāq al-Azraq \u003e Sharīk \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Qays b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ الْأَزْرَقُ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1505

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of prostrating to anyone

hadiths.englishRaw: An Arab man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, give me permission to prostrate to you." The Prophet ﷺ said, "If I were to command anyone to prostrate to another, I would have commanded the wife to prostrate to her husband."   – Sound
hadiths.body: An Arab man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, give me permission to prostrate to you." The Prophet ﷺ said, "If I were to command anyone to prostrate to another, I would have commanded the wife to prostrate to her husband."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ائْذَنْ لِي فَلِأَسْجُدَ لَكَ قَالَ «لَوْ كُنْتُ آمِرًا أَحَدًا أَنْ يَسْجُدَ لِأَحَدٍ لَأَمَرْتُ الْمَرْأَةَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِزَوْجِهَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Ḥizāmī \u003e Ḥibbān b. ʿAlī \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Ḥayyān \u003e Ibn Buraydah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ عَنْ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1506

chapter.englishTitle: Prostration in the Star

hadiths.englishRaw: Translation: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited Surah An-Najm and then prostrated in it. No one remained except for a sheikh who took a handful of gravel and raised it to his forehead, saying, 'This is enough for me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Translation: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited Surah An-Najm and then prostrated in it. No one remained except for a sheikh who took a handful of gravel and raised it to his forehead, saying, 'This is enough for me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَرَأَ النَّجْمَ فَسَجَدَ فِيهَا فَلَمْ يَبْقَ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا سَجَدَ إِلَّا شَيْخٌ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ حَصًى فَرَفَعَهُ إِلَى جَبْهَتِهِ وَقَالَ يَكْفِينِي هَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1507

chapter.englishTitle: Prostration in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us one day and recited [a verse from the Quran]. When he came to the prostration, he descended and prostrated and we prostrated with him. He recited it (the verse) again and when he reached the prostration, we hastened to prostrate. When he saw us, he said, 'It is the repentance of a Prophet, but I see that you have prepared yourselves for prostration.' So he descended and prostrated and we prostrated with him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us one day and recited [a verse from the Quran]. When he came to the prostration, he descended and prostrated and we prostrated with him. He recited it (the verse) again and when he reached the prostration, we hastened to prostrate. When he saw us, he said, 'It is the repentance of a Prophet, but I see that you have prepared yourselves for prostration.' So he descended and prostrated and we prostrated with him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمًا فَقَرَأَ ص فَلَمَّا مَرَّ بِالسَّجْدَةِ نَزَلَ فَسَجَدَ وَسَجَدْنَا مَعَهُ وَقَرَأَهَا مَرَّةً أُخْرَى فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ السَّجْدَةَ تَيَسَّرْنَا لِلسُّجُودِ فَلَمَّا رَآنَا قَالَ «إِنَّمَا هِيَ تَوْبَةُ نَبِيٍّ وَلَكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَدِ اسْتَعْدَدْتُمْ لِلسُّجُودِ» فَنَزَلَ فَسَجَدَ وَسَجَدْنَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Khālid / Ibn Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd / Ibn Abū Hilāl \u003e ʿIyāḍ b. ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿd \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ يَزِيدَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي هِلَالٍ عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1508

chapter.englishTitle: Prostration in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: A prostration when reciting Sad is not one of those which are divinely commanded, but I have seen Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrate himself.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A prostration when reciting Sad is not one of those which are divinely commanded, but I have seen Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrate himself.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي السُّجُودِ فِي ص «لَيْسَتْ مِنْ عَزَائِمِ السُّجُودِ وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَجَدَ فِيهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. Zurārah \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ هُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1509

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ السُّجُودِ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
chapter.englishTitle: Prostration in response to the Splitting of the Sky

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw Abu Huraira prostrating when the sky split, and he was asked, "You prostrate in a chapter (surah) where prostration is not done?" He replied, "Indeed, I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrating in it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I saw Abu Huraira prostrating when the sky split, and he was asked, "You prostrate in a chapter (surah) where prostration is not done?" He replied, "Indeed, I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrating in it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَسْجُدُ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ فَقِيلَ لَهُ تَسْجُدُ فِي سُورَةٍ مَا يُسْجَدُ فِيهَا؟ فَقَالَ «إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْجُدُ فِيهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1510

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ السُّجُودِ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
chapter.englishTitle: Prostration in response to the Splitting of the Sky

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw Abu Hurairah prostrating when the sky split open, so I said, "O Abu Hurairah, I see you prostrating when the sky splits open." He replied, "If I had not seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrating in it, I would not have prostrated."
hadiths.body: I saw Abu Hurairah prostrating when the sky split open, so I said, "O Abu Hurairah, I see you prostrating when the sky splits open." He replied, "If I had not seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prostrating in it, I would not have prostrated."
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَسْجُدُ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَرَاكَ تَسْجُدُ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ فَقَالَ «لَوْ لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَجَدَ فِيهَا لَمْ أَسْجُدْ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1511

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ السُّجُودِ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
chapter.englishTitle: Prostration in response to the Splitting of the Sky

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the Arabic statement "أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سَجَدَ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ" into English is: "That the Prophet ﷺ prostrated when the heavens split."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the Arabic statement "أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سَجَدَ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ" into English is: "That the Prophet ﷺ prostrated when the heavens split."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سَجَدَ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Ḥārith b. Hishām \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1512

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ السُّجُودِ فِي اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ
chapter.englishTitle: Prostrate in Read the Name of your Lord

hadiths.englishRaw: We prostrated ourselves along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on account of: "When the sky is rent asunder" and "Recite in the name of Your Lord Who created"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We prostrated ourselves along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on account of: "When the sky is rent asunder" and "Recite in the name of Your Lord Who created"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «سَجَدْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ وَاقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ayyūb b. Mūsá \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Mīnāʾ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ مِينَاءَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1513

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَسْمَعُ السَّجْدَةَ فَلَا يَسْجُدُ
chapter.englishTitle: One who hears the prostration but does not prostrate.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I recited to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (Surat) An-Najm and he did not prostrate in it."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I recited to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ (Surat) An-Najm and he did not prostrate in it."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَرَأْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَالنَّجْمِ فَلَمْ يَسْجُدْ فِيهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh b. Qusayṭ \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1514

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صِفَةِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Characteristics of the Prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: Between the time when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished the night prayer till the dawn broke, he used to pray eleven rak'ahs, uttering the salutation at the end of every two and observing the witr with a single one, and during that he would make a prostration about as long a one of you would take to recite fifty verses before raising his head. When the mu'adhdhin finished making the call for the dawn prayer, he stood up and prayed two short rak'ahs, then he lay down on his right side till the mu'adhdhin came to him     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Between the time when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished the night prayer till the dawn broke, he used to pray eleven rak'ahs, uttering the salutation at the end of every two and observing the witr with a single one, and during that he would make a prostration about as long a one of you would take to recite fifty verses before raising his head. When the mu'adhdhin finished making the call for the dawn prayer, he stood up and prayed two short rak'ahs, then he lay down on his right side till the mu'adhdhin came to him     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي مَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى الْفَجْرِ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً يُسَلِّمُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَيُوتِرُ بِوَاحِدَةٍ وَيَسْجُدُ فِي سُبْحَتِهِ بِقَدْرِ مَا يَقْرَأُ أَحَدُكُمْ خَمْسِينَ آيَةً قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَإِذَا سَكَتَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ مِنَ الْأَذَانِ الْأَوَّلِ رَكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَيَخْرُجَ مَعَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1515

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صِفَةِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Characteristics of the Prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: He asked Aishah about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at night. She said: "He used to pray thirteen rak'ahs. He would pray eight rak'ahs then pray witr, then pray two rak'ahs sitting down. When he wanted to bow he would stand and bow, and he prayed two rak'ahs between the adhan and iqamah of subh prayer.
hadiths.body: He asked Aishah about the prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at night. She said: "He used to pray thirteen rak'ahs. He would pray eight rak'ahs then pray witr, then pray two rak'ahs sitting down. When he wanted to bow he would stand and bow, and he prayed two rak'ahs between the adhan and iqamah of subh prayer.
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِاللَّيْلِ فَقَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُصَلِّي ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً يُصَلِّي ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ يُوتِرُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ قَامَ فَرَكَعَ وَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَيْنَ النِّدَاءِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn And Wahb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Saʾalt ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَوَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1516

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ صِفَةِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Characteristics of the Prayer of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: I divorced my wife. I then came to Medina to sell my land that was there so that I could buy arms and fight in battle. I met a group of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ. They said: Six persons of us intended to do so (i.e. divorce their wives and purchase weapons), but the Prophet ﷺ prohibited them. He said: For you in the Messenger of Allah there is an excellent model. I then came to Ibn 'Abbas and asked him about the witr observed by the Prophet ﷺ. He said: I point to you a person who is most familiar with the witr observed by the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Go to 'Aishah. While going to her I asked Hakim b. Aflah to accompany me. He refused, but I adjured him. He, therefore, went along with me. We sought permission to enter upon 'Aishah. She said: Who is this ? He said: Hakim b. Aflah. She asked: Who is with you ? He replied: Sa'd b. Hisham. She said: Hisham son of 'Amir who was killed in the Battle of Uhud. I said: Yes. She said: What a good man 'Amir was! I said: Mother of faithful, tell me about the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She asked: Do you not recite the Quran ? The character of Messenger of Allah ﷺ was the Qur'an. I asked: Tell me about his vigil and prayer at night. She replied: Do you not recite: "O thou folded in garments" (73:1). I said: Why not ? When the opening of this Surah was revealed, the Companions stood praying (most of the night) until their fett swelled, and the concluding verses were not revealed for twelve months from heaven. At last the concluding verses were revealed and the prayer at night became voluntary after it was obligatory. I said: Tell me about the witr of the Prophet ﷺ. She replied: He used to pray eight rak'ahs, sitting only during the eighth of them. Then he would stand up and pray another rak'ahs. He would sit only after the eighth and the ninth rak'ahs. He would utter salutation only after the ninth rak'ah. He would then pray two rak'ahs sitting and that made eleven rak'ahs, O my son. But when he grew old and became fleshy he observed a witr of seven, sitting only in sixth and seventh rak'ahs, and would utter salutation only after the seventh rak'ah. He would then pray two rak'ahs sitting, and that made nine rak'ahs, O my son. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would not pray through a whole night, or recite the whole Qur'an in a night or fast a complete month except in Ramadan. When he offered prayer, he would do that regularly. When he was overtaken by sleep at night, he would pray twelve rak'ahs. The narrator said: I came to Ibn 'Abbas and narrated all this to him. By Allah, this is really a tradition. Has I been on speaking terms with her, I would have come to her and heard it from her mouth. I said: If I knew that you were not on speaking terms with her, I would have never narrated it to you.     – Sound Chain

hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَأَتَى الْمَدِينَةَ لِبَيْعِ عَقَارِهِ فَيَجْعَلَهُ فِي السِّلَاحِ وَالْكُرَاعِ فَلَقِيَ رَهْطًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فَقَالُوا أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ سِتَّةٌ مِنَّا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَمَنَعَهُمْ وَقَالَ «أَمَا لَكُمْ فِيَّ أُسْوَةٌ؟» ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ قَدِمَ الْبَصْرَةَ فَحَدَّثَنَا أَنَّهُ لَقِيَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْوِتْرِ فَقَالَ أَلَا أُحَدِّثُكَ بِأَعْلَمِ النَّاسِ بِوِتْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قُلْتُ بَلَى قَالَ أُمُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةُ فَأْتِهَا فَاسْأَلْهَا ثُمَّ ارْجِعْ إِلَيَّ فَحَدِّثْنِي بِمَا تُحَدِّثُكَ فَأَتَيْتُ حَكِيمَ بْنَ أَفْلَحَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ انْطَلِقْ مَعِي إِلَى أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةَ قَالَ إِنِّي لَا آتِيهَا إِنِّي نَهَيْتُ عَنْ هَذِهِ الشِّيعَتَيْنِ فَأَبَتْ إِلَّا مُضِيًّا قُلْتُ أَقْسَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ لَمَا انْطَلَقْتَ فَانْطَلَقْنَا فَسَلَّمْنَا فَعَرَفَتْ صَوْتَ حَكِيمٍ فَقَالَتْ «مَنْ هَذَا؟» قُلْتُ سَعْدُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ قَالَتْ «مَنْ هِشَامٌ؟» قُلْتُ هِشَامُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ قَالَتْ «نِعْمَ الْمَرْءُ قُتِلَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ» قُلْتُ أَخْبِرِينَا عَنْ خُلُقِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَتْ «أَلَسْتَ تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ؟» قُلْتُ بَلَى قَالَتْ «فَإِنَّهُ خُلُقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ» فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَقُومَ وَلَا أَسْأَلَ أَحَدًا عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى أَلْحَقَ بِاللَّهِ فَعَرَضَ لِي الْقِيَامُ فَقُلْتُ أَخْبِرِينَا عَنْ قِيَامِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَتْ أَلَسْتَ تَقْرَأُ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ؟ قُلْتُ بَلَى قَالَتْ «فَإِنَّهَا كَانَتْ قِيَامَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُنْزِلَ أَوَّلُ السُّورَةِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابُهُ حَتَّى انْتَفَخَتْ أَقْدَامُهُمْ وَحُبِسَ آخِرُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ سِتَّةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا ثُمَّ أُنْزِلَ فَصَارَ قِيَامُ اللَّيْلِ تَطَوُّعًا بَعْدَ أَنْ كَانَ فَرِيضَةً» فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَقُومَ وَلَا أَسْأَلَ أَحَدًا عَنْ شَيْءٍ حَتَّى أَلْحَقَ بِاللَّهِ فَعَرَضَ لِي الْوِتْرُ فَقُلْتُ أَخْبِرِينَا عَنْ وِتْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا نَامَ وَضَعَ سِوَاكَهُ عِنْدِي فَيَبْعَثُهُ اللَّهُ لِمَا يَشَاءُ أَنْ يَبْعَثَهُ فَيُصَلِّي تِسْعَ رَكَعَاتٍ لَا يَجْلِسُ إِلَّا فِي الثَّامِنَةِ فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيَدْعُو رَبَّهُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ وَلَا يُسَلِّمُ حَتَّى يَجْلِسَ فِي التَّاسِعَةِ فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيَدْعُو رَبَّهُ وَيُسَلِّمُ تَسْلِيمَةً يُسْمِعُنَا ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فَتِلْكَ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً» يَا بُنَيَّ «فَلَمَّا أَسَنَّ وَحَمَلَ اللَّحْمَ صَلَّى سَبْعَ رَكَعَاتٍ لَا يَجْلِسُ إِلَّا فِي السَّادِسَةِ فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيَدْعُو رَبَّهُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ وَلَا يُسَلِّمُ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فِي السَّابِعَةِ فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَيَدْعُو رَبَّهُ ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ تَسْلِيمَةً ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فَتِلْكَ تِسْعٌ» يَا بُنَيَّ «وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا غَلَبَهُ نَوْمٌ أَوْ مَرَضٌ صَلَّى مِنَ النَّهَارِ ثِنْتَيْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةً وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَخَذَ خُلُقًا أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُدَاوِمَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَا قَامَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَيْلَةً حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ وَلَا قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ وَلَا صَامَ شَهْرًا كَامِلًا غَيْرَ رَمَضَانَ» فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ فَقَالَ «صَدَقَتْكَ أَمَا إِنِّي لَوْ كُنْتُ أَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا لَشَافَهْتُهَا مُشَافَهَةً» قَالَ فَقُلْتُ أَمَا إِنِّي لَوْ شَعَرْتُ أَنَّكَ لَا تَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا مَا حَدَّثْتُكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥaq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Muʿādh b. Hishām from my father \u003e Qatādah \u003e Zurārah b. Awfá \u003e Saʿd b. Hishām
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1517

chapter.englishTitle: Which night prayer is better?

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Prophet ﷺ said, "The best ˹voluntary˺ ritual prayer after the farḍ (mandatory) prayer is ˹that which is done˺ in the middle of the night."
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said, "The best ˹voluntary˺ ritual prayer after the farḍ (mandatory) prayer is ˹that which is done˺ in the middle of the night."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَفْضَلُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ الصَّلَاةُ فِي جَوْفِ اللَّيْلِ»
hadiths.chain: Zayd b. ʿAwf \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Muntashir \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1518

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا نَامَ عَنْ حِزْبِهِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: If he slept away from his party at night

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: He who misses him daily round of recital or part of it due to sleep and he recites it between the dawn and the noon prayers, will be reckoned as if he recited it at night.    – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: He who misses him daily round of recital or part of it due to sleep and he recites it between the dawn and the noon prayers, will be reckoned as if he recited it at night.    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ نَامَ عَنْ حِزْبِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شَيْءٍ مِنْهُ فَقَرَأَهُ فِيمَا بَيْنَ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَصَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ كُتِبَ لَهُ لَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَأَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e al-Sāʾib b. Yazīd And ʿUbayd Allāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAbd \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَبْدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1519

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: Allah descends to the lower sky.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah, the Exalted, descends to the lowest heaven every night in the last third of the night. He says, 'Who will call upon Me, so that I may answer him? Who will ask of Me, so that I may give him? Who will seek My forgiveness, so that I may forgive him?' This continues until dawn or the person offering the Fajr prayer leaves."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah, the Exalted, descends to the lowest heaven every night in the last third of the night. He says, 'Who will call upon Me, so that I may answer him? Who will ask of Me, so that I may give him? Who will seek My forgiveness, so that I may forgive him?' This continues until dawn or the person offering the Fajr prayer leaves."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ لِنِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرِ أَوْ لِثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرِ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ؟ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ أَوْ يَنْصَرِفَ الْقَارِئُ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1520

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: Allah descends to the lower sky.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Our Lord who is blessed and exalted descends every night to the lowest heaven when the last one-third of the night remains, and says: Who supplicated Me so that I may answer him ? Who asks of Me so that I may give to him ? Who asks My forgiveness so that I may forgive him ?     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Our Lord who is blessed and exalted descends every night to the lowest heaven when the last one-third of the night remains, and says: Who supplicated Me so that I may answer him ? Who asks of Me so that I may give to him ? Who asks My forgiveness so that I may forgive him ?     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ يَنْزِلُ رَبُّنَا تَبَارَكَ اسْمُهُ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ حِينَ يَبْقَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَيَقُولُ مَنْ يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ حَتَّى الْفَجْرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman And ʾAbū ʿAbdullāh al-Aghar Ṣāḥibā Abū Hurayrah \u003e Abū Hurayrah Akhbarahumā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَأَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَغَرُّ صَاحِبَا أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَخْبَرَهُمَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1521

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: Allah descends to the lower sky.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, "Allah, the Most High, descends to the lower heaven every night and asks, 'Is there anyone who asks so that I may give to them? Is there anyone who seeks forgiveness so that I may forgive them?'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, "Allah, the Most High, descends to the lower heaven every night and asks, 'Is there anyone who asks so that I may give to them? Is there anyone who seeks forgiveness so that I may forgive them?'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَيَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ سَائِلٍ فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ هَلْ مِنْ مُسْتَغْفِرٍ فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ؟   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Nāfiʿ b. Jubayr b. Muṭʿim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1522

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: Allah descends to the lower sky.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When half or two-thirds of the night passes, Allah descends to the lowest heaven and says, 'Is there anyone who asks of Me so that I may grant them? Is there anyone who seeks My forgiveness so that I may forgive them? Is there anyone who supplicates to Me so that I may answer them?' This continues until dawn breaks."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When half or two-thirds of the night passes, Allah descends to the lowest heaven and says, 'Is there anyone who asks of Me so that I may grant them? Is there anyone who seeks My forgiveness so that I may forgive them? Is there anyone who supplicates to Me so that I may answer them?' This continues until dawn breaks."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا مَضَى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ نِصْفُهُ أَوْ ثُلُثَاهُ هَبَطَ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ يَقُولُ لَا أَسْأَلُ عَنْ عِبَادِي غَيْرِي مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْأَلُنِي فَأُعْطِيَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَسْتَغْفِرُنِي فَأَغْفِرَ لَهُ؟ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَدْعُونِي فَأَسْتَجِيبَ لَهُ؟ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Hilāl b. Abū Maymūnah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Rifāʿah b. ʿArābah al-Juhanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ عَرَابَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1523

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: Allah descends to the lower sky.

hadiths.englishRaw: He informed him that the Prophet ﷺ said something like it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He informed him that the Prophet ﷺ said something like it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ إنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Hilāl b. Abū Maymūnah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Rifāʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَنَّ رِفَاعَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1524

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: Allah descends to the lower sky.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When it is one-third or half of the night, then remember the descent."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When it is one-third or half of the night, then remember the descent."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا كَانَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ أَوْ نِصْفُ اللَّيْلِ فَذَكَرَ النُّزُولَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Mukhtār \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq from his uncle ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yasār \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Rāfiʿ \u003e Abiyih \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِيِهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1525

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: Allah descends to the lower sky.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Were it not that it would be too difficult for my ummah, I would have commanded them to use the siwak every time of prayer, and I would have delayed Ishaʿ until the first third of the night had passed, because when the first third of the night has passed. Allah may he be exalted descends to the first heaven and stays there until dawn comes, and says: Is there any asking so that he might be given? Is there anyone praying so that he might be answered? Is there any sick person asking for healing so that he might be healed? Is there any sinner asking for forgiveness, so that he might be forgiven? A hadeeth like that of Abu Hurairah was narrated from ʿAli bin Abi Talib ؓ from the Prophet ﷺ Abi Talib.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Were it not that it would be too difficult for my ummah, I would have commanded them to use the siwak every time of prayer, and I would have delayed Ishaʿ until the first third of the night had passed, because when the first third of the night has passed. Allah may he be exalted descends to the first heaven and stays there until dawn comes, and says: Is there any asking so that he might be given? Is there anyone praying so that he might be answered? Is there any sick person asking for healing so that he might be healed? Is there any sinner asking for forgiveness, so that he might be forgiven? A hadeeth like that of Abu Hurairah was narrated from ʿAli bin Abi Talib ؓ from the Prophet ﷺ Abi Talib.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ لَوْلَا أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَى أُمَّتِي لَأَمَرْتُهُمْ بِالسِّوَاكِ عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ وَلَأَخَّرْتُ الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ إِلَى ثُلُثِ اللَّيْلِ فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا مَضَى ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ الْأَوَّلُ هَبَطَ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا فَلَمْ يَزَلْ هُنَالِكَ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ يَقُولُ قَائِلٌ أَلَا سَائِلٌ يُعْطَى؟ أَلَا دَاعٍ يُجَابُ؟ أَلَا سَقِيمٌ يَسْتَشْفِي فَيُشْفَى؟ أَلَا مُذْنِبٌ مُسْتَغْفِرُ فَيُغْفَرَ لَهُ؟ َ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá \u003e Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm from my father \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Saʿīd al-Maqburī \u003e ʿAṭāʾ a freed slave of Um Ṣubayyah \u003e Abū Hurayrah \u003e Rasūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي عَنْ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ مَوْلَى أُمِّ صُبَيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1526

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: Allah descends to the lower sky.

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by Ubaidullah bin Abu Raafi', the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , from his father, from Ali ibn Abi Talib, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , similar to the tradition of Abu Hurairah.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by Ubaidullah bin Abu Raafi', the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , from his father, from Ali ibn Abi Talib, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , similar to the tradition of Abu Hurairah.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَة   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Yaʿqūb from my father \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e ʿAmmī ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yasār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَسَارٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1527

chapter.englishTitle: The supplication during Tahajjud.

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up for praying at midnight, he said: o Allah, be praise to Thee, Thou art the light of the heavens and the earth; and to Thee be praise; Thou are the maintainer of the heavens and the earth; and to Thee be praise, Thou art the heavens and the earth and what is between them; Thou art the truth, and Thy statement is truth; and Thy promise is the truth; and the visitation with Thee is true; and the Paradise is true and the Hell-fire is true and the Hour is true; O Allah, to Thee I turned my attention, and by Thee I disputed, and to Thee I brought forth my case, so forgive me my former and latter sins, and my secret and open sins, Thou art my deity, there is no deity but Thou.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up for praying at midnight, he said: o Allah, be praise to Thee, Thou art the light of the heavens and the earth; and to Thee be praise; Thou are the maintainer of the heavens and the earth; and to Thee be praise, Thou art the heavens and the earth and what is between them; Thou art the truth, and Thy statement is truth; and Thy promise is the truth; and the visitation with Thee is true; and the Paradise is true and the Hell-fire is true and the Hour is true; O Allah, to Thee I turned my attention, and by Thee I disputed, and to Thee I brought forth my case, so forgive me my former and latter sins, and my secret and open sins, Thou art my deity, there is no deity but Thou.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ الله ﷺ إِذَا قَامَ يَتَهَجَّدُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ، أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّومُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ وَلِقَاؤُكَ الحَقُّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ، وَالْبَعْثُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّبِيُّونَ حَقٌّ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ حَقٌّ۔ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ، وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ حَاكَمْتُ۔ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ۔ أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِكَ۔»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Sulaymān al-Aḥwal \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1528

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْآيَتَيْنِ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever reads the two verses from the end of Surah Al-Baqarah.

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ that he said, "Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah in one night, it is sufficient for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ that he said, "Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah in one night, it is sufficient for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ قَرَأَ الْآيَتَيْنِ الْآخِرَتَيْنِ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كَفَتَاهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd \u003e Abū Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1529

chapter.englishTitle: Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Allah has not heard anything (more pleasing) than listening to the Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet loud voice.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Allah has not heard anything (more pleasing) than listening to the Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet loud voice.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ كَإِذْنِهِ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ يَجْهَرُ بِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1530

chapter.englishTitle: Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard the recitation of Abu Musa and said: 'This man has been given a Mizmar among the Mazamir of the family of Dawud, peace be upon him.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard the recitation of Abu Musa and said: 'This man has been given a Mizmar among the Mazamir of the family of Dawud, peace be upon him.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَبَا مُوسَى وَهُوَ يَقْرَأُ فَقَالَ «لَقَدْ أُوتِيَ هَذَا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah Urāh \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ أُرَاهُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1531

chapter.englishTitle: Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "He is not one of us who does not find delight in the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "He is not one of us who does not find delight in the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَغَنَّ بِالْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr / Ibn Dīnār \u003e Ibn Abū Mulaykah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Nahīk \u003e Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ عَنْ سَعْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1532

chapter.englishTitle: Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the Prophet, peace be upon him, he said: 'Allah has not granted permission for something that He has granted permission to a prophet to indulge in reciting the Qur'an.' Abu Muhammad said: 'He intends to be self-sufficient through it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From the Prophet, peace be upon him, he said: 'Allah has not granted permission for something that He has granted permission to a prophet to indulge in reciting the Qur'an.' Abu Muhammad said: 'He intends to be self-sufficient through it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ مَا أَذِنَ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «يُرِيدُ بِهِ الِاسْتِغْنَاءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1533

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أُمُّ الْقُرْآنِ: هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي
chapter.englishTitle: Mother of the Quran: It is the Seven Oft-Repeated (verses)

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me and said, "Did not Allah say: 'O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you' [Quran 8:24]?" Then he said, "Shall I not teach you a Surah that is the greatest Surah in the Quran before I leave the mosque?" When he wanted to leave, he said, "All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds" and it is the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Quran that you have been given.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me and said, "Did not Allah say: 'O you who have believed, respond to Allah and to the Messenger when he calls you' [Quran 8:24]?" Then he said, "Shall I not teach you a Surah that is the greatest Surah in the Quran before I leave the mosque?" When he wanted to leave, he said, "All praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds" and it is the seven oft-repeated verses and the Great Quran that you have been given.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «أَلَمْ يَقُلِ اللَّهُ» {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ} [الأنفال 24] ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَلَا أُعَلِّمُكَ سُورَةً أَعْظَمَ سُورَةٍ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ؟» فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَهِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. ʿUmar al-Zahrānī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Khubayb b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Ḥafṣ b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Abū Saʿīd b. al-Muʿallá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُعَلَّى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1534

chapter.englishTitle: In how many parts is the Quran divided?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: He who recites the Qur'an in a period less than three days does not understand it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: He who recites the Qur'an in a period less than three days does not understand it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَفْقَهُ مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Minhāl \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū al-ʿAlāʾ Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1535

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرَّجُلُ لَا يَدْرِي أَثَلَاثًا صَلَّى أَمْ أَرْبَعًا
chapter.englishTitle: The man does not know whether he prayed three or four.

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the call for prayer is made, Satan takes to his heels passing wind so that he may not hear the Adhan and when the call is finished he comes back, and when the Iqama is pronounced, Satan again takes to his heels, and when the Iqama is finished he comes back again and tries to interfere with the person and his thoughts and say, "Remember this and that (which he has not thought of before the prayer)", till the praying person forgets how much he has prayed. If anyone of you does not remember whether he has offered three or four rakʿat then he should perform two prostrations of Sahu while sitting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the call for prayer is made, Satan takes to his heels passing wind so that he may not hear the Adhan and when the call is finished he comes back, and when the Iqama is pronounced, Satan again takes to his heels, and when the Iqama is finished he comes back again and tries to interfere with the person and his thoughts and say, "Remember this and that (which he has not thought of before the prayer)", till the praying person forgets how much he has prayed. If anyone of you does not remember whether he has offered three or four rakʿat then he should perform two prostrations of Sahu while sitting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ إِذَا نُودِيَ بِالْأَذَانِ أَدْبَرَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَهُ ضُرَاطٌ حَتَّى لَا يَسْمَعَ الْأَذَانَ فَإِذَا قُضِيَ الْأَذَانُ أَقْبَلَ فَإِذَا ثُوِّبَ أَدْبَرَ وَإِذَا قُضِيَ التَّثْوِيبُ أَقْبَلَ حَتَّى يَخْطِرَ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَنَفْسِهِ فَيَقُولُ اذْكُرْ كَذَا اذْكُرْ كَذَا لِمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ يَذْكُرُ حَتَّى يَظَلَّ الرَّجُلُ إِنْ يَدْرِي كَمْ صَلَّى فَإِذَا لَمْ يَدْرِ أَحَدُكُمْ كَمْ صَلَّى ثَلَاثًا أَمْ أَرْبَعًا فَلْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1536

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرَّجُلُ لَا يَدْرِي أَثَلَاثًا صَلَّى أَمْ أَرْبَعًا
chapter.englishTitle: The man does not know whether he prayed three or four.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: "If one of you does not know whether he prayed three or four (rak'ahs), let him pray a rak'ah then prostrate twice after that when he is sitting. Then if he prayed five (rak'ahs), they (the two prostrations) will make his prayer even-numbered, and if he had prayed four, they will annoy and humiliate the shaitan."
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "If one of you does not know whether he prayed three or four (rak'ahs), let him pray a rak'ah then prostrate twice after that when he is sitting. Then if he prayed five (rak'ahs), they (the two prostrations) will make his prayer even-numbered, and if he had prayed four, they will annoy and humiliate the shaitan."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا لَمْ يَدْرِ أَحَدُكُمْ أَثَلَاثًا صَلَّى أَمْ أَرْبَعًا فَلْيَقُمْ فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ لِيَسْجُدْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ فَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى خَمْسًا شَفَعَتَا لَهُ صَلَاتَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى أَرْبَعًا كَانَتَا تَرْغِيمًا لِلشَّيْطَانِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «آخُذُ بِهِ»
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Ibn Abū Salamah al-Mājishūn \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونُ أَنْبَأَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1537

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ مِنَ الزِّيَادَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prostration of inadvertence from excess

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed one of the evening prayers, then he performed two additional units of prayer, and then he said the salaam and stood on a wooden platform inside the mosque. He placed his hand on it, and said, "Yazeed and Ibn Awun showed us this." He placed one hand on the other, with the upper hand on the lower one and entered his upper fingers into the lower fingers, pressing them together, and he stood as if he was angry. Immediately, some people left and began saying, "The prayer has been shortened, the prayer has been shortened." Among the people were Abu Bakr and Umar, but they did not speak. Among the people, there was a tall man with long arms named Dhu al-Yadayn (the one with two hands), who said, "O Messenger of Allah, did you forget the prayer or was it shortened?" He ﷺ said, "I did not forget, nor was the prayer shortened." He said, "Is it like that?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Then he returned and completed what remained, then said the salaam and pronounced the takbeer. He prostrated for a long time, then raised his head and pronounced the takbeer, and prostrated again as he did the first time, then raised his head and left."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed one of the evening prayers, then he performed two additional units of prayer, and then he said the salaam and stood on a wooden platform inside the mosque. He placed his hand on it, and said, "Yazeed and Ibn Awun showed us this." He placed one hand on the other, with the upper hand on the lower one and entered his upper fingers into the lower fingers, pressing them together, and he stood as if he was angry. Immediately, some people left and began saying, "The prayer has been shortened, the prayer has been shortened." Among the people were Abu Bakr and Umar, but they did not speak. Among the people, there was a tall man with long arms named Dhu al-Yadayn (the one with two hands), who said, "O Messenger of Allah, did you forget the prayer or was it shortened?" He ﷺ said, "I did not forget, nor was the prayer shortened." He said, "Is it like that?" They said, "Yes." He said, "Then he returned and completed what remained, then said the salaam and pronounced the takbeer. He prostrated for a long time, then raised his head and pronounced the takbeer, and prostrated again as he did the first time, then raised his head and left."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِحْدَى صَلَاتَيِ الْعَشِيِّ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ وَقَامَ إِلَى خَشَبَةٍ مُعْتَرِضَةٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ يَزِيدُ وَأَرَانَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ وَوَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ إِحْدَاهُمَا عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْأُخْرَى وَأَدْخَلَ أَصَابِعَهُ الْعُلْيَا فِي السُّفْلَى وَاضِعًا وَقَامَ كَأَنَّهُ غَضْبَانُ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ السَّرَعَانُ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَجَعَلُوا يَقُولُونَ قُصِرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ قُصِرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَفِي الْقَوْمِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ فَلَمْ يَتَكَلَّمَا وَفِي الْقَوْمِ رَجُلٌ طَوِيلُ الْيَدَيْنِ يُسَمَّى ذُا الْيَدَيْنِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَسِيتَ الصَّلَاةَ أَمْ قُصِرَتْ؟ فَقَالَ «مَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا قُصِرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ» فَقَالَ «أَوَ كَذَلِكَ؟» قَالُوا نَعَمْ قَالَ فَرَجَعَ فَأَتَمَّ مَا بَقِيَ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ وَكَبَّرَ فَسَجَدَ طَوِيلًا ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَكَبَّرَ وَسَجَدَ مِثْلَ مَا سَجَدَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ وَانْصَرَفَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1538

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ مِنَ الزِّيَادَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prostration of inadvertence from excess

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Dhuhr or Asr prayer, and then he performed the tasleem after two units of one of them. Zul-Shimalayn ibn 'Abd Amr ibn Nadlah al-Khuzai, who was an ally of the Banu Zuhrah and shorter than others, said to him, "Did you shorten the prayer, O Messenger of Allah?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "I did not forget nor did I shorten." Then Zul-Shimalayn said, "Some of us saw you doing so, O Messenger of Allah." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to the people and said, "Who do you believe, the one with two hands?" They replied, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah."
