Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and completed the prayer, and no one among them informed me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed two prostrations while sitting in that prayer. And this is what is witnessed, and Allah knows best, as people were content with the certainty of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until they were certain.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed the Dhuhr or Asr prayer, and then he performed the tasleem after two units of one of them. Zul-Shimalayn ibn 'Abd Amr ibn Nadlah al-Khuzai, who was an ally of the Banu Zuhrah and shorter than others, said to him, "Did you shorten the prayer, O Messenger of Allah?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "I did not forget nor did I shorten." Then Zul-Shimalayn said, "Some of us saw you doing so, O Messenger of Allah." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned to the people and said, "Who do you believe, the one with two hands?" They replied, "Yes, O Messenger of Allah." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and completed the prayer, and no one among them informed me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed two prostrations while sitting in that prayer. And this is what is witnessed, and Allah knows best, as people were content with the certainty of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ until they were certain.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَاةَ الظُّهْرِ أَوِ الْعَصْرِ فَسَلَّمَ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ مِنْ إِحْدَاهُمَا فَقَالَ لَهُ ذُو الشِّمَالَيْنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نَضْلَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ وَهُوَ حَلِيفُ بَنِي زُهْرَةَ أَقُصِرَتْ أَمْ نَسِيتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَمْ أَنْسَ وَلَمْ تُقْصَرْ» فَقَالَ ذُو الشِّمَالَيْنِ قَدْ كَانَ بَعْضُ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَقَالَ «أَصَدَقَ ذُو الْيَدَيْنِ؟» قَالُوا نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَتَمَّ الصَّلَاةَ وَلَمْ يُحَدِّثْنِي أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فِي تِلْكَ الصَّلَاةِ وَذَلِكَ فِيمَا يُرَى وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّ النَّاسَ يَقَّنُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى اسْتَيْقَنَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Ibn al-Musayyab And ʾAbū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman Waʾabū Bakr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman Waʿubayd Allāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1539

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ مِنَ الزِّيَادَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prostration of inadvertence from excess

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet of Allah ﷺ , it is narrated that he prayed five units of the Dhuhr prayer. When asked about it, he performed two additional prostrations.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet of Allah ﷺ , it is narrated that he prayed five units of the Dhuhr prayer. When asked about it, he performed two additional prostrations.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ اللَّهُ ﷺ «أَنَّهُ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ خَمْسًا فَقِيلَ لَهُ فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1540

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا كَانَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ نُقْصَانٌ
chapter.englishTitle: If there is a deficiency in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in prayer praying two rak'ahs. When he stood up and did not sit (at the end of two rak'ahs) the people stood up along with him. When he finished the prayer and we expect him to give the salutation, he said: "Allah is most great." While sitting and made two prostrations before giving the salutation. Then he gave it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ led us in prayer praying two rak'ahs. When he stood up and did not sit (at the end of two rak'ahs) the people stood up along with him. When he finished the prayer and we expect him to give the salutation, he said: "Allah is most great." While sitting and made two prostrations before giving the salutation. Then he gave it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَامَ وَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ وَقَامَ النَّاسُ فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ نَظَرْنَا تَسْلِيمَهُ فَكَبَّرَ فَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Hurmuz al-Aʿraj \u003e Ibn Buḥaynah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1541

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا كَانَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ نُقْصَانٌ
chapter.englishTitle: If there is a deficiency in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up from the two units of the Dhuhr or Asr prayer and did not return until he finished his prayer, then he performed the two prostrations of forgetfulness, then he made the salaam."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up from the two units of the Dhuhr or Asr prayer and did not return until he finished his prayer, then he performed the two prostrations of forgetfulness, then he made the salaam."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَامَ مِنَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ أَوِ الْعَصْرِ فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيِ الْوَهْمِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Faḍl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Aʿraj \u003e Mālik Ibn Buḥaynah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ مَالِكِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1542

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا كَانَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ نُقْصَانٌ
chapter.englishTitle: If there is a deficiency in prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah les us in Salat. When he prayed two Rak'ah he stood without sitting. Those who were behind him said 'Subhan Allah' and he indicated to them that they should stand. He said the Taslim when he had finished his Salat and he performed two prostrations of As-Sahw, and said the Taslim. He said that Messenger of Allah did this."    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah les us in Salat. When he prayed two Rak'ah he stood without sitting. Those who were behind him said 'Subhan Allah' and he indicated to them that they should stand. He said the Taslim when he had finished his Salat and he performed two prostrations of As-Sahw, and said the Taslim. He said that Messenger of Allah did this."    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ قُومُوا فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ سَلَّمَ وَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ وَسَلَّمَ وَقَالَ «هَكَذَا صَنَعَ بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e Ziyād b. ʿIlāqah \u003e Ṣallá Binā al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah Falammā Ṣallá Rakʿatayn Qām And Lam Yajlis Fasabbaḥ Bih Man Khalfah Faʾashār Ilayhim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ الْمَسْعُودِيِّ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَامَ وَلَمْ يَجْلِسْ فَسَبَّحَ بِهِ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ فَأَشَارَ إِلَيْهِمْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1543

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْكَلَامِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Speaking in Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: While I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in prayer, a man from the people sneezed, so I said, "May Allah have mercy on you." The people stared at me with their eyes, so I said, "May you be struck and blinded! Why are you looking at me?" They struck their thighs with their hands, and when I saw them silent, I said, "Why are you silencing me? But I remained silent." When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished, I swear by my father and mother that I have never seen a better teacher before or after him. By Allah, he did not hit, scold, or insult me, but he said, "Our prayer does not allow anything of the people's talk in it, it is only for glorification (of Allah), Takbeer (Allah is the Greatest), and recitation of the Quran."
hadiths.body: While I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in prayer, a man from the people sneezed, so I said, "May Allah have mercy on you." The people stared at me with their eyes, so I said, "May you be struck and blinded! Why are you looking at me?" They struck their thighs with their hands, and when I saw them silent, I said, "Why are you silencing me? But I remained silent." When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished, I swear by my father and mother that I have never seen a better teacher before or after him. By Allah, he did not hit, scold, or insult me, but he said, "Our prayer does not allow anything of the people's talk in it, it is only for glorification (of Allah), Takbeer (Allah is the Greatest), and recitation of the Quran."
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَا أَنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الصَّلَاةِ إِذْ عَطَسَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ فَقُلْتُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ قَالَ فَحَدَّقَنِي الْقَوْمُ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ فَقُلْتُ وَا ثُكْلَاهُ مَا لَكُمْ تَنْظُرُونَ إِلَيَّ؟ قَالَ فَضَرَبَ الْقَوْمُ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ عَلَى أَفْخَاذِهِمْ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُهُمْ يُسْكِتُونَنِي قُلْتُ مَا لَكُمْ تُسْكِتُونَنِي؟ لَكِنِّي سَكَتُّ قَالَ فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَبِأَبِي هُوَ وَأُمِّي مَا رَأَيْتُ مُعَلِّمًا قَبْلَهُ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ أَحْسَنَ تَعْلِيمًا مِنْهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا ضَرَبَنِي وَلَا كَهَرَنِي وَلَا سَبَّنِي وَلَكِنْ قَالَ «إِنَّ صَلَاتَنَا هَذِهِ لَا يَصْلُحُ فِيهَا شَيْءٌ مِنْ كَلَامِ النَّاسِ إِنَّمَا هِيَ التَّسْبِيحُ وَالتَّكْبِيرُ وَتِلَاوَةُ الْقُرْآنِ»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Hilāl b. Abū Maymūnah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. al-Ḥakam al-Sulamī \u003e Baynā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ السُّلَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1544

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْكَلَامِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Speaking in Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Mu'awiyah bin 'Abdillah,   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Mu'awiyah bin 'Abdillah,   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ṣadaqah \u003e Ibn ʿUlayyah And Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Ḥajjāj al-Ṣawwāf \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Hilāl \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ هِلَالٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1545

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ قَتْلِ الْحَيَّةِ وَالْعَقْرَبِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Killing snakes and scorpions during prayer.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ enjoined killing the two black ones (snakes and scorpions) while praying.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ enjoined killing the two black ones (snakes and scorpions) while praying.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَ بِقَتْلِ الْأَسْوَدَيْنِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ يَحْيَى وَالْأَسْوَدَاْنِ الْحَيَّةُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ḍamḍam \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ ضَمْضَمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1546

chapter.englishTitle: The shortening of prayer during travel

hadiths.englishRaw: "To shorten the prayer if you fear" [4:101]. This means that people have already accepted it. The Prophet ﷺ said, "I am amazed at what you are amazed at. Allah has granted you a charity, so accept it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To shorten the prayer if you fear" [4:101]. This means that people have already accepted it. The Prophet ﷺ said, "I am amazed at what you are amazed at. Allah has granted you a charity, so accept it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَقْصُرُوا مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ إِنْ خِفْتُمْ} [النساء 101] فَقَدْ أَمِنَ النَّاسُ قَالَ عَجِبْتُ مِمَّا عَجِبْتَ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «صَدَقَةٌ تَصَدَّقَ اللَّهُ بِهَا عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْبَلُوهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn Abū ʿAmmār \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Bābayh \u003e Yaʿlá b. Umayyah \u003e Liʿumar b. al-Khaṭṭāb \u003e Allāh Taʿālá Falays ʿAlaykum Junāḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَابَيْهِ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1547

chapter.englishTitle: The shortening of prayer during travel

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed two Rak'ahs in Mina, Abu Bakr prayed two Rak'ahs, Umar prayed two Rak'ahs, and Uthman prayed two Rak'ahs, leading from his position, and then completed them afterward.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed two Rak'ahs in Mina, Abu Bakr prayed two Rak'ahs, Umar prayed two Rak'ahs, and Uthman prayed two Rak'ahs, leading from his position, and then completed them afterward.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَعُمَرُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَعُثْمَانُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَدْرًا مِنْ إِمَارَتِهِ ثُمَّ أَتَمَّهَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1548

chapter.englishTitle: The shortening of prayer during travel

hadiths.englishRaw: "I prayed Zuhr with the Prophet ﷺ in Al-Madinah, four Rak'ahs and 'Asr in Dhul-Hulaifah, two Rak'ahs."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I prayed Zuhr with the Prophet ﷺ in Al-Madinah, four Rak'ahs and 'Asr in Dhul-Hulaifah, two Rak'ahs."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «صَلَّيْنَا الظُّهْرَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَرْبَعًا وَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1549

chapter.englishTitle: The shortening of prayer during travel

hadiths.englishRaw: I prayed along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ four rak'ahs at the noon prayer at Medina and two rak'ahs at the afternoon prayer in Dhu al-Hulaifah.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I prayed along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ four rak'ahs at the noon prayer at Medina and two rak'ahs at the afternoon prayer in Dhu al-Hulaifah.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يَقُولُ «صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَرْبَعًا وَبِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Maysarah And Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1550

chapter.englishTitle: The shortening of prayer during travel

hadiths.englishRaw: "The prayer was initially ordained with two units (rak'ahs). Then the prayer of travel (safar) was established with a shortened form, while the prayer of residence (hadar) was performed in its complete form." So I asked, "What was the reason for completing the prayer during travel?" He (Uthman) said, "It was interpreted (or understood) in this way as Uthman had also interpreted it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The prayer was initially ordained with two units (rak'ahs). Then the prayer of travel (safar) was established with a shortened form, while the prayer of residence (hadar) was performed in its complete form." So I asked, "What was the reason for completing the prayer during travel?" He (Uthman) said, "It was interpreted (or understood) in this way as Uthman had also interpreted it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ أَوَّلَ مَا فُرِضَتْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَأُقِرَّتْ صَلَاةُ السَّفَرِ وَأُتِمَّتْ صَلَاةُ الْحَضَرِ» فَقُلْتُ مَا لَهَا كَانَتْ تُتِمُّ الصَّلَاةَ فِي السَّفَرِ؟ قَالَ إِنَّهَا تَأَوَّلَتْ كَمَا تَأَوَّلَ عُثْمَانُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يَذْكُرُ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1551

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ بِبَلْدَةٍ كَمْ يُقِيمُ حَتَّى يَقْصُرَ الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever wishes to reside in a town, how long should they reside ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "We accompanied the Prophet ﷺ and he shortened his prayers until we reached Mecca. He stayed there for ten days, shortening his prayers, before returning. This was during his pilgrimage."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We accompanied the Prophet ﷺ and he shortened his prayers until we reached Mecca. He stayed there for ten days, shortening his prayers, before returning. This was during his pilgrimage."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «خَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَجَعَلَ يَقْصُرُ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ فَأَقَامَ بِهَا عَشَرَةَ أَيَّامٍ يَقْصُرُ حَتَّى رَجَعَ وَذَلِكَ فِي حَجَّتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ibn Abū Isḥāq \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1552

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ بِبَلْدَةٍ كَمْ يُقِيمُ حَتَّى يَقْصُرَ الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever wishes to reside in a town, how long should they reside ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The Muhajir may stay for three days after completing his rituals.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The Muhajir may stay for three days after completing his rituals.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مُكْثُ الْمُهَاجِرِ بَعْدَ قَضَاءِ نُسُكِهِ ثَلَاثٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Muḥammad \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAwf \u003e al-Sāʾib b. Yazīd \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Ḥaḍramī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1553

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُقِيمَ بِبَلْدَةٍ كَمْ يُقِيمُ حَتَّى يَقْصُرَ الصَّلَاةَ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever wishes to reside in a town, how long should they reside ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ allowed the migrants to settle three days beyond the sacred territory in Mecca." Abu Muhammad said, "I agree with this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ allowed the migrants to settle three days beyond the sacred territory in Mecca." Abu Muhammad said, "I agree with this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ أَنْ يُقِيمُوا ثَلَاثًا بَعْدَ الصَّدَرِ بِمَكَّةَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «أَقُولُ بِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAwf \u003e al-Sāʾib b. Yazīd \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Ḥaḍramī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1554

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer upon the departed

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray (the Nawafil) on his Mount facing east and whenever he wanted to offer the compulsory prayer, he used to dismount and face the Qibla.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to pray (the Nawafil) on his Mount facing east and whenever he wanted to offer the compulsory prayer, he used to dismount and face the Qibla.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ نَحْوَ الْمَشْرِقِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ نَزَلَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Thawbān \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1555

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer upon the departed

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw the Prophet ﷺ on his Mount praying Nawafil by nodding his head, whatever direction he faced, but Messenger of Allah ﷺ never did the same in offering the compulsory prayers.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I saw the Prophet ﷺ on his Mount praying Nawafil by nodding his head, whatever direction he faced, but Messenger of Allah ﷺ never did the same in offering the compulsory prayers.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُسَبِّحُ وَهُوَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ وَيُومِئُ بِرَأْسِهِ قِبَلَ أَيِّ وَجْهٍ تَوَجَّهَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ فِي الصَّلَاةِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah \u003e ʿĀmir b. Rabīʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ أَنَّ عَامِرَ بْنَ رَبِيعَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1556

chapter.englishTitle: Combining between the two prayers.

hadiths.englishRaw: "We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the expedition of Tabuk. He used to combine the Dhuhr and Asr prayers, praying them together. Then, he entered (a place) and after that he came out again and prayed the Maghrib and Isha prayers together."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the expedition of Tabuk. He used to combine the Dhuhr and Asr prayers, praying them together. Then, he entered (a place) and after that he came out again and prayed the Maghrib and Isha prayers together."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَامَ غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ فَكَانَ يَجْمَعُ الصَّلَاةَ يَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ دَخَلَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿAlī al-Ḥanafī \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Abū al-Zubayr al-Makkī \u003e Abū al-Ṭufayl ʿĀmir b. Wāthilah \u003e Muʿādh b. Jabal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ أَنَّ أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ عَامِرَ بْنَ وَاثِلَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1557

chapter.englishTitle: Combining between the two prayers.

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah joined Maghrib and Isha in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah joined Maghrib and Isha in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِجَمْعٍ فَجَمَعَ بَيْنَهُمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAdī b. Thābit \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd al-Khaṭmī \u003e Abū Ayyūb al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْخَطْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1558

chapter.englishTitle: Combining between the two prayers.

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that if the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in a hurry to travel, he would combine Maghrib and 'Isha'.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that if the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in a hurry to travel, he would combine Maghrib and 'Isha'.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِ السَّيْرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1559

chapter.englishTitle: Combining the prayers at Muzdalifah

hadiths.englishRaw: "I saw Sa'eed bin Jubari in Jam'.[1] He stood and prayed Maghrib, three Rak'ahs, then he stood and prayed 'Isha', two Rak'ahs. Then he mentioned that Ibn 'Umar had done the same thing in that place, and he mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has done the same thing in that place. [1] Meaning Al-Muzdalifah.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I saw Sa'eed bin Jubari in Jam'.[1] He stood and prayed Maghrib, three Rak'ahs, then he stood and prayed 'Isha', two Rak'ahs. Then he mentioned that Ibn 'Umar had done the same thing in that place, and he mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has done the same thing in that place. [1] Meaning Al-Muzdalifah.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَنَعَ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam And Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e Ṣallá Binā Saʿīd b. Jubayr Bijamʿ Biʾiqāmah al-Maghrib Thalāth Falammā Sallam Qām Faṣallá Rakʿatayn al-ʿIshāʾ Thum Ḥaddath \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَكَمُ وَسَلَمَةُ بْنُ كُهَيْلٍ قَالَا صَلَّى بِنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ بِجَمْعٍ بِإِقَامَةٍ الْمَغْرِبَ ثَلَاثًا فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَامَ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ صَنَعَ بِهِمْ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَكَانِ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَحَدَّثَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1560

chapter.englishTitle: Combining the prayers at Muzdalifah

hadiths.englishRaw: Shu'bah narrated to us with his chain of narration about it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Shu'bah narrated to us with his chain of narration about it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1561

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of a man when he returns from his journey

hadiths.englishRaw: "From his father Abdullah and his uncle Ubaidullah ibn Ka'ab, that Ka'ab ibn Malik reported: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to set out for travel only during the daytime. After that, he would enter the mosque and pray two units of prayer, then sit with the people.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From his father Abdullah and his uncle Ubaidullah ibn Ka'ab, that Ka'ab ibn Malik reported: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to set out for travel only during the daytime. After that, he would enter the mosque and pray two units of prayer, then sit with the people.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَعَمِّهِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنَيْ كَعْبٍ عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ لَا يَقْدَمُ مِنْ سَفَرٍ إِلَّا بِالنَّهَارِ ضُحًى ثُمَّ يَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ لِلنَّاسِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAbdullāh b. Kaʿb b. Mālik \u003e Abīh ʿAbdullāh And from his uncle ʿUbaydullāh Āb.ay Kaʿb \u003e Kaʿb b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1562

chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of fear

hadiths.englishRaw: "I went out on a campaign with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ toward Najd. We confronted the enemy and formed ranks facing them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and led us in prayer. Some of us stood with him and some of us faced the enemy. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ bowed and those who were with him bowed, and prostrated twice. Then they moved away and took the place of the others, and the other group who had not prayed came and he led them in bowing once and prostrating twice. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said the salam and each of the Muslims stood up and bowed once, and prostrated twice individually."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I went out on a campaign with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ toward Najd. We confronted the enemy and formed ranks facing them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and led us in prayer. Some of us stood with him and some of us faced the enemy. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ bowed and those who were with him bowed, and prostrated twice. Then they moved away and took the place of the others, and the other group who had not prayed came and he led them in bowing once and prostrating twice. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said the salam and each of the Muslims stood up and bowed once, and prostrated twice individually."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «غَزَوْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ غَزْوَةً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ فَوَازَيْنَا الْعَدُوَّ وَصَافَفْنَاهُمْ» فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي لَنَا فَقَامَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنَّا مَعَهُ وَأَقْبَلَ طَائِفَةٌ عَلَى الْعَدُوِّ فَرَكَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِمَنْ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً وَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفُوا فَكَانُوا مَكَانَ الطَّائِفَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ تُصَلِّ وَجَاءَتِ الطَّائِفَةُ الَّتِي لَمْ تُصَلِّ فَرَكَعَ بِهِمُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ رَكْعَةً وَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَامَ كُلُّ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَرَكَعَ لِنَفْسِهِ رَكْعَةً وَسَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1563

chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of fear

hadiths.englishRaw: "The imam leads one group while another group faces the enemy, then he performs a prayer with those who are with him. The first group then joins their companions and they perform a prayer together, completing a separate prayer for themselves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The imam leads one group while another group faces the enemy, then he performs a prayer with those who are with him. The first group then joins their companions and they perform a prayer together, completing a separate prayer for themselves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يُصَلِّي الْإِمَامُ بِطَائِفَةٍ وَطَائِفَةٌ مُوَاجِهَةُ الْعَدُوِّ فَيُصَلِّي بِالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ رَكْعَةً وَيَذْهَبُ هَؤُلَاءِ إِلَى مَصَافِّ أَصْحَابِهِمْ وَيَجِيءُ أُولَئِكَ فَيُصَلِّي بِهِمْ رَكْعَةً وَيَقْضُونَ رَكْعَةً لِأَنْفُسِهِمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Bashhār \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd al-Anṣārī \u003e al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Khawwāt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَوَّاتٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ فِي صَلَاةِ الْخَوْفِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1564

chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of fear

hadiths.englishRaw: "About the Prophet ﷺ , with his likeness"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "About the Prophet ﷺ , with his likeness"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بمِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Bashhār \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad from his father \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Khawwāt \u003e Sahl b. Abū Ḥathmah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ خَوَّاتٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1565

chapter.englishTitle: Abstaining From Prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: "We were besieged during the Battle of Al-Khandaq (the Trench) until the darkness of night arrived and we were relieved. This is the saying of Allah the Almighty, "And Allah was sufficient for the believers in battle, and ever is Allah Powerful and Exalted in Might." [Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:25]. The Prophet ﷺ then called Bilal and commanded him to call the Adhan (the Muslim call to prayer). He performed the Zuhr prayer perfectly, as he used to pray it in its proper time. Then he commanded him and he established the Asr prayer, and he performed it as well. Then he commanded him and he established the Maghrib prayer, and he performed it. Then he commanded him and he established the Isha prayer, and he performed it." [This happened] before the revelation of the verse "And if you fear [an enemy, then pray] on foot or riding." [Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:239].   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We were besieged during the Battle of Al-Khandaq (the Trench) until the darkness of night arrived and we were relieved. This is the saying of Allah the Almighty, "And Allah was sufficient for the believers in battle, and ever is Allah Powerful and Exalted in Might." [Surah Al-Ahzab, 33:25]. The Prophet ﷺ then called Bilal and commanded him to call the Adhan (the Muslim call to prayer). He performed the Zuhr prayer perfectly, as he used to pray it in its proper time. Then he commanded him and he established the Asr prayer, and he performed it as well. Then he commanded him and he established the Maghrib prayer, and he performed it. Then he commanded him and he established the Isha prayer, and he performed it." [This happened] before the revelation of the verse "And if you fear [an enemy, then pray] on foot or riding." [Surah Al-Baqarah, 2:239].   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: حُبِسْنَا يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ هَوِيٌّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى كُفِينَا وَذَلِكَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى {وَكَفَى اللَّهُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْقِتَالَ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيزًا} [الأحزاب 25] «فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِلَالًا فَأَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ فَأَحْسَنَ كَمَا كَانَ يُصَلِّيهَا فِي وَقْتِهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ الْعَصْرَ فَصَلَّاهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ الْمَغْرِبَ فَصَلَّاهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ الْعِشَاءَ فَصَلَّاهَا» وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ {فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ فَرِجَالًا أَوْ رُكْبَانًا} [البقرة 239]   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Maqburī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1566

chapter.englishTitle: Prayers at the eclipse

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death of someone from the people but they are two signs amongst the signs of Allah. When you see them stand up and pray."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The sun and the moon do not eclipse because of the death of someone from the people but they are two signs amongst the signs of Allah. When you see them stand up and pray."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لَيْسَا يَنْكَسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَلَكِنَّهُمَا آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمُوهُمَا فَقُومُوا فَصَلُّوا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e Qays \u003e Abū Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1567

chapter.englishTitle: Prayers at the eclipse

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet (pbuh) prayed eight units of prayer in four prostrations during an eclipse."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet (pbuh) prayed eight units of prayer in four prostrations during an eclipse."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ صَلَّى فِي كُسُوفٍ ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ فِي أَرْبَعِ سَجَدَاتٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAlī b. ʿAbdullāh al-Madīnī And Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd al-Qaṭṭān \u003e Sufyān b. Saʿīd \u003e Ḥabīb b. Abū Thābit \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمَدِينِيُّ وَمُسَدَّدٌ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنِي حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1568

chapter.englishTitle: Prayers at the eclipse

hadiths.englishRaw: May Allah protect you from the torment of the grave. When the Prophet ﷺ came, she asked him, "How do people get punished in their graves?" He replied, "By seeking refuge in Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: May Allah protect you from the torment of the grave. When the Prophet ﷺ came, she asked him, "How do people get punished in their graves?" He replied, "By seeking refuge in Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَعَاذَكِ اللَّهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ سَأَلَتْهُ أَيُعَذَّبُ النَّاسُ فِي قُبُورِهِمْ؟ قَالَ «عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAmrah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ يَهُودِيَّةً دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1569

chapter.englishTitle: Prayers at the eclipse

hadiths.englishRaw: The sun was eclipsed, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed and his prayer was narrated by Ibn Abbas that he ﷺ prayed two units (rak'ahs) in each unit (rak'ah), then he gave them a sermon and said, "Verily, the sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of Allah; they do not eclipse for the death or life of any person. So, when you witness that, hasten to the remembrance of Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The sun was eclipsed, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed and his prayer was narrated by Ibn Abbas that he ﷺ prayed two units (rak'ahs) in each unit (rak'ah), then he gave them a sermon and said, "Verily, the sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of Allah; they do not eclipse for the death or life of any person. So, when you witness that, hasten to the remembrance of Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَحَكَى ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ صَلَاتَهُ ﷺ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ خَطَبَهُمْ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ آيَتَانِ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ لَا يَخْسِفَانِ لِمَوْتِ أَحَدٍ وَلَا لِحَيَاتِهِ فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ ذَلِكَ فَافْزَعُوا إِلَى ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Yaʿqūb Yūsuf al-Būwayṭī \u003e Muḥammad b. Idrīs \u003e al-Shāfiʿī \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يَعْقُوبَ يُوسُفُ الْبُوَيْطِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ هُوَ الشَّافِعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1570

chapter.englishTitle: Prayers at the eclipse

hadiths.englishRaw: The above hadith has been narrated through several other chains of transmitters.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The above hadith has been narrated through several other chains of transmitters.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ح   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mālik \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1571

chapter.englishTitle: Prayers at the eclipse

hadiths.englishRaw: "The sun set and the Prophet ﷺ prayed, and it was said that he performed two units of prayer in each unit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The sun set and the Prophet ﷺ prayed, and it was said that he performed two units of prayer in each unit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «خَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَّى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَحَكَتْ أَنَّهُ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mālik \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAmrah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1572

chapter.englishTitle: Prayers at the eclipse

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Prophet ﷺ ordered when the sun was eclipsed to perform a prayer of eclipse."
hadiths.body: "That the Prophet ﷺ ordered when the sun was eclipsed to perform a prayer of eclipse."
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَمَرَ حِينَ كَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ بِعَتَاقَةٍ»
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e Fāṭimah b. al-Mundhir \u003e Asmāʾ b. Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1573

chapter.englishTitle: Prayers at the eclipse

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ
hadiths.chain: Abū Ḥudhayfah Mūsá b. Masʿūd \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e Fāṭimah \u003e Asmāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ مُوسَى بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ عَنْ زَائِدَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1574

chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of rain seeking.

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out with the people to the place of prayer seeking rain, and he faced the Qibla (direction of prayer) and turned his cloak."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out with the people to the place of prayer seeking rain, and he faced the Qibla (direction of prayer) and turned his cloak."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَرَجَ بِالنَّاسِ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى يَسْتَسْقِي فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd al-Anṣārī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm \u003e ʿAbbād b. Tamīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Zayd Yadhkur
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زَيْدٍ يَذْكُرُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1575

chapter.englishTitle: In the prayer of rain seeking.

hadiths.englishRaw: He told him that the Prophet ﷺ went out with the people to the prayer place to pray for rain for them. Then he stood up and prayed to God while standing, then he turned towards the Qibla and turned his cloak and they were watered.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He told him that the Prophet ﷺ went out with the people to the prayer place to pray for rain for them. Then he stood up and prayed to God while standing, then he turned towards the Qibla and turned his cloak and they were watered.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ خَرَجَ بِالنَّاسِ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى يَسْتَسْقِي لَهُمْ فَقَامَ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ قَائِمًا ثُمَّ تَوَجَّهَ قِبَلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَحَوَّلَ رِدَاءَهُ فَأُسْقُوا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAbbād b. Tamīm from his uncle
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبَّادُ بْنُ تَمِيمٍ أَنَّ عَمَّهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1576

chapter.englishTitle: Raising Hands in Prayer for Rain

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not raise his hands during any supplication except when praying for rain, when he used to raise his hands so high that the whiteness of his armpits could be seen."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not raise his hands during any supplication except when praying for rain, when he used to raise his hands so high that the whiteness of his armpits could be seen."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ إِلَّا فِي الِاسْتِسْقَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1577

chapter.englishTitle: The Friday Bath

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Anyone of you attending the Friday (prayers) should take a bath."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Anyone of you attending the Friday (prayers) should take a bath."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْجُمُعَةَ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1578

chapter.englishTitle: The Friday Bath

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Ghusl (taking a bath) on Friday is compulsory for every Muslim reaching the age of puberty."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Ghusl (taking a bath) on Friday is compulsory for every Muslim reaching the age of puberty."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «غُسْلُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَاجِبٌ عَلَى كُلِّ مُحْتَلِمٍ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ṣafwān b. Sulaym \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1579

chapter.englishTitle: The Friday Bath

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Ṣafwān b. Sulaym \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1580

chapter.englishTitle: The Friday Bath

hadiths.englishRaw: While 'Umar b. al-Khattab was making a speech on Friday (in the mosque), a man came in. 'Umar said: Are you detained from prayer ? The man said: As soon as I heard the call for prayer, I perfumed ablution. Then 'Umar said: Only ablution ? Did you not hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: When any one of you comes for Friday (prayer) he should take a bath.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: While 'Umar b. al-Khattab was making a speech on Friday (in the mosque), a man came in. 'Umar said: Are you detained from prayer ? The man said: As soon as I heard the call for prayer, I perfumed ablution. Then 'Umar said: Only ablution ? Did you not hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: When any one of you comes for Friday (prayer) he should take a bath.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: تَسْمَعْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قال حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ يَخْطُبُ إِذْ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَعَرَّضَ بِهِ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا زِدْتُ أَنْ تَوَضَّأْتُ حِينَ سَمِعْتُ النِّدَاءَ فَقَالَ وَالْوُضُوءَ أَيْضًا؟ أَلَمْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1581

chapter.englishTitle: The Friday Bath

hadiths.englishRaw: “Whoever performs ablution on Friday, it is well and good for him, and he has done what is obligatory for him. But whoever takes a bath, bath is better.”
hadiths.body: “Whoever performs ablution on Friday, it is well and good for him, and he has done what is obligatory for him. But whoever takes a bath, bath is better.”
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ لِلْجُمُعَةِ فَبِهَا وَنِعْمَتْ وَمَنِ اغْتَسَلَ فَالْغُسْلُ أَفْضَلُ»
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ أَنْبَأَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1582

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالْغُسْلِ وَالطِّيبِ فِيهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Friday and Washing and Perfuming on It

hadiths.englishRaw: From Salman al-Farsi, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever performs Ghusl on the day of Jumu'ah (Friday) and purifies himself as much as he can, and then applies perfume from his own perfume or from the perfume of his house, then goes and does not separate between two people, and performs what is prescribed for him, then when the Imam comes out, he remains silent, he will be forgiven for what is between him and the next Jumu'ah (Friday)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Salman al-Farsi, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever performs Ghusl on the day of Jumu'ah (Friday) and purifies himself as much as he can, and then applies perfume from his own perfume or from the perfume of his house, then goes and does not separate between two people, and performs what is prescribed for him, then when the Imam comes out, he remains silent, he will be forgiven for what is between him and the next Jumu'ah (Friday)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ صَاحِبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنِ اغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَتَطَهَّرَ بِمَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ طُهْرٍ ثُمَّ ادَّهَنَ مِنْ دُهْنِهِ أَوْ مَسَّ مِنْ طِيبِ بَيْتِهِ ثُمَّ رَاحَ فَلَمْ يُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَ اثْنَيْنِ وَصَلَّى مَا كُتِبَ لَهُ فَإِذَا خَرَجَ الْإِمَامُ أَنْصَتَ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجُمُعَةِ الْأُخْرَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Maqburī from his father \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. And Dīʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَدِيعَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1583

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Reading in the Friday dawn prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to recite: The revelation of the Book and; 'Has there not been over man.' in Subh prayer on Friday.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to recite: The revelation of the Book and; 'Has there not been over man.' in Subh prayer on Friday.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَقْرَأُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي صَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةَ وَهَلْ أَتَى عَلَى الْإِنْسَانِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Hurmuz \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1584

chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of migration to Friday

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The one who rushes to Friday prayer is like a slaughtered goat, then the one who comes after him is like a slaughtered cow, then the one who comes after him is like a slaughtered sheep. When the Imam sits on the pulpit, the records are folded and they sit to listen to the reminder."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The one who rushes to Friday prayer is like a slaughtered goat, then the one who comes after him is like a slaughtered cow, then the one who comes after him is like a slaughtered sheep. When the Imam sits on the pulpit, the records are folded and they sit to listen to the reminder."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْمُتَعَجِّلُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ كَالْمُهْدِي جَزُورًا ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ كَالْمُهْدِي بَقَرَةً ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ كَالْمُهْدِي شَاةً فَإِذَا جَلَسَ الْإِمَامُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ طُوِيَتِ الصُّحُفُ وَجَلَسُوا يَسْتَمِعُونَ الذِّكْرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1585

chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of migration to Friday

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said, "When it is the day of Friday, the angels sit at the doors of the mosque and write down those who come for the Friday prayer. When the Imam (leader) comes out, they fold their sheets and listen to the reminder."
hadiths.body: Narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ said, "When it is the day of Friday, the angels sit at the doors of the mosque and write down those who come for the Friday prayer. When the Imam (leader) comes out, they fold their sheets and listen to the reminder."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْأَغَرِّ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ صَاحِبِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ قَعَدَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ عَلَى أَبْوَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَكَتَبُوا مَنْ جَاءَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ فَإِذَا رَاحَ الْإِمَامُ طَوَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ الصُّحُفَ وَدَخَلَتْ تَسْتَمِعُ الذِّكْرَ»
hadiths.chain: Naṣr b. ʿAlī \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e al-Aghar Abū ʿAbdullāh Ṣāḥib Abū Hurayrah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1586

chapter.englishTitle: On Friday.

hadiths.englishRaw: "We used to pray with the Prophet ﷺ on Fridays, then we would return and rush to find shade in the valleys of Bani Ghanim, where there was nothing but the impressions of our feet."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: "We used to pray with the Prophet ﷺ on Fridays, then we would return and rush to find shade in the valleys of Bani Ghanim, where there was nothing but the impressions of our feet."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ الْجُمُعَةَ ثُمَّ نَرْجِعُ فَنُبَادِرُ الظِّلَّ فِي أُطُمِ بَنِي غَنْمٍ فَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا مَوَاضِعُ أَقْدَامِنَا»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e Muslim b. Jundub \u003e al-Zubayr b. al-ʿAwwām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ عَنْ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1587

chapter.englishTitle: On Friday.

hadiths.englishRaw: We used to offer the Friday prayer along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and return (to our homes) while no shade of the walls was seen (at that time).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We used to offer the Friday prayer along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and return (to our homes) while no shade of the walls was seen (at that time).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نُصَلِّي مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْجُمُعَةَ ثُمَّ نَنْصَرِفُ وَلَيْسَ لِلْحِيطَانِ فَيْءٌ نَسْتَظَلُّ بِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān b. Muslim \u003e Yaʿlá b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Iyās b. Salamah b. al-Akwaʿ from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِيَاسَ بْنَ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1588

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الِاسْتِمَاعِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ عِنْدَ الْخُطْبَةِ وَالْإِنْصَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In listening on Friday during the sermon and attentiveness...

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Al-As'ath Al-San'aani, narrated from Aws bin Aws, who narrated from the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , that he said, "Whoever performs ghusl (ritual washing) and takes a bath on the day of Friday, then goes early and sits close to the imam (leader of prayer), listens attentively, and does not engage in idle talk until the imam finishes the prayer, will receive the reward of fasting and praying the whole year for every step he takes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Al-As'ath Al-San'aani, narrated from Aws bin Aws, who narrated from the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , that he said, "Whoever performs ghusl (ritual washing) and takes a bath on the day of Friday, then goes early and sits close to the imam (leader of prayer), listens attentively, and does not engage in idle talk until the imam finishes the prayer, will receive the reward of fasting and praying the whole year for every step he takes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ يَرُدُّهُ إِلَى أَوْسِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ يَرُدُّهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ غَسَّلَ وَاغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ ثُمَّ غَدَا وَابْتَكَرَ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ قَرِيبًا مِنَ الْإِمَامِ وَأَنْصَتَ وَلَمْ يَلْغُ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ الْإِمَامُ كَانَ لَهُ بِكُلِّ خُطْوَةٍ يَخْطُوهَا كَعَمَلِ سَنَةٍ صِيَامِهَا وَقِيَامِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Ṣadaqah \u003e Ibn Khālid \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ هُوَ ابْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1589

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الِاسْتِمَاعِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ عِنْدَ الْخُطْبَةِ وَالْإِنْصَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In listening on Friday during the sermon and attentiveness...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If you say to your companion: 'Be quiet and listen' when the imam is delivering the Khutbah, you have engaged in idle speech."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If you say to your companion: 'Be quiet and listen' when the imam is delivering the Khutbah, you have engaged in idle speech."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ أَنْصِتْ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1590

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الِاسْتِمَاعِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ عِنْدَ الْخُطْبَةِ وَالْإِنْصَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In listening on Friday during the sermon and attentiveness...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If you say to your companion: 'Be quiet and listen' when the imam is delivering the Khutbah, you have engaged in idle speech."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If you say to your companion: 'Be quiet and listen' when the imam is delivering the Khutbah, you have engaged in idle speech."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قُلْتَ لِصَاحِبِكَ أَنْصِتْ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ فَقَدْ لَغَوْتَ   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1591

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الِاسْتِمَاعِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ عِنْدَ الْخُطْبَةِ وَالْإِنْصَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In listening on Friday during the sermon and attentiveness...

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ , like him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ , like him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1592

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: The following heading translates to: "Who entered the mosque on ...

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ said, "If one of you comes while the imam is delivering the sermon or has already left, then let them pray two units (rak'ahs)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ said, "If one of you comes while the imam is delivering the sermon or has already left, then let them pray two units (rak'ahs)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا جَاءَ أَحَدُكُمْ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ أَوْ قَدْ خَرَجَ فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1593

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: The following heading translates to: "Who entered the mosque on ...

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Saeed and Marwan came to propose, so he stood up to pray two units of prayer. Then the guards came and prevented him, so he said, "I would not abandon them when I had seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordering them."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Saeed and Marwan came to propose, so he stood up to pray two units of prayer. Then the guards came and prevented him, so he said, "I would not abandon them when I had seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordering them."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ وَمَرْوَانُ يَخْطُبُ فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَأَتَاهُ الْحَرَسُ يَمْنَعُونَهُ فَقَالَ «مَا كُنْتُ أَتْرُكُهُمَا وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْمُرُ بِهِمَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Ṣadaqah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e ʿIyāḍ b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1594

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
chapter.englishTitle: The following heading translates to: "Who entered the mosque on ...

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw Al-Hassan praying two units of prayer while the imam was delivering a sermon.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I saw Al-Hassan praying two units of prayer while the imam was delivering a sermon.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ الْحَسَنَ «يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Rabīʿ \u003e Ibn Ṣabīḥ al-Baṣrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ هُوَ ابْنُ صَبِيحٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1595

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي قِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In reading the Quran in the Friday sermon.

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic text into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us one day, and he recited Surah (chapter) Sajdah. When he reached the verse of prostration, he descended and performed the prostration."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic text into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to us one day, and he recited Surah (chapter) Sajdah. When he reached the verse of prostration, he descended and performed the prostration."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: «خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمًا فَقَرَأَ ص فَلَمَّا مَرَّ بِالسَّجْدَةِ نَزَلَ فَسَجَدَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Khālid / Ibn Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Hilāl \u003e ʿIyāḍ b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ أَخْبَرَنِي خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ يَزِيدَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1596

chapter.englishTitle: The Speech in the Sermon

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah say, "A man entered the mosque on Friday, while the Prophet ﷺ was giving a sermon. The man was asked, 'Did you pray?' He replied, 'No.' The Prophet then said, 'Pray two units of prayer (Rak'ah).' Abu Muhammad said, 'I also say the same.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Jabir ibn Abdullah say, "A man entered the mosque on Friday, while the Prophet ﷺ was giving a sermon. The man was asked, 'Did you pray?' He replied, 'No.' The Prophet then said, 'Pray two units of prayer (Rak'ah).' Abu Muhammad said, 'I also say the same.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ الْمَسْجِدَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ «أَصَلَّيْتَ؟» قَالَ لَا قَالَ «فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «أَقُولُ بِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1597

chapter.englishTitle: In the palace of the sermon

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Indeed, the length of a man's prayer and the brevity of his sermon are indicative of his understanding of the religion, so prolong your prayers and shorten your sermons, for surely, eloquence lies in clear expression."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Indeed, the length of a man's prayer and the brevity of his sermon are indicative of his understanding of the religion, so prolong your prayers and shorten your sermons, for surely, eloquence lies in clear expression."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «إِنَّ طُولَ صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ وَقِصَرَ خُطْبَتِهِ مَئِنَّةٌ مِنْ فِقْهِهِ فَأَطِيلُوا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ وَاقْصُرُوا هَذِهِ الْخُطَبَ فَإِنَّ مِنَ الْبَيَانِ لسِحْرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-ʿAlāʾ b. ʿUṣaym al-Juʿfī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abjar \u003e Abū ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abjar \u003e Wāṣil b. Ḥayyān \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e Khaṭabanā ʿAmmār b. Yāsir Faʾablagh And ʾAwjaz Faqulnā Yā Abū al-Yaqẓān Law Kunt Tnaffast Shayʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْعَلَاءُ بْنُ عُصَيْمٍ الْجُعْفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبْجَرَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبْجَرَ عَنْ وَاصِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ فَأَبْلَغَ وَأَوْجَزَ فَقُلْنَا يَا أَبَا الْيَقْظَانِ لَوْ كُنْتَ تنَفَّسْتَ شَيْئًا؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1598

chapter.englishTitle: In the palace of the sermon

hadiths.englishRaw: "I used to pray with the Prophet ﷺ and his prayer was moderate in length and his Khutbah was moderate in length."     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "I used to pray with the Prophet ﷺ and his prayer was moderate in length and his Khutbah was moderate in length."     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَكَانَتْ صَلَاتُهُ قَصْدًا وَخُطْبَتُهُ قَصْدًا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e Simāk \u003e Jābir b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1599

chapter.englishTitle: Sitting between the sermons

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver two khutbahs standing, and he would separate them by sitting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to deliver two khutbahs standing, and he would separate them by sitting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَخْطُبُ خُطْبَتَيْنِ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ وَكَانَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمَا بِجُلُوسٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Bishr b. al-Mufaḍḍal \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1600

chapter.englishTitle: Sitting between the sermons

hadiths.englishRaw: The Apostle of Allah ﷺ gave two sermons between which he sat, recited the Qur'an and exhorted the people.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Apostle of Allah ﷺ gave two sermons between which he sat, recited the Qur'an and exhorted the people.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَتْ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ خُطْبَتَانِ يَجْلِسُ بَيْنَهُمَا يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَيُذَكِّرُ النَّاسَ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e Simāk \u003e Jābir b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1601

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ يُشِيرُ الْإِمَامُ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ؟
chapter.englishTitle: How does the imam indicate in the sermon?

hadiths.englishRaw: "May Allah disfigure these hands, for I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the pulpit and he used to point with only his finger."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "May Allah disfigure these hands, for I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the pulpit and he used to point with only his finger."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَبَّحَ اللَّهُ هَاتَيْنِ الْيَدَيْنِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَمَا يُشِيرُ إِلَّا بِإُصْبُعِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Zubayd \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e Raʾá ʿUmārah b. Rūwaybah Bishr b. Marwān \u003e al-Minbar Rāfiʿ Yadayh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ قَالَ رَأَى عُمَارَةُ بْنُ رُوَيْبَةَ بِشْرَ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1602

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ يُشِيرُ الْإِمَامُ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ؟
chapter.englishTitle: How does the imam indicate in the sermon?

hadiths.englishRaw: "And he said, 'I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the pulpit, and he does not say anything with his finger except like this, and he pointed with his index finger at his side.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "And he said, 'I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on the pulpit, and he does not say anything with his finger except like this, and he pointed with his index finger at his side.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ «لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَمَا يَقُولُ بِأُصْبُعِهِ إِلَّا هَكَذَا وَأَشَارَ بِالسَّبَّابَةِ عِنْدَ الْخَاصِرَةِ »   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ḥuṣayn b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿUmārah b. Rūwaybah \u003e Raʾá Bishr b. Marwān Rāfiʿ Yadayh Yadʿū \u003e al-Minbar Yawm al-Jumuʿah \u003e Fasabbah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ حُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ رُوَيْبَةَ قَالَ رَأَى بِشْرَ بْنَ مَرْوَانَ رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ يَدْعُو عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ فَسَبَّهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1603

chapter.englishTitle: The Place of the Imam When He Delivers a Sermon

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to lean against a trunk before the pulpit was set up. When the pulpit was set up, he missed that trunk and we heard him longing for it. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on it and tranquility prevailed.   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to lean against a trunk before the pulpit was set up. When the pulpit was set up, he missed that trunk and we heard him longing for it. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on it and tranquility prevailed.   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُومُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُجْعَلَ الْمِنْبَرُ فَلَمَّا جُعِلَ الْمِنْبَرُ حَنَّ ذَلِكَ الْجِذْعُ حَتَّى سَمِعْنَا حَنِينَهُ فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَسَكَنَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Sulaymān b. Kathīr \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1604

chapter.englishTitle: The Place of the Imam When He Delivers a Sermon

hadiths.englishRaw: “If I had not embraced it, it would have continued to grieve until the Day of Resurrection.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “If I had not embraced it, it would have continued to grieve until the Day of Resurrection.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَخْطُبُ إِلَى جِذْعٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ الْمِنْبَرَ فَلَمَّا اتَّخَذَ الْمِنْبَرَ تَحَوَّلَ إِلَيْهِ حَنَّ الْجِذْعُ فَاحْتَضَنَهُ فَسَكَنَ وَقَالَ «لَوْ لَمْ أَحْتَضِنْهُ لَحَنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAmmār b. Abū ʿAmmār \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1605

chapter.englishTitle: The Place of the Imam When He Delivers a Sermon

hadiths.englishRaw: "Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, he is like him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, he is like him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1606

chapter.englishTitle: The Place of the Imam When He Delivers a Sermon

hadiths.englishRaw: The people in the city increased, causing the man to come and the people to come, and they could hardly hear the words of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before they returned from him. The people said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, the people have increased, and the one coming cannot hardly hear your words." He said, "So what do you want?" So he sent to a boy of the Ansar, a carpenter's wife, and to the outskirts of the forest, and they made for him two or three pulpits. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would sit on them and deliver his sermon. When they did that, the wooden plank on which he used to stand softened. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and placed his hand on it, and it became still.   – Sound
hadiths.body: The people in the city increased, causing the man to come and the people to come, and they could hardly hear the words of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before they returned from him. The people said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, the people have increased, and the one coming cannot hardly hear your words." He said, "So what do you want?" So he sent to a boy of the Ansar, a carpenter's wife, and to the outskirts of the forest, and they made for him two or three pulpits. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would sit on them and deliver his sermon. When they did that, the wooden plank on which he used to stand softened. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and placed his hand on it, and it became still.   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كَثُرَ النَّاسُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ جَعَلَ الرَّجُلُ يَجِيءُ وَالْقَوْمُ يَجِيئُونَ فَلَا يَكَادُونَ ْ يَسْمَعُون كَلَامَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى يَرْجِعُوا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّاسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ كَثُرُوا وَإِنَّ الْجَائِيَ يَجِيءُ فَلَا يَكَادُ يَسْمَعُ كَلَامَكَ قَالَ «فَمَا شِئْتُمْ» فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَى غُلَامٍ لِامْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ نَجَّارٍ وَإِلَى طَرْفَاءِ الْغَابَةِ فَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِرْقَاتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ وَيَخْطُبُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ حَنَّتِ الْخَشَبَةُ الَّتِي كَانَ يَقُومُ عِنْدَهَا فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَيْهَا فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَسَكَنَتْ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd \u003e Lammā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ لَمَّا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1607

chapter.englishTitle: Reading in Friday prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: What did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited on Friday after reciting the Surah al-Jumu'ah (62). He replied: He used to recite, "Had the story of overwhelming event reached you ?" (88).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: What did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited on Friday after reciting the Surah al-Jumu'ah (62). He replied: He used to recite, "Had the story of overwhelming event reached you ?" (88).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الضَّحَّاكَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ سَأَلَ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ مَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقْرَأُ فِى يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ عَلَى إِثْرِ سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ؟ قَالَ «هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ḍamrah b. Saʿīd al-Māzinī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْمَازِنِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1608

chapter.englishTitle: Reading in Friday prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: We asked him what the Prophet ﷺ used to recite on Fridays along with the Surah in which the Friday is mentioned. He said, "He used to recite it along with the Surah Al-Ghashiyah."   – Sound Chain
