hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَعَمِّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1730

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُقَالُ عِنْدَ رُؤْيَةِ الْهِلَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: The phrase said upon sighting the crescent moon.

hadiths.englishRaw: ʿO Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and with soundness and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.”    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: ʿO Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, and with soundness and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.”    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا رَأَى الْهِلَالَ قَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Rifāʿī And ʾIsḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e al-ʿAqadī \u003e Sulaymān b. Sufyān al-Madanī \u003e Bilāl b. Yaḥyá b. Ṭalḥah from his father \u003e Ṭalḥah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا الْعَقَدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ الْمَدَنِيُّ عَنْ بِلَالِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1731

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ التَّقَدُّمِ فِي الصِّيَامِ قَبْلَ الرُّؤْيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of advancing in fasting before sighting

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Do not anticipate Ramadan by fasting one or two days before, except for a man who has a habitual pattern of fasting, in which case let him fast.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ‘Do not anticipate Ramadan by fasting one or two days before, except for a man who has a habitual pattern of fasting, in which case let him fast.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَقَدَّمُوا قَبْلَ رَمَضَانَ يَوْمًا وَلَا يَوْمَيْنِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ رَجُلًا كَانَ يَصُومُ صَوْمًا فَلْيَصُمْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1732

chapter.englishTitle: The month is twenty-nine.

hadiths.englishRaw: The month of Ramadan may consist of twenty-nine days. So do not fast till you have sighted it (the new moon) and do not break fast, till you have sighted it (the new moon of Shawwal), and if the sky is cloudy for you, then calculate.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The month of Ramadan may consist of twenty-nine days. So do not fast till you have sighted it (the new moon) and do not break fast, till you have sighted it (the new moon of Shawwal), and if the sky is cloudy for you, then calculate.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا الشَّهْرُ تِسْعٌ وَعِشْرُونَ فَلَا تَصُومُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْهُ وَلَا تُفْطِرُوا حَتَّى تَرَوْهُ فَإِنْ غُمَّ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْدُرُوا لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1733

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الشَّهَادَةِ عَلَى رُؤْيَةِ هِلَالِ رَمَضَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: The testimony of sighting the crescent moon of Ramadan.

hadiths.englishRaw: The people looked for the moon, so I informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that I had sighted it. He fasted and commanded the people to fast.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The people looked for the moon, so I informed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ that I had sighted it. He fasted and commanded the people to fast.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَرَاءَى النَّاسُ الْهِلَالَ فَأَخْبَرْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ فَصَامَ وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ بِالصِّيَامِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Wahb \u003e Yaḥyá b. Sālim \u003e Abū Bakr b. Nāfiʿ from his father \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1734

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الشَّهَادَةِ عَلَى رُؤْيَةِ هِلَالِ رَمَضَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: The testimony of sighting the crescent moon of Ramadan.

hadiths.englishRaw: A bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: I have sighted the moon. Al-Hasan added in his version: that is, of Ramadan. He asked: Do you testify that there is no god but Allah? He replied: Yes. He again asked: Do you testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? He replied: Yes. and he testified that he had sighted the moon. He said: Bilal, announce to the people that they must fast tomorrow.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: A bedouin came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: I have sighted the moon. Al-Hasan added in his version: that is, of Ramadan. He asked: Do you testify that there is no god but Allah? He replied: Yes. He again asked: Do you testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah? He replied: Yes. and he testified that he had sighted the moon. He said: Bilal, announce to the people that they must fast tomorrow.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقَالَ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ الْهِلَالَ فَقَالَ «أَتَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «يَا بِلَالُ نَادِ فِي النَّاسِ فَلْيَصُومُوا غَدًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿIṣmah b. al-Faḍl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنِي عِصْمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْجُعْفِيُّ عَنْ زَائِدَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1735

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَتَى يُمْسِكُ الْمُتَسَحِّرُ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: When does the person observing "al-Mutsahhir" stop eating and dr...

hadiths.englishRaw: It was the custom among the companions of Muhammad that if any of them was fasting and the food was presented (for breaking his fast), but he slept before eating, he would not eat that night and the following day till sunset. Qais bin Sirma-al-Ansari was fasting and came to his wife at the time of Iftar (breaking one's fast) and asked her whether she had anything to eat. She replied, "No, but I would go and bring some for you." He used to do hard work during the day, so he was overwhelmed by sleep and slept. When his wife came and saw him, she said, "Disappointment for you." When it was midday on the following day, he fainted and the Prophet ﷺ was informed about the whole matter and the following verses were revealed: "You are permitted To go to your wives (for sexual relation) At the night of fasting." So, they were overjoyed by it. And then Allah also revealed: "And eat and drink Until the white thread Of dawn appears to you Distinct from the black thread (of the night)." (2.187)
hadiths.body: It was the custom among the companions of Muhammad that if any of them was fasting and the food was presented (for breaking his fast), but he slept before eating, he would not eat that night and the following day till sunset. Qais bin Sirma-al-Ansari was fasting and came to his wife at the time of Iftar (breaking one's fast) and asked her whether she had anything to eat. She replied, "No, but I would go and bring some for you." He used to do hard work during the day, so he was overwhelmed by sleep and slept. When his wife came and saw him, she said, "Disappointment for you." When it was midday on the following day, he fainted and the Prophet ﷺ was informed about the whole matter and the following verses were revealed: "You are permitted To go to your wives (for sexual relation) At the night of fasting." So, they were overjoyed by it. And then Allah also revealed: "And eat and drink Until the white thread Of dawn appears to you Distinct from the black thread (of the night)." (2.187)
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ أَصْحَابُ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ إِذَا كَانَ الرَّجُلُ صَائِمًا فَحَضَرَ الْإِفْطَارُ فَنَامَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ لَيْلَتَهُ وَلَا يَوْمَهُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ»
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Barāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1736

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَتَى يُمْسِكُ الْمُتَسَحِّرُ عَنِ الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: When does the person observing "al-Mutsahhir" stop eating and dr...

hadiths.englishRaw: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have placed a white thread and a black thread under my pillow, but I cannot distinguish between them." He said, "You have a wide bedspread, and that night is part of the day, as Allah says, 'And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread. Then complete the fast until the night.' And do not approach them while you are in seclusion in the mosques. These are the limits set by Allah, so do not come near them.' Thus Allah makes clear His signs to the people that they may fear Him."
hadiths.body: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have placed a white thread and a black thread under my pillow, but I cannot distinguish between them." He said, "You have a wide bedspread, and that night is part of the day, as Allah says, 'And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread. Then complete the fast until the night.' And do not approach them while you are in seclusion in the mosques. These are the limits set by Allah, so do not come near them.' Thus Allah makes clear His signs to the people that they may fear Him."
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ جَعَلْتُ تَحْتَ وِسَادَتِي خَيْطًا أَبْيَضَ وَخَيْطًا أَسْوَدَ فَمَا تَبَيَّنَ لِي شَيْءٌ قَالَ «إِنَّكَ لَعَرِيضُ الْوِسَادِ وَإِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ اللَّيْلُ مِنَ النَّهَارِ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى» {وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أَتِّمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ وَلَا تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنْتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهَا كَذَالِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتُّقُونَ}
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Sharīk \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAdī b. Ḥātim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1737

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ السُّحُورِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended from delaying suhoor?

hadiths.englishRaw: “We ate Suhur with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ then we got up to perform prayer.” I said: “How long was there between the two?” He said: “As long as it takes to recite fifty verses.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “We ate Suhur with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ then we got up to perform prayer.” I said: “How long was there between the two?” He said: “As long as it takes to recite fifty verses.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَسَحَّرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ» قَالَ «ثُمَّ قَامَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ كَمْ كَانَ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَبَيْنَ السُّحُورِ؟ قَالَ «قَدْرُ قِرَاءَةِ خَمْسِينَ آيَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hishām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1738

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of suhoor.

hadiths.englishRaw: “Eat Suhur, for in Suhur there is a blessing.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Eat Suhur, for in Suhur there is a blessing.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تَسَحَّرُوا فَإِنَّ فِي السُّحُورِ بَرَكَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Ṣuhayb \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1739

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of suhoor.

hadiths.englishRaw: "To prepare food for him, so that he could have his pre-dawn meal without being affected greatly by it. We said to him: 'Command us to prepare it for you and it will not affect you much.' He replied: 'I will not command you to do that, for I desire it, but I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'The difference between our fast and the fast of the people of the Book is eating a meal before dawn.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To prepare food for him, so that he could have his pre-dawn meal without being affected greatly by it. We said to him: 'Command us to prepare it for you and it will not affect you much.' He replied: 'I will not command you to do that, for I desire it, but I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: 'The difference between our fast and the fast of the people of the Book is eating a meal before dawn.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ نَصْنَعَ لَهُ الطَّعَامَ يَتَسَحَّرُ بِهِ فَلَا يُصِيبُ مِنْهُ كَثِيرًا فَقُلْنَا لَهُ تَأْمُرُنَا بِهِ وَلَا تُصِيبُ مِنْهُ كَثِيرًا؟ قَالَ إِنِّي لَا آمُرُكُمْ بِهِ أَنِّي أَشْتَهِيهِ وَلَكِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «فَصْلُ مَا بَيْنَ صِيَامِنَا وَصِيَامِ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ أَكْلَةُ السَّحَرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUlay \u003e Abū \u003e Abū Qays a freed slave of ʿAmr b. al-ʿĀṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَيٍّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ قَالَ كَانَ عَمْرُو بْنُ الْعَاصِ يَأْمُرُنَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1740
hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said, "Whoever does not begin fasting before dawn, then there is no fasting for them." Abdullah said regarding the obligatory duty, "I say about it."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, he said, "Whoever does not begin fasting before dawn, then there is no fasting for them." Abdullah said regarding the obligatory duty, "I say about it."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ لَمْ يُبَيِّتِ الصِّيَامَ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ فَلَا صِيَامَ لَهُ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ فِي فَرْضِ الْوَاجِبِ «أَقُولُ بِهِ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Shuraḥbīl \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ayyūb \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr \u003e Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Ḥafṣah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1741

chapter.englishTitle: In the rush of breaking the fast

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The people will remain on the right path as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The people will remain on the right path as long as they hasten the breaking of the fast."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَزَالُ النَّاسُ بِخَيْرٍ مَا عَجَّلُوا الْفِطْرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān al-Thawrī \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1742

chapter.englishTitle: In the rush of breaking the fast

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:“When night comes and day departs, and the sun sets, then (it is time to) break your fast.ʿ    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:“When night comes and day departs, and the sun sets, then (it is time to) break your fast.ʿ    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا أَقْبَلَ اللَّيْلُ وَأَدْبَرَ النَّهَارُ وَغَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَفْطَرْتَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀṣim b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1743

chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended for Suhoor?

hadiths.englishRaw: "When any one of you breaks his fast, let him break it with dates. If he cannot find dates, then let him break it with water, for it is a means of purification."     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "When any one of you breaks his fast, let him break it with dates. If he cannot find dates, then let him break it with water, for it is a means of purification."     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أَفْطَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيُفْطِرْ عَلَى تَمْرٍ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَلْيُفْطِرْ عَلَى مَاءٍ فَإِنَّ الْمَاءَ طَهُورٌ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Thābit b. Yazīd \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥafṣah \u003e al-Rabāb al-Ḍabbiyyah from her uncle Salmān b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ عَنْ الرَّبَابِ الضَّبِّيَّةِ عَنْ عَمِّهَا سَلْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1744

chapter.englishTitle: The reward is for the one who breaks their fast

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Whoever feeds a fasting person will have a reward equal to theirs, without diminishing the reward of the fasting person."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Whoever feeds a fasting person will have a reward equal to theirs, without diminishing the reward of the fasting person."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ فَطَّرَ صَائِمًا كُتِبَ لَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِهِ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَا يَنْقُصُ مِنْ أَجْرِ الصَّائِمِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Zayd b. Khālid al-Juhanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1745

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فِي الصَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of intimacy during fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Beware of excessive attachment (to worldly things)." They asked, "But you, O Messenger of Allah, are continuously connected to such things." He replied, "Indeed, I am not like you. I spend the night while my Lord feeds me and quenches my thirst."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Beware of excessive attachment (to worldly things)." They asked, "But you, O Messenger of Allah, are continuously connected to such things." He replied, "Indeed, I am not like you. I spend the night while my Lord feeds me and quenches my thirst."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْوِصَالَ» مَرَّتَيْنِ قَالُوا فَإِنَّكَ تُوَاصِلُ قَالَ «إِنِّي لَسْتُ مِثْلَكُمْ إِنِّي أَبِيتُ يُطْعِمُنِي رَبِّي وَيَسْقِينِي»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1746

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فِي الصَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of intimacy during fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not continue." It was said, "Indeed, you do that." He said, "I am not like any one of you. I am fed and provided with drink."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not continue." It was said, "Indeed, you do that." He said, "I am not like any one of you. I am fed and provided with drink."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تُوَاصِلُوا» قِيلَ إِنَّكَ تَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «إِنِّي لَسْتُ كَأَحَدِكُمْ إِنِّي أُطْعَمُ وَأُسْقَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1747

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فِي الصَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of intimacy during fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Do not observe perpetual fasting. If any of you wants to observe perpetual fast, he should observe it until the dawn. They (the people) asked: You observe perpetual fast ? He replied: My position is not like that of yours. There is One Who gives me to eat, and there is One who gives me to drink.     – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Do not observe perpetual fasting. If any of you wants to observe perpetual fast, he should observe it until the dawn. They (the people) asked: You observe perpetual fast ? He replied: My position is not like that of yours. There is One Who gives me to eat, and there is One who gives me to drink.     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَا تُوَاصِلُوا فَأَيُّكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُوَاصِلَ فَلْيُوَاصِلْ إِلَى السَّحَرِ» قَالُوا إِنَّكَ تُوَاصِلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «إِنِّي أَبِيتُ لِي مُطْعِمٌ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِي»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Khabbāb \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خَبَّابٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1748

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فِي الصَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of intimacy during fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Al-Wisal in fasting. So, one of the Muslims said to him, "But you practice Al- Wisal. O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Who amongst you is similar to me? I am given food and drink during my sleep by my Lord." So, when the people refused to stop Al-Wisal (fasting continuously), the Prophet ﷺ fasted day and night continuously along with them for a day and then another day and then they saw the crescent moon (of the month of Shawwal). The Prophet ﷺ said to them (angrily), "If It (the crescent) had not appeared, I would have made you fast for a longer period." That was as a punishment for them when they refused to stop (practicing Al-Wisal).    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Al-Wisal in fasting. So, one of the Muslims said to him, "But you practice Al- Wisal. O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Who amongst you is similar to me? I am given food and drink during my sleep by my Lord." So, when the people refused to stop Al-Wisal (fasting continuously), the Prophet ﷺ fasted day and night continuously along with them for a day and then another day and then they saw the crescent moon (of the month of Shawwal). The Prophet ﷺ said to them (angrily), "If It (the crescent) had not appeared, I would have made you fast for a longer period." That was as a punishment for them when they refused to stop (practicing Al-Wisal).    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَإِنَّكَ تُوَاصِلُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنِّي لَسْتُ مِثْلَكُمْ إِنِّي أَبِيتُ يُطْعِمُنِي رَبِّي وَيَسْقِينِي» فَلَمَّا أَبَوْا أَنْ يَنْتَهُوا عَنِ الْوِصَالِ وَاصَلَ بِهِمْ يَوْمًا ثُمَّ يَوْمًا ثُمَّ رَأَوْا الْهِلَالَ فَقَالَ «لَوْ تَأَخَّرَ لَزِدْتُكُمْ» كَالْمُنَكِّلِ لَهُمْ حِينَ أَبَوْا أَنْ يَنْتَهُوا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1749

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فِي الصَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of intimacy during fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out during the year of the conquest and he fasted. The people also fasted until reaching al-Qadeed (a place). Then, he broke his fast and the people broke their fast. They used to follow the latest action of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out during the year of the conquest and he fasted. The people also fasted until reaching al-Qadeed (a place). Then, he broke his fast and the people broke their fast. They used to follow the latest action of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ فَصَامَ وَصَامَ النَّاسُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْكَدِيدَ ثُمَّ أَفْطَرَ فَأَفْطَرَ النَّاسُ» فَكَانُوا يَأْخُذُونَ بِالْأَحْدَثِ فَالْأَحْدَثِ مِنْ فِعْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1750

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فِي الصَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of intimacy during fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ was traveling and saw a crowd, and there was a man sitting in the shade. He asked, "What is this?" They answered, "This is a fasting person." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Fasting while traveling is not from righteousness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ was traveling and saw a crowd, and there was a man sitting in the shade. He asked, "What is this?" They answered, "This is a fasting person." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Fasting while traveling is not from righteousness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَرَأَى زِحَامًا وَرَجُلٌ قَدْ ظُلِّلَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «مَا هَذَا؟» قَالُوا هَذَا صَائِمٌ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَيْسَ مِنَ الْبِرِّ الصَّوْمُ فِي السَّفَرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim And ʾAbū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Anṣārī \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. al-Ḥasan \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Dhakar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ وَأَبُو الْوَلِيدِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَسَنِ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1751

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فِي الصَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of intimacy during fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: "It is not righteousness to fast when traveling."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It is not righteousness to fast when traveling."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَيْسَ مِنَ الْبِرِّ الصِّيَامُ فِي السَّفَرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ṣafwān b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Um al-Dardāʾ \u003e Kaʿb b. ʿĀṣim al-Ashʿarī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الْأَشْعَرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1752

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْوِصَالِ فِي الصَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of intimacy during fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Fasting while traveling is not counted as an act of righteousness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Fasting while traveling is not counted as an act of righteousness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَيْسَ مِنَ الْبِرِّ الصِّيَامُ فِي السَّفَرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ṣafwān b. ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣafwān \u003e Um al-Dardāʾ \u003e Kaʿb b. ʿĀṣim al-Ashʿarī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ الْأَشْعَرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1753

chapter.englishTitle: The License for Travelers in Breakfast.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I came to the Messenger of Allah from a journey and greeted him with Salam. When I was going to leave he said: 'Stay and have meal for breakfast, O Abu Umayyah.' I said: 'I am fasting, O Prophet of Allah.' He said: 'Come and I will tell about the traveler. Allah, most high, has waived fasting and of the prayer for him."'     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I came to the Messenger of Allah from a journey and greeted him with Salam. When I was going to leave he said: 'Stay and have meal for breakfast, O Abu Umayyah.' I said: 'I am fasting, O Prophet of Allah.' He said: 'Come and I will tell about the traveler. Allah, most high, has waived fasting and of the prayer for him."'     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَدِمْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ سَفَرٍ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمَّا ذَهَبْتُ لِأَخْرُجَ قَالَ «انْتَظِرِ الْغَدَاءَ يَا أَبَا أُمَيَّةَ» قَالَ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ «تَعَالَ أُخْبِرْكَ عَنِ الْمُسَافِرِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَضَعَ عَنْهُ الصِّيَامَ وَنِصْفَ الصَّلَاةِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «إِنْ شَاءَ صَامَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَفْطَرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Muhājir \u003e Abū Umayyah al-Ḍamrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَاجِرِ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1754

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَتَى يُفْطِرُ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ يُرِيدُ السَّفَرَ
chapter.englishTitle: When does a man break his fast if he leaves his house intending ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I traveled with my father Abu Basrah al-Ghifari on a ship from Fustat during Ramadan. He paid and brought his lunch closer, then he said, 'Come closer.' I said, 'Don't you see the houses?' Abu Basrah replied, 'Did you deviate from the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "I traveled with my father Abu Basrah al-Ghifari on a ship from Fustat during Ramadan. He paid and brought his lunch closer, then he said, 'Come closer.' I said, 'Don't you see the houses?' Abu Basrah replied, 'Did you deviate from the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَكِبْتُ مَعَ أَبِي بَصْرَةَ الْغِفَارِيِّ سَفِينَةً مِنَ الْفُسْطَاطِ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَدَفَعَ فَقَرَّبَ غَدَاءَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ اقْتَرِبْ فَقُلْتُ أَلَسْتَ تَرَى الْبُيُوتَ؟ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَصْرَةَ «أَرَغِبْتَ عَنْ سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd al-Muqriʾ \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Ayyūb \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Kulayb b. Dhuhl al-Ḥaḍramī \u003e ʿUbayd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ أَنَّ كُلَيْبَ بْنَ ذُهْلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1755

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْمًا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّدًا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever breaks their fast during Ramadan intentionally for a day

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever breaks the fast during Ramadan without an allowance or illness, then if he fasted for all time, his fasting would not make up for it."     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: "Whoever breaks the fast during Ramadan without an allowance or illness, then if he fasted for all time, his fasting would not make up for it."     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْمًا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِ رُخْصَةٍ وَلَا مَرَضٍ فَلَنْ يَقْضِيَهُ صِيَامُ الدَّهْرِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ صَامَ الدَّهْرَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ḥabīb b. Abū Thābit \u003e ʿUmārah b. ʿUmayr \u003e Ibn al-Muṭawwis from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَارَةَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُطَوِّسِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1756

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْمًا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ مُتَعَمِّدًا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever breaks their fast during Ramadan intentionally for a day

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone breaks his fast one day in Ramadan without a concession granted to him by Allah, a perpetual fast will not atone for it.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone breaks his fast one day in Ramadan without a concession granted to him by Allah, a perpetual fast will not atone for it.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَفْطَرَ يَوْمًا مِنْ رَمَضَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِ رُخْصَةٍ رَخَّصَهَا اللَّهُ لَهُ لَمْ يَقْضِ عَنْهُ صِيَامُ الدَّهْرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ḥabīb b. Abū Thābit \u003e ʿUmārah b. ʿUmayr \u003e Abū al-Muṭawwis from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي حَبِيبُ بْنُ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَارَةَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُطَوِّسِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1757

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ نَهَارًا
chapter.englishTitle: During Ramadan, what happens to a woman during the day?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to a man and said, "Have you perished?" The man said, "What has caused my destruction?" He said, "I had sexual intercourse with my wife in the month of Ramadan." He said, "Then, free a slave." He said, "I cannot afford that." He said, "Then, fast two consecutive months." He said, "I am unable to do so." He said, "Then, feed sixty poor people." He said, "I cannot find them." Then, Allah's Messenger ﷺ was given a basket of dates, so he said, "Where is the questioner? Give this in charity." He said, "Shall I give it to someone poorer than my household, O Messenger of Allah?" By Allah, there is no household around us poorer than ours!" Then, Allah's Messenger ﷺ laughed until his molars were visible.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to a man and said, "Have you perished?" The man said, "What has caused my destruction?" He said, "I had sexual intercourse with my wife in the month of Ramadan." He said, "Then, free a slave." He said, "I cannot afford that." He said, "Then, fast two consecutive months." He said, "I am unable to do so." He said, "Then, feed sixty poor people." He said, "I cannot find them." Then, Allah's Messenger ﷺ was given a basket of dates, so he said, "Where is the questioner? Give this in charity." He said, "Shall I give it to someone poorer than my household, O Messenger of Allah?" By Allah, there is no household around us poorer than ours!" Then, Allah's Messenger ﷺ laughed until his molars were visible.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ هَلَكْتُ؟ فَقَالَ «وَمَا أَهْلَكَكَ؟» قَالَ وَاقَعْتُ امْرَأَتِي فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ «فَأَعْتِقْ رَقَبَةً» قَالَ لَيْسَ عِنْدِي قَالَ «فَصُمْ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ» قَالَ لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ قَالَ «فَأَطْعِمْ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا» قَالَ لَا أَجِدُ قَالَ فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِعَرَقٍ فِيهِ تَمْرٌ فَقَالَ «أَيْنَ السَّائِلُ؟ تَصَدَّقْ بِهَذَا» فَقَالَ أَعَلَى أَفْقَرَ مِنْ أَهْلِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا بَيْنَ لَابَتَيْهَا أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ أَفْقَرَ مِنَّا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَأَنْتُمْ إِذًا» وَضَحِكَ حَتَّى بَدَتْ أَنْيَابُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Dāwud al-Hāshimī \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1758

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ نَهَارًا
chapter.englishTitle: During Ramadan, what happens to a woman during the day?

hadiths.englishRaw: A man broke his fast in Ramadan, and he mentioned the saying.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man broke his fast in Ramadan, and he mentioned the saying.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَفْطَرَ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1759

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَقَعُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ نَهَارًا
chapter.englishTitle: During Ramadan, what happens to a woman during the day?

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard Aisha saying that a man asked the Prophet ﷺ and said that he had been burned. So, he asked him what happened to him? He said that his family got affected during Ramadan. The Prophet ﷺ was brought a container called "al-'araq" that contained dates, and he said, "Where is the one who was burned?" So, the man stood up and said, "Give this as charity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard Aisha saying that a man asked the Prophet ﷺ and said that he had been burned. So, he asked him what happened to him? He said that his family got affected during Ramadan. The Prophet ﷺ was brought a container called "al-'araq" that contained dates, and he said, "Where is the one who was burned?" So, the man stood up and said, "Give this as charity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ تَقُولُ إِنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَدِ احْتَرَقَ فَسَأَلَهُ مَا لَهُ؟ فَقَالَ أَصَابَ أَهْلَهُ فِي رَمَضَانَ فَأُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِمِكْتَلٍ يُدْعَى الْعَرَقَ فِيهِ تَمْرٌ فَقَالَ «أَيْنَ الْمُحْتَرِقُ؟» فَقَامَ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ «تَصَدَّقْ بِهَذَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá / Ibn Saʿīd al-Anṣārī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim \u003e Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿAbbād b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبَّادَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1760

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ صَوْمِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطَوُّعًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of a woman fasting voluntarily except with her h...

hadiths.englishRaw: It translates to: "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said to a woman, 'Do not fast without his permission.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: It translates to: "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said to a woman, 'Do not fast without his permission.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِامْرَأَةٍ «لَا تَصُومِي إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1761

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ صَوْمِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطَوُّعًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of a woman fasting voluntarily except with her h...

hadiths.englishRaw: “When her husband is present, no woman should fast any day apart from the month of Ramadan without his permission.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “When her husband is present, no woman should fast any day apart from the month of Ramadan without his permission.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَصُومُ الْمَرْأَةُ يَوْمًا تَطَوُّعًا فِي غَيْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَزَوْجُهَا شَاهِدٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1762

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ صَوْمِ الْمَرْأَةِ تَطَوُّعًا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of a woman fasting voluntarily except with her h...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: "A woman should not fast a day while her husband is present without his permission." He said, "In making vows, she fulfills them."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "A woman should not fast a day while her husband is present without his permission." He said, "In making vows, she fulfills them."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَصُومُ الْمَرْأَةُ يَوْمًا وَزَوْجُهَا شَاهِدٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ» قَالَ فِي النُّذُورِ تَفِي بِهَا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e Mūsá b. Abū ʿUthmān from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1763

chapter.englishTitle: License for Kissing During Fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while he was fasting." Urwah said, "Indeed, it does not call to anything good."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss while he was fasting." Urwah said, "Indeed, it does not call to anything good."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يُقَبِّلُ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ» فَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ أَمَا إِنَّهَا لَا تَدْعُو إِلَى خَيْرٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1764

chapter.englishTitle: License for Kissing During Fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss when he was fasting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to kiss when he was fasting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يُقَبِّلُهَا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿd b. Ḥafṣ al-Ṭalḥī \u003e Shaybān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ الطَّلْحِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1765

chapter.englishTitle: License for Kissing During Fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: "I had a dry throat, so I kissed while fasting. Then I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'I have done something great today; I kissed while fasting.' He asked, 'What if you had rinsed your mouth with water?' I replied, 'Then it would not have been harmful.' He said, 'Then do so.'"
hadiths.body: "I had a dry throat, so I kissed while fasting. Then I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'I have done something great today; I kissed while fasting.' He asked, 'What if you had rinsed your mouth with water?' I replied, 'Then it would not have been harmful.' He said, 'Then do so.'"
hadiths.arabic: هَشِشْتُ فَقَبَّلْتُ وَأَنَا صَائِمٌ فَجِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي صَنَعْتُ الْيَوْمَ أَمْرًا عَظِيمًا قَبَّلْتُ وَأَنَا صَائِمٌ قَالَ «أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ مَضْمَضْتَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ؟» قُلْتُ إِذًا لَا يَضُرُّ قَالَ «فَفِيمَ؟»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Bukayr b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ashaj \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. Saʿīd al-Anṣārī \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb \u003e Hashisht Faqabbalt
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1766

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ يُصْبِحُ جُنُبًا وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ الصَّوْمَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who wakes up in a state of impurity and intends to fast

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Prophet ﷺ would wake up in a state of Janaba (sexual impurity) from being with his spouse, and then he would fast."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Prophet ﷺ would wake up in a state of Janaba (sexual impurity) from being with his spouse, and then he would fast."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يُصْبِحُ جُنُبًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ ثُمَّ يَصُومُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik / Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Bakr from his father \u003e Um Salamah And ʿĀʾishah Akhbartāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ وَعَائِشَةَ أَخْبَرتَاهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1767

chapter.englishTitle: Who ate forgetfully

hadiths.englishRaw: If anyone forgets that he is fasting and eats or drinks he should complete his fast, for it is only Allah Who has fed him and given him drink.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: If anyone forgets that he is fasting and eats or drinks he should complete his fast, for it is only Allah Who has fed him and given him drink.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ نَسِيَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ فَأَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ فَإِنَّمَا أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ وَسَقَاهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Jarīr \u003e Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1768

chapter.englishTitle: Who ate forgetfully

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If any of you forgets and eats or drinks while fasting, let him complete his fast for it is Allah who has provided him with food and drink." Abu Muhammad said, "The people of Hijaz say he should make up for that day, but I say he should not."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If any of you forgets and eats or drinks while fasting, let him complete his fast for it is Allah who has provided him with food and drink." Abu Muhammad said, "The people of Hijaz say he should make up for that day, but I say he should not."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَوْ شَرِبَ نَاسِيًا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ فَلْيُتِمَّ صِيَامَهُ فَإِنَّمَا أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ وَسَقَاهُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد أَهْلُ الْحِجَازِ يَقُولُونَ يَقْضِي وَأَنَا أَقُولُ لَا يَقْضِي   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad b. Mihrān al-Jammāl \u003e Ḥātim b. Ismāʿīl \u003e al-Ḥārith b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Dhubāb from his uncle \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الْجَمَّالُ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي ذُبَابٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1769

chapter.englishTitle: Vomiting for the fasting person.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ was thirsty, so he drank." I met Thawban in the mosque of Damascus and mentioned it to him, so he said, "It is true, I poured water for him for ablution." Abdullah said, "When he was thirsty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ was thirsty, so he drank." I met Thawban in the mosque of Damascus and mentioned it to him, so he said, "It is true, I poured water for him for ablution." Abdullah said, "When he was thirsty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَاءَ فَأَفْطَرَ» قَالَ فَلَقِيتُ ثَوْبَانَ بِمَسْجِدِ دِمَشْقَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ أَنَا صَبَبْتُ لَهُ الْوَضُوءَ قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «إِذَا اسْتَقَاءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad b. ʿAbd al-Wārith from my father \u003e Ḥusayn al-Muʿallim \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaʿīsh b. al-Walīd from his father \u003e Maʿdān b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي حَدَّثَنِي حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ يَعِيشَ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1770

chapter.englishTitle: The License in it

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a fasting person vomits unintentionally, there is no need for them to make up the fast. But if they induce vomiting, they must make up the fast." 'Isa said, "The people of Basra claim that Hisham made a mistake regarding this issue, and the point of disagreement is here."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a fasting person vomits unintentionally, there is no need for them to make up the fast. But if they induce vomiting, they must make up the fast." 'Isa said, "The people of Basra claim that Hisham made a mistake regarding this issue, and the point of disagreement is here."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا ذَرَعَ الصَّائِمَ الْقَيْءُ وَهُوَ لَا يُرِيدُهُ فَلَا قَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا اسْتَقَاءَ فَعَلَيْهِ الْقَضَاءُ» قَالَ عِيسَى «زَعَمَ أَهْلُ الْبَصْرَةِ أَنَّ هِشَامًا أَوْهَمَ فِيهِ فَمَوْضِعُ الْخِلَافِ هَا هُنَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus \u003e Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1771

chapter.englishTitle: Hijama breaks the fast

hadiths.englishRaw: I accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during the eighteenth night of the month of Ramadan, and I saw a man shaving his head. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The one who is shaving his head and the one who has his head shaved have broken their fast."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during the eighteenth night of the month of Ramadan, and I saw a man shaving his head. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The one who is shaving his head and the one who has his head shaved have broken their fast."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَرَرْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي ثَمَانِ عَشْرَةَ خَلَتْ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَأَبْصَرَ رَجُلًا يَحْتَجِمُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَفْطَرَ الْحَاجِمُ وَالْمَحْجُومُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Abū al-Ashʿath al-Ṣanʿānī \u003e Abū Asmāʾ al-Raḥabī \u003e Shaddād b. Aws
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1772

chapter.englishTitle: Hijama breaks the fast

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was walking in Al-Baqi' when he saw a man getting cupping (hijama) done. He said, "The person getting cupping done and the person doing the cupping have broken their fast." Abu Muhammad said, "I fear getting cupping done while fasting in Ramadan."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was walking in Al-Baqi' when he saw a man getting cupping (hijama) done. He said, "The person getting cupping done and the person doing the cupping have broken their fast." Abu Muhammad said, "I fear getting cupping done while fasting in Ramadan."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَمْشِي بِالْبَقِيعِ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ يَحْتَجِمُ فَقَالَ «أَفْطَرَ الْحَاجِمُ وَالْمَحْجُومُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «أَنَا أَتَّقِي الْحِجَامَةَ فِي الصَّوْمِ فِي رَمَضَانَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū Asmāʾ al-Raḥabī \u003e Thawbān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ ثَوْبَانَ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1773

chapter.englishTitle: The fasting person backbites, thus breaking their fast.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Fasting is a shield as long as it is not break by backbiting.'" Abu Muhammad said, "He means by backbiting."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Fasting is a shield as long as it is not break by backbiting.'" Abu Muhammad said, "He means by backbiting."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «الصَّوْمُ جُنَّةٌ مَا لَمْ يَخْرِقْهَا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «يَعْنِي بِالْغِيبَةِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Wāṣil a freed slave of Abū ʿUyaynah \u003e Bashhār b. Abū Sayf \u003e al-Walīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿIyāḍ b. Ghuṭayf \u003e Abū ʿUbaydah b. al-Jarrāḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ وَاصِلٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ بَشَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي سَيْفٍ عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ غُطَيْفٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1774

chapter.englishTitle: Kohl for the fasting person

hadiths.englishRaw: My grandfather told me that the Prophet ﷺ wiped his head and said, "Do not apply kohl during the day when you are fasting. Apply kohl at night with antimony, as it clears the vision and promotes hair growth." Abu Muhammad said, "I do not see any harm in using kohl."
hadiths.body: My grandfather told me that the Prophet ﷺ wiped his head and said, "Do not apply kohl during the day when you are fasting. Apply kohl at night with antimony, as it clears the vision and promotes hair growth." Abu Muhammad said, "I do not see any harm in using kohl."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ جَدِّي وَكَانَ جَدِّي قَدْ أُتِيَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَمَسَحَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَقَالَ «لَا تَكْتَحِلْ بِالنَّهَارِ وَأَنْتَ صَائِمٌ اكْتَحِلْ لَيْلًا بِالْإِثْمِدِ فَإِنَّهُ يَجْلُو الْبَصَرَ وَيُنْبِتُ الشَّعَرَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «لَا أَرَى بِالْكُحْلِ بَأْسًا»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Nuʿmān Abū al-Nuʿmān al-Anṣārī from my father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1775

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَفْسِيرِ قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {فَمَنْ شَهِدَ مِنْكُمُ الشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ} [البقرة: 185]
chapter.englishTitle: In the interpretation of His saying: "So whoever of you sights t...

hadiths.englishRaw: Salamah bin Al Akwa said “After the revelation of the verse “For those who can do it(with hardship) is a ransom, the feeding of one, that is indigent, is one of us intended to leave fast and pay ransom, he could do so.” until the verse following it was revealed and abrogated the (previous) verse.”     – Sound
hadiths.body: Salamah bin Al Akwa said “After the revelation of the verse “For those who can do it(with hardship) is a ransom, the feeding of one, that is indigent, is one of us intended to leave fast and pay ransom, he could do so.” until the verse following it was revealed and abrogated the (previous) verse.”     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ {وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ} [البقرة 184] قَالَ «كَانَ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُفْطِرَ وَيَفْتَدِيَ فَعَلَ حَتَّى نَزَلَتِ الْآيَةُ الَّتِي بَعْدَهَا فَنَسَخَتْهَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Bakr \u003e Ibn Muḍar \u003e ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Yazīd a freed slave of Salamah b. al-Akwaʿ \u003e Salamah b. al-Akwaʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مُضَرَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ مَوْلَى سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1776

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ يُصْبِحُ صَائِمًا تَطَوُّعًا ثُمَّ يُفْطِرُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who should fast voluntarily and then break it?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon her while she was fasting. Then a vessel was brought to him and he drank from it, and also offered it to her and she drank from it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If it is a missed fast from Ramadan, then fast another day instead. And if it is a voluntary fast, then if you wish, complete it, and if you wish, break it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon her while she was fasting. Then a vessel was brought to him and he drank from it, and also offered it to her and she drank from it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If it is a missed fast from Ramadan, then fast another day instead. And if it is a voluntary fast, then if you wish, complete it, and if you wish, break it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَهِيَ صَائِمَةٌ فَأُتِيَ بِإِنَاءٍ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهَا فَشَرِبَتْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنْ كَانَ قَضَاءَ رَمَضَانَ فَصُومِي يَوْمًا آخَرَ وَإِنْ كَانَ تَطَوُّعًا فَإِنْ شِئْتِ فَاقْضِيهِ وَإِنْ شِئْتِ فَلَا تَقْضِيهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e Hārūn Ibn Āb.ah Um Hāniʾ or Ibn Āb. Um Hāniʾ \u003e Um Hāniʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ ابْنِ ابْنَةِ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ أَوْ ابْنِ ابْنِ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1777

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ يُصْبِحُ صَائِمًا تَطَوُّعًا ثُمَّ يُفْطِرُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who should fast voluntarily and then break it?

hadiths.englishRaw: On the days of the conquest of Mecca, when Mecca was captured, Fatimah came and sat on the left side of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Umm Hani was on his right side. A slave-girl brought a vessel which contained some drink; she gave it to him and he drank of it. He then gave it to Umm Hani who drank of it. She said: Messenger of Allah, I have broken my fast; I was fasting. He said to her: Were you making atonement for something? She replied: No. He said: Then it does not harm you if it was voluntary (fast).    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: On the days of the conquest of Mecca, when Mecca was captured, Fatimah came and sat on the left side of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Umm Hani was on his right side. A slave-girl brought a vessel which contained some drink; she gave it to him and he drank of it. He then gave it to Umm Hani who drank of it. She said: Messenger of Allah, I have broken my fast; I was fasting. He said to her: Were you making atonement for something? She replied: No. He said: Then it does not harm you if it was voluntary (fast).    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ جَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ فَجَلَسَتْ عَنْ يَسَارِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأُمُّ هَانِئٍ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ قَالَتْ فَجَاءَتِ الْوَلِيدَةُ بِإِنَاءٍ فِيهِ شَرَابٌ فَنَاوَلَتْهُ فَشَرِبَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهُ أُمَّ هَانِئٍ فَشَرِبَتْ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَفْطَرْتُ وَكُنْتُ صَائِمَةً فَقَالَ لَهَا «أَكُنْتِ تَقْضِينَ شَيْئًا؟» قَالَتْ لَا قَالَ فَلَا يَضُرُّكِ إِنْ كَانَ تَطَوُّعًا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد أَقُولُ بِهِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Jarīr \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ziyād \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Um Hāniʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أُمِّ هَانِئٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1778

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ دُعِيَ إِلَى الطَّعَامِ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ فَلْيَقُلْ: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the heading is: "Whoever is invited to eat wh...

hadiths.englishRaw: When one of you is invited (to a meal), and he is fasting, he should say that he is fasting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When one of you is invited (to a meal), and he is fasting, he should say that he is fasting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ فَلْيَقُلْ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1779

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الصَّائِمِ إِذَا أُكِلَ عِنْدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: When fasting, if one eats in their presence

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon her, so she invited him to eat. He said to her, "Eat." She said, "I am fasting." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, when a fasting person is offered food at his place, the angels send prayers upon him until they finish (eating), and perhaps he said, 'until they complete their meal.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon her, so she invited him to eat. He said to her, "Eat." She said, "I am fasting." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, when a fasting person is offered food at his place, the angels send prayers upon him until they finish (eating), and perhaps he said, 'until they complete their meal.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَدَعَتْ لَهُ بِطَعَامٍ فَقَالَ لَهَا «كُلِي» فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي صَائِمَةٌ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِنَّ الصَّائِمَ إِذَا أُكِلَ عِنْدَهُ صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يَفْرُغُوا وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ حَتَّى يَقْضُوا أَكْلَهُمْ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ḥabīb al-Anṣārī \u003e Mawlāh Lanā Yuqāl Lahā Laylá \u003e Jaddatihā Um ʿUmārah b. Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ حَبِيبٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَوْلَاةً لَنَا يُقَالُ لَهَا لَيْلَى تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ جَدَّتِهَا أُمِّ عُمَارَةَ بِنْتِ كَعْبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1780

chapter.englishTitle: In the Blessings of Sha'ban in Ramadan

hadiths.englishRaw: I have not seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complete a month of fasting except for the month of Sha'ban. For he used to connect it with Ramadan so that they would be two consecutive months of fasting. He used to fast throughout the month, until we would say that he did not break his fast, and he would break his fast until we would say that he did not fast.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I have not seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complete a month of fasting except for the month of Sha'ban. For he used to connect it with Ramadan so that they would be two consecutive months of fasting. He used to fast throughout the month, until we would say that he did not break his fast, and he would break his fast until we would say that he did not fast.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَامَ شَهْرًا تَامًّا إِلَّا شَعْبَانَ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَصِلُهُ بِرَمَضَانَ لِيَكُونَا شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ وَكَانَ يَصُومُ مِنَ الشَّهْرِ حَتَّى نَقُولَ لَا يُفْطِرُ وَيُفْطِرُ حَتَّى نَقُولَ لَا يَصُومُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Sālim \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1781

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الصَّوْمِ بَعْدَ انْتِصَافِ شَعْبَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of fasting after the middle of Sha'ban

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When it is the middle of ˹the month of˺ Shaʿbān then withhold fasting.”   – Weak, Rejected
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When it is the middle of ˹the month of˺ Shaʿbān then withhold fasting.”   – Weak, Rejected
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا كَانَ النِّصْفُ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَأَمْسِكُوا عَنِ الصَّوْمِ۔»   – ضغيف متروك
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad b. ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Ḥanafī / ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ibrāhīm \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ؛ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحَنَفِيُّ يُقَالُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ؛ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ؛ عَنْ أَبِيهِ؛ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1782

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الصَّوْمِ بَعْدَ انْتِصَافِ شَعْبَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of fasting after the middle of Sha'ban

hadiths.englishRaw: From Abu Huraira, approximately like this.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Abu Huraira, approximately like this.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ نَحْوَ هَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1783

chapter.englishTitle: Fasting is one of the secrets of the month.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a man, "Have you fasted any days of this month for voluntary reasons?" The man replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ then said, "If you have already broken your fast in Ramadan, then fast for two consecutive days." Abu Muhammad said, "The man's last fasting days were the two consecutive ones."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to a man, "Have you fasted any days of this month for voluntary reasons?" The man replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ then said, "If you have already broken your fast in Ramadan, then fast for two consecutive days." Abu Muhammad said, "The man's last fasting days were the two consecutive ones."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ «هَلْ صُمْتَ مِنْ سَرَرِ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ؟» فَقَالَ لَا قَالَ «فَإِذَا أَفْطَرْتَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَصُمْ يَوْمَيْنِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد سَرَرُهُ آخِرُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Shikhhīr \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1784

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not fast throughout any month except during ramadan. And when he observed fast (he fasted so continuously) that one would say that he would not break (them) and when he Abandoned, he abandoned (so continuously) that one would say: By Allah, perhaps he would never fast.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not fast throughout any month except during ramadan. And when he observed fast (he fasted so continuously) that one would say that he would not break (them) and when he Abandoned, he abandoned (so continuously) that one would say: By Allah, perhaps he would never fast.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا صَامَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ شَهْرًا كَامِلًا غَيْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَإِنْ كَانَ لَيَصُومُ إِذَا صَامَ حَتَّى يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُ لَا وَاللَّهِ لَا يُفْطِرُ وَيُفْطِرُ إِذَا أَفْطَرَ حَتَّى يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُ لَا وَاللَّهِ لَا يَصُومُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1785

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of fasting indefinitely.

hadiths.englishRaw: "My father told me that he heard the Messenger of Allah say, when mention was made in his presence of a man who fasted for the rest of his life: 'He neither fasted nor broke his fast."' 'Ata said: "someone who heard him told me that Ibn 'Umar (said) that the Prophet said: 'Whoever fasts every day of his life, then he has not fasted."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "My father told me that he heard the Messenger of Allah say, when mention was made in his presence of a man who fasted for the rest of his life: 'He neither fasted nor broke his fast."' 'Ata said: "someone who heard him told me that Ibn 'Umar (said) that the Prophet said: 'Whoever fasts every day of his life, then he has not fasted."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: ذُكِرَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَجُلٌ يَصُومُ الدَّهْرَ فَقَالَ «لَا صَامَ وَلَا أَفْطَرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Qatādah \u003e Muṭarrif b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Shikhhīr from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1786

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَوْمِ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of three days from each month

hadiths.englishRaw: "He heard Abu Huraira say: 'My beloved friend advised me with three things that I will never neglect. Firstly, to never sleep except after praying Witr (an additional prayer performed after Isha prayer). Secondly, to fast three days every month. And thirdly, to never abandon the two Rak'ahs of Dhuha (a voluntary prayer performed in the morning).' "   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "He heard Abu Huraira say: 'My beloved friend advised me with three things that I will never neglect. Firstly, to never sleep except after praying Witr (an additional prayer performed after Isha prayer). Secondly, to fast three days every month. And thirdly, to never abandon the two Rak'ahs of Dhuha (a voluntary prayer performed in the morning).' "   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي بِثَلَاثٍ لَسْتُ بِتَارِكِهِنَّ أَنْ لَا أَنَامَ إِلَّا عَلَى وِتْرٍ وَأَنْ أَصُومَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَأَنْ لَا أَدَعَ رَكْعَتَيِ الضُّحَى   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-ʿAwwām \u003e Sulaymān b. Abū Sulaymān \u003e Abū Hurayrah \u003e Awṣānī Khalīlī Bithalāth Last Bitārikihin \u003e Lā Anām Illā \u003e Witr \u003e Aṣūm Thalāthah Ayyām from Kul Shahr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا الْعَوَّامُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1787

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَوْمِ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of three days from each month

hadiths.englishRaw: A similar report was narrated from Abu Hurairah, but was not attributed to the Prophet     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A similar report was narrated from Abu Hurairah, but was not attributed to the Prophet     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbbās al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبَّاسٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1788

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَوْمِ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ مِنْ كُلِّ شَهْرٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of three days from each month

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Fasting on the white days is equivalent to fasting the entire year, and breaking the fast on these days is also rewarding."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Fasting on the white days is equivalent to fasting the entire year, and breaking the fast on these days is also rewarding."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «صِيَامُ الْبِيضِ صِيَامُ الدَّهْرِ وَإِفْطَارُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Qurrah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ قُرَّةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1789

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الصِّيَامِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of fasting on Friday.

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to Jabir, "Did the Prophet ﷺ prohibit fasting on Fridays?" He replied, "Yes, by the Lord of this house."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to Jabir, "Did the Prophet ﷺ prohibit fasting on Fridays?" He replied, "Yes, by the Lord of this house."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِجَابِرٍ أَنَهَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ وَرَبِّ هَذَا الْبَيْتِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jubayr b. Shaybah \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbbād b. Jaʿfar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1790

chapter.englishTitle: On the fasting of Saturday

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah said: "Do not fast on Saturday except for what has been made obligatory upon you (by Allah). If one of you does not find but a grape peal or a tree's twig, then let him chew it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: "Do not fast on Saturday except for what has been made obligatory upon you (by Allah). If one of you does not find but a grape peal or a tree's twig, then let him chew it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَصُومُوا يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ إِلَّا فِيمَا افْتُرِضَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَّا كَذَا أَوْ لِحَاءَ شَجَرَةٍ فَلْيَمْضَغْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Thawr \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Busr \u003e Ukhtih Yuqāl Lahā al-Ṣammāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ثَوْرٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُسْرٍ عَنْ أُخْتِهِ يُقَالُ لَهَا الصَّمَّاءُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1791

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صِيَامِ يَوْمِ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ
chapter.englishTitle: On the fasting of Monday and Thursday

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "Usama used to ride to his wealth in the Valley of Al-Qura. He used to fast on Mondays and Thursdays while on the journey. So, I said to him, 'Why do you fast on Mondays and Thursdays while traveling, considering your old age and the weakness or softness of your body?' He replied, 'Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to fast on Mondays and Thursdays, and he said, 'Verily, the deeds are presented [to Allah] on Mondays and Thursdays."'   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "Usama used to ride to his wealth in the Valley of Al-Qura. He used to fast on Mondays and Thursdays while on the journey. So, I said to him, 'Why do you fast on Mondays and Thursdays while traveling, considering your old age and the weakness or softness of your body?' He replied, 'Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to fast on Mondays and Thursdays, and he said, 'Verily, the deeds are presented [to Allah] on Mondays and Thursdays."'   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ كَانَ أُسَامَةُ يَرْكَبُ إِلَى مَالٍ لَهُ بِوَادِي الْقُرَى فَيَصُومُ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسَ فِي الطَّرِيقِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لِمَ تَصُومُ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسَ فِي السَّفَرِ وَقَدْ كَبِرْتَ وَضَعُفْتَ أَوْ رَقِقْتَ ؟ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَصُومُ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسَ وَقَالَ «إِنَّ أَعْمَالَ النَّاسِ تُعْرَضُ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Ḥakam b. Thawbān \u003e a freed slave of Qudāmah b. Maẓʿūn \u003e a freed slave of Usāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ أَنَّ مَوْلَى قُدَامَةَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ مَوْلَى أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1792

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صِيَامِ يَوْمِ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ
chapter.englishTitle: On the fasting of Monday and Thursday

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to fast on Mondays and Thursdays, so I asked him about it and he said, "Deeds are presented to Allah on Mondays and Thursdays."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to fast on Mondays and Thursdays, so I asked him about it and he said, "Deeds are presented to Allah on Mondays and Thursdays."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَصُومُ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ الْأَعْمَالَ تُعْرَضُ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ وَالْخَمِيسِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Muḥammad b. Rifāʿah \u003e Suhayl from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1793

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صَوْمِ دَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام
chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of Prophet David, ﷺ .

hadiths.englishRaw: "I prefer fasting to Allah, Most High. The fasting of Dawood (David) was that he used to fast one day and break his fast the next day. And I prefer prayer to Allah, Most High. The prayer of Dawood was that he used to pray half the night and sleep for a third of it and glorify Allah for a sixth of it." Abu Muhammad said, "The last statement is incorrect or a mistake. Rather, he used to sleep half of the night, pray a third of it, and glorify Allah for a sixth of it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I prefer fasting to Allah, Most High. The fasting of Dawood (David) was that he used to fast one day and break his fast the next day. And I prefer prayer to Allah, Most High. The prayer of Dawood was that he used to pray half the night and sleep for a third of it and glorify Allah for a sixth of it." Abu Muhammad said, "The last statement is incorrect or a mistake. Rather, he used to sleep half of the night, pray a third of it, and glorify Allah for a sixth of it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَحَبُّ الصِّيَامِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ﷻ صِيَامُ دَاوُدَ كَانَ يَصُومُ يَوْمًا وَيُفْطِرُ يَوْمًا وَأَحَبُّ الصَّلَاةِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ﷻ صَلَاةُ دَاوُدَ كَانَ يُصَلِّي نِصْفًا وَيَنَامُ ثُلُثًا وَيُسَبِّحُ سُدُسًا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «هَذَا اللَّفْظُ الْأَخِيرُ غَلَطٌ أَوْ خَطَأٌ إِنَّمَا هُوَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَنَامُ نِصْفَ اللَّيْلِ وَيُصَلِّي ثُلُثَهُ وَيُسَبِّحُ سُدُسَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr / Ibn Dīnār \u003e ʿAmr b. Aws \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr Yarfaʿuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَوْسٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ
