hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1794

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الصِّيَامِ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ وَيَوْمَ الْأَضْحَى
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of fasting on the day of Eid al-Fitr and the day...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "No fasting on the days of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "No fasting on the days of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَا صَوْمَ يَوْمَيْنِ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ وَيَوْمَ النَّحْرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Qazaʿah a freed slave of Ziyād \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ قَزَعَةَ مَوْلَى زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1795

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صِيَامِ السِّتَّةِ مِنْ شَوَّالٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of the six days of Shawwal.

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Whoever fasts Ramadan and then follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he has fasted for a lifetime."   – Sound
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Whoever fasts Ramadan and then follows it with six days of Shawwal, it is as if he has fasted for a lifetime."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَهُ سِتَّةً مِنْ شَوَّالٍ فَذَلِكَ صِيَامُ الدَّهْرِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Ṣafwān Wsaʿd b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUmar b. Thābit \u003e Abū Ayyūb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ وسَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1796

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صِيَامِ السِّتَّةِ مِنْ شَوَّالٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of the six days of Shawwal.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Fasting the month of Ramadan, followed by six days of Shawwal, completes the reward of a full year."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Fasting the month of Ramadan, followed by six days of Shawwal, completes the reward of a full year."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «صِيَامُ شَهْرٍ بِعَشَرَةِ أَشْهُرٍ وَسِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ بَعْدَهُنَّ بِشَهْرَيْنِ فَذَلِكَ تَمَامُ سَنَةٍ» يَعْنِي شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ وَسِتَّةَ أَيَّامٍ بَعْدَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith al-Dhimārī \u003e Abū Asmāʾ al-Raḥabī \u003e Thawbān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ الذِّمَارِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1797

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of Muharram

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard a man asking the Prophet ﷺ: "Which month should I fast after the month of Ramadan?" The Prophet ﷺ ordered him to fast during the month of Muharram and said, "Indeed, in it there is a day where Allah granted repentance to a nation, and He accepts the repentance of another nation."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard a man asking the Prophet ﷺ: "Which month should I fast after the month of Ramadan?" The Prophet ﷺ ordered him to fast during the month of Muharram and said, "Indeed, in it there is a day where Allah granted repentance to a nation, and He accepts the repentance of another nation."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَيُّ شَهْرٍ يَصُومُهُ مِنَ السَّنَةِ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ؟ فَأَمَرَهُ بِصِيَامِ الْمُحَرَّمِ وَقَالَ «إِنَّ فِيهِ يَوْمًا تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَى قَوْمٍ وَيَتُوبُ فِيهِ عَلَى قَوْمٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Muḥammad b. Fuḍayl \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Saʿd \u003e Jāʾ a man \u003e ʿAlī Fasaʾalah \u003e Shahr Baʿd Shahr Ramaḍān Yaṣūmuh \u003e Lah ʿAlī Mā Saʾalanī Aḥad \u003e Hadhā Baʿd Idh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ إِسْحاَقَ عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ شَهْرٍ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ يَصُومُهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيٌّ مَا سَأَلَنِي أَحَدٌ عَنْ هَذَا بَعْدَ إِذْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1798

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of Muharram

hadiths.englishRaw: “A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘Which fasting is better after the month of Ramadan?’ He said: ‘The month of Allah which is called Muharram.’”     – Sound
hadiths.body: “A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘Which fasting is better after the month of Ramadan?’ He said: ‘The month of Allah which is called Muharram.’”     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَفْضَلُ الصِّيَامِ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ شَهْرُ اللَّهِ الَّذِي تَدْعُونَهُ الْمُحَرَّمَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zayd b. ʿAwf \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Muntashir \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْتَشِرِ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1799

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of Muharram

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said, "The best fasting after the month of Ramadan is the month of Muharram."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said, "The best fasting after the month of Ramadan is the month of Muharram."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَفْضَلُ الصِّيَامِ بَعْدَ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُحَرَّمُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Ḥimyarī \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ وَأَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ قَالَا أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1800

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of the day of Ashura

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived in Medina and found the Jews fasting on the day of Ashura. He asked them, 'What is the significance of this day?' They replied, 'This is the day on which Musa (Moses) and his people were saved from Pharaoh.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'We have more right to Musa than you, so fast on this day.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived in Medina and found the Jews fasting on the day of Ashura. He asked them, 'What is the significance of this day?' They replied, 'This is the day on which Musa (Moses) and his people were saved from Pharaoh.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'We have more right to Musa than you, so fast on this day.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ وَالْيَهُودُ يَصُومُونَ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ فَسَأَلَهُمْ فَقَالُوا هَذَا الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي ظَهَرَ فِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَى فِرْعَوْنَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَنْتُمْ أَوْلَى بِمُوسَى فَصُومُوهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1801

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of the day of Ashura

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Prophet ﷺ used to fast on the day of Ashura and would encourage others to fast as well."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Prophet ﷺ used to fast on the day of Ashura and would encourage others to fast as well."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَصُومُ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ وَيَأْمُرُُ بِصِيَامِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1802

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of the day of Ashura

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet (pbuh) sent a man on the day of Ashura who embraced Islam saying, "Indeed, today is the day of Ashura, so whoever has eaten or drank should complete the rest of his day, and whoever has not eaten or drank should observe fasting."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet (pbuh) sent a man on the day of Ashura who embraced Islam saying, "Indeed, today is the day of Ashura, so whoever has eaten or drank should complete the rest of his day, and whoever has not eaten or drank should observe fasting."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بَعَثَ يَوْمَ عَاشُورَاءَ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَسْلَمَ «إِنَّ الْيَوْمَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ فَمَنْ كَانَ أَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ فَلْيُتِمَّ بَقِيَّةَ يَوْمِهِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Yazīd b. Abū ʿUbayd \u003e Salamah b. al-Akwaʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1803

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of the day of Ashura

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "This is the day of Ashura, which the Quraysh used to fast during the time of ignorance. So whoever among you wishes to fast on this day, let them fast, and whoever wishes to abandon it, let them abandon it." Ibn Umar used to observe this fast except when it coincided with his own fast.   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "This is the day of Ashura, which the Quraysh used to fast during the time of ignorance. So whoever among you wishes to fast on this day, let them fast, and whoever wishes to abandon it, let them abandon it." Ibn Umar used to observe this fast except when it coincided with his own fast.   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «هَذَا يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ كَانَتْ قُرَيْشٌ تَصُومُهُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَصُومَهُ فَلْيَصُمْهُ فَمَنْ أَحَبَّ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَتْرُكَهُ فَلْيَتْرُكْهُ» وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَا يَصُومُهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يُوَافِقَ صِيَامَهُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1804

chapter.englishTitle: In the fasting of the day of Ashura

hadiths.englishRaw: The Quraish used to fast on the day of 'Ashurah in pre Islamic days. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would fast on it in pre-Islamic period. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Medina, he fasted on it and commanded to fast on it. When the fast of Ramadan was prescribed, that became obligatory, and (fasting on) 'Ashurah was abandoned. He who wishes may fast on it and he who wishes may leave it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Quraish used to fast on the day of 'Ashurah in pre Islamic days. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would fast on it in pre-Islamic period. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to Medina, he fasted on it and commanded to fast on it. When the fast of Ramadan was prescribed, that became obligatory, and (fasting on) 'Ashurah was abandoned. He who wishes may fast on it and he who wishes may leave it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ يَوْمًا تَصُومُهُ قُرَيْشٌ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ صَامَهُ وَأَمَرَ بِصِيَامِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا فُرِضَ رَمَضَانُ كَانَ رَمَضَانُ هُوَ الْفَرِيضَةُ وَتُرِكَ يَوْمُ عَاشُورَاءَ فَمَنْ شَاءَ صَامَهُ وَمَنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb b. Saʿīd \u003e Shuʿayb b. Isḥāq \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1805

chapter.englishTitle: On the fasting of the Day of Arafah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: The day of Arafah, the day of sacrifice, the days of tashriq are (the days of) our festival, O people of Islam. These are the days of eating and drinking.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: The day of Arafah, the day of sacrifice, the days of tashriq are (the days of) our festival, O people of Islam. These are the days of eating and drinking.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ وَأَيَّامُ التَّشْرِيقِ عِيدُنَا أَهْلَ الْإِسْلَامِ وَهِيَ أَيَّامُ أَكْلٍ وَشُرْبٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUlay from his father \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1806

chapter.englishTitle: On the fasting of the Day of Arafah

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ibn Umar was asked about fasting (the Day of) Arafah (at Arafat). He said: 'I performed Hajj with the Prophet, and he did not fast it, and with Abu Bakr, and he did not fast it, and with Umar, and he did not fast it, and with Uthman, and he did not fast it. I do no fast it, nor order it nor forbid it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Ibn Umar was asked about fasting (the Day of) Arafah (at Arafat). He said: 'I performed Hajj with the Prophet, and he did not fast it, and with Abu Bakr, and he did not fast it, and with Umar, and he did not fast it, and with Uthman, and he did not fast it. I do no fast it, nor order it nor forbid it."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «حَجَجْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَ عُثْمَانَ فَلَمْ يَصُمْهُ وَأَنَا لَا أَصُومُهُ وَلَا آمُرُ بِهِ وَلَا أَنْهَى عَنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Ismāʿīl Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ from his father \u003e Suʾil Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Ṣawm Yawm ʿArafah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ سُئِلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ صَوْمِ يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1807

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ صِيَامِ أَيَّامِ التَّشْرِيقِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of fasting on the days of Tashreeq

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet [SAW] commanded him to call out on the days of At-Tashriq that no one would enter Paradise except a believer, and that these were the days of eating and drinking.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet [SAW] commanded him to call out on the days of At-Tashriq that no one would enter Paradise except a believer, and that these were the days of eating and drinking.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أن رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَهُ أَوْ أَمَرَ رَجُلًا يُنَادِي أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ «أَنَّهُ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مُؤْمِنٌ وَهِيَ أَيَّامُ أَكْلٍ وَشُرْبٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Nāfiʿ b. Jubayr \u003e Bishr b. Suḥaym
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1808

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ صِيَامِ أَيَّامِ التَّشْرِيقِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of fasting on the days of Tashreeq

hadiths.englishRaw: Umru, break your fast, "for these are the days that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to order us to break our fast and forbid us from fasting." So Abdullah broke his fast, and I ate with him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Umru, break your fast, "for these are the days that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to order us to break our fast and forbid us from fasting." So Abdullah broke his fast, and I ate with him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَمْرٌو أَفْطِرْ «فَإِنَّ هَذِهِ الْأَيَّامَ الَّتِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْمُرُنَا بِفِطْرِهَا وَيَنْهَانَا عَنْ صِيَامِهَا» فَأَفْطَرَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَأَكَلَ وَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Murrah a freed slave of ʿAqīl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي مُرَّةَ مَوْلَى عَقِيلٍ أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ هُوَ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ وَذَلِكَ الْغَدَ أَوْ بَعْدَ الْغَدِ مِنْ يَوْمِ الْأَضْحَى فَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْهِمْ عَمْرٌو طَعَامًا فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِنِّي صَائِمٌ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1809

chapter.englishTitle: The man dies and he has a fast

hadiths.englishRaw: When she died, her brother went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him about it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "If she had a debt, would you not be responsible for it?" He replied, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "So fulfill the rights of Allah, as Allah is more deserving of fulfillment." He said, "So he fasted on her behalf."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When she died, her brother went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him about it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "If she had a debt, would you not be responsible for it?" He replied, "Yes." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "So fulfill the rights of Allah, as Allah is more deserving of fulfillment." He said, "So he fasted on her behalf."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَصُومَ فَمَاتَتْ فَجَاءَ أَخُوهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْهَا دَيْنٌ أَكُنْتَ قَاضِيَهُ؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «فَاقْضُوا اللَّهَ اللَّهُ أَحَقُّ بِالْوَفَاءِ» قَالَ فَصَامَ عَنْهَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Āmraʾah Nadharat
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً نَذَرَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1810

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the fasting person

hadiths.englishRaw: "Allah, may He be exalted, said: 'Fasting is for me and I shall reward for it. The fasting person has two moments of joy: When he breaks his fast and when he meets his Lord. And the smell that comes from the mouth of the fasting person is better before Allah than the fragrance of musk."' '
hadiths.body: "Allah, may He be exalted, said: 'Fasting is for me and I shall reward for it. The fasting person has two moments of joy: When he breaks his fast and when he meets his Lord. And the smell that comes from the mouth of the fasting person is better before Allah than the fragrance of musk."' '
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَخُلُوفُ فَمِ الصَّائِمِ أَطْيَبُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ وَلِلصَّائِمِ فَرْحَتَانِ فَرْحَةٌ عِنْدَ فِطْرِهِ وَفَرْحَةٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1811

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the fasting person

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, the Most High, says: 'Every action of the son of Adam is for him, except fasting. It is for Me and I shall reward for it. Verily, he gives up his desires and food for My sake.' The fasting person has two moments of joy: one when he breaks his fast and another when he meets his Lord. Indeed, the smell coming from the mouth of a fasting person is better in the sight of Allah than the smell of musk."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Allah, the Most High, says: 'Every action of the son of Adam is for him, except fasting. It is for Me and I shall reward for it. Verily, he gives up his desires and food for My sake.' The fasting person has two moments of joy: one when he breaks his fast and another when he meets his Lord. Indeed, the smell coming from the mouth of a fasting person is better in the sight of Allah than the smell of musk."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى كُلُّ عَمَلِ ابْنِ آدَمَ لَهُ فَالْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا إِلَى سَبْعِ مِائَةِ ضِعْفٍ إِلَّا الصِّيَامَ هُوَ لِي وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ إِنَّهُ يَتْرُكُ الطَّعَامَ وَشَهْوَتَهُ مِنْ أَجْلِي وَيَتْرُكُ الشَّرَابَ وَشَهْوَتَهُ مِنْ أَجْلِي فَهُوَ لِي وَأَنَا أَجْزِي بِهِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1812

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the fasting person

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Fasting is a shield."'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Fasting is a shield."'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الصَّوْمُ جُنَّةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1813

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ دُعَاءِ الصَّائِمِ لِمَنْ يُفْطِرُ عِنْدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: The supplication of the fasting person for the one who breaks hi...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When the Prophet ﷺ used to break his fast with the people, he would say, 'The fasting ones among you have broken their fast, and the righteous have eaten your food, and the angels have descended upon you.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When the Prophet ﷺ used to break his fast with the people, he would say, 'The fasting ones among you have broken their fast, and the righteous have eaten your food, and the angels have descended upon you.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَ النَّاسِ قَالَ «أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ وَتَنَزَّلَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1814

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ الْعَمَلِ فِي الْعَشْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Working in the Ten

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "There is no deed that is better in the sight of Allah than the deeds performed during the ten days of Dhul-Hijjah." It was asked, "Not even Jihad for the sake of Allah?" He ﷺ replied, "Not even Jihad for the sake of Allah, unless a person goes out with his life and wealth and does not return with anything."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "There is no deed that is better in the sight of Allah than the deeds performed during the ten days of Dhul-Hijjah." It was asked, "Not even Jihad for the sake of Allah?" He ﷺ replied, "Not even Jihad for the sake of Allah, unless a person goes out with his life and wealth and does not return with anything."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَا الْعَمَلُ فِي أَيَّامٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ فِي عَشْرِ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ» قِيلَ وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْجِعْ بِشَيْءٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Muslim al-Baṭīn \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُسْلِمًا الْبَطِينَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1815

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ الْعَمَلِ فِي الْعَشْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Working in the Ten

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "There is no deed more pure in the sight of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and no deed more deserving of rewards than a good deed performed during the ten days of Dhul-Hijjah." It was asked, "Not even Jihad for the sake of Allah?" He replied, "Not even Jihad for the sake of Allah, except for a man who went out with himself and his wealth and did not return with anything." It is reported that Sa'eed ibn Jubayr would exert extreme effort and strive his best during the ten days (of Dhul-Hijjah) to the extent that he could barely manage it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "There is no deed more pure in the sight of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, and no deed more deserving of rewards than a good deed performed during the ten days of Dhul-Hijjah." It was asked, "Not even Jihad for the sake of Allah?" He replied, "Not even Jihad for the sake of Allah, except for a man who went out with himself and his wealth and did not return with anything." It is reported that Sa'eed ibn Jubayr would exert extreme effort and strive his best during the ten days (of Dhul-Hijjah) to the extent that he could barely manage it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَا مِنْ عَمَلٍ أَزْكَى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ﷻ وَلَا أَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا مِنْ خَيْرٍ يَعْمَلُهُ فِي عَشْرِ الْأَضْحَى» قِيلَ وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ قَالَ «وَلَا الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ خَرَجَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بِشَيْءٍ» قَالَ وَكَانَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَيَّامُ الْعَشْرِ اجْتَهَدَ اجْتِهَادًا شَدِيدًا حَتَّى مَا يَكَادُ يَقْدِرُ عَلَيْهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Aṣbagh \u003e al-Qāsim b. Abū Ayyūb \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَصْبَغُ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1816

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the month of Ramadan

hadiths.englishRaw: "When the month of Ramadan begins, the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of Hell are shut, and the devils are fettered."
hadiths.body: "When the month of Ramadan begins, the gates of Paradise are opened and the gates of Hell are shut, and the devils are fettered."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا جَاءَ رَمَضَانُ فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَغُلِّقَتْ أَبْوَابُ النَّارِ وَصُفِّدَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Rabīʿ al-Zahrānī \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar \u003e Abū Suhayl from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1817

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ قِيَامِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtues of observing the month of Ramadan

hadiths.englishRaw: He who observed the fasts of Ramadan with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven, and he who observed prayer on Lailat-ul- Qadr with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He who observed the fasts of Ramadan with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven, and he who observed prayer on Lailat-ul- Qadr with faith and seeking reward (from Allah), all his previous sins would be forgiven.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ وَمَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1818

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ قِيَامِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtues of observing the month of Ramadan

hadiths.englishRaw: We fasted with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during Ramadan, but he did not make us get up at night for prayer at any time during the month till seven nights remained; then he made us get up for prayer till a third of the night had passed. When the sixth remaining night came, he did not make us get up for prayer. When the fifth remaining night came, he made us stand in prayer till a half of the night had gone. So I said: Messenger of Allah, I wish you had led us in supererogatory prayers during the whole of tonight. He said: When a man prays with an imam till he goes he is reckoned as having spent a whole night in prayer. On the fourth remaining night he did not make us get up. When the third remaining night came, he gathered his family, his wives, and the people and prayed with us till we were afraid we should miss the falah (success). I said: What is falah? He said: The meal before daybreak. Then he did not make us get up for prayer during the remainder of the month.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We fasted with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ during Ramadan, but he did not make us get up at night for prayer at any time during the month till seven nights remained; then he made us get up for prayer till a third of the night had passed. When the sixth remaining night came, he did not make us get up for prayer. When the fifth remaining night came, he made us stand in prayer till a half of the night had gone. So I said: Messenger of Allah, I wish you had led us in supererogatory prayers during the whole of tonight. He said: When a man prays with an imam till he goes he is reckoned as having spent a whole night in prayer. On the fourth remaining night he did not make us get up. When the third remaining night came, he gathered his family, his wives, and the people and prayed with us till we were afraid we should miss the falah (success). I said: What is falah? He said: The meal before daybreak. Then he did not make us get up for prayer during the remainder of the month.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: صُمْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ قَالَ فَلَمْ يَقُمْ بِنَا مِنَ الشَّهْرِ شَيْئًا حَتَّى بَقِيَ سَبْعٌ قَالَ فَقَامَ بِنَا حَتَّى ذَهَبَ ثُلُثُ اللَّيْلِ قَالَ فَلَمَّا كَانَتِ السَّادِسَةُ لَمْ يَقُمْ بِنَا فَلَمَّا كَانَتِ الْخَامِسَةُ قَامَ بِنَا حَتَّى ذَهَبَ شَطْرُ اللَّيْلِ الْآخِرُ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ نَفَّلْتَنَا بَقِيَّةَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا قَامَ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ حُسِبَ لَهُ قِيَامُ لَيْلَتِهِ» فَلَمَّا كَانَتِ الرَّابِعَةُ لَمْ يَقُمْ بِنَا فَلَمَّا كَانَتِ الثَّالِثَةُ جَمَعَ أَهْلَهُ وَنِسَاءَهُ وَالنَّاسَ فَقَامَ بِنَا حَتَّى خَشِينَا أَنْ يَفُوتَنَا الْفَلَاحُ قُلْنَا وَمَا الْفَلَاحُ قَالَ السُّحُورُ قَالَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَقُمْ بِنَا بَقِيَّةَ الشَّهْرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e al-Walīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Jubayr b. Nufayr \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1819

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ قِيَامِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtues of observing the month of Ramadan

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Abu Dharr, towards him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From Abu Dharr, towards him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Dāwud \u003e al-Walīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Jurashī \u003e Jubayr b. Nufayr al-Ḥaḍramī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْجُرَشِيِّ عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1820

chapter.englishTitle: The seclusion of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic text into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to observe I'tikaf during the last ten days (of Ramadan), but when it was the year in which he passed away, he observed I'tikaf for twenty days."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic text into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to observe I'tikaf during the last ten days (of Ramadan), but when it was the year in which he passed away, he observed I'tikaf for twenty days."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَعْتَكِفُ الْعَشْرَ الْأَوَاخِرَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْعَامُ الَّذِي قُبِضَ فِيهِ اعْتَكَفَ عِشْرِينَ يَوْمًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿĀṣim b. Yūsuf \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAyyāsh \u003e Abū Ḥaṣīn \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1821

chapter.englishTitle: The seclusion of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: "She (referring to a female) came to visit the Prophet ﷺ during his seclusion in the mosque in the last ten nights of Ramadan. They spoke for an hour, then she left."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "She (referring to a female) came to visit the Prophet ﷺ during his seclusion in the mosque in the last ten nights of Ramadan. They spoke for an hour, then she left."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا «جَاءَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تَزُورُهُ فِي اعْتِكَافِهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فِي الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ فَتَحَدَّثَتْ عِنْدَهُ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَامَتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Yamān \u003e Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAlī b. Ḥusayn \u003e Ṣaffiyah b. Ḥuyay
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ أَنَّ صَفِّيَةَ بِنْتَ حُيَيٍّ أَخْبَرَتْهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1822

chapter.englishTitle: In the Night of Power

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us intending to inform us about Laylatul Qadr (the Night of Decree). Two Muslims started arguing, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I came to you wanting to inform you about Laylatul Qadr, but there was a dispute between so-and-so and so-and-so, and it was raised to the point where it may be better for you to seek it in the last ten nights, on the fifth, seventh, and ninth nights."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us intending to inform us about Laylatul Qadr (the Night of Decree). Two Muslims started arguing, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I came to you wanting to inform you about Laylatul Qadr, but there was a dispute between so-and-so and so-and-so, and it was raised to the point where it may be better for you to seek it in the last ten nights, on the fifth, seventh, and ninth nights."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُخْبِرَنَا بِلَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ فَتَلَاحَى رَجُلَانِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنِّي خَرَجْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخْبِرَكُمْ بِلَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ فُلَانٍ وَفُلَانٍ لِحَاءٌ فَرُفِعَتْ وَعَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرًا فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الْأَوَاخِرِ فِي الْخَامِسَةِ وَالسَّابِعَةِ وَالتَّاسِعَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1823

chapter.englishTitle: In the Night of Power

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "I saw the Night of Qadr, but then some of my family members woke me up and I forgot about it, so search for it in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "I saw the Night of Qadr, but then some of my family members woke me up and I forgot about it, so search for it in the odd nights of the last ten days of Ramadan."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «رِأَيْتُ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ ثُمَّ أَيْقَظَنِي بَعْضُ أَهْلِي فَنَسِيتُهَا فَالْتَمِسُوهَا فِي الْعَشْرِ الْغَوَابِرِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ وَقَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1824

chapter.englishTitle: In the Night of Power

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Seek lailat al-qadr in the last seven days.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Seek lailat al-qadr in the last seven days.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «الْتَمِسُوا لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ فِي السَّبْعِ الْأَوَاخِرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1825

chapter.englishTitle: Whoever wishes to perform Hajj, let them hurry

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: He who intends to perform hajj should hasten to do so.    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: He who intends to perform hajj should hasten to do so.    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ فَلْيَتَعَجَّلْ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Abū Muʿāwiyah \u003e al-Ḥasan b. ʿAmr al-Fuqaymī \u003e Mihrān Abū Ṣafwān \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الْفُقَيْمِيُّ عَنْ مِهْرَانَ أَبِي صَفْوَانَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1826

chapter.englishTitle: Who dies without performing Hajj

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever is not prevented from performing the Hajj by an obvious need, oppressive authority, or an imprisoning illness, and dies without performing Hajj, then let them die as either a Jew or a Christian, if they wish."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever is not prevented from performing the Hajj by an obvious need, oppressive authority, or an imprisoning illness, and dies without performing Hajj, then let them die as either a Jew or a Christian, if they wish."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ لَمْ يَمْنَعْهُ عَنِ الْحَجِّ حَاجَةٌ ظَاهِرَةٌ أَوْ سُلْطَانٌ جَائِرٌ أَوْ مَرَضٌ حَابِسٌ فَمَاتَ وَلَمْ يَحُجَّ فَلْيَمُتْ إِنْ شَاءَ يَهُودِيًّا وَإِنْ شَاءَ نَصْرَانِيًّا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sharīk \u003e Layth \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Sābiṭ \u003e Abū Umāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1827

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي حَجِّ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَجَّةً وَاحِدَةً
chapter.englishTitle: In the Prophet's ﷺ pilgrimage, there was only one pilgrimage.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Zaid ibn Arqam saying, "The Prophet ﷺ performed Hajj after his migration." He (Zaid) said, and Abu Ishaq also said, "He (the Prophet) performed Hajj before his migration."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Zaid ibn Arqam saying, "The Prophet ﷺ performed Hajj after his migration." He (Zaid) said, and Abu Ishaq also said, "He (the Prophet) performed Hajj before his migration."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ يَقُولُ «حَجَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بَعْدَ هِجْرَتِهِ حَجَّةً» قَالَ وَقَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ «حَجَّ قَبْلَ هِجْرَتِهِ حَجَّةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mujāhid b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ādam \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Zayd b. Arqam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1828

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي حَجِّ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَجَّةً وَاحِدَةً
chapter.englishTitle: In the Prophet's ﷺ pilgrimage, there was only one pilgrimage.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked Anas, "How many times did the Prophet ﷺ perform Hajj?" He replied, "He performed Hajj once and he performed Umrah four times. The first Umrah was the one that the pagans prevented him from completing, and the second Umrah was when they made a peace treaty with him. He returned from the upcoming year. The third Umrah was from Al-Ji'rana when he distributed the spoils of Hunain in Dhul-Qa'dah, and the fourth Umrah was performed along with his Hajj."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked Anas, "How many times did the Prophet ﷺ perform Hajj?" He replied, "He performed Hajj once and he performed Umrah four times. The first Umrah was the one that the pagans prevented him from completing, and the second Umrah was when they made a peace treaty with him. He returned from the upcoming year. The third Umrah was from Al-Ji'rana when he distributed the spoils of Hunain in Dhul-Qa'dah, and the fourth Umrah was performed along with his Hajj."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِأَنَسٍ كَمْ حَجَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ؟ قَالَ حَجَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَاعْتَمَرَ أَرْبَعًا عُمْرَتُهُ الْأُولَى الَّتِي صَدَّهُ الْمُشْرِكُونَ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ وَعُمْرَتُهُ الثَّانِيَةُ حِينَ صَالَحُوهُ فَرَجَعَ مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ وَعُمْرَتُهُ مِنَ الْجِعْرَانَةِ حِينَ قَسَّمَ غَنِيمَةَ حُنَيْنٍ فِي ذِي الْقَعْدَةِ وَعُمْرَتُهُ مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1829

chapter.englishTitle: How is the obligation of Hajj performed?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Hajj (pilgrimage) has been ordained upon you." It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, is it obligatory every year?" He said, "No, if I had said it was obligatory to perform Hajj every year, it would have become obligatory and anything beyond that would be voluntary."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Hajj (pilgrimage) has been ordained upon you." It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, is it obligatory every year?" He said, "No, if I had said it was obligatory to perform Hajj every year, it would have become obligatory and anything beyond that would be voluntary."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْحَجُّ» فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِي كُلِّ عَامٍ؟ قَالَ «لَا وَلَوْ قُلْتُهَا لَوَجَبَتْ الْحَجُّ مَرَّةٌ فَمَا زَادَ فَهُوَ تَطَوُّعٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Sulaymān b. Kathīr \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sinān \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سِنَانٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1830

chapter.englishTitle: How is the obligation of Hajj performed?

hadiths.englishRaw: Another chain with similar narration.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Another chain with similar narration.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sharīk \u003e Simāk \u003e ʿIkrimah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1831

chapter.englishTitle: The schedules/timings in Hajj.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) appointed the following places for putting on Ihram : Dhul al-Hulaifah for the people of Madina, al-Juhfah for the people of Syria and al-Qarn for the people of Najd and have been told that appointed Yalamlam for the people of Yemen.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) appointed the following places for putting on Ihram : Dhul al-Hulaifah for the people of Madina, al-Juhfah for the people of Syria and al-Qarn for the people of Najd and have been told that appointed Yalamlam for the people of Yemen.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «وَقَّتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَلِأَهْلِ الشَّامِ الْجُحْفَةَ وَلِأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ قَرْنًا» قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ أَمَّا هَذِهِ الثَّلَاثُ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُنَّ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَبَلَغَنِي «أَنَّهُ وَقَّتَ لِأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1832

chapter.englishTitle: The schedules/timings in Hajj.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Like him is Ibn Umar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Like him is Ibn Umar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1833

chapter.englishTitle: The schedules/timings in Hajj.

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ made Dhul-Huiaifa as the Miqat for the people of Medina; Al-Juhfa for the people of Sham; Qarn-al-Manazil for the people of Najd; and Yalamlam for the people of Yemen; and these Mawaqit are for the people at those very places, and besides them for those who come thorough those places with the intention of performing Hajj and ʿUmra; and whoever is living within these boundaries can assume lhram from the place he starts, and the people of Mecca can assume Ihram from Mecca.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ made Dhul-Huiaifa as the Miqat for the people of Medina; Al-Juhfa for the people of Sham; Qarn-al-Manazil for the people of Najd; and Yalamlam for the people of Yemen; and these Mawaqit are for the people at those very places, and besides them for those who come thorough those places with the intention of performing Hajj and ʿUmra; and whoever is living within these boundaries can assume lhram from the place he starts, and the people of Mecca can assume Ihram from Mecca.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَقَّتَ لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ وَلِأَهْلِ الشَّامِ الْجُحْفَةَ وَلِأَهْلِ نَجْدٍ قَرْنَ الْمَنَازِلِ وَلِأَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ يَلَمْلَمَ هُنَّ لِأَهْلِهِنَّ وَلِكُلِّ آتٍ أَتَى عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ غَيْرِهِنَّ مِمَّنْ أَرَادَ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ وَمَنْ كَانَ دُونَ ذَلِكَ فَمِنْ حَيْثُ أَنْشَأَ حَتَّى أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ibn Ṭāwus from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1834

chapter.englishTitle: In Ihram, while performing ablution

hadiths.englishRaw: Al-Miswar ibn Makhrama and Ibn Abbas saw a person washing his head while being in the state of ihram (sacred pilgrimage clothes). They sent me to Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari and asked me, "How did you see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ washing his head while in the state of ihram?" So I came to Abu Ayyub and found him between the two corners of the well, with a cloth covering him. I greeted him and he pulled the cloth closer to him. I said, "My cousin Ibn Abbas sent me to you to ask how you saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ washing his head." Abu Ayyub then motioned his hands over his head, moving them forwards and backwards.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Al-Miswar ibn Makhrama and Ibn Abbas saw a person washing his head while being in the state of ihram (sacred pilgrimage clothes). They sent me to Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari and asked me, "How did you see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ washing his head while in the state of ihram?" So I came to Abu Ayyub and found him between the two corners of the well, with a cloth covering him. I greeted him and he pulled the cloth closer to him. I said, "My cousin Ibn Abbas sent me to you to ask how you saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ washing his head." Abu Ayyub then motioned his hands over his head, moving them forwards and backwards.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: امْتَرَى الْمِسْوَرُ بْنُ مَخْرَمَةَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فِي غَسْلِ الْمُحْرِمِ رَأْسَهُ فَأَرْسَلُونِي إِلَى أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ كَيْفَ رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ؟ فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ وَهُوَ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيِ الْبِئْرِ وَقَدْ سُتِرَ عَلَيْهِ بِثَوْبٍ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَضَمَّ الثَّوْبَ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْكَ ابْنُ أَخِيكَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ كَيْفَ رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَغْسِلُ رَأْسَهُ؟ «فَأَمَرَّ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ مُقْبِلًا وَمُدْبِرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbdullāh b. Ḥunayn from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1835

chapter.englishTitle: In Ihram, while performing ablution

hadiths.englishRaw: who said that he saw the Prophet disrobing for his Ihlal and to perform Ghusl.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: who said that he saw the Prophet disrobing for his Ihlal and to perform Ghusl.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تَجَرَّدَ لِلْإِهْلَالِ وَاغْتَسَلَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ziyād \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yaʿqūb al-Madanī \u003e Ibn Abū al-Zinād from his father \u003e Khārijah b. Zayd b. Thābit from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْمَدَنِيُّ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1836

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Hajj and Umrah

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said: A well-performed Hajj has no reward other than Paradise, and two Umrahs expiate the sins committed between them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said: A well-performed Hajj has no reward other than Paradise, and two Umrahs expiate the sins committed between them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ حَجَّةٌ مَبْرُورَةٌ لَيْسَ لَهَا ثَوَابٌ إِلَّا الْجَنَّةُ وَعُمْرَتَانِ تُكَفِّرَانِ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Sumay \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ سُمَيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1837

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Hajj and Umrah

hadiths.englishRaw: From the prophet ﷺ that he said "Whoever performs Hajj to the House [of Allah] without engaging in sexual relations or committing sins will return [from Hajj] as pure and sinless as the day he was born."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the prophet ﷺ that he said "Whoever performs Hajj to the House [of Allah] without engaging in sexual relations or committing sins will return [from Hajj] as pure and sinless as the day he was born."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ رَجَعَ كَمَا وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَازِمٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1838

chapter.englishTitle: Which Hajj is the best?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked, "Which Hajj is better?" He replied, "Performing Tawaf (circumambulation) of the Kaaba (Al-'Aj) and offering animal sacrifice (Al-Thaj)." Al-'Aj refers to performing the Tawaf, and Al-Thaj refers to the act of sacrificing an animal.
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked, "Which Hajj is better?" He replied, "Performing Tawaf (circumambulation) of the Kaaba (Al-'Aj) and offering animal sacrifice (Al-Thaj)." Al-'Aj refers to performing the Tawaf, and Al-Thaj refers to the act of sacrificing an animal.
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَيُّ الْحَجِّ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «الْعَجُّ وَالثَّجُّ» الْعَجُّ يَعْنِي التَّلْبِيَةَ وَالثَّجُّ يَعْنِي إِهْرَاقَ الدَّمِ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Abū Fudayk \u003e al-Ḍaḥḥāk b. ʿUthmān \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yarbūʿ \u003e Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ عَنْ الضَّحَّاكِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَرْبُوعٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1839

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the pilgrim should not wear of clothing.

hadiths.englishRaw: a man asked the Messenger of Allah what garments we should wear when we enter Ihram. He said: "Do not wear shirts, or pants, or 'Imamahs, or burnouses, or Khuffs unless someone does not have any sandals, in which case he should wear Khuffs that come beneath the ankles. And do not wear any garment that has been touched by (dyed with) Wars or saffron.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: a man asked the Messenger of Allah what garments we should wear when we enter Ihram. He said: "Do not wear shirts, or pants, or 'Imamahs, or burnouses, or Khuffs unless someone does not have any sandals, in which case he should wear Khuffs that come beneath the ankles. And do not wear any garment that has been touched by (dyed with) Wars or saffron.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مَا نَلْبَسُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ إِذَا أَحْرَمْنَا؟ قَالَ «لَا تَلْبَسُوا الْقُمُصَ وَلَا السَّرَاوِيلَاتِ وَلَا الْعَمَائِمَ وَلَا الْبَرَانِسَ وَلَا الْخِفَافَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ أَحَدٌ لَيْسَتْ لَهُ نَعْلَانِ فَلْيَلْبَسِ الْخُفَّيْنِ وَلْيَجْعَلْهُمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ وَلَا تَلْبَسُوا مِنَ الثِّيَابِ شَيْئًا مَسَّهُ وَرْسٌ وَلَا زَعْفَرَانٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ibn Saʿīd \u003e ʿUmar b. Nāfiʿ from his father \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ نَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1840

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the pilgrim should not wear of clothing.

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard the Prophet [SAW] say in 'Arafat: "Whoever cannot find an Izar (waist wrapper), let him wear trousers, and whoever cannot find sandals, let him wear Khuffs (leather socks)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard the Prophet [SAW] say in 'Arafat: "Whoever cannot find an Izar (waist wrapper), let him wear trousers, and whoever cannot find sandals, let him wear Khuffs (leather socks)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ إِزَارًا فَلْيَلْبَسْ سَرَاوِيلَ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ نَعْلَيْنِ فَلْيَلْبَسْ خُفَّيْنِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ أَوْ قِيلَ أَيَقْطَعُهُمَا؟ قَالَ لَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1841

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ مِنَ الثِّيَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the pilgrim should not wear of clothing.

hadiths.englishRaw: “He should not wear a shirt, or turbans (or head cover), pants or pajamas, hooded cloaks and no leather socks, unless he cannot find sandals, in which case he may wear leather socks but should cut them to below the ankles. And he should not wear any clothes that have been touched (dyed) with saffron or Wars.”*     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “He should not wear a shirt, or turbans (or head cover), pants or pajamas, hooded cloaks and no leather socks, unless he cannot find sandals, in which case he may wear leather socks but should cut them to below the ankles. And he should not wear any clothes that have been touched (dyed) with saffron or Wars.”*     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَمَّا يَلْبَسُ الْمُحْرِمُ قَالَ «لَا يَلْبَسُ الْقُمُصَ وَلَا الْعَمَائِمَ وَلَا السَّرَاوِيلَاتِ وَلَا الْبَرَانِسَ وَلَا الْخِفَافَ إِلَّا أَنْ لَا يَجِدَ نَعْلَيْنِ فَيَلْبَسَ خُفَّيْنِ وَلْيَقْطَعَهْمَا أَسْفَلَ مِنَ الْكَعْبَيْنِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1842

chapter.englishTitle: Goodness when entering the state of Ihram.

hadiths.englishRaw: She said, "I used to perfume the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before he was prohibited from using the best perfume." He said, and 'Urwah used to say to us, "Perfume yourselves before you enter the state of Ihram and before you pour the sacrificial blood on the day of sacrifice."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: She said, "I used to perfume the Messenger of Allah ﷺ before he was prohibited from using the best perfume." He said, and 'Urwah used to say to us, "Perfume yourselves before you enter the state of Ihram and before you pour the sacrificial blood on the day of sacrifice."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ «كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُحْرِمَ بِأَطْيَبِ الطِّيبِ» قَالَ وَكَانَ عُرْوَةُ يَقُولُ لَنَا «تَطَيَّبُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحْرِمُوا وَقَبْلَ أَنْ تُفِيضُوا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1843

chapter.englishTitle: Goodness when entering the state of Ihram.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I used to put perfume on the Messenger of Allah when he entered Ihram, using the best perfume I could find.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I used to put perfume on the Messenger of Allah when he entered Ihram, using the best perfume I could find.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أُطَيِّبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عِنْدَ إِحْرَامِهِ بِأَطْيَبِ مَا أَجِدُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Hishām \u003e ʿUthmān b. ʿUrwah \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1844

chapter.englishTitle: Goodness when entering the state of Ihram.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Aisha say, "I perfumed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I perfumed myself in Mina before he overflowed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Aisha say, "I perfumed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and I perfumed myself in Mina before he overflowed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ تَقُولُ «طَيَّبْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِحُرْمِهِ وَطَيَّبْتُهُ بِمِنًى قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn And Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْقَاسِمِ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1845

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فِي النُّفَسَاءِ وَالْحَائِضِ إِذَا أَرَادَتَا الْحَجَّ وَبَلَغَتَا الْمِيقَاتَ
chapter.englishTitle: In women during the state of menstruation and postpartum bleedin...

hadiths.englishRaw: Asma daughther of 'Umais gave birth to Muhammad bin Abi Bakr at Shajarah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Abu Bakr to ask her to take a bath and wear ihram.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Asma daughther of 'Umais gave birth to Muhammad bin Abi Bakr at Shajarah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Abu Bakr to ask her to take a bath and wear ihram.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: نُفِسَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ بِالشَّجَرَةِ «فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُهِلَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1846

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فِي النُّفَسَاءِ وَالْحَائِضِ إِذَا أَرَادَتَا الْحَجَّ وَبَلَغَتَا الْمِيقَاتَ
chapter.englishTitle: In women during the state of menstruation and postpartum bleedin...

hadiths.englishRaw: “Asma’ bint ‘Umais gave birth at Shajarah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ told Abu Bakr to tell her to take a bath and begin the Talbiyah.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Asma’ bint ‘Umais gave birth at Shajarah, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ told Abu Bakr to tell her to take a bath and begin the Talbiyah.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ جَابِرٍ فِي حَدِيثِ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ عُمَيْسٍ حِينَ نُفِسَتْ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ «فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهَا أَنْ تَغْتَسِلَ وَتُهِلَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Jarīr \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1847
hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet started the Talbiyah after the Salat."     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet started the Talbiyah after the Salat."     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَحْرَمَ دُبُرَ الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām b. Ḥarb \u003e Khuṣayf \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1848
hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet started the Talbiyah after the Salat."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet started the Talbiyah after the Salat."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَحْرَمَ وَأَهَلَّ فِي دُبُرِ الصَّلَاةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e al-Naḍr \u003e Ibn Shumayl \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ هُوَ ابْنُ شُمَيْلٍ أَنْبَأَنَا أَشْعَثُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1849

chapter.englishTitle: In the talbiyah

hadiths.englishRaw: Verily, the Prophet ﷺ used to say when he performed the pilgrimage, "Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal hamda wani'mata laka wal mulk, la sharika laka." Yahya and Nafi' have mentioned that Ibn 'Umar used to add the following words to this phrase, "Labbayka war-rahba'u ilayk, wal 'amal labbayk labbayk."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Verily, the Prophet ﷺ used to say when he performed the pilgrimage, "Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal hamda wani'mata laka wal mulk, la sharika laka." Yahya and Nafi' have mentioned that Ibn 'Umar used to add the following words to this phrase, "Labbayka war-rahba'u ilayk, wal 'amal labbayk labbayk."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا لَبَّى قَالَ «لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ» قَالَ يَحْيَى وَذَكَرَ نَافِعٌ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يَزِيدُ هَؤُلَاءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ «لَبَّيْكَ وَالرَّغْبَاءُ إِلَيْكَ وَالْعَمَلُ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá / Ibn Saʿīd \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1850

chapter.englishTitle: In raising the voice with the Takbeer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Gabriel came to me and said, "Order your companions or those with you to raise their voices with the talbiyah or with the pronouncement of 'Al-Ihlaal'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Gabriel came to me and said, "Order your companions or those with you to raise their voices with the talbiyah or with the pronouncement of 'Al-Ihlaal'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَتَانِي جِبْرِيلُ فَقَالَ مُرْ أَصْحَابَكَ أَوْ مَنْ مَعَكَ أَنْ يَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَهُمْ بِالتَّلْبِيَةِ أَوْ بِالْإِهْلَالِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abū Bakr b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Khallād b. al-Sāʾib from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ خَلَّادِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1851

chapter.englishTitle: In raising the voice with the Takbeer

hadiths.englishRaw: From Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr, with his chain of narration to him, something similar to this.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr, with his chain of narration to him, something similar to this.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1852

chapter.englishTitle: The Requirement in Hajj

hadiths.englishRaw: "I asked Sa'eed bin Jubair about a man who performs Hajj and stipulates a condition. He said: 'Conditions are something that people do among themselves.' I narrated the Hadith of 'Ikrimah to him, and he narrated to me from Ibn 'Abbas, that Duba'ah bint Az-Zubair bin 'Abdul-Muttalib came to the Prophet, and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I want to perform Hajj, so what should I say?' He said: 'Say: Labbaik Allahumma! Labbaika wa mahilli min al-ardihayth tahbisuni (Here I am, O Allah, Here I am, and I shall exit Ihram at any place where You decree that I cannot proceed.)" And whatever condition you stipulate will be accepted by your Lord."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I asked Sa'eed bin Jubair about a man who performs Hajj and stipulates a condition. He said: 'Conditions are something that people do among themselves.' I narrated the Hadith of 'Ikrimah to him, and he narrated to me from Ibn 'Abbas, that Duba'ah bint Az-Zubair bin 'Abdul-Muttalib came to the Prophet, and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I want to perform Hajj, so what should I say?' He said: 'Say: Labbaik Allahumma! Labbaika wa mahilli min al-ardihayth tahbisuni (Here I am, O Allah, Here I am, and I shall exit Ihram at any place where You decree that I cannot proceed.)" And whatever condition you stipulate will be accepted by your Lord."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ ضُبَاعَةَ بِنْتَ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَحُجَّ فَكَيْفَ أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ «قُولِي لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ وَمَحِلِّي حَيْثُ تَحْبِسُنِي فَإِنَّ لَكِ عَلَى رَبِّكِ مَا اسْتَثْنَيْتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Thābit b. Yazīd \u003e Hilāl b. Khabbāb \u003e Faḥaddatht ʿIkrimah Faḥaddathanī \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا هِلَالُ بْنُ خَبَّابٍ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ فَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1853

chapter.englishTitle: In the individualization of Hajj

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) performed Hajj exclusively (without performing ʿUmrah in the beginning).    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) performed Hajj exclusively (without performing ʿUmrah in the beginning).    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْهَا «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَفْرَدَ الْحَجَّ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah Raḍī Allāh Taʿālá ʿAnhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1854

chapter.englishTitle: In the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: That pleasure is permissible in the book of Allah, no prophet has forbidden it and no book has descended regarding it. A man said based on his opinion what seemed apparent to him.   – Sound
hadiths.body: That pleasure is permissible in the book of Allah, no prophet has forbidden it and no book has descended regarding it. A man said based on his opinion what seemed apparent to him.   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الْمُتْعَةَ حَلَالٌ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ لَمْ يَنْهَ عَنْهَا نَبِيٌّ وَلَمْ يَنْزِلْ فِيهَا كِتَابٌ قَالَ رَجُلٌ بِرَأْيِهِ مَا بَدَا لَهُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Abū Hilāl \u003e Qatādah \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn Innī Muḥaddithuk Biḥadīth Laʿal Allāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو هِلَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ قَالَ قَالَ عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُصَيْنٍ إِنِّي مُحَدِّثُكَ بِحَدِيثٍ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَنْفَعَكَ بِهِ بَعْدُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُسَلَّمُ عَلَيَّ وَإِنَّ ابْنَ زِيَادٍ أَمَرَنِي فَاكْتَوَيْتُ فَاحْتُبِسَ عَنِّي حَتَّى ذَهَبَ أَثَرُ الْمَكَاوِي وَاعْلَمْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1855

chapter.englishTitle: In enjoyment

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "Umar is better than me, and the Prophet ﷺ did that while he is better than Umar."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic sentence into English is: "Umar is better than me, and the Prophet ﷺ did that while he is better than Umar."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي «وَقَدْ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عُمَرَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Nawfal \u003e ʿĀm Ḥaj Muʿāwiyah Yasʾal Saʿd b. Mālik Kayf \u003e Bi-al-Ttamattuʿ Bi-al-ʿUmrah \u003e al-Ḥaj \u003e Ḥasanah Jamīlah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَامَ حَجَّ مُعَاوِيَةُ يَسْأَلُ سَعْدَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ كَيْفَ تَقُولُ بِالتَّمَتُّعِ بِالْعُمْرَةِ إِلَى الْحَجِّ؟ قَالَ حَسَنَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ فَقَالَ قَدْ كَانَ عُمَرُ يَنْهَى عَنْهَا فَأَنْتَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عُمَرَ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1856

chapter.englishTitle: In enjoyment

hadiths.englishRaw: I came to the Prophet ﷺ while he was throwing pebbles at the pillars during the Hajj. He asked me, "Have you performed Hajj?" I replied, "Yes." He then asked, "How did you perform the ritual of Ihram?" I said, "I made the intention of Ihram at the same time as the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ did." He said, "You have done well. Now go and perform Tawaf around the Kaaba, then go to Safa and Marwa, and then come out of the state of Ihram." He said, "I performed Tawaf around the Kaaba, went to Safa and Marwa, and then I went to visit a woman from the Banu Qays tribe. She began to touch my hair, and I started giving religious rulings to people based on this interaction. A man said to me, 'O Abdullah bin Qays, take it easy and be cautious with some of your rulings, for you do not know what instructions the Commander of the Believers has brought regarding the rituals after you.' So, I said, 'O people, whoever we have given a religious ruling, let them be cautious, for the Commander of the Believers is coming to you with instructions. Therefore, complete your rituals.' When he arrived, I went to him and mentioned what happened. He said, 'If we follow the Book of Allah, then the Book of Allah instructs us to complete the rituals. If we follow the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not exit the state of Ihram until the sacrificial animal reached its designated place.'"   – Sound Chain
