hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ حِينَ حَجَّ وَهُوَ مُنِيخٌ بِالْبَطْحَاءِ فَقَالَ لِي «أَحَجَجْتَ؟» قُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ «كَيْفَ أَهْلَلْتَ؟» قَالَ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ بِإِهْلَالٍ كَإِهْلَالِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَحْسَنْتَ اذْهَبْ فَطُفْ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ثُمَّ حِلَّ» قَالَ فَطُفْتُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ امْرَأَةً مِنْ نِسَاءِ بَنِي قَيْسٍ فَجَعَلَتْ تَفْلِي رَأْسِي فَجَعَلْتُ أُفْتِي النَّاسَ بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لِي رَجُلٌ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ رُوَيْدًا بَعْضَ فُتْيَاكَ فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي النُّسُكِ بَعْدَكَ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ مَنْ كُنَّا أَفْتَيْنَاهُ فُتْيَا فَلْيَتَّئِدْ فَإِنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَادِمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ فَبِهِ فَأْتَمُّوا فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ أَتَيْتُهُ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ «إِنْ نَأْخُذْ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ يَأْمُرُ بِالتَّمَامِ وَإِنْ نَأْخُذْ بِسُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَمْ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى بَلَغَ الْهَدْيُ مَحِلَّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qays b. Muslim \u003e Ṭāriq \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ طَارِقٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1857

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَقْتُلُ الْمُحْرِمُ فِي إِحْرَامِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is forbidden to kill during pilgrimage?

hadiths.englishRaw: the Prophet said "There are five kinds of animals for which there is no sin on the one who kills them when he is in a state of Ihram: Kites, mice, vicious dogs, scorpions and crows." (Sahih) Chpater 87. Killing Kites
hadiths.body: the Prophet said "There are five kinds of animals for which there is no sin on the one who kills them when he is in a state of Ihram: Kites, mice, vicious dogs, scorpions and crows." (Sahih) Chpater 87. Killing Kites
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ خَمْسٌ لَا جُنَاحَ فِي قَتْلِ مَنْ قُتِلَ مِنْهُنَّ الْغُرَابُ وَالْفَأْرَةُ وَالْحِدَأَةُ وَالْعَقْرَبُ وَالْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1858

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَقْتُلُ الْمُحْرِمُ فِي إِحْرَامِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is forbidden to kill during pilgrimage?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ ordered the killing of five seditious creatures in the sacred and non-sacred lands: the hoopoe, the mouse, the scorpion, the rabid dog, and the crow. Abdullah said, «The rabid dog.» And some of them said, «The black one.»   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ ordered the killing of five seditious creatures in the sacred and non-sacred lands: the hoopoe, the mouse, the scorpion, the rabid dog, and the crow. Abdullah said, «The rabid dog.» And some of them said, «The black one.»   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِقَتْلِ خَمْسِ فَوَاسِقَ فِي الْحِلِّ وَالْحَرَمِ الْحِدَأَةِ وَالْغُرَابِ وَالْفَأْرَةِ وَالْعَقْرَبِ وَالْكَلْبِ الْعَقُورِ قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «الْكَلْبُ الْعَقُورُ» وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ الْأَسْوَدُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbd al-Razzāq \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1859

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَقْتُلُ الْمُحْرِمُ فِي إِحْرَامِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is forbidden to kill during pilgrimage?

hadiths.englishRaw: Some of our companions reported that Ma'mar used to mention it from Az-Zuhri from Salim from his father, and from Urwah from Aisha from the Prophet ﷺ .
hadiths.body: Some of our companions reported that Ma'mar used to mention it from Az-Zuhri from Salim from his father, and from Urwah from Aisha from the Prophet ﷺ .
hadiths.arabic: بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا إِنَّ مَعْمَرًا كَانَ يَذْكُرُهُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَعَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Razzāq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1860

chapter.englishTitle: Cupping for pilgrims

hadiths.englishRaw: "the Messenger of Allah was cupped while he was fasting and in Ihram."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "the Messenger of Allah was cupped while he was fasting and in Ihram."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUthmān \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1861

chapter.englishTitle: Cupping for pilgrims

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had his camel's saddle tied up with a camel's hair while in the state of ihram.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had his camel's saddle tied up with a camel's hair while in the state of ihram.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِلَحْيِ جَمَلٍ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Sulaymān b. Bilāl \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Abū ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Aʿraj \u003e ʿAbdullāh Ibn Buḥaynah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ أَبِي عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنِ بُحَيْنَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1862

chapter.englishTitle: Cupping for pilgrims

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Ihram while in a state of consecration." Isaac said, Sufyan narrated once from Ata and once from Tawus, and they both mentioned it once.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Ihram while in a state of consecration." Isaac said, Sufyan narrated once from Ata and once from Tawus, and they both mentioned it once.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ احْتَجَمَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ» قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ مَرَّةً عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَمَرَّةً عَنْ طَاوُسٍ وَجَمَعَهُمَا مَرَّةً   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr \u003e ʿAṭāʾ And Ṭāws \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَطَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1863

chapter.englishTitle: In the marriage of the prohibited.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet married Maimunah when he was in Ihram."
hadiths.body: "The Prophet married Maimunah when he was in Ihram."
hadiths.arabic: «تَزَوَّجَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ»
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Jābir b. Zayd \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1864

chapter.englishTitle: In the marriage of the prohibited.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Nubayh ibn Wahb that a man from the Quraysh proposed to Aban ibn Uthman and he was the leader of Al-Mawsim. Aban said, "I only see him as an impoverished man from Iraq. Indeed, the one who is in the state of ihram neither marries nor is he married." Uthman informed us about that from the Messenger of Allah. Abu Muhammad was asked, "Do you agree with this?" He said, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Nubayh ibn Wahb that a man from the Quraysh proposed to Aban ibn Uthman and he was the leader of Al-Mawsim. Aban said, "I only see him as an impoverished man from Iraq. Indeed, the one who is in the state of ihram neither marries nor is he married." Uthman informed us about that from the Messenger of Allah. Abu Muhammad was asked, "Do you agree with this?" He said, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ خَطَبَ إِلَى أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ وَهُوَ أَمِيرُ الْمَوْسِمِ فَقَالَ أَبَانُ لَا أُرَاهُ إِلَّا عِرَاقِيًّا جَافِيًا «إِنَّ الْمُحْرِمَ لَا يَنْكِحُ وَلَا يُنْكِحُ» أَخْبَرَنَا بِذَلِكَ عُثْمَانُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Nubayh b. Wahb \u003e a man from Quraysh Khaṭab \u003e Abān b. ʿUthmān Wahū Amīr al-Mawsim \u003e Abān Lā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1865

chapter.englishTitle: In the marriage of the prohibited.

hadiths.englishRaw: Yazid bin Al Asamm, Maimunah’s nephew said on Maimunah’s authority The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ married me when we were not in the sacred state at Sarif.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Yazid bin Al Asamm, Maimunah’s nephew said on Maimunah’s authority The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ married me when we were not in the sacred state at Sarif.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَزَوَّجَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ حَلَالَانِ بَعْدَمَا رَجَعَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ بِسَرِفَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥabīb b. al-Shahīd \u003e Maymūn b. Mihrān \u003e Yazīd b. al-Aṣam \u003e Maymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ أَنَّ مَيْمُونَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1866

chapter.englishTitle: In the marriage of the prohibited.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah married Maimunah while he was Halal, and he stayed with her while he was Halal, and I was the messenger between the two of them."     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah married Maimunah while he was Halal, and he stayed with her while he was Halal, and I was the messenger between the two of them."     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَزَوَّجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَيْمُونَةَ حَلَالًا وَبَنَى بِهَا حَلَالًا وَكُنْتُ الرَّسُولَ بَيْنَهُمَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Maṭar al-Warrāq \u003e Rabīʿah b. Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Abū Rāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ مَطَرٍ الْوَرَّاقِ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1867

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي أَكْلِ لَحْمِ الصَّيْدِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا لَمْ يَصِدْ هُوَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of hunt meat for the forbidden, if it did not...

hadiths.englishRaw: "My father accompanied the Prophet ﷺ in the year of Hudaybiyah, and his companions entered into Ihram (the state of ritual consecration for pilgrimage), but Abu Qatadah did not enter into Ihram. He then struck a wild donkey and ate its meat. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I struck a wild donkey and killed it.' He said to the people, 'Eat, for you are in a state of Ihram.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "My father accompanied the Prophet ﷺ in the year of Hudaybiyah, and his companions entered into Ihram (the state of ritual consecration for pilgrimage), but Abu Qatadah did not enter into Ihram. He then struck a wild donkey and ate its meat. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I struck a wild donkey and killed it.' He said to the people, 'Eat, for you are in a state of Ihram.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: انْطَلَقَ أَبِي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَامَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَأَحْرَمَ أَصْحَابُهُ وَلَمْ يُحْرِمْ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ فَأَصَابَ حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ فَطَعَنَهُ وَأَكَلَ مِنْ لَحْمِهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حِمَارَ وَحْشٍ فَطَعَنْتُهُ فَقَالَ لِلْقَوْمِ «كُلُوا وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1868

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي أَكْلِ لَحْمِ الصَّيْدِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا لَمْ يَصِدْ هُوَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of hunt meat for the forbidden, if it did not...

hadiths.englishRaw: Not found
hadiths.body: Not found
hadiths.arabic: لا أوجد

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1869

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي أَكْلِ لَحْمِ الصَّيْدِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا لَمْ يَصِدْ هُوَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of hunt meat for the forbidden, if it did not...

hadiths.englishRaw: "While we were walking and they were forbidden, and Abu Qatadah was permissible, I saw a donkey, so I rode a horse and hit it, so they ate its meat even though it was forbidden. I did not eat it, so they came to the Prophet and asked him. He said, 'Did you indicate killing? Or did you say hitting?' They said, 'No.' He said, 'Then eat.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "While we were walking and they were forbidden, and Abu Qatadah was permissible, I saw a donkey, so I rode a horse and hit it, so they ate its meat even though it was forbidden. I did not eat it, so they came to the Prophet and asked him. He said, 'Did you indicate killing? Or did you say hitting?' They said, 'No.' He said, 'Then eat.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ نَسِيرُ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ وَأَبُو قَتَادَةَ حَلَالٌ إِذْ رَأَيْتُ حِمَارًا فَرَكِبْتُ فَرَسًا فَأَصَبْتُهُ فَأَكَلُوا مِنْ لَحْمِهِ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ وَلَمْ آكُلْ فَأَتَوْا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَسَأَلُوهُ فَقَالَ «أَشَرْتُمْ قَتَلْتُمْ؟» أَوْ قَالَ «ضَرَبْتُمْ؟» قَالُوا لَا قَالَ «فَكُلُوا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿUthmān b. ʿAbdullāh b. Mawhab \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1870

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي أَكْلِ لَحْمِ الصَّيْدِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا لَمْ يَصِدْ هُوَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of hunt meat for the forbidden, if it did not...

hadiths.englishRaw: the Prophet came, and when he was in Waddan, he saw an onager, but he gave it back to him and said: "'We are in Ihram, we cannot eat game.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Prophet came, and when he was in Waddan, he saw an onager, but he gave it back to him and said: "'We are in Ihram, we cannot eat game.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِلَحْمِ حِمَارِ وَحْشٍ فَرَدَّهُ وَقَالَ «إِنَّا حُرُمٌ لَا نَأْكُلُ الصَّيْدَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Kaysān \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Ṣaʿb b. Jathhāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ الصَّعْبِ بْنِ جَثَّامَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1871

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي أَكْلِ لَحْمِ الصَّيْدِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا لَمْ يَصِدْ هُوَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of hunt meat for the forbidden, if it did not...

hadiths.englishRaw: “We were with Talhah bin ‘Ubaidullah ؓ and we were in ihram. We were given a bird as a gift whilst Talhah was sleeping. Some of us ate and some of us refrained and did not eat. When Talhah woke up, he approved of those who had eaten it and said: “We ate it with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “We were with Talhah bin ‘Ubaidullah ؓ and we were in ihram. We were given a bird as a gift whilst Talhah was sleeping. Some of us ate and some of us refrained and did not eat. When Talhah woke up, he approved of those who had eaten it and said: “We ate it with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ «أَكَلْنَاهُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn al-Munkadir \u003e Muʿādh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿUthmān al-Taymī from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ فِي سَفَرٍ فَأُهْدِيَ لَهُ طَيْرٌ وَهُمْ مُحْرِمُونَ وَهُوَ رَاقِدٌ فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَكَلَ وَمِنَّا مَنْ تَوَرَّعَ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ طَلْحَةُ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ فَوَافََقَ مَنْ أَكَلَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1872

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي أَكْلِ لَحْمِ الصَّيْدِ لِلْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا لَمْ يَصِدْ هُوَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of hunt meat for the forbidden, if it did not...

hadiths.englishRaw: “Sa;b bin Jaththamah told us: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me when I was in Abwa’ or Waddan, and I gave him some meat of a wild donkey, but he gave it back to me, and when he saw from my face that I was upset, he said: ‘The only reason that we are giving it back is that we are in Ihram.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Sa;b bin Jaththamah told us: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by me when I was in Abwa’ or Waddan, and I gave him some meat of a wild donkey, but he gave it back to me, and when he saw from my face that I was upset, he said: ‘The only reason that we are giving it back is that we are in Ihram.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا بِالْأَبْوَاءِ أَوْ بِوَدَّانَ وَأَهْدَيْتُ لَهُ لَحْمَ حِمَارِ وَحْشٍ فَرَدَّهُ عَلَيَّ فَلَمَّا رَأَى فِي وَجْهِي الْكَرَاهِيَةَ قَالَ «إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِنَا رَدٌّ عَلَيْكَ وَلَكِنَّا حُرُمٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Ṣaʿb b. Jathhāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الصَّعْبُ بْنُ جَثَّامَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1873

chapter.englishTitle: In Hajj about Al-Hayy

hadiths.englishRaw: He was in the company of the Prophet ﷺ during the Farewell Hajj. A woman from Khath'am came and said, "I have fulfilled my obligation to Allah in performing Hajj, but my elderly father cannot ride on his mount and has not performed Hajj. Should I perform Hajj on his behalf?" He replied, "Yes." Abu Muhammad asked, "Do you say this?" He replied, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He was in the company of the Prophet ﷺ during the Farewell Hajj. A woman from Khath'am came and said, "I have fulfilled my obligation to Allah in performing Hajj, but my elderly father cannot ride on his mount and has not performed Hajj. Should I perform Hajj on his behalf?" He replied, "Yes." Abu Muhammad asked, "Do you say this?" He replied, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ رَدِيفَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ خَثْعَمَ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ فِي الْحَجِّ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ أَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا لَا يَسْتَمْسِكُ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ وَلَمْ يَحُجَّ أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟» قَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Faḍl b. ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1874

chapter.englishTitle: In Hajj about Al-Hayy

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman asked the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, my father is an elderly man who cannot ride a camel due to the burden of Allah's obligatory acts upon him." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Perform Hajj on his behalf."
hadiths.body: A woman asked the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, my father is an elderly man who cannot ride a camel due to the burden of Allah's obligatory acts upon him." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Perform Hajj on his behalf."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً سَأَلَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ أَبِي شَيْخٌ لَا يَسْتَوِي عَلَى الْبَعِيرِ أَدْرَكَتْهُ فَرِيضَةُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «حُجِّي عَنْهُ»
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Faḍl \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ الْفَضْلِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1875

chapter.englishTitle: In Hajj about Al-Hayy

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman from the tribe of Khath'am asked for the verdict of Messenger of Allah ﷺ (regarding something) during Hajjat-ul-Wadaʿ while Al-Fadl bin ʿAbbas was the companion-rider behind Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She asked, "Allah's ordained obligation (i.e. compulsory Hajj) enjoined on His slaves has become due on my old father who cannot sit firmly on the riding animal. Will it be sufficient if I perform the Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "Yes."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman from the tribe of Khath'am asked for the verdict of Messenger of Allah ﷺ (regarding something) during Hajjat-ul-Wadaʿ while Al-Fadl bin ʿAbbas was the companion-rider behind Messenger of Allah ﷺ. She asked, "Allah's ordained obligation (i.e. compulsory Hajj) enjoined on His slaves has become due on my old father who cannot sit firmly on the riding animal. Will it be sufficient if I perform the Hajj on his behalf?" He said, "Yes."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ خَثْعَمَ اسْتَفْتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ وَالْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَدِيفُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ فَرِيضَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ أَدْرَكَتْ أَبِي شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ فَهَلْ يَقْضِي أَنْ أَحُجَّ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1876

chapter.englishTitle: In Hajj about Al-Hayy

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , a narration from the hadith of Al-Awza'i.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , a narration from the hadith of Al-Awza'i.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوًا مِنْ حَدِيثِ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1877

chapter.englishTitle: In Hajj about Al-Hayy

hadiths.englishRaw: he was riding behind the Messenger of Allah and a man came and said: "O Messenger of Allah! My mother is an old woman and she cannot sit firmly in the saddle. If I tie her I fear that I may kill her." The Messenger of Allah said: "Don't you think that if your mother owed a debt you would pay it off?" He said: "Yes." Her said: "Then perform Hajj on behalf of your mother."(Shih)
hadiths.body: he was riding behind the Messenger of Allah and a man came and said: "O Messenger of Allah! My mother is an old woman and she cannot sit firmly in the saddle. If I tie her I fear that I may kill her." The Messenger of Allah said: "Don't you think that if your mother owed a debt you would pay it off?" He said: "Yes." Her said: "Then perform Hajj on behalf of your mother."(Shih)
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبِي أَوْ أُمِّي عَجُوزٌ كَبِيرٌ إِنْ أَنَا حَمَلْتُهَا لَمْ تَسْتَمْسِكْ وَإِنْ رَبَطْتُهَا خَشِيتُ أَنْ أَقْتُلَهَا قَالَ «أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ أَوْ أُمِّكَ دَيْنٌ أَكُنْتَ تَقْضِيهِ؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «فَحُجَّ عَنْ أَبِيكَ أَوْ أُمِّكَ»
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Isḥāq \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e al-Faḍl b. ʿAbbās or ʿUbaydullāh b. al-ʿAbbās \u003e a man
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ حَدَّثَنِي الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَوْ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْعَبَّاسِ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1878

chapter.englishTitle: Hajj for the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man from Khath'am came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'My father is an old man who cannot ride, and the command of Allah to perform Hajj has come. Will it be good enough if I perform Hajj on his behalf?' He said: 'Are you the oldest of his children?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Don't you think that if he owed a debt you would pay it off?, He' said: 'Yes.' He said: 'then perform Hajj on his behalf.'''(Daif)
hadiths.body: "A man from Khath'am came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'My father is an old man who cannot ride, and the command of Allah to perform Hajj has come. Will it be good enough if I perform Hajj on his behalf?' He said: 'Are you the oldest of his children?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'Don't you think that if he owed a debt you would pay it off?, He' said: 'Yes.' He said: 'then perform Hajj on his behalf.'''(Daif)
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ خَثْعَمَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَبِي أَدْرَكَهُ الْإِسْلَامُ وَهُوَ شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ رُكُوبَ الرَّحْلِ وَالْحَجُّ مَكْتُوبٌ عَلَيْهِ أَفَأَحُجُّ عَنْهُ؟ قَالَ «أَنْتَ أَكْبَرُ وَلَدِهِ؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ دَيْنٌ فَقَضَيْتَهُ عَنْهُ أَكَانَ ذَلِكَ يُجْزِئُ عَنْهُ؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «فَاحْجُجْ عَنْهُ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Jarīr \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Yūsuf b. al-Zubayr a freed slave of Liāl al-Zzubayr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ مَوْلًى لِآلِ الْزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1879

chapter.englishTitle: Hajj for the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, my father is an old man who is unable to perform Hajj." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Have you considered if your father had a debt and you paid it off, would that be accepted from him?" He replied, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah is more merciful to perform Hajj on behalf of your father."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, my father is an old man who is unable to perform Hajj." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Have you considered if your father had a debt and you paid it off, would that be accepted from him?" He replied, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah is more merciful to perform Hajj on behalf of your father."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَبِي شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَحُجَّ قَالَ «أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَ عَلَى أَبِيكَ دَيْنٌ فَقَضَيْتَهُ عَنْهُ قُبِلَ مِنْهُ؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «اللَّهُ أَرْحَمُ حُجَّ عَنْ أَبِيكَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Ṣāliḥ b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Ibn ʿAbd al-Ṣamad \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Mujāhid \u003e a freed slave of Ibn al-Zubayr Yuqāl Lah Yūsuf b. al-Zubayr or al-Zubayr b. Yūsuf \u003e Sawdah b. Zamʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ مَوْلَى ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ يُقَالُ لَهُ يُوسُفُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَوِ الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سَوْدَةَ بِنْتِ زَمْعَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1880

chapter.englishTitle: In the reception of the stone

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn ʿUmar. said, "I have never missed the touching of these two stones of Kaʿba (the Black Stone and the Yemenite Corner) both in the presence and the absence of crowds, since I saw the Prophet ﷺ touching them." I asked Nafiʿ: "Did Ibn ʿUmar use to walk between the two Corners?" Nafiʿ replied, "He used to walk in order that it might be easy for him to touch it (the Corner Stone)."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn ʿUmar. said, "I have never missed the touching of these two stones of Kaʿba (the Black Stone and the Yemenite Corner) both in the presence and the absence of crowds, since I saw the Prophet ﷺ touching them." I asked Nafiʿ: "Did Ibn ʿUmar use to walk between the two Corners?" Nafiʿ replied, "He used to walk in order that it might be easy for him to touch it (the Corner Stone)."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا تَرَكْتُ اسْتِلَامَ هَذَيْنِ الرُّكْنَيْنِ فِي شِدَّةٍ وَلَا رَخَاءٍ مُنْذُ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْتَلِمُهُمَا» قُلْتُ لِنَافِعٍ أَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَمْشِي بَيْنَ الرُّكْنَيْنِ؟ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَمْشِي لِيَكُونَ أَيْسَرَ لِاسْتِلَامِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1881

chapter.englishTitle: The privilege of receiving the stone

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said about the (Black) Stone: "By Allah! Allah will raise it on the Day of Resurrection with two eyes by which it sees and a tongue that it speaks with, testifying to whoever touched it in truth."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said about the (Black) Stone: "By Allah! Allah will raise it on the Day of Resurrection with two eyes by which it sees and a tongue that it speaks with, testifying to whoever touched it in truth."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَيَبْعَثَنَّ اللَّهُ الْحَجَرَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَهُ عَيْنَانِ يُبْصِرُ بِهِمَا وَلِسَانٌ يَنْطِقُ بِهِ يَشْهَدُ عَلَى مَنِ اسْتَلَمَهُ بِحَقٍّ» قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ «لِمَنِ اسْتَلَمَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl And Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUthmān b. Khuthaym \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1882

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَمَلَ ثَلَاثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the heading is as follows: "Who threw three a...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw pebbles from one stone to another stone three times."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw pebbles from one stone to another stone three times."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَمَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْحَجَرِ إِلَى الْحَجَرِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1883

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَمَلَ ثَلَاثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the heading is as follows: "Who threw three a...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn ʿUmar said, "When Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the first Tawaf he did Ramal in the first three rounds and then walked in the remaining four rounds (of Tawaf of the Kaʿba), where as in performing Tawaf between Safa and Marwa he used to run in the midst of the rainwater passage," I asked Nafiʿ, "Did ʿAbdullah (bin ʿUmar) use to walk steadily on reaching the Yemenite Corner?" He replied, "No, unless people were crowded at the Corner; otherwise he would not leave it without touching it."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn ʿUmar said, "When Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed the first Tawaf he did Ramal in the first three rounds and then walked in the remaining four rounds (of Tawaf of the Kaʿba), where as in performing Tawaf between Safa and Marwa he used to run in the midst of the rainwater passage," I asked Nafiʿ, "Did ʿAbdullah (bin ʿUmar) use to walk steadily on reaching the Yemenite Corner?" He replied, "No, unless people were crowded at the Corner; otherwise he would not leave it without touching it."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ الطَّوَافَ الْأَوَّلَ خَبَّ ثَلَاثَةً وَمَشَى أَرْبَعَةً وَكَانَ يَسْعَى بِبَطْنِ الْمَسِيلِ إِذَا سَعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ فَقُلْتُ لِنَافِعٍ أَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَمْشِي إِذَا بَلَغَ الرُّكْنَ الْيَمَانِيَ؟ قَالَ «لَا إِلَّا أَنْ يُزَاحَمَ عَلَى الرُّكْنِ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يَدَعُهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَلِمَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1884

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ رَمَلَ ثَلَاثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا
chapter.englishTitle: The translation of the heading is as follows: "Who threw three a...

hadiths.englishRaw: Nafi' reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that Messenger of Allah ﷺ walked swiftly from stone to stone in three circuits and walked (normally) in four.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Nafi' reported on the authority of Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) that Messenger of Allah ﷺ walked swiftly from stone to stone in three circuits and walked (normally) in four.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَمَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْحَجَرِ إِلَى الْحَجَرِ ثَلَاثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar b. Abān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنْبَأَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1885

chapter.englishTitle: The imprint in the sand

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ , it is narrated that he performed tawaf while wearing sandals.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ , it is narrated that he performed tawaf while wearing sandals.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «أَنَّهُ طَافَ مُضْطَبِعًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd \u003e Ibn Jubayr \u003e Ibn Yaʿlá from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ هُوَ ابْنُ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ يَعْلَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1886

chapter.englishTitle: The circumambulation of Al-Qarin.

hadiths.englishRaw: “Whoever enters Ihram for Hajj and ‘Umrah, one Tawaf is sufficient for both, and he should not exit Ihram until he has completed his Hajj, when he should exit Ihram for both.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Whoever enters Ihram for Hajj and ‘Umrah, one Tawaf is sufficient for both, and he should not exit Ihram until he has completed his Hajj, when he should exit Ihram for both.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ كَفَاهُ لَهُمَا طَوَافٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلَا يَحِلُّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Manṣūr \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1887

chapter.englishTitle: Circumambulation around the Kaaba

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Tawaf (of the Kaʿba) riding a camel (at that time the Prophet ﷺ had a foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Tawaf (of the Kaʿba) riding a camel (at that time the Prophet ﷺ had a foot injury). Whenever he came to the Corner (having the Black Stone) he would point out towards it with a thing in his hand and say, "Allahu-Akbar."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ كُلَّمَا أَتَى عَلَى الرُّكْنِ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ بِشَيْءٍ فِي يَدِهِ وَكَبَّرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1888

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا تَصْنَعُ الْحَاجَّةُ إِذَا كَانَتْ حَائِضًا
chapter.englishTitle: What does a woman do when she is menstruating

hadiths.englishRaw: I went to Makkah while I was menstruating and I didn't perform Sa'i (the walks between the hills of Safa and Marwa). I complained about it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said, "Do everything that the pilgrims do, except do not perform Tawaf (circumambulation) around the Kaaba."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: I went to Makkah while I was menstruating and I didn't perform Sa'i (the walks between the hills of Safa and Marwa). I complained about it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said, "Do everything that the pilgrims do, except do not perform Tawaf (circumambulation) around the Kaaba."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ وَأَنَا حَائِضٌ وَلَمْ أَطُفْ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ فَشَكَوْتُ ذَلِكَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «افْعَلِي مَا يَفْعَلُ الْحَاجُّ غَيْرَ أَنْ لَا تَطُوفِي بِالْبَيْتِ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1889

chapter.englishTitle: Talking About Tawaf

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Circumambulating the Kaaba is a prayer, except that Allah has allowed speaking during it. So, whoever speaks during it should only speak good."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Circumambulating the Kaaba is a prayer, except that Allah has allowed speaking during it. So, whoever speaks during it should only speak good."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ صَلَاةٌ إِلَّا أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَبَاحَ فِيهِ الْمَنْطِقَ فَمَنْ نَطَقَ فِيهِ فَلَا يَنْطِقْ إِلَّا بِخَيْرٍ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥumaydī \u003e al-Fuḍayl b. ʿIyāḍ \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1890

chapter.englishTitle: Talking About Tawaf

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAlī b. Maʿbad \u003e Mūsá b. Aʿyan \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1891

chapter.englishTitle: Praying behind the Maqam

hadiths.englishRaw: Omar Ibn Al Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said: "I asked the Messenger of Allah, 'If you had taken the station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer.' Then Allah revealed the verse: 'And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer.' [Surah Al Baqarah, verse 125]."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Omar Ibn Al Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, said: "I asked the Messenger of Allah, 'If you had taken the station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer.' Then Allah revealed the verse: 'And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer.' [Surah Al Baqarah, verse 125]."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَافَقْتُ رَبِّي فِي ثَلَاثٍ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوِ اتَّخَذْتَ مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ {وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى} [سورة البقرة آية رقم 125]   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1892

chapter.englishTitle: In the Sunnah of Hajj

hadiths.englishRaw: “We entered upon Jabir bin ‘Abdullah, and when we reached him he asked about the people (i.e., what their names were, etc.). When he reached me, I said: ‘I am Muhammad bin ‘Ali bin Husain.’ He stretched forth his hand towards my head, and undid my top button, then undid my lower button. Then he placed his hand on my chest, and I was a young boy at that time. Then he said: ‘Welcome to you, ask whatever you want.’ So I asked him, and he was blind. The time for prayer came, so he stood up, wrapping himself in a woven cloth. Every time he put it on his shoulders, its edges came up, because it was too small. And his cloak was beside him on a hook. He led us in prayer, then he said: ‘Tell us about the Hajj of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.’ He held up his hands, showing nine (fingers), and said: ‘The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed for nine years without performing Hajj, then it was announced to the people in the tenth year that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was going for Hajj. So many people came to Al-Madinah, all of them seeking to follow the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and do what he did. He set out and we set out with him, and we came to Dhul-Hulaifah where Asma’ bint ‘Umais gave birth to Muhammad bin Abu Bakr. She sent word to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asking what she should do. He said: “Perform Ghusl, fasten a cloth around your waist and enter Ihram.” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed in the mosque, then he rode Qaswa’ (his she-camel) until, when his she-camel arose with him upon Baida’,’ Jabir said: ‘As far as I could see, I saw people riding and walking in front of him, and I saw the same to his right and left, and behind him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was among us and Qur’an was being revealed to him, and he understood its meaning. Whatever he did, we did too. Then he began the Talbiyah of monotheism: “Labbaika Allahumma labbaik, labbaika la sharika laka labbaik. Innal-hamda wan-ni’mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika laka (Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Verily all praise and blessings are Yours, and all sovereignty, You have no partner).” And the people repeated his words. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ approved of that. And the Messenger of Allah ﷺ continued to recite the Talbiyah.’ Jabir said: ‘We did not intend (to do) anything but Hajj. We were not aware of ‘Umrah. Then when we reached the House with him, he touched the Corner, and walked quickly (Ramal) for three circuits and walked (normally) for four. Then he stood at the place of Ibrahim and said: “And take you (people) the place of Ibrahim as a place of prayer.” [2:125] He stood with the place between him and the House. My father used to say:* “And I do not think that he mentioned it other than from the Prophet ﷺ: ‘That he used to recite in those two Rak’ah (at the place of Ibrahim): “Say: ‘O you disbelievers!’” [Al-Kafirun (109)] and “Say: ‘He is Allah, (the) One.’” [Al-Ikhlas (112)] “Then he went back to the House and touched the Corner, then he went out through the gate to Safa. When he drew near to Safa he recited: “Verily, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah,” [2:158] (and said:) “We will start with that with which Allah started.” So he started with Safa and climbed it until he could see the House, then proclaimed the greatness of Allah (by saying: Allahu Akbar) and said Tahlil (La ilaha illallah) and praised Him (saying Al-Hamdulillah), and he said: “La ilaha illallah wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku, wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumit wa huwa ‘ala kulli shai’in Qadir. La ilaha illallah wahdahu, La sharika lahu anjaza wa’dahu, wa nasara ‘abduhu, wa hazamal-Ahzaba wahdahu (None has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone, with no partner or associate; His is the dominion, all praise is due to Him, He gives life and causes death and He is able to do all things. None has the right to be worshiped but Allah alone; He has no partner or associate, He fulfilled His promise, granted victory to His slave, and defeated the Confederates alone).” And he said that three times, supplication in between. Then he headed towards Marwah walking normally until, when he started to go downhill, he walked quickly (Ramal) in the bottom of the valley. When he started to go uphill, he walked normally, until he reached Marwah, and he did atop Marwah what he had done atop Safa. At the end of his Sa’y, atop Marwah he said: “If I had known before what I have come to know now, I would not have garlanded the sacrificial animal, and I would have made it ‘Umrah. Whoever among you does not have a sacrificial animal with him, let him exit Ihram and make it ‘Umrah.” So all the people exited Ihram and cut their hair, except the Prophet ﷺ and those who had sacrificial animals with them. Suraqah bin Malik bin Ju’shum stood up and said: “O Messenger of Allah! Is this for this year only, or forever and ever?” The Messenger of Allah ﷺ interlaced his fingers and said: “‘Umrah is included in Hajj like this,” twice. “No, it is forever and ever.” ‘Ali brought the camels of the Prophet ﷺ, and he found that Fatimah was one of those who had exited Ihram. She had put on a dyed garment and used kohl. ‘Ali disliked this action on her part, but she said: “My father told me to do this.” ‘Ali used to say in Iraq: “So I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, feeling upset with Fatimah because of what she had done, to ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about what she had said that he said, and that I had disliked that. He said: ‘She spoke the truth, she spoke the truth. What did you say when you began your Hajj?’” He said: “I said: ‘O Allah, I begin the Talbiyah for that for which your Messenger ﷺ begins the Talbiyah.’ (He said:) ‘And I have the sacrificial animal with me, so do not exit Ihram.’ He said: “The total number of sacrificial animals that ‘Ali had brought from Yemen and that the Prophet ﷺ brought from Al-Madinah were one hundred. Then all the people exited Ihram and cut their hair, apart from the Prophet ﷺ and those who had sacrificial animals with them. When the day of Tarwiyah came (the 8th of Dhul-Hijjah), they headed for Mina and began the Talbiyah for Hajj. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ rode. He prayed Zuhr, ‘Asr, Maghrib, ‘Isha’ and Fajr at Mina. Then he stayed for a short while until the sun rose, and he ordered that a tent of goat hair be pitched for him in Namirah. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out, and the Quraish were certain that he was going to stay at Al-Mash’ar Haram or at Al-Muzdalifah, as Quraish used to do during the Ignorance days. But the Messenger of Allah ﷺ continued until he came to ‘Arafat, where he found that the tent had been pitched for him in Namirah, and he stopped there. Then when the sun had passed its zenith, he called for Qaswa’ and she was saddled for him. He rode until he came to the bottom of the valley, and he addressed the people and said: ‘Your blood and your wealth are sacred to you, as sacred as this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this land of yours. Every matter of Ignorance days is abolished, beneath these two feet of mine. The blood feuds of the Ignorance days are abolished, and the first blood feud of Rabi’ah bin Harith, who was nursed among Banu Sa’d and killed by Hudhail. The usuries of Ignorance days are abolished, and the first usury (that I abolish) is our usury, the usury due to ‘Abbas bin ‘Abdul-Muttalib. It is all abolished. Fear Allah with regard to women, for you have taken them as a trust from Allah, and intimacy with them has become permissible to you through Allah’s Word. Your rights over them are that they should not allow anyone whom you dislike to sit on your bedding.** If they do that, then hit them, but in a manner that does not cause injury or leave a mark. Their rights over you are that you should provide for them and clothe them in a reasonable manner. I have left behind you something which, if you adhere to it, you will never go astray: the Book of Allah. You will be asked about me. What will you say?’ They said: ‘We bear witness that you have conveyed (the message) and fulfilled (your duty) and offered sincere advice.’ He gestured with his forefinger towards the sky and then towards the people, (and said:) ‘O Allah, bear witness, O Allah bear witness,’ three times. Then Bilal called the Adhan, then the Iqamah, and he prayed Zuhr. Then he made Iqamah and prayed ‘Asr, and he did not offer any prayer between them. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rode until he came to the place of standing, and he made his she-camel face Sakharat*** with the path in the sand in front of him, and he faced the Qiblah, then he remained standing until the sun had set and the afterglow had lessened somewhat, when the disk of the sun disappeared. Then he seated Usamah bin Zaid behind him and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out. He pulled Qaswa’s reins tight until her head was touching the saddle, and he gestured with his right hand: ‘O people, calmly, calmly!’ Every time he came to a hill, he released the reins a little so that she could climb. Then he came to Muzdalifah where he prayed Maghrib and ‘Isha’ with one Adhan and two Iqamah, offering no prayer in between. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ lay down until dawn came, and he prayed Fajr, when he saw that morning had come, with one Adhan and one Iqamah. Then he rode Qaswa’ until he came to Al-Mash’ar Al-Haram. He climbed it and praised Allah and proclaimed His greatness and that He is the only One worthy of worship. Then he remained standing until it had become quite bright, then he moved on before the sun rose. He seated Fadl bin ‘Abbas behind him, who was a man with lovely hair, white and handsome. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ moved on, he passed some women riding camels. Fadl started to look at them, so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ put his hand on the other side. Fadl turned his face to the other side to look. When he came to Muhassir, he sped up a little. Then he followed the middle road that brings you out to the biggest Pillar, until he reached the Pillar that is by the tree. He threw seven pebbles, saying the Takbir with each throw, pebbles suitable for Khadhf (i.e., the size of a chickpea) throwing from the bottom of the valley. Then he went to the place of slaughter, and slaughtered sixty-three camels with his own hand. Then he handed it over to ‘Ali who slaughtered the rest, and he gave him a share in his sacrificial animal. Then he ordered that a piece from each camel be brought; (the pieces) were put in a pot and cooked, and they (the Prophet ﷺ and ‘Ali) ate from the meat and drank from the soup. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ hastened to the House, and prayed Zuhr in Makkah. He came to Banu ‘Abdul-Muttalib, who were providing water to the pilgrims at Zamzam, and said: ‘Draw me some water, O Banu ‘Abdul-Muttalib. Were it not that the people would overwhelm you, I would have drawn water with you.’ So they drew up a bucket for him and he drank from it.’” * It appears that the speaker is Ja’far bin Muhammad who is narrating from his father, from Jabir. **And they say that the meaning if ‘your furniture’ or, ‘your special place’ in which case the objective is to say that the wife is not to admit anyone in the house whom the husband would be displeased with. ***Sakharat plural of Sakhrah rock or boulder. Nawawi said: “They are the rocks that lay at the base of the Mount of Mercy, and it is the mount in the middle of ‘Arafat.”    – Sound Chain
