hadiths.arabic: أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ حَجَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ فَعَقَدَ تِسْعًا فَقَالَ مَكَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ تِسْعَ سِنِينَ لَمْ يَحُجَّ ثُمَّ أُذِّنَ فِي النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ فِي الْعَاشِرَةِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَاجٌّ فَقَدِمَ الْمَدِينَةَ بَشَرٌ كَثِيرٌ كُلُّهُمْ يَلْتَمِسُ أَنْ يَأْتَمَّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَيَعْمَلَ مِثْلَ عَمَلِهِ فَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ فَوَلَدَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ عُمَيْسٍ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ؟ فَقَالَ «اغْتَسِلِي وَاسْتَثْفِرِي بِثَوْبٍ وَأَحْرِمِي» فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ عَلَى الْبَيْدَاءِ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى مَدِّ بَصَرِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ مِنْ رَاكِبٍ وَمَاشٍ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَخَلْفَهُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا وَعَلَيْهِ يُنْزَلُ الْقُرْآنُ وَهُوَ يَعْرِفُ تَأْوِيلَهُ فَأَهَلَّ بِالتَّوْحِيدِ «لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ» فَأَهَلَّ النَّاسُ بِهَذَا الَّذِي يُهِلُّونَ بِهِ فَلَمْ يَرُِدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَيْهِمْ شَيْئًا وَلَبَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ تَلْبِيَتَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَيْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَعَهُ قَالَ جَابِرٌ لَسْنَا نَنْوِي إِلَّا الْحَجَّ لَسْنَا نَعْرِفُ الْعُمْرَةَ حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَيْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَعَهُ اسْتَلَمَ الرُّكْنَ فَرَمَلَ ثَلَاثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ إِلَى مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَصَلَّى فَقَرَأَ {وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى} [البقرة 125] فَجَعَلَ الْمَقَامَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ وَكَانَ أَبِي يَقُولُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُهُ ذَكَرَهُ إِلَّا عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ وَقُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى الرُّكْنِ فَاسْتَلَمَهُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ مِنَ الْبَابِ إِلَى الصَّفَا فَلَمَّا أَتَى الصَّفَا قَرَأَ {إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ} [البقرة 158] «أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ» فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى رَأَى الْبَيْتَ فَوَحَّدَ اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ» ثُمَّ دَعَا بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ هَذَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ إِلَى الْمَرْوَةِ حَتَّى إِذَا انْصَبَّتْ قَدَمَاهُ فِي بَطْنِ الْوَادِي قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ يَعْنِي فَرَمَلَ حَتَّى إِذَا صَعِدْنَا مَشَى حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَيْنَا الْمَرْوَةَ فَفَعَلَ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ آخِرَ طَوَافٍ عَلَى الْمَرْوَةِ قَالَ «إِنِّي لَوِ اسْتَقْبَلْتُ مِنْ أَمْرِي مَا اسْتَدْبَرْتُ لَمْ أَسُقِ الْهَدْيَ وَجَعَلْتُهَا عُمْرَةً فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْكُمْ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ فَلْيُحِلَّ وَليَجْعَلْهَا عُمْرَةً» فَقَامَ سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ جُعْشُمٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلِعَامِنَا هَذَا أَمْ لِأَبَدٍ فَشَبَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي الْأُخْرَى فَقَالَ «دَخَلَتِ الْعُمْرَةُ فِي الْحَجِّ» هَكَذَا مَرَّتَيْنِ لَا بَلْ لِأَبَدِ أَبَدٍ لَا بَلْ لَأَبَدِ أَبَدٍ؟ فَشَبَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَصَابِعَهُ فِي الْأُخْرَى فَقَالَ «دَخَلَتِ الْعُمْرَةُ فِي الْحَجِّ» هَكَذَا مَرَّتَيْنِ «لَا بَلْ لِأَبَدِ أَبَدٍ لَا بَلْ لَأَبَدِ أَبَدٍ» وَقَدِمَ عَلِيٌّ بِبُدْنٍ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَوَجَدَ فَاطِمَةَ مِمَّنْ حَلَّ وَلَبِسَتْ ثِيَابَ صَبِيغٍ وَاكْتَحَلَتْ فَأَنْكَرَ عَلِيٌّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَتْ أَبِي أَمَرَنِي فَكَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَقُولُ ذَهَبْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُحَرِّشُهُ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ فِي الَّذِي صَنَعَتْ مُسْتَفْتِيًا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِيمَا ذَكَرَتْ فَأَنْكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ «صَدَقَتْ مَا فَعَلْتَ حِينَ فَرَضْتَ الْحَجَّ؟» قَالَ قُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أُهِلُّ بِمَا أَهَلَّ بِهِ رَسُولُكَ قَالَ «فَإِنَّ مَعِيَ الْهَدْيَ فَلَا تَحْلِلْ» قَالَ فَكَانَ جَمَاعَةُ الْهَدْيِ الَّذِي قَدِمَ بِهِ عَلِيٌّ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ وَالَّذِي أَتَى بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِائَةَ بَدَنَةٍ فَحَلَّ النَّاسُ كُلُّهُمْ وَقَصَّرُوا إِلَّا النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَمَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ التَّرْوِيَةِ وَجَّهَ إِلَى مِنًى فَأَهْلَلْنَا بِالْحَجِّ وَرَكِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَصَلَّى بِنَا الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ وَالصُّبْحَ ثُمَّ مَكَثَ قَلِيلًا حَتَّى إِذَا طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ أَمَرَ بِقُبَّةٍ مِنْ شَعَرٍ تُضْرَبُ لَهُ بِنَمِرَةَ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَارَ لَا تَشُكُّ قُرَيْشٌ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ وَاقِفٌ عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ كَمَا كَانَتْ قُرَيْشٌ تَصْنَعُ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فِي الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ فَسَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى أَتَى عَرَفَةَ فَوَجَدَ الْقُبَّةَ قَدْ ضُرِبَتْ بِنَمِرَةَ فَنَزَلَهَا حَتَّى إِذَا زَاغَتْ يَعْنِي الشَّمْسَ أَمَرَ بِالْقَصْوَاءِ فَرُحِّلَتْ لَهُ فَأَتَى بَطْنَ الْوَادِي فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ وَقَالَ «إِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ حَرَامٌ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا أَلَا إِنَّ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيَّ مَوْضُوعٌ وَدِمَاءُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَوْضُوعَةٌ وَأَوَّلُ دَمٍ وُضِعَ دِمَاؤُنَا دَمُ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ كَانَ مُسْتَرْضَعًا فِي بَنِي سَعْدٍ فَقَتَلَتْهُ هُذَيْلٌ وَرِبَا الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ مَوْضُوعٌ وَأَوَّلُ رِبًا أَضَعُهُ رِبَا عَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَإِنَّهُ مَوْضُوعٌ كُلُّهُ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ فِي النِّسَاءِ فَإِنَّمَا أَخَذْتُمُوهُنَّ بِأَمَانَةِ اللَّهِ وَاسْتَحْلَلْتُمْ فُرُوجَهُنَّ بِكَلِمَةِ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ أَنْ لَا يُوطِئْنَ فُرُشَكُمْ أَحَدًا تَكْرَهُونَهُ فَإِنْ فَعَلْنَ ذَلِكَ فَاضْرِبُوهُنَّ ضَرْبًا غَيْرَ مُبَرِّحٍ وَلَهُنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَأَنْتُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ عَنِّي فَمَا أَنْتُمْ قَائِلُونَ؟» قَالُوا نَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ وَأَدَّيْتَ وَنَصَحْتَ فَقَالَ بِأُصْبُعِهِ السَّبَّابَةِ فَرَفَعَهَا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ وَيَنْكُتُهَا إِلَى النَّاسِ «اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ» ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ بِلَالٌ بِنِدَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ أَقَامَ فَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئًا ثُمَّ رَكِبَ حَتَّى وَقَفَ فَجَعَلَ بَطْنَ نَاقَتِهِ الْقَصْوَاءِ إِلَى الصُّخَيْرَاتِ وَقَالَ إِسْمَعِيلُ إِلَى الشُّجَيْرَاتِ وَجَعَلَ حَبْلَ الْمُشَاةِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفًا حَتَّى غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَذَهَبَتِ الصُّفْرَةُ حَتَّى غَابَ الْقُرْصُ فَأَرْدَفَ أُسَامَةَ خَلْفَهُ ثُمَّ دَفَعَ وَقَدْ شَنَقَ لِلْقَصْوَاءِ الزِّمَامَ حَتَّى إِنَّهُ لَيُصِيبُ رَأْسُهَا مَوْرِكَ رَحْلِهِ وَيَقُولُ بِيَدِهِ الْيُمْنَى «السَّكِينَةَ السَّكِينَةَ» كُلَّمَا أَتَى حَبْلًا مِنَ الْحِبَالِ أَرْخَى لَهَا قَلِيلًا حَتَّى تَصْعَدَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ فَصَلَّى بِهَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ اضْطَجَعَ حَتَّى إِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ صَلَّى الْفَجْرَ بِأَذَانٍ وَإِقَامَةٍ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى وَقَفَ عَلَى الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ وَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَهُ وَهَلَّلَهُ وَوَحَّدَهُ حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدًّا ثُمَّ دَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ وَأَرْدَفَ الْفَضْلَ بْنَ الْعَبَّاسِ وَكَانَ رَجُلًا حَسَنَ الشَّعْرِ أَبْيَضَ وَسِيمًا فَلَمَّا دَفَعَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مَرَّ بِالظُّعُنِ يَجْرِينَ فَطَفِقَ الْفَضْلُ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِنَّ فَأَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَدَهُ فَوَضَعَهَا عَلَى وَجْهِ الْفَضْلِ فَحَوَّلَ الْفَضْلُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الشِّقِّ الْآخَرِ فَوَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَدَهُ مِنَ الشِّقِّ الْآخَرِ حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَى مُحَسِّرَ حَرَّكَ قَلِيلًا ثُمَّ سَلَكَ الطَّرِيقَ الْوُسْطَى الَّتِي تُخْرِجُكَ إِلَى الْجَمْرَةِ الْكُبْرَى حَتَّى إِذَا أَتَى الْجَمْرَةَ الَّتِي عِنْدَهَا الشَّجَرَةُ فَرَمَى بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ مِنْ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ ثُمَّ رَمَى مِنْ بَطْنِ الْوَادِي ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى الْمَنْحَرِ فَنَحَرَ ثَلَاثًا وَسِتِّينَ بَدَنَةً بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ أَعْطَى عَلِيًّا فَنَحَرَ مَا غَبَرَ وَأَشْرَكَهُ فِي بُدْنِهِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ بَدَنَةٍ بِبِضْعَةٍ فَجُعِلَتْ فِي قِدْرٍ فَطُبِخَتْ فَأَكَلَا مِنْ لُحُومِهَا وَشَرِبَا مِنْ مَرَقِهَا ثُمَّ رَكِبَ فَأَفَاضَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَأَتَى الْبَيْتَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ بِمَكَّةَ وَأَتَى بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَهُمْ يَسْتَقُونَ عَلَى زَمْزَمَ فَقَالَ «انْزِعُوا بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَلَوْلَا يَغْلِبُكُمُ النَّاسُ عَلَى سِقَايَتِكُمْ لَنَزَعْتُ مَعَكُمْ» فَنَاوَلُوهُ دَلْوًا فَشَرِبَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Ḥātim b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Jaʿfar Dakhalnā \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh Fasaʾal \u003e al-Qawm Ḥattá Āntahá Ilay \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī Faʾahwá Biyadih \u003e Zirrī al-Aʿlá And Zirrī al-Asfal Thum Waḍaʿ Famah Bayn Thadyay \u003e Yawmaʾidh Ghulām Shāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ دَخَلْنَا عَلَى جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَسَأَلَ عَنِ الْقَوْمِ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَيَّ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ إِلَى زِرِّيَ الْأَعْلَى وَزِرِّيَ الْأَسْفَلِ ثُمَّ وَضَعَ فَمَهُ بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيَّ وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ غُلَامٌ شَابٌّ فَقَالَ مَرْحَبًا بِكَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي سَلْ عَمَّا شِئْتَ فَسَأَلْتُهُ وَهُوَ أَعْمَى وَجَاءَ وَقْتُ الصَّلَاةِ فَقَامَ فِي نسَاجَةٍ مُلْتَحِفًا بِهَا كُلَّمَا وَضَعَهَا عَلَى مَنْكِبَيْهِ رَجَعَ طَرَفُهَا إِلَيْهِ مِنْ صِغَرِهَا وَرِدَاؤُهُ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ عَلَى الْمِشْجَبِ فَصَلَّى فَقُلْتُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1893

chapter.englishTitle: In the Sunnah of Hajj

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Jabir with this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From Jabir with this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ جَابِرٍ بِهَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd al-Aṣbahānī \u003e Ḥātim b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Jaʿfar from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْأَصْبَهَانِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1894

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا مَاتَ مَا يُصْنَعُ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In Muharram, what is done with the deceased?

hadiths.englishRaw: "While a man was standing in Arafat with the Messenger of Allah, he fell from his mount and it killed him. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Wash him with water and lotus leaves, and shroud him in two cloths. Do not apply aromatics to him or cover his head, for Allah, the Might and Sublime, wil raise him on the Day of Resurrection reciting the Talbiyah.'".     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "While a man was standing in Arafat with the Messenger of Allah, he fell from his mount and it killed him. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Wash him with water and lotus leaves, and shroud him in two cloths. Do not apply aromatics to him or cover his head, for Allah, the Might and Sublime, wil raise him on the Day of Resurrection reciting the Talbiyah.'".     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَا رَجُلٌ وَاقِفٌ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِعَرَفَةَ فَوَقَعَ عَنْ رَاحِلَتِهِ أَوْ قَالَ فَأَقْعَصَتْهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اغْسِلُوهُ بِمَاءٍ وَسِدْرٍ وَكَفِّنُوهُ فِي ثَوْبَيْنِ وَلَا تُحَنِّطُوهُ وَلَا تُخَمِّرُوا رَأْسَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَبْعَثُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُلَبِّيًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibn Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1895

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الذِّكْرِ فِي الطَّوَافِ وَالسَّعْيِ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Remembrance in Tawaf and Sai between Safa and Marwa

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic phrase is: "Indeed, the purpose of circumambulating the Ka'bah, stoning the pillars, and walking between Safa and Marwa is for the remembrance of Allah." Abu Asim used to recite it.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic phrase is: "Indeed, the purpose of circumambulating the Ka'bah, stoning the pillars, and walking between Safa and Marwa is for the remembrance of Allah." Abu Asim used to recite it.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الطَّوَافُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَرَمْيُ الْجِمَارِ وَالسَّعْيُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِإِقَامَةِ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ» قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ كَانَ يَرْفَعُهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Ziyād \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1896

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الذِّكْرِ فِي الطَّوَافِ وَالسَّعْيِ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Remembrance in Tawaf and Sai between Safa and Marwa

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym And Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Ziyād \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1897

chapter.englishTitle: In the nullification of Hajj.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked: Messenger of Allah, is the (command of) cancelling hajj meant exclusively for us, or for others too? He replied: No, this is meant exclusively for you.     – Repudiated
hadiths.body: I asked: Messenger of Allah, is the (command of) cancelling hajj meant exclusively for us, or for others too? He replied: No, this is meant exclusively for you.     – Repudiated
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَسْخُ الْحَجِّ ألَنَا خَاصَّةً أَمْ لِمَنْ بَعْدَنَا؟ قَالَ «بَلْ لَنَا خَاصَّةً»   – ضعيف منكر
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Rabīʿah b. Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e al-Ḥārith b. Bilāl b. al-Ḥārith from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ بِلَالِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1898

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنِ اعْتَمَرَ فِي أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Who performed 'Umrah during the months of Hajj

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn ‘Abbas reported the Prophet ﷺ as saying This is an ‘Umrah from which we have benefitted. Anyone who has brought sacrificial animal with him should take off ihram totally. ‘Umrah has been included in Hajj till the Day of Judgment. Abu Dawud said This is a munkar (uncommon) tradition. This is in fact the statement of Ibn ‘Abbas himself.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn ‘Abbas reported the Prophet ﷺ as saying This is an ‘Umrah from which we have benefitted. Anyone who has brought sacrificial animal with him should take off ihram totally. ‘Umrah has been included in Hajj till the Day of Judgment. Abu Dawud said This is a munkar (uncommon) tradition. This is in fact the statement of Ibn ‘Abbas himself.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «هَذِهِ عُمْرَةٌ اسْتَمْتَعْنَا بِهَا فَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ فَلْيَحِلَّ الْحِلَّ كُلَّهُ فَقَدْ دَخَلَتِ الْعُمْرَةُ فِي الْحَجِّ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1899

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنِ اعْتَمَرَ فِي أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Who performed 'Umrah during the months of Hajj

hadiths.englishRaw: Ar-Rabi' ibn Saburah said on the authority of his father (Saburah): We went out along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ till we reached Usfan, Suraqah ibn Malik al-Mudlaji said to him: Messenger of Allah, explain to us like the people as if they were born today. He said: Allah, the Exalted, has included this umrah in your hajj. When you come (to Mecca), and he who goes round the House (the Ka'bah), and runs between as-Safa and al-Marwah, is allowed to take off ihram except he who has brought the sacrificial animals with him.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ar-Rabi' ibn Saburah said on the authority of his father (Saburah): We went out along with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ till we reached Usfan, Suraqah ibn Malik al-Mudlaji said to him: Messenger of Allah, explain to us like the people as if they were born today. He said: Allah, the Exalted, has included this umrah in your hajj. When you come (to Mecca), and he who goes round the House (the Ka'bah), and runs between as-Safa and al-Marwah, is allowed to take off ihram except he who has brought the sacrificial animals with him.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُمْ سَارُوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ حَتَّى بَلَغُوا عُسْفَانَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي مُدْلِجٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَالِكُ بْنُ سُرَاقَةَ أَوْ سُرَاقَةُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ اقْضِ لَنَا قَضَاءَ قَوْمٍ وُلِدُوا الْيَوْمَ قَالَ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَدْخَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي حَجِّكُمْ هَذَا عُمْرَةً فَإِذَا أَنْتُمْ قَدِمْتُمْ فَمَنْ تَطَوَّفَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبِالصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ فَقَدْ حَلَّ إِلَّا مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْيٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Rabīʿ b. Sabrah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ رَبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1900

chapter.englishTitle: How old did the Prophet ﷺ live?

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ‘Umrah four times: The ‘Umrah of Hudaibiyah, the ‘Umrah to make up for (the one not completed previously), the third from Ji’ranah and the fourth that he did with his Hajj.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed ‘Umrah four times: The ‘Umrah of Hudaibiyah, the ‘Umrah to make up for (the one not completed previously), the third from Ji’ranah and the fourth that he did with his Hajj.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ اعْتَمَرَ أَرْبَعَ عُمَرٍ عُمْرَةَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَعُمْرَةَ الْقَضَاءِ أَوْ قَالَ عُمْرَةَ الْقِصَاصِ شَكَّ شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ مِنْ قَابِلٍ وَالثَّالِثَةَ مِنَ الْجِعْرَانَةِ وَالرَّابِعَةَ الَّتِي مَعَ حَجَّتِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Shihāb b. ʿAbbād \u003e Dāwud b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا شِهَابُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1901

chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of Umrah in Ramadan

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said to a woman, "Perform 'Umrah during Ramadan, for a 'Umrah in Ramadan equals a Hajj in reward."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said to a woman, "Perform 'Umrah during Ramadan, for a 'Umrah in Ramadan equals a Hajj in reward."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لِامْرَأَةٍ «اعْتَمِرِي فِي رَمَضَانَ فَإِنَّ عُمْرَةً فِي رَمَضَانَ تَعْدِلُ حَجَّةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1902

chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of Umrah in Ramadan

hadiths.englishRaw: “ ‘Umrah during Ramadan is equivalent to Hajj (i.e. in reward).”    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “ ‘Umrah during Ramadan is equivalent to Hajj (i.e. in reward).”    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عُمْرَةٌ فِي رَمَضَانَ تَعْدِلُ حَجَّةً»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿĪsá b. Maʿqil b. Abū Maʿqal al-Asadī Asad Khuzaymah \u003e Yūsuf b. ʿAbdullāh b. Salām \u003e Jaddatih Um Maʿqal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ أَبِي مَعْقَلٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ أَسَدُ خُزَيْمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ أُمِّ مَعْقَلٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1903

chapter.englishTitle: The meeqat in Umrah

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, left from Al-Ji'ranah when he intended to perform Umrah, and he entered Mecca at night and completed his Umrah. Then he left from beneath his tent in the morning and returned to Al-Ji'ranah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, left from Al-Ji'ranah when he intended to perform Umrah, and he entered Mecca at night and completed his Umrah. Then he left from beneath his tent in the morning and returned to Al-Ji'ranah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَرَجَ مِنَ الْجِعْرَانَةِ حِينَ أَنْشَأَ مُعْتَمِرًا فَدَخَلَ مَكَّةَ لَيْلًا فَقَضَى عُمْرَتَهُ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ مِنْ تَحْتِ لَيْلَتِهِ فَأَصْبَحَ بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ كَبَائِتٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Bazzāz \u003e Yaḥyá b. Zakariyyā \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Muzāḥim b. Abū Muzāḥim \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Muḥarrish al-Kaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُزَاحِمُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَرِّشٍ الْكَعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1904

chapter.englishTitle: The meeqat in Umrah

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Bakr told me, stating that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me to be good to Aisha and make her feel comfortable. Sufyan said, "Shu'bah was impressed by a similar chain of narration."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdul Rahman ibn Abi Bakr told me, stating that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me to be good to Aisha and make her feel comfortable. Sufyan said, "Shu'bah was impressed by a similar chain of narration."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ يَقُولُ «أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ أُرْدِفَ عَائِشَةَ فَأُعْمِرَهَا مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ» قَالَ سُفْيَانُ «كَانَ شُعْبَةُ يُعْجِبُهُ مِثْلَ هَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ṣadaqah b. al-Faḍl \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr \u003e ʿAmr b. Aws \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو سَمِعَ عَمْرَو بْنَ أَوْسٍ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1905

chapter.englishTitle: The meeqat in Umrah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to AbdurRahman: AbdurRahman, put your sister Aisha on the back of the camel behind you and make her perform umrah from at-Tan'im. When you come down from the hillock (in at-Tan'im), she must wear (ihram for umrah), for this is an umrah accepted (by Allah).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to AbdurRahman: AbdurRahman, put your sister Aisha on the back of the camel behind you and make her perform umrah from at-Tan'im. When you come down from the hillock (in at-Tan'im), she must wear (ihram for umrah), for this is an umrah accepted (by Allah).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ «أَرْدِفْ أُخْتَكَ يَعْنِي عَائِشَةَ وَأَعْمِرْهَا مِنَ التَّنْعِيمِ فَإِذَا هَبَطْتَ مِنَ الْأَكَمَةِ فَمُرْهَا فَلْتُحْرِمْ فَإِنَّهَا عُمْرَةٌ مُتَقَبَّلَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Yūnus \u003e Dāwud al-ʿAṭṭār \u003e Ibn Khuthaym \u003e Yūsuf b. Māhak \u003e Ḥafṣah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq from her father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ الْعَطَّارُ عَنْ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ عَنْ أَبِيهَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1906

chapter.englishTitle: In kissing the stone

hadiths.englishRaw: I am kissing you, whereas I know that you are a stone, but I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissing you (that Is why I kiss you).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I am kissing you, whereas I know that you are a stone, but I saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ kissing you (that Is why I kiss you).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنِّي لَأُقَبِّلُكَ وَإِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ حَجَرٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُقَبِّلُكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1907

chapter.englishTitle: In kissing the stone

hadiths.englishRaw: "I know that you are a stone, but I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I know that you are a stone, but I have seen the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ حَجَرٌ وَلَكِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَفْعَلُ هَذَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Jaʿfar b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUthmān \u003e Raʾayt Muḥammad b. ʿAbbād b. Jaʿfar Yastalim al-Ḥajar Thum Yuqabbiluh And Yasjud ʿAlayh \u003e Lah Mā Hadhā \u003e Raʾayt Khālak ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbbās Riḍwān Allāh ʿAlayh Yafʿaluh Thum \u003e Raʾayt ʿUmar Faʿalah Thum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ يَسْتَلِمُ الْحَجَرَ ثُمَّ يُقَبِّلُهُ وَيَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ مَا هَذَا؟ فَقَالَ رَأَيْتُ خَالَكَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ يَفْعَلُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ عُمَرَ فَعَلَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1908

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in the Kaaba

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah, and with him was Usama bin Zaid. I was hiding behind the Kaaba, and Ibn Umar said, "The people gathered and the Prophet ﷺ , Bilal, and Usama entered." So I asked Bilal from behind the door, "Where did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray?" Bilal replied, "Between the two Sara."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered Makkah, and with him was Usama bin Zaid. I was hiding behind the Kaaba, and Ibn Umar said, "The people gathered and the Prophet ﷺ , Bilal, and Usama entered." So I asked Bilal from behind the door, "Where did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ pray?" Bilal replied, "Between the two Sara."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَكَّةَ وَرَدِيفُهُ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ فَأَنَاخَ فِي أَصْلِ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَسَعَى النَّاسُ فَدَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَبِلَالٌ وَأُسَامَةُ فَقُلْتُ لِبِلَالٍ مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْبَابِ أَيْنَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ فَقَالَ «بَيْنَ السَّارِيَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1909

chapter.englishTitle: Prayer in the Kaaba

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the house, along with Usama bin Zaid, Bilal, and Uthman bin Talha al-Hajabi, and he mentioned something similar to it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the house, along with Usama bin Zaid, Bilal, and Uthman bin Talha al-Hajabi, and he mentioned something similar to it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْبَيْتَ هُوَ وَأُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَبِلَالٌ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ الْحَجَبِيُّ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Layth \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sālim \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1910

chapter.englishTitle: The heading in English is: "The Stone from the House

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: "Were it not for the fact that your people have recently left disbelief, I would have knocked down the House and rebuilt it on the foundation of Ibrahim, peace be upon him, and I would have given it a back door. For when the Quraish built the House, they made it too small.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: "Were it not for the fact that your people have recently left disbelief, I would have knocked down the House and rebuilt it on the foundation of Ibrahim, peace be upon him, and I would have given it a back door. For when the Quraish built the House, they made it too small.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوْلَا حَدَاثَةُ عَهْدِ قَوْمِكِ بِالْكُفْرِ لَنَقَضْتُ الْكَعْبَةَ ثُمَّ لَبَنَيْتُهَا عَلَى أُسِّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَإِنَّ قُرَيْشًا حِينَ بَنَتْ اسْتَقْصَرَتْ ثُمَّ جَعَلَتْ لَهَا خَلْفًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Farwah b. Abū al-Maghrāʾ \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنِي فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1911

chapter.englishTitle: The heading in English is: "The Stone from the House

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about the Black Stone, is it secure inside the Kaaba? He said, "Yes." I asked, "Then why don't they let people inside?" He said, "Your people cannot afford to provide for their expenses." I asked, "What about its elevated door?" He said, "Your people did that so that they can let in whomever they want and prevent whomever they want. If it wasn't for your people's recent departure from ignorance, I would have certainly had the stone removed and had its door placed on the ground."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Prophet ﷺ about the Black Stone, is it secure inside the Kaaba? He said, "Yes." I asked, "Then why don't they let people inside?" He said, "Your people cannot afford to provide for their expenses." I asked, "What about its elevated door?" He said, "Your people did that so that they can let in whomever they want and prevent whomever they want. If it wasn't for your people's recent departure from ignorance, I would have certainly had the stone removed and had its door placed on the ground."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنِ الحَجَرِِ أَمِنَ الْبَيْتِ هُوَ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ فَمَا لَهُمْ لَمْ يُدْخِلُوهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ؟ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ قَوْمَكِ قَصَّرَتْ بِهِمُ النَّفَقَةُ» قُلْتُ فَمَا شَأْنُ بَابِهِ مُرْتَفِعًا؟ قَالَ «فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ قَوْمُكِ لِيُدْخِلُوا مَنْ شَاءُوا وَيَمْنَعُوا مَنْ شَاءُوا وَلَوْلَا أَنَّ قَوْمَكِ حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِجَاهِلِيَّةٍ فَأَخَافُ أَنْ تُنْكِرَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لَعَمَدْتُ إِلَى الْحِجْرِ فَجَعَلْتُهُ فِي الْبَيْتِ وَأَلْزَقْتُ بَابَهُ بِالْأَرْضِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e al-Ashʿath b. Sulaym \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1912

chapter.englishTitle: In Tashhib

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Ibn Abbas saying, "Al-Tahsib is nothing but a place where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ camped." Abu Muhammad said, "Al-Tahsib is a location in Makkah and it is also a location in Al-Bathaa."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Ibn Abbas saying, "Al-Tahsib is nothing but a place where the Messenger of Allah ﷺ camped." Abu Muhammad said, "Al-Tahsib is a location in Makkah and it is also a location in Al-Bathaa."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ «التَّحْصِيبُ لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مَنْزِلٌ نَزَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «التَّحْصِيبُ مَوْضِعٌ بِمَكَّةَ وَهُوَ مَوْضِعٌ بِبَطْحَاءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1913

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَمْ صَلَاةً يُصَلَّى بِمِنًى حَتَّى يَغْدُوَ إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ
chapter.englishTitle: How many prayers are performed in Mina before proceeding to Araf...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed five prayers in Mina."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed five prayers in Mina."
hadiths.arabic: «صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِمِنًى خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍ»
hadiths.chain: al-Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Abū Kudaynah \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Muhallab \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Miqsam \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُدَيْنَةَ هُوَ يَحْيَى بْنُ الْمُهَلَّبِ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1914

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَمْ صَلَاةً يُصَلَّى بِمِنًى حَتَّى يَغْدُوَ إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ
chapter.englishTitle: How many prayers are performed in Mina before proceeding to Araf...

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Abd Al ‘Aziz bin Rufai’ said I asked Anas bin Malik saying “Tell me something you knew about the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ viz where he offered the noon prayer on Yawm Al Tarwiyah(8th of Dhu Al Hijjah). He replied, In Mina I asked Where did he pray the afternoon prayer on Yaum Al Nafr(12th or 13th of Dhu Al Hijjah). He replied In al-Abtah he then said “Do as your commanders do.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ‘Abd Al ‘Aziz bin Rufai’ said I asked Anas bin Malik saying “Tell me something you knew about the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ viz where he offered the noon prayer on Yawm Al Tarwiyah(8th of Dhu Al Hijjah). He replied, In Mina I asked Where did he pray the afternoon prayer on Yaum Al Nafr(12th or 13th of Dhu Al Hijjah). He replied In al-Abtah he then said “Do as your commanders do.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَيْنَ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ؟ قَالَ «بِمِنًى» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَأَيْنَ صَلَّى الْعَصْرَ يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ؟ قَالَ «بِالْأَبْطَحِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ اصْنَعْ مَا يَصْنَعُ أُمَرَاؤُكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad And ʾAḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ḥanbal \u003e Isḥāq b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān al-Thawrī \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Rufayʿ \u003e Liʾanas b. Mālik Ḥaddithnī Bishayʾ ʿAqaltah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَنْبَلٍ عَنْ إِسْحاَقَ بْنِ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ حَدِّثْنِي بِشَيْءٍ عَقَلْتَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1915

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَمْ صَلَاةً يُصَلَّى بِمِنًى حَتَّى يَغْدُوَ إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ
chapter.englishTitle: How many prayers are performed in Mina before proceeding to Araf...

hadiths.englishRaw: He (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) told him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha prayers and then slept in Mina. Then he rode to the house and performed Tawaf around it.   – Sound
hadiths.body: He (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) told him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha prayers and then slept in Mina. Then he rode to the house and performed Tawaf around it.   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ وَرَقَدَ رَقْدَةً بِمِنًى ثُمَّ رَكِبَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَطَافَ بِهِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Khālid \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Hilāl \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1916

chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "Shortening of prayer in Mina

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah prayed with Uthman in Mina four units of prayer. He said, "I have prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in this place two units of prayer, and with Abu Bakr two units of prayer, and with Umar two units of prayer. Then our paths diverged. I wish I could have two accepted units of prayer from the four units."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah prayed with Uthman in Mina four units of prayer. He said, "I have prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in this place two units of prayer, and with Abu Bakr two units of prayer, and with Umar two units of prayer. Then our paths diverged. I wish I could have two accepted units of prayer from the four units."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَصَلَّى مَعَ عُثْمَانَ بِمِنًى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ «لَقَدْ صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي هَذَا الْمَكَانِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَمَعَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَمَعَ عُمَرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ تَفَرَّقَتْ بِكُمُ الطُّرُقُ فَلَيْتَ حَظِّي مِنْ أَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ رَكْعَتَانِ مُتَقَبَّلَتَانِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Manṣūr b. Abū al-Aswad \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ أَبِي الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1917

chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "Shortening of prayer in Mina

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed two units of prayer in Mina, Abu Bakr performed two units of prayer, Umar performed two units of prayer, and Uthman performed two units of prayer as well. All of this was at the beginning of his caliphate, and then he completed them afterwards.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed two units of prayer in Mina, Abu Bakr performed two units of prayer, Umar performed two units of prayer, and Uthman performed two units of prayer as well. All of this was at the beginning of his caliphate, and then he completed them afterwards.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى بِمِنًى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَعُمَرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَعُثْمَانَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَدْرًا مِنْ إِمَارَتِهِ ثُمَّ أَتَمَّهَا بَعْدُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1918

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ الْعَمَلُ فِي الْقُدُومِ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: How to perform the journey from Mina to Arafat?

hadiths.englishRaw: "We left with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from Mina. Among us were those who performed the Takbeer and among us were those who performed the Talbiyah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We left with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ from Mina. Among us were those who performed the Takbeer and among us were those who performed the Talbiyah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ مِنًى فَمِنَّا مَنْ يُكَبِّرُ وَمِنَّا مَنْ يُلَبِّي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Salamah al-Mājishūn \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونِ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1919

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ الْعَمَلُ فِي الْقُدُومِ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: Translation: How to perform the journey from Mina to Arafat?

hadiths.englishRaw: About the tawaf, how did you used to interact with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said, "He used to perform tawaf with the performers of tawaf and he would not be denied, and he would magnify the magnifiers and he would not be denied."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the tawaf, how did you used to interact with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? He said, "He used to perform tawaf with the performers of tawaf and he would not be denied, and he would magnify the magnifiers and he would not be denied."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ التَّلْبِيَةِ كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قَالَ «كَانَ يُلَبِّي الْمُلَبِّي فَلَا يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ وَيُكَبِّرُ الْمُكَبِّرُ فَلَا يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ وَنَحْنُ غَادِيَانِ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1920

chapter.englishTitle: Standing at Arafat

hadiths.englishRaw: Jubair, I lost my camel so I went to search for it. "Then I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ standing with the people at Arafat." So I said, "By Allah, this is among the hillocks, so what is his relevance here?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Jubair, I lost my camel so I went to search for it. "Then I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ standing with the people at Arafat." So I said, "By Allah, this is among the hillocks, so what is his relevance here?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جُبَيْرٌ أَضْلَلْتُ بَعِيرًا لِي فَذَهَبْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ «فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَاقِفًا مَعَ النَّاسِ بِعَرَفَةَ» فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا لَمِنَ الْحُمْسِ فَمَا شَأْنُهُ هَا هُنَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Muḥammad b. Jubayr b. Muṭʿim
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1921

chapter.englishTitle: All of Arafah is a standing.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw stones and then sat down for the people. A man came to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have shaved before slaughtering." He said, "There is no harm." Then another man came to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have performed Tawaf before throwing the stones." He said, "There is no harm." He was asked about something, and he said, "There is no harm," in response to everything. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every part of Arafat is a standing place, and every part of Muzdalifa is a standing place, and all of Mina is a place of slaughter, and every path of Makkah is a path and a place of slaughter."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw stones and then sat down for the people. A man came to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have shaved before slaughtering." He said, "There is no harm." Then another man came to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have performed Tawaf before throwing the stones." He said, "There is no harm." He was asked about something, and he said, "There is no harm," in response to everything. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every part of Arafat is a standing place, and every part of Muzdalifa is a standing place, and all of Mina is a place of slaughter, and every path of Makkah is a path and a place of slaughter."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَمَى ثُمَّ قَعَدَ لِلنَّاسِ فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ قَالَ «لَا حَرَجَ» ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ آخَرُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طُفْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ قَالَ «لَا حَرَجَ» قَالَ فَمَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا قَالَ «لَا حَرَجَ» ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «كُلُّ عَرَفَةَ مَوْقِفٌ وَكُلُّ مُزْدَلِفَةَ مَوْقِفٌ وَمِنًى كُلُّهَا مَنْحَرٌ وَكُلُّ فِجَاجِ مَكَّةَ طَرِيقٌ وَمَنْحَرٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1922

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ السَّيْرُ فِي الْإِفَاضَةِ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: How is the traffic flow during the exodus from Arafat?

hadiths.englishRaw: "He was in the row behind the Prophet ﷺ , so he overflowed from Arafah, and he was walking with a slight tilt of the neck, and when he reached a valley, he stopped."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He was in the row behind the Prophet ﷺ , so he overflowed from Arafah, and he was walking with a slight tilt of the neck, and when he reached a valley, he stopped."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ رَدِيفَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَأَفَاضَ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ وَكَانَ يَسِيرُ الْعَنَقَ فَإِذَا أَتَى عَلَى فَجْوَةٍ نَصَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1923

chapter.englishTitle: Combining prayers through consolidation

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim bin ’Uqabah said “Kuraib told me that he asked Umamah bin Zaid saying tell me how you did in the evening when you rode behind the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ. He said “We came to the valley where the people make their Camels kneel down to take rest at night.” The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ made his she Camel kneel down and he then urinated. He then called for water for ablution and performed the ablution but he did not perform minutely (but performed lightly). I asked Apostle of Allaah ﷺ, prayer? He replied “Prayer ahead of you”. He then mounted (the Camel) till we came to Al Muzadalifah. There iqamah for the sunset prayer was called. The people then made their Camels kneel down at their places. The Camels were not unloaded as yet, iqamah for the night prayers was called and he prayed. The people then unloaded the Camels. The narrator Muhammad added in his version of the tradition How did you do when the morning came? He replied Al Fadl rode behind him and I walked on foot among the people of the Quraish who went ahead.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim bin ’Uqabah said “Kuraib told me that he asked Umamah bin Zaid saying tell me how you did in the evening when you rode behind the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ. He said “We came to the valley where the people make their Camels kneel down to take rest at night.” The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ made his she Camel kneel down and he then urinated. He then called for water for ablution and performed the ablution but he did not perform minutely (but performed lightly). I asked Apostle of Allaah ﷺ, prayer? He replied “Prayer ahead of you”. He then mounted (the Camel) till we came to Al Muzadalifah. There iqamah for the sunset prayer was called. The people then made their Camels kneel down at their places. The Camels were not unloaded as yet, iqamah for the night prayers was called and he prayed. The people then unloaded the Camels. The narrator Muhammad added in his version of the tradition How did you do when the morning came? He replied Al Fadl rode behind him and I walked on foot among the people of the Quraish who went ahead.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبِرْنِي عَشِيَّةَ رَدِفْتَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَيْفَ فَعَلْتُمْ أَوْ صَنَعْتُمْ ؟ قَالَ جِئْنَا الشِّعْبَ الَّذِي يُنِيخُ النَّاسُ فِيهِ لِلْمُعَرَّسِ فَأَنَاخَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَاقَتَهُ ثُمَّ بَالَ وَمَا قَالَ أَهْرَاقَ الْمَاءَ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِالْوَضُوءِ فَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا لَيْسَ بِالسَّابِغِ جِدًّا ثُمَّ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الصَّلَاةَ قَالَ «الصَّلَاةُ أَمَامَكَ» قَالَ فَرَكِبَ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ فَأَقَامَ الْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ أَنَاخَ وَالنَّاسُ فِي مَنَازِلِهِمْ فَلَمْ يَحِلُّوا حَتَّى أَقَامَ الْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ حَلَّ النَّاسُ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَخْبِرْنِي كَيْفَ فَعَلْتُمْ حِينَ أَصْبَحْتُمْ؟ قَالَ رَدِفَهُ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَانْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا فِي سُبَّاقِ قُرَيْشٍ عَلَى رِجْلَيَّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Ibrāhīm b. ʿUqbah \u003e Kurayb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي كُرَيْبٌ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1924

chapter.englishTitle: Combining prayers through consolidation

hadiths.englishRaw: About Osama, towards him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Osama, towards him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُسَامَةَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUqbah \u003e Kurayb b. Abū Muslim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1925

chapter.englishTitle: Combining prayers through consolidation

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah joined Maghrib and Isha in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah joined Maghrib and Isha in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ يَعْنِي بِجَمْعٍ »   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAdī b. Thābit \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Abū Ayyūb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ أَنْبَأَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1926

chapter.englishTitle: Combining prayers through consolidation

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Prophet of Allah, peace be upon him, performed the Maghrib and Isha prayers in Muzdalifah without calling the adhan in either of them, except with the Iqamah. He did not offer any additional supplications (tasbih) between the prayers or after one of them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Prophet of Allah, peace be upon him, performed the Maghrib and Isha prayers in Muzdalifah without calling the adhan in either of them, except with the Iqamah. He did not offer any additional supplications (tasbih) between the prayers or after one of them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ اللَّهُ ﷺ صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ لَمْ يُنَادِ فِي وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْإِقَامَةِ وَلَمْ يُسَبِّحْ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَا عَلَى إِثْرِ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sālim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1927

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرُّخْصَةِ فِي النَّفْرِ مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The license for one person in collective by night.

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her to participate in a nighttime expedition."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded her to participate in a nighttime expedition."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَنْفِرَ مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn Shawwāl \u003e Um Ḥabībah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شَوَّالٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1928

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرُّخْصَةِ فِي النَّفْرِ مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The license for one person in collective by night.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Sawdah bint Zam'ah, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , asked for permission to go out and was granted permission. However, before she could go out, someone else came, and she allowed them in. Al-Qasim said she was a woman who is slow in movement. Al-Qasim also said that a woman who is slow in movement is considered as someone heavy. So, Sawdah allowed the other person to enter first, and we were detained with her until she allowed us to move. Aisha said, 'By Allah, I would prefer not to be given permission by the Prophet ﷺ as Sawdah was given, so that I could push ahead before others. This is more pleasing to me than receiving something that makes me happy.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Sawdah bint Zam'ah, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , asked for permission to go out and was granted permission. However, before she could go out, someone else came, and she allowed them in. Al-Qasim said she was a woman who is slow in movement. Al-Qasim also said that a woman who is slow in movement is considered as someone heavy. So, Sawdah allowed the other person to enter first, and we were detained with her until she allowed us to move. Aisha said, 'By Allah, I would prefer not to be given permission by the Prophet ﷺ as Sawdah was given, so that I could push ahead before others. This is more pleasing to me than receiving something that makes me happy.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «اسْتَأْذَنَتْ سَوْدَةُ بِنْتُ زَمْعَةَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهَا فَتَدْفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَدْفَعَ فَأَذِنَ لَهَا» قَالَ الْقَاسِمُ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةً ثَبِطَةً وَقَالَ الْقَاسِمُ الثَّبِطَةُ الثَّقِيلَةُ فَدَفَعَتْ وَحُبِسْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى دَفَعْنَا بِدَفْعِهِ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَلَأَنْ أَكُونَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَمَا اسْتَأْذَنَتْ سَوْدَةُ فَأَدْفَعَ قَبْلَ النَّاسِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ مَفْرُوحٍ بِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Aflaḥ \u003e al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1929

chapter.englishTitle: How is Hajj performed?

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Abdullah bin Yamar Al-Dili saying that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about Hajj, and he said, "Hajj is Arafat, or he said Arafah. And whoever reaches the night of Al-Jam' before Fajr prayer has indeed reached it." And he said, "The days of Mina are three days. So whoever hastens [the departure] in two days, there is no sin upon him. And whoever delays, there is no sin upon him." [Al-Baqarah 203]   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Abdullah bin Yamar Al-Dili saying that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about Hajj, and he said, "Hajj is Arafat, or he said Arafah. And whoever reaches the night of Al-Jam' before Fajr prayer has indeed reached it." And he said, "The days of Mina are three days. So whoever hastens [the departure] in two days, there is no sin upon him. And whoever delays, there is no sin upon him." [Al-Baqarah 203]   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَعْمُرَ الدِّيلِيَّ يَقُولُ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَنِ الْحَجِّ فَقَالَ «الْحَجُّ عَرَفَاتٌ أَوْ قَالَ عَرَفَةَ وَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ لَيْلَةَ جَمْعٍ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ» وَقَالَ «أَيَّامُ مِنًى ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ» {فَمَنْ تَعَجَّلَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ تَأَخَّرَ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ} [البقرة 203]   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Bukayr b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yaʿmur al-Dīlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا بُكَيْرُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1930

chapter.englishTitle: How is Hajj performed?

hadiths.englishRaw: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the place of halting, that is, al-Muzdalifah. I said: I have come from the mountains of Tayy. I fatigued my mount and fatigued myself. By Allah, I found no hill (on my way) but I halted there. Have I completed my hajj? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Anyone who offers this prayer along with us and comes over to Arafat before it by night or day will complete his hajj and he may wash away the dirt (of his body).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at the place of halting, that is, al-Muzdalifah. I said: I have come from the mountains of Tayy. I fatigued my mount and fatigued myself. By Allah, I found no hill (on my way) but I halted there. Have I completed my hajj? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Anyone who offers this prayer along with us and comes over to Arafat before it by night or day will complete his hajj and he may wash away the dirt (of his body).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْمَوْقِفِ عَلَى رُءُوسِ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جِئْتُ مِنْ جَبَلِ طَيِّىءٍ أَكْلَلْتُ مَطِيَّتِي وَأَتْعَبْتُ نَفْسِي وَاللَّهِ إِنْ بَقِيَ جَبَلٌ إِلَّا وَقَفْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَهَلْ لِي حَجٍّ؟ قَالَ «مَنْ شَهِدَ مَعَنَا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ وَقَدْ أَتَى عَرَفَاتٍ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا فَقَدْ قَضَى تَفَثَهُ وَتَمَّ حَجُّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e ʿUrwah b. Muḍarris
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1931

chapter.englishTitle: How is Hajj performed?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I came to the Messenger of Allah" and he mentioned something similar.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I came to the Messenger of Allah" and he mentioned something similar.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū al-Safar \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿUrwah b. Muḍarris b. Ḥārithah b. Lām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ لَامٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1932

chapter.englishTitle: Payment Time from Muzdalifah

hadiths.englishRaw: In the pre-Islamic era, people used to gather after sunrise and they used to say, "Asthiru Labariana Nughiru" which means "Sun, Rise and Illuminate us so that we may change." However, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would oppose them and he would delay offering the morning prayer until just before sunrise, like the prayer of the travelers or the prayer of the early morning.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: In the pre-Islamic era, people used to gather after sunrise and they used to say, "Asthiru Labariana Nughiru" which means "Sun, Rise and Illuminate us so that we may change." However, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would oppose them and he would delay offering the morning prayer until just before sunrise, like the prayer of the travelers or the prayer of the early morning.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ يُفِيضُونَ مِنْ جَمْعٍ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَكَانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَشْرِقْ ثَبِيرُ لَعَلَّنَا نُغِيرُ وَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَالَفَهُمْ فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ بِقَدْرِ صَلَاةِ الْمُسْفِرِينَ أَوْ قَالَ الْمُشْرِقِينَ بِصَلَاةِ الْغَدَاةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Ghassān Mālik b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAmr b. Maymūn \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1933

chapter.englishTitle: The situation in a difficult situation

hadiths.englishRaw: "The prophet (pbuh) said on the evening of Arafah and the morning of Jumu'ah, while they were settling down, 'May tranquility be upon you.' He had stopped his camel until it entered a narrow valley and then he let it down."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The prophet (pbuh) said on the evening of Arafah and the morning of Jumu'ah, while they were settling down, 'May tranquility be upon you.' He had stopped his camel until it entered a narrow valley and then he let it down."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ فِي عَشِيَّةِ عَرَفَةَ وَغَدَاةِ جَمْعٍ حِينَ دَفَعُوا «عَلَيْكُمُ السَّكِينَةَ» وَهُوَ كَافٌّ نَاقَتَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلَ وَادِيَ مُحَسِّرً أَوْضَعَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Abū Maʿbad a freed slave of Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Faḍl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنْبَأَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ أَبَا مَعْبَدٍ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ الْفَضْلِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1934

chapter.englishTitle: The situation in a difficult situation

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah said, "The taming of camels and the training of horses."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah said, "The taming of camels and the training of horses."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْد اللَّهِ «الْإِيضَاعُ لِلْإِبِلِ وَالْإِيجَافُ لِلْخَيْلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Layth \u003e Abū al-Zubayr Biʾisnādih
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1935

chapter.englishTitle: In the trap with an enemy

hadiths.englishRaw: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah, wearing our ihram, and when the non-believers of Quraysh stopped us before reaching the Kaaba, the Messenger of Allah sacrificed his offering and shaved his head, then we returned. So I bear witness that I have performed 'Umrah. If there is a gap between me and the House, I will perform tawaf, and if there is a barrier between me and it, then I will do as the Messenger of Allah did when I was with him, so I will perform 'Umrah in Dhu al-Hulayfah." Then he continued on and said, "Indeed, their status is one." So I bear witness that I have performed Hajj along with my 'Umrah." Nafi' said, "And he performed a single circumambulation and a single sa'i for both of them. Then he did not remove his ihram until the Day of Sacrifice came, so he performed the sacrifice." And he used to say, "Whoever combines 'Umrah and Hajj, let him perform them both together. It is not permissible for him to remove his ihram until both of them are performed on the Day of Sacrifice."   – Sound Chain

And he used to say, "Whoever combines 'Umrah and Hajj, let him perform them both together. It is not permissible for him to remove his ihram until both of them are performed on the Day of Sacrifice."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَدْ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مُعْتَمِرِينَ فَحَالَ كُفَّارُ قُرَيْشٍ دُونَ الْبَيْتِ فَنَحَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ هَدْيَهُ وَحَلَقَ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ» فَأُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ عُمْرَةً فَإِنْ خُلِّيَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ طُفْتُ وَإِنْ حِيلَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ «فَعَلْتُ كَمَا كَانَ فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ فَأَهَلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ مِنْ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ» ثُمَّ سَارَ فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا شَأْنُهُمَا وَاحِدٌ أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ حَجًّا مَعَ عُمْرَتِي قَالَ نَافِعٌ فَطَافَ لَهُمَا طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا وَسَعَى لَهُمَا سَعْيًا وَاحِدًا ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحِلَّ حَتَّى جَاءَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَأَهْدَى وَكَانَ يَقُولُ مَنْ جَمَعَ الْعُمْرَةَ وَالْحَجَّ فَأَهَلَّ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا فَلَا يَحِلَّ حَتَّى يَحِلَّ مِنْهُمَا جَمِيعًا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbdullāh And Sālim Kallamā Ibn ʿUmar Layālī Nazal al-Ḥajjāj Biāb. al-Zubayr Qabl \u003e Yuqtal \u003e Lā Yaḍurruk \u003e Lā Taḥuj al-ʿĀm Nakhāf \u003e Yuḥāl Baynak Wabayn al-Bayt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَسَالِمًا كَلَّمَا ابْنَ عُمَرَ لَيَالِيَ نَزَلَ الْحَجَّاجُ بِابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْتَلَ فَقَالَا لَا يَضُرُّكَ أَنْ لَا تَحُجَّ الْعَامَ نَخَافُ أَنْ يُحَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1936

chapter.englishTitle: In the trap with an enemy

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet, peace be upon him, he said, "Whoever has a bone broken or dislocated has indeed become lawful and must perform another (obligatory) pilgrimage."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet, peace be upon him, he said, "Whoever has a bone broken or dislocated has indeed become lawful and must perform another (obligatory) pilgrimage."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ كُسِرَ أَوْ عُرِجَ فَقَدْ حَلَّ وَعَلَيْهِ حَجَّةٌ أُخْرَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥajjāj al-Ṣawwāf \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e al-Ḥajjāj b. ʿAmr al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْأَنْصَارِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1937

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي جَمْرَةِ الْعَقَبَةِ أَيُّ سَاعَةٍ تُرْمَى
chapter.englishTitle: At what time is the stoning in Jamarat Al-Aqaba?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw the pebble on the day of the sacrifice (Eid al-Adha), and after that, at the decline of the sun.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ threw the pebble on the day of the sacrifice (Eid al-Adha), and after that, at the decline of the sun.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَمَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْجَمْرَةَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ الضُّحَى وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1938

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي جَمْرَةِ الْعَقَبَةِ أَيُّ سَاعَةٍ تُرْمَى
chapter.englishTitle: At what time is the stoning in Jamarat Al-Aqaba?

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ allowed the owners of camels to throw pebbles on the day of sacrifice, then they throw on the following day or the day after for two days, and then they throw on the day of departure." Abu Muhammad said, "Among them is Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr, who narrated from his father, who narrated from Abu Al-Bada'."
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ allowed the owners of camels to throw pebbles on the day of sacrifice, then they throw on the following day or the day after for two days, and then they throw on the day of departure." Abu Muhammad said, "Among them is Abdullah ibn Abu Bakr, who narrated from his father, who narrated from Abu Al-Bada'."
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَرْخَصَ لِرِعَاءِ الْإِبِلِ أَنْ يَرْمُوا يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ ثُمَّ يَرْمُوا الْغَدَ أَوْ مِنْ بَعْدِ الْغَدِ لِيَوْمَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَرْمُوا يَوْمَ النَّفْرِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي الْبَدَّاحِ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr \u003e Abū al-Baddāḥ b. ʿĀṣim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْبَدَّاحِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1939

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الرَّمْيِ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ
chapter.englishTitle: In Throwing with Pebbles like Throwing

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah stoned the Jamarat with pebbles like date sones or fingertips.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah stoned the Jamarat with pebbles like date sones or fingertips.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ أَنْ نَرْمِيَ الْجَمْرَةَ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿUthmān b. Murrah \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿUthmān al-Taymī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُرَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1940

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الرَّمْيِ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ
chapter.englishTitle: In Throwing with Pebbles like Throwing

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ hastened from al-Muzdalifah with a quite demeanour and ordered them (the people) to throw small pebbles and he hastened in the valley (wadi) of Muhassir.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ hastened from al-Muzdalifah with a quite demeanour and ordered them (the people) to throw small pebbles and he hastened in the valley (wadi) of Muhassir.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَمَرَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَرَمَوْا بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ وَأَوْضَعَ فِي وَادِي مُحَسِّرٍ وَقَالَ «عَلَيْكُمُ السَّكِينَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1941

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الرَّمْيِ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ
chapter.englishTitle: In Throwing with Pebbles like Throwing

hadiths.englishRaw: "It is said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command us to throw the pebbles in an act of stoning called Jamrah similar to the size of hailstones. It was asked to Abu Muhammad (Abdul Rahman ibn Mu'adh), 'Does he have any companionship?' He said, 'Yes.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It is said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to command us to throw the pebbles in an act of stoning called Jamrah similar to the size of hailstones. It was asked to Abu Muhammad (Abdul Rahman ibn Mu'adh), 'Does he have any companionship?' He said, 'Yes.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَأْمُرُنَا أَنْ نَرْمِيَ الْجِمَارَ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ «عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ؟» قَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Ḥumayd al-Aʿraj \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Muʿādh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1942

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رَمْيِ الْجِمَارِ يَرْمِيهَا رَاكِبًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the throwing of the Jimaar, he throws it while mounted.

hadiths.englishRaw: “I saw the Prophet ﷺ stone the Pillar, on the Day of Sacrifice, from atop a reddish-brown camel of his, without beating anyone, driving them off or telling them to go away.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I saw the Prophet ﷺ stone the Pillar, on the Day of Sacrifice, from atop a reddish-brown camel of his, without beating anyone, driving them off or telling them to go away.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَرْمِي الْجِمَارَ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ صَهْبَاءَ لَيْسَ ثَمَّ ضَرْبٌ وَلَا طَرْدٌ وَلَا إِلَيْكَ إِلَيْكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim And al-Muʾammal Waʾabū Nuʿaym \u003e Ayman b. Nābil \u003e Qudāmah b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmmār al-Kilābī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ وَالْمُؤَمَّلُ وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ أَيْمَنَ بْنِ نَابِلٍ عَنْ قُدَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ الْكِلَابِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1943

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رَمْيِ الْجِمَارِ يَرْمِيهَا رَاكِبًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the throwing of the Jimaar, he throws it while mounted.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was riding behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he continued to respond to the greetings until he threw the pebble at the Jamrah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I was riding behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and he continued to respond to the greetings until he threw the pebble at the Jamrah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ رِدْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يُلَبِّي حَتَّى رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm \u003e al-Jazarī \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Faḍl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ هُوَ الْجَزَرِيُّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ الْفَضْلِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1944

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرَّمْيِ مِنْ بَطْنِ الْوَادِي وَالتَّكْبِيرِ مَعَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Throwing from the valley and shouting with every stone

hadiths.englishRaw: Whenever Messenger of Allah ﷺ stoned the Jamra near Mina Mosque, he would do Ramy of it with seven small pebbles and say Takbir on throwing each pebble. Then he would go ahead and stand facing the Qiblah with his hands raised, and invoke (Allah) and he sued to stand for a long period. Then he would come to the second Jamra (Al-Wusta) and stone it will seven small stones, reciting Takbir on throwing each stone. Then he would stand facing the Qiblah with raised hands to invoke (Allah). Then he would come to the Jamra near the 'Aqaba (Jamrat-ul-'Aqaba) and do Ramy of it with seven small pebbles, reciting Takbir on throwing each stone. he then would leave and not stay by it. Narrated Az-Zuhri: I heard Salim bin 'Abdullah saying the same that his father said on the authority of the Prophet ﷺ. And Ibn 'Umar used to do the same.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Whenever Messenger of Allah ﷺ stoned the Jamra near Mina Mosque, he would do Ramy of it with seven small pebbles and say Takbir on throwing each pebble. Then he would go ahead and stand facing the Qiblah with his hands raised, and invoke (Allah) and he sued to stand for a long period. Then he would come to the second Jamra (Al-Wusta) and stone it will seven small stones, reciting Takbir on throwing each stone. Then he would stand facing the Qiblah with raised hands to invoke (Allah). Then he would come to the Jamra near the 'Aqaba (Jamrat-ul-'Aqaba) and do Ramy of it with seven small pebbles, reciting Takbir on throwing each stone. he then would leave and not stay by it. Narrated Az-Zuhri: I heard Salim bin 'Abdullah saying the same that his father said on the authority of the Prophet ﷺ. And Ibn 'Umar used to do the same.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ الَّتِي تَلِي الْمَسْجِدَ مَسْجِدَ مِنًى يَرْمِيهَا بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ مَعَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ أَمَامَهَا فَوَقَفَ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ وَكَانَ يُطِيلُ الْوُقُوفَ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي الْجَمْرَةَ الثَّانِيَةَ فَيَرْمِيهَا بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ ثُمَّ يَنْحَدِرُ ذَاتَ الْيَسَارِ مِمَّا يَلِي الْوَادِي رَافِعًا يَدَيْهِ يَدْعُو ثُمَّ يَأْتِي الْجَمْرَةَ الَّتِي عِنْدَ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا بِسَبْعِ حَصَيَاتٍ يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ ثُمَّ يَنْصَرِفُ وَلَا يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا» قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يُحَدِّثُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1945

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Baqarah provides atonement for Bada'nah

hadiths.englishRaw: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and we only mentioned Hajj. When we arrived, I started menstruating. When it was the day of sacrifice, I became clean. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me, so I performed the Farewell Tawaf. Then I was given the meat of a cow. I asked, "What is this?" They said, "It is a gift from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on behalf of his wives, a cow."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and we only mentioned Hajj. When we arrived, I started menstruating. When it was the day of sacrifice, I became clean. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me, so I performed the Farewell Tawaf. Then I was given the meat of a cow. I asked, "What is this?" They said, "It is a gift from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on behalf of his wives, a cow."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا نَذْكُرُ إِلَّا الْحَجَّ فَلَمَّا جِئْنَا سَرِفَ طَمِثْتُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ طَهُرْتُ فَأَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَفَضْتُ فَأُتِيَ بِلَحْمِ بَقَرٍ فَقُلْتُ مَا هَذَا؟ قَالُوا أَهْدَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ نِسَائِهِ الْبَقَرَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e al-Mājishūn \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Ibn al-Qāsim \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ الْمَاجِشُونُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1946

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: لَيْسَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ حَلْقٌ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "Women do not have to shave"?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: Shaving is not a duty laid on women; only clipping the hair is incumbent on them.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: Shaving is not a duty laid on women; only clipping the hair is incumbent on them.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَتْنِي أُمُّ عُثْمَانَ بِنْتُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ أَنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَيْسَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ حَلْقٌ إِنَّمَا عَلَى النِّسَاءِ التَّقْصِيرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAlī b. ʿAbdullāh al-Madīnī \u003e Hishām b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ṣafiyyah b. Shaybah \u003e Um ʿUthmān b. Abū Sufyān \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمَدِينِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1947

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Shaving Over Trimming.

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "May Allah have mercy on those who shave their heads." It was asked, "And what about those who trim?" He said, "May Allah have mercy on those who shave." He said again in the fourth time, "And on those who trim."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "May Allah have mercy on those who shave their heads." It was asked, "And what about those who trim?" He said, "May Allah have mercy on those who shave." He said again in the fourth time, "And on those who trim."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ» قِيلَ وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ؟ قَالَ «رَحِمَ اللَّهُ الْمُحَلِّقِينَ» قَالَ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ «وَالْمُقَصِّرِينَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1948

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ قَدَّمَ نُسُكَهُ شَيْئًا قَبْلَ شَيْءٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Who performed their rituals before someone else?

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw the Prophet ﷺ near the Jamra and the people were asking him questions (about religious problems). A man asked, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! I have slaughtered the Hadi (animal) before doing the Rami." The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Do the Rami (now) and there is no harm." Another person asked, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! I got my head shaved before slaughtering the animal." The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Do the slaughtering (now) and there is no harm."
