So on that day, when the Prophet ﷺ was asked about anything as regards the ceremonies of Hajj performed before or after its due time his reply was, "Do it (now) and there is no harm."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I saw the Prophet ﷺ near the Jamra and the people were asking him questions (about religious problems). A man asked, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! I have slaughtered the Hadi (animal) before doing the Rami." The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Do the Rami (now) and there is no harm." Another person asked, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! I got my head shaved before slaughtering the animal." The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Do the slaughtering (now) and there is no harm." So on that day, when the Prophet ﷺ was asked about anything as regards the ceremonies of Hajj performed before or after its due time his reply was, "Do it (now) and there is no harm."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عِنْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ وَهُوَ يُسْأَلُ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَحَرْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ؟ قَالَ «ارْمِ وَلَا حَرَجَ» قَالَ آخَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَنْحَرَ؟ قَالَ «انْحَرْ وَلَا حَرَجَ» قَالَ فَمَا سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْءٍ قُدِّمَ وَلَا أُخِّرَ إِلَّا قَالَ «افْعَلْ وَلَا حَرَجَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Ibn Abū Salamah al-Mājishūn \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿĪsá b. Ṭalḥah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1949

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ قَدَّمَ نُسُكَهُ شَيْئًا قَبْلَ شَيْءٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Who performed their rituals before someone else?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood in front of the people during the Farewell Pilgrimage and a man said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, I have already shaved my head before sacrificing." He ﷺ replied, "There is no harm in that." The man then asked, "I have already slaughtered my animal before throwing pebbles at the Jamarat (stone pillars)." He ﷺ again replied, "There is no harm in that." On that day, he ﷺ was not asked about anything that has been done before or after, except that he ﷺ said, "There is no harm in that." Abdullah said, "I say this, but the people of Kufa differ with me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood in front of the people during the Farewell Pilgrimage and a man said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, I have already shaved my head before sacrificing." He ﷺ replied, "There is no harm in that." The man then asked, "I have already slaughtered my animal before throwing pebbles at the Jamarat (stone pillars)." He ﷺ again replied, "There is no harm in that." On that day, he ﷺ was not asked about anything that has been done before or after, except that he ﷺ said, "There is no harm in that." Abdullah said, "I say this, but the people of Kufa differ with me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَقَفَ لِلنَّاسِ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَلَقْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَذْبَحَ؟ قَالَ «لَا حَرَجَ» قَالَ لَمْ أَشْعُرْ ذَبَحْتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَرْمِيَ؟ قَالَ «لَا حَرَجَ» فَلَمْ يُسْأَلْ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنْ شَيْءٍ قُدِّمَ أَوْ أُخِّرَ إِلَّا قَالَ «لَا حَرَجَ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «أَنَا أَقُولُ بِهَذَا وَأَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ يُشَدِّدُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿĪsá b. Ṭalḥah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1950

chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah of Al-Badana When It Breaks

hadiths.englishRaw: From Najiyah al-Aslami, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "What should I do with the defective parts of the sacrificial animal?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every part that is defective should be slaughtered, then throw its sandals in its blood, and then distribute it between the people so that they may eat it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Najiyah al-Aslami, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , "What should I do with the defective parts of the sacrificial animal?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Every part that is defective should be slaughtered, then throw its sandals in its blood, and then distribute it between the people so that they may eat it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نَاجِيَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ صَاحِبِ هَدْيِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ بِمَا عَطِبَ مِنَ الْهَدْيِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «كُلُّ بَدَنَةٍ عَطِبَتْ فَانْحَرْهَا ثُمَّ أَلْقِ نَعْلَهَا فِي دَمِهَا ثُمَّ خَلِّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ النَّاسِ فَلْيَأْكُلُوهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Wahhāb b. Saʿīd \u003e Shuʿayb b. Isḥāq \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1951

chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah of Al-Badana When It Breaks

hadiths.englishRaw: Concerning Najiya towards him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Concerning Najiya towards him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نَاجِيَةَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1952

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: الشَّاةُ تُجْزِئُ فِي الْهَدْيِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "The sheep is acceptable for sacrifice

hadiths.englishRaw: Once the Prophet ﷺ sent sheep as Hadi.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Once the Prophet ﷺ sent sheep as Hadi.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَهْدَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَرَّةً غَنَمًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd And ʾAbū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1953

chapter.englishTitle: In poetry, how is feeling expressed?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) offered the noon prayer at Dhu al-Hulaifah. He then sent for a camel and made incision in the right side of its hump ; he then took out the blood by pressing it and tied two shoes in its neck. He then rode on his mount (camel) and reached al-Baida, he raised his voice for the talbiyah for performing Hajj.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) offered the noon prayer at Dhu al-Hulaifah. He then sent for a camel and made incision in the right side of its hump ; he then took out the blood by pressing it and tied two shoes in its neck. He then rode on his mount (camel) and reached al-Baida, he raised his voice for the talbiyah for performing Hajj.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِبَدَنَةٍ فَأَشْعَرَهَا مِنْ صَفْحَةِ سَنَامِهَا الْأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ سَلَتَ الدَّمَ عَنْهَا وَقَلَّدَهَا نَعْلَيْنِ ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِرَاحِلَتِهِ فَلَمَّا قَعَدَ عَلَيْهَا وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْبَيْدَاءِ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū Ḥassān \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَسَّانَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1954

chapter.englishTitle: In riding the bicycle

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah saw a man driving a Badanah and said: "Ride it." He said: "It is Badanah." He said: "Ride it." He said: "It is a Badanah." The fourth time he said: Ride it, woe to you!"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah saw a man driving a Badanah and said: "Ride it." He said: "It is Badanah." He said: "Ride it." He said: "It is a Badanah." The fourth time he said: Ride it, woe to you!"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ انْتَهَى إِلَى رَجُلٍ يَسُوقُ بَدَنَةً قَالَ «ارْكَبْهَا» فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ قَالَ «ارْكَبْهَا» قَالَ إِنَّهَا بَدَنَةٌ قَالَ «ارْكَبْهَا وَيْحَكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Naḍr Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا يُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1955

chapter.englishTitle: In sacrificing bodies, there is standing

hadiths.englishRaw: I was present with Ibn ʿUmar at Minah. He passed a man who was sacrificing his camel while it was sitting. He said make it stand and tie its leg ; thus follow the practice (sunnah) of Muhammad (SWAS).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I was present with Ibn ʿUmar at Minah. He passed a man who was sacrificing his camel while it was sitting. He said make it stand and tie its leg ; thus follow the practice (sunnah) of Muhammad (SWAS).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ابْعَثْهَا قِيَامًا مُقَيَّدَةً سُنَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yūnus b. ʿUbayd \u003e Ziyād b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Raʾá a man Qad Anākh Badanah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَجُلًا قَدْ أَنَاخَ بَدَنَةً فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1956

chapter.englishTitle: In the sermon of the season

hadiths.englishRaw: when the Prophet came back from the Umrah of Al-Jirranah, he sent Abu Bakr to lead the Hajj. We wnet the him until, when he was in Al-Urj, the Iqamah for Subh was said, and he stood up to say the Takbir while he heard the grunting of a camel behind him, and he did not say the Takbir. He said: "This is the grunting of the camel of the Messenger of Allah has had second thoughts about the Hajj, and may be he is here, and we will pray with him." But it was 'Ali on the camel. Abu Bakr said to him: "(Have you come) as a leader or as messenger?" He said: "No, as a messenger, sent by the Messenger of Allah with a declaration of innocence to recite it to the people in the stations of Hajj. So we came to makkah and one day before the day of At-Tarwiyah Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and addressed the people telling them about their rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. Then we went out with hm and on the day of Arafat. Abu Bakr stood up and addressed people, telling them about rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. Then on the day of Sacrifice, we departed (Ifadah) and when Abu Bakr came back, eh addressed the people, telling them about their departure (Ifadah), sacrifice and rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. On the first day of An-Nafr (The 12th of Dhul-Hijjah), Abu Bakr stood up and addressed the people, telling them how to offer their sacrifice and how to stone the Jamrat, and teaching them their rituals. When he had finished, "Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. (Daif) Abu Abdur-Rahman (An-Nasai) said: Ibn Khuthaim is not strong in Hadith, and I only narrated this so it would not be considered to be from Ibn Juraij from Abu Az-Zubai. And we did not write it except from Ishaq bin Rahuyah bin Ibrahm. And yahya bin Saeed Al-Qattan did not abandon the narrations of Ibn Khuthaim, or dod Abdur-Rahamn. However, Ali bin Al-Madini said: "Ibn Khuthaim is Munkar in Hadith," and Ali bin Al-Madini is more knowledgeable of Hadith.
hadiths.body: when the Prophet came back from the Umrah of Al-Jirranah, he sent Abu Bakr to lead the Hajj. We wnet the him until, when he was in Al-Urj, the Iqamah for Subh was said, and he stood up to say the Takbir while he heard the grunting of a camel behind him, and he did not say the Takbir. He said: "This is the grunting of the camel of the Messenger of Allah has had second thoughts about the Hajj, and may be he is here, and we will pray with him." But it was 'Ali on the camel. Abu Bakr said to him: "(Have you come) as a leader or as messenger?" He said: "No, as a messenger, sent by the Messenger of Allah with a declaration of innocence to recite it to the people in the stations of Hajj. So we came to makkah and one day before the day of At-Tarwiyah Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and addressed the people telling them about their rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. Then we went out with hm and on the day of Arafat. Abu Bakr stood up and addressed people, telling them about rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. Then on the day of Sacrifice, we departed (Ifadah) and when Abu Bakr came back, eh addressed the people, telling them about their departure (Ifadah), sacrifice and rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. On the first day of An-Nafr (The 12th of Dhul-Hijjah), Abu Bakr stood up and addressed the people, telling them how to offer their sacrifice and how to stone the Jamrat, and teaching them their rituals. When he had finished, "Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. (Daif) Abu Abdur-Rahman (An-Nasai) said: Ibn Khuthaim is not strong in Hadith, and I only narrated this so it would not be considered to be from Ibn Juraij from Abu Az-Zubai. And we did not write it except from Ishaq bin Rahuyah bin Ibrahm. And yahya bin Saeed Al-Qattan did not abandon the narrations of Ibn Khuthaim, or dod Abdur-Rahamn. However, Ali bin Al-Madini said: "Ibn Khuthaim is Munkar in Hadith," and Ali bin Al-Madini is more knowledgeable of Hadith.
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ حِينَ رَجَعَ مِنْ عُمْرَةِ الْجِعْرَانَةِ بَعَثَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ عَلَى الْحَجِّ» فَأَقْبَلْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِالْعَرْجِ ثُوِّبَ بِالصُّبْحِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَى لِيُكَبِّرَ سَمِعَ الرَّغْوَةَ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ فَوَقَفَ عَنِ التَّكْبِيرِ فَقَالَ هَذِهِ رَغْوَةُ نَاقَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْجَدْعَاءِ لَقَدْ بَدَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْحَجِّ فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَنُصَلِّيَ مَعَهُ فَإِذَا عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَمِيرٌ أَمْ رَسُولٌ؟ قَالَ لَا بَلْ رَسُولٌ «أَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِبَرَاءَةٌ أَقْرَؤُهَا عَلَى النَّاسِ فِي مَوَاقِفِ الْحَجِّ» فَقَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ قَبْلَ التَّرْوِيَةِ بِيَوْمٍ قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةٌ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةٌ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا ثُمَّ كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ فَأَفَضْنَا فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ إِفَاضَتِهِمْ وَعَنْ نَحْرِهِمْ وَعَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةٌ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّفْرِ الْأَوَّلُ قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثَهُمْ كَيْفَ يَنْفِرُونَ وَكَيْفَ يَرْمُونَ فَعَلَّمَهُمْ مَنَاسِكَهُمْ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ بَرَاءَةٌ عَلَى النَّاسِ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abū Qurrah Mūsá b. Ṭāriq \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUthmān b. Khuthaym \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحاَقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى أَبِي قُرَّةَ مُوسَى بْنُ طَارِقٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1957

chapter.englishTitle: In the sermon on Eid al-Adha...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When that day came, the Prophet ﷺ sat on a camel, I do not know if it was a camel or a camel. A man took hold of its reins or said his bridle and said, 'What day is this?' We remained silent until we thought that he would give it a different name. He said, 'Isn't it the day of Sacrifice?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Then which month is this?' We remained silent until we thought that he would give it a different name. He said, 'Isn't it the month of Dhul-Hijjah?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Then which city is this?' We remained silent until we thought that he would give it a different name. He said, 'Isn't it this city?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Indeed, your blood, your property, and your honor are sacred among you like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this city of yours. Behold! Let the witness inform the absent, perhaps the witness will convey it to one who is more aware."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When that day came, the Prophet ﷺ sat on a camel, I do not know if it was a camel or a camel. A man took hold of its reins or said his bridle and said, 'What day is this?' We remained silent until we thought that he would give it a different name. He said, 'Isn't it the day of Sacrifice?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Then which month is this?' We remained silent until we thought that he would give it a different name. He said, 'Isn't it the month of Dhul-Hijjah?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Then which city is this?' We remained silent until we thought that he would give it a different name. He said, 'Isn't it this city?' We said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Indeed, your blood, your property, and your honor are sacred among you like the sacredness of this day of yours, in this month of yours, in this city of yours. Behold! Let the witness inform the absent, perhaps the witness will convey it to one who is more aware."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَمَّا كَانَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمُ قَعَدَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ لَا أَدْرِي جَمَلٌ أَوْ نَاقَةٌ وَأَخَذَ إِنْسَانٌ بِخِطَامِهِ أَوْ قَالَ بِزِمَامِهِ فَقَالَ «أَيُّ يَوْمٍ هَذَا؟» قَالَ فَسَكَتْنَا حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ سِوَى اسْمِهِ فَقَالَ «أَلَيْسَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ؟» قُلْنَا بَلَى قَالَ «فَأَيُّ شَهْرٍ هَذَا؟» قَالَ فَسَكَتْنَا حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ سِوَى اسْمِهِ فَقَالَ «أَلَيْسَ ذَا الْحِجَّةِ؟» قُلْنَا بَلَى قَالَ «فَأَيُّ بَلَدٍ هَذَا؟» قَالَ فَسَكَتْنَا حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ سَيُسَمِّيهِ سِوَى اسْمِهِ فَقَالَ «أَلَيْسَ الْبَلْدَةَ؟» قُلْنَا بَلَى قَالَ «فَإِنَّ دِمَاءَكُمْ وَأَمْوَالَكُمْ وَأَعْرَاضَكُمْ بَيْنَكُمْ حَرَامٌ كَحُرْمَةِ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا فِي شَهْرِكُمْ هَذَا فِي بَلَدِكُمْ هَذَا أَلَا لِيُبَلِّغِ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ فَإِنَّ الشَّاهِدَ عَسَى أَنْ يُبَلِّغَ مَنْ هُوَ أَوْعَى مِنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Ḥātim Ashhal b. Ḥātim \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Bakrah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ أَشْهَلُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1958

chapter.englishTitle: The woman menstruates after the visit.

hadiths.englishRaw: Safiyyah had her period and when it was the night of departure she said, "Should I perform ghusl (ritual bath) or should I delay it for them to understand?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Didn't you perform tawaf (circumambulation) on the day of sacrifice?" She replied, "Yes, I did." He then said, "Then proceed."
hadiths.body: Safiyyah had her period and when it was the night of departure she said, "Should I perform ghusl (ritual bath) or should I delay it for them to understand?" So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Didn't you perform tawaf (circumambulation) on the day of sacrifice?" She replied, "Yes, I did." He then said, "Then proceed."
hadiths.arabic: حَاضَتْ صَفِيَّةُ فَلَمَّا كَانَتْ لَيْلَةُ النَّفْرِ قَالَتْ أَيْ حَلْقَى أَيْ عَقْرَى بِلُغَةٍ لَهُمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَلَسْتِ قَدْ طُفْتِ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ؟» قَالَتْ بَلَى قَالَ «فَارْكَبِي»
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Ḥāḍat Ṣafiyyah Falammā Kānat Laylah al-Nafr \u003e Ay Ḥalqá Ay ʿAqrá Bilughah Lahum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1959

chapter.englishTitle: The woman menstruates after the visit.

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Aisha in his way"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From Aisha in his way"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1960

chapter.englishTitle: Do not include this translation: "No one circumambulates the hou...

hadiths.englishRaw: I was sent with four (things). No one shall enter Paradise except a believing soul. No one shall make Tawaf around the Kaaba naked. No Muslim and disbeliever shall perform Hajj together after this year. And whoever has a pledge of allegiance with the Messenger of Allah, his pledge is until its term. And whoever does not have a pledge of allegiance, then it is four months. He says after the Day of Sacrifice: their appointed time is the twentieth of Dhul-Hijjah, so kill them after the four (months).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I was sent with four (things). No one shall enter Paradise except a believing soul. No one shall make Tawaf around the Kaaba naked. No Muslim and disbeliever shall perform Hajj together after this year. And whoever has a pledge of allegiance with the Messenger of Allah, his pledge is until its term. And whoever does not have a pledge of allegiance, then it is four months. He says after the Day of Sacrifice: their appointed time is the twentieth of Dhul-Hijjah, so kill them after the four (months).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بُعِثْتُ بِأَرْبَعٍ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا نَفْسٌ مُؤْمِنَةٌ وَلَا يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ وَلَا يَجْتَمِعُ مُسْلِمٌ وَكَافِرٌ فِي الْحَجِّ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَذَا وَمَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَهْدٌ فَعَهْدُهُ إِلَى مُدَّتِهِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ عَهْدٌ فَهِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ يَقُولُ بَعْدَ يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ أَجَلُهُمْ عِشْرِينَ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ فَاقْتُلُوهُمْ بَعْدَ الْأَرْبَعَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Bazzāz \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Zayd b. Yuthayʿ \u003e Saʾalnā ʿAlī Biʾay Shayʾ Buʿitht
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ يُثَيْعٍ قَالَ سَأَلْنَا عَلِيًّا بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ بُعِثْتَ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1961

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا وَدَّعَ الْبَيْتَ لَا يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: When he leaves the house, he does not raise his hands

hadiths.englishRaw: "Did we do the same as those Jews used to do by making arguments with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?"
hadiths.body: "Did we do the same as those Jews used to do by making arguments with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?"
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّمَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ ذَلِكَ الْيَهُودُ حَجَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَفَصَنَعْنَا ذَلكَ؟»
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd al-Ḥanafī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Qazaʿah \u003e Muhājir \u003e Suʾil Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Rafʿ al-Aydī ʿInd al-Bayt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو قَزَعَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُهَاجِرًا يَقُولُ سُئِلَ جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ رَفْعِ الْأَيْدِي عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1962

chapter.englishTitle: In the sanctity of the Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw: “Make the people pay attention.” Then he said: “Do not turn back into disbelievers after I am gone, striking one another’s necks.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Make the people pay attention.” Then he said: “Do not turn back into disbelievers after I am gone, striking one another’s necks.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ اسْتَنْصَتَ النَّاسَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «لَا تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd And Ḥajjāj \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mudrik \u003e Abū Zurʿah \u003e Jarīr b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ وَحَجَّاجٌ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُدْرِكٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1963

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي السَّعْيِ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the endeavor between Safa and Marwa

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the son of Abu Awfah say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ raced between Safa and Marwa while we were protecting him from the people of Makkah so that no one would hit him with a stone or throw at him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the son of Abu Awfah say, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ raced between Safa and Marwa while we were protecting him from the people of Makkah so that no one would hit him with a stone or throw at him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى يَقُولُ «سَعَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ وَنَحْنُ نَسْتُرُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ أَنْ يُصِيبَهُ أَحَدٌ بِحَجَرٍ أَوْ بِرَمْيَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid \u003e Ibn Abū Awfá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1964

chapter.englishTitle: In the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw ʿAli and ʿUthman ؓ between Makkah and Madinah. ʿUthman was telling people not to do tamattuʿ or join them together (Hajj and ‘Umrah, i.e., qiran). When ʿAli ؓ saw that, he entered ihram for both of them together and said: Here I am for ʿUmrah and Hajj together ‘Uthman ؓ said: You see me telling the people not to do that and you do it? He said: I will not give up a Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for the opinion of anyone among the people.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I saw ʿAli and ʿUthman ؓ between Makkah and Madinah. ʿUthman was telling people not to do tamattuʿ or join them together (Hajj and ‘Umrah, i.e., qiran). When ʿAli ؓ saw that, he entered ihram for both of them together and said: Here I am for ʿUmrah and Hajj together ‘Uthman ؓ said: You see me telling the people not to do that and you do it? He said: I will not give up a Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for the opinion of anyone among the people.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ شَهِدَ عَلِيًّا وَعُثْمَانَ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ وَعُثْمَانُ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ عَلِيٌّ أَهَلَّ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا فَقَالَ «لَبَّيْكَ بِحَجَّةٍ وَعُمْرَةٍ مَعًا» فَقَالَ تَرَانِي أَنْهَى عَنْهُ وَتَفْعَلُهُ فَقَالَ «لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَدَعَ سُنَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِقَوْلِ أَحَدٍ مِنَ النَّاسِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn \u003e Marwān b. al-Ḥakam \u003e Shahid ʿAlī And ʿUthmān Bayn Makkah Wa-al-Madīnah And ʿUthmān Yanhá \u003e al-Mutʿah Falammā Raʾá Dhalik ʿAlī Ahal Bihimā \u003e Labbayk Biḥajjah Waʿumrah Maʿ \u003e Tarānī Anhá \u003e h Watafʿaluh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1965

chapter.englishTitle: In the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: “Labbaika bi-‘Umratin wa hajjatin [Here I am (O Allah), for ‘Umrah and Hajj].”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Labbaika bi-‘Umratin wa hajjatin [Here I am (O Allah), for ‘Umrah and Hajj].”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَبَّيْكَ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَحَجٍّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1966

chapter.englishTitle: In the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "I met Ibn Umar and informed him about Anas's statement that Allah's Messenger ﷺ accommodated both of them. Ibn Umar replied, 'He only accommodated them for the Hajj.' I then returned to Anas and informed him about Ibn Umar's statement. Anas responded, 'They consider us to be nothing more than children.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I met Ibn Umar and informed him about Anas's statement that Allah's Messenger ﷺ accommodated both of them. Ibn Umar replied, 'He only accommodated them for the Hajj.' I then returned to Anas and informed him about Ibn Umar's statement. Anas responded, 'They consider us to be nothing more than children.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَهَلَّ بِهِمَا جَمِيعًا» فَلَقِيتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ أَنَسٍ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ» فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى أَنَسٍ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ مَا يَعُدُّونَنَا إِلَّا صِبْيَانًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Ḥabīb b. al-Shahīd \u003e Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ الشَّهِيدِ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1967

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الطَّوَافِ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِ الصَّلَاةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Tawaf outside of prayer time.

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Banu 'Abd Manaf, do not prevent anyone from circumambulating this House and praying at any time he wants of night or day."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "O Banu 'Abd Manaf, do not prevent anyone from circumambulating this House and praying at any time he wants of night or day."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ إِنْ وَلِيتُمْ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ فَلَا تَمْنَعُوا أَحَدًا طَافَ أَوْ صَلَّى أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شَاءَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Bābāh \u003e Jubayr b. Muṭʿim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَابَاهُ عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1968

chapter.englishTitle: Upon entering the house during the day

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spent the night at Dhi Tuwa and then entered Makkah. Ibn Umar used to do the same."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ spent the night at Dhi Tuwa and then entered Makkah. Ibn Umar used to do the same."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَاتَ بِذِي طُوًى حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ» وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1969

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي أَيِّ طَرِيقٍ يَدْخُلُ مَكَّةَ
chapter.englishTitle: In which road does one enter Makkah?

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to enter Makkah from the upper mountain pass and when he left, he would leave from the lower mountain pass.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to enter Makkah from the upper mountain pass and when he left, he would leave from the lower mountain pass.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَدْخُلُ مَكَّةَ مِنَ الثَّنِيَّةِ الْعُلْيَا وَيَخْرُجُ مِنَ الثَّنِيَّةِ السُّفْلَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1970

chapter.englishTitle: When does the man arrive?

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ put his foot in the stirrup and his riding beast rose up with him, he would say the Talbiyah from the mosque of Dhul-Hulaifah.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ put his foot in the stirrup and his riding beast rose up with him, he would say the Talbiyah from the mosque of Dhul-Hulaifah.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَدْخَلَ رِجْلَهُ فِي الْغَرْزِ وَاسْتَوَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ أَهَلَّ مِنْ مَسْجِدِ ذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1971

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَصْنَعُ الْمُحْرِمُ إِذَا اشْتَكَى عَيْنَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What does the forbidden person do when his eyes hurt?

hadiths.englishRaw: From Nu'ayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said about Muhammara, "If his eyes are sore, he should cover them with patience."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Nu'ayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from his father, that the Prophet ﷺ said about Muhammara, "If his eyes are sore, he should cover them with patience."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ فِي الْمُحْرِمِ إِذَا اشْتَكَى عَيْنَيْهِ «يَضْمِدُهَا بِالصَّبِرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad b. Abū Shaybah And Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ayyūb b. Mūsá \u003e Nubayh b. Wahb \u003e Abān b. ʿUthmān from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1972

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَيْنَ يُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ بَعْدَ الطَّوَافِ
chapter.englishTitle: Where does a man pray after circumambulation (around the Kaaba)?

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Ibn Umar saying, "The Prophet ﷺ came and performed Tawaf (circumambulation) around the Kaaba, and then prayed two Rak'ahs by the Station (of Abraham), and then came out to Safa."
hadiths.body: I heard Ibn Umar saying, "The Prophet ﷺ came and performed Tawaf (circumambulation) around the Kaaba, and then prayed two Rak'ahs by the Station (of Abraham), and then came out to Safa."
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ «قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَصَلَّى عِنْدَ الْمَقَامِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى الصَّفَا»
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1973

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَيْنَ يُصَلِّي الرَّجُلُ بَعْدَ الطَّوَافِ
chapter.englishTitle: Where does a man pray after circumambulation (around the Kaaba)?

hadiths.englishRaw: It is the Sunnah.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is the Sunnah.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: هِيَ السُّنَّةُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Shuʿbah Faḥaddathanī Ayyūb \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَحَدَّثَنِي أَيُّوبُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1974

chapter.englishTitle: In the Farewell Tawaf

hadiths.englishRaw: The people used to go out (from Mecca after Hajj) by all sides. The Prophet ﷺ said: No one should leave (Mecca) until he performs the last circumambulation of the House (the Ka'bah).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The people used to go out (from Mecca after Hajj) by all sides. The Prophet ﷺ said: No one should leave (Mecca) until he performs the last circumambulation of the House (the Ka'bah).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّاسُ يَنْصَرِفُونَ فِي كُلِّ وَجْهٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَنْفِرَنَّ أَحَدٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ آخِرُ عَهْدِهِ بِالْبَيْتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Sulaymān al-Aḥwal \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1975

chapter.englishTitle: In the Farewell Tawaf

hadiths.englishRaw: "To leave when it overflows."
hadiths.body: "To leave when it overflows."
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَنْفِرَ إِذَا أَفَاضَتْ»
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ibn Ṭāwus from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Rukhhiṣ Lilḥāʾiḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ «رُخِّصَ لِلْحَائِضِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1976

chapter.englishTitle: In the Farewell Tawaf

hadiths.englishRaw: "It (referring to a female) does not get tired, then I heard him say it gets tired because the Prophet ﷺ made an exception for them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It (referring to a female) does not get tired, then I heard him say it gets tired because the Prophet ﷺ made an exception for them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا لَا تَنْفِرُ ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ تَنْفِرُ «إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ رَخَّصَ لَهُنَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibn ʿUmar ʿĀm al-Awwal \u003e Lā Tanfir Thum Samiʿtuh \u003e Tanfir
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَامَ الْأَوَّلِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1977

chapter.englishTitle: In the Farewell Tawaf

hadiths.englishRaw: About circumambulation around the Kaaba when menstruating before departing after the Day of Sacrifice, he said, "[Prophet] Aisha used to remember a concession for women, and that was before the death of Abdullah bin Umar by a year."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About circumambulation around the Kaaba when menstruating before departing after the Day of Sacrifice, he said, "[Prophet] Aisha used to remember a concession for women, and that was before the death of Abdullah bin Umar by a year."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الطَّوَافِ بِالْبَيْتِ إِذَا حِضْنَ قَبْلَ النَّفْرِ وَقَدْ أَفَضْنَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ عَائِشَةَ كَانَتْ «تَذْكُرُ رُخْصَةً لِلنِّسَاءِ وَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بِعَامٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Ṭāwus al-Yamānī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar / Yusʾal \u003e Ḥabs al-Nisāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي طَاوُسٌ الْيَمَانِيُّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ وَهُوَ يُسْأَلُ عَنْ حَبْسِ النِّسَاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1978

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَبْعَثُ هَدْيَهُ وَهُوَ يُقِيمُ فِي بَلَدِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who sends his gift while he is residing in his country.

hadiths.englishRaw: "He said to A'isha, 'O Mother of the Believers, indeed, there are men who send one of them with the offering, along with a person who says, 'When you reach such and such a place, perform the imitation.' When that place is reached, it remains prohibited until the people return.' He said, 'So I heard that transaction from behind the curtain with her, and she said, 'I used to untie the knots for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he sent the offering to the Ka'bah. Nothing was forbidden to him from what was permissible for a man from his family until the people returned.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He said to A'isha, 'O Mother of the Believers, indeed, there are men who send one of them with the offering, along with a person who says, 'When you reach such and such a place, perform the imitation.' When that place is reached, it remains prohibited until the people return.' He said, 'So I heard that transaction from behind the curtain with her, and she said, 'I used to untie the knots for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he sent the offering to the Ka'bah. Nothing was forbidden to him from what was permissible for a man from his family until the people returned.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَائِشَةَ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنَّ رِجَالًا يَبْعَثُ أَحَدُهُمْ بِالْهَدْيِ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ فَيَقُولُ إِذَا بَلَغْتَ مَكَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَقَلِّدْهُ فَإِذَا بَلَغَ ذَلِكَ الْمَكَانَ لَمْ يَزَلْ مُحْرِمًا حَتَّى يَحِلَّ النَّاسُ قَالَ فَسَمِعْتُ صَفْقَتَهَا بِيَدِهَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ الْحِجَابِ وَقَالَتْ «لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ الْقَلَائِدَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَيَبْعَثُ بِالْهَدْيِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا يَحِلُّ لِلرَّجُلِ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ النَّاسُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl / Ibn Abū Khālid \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Masrūq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1979

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَبْعَثُ هَدْيَهُ وَهُوَ يُقِيمُ فِي بَلَدِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who sends his gift while he is residing in his country.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I used to untangle the necklaces of the Prophet's ﷺ gifts, then he would send his gift with a replica and he would stay in Madinah and not avoid anything until his gift is sacrificed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I used to untangle the necklaces of the Prophet's ﷺ gifts, then he would send his gift with a replica and he would stay in Madinah and not avoid anything until his gift is sacrificed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنْتُ أَفْتِلُ قَلَائِدَ هَدْيِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَيَبْعَثُ بِهَدْيِهِ مُقَلَّدَةً وَيُقِيمُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَلَا يَجْتَنِبُ شَيْئًا حَتَّى يُنْحَرَ هَدْيُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr And ʿAmrah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ وَعَمْرَةُ بِنْتُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1980

chapter.englishTitle: The Dislike of Building in Mina

hadiths.englishRaw: I said: Messenger of Allah, should we not build a house or a building which shades you from the sun? He replied: No, it is a place for the one who reaches there earlier.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I said: Messenger of Allah, should we not build a house or a building which shades you from the sun? He replied: No, it is a place for the one who reaches there earlier.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَا نَبْنِي لَكَ بِمِنًى بِنَاءً يُظِلُّكَ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا مِنًى مُنَاخُ مَنْ سَبَقَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Wakīʿ \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Muhājir \u003e Yūsuf b. Māhak \u003e Ummih Musaykah Waʾathná ʿAlayhā Khayr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ عَنْ أُمِّهِ مُسَيْكَةَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهَا خَيْرًا عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1981

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي دُخُولِ مَكَّةَ بِغَيْرِ إِحْرَامِ حَجٍّ وَلَا عُمْرَةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Entering Mecca without performing the obligatory Hajj or Umrah

hadiths.englishRaw: In the year of the conquest of Mecca the Prophet ﷺ entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: In the year of the conquest of Mecca the Prophet ﷺ entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ مِغْفَرٌ فَلَمَّا نَزَعَهُ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا ابْنُ خَطَلٍ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِأَسْتَارِ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اقْتُلُوهُ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ وَقُرِئَ عَلَى مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُحْرِمًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Khālid \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1982

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي دُخُولِ مَكَّةَ بِغَيْرِ إِحْرَامِ حَجٍّ وَلَا عُمْرَةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Entering Mecca without performing the obligatory Hajj or Umrah

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah when he conquered it, and he was wearing a black turban without being in a state of Ihram." Isma'il said, "I heard it from Abu Zubair who was with his father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ entered Makkah when he conquered it, and he was wearing a black turban without being in a state of Ihram." Isma'il said, "I heard it from Abu Zubair who was with his father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مَكَّةَ حِينَ افْتَتَحَهَا وَعَلَيْهِ عِمَامَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ بِغَيْرِ إِحْرَامٍ» قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ «سَمِعَهُ مِنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ كَانَ مَعَ أَبِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. ʿAmmār al-Duhnī \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ الدُّهْنِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1983

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ لَا يُعْطَى الْجَازِرُ مِنَ الْبُدْنِ شَيْئًا
chapter.englishTitle: The carrot does not give anything to the body

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ ordered me to supervise the (slaughtering) of Budn (Hadi camel) and to distribute their meat, skins and covering sheets in charity and not to give anything (of their bodies) to the butcher as wages for slaughtering.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ ordered me to supervise the (slaughtering) of Budn (Hadi camel) and to distribute their meat, skins and covering sheets in charity and not to give anything (of their bodies) to the butcher as wages for slaughtering.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أن رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ عَلَى بُدْنِهِ وَأَنْ يَقْسِمَ بُدْنَهُ كُلَّهَا لُحُومَهَا وَجُلُودَهَا وَجِلَالَهَا وَلَا يُعْطِيَ فِي جِزَارَتِهَا مِنْهَا شَيْئًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Muslim And ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Jazarī \u003e Mujāhid Akhbarahumā \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ وَعَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيُّ أَنَّ مُجَاهِدًا أَخْبَرَهُمَا أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1984

chapter.englishTitle: In the reward of the fox.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the hyena. He replied: It is game, and if one who is wearing ihram (pilgrim's robe) hunts it, he should give a sheep as atonement.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the hyena. He replied: It is game, and if one who is wearing ihram (pilgrim's robe) hunts it, he should give a sheep as atonement.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الضَّبُعِ فَقَالَ «هُوَ صَيْدٌ وَفِيهِ كَبْشٌ إِذَا أَصَابَهُ الْمُحْرِمُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Jarīr b. Ḥāzim \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū ʿAmmār \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1985

chapter.englishTitle: In the reward of the fox.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Yes," I said, "I heard it from the messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said, "Yes." It was said to Abu Muhammad, "What do you say about eating a hyena?" He said, "I dislike eating it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Yes," I said, "I heard it from the messenger of Allah ﷺ?" He said, "Yes." It was said to Abu Muhammad, "What do you say about eating a hyena?" He said, "I dislike eating it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ «مَا تَقُولُ فِي الضَّبُعِ تَأْكُلُهُ؟» قَالَ «أَنَا أَكْرَهُ أَكْلَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū ʿAmmār \u003e Saʾalt Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e al-Ḍabuʿ Ākuluh \u003e Naʿam \u003e Ṣayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الضَّبُعِ آكُلُهُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ هُوَ صَيْدٌ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1986

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ يَبِيتُ بِمَكَّةَ لَيَالِيَ مِنًى مِنْ عِلَّةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Who Stays in Makkah During the Nights of Mina for a Reason

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that al-'A'bbas b. Abd al-Muttalib (Allah be pleased with him) sought permission from Messenger of Allah ﷺ to spend in Mecca the nights (which be was required to spend) at Mina on account of his office of supplier of water, and he (the Holy Prophet) granted him permission.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported that al-'A'bbas b. Abd al-Muttalib (Allah be pleased with him) sought permission from Messenger of Allah ﷺ to spend in Mecca the nights (which be was required to spend) at Mina on account of his office of supplier of water, and he (the Holy Prophet) granted him permission.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الْعَّبَاسَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ اسْتَأْذَنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِيَبِيتَ بِمَكَّةَ لَيَالِيَ مِنًى مِنْ أَجْلِ سِقَايَتِهِ «فَأَذِنَ لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1987

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ يَبِيتُ بِمَكَّةَ لَيَالِيَ مِنًى مِنْ عِلَّةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Who Stays in Makkah During the Nights of Mina for a Reason

hadiths.englishRaw: From Ubaidullah ibn Umar, approximately.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Ubaidullah ibn Umar, approximately.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1988

chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah in Eid Al-Adha.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah sacrificed two horned, Amlah rams, saying: 'Allah Akbar and pronouncing the Name of Allah. I saw him slaughtering them with his own hand, and placing his foot on their sides." I said: You heard it from Him? He said: Yes. (Sahih )    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah sacrificed two horned, Amlah rams, saying: 'Allah Akbar and pronouncing the Name of Allah. I saw him slaughtering them with his own hand, and placing his foot on their sides." I said: You heard it from Him? He said: Yes. (Sahih )    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِكَبْشَيْنِ أَمْلَحَيْنِ أَقْرَنَيْنِ وَيُسَمِّي وَيُكَبِّرُ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَذْبَحُهُمَا بِيَدِهِ وَاضِعًا عَلَى صِفَاحِهِمَا قَدَمَهُ» قُلْتُ أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَهُ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1989

chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah in Eid Al-Adha.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed two rams on the Day of ‘Eid. When he turned them to face towards the prayer direction he said: ‘Verily, I have turned my face towards Him Who has created the heavens and the earth, as a monotheist, and I am not of the polytheists. Verily, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of all that exists. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims. [6:79,162-163] O Allah, from You to You, on behalf of Muhammad and his nation.’”    – Sound
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sacrificed two rams on the Day of ‘Eid. When he turned them to face towards the prayer direction he said: ‘Verily, I have turned my face towards Him Who has created the heavens and the earth, as a monotheist, and I am not of the polytheists. Verily, my prayer, my sacrifice, my living, and my dying are for Allah, the Lord of all that exists. He has no partner. And of this I have been commanded, and I am the first of the Muslims. [6:79,162-163] O Allah, from You to You, on behalf of Muhammad and his nation.’”    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: ضَحَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِكَبْشَيْنِ فِي يَوْمِ الْعِيدِ فَقَالَ حِينَ وَجَّهَهُمَا «إِنِّي وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنْكَ وَلَكَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأُمَّتِهِ» ثُمَّ سَمَّى اللَّهَ وَكَبَّرَ وَذَبَحَ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū ʿAyyāsh \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1990

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَدَلُّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ الْأُضْحِيَّةَ لَيْسَ بِوَاجِبٍ
chapter.englishTitle: What can be inferred from the narration of the Prophet ﷺ that ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ibn Al-Musayyab told me that Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet told him that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever wants to offer a sacrifice, let him not remove anything from his nails or cut his hair for the first ten days Dhul-Jijjah."'     – Sound
hadiths.body: "Ibn Al-Musayyab told me that Umm Salamah, the wife of the Prophet told him that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever wants to offer a sacrifice, let him not remove anything from his nails or cut his hair for the first ten days Dhul-Jijjah."'     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ فَلَا يُقَلِّمْ أَظْفَارَهُ وَلَا يَحْلِقْ شَيْئًا مِنْ شَعْرِهِ فِي الْعَشْرِ الْأُوَلِ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Khālid / Ibn Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd / Ibn Abū Hilāl \u003e ʿAmr b. Muslim \u003e Ibn al-Musayyab \u003e Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي هِلَالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1991

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَدَلُّ مِنْ حَدِيثِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ الْأُضْحِيَّةَ لَيْسَ بِوَاجِبٍ
chapter.englishTitle: What can be inferred from the narration of the Prophet ﷺ that ...

hadiths.englishRaw: “When the ten days (of Dhul-Hijjah) begin, and one of you wants to offer a sacrifice, let him not remove anything from his hair or skin.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “When the ten days (of Dhul-Hijjah) begin, and one of you wants to offer a sacrifice, let him not remove anything from his hair or skin.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا دَخَلَتِ الْعَشْرُ وَأَرَادَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يُضَحِّيَ فَلَا يَمَسَّ مِنْ شَعْرِهِ وَلَا أَظْفَارِهِ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ḥumayd \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1992

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يَجُوزُ فِي الْأَضَاحِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What is not permissible in sacrifice

hadiths.englishRaw: A Marfu' narration (from the Prophet ﷺ), saying: "A crippled animal whose limp is obvious is not to be slaughtered as sacrifice, nor an animal with a bad eye whose blindness is obvious, nor a sick animal whose sickness is obvious, nor an emaciated animal that has no marrow (in its bones)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A Marfu' narration (from the Prophet ﷺ), saying: "A crippled animal whose limp is obvious is not to be slaughtered as sacrifice, nor an animal with a bad eye whose blindness is obvious, nor a sick animal whose sickness is obvious, nor an emaciated animal that has no marrow (in its bones)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَا يُتَّقَى مِنَ الضَّحَايَا؟ قَالَ «الْعَوْرَاءُ الْبَيِّنُ عَوَرُهَا وَالْعَرْجَاءُ الْبَيِّنُ ظَلْعُهَا وَالْمَرِيضَةُ الْبَيِّنُ مَرَضُهَا وَالْعَجْفَاءُ الَّتِي لَا تُنْقِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿUbayd b. Fayrūz \u003e al-Barāʾ b. ʿĀzib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ فَيْرُوزَ عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1993

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يَجُوزُ فِي الْأَضَاحِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What is not permissible in sacrifice

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard ‘Ubaid bin Fairuz say: ‘I said to Bara’ bin ‘Azib: “Tell us of the sacrificial animals that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ disliked or forbade.” He said: “Allah’s Messenger ﷺ said like this with his hand. And my hand is shorter than his hand:* ‘There are four that will not be accepted as sacrifices: The one-eyed animal that is obviously blind in one eye; the sick animal that is obviously sick; the lame animal with an obvious limp; and the animal that is so emaciated that it is as if there is no marrow in its bones.’” He said:** “And I dislike that the animal should have some fault in its ears.” He said: “What you dislike, forget about it and do not make it forbidden to anyone.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard ‘Ubaid bin Fairuz say: ‘I said to Bara’ bin ‘Azib: “Tell us of the sacrificial animals that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ disliked or forbade.” He said: “Allah’s Messenger ﷺ said like this with his hand. And my hand is shorter than his hand:* ‘There are four that will not be accepted as sacrifices: The one-eyed animal that is obviously blind in one eye; the sick animal that is obviously sick; the lame animal with an obvious limp; and the animal that is so emaciated that it is as if there is no marrow in its bones.’” He said:** “And I dislike that the animal should have some fault in its ears.” He said: “What you dislike, forget about it and do not make it forbidden to anyone.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ الْبَرَاءَ عَمَّا نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْأَضَاحِيِّ فَقَالَ أَرْبَعٌ لَا يُجْزِئْنَ الْعَوْرَاءُ الْبَيِّنُ عَوَرُهَا وَالْعَرْجَاءُ الْبَيِّنُ ظَلْعُهَا وَالْمَرِيضَةُ الْبَيِّنُ مَرَضُهَا وَالْكَسِيرُ الَّتِي لَا تُنْقِي قَالَ قُلْتُ لِلْبَرَاءِ فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي السِّنِّ نَقْصٌ وَفِي الْأُذُنِ نَقْصٌ وَفِي الْقَرْنِ نَقْصٌ قَالَ فَمَا كَرِهْتَ فَدَعْهُ وَلَا تُحَرِّمْهُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sulaymān b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿUbayd b. Fayrūz
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ فَيْرُوزَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1994

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يَجُوزُ فِي الْأَضَاحِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What is not permissible in sacrifice

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to check the eyes and ears [when selecting an animal for sacrifice]    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to check the eyes and ears [when selecting an animal for sacrifice]    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ نَسْتَشْرِفَ الْعَيْنَ وَالْأُذُنَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e Ḥujayyah b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿAlī And Saʾalah a man \u003e Yā Amīr al-Muʾminīn al-Baqarah \u003e Sabʿah \u003e al-Qarn \u003e Lā Yaḍurruk \u003e al-ʿAraj \u003e Idhā Balaghat al-Mansak Thum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُجَيَّةَ بْنَ عَدِيٍّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا وَسَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ الْبَقَرَةُ؟ قَالَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ قُلْتُ الْقَرْنُ؟ قَالَ لَا يَضُرُّكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ الْعَرَجُ؟ قَالَ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ الْمَنْسَكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1995

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يَجُوزُ فِي الْأَضَاحِيِّ
chapter.englishTitle: What is not permissible in sacrifice

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to trim the eye and ear, and not to shave, trim, or pierce." So, "trimming" refers to cutting the edge of the ear, "shaving" refers to cutting from the side of the ear, "pierced" refers to a perforated (eared?) one, and "split" refers to a split one.
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to trim the eye and ear, and not to shave, trim, or pierce." So, "trimming" refers to cutting the edge of the ear, "shaving" refers to cutting from the side of the ear, "pierced" refers to a perforated (eared?) one, and "split" refers to a split one.
hadiths.arabic: «أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ نَسْتَشْرِفَ الْعَيْنَ وَالْأُذُنَ وَأَنْ لَا نُضَحِّيَ بِمُقَابَلَةٍ وَلَا مُدَابَرَةٍ وَلَا خَرْقَاءَ وَلَا شَرْقَاءَ» فَالْمُقَابَلَةُ مَا قُطِعَ طَرَفُ أُذُنِهَا وَالْمُدَابَرَةُ مَا قُطِعَ مِنْ جَانِبِ الْأُذُنِ وَالْخَرْقَاءُ الْمَثْقُوبَةُ وَالشَّرْقَاءُ الْمَشْقُوقَةُ
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Shurayḥ b. al-Nuʿmān al-Ṣāʾidī \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ الصَّائِدِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1996

chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible from sacrifices?

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed sacrificial animals (amongst us for sacrificing them on 'Id al-Adha). So we sacrificed them. There fell to my lot a lamb of less than one year I said: Messenger of Allah, there has fallen to my lot a lamb (Jadha'a), whereupon he said: Sacrifice that.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed sacrificial animals (amongst us for sacrificing them on 'Id al-Adha). So we sacrificed them. There fell to my lot a lamb of less than one year I said: Messenger of Allah, there has fallen to my lot a lamb (Jadha'a), whereupon he said: Sacrifice that.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ضَحَايَا بَيْنَ أَصْحَابِهِ فَأَصَابَنِي جَذَعٌ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا صَارَتْ لِي جَذَعَةٌ فَقَالَ «ضَحِّ بِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Baʿjah al-Juhanī \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir al-Juhanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ بَعْجَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1997

chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible from sacrifices?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me a sheep, which I divided among his companions. After dividing it, there was a part left for me, I mentioned it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said, "Sacrifice it." Abu Muhammad Al-'Atud Al-Jadai said, "It is a male offspring of the goat."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me a sheep, which I divided among his companions. After dividing it, there was a part left for me, I mentioned it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said, "Sacrifice it." Abu Muhammad Al-'Atud Al-Jadai said, "It is a male offspring of the goat."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَعْطَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ غَنَمًا أَقْسِمُهَا عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَسَمْتُهَا وَبَقِيَ مِنْهَا عَتُودٌ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «ضَحِّ بِهِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الْعَتُودُ الْجَذَعُ مِنَ الْمَعْزِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū al-Khayr \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1998

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَدَنَةُ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ وَالْبَقَرَةُ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Badana is about seven and Al-Baqara is about seven.

hadiths.englishRaw: "We sacrificed seventy camels on the day of Hudaybiyah, one after another, on behalf of seven people. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Participate in the offering.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We sacrificed seventy camels on the day of Hudaybiyah, one after another, on behalf of seven people. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Participate in the offering.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: نَحَرْنَا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ سَبْعِينَ بَدَنَةً الْبَدَنَةُ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اشْتَرِكُوا فِي الْهَدْيِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir \u003e Naḥarnā Yawm al-Ḥudaybiyah Sabʿīn Badanah al-Badanah \u003e Sabʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 1999

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْبَدَنَةُ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ وَالْبَقَرَةُ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Badana is about seven and Al-Baqara is about seven.

hadiths.englishRaw: "We sacrificed the cow with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on behalf of seven individuals." It was said to Abu Muhammad, "Do you assert this?" He said, "Yes."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "We sacrificed the cow with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on behalf of seven individuals." It was said to Abu Muhammad, "Do you assert this?" He said, "Yes."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَحَرْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْبَقَرَةَ عَنْ سَبْعَةٍ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2000

chapter.englishTitle: In the meat of the sacrificial animals.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited eating the meat of sacrificial animals after three days.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited eating the meat of sacrificial animals after three days.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِيِّ أَوْ قَالَ «لَا تَأْكُلُوا لُحُومَ الْأَضَاحِيِّ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2001

chapter.englishTitle: In the meat of the sacrificial animals.

hadiths.englishRaw: From Nubayshah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said: "Indeed, we used to prohibit you from eating the meat of sacrificial animals (udhiyah) beyond three days so that it would last you. But Allah has brought abundance, so eat, save, and earn (through selling)." Abu Muhammad said: "Earn, seek payment for it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Nubayshah, from the Prophet ﷺ who said: "Indeed, we used to prohibit you from eating the meat of sacrificial animals (udhiyah) beyond three days so that it would last you. But Allah has brought abundance, so eat, save, and earn (through selling)." Abu Muhammad said: "Earn, seek payment for it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نُبَيْشَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّا كُنَّا نَهَيْنَاكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِيِّ أَنْ تَأْكُلُوهَا فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ كَيْ تَسَعَكُمْ فَقَدْ جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِالسَّعَةِ فَكُلُوا وَادَّخِرُوا وَائْتَّجِرُوا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد ائْتَّجِرُوا اطْلُبُوا فِيهِ الْأَجْرَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Ibn ʿAbdullāh al-Ṭaḥḥān \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Malīḥ \u003e Nubayshah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الطَّحَّانُ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2002

chapter.englishTitle: In the meat of the sacrificial animals.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ had prohibited consuming the meat of sacrificial animals after three days. When the following year came and people were sacrificing their animals, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, if these sacrificial animals were to be distributed among people, would they still be allowed to save some of the meat for later?" He replied, "What would prevent them from doing so on that day?" I then asked, "O Prophet of Allah, were they not prohibited in the first year from eating the meat after three days?" He said, "I had only prohibited them for the people who were present at that time from the dwellers of the outskirts, so that they could distribute the meat amongst themselves. But now, let them eat and save it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ had prohibited consuming the meat of sacrificial animals after three days. When the following year came and people were sacrificing their animals, I said, "O Messenger of Allah, if these sacrificial animals were to be distributed among people, would they still be allowed to save some of the meat for later?" He replied, "What would prevent them from doing so on that day?" I then asked, "O Prophet of Allah, were they not prohibited in the first year from eating the meat after three days?" He said, "I had only prohibited them for the people who were present at that time from the dwellers of the outskirts, so that they could distribute the meat amongst themselves. But now, let them eat and save it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَدْ نَهَى عَنْ لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِيِّ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثٍ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْعَامُ الْقَابِلُ وَضَحَّى النَّاسُ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ الْأَضَاحِيُّ لَتَرْفُقُ بِالنَّاسِ كَانُوا يَدَّخِرُونَ مِنْ لُحُومِهَا وَوَدَكِهَا؟ قَالَ «فَمَا يَمْنَعُهُمْ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ؟» قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ أَوَ لَمْ تَنْهَهُمْ عَامَ أَوَّلَ عَنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلُوا لُحُومَهَا فَوْقَ ثَلَاثٍ؟ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا نَهَيْتُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ لِلْحَاضِرَةِ الَّتِي حَضَرَتْهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ لِيَنُثُّوا لُحُومَهَا فِيهِمْ فَأَمَّا الْآنَ فَلْيَأْكُلُوا وَلْيَدَّخِرُوا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿAmrah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2003

chapter.englishTitle: In the meat of the sacrificial animals.

hadiths.englishRaw: "He heard Thawban, the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him while we were in Mina, 'Fix some meat for us.' So I prepared it for him and he kept eating from it until we reached Madinah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He heard Thawban, the servant of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him while we were in Mina, 'Fix some meat for us.' So I prepared it for him and he kept eating from it until we reached Madinah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ثَوْبَانَ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ بِمِنًى «أَصْلِحْ لَنَا مِنْ هَذَا اللَّحْمِ» فَأَصْلَحْتُ لَهُ مِنْهُ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى بَلَغْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Walīd al-Zabīdī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Jubayr b. Nufayr from my father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الزَّبِيدِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2004

chapter.englishTitle: In the meat of the sacrificial animals.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Jabir saying, "We used to supply ourselves from Mecca to Medina during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ." Abu Muhammad said, "By that he means the meat of the sacrificial animals."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Jabir saying, "We used to supply ourselves from Mecca to Medina during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ." Abu Muhammad said, "By that he means the meat of the sacrificial animals."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا يَقُولُ «إِنْ كُنَّا لَنَتَزَوَّدُ مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد يَعْنِي لُحُومَ الْأَضَاحِيِّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2005

chapter.englishTitle: In the Sacrifice before the Imam

hadiths.englishRaw: "Then the Prophet ﷺ called him after he prayed, and he mentioned to him what he had done. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, 'Your sheep is in exchange for meat.' He said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have a slaughtered goat that is more beloved to me than two sheep.' He (the Prophet) said, 'Carve it and distribute it as charity, but it will not suffice anyone after you.' Abu Muhammad said, 'It was recited to Muhammad from Sufyan that whoever slaughters after the prayer and the Imam gives the sermon, his sacrifice is accepted.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Then the Prophet ﷺ called him after he prayed, and he mentioned to him what he had done. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, 'Your sheep is in exchange for meat.' He said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I have a slaughtered goat that is more beloved to me than two sheep.' He (the Prophet) said, 'Carve it and distribute it as charity, but it will not suffice anyone after you.' Abu Muhammad said, 'It was recited to Muhammad from Sufyan that whoever slaughters after the prayer and the Imam gives the sermon, his sacrifice is accepted.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ دَعَاهُ فَذَكَرَ لَهُ مَا فَعَلَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا شَاتُكَ شَاةُ لَحْمٍ» فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عِنْدِي عَنَاقٌ جَذَعَةٌ مِنَ الْمَعْزِ هِيَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ شَاتَيْنِ قَالَ «فَضَحِّ بِهَا وَلَا تُجْزِئُ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «قُرِئَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ وَمَنْ ذَبَحَ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ أَجْزَأَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr And Zubayd \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e al-Barāʾ b. ʿĀzib \u003e Abū Burdah b. Niyār Ḍaḥḥá Qabl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ وَزُبَيْدٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ أَنَّ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ بْنَ نِيَارٍ ضَحَّى قَبْلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2006

chapter.englishTitle: In the Sacrifice before the Imam

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Prophet ﷺ should leave and he ordered him to return.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Prophet ﷺ should leave and he ordered him to return.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَنْصَرِفَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «فَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُعِيدَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿAlī al-Ḥanafī \u003e Mālik \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Bushayr b. Yasār \u003e Abū Burdah b. Niyār \u003e a man Dhabaḥ Qabl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ بُشَيْرِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ نِيَارٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2007

chapter.englishTitle: In Al-Fara'a and Al-Atira

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no fara' and no' Atirah."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no fara' and no' Atirah."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا فَرَعَ وَلَا عَتِيرَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2008

chapter.englishTitle: In Al-Fara'a and Al-Atira

hadiths.englishRaw: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, we used to sacrifice during the month of Rajab. What do you think?" He said, "There is no problem with that." Waki said, "I will never leave it."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, we used to sacrifice during the month of Rajab. What do you think?" He said, "There is no problem with that." Waki said, "I will never leave it."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَذْبَحُ فِي رَجَبٍ فَمَا تَرَى؟ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ» قَالَ وَكِيعٌ «لَا أَدَعُهُ أَبَدًا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Wakīʿ b. Ḥudus \u003e Abū Razīn al-ʿUqaylī Laqīṭ b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ وَكِيعِ بْنِ حُدُسٍ عَنْ أَبِي رَزِينٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ لَقِيطِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2009

chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah in Aqiqah.

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ‘On behalf of a boy, two sheep of equal age and on behalf of a girl one sheep.’”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ‘On behalf of a boy, two sheep of equal age and on behalf of a girl one sheep.’”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ فِي الْعَقِيقَةِ «عَنِ الْغُلَامِ شَاتَانِ مُكَافِئَتَانِ وَعَنِ الْجَارِيَةِ شَاةٌ»   – إسناده جيد
