hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ḥabībah b. Maysarah b. Abū Khuthaym \u003e Um Kurz
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ عَنْ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتِ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ أَبِي خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ أُمِّ كُرْزٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2010

chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah in Aqiqah.

hadiths.englishRaw: "For a boy there shoud be an 'Aqiqah, so shed blood for him, and remove the harm from him."    – Sound
hadiths.body: "For a boy there shoud be an 'Aqiqah, so shed blood for him, and remove the harm from him."    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَعَ الْغُلَامِ عَقِيقَةٌ فَأَهْرِيقُوا عَنْهُ دَمًا وَأَمِيطُوا عَنْهُ الْأَذَى»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hishām \u003e Ḥafṣah b. Sīrīn \u003e Salmān b. ʿĀmir al-Ḍabbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ سَلْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الضَّبِّيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2011

chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah in Aqiqah.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Two sheep which resemble each other are to be sacrificed for a boy and one for a girl. Abu Dawud said: This is a sound tradition, and the tradition narrated by Sufyan is misunderstanding.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Two sheep which resemble each other are to be sacrificed for a boy and one for a girl. Abu Dawud said: This is a sound tradition, and the tradition narrated by Sufyan is misunderstanding.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَنِ الْغُلَامِ شَاتَانِ مِثْلَانِ وَعَنِ الْجَارِيَةِ شَاةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Yazīd \u003e Sibāʿ b. Thābit \u003e Um Kurz
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ عَنْ سِبَاعِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أُمِّ كُرْزٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2012

chapter.englishTitle: The Sunnah in Aqiqah.

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Every newborn is pledged with its sacrificial animal. It is slaughtered on its seventh day, and it is shaved and named." Qatadah used to describe the blood and say: "When the sacrificial animal is slaughtered, a wool is taken and the edges of the animal are wiped with it. Then, it is placed on the forehead of the baby until the blood flows resembling a thin string. After that, the baby's head is washed, and then it is shaved." Affan said: Aban informed us with this hadith and said: Abdullah said, "And I do not consider it obligatory."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Every newborn is pledged with its sacrificial animal. It is slaughtered on its seventh day, and it is shaved and named." Qatadah used to describe the blood and say: "When the sacrificial animal is slaughtered, a wool is taken and the edges of the animal are wiped with it. Then, it is placed on the forehead of the baby until the blood flows resembling a thin string. After that, the baby's head is washed, and then it is shaved." Affan said: Aban informed us with this hadith and said: Abdullah said, "And I do not consider it obligatory."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «كُلُّ غُلَامٍ رَهِينَةٌ بِعَقِيقَتِهِ يُذْبَحُ عَنْهُ يَوْمَ سَابِعِهِ وَيُحْلَقُ وَيُدَمَّى» وَكَانَ قَتَادَةُ يَصِفُ الدَّمَ فَيَقُولُ «إِذَا ذُبِحَتِ الْعَقِيقَةُ تُؤْخَذُ صُوفَةٌ فَيُسْتَقْبَلُ بِهَا أَوْدَاجُ الذَّبِيحَةِ ثُمَّ تُوضَعُ عَلَى يَافُوخِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى إِذَا سَالَ شَبَهُ الْخَيْطِ غُسِلَ رَأْسُهُ ثُمَّ حُلِقَ بَعْدُ» قَالَ عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ وَيُسَمَّى قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «وَلَا أُرَاهُ وَاجِبًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān b. Muslim \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2013

chapter.englishTitle: In the beauty of the sacrifice.

hadiths.englishRaw: There are two characteristics that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Allah has decreed that everything should be done in a good way, so when you kill use a good method. The version of the narrators other than Muslim says: "So kill in a good manner." And when you slaughter, you should use a good method, for one of you should sharpen his knife, and give the animal as little pain as possible.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: There are two characteristics that I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Allah has decreed that everything should be done in a good way, so when you kill use a good method. The version of the narrators other than Muslim says: "So kill in a good manner." And when you slaughter, you should use a good method, for one of you should sharpen his knife, and give the animal as little pain as possible.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: حَفِظْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ اثْنَتَيْنِ قَالَ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْإِحْسَانَ فَإِذَا قَتَلْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الْقِتْلَةَ وَإِذَا ذَبَحْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الذَّبْحَ وَلْيُحِدَّ أَحَدُكُمْ شَفْرَتَهُ ثُمَّ لِيُرِحْ ذَبِيحَتَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Ashʿath al-Ṣanʿānī \u003e Shaddād b. Aws
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2014

chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible to slaughter

hadiths.englishRaw: "To die, then she took a stone and slaughtered it with it, and indeed, that was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, so he commanded them to eat it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To die, then she took a stone and slaughtered it with it, and indeed, that was mentioned to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, so he commanded them to eat it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَمُوتَ فَأَخَذَتْ حَجَرًا فَذَبَحَتْهَا بِهِ وَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ ذُكِرَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَأَمَرَهُمْ بِأَكْلِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Āmraʾah Kānat Tarʿá Liāl Kaʿb b. Mālik Ghanam Bisalʿ Fakhāfat \u003e Shāh Minhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً كَانَتْ تَرْعَى لِآلِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ غَنَمًا بِسَلْعٍ فَخَافَتْ عَلَى شَاةٍ مِنْهَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2015
hadiths.englishRaw: “I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, should slaughtering only be done in the throat or upper chest?’ He said: ‘If you stab it in the thigh that will suffice you.’”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: “I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, should slaughtering only be done in the throat or upper chest?’ He said: ‘If you stab it in the thigh that will suffice you.’”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَمَا تَكُونُ الذَّكَاةُ إِلَّا فِي الْحَلْقِ وَاللَّبَّةِ؟ فَقَالَ «لَوْ طَعَنْتَ فِي فَخِذِهَا لَأَجْزَأَ عَنْكَ» قَالَ حَمَّادٌ «حَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَى الْمُتَرَدِّي»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd And ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar Waʿaffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū al-ʿUsharāʾ from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ وَعَفَّانُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعُشَرَاءِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2016

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Animal Mutilation

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who imitates or mimics animals.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ cursed the one who imitates or mimics animals.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَعَنَ مَنْ مَثَّلَ بِالْحَيَوَانِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Minhāl b. ʿAmr \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنِي الْمِنْهَالُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ يَقُولُ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فِي طَرِيقٍ مِنْ طُرُقِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَإِذَا بغِلْمَةٌ يَرْمُونَ دَجَاجَةً فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا؟ فَتَفَرَّقُوا فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2017

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Animal Mutilation

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade being patient with animals," said Abu Ayyub, "If it were a chicken, I would not have been patient with it."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade being patient with animals," said Abu Ayyub, "If it were a chicken, I would not have been patient with it."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ صَبْرِ الدَّابَّةِ» قَالَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ «لَوْ كَانَتْ دَجَاجَةً مَا صَبَرْتُهَا»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jaʿfar \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Bukayr b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ashaj from his father \u003e ʿUbayd b. Tiʿlá \u003e Abū Ayyūb al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ تِعْلَى عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2018

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Animal Mutilation

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet of Allah forbade Mutathammah," said Abu Muhammad, "which means a tightened and bound garment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet of Allah forbade Mutathammah," said Abu Muhammad, "which means a tightened and bound garment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُجَثَّمَةِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «الْمُجَثَّمَةُ الْمَصْبُورَةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2019

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ اللَّحْمِ يُوجَدُ فَلَا يُدْرَى أَذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ أَمْ لَا
chapter.englishTitle: The meat is available, it is unknown whether the name of Allah i...

hadiths.englishRaw: “O Messenger of Allah, some people bring us meat, and we do not know whether the Name of Allah has been mentioned over it or not.” He said: “Say: Bismillah and eat.’ They were new in Islam.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “O Messenger of Allah, some people bring us meat, and we do not know whether the Name of Allah has been mentioned over it or not.” He said: “Say: Bismillah and eat.’ They were new in Islam.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ قَوْمًا قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ قَوْمًا يَأْتُونَا بِاللَّحْمِ لَا نَدْرِي أَذُكِرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ أَمْ لَا؟ فَقَالَ «سَمُّوا أَنْتُمْ وَكُلُوا» وَكَانُوا حَدِيثَ عَهْدٍ بِجَاهِلِيَّةٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥīm \u003e Ibn Sulaymān \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ هُوَ ابْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2020

chapter.englishTitle: In animals, when she calls out

hadiths.englishRaw: My grandfather, Rafiʿ bin Khadij said, "We were in the valley of Dhul-Hulaifa of Tuhama in the company of the Prophet ﷺ and had some camels and sheep (of the booty). The people hurried (in slaughtering the animals) and put their meat in the pots and started cooking. Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and ordered them to upset the pots, and distributed the booty considering one camel as equal to ten sheep. One of the camels fled and the people had only a few horses, so they got worried. (The camel was chased and) a man slopped the camel by throwing an arrow at it. Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Some of these animals are untamed like wild animals, so if anyone of them went out of your control, then you should treat it as you have done now.' " My grandfather said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! We fear that we may meet our enemy tomorrow and we have no knives, could we slaughter the animals with reeds?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "Yes, or you can use what would make blood flow (slaughter) and you can eat what is slaughtered and the Name of Allah is mentioned at the time of slaughtering. But don't use teeth or fingernails (in slaughtering). I will tell you why, as for teeth, they are bones, and fingernails are used by Ethiopians for slaughtering. (See Hadith 668)    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: My grandfather, Rafiʿ bin Khadij said, "We were in the valley of Dhul-Hulaifa of Tuhama in the company of the Prophet ﷺ and had some camels and sheep (of the booty). The people hurried (in slaughtering the animals) and put their meat in the pots and started cooking. Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and ordered them to upset the pots, and distributed the booty considering one camel as equal to ten sheep. One of the camels fled and the people had only a few horses, so they got worried. (The camel was chased and) a man slopped the camel by throwing an arrow at it. Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Some of these animals are untamed like wild animals, so if anyone of them went out of your control, then you should treat it as you have done now.' " My grandfather said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! We fear that we may meet our enemy tomorrow and we have no knives, could we slaughter the animals with reeds?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "Yes, or you can use what would make blood flow (slaughter) and you can eat what is slaughtered and the Name of Allah is mentioned at the time of slaughtering. But don't use teeth or fingernails (in slaughtering). I will tell you why, as for teeth, they are bones, and fingernails are used by Ethiopians for slaughtering. (See Hadith 668)    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ بَعِيرًا نَدَّ وَلَيْسَ فِي الْقَوْمِ إِلَّا خَيْلٌ يَسِيرَةٌ فَرَمَاهُ رَجُلٌ بِسَهْمٍ فَحَبَسَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ لِهَذِهِ الْبَهَائِمِ أَوَابِدَ كَأَوَابِدِ الْوَحْشِ فَمَا غَلَبَكُمْ مِنْهَا فَاصْنَعُوا بِهِ هَكَذَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān from his father \u003e ʿAbāyah b. Rifāʿah b. Rāfiʿ from his grandfather Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ بْنِ رَافِعٍ عَنْ جَدِّهِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2021

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَتَلَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ عَبَثًا
chapter.englishTitle: Who killed an animal in vain?

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no person who kills a small bird or anything larger, for no just reason, but Allah will ask him about it." It was said: "O Messenger of Allah, what does 'just reason mean?" He said: "That you slaughters it and eat it, and o not cut off its head and throw it aside,"     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no person who kills a small bird or anything larger, for no just reason, but Allah will ask him about it." It was said: "O Messenger of Allah, what does 'just reason mean?" He said: "That you slaughters it and eat it, and o not cut off its head and throw it aside,"     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ قَتَلَ عُصْفُورًا بِغَيْرِ حَقِّهِ سَأَلَهُ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ» قِيلَ وَمَا حَقُّهُ؟ قَالَ «أَنْ تَذْبَحَهُ فَتَأْكُلَهُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū Maʿmar Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr \u003e Ibn Dīnār \u003e Ṣuhayb a freed slave of Ibn ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو هُوَ ابْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2022

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي ذَكَاةُ الْجَنِينِ ذَكَاةُ أُمِّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the occurrence of fetal hiccups, the mother's hiccup

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The nourishment of the fetus is the nourishment of its mother." Abu Muhammad was asked, "Is it eaten?" He said, "Yes."
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The nourishment of the fetus is the nourishment of its mother." Abu Muhammad was asked, "Is it eaten?" He said, "Yes."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «ذَكَاةُ الْجَنِينِ ذَكَاةُ أُمِّهِ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ «يُؤْكَلُ؟» قَالَ «نَعَمْ»
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAttāb b. Bashīr \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Ziyād \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا عَتَّابُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2023

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُؤْكَلُ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is not edible among animals?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ forbade the eating of wild animals having fangs. (Az-Zuhri said: I did not hear this narration except when I went to Sham.) Al-Laith said: Narrated Yunus: I asked Ibn Shihab, "May we perform the ablution with the milk of she-asses or drink it, or drink the bile of wild animals or urine of camels?" He replied, "The Muslims used to treat themselves with that and did not see any harm in it. As for the milk of she-asses, we have learnt that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the eating of their meat, but we have not received any information whether drinking of their milk is allowed or forbidden." As for the bile of wild animals, Ibn Shihab said, "Abu Idris Al-Khaulani told me that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the eating of the flesh of every wild beast having fangs . "    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ forbade the eating of wild animals having fangs. (Az-Zuhri said: I did not hear this narration except when I went to Sham.) Al-Laith said: Narrated Yunus: I asked Ibn Shihab, "May we perform the ablution with the milk of she-asses or drink it, or drink the bile of wild animals or urine of camels?" He replied, "The Muslims used to treat themselves with that and did not see any harm in it. As for the milk of she-asses, we have learnt that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the eating of their meat, but we have not received any information whether drinking of their milk is allowed or forbidden." As for the bile of wild animals, Ibn Shihab said, "Abu Idris Al-Khaulani told me that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the eating of the flesh of every wild beast having fangs . "    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السَّبُعِ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Idrīs al-Khawlānī \u003e Abū Thaʿlabah al-Khushanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2024

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُؤْكَلُ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is not edible among animals?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade kidnapping, extortion, plunder, and eating any animal with fangs from the wild.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade kidnapping, extortion, plunder, and eating any animal with fangs from the wild.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْخَطْفَةِ وَالْمُجَثَّمَةِ وَالنُّهْبَةِ وَعَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Abū Ūways Ibn ʿAm Mālik b. Anas \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Idrīs al-Khawlānī \u003e Abū Thaʿlabah al-Khushanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُوَيْسٍ ابْنُ عَمِّ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2025

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُؤْكَلُ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is not edible among animals?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the eating of every beast of prey with fang, and every bird with a talon.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the eating of every beast of prey with fang, and every bird with a talon.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ وَكُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Maymūn b. Mihrān \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2026

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ لُبْسِ جُلُودِ السِّبَاعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Wearing Animal Skins

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade (the use of) the skins of beasts of prey.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade (the use of) the skins of beasts of prey.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ جُلُودِ السِّبَاعِ أَنْ تُفْتَرَشَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿmar b. Bishr \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū al-Malīḥ from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْمَرُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2027

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ لُبْسِ جُلُودِ السِّبَاعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Wearing Animal Skins

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū al-Malīḥ from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2028

chapter.englishTitle: Enjoying Dead Animal Skins

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Any skin that has been tanned has been purified.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Any skin that has been tanned has been purified.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَا أَدْرِي مَا أَقُولُ لَكَ غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «أَيُّمَا إِهَابٍ دُبِغَ فَقَدْ طَهُرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. And ʿLah \u003e Saʾalt Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Asqiyah \u003e Mā Adrī Mā Aqūl Lak Ghayr Annī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الْأَسْقِيَةِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2029

chapter.englishTitle: Enjoying Dead Animal Skins

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Its tanning purifies it." Abu Muhammad Abdullah was asked, "Do you say this?" He replied, "Yes, if its meat is eaten."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Its tanning purifies it." Abu Muhammad Abdullah was asked, "Do you say this?" He replied, "Yes, if its meat is eaten."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «دِبَاغُهَا طَهُورُهَا» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ «تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟» قَالَ «نَعَمْ إِذَا كَانَ يُؤْكَلُ لَحْمُهُ»
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Qaʿqāʿ b. Ḥakīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. And ʿLah \u003e Saʾalt Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Julūd al-Maytah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2030

chapter.englishTitle: Enjoying Dead Animal Skins

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that use should be made of the skins of dead animals, if they were tanned.”    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that use should be made of the skins of dead animals, if they were tanned.”    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُسْتَمْتَعَ بِجُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Yazīd b. Qusayṭ \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Thawbān from his mother \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ ثَوْبَانَ عَنْ أُمِّهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2031

chapter.englishTitle: Enjoying Dead Animal Skins

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Would you like to benefit from its skin?" They said, "O Messenger of Allah, it is a dead animal (carcass)." He replied, "Its consumption is only forbidden."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Would you like to benefit from its skin?" They said, "O Messenger of Allah, it is a dead animal (carcass)." He replied, "Its consumption is only forbidden."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوِ اسْتَمْتَعْتُمْ بِإِهَابِهَا؟» قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهَا مَيْتَةٌ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا حُرِّمَ أَكْلُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Mātat Shāh Limaymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ مَاتَتْ شَاةٌ لِمَيْمُونَةَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2032

chapter.englishTitle: Enjoying Dead Animal Skins

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from the Prophet ﷺ that it was said to Abu Muhammad, "What do you say about foxes when they are dyed?" He replied, "I dislike them."   – Sound
hadiths.body: It was narrated from the Prophet ﷺ that it was said to Abu Muhammad, "What do you say about foxes when they are dyed?" He replied, "I dislike them."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ «مَا تَقُولُ فِي الثَّعَالِبِ إِذَا دُبِغَتْ» قَالَ «أَكْرَهُهَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Muṣaffá \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e al-Zubaydī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ عَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2033

chapter.englishTitle: In red beef meat

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah forbade Mut'ah and the flesh of domesticated donkeys on the Day of Khaibar."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah forbade Mut'ah and the flesh of domesticated donkeys on the Day of Khaibar."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ وَعَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْإِنْسِيَّةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e al-Ḥasan And ʿAbd Allāh Āb.ay Muḥammad \u003e Abīhimā \u003e ʿAlī \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنَيْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا عَنْ عَلِيٍّ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2034

chapter.englishTitle: In red beef meat

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah, the donkeys have been eaten or are being slaughtered." Then he said, "O Messenger of Allah, the donkeys have been slaughtered or are being eaten." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered a man to announce, "Indeed, Allah and His Messenger prohibit you from consuming donkey meat, as it is impure."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah, the donkeys have been eaten or are being slaughtered." Then he said, "O Messenger of Allah, the donkeys have been slaughtered or are being eaten." So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered a man to announce, "Indeed, Allah and His Messenger prohibit you from consuming donkey meat, as it is impure."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُكِلَتِ الْحُمُرُ أَوْ أُفْنِيَتِ الْحُمُرُ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُفْنِيَتِ الْحُمُرُ أَوْ أُكِلَتِ الْحُمُرُ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَجُلًا فَنَادَى «إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ فَإِنَّهَا رِجْسٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Anas b. Mālik \u003e Qām a man Yawm Khaybar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَامَ رَجُلٌ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2035

chapter.englishTitle: In eating horse meat

hadiths.englishRaw: "We ate the meat of a horse during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Madinah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We ate the meat of a horse during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Madinah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَكَلْنَا لَحْمَ فَرَسٍ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْمَدِينَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e Fāṭimah b. al-Mundhir \u003e Asmāʾ b. Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2036

chapter.englishTitle: In eating horse meat

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the flesh of domestic asses on the day of Khaibar, but permitted horse flesh.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the flesh of domestic asses on the day of Khaibar, but permitted horse flesh.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْأَهْلِيَّةِ وَأَذِنَ فِي لُحُومِ الْخَيْلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAlī \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2037

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of looting

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: "No honorable booty is taken that the believers raise their gazes towards, while a believer takes it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "No honorable booty is taken that the believers raise their gazes towards, while a believer takes it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَنْتَهِبُ نُهْبَةً ذَاتَ شَرَفٍ يَرْفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ فِيهَا أَبْصَارَهُمْ وَهُوَ حِينَ يَنْتَهِبُهَا مُؤْمِنٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʾAbī Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2038

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of looting

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited looting. Abu Muhammad said, "This is regarding the spoils of war, if they are taken before being distributed."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited looting. Abu Muhammad said, "This is regarding the spoils of war, if they are taken before being distributed."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ النُّهْبَةِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «هَذَا فِي الْغَزْوِ إِذَا غَنِمُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْسَمَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wahbb. Jarīr b. Ḥāzim from his father \u003e Yaʿlá b. Ḥakīm \u003e Abū Labīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِي لَبِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2039

chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of dead animals for the desperate

hadiths.englishRaw: We said, "O Messenger of Allah, we are in a land where there is makhmasah (a type of lizard). What is permissible for us regarding animals that have died?" He said, "If you do not hunt it, do not find it dead, and do not hide it, then it is permissible for you." The people said, "They say it with a 'ha' (حاء), but he said it with a 'kha' (خاء)."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: We said, "O Messenger of Allah, we are in a land where there is makhmasah (a type of lizard). What is permissible for us regarding animals that have died?" He said, "If you do not hunt it, do not find it dead, and do not hide it, then it is permissible for you." The people said, "They say it with a 'ha' (حاء), but he said it with a 'kha' (خاء)."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضٍ تَكُونُ بِهَا الْمَخْمَصَةُ فَمَا يَحِلُّ لَنَا مِنَ الْمَيْتَةِ؟ قَالَ «إِذَا لَمْ تَصْطَبِحُوا وَلَمْ تَغْتَبِقُوا وَلَمْ تَخْتَفِئُوا بَقْلًا فَشَأْنُكُمْ بِهَا» قَالَ النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ بِالْحَاءِ وَهَذَا قَالَ بِالْخَاءِ   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ḥassān b. ʿAṭiyyah \u003e Abū Wāqid
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ حَسَّانَ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي وَاقِدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2040

chapter.englishTitle: In the valley, the milk is strained.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I gifted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a she-camel, and he commanded me to milk it. So I milked it and exerted effort in milking it, and he said, 'Leave some milk for the caller of the milk.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I gifted the Messenger of Allah ﷺ a she-camel, and he commanded me to milk it. So I milked it and exerted effort in milking it, and he said, 'Leave some milk for the caller of the milk.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَهْدَيْتُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِقْحَةً فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَحْلُبَهَا فَحَلَبْتُهَا فَجَهَدْتُ فِي حَلْبِهَا فَقَالَ «دَعْ دَاعِيَ اللَّبَنِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Yaʿqūb b. Baḥīr \u003e Ḍirār b. al-Azwar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ بَحِيرٍ عَنْ ضِرَارِ بْنِ الْأَزْوَرِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2041

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ قَتْلِ الضِّفْدَعِ وَالنَّحْلَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of killing the frog and the bee

hadiths.englishRaw: Nafi' reported that he heard Abu Lubaba informing Ibn 'Umar that Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden the killing of domestic snakes.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Nafi' reported that he heard Abu Lubaba informing Ibn 'Umar that Messenger of Allah ﷺ had forbidden the killing of domestic snakes.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنْ قَتْلِ الضِّفْدَعِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e Saʿīd b. Khālid al-Qāriẓī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْقَارِظِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2042

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ قَتْلِ الضِّفْدَعِ وَالنَّحْلَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of killing the frog and the bee

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade killing four kinds of animals: Ants, bees, hoopoes and shrikes.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade killing four kinds of animals: Ants, bees, hoopoes and shrikes.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ قَتْلِ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ النَّمْلَةِ وَالنَّحْلَةِ وَالْهُدْهُدِ وَالصُّرَدِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá \u003e ʿAbd al-Razzāq \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ أَنْبَأَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2043

chapter.englishTitle: In the murder of the lizard

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Umm Sharik that the Prophet ﷺ told her to kill house lizards.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Umm Sharik that the Prophet ﷺ told her to kill house lizards.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ» أَمَرَ بِقَتْلِ الْأَوْزَاغِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jubayr b. Shaybah \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Um Sharīk
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2044

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْجَلَّالَةِ وَمَا جَاءَ فِيهِ مِنَ النَّهْيِ
chapter.englishTitle: In Al-Jalalah and what came in it from prohibition

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah forbade (eating) animals that had been taken as targets, the milk of Al-Jallalah (animals that eat dung), and drinking directly from water skins."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah forbade (eating) animals that had been taken as targets, the milk of Al-Jallalah (animals that eat dung), and drinking directly from water skins."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُجَثَّمَةِ وَعَنْ لَبَنِ الْجَلَّالَةِ وَأَنْ يُشْرَبَ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2045

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ التَّسْمِيَةِ عِنْدَ إِرْسَالِ الْكَلْبِ، وَصَيْدِ الْكِلَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: The title translates to: "The name when sending the dog, and hun...

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about hunting with a dog, and he said, "Whatever your dog hunts and you are able to catch, then eat it, for its catch is a gift for you. But if you find another dog with it and you fear that it may have killed it, then do not eat it, for you only mentioned the name of Allah on your own dog and did not mention it on any other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about hunting with a dog, and he said, "Whatever your dog hunts and you are able to catch, then eat it, for its catch is a gift for you. But if you find another dog with it and you fear that it may have killed it, then do not eat it, for you only mentioned the name of Allah on your own dog and did not mention it on any other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ صَيْدِ الْكَلْبِ فَقَالَ «مَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْكَ كَلْبُكَ فَكُلْ فَإِنَّ أَخْذَهُ ذَكَاتُهُ وَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ مَعَهُ كَلْبًا فَخَشِيتَ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدْ أَخَذَهُ مَعَهُ وَقَدْ قَتَلَهُ فَلَا تَأْكُلْهُ فَإِنَّكَ إِنَّمَا ذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ وَلَمْ تَذْكُرْهُ عَلَى غَيْرِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAdī b. Ḥātim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ ثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2046

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ التَّسْمِيَةِ عِنْدَ إِرْسَالِ الْكَلْبِ، وَصَيْدِ الْكِلَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: The title translates to: "The name when sending the dog, and hun...

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about hunting with throwing arrows, so he mentioned something similar to it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about hunting with throwing arrows, so he mentioned something similar to it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ صَيْدِ الْمِعْرَاضِ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAdī b. Ḥātim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2047

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي اقْتِنَاءِ كَلْبِ الصَّيْدِ، والْمَاشِيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In acquiring a hunting dog, and livestock.

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn 'Umar reported Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying He who kept a dog other than one meant for hunting or for watching the herd lost out of his deeds (equal to) two qirat every day.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn 'Umar reported Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying He who kept a dog other than one meant for hunting or for watching the herd lost out of his deeds (equal to) two qirat every day.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ اقْتَنَى كَلْبًا إِلَّا كَلْبَ صَيْدٍ أَوْ مَاشِيَةٍ نَقَصَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ قِيرَاطَانِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2048

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي اقْتِنَاءِ كَلْبِ الصَّيْدِ، والْمَاشِيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In acquiring a hunting dog, and livestock.

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ‘Whoever keeps a dog that he does not need for farming or herding, one Qirat will be deducted from his (good) deeds each day.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: ‘Whoever keeps a dog that he does not need for farming or herding, one Qirat will be deducted from his (good) deeds each day.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ اقْتَنَى كَلْبًا لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ زَرْعًا وَلَا ضَرْعًا نَقَصَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ قِيرَاطٌ» قَالُوا أَنْتَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قَالَ إِي وَرَبِّ هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik \u003e Yazīd b. Khuṣayfah \u003e al-Sāʾib b. Yazīd \u003e Sufyān b. Abū Zuhayr \u003e Nās Maʿah ʿInd Bāb al-Masjid
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُصَيْفَةَ عَنْ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ أَبِي زُهَيْرٍ يُحَدِّثُ نَاسًا مَعَهُ عِنْدَ بَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2049

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي اقْتِنَاءِ كَلْبِ الصَّيْدِ، والْمَاشِيَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In acquiring a hunting dog, and livestock.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ ordered the killing of dogs, then he said, "What is the matter with me and the dogs?" Then he permitted the keeping of farm dogs and hunting dogs.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ ordered the killing of dogs, then he said, "What is the matter with me and the dogs?" Then he permitted the keeping of farm dogs and hunting dogs.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَمَرَ بِقَتْلِ الْكِلَابِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «مَالِي وَلِلْكِلَابِ؟» ثُمَّ رَخَّصَ فِي كَلْبِ الزَّرْعِ وَكَلْبِ الصَّيْدِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū al-Tayyāḥ \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2050

chapter.englishTitle: In the killing of the dogs

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that dogs be killed.”    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded that dogs be killed.”    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِقَتْلِ الْكِلَابِ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2051

chapter.englishTitle: In the killing of the dogs

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: Were dogs not a species of creature I should command that they all be killed; but kill every pure black one.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: Were dogs not a species of creature I should command that they all be killed; but kill every pure black one.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوْلَا أَنَّ الْكِلَابَ أُمَّةٌ مِنَ الْأُمَمِ لَأَمَرْتُ بِقَتْلِهَا كُلِّهَا وَلَكِنِ اقْتُلُوا مِنْهَا كُلَّ أَسْوَدَ بَهِيمٍ» قَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ «الْبَهِيمُ الْأَسْوَدُ كُلُّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAwf \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَوْفٌ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2052
hadiths.englishRaw: " I heard 'Adiyy bin Hatim say: 'I asked the Messenger of Allah about the Mirad and he said: "If the sharp point hits 9the game) then eat, bu8t if the broad edge of it hits it, and it is killed, then it has been killed by a blow, so do not eat."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: " I heard 'Adiyy bin Hatim say: 'I asked the Messenger of Allah about the Mirad and he said: "If the sharp point hits 9the game) then eat, bu8t if the broad edge of it hits it, and it is killed, then it has been killed by a blow, so do not eat."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنِ الْمِعْرَاضِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَصَابَ بِحَدِّهِ فَكُلْ وَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِعَرْضِهِ فَقَتَلَ فَإِنَّهُ وَقِيذٌ فَلَا تَأْكُلْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū al-Safar \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAdī b. Ḥātim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2053

chapter.englishTitle: In eating locusts.

hadiths.englishRaw: We went on seven expeditions with Messenger of Allah ﷺ and ate locusts.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We went on seven expeditions with Messenger of Allah ﷺ and ate locusts.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ نَأْكُلُ الْجَرَادَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Yaʿfūr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Awfá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2054

chapter.englishTitle: In sea hunting

hadiths.englishRaw: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Messenger of Allah, we travel on the sea and take a small quantity of water with us. If we use this for ablution, we would suffer from thirst. Can we perform ablution with sea water? The Messenger ﷺ replied: Its water is pure and what dies in it is lawful food.    – Sound
hadiths.body: A man asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: Messenger of Allah, we travel on the sea and take a small quantity of water with us. If we use this for ablution, we would suffer from thirst. Can we perform ablution with sea water? The Messenger ﷺ replied: Its water is pure and what dies in it is lawful food.    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنَّا نَرْكَبُ الْبَحْرَ وَنَحْمِلُ مَعَنَا الْقَلِيلَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَإِنْ تَوَضَّأْنَا بِهِ عَطِشْنَا أَفَنَتَوَضَّأُ مِنْ مَاءِ الْبَحْرِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «هُوَ الطَّهُورُ مَاؤُهُ الْحِلُّ مَيْتَتُهُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak Qirāʾah \u003e Mālik \u003e Ṣafwān b. Sulaym \u003e Saʿīd b. Salamah from Āl al-Azraq \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Abū Burdah / a man from Banī ʿAbd al-Dār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ قِرَاءَةً عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ مِنْ آلِ الْأَزْرَقِ أَنَّ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ وَهُوَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2055

chapter.englishTitle: In sea hunting

hadiths.englishRaw: "We were sent the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with three hundred men, and we suffered from hunger until we reached the sea. There, a creature was thrown at us and we ate from it until our bodies were satisfied. Abu Ubaidah took a rib from it and placed it. Then, the longest man in the army carried it on the greatest camel in the army, and it passed under it." This is its meaning.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We were sent the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with three hundred men, and we suffered from hunger until we reached the sea. There, a creature was thrown at us and we ate from it until our bodies were satisfied. Abu Ubaidah took a rib from it and placed it. Then, the longest man in the army carried it on the greatest camel in the army, and it passed under it." This is its meaning.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي ثَلَاثِ مِائَةٍ فَأَصَابَنَا جُوعٌ حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا الْبَحْرَ وَقَدْ قَذَفَ دَابَّةً فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْهَا حَتَّى ثَابَتْ أَجْسَامُنَا فَأَخَذَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ضِلْعًا مِنْ أَضْلَاعِهَا فَوَضَعَهُ ثُمَّ حَمَلَ أَطْوَلَ رَجُلٍ فِي الْجَيْشِ عَلَى أَعْظَمِ بَعِيرٍ فِي الْجَيْشِ فَمَرَّ تَحْتَهُ» هَذَا مَعْنَاهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr / Ibn Dīnār \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2056

chapter.englishTitle: In eating rabbits

hadiths.englishRaw: He informed me, he said, "I heard Anas ibn Malik say, 'We captured a rabbit while we were passing by Aldhahran. The people rushed and scared it away, but I caught it and brought it to Abu Talha. He slaughtered it and sent its forelegs or hindlegs as a gift to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ .' So he accepted it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He informed me, he said, "I heard Anas ibn Malik say, 'We captured a rabbit while we were passing by Aldhahran. The people rushed and scared it away, but I caught it and brought it to Abu Talha. He slaughtered it and sent its forelegs or hindlegs as a gift to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ .' So he accepted it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يَقُولُ أَنْفَجْنَا أَرْنَبًا وَنَحْنُ بِمَرِّ الظَّهْرَانِ فَسَعَى الْقَوْمُ فَلَغِبُوا فَأَخَذْتُهَا وَجِئْتُ بِهَا إِلَى أَبِي طَلْحَةَ فَذَبَحَهَا وَبَعَثَ بِوَرِكَيْهَا أَوْ فَخِذَيْهَا شَكَّ شُعْبَةُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَقَبِلَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Hishām b. Zayd b. Anas \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ هِشَامُ بْنُ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2057

chapter.englishTitle: In eating rabbits

hadiths.englishRaw: “O Messenger of Allah, I caught these two rabbits but I cannot find any iron* with which to slaughter them with Marwah** and eat them?” He said: “Eat.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “O Messenger of Allah, I caught these two rabbits but I cannot find any iron* with which to slaughter them with Marwah** and eat them?” He said: “Eat.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ مَرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِأَرْنَبَيْنِ مُعَلِّقُهُمَا فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي دَخَلْتُ غَنَمَ أَهْلِي فَاصْطَدْتُ هَذَيْنِ الْأَرْنَبَيْنِ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ حَدِيدَةً أُذَكِّيهِمَا بِهَا فَذَكَّيْتُهُمَا بِمَرْوَةٍ أَفَآكُلُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Muḥammad b. Ṣafwān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2058

chapter.englishTitle: In eating the lizard

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the eating of (the flesh) of the lizard, whereupon he said: I am neither the eater of it nor its prohibitor.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the eating of (the flesh) of the lizard, whereupon he said: I am neither the eater of it nor its prohibitor.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَنِ الضَّبِّ فَقَالَ «لَسْتُ بِآكِلِهِ وَلَا مُحَرِّمِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2059

chapter.englishTitle: In eating the lizard

hadiths.englishRaw: a man brought a mastigure to the Prophet and he said? "A nation was transformed, and Allah knows best "     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: a man brought a mastigure to the Prophet and he said? "A nation was transformed, and Allah knows best "     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِضَبٍّ فَقَالَ «أُمَّةٌ مُسِخَتْ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Zayd b. WahbYuḥaddith \u003e al-Barāʾ b. ʿĀzib \u003e Thābit b. Wadīʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ وَدِيعَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2060

chapter.englishTitle: In eating the lizard

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah, it is a lizard. Messenger of Allah ﷺ withdrew his hand, whereupon Khalid b. Walid said: Messenger of Allah, is a lizard forbidden? There opon he said: No, but it is not found in the land of my people, and I feel that I have no liking for it. Khalid said: I then chewed and ate it, and Messenger of Allah ﷺ was looking at me and he did not forbid (me to eat it).    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah, it is a lizard. Messenger of Allah ﷺ withdrew his hand, whereupon Khalid b. Walid said: Messenger of Allah, is a lizard forbidden? There opon he said: No, but it is not found in the land of my people, and I feel that I have no liking for it. Khalid said: I then chewed and ate it, and Messenger of Allah ﷺ was looking at me and he did not forbid (me to eat it).    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهِيَ خَالَتُهُ وَخَالَةُ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا ضَبًّا مَحْنُوذًا قَدِمَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا حُفَيْدَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ فَقَدَّمَتِ الضَّبَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَكَانَ قَلَّمَا يُقَدِّمُ يَدَهُ لِطَعَامٍ حَتَّى يُحَدَّثَ بِهِ وَيُسَمَّى لَهُ فَأَهْوَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَهُ إِلَى الضَّبِّ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ نِسْوَةِ الْحُضُورِ أَخْبِرْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَا قَدَّمْتُنَّ لَهُ قُلْنَ هَذَا الضَّبُّ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَهُ فَقَالَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ أَتُحَرِّمُ الضَّبَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «لَا وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ» قَالَ خَالِدٌ فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْظُرُ فَلَمْ يَنْهَنِي   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Umāmah b. Sahl b. Ḥunayf al-Anṣārī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbbās \u003e Khālid b. al-Walīd al--Adhī Yuqāl Lah Sayf Allāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو أُمَامَةَ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ سَيْفُ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2061

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الصَّيْدِ يَبِينُ مِنْهُ الْعُضْوُ
chapter.englishTitle: In hunting, the organ is revealed from it.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina and the people were slaughtering camels and sheep. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whatever is cut from an animal while it is still alive is considered dead meat."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina and the people were slaughtering camels and sheep. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whatever is cut from an animal while it is still alive is considered dead meat."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ وَالنَّاسُ يَجُبُّونَ أَسْنِمَةَ الْإِبِلِ وَأَلْيَاتِ الْغَنَمِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا قُطِعَ مِنْ بَهِيمَةٍ وَهِيَ حَيَّةٌ فَهُوَ مَيْتَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman Aḥsabuh \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Abū Wāqid al-Laythī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ أَحْسَبُهُ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَاقِدٍ اللَّيْثِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2062

chapter.englishTitle: In food labeling

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Say Bismillah (in the name of Allah) and eat from what is in front of you."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Say Bismillah (in the name of Allah) and eat from what is in front of you."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهُ «سَمِّ اللَّهَ وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Wahbb. Kaysān \u003e ʿUmar b. Abū Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2063

chapter.englishTitle: In food labeling

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was eating food with six of his Companions when a Bedouin came and ate it all in two bites. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘If he had said Bismillah, it would have sufficed you (all). When any one of you eats food, let him say Bismillah, and if he forgets to say Bismillah at the beginning, let him say Bismillah fi awwalihi wa akhirih (In the Name of Allah at the beginning and at the end).’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was eating food with six of his Companions when a Bedouin came and ate it all in two bites. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘If he had said Bismillah, it would have sufficed you (all). When any one of you eats food, let him say Bismillah, and if he forgets to say Bismillah at the beginning, let him say Bismillah fi awwalihi wa akhirih (In the Name of Allah at the beginning and at the end).’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَأْكُلُ طَعَامًا فِي سِتَّةِ نَفَرٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فَجَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَأَكَلَهُ بِلُقْمَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَوْ ذَكَرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ لَكَفَاكُمْ فَإِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَذْكُرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām \u003e Budayl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2064

chapter.englishTitle: In food labeling

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Aisha, with this hadith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "About Aisha, with this hadith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bundār \u003e Muʿādh b. Hishām from his father \u003e Budayl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr \u003e Um Kulthūm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بُنْدَارٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أُمِّ كُلْثُومٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2065

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الدُّعَاءِ لِصَاحِبِ الطَّعَامِ إِذَا أَطْعَمَ
chapter.englishTitle: Dua for the Host when Serving Food

hadiths.englishRaw: My father, for my mother, if you were to make food for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, she made Thareed (a dish) and he said with his hand, "Let's start." My father then left and he called him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on top of it and then said, "Take in the name of Allah." So they took from its sides. When they tasted it, he prayed for them and said, "O Allah, forgive them, have mercy on them, and bless their sustenance."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: My father, for my mother, if you were to make food for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, she made Thareed (a dish) and he said with his hand, "Let's start." My father then left and he called him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ placed his hand on top of it and then said, "Take in the name of Allah." So they took from its sides. When they tasted it, he prayed for them and said, "O Allah, forgive them, have mercy on them, and bless their sustenance."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبِي لِأُمِّي لَوْ صَنَعْتِ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ طَعَامًا فَصَنَعَتْ ثَرِيدَةً وَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ يُقْلِلُ فَانْطَلَقَ أَبِي فَدَعَاهُ فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَدَهُ عَلَى ذِرْوَتِهَا ثُمَّ قَالَ «خُذُوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ» فَأَخَذُوا مِنْ نَوَاحِيهَا فَلَمَّا طَعِمُوا دَعَا لَهُمْ فَقَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي رِزْقِهِمْ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus \u003e Ṣafwān b. ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Busr And Kānat Lah Ṣuḥbah Yasīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُسْرٍ وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ يَسِيرَةٌ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2066

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الدُّعَاءِ بَعْدَ الْفَرَاغِ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prayer after finishing the meal

hadiths.englishRaw: When the food cloth was removed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “praise be to Allah abundantly and sincerely, of such a nature as is productive of blessing, is not insufficient, Abandoned, or ignored, O our lord.”     – Sound
hadiths.body: When the food cloth was removed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “praise be to Allah abundantly and sincerely, of such a nature as is productive of blessing, is not insufficient, Abandoned, or ignored, O our lord.”     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ قَالَ «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ غَيْرَ مَكْفُورٍ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبِّنَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Qāsim al-Asadī \u003e Thawr \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān \u003e Abū Umāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ الْأَسَدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرٌ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2067

chapter.englishTitle: In gratitude for the food

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The grateful eater is like the patient person who observes fasting."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The grateful eater is like the patient person who observes fasting."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الطَّاعِمُ الشَّاكِرُ كَالصَّائِمِ الصَّابِرِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ḥurrah from his uncle \u003e Sinān b. Sannah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي حُرَّةَ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ سَنَّةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2068

chapter.englishTitle: In licking fingers

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , he said, "When one of you eats, let him lick his three fingers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , he said, "When one of you eats, let him lick his three fingers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَلْعَقْ أَصَابِعَهُ الثَّلَاثَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى أَنْبَأَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2069

chapter.englishTitle: In the napkin at the dining table

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, 'When you eat, do not wipe your hands till you have licked it, or had it licked by somebody else."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, 'When you eat, do not wipe your hands till you have licked it, or had it licked by somebody else."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلَا يَمْسَحْ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَ أَصَابِعَهُ أَوْ يُلْعِقَهَا »   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2070

chapter.englishTitle: In licking the newspaper

hadiths.englishRaw: "Nubayshah, the servant of the Messenger of Allah, entered upon us while we were eating, so we invited him and he ate with us. Then he said, the Messenger of Allah narrated to us that 'whoever eats in a plate or bowl and licks it, the plate itself seeks forgiveness for him.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "Nubayshah, the servant of the Messenger of Allah, entered upon us while we were eating, so we invited him and he ate with us. Then he said, the Messenger of Allah narrated to us that 'whoever eats in a plate or bowl and licks it, the plate itself seeks forgiveness for him.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا نُبَيْشَةُ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ نَأْكُلُ طَعَامًا فَدَعَوْنَاهُ فَأَكَلَ مَعَنَا ثُمَّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ «مَنْ أَكَلَ فِي قَصْعَةٍ ثُمَّ لَحِسَهَا اسْتَغْفَرَتْ لَهُ الْقَصْعَةُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Abū al-Yamān al-Barrāʾ / Muʿallá b. Rāshid \u003e Jaddatī Um ʿĀṣim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْبَرَّاءُ وَهُوَ مُعَلَّى بْنُ رَاشِدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي جَدَّتِي أُمُّ عَاصِمٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2071

chapter.englishTitle: In the summit, when it falls

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a morsel of food falls from any of you, then let him wipe the dirt off it, mention the name of Allah, and eat it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When a morsel of food falls from any of you, then let him wipe the dirt off it, mention the name of Allah, and eat it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا سَقَطَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَمْسَحْ عَنْهَا التُّرَابَ وَلْيُسَمِّ اللَّهَ وَلْيَأْكُلْهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2072

chapter.englishTitle: In the summit, when it falls

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "So, those executioners started mocking him, and they said to him, 'What do you see that these non-Arabs say? They say, 'Look at the food in front of him and what he does with this morsel.'" He said, "Indeed, I would not forsake what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding the saying of these non-Arabs. We were commanded that when a morsel falls from one of us, we should remove any harm from it and eat it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "So, those executioners started mocking him, and they said to him, 'What do you see that these non-Arabs say? They say, 'Look at the food in front of him and what he does with this morsel.'" He said, "Indeed, I would not forsake what I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ regarding the saying of these non-Arabs. We were commanded that when a morsel falls from one of us, we should remove any harm from it and eat it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قال فَجَعَلَ أُولَئِكَ الدَّهَاقِينُ يَتَغَامَزُونَ بِهِ فَقَالُوا لَهُ مَا تَرَى مَا يَقُولُ هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَعَاجِمُ يَقُولُونَ انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ وَإِلَى مَا يَصْنَعُ بِهَذِهِ اللُّقْمَةِ؟ فَقَالَ «إِنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَدَعَ مَا سَمِعْتُ منْ رسولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِقَوْلِ هَؤُلَاءِ الْأَعَاجِمِ إِنَّا كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ إِذَا سَقَطَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِنَا أَنْ يُمِيطَ مَا بِهَا مِنَ الْأَذَى وَأَنْ يَأْكُلَهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ كَانَ مَعْقِلُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ يَتَغَدَّى فَسَقَطَتْ لُقْمَتُهُ فَأَخَذَهَا فَأَمَاطَ مَا بِهَا مِنْ أَذًى ثُمَّ أَكَلَهَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2073

chapter.englishTitle: Eating with the right hand

hadiths.englishRaw: When any one of you intends to eat (meal), he should eat with his right hand. and when he (intends) to drink he should drink with his right hand, for the Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When any one of you intends to eat (meal), he should eat with his right hand. and when he (intends) to drink he should drink with his right hand, for the Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِيَمِينِهِ وَلْيَشْرَبْ بِيَمِينِهِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ وَيَشْرَبُ بِشِمَالِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿAlī al-Ḥanafī \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2074

chapter.englishTitle: Eating with the right hand

hadiths.englishRaw: The above-mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The above-mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2075

chapter.englishTitle: Eating with the right hand

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw Busrah ibn Ra'i al-A'iri eating with his left hand, so he said, "Eat with your right hand." He replied, "I cannot." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You cannot?" The man said, "Then my right hand has become paralyzed."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw Busrah ibn Ra'i al-A'iri eating with his left hand, so he said, "Eat with your right hand." He replied, "I cannot." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "You cannot?" The man said, "Then my right hand has become paralyzed."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبْصَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بُسْرَ بْنَ رَاعِي الْعِيرِ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَقَالَ «كُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ» قَالَ لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ قَالَ «لَا اسْتَطَعْتَ» قَالَ فَمَا وَصَلَتْ يَمِينُهُ إِلَى فِيهِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e ʿIkrimah b. ʿAmmār \u003e Iyās b. Salamah from my father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2076
hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to eat with three fingers and not wipe his before licking it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to eat with three fingers and not wipe his before licking it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَأْكُلُ بِثَلَاثِ أَصَابِعَ وَلَا يَمْسَحُ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Abū Muʿāwiyah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Saʿd al-Madanī \u003e Ibn Kaʿb b. Mālik from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ الْمَدَنِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2077
hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ used to eat with his three fingers, and when he finished, he would lick them." Hisham also pointed with his three fingers.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ used to eat with his three fingers, and when he finished, he would lick them." Hisham also pointed with his three fingers.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِأَصَابِعِهِ الثَّلَاثِ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ لَعِقَهَا» وَأَشَارَ هِشَامٌ بِأَصَابِعِهِ الثَّلَاثِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Saʿd al-Madanī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Kaʿb or ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Kaʿb Shak Hishām from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ الْمَدَنِيِّ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ أَوْ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ شَكَّ هِشَامٌ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2078

chapter.englishTitle: In hospitality

hadiths.englishRaw: He who believes in Allah and in the last day should honour his guest; he who believes in Allah and in the last day should not harm his neighbor; he who believes in Allah and in the last day should speak good or keep silence.
hadiths.body: He who believes in Allah and in the last day should honour his guest; he who believes in Allah and in the last day should not harm his neighbor; he who believes in Allah and in the last day should speak good or keep silence.
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ جَارَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِِيَصْمُتْ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ جَائِزَتَهُ يَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً وَالضِّيَافَةُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ صَدَقَةٌ»
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Saʿīd \u003e Abū Shurayḥ al-Khuzāʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2079

chapter.englishTitle: In hospitality

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever believes in the Last Day, let him treat his neighbour well. Whoever believes in Allah and Last Day, let him honor his guest. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say something good or else remain silent"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever believes in the Last Day, let him treat his neighbour well. Whoever believes in Allah and Last Day, let him honor his guest. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him say something good or else remain silent"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُحْسِنْ إِلَى جَارِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَسْكُتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Nāfiʿ b. Jubayr \u003e Abū Shurayḥ al-Khuzāʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قال سَمِعتُ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2080

chapter.englishTitle: In hospitality

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: If any Muslim is a guest of people and is given nothing, it is the duty of every Muslim to help him to the extent of taking for him from their crop and property for the entertainment of one night.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: If any Muslim is a guest of people and is given nothing, it is the duty of every Muslim to help him to the extent of taking for him from their crop and property for the entertainment of one night.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَيُّمَا مُسْلِمٍ ضَافَ قَوْمًا فَأَصْبَحَ الضَّيْفُ مَحْرُومًا فَإِنَّ عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ نَصْرَهُ حَتَّى يَأْخُذَ لَهُ بِقِرَى لَيْلَتِهِ مِنْ زَرْعِهِ وَمَالِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū al-Jūdī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Muhājir \u003e al-Miqdām b. Maʿdī Karib Abū Karīmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي الْجُودِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ عَنْ الْمِقْدَامِ بْنِ مَعْدِي كَرِبَ أَبِي كَرِيمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2081

chapter.englishTitle: The fly falls into the food.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a fly falls in the drink of one of you, he should dip it all in and then remove it, for in one of its wings there is a disease and in the other there is a cure."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If a fly falls in the drink of one of you, he should dip it all in and then remove it, for in one of its wings there is a disease and in the other there is a cure."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا سَقَطَ الذُّبَابٌ فِي شَرَابِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَغْمِسْهُ كُلَّهُ ثُمَّ لِيَنْزِعْهُ فَإِنَّ فِي أَحَدِ جَنَاحَيْهِ دَاءً وَفِي الْآخَرِ شِفَاءً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Sulaymān b. Bilāl \u003e ʿUtbah b. Muslim \u003e ʿUbayd b. Ḥunayn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ حُنَيْنٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2082

chapter.englishTitle: The fly falls into the food.

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "When a fly falls into the vessel of any one of you, let him immerse it, for indeed in one of its wings there is a disease and in the other there is a cure." Abu Muhammad said, "Except for Hammaad, Thumamah, and Anas in the place of Abu Hurayrah, and a group that says it is from al-Qaqa' (another narrator) from Abu Hurayrah." And the narration of Ubayd ibn Hunayn is the most authentic.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "When a fly falls into the vessel of any one of you, let him immerse it, for indeed in one of its wings there is a disease and in the other there is a cure." Abu Muhammad said, "Except for Hammaad, Thumamah, and Anas in the place of Abu Hurayrah, and a group that says it is from al-Qaqa' (another narrator) from Abu Hurayrah." And the narration of Ubayd ibn Hunayn is the most authentic.   – Weak Chain
