hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ إِذَا وَقَعَ الذُّبَابٌ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَغْمِسْهُ فَإِنَّ فِي أَحَدِ جَنَاحَيْهِ دَاءً وَفِي الْآخَرِ شِفَاءً قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد قَالَ غَيْرُ حَمَّادٍ ثُمَامَةُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ مَكَانَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَقَوْمٌ يَقُولُونَ عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ «وَحَدِيثُ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ أَصَحُّ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thumāmah b. ʿAbdullāh b. Anas \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2083

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The believer eats in one stomach.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The disbeliever eats with seven intestines and the believer eats with one intestine.”    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: “The disbeliever eats with seven intestines and the believer eats with one intestine.”    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ وَالْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2084

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The believer eats in one stomach.

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Dawud said “I heard Muhammad bin Isa narrating this tradition who said Mu’tamar narrated it to us. And he (Mu’tamar) said “ I heard Al Hakam bin Aban narrating this tradition. He did not mention the name of Ibn ‘Abbas. Abu Dawud said “Al Hussain bin Huraith wrote to me saying “Al Fadl bin Musa narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Dawud said “I heard Muhammad bin Isa narrating this tradition who said Mu’tamar narrated it to us. And he (Mu’tamar) said “ I heard Al Hakam bin Aban narrating this tradition. He did not mention the name of Ibn ‘Abbas. Abu Dawud said “Al Hussain bin Huraith wrote to me saying “Al Fadl bin Musa narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ ح   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar al-Qawārīrī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2085

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The believer eats in one stomach.

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Dawud said “I heard Muhammad bin Isa narrating this tradition who said Mu’tamar narrated it to us. And he (Mu’tamar) said “ I heard Al Hakam bin Aban narrating this tradition. He did not mention the name of Ibn ‘Abbas. Abu Dawud said “Al Hussain bin Huraith wrote to me saying “Al Fadl bin Musa narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Dawud said “I heard Muhammad bin Isa narrating this tradition who said Mu’tamar narrated it to us. And he (Mu’tamar) said “ I heard Al Hakam bin Aban narrating this tradition. He did not mention the name of Ibn ‘Abbas. Abu Dawud said “Al Hussain bin Huraith wrote to me saying “Al Fadl bin Musa narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Mujālid \u003e Abū al-Waddāk \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: وحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2086

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The believer eats in one stomach.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The disbeliever eats with seven intestines and the believer eats with one intestine.”    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “The disbeliever eats with seven intestines and the believer eats with one intestine.”    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ وَالْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: وحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2087

chapter.englishTitle: The food of one is sufficient for two.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The food of one person is sufficient for two, the food of two is sufficient for four, and the food for four is sufficient for eight.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The food of one person is sufficient for two, the food of two is sufficient for four, and the food for four is sufficient for eight.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «طَعَامُ الْوَاحِدِ يَكْفِي الِاثْنَيْنِ وَطَعَامُ الِاثْنَيْنِ يَكْفِي الْأَرْبَعَةَ وَطَعَامُ الْأَرْبَعَةِ يَكْفِي ثَمَانِيَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2088

chapter.englishTitle: The food of one is sufficient for two.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "In the name of Allah, and eat whatever is before you."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "In the name of Allah, and eat whatever is before you."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَهُ «سَمِّ اللَّهَ وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Wahbb. Kaysān \u003e ʿUmar b. Abū Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2089

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا يَلِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the one who eats what follows it

hadiths.englishRaw: Not found
hadiths.body: Not found
hadiths.arabic: لا أوجد

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2090

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ أَكْلِ وَسَطِ الثَّرِيدِ حَتَّى يَأْكُلَ جَوَانِبَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of eating the core until its sides are eaten.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was presented with a handful or a piece of bread, and he said, 'Eat from its edges or sides and do not eat from its center, for blessings descend in its center.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was presented with a handful or a piece of bread, and he said, 'Eat from its edges or sides and do not eat from its center, for blessings descend in its center.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِجَفْنَةٍ أَوْ قَالَ قَصْعَةٍ مِنْ ثَرِيدٍ فَقَالَ كُلُوا مِنْ حَافَاتِهَا أَوْ قَالَ جَوَانِبِهَا وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ وَسَطِهَا فَإِنَّ الْبَرَكَةَ تَنْزِلُ فِي وَسَطِهَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2091

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ أَكْلِ الطَّعَامِ الْحَارِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition on eating hot food

hadiths.englishRaw: "It used to be that when she was brought a throw, she would command it to be covered until its heat and smoke disappear, and she would say, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'It is greater in blessing.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "It used to be that when she was brought a throw, she would command it to be covered until its heat and smoke disappear, and she would say, 'I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'It is greater in blessing.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ إِذَا أُتِيَتْ بِثَرِيدٍ أَمَرَتْ بِهِ فَغُطِّيَ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ فَوْرَةُ وَدُخَانُهُ وَتَقُولُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «هُوَ أَعْظَمُ لِلْبَرَكَةِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ibrāhīm al-Dimashqī \u003e Ibn Wahb \u003e Qurrah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e Asmāʾ b. Abū Bakr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ قُرَّةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2092

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَيُّ الْإِدَامِ كَانَ أَحَبَّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: Which meal was most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ took hold of my hand one day (and led me) to his residence. There was presented to him some pieces of bread, whereupon he said: Is there no condiment? They (the members of his household) said: No, except some vinegar. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Vinegar is a good condiment. Jabir said: I have always loved vinegar since I heard it trom Allah's Apostle ﷺ. Talha said: I have always loved vinegar since I heard about it from Jabir.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ took hold of my hand one day (and led me) to his residence. There was presented to him some pieces of bread, whereupon he said: Is there no condiment? They (the members of his household) said: No, except some vinegar. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Vinegar is a good condiment. Jabir said: I have always loved vinegar since I heard it trom Allah's Apostle ﷺ. Talha said: I have always loved vinegar since I heard about it from Jabir.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخَذَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِيَدِي ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ فَقَالَ «هَلْ مِنْ غَدَاءٍ أَوْ مِنْ عَشَاءٍ؟» شَكَّ طَلْحَةُ قَالَ فَأَخْرَجَ إِلَيْهِ فِلَقًا مِنْ خُبْزٍ فَقَالَ «أَمَا مِنْ أُدْمٍ؟» قَالُوا لَا إِلَّا شَيْءٌ مِنْ خَلٍّ فَقَالَ «هَاتُوهُ فَنِعْمَ الْإِدَامُ الْخَلُّ» قَالَ جَابِرٌ «فَمَا زِلْتُ أُحِبُّ الْخَلَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ» فَقَالَ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ «فَمَا زِلْتُ أُحِبُّهُ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ جَابِرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Muthanná b. Saʿīd \u003e Ṭalḥah b. Nāfiʿ Abū Sufyān \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَبُو سُفْيَانَ حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2093

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَيُّ الْإِدَامِ كَانَ أَحَبَّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: Which meal was most beloved to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?

hadiths.englishRaw: What a good condiment vinegar is!     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: What a good condiment vinegar is!     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «نِعْمَ الْإِدَامُ أَوْ نِعْمَ الْأُدْمُ الْخَلُّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sulaymān b. Bilāl \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2094

chapter.englishTitle: There is no context provided for the phrase "الْقَرْعِ" in Arabi...

hadiths.englishRaw: I saw the Prophet ﷺ being served with soup and containing gourd and cured meat, and I saw him picking and eating the pieces of gourd.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I saw the Prophet ﷺ being served with soup and containing gourd and cured meat, and I saw him picking and eating the pieces of gourd.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِمَرَقَةٍ فِيهَا دُبَّاءٌ وَقَدِيدٌ فَرَأَيْتُهُ يَتَتَبَّعُ الدُّبَّاءَ يَأْكُلُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Mālik \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2095

chapter.englishTitle: There is no context provided for the phrase "الْقَرْعِ" in Arabi...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ used to like pumpkin." He said, "So it was brought to him and I started eating it while he placed it in front of him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ used to like pumpkin." He said, "So it was brought to him and I started eating it while he placed it in front of him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يُعْجِبُهُ الْقَرْعُ» قَالَ «فَقُدِّمَ إِلَيْهِ فَجَعَلْتُ أَتَنَاوَلُهُ وَأَجْعَلُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2096

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of olive oil

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Season (your food) with olive oil and anoint yourselves with it, for it comes from a blessed tree.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: ‘Season (your food) with olive oil and anoint yourselves with it, for it comes from a blessed tree.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «كُلُوا الزَّيْتَ فَإِنَّهُ مُبَارَكٌ وَائْتَدِمُوا بِهِ وَادَّهِنُوا بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAṭāʾ And Lays Biāb. Abū Rabāḥ \u003e Abū Asīd al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَلَيْسَ بِابْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَسِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2097

chapter.englishTitle: In eating garlic

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said in the Battle of Khaybar, "Whoever eats from this tree, meaning garlic, should not come to the mosques."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said in the Battle of Khaybar, "Whoever eats from this tree, meaning garlic, should not come to the mosques."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ فِي غَزْوَةِ خَيْبَرَ «مَنْ أَكَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الشَّجَرَةِ يَعْنِي الثُّومَ فَلَا يَأْتِيَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2098

chapter.englishTitle: In eating garlic

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed with us and we provided him with food in which there was something from these dishes. When we brought it to him, he disliked it and said to his companions, "Eat, for I am not like any of you. I fear that my companion will be hurt." Abu Muhammad said, "If no one is hurt, then there is no harm in eating it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed with us and we provided him with food in which there was something from these dishes. When we brought it to him, he disliked it and said to his companions, "Eat, for I am not like any of you. I fear that my companion will be hurt." Abu Muhammad said, "If no one is hurt, then there is no harm in eating it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: نَزَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَتَكَلَّفْنَا لَهُ طَعَامًا فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ بَعْضِ هَذِهِ الْبُقُولِ فَلَمَّا أَتَيْنَا بِهِ كَرِهَهُ وَقَالَ لِأَصْحَابِهِ «كُلُوا فَإِنِّي لَسْتُ كَأَحَدٍ مِنْكُمْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ أُوذِيَ صَاحِبِي» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «إِذَا لَمْ يُؤْذِ أَحَدًا فَلَا بَأْسَ بِأَكْلِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAlī b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Yazīd from his father \u003e Um Ayyūb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ أُمَّ أَيُّوبَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2099

chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of chicken

hadiths.englishRaw: "We were with Abu Musa and His food was brought, including chicken. Among the people there was a man from banu Taimullah who had reddish complexion, as if he were a freed slave. He did not come close and Abu Musa said: "Come (and eat) for I saw the Messenger of All eating it"'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We were with Abu Musa and His food was brought, including chicken. Among the people there was a man from banu Taimullah who had reddish complexion, as if he were a freed slave. He did not come close and Abu Musa said: "Come (and eat) for I saw the Messenger of All eating it"'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا عِنْدَ أَبِي مُوسَى فَقَدَّمَ طَعَامُهُ فَقُدِّمَ فِي طَعَامِهِ لَحْمُ دَجَاجٍ وَفِي الْقَوْمِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي تَيْمِ اللَّهِ أَحْمَرُ فَلَمْ يَدْنُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو مُوسَى «ادْنُ فَإِنِّي قَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e al-Qāsim al-Tamīmī \u003e Zahdam al-Jarmī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ التَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2100

chapter.englishTitle: In the consumption of chicken

hadiths.englishRaw: Why do you put on the lower garment in this way? He replied: It is how I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Why do you put on the lower garment in this way? He replied: It is how I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَأْكُلُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Zahdam al-Jarmī \u003e Abū Mūsá \u003e Dhakar al-Dajāj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ زَهْدَمٍ الْجَرْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ الدَّجَاجَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2101

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُطْعِمَ طَعَامَهُ إِلَّا َتْقِيًّا
chapter.englishTitle: Who detests to feed his food unless righteously

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not accompany except a believer, and do not serve your food except to one with Taqwa."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not accompany except a believer, and do not serve your food except to one with Taqwa."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَا تَصْحَبْ إِلَّا مُؤْمِنًا وَلَا يَأْكُلْ طَعَامَكَ إِلَّا تَقِيٌّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd al-Muqriʾ \u003e Ḥaywah \u003e Sālim b. Ghaylān \u003e al-Walīd b. Qays \u003e Abū Saʿīd or \u003e Abū al-Haytham \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī \u003e Nabī Allāh ﷺ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ غَيْلَانَ أَنَّ الْوَلِيدَ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ أَوْ عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2102

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ بَأْسًا أَنْ يُجْمَعَ بَيْنَ الشَّيْئَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The one who has not seen any harm in bringing together two things

hadiths.englishRaw: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating cucumbers with dates.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eating cucumbers with dates.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَأْكُلُ الْقِثَّاءَ بِالرُّطَبِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd from his father \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2103

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of the Quran.

hadiths.englishRaw: "While at Medina we were struck with famine. Ibn Az-Zubair used to provide us with dates as our food. Ibn ʿUmar used to pass by us and say, "Don't eat two dates together at a time as the Prophet ﷺ has forbidden eating two dates together at a time (in a gathering) unless one takes the permission of one's companion brother."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "While at Medina we were struck with famine. Ibn Az-Zubair used to provide us with dates as our food. Ibn ʿUmar used to pass by us and say, "Don't eat two dates together at a time as the Prophet ﷺ has forbidden eating two dates together at a time (in a gathering) unless one takes the permission of one's companion brother."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَأَصَابَتْنَا سَنَةٌ فَكَانَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَرْزُقُ التَّمْرَ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَمُرُّ بِنَا وَيَقُولُ لَا تُقَارِنُوا «فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الْقِرَانِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَسْتَأْذِنَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Jabalah b. Suḥaym
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا جَبَلَةُ بْنُ سُحَيْمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2104

chapter.englishTitle: In the date (fruit)

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O Aisha, a house in which its inhabitants do not pass by hunger or cause hunger to others.' This was said twice or thrice."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O Aisha, a house in which its inhabitants do not pass by hunger or cause hunger to others.' This was said twice or thrice."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «يَا عَائِشَةُ بَيْتٌ لَا تَمْرَ فِيهِ جِيَاعٌ أَهْلُهُ أَوْ جَاعَ أَهْلُهُ » مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Yaʿqūb b. Muḥammad b. Ṭaḥlāʾ \u003e Abū al-Rijāl \u003e Ummih ʿAmrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ طَحْلَاءَ عَنْ أَبِي الرِّجَالِ عَنْ أُمِّهِ عَمْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2105

chapter.englishTitle: In the date (fruit)

hadiths.englishRaw: A family which has dates will not be hungry.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A family which has dates will not be hungry.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَجُوعُ أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ عِنْدَهُمُ التَّمْرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Sulaymān b. Bilāl \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2106

chapter.englishTitle: In the date (fruit)

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Anas ibn Malik say, "Dates were presented to the Prophet (pbuh), so he started distributing them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Anas ibn Malik say, "Dates were presented to the Prophet (pbuh), so he started distributing them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يَقُولُ أُهْدِيَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ تَمْرٌ «فَأَخَذَ يُهَدِّيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Muṣʿab b. Sulaym \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2107

chapter.englishTitle: In ablution after eating

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever goes to sleep with the smell of garlic on his hand and then experiences a bad odor, he has no one to blame but himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever goes to sleep with the smell of garlic on his hand and then experiences a bad odor, he has no one to blame but himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ نَامَ وَفِي يَدِهِ رِيحُ غَمَرٍ فَعَرَضَ لَهُ عَارِضٌ فَلَا يَلُومَنَّ إِلَّا نَفْسَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Suhayl from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2108

chapter.englishTitle: In the celebration

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said to Abdur Rahman ibn Awf when he saw a smallpox scar on him, 'Have you contracted chickenpox?' He replied, 'No, I got married.' The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said, 'You should have been treated even if it was with a sheep."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said to Abdur Rahman ibn Awf when he saw a smallpox scar on him, 'Have you contracted chickenpox?' He replied, 'No, I got married.' The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم said, 'You should have been treated even if it was with a sheep."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَرَأَى عَلَيْهِ وَضَرًا مِنْ صُفْرَةٍ «مَهْيَمْ؟» قَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ قَالَ «أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2109

chapter.englishTitle: In the celebration

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: The wedding feast on the first day is a duty, that on the second is a good practice, but that on the third day is to make men hear of it and show it to them. Qatadah said: A man told me that Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab was invited (to a wedding feast on the first day and he accepted it. He was again invited on the second day, and he accepted. When he was invited on the third day, he did not accept; he said: They are the people who make men hear of it and show it to them.
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: The wedding feast on the first day is a duty, that on the second is a good practice, but that on the third day is to make men hear of it and show it to them. Qatadah said: A man told me that Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab was invited (to a wedding feast on the first day and he accepted it. He was again invited on the second day, and he accepted. When he was invited on the third day, he did not accept; he said: They are the people who make men hear of it and show it to them.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْوَلِيمَةُ أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ حَقٌّ وَالثَّانِيَ مَعْرُوفٌ وَالثَّالِثَ سُمْعَةٌ وَرِيَاءٌ» قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ أَنَّهُ دُعِيَ أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ فَأَجَابَ وَدُعِيَ الْيَوْمَ الثَّانِيَ فَأَجَابَ وَدُعِيَ الْيَوْمَ الثَّالِثَ فَحَصَبَ الرَّسُولَ وَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ وَقَالَ «أَهْلُ سُمْعَةٍ وَرِيَاءٍ»
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ الثَّقَفِيِّ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ ثَقِيفَ أَعْوَرَ قَالَ كَانَ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَعْرُوفٌ أَيْ يُثْنَى عَلَيْهِ خَيْرٌ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنِ اسْمُهُ زُهَيْرَ بْنَ عُثْمَانَ فَلَا أَدْرِي مَا اسْمُهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2110

chapter.englishTitle: In the celebration

hadiths.englishRaw: The worst kind of food is that at a wedding feast to which the rich are invited and from which the poor are left out. If anyone does not attend the feast to which he was invited, he has disobeyed Allah and His Apostle (may peace upon him).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The worst kind of food is that at a wedding feast to which the rich are invited and from which the poor are left out. If anyone does not attend the feast to which he was invited, he has disobeyed Allah and His Apostle (may peace upon him).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «شَرُّ الطَّعَامِ طَعَامُ الْوَلِيمَةِ يُدْعَى إِلَيْهِ الْأَغْنِيَاءُ وَيُتْرَكُ الْمَسَاكِينُ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ الدَّعْوَةَ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2111

chapter.englishTitle: In the celebration

hadiths.englishRaw: A man came who had prepared food to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, "O Messenger of Allah, like this," and he pointed to it with his hand. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ responded, saying, "Like this," and gestured towards Aisha. He replied, "No," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from him. He pointed to it a second time, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from him again. He pointed to it a third time, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "What about this?" He replied, "Yes," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Aisha went with him and had some of his food.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man came who had prepared food to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, "O Messenger of Allah, like this," and he pointed to it with his hand. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ responded, saying, "Like this," and gestured towards Aisha. He replied, "No," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from him. He pointed to it a second time, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ turned away from him again. He pointed to it a third time, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "What about this?" He replied, "Yes," so the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and Aisha went with him and had some of his food.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ قَدْ صَنَعَ طَعَامًا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ هَكَذَا وَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ بِيَدِهِ قَالَ يَقُولُ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «هَكَذَا» وَأَشَارَ إِلَى عَائِشَةَ قَالَ لَا فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ الثَّانِيَةَ وَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «وَهَذِهِ؟» قَالَ نَعَمْ فَانْطَلَقَ مَعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعَائِشَةُ فَأَكَلَا مِنْ طَعَامِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Sulaymān \u003e Sulaymān b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2112

chapter.englishTitle: In the celebration

hadiths.englishRaw: He is called Abu Shuayb and he had a young worker. He said, "Make food for me and invite the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for the fifth of five." So he invited the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for the fifth of five. A man followed them, and the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "You invited us for the fifth of five and this man has followed me. If you want, you can allow him, and if you want, you can leave him." He said, "So he allowed him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He is called Abu Shuayb and he had a young worker. He said, "Make food for me and invite the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for the fifth of five." So he invited the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, for the fifth of five. A man followed them, and the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "You invited us for the fifth of five and this man has followed me. If you want, you can allow him, and if you want, you can leave him." He said, "So he allowed him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو شُعَيْبٍ وَكَانَ لَهُ غُلَامٌ لَحَّامٌ فَقَالَ اصْنَعْ لِي طَعَامًا أَدْعُو رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَامِسَ خَمْسَةٍ قَالَ فَدَعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَامِسَ خَمْسَةٍ فَتَبِعَهُمْ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّكَ دَعَوْتَنَا خَامِسَ خَمْسَةٍ وَهَذَا رَجُلٌ قَدْ تَبِعَنِي فَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَذِنْتَ لَهُ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ تَرَكْتَهُ» قَالَ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e Abū Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ كَانَ رَجُلٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2113

chapter.englishTitle: In the Virtue of the Thurayya.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The superiority of ‘Aishah over other women is like the superiority of Tharid over all other foods.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘The superiority of ‘Aishah over other women is like the superiority of Tharid over all other foods.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَضْلُ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّعَامِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Abū Ṭuwālah ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Maʿmar \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ أَبِي طُوَالَةَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2114

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنِ اسْتَحَبَّ أَنْ يَنْهَسَ اللَّحْمَ، وَلَا يَقْطَعَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who is it preferable to tear the meat and not cut it?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Nawfal married me off on behalf of my father in the reign of Uthman. He invited a group of companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and among those he invited was Safwan ibn Umayyah, who was an elderly gentleman. He said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Tenderize the meat thoroughly, for it is more delicious and more enjoyable."'   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah ibn al-Harith ibn Nawfal married me off on behalf of my father in the reign of Uthman. He invited a group of companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and among those he invited was Safwan ibn Umayyah, who was an elderly gentleman. He said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Tenderize the meat thoroughly, for it is more delicious and more enjoyable."'   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ زَوَّجَنِي أَبِي فِي إِمَارَةِ عُثْمَانَ فَدَعَا رَهْطًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَكَانَ فِيمَنْ دَعَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ وَهُوَ شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «انْهَسُوا اللَّحْمَ نَهْسًا فَإِنَّهُ أَشْهَى وَأَمْرَأُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAlī b. al-Madīnī \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm Abū Umayyah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْمَدِينِيِّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْكَرِيمِ أَبُو أُمَيَّةَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2115

chapter.englishTitle: In Food, Reclining

hadiths.englishRaw: I do not eat while reclining.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I do not eat while reclining.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا آكُلُ مُتَّكِئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAlī b. al-Aqmar \u003e Abū Juḥayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْأَقْمَرِ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جُحَيْفَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2116

chapter.englishTitle: In the morning

hadiths.englishRaw: “O Allah, bless us in our city and in our fruits, in our Mudd and in our Sa’,* blessing upon blessing.” Then he would give it to the smallest of the children present.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “O Allah, bless us in our city and in our fruits, in our Mudd and in our Sa’,* blessing upon blessing.” Then he would give it to the smallest of the children present.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أُتِيَ بِالْبَاكُورَةِ بِأَوَّلِ الثَّمَرَةِ قَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا وَفِي ثَمَرَتِنَا وَفِي مُدِّنَا وَفِي صَاعِنَا بَرَكَةً مَعَ بَرَكَةٍ» ثُمَّ يُعْطِيهِ أَصْغَرَ مَنْ يَحْضُرُهُ مِنَ الْوِلْدَانِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Suhayl from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2117

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي إِكْرَامِ الْخَادِمِ عِنْدَ الطَّعَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In honoring the servant during the meal

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When your servant brings you food, make him sit and if he refuses, then serve him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When your servant brings you food, make him sit and if he refuses, then serve him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا جَاءَ خَادِمُ أَحَدِكُمْ بِالطَّعَامِ فَلْيُجْلِسْهُ فَإِنْ أَبَى فَلْيُنَاوِلْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2118

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي إِكْرَامِ الْخَادِمِ عِنْدَ الطَّعَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In honoring the servant during the meal

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When one of you's servant brings him food, let him make him sit with him or let him give him a bite or two, or a meal or two, for he is his guardian and companion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When one of you's servant brings him food, let him make him sit with him or let him give him a bite or two, or a meal or two, for he is his guardian and companion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا أَتَى أَحَدَكُمْ خَادِمُهُ بِطَعَامٍ فَلْيُجْلِسْهُ مَعَهُ أَوْ َلْيُنَاوِلْهُ لُقْمَةً أَوْ لُقْمَتَيْنِ أَوْ أُكْلَةً أَوْ أُكْلَتَيْنِ فَإِنَّهُ وَلِيَ حَرَّهُ وَدُخَانَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. Ziyād \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2119

chapter.englishTitle: In sweets and honey.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah 9saw) used to like sweets and honey.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah 9saw) used to like sweets and honey.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُحِبُّ الْحَلْوَاءَ وَالْعَسَلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Farwah b. Abū al-Maghrāʾ \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2120

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْأَكْلِ وَالشُّرْبِ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In eating and drinking without ablution

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ came out of the toilet and food was brought to him. It was said to him, "Don't you perform ablution?" He replied, "Should I perform prayer and then perform ablution?" Abu Muhammad said, "He is Sa'id ibn al-Huwairith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ came out of the toilet and food was brought to him. It was said to him, "Don't you perform ablution?" He replied, "Should I perform prayer and then perform ablution?" Abu Muhammad said, "He is Sa'id ibn al-Huwairith."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مِنَ الْبَرَازِ فَقُدِّمَ إِلَيْهِ الطَّعَامٌ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَلَا تَوَضَّأُ؟ قَالَ فَقَالَ «أُصَلِّي فَأَتَوَضَّأُ؟» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «إِنَّمَا هُوَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْحُوَيْرِثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū al-Ḥūwayrith \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحُوَيْرِثِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2121

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْأَكْلِ وَالشُّرْبِ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In eating and drinking without ablution

hadiths.englishRaw: A similar tradition has also been transmitted by Ibn 'Abbas through a different chain of narrators.
hadiths.body: A similar tradition has also been transmitted by Ibn 'Abbas through a different chain of narrators.
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Ḥūwayrith
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2122

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْأَكْلِ وَالشُّرْبِ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In eating and drinking without ablution

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Ibn Abbas with his chain of narration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Ibn Abbas with his chain of narration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ بِإِسْنَادِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Ḥūwayrith
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَاصِمٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2123

chapter.englishTitle: In the south, he eats

hadiths.englishRaw: "If the Messenger of Allah wanted to eat when he was sexually impure, he would perform ablution."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If the Messenger of Allah wanted to eat when he was sexually impure, he would perform ablution."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَجْنَبَ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ أَوْ يَنَامَ تَوَضَّأَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2124

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي إِكْثَارِ الْمَاءِ فِي الْقِدْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: In increasing the water in the pot

hadiths.englishRaw: Whenever you prepare a broth, add water to it, and have in your mind the members of the household of your neighbours and then give them out of this with courtesy.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Whenever you prepare a broth, add water to it, and have in your mind the members of the household of your neighbours and then give them out of this with courtesy.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا طَبَخْتَ مَرَقَةً فَأَكْثِرْ مَاءَهَا ثُمَّ انْظُرْ أَهْلَ بَيْتٍ مِنْ جِِيرَانِكََ فَاغْرِفْ لَهُمْ مِنْهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit \u003e Abū Dhar \u003e Awṣānī Khalīlī ﷺ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ أَوْصَانِي خَلِيلِي ﷺ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2125

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي خَلْعِ النِّعَالِ عِنْدَ الْأَكْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: In removing shoes during meals

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the food is served, remove your shoes, for it is better for your feet."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When the food is served, remove your shoes, for it is better for your feet."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا وُضِعَ الطَّعَامُ فَاخْلَعُوا نِعَالَكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ أَرْوَحُ لِأَقْدَامِكُمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e Mūsá b. Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm from my father \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2126

chapter.englishTitle: In Feeding Food

hadiths.englishRaw: "Worship the Most Merciful and spread (the greeting of) peace.'"     – Sound
hadiths.body: "Worship the Most Merciful and spread (the greeting of) peace.'"     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اعْبُدُوا الرَّحْمَنَ وَأَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ تَدْخُلُوا الْجِنَانَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Jarīr \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib from his father \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2127

chapter.englishTitle: In the call/invitation

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Respond to the caller when you are invited." He said, "And Abdullah used to attend invitations, whether they were wedding celebrations or not, even while fasting."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Respond to the caller when you are invited." He said, "And Abdullah used to attend invitations, whether they were wedding celebrations or not, even while fasting."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «أَجِيبُوا الدَّاعِيَ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ» قَالَ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِي الدَّعْوَةَ فِي الْعُرْسِ وَفِي غَيْرِ الْعُرْسِ وَيَأْتِيهَا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUqbah \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2128

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْفَأْرَةِ تَقَعُ فِي السَّمْنِ فَمَاتَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: In the mouse, falling in the ghee, it died.

hadiths.englishRaw: a mouse fell into some cooking fat and died. The Prophet was asked (about that) and he said: "Throw it away, and whatever is around it, and eat (the rest)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: a mouse fell into some cooking fat and died. The Prophet was asked (about that) and he said: "Throw it away, and whatever is around it, and eat (the rest)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنْ فَأْرَةٍ وَقَعَتْ فِي سَمْنٍ فَقَالَ «أَلْقُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا وَكُلُوا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAlī b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Maymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2129

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْفَأْرَةِ تَقَعُ فِي السَّمْنِ فَمَاتَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: In the mouse, falling in the ghee, it died.

hadiths.englishRaw: This cannot be translated into English as it is an incomplete sentence and the meaning depends on the context.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This cannot be translated into English as it is an incomplete sentence and the meaning depends on the context.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2130

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْفَأْرَةِ تَقَعُ فِي السَّمْنِ فَمَاتَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: In the mouse, falling in the ghee, it died.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about a rat that fell into oil and died, so he said: "Take it and what is around it, then discard it."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ was asked about a rat that fell into oil and died, so he said: "Take it and what is around it, then discard it."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَنْ فَأْرَةٍ وَقَعَتْ فِي سَمْنٍ فَمَاتَتْ فَقَالَ «خُذُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا فَاطْرَحُوهُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2131

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْفَأْرَةِ تَقَعُ فِي السَّمْنِ فَمَاتَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: In the mouse, falling in the ghee, it died.

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ, about him, Abu Muhammad said: "When it is in a liquid state, pour it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ, about him, Abu Muhammad said: "When it is in a liquid state, pour it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «إِذَا كَانَ ذَائِبًا أُهَرِيقَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zayd b. Yaḥyá \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Maymūnah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2132

chapter.englishTitle: In Hebron

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever eats, let him rinse his mouth, and whatever he rinses from it, let him spit it out, and whatever remains in his mouth, let him swallow it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: He said, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever eats, let him rinse his mouth, and whatever he rinses from it, let him spit it out, and whatever remains in his mouth, let him swallow it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ أَكَلَ فَلْيَتَخَلَّلْ فَمَا تَخَلَّلَ فَلْيَلْفِظْهُ وَمَا لَاكَ بِلِسَانِهِ فَلْيَبْتَلِعْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Thawr b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥuṣayn al-Ḥimyarī \u003e Abū Saʿd al-Khayr \u003e Abū Hurayrah Raḍī Allāh Taʿālá ʿAnh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ثَوْرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَعْدٍ الْخَيْرُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2133
hadiths.englishRaw: On the night Messenger of Allah ﷺ was taken on a night journey (Miraj) two cups, one containing wine and the other milk, were presented to him at Jerusalem. He looked at it and took the cup of milk. Gabriel said, "Praise be to Allah Who guided you to Al-Fitra (the right path); if you had taken (the cup of) wine, your nation would have gone astray."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the night Messenger of Allah ﷺ was taken on a night journey (Miraj) two cups, one containing wine and the other milk, were presented to him at Jerusalem. He looked at it and took the cup of milk. Gabriel said, "Praise be to Allah Who guided you to Al-Fitra (the right path); if you had taken (the cup of) wine, your nation would have gone astray."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِهِ بِإِيلِيَاءَ بِقَدَحَيْنِ مِنْ خَمْرٍ وَلَبَنٍ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِمَا ثُمَّ أَخَذَ اللَّبَنَ فَقَالَ جِِبْرَائِِيلُ «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَاكَ لِلْفِطْرَةِ لَوْ أَخَذْتَ الْخَمْرَ غَوَتْ أُمَّتُكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2134

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَحْرِيمِ الْخَمْرِ كَيْفَ كَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of alcohol, how was it?

hadiths.englishRaw: I used to be a bartender at the house of Abu Talha. He said, "The prohibition of alcohol has been revealed." He then ordered a caller to make an announcement, and the caller said, "Abu Talha, come out and see what this is." So I went out and said, "This is a caller announcing, 'Indeed, alcohol has been prohibited.'" He told me to go and pour it out. I poured it out in the streets of Madinah. Their alcohol on that day was called "al-Fadeekh" (a type of date wine). Some people said, "A people were killed while it was still in their stomachs." So Allah revealed the verse, "There is no blame upon those who believe and do righteous deeds for what they have eaten [in the past] if they fear Allah and believe" (Quran 5:93).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I used to be a bartender at the house of Abu Talha. He said, "The prohibition of alcohol has been revealed." He then ordered a caller to make an announcement, and the caller said, "Abu Talha, come out and see what this is." So I went out and said, "This is a caller announcing, 'Indeed, alcohol has been prohibited.'" He told me to go and pour it out. I poured it out in the streets of Madinah. Their alcohol on that day was called "al-Fadeekh" (a type of date wine). Some people said, "A people were killed while it was still in their stomachs." So Allah revealed the verse, "There is no blame upon those who believe and do righteous deeds for what they have eaten [in the past] if they fear Allah and believe" (Quran 5:93).   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ فِي مَنْزِلِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ قََالَ فَنَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ قَالَ فَأَمَرَ مُنَادِيًا فَنَادَى فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ اخْرُجْ فَانْظُرْ مَا هَذَا قَالَ فَخَرَجْتُ فَقُلْتُ هَذَا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي «أَلَا إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ» فَقَالَ لِيَ اذْهَبْ فَأَهْرِقْهَا قَالَ فَجَرَتْ فِي سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ وَكَانَتْ خَمْرُهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْفَضِيخَ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ قُتِلَ قَوْمٌ وَهِيَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ﷻ {لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا إِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَآمَنُوا} [المائدة 93] الْآيَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2135

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي التَّشْدِيدِ عَلَى شَارِبِ الْخَمْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: In tightening the grip on the consumption of alcohol

hadiths.englishRaw: He who drank wine in the world and did not repent would be deprived of it (the pure drink) in the Hereafter. It was said to Malik: Is this hadith Marfu'? He said: Yes.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: He who drank wine in the world and did not repent would be deprived of it (the pure drink) in the Hereafter. It was said to Malik: Is this hadith Marfu'? He said: Yes.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُبْ مِنْهَا حُرِمَهَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ فَلَمْ يُسْقَهَا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2136

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي التَّشْدِيدِ عَلَى شَارِبِ الْخَمْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: In tightening the grip on the consumption of alcohol

hadiths.englishRaw: He is called Al-Wahṭu, and he is a young man from the Quraysh tribe. This young man is known for his habit of drinking alcohol. I said, "I have heard that you talk about the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and say that he said, 'Whoever drinks alcohol, his prayers will not be accepted for forty mornings.' " When the young man heard the mention of alcohol, his hand shook with the hand of Abdullah. Then he turned away and Abdullah said, "O Allah, I do not allow anyone to attribute to me something I did not say. And I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say, 'Whoever drinks alcohol, his prayers will not be accepted for forty mornings.' If he repents, then Allah will accept his repentance. But I don't know if it was in the third morning or the fourth morning that it became the right of Allah to make him drink from the pus of the putrid on the Day of Resurrection."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He is called Al-Wahṭu, and he is a young man from the Quraysh tribe. This young man is known for his habit of drinking alcohol. I said, "I have heard that you talk about the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, and say that he said, 'Whoever drinks alcohol, his prayers will not be accepted for forty mornings.' " When the young man heard the mention of alcohol, his hand shook with the hand of Abdullah. Then he turned away and Abdullah said, "O Allah, I do not allow anyone to attribute to me something I did not say. And I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, say, 'Whoever drinks alcohol, his prayers will not be accepted for forty mornings.' If he repents, then Allah will accept his repentance. But I don't know if it was in the third morning or the fourth morning that it became the right of Allah to make him drink from the pus of the putrid on the Day of Resurrection."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ لَهُ الْوَهْطُ فَإِذَا هُوَ مُخَاصِرٌ فَتًى مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يُزَنُّ ذَلِكَ الْفَتَى بِشُرْبِ الْخَمْرِ فَقُلْتُ خِصَالٌ بَلَغَتْنِي عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ تُحَدِّثُ بِهَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ «قَالَ» مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ شَرْبَةً لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلَاةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا فَلَمَّا أَنْ سَمِعَ الْفَتَى يَذْكُرُ الْخَمْرَ اخْتَلَجَ يَدَهُ مِنْ يَدِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ وَلَّى فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي لَا أُحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَقُولَ عَلَيَّ مَا لَمْ أَقُلْ وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ شَرْبَةً لَمْ تُقْبَلْ لَهُ صَلَاةٌ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا فَإِنْ تَابَ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَا أَدْرِي فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَمْ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ رَدْغَةِ الْخَبَالِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Rabīʿah b. Yazīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Daylamī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي رَبِيعَةُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الدَّيْلَمِيِّ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ فِي حَائِطٍ لَهُ بِالطَّائِفِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2137

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْقُعُودِ عَلَى مَائِدَةٍ يُدَارُ عَلَيْهَا الْخَمْرُ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of sitting at a table where alcohol is being served.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not sit at a table where alcohol is being consumed."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not sit at a table where alcohol is being consumed."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلَا يَقْعُدْ عَلَى مَائِدَةٍ يُشْرَبُ عَلَيْهَا الْخَمْرُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Abū Jaʿfar \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2138

chapter.englishTitle: In the wine addict

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "No illegitimate child, miser, disobedient person, or habitual drinker of alcohol will enter Paradise."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "No illegitimate child, miser, disobedient person, or habitual drinker of alcohol will enter Paradise."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَدُ زِنْيَةٍ وَلَا مَنَّانٌ وَلَا عَاقٌّ وَلَا مُدْمِنُ خَمْرٍ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr al-Baṣrī \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Jābān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ جَابَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2139

chapter.englishTitle: In the wine addict

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet [SAW] said: "No one who reminds others of his favors, no one who is disobedient to his parents and no drunkard, will enter Paradise."    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet [SAW] said: "No one who reminds others of his favors, no one who is disobedient to his parents and no drunkard, will enter Paradise."    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نُبَيْطِ بْنِ شَرِيطٍ عَنْ جَابَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَاقٌّ وَلَا مَنَّانٌ وَلَا مُدْمِنُ خَمْرٍ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Mahdī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Nubayṭ b. Sharīṭ \u003e Jābān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2140

chapter.englishTitle: There is no cure in alcohol.

hadiths.englishRaw: Suwaibid bin Tarik asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about alcohol, and he prohibited him from making it. He said, "Indeed, it is a medicine." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "Verily, it is not a medicine, but it is a disease."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: Suwaibid bin Tarik asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about alcohol, and he prohibited him from making it. He said, "Indeed, it is a medicine." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "Verily, it is not a medicine, but it is a disease."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ طَارِقٍ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا أَنْ يَصْنَعَهَا فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا دَوَاءٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ دَوَاءً وَلَكِنَّهَا دَاءٌ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Simāk \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Wāʾil \u003e Abīh Wāʾil
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سِمَاكٌ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنَ وَائِلٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَائِلٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2141

chapter.englishTitle: What is wine made from?

hadiths.englishRaw: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا كَثِيرٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2142

chapter.englishTitle: What was said about the drunkard

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about Bit'i, whereupon he said: Every drink that causes intoxication is forbidden.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about Bit'i, whereupon he said: Every drink that causes intoxication is forbidden.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْبِتْعِ قَالَ «كُلُّ شَرَابٍ أَسْكَرَ حَرَامٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2143

chapter.englishTitle: What was said about the drunkard

hadiths.englishRaw: The following is the English translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me and Mu'adh bin Jabal to Yemen, and he said, "Drink, but do not drink intoxicants, for every intoxicant is forbidden."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The following is the English translation: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent me and Mu'adh bin Jabal to Yemen, and he said, "Drink, but do not drink intoxicants, for every intoxicant is forbidden."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَا وَمُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ إِلَى الْيَمَنِ فَقَالَ «اشْرَبُوا وَلَا تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا فَإِنَّ كُلَّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū Burdah b. Abū Mūsá from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2144

chapter.englishTitle: What was said about the drunkard

hadiths.englishRaw: “Whatever causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “Whatever causes intoxication in large amounts, a small amount of it is (also) unlawful.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ قَلِيلِ مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e al-Walīd b. Kathīr b. Sinān \u003e al-Ḍaḥḥāk b. ʿUthmān \u003e Bukayr b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ashaj \u003e ʿĀmir b. Saʿd \u003e Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ حَدَّثَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سَعْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2145

chapter.englishTitle: What was said about the drunkard

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Indeed, the first thing that will be forbidden is said to be Zaid, meaning in Islam just like a container is forbidden, meaning alcohol. So it was said, 'How so, O Messenger of Allah, when Allah has clearly stated what is haram in it?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'They will give it a different name and make it permissible.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Indeed, the first thing that will be forbidden is said to be Zaid, meaning in Islam just like a container is forbidden, meaning alcohol. So it was said, 'How so, O Messenger of Allah, when Allah has clearly stated what is haram in it?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'They will give it a different name and make it permissible.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا يُكْفَأُ قَالَ زَيْدٌ يَعْنِي في الْإِسْلَامَ كَمَا يُكْفَأُ الْإِنَاءُ يَعْنِي الْخَمْرَ فَقِيلَ كَيْفَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ بَيَّنَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا مَا بَيَّنَ؟ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يُسَمُّونَهَا بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهَا فَيَسْتَحِلُّونَهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Zayd b. Yaḥyá \u003e Muḥammad b. Rāshid \u003e Abū Wahbal-Kalāʿī \u003e al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَهْبٍ الْكَلَاعِيِّ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2146

chapter.englishTitle: What was said about the drunkard

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The first of your religion is prophethood and mercy, then kingship and mercy, then harsh kingship. Then comes a time of mercy and harshness, wherein wine and silk are permissible." Abu Muhammad was asked about "a'far" and he said: "It is likened to dust, and there is no good in it."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The first of your religion is prophethood and mercy, then kingship and mercy, then harsh kingship. Then comes a time of mercy and harshness, wherein wine and silk are permissible." Abu Muhammad was asked about "a'far" and he said: "It is likened to dust, and there is no good in it."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَوَّلُ دِينِكُمْ نُبُوَّةٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ ثُمَّ مُلْكٌ وَرَحْمَةٌ ثُمَّ مُلْكٌ أَعْفَرُ ثُمَّ مُلْكٌ وَجَبَرُوتٌ يُسْتَحَلُّ فِيهَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْحَرِيرُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد سُئِلَ عَنْ أَعْفَرَ فقال يُشَبِّهُهُ بالتُّرَابِ ولَيْسَ فِيهِ خَيْرٌ   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Abū Wahb \u003e Makḥūl \u003e Abū Thaʿlabah al-Khushanī \u003e Abū ʿUbaydah b. al-Jarrāḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو وَهْبٍ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ الْجَرَّاحِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2147

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ وَشِرَائِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of selling alcohol and its derivatives.

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "Whoever sells alcohol should slaughter pigs." Abu Muhammad said, "This is only Umar ibn Bayan."
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , he said, "Whoever sells alcohol should slaughter pigs." Abu Muhammad said, "This is only Umar ibn Bayan."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَنْ بَاعَ الْخَمْرَ فَلْيُشَقِّصِ الْخَنَازِيرَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «إِنَّمَا هُوَ عُمَرُ بْنُ بَيَانٍ»
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Ṭuʿmah \u003e ʿUmar b. Bayān al-Taghlibī \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا طُعْمَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ بَيَانٍ التَّغْلِبِيُّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2148

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ وَشِرَائِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of selling alcohol and its derivatives.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a companion from Thaqif or Daws. He met him in Makkah during the year of the conquest, and the companion offered him a container of wine as a gift. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O so-and-so, don't you know that Allah has forbidden it?" The companion then turned to his servant and told him to go and sell it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "What did you command him to do, O so-and-so?" The companion replied, "I commanded him to sell it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever forbids the consumption of something, it is also forbidden to sell it." Then he ordered the wine to be poured out in the Bat-haa.   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a companion from Thaqif or Daws. He met him in Makkah during the year of the conquest, and the companion offered him a container of wine as a gift. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O so-and-so, don't you know that Allah has forbidden it?" The companion then turned to his servant and told him to go and sell it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked, "What did you command him to do, O so-and-so?" The companion replied, "I commanded him to sell it." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever forbids the consumption of something, it is also forbidden to sell it." Then he ordered the wine to be poured out in the Bat-haa.   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ صَدِيقٌ مِنْ ثَقِيفٍ أَوْ مِنْ دَوْسٍ فَلَقِيَهُ بِمَكَّةَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ بِرَاوِيَةٍ مِنْ خَمْرٍ يُهْدِيهَا لَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَا فُلَانُ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى قَدْ حَرَّمَهَا؟» قَالَ فَأَقْبَلَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى غُلَامِهِ فَقَالَ اذْهَبْ فَبِعْهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِمَاذَا أَمَرْتَهُ يَا فُلَانُ؟ قَالَ أَمَرْتُهُ بِبَيْعِهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ الَّذِي حَرَّمَ شُرْبَهَا حَرَّمَ بَيْعَهَا فَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَأُكْفِئَتْ فِي الْبَطْحَاءِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Qaʿqāʿ b. Ḥakīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. And ʿLah \u003e Saʾalt Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Bayʿ al-Khamr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2149

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ وَشِرَائِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of selling alcohol and its derivatives.

hadiths.englishRaw: Not found
hadiths.body: Not found
hadiths.arabic: لا أوجد

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2150

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ وَشِرَائِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of selling alcohol and its derivatives.

hadiths.englishRaw: Umar heard that Samurah had sold some wine, and he said: “May Allah ruin Samurah! Does he not know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘May Allah curse the Jews, for animal fat was forbidden to them, so they melted it down and sold it.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Umar heard that Samurah had sold some wine, and he said: “May Allah ruin Samurah! Does he not know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘May Allah curse the Jews, for animal fat was forbidden to them, so they melted it down and sold it.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْيَهُودَ حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّحُومُ فَجَمَلُوهَا فَبَاعُوهَا قَالَ سُفْيَانُ جَمَلُوهَا أَذَابُوهَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr / Ibn Dīnār \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Balagh ʿUmar \u003e Samurah Bāʿ Khamr \u003e Qātal Allāh Samurah Amā ʿAlim
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ بَلَغَ عُمَرَ أَنَّ سَمُرَةَ بَاعَ خَمْرًا فَقَالَ قَاتَلَ اللَّهُ سَمُرَةَ أَمَا عَلِمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2151

chapter.englishTitle: The punishment for drinking alcohol.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "If he becomes drunk, whip him; then if he becomes drunk, whip him; then if he becomes drunk, whip him." Then he said concerning the fourth time, "Strike his neck (i.e., kill him)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "If he becomes drunk, whip him; then if he becomes drunk, whip him; then if he becomes drunk, whip him." Then he said concerning the fourth time, "Strike his neck (i.e., kill him)."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا سَكِرَ فَاجْلِدُوهُ ثُمَّ إِذَا سَكِرَ فَاجْلِدُوهُ ثُمَّ إِذَا سَكِرَ فَاجْلِدُوهُ ثُمَّ إِذَا سَكِرَ فَاضْرِبُوا عُنُقَهُ يَعْنِي فِي الرَّابِعَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿĀṣim b. ʿAlī \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Ḥārith b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2152

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي التَّغْلِيظِ لِمَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ
chapter.englishTitle: In amplifying the punishment for those who consume alcohol

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When an adulterer commits illegal sexual intercourse, then he is not a believer at the time, he is doing it, and when a drinker of an alcoholic liquor drinks it, then he is not a believer at the time of drinking it, and when a thief steals, then he is not a believer at the time of stealing, and when a robber robs, and the people look at him, then he is not a believer at the time of doing robbery.
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "When an adulterer commits illegal sexual intercourse, then he is not a believer at the time, he is doing it, and when a drinker of an alcoholic liquor drinks it, then he is not a believer at the time of drinking it, and when a thief steals, then he is not a believer at the time of stealing, and when a robber robs, and the people look at him, then he is not a believer at the time of doing robbery.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا يَزْنِي الزَّانِي حِينَ يَزْنِي وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلَا يَسْرِقُ السَّارِقُ حِينَ يَسْرِقُ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَلَا يَشْرَبُ الْخَمْرَ حِينَ يَشْرَبُهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2153

chapter.englishTitle: What is forbidden for the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ ?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ was being insulted in the street. If it wasn't a street where garbage was thrown, then it was thrown upon him in a pile of dung.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ was being insulted in the street. If it wasn't a street where garbage was thrown, then it was thrown upon him in a pile of dung.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي السِّقَاءِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سِقَاءٌ نُبِذَ لَهُ فِي تَوْرٍ مِنْ بِرَامٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abū Sulaymān \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2154

chapter.englishTitle: In the swamp

hadiths.englishRaw: A man from among them asked the Prophet ﷺ , "O Messenger of Allah, we have come from where you know, and we have settled among the people whom you know. So, who is our guardian?" He replied, "Allah and His Messenger." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, we used to be people of generosity and wine-drinking, and Allah has prohibited wine. So, what should we do with our generosity?" He said, "Make it dried grapes (raisins)." They asked, "What should we do with raisins?" He said, "Soak them in water till they become soft and drink the water for your meals, drink it for your dinner, and soak it for your dinner, and drink it for your meals. When the two dark parts (dawn and dusk) meet, it will turn into wine."
hadiths.body: A man from among them asked the Prophet ﷺ , "O Messenger of Allah, we have come from where you know, and we have settled among the people whom you know. So, who is our guardian?" He replied, "Allah and His Messenger." They said, "O Messenger of Allah, we used to be people of generosity and wine-drinking, and Allah has prohibited wine. So, what should we do with our generosity?" He said, "Make it dried grapes (raisins)." They asked, "What should we do with raisins?" He said, "Soak them in water till they become soft and drink the water for your meals, drink it for your dinner, and soak it for your dinner, and drink it for your meals. When the two dark parts (dawn and dusk) meet, it will turn into wine."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْهُمْ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا قَدْ خَرَجْنَا مِنْ حَيْثُ عَلِمْتَ وَنَزَلْنَا بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانَيْ مَنْ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ فَمَنْ وَلِيُّنَا؟ قَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا كُنَّا أَصْحَابَ كَرْمٍ وَخَمْرٍ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَ الْخَمْرَ فَمَا نَصْنَعُ بِالْكَرْمِ؟ قَالَ اصْنَعُوهُ زَبِيبًا قَالُوا فَمَا نَصْنَعُ بِالزَّبِيبِ؟ قَالَ انْقَعُوا فِي الشِّنَانِ انْقَعُوهُ عَلَى غَدَائِكُمْ وَاشْرَبُوهُ عَلَى عَشَائِكُمْ وَانْقَعُوهُ عَلَى عَشَائِكُمْ وَاشْرَبُوهُ عَلَى غَدَائِكُمْ فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا أَتَى عَلَيْهِ الْعَصْرَانِ كَانَ خَلًّا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَكُونَ خَمْرًا
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū ʿAmr al-Saybānī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Daylamī from his father \u003e Abāh Aw
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو السَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الدَّيْلَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَوْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2155

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ، وَمَا يُنْبَذُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition on wine and what is discarded in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: About the wine, the Prophet ﷺ forbade it. So, I met Ibn Abbas and informed him about Ibn Umar's statement. He replied, "Abu Abdillah (Ibn Umar) spoke the truth."   – Sound
hadiths.body: About the wine, the Prophet ﷺ forbade it. So, I met Ibn Abbas and informed him about Ibn Umar's statement. He replied, "Abu Abdillah (Ibn Umar) spoke the truth."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ فَقَالَ حَرَّمَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَقِيتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ   – صحيح
