hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿAzrah \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Saʾalt Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Nabīdh al-Jar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَزْرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2156

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ، وَمَا يُنْبَذُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition on wine and what is discarded in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not seek shelter in wolves and snakes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Do not seek shelter in wolves and snakes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَنْتَبِذُوا فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2157

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ، وَمَا يُنْبَذُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition on wine and what is discarded in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: About wine, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ forbade wine and alcohol. I asked Ibn Zubayr and he said the same as what Ibn Abbas said. Ibn Abbas said, "Whoever is pleased to make unlawful what Allah and His Messenger have made unlawful, or whoever considers unlawful what Allah and His Messenger have made unlawful, should also consider wine to be unlawful."
hadiths.body: About wine, the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ forbade wine and alcohol. I asked Ibn Zubayr and he said the same as what Ibn Abbas said. Ibn Abbas said, "Whoever is pleased to make unlawful what Allah and His Messenger have made unlawful, or whoever considers unlawful what Allah and His Messenger have made unlawful, should also consider wine to be unlawful."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ فَقَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ وَالدُّبَّاءِ وَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُحَرِّمَ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَوْ مَنْ كَانَ مُحَرِّمًا مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ فَلْيُحَرِّمِ النَّبِيذَ
hadiths.chain: Abū Zayd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e Abū al-Ḥakam \u003e Saʾalt Ibn ʿAbbās or Samiʿtuh Suʾil \u003e Nabīdh al-Jar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَكَمِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَوْ سَمِعْتُهُ سُئِلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2158

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ، وَمَا يُنْبَذُ فِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition on wine and what is discarded in it.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Muhammad ﷺ start with either the name or the message and he said, "He forbade using wild animals for target practice, wearing garments made of silk, and sounding bells."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Muhammad ﷺ start with either the name or the message and he said, "He forbade using wild animals for target practice, wearing garments made of silk, and sounding bells."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ بَدَأَ بِالِاسْمِ أَوْ بِالرِّسَالَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ «نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Thābit b. Yazīd \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Fuḍayl b. Zayd al-Raqāshī \u003e Atá ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal \u003e Akhbirnī Bimā Yaḥrum ʿAlaynā from al-Sharāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الرَّقَاشِيِّ أَنَّهُ أَتَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُغَفَّلٍ فَقَالَ أَخْبِرْنِي بِمَا يَحْرُمُ عَلَيْنَا مِنَ الشَّرَابِ فَقَالَ الْخَمْرُ قُلْتُ هُوَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ قَالَ مَا أُحَدِّثُكَ إِلَّا مَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2159

chapter.englishTitle: In prohibiting the mixture

hadiths.englishRaw: Do not prepare Nabidh by mixing nearly ripe dates and fresh dates together, and do not prepare Nabidh by mixing grapes and dates together, but prepare Nabidh from each (one of them) separately.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Do not prepare Nabidh by mixing nearly ripe dates and fresh dates together, and do not prepare Nabidh by mixing grapes and dates together, but prepare Nabidh from each (one of them) separately.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَنْتَبِذُوا الزَّهْوَ وَالرُّطَبَ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَنْتَبِذُوا الزَّبِيبَ وَالتَّمْرَ جَمِيعًا وَانْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn And Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir Wa-al-Lafẓ Liyazīd \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَزِيدَ قَالَا أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2160

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ أَنْ يُسَمَّى الْعِنَبُ الْكَرْمَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of calling the vine al-Karam.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Allah's Messenger ﷺ said: 'Do not say 'generosity,' say 'grapes' or 'vines.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "Allah's Messenger ﷺ said: 'Do not say 'generosity,' say 'grapes' or 'vines.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لَا تَقُولُوا الْكَرْمَ وَقُولُوا الْعِنَبَ أَوِ الْحَبَلَةَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Simāk \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Wāʾil from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2161

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ أَنْ يُجْعَلَ الْخَمْرُ خَلًّا
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of making wine vinegar

hadiths.englishRaw: "In the room of Abu Talha, there were orphans, so he bought wine for them. When the prohibition of wine was revealed, he came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Turn it into vinegar.' Abu Talha replied, 'No,' so he poured it out."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "In the room of Abu Talha, there were orphans, so he bought wine for them. When the prohibition of wine was revealed, he came to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Turn it into vinegar.' Abu Talha replied, 'No,' so he poured it out."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ فِي حِجْرِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ يَتَامَى فَاشْتَرَى لَهُمْ خَمْرًا فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ «أَجْعَلُهُ خَلًّا» قَالَ لَا فَأَهْرَاقَهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e al-Suddī \u003e Yaḥyá b. ʿAbbād \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ السُّدِّيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2162

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي سُنَّةِ الشَّرَابِ كَيْفَ هِيَ؟
chapter.englishTitle: What is the Sunnah of drinking like?

hadiths.englishRaw: "He saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ drinking milk, with Abu Bakr on his left and a Bedouin man on his right. The Prophet ﷺ gave the Bedouin his share of the milk, then he said, "The right, the right."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ drinking milk, with Abu Bakr on his left and a Bedouin man on his right. The Prophet ﷺ gave the Bedouin his share of the milk, then he said, "The right, the right."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَرِبَ لَبَنًا وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ رَجُلٌ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَأَعْطَى الْأَعْرَابِيَّ فَضْلَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ الْأَيْمَنَ فَالْأَيْمَنَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2163

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الشُّرْبِ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of drinking from the water skin

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking (directly) from the mouth of a water skin.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking (directly) from the mouth of a water skin.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَهَى أَنْ يُشْرَبَ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ أَنْبَأَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2164

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الشُّرْبِ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of drinking from the water skin

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking (directly) from the mouth of a water skin.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade drinking (directly) from the mouth of a water skin.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يُشْرَبَ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2165

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الشُّرْبِ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of drinking from the water skin

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Sa'id (Khudri) reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade from turning the waterskins upside down and drinking from its mouth.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Sa'id (Khudri) reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade from turning the waterskins upside down and drinking from its mouth.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «نَهَى عَنْ اخْتِنَاثِ الْأَسْقِيَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2166

chapter.englishTitle: In drinking with three breaths.

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Anas that he used to drink from a vessel in three draughts, and Anas said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to drink from a vessel in three draughts.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Anas that he used to drink from a vessel in three draughts, and Anas said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to drink from a vessel in three draughts.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ أَنَسٌ يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ «يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الْإِنَاءِ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAzrah b. Thābit \u003e Thumāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2167

chapter.englishTitle: Who drank from one breath?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was with Marwan when Abu Sa'id came and said, 'A man said, "O Messenger of Allah, I feel suffocated from a single breath."' He said, 'Leave the vessel from your mouth and then breathe.' He said, 'I see phlegm.' He said, 'Spit it out.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I was with Marwan when Abu Sa'id came and said, 'A man said, "O Messenger of Allah, I feel suffocated from a single breath."' He said, 'Leave the vessel from your mouth and then breathe.' He said, 'I see phlegm.' He said, 'Spit it out.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ مَرْوَانَ فَجَاءَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لَا أَرْوَى مِنْ نَفَسٍ وَاحِدٍ قَالَ «فَأَبِنِ الْإِنَاءَ عَنْ فِيكَ ثُمَّ تَنَفَّسْ» قَالَ إِنِّي أَرَى الْقَذَاةَ قَالَ «أَهْرِقْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Mālik \u003e Ayyūb b. Ḥabīb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū al-Muthanná
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُثَنَّى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2168

chapter.englishTitle: Who drank from one breath?

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "When one of you urinates, do not touch his private parts with his right hand, nor cleanse himself with his right hand, nor breathe into the vessel."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "When one of you urinates, do not touch his private parts with his right hand, nor cleanse himself with his right hand, nor breathe into the vessel."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ «إِذَا بَالَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلَا يَمَسَّ ذَكَرَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ وَلَا يَسْتَنْجِي بِيَمِينِهِ وَلَا يَتَنَفَّسْ فِي الْإِنَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from my father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2169

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَكْرَعُ فِي النَّهْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the one who grazes by the river

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ came across a man from the Ansar (the Medinan supporters of Prophet Muhammad) who was complaining to him about a running nose. The Prophet ﷺ asked him, "Do you have any water left with you?" The man replied, "Yes, it stayed in my nose overnight." The Prophet ﷺ said, "If it were not for that, we would have rinsed our mouths with it."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ came across a man from the Ansar (the Medinan supporters of Prophet Muhammad) who was complaining to him about a running nose. The Prophet ﷺ asked him, "Do you have any water left with you?" The man replied, "Yes, it stayed in my nose overnight." The Prophet ﷺ said, "If it were not for that, we would have rinsed our mouths with it."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يَعُودُهُ وَجَدْوَلٌ يَجْرِي فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكُمْ مَاءٌ بَاتَ فِي الشَّنِّ وَإِلَّا كَرَعْنَا   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Fulayḥ b. Sulaymān \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Ḥārith al-Anṣārī \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا فُلَيْحُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2170

chapter.englishTitle: Standing in line for a drink

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Prophet ﷺ drank standing from a container."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Prophet ﷺ drank standing from a container."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «شَرِبَ مِنْ فَمِ قِرْبَةٍ قَائِمًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Manṣūr b. Salamah al-Khuzāʿī \u003e Sharīk \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm \u003e al-Barāʾ Ibn Āb.ah Anas \u003e Anas \u003e Um Sulaym
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ ابْنِ ابْنَةِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنْ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2171

chapter.englishTitle: Standing in line for a drink

hadiths.englishRaw: “At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to eat while walking, and drink while standing up.”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ we used to eat while walking, and drink while standing up.”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نَشْرَبُ وَنَحْنُ قِيَامٌ وَنَأْكُلُ وَنَحْنُ نَسْعَى عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥudayr \u003e Abū al-Bazarī Yazīd b. ʿUṭārid \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُدَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْبَزَرِيِّ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عُطَارِدَ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2172

chapter.englishTitle: Standing in line for a drink

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibn 'Umar regarding it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibn 'Umar regarding it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2173

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes standing while drinking?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ forbade drinking while standing. [Someone] said, "I asked him about eating", and he replied, "That is even worse."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ forbade drinking while standing. [Someone] said, "I asked him about eating", and he replied, "That is even worse."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «نَهَى عَنِ الشُّرْبِ قَائِمًا» قَالَ وَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْأَكْلِ قَالَ ذَاكَ أَخْبَثُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2174

chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes standing while drinking?

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said to a man whom he saw drinking while standing, "Vomit." He asked, "Why?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "Would you like to drink with Satan?" He replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Then Satan has indeed drunk with you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said to a man whom he saw drinking while standing, "Vomit." He asked, "Why?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "Would you like to drink with Satan?" He replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Then Satan has indeed drunk with you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ لِرَجُلٍ رَآهُ يَشْرَبُ قَائِمًا قِئْ قَالَ لِمَ قَالَ «أَتُحِبُّ أَنْ تَشْرَبَ مَعَ الْهِرِّ» قَالَ لَا قَالَ «فَقَدْ شَرِبَ مَعَكَ شَرٌّ مِنْهُ الشَّيْطَانُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Ziyād al-Ṭaḥḥān \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي زِيَادٍ الطَّحَّانِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2175

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking in moderation

hadiths.englishRaw: “The one who drinks from a silver vessel is swallowing Hell-fire into his belly.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The one who drinks from a silver vessel is swallowing Hell-fire into his belly.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ الَّذِي يَشْرَبُ فِي آنِيَةٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَرْجِرُ فِي بَطْنِهِ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Yūnus \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Zayd b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Bakr \u003e Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2176

chapter.englishTitle: Drinking in moderation

hadiths.englishRaw: "We went out with Hudhaifah to Al-Madain, seeking rain. A Bedouin came to him with a silver vessel, and Hudhaifah threw it away. We told him to quiet down, for if we asked him, he would not speak to us. However, later he asked us, 'Do you know why I threw it?' We said, 'No.' He said, 'I was forbidden to drink from vessels made of gold or silver, and forbidden to wear silk and brocade. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Those are for them in this world, and for you in the Hereafter.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We went out with Hudhaifah to Al-Madain, seeking rain. A Bedouin came to him with a silver vessel, and Hudhaifah threw it away. We told him to quiet down, for if we asked him, he would not speak to us. However, later he asked us, 'Do you know why I threw it?' We said, 'No.' He said, 'I was forbidden to drink from vessels made of gold or silver, and forbidden to wear silk and brocade. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Those are for them in this world, and for you in the Hereafter.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ إِلَى الْمَدَائِنِ فَاسْتَسْقَى فَأَتَاهُ دِهْقَانٌ بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَرَمَى بِهِ وَجْهَهُ فَقُلْنَا اسْكُتُوا فَإِنَّا إِنْ سَأَلْنَاهُ لَمْ يُحَدِّثْنَا فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدُ قَالَ أَتدْرُونَ لِمَ رَمَيْتُهُ؟ قُلْنَا لَا قَالَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ نَهَيْتُهُ وَذَكَرَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَعَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ وَالدِّيبَاجِ وَقَالَ «هُمَا لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَكُمْ فِي الْآخِرَة»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Mujāhid \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2177

chapter.englishTitle: In the fermentation of the container

hadiths.englishRaw: I brought the Prophet ﷺ some milk, and he said: "Why don't you pour some yogurt into it, even if you only dab it with wood?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I brought the Prophet ﷺ some milk, and he said: "Why don't you pour some yogurt into it, even if you only dab it with wood?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِلَبَنٍ فَقَالَ أَلَا خَمَّرْتَهُ وَلَوْ تَعْرِضُ عَلَيْهِ عُودًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir \u003e Abū Ḥumayd al-Sāʿidī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حُمَيْدٍ السَّاعِدِيُّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2178

chapter.englishTitle: In the fermentation of the container

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to cover our vessels, tie up our water skins and turn over our vessels.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded us to cover our vessels, tie up our water skins and turn over our vessels.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِتَغْطِيَةِ الْوَضُوءِ وَإِيكَاءِ السِّقَاءِ وَإِكْفَاءِ الْإِنَاءِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Suhayl from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2179

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ النَّفْخِ فِي الشَّرَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of blowing into the drink

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding blowing into drinks?" He said, "Yes."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding blowing into drinks?" He said, "Yes."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَى عَنِ النَّفْخِ فِي الشَّرَابِ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ayyūb b. Ḥabīb \u003e Abū al-Muthanná al-Juhanī \u003e Marwān Liʾabī Saʿīd al-Khudrī Hal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُثَنَّى الْجُهَنِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ مَرْوَانُ لِأَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ هَلْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2180

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ النَّفْخِ فِي الشَّرَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of blowing into the drink

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ prohibited blowing into the drink.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ prohibited blowing into the drink.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ النَّفْخِ فِي الشَّرَابِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Jazarī \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2181

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي سَاقِي الْقَوْمِ آخِرُهُمْ شُرْبًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the tribe's cup, the last of them drank.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The oen who serves water to others should be the last one to drink from it.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The oen who serves water to others should be the last one to drink from it.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «سَاقِي الْقَوْمِ آخِرُهُمْ شُرْبًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān b. Muslim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah And Sulaymān b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Thābit \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Rabāḥ \u003e Abū Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2182
hadiths.englishRaw: I said, "O Prophet of Allah, the saying of Allah to them is glad tidings in this worldly life." He said, "You asked me about something that no one before you or anyone from my Ummah has asked me about." He said, "It is the righteous vision that a Muslim sees or is shown."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said, "O Prophet of Allah, the saying of Allah to them is glad tidings in this worldly life." He said, "You asked me about something that no one before you or anyone from my Ummah has asked me about." He said, "It is the righteous vision that a Muslim sees or is shown."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَى فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا قَالَ سَأَلْتَنِي عَنْ شَيْءٍ مَا سَأَلَنِي عَنْهُ أَحَدٌ قَبْلَكَ أَوْ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي قَالَ «هِيَ الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ يَرَاهَا الْمُسْلِمُ أَوْ تُرَى لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abān \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2183

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رُؤْيَا الْمُسْلِمِ جُزْءٌ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنَ النُّبُوَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Muslim vision, a part of fifty-six parts of prophecy

hadiths.englishRaw: A believer’s vision is the forty-sixth part of Prophecy.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A believer’s vision is the forty-sixth part of Prophecy.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «رُؤْيَا الْمُؤْمِنِ جُزْءٌ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنَ النُّبُوَّةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2184

chapter.englishTitle: The Prophecy Departed and the Glad Tidings Remained

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Prophecy is gone, but good dreams remain.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘Prophecy is gone, but good dreams remain.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «ذَهَبَتِ النُّبُوَّةُ وَبَقِيَتِ الْمُبَشِّرَاتُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hārūn b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Yazīd from his father \u003e Sibāʿ b. Thābit \u003e Um Kurz al-Kaʿbiyyah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سِبَاعِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أُمِّ كُرْزٍ الْكَعْبِيَّةِ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2185

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رُؤْيَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي الْمَنَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Prophet's ﷺ vision in the dream-

hadiths.englishRaw: “Whoever sees me in a dream has (really) seen me, for Satan cannot appear in my form.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Whoever sees me in a dream has (really) seen me, for Satan cannot appear in my form.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ رَآنِي فِي الْمَنَامِ فَقَدْ رَآنِي فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَا يَتَمَثَّلُ مِثْلِي   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2186

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رُؤْيَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي الْمَنَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Prophet's ﷺ vision in the dream-

hadiths.englishRaw: He who saw me in dream in fact saw the truth (what is true).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He who saw me in dream in fact saw the truth (what is true).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ رَآنِي فِي الْمَنَامِ فَقَدْ رَأَى الْحَقَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Muṣaffá \u003e Muḥammad b. Ḥarb \u003e al-Zubaydī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُصَفَّى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2187

chapter.englishTitle: Regarding someone who sees a dream that they dislike

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan. So if anyone of you sees a dream that he dislikes, let him spit to his left three times and seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for it will not harm him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A good dream is from Allah, and a bad dream is from Satan. So if anyone of you sees a dream that he dislikes, let him spit to his left three times and seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for it will not harm him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَالْحُلْمُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِذَا حَلَمَ أَحَدُكُمْ حُلْمًا يَخَافُهُ فَلْيَبْصُقْ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَلْيَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَضُرُّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2188

chapter.englishTitle: Regarding someone who sees a dream that they dislike

hadiths.englishRaw: I used to see (such horrible dreams) that I fell ill. I saw Abu Qatada who also said: I used to see dreams which made me sick until I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Good dreams are from Allah, so if any one of you sees which he likes he should not disclose it to one but whom he loves, but if he sees something which he does not like he should spit on his left side thrice and seek refuge with Allah from the mischief of the Satan and its mischief (i.e. of the dream), and he should not relate it to anyone, then it would not harm him.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I used to see (such horrible dreams) that I fell ill. I saw Abu Qatada who also said: I used to see dreams which made me sick until I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Good dreams are from Allah, so if any one of you sees which he likes he should not disclose it to one but whom he loves, but if he sees something which he does not like he should spit on his left side thrice and seek refuge with Allah from the mischief of the Satan and its mischief (i.e. of the dream), and he should not relate it to anyone, then it would not harm him.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَأَنَا إِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَرَى الرُّؤْيَا تُمْرِضُنِي حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ مِنَ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مَا يُحِبُّ فَلْيَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ وَلَا يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا إِلَّا مَنْ يُحِبُّ وَإِذَا رَأَى مَا يَكْرَهُه فَلْيَتْفُلْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ ثَلَاثًا وَلْيَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَلَا يُحَدِّثْ بِهَا أَحَدًا فَإِنَّهَا لَنْ تَضُرَّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbd Rabbih b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَقُولُ إِنْ كُنْتُ لَأَرَى الرُّؤْيَا تُمْرِضُنِي فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِأَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2189

chapter.englishTitle: The vision is three.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Dreams are of three types: a good dream is glad tidings from Allah, a bad dream is from Shaytan, and a dream that a person narrates about himself. So, if any one of you sees a dream that he dislikes, let him not speak about it, and let him pray and seek protection from it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Dreams are of three types: a good dream is glad tidings from Allah, a bad dream is from Shaytan, and a dream that a person narrates about himself. So, if any one of you sees a dream that he dislikes, let him not speak about it, and let him pray and seek protection from it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الرُّؤْيَا ثَلَاثٌ فَالرُّؤْيَا الْحَسَنَةُ بُشْرَى مِنَ اللَّهِ وَالرُّؤْيَا تَحْزِينٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَالرُّؤْيَا مِمَّا يُحَدِّثُ بِهِ الْإِنْسَانُ نَفْسَهُ فَإِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُمْ مَا يَكْرَهُهُ فَلَا يُحَدِّثْ بِهِ وَلْيَقُمْ وَلْيُصَلِّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Makhlad b. Ḥusayn \u003e Hishām \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مَخْلَدِ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2190

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَصْدَقُ النَّاسِ رُؤْيَا أَصْدَقُهُمْ حَدِيثًا
chapter.englishTitle: The most truthful people are the most truthful in their speech.

hadiths.englishRaw: “When the end of time draws near, hardly any believer will see a false dream, and the ones who see the truest dreams will be the ones who are truest in speech. And the dream of the believer is one of the forty-six parts of prophecy.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “When the end of time draws near, hardly any believer will see a false dream, and the ones who see the truest dreams will be the ones who are truest in speech. And the dream of the believer is one of the forty-six parts of prophecy.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا اقْتَرَبَ الزَّمَانُ لَمْ تَكَدْ رُؤْيَا الْمُؤْمِنِ تَكْذِبُ وَأَصْدَقُهُمْ رُؤْيَا أَصْدَقُهُمْ حَدِيثًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Makhlad b. Ḥusayn \u003e Hishām \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مَخْلَدِ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2191

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ أَنْ يَتَحَلَّمَ الرَّجُلُ رُؤْيَا لَمْ يَرَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of a man interpreting a dream he has not seen.

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by Ali, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever lies in his dreams will be tasked with tying two barley stalks together on the Day of Judgment."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by Ali, the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever lies in his dreams will be tasked with tying two barley stalks together on the Day of Judgment."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «مَنْ كَذَبَ فِي حُلْمِهِ كُلِّفَ عَقْدَ شَعِيرَتَيْنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2192

chapter.englishTitle: The most truthful dreams are during the pre-dawn hours

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The most truthful of dreams are those seen in the pre-dawn hours."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The most truthful of dreams are those seen in the pre-dawn hours."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَصْدَقُ الرُّؤْيَا بِالْأَسْحَارِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Wahb \u003e ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Darrāj Abū al-Samḥ \u003e Abū al-Haytham \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ دَرَّاجٍ أَبِي السَّمْحِ عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2193

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ أَنْ يَعْبُرَ الرُّؤْيَا إِلَّا عَلَى عَالِمٍ أَوْ نَاصِحٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Dislike of a Dream Being Interpreted by anyone other than a Scho...

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ, he used to say, "Do not interpret dreams except by a knowledgeable person or an advisor."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ, he used to say, "Do not interpret dreams except by a knowledgeable person or an advisor."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «لَا تَقُصُّوا الرُّؤْيَا إِلَّا عَلَى عَالِمٍ أَوْ نَاصِحٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2194

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرُّؤْيَا لَا تَقَعُ مَا لَمْ تُعَبَّرْ
chapter.englishTitle: Dreams do not materialize unless expressed

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Dreams are like a bird perched on a man, as long as it is not mentioned, it will occur."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Dreams are like a bird perched on a man, as long as it is not mentioned, it will occur."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «الرُّؤْيَا هِيَ عَلَى رِجْلِ طَائِرٍ مَا لَمْ يُحَدَّثْ بِهَا فَإِذَا حُدِّثَ بِهَا وَقَعَتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Wakīʿ b. ʿUdus from his uncle Abū Razīn al-ʿUqaylī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ وَكِيعَ بْنَ عُدُسٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمِّهِ أَبِي رَزِينٍ الْعُقَيْلِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2195

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الرَّبِّ تَعَالَى فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the vision of the Most High in sleep

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "I saw my Lord in the best form." He said, "In what did the highest assembly differ?" So I said, "You know best, O Lord." He said, "He placed His hand between my shoulders, and I felt its coolness between my chest, and thus I knew what is in the heavens and the earth. And [Allah said], 'And thus We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith].'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "I saw my Lord in the best form." He said, "In what did the highest assembly differ?" So I said, "You know best, O Lord." He said, "He placed His hand between my shoulders, and I felt its coolness between my chest, and thus I knew what is in the heavens and the earth. And [Allah said], 'And thus We show Abraham the realm of the heavens and the earth that he would be among the certain [in faith].'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «رَأَيْتُ رَبِّي فِي أَحْسَنِ صُورَةٍ» قَالَ فِيمَ يَخْتَصِمُ الْمَلَأُ الْأَعْلَى؟ فَقُلْتُ «أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ يَا رَبِّ» قَالَ فَوَضَعَ كَفَّهُ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيَّ فَوَجَدْتُ بَرْدَهَا بَيْنَ ثَدْيَيَّ فَعَلِمْتُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَتَلَا {وَكَذَلِكَ نُرِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُوقِنِينَ}   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd b. Muslim \u003e Ibn Jābir \u003e Khālid b. al-Lajlāj And Saʾalah Makḥūl \u003e Yuḥaddithah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿĀʾish
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جَابِرٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ اللَّجْلَاجِ وَسَأَلَهُ مَكْحُولٌ أَنْ يُحَدِّثَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَائِشٍ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2196

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الرَّبِّ تَعَالَى فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the vision of the Most High in sleep

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever sees his Lord in a dream will enter paradise."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever sees his Lord in a dream will enter paradise."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ رَأَى رَبَّهُ فِي الْمَنَامِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Quṭbah \u003e Yūsuf \u003e Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ قُطْبَةَ عَنْ يُوسُفَ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2197

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: While I was asleep I saw people being presented to me (in a dream) and they wore shirts and some of these reached up to the breasts and some even beyond them. Then there happened to pass 'Umar b. Khattab and his shirt had been trailing. They said: Allah's Messeneer, how do you interpret the dream? He said: (As strength of) faith.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: While I was asleep I saw people being presented to me (in a dream) and they wore shirts and some of these reached up to the breasts and some even beyond them. Then there happened to pass 'Umar b. Khattab and his shirt had been trailing. They said: Allah's Messeneer, how do you interpret the dream? He said: (As strength of) faith.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُ النَّاسَ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَيْهِمْ قُمُصٌ مِنْهَا مَا يَبْلُغُ الثُّدِيَّ وَمِنْهَا مَا يَبْلُغُ دُونَ ذَلِكَ» وَعُرِضَ عَلَيَّ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَعَلَيْهِ قَمِيصٌ يَجُرُّهُ فَقَالَ «مَنْ حَوْلَهُ» فَمَاذَا تَأَوَّلْتَ ذَلِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «الدِّينَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Ibn Saʿd \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Kaysān \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Umāmah b. Sahl b. Ḥunayf \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2198

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: I was in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, and I had nowhere to stay except in the Prophet's Mosque. Whenever the Prophet ﷺ would wake up in the morning, people would come to him and narrate their dreams to him. So I said, "Why don't I see anything?" Then I saw as if people were being gathered and thrown onto their faces in a pit. I was taken and when I approached the well, a man said, "Take him with the right group." When I woke up, my dream bothered me, so I asked Hafsah about it. She said, "Yes, what did you see?" So I said, "Ask the Prophet ﷺ about it." So she asked him, and he said, "Indeed, the man is Abdullah. If he were to offer the night prayer."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I was in the time of the Prophet ﷺ, and I had nowhere to stay except in the Prophet's Mosque. Whenever the Prophet ﷺ would wake up in the morning, people would come to him and narrate their dreams to him. So I said, "Why don't I see anything?" Then I saw as if people were being gathered and thrown onto their faces in a pit. I was taken and when I approached the well, a man said, "Take him with the right group." When I woke up, my dream bothered me, so I asked Hafsah about it. She said, "Yes, what did you see?" So I said, "Ask the Prophet ﷺ about it." So she asked him, and he said, "Indeed, the man is Abdullah. If he were to offer the night prayer."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ فِي عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَمَا لِي مَبِيتٌ إِلَّا فِي مَسْجِدِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ يَأْتُونَهُ فَيَقُصُّونَ عَلَيْهِ الرُّؤْيَا قَالَ فَقُلْتُ مَا لِي لَا أَرَى شَيْئًا فَرَأَيْتُ كَأَنَّ النَّاسَ يُحْشَرُونَ فَيُرْمَى بِهِمْ عَلَى أَرْجُلِهِمْ فِي رَكِيٍّ فَأُخِذْتُ فَلَمَّا دَنَا إِلَى الْبِئْرِ قَالَ رَجُلٌ خُذُوا بِهِ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَيْقَظْتُ هَمَّتْنِي رُؤْيَايَ وَأَشْفَقْتُ مِنْهَا فَسَأَلْتُ حَفْصَةَ عَنْهَا؟ فَقَالَتْ نِعْمَ مَا رَأَيْتَ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا سَلِي النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَسَأَلَتْهُ؟ فَقَالَ «نِعْمَ الرَّجُلُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَوْ كَانَ يُصَلِّي مِنَ اللَّيْلِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿAlī al-Ḥanafī \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2199

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: Helpful, and Ibn Umar used to pray at night.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Helpful, and Ibn Umar used to pray at night.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: نَافِعٌ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يُصَلِّي اللَّيْلَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad al-Fazārī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar Bihadhā al-Ḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْفَزَارِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَكُنْتُ إِذَا نِمْتُ لَمْ أَقُمْ حَتَّى أُصْبِحَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2200

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard the Prophet ﷺ say that while I was asleep, I was brought a cup of milk, and I drank from it until I could see the whiteness in my nails or he said, in my finger nails. Then I handed the remaining portion to Umar. They asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, what did you interpret from this?' He said, 'Knowledge.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard the Prophet ﷺ say that while I was asleep, I was brought a cup of milk, and I drank from it until I could see the whiteness in my nails or he said, in my finger nails. Then I handed the remaining portion to Umar. They asked, 'O Messenger of Allah, what did you interpret from this?' He said, 'Knowledge.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ إِذْ أُتِيتُ بِقَدَحٍ مِنْ لَبَنٍ فَشَرِبْتُ مِنْهُ حَتَّى إِنِّي لَأَرَى الرِّيَّ فِي ظُفْرِي أَوْ قَالَ فِي أَظْفَارِي ثُمَّ نَاوَلْتُ فَضْلَهُ عُمَرَ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَوَّلْتَهُ قَالَ «الْعِلْمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ḥamzah b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2201

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: Some of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ told me that the Prophet ﷺ said, "Milk is natural, swimming is a salvation, camels bring sadness, greenery is paradise, and women are good."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Some of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ told me that the Prophet ﷺ said, "Milk is natural, swimming is a salvation, camels bring sadness, greenery is paradise, and women are good."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «اللَّبَنُ الْفِطْرَةُ وَالسَّفِينَةُ نَجَاةٌ وَالْجَمَلُ حُزْنٌ وَالْخُضْرَةُ الْجَنَّةُ وَالْمَرْأَةُ خَيْرٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd \u003e Ibn Jābir \u003e Muḥammad b. Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جَابِرٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2202

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: "I had a dream of a cloud with shade dripping butter and honey. I saw the people scooping it up with their hands, some taking much and some taking little. I saw a rope extending from the sky to the earth. Then I saw you O Messenger of Allah ! You took hold of it and went up, then a man took hold of it after you do so, then a man took hold of it after him to do so. Then a man took hold of it and it was severed, and then connected for him, and he did so (i.e. , went up)." Abu Bakr said: "May my father and mother be ransomed for you O Messenger of Allah! Allow me to interpret it." He said: "Interpret it." so he said: "As for the cloud with its shade, it is Islam. As for what the butter and honey that dropped from it, this is the Quran and its delicateness and sweetness. It means some of them gathered much of the Quran and some of them a little. As for the rope extending from the sky to the earth, it is the truth which you are upon, you clug to it and Allah exalted you. Then another man will take hold of it after you and ascend on it, then after him, another man will take hold of it and ascend on it. Then another [man] will take hold of it but it will break, then be connected so he will ascend on it. Inform me O Messenger of Allah! Am I correct or am I mistaken?" The Prophet ﷺ said: "You are correct in some of it and mistaken in some of it." He (i.e., Abu Bakr) said: "I swear to you by my father and my mother O Messenger of Allah! Inform me in what I was mistaken?" The Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not swear."     – Sound Chain

I saw a rope extending from the sky to the earth. Then I saw you O Messenger of Allah ! You took hold of it and went up, then a man took hold of it after you do so, then a man took hold of it after him to do so. Then a man took hold of it and it was severed, and then connected for him, and he did so (i.e. , went up)." Abu Bakr said: "May my father and mother be ransomed for you O Messenger of Allah! Allow me to interpret it." He said: "Interpret it." so he said: "As for the cloud with its shade, it is Islam. As for what the butter and honey that dropped from it, this is the Quran and its delicateness and sweetness. It means some of them gathered much of the Quran and some of them a little. As for the rope extending from the sky to the earth, it is the truth which you are upon, you clug to it and Allah exalted you. Then another man will take hold of it after you and ascend on it, then after him, another man will take hold of it and ascend on it. Then another [man] will take hold of it but it will break, then be connected so he will ascend on it. Inform me O Messenger of Allah! Am I correct or am I mistaken?" The Prophet ﷺ said: "You are correct in some of it and mistaken in some of it." He (i.e., Abu Bakr) said: "I swear to you by my father and my mother O Messenger of Allah! Inform me in what I was mistaken?" The Prophet ﷺ said: "Do not swear."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ مِمَّا يَقُولُ لِأَصْحَابِهِ «مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ رُؤْيَا فَلْيَقُصَّهَا عَلَيَّ فَأَعْبُرَهَا لَهُ» قَالَ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ رَأَيْتُ ظُلَّةً بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ تَنْطِفُ عَسَلًا وَسَمْنًا وَرَأَيْتُ سَبَبًا وَاصِلًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَرَأَيْتُ أُنَاسًا يَتَكَفَّفُونَ مِنْهَا فَمُسْتَكْثِرٌ وَمُسْتَقِلٌّ وَرَأَيْتُ سَبَبًا وَاصِلًا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذْتَ بِهِ فَعَلَوْتَ «فَأَعْلَاكَ اللَّهُ» ثُمَّ أَخَذَ بِهِ الَّذِي بَعْدَكَ فَعَلَا «فَأَعْلَاهُ اللَّهُ» ثُمَّ أَخَذَهُ الَّذِي بَعْدَهُ فَعَلَا «فَأَعْلَاهُ اللَّهُ» ثُمَّ أَخَذَهُ الَّذِي بَعْدَهُ فَقُطِعَ بِهِ ثُمَّ وُصِلَ فَاتَّصَلَ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ائْذَنْ لِي فَأَعْبُرَهَا فَقَالَ «اعْبُرْهَا» وَكَانَ أَعْبَرَ النَّاسِ لِلرُّؤْيَا بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ أَمَّا الظُّلَّةُ فَالْإِسْلَامُ وَأَمَّا الْعَسَلُ وَالسَّمْنُ فَالْقُرْآنُ حَلَاوَةُ الْعَسَلِ وَلِينُ السَّمْنِ وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ يَتَكَفَّفُونَ مِنْهُ فَمُسْتَكْثِرٌ وَمُسْتَقِلٌّ فَهُمْ حَمَلَةُ الْقُرْآنِ وَأَمَّا السَّبَبُ الْوَاصِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ فَالْحَقُّ الَّذِي أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِ تَأْخُذُ بِهِ فَيُعْلِيكَ اللَّهُ بِهِ ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ بِهِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَعْدِكَ فَيَعْلُوَ بِهِ ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ بِهِ رَجُلٌ آَخَرُ فَيَعْلُو بِهِ ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ بِهِ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَيَنْقَطِعُ بِهِ ثُمَّ يَوصَلُ لَهُ فَيَعْلُو بِهِ فَأَخْبِرْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَأَبِي أَنْتَ أَصَبْتُ أَمْ أَخْطَأْتَ فَقَالَ «أَصَبْتَ وَأَخْطَأْتَ» فَقَالَ فَمَا الَّذِي أَصَبْتُ؟ وَمَا الَّذِي أَخْطَأْتُ؟ فَأَبَى أَنْ يُخْبِرَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Ibn Kathīr \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2203

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: It seemed as if the sun or the moon was suspended on the Earth, with strong chains. Abu Ja'far had doubts about it, so he mentioned that to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. The Prophet replied, "That is the death of your nephew, meaning the Messenger of Allah himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It seemed as if the sun or the moon was suspended on the Earth, with strong chains. Abu Ja'far had doubts about it, so he mentioned that to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. The Prophet replied, "That is the death of your nephew, meaning the Messenger of Allah himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَأَنَّ شَمْسًا أَوْ قَمَرًا شَكَّ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ تُرْفَعُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ بِأَشْطَانٍ شِدَادٍ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «ذَاكَ وَفَاةُ ابْنِ أَخِيكَ يَعْنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَفْسَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Mihrān \u003e Miskīn al-Ḥarrānī \u003e Jaʿfar b. Burqān \u003e Yazīd b. al-Aṣam \u003e al-ʿAbbās b. ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا مِسْكِينٌ الْحَرَّانِيُّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْأَصَمِّ عَنْ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَقَالَ رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2204

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: “In a dream I saw myself emigrating from Makkah to a land in which there were date-palm trees, and I thought that it was Yamamah or Hajar, but it was Al-Madinah, Yathrib. And I saw in this dream of mine that I was wielding a sword then it broke in the middle. That was what befell the believers on the Day of Uhud. Then I wielded it again and it was better than it had been before, and that is what Allah brought about of the Conquest and the regrouping of the believers. And I also saw cows, and by Allah it is good, for they are the group of the believers (who were martyred) on the Day of Uhud, and the goodness is that which Allah brought forth after that, and the reward of the truth which Allah brought us on the Day of Badr.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “In a dream I saw myself emigrating from Makkah to a land in which there were date-palm trees, and I thought that it was Yamamah or Hajar, but it was Al-Madinah, Yathrib. And I saw in this dream of mine that I was wielding a sword then it broke in the middle. That was what befell the believers on the Day of Uhud. Then I wielded it again and it was better than it had been before, and that is what Allah brought about of the Conquest and the regrouping of the believers. And I also saw cows, and by Allah it is good, for they are the group of the believers (who were martyred) on the Day of Uhud, and the goodness is that which Allah brought forth after that, and the reward of the truth which Allah brought us on the Day of Badr.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «رَأَيْتُ فِي رُؤْيَايَ هَذِهِ أَنِّي هَزَزْتُ سَيْفًا فَانْقَطَعَ صَدْرُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ مَا أُصِيبَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ ثُمَّ هَزَزْتُهُ أُخْرَى فَعَادَ كَأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانَ فَإِذَا هُوَ مَا جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مِنَ الْفَتْحِ وَاجْتِمَاعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَرَأَيْتُ فِيهَا أَيْضًا بَقَرًا وَاللَّهِ خَيْرٌ فَإِذَا هُوَ النَّفَرُ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَإِذَا الْخَيْرُ مَا جَاءَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَثَوَابِ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي آتَانَا بَعْدَ يَوْمِ بَدْرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Barīd \u003e Abū Burdah \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ بَرِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2205

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I saw as if I were in a fortified shield and I saw a cow being slaughtered. I interpreted the shield to be Madinah and the cow to be a group of people. By Allah, they are better off if we confront them when they enter upon us." They said, "By Allah, they have never entered upon us during the pre-Islamic times. Will they then enter upon us during Islam?" He said, "That is your concern then." Some of the Ansar said to each other, "We will discuss the Prophet's ﷺ matter in his presence." So they went to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is your opinion?" He said, "Now, if a prophet wears an armor for his people, he should not take it off until he fights."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I saw as if I were in a fortified shield and I saw a cow being slaughtered. I interpreted the shield to be Madinah and the cow to be a group of people. By Allah, they are better off if we confront them when they enter upon us." They said, "By Allah, they have never entered upon us during the pre-Islamic times. Will they then enter upon us during Islam?" He said, "That is your concern then." Some of the Ansar said to each other, "We will discuss the Prophet's ﷺ matter in his presence." So they went to him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, what is your opinion?" He said, "Now, if a prophet wears an armor for his people, he should not take it off until he fights."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «رَأَيْتُ كَأَنِّي فِي دِرْعٍ حَصِينَةٍ وَرَأَيْتُ بَقَرًا يُنْحَرُ فَأَوَّلْتُ أَنَّ الدِّرْعَ الْمَدِينَةُ وَأَنَّ الْبَقَرَ نَفَرٌ وَاللَّهِ خَيْرٌ وَلَوْ أَقَمْنَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَإِذَا دَخَلُوا عَلَيْنَا قَاتَلْنَاهُمْ» فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْنَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَفَتُدْخَلُ عَلَيْنَا فِي الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ «فَشَأْنَكُمْ إِذًا» وَقَالَتْ الْأَنْصَارُ بَعْضُهَا لِبَعْضٍ رَدَدْنَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ رَأْيَهُ فَجَاءُوا فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ شَأْنُكَ فَقَالَ «الْآنَ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِنَبِيٍّ إِذَا لَبِسَ لَأْمَتَهُ أَنْ يَضَعَهُا حَتَّى يُقَاتِلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2206

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , it is narrated that he used to say, "I dislike extremism and I love moderation. Moderation is firmness in religion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , it is narrated that he used to say, "I dislike extremism and I love moderation. Moderation is firmness in religion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «أَكْرَهُ الْغُلَّ وَأُحِبُّ الْقَيْدَ الْقَيْدُ ثَبَاتٌ فِي الدِّينِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2207

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "I saw in a dream a black woman with disheveled hair being expelled from the city and settled in Mahyah, and then I interpreted it as an epidemic hitting Madinah being transferred by Allah to Mahyah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "I saw in a dream a black woman with disheveled hair being expelled from the city and settled in Mahyah, and then I interpreted it as an epidemic hitting Madinah being transferred by Allah to Mahyah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ امْرَأَةً سَوْدَاءَ ثَائِرَةَ الشَّعْرِ تَفِلَةً أُخْرِجَتْ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَأُسْكِنَتْ مَهْيَعَةَ فَأَوَّلْتُهَا وَبَاءَ الْمَدِينَةِ يَنْقُلُهَا اللَّهُ إِلَى مَهْيَعَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Dāwud al-Hāshimī \u003e Ibn Abū al-Zinād \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUqbah \u003e Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2208

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said one day, "Indeed, I saw in a dream that a man came to me with a bunch of dates, and I ate them. Then I found a seed in them that harmed me when I chewed it. Then he gave me another bunch of dates." So I said, "When I ate what you gave me, I found a seed in it that harmed me." Abu Bakr said, "Your eyes found sleep, O Messenger of Allah. This is the secret mission that you sent, both of which they captured, and they found a man seeking your protection. So I said to Mujalid, 'What is he seeking your protection for?' He said, 'He says, "There is no god but Allah".'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said one day, "Indeed, I saw in a dream that a man came to me with a bunch of dates, and I ate them. Then I found a seed in them that harmed me when I chewed it. Then he gave me another bunch of dates." So I said, "When I ate what you gave me, I found a seed in it that harmed me." Abu Bakr said, "Your eyes found sleep, O Messenger of Allah. This is the secret mission that you sent, both of which they captured, and they found a man seeking your protection. So I said to Mujalid, 'What is he seeking your protection for?' He said, 'He says, "There is no god but Allah".'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَوْمًا مِنَ الْأَيَّامِ «إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَانِي بِكُتْلَةٍ مِنْ تَمْرٍ فَأَكَلْتُهَا فَوَجَدْتُ فِيهَا نَوَاةً فَآذَتْنِي حِينَ مَضَغْتُهَا ثُمَّ أَعْطَانِي كُتْلَةً أُخْرَى» فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ الَّذِي أَعْطَيْتَنِي وَجَدْتُ فِيهَا نَوَاةً آذَتْنِي فَأَكَلْتُهَا فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ نَامَتْ عَيْنُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذِهِ السَّرِيَّةُ الَّتِي بَعَثْتَ بِهَا غَنِمُوا مَرَّتَيْنِ كِلْتَاهُمَا وَجَدُوا رَجُلًا يَنْشُدُ ذِمَّتَكَ فَقُلْتُ لِمُجَالِدٍ «مَا يَنْشُدُ ذِمَّتَكَ» قَالَ يَقُولُ «لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Yaḥyá b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿAbīdah b. al-Aswad \u003e Mujālid \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبِيدَةُ بْنُ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2209

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقُمُصِ، وَالْبِئْرِ، وَاللَّبَنِ، وَالْعَسَلِ، وَالسَّمْنِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فِي النَّوْمِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the shirt, the well, the milk, the honey, the butter, the dat...

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated Aisha, the wife of the Prophet: "There was a woman from the people of Medina who had a merchant husband. They used to have disputes, and whenever her husband was absent, she would see a dream. Every time he was away, she would see in her dream that the roof of her house had collapsed and that she had given birth to a male child who was blind in one eye. So, she would come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and say, 'My husband has gone out as a merchant, and he has left me behind while I am pregnant. I have seen in my dream what a sleeper sees.?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would say: 'Good, it will be as you have seen it,' and she would return to her house. Indeed, her husband would return to her, and she would give birth to a male child who was blind in one eye. This happened two or three times, and every time she would see the dream, she would come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and tell him about it. Once, she came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was absent, and she had seen the dream. She said to me, 'What do you advise me to do? Should I ask the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about it?' I said, 'Yes.' So, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came, she told him about it. He said to her, 'What is your desired outcome?' She replied, 'By Allah, if your interpretation is true, my husband will die and I will give birth to a male child who will eventually become evil.' Then, she started weeping. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the room while she was weeping and asked her what was wrong. She told him what she had said and how she had interpreted the dream. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O Aisha, tell her that when you see a dream, it is either about what you have seen or about what the person who sees it interprets it to be. Her husband will die, and by Allah, she will give birth to a male child who will eventually become evildoer.'   – Good Chain

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O Aisha, tell her that when you see a dream, it is either about what you have seen or about what the person who sees it interprets it to be. Her husband will die, and by Allah, she will give birth to a male child who will eventually become evildoer.'   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ كَانَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ لَهَا زَوْجٌ تَاجِرٌ يَخْتَلِفُ فَكَانَتْ تَرَى رُؤْيَا كُلَّمَا غَابَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَقَلَّمَا يَغِيبُ إِلَّا تَرَكَهَا حَامِلًا فَتَأْتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَتَقُولُ إِنَّ زَوْجِي خَرَجَ تَاجِرًا فَتَرَكَنِي حَامِلًا فَرَأَيْتُ فِيمَا يَرَى النَّائِمُ أَنَّ سَارِيَةَ بَيْتِي انْكَسَرَتْ وَأَنِّي وَلَدْتُ غُلَامًا أَعْوَرَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «خَيْرٌ يَرْجِعُ زَوْجُكِ عَلَيْكِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى صَالِحًا وَتَلِدِينَ غُلَامًا بَرًّا» فَكَانَتْ تَرَاهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا كُلُّ ذَلِكَ تَأْتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَيَقُولُ ذَلِكَ لَهَا فَيَرْجِعُ زَوْجُهَا وَتَلِدُ غُلَامًا فَجَاءَتْ يَوْمًا كَمَا كَانَتْ تَأْتِيهِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ غَائِبٌ وَقَدْ رَأَتْ تِلْكَ الرُّؤْيَا فَقُلْتُ لَهَا عَمَّ تَسْأَلِينَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَا أَمَةَ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَتْ رُؤْيَا كُنْتُ أُرَاهَا فَآتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَسْأَلُهُ عَنْهَا؟ فَيَقُولُ خَيْرًا فَيَكُونُ كَمَا قَالَ فَقُلْتُ فَأَخْبِرِينِي مَا هِيَ؟ قَالَتْ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَعْرِضَهَا عَلَيْهِ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَعْرِضُ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا تَرَكْتُهَا حَتَّى أَخْبَرَتْنِي فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ صَدَقَتْ رُؤْيَاكِ لَيَمُوتَنَّ زَوْجُكِ وَتَلِدِينَ غُلَامًا فَاجِرًا فَقَعَدَتْ تَبْكِي وَقَالَتْ مَا لِي حِينَ عَرَضْتُ عَلَيْكِ رُؤْيَايَ فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهِيَ تَبْكِي فَقَالَ لَهَا مَا لَهَا يَا عَائِشَةُ؟ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ الْخَبَرَ وَمَا تَأَوَّلْتُ لَهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَهْ يَا عَائِشَةُ «إِذَا عَبَرْتُمْ لِلْمُسْلِمِ الرُّؤْيَا فَاعْبُرُوهَا عَلَى الْخَيْرِ فَإِنَّ الرُّؤْيَا تَكُونُ عَلَى مَا يَعْبُرُهَا صَاحِبُهَا فَمَاتَ وَاللَّهِ زَوْجُهَا وَلَا أُرَاهَا إِلَّا وَلَدَتْ غُلَامًا فَاجِرًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUbayd b. Yaʿīsh \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Bukayr \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ هُوَ ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2210

chapter.englishTitle: Encouragement for Marriage

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, "Whoever is capable of marriage but does not marry, then he is not from among us."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, "Whoever is capable of marriage but does not marry, then he is not from among us."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ قَدَرَ عَلَى أَنْ يَنْكِحَ فَلَمْ يَنْكِحْ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Mughallis \u003e Abū Najīḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُغَلِّسِ عَنْ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2211

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ طَوْلٌ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever has the means should get married.

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated that 'Abdullah said: "The Messenger of Allah said to us: 'O young men, whoever among you can afford it, let him get married, for it is more effective in lowering the gaze and guarding chastity, and whoever cannot then he should fast, for it will be a restraint (wija') for him.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated that 'Abdullah said: "The Messenger of Allah said to us: 'O young men, whoever among you can afford it, let him get married, for it is more effective in lowering the gaze and guarding chastity, and whoever cannot then he should fast, for it will be a restraint (wija') for him.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَبَابًا لَيْسَ لَنَا شَيْءٌ فَقَالَ «يَا مَعْشَرَ الشَّبَابِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمُ الْبَاءَةَ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ فَإِنَّهُ أَغَضُّ لِلْبَصَرِ وَأَحْصَنُ لِلْفَرْجِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَعَلَيْهِ بِالصَّوْمِ فَإِنَّ الصَّوْمَ لَهُ وِجَاءٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿUmārah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2212

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ طَوْلٌ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever has the means should get married.

hadiths.englishRaw: Do you have a young virgin girl who reminds you of Abu Abdurrahman? So he said, "If you say that, then I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'O youth, whoever among you is able to marry, let him do so, for it is more effective in guarding the gaze and preserving chastity. And whoever is not able, then let him fast, for it will be a shield for him.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Do you have a young virgin girl who reminds you of Abu Abdurrahman? So he said, "If you say that, then I have heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, 'O youth, whoever among you is able to marry, let him do so, for it is more effective in guarding the gaze and preserving chastity. And whoever is not able, then let him fast, for it will be a shield for him.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هَلْ لَكَ فِي جَارِيَةٍ بِكْرٍ تُذَكِّرُكَ؟ فَقَالَ لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَاكَ فَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «يَا مَعْشَرَ الشَّبَابِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمُ الْبَاءَةَ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ فَإِنَّهُ أَغَضُّ لِلْبَصَرِ وَأَحْصَنُ لِلْفَرْجِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَلْيَصُمْ فَإِنَّ الصَّوْمَ لَهُ وِجَاءٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Laqiyah ʿUthmān \u003e Maʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ لَقِيَهُ عُثْمَانُ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2213

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of hypocrisy

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ prevented ʿUthman bin Mazun from that (not marrying), and had he allowed him, we would have got ourselves castrated.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ prevented ʿUthman bin Mazun from that (not marrying), and had he allowed him, we would have got ourselves castrated.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ يَقُولُ «لَقَدْ رَدَّ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ وَلَوْ أَجَازَ لَهُ التَّبَتُّلَ لَاخْتَصَيْنَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Yamān \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Saʿd b. Abū Waqqāṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ أََنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2214

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of hypocrisy

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic phrase "نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ التَّبَتُّلِ" into English is: "The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) forbade self-mutilation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic phrase "نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ التَّبَتُّلِ" into English is: "The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) forbade self-mutilation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ التَّبَتُّلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Ḥammād b. Masʿadah \u003e al-Ashʿath b. ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Saʿd b. Hishām \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2215

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of hypocrisy

hadiths.englishRaw: "When it came to the matter of Uthman ibn Madhun, who was known for his abstention from women, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a messenger to him and said, 'O Uthman, I have not been commanded to adopt a monastic lifestyle. Have you turned away from my Sunnah?' Uthman replied, 'No, O Messenger of Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Verily, it is from my Sunnah to pray, sleep, fast, give charity, get married, and divorce. Whoever turns away from my Sunnah is not of me, O Uthman. Indeed, your family has rights over you, and you have rights over yourself.' Saad said, 'By Allah, all the men among the Muslims were united in their acknowledgement that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ showed special preference to Uthman regarding his choice to abstain from women.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When it came to the matter of Uthman ibn Madhun, who was known for his abstention from women, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a messenger to him and said, 'O Uthman, I have not been commanded to adopt a monastic lifestyle. Have you turned away from my Sunnah?' Uthman replied, 'No, O Messenger of Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Verily, it is from my Sunnah to pray, sleep, fast, give charity, get married, and divorce. Whoever turns away from my Sunnah is not of me, O Uthman. Indeed, your family has rights over you, and you have rights over yourself.' Saad said, 'By Allah, all the men among the Muslims were united in their acknowledgement that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ showed special preference to Uthman regarding his choice to abstain from women.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَمَّا كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مَظْعُونٍ الَّذِي كَانَ مِنْ تَرْكِ النِّسَاءِ بَعَثَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «يَا عُثْمَانُ إِنِّي لَمْ أُومَرْ بِالرَّهْبَانِيَّةِ أَرَغِبْتَ عَنْ سُنَّتِي؟» قَالَ لَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «إِنَّ مِنْ سُنَّتِي أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ وَأَنَامَ وَأَصُومَ وَأَطْعَمَ وَأَنْكِحَ وَأُطَلِّقَ فَمَنْ رَغِبَ عَنْ سُنَّتِي فَلَيْسَ مِنِّي يَا عُثْمَانُ إِنَّ لِأَهْلِكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقًّا وَلِنَفْسِكَ عَلَيْكَ حَقًّا» قَالَ سَعْدٌ فَوَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كَانَ أَجْمَعَ رِجَالٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنْ هُوَ أَقَرَّ عُثْمَانَ عَلَى مَا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ نَخْتَصِيَ فَنَتَبَتَّلَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Ḥizāmī \u003e Yūnus b. Bukayr \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Saʿd b. Abū Waqqāṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2216

chapter.englishTitle: The woman is married to four.

hadiths.englishRaw: for her property, her ranks, her beauty and her religiosity. So get the one who is religious and prosper (lit. may your hands cleave to the dust).”
hadiths.body: for her property, her ranks, her beauty and her religiosity. So get the one who is religious and prosper (lit. may your hands cleave to the dust).”
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ تُنْكَحُ النِّسَاءُ لِأَرْبَعٍ لِلدِّينِ وَالْجَمَالِ وَالْمَالِ وَالْحَسَبِ فَعَلَيْكَ بِذَاتِ الدِّينِ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكَ
hadiths.chain: Ṣadaqah b. al-Faḍl \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Saʿīd from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
