hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2217

chapter.englishTitle: The woman is married to four.

hadiths.englishRaw: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Rukanah bin Yazid from the Prophet ﷺ through a different chain of narrators.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Rukanah bin Yazid from the Prophet ﷺ through a different chain of narrators.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Rabāḥ \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2218

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرُّخْصَةِ فِي النَّظَرِ إِلَى الْمَرْأَةِ عِنْدَ الْخِطْبَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The license to look at a woman during the engagement.

hadiths.englishRaw: His messenger ﷺ said to him, "Go and look at her, as it is more appropriate for reconciliation to take place between you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: His messenger ﷺ said to him, "Go and look at her, as it is more appropriate for reconciliation to take place between you."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اذْهَبْ فَانْظُرْ إِلَيْهَا فَإِنَّهُ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ يُؤْدَمَ بَيْنَكُمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal \u003e Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh al-Muzanī \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah \u003e Khaṭab Āmraʾah from al-Anṣār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ أَنَّهُ خَطَبَ امْرَأَةً مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2219

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ الرَّجُلُ مَا يُقَالُ لَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: If a man gets married, what is said to him?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not say that, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from doing so and commanded us to say 'May Allah bless you and grant you blessings'."
hadiths.body: "Do not say that, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from doing so and commanded us to say 'May Allah bless you and grant you blessings'."
hadiths.arabic: لَا تَقُولُوا ذَلِكَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَانَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ وَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نَقُولَ «بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr al-ʿAbdī al-Baṣrī \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Samiʿtuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ الْبَصْرِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ قَدِمَ عَقِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ الْبَصْرَةَ فَتَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنِي جُشَمٍ فَقَالُوا لَهُ بِالرِّفَاءِ وَالْبَنِينَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2220

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ الرَّجُلُ مَا يُقَالُ لَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: If a man gets married, what is said to him?

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Prophet ﷺ congratulated a man on his marriage, he said: May Allah bless for you, and may He bless on you, and combine both of you in good (works).     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: When the Prophet ﷺ congratulated a man on his marriage, he said: May Allah bless for you, and may He bless on you, and combine both of you in good (works).     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا رَفَّأَ لِإِنْسَانٍ قَالَ «بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Suhayl from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2221

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ خِطْبَةِ الرَّجُلِ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of a man's proposal to his brother's proposal

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ who said, "A man should not propose marriage to his brother's fiancée."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ who said, "A man should not propose marriage to his brother's fiancée."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ «نَهَى عَنْ أَنْ يَخْطُبَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Suhayl b. Abū Ṣāliḥ from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2222

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ خِطْبَةِ الرَّجُلِ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of a man's proposal to his brother's proposal

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: One of you must not ask a woman in marriage when his brother has done so already, and one of you must not sell (his own goods) when his brother has already sold (his goods) except with his permission.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: One of you must not ask a woman in marriage when his brother has done so already, and one of you must not sell (his own goods) when his brother has already sold (his goods) except with his permission.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَخْطُبُ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ وَلَا يَبِيعُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يَأْذَنَ لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2223

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ خِطْبَةِ الرَّجُلِ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of a man's proposal to his brother's proposal

hadiths.englishRaw: She was under the authority of a man from the Quraysh tribe of Banu Makhzum, but he divorced her abruptly. She then sent a message to her family seeking financial support, but they informed her that they had no provision for her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was informed of this, and he said, "You have no financial support, but you have an 'iddah (waiting period). Move to the house of Umm Sharik and do not burden us with your presence." Then he said, "Umm Sharik is a woman who is visited by her brothers from the Muhajirin, but move to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, for he is a blind man. If you take off your clothes, he will not see anything, and do not burden us with your presence." So she went to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, and when she arrived, she remembered that Mu'awiyah and Abu Jahm had proposed to her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "As for Mu'awiyah, he is a man without wealth, and as for Abu Jahm, he does not take his cane off his shoulder. So where do you stand with regard to Usamah?" Her family seemed to dislike this, so she said, "By Allah, I will not marry anyone except the one whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has mentioned." Therefore, she married Usamah. Muhammad ibn Amr said that Muhammad ibn Ibrahim said, "O Fatimah, fear Allah, for you have known what this meant."
hadiths.body: She was under the authority of a man from the Quraysh tribe of Banu Makhzum, but he divorced her abruptly. She then sent a message to her family seeking financial support, but they informed her that they had no provision for her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was informed of this, and he said, "You have no financial support, but you have an 'iddah (waiting period). Move to the house of Umm Sharik and do not burden us with your presence." Then he said, "Umm Sharik is a woman who is visited by her brothers from the Muhajirin, but move to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, for he is a blind man. If you take off your clothes, he will not see anything, and do not burden us with your presence." So she went to the house of Ibn Umm Maktum, and when she arrived, she remembered that Mu'awiyah and Abu Jahm had proposed to her. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "As for Mu'awiyah, he is a man without wealth, and as for Abu Jahm, he does not take his cane off his shoulder. So where do you stand with regard to Usamah?" Her family seemed to dislike this, so she said, "By Allah, I will not marry anyone except the one whom the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has mentioned." Therefore, she married Usamah. Muhammad ibn Amr said that Muhammad ibn Ibrahim said, "O Fatimah, fear Allah, for you have known what this meant."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ مِنْ بَنِي مَخْزُومٍ فَطَلَّقَهَا الْبَتَّةَ فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ تَبْتَغِي مِنْهُمُ النَّفَقَةَ فَقَالُوا لَيْسَ لَكِ نَفَقَةٌ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «لَيْسَ لَكِ نَفَقَةٌ وَعَلَيْكِ الْعِدَّةُ وَانْتَقِلِي إِلَى بَيْتِ أُمِّ شَرِيكٍ وَلَا تُفَوِّتِينَا بِنَفْسِكِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنَّ أُمَّ شَرِيكٍ امْرَأَةٌ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا إِخْوَانُهَا مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَلَكِنِ انْتَقِلِي إِلَى بَيْتِ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَإِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ أَعْمَى إِنْ وَضَعْتِ ثِيَابَكِ لَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُفَوِّتِينَا بِنَفْسِكِ» فَانْطَلَقَتْ إِلَى بَيْتِ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَلَمَّا حَلَّتْ ذَكَرَتْ أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَأَبَا جَهْمٍ خَطَبَاهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَمَّا مُعَاوِيَةُ فَرَجُلٌ لَا مَالَ لَهُ وَأَمَّا أَبُو جَهْمٍ فَلَا يَضَعُ عَصَاهُ عَنْ عَاتِقِهِ فَأَيْنَ أَنْتَ مِنْ أُسَامَةَ؟» فَكَأَنَّ أَهْلَهَا كَرِهُوا ذَلِكَ فَقَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ لَا أَنْكِحُ إِلَّا الَّذِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَنَكَحَتْ أُسَامَةَ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يَا فَاطِمَةُ اتَّقِي اللَّهَ فَقَدْ عَلِمْتِ فِي أَيِّ شَيْءٍ كَانَ هَذَا
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Fāṭimah b. Qays \u003e And Katabah Minhā Kitāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أََنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ أَنَّهَا حَدَّثَتْهُ وَكَتَبَهُ مِنْهَا كِتَابًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2224

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَالِ الَّتِي يَجُوزُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَخْطُبَ فِيهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The conditions under which a man is allowed to propose.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah prohibited that a woman be married along with her paternal aunt, or the paternal aunt along with her brother's daughter, or a woman with her maternal aunt, or the maternal aunt along with her sister's daughter, and the younger is not to be married with the older, nor the older with the younger."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah prohibited that a woman be married along with her paternal aunt, or the paternal aunt along with her brother's daughter, or a woman with her maternal aunt, or the maternal aunt along with her sister's daughter, and the younger is not to be married with the older, nor the older with the younger."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَهَى أَنْ تُنْكَحَ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى عَمَّتِهَا وَالْعَمَّةُ عَلَى ابْنَةِ أَخِيهَا أَوِ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى خَالَتِهَا أَوِ الْخَالَةُ عَلَى بِنْتِ أُخْتِهَا وَلَا تُنْكَحُ الصُّغْرَى عَلَى الْكُبْرَى وَلَا الْكُبْرَى عَلَى الصُّغْرَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Dāwud / Ibn Abū Hind \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي هِنْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَامِرٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2225

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَالِ الَّتِي يَجُوزُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَخْطُبَ فِيهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The conditions under which a man is allowed to propose.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: '(A man should not be married to) a woman and her paternal aunt nor to a woman and her maternal aunt at the same time.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: '(A man should not be married to) a woman and her paternal aunt nor to a woman and her maternal aunt at the same time.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَهَى أَنْ يُجْمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَعَمَّتِهَا وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَخَالَتِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2226

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of envy

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited 'shighar'. Malik said, 'Shighar' is when a man gives his daughter in marriage to another man, while that man gives his daughter in marriage to the first man, without any dowry. Abu Muhammad was asked, 'Do you consider marriage between them valid?' He said, 'I do not approve of it.'"   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited 'shighar'. Malik said, 'Shighar' is when a man gives his daughter in marriage to another man, while that man gives his daughter in marriage to the first man, without any dowry. Abu Muhammad was asked, 'Do you consider marriage between them valid?' He said, 'I do not approve of it.'"   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الشِّغَارِ» قَالَ مَالِكٌ وَالشِّغَارُ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَ الرَّجُلُ الْآخَرَ ابْنَتَهُ عَلَى أَنْ يُزَوِّجَهُ الْآخَرُ ابْنَتَهُ بِغَيْرِ صَدَاقٍ قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ تَرَى بَيْنَهُمَا نِكَاحًا قَالَ لَا يُعْجِبُنِي   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2227
hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Marry the righteous men and the righteous women." Abu Muhammad said, "And it was revealed to me from the Hadith, so whatever follows after them is good."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Marry the righteous men and the righteous women." Abu Muhammad said, "And it was revealed to me from the Hadith, so whatever follows after them is good."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَنْكِحُوا الصَّالِحِينَ وَالصَّالِحَاتِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «وَسَقَطَ عَلَيَّ مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ فَمَا تَبِعَهُمْ بَعْدُ فَحَسَنٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibrāhīm b. ʿUmar b. Kaysān from his father \u003e Wahbb. Abū Mughīth \u003e Asmāʾ b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ أَبِي مُغِيثٍ حَدَّثَتْنِي أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2228

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ النِّكَاحِ بِغَيْرِ وَلِيٍّ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of marriage without a guardian

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah said: “There is no marriage except with a guardian.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: “There is no marriage except with a guardian.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا نِكَاحَ إِلَّا بِوَلِيٍّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mālik b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū Burdah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2229

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ النِّكَاحِ بِغَيْرِ وَلِيٍّ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of marriage without a guardian

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ who said, "There is no marriage except with a guardian."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ who said, "There is no marriage except with a guardian."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا نِكَاحَ إِلَّا بِوَلِيٍّ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAlī b. Ḥujr \u003e Sharīk \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū Burdah \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2230

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ النِّكَاحِ بِغَيْرِ وَلِيٍّ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of marriage without a guardian

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Any woman who is married without the permission of her guardian, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid. If they dispute, Abu Asim said: and he said it once: if they argue, then the ruler is the guardian of the one who has no guardian. If he (the ruler) decides in her favor, then she has the dowry for what he has permitted from her private parts." Abu Asim said: He (the Prophet) repeated this statement forty-six times.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "Any woman who is married without the permission of her guardian, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid, her marriage is invalid. If they dispute, Abu Asim said: and he said it once: if they argue, then the ruler is the guardian of the one who has no guardian. If he (the ruler) decides in her favor, then she has the dowry for what he has permitted from her private parts." Abu Asim said: He (the Prophet) repeated this statement forty-six times.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ نُكِحَتْ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ وَلِيِّهَا فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَنِكَاحُهَا بَاطِلٌ فَإِنِ اشْتَجَرُوا قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ وَقَالَ مَرَّةً فَإِنْ تَشَاجَرُوا فَالسُّلْطَانُ وَلِيُّ مَنْ لَا وَلِيَّ لَهُ فَإِنْ أَصَابَهَا فَلَهَا الْمَهْرُ بِمَا اسْتَحَلَّ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ أَمْلَاهُ عَلَيَّ سَنَةَ سِتٍّ وَأَرْبَعِينَ وَمِائَةٍ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2231

chapter.englishTitle: In the orphan, getting married

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'An orphan girl should be consulted with regard to marriage, and if she remains silent, that is her permission. If she refuses then she is not to be forced.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'An orphan girl should be consulted with regard to marriage, and if she remains silent, that is her permission. If she refuses then she is not to be forced.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تُسْتَأْمَرُ الْيَتِيمَةُ فِي نَفْسِهَا فَإِنْ سَكَتَتْ فَقَدْ أَذِنَتْ وَإِنْ أَبَتْ لَمْ تُكْرَهْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Yūnus b. Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū Burdah b. Abū Mūsá \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2232

chapter.englishTitle: In the permissible acts of the virgin and the non-virgin

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah said: “A previously-married woman should not be married until she is consulted, and a virgin should not be married until her consent is sought, and her consent is her silence.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah said: “A previously-married woman should not be married until she is consulted, and a virgin should not be married until her consent is sought, and her consent is her silence.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تُنْكَحُ الثَّيِّبُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْمَرَ وَلَا تُنْكَحُ الْبِكْرُ حَتَّى تُسْتَأْذَنَ وَإِذْنُهَا الصُّمُوتُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2233

chapter.englishTitle: In the permissible acts of the virgin and the non-virgin

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with this narration...   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with this narration...   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2234

chapter.englishTitle: In the permissible acts of the virgin and the non-virgin

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn ‘Abbas reported the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ as saying “A woman without a husband has more right to her person than her guardian and a virgin’s permission must be asked, her permission being her silence. These are the words of Al Qa’nabi.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn ‘Abbas reported the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ as saying “A woman without a husband has more right to her person than her guardian and a virgin’s permission must be asked, her permission being her silence. These are the words of Al Qa’nabi.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْأَيِّمُ أَحَقُّ بِنَفْسِهَا مِنْ وَلِيِّهَا وَالْبِكْرُ تُسْتَأْذَنُ فِي نَفْسِهَا وَإِذْنُهَا صُمَاتُهَا»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Faḍl \u003e Nāfiʿ b. Jubayr b. Muṭʿim \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2235

chapter.englishTitle: In the permissible acts of the virgin and the non-virgin

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The permission of a virgin is sought, and her silence is considered as her permission."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The permission of a virgin is sought, and her silence is considered as her permission."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تُسْتَأْذَنُ الْبِكْرُ وَإِذْنُهَا صُمَاتُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Mālik Awwal Shayʾ Saʾaltuh ʿAnh \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Faḍl \u003e Nāfiʿ b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ أَوَّلُ شَيْءٍ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2236

chapter.englishTitle: In the permissible acts of the virgin and the non-virgin

hadiths.englishRaw: "A previously married woman has more right (to decide) about herself (with regard to marriage) than her guardian, and an orphan girl should be consulted with regard to marriage, and her permission is her silence."     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "A previously married woman has more right (to decide) about herself (with regard to marriage) than her guardian, and an orphan girl should be consulted with regard to marriage, and her permission is her silence."     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «الْأَيِّمُ أَمْلَكُ بِأَمْرِهَا مِنْ وَلِيِّهَا وَالْبِكْرُ تُسْتَأْمَرُ فِي نَفْسِهَا وَصَمْتُهَا إِقْرَارُهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Mawhab \u003e Nāfiʿ b. Jubayr b. Muṭʿim \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ أَخْبَرَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2237

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الثَّيِّبِ يُزَوِّجُهَا أَبُوهَا وَهِيَ كَارِهَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: The bachelor marries her against her will, while she is unwillin...

hadiths.englishRaw: that a man among them who was called Khidam arranged a marriage for his daughter, and she did not like the marriage arranged by her father. She went to the Messenger of Allah and told him about that, and he annulled the marriage arranged by her father. Then she married Abu Lubabah bin Abdul-Mundhir.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that a man among them who was called Khidam arranged a marriage for his daughter, and she did not like the marriage arranged by her father. She went to the Messenger of Allah and told him about that, and he annulled the marriage arranged by her father. Then she married Abu Lubabah bin Abdul-Mundhir.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْهُمْ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يُدْعَى خِذَامًا «أَنْكَحَ بِنْتًا لَهُ فَكَرِهَتْ نِكَاحَ أَبِيهَا» فَأَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَرَدَّ عَنْهَا نِكَاحَ أَبِيهَا فَنَكَحَتْ أَبَا لُبَابَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُنْذِرِ فَذَكَرَ يَحْيَى أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ ثَيِّبًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd And Mujammiʿ b. Yazīd al-Anṣāriyyayn Ḥaddathāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ وَمُجَمِّعَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّيْنِ حَدَّثَاهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2238

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الثَّيِّبِ يُزَوِّجُهَا أَبُوهَا وَهِيَ كَارِهَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: The bachelor marries her against her will, while she is unwillin...

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Khansa' bint Khidham that her father married her off when she had been previously married, and she was unwilling. She went to the Messenger of Allah and he annulled the marriage.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Khansa' bint Khidham that her father married her off when she had been previously married, and she was unwilling. She went to the Messenger of Allah and he annulled the marriage.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ خَنْسَاءَ بِنْتَ خِذَامٍ زَوَّجَهَا أَبُوهَا وَهِيَ ثَيِّبٌ فَكَرِهَتْ ذَلِكَ فَأَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَرَدَّ نِكَاحَهَا»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman Wumujammiʿ Āb.ay Yazīd Ibn a neighboriyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وُمُجَمِّعٍ ابْنَيْ يَزِيدَ ابْنِ جَارِيَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2239

chapter.englishTitle: The woman is married by the guardians

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: Any woman who is married by two guardians (to two different men) belongs to the first woman who is married by two guardians (to two different men) belongs to the first of them and anything sold by a man to two persons belongs to the first of them.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: Any woman who is married by two guardians (to two different men) belongs to the first woman who is married by two guardians (to two different men) belongs to the first of them and anything sold by a man to two persons belongs to the first of them.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ زَوَّجَهَا وَلِيَّانِ لَهَا فَهِيَ لِلْأَوَّلِ مِنْهُمَا وَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ بَاعَ بَيْعًا مِنْ رَجُلَيْنِ فَهُوَ لِلْأَوَّلِ مِنْهُمَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir or Samurah b. Jundub
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أََنْبَأَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ أَوْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2240

chapter.englishTitle: The woman is married by the guardians

hadiths.englishRaw: (Another chain) from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a similar report.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: (Another chain) from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a similar report.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ أََنْبَأَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2241

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of women's pleasure

hadiths.englishRaw: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah on the Farewell pilgrimage, and they said : 'O Messenger of Allah, ﷺ celibacy has become too difficult for us'. He said : 'Then make temporary marriages with these women'. So we went to them, but they insisted on setting a fixed time between us and them. They mentioned that to the Prophet and he said : 'Set a fixed time between you and them.' So I went out with a cousin of mine. He had a cloak and I had a cloak, but his cloak was finer than mine, and I was younger than him. We came to a women and she said: 'One cloak is like another.' So I married her and stayed with her that night. Then the next day I saw the Messenger of Allah standing between the Rukn (corner) and the door (of the Ka'bah), saying : 'O people, I had permitted temporary marriage for you, but Allah has forbidden it until the Day of Resurrection. however had any temporary wives, he should let them go, and do not take back anything that you had given to them.' "     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah on the Farewell pilgrimage, and they said : 'O Messenger of Allah, ﷺ celibacy has become too difficult for us'. He said : 'Then make temporary marriages with these women'. So we went to them, but they insisted on setting a fixed time between us and them. They mentioned that to the Prophet and he said : 'Set a fixed time between you and them.' So I went out with a cousin of mine. He had a cloak and I had a cloak, but his cloak was finer than mine, and I was younger than him. We came to a women and she said: 'One cloak is like another.' So I married her and stayed with her that night. Then the next day I saw the Messenger of Allah standing between the Rukn (corner) and the door (of the Ka'bah), saying : 'O people, I had permitted temporary marriage for you, but Allah has forbidden it until the Day of Resurrection. however had any temporary wives, he should let them go, and do not take back anything that you had given to them.' "     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُمْ سَارُوا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي حِجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَقَالَ «اسْتَمْتِعُوا مِنْ هَذِهِ النِّسَاءِ» وَالِاسْتِمْتَاعُ عِنْدَنَا التَّزْوِيجُ فَعَرَضْنَا ذَلِكَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ فَأَبَيْنَ أَنْ لَا يَضْرِبنَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُنَّ أَجَلًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «افْعَلُوا» فَخَرَجْتُ أَنَا وَابْنُ عَمٍّ لِي مَعَهُ بُرْدٌ وَمَعِي بُرْدٌ وَبُرْدُهُ أَجْوَدُ مِنْ بُرْدِي وَأَنَا أَشَبُّ مِنْهُ فَأَتَيْنَا عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ فَأَعْجَبَهَا شَبَابِي وَأَعْجَبَهَا بُرْدُهُ فَقَالَتْ بُرْدٌ كَبُرْدٍ وَكَانَ الْأَجَلُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهَا عَشْرًا فَبِتُّ عِنْدَهَا تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ ثُمَّ غَدَوْتُ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَائِمٌ بَيْنَ الرُّكْنِ وَالْبَابِ فَقَالَ «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنِّي قَدْ كُنْتُ أَذِنْتُ لَكُمْ فِي الِاسْتِمْتَاعِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ أَلَا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ فَمَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ مِنْهُنَّ شَيْءٌ فَلْيُخَلِّ سَبِيلَهَا وَلَا تَأْخُذُوا مِمَّا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e al-Rabīʿ b. Sabrah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2242

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of women's pleasure

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, prohibited temporary marriage during the Year of the Conquest.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, prohibited temporary marriage during the Year of the Conquest.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ نِكَاحِ الْمُتْعَةِ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e al-Rabīʿ b. Sabrah al-Juhanī from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2243

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of women's pleasure

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Ali say to Ibn Abbas, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade temporary marriage and the consumption of domesticated donkeys' meat during the Battle of Khaybar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Ali say to Ibn Abbas, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade temporary marriage and the consumption of domesticated donkeys' meat during the Battle of Khaybar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عَلِيًّا يَقُولُ لِابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَهَى عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ وَعَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْأَهْلِيَّةِ عَامَ خَيْبَرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e al-Ḥasan And ʿAbd Allāh \u003e Abīhimā \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2244

chapter.englishTitle: In the Forbidden Marriage

hadiths.englishRaw: ʿThe pilgrim in ihram should not get married, arrange a marriage or propose marriage.ʿ     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ʿThe pilgrim in ihram should not get married, arrange a marriage or propose marriage.ʿ     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْمُحْرِمُ لَا يَنْكِحُ وَلَا يُنْكِحُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e Ayyūb b. Mūsá \u003e Nubayh b. Wahb \u003e Abān b. ʿUthmān \u003e ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2245

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَمْ كَانَتْ مُهُورُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَبَنَاتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What were the dowries of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ and his daug...

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked Aisha, "How much was the dowry of the wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" She said, "His dowry for his wives was twelve uqiyyas of silver and some sheeps." She also asked, "Do you know what sheeps are?" I said, "No." She said, "Half a uqiyya. So this was the dowry of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for his wives."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I asked Aisha, "How much was the dowry of the wives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ?" She said, "His dowry for his wives was twelve uqiyyas of silver and some sheeps." She also asked, "Do you know what sheeps are?" I said, "No." She said, "Half a uqiyya. So this was the dowry of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for his wives."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ كَمْ كَانَ صَدَاقُ أَزْوَاجِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قَالَتْ «كَانَ صَدَاقُهُ لِأَزْوَاجِهِ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أُوقِيَّةً وَنَشًّا» وَقَالَتْ «أَتَدْرِي مَا النَّشُّ؟» قَالَ قُلْتُ لَا قَالَتْ نِصْفُ أُوقِيَّةٍ فَهَذَا صَدَاقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِأَزْوَاجِهِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Ibn Muḥammad \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abū Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ هُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2246

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَمْ كَانَتْ مُهُورُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَبَنَاتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What were the dowries of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ and his daug...

hadiths.englishRaw: Do not exaggerate in the dowry of women, for if it were honorable in this world or a means of righteousness before Allah, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, would have been the most truthful in his attachment to his wives. No man has ever believed in a woman more than her own husband, and no woman has ever believed in a man more than her own father, even if she were given in marriage for twelve ounces of gold. And behold, one of you may exaggerate in the dowry of his wife until there remains animosity towards her in his heart, and he might even say, "I spent my dowry on you, whether it was the high status or the low status."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Do not exaggerate in the dowry of women, for if it were honorable in this world or a means of righteousness before Allah, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, would have been the most truthful in his attachment to his wives. No man has ever believed in a woman more than her own husband, and no woman has ever believed in a man more than her own father, even if she were given in marriage for twelve ounces of gold. And behold, one of you may exaggerate in the dowry of his wife until there remains animosity towards her in his heart, and he might even say, "I spent my dowry on you, whether it was the high status or the low status."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَلَا لَا تُغَالُوا فِي صُدُقِ النِّسَاءِ فَإِنَّهَا لَوْ كَانَتْ مَكْرُمَةً فِي الدُّنْيَا أَوْ تَقْوَى عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَانَ أَوْلَاكُمْ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَا أَصْدَقَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ نِسَائِهِ وَلَا أُصْدِقَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ بَنَاتِهِ فَوْقَ اثْنَتَيْ عَشْرَةَ أُوقِيَّةً أَلَا وَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَيُغَالِي بِصَدَاقِ امْرَأَتِهِ حَتَّى يَبْقَى لَهَا فِي نَفْسِهِ عَدَاوَةٌ حَتَّى يَقُولَ «كَلِفْتُ لْكِ عَلَقَ الْقِرْبَةِ أَوْ عَرَقَ الْقِرْبَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Hushaym \u003e Manṣūr b. Zādhān \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Abū al-ʿAjfāʾ al-Sulamī \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb Yakhṭub Faḥamid Allāh And ʾAthná ʿAlayh Thum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ زَاذَانَ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَجْفَاءِ السُّلَمِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ يَخْطُبُ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2247

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَجُوزُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَهْرًا
chapter.englishTitle: What is not allowed to be a dowry

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, I have dedicated myself to Allah and His Messenger." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I have no need for women." A man said, "Marry her to me." He said, "Give her a garment." He replied, "I cannot find one." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Give her even if it is an iron ring." He said, "I do not have anything from the Quran." The Prophet ﷺ asked, "Do you possess any knowledge from the Quran?" He replied, "Yes, I do." The Prophet ﷺ then said, "Then I have married her to you based on the knowledge you have from the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, I have dedicated myself to Allah and His Messenger." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I have no need for women." A man said, "Marry her to me." He said, "Give her a garment." He replied, "I cannot find one." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Give her even if it is an iron ring." He said, "I do not have anything from the Quran." The Prophet ﷺ asked, "Do you possess any knowledge from the Quran?" He replied, "Yes, I do." The Prophet ﷺ then said, "Then I have married her to you based on the knowledge you have from the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهَا وَهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا لِي فِي النِّسَاءِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ» فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ زَوِّجْنِيهَا فَقَالَ «أَعْطِهَا ثَوْبًا» فَقَالَ لَا أَجِدُ قَالَ «أَعْطِهَا وَلَوْ خَاتَمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ قَالَ فَاعْتَلَّ لَهُ» فَقَالَ «مَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ» قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ «فَقَدْ زَوَّجْتُكَهَا عَلَى مَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2248

chapter.englishTitle: In the sermon of marriage

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught us the address in case of some need: Praise be to Allah from Whom we ask help and pardon, and in Whom we take refuge from the evils within ourselves. He whom Allah guides has no one who can lead him astray, and he whom He leads astray has no one to guide him. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Apostle. "You who believe,...fear Allah by Whom you ask your mutual rights, and reverence the wombs. Allah has been watching you." ..."you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and die only as Muslims" ...."you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and die only as Muslims"....."you who believe, fear Allah and say what is true. He will make your deeds sound, and forgive your sins. He who obeys Allah and His Apostle has achieved a mighty success." The narrator, Muhammad ibn Sulayman, did mention the word "inna" (verily).
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught us the address in case of some need: Praise be to Allah from Whom we ask help and pardon, and in Whom we take refuge from the evils within ourselves. He whom Allah guides has no one who can lead him astray, and he whom He leads astray has no one to guide him. I testify that there is no god but Allah, and I testify that Muhammad is His servant and Apostle. "You who believe,...fear Allah by Whom you ask your mutual rights, and reverence the wombs. Allah has been watching you." ..."you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and die only as Muslims" ...."you who believe, fear Allah as He should be feared, and die only as Muslims"....."you who believe, fear Allah and say what is true. He will make your deeds sound, and forgive your sins. He who obeys Allah and His Apostle has achieved a mighty success." The narrator, Muhammad ibn Sulayman, did mention the word "inna" (verily).
hadiths.arabic: عَلَّمَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ خُطْبَةَ الْحَاجَةِ «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ أَوْ إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ لِلَّهِ نَحْمَدُهُ وَنَسْتَعِينُهُ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُهُ وَنَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شُرُورِ أَنْفُسِنَا مَنْ يَهْدِهِ اللَّهُ فَلَا مُضِلَّ لَهُ وَمَنْ يُضْلِلْ فَلَا هَادِيَ لَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ» ثُمَّ يَقْرَأُ ثَلَاثَ آيَاتٍ {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ} [آل عمران 102] {يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِى تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَاْلْأَرْحَامِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا} {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا} [الأحزاب 71] ثُمَّ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِحَاجَتِهِ
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd And Ḥajjāj \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū ʿUbaydah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ وَحَجَّاجٌ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2249

chapter.englishTitle: Conditions in marriage

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Prophet said: “The conditions most deserving to be fulfilled are those by means of which the private parts become permissible for you.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the Prophet said: “The conditions most deserving to be fulfilled are those by means of which the private parts become permissible for you.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ أَحَقَّ الشُّرُوطِ أَنْ تُوفُوا بِهِ مَا اسْتَحْلَلْتُمْ بِهِ الْفُرُوجَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Jaʿfar \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Marthad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2250

chapter.englishTitle: At the feast

hadiths.englishRaw: the Prophet saw traces of yellow perfume on 'Abdur-Rahmaan bin 'Awf, and he asked him “What is this?” He said: “O Messenger of Allah, I married a women for the weight of a Nawah (Stone) of gold. He said: “May Allah bless you. Give a feast even if it is only with one sheep.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Prophet saw traces of yellow perfume on 'Abdur-Rahmaan bin 'Awf, and he asked him “What is this?” He said: “O Messenger of Allah, I married a women for the weight of a Nawah (Stone) of gold. He said: “May Allah bless you. Give a feast even if it is only with one sheep.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ رَأَى عَلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ صُفْرَةً فَقَالَ «مَا هَذِهِ الصُّفْرَةُ؟» قَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً عَلَى وَزْنِ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ قَالَ «بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2251

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي إِجَابَةِ الْوَلِيمَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What came in the response of the banquet?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you is invited to a feast, let him accept the invitation." Abu Muhammad said, "He should accept the invitation, but it is not obligatory for him to eat."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "When one of you is invited to a feast, let him accept the invitation." Abu Muhammad said, "He should accept the invitation, but it is not obligatory for him to eat."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى وَلِيمَةٍ فَلْيُجِبْ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُجِيبَ وَلَيْسَ الْأَكْلُ عَلَيْهِ بِوَاجِبٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2252

chapter.englishTitle: Injustice between women

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: When a man has two wives and he is inclined to one of them, he will come on the Day of resurrection with a side hanging down.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: When a man has two wives and he is inclined to one of them, he will come on the Day of resurrection with a side hanging down.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتَانِ فَمَالَ إِلَى إِحْدَاهُمَا جَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَشِقُّهُ مَائِلٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Naḍr b. Anas \u003e Bashīr b. Nahīk \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ نَهِيكٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2253

chapter.englishTitle: In the division among women

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to divide his time equally and said: O Allah, this is my division concerning what I control, so do not blame me concerning what You control and I do not. Abu Dawud said: By it meant the heart.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to divide his time equally and said: O Allah, this is my division concerning what I control, so do not blame me concerning what You control and I do not. Abu Dawud said: By it meant the heart.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقْسِمُ فَيَعْدِلُ وَيَقُولُ «اللَّهُمَّ هَذِا قَسْمِي فِيمَا أَمْلِكُ فَلَا تَلُمْنِي فِيمَا تَمْلِكُ وَلَا أَمْلِكُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd al-Khaṭmī \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْخَطْمِيِّ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2254

chapter.englishTitle: The man has women.

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic text into English is as follows: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to race with his wives while traveling, and whichever of them surpassed him, her arrow would go out with him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic text into English is as follows: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to race with his wives while traveling, and whichever of them surpassed him, her arrow would go out with him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا سَافَرَ أَقْرَعَ بَيْنَ نِسَائِهِ فَأَيَّتُهُنَّ خَرَجَ سَهْمُهَا خَرَجَ بِهَا مَعَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Yūnus b. Yazīd \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2255

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْإِقَامَةِ عِنْدَ الثَّيِّبِ وَالْبِكْرِ إِذَا بَنَى بِهِمَا
chapter.englishTitle: Residence with Thayyib and Bakr when building with them

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Messenger of Allah said: “Three days for a previously-married woman and seven days for a virgin.”     – Sound
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah said: “Three days for a previously-married woman and seven days for a virgin.”     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لِلْبِكْرِ سَبْعٌ وَلِلثَّيِّبِ ثَلَاثٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2256

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْإِقَامَةِ عِنْدَ الثَّيِّبِ وَالْبِكْرِ إِذَا بَنَى بِهِمَا
chapter.englishTitle: Residence with Thayyib and Bakr when building with them

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ married Umm Salamah, he stayed with her three night, and said: Your people (i.e. clan) are not being humbled for you in my estimation. If you wish I shall stay with you seven nights; and if I stay with you seven nights, I shall stay with my other wives seven nights.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ married Umm Salamah, he stayed with her three night, and said: Your people (i.e. clan) are not being humbled for you in my estimation. If you wish I shall stay with you seven nights; and if I stay with you seven nights, I shall stay with my other wives seven nights.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ أَقَامَ عِنْدَهَا ثَلَاثًا وَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِكِ عَلَى أَهْلِكِ هَوَانٌ إِنْ شِئْتِ سَبَّعْتُ لَكِ وَإِنْ سَبَّعْتُ لَكِ سَبَّعْتُ لِسَائِرِ نِسَائِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥammad b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abū Bakr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Ḥārith b. Hishām from his father \u003e Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2257

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ بِنَاءِ الرَّجُلِ بِأَهْلِهِ فِي شَوَّالٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Building a man with his family in Shawwal

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from 'Urwah, that 'Aishah said: "The Messenger of Allah married me in Shawwal and my marriage was consummated in Shawwal." --'Aishah liked for her women's marriages to be consummated in Shawwal --"and which of his wives was more beloved to him than me?"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from 'Urwah, that 'Aishah said: "The Messenger of Allah married me in Shawwal and my marriage was consummated in Shawwal." --'Aishah liked for her women's marriages to be consummated in Shawwal --"and which of his wives was more beloved to him than me?"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: تَزَوَّجَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي شَوَّالٍ وَأُدْخِلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِي شَوَّالٍ فَأَيُّ نِسَائِهِ كَانَ أَحْظَى عِنْدَهُ مِنِّي؟ قَالَتْ «وَكَانَتْ تَسْتَحِبُّ أَنْ تُدْخِلَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ فِي شَوَّالٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Umayyah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUrwah \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2258

chapter.englishTitle: The saying during intercourse

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "If anyone of you, when having sexual intercourse with his wife, says: (Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-Shaitana wa jannibish-Shaitana ma razaqtana) 'In the Name of Allah, O Allah! Protect me from Shaitan and protect what you bestow upon us from Shaitan' - then if Allah decrees that they should have a child, Shaitan will not be able to harm him.'"
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "If anyone of you, when having sexual intercourse with his wife, says: (Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-Shaitana wa jannibish-Shaitana ma razaqtana) 'In the Name of Allah, O Allah! Protect me from Shaitan and protect what you bestow upon us from Shaitan' - then if Allah decrees that they should have a child, Shaitan will not be able to harm him.'"
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَا يَمْنَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ حِينَ يُجَامِعُ أَهْلَهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا «فَإِنْ قَضَى اللَّهُ وَلَدًا لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ الشَّيْطَانُ»
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Sālim \u003e Kurayb \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2259

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ إِتْيَانِ النِّسَاءِ فِي أَعْجَازِهِنَّ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of approaching women without their permission in the...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Verily, Allah is not shy of the truth. Do not enter upon women in their private quarters."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "Verily, Allah is not shy of the truth. Do not enter upon women in their private quarters."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ لَا تَأْتُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي أَعْجَازِهِنَّ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e al-Walīd b. Kathīr \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ḥuṣayn \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿAmr b. Qays al-Khaṭmī \u003e Haramī b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khuzaymah b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ قَيْسٍ الْخَطْمِيِّ عَنْ هَرَمِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ خُزَيْمَةَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2260

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ إِتْيَانِ النِّسَاءِ فِي أَعْجَازِهِنَّ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of approaching women without their permission in the...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, the Jews said to the Muslims: Whoever approaches his wife from behind, his child will be illegitimate. So Allah, the Exalted, revealed: "Your women are a plowed field for you, so come to your field however you wish." [Al-Baqarah 223].
hadiths.body: "Indeed, the Jews said to the Muslims: Whoever approaches his wife from behind, his child will be illegitimate. So Allah, the Exalted, revealed: "Your women are a plowed field for you, so come to your field however you wish." [Al-Baqarah 223].
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ قَالُوا لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ مُدْبِرَةٌ جَاءَ وَلَدُهُ أَحْوَلَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {نِسَاؤُكُمْ حَرْثٌ لَكُمْ فَأْتُوا حَرْثَكُمْ أَنَّى شِئْتُمْ} [البقرة 223]
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2261

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَرَى الْمَرْأَةَ فَيَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The man sees a woman and is afraid for himself.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a woman who impressed him, so he went to Sawdah while she was making perfume and had women with her. He asked them to leave him alone, fulfilled his need and then said, "If any man sees a woman who impresses him, let him go to his wife, for she has the same qualities as the other woman."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ saw a woman who impressed him, so he went to Sawdah while she was making perfume and had women with her. He asked them to leave him alone, fulfilled his need and then said, "If any man sees a woman who impresses him, let him go to his wife, for she has the same qualities as the other woman."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ امْرَأَةً فَأَعْجَبَتْهُ فَأَتَى سَوْدَةَ وَهِيَ تَصْنَعُ طِيبًا وَعِنْدَهَا نِسَاءٌ فَأَخْلَيْنَهُ فَقَضَى حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ رَأَى امْرَأَةً تُعْجِبُهُ فَلْيَقُمْ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَإِنَّ مَعَهَا مِثْلَ الَّذِي مَعَهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Ḥallām \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَلَّامٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2262

chapter.englishTitle: In the marriage of virgins

hadiths.englishRaw: "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, and when we camped, I hurried and someone riding caught up with me. He said, 'I turned back and there was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with me.' He said to me, 'What made you hurry, Jabir?' I said, 'I am newly married.' He said, 'Did you marry a virgin or a previously married woman?' I said, 'No, a previously married woman.' He said, 'Why didn't you marry a virgin so you could play with her and she could play with you?' Then he said to me, 'When you enter (your wife), do so from the easy direction.' When we entered (Medina), we waited until it was evening, meaning it was time for dinner, so that she could tidy her hair and put on perfume."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, and when we camped, I hurried and someone riding caught up with me. He said, 'I turned back and there was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with me.' He said to me, 'What made you hurry, Jabir?' I said, 'I am newly married.' He said, 'Did you marry a virgin or a previously married woman?' I said, 'No, a previously married woman.' He said, 'Why didn't you marry a virgin so you could play with her and she could play with you?' Then he said to me, 'When you enter (your wife), do so from the easy direction.' When we entered (Medina), we waited until it was evening, meaning it was time for dinner, so that she could tidy her hair and put on perfume."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي سَفَرٍ فَلَمَّا قَفَلْنَا تَعَجَّلْتُ فَلَحِقَنِي رَاكِبٌ قَالَ فَالْتَفَتُّ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ لِي «مَا أَعْجَلَكَ يَا جَابِرُ؟» قَالَ إِنِّي حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِعُرْسٍ قَالَ «أَفَبِكْرًا تَزَوَّجْتَهَا أَمْ ثَيِّبًا» قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلْ ثَيِّبًا قَالَ «فَهَلَّا بِكْرًا تُلَاعِبُهَا وَتُلَاعِبُكَ» قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي «إِذَا قَدِمْتَ فَالْكَيْسَ الْكَيْسَ» قَالَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا ذَهَبْنَا نَدْخُلُ قَالَ «أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى نَدْخُلَ لَيْلًا أَيْ عِشَاءً لِكَيْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muṭīʿ \u003e Hushaym Anbaʾnā Sayyār \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُطِيعٍ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أََنْبَأنَا سَيَّارٌ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2263

chapter.englishTitle: In Al Ghaylah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I had intended to forbid the practice of Ghila (maternal aunt) but then I remembered that the Persians and the Romans practice it and it does not harm their children." Abu Muhammad said, "Ghila refers to sexual intercourse with a woman while she is breastfeeding."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "I had intended to forbid the practice of Ghila (maternal aunt) but then I remembered that the Persians and the Romans practice it and it does not harm their children." Abu Muhammad said, "Ghila refers to sexual intercourse with a woman while she is breastfeeding."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَنْهَى عَنِ الْغِيلَةِ حَتَّى ذَكَرْتُ أَنَّ فَارِسَ وَالرُّومَ يَصْنَعُونَ ذَلِكَ فَلَا يَضُرُّ أَوْلَادَهُمْ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «الْغِيلَةُ أَنْ يُجَامِعَهَا وَهِيَ تُرْضِعُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Nawfal al-Asadī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Judāmah b. Wahbal-Asadiyyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ الْأَسَدِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ جُدَامَةَ بِنْتِ وَهْبٍ الْأَسَدِيَّةِ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2264

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ ضَرْبِ النِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of hitting women

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never struck a servant and he never struck anything with his hand except when he was fighting in the cause of Allah, the Almighty and Glorious."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never struck a servant and he never struck anything with his hand except when he was fighting in the cause of Allah, the Almighty and Glorious."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا ضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَادِمًا قَطُّ وَلَا ضَرَبَ بِيَدِهِ شَيْئًا إِلَّا أَنْ يُجَاهِدَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأََنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2265

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ ضَرْبِ النِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of hitting women

hadiths.englishRaw: Do not beat Allah's handmaidens, but when Umar came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: Women have become emboldened towards their husbands, he (the Prophet) gave permission to beat them. Then many women came round the family of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complaining against their husbands. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Many women have gone round Muhammad's family complaining against their husbands. They are not the best among you.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Do not beat Allah's handmaidens, but when Umar came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: Women have become emboldened towards their husbands, he (the Prophet) gave permission to beat them. Then many women came round the family of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ complaining against their husbands. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Many women have gone round Muhammad's family complaining against their husbands. They are not the best among you.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَضْرِبُوا إِمَاءَ اللَّهِ» فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ قَدْ ذَئِرْنَ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ فَرَخَّصَ لَهُمْ فِي ضَرْبِهِنَّ فَأَطَافَ بِآلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ نِسَاءٌ كَثِيرٌ يَشْكُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُنَّ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَقَدْ طَافَ بِآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ نِسَاءٌ كَثِيرٌ يَشْكُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُنَّ لَيْسَ أُولَئِكَ بِخِيَارِكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Iyās b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Dhubāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي ذُبَابٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2266

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ ضَرْبِ النِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of hitting women

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to the people one day, and he advised them about women. He said, "What is the matter with a man who beats his wife like the beating of a slave, and then he lies with her on the last day?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon to the people one day, and he advised them about women. He said, "What is the matter with a man who beats his wife like the beating of a slave, and then he lies with her on the last day?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ النَّاسَ يَوْمًا وَوَعَظَهُمْ فِي النِّسَاءِ فَقَالَ «مَا بَالُ الرَّجُلِ يَجْلِدُ امْرَأَتَهُ جَلْدَ الْعَبْدِ وَلَعَلَّهُ يُضَاجِعُهَا فِي آخِرِ يَوْمِهِ؟ ‍‍»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn Anbʾanā Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Zamaʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبأَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَمَعَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2267

chapter.englishTitle: Management of One's Household

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, woman was created from a rib, and indeed, if you try to straighten her, you will break her. So, treat her kindly, as there is goodness in her and she is your partner."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, woman was created from a rib, and indeed, if you try to straighten her, you will break her. So, treat her kindly, as there is goodness in her and she is your partner."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ خُلِقَتْ مِنْ ضِلَعٍ فَإِنْ تُقِمْهَا كَسَرْتَهَا فَدَارِهَا فَإِنَّ فِيهَا أَوَدًا وَبُلْغَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Nuʿaym b. Qaʿnab \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2268

chapter.englishTitle: Management of One's Household

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, a woman is like a rib: if you straighten her, she will break; and if you enjoy her, you enjoy her with her flaw."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, a woman is like a rib: if you straighten her, she will break; and if you enjoy her, you enjoy her with her flaw."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا الْمَرْأَةُ كَالضِّلَعِ إِنْ تُقِمْهَا تَكْسِرْهَا وَإِنْ تَسْتَمْتِعْ بها تَسْتَمْتِعْ وَفِيهَا عِوَجٌ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2269

chapter.englishTitle: In isolation

hadiths.englishRaw: “A man asked the Messenger of about coitus interruptus. He said: 'Do you do that? If you do not do so, it will not harm; for there is no soul that (SWT) has decreed will exist but it will come into being.' “     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “A man asked the Messenger of about coitus interruptus. He said: 'Do you do that? If you do not do so, it will not harm; for there is no soul that (SWT) has decreed will exist but it will come into being.' “     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْعَزْلِ؟ فَقَالَ «أَوَ تَفْعَلُونَ ذَلِكَ فَلَا عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لَا تَفْعَلُوا فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ نَسَمَةٍ قَضَى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنْ تَكُونَ إِلَّا كَانَتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Dāwud al-Hāshimī \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2270

chapter.englishTitle: In isolation

hadiths.englishRaw: We said, "O Messenger of Allah, if a man has a slave-girl and he dislikes that she becomes pregnant, should he separate from her? And if a man has a wife who is breastfeeding and he dislikes that she becomes pregnant, should he separate from her?" He said, "It is not upon you to do so, as it is a matter of fate." Ibn 'Awn said, "I mentioned this to Al-Hasan, and he said, 'By Allah, it is as if this is a prohibition, and by Allah, it is as if this is a prohibition.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We said, "O Messenger of Allah, if a man has a slave-girl and he dislikes that she becomes pregnant, should he separate from her? And if a man has a wife who is breastfeeding and he dislikes that she becomes pregnant, should he separate from her?" He said, "It is not upon you to do so, as it is a matter of fate." Ibn 'Awn said, "I mentioned this to Al-Hasan, and he said, 'By Allah, it is as if this is a prohibition, and by Allah, it is as if this is a prohibition.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ تَكُونُ لَهُ الْجَارِيَةُ فَيُصِيبُ مِنْهَا وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ أَفَيَعْزِلُ عَنْهَا؟ وَتَكُونُ عِنْدَهُ الْمَرْأَةُ تُرْضِعُ فَيُصِيبُ مِنْهَا وَيَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ أَفَيَعْزِلُ عَنْهَا؟ قَالَ «لَا عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ لَا تَفْعَلُوا فَإِنَّمَا هُوَ الْقَدَرُ» قَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلْحَسَنِ فَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لَكَأَنَّ هَذَا زَجْرًا وَاللَّهِ لَكَأَنَّ هَذَا زَجْرًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Bishr Yarud al-Ḥadīth \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأََنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ يَرُدُّ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2271

chapter.englishTitle: In jealousy

hadiths.englishRaw: Nothing is more loveable to Allah than His praise as He has praised Himself and no one is more self-respecting than Allah Himself and it As because of this that He has prohibited abominable acts.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Nothing is more loveable to Allah than His praise as He has praised Himself and no one is more self-respecting than Allah Himself and it As because of this that He has prohibited abominable acts.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَغْيَرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ لِذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Shaqīq \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2272

chapter.englishTitle: In jealousy

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: From jealousy there is that which Allah loves, and from it there is that which Allah hates. The jealousy that Allah loves is the jealousy regarding suspicion, and the jealousy that Allah hates is the jealousy without any basis for suspicion."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: From jealousy there is that which Allah loves, and from it there is that which Allah hates. The jealousy that Allah loves is the jealousy regarding suspicion, and the jealousy that Allah hates is the jealousy without any basis for suspicion."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مِنَ الْغَيْرَةِ مَا يُحِبُّ اللَّهُ وَمِنْهَا مَا يُبْغِضُ اللَّهُ فَالْغَيْرَةُ الَّتِي يُحِبُّ اللَّهُ الْغَيْرَةُ فِي الرِّيبَةِ وَالْغَيْرَةُ الَّتِي يُبْغِضُ اللَّهُ الْغَيْرَةُ فِي غَيْرِ رِيبَةٍ
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Ibn Jābir b. ʿAtīk from my father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَتِيكٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2273

chapter.englishTitle: In jealousy

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was informed that Sa'd ibn Ubada said, "If I found a man with her, I would strike her with a sword, not sparing her." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Are you surprised by Sa'd's jealousy? I am more jealous than Sa'd, and Allah is more jealous than me. That is why He has forbidden the committing of indecent acts, whether openly or in secret. No one is more jealous than Allah, and I am the most beloved to Him when seeking forgiveness. That is why Allah sent prophets as bearers of good news and warners. No one is more beloved to Him than the one who praises Allah, and that is why He has promised Paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was informed that Sa'd ibn Ubada said, "If I found a man with her, I would strike her with a sword, not sparing her." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Are you surprised by Sa'd's jealousy? I am more jealous than Sa'd, and Allah is more jealous than me. That is why He has forbidden the committing of indecent acts, whether openly or in secret. No one is more jealous than Allah, and I am the most beloved to Him when seeking forgiveness. That is why Allah sent prophets as bearers of good news and warners. No one is more beloved to Him than the one who praises Allah, and that is why He has promised Paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَلَغَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَادَةَ يَقُولُ لَوْ وَجَدْتُ مَعَهَا رَجُلًا لَضَرَبْتُهَا بِالسَّيْفِ غَيْرَ مُصْفَحٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَتَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ غَيْرَةِ سَعْدٍ أَنَا أَغَيْرُ مِنْ سَعْدٍ وَاللَّهُ أَغَيْرُ مِنِّي وَلِذَلِكَ حَرَّمَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَلَا شَخْصَ أَغَيْرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَعَاذِيرِ وَلِذَلِكَ بَعَثَ النَّبِيِّينَ مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنْذِرِينَ وَلَا شَخْصَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ الْمَدْحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَلِذَلِكَ وَعَدَ الْجَنَّةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e And Rrād a freed slave of al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ وَرَّادٍ مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2274

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي حَقِّ الزَّوْجِ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the right of the husband over the woman

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet (pbuh) said, "When a woman goes to her husband's bed at night and he refuses her, then the angels curse her until she returns."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet (pbuh) said, "When a woman goes to her husband's bed at night and he refuses her, then the angels curse her until she returns."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا بَاتَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ هَاجِرَةً لِفِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا لَعَنَتْهَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah Anbʾanā Qatādah \u003e Zurārah b. Awfá al-ʿĀmirī \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ أَنبأَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى الْعَامِرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2275

chapter.englishTitle: In the mud

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah, what do you think about a man who finds another man with his wife, should he kill him and they kill him, or how should he act?" The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Allah has revealed regarding you and your wife, so go and bring her." Sahil, who was present among the people before the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, cursed her. When they finished cursing each other, he said, "O Messenger of Allah, I lied about her. If I had caught her, I would have divorced her three times before the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, ordered me." Ibn Shihab said, "And that was after the Sunnah of the two who cursed each other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah, what do you think about a man who finds another man with his wife, should he kill him and they kill him, or how should he act?" The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said, "Allah has revealed regarding you and your wife, so go and bring her." Sahil, who was present among the people before the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, cursed her. When they finished cursing each other, he said, "O Messenger of Allah, I lied about her. If I had caught her, I would have divorced her three times before the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, ordered me." Ibn Shihab said, "And that was after the Sunnah of the two who cursed each other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا وَجَدَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ رَجُلًا أَيَقْتُلُهُ فَيَقْتُلُونَهُ أَمْ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «قَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ وَفِي صَاحِبَتِكَ فَاذْهَبْ فَأْتِ بِهَا» قَالَ سَهْلٌ فَتَلَاعَنَا وَأَنَا مَعَ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَا مِنْ تَلَاعُنِهِمَا قَالَ كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتُهَا فَطَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَأْمُرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ بَعْدُ سُنَّةَ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd \u003e ʿŪwaymir al-ʿAjlānī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا الْعَجْلَانِيَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2276

chapter.englishTitle: In the mud

hadiths.englishRaw: A person named 'Uwaymir came to 'Asim ibn 'Adi, who was the leader of Bani 'Ajlan tribe. He mentioned something similar to what he said before, but he did not mention divorcing her three times.   – Sound Chain
