hadiths.body: A person named 'Uwaymir came to 'Asim ibn 'Adi, who was the leader of Bani 'Ajlan tribe. He mentioned something similar to what he said before, but he did not mention divorcing her three times.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عُوَيْمِرًا أَتَى عَاصِمَ بْنَ عَدِيٍّ وَكَانَ سَيِّدَ بَنِي عَجْلَانَ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2277

chapter.englishTitle: In the mud

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was asked about those who were involved in the case of Li'an and if they are to be separated, during the leadership of Mus'ab bin Az-Zubair. I did not know what to say. So I went to the house of Abdullah bin Umar and I sought permission to enter. I was told that he was taking a nap, but he heard me talking and he said: 'Is it Ibn Jubair? Enter. You would not have come except for a need.'"He said: "So I entered and found him lying on a saddlecloth from his mount. I said: 'O Abu Abdur-Rahman! Are those involved in Li'an separated?' He said: 'Glorious is Allah! Yes. The first who asked about that was so-and-so the son of so-and-so. He came to the Prophet and said: "O Messenger of Allah! If one of us saw his wife committing adultery what should he do? If he were to say anything, his statement would be a horrible matter, and if he were to remain silent, his silence about the matter would be horrible." "He said: 'So the Prophet remained silent and did not answer him. Afterwards he came to the Prophet and said: "The one who asked you about it has been tried by it." So Allah revealed these Ayat from Surat An-Nur. And those who accuse their wives and have no witnesses except themselves - until the end of those Ayat. So he called for the man and recited the Ayat to him and admonished him, reminded him, and he told him: "Indeed the punishment of the world is less than the punishment of the Hereafter." So he said: "Nay! By the One Who sent you with the truth! I did not lie about her." Then he did the same with the woman, admonished her and reminding her and he told her: "Indeed the punishment of the world is less than the punishment of the Hereafter." She said: "Nay! By the One Who sent you with the truth! He is not telling the truth.'" "He said: 'So he started with the man: He testified four times, by Allah that he is one of the truthful, and the fifth time that the curse of Allah be upon him if he was one of the liars. Then the same with the woman: She testified four times by Allah, that he was one of the liars, and the fifth time that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was one of the truthful. Then he separated the two of them.'"     – Sound Chain

hadiths.arabic: ادْخُلْ فَمَا جَاءَ بِكَ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ إِلَّا حَاجَةٌ قَالَ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَوَجَدْتُهُ وَهُوَ مُفْتَرِشٌ بَرْذَعَةَ رَحْلِهِ مُتَوَسِّدٌ مِرْفَقَةً أَوْ قَالَ نُمْرُقَةً شَكَّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ حَشْوُهَا لِيفٌ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَانِ أَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا؟ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ نَعَمْ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَنْ سَأَلَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فُلَانٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَنَا رَأَى امْرَأَتَهُ عَلَى فَاحِشَةٍ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ؟ إِنْ سَكَتَ سَكَتَ عَلَى أَمْرٍ عَظِيمٍ وَإِنْ تَكَلَّمَ فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ فَقَامَ لِحَاجَتِهِ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذِي سَأَلْتُكَ عَنْهُ قَدِ ابْتُلِيتُ بِهِ قَالَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى هَؤُلَاءِ الْآيَاتِ الَّتِي فِي سُورَةِ النُّورِ {وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُمْ شُهَدَاءُ إِلَّا أَنْفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ وَالْخَامِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَةَ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ وَيَدْرَأُ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللهِ عَلَيْهَا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِين} َحتى ختم هَؤُلَاءِ الْآيَاتِ قَالَ فَدَعَا الرَّجُلَ فَتَلَاهُنَّ عَلَيْهِ وَذَكَّرَهُ بِاللَّهِ وَأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَذَابَ الدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ فَقَالَ مَا كَذَبْتُ عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ دَعَا الْمَرَأَةَ فَوَعَظَهَا وَذَكَّرَهَا وَأَخْبَرَهَا أَنَّ عَذَابَ الدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْآخِرَةِ فَقَالَتْ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّهُ لَكَاذِبٌ فَدَعَا الرَّجُلَ فَشَهِدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ وَالْخَامِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِالْمَرْأَةِ فَشَهِدَتْ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ وَالْخَامِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا إِنْ كَانَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ ثُمَّ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn Anbʾanā ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abū Sulaymān \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Suʾilt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنبأَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ يَقُولُ سُئِلْتُ عَنِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ فِي إِمَارَةِ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَيُفَرَّقُ بَيْنَهُمَا؟ فَمَا دَرَيْتُ مَا أَقُولُ قَالَ فَقُمْتُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ مَنْزِلَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فَقُلْتُ لِلْغُلَامِ اسْتَأْذِنْ لِي عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ قَائِلٌ لَا تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ فَسَمِعَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ صَوْتِي فَقَالَ ابْنُ جُبَيْرٍ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2278

chapter.englishTitle: In the mud

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ separated between the two cursed ones and reunited the child with his mother.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ separated between the two cursed ones and reunited the child with his mother.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فَرَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَيْنَ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ وَأَلْحَقَ الْوَلَدَ بِأُمِّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2279

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْعَبْدِ يَتَزَوَّجُ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنٍ مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a person marries without permission from his master

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: If any slave marries without the permission of his masters, he is a fornicator.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: If any slave marries without the permission of his masters, he is a fornicator.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ تَزَوَّجَ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ أَوْ أَهْلِهِ فَهُوَ عَاهِرٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. ʿAqīl \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2280

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْعَبْدِ يَتَزَوَّجُ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنٍ مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a person marries without permission from his master

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah narrated that the Prophet said: "Whichever slave gets married without the permission of his owner, then he is a fornicator."
hadiths.body: Abdullah narrated that the Prophet said: "Whichever slave gets married without the permission of his owner, then he is a fornicator."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ تَزَوَّجَ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ مَوَالِيهِ فَهُوَ زَانٍ»
hadiths.chain: Mālik b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Mindal \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUqbah \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا مِنْدَلٌ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2281

chapter.englishTitle: The child to the bed

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The boy is for (the owner of) the bed and the stone is for the person who commits illegal sexual intercourse.'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The boy is for (the owner of) the bed and the stone is for the person who commits illegal sexual intercourse.'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ibn al-Musayyab \u003e Abū Hurayrah Yarfaʿuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2282

chapter.englishTitle: The child to the bed

hadiths.englishRaw: ʿThe child belongs to the (husband or master of the) woman.ʿ     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ʿThe child belongs to the (husband or master of the) woman.ʿ     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2283

chapter.englishTitle: The child to the bed

hadiths.englishRaw: 'Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , said, "Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas made a request to his brother Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas to give him custody of his son from Walidah Zam'ah. Utbah claimed that the child was his. When the Prophet ﷺ arrived during the time of conquest, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas presented the son of Walidah Zam'ah to him. The boy resembled Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas the most. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'He is yours, O Abd ibn Zam'ah, because he was born on his father's bed.' The Prophet ﷺ also said, 'Sawdah bint Zam'ah, cover yourself from him, as he looks like Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: 'Aisha, the wife of the Prophet ﷺ , said, "Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas made a request to his brother Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas to give him custody of his son from Walidah Zam'ah. Utbah claimed that the child was his. When the Prophet ﷺ arrived during the time of conquest, Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas presented the son of Walidah Zam'ah to him. The boy resembled Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas the most. The Prophet ﷺ said, 'He is yours, O Abd ibn Zam'ah, because he was born on his father's bed.' The Prophet ﷺ also said, 'Sawdah bint Zam'ah, cover yourself from him, as he looks like Utbah ibn Abi Waqqas.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ كَانَ عُتْبَةُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَهِدَ إِلَى أَخِيهِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ أَنْ يَقْبِضَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ فَقَالَ عُتْبَةُ إِنَّهُ ابْنِي فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ زَمَنَ الْفَتْحِ أَخَذَ سَعْدُ بْنُ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ ابْنَ وَلِيدَةِ زَمْعَةَ فَإِذَا هو أَشْبَهُ النَّاسِ بِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ هُوَ لَكَ يَا عَبْدُ بْنَ زَمْعَةَ مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ وُلِدَ عَلَى فِرَاشِ أَبِيهِ وَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «احْتَجِبِي مِنْهُ يَا سَوْدَةُ بِنْتَ زَمْعَةَ مِمَّا رَأَى مِنْ شَبَهِهِ بِعُتْبَةَ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ وَسَوْدَةُ بِنْتُ زَمْعَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2284

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ جَحَدَ وَلَدَهُ وَهُوَ يَعْرِفُهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who denies his own son knowing him

hadiths.englishRaw: AbuHurayrah heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say when the verse about invoking curses came down: Any woman who brings to her family one who does not belong to it has nothing to do with Allah (i.e. expects no mercy from Allah), and Allah will not bring her into His Paradise. Allah, the Exalted, will veil Himself from any man who disowns his child when he looks at him, and disgrace him in the presence of all creatures, first and last.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: AbuHurayrah heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say when the verse about invoking curses came down: Any woman who brings to her family one who does not belong to it has nothing to do with Allah (i.e. expects no mercy from Allah), and Allah will not bring her into His Paradise. Allah, the Exalted, will veil Himself from any man who disowns his child when he looks at him, and disgrace him in the presence of all creatures, first and last.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ حِينَ أُنْزِلَتْ آيَةُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ «أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ أَدْخَلَتْ عَلَى قَوْمٍ نَسَبًا لَيْسَ مِنْهُمْ فَلَيْسَتْ مِنَ اللَّهِ فِي شَيْءٍ وَلَن يُدْخِلْهَا اللَّهُ جَنَّتَهُ وَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ جَحَدَ وَلَدَهُ وَهُوَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ احْتَجَبَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ وَفَضَحَهُ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيُّ وَسَعِيدٌ يُحَدِّثَهُ بِهِ بِهََذا وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yūnus \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Saʿīd \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2285

chapter.englishTitle: The man marries his father's wife

hadiths.englishRaw: I met my uncle who was carrying a standard. I asked him: Where are you going? He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has sent me to a man who has married his father's wife. He has ordered me to cut off his head and take his property.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I met my uncle who was carrying a standard. I asked him: Where are you going? He said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has sent me to a man who has married his father's wife. He has ordered me to cut off his head and take his property.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَقِيتُ عَمِّي وَمَعَهُ رَايَةٌ فَقُلْتُ أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ؟ قَالَ «بَعَثَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى رَجُلٍ نَكَحَ امْرَأَةَ أَبِيهِ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ وَآخُذَ مَالَهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar al-Raqqī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Zayd \u003e ʿAdī b. Thābit \u003e Yazīd b. al-Barāʾ from his father \u003e Laqīt ʿAmmī And Maʿah Rāyah \u003e Ayn Turīd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْبَرَاءِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2286

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى لَا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ بَعْدُ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Allah, the Most High: "It is not permissible for y...

hadiths.englishRaw: The question is asking about whether it was permissible for the Prophet's wives ﷺ to remarry after his death. He answered, "Yes, Allah permitted him to marry multiple women and described certain qualities for him." Then he added, "You are not allowed to marry women after this description."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The question is asking about whether it was permissible for the Prophet's wives ﷺ to remarry after his death. He answered, "Yes, Allah permitted him to marry multiple women and described certain qualities for him." Then he added, "You are not allowed to marry women after this description."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَزْوَاجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مُتْنَ كَانَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ إِنَّمَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ ضَرْبًا مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَوَصَفَ لَهُ صِفَةً فَقَالَ «لَا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ بَعْدُ مِنْ بَعْدِ هَذِهِ الصِّفَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e Muḥammad b. Abū Mūsá \u003e a man from al-Anṣār Yusammá Ziyād \u003e Liʾubay b. Kaʿb Araʾayt Law
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنِي مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ يُسَمَّى زِيَادًا قَالَ قُلْتُ لِأُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2287

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى لَا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاءُ مِنْ بَعْدُ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Allah, the Most High: "It is not permissible for y...

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated that 'Aishah said: "The Messenger of Allah did not die until Allah permitted him to marry whatever women he wanted."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated that 'Aishah said: "The Messenger of Allah did not die until Allah permitted him to marry whatever women he wanted."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَا شَاءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2288

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْأَمَةِ يُجْعَلُ عِتْقُهَا صَدَاقَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: In the nation, its freedom is made its ransom

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set Safiyyah free, and made her ransom her dowry, and he married her.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set Safiyyah free, and made her ransom her dowry, and he married her.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَعْتَقَ صَفِيَّةَ وَجَعَلَ عِتْقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Shuʿayb b. al-Ḥabḥāb \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ الْحَبْحَابِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2289

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْأَمَةِ يُجْعَلُ عِتْقُهَا صَدَاقَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: In the nation, its freedom is made its ransom

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set Safiyyah free, and made her ransom her dowry, and he married her.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set Safiyyah free, and made her ransom her dowry, and he married her.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَعْتَقَ صَفِيَّةَ وَتَزَوَّجَهَا وَجَعَلَ عِتْقَهَا صَدَاقَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2290

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَمَةً ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The favor of one who freed a slave and then married her.

hadiths.englishRaw: I was with Ash-Sha'abi (a scholar) when a man from the people of Khurasan came to him and said, "O Abu Amr, the people of Khurasan say that if a man frees his slave and then marries her, he is like a rider whose mount is tired. Is this true?" Ash-Sha'abi said, "Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa informed me that his father said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There are three whose reward is given twice: a man from the people of the Book who believed in his prophet and then believed in the Prophet ﷺ and followed him, and a slave who fulfilled the rights of Allah and the rights of his master, and a man who had a female slave and he fed her and treated her well and taught her well. Then he set her free and married her." Ash-Sha'abi then said to the man, "Take this hadith without doubt, for he used to travel to Medina for matters less important than this." Hushaim said, "They informed me in Basra, so I went to him and asked him about it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I was with Ash-Sha'abi (a scholar) when a man from the people of Khurasan came to him and said, "O Abu Amr, the people of Khurasan say that if a man frees his slave and then marries her, he is like a rider whose mount is tired. Is this true?" Ash-Sha'abi said, "Abu Burdah ibn Abi Musa informed me that his father said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There are three whose reward is given twice: a man from the people of the Book who believed in his prophet and then believed in the Prophet ﷺ and followed him, and a slave who fulfilled the rights of Allah and the rights of his master, and a man who had a female slave and he fed her and treated her well and taught her well. Then he set her free and married her." Ash-Sha'abi then said to the man, "Take this hadith without doubt, for he used to travel to Medina for matters less important than this." Hushaim said, "They informed me in Basra, so I went to him and asked him about it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ الشَّعْبِيِّ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ خُرَاسَانَ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَمْرٍو إِنَّ مَنْ قِبَلَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِ خُرَاسَانَ يَقُولُونَ فِي الرَّجُلِ إِذَا أَعْتَقَ أَمَتَهُ ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا فَهُوَ كَالرَّاكِبِ بَدَنَتَهُ؟ فَقَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ بْنُ أَبِي مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلَاثَةٌ يُؤْتَوْنَ أَجْرَهُمْ مَرَّتَيْنِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ آمَنَ بِنَبِيِّهِ ثُمَّ أَدْرَكَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَآمَنَ بِهِ وَاتَّبَعَهُ وَعَبْدٌ مَمْلُوكٌ أَدَّى حَقَّ اللَّهِ وَحَقَّ مَوَالِيهِ فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ وَرَجُلٌ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَمَةٌ فَغَذَّاهَا فَأَحْسَنَ غِذَاءَهَا وَأَدَّبَهَا فَأَحْسَنَ تَأْدِيبَهَا فَأَعْتَقَهَا وَتَزَوَّجَهَا فَلَهُ أَجْرَانِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلرَّجُلِ «خُذْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ بِغَيْرِ شَيْءٍ فَقَدْ كَانَ يُرْحَلُ فِيمَا دُونَ هَذَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ» فَقَالَ هُشَيْمٌ أَفَادُونِي بِالْبَصْرَةِ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهُ؟   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Hushaym \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Ṣāliḥ b. Ḥay al-Hamdānī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ صَالِحِ بْنِ حَيٍّ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2291

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ فَضْلِ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ أَمَةً ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The favor of one who freed a slave and then married her.

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Ḥay \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Abū Burdah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ حَيٍّ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2292

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَتَزَوَّجُ الْمَرْأَةَ فَيَمُوتُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْرِضَ لَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The man marries the woman and dies before imposing upon her.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah narrated that there was a man who married a woman without giving her any dowry, nor did he consummate the marriage with her. Then, he passed away from her. The Prophet ﷺ ruled that she should receive her bridal gift, observe the waiting period (iddah), and inherit from him. Ma'qil al-Ashja'i said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled similarly regarding Bura' bint Washiq, a woman from the Banu Ru'as tribe.' Hearing this, Muhammad and Sufyan rejoiced, and both said, 'We will follow this ruling.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah narrated that there was a man who married a woman without giving her any dowry, nor did he consummate the marriage with her. Then, he passed away from her. The Prophet ﷺ ruled that she should receive her bridal gift, observe the waiting period (iddah), and inherit from him. Ma'qil al-Ashja'i said, 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled similarly regarding Bura' bint Washiq, a woman from the Banu Ru'as tribe.' Hearing this, Muhammad and Sufyan rejoiced, and both said, 'We will follow this ruling.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فَرَضَ لَهَا شَيْئًا وَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا وَمَاتَ عَنْهَا قَالَ فِيهَا لَهَا صَدَاقُ نِسَائِهَا وَعَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةُ وَلَهَا الْمِيرَاثُ قَالَ مَعْقِلٌ الْأَشْجَعِيُّ «قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بِرْوَعَ بِنْتِ وَاشِقٍ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي رُؤَاسٍ بِمِثْلِ مَا قَضَيْتَ» قَالَ فَفَرِحَ بِذَلِكَ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَسُفْيَانُ نَأْخُذُ بِهَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2293

chapter.englishTitle: What is prohibited from breastfeeding

hadiths.englishRaw: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, there is a man asking permission to enter your house.' The Messenger of Allah said: 'I think it is so-and-so the paternal uncle of Hafsah through breast-feeding.' 'Aishah said: If so-and-so (her own paternal uncle through breast-feeding) were alive, would he be allowed to enter upon me?' The Messenger of Allah said: 'What becomes unlawful (for marriage) through breast-feeding is that which becomes unlawful through birth.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, there is a man asking permission to enter your house.' The Messenger of Allah said: 'I think it is so-and-so the paternal uncle of Hafsah through breast-feeding.' 'Aishah said: If so-and-so (her own paternal uncle through breast-feeding) were alive, would he be allowed to enter upon me?' The Messenger of Allah said: 'What becomes unlawful (for marriage) through breast-feeding is that which becomes unlawful through birth.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي بَيْتِ حَفْصَةَ فَسَمِعَتْ صَوْتَ إِنْسَانٍ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ إِنْسَانٍ فِي بَيْتِكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أُرَاهُ فُلَانًا لِعَمِّ حَفْصَةَ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ» قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلَوْ كَانَ فُلَانٌ حَيًّا لِعَمِّهَا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَعَمْ يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الْوِلَادَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Rawḥ \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm \u003e ʿAmrah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2294

chapter.englishTitle: What is prohibited from breastfeeding

hadiths.englishRaw: Her uncle, the brother of her father Al-Quais, came to seek permission from her after the veiling of women had been commanded. She refused to give him permission until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and sought permission for him. When the Prophet ﷺ came, she mentioned this to him, and she said, "My uncle, the brother of my father, came, and I kept repeating it until I sought your permission." He said, "Isn't he your uncle?" She said, "He breastfed me, but I was not breastfed by a man." He said, "He is your uncle, so let him enter upon you." Aisha used to say that what is forbidden by birth is also forbidden by breastfeeding.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Her uncle, the brother of her father Al-Quais, came to seek permission from her after the veiling of women had been commanded. She refused to give him permission until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came and sought permission for him. When the Prophet ﷺ came, she mentioned this to him, and she said, "My uncle, the brother of my father, came, and I kept repeating it until I sought your permission." He said, "Isn't he your uncle?" She said, "He breastfed me, but I was not breastfed by a man." He said, "He is your uncle, so let him enter upon you." Aisha used to say that what is forbidden by birth is also forbidden by breastfeeding.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَمَّهَا أَخَا أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ جَاءَ يَسْتَأْذِنُ عَلَيْهَا بَعْدَمَا ضُرِبَ الْحِجَابُ فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَأْذَنَ لَهُ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَسْتَأْذِنَهُ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ ذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَتْ جَاءَ عَمِّي أَخُو أَبِي الْقُعَيْسِ فَرَدَدْتُهُ حَتَّى أَسْتَأْذِنَكَ قَالَ «أَوَ لَيْسَ بِعَمِّكِ؟» قَالَتْ إِنَّمَا أَرْضَعَتْنِي الْمَرْأَةُ وَلَمْ يُرْضِعْنِي الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ «إِنَّهُ عَمُّكِ فَلْيَلِجْ عَلَيْكِ» فَقََالَتْ وَكَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ تَقُولُ يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الْوِلَادَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn Anbʾanā Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنبأَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2295

chapter.englishTitle: What is prohibited from breastfeeding

hadiths.englishRaw: "What becomes unlawful through breastfeeding is that which becomes unlawful through birth."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "What becomes unlawful through breastfeeding is that which becomes unlawful through birth."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ مَا يَحْرُمُ مِنَ الْوِلَادَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ṣadaqah b. al-Faḍl \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2296

chapter.englishTitle: What is prohibited from breastfeeding

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ like him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ like him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿAmrah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ مَالِكٌ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2297

chapter.englishTitle: How many times is breastfeeding prohibited?

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Prophet Allah said: “Suckling once or twice does not make (marriage) unlawful.”    – Sound
hadiths.body: that the Prophet Allah said: “Suckling once or twice does not make (marriage) unlawful.”    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تُحَرِّمُ الْمَصَّةُ وَالْمَصَّتَانِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2298

chapter.englishTitle: How many times is breastfeeding prohibited?

hadiths.englishRaw: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have married one woman while I still have another, and the first woman claims that she breastfed the newborn." He said, "Breastfeeding does not make prohibited (marriage) or create the relationship of foster children."
hadiths.body: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have married one woman while I still have another, and the first woman claims that she breastfed the newborn." He said, "Breastfeeding does not make prohibited (marriage) or create the relationship of foster children."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً وَعِنْدِي أُخْرَى فَزَعَمَتِ الْأُولَى أَنَّهَا أَرْضَعَتِ الْحُدْثَى فَقَالَ «لَا تُحَرِّمُ الْإِمْلَاجَةُ وَلَا الْإِمْلَاجَتَانِ»
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū al-Khalīl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Um al-Faḍl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أُمِّ الْفَضْلِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2299

chapter.englishTitle: How many times is breastfeeding prohibited?

hadiths.englishRaw: A’ishah said “In what was sent down in the Qu’ran ten suckling’s made marriage unlawful, but they were abrogated by five known ones and when the Prophet ﷺ dies, these words were among what was recited in the Qur’an.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A’ishah said “In what was sent down in the Qu’ran ten suckling’s made marriage unlawful, but they were abrogated by five known ones and when the Prophet ﷺ dies, these words were among what was recited in the Qur’an.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ بِعَشْرِ رَضَعَاتٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ يُحَرِّمْنَ ثُمَّ نُسِخْنَ بِخَمْسٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ فَتُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُنَّ مِمَّا يُقْرَأُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Rawḥ \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Bakr \u003e ʿAmrah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ أَنْبَأََنَا رَوْحٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2300

chapter.englishTitle: What removes the criticism of breastfeeding?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, how can I pay back the dues of the one who breast-fed me?' He said: 'By giving a male or female slave.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, how can I pay back the dues of the one who breast-fed me?' He said: 'By giving a male or female slave.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا يُذْهِبُ عَنِّي مَذَمَّةَ الرَّضَاعِ قَالَ «الْغُرَّةُ الْعَبْدُ أَوِ الْأَمَةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e Hishām from his father \u003e Ḥajjāj b. Ḥajjāj al-Aslamī from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ حَجَّاجٍ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2301

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ شَهَادَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْوَاحِدَةِ عَلَى الرَّضَاعِ
chapter.englishTitle: The testimony of one woman regarding breastfeeding.

hadiths.englishRaw: He did not inform me, but I heard him telling the people that he married the daughter of Abu Ihab, and then a black female slave came and said, "I breastfed both of you." So I went to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him about it, but he turned away from me. Abu Asim said, "He mentioned it in the third or fourth year." I said, "How is that when it has been prohibited?" And he forbade it. Abu Asim said, "Umar ibn Sa'eed ibn Abi Husain reported from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, 'How is that when it has been said?' And he did not say that it has been forbidden from it." Abu Muhammad said, "That's how it is according to us."   – Sound
hadiths.body: He did not inform me, but I heard him telling the people that he married the daughter of Abu Ihab, and then a black female slave came and said, "I breastfed both of you." So I went to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him about it, but he turned away from me. Abu Asim said, "He mentioned it in the third or fourth year." I said, "How is that when it has been prohibited?" And he forbade it. Abu Asim said, "Umar ibn Sa'eed ibn Abi Husain reported from Ibn Abi Mulaykah, 'How is that when it has been said?' And he did not say that it has been forbidden from it." Abu Muhammad said, "That's how it is according to us."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: لَمْ يُحَدِّثْنِيهِ وَلَكِنْ سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ الْقَوْمَ قَالَ تَزَوَّجْتُ بِنْتَ أَبِي إِهَابٍ فَجَاءَتْ أَمَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي أَرْضَعْتُكُمَا «فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنِّي» قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ قَالَ «فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ» قَالَ كَيْفَ وَقَدْ قِيلَ؟ وَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ وقَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ فَكَيْفَ وَقَدْ قِيلَ؟ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ نَهَاهُ عَنْهَا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «كَذَا عِنْدَنَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn Abū Mulaykah \u003e ʿUqbah b. al-Ḥārith Thum \u003e Lam Yuḥaddithnīh And Lakin Samiʿtuh \u003e al-Qawm \u003e Tazawwajt b. Abū Ihāb Fajāʾat Amah Sawdāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقْبَةُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ ثُمَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2302

chapter.englishTitle: In Breastfeeding of the Elder

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Prophet ﷺ entered upon her while a man was sitting with her. Signs of answer seemed to appear on his face as if he disliked that. She said, "Here is my (foster) brother." He said, "Be sure as to who is your foster brother, for foster suckling relationship is established only when milk is the only food of the child."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ entered upon her while a man was sitting with her. Signs of answer seemed to appear on his face as if he disliked that. She said, "Here is my (foster) brother." He said, "Be sure as to who is your foster brother, for foster suckling relationship is established only when milk is the only food of the child."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا وَعِنْدَهَا رَجُلٌ فَتَغَيَّرَ وَجْهُهُ وَكَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَ ذَلِكَ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّهُ أَخِي مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ فَقَالَ «انْظُرْنَ مَا إِخْوَانُكُنَّ فَإِنَّمَا الرَّضَاعَةُ مِنَ الْمَجَاعَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ashʿath b. Sulaym from his father \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2303

chapter.englishTitle: In Breastfeeding of the Elder

hadiths.englishRaw: Sahla, the daughter of Suhail ibn Amr, came and she was under the care of Abu Hudhayfa ibn Utba ibn Rabee'a, the messenger of Allah ﷺ . Sahla said, "Salim, the slave of Abu Hudhayfa, enters upon us and I am [still] of a [young] age [and cover my face], but we can only see him as a son [not as a slave]. Abu Hudhayfa adopted him just as the Prophet ﷺ adopted Zaid. So Allah revealed the verse {Call them by their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah} [Surah Al-Ahzab, verse 5]. The Prophet ﷺ then instructed her to breastfeed Salim. Abu Muhammad [i.e. Sahla's son] said, "This is exclusively for Salim."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Sahla, the daughter of Suhail ibn Amr, came and she was under the care of Abu Hudhayfa ibn Utba ibn Rabee'a, the messenger of Allah ﷺ . Sahla said, "Salim, the slave of Abu Hudhayfa, enters upon us and I am [still] of a [young] age [and cover my face], but we can only see him as a son [not as a slave]. Abu Hudhayfa adopted him just as the Prophet ﷺ adopted Zaid. So Allah revealed the verse {Call them by their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allah} [Surah Al-Ahzab, verse 5]. The Prophet ﷺ then instructed her to breastfeed Salim. Abu Muhammad [i.e. Sahla's son] said, "This is exclusively for Salim."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَتْ سَهْلَةُ بِنْتُ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ سَالِمًا مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْنَا وَأَنَا فُضُلٌ وَإِنَّمَا نَرَاهُ وَلَدًا وَكَانَ أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ تَبَنَّاهُ كَمَا تَبَنَّى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ زَيْدًا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {ادْعُوهُمْ لِآبَائِهِمْ هُوَ أَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ} [الأحزاب 5] فَأَمَرَهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ أَنْ تُرْضِعَ سَالِمًا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «هَذَا لِسَالِمٍ خَاصَّةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Yamān al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَنْبَأََنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2304

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of analysis.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah cursed the Muhallil and the Muhallal lahu.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah cursed the Muhallil and the Muhallal lahu.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمُحِلَّ وَالْمُحَلَّلَ لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Qays \u003e al-Huzayl \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ عَنِ الْهُزَيْلِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2305

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي وُجُوبِ نَفَقَةِ الرَّجُلِ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The obligation of a man to support his family.

hadiths.englishRaw: Hind, the mother of Muawiya and the wife of Abu Sufyan, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, Abu Sufyan is a stingy man and does not provide me and my children with enough. I only take from him what I can take, and he does not know. Is there any blame on me regarding this?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Take what is sufficient for you and your children in a manner that is acceptable."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Hind, the mother of Muawiya and the wife of Abu Sufyan, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, Abu Sufyan is a stingy man and does not provide me and my children with enough. I only take from him what I can take, and he does not know. Is there any blame on me regarding this?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Take what is sufficient for you and your children in a manner that is acceptable."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ هِنْدًا أُمَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ امْرَأَةَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ رَجُلٌ شَحِيحٌ وَإِنَّهُ لَا يُعْطِينِي مَا يَكْفِينِي وَبَنِيَّ إِلَّا مَا أَخَذْتُ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ لَا يَعْلَمُ فَهَلْ عَلَيَّ فِي ذَلِكَ جُنَاحٌ؟ فَقَالَ «خُذِي مَا يَكْفِيكِ وَوَلَدَكِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأََنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2306

chapter.englishTitle: In the good treatment of women

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best of you is the best to his wives, and I am the best of you to my wives, and when your companion dies, leave him alone."     – Sound
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The best of you is the best to his wives, and I am the best of you to my wives, and when your companion dies, leave him alone."     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ وَإِذَا مَاتَ صَاحِبُكُمْ فَدَعُوهُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2307

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَزْوِيجِ الصِّغَارِ إِذَا زَوَّجَهُنَّ آبَاؤُهُنَّ
chapter.englishTitle: In the marriage of minors when their fathers marry them.

hadiths.englishRaw: Aishah said: “The Messenger of Allah married me when I was six years old. Then we came to Al-Madinah and settled among Banu Harith bin Khazraj. I became ill and my hair fell out, then it grew back and became abundant. My mother Umm Ruman came to me while I was on an Urjuhah with some of my friends, and called for me. I went to her, and I did not know what she wanted. She took me by the hand and made me stand at the door of the house, and I was panting. When I got my breath back, she took some water and wiped my face and head, and led me into the house. There were some woman of the Ansar inside the house, and they said: 'With blessings and good fortune (from Allah).' (My mother) handed me over to them and they tidied me up. And suddenly I saw the Messenger of Allah in the morning. And she handed me over to him and I was at that time, nine years old.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Aishah said: “The Messenger of Allah married me when I was six years old. Then we came to Al-Madinah and settled among Banu Harith bin Khazraj. I became ill and my hair fell out, then it grew back and became abundant. My mother Umm Ruman came to me while I was on an Urjuhah with some of my friends, and called for me. I went to her, and I did not know what she wanted. She took me by the hand and made me stand at the door of the house, and I was panting. When I got my breath back, she took some water and wiped my face and head, and led me into the house. There were some woman of the Ansar inside the house, and they said: 'With blessings and good fortune (from Allah).' (My mother) handed me over to them and they tidied me up. And suddenly I saw the Messenger of Allah in the morning. And she handed me over to him and I was at that time, nine years old.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: تَزَوَّجَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَنَا بِنْتُ سِتِّ سِنِينَ فَقَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ فَنَزَلْنَا فِي بَنِي الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ فَوُعِكْتُ فَتَمَرَّقَ رَأْسِي فَأَوْفَى جُمَيْمَةً فَأَتَتْنِي أُمُّ رُومَانَ وَإِنِّي لَفِي أُرْجُوحَةٍ وَمَعِي صَوَاحِبَاتٌ لِي فَصَرَخَتْ بِي فَأَتَيْتُهَا وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا تُرِيدُ فَأَخَذَتْ بِيَدِي حَتَّى أَوْقَفَتْنِي عَلَى بَابِ الدَّارِ وَإِنِّي لَأَنْهَجُ حَتَّى سَكَنَ بَعْضُ نَفَسِي ثُمَّ أَخَذَتْ شَيْئًا مِنْ مَاءٍ فَمَسَحَتْ بِهِ وَجْهِي وَرَأْسِي ثُمَّ أَدْخَلَتْنِي الدَّارَ فَإِذَا نِسْوَةٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فِي الْبَيْتِ فَقُلْنَ عَلَى الْخَيْرِ وَالْبَرَكَةِ وَعَلَى خَيْرِ طَائِرٍ فَأَسْلَمَتْنِي إِلَيْهِنَّ فَأَصْلَحْنَ مِنْ شَأْنِي فَلَمْ يَرُعْنِي إِلَّا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ضُحًى فَأَسْلَمَتْنِي إِلَيْهِ وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ ابْنَةُ تِسْعِ سِنِينَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismaʿīl b. Khalīl \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Hishām from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ أَنْبَأََنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2308
hadiths.englishRaw: "I divorced my wife when she was menstruating. 'Umar mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'Tell him to take her back until she becomes pure (i.e., her period ends), then she has her period (again), then she becomes pure (again), then if he wishes he may divorce her before having sexual relations with her, and if he wishes he may keep her. This is the waiting period that Allah has enjoined.'"     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "I divorced my wife when she was menstruating. 'Umar mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'Tell him to take her back until she becomes pure (i.e., her period ends), then she has her period (again), then she becomes pure (again), then if he wishes he may divorce her before having sexual relations with her, and if he wishes he may keep her. This is the waiting period that Allah has enjoined.'"     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ عُمَرُ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «مُرْهُ أَنْ يُرَاجِعَهَا وَيُمْسِكَهَا حَتَّى تَطْهُرَ ثُمَّ تَحِيضَ ثُمَّ تَطْهُرَ ثُمَّ إِنْ شَاءَ أَمْسَكَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ طَلَّقَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمَسَّ فَتِلْكَ الْعِدَّةُ الَّتِي أَمَرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُطَلَّقَ لَهَا النِّسَاءُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2309
hadiths.englishRaw: "When the Prophet ﷺ divorced the wife of Ibn Umar, he said, 'Let him take her back and then divorce her while she is in a state of purity.' Abu Muhammad said, 'This was narrated by Ibn Al-Mubarak, Wakie, or Hamil.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When the Prophet ﷺ divorced the wife of Ibn Umar, he said, 'Let him take her back and then divorce her while she is in a state of purity.' Abu Muhammad said, 'This was narrated by Ibn Al-Mubarak, Wakie, or Hamil.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ حِينَ طَلَّقَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَقَالَ «مُرْهُ فَلْيُرَاجِعْهَا ثُمَّ لِيُطَلِّقْهَا وَهِيَ طَاهِرَةٌ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «رَوَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ وَوَكِيعٌ أَوْ حَامِلٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Sālim \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e ʿUmar \u003e Lilnnabī ﷺ Ḥīn Ṭallaq Ibn ʿUmar Āmraʾatah \u003e Murh Falyurājiʿhā Thum Liyuṭalliqhā And Hī Ṭāhirah \u003e Abū Muḥammad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى أَنْبَأََنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا يَذْكُرُ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2310

chapter.englishTitle: In the return

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ divorced Hafsah, but he took her back in marriage.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ divorced Hafsah, but he took her back in marriage.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «طَلَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَفْصَةَ ثُمَّ رَاجَعَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Khalīl And ʾIsmāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Zāʾidah \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2311

chapter.englishTitle: In the return

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ divorced Hafsah and then took her back," Abu Muhammad said, "It seems that Ali ibn al-Madinah disapproved of this hadith and said, 'We do not have this hadith in Basra from Humaid.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ divorced Hafsah and then took her back," Abu Muhammad said, "It seems that Ali ibn al-Madinah disapproved of this hadith and said, 'We do not have this hadith in Basra from Humaid.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «طَلَّقَ حَفْصَةَ ثُمَّ رَاجَعَهَا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد كَأَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْمَدِينِيِّ أَنْكَرَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَنَا هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ بِالْبَصْرَةِ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Sulaymān \u003e Hushaym \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2312

chapter.englishTitle: No divorce before marriage

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, "The Quran should not be touched except by one who is pure, and divorce cannot be pronounced before ownership is established, and the freeing of a slave cannot be done until it is bought." Abu Muhammad was asked about Sulaiman, and he said, "I think he is a writer among the writers of Umar ibn Abdul Aziz."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, "The Quran should not be touched except by one who is pure, and divorce cannot be pronounced before ownership is established, and the freeing of a slave cannot be done until it is bought." Abu Muhammad was asked about Sulaiman, and he said, "I think he is a writer among the writers of Umar ibn Abdul Aziz."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ «أَنْ لَا يَمَسَّ الْقُرْآنَ إِلَّا طَاهِرٌ وَلَا طَلَاقَ قَبْلَ إِمْلَاكٍ وَلَا عَتَاقَ حَتَّى يَبْتَاعَ» سُئِلَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانُ قَالَ أَحْسَبُ كَاتِبًا مِنْ كُتَّابِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Lī Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah Afṣil
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ الْحَكَمُ قَالَ لِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ أَفْصِلُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2313

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُحِلُّ الْمَرْأَةَ لِزَوْجِهَا الَّذِي طَلَّقَهَا فَبَتَّ طَلَاقَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible for a woman to do for her husband who divorc...

hadiths.englishRaw: The woman of Rifaa'a al-Qurazi came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and with him were Abu Bakr and Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-'As, waiting at the door to be permitted to enter to see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The woman said, "O Messenger of Allah, I was with Rifaa'a and he divorced me, and now my 'Iddah (waiting period) is complete." He said, "Do you want to go back to Rifaa'a? No, not until he has sexual intercourse with you and you have tasted his semen, and he has tasted yours." Khalid ibn Sa'id called out to Abu Bakr, "Don't you see what she is saying loudly? This is in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ !"   – Sound
hadiths.body: The woman of Rifaa'a al-Qurazi came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and with him were Abu Bakr and Khalid ibn Sa'id ibn al-'As, waiting at the door to be permitted to enter to see the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The woman said, "O Messenger of Allah, I was with Rifaa'a and he divorced me, and now my 'Iddah (waiting period) is complete." He said, "Do you want to go back to Rifaa'a? No, not until he has sexual intercourse with you and you have tasted his semen, and he has tasted yours." Khalid ibn Sa'id called out to Abu Bakr, "Don't you see what she is saying loudly? This is in front of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ !"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةُ رِفَاعَةَ الْقُرَظِيِّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعِنْدَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ عَلَى الْبَابِ يَنْتَظِرُ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَهُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رِفَاعَةَ فَطَلَّقَنِي فَبَتَّ طَلَاقِي قَالَ «أَتُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ؟ لَا حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ وَتَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ» فَنَادَى خَالِدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَلَا تَرَى مَا تَجْهَرُ بِهِ؟ هَذِهِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2314

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يُحِلُّ الْمَرْأَةَ لِزَوْجِهَا الَّذِي طَلَّقَهَا فَبَتَّ طَلَاقَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible for a woman to do for her husband who divorc...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The wife of Rifa'ah Al-Qurazi came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I got married to 'Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zabir, and what he has is like this fringe.' The Messenger of Allah said: 'Perhaps you want to go back to Rifa'ah? No, not until he ('Abdur-Rahman) tastes your sweetness and you taste his sweetness.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The wife of Rifa'ah Al-Qurazi came to the Messenger of Allah and said: 'O Messenger of Allah! I got married to 'Abdur-Rahman bin Az-Zabir, and what he has is like this fringe.' The Messenger of Allah said: 'Perhaps you want to go back to Rifa'ah? No, not until he ('Abdur-Rahman) tastes your sweetness and you taste his sweetness.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: طَلَّقَ رِفَاعَةُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ فَدَخَلَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ إِنْ مَعَهُ إِلَّا مِثْلُ هُدْبَتِي هَذِهِ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَعَلَّكِ تُرِيدِينَ أَنْ تَرْجِعِي إِلَى رِفَاعَةَ لَا حَتَّى يَذُوقَ عُسَيْلَتَكِ أَوْ قَالَ تَذُوقِي عُسَيْلَتَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Farwah b. Abū al-Maghrāʾ \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2315

chapter.englishTitle: In the option

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah gave his wives the choice; was that a divorce?"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah gave his wives the choice; was that a divorce?"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَدْ «خَيَّرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَفَكَانَ طَلَاقًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Masrūq \u003e Saʾalt ʿĀʾishah \u003e al-Khiyarah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ الْخِيَرَةِ فَقَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2316

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ أَنْ تَسْأَلَ الْمَرْأَةُ زَوْجَهَا طَلَاقَهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of a woman asking her husband for a divorce.

hadiths.englishRaw: 'Any woman who asks her husband for a divorce when it is not absolutely necessary, the fragrance of Paradise will be forbidden to her.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: 'Any woman who asks her husband for a divorce when it is not absolutely necessary, the fragrance of Paradise will be forbidden to her.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ سَأَلَتْ زَوْجَهَا الطَّلَاقَ مِنْ غَيْرِ بَأْسٍ فَحَرَامٌ عَلَيْهَا رَائِحَةُ الْجَنَّةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Faḍl \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū Asmāʾ \u003e Thawbān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2317

chapter.englishTitle: In divorce

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ desired to marry her, and she was his neighbor. Thabit struck her, so she came to the door of the Prophet ﷺ with a bandage on her head. The Prophet ﷺ came out and saw a man, and asked, "Who is this?" She said, "I am Habiba bint Sahl." He asked, "What happened to you?" She replied, "Neither I nor Thabit have any problem." Thabit then came to the Prophet ﷺ , and the Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Take from her and leave her alone." She said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have everything he gave me." So he took from her and she went back to her family.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ desired to marry her, and she was his neighbor. Thabit struck her, so she came to the door of the Prophet ﷺ with a bandage on her head. The Prophet ﷺ came out and saw a man, and asked, "Who is this?" She said, "I am Habiba bint Sahl." He asked, "What happened to you?" She replied, "Neither I nor Thabit have any problem." Thabit then came to the Prophet ﷺ , and the Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Take from her and leave her alone." She said, "O Messenger of Allah, I have everything he gave me." So he took from her and she went back to her family.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ هَمَّ أَنْ يَتَزَوَّجَهَا وَكَانَتْ جَارَةً لَهُ وَأَنَّ ثَابِتًا ضَرَبَهَا فَأَصْبَحَتْ عَلَى بَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْغَلَسِ وَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَرَجَ فَرَأَى إِنْسَانًا فَقَالَ «مَنْ هَذَا؟» قَالَتْ أَنَا حَبِيبَةُ بِنْتُ سَهْلٍ فَقَالَ «مَا شَأْنُكِ؟» قَالَتْ لَا أَنَا وَلَا ثَابِتٌ فَأَتَى ثَابِتٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ «خُذْ مِنْهَا وَخَلِّ سَبِيلَهَا» فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عِنْدِي كُلُّ شَيْءٍ أَعْطَانِيهِ فَأَخَذَ مِنْهَا وَقَعَدَتْ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ibn Saʿīd \u003e ʿAmrah \u003e Ḥabībah b. Sahl Tazawwajahā Thābit b. Qays b. Shammās Fadhakarat
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّ عَمْرَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ سَهْلٍ تَزَوَّجَهَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ قَيْسِ بْنِ شَمَّاسٍ فَذَكَرَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2318

chapter.englishTitle: In the divorce of al-batta

hadiths.englishRaw: "He divorced his wife, Al-Batta, and then went to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him about it. The Prophet ﷺ asked him, 'What did you intend?' He replied, 'One divorce.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Did you intend by the name of Allah?' He replied, 'Yes, by the name of Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Then that is what you have intended.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He divorced his wife, Al-Batta, and then went to the Prophet ﷺ and informed him about it. The Prophet ﷺ asked him, 'What did you intend?' He replied, 'One divorce.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Did you intend by the name of Allah?' He replied, 'Yes, by the name of Allah.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'Then that is what you have intended.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ الْبَتَّةَ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ «مَا أَرَدْتَ؟» فَقَالَ وَاحِدَةً قَالَ «آللَّهِ؟» قَالَ آللَّهِ قَالَ هُوَ مَا نَوَيْتَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Jarīr b. Ḥāzim \u003e al-Zubayr b. Saʿīd a man from Banī ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib \u003e Balaghanī Ḥadīth
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ عَنْ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي حَدِيثٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُكَانَةَ وَهُوَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ لَهُ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ؟ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ جَدِّي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2319

chapter.englishTitle: In the daytime

hadiths.englishRaw: I was a man who was more given than others to sexual intercourse with women. When the month of Ramadan came, I feared lest I should have intercourse with my wife, and this evil should remain with me till the morning. So I made my wife like my mother's back to me till the end of Ramadan. But one night when she was waiting upon me, something of her was revealed. Suddenly I jumped upon her. When the morning came I went to my people and informed them about this matter. I said: Go along with me to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. They said: No, by Allah. So I went to the Prophet (peace be upon him and informed him of the matter. He said: Have you really committed it, Salamah? I said: I committed it twice, Messenger of Allah. I am content with the Commandment of Allah, the Exalted; so take a decision about me according to what Allah has shown you. He said: Free a slave. I said: By Him Who sent you with truth, I do not possess a neck other than this: and I struck the surface of my neck. He said: Then fast two consecutive months. I said: Whatever I suffered is due to fasting. He said: Feed sixty poor people with a wasq of dates. I said: By Him Who sent you with truth, we passed the night hungry; there was no food in our house. He said: Then go to the collector of sadaqah of Banu Zurayq; he must give it to you. Then feed sixty poor people with a wasq of dates; and you and your family eat the remaining dates. Then I came back to my people, and said (to them): I found with you poverty and bad opinion; and I found with the Prophet ﷺ prosperity and good opinion. He has commanded me to give alms to you. Ibn al-Ala' added: Ibn Idris said: Bayadah is a sub-clan of Banu Zurayq.

hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ امْرَأً أُصِيبُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ مَا لَا يُصِيبُ غَيْرِي فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ خِفْتُ أَنْ أُصِيبَ فِي لَيْلِي شَيْئًا فَيَتَتَابَعَ بِي ذَلِكَ إِلَى أَنْ أُصْبِحَ قَالَ فَتَظَاهَرْتُ إِلَى أَنْ يَنْسَلِخَ فَبَيْنَا هِيَ لَيْلَةً تَخْدُمُنِي إِذْ تَكَشَّفَ لِي مِنْهَا شَيْءٌ فَمَا لَبِثْتُ أَنْ نَزَوْتُ عَلَيْهَا فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْتُ خَرَجْتُ إِلَى قَوْمِي فَأَخْبَرْتُهُمْ وَقُلْتُ امْشُوا مَعِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالُوا لَا وَاللَّهِ لَا نَمْشِي مَعَكَ مَا نَأْمَنُ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ فِيكَ الْقُرْآنُ أَوْ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِيكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَقَالَةٌ يَلْزَمُنَا عَارُهَا وَلَنُسْلِمَنَّكَ بِجَرِيرَتِكَ فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَصَصْتُ عَلَيْهِ قصتي فَقَالَ يَا سَلَمَةُ «أَنْتَ بِذَاكَ» قُلْتُ أَنَا بِذَاكَ قَالَ يَا سَلَمَةُ «أَنْتَ بِذَاكَ» قُلْتُ أَنَا بِذَاكَ قَالَ يَا سَلَمَةُ «أَنْتَ بِذَاكَ» قُلْتُ أَنَا بِذَاكَ وَهَا أَنَا صَابِرٌ نَفْسِي فَاحْكُمْ فِيَّ مَا أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ قَالَ «فَأَعْتِقْ رَقَبَةً» قَالَ «فَضَرَبْتُ صَفْحَةَ رَقَبَتِي» فَقُلْتُ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ مَا أَصْبَحْتُ أَمْلِكُ رَقَبَةً غَيْرَهَا قَالَ «فَصُمْ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ» قُلْتُ وَهَلْ أَصَابَنِي الَّذِي أَصَابَنِي إِلَّا فِي الصِّيَامِ؟ قَالَ «فَأَطْعِمْ وَسْقًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا» فَقُلْتُ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ لَقَدْ بِتْنَا لَيْلَتَنَا وَحْشَى مَا لَنَا مِنَ الطَّعَامِ قَالَ فَانْطَلِقْ إِلَى صَاحِبِ صَدَقَةِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ فَلْيَدْفَعْهَا إِلَيْكَ وَأَطْعِمْ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا وَسْقًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ وَكُلْ بَقِيَّتَهُ أَنْتَ وَعِيَالُكَ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُ قَوْمِي فَقُلْتُ وَجَدْتُ عِنْدَكُمُ الضِّيقَ وَسُوءَ الرَّأْيِ وَوَجَدْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ السَّعَةَ وَحُسْنَ الرَّأْيِ وَقَدْ أَمَرني بِصَدَقَتِكُمْ
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Salamah b. Ṣakhr al-Bayāḍī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ صَخْرٍ الْبَيَاضِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2320

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا أَلَهَا السُّكْنَى، وَالنَّفَقَةُ أَمْ لَا
chapter.englishTitle: Three things to consider in divorced women: Housing, financial s...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Her husband divorced her three times, so the Prophet ﷺ did not provide her with maintenance or accommodation. Salama said that he mentioned this to Ibrahim, who said, 'Umar ibn al-Khattab said: We do not abandon the book of our Lord and the Sunnah of His Prophet based on the words of a woman, so he provided her with accommodation and maintenance.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "Her husband divorced her three times, so the Prophet ﷺ did not provide her with maintenance or accommodation. Salama said that he mentioned this to Ibrahim, who said, 'Umar ibn al-Khattab said: We do not abandon the book of our Lord and the Sunnah of His Prophet based on the words of a woman, so he provided her with accommodation and maintenance.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا «فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ نَفَقَةً وَلَا سُكْنَى» قَالَ سَلَمَةُ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ فَقَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ لَا نَدَعُ كِتَابَ رَبِّنَا وَسُنَّةَ نَبِيِّهِ بِقَوْلِ امْرَأَةٍ فَجَعَلَ لَهَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةَ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Fāṭimah b. Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ قَيْسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2321

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا أَلَهَا السُّكْنَى، وَالنَّفَقَةُ أَمْ لَا
chapter.englishTitle: Three things to consider in divorced women: Housing, financial s...

hadiths.englishRaw: "That her husband divorced her three times, so the Prophet ﷺ ordered her to observe 'iddah (waiting period) at the house of her cousin, the son of her maternal aunt, Ibn Umm Maktum."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That her husband divorced her three times, so the Prophet ﷺ ordered her to observe 'iddah (waiting period) at the house of her cousin, the son of her maternal aunt, Ibn Umm Maktum."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ زَوْجَهَا طَلَّقَهَا ثَلَاثًا فَأَمَرَهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَنْ تَعْتَدَّ عِنْدَ ابْنِ عَمِّهَا ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Fāṭimah b. Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَتْنِي فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ قَيْسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2322

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا أَلَهَا السُّكْنَى، وَالنَّفَقَةُ أَمْ لَا
chapter.englishTitle: Three things to consider in divorced women: Housing, financial s...

hadiths.englishRaw: "We do not invalidate our scriptures and the practices of our Prophet by the statement of a divorced woman, who is granted housing and financial support."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "We do not invalidate our scriptures and the practices of our Prophet by the statement of a divorced woman, who is granted housing and financial support."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: «لَا نَدَعُ كِتَابَ رَبِّنَا وَسُنَّةَ نَبِيِّهِ بِقَوْلِ امْرَأَةٍ الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلَاثًا لَهَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥakam And Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ وَحَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2323

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا أَلَهَا السُّكْنَى، وَالنَّفَقَةُ أَمْ لَا
chapter.englishTitle: Three things to consider in divorced women: Housing, financial s...

hadiths.englishRaw: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Ma’mar through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Ma’mar through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عُمَرَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ṭalq b. Ghannām \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا طَلْقُ بْنُ غَنَّامٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2324

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا أَلَهَا السُّكْنَى، وَالنَّفَقَةُ أَمْ لَا
chapter.englishTitle: Three things to consider in divorced women: Housing, financial s...

hadiths.englishRaw: Umar said, "We do not allow a divorced woman to have the right to housing and financial support in the religion of Allah, three times for her. Abu Muhammad said, "I do not see housing and financial support for the divorced woman."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Umar said, "We do not allow a divorced woman to have the right to housing and financial support in the religion of Allah, three times for her. Abu Muhammad said, "I do not see housing and financial support for the divorced woman."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ «لَا نُجِيزُ قَوْلَ امْرَأَةٍ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ الْمُطَلَّقَةُ ثَلَاثًا لَهَا السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «لَا أَرَى السُّكْنَى وَالنَّفَقَةَ لِلْمُطَلَّقَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2325

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي عِدَّةِ الْحَامِلِ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَالْمُطَلَّقَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the case of a deceased husband and divorced woman...

hadiths.englishRaw: He informed him that he and Ibn Abbas met with Abu Hurairah and they mentioned a man whose wife dies and he remarries after a few nights. Ibn Abbas said that her waiting period is the end of the two terms (the waiting period for pregnancy and for being widowed). Abu Salama said that when she gives birth, her waiting period ends. They disagreed about it, so Abu Hurairah said, "I am with my nephew's son, meaning Abu Salama." So they sent Kureib, the slave of Ibn Abbas, to Umm Salamah and he asked her. Umm Salamah mentioned that Subay'ah bint al-Harith al-Aslamiyah died and her husband passed away and after him she got her period after a few nights, and a man from Bani Abd Ad-Dar proposed to her and informed her that she had her period. She wanted to marry someone else, so Abu As-Sanabil said to her, "Indeed, you have not completed your waiting period." Subay'ah mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he ordered her to get married.   – Sound Chain
