She wanted to marry someone else, so Abu As-Sanabil said to her, "Indeed, you have not completed your waiting period." Subay'ah mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he ordered her to get married.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ اجْتَمَعَ هُوَ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عِنْدَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَذَكَرُوا الرَّجُلَ يُتَوَفَّى عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ فَتَلِدُ بَعْدَهُ بِلَيَالٍ قَلَائِلَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ حِلُّهَا آخِرُ الْأَجَلَيْنِ وَقَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ إِذَا وَضَعَتْ فَقَدْ حَلَّتْ فَتَرَاجَعَا فِي ذَلِكَ بَيْنَهُمَا فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَا مَعَ ابْنِ أَخِي يَعْنِي أَبَا سَلَمَةَ فَبَعَثُوا كُرَيْبًا مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ فَسَأَلَهَا فَذَكَرَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ الْأَسْلَمِيَّةَ مَاتَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا فَنَفِسَتْ بَعْدَهُ بِلَيَالٍ وَأَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ الدَّارِ يُكَنَّى أَبَا السَّنَابِلِ خَطَبَهَا وَأَخْبَرَهَا أَنَّهَا قَدْ حَلَّتْ فَأَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ غَيْرَهُ فَقَالَ لَهَا أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ فَإِنَّكِ لَمْ تَحِلِّينَ فَذَكَرَتْ سُبَيْعَةُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأََنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2326

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي عِدَّةِ الْحَامِلِ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَالْمُطَلَّقَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the case of a deceased husband and divorced woman...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Subai'ah gave birth a few days after her husband died, and the Messenger of Allah told her to get married."     – Sound
hadiths.body: "Subai'ah gave birth a few days after her husband died, and the Messenger of Allah told her to get married."     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: تُوُفِّيَ زَوْجُ سُبَيْعَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ فَوَضَعَتْ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِأَيَّامٍ «فَأَمَرَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Kurayb \u003e Um Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2327

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي عِدَّةِ الْحَامِلِ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَالْمُطَلَّقَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the case of a deceased husband and divorced woman...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Subai'ah Aslamiyyah bint Harith gave birth twenty-odd days after her husband died. When her postnatal bleeding ended, she adorned herself, and was criticized for doing that. Her case was mentioned to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: 'If she does that, then her waiting period is over."'     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Subai'ah Aslamiyyah bint Harith gave birth twenty-odd days after her husband died. When her postnatal bleeding ended, she adorned herself, and was criticized for doing that. Her case was mentioned to the Prophet ﷺ and he said: 'If she does that, then her waiting period is over."'     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَضَعَتْ سُبَيْعَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ حَمْلَهَا بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِبِضْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً فَلَمَّا تَعَلَّتْ مِنْ نِفَاسِهَا تَشَوَّفَتْ فَعِيبَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهَا فَذُكِرَ أَمْرُهَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «إِنْ تَفْعَلْ فَقَدِ انْقَضَى أَجَلُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. ʿUmar al-Zahrānī \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e Abū al-Sanābil
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ أَبِي السَّنَابِلِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2328

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي عِدَّةِ الْحَامِلِ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَالْمُطَلَّقَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the case of a deceased husband and divorced woman...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Sab'iyah had passed away a few days after her husband's death, so Abu Al-Sanabil noticed her and asked her if she had mentioned her situation to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He instructed her to get married."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "Sab'iyah had passed away a few days after her husband's death, so Abu Al-Sanabil noticed her and asked her if she had mentioned her situation to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He instructed her to get married."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ سُبَيْعَةَ وَضَعَتْ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ زَوْجِهَا بِأَيَّامٍ فَتَشَوَّفَتْ فَعَابَ أَبُو السَّنَابِلِ فَسَأَلَتْ أَوْ ذَكَرَتْ أَمْرَهَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ «فَأَمَرَهَا أَنْ تَتَزَوَّجَ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2329

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي إِحْدَادِ الْمَرْأَةِ عَلَى الزَّوْجِ
chapter.englishTitle: During a woman's mourning for her husband

hadiths.englishRaw: "It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days, except for her husband."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days, except for her husband."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَحِلُّ لِامْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَوْ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ أَنْ تَحِدَّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا عَلَى زَوْجِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Sulaymān b. Kathīr \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ أَنْبَأََنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2330

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي إِحْدَادِ الْمَرْأَةِ عَلَى الزَّوْجِ
chapter.englishTitle: During a woman's mourning for her husband

hadiths.englishRaw: "A brother or a close relative of hers passed away, so she rushed to make her hands disheveled and said, 'I am doing this because the Prophet ﷺ said, 'It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days, except for her husband. In that case, she mourns for four months and ten days.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A brother or a close relative of hers passed away, so she rushed to make her hands disheveled and said, 'I am doing this because the Prophet ﷺ said, 'It is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days, except for her husband. In that case, she mourns for four months and ten days.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَخًا لَهَا مَاتَ أَوْ حَمِيمًا لَهَا فَعَمَدَتْ إِلَى صُفْرَةٍ فَجَعَلَتْ تَمْسَحُ يَدَيْهَا وَقَالَتْ إِنَّمَا أَفْعَلُ هَذَا لِأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَحِلُّ لِامْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ أَنْ تَحِدَّ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثٍ إِلَّا عَلَى زَوْجِهَا فَإِنَّهَا تَحِدُّ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ḥumayd b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Zaynab b. Abū Salamah \u003e Um Ḥabībah b. Abū Sufyān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2331

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي إِحْدَادِ الْمَرْأَةِ عَلَى الزَّوْجِ
chapter.englishTitle: During a woman's mourning for her husband

hadiths.englishRaw: About her mother or a woman from the Prophet's wives, similar to her.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About her mother or a woman from the Prophet's wives, similar to her.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُمِّهَا أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ḥumayd b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Zaynab b. Um Salamah Tuḥaddith
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ أَنْبَأََنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ تُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2332

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ لِلْمَرْأَةِ عَنِ الزِّينَةِ فِي الْعِدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition for a woman from adorning herself during the waiting...

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Umm Athiyah reported the Prophet ﷺ as saying “A woman must not observe mourning for more than three (days) except for four months and ten days in the case of a husband and she must not wear a dyed garment except one of the types made of dyed yarn or apply collyrium or touch perfume except for a little costus or azfar when she has been purified after her menstrual courses. The narrator Ya’qub mentioned the words “except washed clothes” instead of the words “one of the types made of dyed yarn”. Ya’qub also added “She must not apply Henna”     – Sound
hadiths.body: ‘Umm Athiyah reported the Prophet ﷺ as saying “A woman must not observe mourning for more than three (days) except for four months and ten days in the case of a husband and she must not wear a dyed garment except one of the types made of dyed yarn or apply collyrium or touch perfume except for a little costus or azfar when she has been purified after her menstrual courses. The narrator Ya’qub mentioned the words “except washed clothes” instead of the words “one of the types made of dyed yarn”. Ya’qub also added “She must not apply Henna”     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَحِدُّ الْمَرْأَةُ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا عَلَى زَوْجٍ فَإِنَّهَا تَحِدُّ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا لَا تَلْبَسُ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا إِلَّا ثَوْبَ عَصْبٍ وَلَا تَكْتَحِلُ وَلَا تَمَسُّ طِيبًا إِلَّا فِي أَدْنَى طُهْرِهَا إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ مِنْ مَحِيضِهَا نُبْذَةً مِنْ كُسْتٍ وَأَظْفَارٍ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥafṣah b. Sīrīn \u003e Um ʿAṭiyyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2333

chapter.englishTitle: The departure of her deceased husband from her.

hadiths.englishRaw: She asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for permission to return to her family. Her husband had gone out in search of a sustenance, so they decided to wait for him. They caught up with him when he was about to arrive and they killed him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her, "Stay in your house until the time appointed in the Quran." I said, "He did not leave for me a house that I own nor any provision." He said, "Stay until the time appointed in the Quran." So she observed 'Iddah (waiting period) for four months and ten days. When 'Uthman sent for me, he asked about this. I informed him of the situation, so he followed the same ruling and decreed accordingly.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: She asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for permission to return to her family. Her husband had gone out in search of a sustenance, so they decided to wait for him. They caught up with him when he was about to arrive and they killed him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her, "Stay in your house until the time appointed in the Quran." I said, "He did not leave for me a house that I own nor any provision." He said, "Stay until the time appointed in the Quran." So she observed 'Iddah (waiting period) for four months and ten days. When 'Uthman sent for me, he asked about this. I informed him of the situation, so he followed the same ruling and decreed accordingly.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا سَأَلَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهَا أَنْ تَرْجِعَ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا؟ فَإِنَّ زَوْجَهَا قَدْ خَرَجَ فِي طَلَبِ أَعْبُدٍ لَهُ أَبَقُوا فَأَدْرَكَهُمْ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِطَرَفِ الْقَدُومِ قَتَلُوهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «امْكُثِي فِي بَيْتِكِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْكِتَابُ أَجَلَهُ» فَقُلْتُ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَدَعْنِي فِي بَيْتٍ أَمْلِكُهُ وَلَا نَفَقَةٍ فَقَالَ «امْكُثِي حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الْكِتَابُ أَجَلَهُ» فَاعْتَدَّتْ فِيهِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُثْمَانُ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيَّ فَسَأَلَنِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ؟ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَاتَّبَعَ ذَلِكَ وَقَضَى بِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Mālik \u003e Saʿd b. Isḥāq b. Kaʿb b. ʿUjrah \u003e ʿAmmatih Zaynab b. Kaʿb b. ʿUjrah \u003e al-Furayʿah b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ عَنْ عَمَّتِهِ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ كَعْبِ بْنِ عُجْرَةَ أَنَّ الْفُرَيْعَةَ بِنْتَ مَالِكٍ أَخْبَرَتْهَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2334

chapter.englishTitle: The departure of her deceased husband from her.

hadiths.englishRaw: "So I went to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him. He said, 'Go out and suck the milk from your date palm tree, perhaps you may give charity or do a good deed.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "So I went to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him. He said, 'Go out and suck the milk from your date palm tree, perhaps you may give charity or do a good deed.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ «اخْرُجِي فَجُدِّي نَخْلَكِ فَلَعَلَّكِ أَنْ تَصَدَّقِي أَوْ تَصْنَعِي مَعْرُوفًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir \u003e Ṭulliqat Khālatī Faʾarādat \u003e Tajud Nakhl Lahā \u003e Lahā a man Lays Lak \u003e Takhrujī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ طُلِّقَتْ خَالَتِي فَأَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَجُدَّ نَخْلًا لَهَا فَقَالَ لَهَا رَجُلٌ لَيْسَ لَكِ أَنْ تَخْرُجِي قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2335

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَخْيِيرِ الْأَمَةِ تَكُونُ تَحْتَ الْعَبْدِ فَتُعْتَقُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the choice of the nation, it is under the slave, so it is fre...

hadiths.englishRaw: she wanted to buy Barirah and set her free, but they stipulated that her loyally as a freed slave (wala') should be to them. She mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah and he said: "Buy her and set her fee, and loyally is due to the one who frees the slave." She was given the choice when she was freed. Some meat was brought to the Messenger of Allah and it was said: "This is something that is given in charity to Barirah." He said: "It is charity for her and gift for us." And her husband was a free man.
hadiths.body: she wanted to buy Barirah and set her free, but they stipulated that her loyally as a freed slave (wala') should be to them. She mentioned that to the Messenger of Allah and he said: "Buy her and set her fee, and loyally is due to the one who frees the slave." She was given the choice when she was freed. Some meat was brought to the Messenger of Allah and it was said: "This is something that is given in charity to Barirah." He said: "It is charity for her and gift for us." And her husband was a free man.
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَشْتَرِطُوا وَلَاءَهَا فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «اشْتَرِيهَا فَإِنَّمَا الْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ» فَاشْتَرَتْهَا فَأَعْتَقَتْهَا وَخَيَّرَهَا مِنْ زَوْجِهَا وَكَانَ حُرًّا وَأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِلَحْمٍ فَقَالَ مِنْ أَيْنَ هَذَا؟ قِيلَ تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ فَقَالَ «هُوَ لَهَا صَدَقَةٌ وَلَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ»
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Arādat \u003e Tashtarī Barīrah Faʾarād Mawālīhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّهَا أَرَادَتْ أَنْ تَشْتَرِيَ بَرِيرَةَ فَأَرَادَ مَوَالِيهَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2336

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَخْيِيرِ الْأَمَةِ تَكُونُ تَحْتَ الْعَبْدِ فَتُعْتَقُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the choice of the nation, it is under the slave, so it is fre...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon me, so I brought him some food that did not contain meat. He said, "Did I not see a raised portion for you?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, this is meat given as a charity to our slave girl who then gifted it to us." He said, "It is charity for her and a gift for us." She had a husband, so when she was freed, she was given the choice.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ entered upon me, so I brought him some food that did not contain meat. He said, "Did I not see a raised portion for you?" I said, "O Messenger of Allah, this is meat given as a charity to our slave girl who then gifted it to us." He said, "It is charity for her and a gift for us." She had a husband, so when she was freed, she was given the choice.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَلَيَّ فَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامًا لَيْسَ فِيهِ لَحْمٌ فَقَالَ «أَلَمْ أَرَ لَكُمْ قِدْرًا مَنْصُوبَةً» قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا لَحْمٌ تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَلَى بَرِيرَةَ فَأَهْدَتْ لَنَا قَالَ «هُوَ عَلَيْهَا صَدَقَةٌ ولَنَا هَدِيَّةٌ» وَكَانَ لَهَا زَوْجٌ فَلَمَّا عُتِقَتْ خُيِّرَتْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Khalīl \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2337

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَخْيِيرِ الْأَمَةِ تَكُونُ تَحْتَ الْعَبْدِ فَتُعْتَقُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the choice of the nation, it is under the slave, so it is fre...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When Aisha freed Barira, her husband was still a slave. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ encouraged her to stay with him. She said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, 'Shouldn't I separate from him?' He replied, 'Yes.' So she indeed separated from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When Aisha freed Barira, her husband was still a slave. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ encouraged her to stay with him. She said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, 'Shouldn't I separate from him?' He replied, 'Yes.' So she indeed separated from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ بَرِيرَةَ حِينَ أَعْتَقَتْهَا عَائِشَةُ كَانَ زَوْجُهَا عَبْدًا فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَحُضُّهَا عَلَيْهِ فَجَعَلَتْ تَقُولُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَلَيْسَ لِي أَنْ أُفَارِقَهُ؟ قَالَ «بَلَى» قَالَتْ فَقَدْ فَارَقْتُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Ḍaḥḥāk \u003e al-Mughīrah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Makhzūmī \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الضَّحَّاكِ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2338

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَخْيِيرِ الْأَمَةِ تَكُونُ تَحْتَ الْعَبْدِ فَتُعْتَقُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the choice of the nation, it is under the slave, so it is fre...

hadiths.englishRaw: The husband of Barirah was a slave called Mughith. It is as if I can see him walking behind her weeping, with the tears running down onto his beard. The Prophet [SAW] said to Al-'Abbas: "O 'Abbas, are you not amazed by the love of Mughith for Barirah and the hatred of Barirah for Mughith?" The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said to her: "Why don't you take him back, for he is the father of your child?" She said: "O Messenger of Allah, are you commanding me (to do so)?" He said: "I am just interceding." She said: "I have no need of him."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The husband of Barirah was a slave called Mughith. It is as if I can see him walking behind her weeping, with the tears running down onto his beard. The Prophet [SAW] said to Al-'Abbas: "O 'Abbas, are you not amazed by the love of Mughith for Barirah and the hatred of Barirah for Mughith?" The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said to her: "Why don't you take him back, for he is the father of your child?" She said: "O Messenger of Allah, are you commanding me (to do so)?" He said: "I am just interceding." She said: "I have no need of him."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ لَهُ مُغِيثٌ كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ يَطُوفُ خَلْفَهَا يَبْكِي وَدُمُوعُهُ تَسِيلُ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لِلْعَبَّاسِ يَا عَبَّاسُ «أَلَا تَعْجَبُ مِنْ شِدَّةِ حُبِّ مُغِيثٍ بَرِيرَةَ وَمِنْ شِدَّةِ بُغْضِ بَرِيرَةَ مُغِيثًا» فَقَالَ لَهَا «لَوْ رَاجَعْتِيهِ فَإِنَّهُ أَبُو وَلَدِكِ» فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَأْمُرُنِي؟ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا أَنَا شَافِعٌ» قَالَتْ لَا حَاجَةَ لِي فِيهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khālid / al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأََنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ يَعْنِي الْحَذَّاءَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ زَوْجَ بَرِيرَةَ كَانَ عَبْدًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2339

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَخْيِيرِ الصَّبِيِّ بَيْنَ أَبَوَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the child's dilemma between his parents

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by Abu Maymuna Sulaiman, the servant of the people of Madinah, who said: I was with Abu Huraira when a woman came to him and said, "Indeed, my husband wants to take away my child." Abu Huraira said, "I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when a woman came to him and said, 'Indeed, my husband wants to take away my child or my son, and he has benefited me and provided me with water from the well of Abu 'Inaba.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Bring your husband here.' So her husband came and said, 'Who will contend with me regarding my child or my son?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O young boy, this is your father and this is your mother, so take the hand of whoever you wish.' Abu Asim said, 'Follow whichever of them you wish.' So he took the hand of his mother and they left together."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by Abu Maymuna Sulaiman, the servant of the people of Madinah, who said: I was with Abu Huraira when a woman came to him and said, "Indeed, my husband wants to take away my child." Abu Huraira said, "I was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when a woman came to him and said, 'Indeed, my husband wants to take away my child or my son, and he has benefited me and provided me with water from the well of Abu 'Inaba.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Bring your husband here.' So her husband came and said, 'Who will contend with me regarding my child or my son?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'O young boy, this is your father and this is your mother, so take the hand of whoever you wish.' Abu Asim said, 'Follow whichever of them you wish.' So he took the hand of his mother and they left together."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ سُلَيْمَانَ مَوْلًى لِأَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فَجَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ زَوْجِي يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ بِوَلَدِي فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذْ جَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ زَوْجِي يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ بِوَلَدِي أَوْ بِابْنِي وَقَدْ نَفَعَنِي وَسَقَانِي مِنْ بِئْرِ أَبِي عِنَبَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ اسْتَهِمَا أَوْ قَالَ تَسَاهَمَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ الشَّاكُّ فَجَاءَ زَوْجُهَا فَقَالَ مَنْ يُخَاصِمُنِي فِي وَلَدِي أَوْ فِي ابْنِي؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَا غُلَامُ هَذَا أَبُوكَ وَهَذِهِ أُمُّكَ فَخُذْ بِيَدِ أَيِّهِمَا شِئْتَ» وَقَدْ قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ فَاتْبَعْ أَيَّهُمَا شِئْتَ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِ أُمِّهِ فَانْطَلَقَتْ بِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ziyād b. Saʿd \u003e Hilāl b. Usāmah \u003e Abū Maymūnah Sulaymān a freed slave of Liʾahl al-Madīnah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2340

chapter.englishTitle: In the divorce of the mother

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "For women, there are two types of divorce and their recurrences during the period of menstruation." Abu Asim said, "I heard this from Muzahir."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "For women, there are two types of divorce and their recurrences during the period of menstruation." Abu Asim said, "I heard this from Muzahir."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لِلْأَمَةِ تَطْلِيقَتَانِ وَقُرُوؤُهَا حَيْضَتَانِ» قَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ مُظَاهِرٍ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Muẓāhir / Ibn Aslam \u003e al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ أَنْبَأََنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُظَاهِرٌ وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَسْلَمَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2341

chapter.englishTitle: In the exception of the nation

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Sa’id Al Khudri traced to Prophet ﷺ the following statement regarding the captives taken at Atwas. There must be no intercourse with pregnant woman till she gives birth to her child or with the one who is not pregnant till she has had one menstrual period.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Sa’id Al Khudri traced to Prophet ﷺ the following statement regarding the captives taken at Atwas. There must be no intercourse with pregnant woman till she gives birth to her child or with the one who is not pregnant till she has had one menstrual period.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي سَبَايَا أَوْطَاسٍ «لَا تُوطَأُ حَامِلٌ حَتَّى تَضَعَ حَمْلَهَا وَلَا غَيْرُ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَتَّى تَحِيضَ حَيْضَةً»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Sharīk \u003e Qays b. Wahb \u003e Abū al-Waddāk \u003e Abū Saʿīd Warafaʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأََنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْوَدَّاكِ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ وَرَفَعَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2342
hadiths.englishRaw: ʿThe Pen has been lifted from three; from the sleeper until he wakes up, from the crazy - or insane- one until he comes back to his senses, and from the minor until he grows up.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ʿThe Pen has been lifted from three; from the sleeper until he wakes up, from the crazy - or insane- one until he comes back to his senses, and from the minor until he grows up.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ رُفِعَ الْقَلَمُ عَنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ عَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ وَعَنِ الصَّغِيرِ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ وَعَنِ الْمَجْنُونِ حَتَّى يَعْقِلَ وَقَدْ قَالَ حَمَّادٌ أَيْضًا وَعَنِ الْمَعْتُوهِ حَتَّى يَعْقِلَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2343

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَحِلُّ بِهِ دَمُ الْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible to do with the blood of a Muslim?

hadiths.englishRaw: Why would they kill me? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ʿIt is not permissible (to shed) the blood of a Muslim except in three cases: If a man disbelieves after becoming Muslim, or commits zina after being married or kills someone and is executed in retaliation.ʿ     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Why would they kill me? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ʿIt is not permissible (to shed) the blood of a Muslim except in three cases: If a man disbelieves after becoming Muslim, or commits zina after being married or kills someone and is executed in retaliation.ʿ     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ لَا يَحِلُّ دَمُ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ إِلَّا بِإِحْدَى ثَلَاثٍ بِكُفْرٍ بَعْدَ إِيمَانٍ أَوْ بِزِنًى بَعْدَ إِحْصَانٍ أَوْ يَقْتُلُ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ فَيُقْتَلُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Umāmah b. Sahl b. Ḥunayf \u003e ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2344

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَحِلُّ بِهِ دَمُ الْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible to do with the blood of a Muslim?

hadiths.englishRaw: The blood of a Muslim man who testifies that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah should not be lawfully shed but only for one of three reasons: married fornicator, soul for soul, and one who deserts his religion separating himself from the community.
hadiths.body: The blood of a Muslim man who testifies that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah should not be lawfully shed but only for one of three reasons: married fornicator, soul for soul, and one who deserts his religion separating himself from the community.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا يَحِلُّ دَمُ رَجُلٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَّا أَحَدَ ثَلَاثَةِ نَفَرٍ النَّفْسُ بِالنَّفْسِ وَالثَّيِّبُ الزَّانِي وَالتَّارِكُ لِدِينِهِ الْمُفَارِقُ لِلْجَمَاعَةِ
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Murrah \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2345

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ السَّارِقِ تُوهَبُ مِنْهُ السَّرِقَةُ بَعْدَ مَا سَرَقَ
chapter.englishTitle: The thief donates the stolen item after stealing it.

hadiths.englishRaw: Safwan bin Umayyah was sleeping in the mosque, then a man came to him while he was also sleeping. He took his cloak from under his head and woke him up. Safwan caught up with him and took it back, then he went to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I was sleeping in the mosque and this man came to me and took my cloak from under my head. I caught up with him and took it back. He ordered for it to be cut, so Safwan said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, my cloak has not reached the point where it should be cut." He said, "Why didn't you accept it before bringing it to me?"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Safwan bin Umayyah was sleeping in the mosque, then a man came to him while he was also sleeping. He took his cloak from under his head and woke him up. Safwan caught up with him and took it back, then he went to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and said, "O Messenger of Allah, I was sleeping in the mosque and this man came to me and took my cloak from under my head. I caught up with him and took it back. He ordered for it to be cut, so Safwan said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, my cloak has not reached the point where it should be cut." He said, "Why didn't you accept it before bringing it to me?"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ صَفْوَانُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ نَائِمًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ وَهُوَ نَائِمٌ فَاسْتَلَّ رِدَاءَهُ مِنْ تَحْتِ رَأْسِهِ فَتَنَبَّهَ بِهِ فَلَحِقَهُ فَأَخَذَهُ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كُنْتُ نَائِمًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَتَانِي هَذَا فَاسْتَلَّ رِدَائِي مِنْ تَحْتِ رَأْسِي فَلَحِقْتُهُ فَأَخَذْتُهُ فَأَمَرَ بِقَطْعِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ صَفْوَانُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ رِدَائِي لَمْ يَبْلُغْ أَنْ يُقْطَعَ فِيهِ هَذَا قَالَ «فَهَلَّا قَبْلَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنِي بِهِ؟»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿd b. Ḥafṣ \u003e Shaybān \u003e Ashʿath \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2346

chapter.englishTitle: What is not cut off by the hand?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah used to cut off the (thief's) hand for one-quarter of a Dinar or more."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah used to cut off the (thief's) hand for one-quarter of a Dinar or more."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «تُقْطَعُ الْيَدُ فِي رُبْعِ دِينَارٍ فَصَاعِدًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Dāwud al-Hāshimī \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAmrah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْهَاشِمِيُّ أَنْبَأََنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَمْرَةَ بِنْتِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2347

chapter.englishTitle: What is not cut off by the hand?

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Prophet ﷺ cut off (the hand of a thief) for a shield worth three Dirham.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Prophet ﷺ cut off (the hand of a thief) for a shield worth three Dirham.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَطَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي مِجَنٍّ قِيمَتُهُ ثَلَاثَةُ دَرَاهِمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ayyūb And ʾIsmāʿīl b. Umayyah Waʿubayd Allāh Wamūsá b. ʿUqbah \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَمُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2348

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الشَّفَاعَةِ فِي الْحُدُودِ دُونَ السُّلْطَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: Intercession in boundaries without authority.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Quraish were anxious about the Makhzumi woman who had committed theft, They said : Who will speak to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her ? Then they said: Who will be bold enough for it but Uasmah bin Zaid, the prophet’s ﷺ friend! So Usamah spoke to him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said : Are you interceding regarding one of the punishments prescribed by Allah ? He then got up and gave an address, saying : What destroyed your predecessors was just that when a person of rank among them committed a theft, They left him alone , and when a weak one of them committed a theft, they inflicted the prescribed punishment on him . I swear by Allah that if Fatimah daughter of Muhammad should steal, I would have her hand cut off.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Quraish were anxious about the Makhzumi woman who had committed theft, They said : Who will speak to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about her ? Then they said: Who will be bold enough for it but Uasmah bin Zaid, the prophet’s ﷺ friend! So Usamah spoke to him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said : Are you interceding regarding one of the punishments prescribed by Allah ? He then got up and gave an address, saying : What destroyed your predecessors was just that when a person of rank among them committed a theft, They left him alone , and when a weak one of them committed a theft, they inflicted the prescribed punishment on him . I swear by Allah that if Fatimah daughter of Muhammad should steal, I would have her hand cut off.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: شَأْنُ الْمَرْأَةِ الْمَخْزُومِيَّةِ الَّتِي سَرَقَتْ فَقَالُوا مَنْ يُكَلِّمُ فِيهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالُوا وَمَنْ يَجْتَرِئُ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حِبُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَكَلَّمَهُ أُسَامَةُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَتَشْفَعُ فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَاخْتَطَبَ» فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا هَلَكَ الَّذِينَ قَبْلَكُمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الشَّرِيفُ تَرَكُوهُ وَإِذَا سَرَقَ فِيهِمُ الضَّعِيفُ أَقَامُوا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَرَقَتْ لَقَطَعْتُ يَدَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e al-Layth \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUrwah b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿĀʾishah \u003e Quraysh Ahammahum
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أَنَّ قُرَيْشًا أَهَمَّهُمْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2349

chapter.englishTitle: Recognizing Theft

hadiths.englishRaw: a thief who confused to a crime but with whom no stolen goods has been found, was brought to the Messenger of Allah. The Messenger of Allah said to him: "I do not think that you stole anything."He He said: "Yes I did." He said: "Take him and cut off his hands, then bring him here, "So they cut off his hand then they brought him to him. He said to him; "Say: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him." He said: "I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him." He said:: "O Allah, accept his repentance."(Daif)
hadiths.body: a thief who confused to a crime but with whom no stolen goods has been found, was brought to the Messenger of Allah. The Messenger of Allah said to him: "I do not think that you stole anything."He He said: "Yes I did." He said: "Take him and cut off his hands, then bring him here, "So they cut off his hand then they brought him to him. He said to him; "Say: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him." He said: "I seek the forgiveness of Allah and I repent to Him." He said:: "O Allah, accept his repentance."(Daif)
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِسَارِقٍ اعْتَرَفَ اعْتِرَافًا لَمْ يُوجَدْ مَعَهُ مَتَاعٌ فَقَالَ «مَا إِخَالُكَ سَرَقْتَ؟» قَالَ بَلَى قَالَ «مَا إِخَالُكَ سَرَقْتَ؟» قَالَ بَلَى قَالَ «فَاذْهَبُوا فَاقْطَعُوا يَدَهُ ثُمَّ جِيئُوا بِهِ فَقَطَعُوا يَدَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءُوا بِهِ» فَقَالَ اسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيْهِ اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيْهِ»
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Abū al-Mundhir a freed slave of Abū Dhar \u003e Abū Umayyah al-Makhzūmī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُنْذِرِ مَوْلَى أَبِي ذَرٍّ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ الْمَخْزُومِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2350

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُقْطَعُ فِيهِ مِنَ الثِّمَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What cannot be cut from the fruits

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees."'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees."'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ibn Saʿīd \u003e Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá b. Ḥabbān \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأََنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2351

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُقْطَعُ فِيهِ مِنَ الثِّمَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What cannot be cut from the fruits

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees."'    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees."'    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥusayn b. Manṣūr \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá b. Ḥabbān \u003e a man from Qawmih \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2352

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُقْطَعُ فِيهِ مِنَ الثِّمَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What cannot be cut from the fruits

hadiths.englishRaw: “The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The hand is not to be cut off for (stealing) produce or the spadix of palm trees.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Wakīʿ \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá b. Ḥabbān from his uncle Wāsiʿ b. Ḥabbān \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنْ عَمِّهِ وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2353

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُقْطَعُ فِيهِ مِنَ الثِّمَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What cannot be cut from the fruits

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá b. Ḥabbān \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2354

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُقْطَعُ فِيهِ مِنَ الثِّمَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What cannot be cut from the fruits

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "There should be no cutting in the fruit nor excess." He said this while referring to the fat of the date palm, and excess refers to the fibers in it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "There should be no cutting in the fruit nor excess." He said this while referring to the fat of the date palm, and excess refers to the fibers in it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَا قَطْعَ فِي ثَمَرٍ وَلَا كَثَرٍ» قَالَ وَهُوَ شَحْمُ النَّخْلِ وَالْكَثَرُ الْجُمَّارُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ وَالثَّقَفِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2355

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُقْطَعُ فِيهِ مِنَ الثِّمَارِ
chapter.englishTitle: What cannot be cut from the fruits

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "There is no cutting in abundance." Abu Muhammad said that Abu Usamah did not say that.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Prophet ﷺ saying, "There is no cutting in abundance." Abu Muhammad said that Abu Usamah did not say that.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَا قَطْعَ فِي كَثَرٍ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الْقَوْلُ مَا قَالَ أَبُو أُسَامَةَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Manṣūr \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá b. Ḥabbān \u003e Abū Maymūn \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2356

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا لَا يُقْطَعُ مِنَ السُّرَّاقِ
chapter.englishTitle: What can't be severed from the thieves

hadiths.englishRaw: “The hand of the one who betrays a trust, the robber and the pilferer is not to be cut off”.     – Sound
hadiths.body: “The hand of the one who betrays a trust, the robber and the pilferer is not to be cut off”.     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَيْسَ عَلَى الْمُنْتَهِبِ وَلَا عَلَى الْمُخْتَلِسِ وَلَا عَلَى الْخَائِنِ قَطْعٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأََنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ جَابِرٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2357

chapter.englishTitle: At the limit of alcohol

hadiths.englishRaw: That a man who had drunk wine was brought to the Prophet ﷺ, so he beat him about forty times with two stalks of a palm tree. So Abu Bakr did similarly, and by the time 'Umar became Khalifah he sought council from the people. And 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf said: 'I see that the lightest penalty is eighty lashes,' so 'Umar ordered that.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That a man who had drunk wine was brought to the Prophet ﷺ, so he beat him about forty times with two stalks of a palm tree. So Abu Bakr did similarly, and by the time 'Umar became Khalifah he sought council from the people. And 'Abdur-Rahman bin 'Awf said: 'I see that the lightest penalty is eighty lashes,' so 'Umar ordered that.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «أُتِيَ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ شَرِبَ خَمْرًا فَضَرَبَهُ بِجَرِيدَتَيْنِ» ثُمَّ فَعَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ اسْتَشَارَ النَّاسَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ أَخَفُّ الْحُدُودِ ثَمَانِينَ قَالَ «فَفَعَلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2358

chapter.englishTitle: At the limit of alcohol

hadiths.englishRaw: “When Walid bin ʿUqbah was brought to ʿUthman, they had testified against him. He said to 'Ali: 'You are close to your uncle's son, so carry out the legal punishment on him.' So 'Ali whipped him. He said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave forty lashes, and Abu Bakr gave forty lashes, and 'Umar gave eighty all are Sunnah.'”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “When Walid bin ʿUqbah was brought to ʿUthman, they had testified against him. He said to 'Ali: 'You are close to your uncle's son, so carry out the legal punishment on him.' So 'Ali whipped him. He said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave forty lashes, and Abu Bakr gave forty lashes, and 'Umar gave eighty all are Sunnah.'”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَلِيٌّ «جَلَدَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَرْبَعِينَ وَجَلَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ وَعُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ وَكُلٌّ سُنَّةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. al-Mukhtār \u003e ʿAbdullāh al-Dānāj \u003e Ḥuḍayn b. al-Mundhir al-Raqāshī \u003e Shahidt ʿUthmān b. ʿAffān And ʾUtī Bi-al-Walīd b. ʿUqbah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنْبَأََنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الدَّانَاجُ حَدَّثَنَا حُضَيْنُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ قَالَ شَهِدْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ وَأُتِيَ بِالْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2359

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي شَارِبِ الْخَمْرِ إِذَا أُتِيَ بِهِ الرَّابِعَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Shop of Wine, When the Fourth One is Brought

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "If one of you drinks, then strike him. If he repeats it, then strike him. If he repeats it again, then strike him. If he repeats it for the fourth time, then kill him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "If one of you drinks, then strike him. If he repeats it, then strike him. If he repeats it again, then strike him. If he repeats it for the fourth time, then kill him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «إِذَا شَرِبَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَاضْرِبُوهُ ثُمَّ إِنْ عَادَ فَاضْرِبُوهُ ثُمَّ إِنْ عَادَ فَاضْرِبُوهُ ثُمَّ إِنْ عَادَ الرَّابِعَةَ فَاقْتُلُوهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd \u003e Ibn Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥāq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ هُوَ ابْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الشَّرِيدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2360

chapter.englishTitle: Punishment in sins

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "It is not permissible for anyone to strike another person with more than ten lashes except within the limits prescribed by Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "It is not permissible for anyone to strike another person with more than ten lashes except within the limits prescribed by Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَا يَحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَضْرِبَ أَحَدًا فَوْقَ عَشَرَةِ أَسْوَاطٍ إِلَّا فِي حَدٍّ مِنْ حُدُودِ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Abū Ayyūb \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Bukayr b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ashaj \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Ibn Jābir \u003e Abū Burdah b. Niyār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ ابْنُ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ نِيَارٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2361

chapter.englishTitle: Recognition of Adultery

hadiths.englishRaw: A man who had embraced Islam came to the Prophet ﷺ and confessed that he had committed adultery. He testified against himself that he had committed adultery four times. So, the Prophet ordered that he be stoned to death, although he was married.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man who had embraced Islam came to the Prophet ﷺ and confessed that he had committed adultery. He testified against himself that he had committed adultery four times. So, the Prophet ordered that he be stoned to death, although he was married.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ أَسْلَمَ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَحَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ زَنَى فَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَنَّهُ زَنَى أَرْبَعًا «فَأَمَرَ بِرَجْمِهِ وَكَانَ قَدْ أُحْصِنَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2362

chapter.englishTitle: Recognition of Adultery

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard Jabir bin Samurah saying, "The Prophet ﷺ was presented with a short man wearing an izār (a lower garment) without a rida (a upper garment). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was reclining on a cushion on his left side. He spoke to him, but I do not know what he said to him as I was far away from them and the people were between me and him. He said, "Take him away and stone him." Then he said, "Bring him back." He spoke to him again and I listened, although the people were still between me and him. Then he said, "Take him away and stone him." Then the Prophet ﷺ stood up and delivered a sermon, and I listened to it. Then he said, "Whenever we go out in the cause of Allah, one of them would be given a she-camel to ride and the rest would share its milk. By Allah, I cannot convey the like of one of them without facing hardship."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard Jabir bin Samurah saying, "The Prophet ﷺ was presented with a short man wearing an izār (a lower garment) without a rida (a upper garment). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was reclining on a cushion on his left side. He spoke to him, but I do not know what he said to him as I was far away from them and the people were between me and him. He said, "Take him away and stone him." Then he said, "Bring him back." He spoke to him again and I listened, although the people were still between me and him. Then he said, "Take him away and stone him." Then the Prophet ﷺ stood up and delivered a sermon, and I listened to it. Then he said, "Whenever we go out in the cause of Allah, one of them would be given a she-camel to ride and the rest would share its milk. By Allah, I cannot convey the like of one of them without facing hardship."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ يَقُولُ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ رَجُلٍ قَصِيرٍ فِي إِزَارٍ مَا عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءٌ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مُتَّكِئٌ عَلَى وِسَادَةٍ عَلَى يَسَارِهِ فَكَلَّمَهُ فَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُكَلِّمُهُ بِهِ وَأَنَا بَعِيدٌ مِنْهُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ الْقَوْمُ فَقَالَ «اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «رُدُّوهُ» فَكَلَّمَهُ أَيْضًا وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ الْقَوْمَ ثُمَّ قَالَ «اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ» ثُمَّ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَخَطَبَ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ «كُلَّمَا نَفَرْنَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَلَفَ أَحَدُهُمْ لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ يَمْنَحُ إِحْدَاهُنَّ الْكُثْبَةَ مِنَ اللَّبَنِ؟ وَاللَّهِ لَا أَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا نَكَّلْتُ بِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Simāk \u003e Jābir b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2363

chapter.englishTitle: Recognition of Adultery

hadiths.englishRaw: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "I beseech you to judge us according to Allah's Laws." Then his opponent who was wiser than he, got up and said, "He has spoken the truth. So judge us according to Allah's Laws and please allow me (to speak), O Messenger of Allah ﷺ." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Speak." He said, "My son was a laborer for the family of this man and he committed illegal sexual intercourse with his wife, and I gave one-hundred sheep and a slave as a ransom (for my son), but I asked the religious learned people (regarding this case), and they informed me that my son should be flogged onehundred stripes, and be exiled for one year, and the wife of this man should be stoned (to death)."The Prophet ﷺ said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is, I will Judge you (in this case) according to Allah's Laws. The one-hundred (sheep) and the slave shall be returned to you and your son shall be flogged one-hundred stripes and be exiled for one year. And O Unais! Go in the morning to the wife of this man and ask her, and if she confesses, stone her to death." She confessed and he stoned her to death.

The one-hundred (sheep) and the slave shall be returned to you and your son shall be flogged one-hundred stripes and be exiled for one year. And O Unais! Go in the morning to the wife of this man and ask her, and if she confesses, stone her to death." She confessed and he stoned her to death.
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَزَيْدِ بْن خَالِدٍ وَشِبْلٍ قالُوا جاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ إِلَّا قَضَيْتَ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ خصْمُهُ وَكَانَ أَفْقَهَ مِنْهُ صَدَقَ اقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَأْذَنْ لِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَليْهِ وَسَلَّمَ «قُلْ» فَقَالَ إِنَّ ابْنِي كَانَ عَسِيفًا عَلَى أَهْلِ هَذَا فَزَنَى بِامْرَأَتِهِ فَافْتَدَيْتُ مِنْهُ بِمِائَةِ شَاةٍ وَخَادِمٍ وَإِنِّي سَأَلْتُ رِجَالًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ فَأَخْبَرُونِي أَنَّ عَلَى ابْنِي جَلْدَ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبَ عَامٍ وَأَنَّ عَلى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا الرَّجْمَ فَقَالَ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَأَقْضِيَنَّ بَيْنَكُمَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ الْمِائَةُ شَاةٍ وَالْخَادِمُ رَدٌّ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى ابْنِكَ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ وَيَا أُنَيْسُ اغْدُ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا فَسَلْهَا فَإِنِ اعْتَرَفَتْ فَارْجُمْهَا فَاعْتَرَفَتْ فَرَجَمَهَا
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e Abū Hurayrah And Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2364

chapter.englishTitle: The confessor retracts his confession.

hadiths.englishRaw: "So we reminded the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said, 'So why didn't you abandon it?'"
hadiths.body: "So we reminded the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he said, 'So why didn't you abandon it?'"
hadiths.arabic: فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «فَهَلَّا تَرَكْتُمُوهُ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥāq b. Yasār \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Taymī \u003e Abū al-Haytham b. Naṣr b. Dahr al-Aslamī from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ نَصْرِ بْنِ دَهْرٍ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد يَعْنِي مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ «فَلَمَّا وَجَدَ مَسَّ الْحِجَارَةِ جَزِعَ جَزَعًا شَدِيدًا» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2365

chapter.englishTitle: The digging for whom stoning is intended

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Go with Ma'iz ibn Malik and stone him." So we went with him to Baqee' al-Gharqad. By Allah, we did not tie him up or dig a hole for him. Rather, he stood and we stoned him with bones, pottery, and gravel.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Go with Ma'iz ibn Malik and stone him." So we went with him to Baqee' al-Gharqad. By Allah, we did not tie him up or dig a hole for him. Rather, he stood and we stoned him with bones, pottery, and gravel.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «انْطَلِقُوا بِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَارْجُمُوهُ» فَانْطَلَقْنَا بِهِ إِلَى بَقِيعِ الْغَرْقَدِ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا أَوْثَقْنَاهُ وَلَا حَفَرْنَا لَهُ وَلَكِنْ قَامَ فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِالْعِظَامِ وَالْخَزَفِ وَالْجَنْدَلِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Zāʾidah \u003e Dāwud \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2366

chapter.englishTitle: The digging for whom stoning is intended

hadiths.englishRaw: I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when a man named Ma'iz ibn Malik came to him and confessed to committing adultery. The Prophet ﷺ asked him three times if he was sure, and each time the man confirmed his confession. Then, he came for the fourth time and confessed again. The Prophet ﷺ ordered a pit to be dug for him and he was placed in it up to his chest. The Prophet ﷺ then commanded the people to stone him.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when a man named Ma'iz ibn Malik came to him and confessed to committing adultery. The Prophet ﷺ asked him three times if he was sure, and each time the man confirmed his confession. Then, he came for the fourth time and confessed again. The Prophet ﷺ ordered a pit to be dug for him and he was placed in it up to his chest. The Prophet ﷺ then commanded the people to stone him.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَاعْتَرَفَ عِنْدَهُ بِالزِّنَا فَرَدَّهُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَ الرَّابِعَةَ فَاعْتَرَفَ «فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَحُفِرَ لَهُ حُفْرَةٌ فَجُعِلَ فِيهَا إِلَى صَدْرِهِ وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يَرْجُمُوهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Bashīr b. al-Muhājir \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Buraydah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2367

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْحُكْمِ بَيْنَ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ إِذَا تَحَاكَمُوا إِلَى حُكَّامِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the judgment between the people of the Book when they seek ar...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, the Jews came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a man and a woman from among them who had committed adultery. The Messenger said, 'What should be done with those who have committed adultery among you?' They replied, 'We do not find anything mentioned about it in our scripture.' Abdullah bin Salam said, 'You have lied regarding stoning in the Torah. Bring the Torah and recite it if you are truthful.' So they brought the Torah, and he placed his hand on the verse of stoning and asked, 'What is this?' When they saw that, they said, 'It is the verse of stoning.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered that they be stoned near the site where funeral processions are placed near the mosque.' Abdullah said, 'I saw the man shielding the woman with his body from the stones.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, the Jews came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a man and a woman from among them who had committed adultery. The Messenger said, 'What should be done with those who have committed adultery among you?' They replied, 'We do not find anything mentioned about it in our scripture.' Abdullah bin Salam said, 'You have lied regarding stoning in the Torah. Bring the Torah and recite it if you are truthful.' So they brought the Torah, and he placed his hand on the verse of stoning and asked, 'What is this?' When they saw that, they said, 'It is the verse of stoning.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered that they be stoned near the site where funeral processions are placed near the mosque.' Abdullah said, 'I saw the man shielding the woman with his body from the stones.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ جَاءُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ وَامْرَأَةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا فَقَالَ «كَيْفَ تَفْعَلُونَ بِمَنْ زَنَى مِنْكُمْ؟» قَالُوا لَا نَجِدُ فِيهَا شَيْئًا فَقَالَ لَهُمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلَامٍ كَذَبْتُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ الرَّجْمُ فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَاتْلُوهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ فَجَاءُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَوَضَعَ مِدْرَاسُهَا الَّذِي يَدْرُسُهَا مِنْهُمْ كَفَّهُ عَلَى آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ فَقَالَ «مَا هَذِهِ؟» فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا ذَلِكَ قَالُوا هِيَ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَرُجِمَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ حَيْثُ تُوضَعُ الْجَنَائِزُ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَرَأَيْتُ صَاحِبَهَا يَجْنَأُ عَلَيْهَا يَقِيهَا الْحِجَارَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUqbah \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2368

chapter.englishTitle: In the case of those protected by marital confinement who commit...

hadiths.englishRaw: ʿUmar said: Allah, may He be exalted, sent Muhammad ﷺ and sent down the Book to him. Among that which was revealed to him was the verse of stoning. We recited it and understood it. But I fear that with the passage of time, some people will say: We do not find the verse of stoning in the Book of Allah, and as a result an obligation that Allah revealed will be forsaken. Stoning is the due punishment in the Book of Allah for those who commit zina, both men and women, if they have been married and if proof is established, or there is a pregnancy or a confession.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ʿUmar said: Allah, may He be exalted, sent Muhammad ﷺ and sent down the Book to him. Among that which was revealed to him was the verse of stoning. We recited it and understood it. But I fear that with the passage of time, some people will say: We do not find the verse of stoning in the Book of Allah, and as a result an obligation that Allah revealed will be forsaken. Stoning is the due punishment in the Book of Allah for those who commit zina, both men and women, if they have been married and if proof is established, or there is a pregnancy or a confession.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بَعَثَ مُحَمَّدًا ﷺ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابَ وَكَانَ فِيمَا أَنْزَلَ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ فَقَرَأْنَاهَا وَوَعَيْنَاهَا وَعَقَلْنَاهَا وَرَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَرَجَمْنَا بَعْدَهُ فَأَخْشَى إِنْ طَالَ بِالنَّاسِ زَمَانٌ أَنْ يَقُولَ الْقَائِلُ لَا نَجِدُ حَدَّ آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَالرَّجْمُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ عَلَى مَنْ زَنَى مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ إِذَا أُحْصِنَ إِذَا قَامَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيِّنَةُ أَوْ كَانَ الْحَبَلُ أَوِ الِاعْتِرَافُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2369

chapter.englishTitle: When a pregnant woman confesses to adultery

hadiths.englishRaw: I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when a woman from the tribe of Banu Ghamed came to him and said, "O Prophet of Allah, I have committed adultery and I want you to purify me." He told her to go back. The next day she came to him again and confessed her sin. She said, "O Prophet of Allah, purify me, and perhaps you will treat me as you treated Ma'iz ibn Malik." She pleaded with him, saying, "By Allah, I am pregnant." The Prophet ﷺ told her to go back until she gave birth. When she gave birth, she came to him carrying the baby in a cloth and said, "O Prophet of Allah, I have given birth." He said, "Go and breastfeed him, then wean him." When she weaned the baby, she came to him holding a piece of bread in his hand and said, "O Prophet of Allah, I have weaned him." The Prophet ﷺ ordered the baby to be given to a Muslim man and ordered a hole to be dug for her. She was placed in the hole up to her chest and the people were ordered to stone her. Khalid ibn al-Walid came forward with a stone and struck her head, causing blood to splatter onto Khalid's cheek. He cursed her, and the Prophet ﷺ heard his curse. He said, "Stop, O Khalid, do not curse her. By the One in whose hand is my soul, she has repented in a way that if a sinful person were to repent the same way, Allah would have forgiven him." He ordered for her to be prayed upon and buried.

When she weaned the baby, she came to him holding a piece of bread in his hand and said, "O Prophet of Allah, I have weaned him." He said, "Stop, O Khalid, do not curse her. By the One in whose hand is my soul, she has repented in a way that if a sinful person were to repent the same way, Allah would have forgiven him." He ordered for her to be prayed upon and buried.
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَجَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ بَنِي غَامِدٍ فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُطَهِّرَنِي فَقَالَ لَهَا «ارْجِعِي فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ الْغَدِ أَتَتْهُ أَيْضًا فَاعْتَرَفَتْ عِنْدَهُ بِالزِّنَا» فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي فَلَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تَرْدُدَنِي كَمَا رَدَدْتَ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَحُبْلَى فَقَالَ لَهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «ارْجِعِي حَتَّى تَلِدِي» فَلَمَّا وَلَدَتْ جَاءَتْ بِالصَّبِيِّ تَحْمِلُهُ فِي خِرْقَةٍ فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ هَذَا قَدْ وَلَدْتُ فَقَالَ فَاذْهَبِي فَأَرْضِعِيهِ ثُمَّ افْطِمِيهِ فَلَمَّا فَطَمَتْهُ جَاءَتْ بِالصَّبِيِّ فِي يَدِهِ كِسْرَةُ خُبْزٍ فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَدْ فَطَمْتُهُ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِالصَّبِيِّ فَدُفِعَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُفِرَ لَهَا حُفْرَةٌ فَجُعِلَتْ فِيهَا إِلَى صَدْرِهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يَرْجُمُوهَا فَأَقْبَلَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بِحَجَرٍ فَرَمَى رَأْسَهَا فَتَلَطَّخَ الدَّمُ عَلَى وَجْنَةِ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ فَسَبَّهَا فَسَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ سَبَّهُ إِيَّاهَا فَقَالَ «مَهْ يَا خَالِدُ لَا تَسُبَّهَا فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ تَابَهَا صَاحِبُ مَكْسٍ لَغُفِرَ لَهُ» فَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَصُلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا وَدُفِنَتْ
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Bashīr b. al-Muhājir \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Buraydah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2370

chapter.englishTitle: When a pregnant woman confesses to adultery

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman belonging to the tribe of Juhaynah (according to the version of Aban) came to the Prophet ﷺ and said that she had committed fornication and that she was pregnant. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ called her guardian. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: Be good to her, and when she bears a child, bring her (to me). When she gave birth to the child, he brought her (to him). The Prophet ﷺ gave orders regarding her, and her clothes were tied to her. He then commanded regarding her and she was stoned to death. He commanded the people (to pray) and they prayed over her. Thereupon Umar said: Are you praying over her, Messenger of Allah, when she has committed fornication? He said: By Him in Whose hand my soul is, she has repented to such an extent that if it were divided among the seventy people of Medina, it would have been enough for them all. And what do you find better than the fact that she gave her life. Aban did not say in his version: Then her clothes were tied to her.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman belonging to the tribe of Juhaynah (according to the version of Aban) came to the Prophet ﷺ and said that she had committed fornication and that she was pregnant. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ called her guardian. Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him: Be good to her, and when she bears a child, bring her (to me). When she gave birth to the child, he brought her (to him). The Prophet ﷺ gave orders regarding her, and her clothes were tied to her. He then commanded regarding her and she was stoned to death. He commanded the people (to pray) and they prayed over her. Thereupon Umar said: Are you praying over her, Messenger of Allah, when she has committed fornication? He said: By Him in Whose hand my soul is, she has repented to such an extent that if it were divided among the seventy people of Medina, it would have been enough for them all. And what do you find better than the fact that she gave her life. Aban did not say in his version: Then her clothes were tied to her.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَهِيَ حُبْلَى مِنَ الزِّنَا فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَيَّ فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلِيَّهَا فَقَالَ «اذْهَبْ فَأَحْسِنْ إِلَيْهَا فَإِذَا وَضَعَتْ حَمْلَهَا فَأْتِنِي بِهَا» فَفَعَلَ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَشُكَّتْ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابُهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَرُجِمَتْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا وَقَدْ زَنَتْ فَقَالَ «لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِمَتْ بَيْنَ سَبْعِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ وَهَلْ وَجَدْتَ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَنْ جَادَتْ بِنَفْسِهَا لِلَّهِ ﷻ؟»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Muhallab \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2371

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْمَمَالِيكِ إِذَا زَنَوْا يُقِيمُ سَادَتُهُمْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْحَدَّ دُونَ السُّلْطَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Mamluks, if they commit adultery, their rulers impose the...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ was asked about a slave woman who commits adultery but is not married. He said, 'If she commits adultery, then flog her, and if she commits adultery again, then flog her.' He said, 'I do not know about the third or fourth time, sell her, even if it is for a lock of hair.'"   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ was asked about a slave woman who commits adultery but is not married. He said, 'If she commits adultery, then flog her, and if she commits adultery again, then flog her.' He said, 'I do not know about the third or fourth time, sell her, even if it is for a lock of hair.'"   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنِ الْأَمَةِ تَزْنِي وَلَمْ تُحْصَنْ فَقَالَ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا قَالَ فَمَا أَدْرِي فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوْ فِي الرَّابِعَةِ «فَبِيعُوهَا وَلَوْ بِضَفِيرٍ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e Zayd b. Khālid al-Juhanī And ʾAbī Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2372

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَفْسِيرِ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the interpretation of Allah's saying "or Allah will make a wa...

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Receive (teaching) from me, receive (teaching) from me. Allah has ordained a way for those (women). When an unmarried male commits adultery with an unmarried female (they should receive) one hundred lashes and banishment for one year. And in case of married male committing adultery with a married female, they shall receive one hundred lashes and be stoned to death.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Receive (teaching) from me, receive (teaching) from me. Allah has ordained a way for those (women). When an unmarried male commits adultery with an unmarried female (they should receive) one hundred lashes and banishment for one year. And in case of married male committing adultery with a married female, they shall receive one hundred lashes and be stoned to death.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ خُذُوا عَنِّي خُذُوا عَنِّي قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا الْبِكْرُ بِالْبِكْرِ وَالثَّيِّبُ بِالثَّيِّبِ الْبِكْرُ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَنَفْيُ سَنَةٍ وَالثَّيِّبُ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَالرَّجْمُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. ʿUmar al-Zahrānī \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Ḥiṭṭān b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2373

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي تَفْسِيرِ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the interpretation of Allah's saying "or Allah will make a wa...

hadiths.englishRaw: The above-mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The above-mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Hushaym \u003e Manṣūr \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Ḥiṭṭān b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2374

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ يَقَعُ عَلَى جَارِيَةِ امْرَأَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who falls on his wife's maid?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I will spend in it a year of medical treatment if it is permissible for him." If she made it permissible for him, he would receive one hundred lashes. And if she did not make it permissible for him, she would be stoned. Her husband was asked, and he said, "Indeed, I have made it permissible for him." So he struck him one hundred times. Yahya said, "He is elevated."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I will spend in it a year of medical treatment if it is permissible for him." If she made it permissible for him, he would receive one hundred lashes. And if she did not make it permissible for him, she would be stoned. Her husband was asked, and he said, "Indeed, I have made it permissible for him." So he struck him one hundred times. Yahya said, "He is elevated."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَأَقْضِيَنَّ فِيهِ بِقَضَاءٍ شَافٍ إِنْ كَانَتْ أَحَلَّتْهَا لَهُ جَلَدْتُهُ مِائَةً وَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَمْ تُحِلَّهَا لَهُ رَجَمْتُهُ فَقِيلَ لَهَا زَوْجُكِ فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي قَدْ أَحْلَلْتُهَا لَهُ فَضَرَبَهُ مِائَةً قَالَ يَحْيَى هُوَ مَرْفُوعٌ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abān b. Yazīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Katab Ilay Khālid b. ʿUrfuṭah \u003e Ḥabīb b. Sālim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ خَالِدُ بْنُ عُرْفُطَةَ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ أَنَّ غُلَامًا كَانَ يُنْبَزُ فُرْفُورًا فَوَقَعَ عَلَى جَارِيَةِ امْرَأَتِهِ فَرُفِعَ ذلك إِلَى النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2375

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ يَقَعُ عَلَى جَارِيَةِ امْرَأَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who falls on his wife's maid?

hadiths.englishRaw: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: This tradition has also been narrated on the authority of ‘A’ishah through a different chain.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ṣadaqah b. al-Faḍl \u003e Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Khālid b. ʿUrfuṭah \u003e Ḥabīb b. Sālim \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Bashīr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عُرْفُطَةَ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2376

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْحَدُّ كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَنْ أُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The penalty of Kaffarah for one who breaks fast.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever is punished for a sin, that sin will be forgiven for him."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever is punished for a sin, that sin will be forgiven for him."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ أُقِيمَ عَلَيْهِ حَدٌّ غُفِرَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ الذَّنْبُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad al-Dimashqī \u003e Ibn Wahb \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Munakdir \u003e Ibn Khuzaymah b. Thābit from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنَكْدِرِ عَنْ ابْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2377

chapter.englishTitle: Fulfilling the vow

hadiths.englishRaw: "To perform the Hajj and then die, and her brother came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him about it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, 'If she had any debts, would you have been her judge?' He said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Then fulfill the obligations on behalf of Allah, for Allah is more entitled to fulfill the obligations.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To perform the Hajj and then die, and her brother came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him about it, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, 'If she had any debts, would you have been her judge?' He said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Then fulfill the obligations on behalf of Allah, for Allah is more entitled to fulfill the obligations.'"   – Sound Chain
