hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَحُجَّ فَمَاتَتْ فَجَاءَ أَخُوهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوْ كَانَ عَلَيْهَا دَيْنٌ أكُنْتَ قَاضِيَهُ» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ «فَاقْضُوا اللَّهَ فَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ بِالْوَفَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Bishr \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Āmraʾah Nadharat
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً نَذَرَتْ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2377

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2378

chapter.englishTitle: Fulfilling the vow

hadiths.englishRaw: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, indeed I made a vow in the time of ignorance, then Islam came." He said, "Fulfill your vow."
hadiths.body: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, indeed I made a vow in the time of ignorance, then Islam came." He said, "Fulfill your vow."
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ نَذْرًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْإِسْلَامُ قَالَ فِ بِنَذْرِكَ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عُمَرَ قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2378

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2379

chapter.englishTitle: In the expiation of a vow

hadiths.englishRaw: "To perform Hajj for Allah on foot, without riding an animal that has been prepared. So, I mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, 'Go, sister, and prepare (the animal) and ride it, and observe fasting for three days.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "To perform Hajj for Allah on foot, without riding an animal that has been prepared. So, I mentioned this to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and he said, 'Go, sister, and prepare (the animal) and ride it, and observe fasting for three days.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ تَحُجَّ لِلَّهِ مَاشِيَةً غَيْرَ مُخْتَمِرَةٍ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «مُرْ أُخْتَكَ فَلْتَخْتَمِرْ وَلْتَرْكَبْ وَلْتَصُمْ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Zaḥr \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Ruʿaynī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mālik \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir al-Juhanī \u003e Nadharat Ukhtī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَحْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الرُّعَيْنِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ قَالَ نَذَرَتْ أُخْتِي
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2379

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2380

chapter.englishTitle: In the expiation of a vow

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the phrase "رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنْ نَذْرِ أُخْتِكَ لِتَرْكَبْ وَلْتُهْدِ هَدْيًا»" into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Verily, Allah is self-sufficient and has no need for your sister's vow in order to ride or offer a sacrificial animal.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the phrase "رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنْ نَذْرِ أُخْتِكَ لِتَرْكَبْ وَلْتُهْدِ هَدْيًا»" into English is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Verily, Allah is self-sufficient and has no need for your sister's vow in order to ride or offer a sacrificial animal.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَنِيٌّ عَنْ نَذْرِ أُخْتِكَ لِتَرْكَبْ وَلْتُهْدِ هَدْيًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Ukht ʿUqbah Nadharat \u003e Tamshī \u003e al-Bayt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ أَخْبَرَنِي قَتَادَةُ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ أُخْتَ عُقْبَةَ نَذَرَتْ أَنْ تَمْشِيَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2380

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2381

chapter.englishTitle: In the expiation of a vow

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ saw an old man walking between his two sons, and he said: What is the matter with him?' His sons said: 'A vow, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Let this old man ride, for Allah has no need of you or your vow."'     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ saw an old man walking between his two sons, and he said: What is the matter with him?' His sons said: 'A vow, O Messenger of Allah.' He said: 'Let this old man ride, for Allah has no need of you or your vow."'     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَدْرَكَ شَيْخًا يَمْشِي بَيْنَ ابْنَيْهِ فَقَالَ مَا شَأْنُ هَذَا الشَّيْخِ؟ فَقَالَ ابْنَاهُ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ فَقَالَ «ارْكَبْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْكَ وَعَنْ نَذْرِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Manṣūr \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAmr b. Abū ʿAmr \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2381

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2382

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ لَا نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: No commitment in disobeying Allah.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "There is no vow to commit an act of disobedience or with regard to that which the son of Adam does not possess."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "There is no vow to commit an act of disobedience or with regard to that which the son of Adam does not possess."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا وَفَاءَ لِنَذْرٍ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ وَلَا فِيمَا لَا يَمْلِكُ ابْنُ آدَمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Muhallab \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2382

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2383

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ لَا نَذْرَ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: No commitment in disobeying Allah.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: If anyone vows to obey Allah, let him obey Him, but if anyone vows to disobey Him, let him not disobey Him.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: If anyone vows to obey Allah, let him obey Him, but if anyone vows to disobey Him, let him not disobey Him.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَطِيعَ اللَّهَ فَلْيُطِعْهُ وَمَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَعْصِيَ اللَّهَ فَلَا يَعْصِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ṭalḥah b. ʿAbd al-Malik al-Aylī \u003e al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْأَيْلِيِّ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2383

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2384

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ أَيُجْزِئُهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِمَكَّةَ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever vows to pray in the Al-Masjid al-Haram, is it permissibl...

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah, I have made a vow that if Allah grants you victory, I will pray in Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa (the Holy Mosque). He said, 'Pray here.' So, I repeated it to him three times. Then, the Prophet ﷺ said, 'So what is your intention then?'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah, I have made a vow that if Allah grants you victory, I will pray in Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa (the Holy Mosque). He said, 'Pray here.' So, I repeated it to him three times. Then, the Prophet ﷺ said, 'So what is your intention then?'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ إِنْ فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ فَقَالَ صَلِّ هَا هُنَا فَأَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَشَأْنُكَ إِذَنْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥabīb b. Abū Baqiyyah al-Muʿallim \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Rabāḥ \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e a man
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي بَقِيَّةَ الْمُعَلِّمِ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2384

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2385

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Vows

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah forbade vows and said: 'They do not change anything; they are just a means of taking wealth from the miserly.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah forbade vows and said: 'They do not change anything; they are just a means of taking wealth from the miserly.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ «إِنَّ النَّذْرَ لَا يَرُدُّ شَيْئًا وَإِنَّمَا يُسْتَخْرَجُ بِهِ مِنَ الْبَخِيلِ الشَّحِيحِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Murrah \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2385

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2386

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنْ أَنْ يُحْلَفَ بِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prohibition of Swearing by Other than Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ met ʿUmar bin Al-Khattab while the latter was going with a group of camel-riders, and he was swearing by his father. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Lo! Allah forbids you to swear by your fathers, so whoever has to take an oath, he should swear by Allah or keep quiet."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ met ʿUmar bin Al-Khattab while the latter was going with a group of camel-riders, and he was swearing by his father. The Prophet ﷺ said, "Lo! Allah forbids you to swear by your fathers, so whoever has to take an oath, he should swear by Allah or keep quiet."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَدْرَكَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ وَهُوَ يَسِيرُ فِي رَكْبٍ وَهُوَ يَحْلِفُ بِأَبِيهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَنْهَاكُمْ أَنْ تَحْلِفُوا بِآبَائِكُمْ فَمَنْ كَانَ حَالِفًا فَلْيَحْلِفْ بِاللَّهِ أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik b. Anas \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2386

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2387

chapter.englishTitle: In the exception with the right

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone says when swearing an oath: "If Allah wills," he makes an exception.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone says when swearing an oath: "If Allah wills," he makes an exception.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَقَدِ اسْتَثْنَى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2387

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2388

chapter.englishTitle: In the exception with the right

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever takes an oath by a right hand and then says, 'If Allah wills,' then he is choosing the best way. And if He wills otherwise, then he will not do it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever takes an oath by a right hand and then says, 'If Allah wills,' then he is choosing the best way. And if He wills otherwise, then he will not do it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ فَعَلَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2388

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2389

chapter.englishTitle: The Right Division

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Bakr, "Do not swear an oath." Abu Muhammad replied, "The hadith is lengthy."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said to Abu Bakr, "Do not swear an oath." Abu Muhammad replied, "The hadith is lengthy."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ لِأَبِي بَكْرٍ «لَا تُقْسِمْ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «الْحَدِيثُ فِيهِ طُولٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2389

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2390

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever swears an oath on something and then sees something else...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever swears an oath, then sees something better than it, let him do that which is better."    – Sound
hadiths.body: "Whoever swears an oath, then sees something better than it, let him do that which is better."    – Sound
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَلْيَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ وَلْيُكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr Ibn Murrah \u003e a man Yuqāl Lah ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr Zaman al-Jamājim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو ابْنُ مُرَّةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا يُقَالُ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو زَمَنَ الْجَمَاجِمِ يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ؟ فَحَلَفَ أَنْ لَا يُعْطِيَهُ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ قَالَ لَوْلَا أَنِّي
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2390

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2391

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever swears an oath on something and then sees something else...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "O ʿAbdur-Rahman bin Samura! Do not seek to be a ruler, because if you are given authority for it, then you will be held responsible for it, but if you are given it without asking for it, then you will be helped in it (by Allah): and whenever you take an oath to do something and later you find that something else is better than the first, then do the better one and make expiation for your oath."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "O ʿAbdur-Rahman bin Samura! Do not seek to be a ruler, because if you are given authority for it, then you will be held responsible for it, but if you are given it without asking for it, then you will be helped in it (by Allah): and whenever you take an oath to do something and later you find that something else is better than the first, then do the better one and make expiation for your oath."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ «لَا تَسْأَلِ الْإِمَارَةَ فَإِنَّكَ إِنْ أُعْطِيتَهَا عَنْ مَسْأَلَةٍ وُكِلْتَ إِلَيْهَا وَإِنْ أُعْطِيتَهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ مَسْأَلَةٍ أُعِنْتَ عَلَيْهَا فَإِذَا حَلَفْتَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَيْتَ غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ وَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Faḍl \u003e Jarīr b. Ḥāzim \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2391

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2392

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى غَيْرَهَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever swears an oath on something and then sees something else...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: He then mentioned the rest of the tradition to the same effect as mentioned by Sufyan.     – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: He then mentioned the rest of the tradition to the same effect as mentioned by Sufyan.     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ الْحَدِيثِ   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2392

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2393

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ إِذَا كَانَ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ رَقَبَةٌ مُؤْمِنَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: If a man has a trusting neck

hadiths.englishRaw: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, my mother has a slave girl, and I have an Abyssinian slave girl. Should I set her free?" He said, "Bring her to me." Then he asked, "Do you bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah?" She replied, "Yes." He said, "Set her free, for she is a believer."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "Indeed, my mother has a slave girl, and I have an Abyssinian slave girl. Should I set her free?" He said, "Bring her to me." Then he asked, "Do you bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah?" She replied, "Yes." He said, "Set her free, for she is a believer."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ عَلَى أُمِّي رَقَبَةً وَإِنَّ عِنْدِي جَارِيَةً سَوْدَاءَ نُوبِيَّةً أَفَتُجْزِئُ عَنْهَا قَالَ «ادْعُ بِهَا» فَقَالَ أَتَشْهَدِينَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ قَالَ «أَعْتِقْهَا فَإِنَّهَا مُؤْمِنَةٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e al-Sharīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ الشَّرِيدِ قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2393

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2394
hadiths.englishRaw: "Your oath is as your companion understands it to be."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Your oath is as your companion understands it to be."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَمِينُكَ عَلَى مَا يَصْدُّ قَكَ بِهِ صَاحِبُكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Hushaym \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṣāliḥ from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2394

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2395

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ بِأَيِّ أَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ حَلَفْتَ لَزِمَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: By which names of Allah did you swear to adhere?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The oath by which the Messenger of Allah used to swear was: 'No, by the Controller of the hearts.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The oath by which the Messenger of Allah used to swear was: 'No, by the Controller of the hearts.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَتْ يَمِينُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الَّتِي يَحْلِفُ بِهَا «لَا وَمُقَلِّبِ الْقُلُوبِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUqbah \u003e Sālim \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
references: Book of Vows and Oaths, Hadith 2395

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2396
hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Whoever is afflicted with a wound or a boil, and the boil is a kind of wound, then he has three options. If he wishes for a fourth option, then you should take hold of his hands between whether he seeks retribution, or forgives, or takes compensation. If he takes anything from that and then goes beyond that, then the Fire is for him, he will abide therein forever."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Whoever is afflicted with a wound or a boil, and the boil is a kind of wound, then he has three options. If he wishes for a fourth option, then you should take hold of his hands between whether he seeks retribution, or forgives, or takes compensation. If he takes anything from that and then goes beyond that, then the Fire is for him, he will abide therein forever."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ أُصِيبَ بِدَمٍ أَوْ خَبْلٍ وَالْخَبْلُ الْجُرْحُ فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ بَيْنَ إِحْدَى ثَلَاثٍ فَإِنْ أَرَادَ الرَّابِعَةَ فَخُذُوا عَلَى يَدَيْهِ بَيْنَ أَنْ يَقْتَصَّ أَوْ يَعْفُوَ أَوْ يَأْخُذَ الْعَقْلَ فَإِنْ أَخَذَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ عَدَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَهُ النَّارُ خَالِدًا فِيهَا مُخَلَّدًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith b. Fuḍayl \u003e Sufyān b. Abū al-ʿAwjāʾ al-Sulamī \u003e Abū Shurayḥ al-Khuzāʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ فُضَيْلٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَوْجَاءِ السُّلَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2397
hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen and in his letter, he stated: "Whoever kills a believer without a just cause, his hands are to be tied, unless the relatives of the slain demand blood money." Abu Muhammad said: "Killing without a valid reason is considered murder."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen and in his letter, he stated: "Whoever kills a believer without a just cause, his hands are to be tied, unless the relatives of the slain demand blood money." Abu Muhammad said: "Killing without a valid reason is considered murder."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ وَكَانَ فِي كِتَابِهِ «أَنَّ مَنْ اعْتَبَطَ مُؤْمِنًا قَتْلًا عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ فَإِنَّهُ قَوَدُ يَدِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَرْضَى أَوْلِيَاءُ الْمَقْتُولِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «اعْتَبَطَ قَتَلَ مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلَّةٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2398

chapter.englishTitle: In the division of

hadiths.englishRaw: "Then, they went against Abdullah and he was killed. His neck was struck until it was severed, then he was thrown into a pit among the pits of Khaybar. His companions called out to him, and they pulled him out and concealed him. Then, they arrived in Medina to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . His brother, Abdullah ibn Sahl, came forward. He had accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his two cousins, Huwayshah ibn Mas'ud and Muhayyisah. Abdullah spoke, and he was the youngest among them in age, but he had spilled blood and was respected among his people. When he finished speaking, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Al-Kubra! (The greatest!)' He then stepped back, and Huwayshah and Muhayyisah spoke. Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'You call your killer, then you swear fifty oaths upon him, then we will hand him over to you.' They said, 'O Messenger of Allah! We would not swear upon something we do not know. We do not know who killed him except that it was a Jew, our enemy, and among their ranks he was killed.' He said, 'So, they would swear to you by Allah that they are innocent of the blood of your companion, and then they would dissociate themselves from it.' They said, 'We would not accept oaths from Jews. There is no greater crime than them swearing falsely.' He said, 'By Allah! The Messenger of Allah desires from it one hundred camels as compensation.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Then, they went against Abdullah and he was killed. His neck was struck until it was severed, then he was thrown into a pit among the pits of Khaybar. His companions called out to him, and they pulled him out and concealed him. Then, they arrived in Medina to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . His brother, Abdullah ibn Sahl, came forward. He had accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his two cousins, Huwayshah ibn Mas'ud and Muhayyisah. Abdullah spoke, and he was the youngest among them in age, but he had spilled blood and was respected among his people. When he finished speaking, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Al-Kubra! (The greatest!)' He then stepped back, and Huwayshah and Muhayyisah spoke. Then, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'You call your killer, then you swear fifty oaths upon him, then we will hand him over to you.' They said, 'O Messenger of Allah! We would not swear upon something we do not know. We do not know who killed him except that it was a Jew, our enemy, and among their ranks he was killed.' He said, 'So, they would swear to you by Allah that they are innocent of the blood of your companion, and then they would dissociate themselves from it.' They said, 'We would not accept oaths from Jews. There is no greater crime than them swearing falsely.' He said, 'By Allah! The Messenger of Allah desires from it one hundred camels as compensation.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فَعُدِيَ عَلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقُتِلَ فَتُلَّتْ عُنُقُهُ حَتَّى نُخِعَ ثُمَّ طُرِحَ فِي مَنْهَلٍ مِنْ مَنَاهِلِ خَيْبَرَ فَاسْتُصْرِخَ عَلَيْهِ أَصْحَابُهُ فَاسْتَخْرَجُوهُ فَغَيَّبُوهُ ثُمَّ قَدِمُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ فَتَقَدَّمَ أَخُوهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ وَكَانَ ذَا قِدَمٍ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَابْنَا عَمِّهِ مَعَهُ حُوَيِّصَةُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَمُحَيِّصَةُ فَتَكَلَّمَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ وَكَانَ أَحْدَثَهُمْ سِنًّا وَهُوَ صَاحِبُ الدَّمِ وَذَا قَدَمٍ فِي الْقَوْمِ فَلَمَّا تَكَلَّمَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْكُبْرَ الْكُبْرَ» قَالَ فَاسْتَأْخَرَ فَتَكَلَّمَ حُوَيِّصَةُ وَمُحَيِّصَةُ ثُمَّ هُوَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تُسَمُّونَ قَاتِلَكُمْ ثُمَّ تَحْلِفُونَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْسِينَ يَمِينًا ثُمَّ نُسَلِّمُهُ إِلَيْكُمْ» قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا كُنَّا لِنَحْلِفَ عَلَى مَا لَا نَعْلَمُ مَا نَدْرِي مَنْ قَتَلَهُ إِلَّا أَنَّ يَهُودَ عَدُوُّنَا وَبَيْنَ أَظْهُرِهِمْ قُتِلَ قَالَ «فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُمْ لَبُرَءَاءُ مِنْ دَمِ صَاحِبِكُمْ ثُمَّ يَبْرَءُونَ مِنْهُ» قَالُوا مَا كُنَّا لِنَقْبَلَ أَيْمَانَ يَهُودَ مَا فِيهِمْ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أَنْ يَحْلِفُوا عَلَى إِثْمٍ قَالَ «فَوَدَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ بِمِائَةِ نَاقَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Bushayr b. Yasār \u003e Sahl b. Abū Ḥathmah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا بُشَيْرُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ قَالَ خَرَجَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَهْلٍ أَحَدُ بَنِي حَارِثَةَ إِلَى خَيْبَرَ مَعَ نَفَرٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ يُرِيدُونَ الْمِيرَةَ بِخَيْبَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2399

chapter.englishTitle: The power dynamics between men and women.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen in his letter, saying, "A man is killed by a woman."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen in his letter, saying, "A man is killed by a woman."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ وَكَانَ فِي كِتَابِهِ «أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يُقْتَلُ بِالْمَرْأَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2400

chapter.englishTitle: How does work in Al-Qawad?

hadiths.englishRaw: A girl was found with her head crushed between two stoned. She was asked: Who did it with you ? Was it so and so ? Was it so and so ? Until the Jew was named. Thereupon she gave a sign with her head. The Jew was arrested and he admitted. So the Prophet ﷺ gave command that his head should be crushed with stones.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A girl was found with her head crushed between two stoned. She was asked: Who did it with you ? Was it so and so ? Was it so and so ? Until the Jew was named. Thereupon she gave a sign with her head. The Jew was arrested and he admitted. So the Prophet ﷺ gave command that his head should be crushed with stones.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ جَارِيَةً رُضَّ رَأْسُهَا بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ فَقِيلَ لَهَا مَنْ فَعَلَ بِكِ هَذَا؟ أَفُلَانٌ؟ أَفُلَانٌ؟ حَتَّى سُمِّيَ الْيَهُودِيُّ؟ فَأَوْمَأَتْ بِرَأْسِهَا فَبُعِثَ إِلَيْهِ فَجِيءَ بِهِ فَاعْتَرَفَ «فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَرُضَّ رَأْسُهُ بَيْنَ حَجَرَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2401

chapter.englishTitle: A Muslim should not be killed by a non-believer.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I said to 'Ali: O Commander of the Believers! Do you have anything written that is not in Allah's Book?' He said: 'By the One Who splits the seed and creates the soul, I have not learned from it except what understanding of the Qur'an Allah gives to a man, and what is in this sheet of paper.' I said: 'What is in the paper?' He said: 'It is the 'Aql, the (ransom for) release of captives, and the judgement that no believer is killed for a disbeliever.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I said to 'Ali: O Commander of the Believers! Do you have anything written that is not in Allah's Book?' He said: 'By the One Who splits the seed and creates the soul, I have not learned from it except what understanding of the Qur'an Allah gives to a man, and what is in this sheet of paper.' I said: 'What is in the paper?' He said: 'It is the 'Aql, the (ransom for) release of captives, and the judgement that no believer is killed for a disbeliever.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِعَلِيٍّ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ هَلْ عَلِمْتَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الْوَحْيِ إِلَّا مَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى؟ قَالَ «لَا وَالَّذِي فَلَقَ الْحَبَّةَ وَبَرَأَ النَّسَمَةَ مَا أَعْلَمُهُ إِلَّا فَهْمًا يُعْطِيهِ اللَّهُ الرَّجُلَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ وَمَا فِي الصَّحِيفَةِ» قُلْتُ وَمَا فِي الصَّحِيفَةِ؟ قَالَ «الْعَقْلُ وَفِكَاكُ الْأَسِيرِ وَلَا يُقْتَلُ مُسْلِمٌ بِمُشْرِكٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Jarīr \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Abū Juḥayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ أَنْبَأَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2402

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقَوَدِ بَيْنَ الْوَالِدِ وَالْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the power struggle between parent and child

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Prophet ﷺ said: 'The Hudud are not carried in the Masjid, and the father is not killed for the son."     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said: 'The Hudud are not carried in the Masjid, and the father is not killed for the son."     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَا تُقَامُ الْحُدُودُ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ وَلَا يُقَادُ بِالْوَلَدِ الْوَالِدُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Muslim \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَونٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2403

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الْقَوَدِ بَيْنَ الْعَبْدِ وَسَيِّدِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the power dynamics between the servant and his master

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever kills his slave, we will kill him. And whoever mutilates him, we will mutilate him." Then Al-Hasan forgot this Hadith and used to say, "A free man should not be killed for a slave."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever kills his slave, we will kill him. And whoever mutilates him, we will mutilate him." Then Al-Hasan forgot this Hadith and used to say, "A free man should not be killed for a slave."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ قَتَلَ عَبْدَهُ قَتَلْنَاهُ وَمَنْ جَدَعَهُ جَدَعْنَاهُ» قَالَ ثُمَّ نَسِيَ الْحَسَنُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ لَا يُقْتَلُ حُرٌّ بِعَبْدٍ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Samurah b. Jundub
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2404

chapter.englishTitle: To Whom Does He Pardon His Killer?

hadiths.englishRaw: I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ when a killer was brought to him, bound in chains. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the guardian of the slain person, "Will you pardon him?" He replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ then asked, "Will you accept blood money?" He again replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ then asked, "Will you kill him?" He finally replied, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said, "If you forgive him, then he will bear your sin and the sin of his companion." The guardian decided to forgive him and said, "I have seen him dragging his chains, and he has been forgiven."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I witnessed the Prophet ﷺ when a killer was brought to him, bound in chains. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to the guardian of the slain person, "Will you pardon him?" He replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ then asked, "Will you accept blood money?" He again replied, "No." The Prophet ﷺ then asked, "Will you kill him?" He finally replied, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said, "If you forgive him, then he will bear your sin and the sin of his companion." The guardian decided to forgive him and said, "I have seen him dragging his chains, and he has been forgiven."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: شَهِدْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ حِينَ أُتِيَ بِالرَّجُلِ الْقَاتِلِ يُقَادُ فِي نِسْعَةٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِوَلِيِّ الْمَقْتُولِ «أَتَعْفُو» قَالَ لَا قَالَ «فَتَأْخُذُ الدِّيَةَ» قَالَ لَا قَالَ «فَتَقْتُلُهُ» قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّكَ إِنْ عَفَوْتَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَبُوءُ بِإِثْمِكَ وَإِثْمِ صَاحِبِكَ» قَالَ فَتَرَكَهُ قَالَ «فَأَنَا رَأَيْتُهُ يَجُرُّ نِسْعَتَهُ قَدْ عَفَا عَنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Hamdānī \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e ʿAwf \u003e Ḥamzah Abū ʿUmar \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Wāʾil al-Ḥaḍramī \u003e Abīh Wāʾil b. Ḥujr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ أَبِي عُمَرَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَائِلِ بْنِ حُجْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2405

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ التَّشْدِيدِ فِي قَتْلِ النَّفْسِ الْمُسْلِمَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: Tashdeed fi qatl alnafs almuslima

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet [SAW] said: "The major sins are: Associating others with Allah, disobeying parents, killing a soul (murder) and swearing a false oath knowingly."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet [SAW] said: "The major sins are: Associating others with Allah, disobeying parents, killing a soul (murder) and swearing a false oath knowingly."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْكَبَائِرُ الْإِشْرَاكُ بِاللَّهِ وَعُقُوقُ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَقَتْلُ النَّفْسِ شُعْبَةُ الشَّاكُّ أَوِ الْيَمِينُ الْغَمُوسُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Bashhār \u003e Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Firās \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ فِرَاسٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2406

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ التَّشْدِيدِ عَلَى مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Tightening the noose on the one who kills himself

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Cursed is the believer as he kills, and whoever kills himself with something in this world will be punished with it on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Cursed is the believer as he kills, and whoever kills himself with something in this world will be punished with it on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَعْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَقَتْلِهِ وَمَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِشَيْءٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا عُذِّبَ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Thābit b. al-Ḍaḥḥāk
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ الضَّحَّاكِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2407

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ التَّشْدِيدِ عَلَى مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Tightening the noose on the one who kills himself

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever purposely throws himself from a mountain and kills himself, will be in the (Hell) Fire falling down into it and abiding therein perpetually forever; and whoever drinks poison and kills himself with it, he will be carrying his poison in his hand and drinking it in the (Hell) Fire wherein he will abide eternally forever; and whoever kills himself with an iron weapon, will be carrying that weapon in his hand and stabbing his ʿAbdomen with it in the (Hell) Fire wherein he will abide eternally forever."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever purposely throws himself from a mountain and kills himself, will be in the (Hell) Fire falling down into it and abiding therein perpetually forever; and whoever drinks poison and kills himself with it, he will be carrying his poison in his hand and drinking it in the (Hell) Fire wherein he will abide eternally forever; and whoever kills himself with an iron weapon, will be carrying that weapon in his hand and stabbing his ʿAbdomen with it in the (Hell) Fire wherein he will abide eternally forever."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِحَدِيدَةٍ فَحَدِيدَتُهُ فِي يَدِهِ يَتَوَجَّأُ بِهَا فِي بَطْنِهِ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا وَمَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِسُمٍّ فَسُمُّهُ فِي يَدِهِ يَتَحَسَّاهُ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا وَمَنْ تَرَدَّى مِنْ جَبَلٍ فَقَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ فَهُوَ يَتَرَدَّى فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدًا مُخَلَّدًا فِيهَا أَبَدًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2408

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَمِ الدِّيَةُ مِنَ الْوَرِقِ وَالذَّهَبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is the value of the ransom from paper and gold?

hadiths.englishRaw: A man killed another man during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , so the Prophet ﷺ set his blood money at twelve thousand. This is mentioned in the verse in the Quran: "They swear by Allah that they did not say [anything against the Prophet], while they had definitely uttered disbelief and disbelieved after their [pretense of] Islam and planned that which they were not to attain. And they were not resentful except [for the fact] that Allah and His Messenger had enriched them of His bounty." [Surah At-Tawbah, 9:74]
hadiths.body: A man killed another man during the time of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , so the Prophet ﷺ set his blood money at twelve thousand. This is mentioned in the verse in the Quran: "They swear by Allah that they did not say [anything against the Prophet], while they had definitely uttered disbelief and disbelieved after their [pretense of] Islam and planned that which they were not to attain. And they were not resentful except [for the fact] that Allah and His Messenger had enriched them of His bounty." [Surah At-Tawbah, 9:74]
hadiths.arabic: قَتَلَ رَجُلٌ رَجُلًا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ دِيَتَهُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ أَلْفًا فهو قَوْلُهُ {يَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ مَا قَالُوا وَلَقَدْ قَالُوا كَلِمَةَ الْكُفْرِ وَكَفَرُوا بَعْدَ إِسْلَامِهِمْ وَهَمُّوا بِمَا لَمْ يَنَالُوا وَمَا نَقَمُوا إِلَّا أَنْ أَغْنَاهُمُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ} [التوبة 74] بِأَخْذِهِمُ الدِّيَةَ
hadiths.chain: Muʿādh b. Hāniʾ \u003e Muḥammad b. Muslim \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2409

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَمِ الدِّيَةُ مِنَ الْوَرِقِ وَالذَّهَبِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is the value of the ransom from paper and gold?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, "And for the people of Ad-Dhahab, one thousand dinars."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, "And for the people of Ad-Dhahab, one thousand dinars."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ «وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الذَّهَبِ أَلْفُ دِينَارٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2410

chapter.englishTitle: What is the "diyah" of the camels?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. From Muhammad, the Prophet ﷺ , to Shurahbil ibn Abd Kulal, Harith ibn Abd Kulal, and Nuaim ibn Abd Kulal, also known as Dhī Ruayn, Ma'āfir, and Hamdān. In his letter, he said, "Verily, in the soul is a hundred camels."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. From Muhammad, the Prophet ﷺ , to Shurahbil ibn Abd Kulal, Harith ibn Abd Kulal, and Nuaim ibn Abd Kulal, also known as Dhī Ruayn, Ma'āfir, and Hamdān. In his letter, he said, "Verily, in the soul is a hundred camels."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ إِلَى شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ كُلَالٍ وَالْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ كُلَالٍ وَنُعَيْمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ كُلَالٍ قِيَلِ ذِي رُعَيْنٍ وَمَعَافِرَ وَهَمْدَانَ فَكَانَ فِي كِتَابِهِ «وَإِنَّ فِي النَّفْسِ الدِّيَةَ مِائَةٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2411

chapter.englishTitle: What is the "diyah" of the camels?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote a letter to the people of Yemen and in his letter he mentioned: 'In the nose, when its tip becomes reddish, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the tongue, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the lips, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the two front teeth, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the male organ, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the chest, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the eyes, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In one leg, there is half of blood money (Diyah). In the mamoomeh (a domestic animal other than a camel), there is one-third of blood money (Diyah). In the jaifa (a domestic animal other than a camel), there is one-third of blood money (Diyah). In the manqqilah (a type of camel), there are fifteen camels worth of blood money (Diyah)."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote a letter to the people of Yemen and in his letter he mentioned: 'In the nose, when its tip becomes reddish, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the tongue, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the lips, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the two front teeth, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the male organ, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the chest, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In the eyes, there is a portion of blood money (Diyah). In one leg, there is half of blood money (Diyah). In the mamoomeh (a domestic animal other than a camel), there is one-third of blood money (Diyah). In the jaifa (a domestic animal other than a camel), there is one-third of blood money (Diyah). In the manqqilah (a type of camel), there are fifteen camels worth of blood money (Diyah)."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ وَكَانَ فِي كِتَابِهِ «وَفِي الْأَنْفِ إِذَا أُوعِبَ جَدْعُهُ الدِّيَةُ وَفِي اللِّسَانِ الدِّيَةُ وَفِي الشَّفَتَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ وَفِي الْبَيْضَتَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ وَفِي الذَّكَرِ الدِّيَةُ وَفِي الصُّلْبِ الدِّيَةُ وَفِي الْعَيْنَيْنِ الدِّيَةُ وَفِي الرِّجْلِ الْوَاحِدَةِ نِصْفُ الدِّيَةِ وَفِي الْمَأْمُومَةِ ثُلُثُ الدِّيَةِ وَفِي الْجَائِفَةِ ثُلُثُ الدِّيَةِ وَفِي الْمُنَقِّلَةِ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2412

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ كَيْفَ الْعَمَلُ فِي أَخْذِ دِيَةِ الْخَطَأِ
chapter.englishTitle: How to carry out the wrongful death settlement

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made the blood money for accidental killing to be one-fifth."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ made the blood money for accidental killing to be one-fifth."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «جَعَلَ الدِّيَةَ فِي الْخَطَإِ أَخْمَاسًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Muʿāwiyah \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e Zayd b. Jubayr \u003e Khishf b. Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ خِشْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2413

chapter.englishTitle: Retaliation between slaves

hadiths.englishRaw: A servant of some poor people cut off the ear of the servant of some rich people. His people came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: Messenger of Allah! we are poor people. So he imposed no compensation on them.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: A servant of some poor people cut off the ear of the servant of some rich people. His people came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: Messenger of Allah! we are poor people. So he imposed no compensation on them.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَبْدًا لِأُنَاسٍ فُقَرَاءَ قَطَعَ يَدَ غُلَامٍ لِأُنَاسٍ أَغْنِيَاءَ فَأَتَى أَهْلُهُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لِأُنَاسٍ فُقَرَاءَ؟ «فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ عَلَيْهِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Rifāʿī \u003e Muʿādh b. Hishām from his father \u003e Qatādah \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2414

chapter.englishTitle: In the Land of Fingers

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , he said, "Fingers are equal." I then asked, "Ten, ten?" He replied, "Yes."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , he said, "Fingers are equal." I then asked, "Ten, ten?" He replied, "Yes."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْأَصَابِعُ سَوَاءٌ» قَالَ فَقُلْتُ عَشْرٌ عَشْرٌ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ghālib al-Tammār \u003e Masrūq b. Aws \u003e Abū Mūsá al-Ashʿarī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ غَالِبٍ التَّمَّارِ عَنْ مَسْرُوقِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2415

chapter.englishTitle: In the Land of Fingers

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "This and that are equal." And he said, "With his pinky finger and thumb."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "This and that are equal." And he said, "With his pinky finger and thumb."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «هَذَا وَهَذَا سَوَاءٌ» وَقَالَ «بِخِنْصِرِهِ وَإِبْهَامِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2416

chapter.englishTitle: In the Land of Fingers

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: "And on every finger of the hand and foot, there are ten camels."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen: "And on every finger of the hand and foot, there are ten camels."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ «وَفِي كُلِّ إِصْبَعٍ مِنْ أَصَابِعِ الْيَدِ وَالرِّجْلِ عَشْرٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2417

chapter.englishTitle: In the clarification

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed the spoil equally among the participants, with five camels for each."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed the spoil equally among the participants, with five camels for each."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْمَوَاضِحِ خَمْسًا خَمْسًا مِنَ الْإِبِلِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Maṭar \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مَطَرٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2418

chapter.englishTitle: In the clarification

hadiths.englishRaw: The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, wrote to the people of Yemen: "In every finger of the hand and foot, there are ten camels, and in the hump, there are five camels."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, wrote to the people of Yemen: "In every finger of the hand and foot, there are ten camels, and in the hump, there are five camels."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ «وَفِي كُلِّ إِصْبَعٍ مِنْ أَصَابِعِ الْيَدِ وَالرِّجْلِ عَشْرٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ وَفِي الْمُوضِحَةِ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2419

chapter.englishTitle: In the field of dentistry.

hadiths.englishRaw: "For teeth (the Diyah is) five camels.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "For teeth (the Diyah is) five camels.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْأَسْنَانِ خَمْسًا خَمْسًا مِنَ الْإِبِلِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Maṭar \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مَطَرٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2420

chapter.englishTitle: In the field of dentistry.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, "And in the year, there are five types of camels."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ wrote to the people of Yemen, "And in the year, there are five types of camels."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ «وَفِي السِّنِّ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْإِبِلِ» س   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Mūsá \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Sulaymān b. Dāwud \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2421

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِيمَنْ عَضَّ يَدَ رَجُلٍ فَانْتَزَعَ الْمَعْضُوضُ يَدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who bit a man's hand and pulled his bitten hand?

hadiths.englishRaw: He pulled his hand away and his two fingers got dislocated, so they argued with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said, "Will one of you bite his brother as a stallion bites?" You have no compensation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He pulled his hand away and his two fingers got dislocated, so they argued with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. He said, "Will one of you bite his brother as a stallion bites?" You have no compensation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَوَقَعَتْ ثَنِيَّتَاهُ فَاخْتَصَمُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «يَعَضُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ كَمَا يَعَضُّ الْفَحْلُ؟ لَا دِيَةَ لَكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Zurārah b. Awfá \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn \u003e a man ʿAḍ Yad a man
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زُرَارَةَ بْنَ أَوْفَى عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا عَضَّ يَدَ رَجُلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2422

chapter.englishTitle: The wound of the Ajma'a is severe.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah said: "The injuries caused by the well are without liability, [1] and beasts are without liability, and mines are without liability, and the Khumus is due on Rikaz."    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah said: "The injuries caused by the well are without liability, [1] and beasts are without liability, and mines are without liability, and the Khumus is due on Rikaz."    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْعَجْمَاءُ جُرْحُهَا جُبَارٌ وَالْبِئْرُ جُبَارٌ وَالْمَعْدِنُ جُبَارٌ وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2423

chapter.englishTitle: The wound of the Ajma'a is severe.

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no Diya for persons killed by animals or for the one who has been killed accidentally by falling into a well or for the one killed in a mine. And one-fifth of Rikaz (treasures buried before the Islamic era) is to be given to the state."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no Diya for persons killed by animals or for the one who has been killed accidentally by falling into a well or for the one killed in a mine. And one-fifth of Rikaz (treasures buried before the Islamic era) is to be given to the state."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «جُرْحُ الْعَجْمَاءِ جُبَارٌ وَالْبِئْرُ جُبَارٌ وَالْمَعْدِنُ جُبَارٌ وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʾAbī Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2424

chapter.englishTitle: The wound of the Ajma'a is severe.

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "The metal is strong, the sailing ship is strong, the well is strong, and in the fifth is the scale."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "The metal is strong, the sailing ship is strong, the well is strong, and in the fifth is the scale."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْمَعْدِنُ جُبَارٌ وَالسَّائِمَةُ جُبَارٌ وَالْبِئْرُ جُبَارٌ وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2425

chapter.englishTitle: In the womb's environment

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the Prophet ﷺ, that there were two women who were under the authority of a man, and they had a disagreement. One of them struck the other with a stick and killed her, along with the fetus in her womb. They brought their dispute to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who ruled in favor of the unborn child and made it the responsibility of the family of the woman."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From the Prophet ﷺ, that there were two women who were under the authority of a man, and they had a disagreement. One of them struck the other with a stick and killed her, along with the fetus in her womb. They brought their dispute to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, who ruled in favor of the unborn child and made it the responsibility of the family of the woman."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ امْرَأَتَيْنِ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ فَتَغَايَرَتَا فَضَرَبَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى بِعَمُودٍ فَقَتَلَتْهَا وَمَا فِي بَطْنِهَا فَاخْتَصَمَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ «فَقَضَى فِيهِ غُرَّةً وَجَعَلَهَا عَلَى عَاقِلَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿUbayd b. Nuḍaylah \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ نُضَيْلَةَ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2426

chapter.englishTitle: In the womb's environment

hadiths.englishRaw: he asked the people about the ruling of the Prophet ﷺ concerning that - concerning a fetus. Hamal bin Malik bin Nabighah stood up and said: “I was between my two wives and one of them struck the other with a tent-pole, killing her and a fetus. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the blood money for the fetus was a slave, and that she would be killed in retaliation.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: he asked the people about the ruling of the Prophet ﷺ concerning that - concerning a fetus. Hamal bin Malik bin Nabighah stood up and said: “I was between my two wives and one of them struck the other with a tent-pole, killing her and a fetus. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the blood money for the fetus was a slave, and that she would be killed in retaliation.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عُمَرَ نَشَدَ النَّاسَ قَضَاءَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْجَنِينِ فَقَامَ حَمَلُ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ النَّابِغَةِ فَقَالَ كُنْتُ بَيْنَ امْرَأَتَيْنِ فَضَرَبَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى بِمِسْطَحٍ «فَقَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي جَنِينِهَا بِغُرَّةٍ وَأَنْ تُقْتَلَ بِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAmr \u003e Ibn Dīnār \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو هُوَ ابْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2427

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ دِيَةِ الْخَطَإِ عَلَى مَنْ هِيَ
chapter.englishTitle: The responsibility for the mistake falls on whom?

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah, why should I play blood-wit for one who neither drank, nor ate, nor spoke, nor made any noise; it is like a nonentity (it is, therefore, not justifiable to demand blood-wit for it). Thereupon Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: He seems to be one of the brothers of soothsavers on account of the rhymed speech which he has composed.
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah, why should I play blood-wit for one who neither drank, nor ate, nor spoke, nor made any noise; it is like a nonentity (it is, therefore, not justifiable to demand blood-wit for it). Thereupon Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: He seems to be one of the brothers of soothsavers on account of the rhymed speech which he has composed.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَتَيْنِ مِنْ هُذَيْلٍ اقْتَتَلَتَا فَرَمَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى بِحَجَرٍ فَقَتَلَتْهَا وَمَا فِي بَطْنِهَا فَاخْتَصَمُوا فِي الدِّيَةِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَضَى أَنَّ دِيَةَ جَنِينِهَا غُرَّةٌ عَبْدٌ أَوْ وَلِيدَةٌ وَقَضَى بِدِيَتِهَا عَلَى عَاقِلَتِهَا وَرَثَتُهَا وَلَدُهَا وَمَنْ مَعَهَا فَقَالَ حَمَلُ بْنُ النَّابِغَةِ الْهُذَلِيُّ كَيْفَ أُغَرَّمُ مَنْ لَا شَرِبَ وَلَا أَكَلَ وَلَا نَطَقَ وَلَا اسْتَهَلَّ فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ يُطَلُّ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنْ إِخْوَانِ الْكُهَّانِ مِنْ أَجْلِ سَجْعِهِ الَّذِي سَجَعَ»
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʾAbī Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2428

chapter.englishTitle: Diyya in partial negligence

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed the accidental killing, which seems intentional, with a whip or a stick, (the Diyah) is one hundred camels, of which forty should be (she-camels) with their young in their wombs."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed the accidental killing, which seems intentional, with a whip or a stick, (the Diyah) is one hundred camels, of which forty should be (she-camels) with their young in their wombs."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «دِيَةُ قَتِيلِ الْخَطَإِ شِبْهِ الْعَمْدِ وَمَا كَانَ بِالسَّوْطِ وَالْعَصَا مِنْهَا أَرْبَعُونَ فِي بُطُونِهَا أَوْلَادُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e al-Qāsim b. Rabīʿah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2429

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنِ اطَّلَعَ فِي دَارِ قَوْمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: Who entered someone's house without their permission?

hadiths.englishRaw: If I were to know that you had been peeping through the door, I would have thrust that into your eyes, and Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Permission is needed as a protection against glance.
hadiths.body: If I were to know that you had been peeping through the door, I would have thrust that into your eyes, and Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Permission is needed as a protection against glance.
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلًا اطَّلَعَ فِي جُحْرٍ فِي حُجْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَمَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِدْرًى يُخَلِّلُ بِهَا رَأْسَهُ فَرَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُنِي لَطَعَنْتُ بِهَا فِي عَيْنَيْكَ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الْإِذْنُ مِنْ أَجْلِ النَّظَرِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd al-Sāʿidī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2430

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنِ اطَّلَعَ فِي دَارِ قَوْمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: Who entered someone's house without their permission?

hadiths.englishRaw: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in a chamber, and with him was a comb with which he would comb his hair, a man looked at him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "If I had known that you were watching, I would have stabbed your eyes with this comb. Indeed, permission was granted only for the purpose of looking."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in a chamber, and with him was a comb with which he would comb his hair, a man looked at him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to him, "If I had known that you were watching, I would have stabbed your eyes with this comb. Indeed, permission was granted only for the purpose of looking."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي حُجْرَةٍ وَمَعَهُ مِدْرًى يَحُكُّ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ اطَّلَعَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُ لَقُمْتُ حَتَّى أَطْعَنَ بِهِ عَيْنَيْكَ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الْإِذْنُ مِنْ أَجْلِ النَّظَرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2431

chapter.englishTitle: A Quraishi is not killed patiently

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say on the day of the Conquest of Mecca: No Quraishite will be killed hound hand and foot from this day until the Day of judgment.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say on the day of the Conquest of Mecca: No Quraishite will be killed hound hand and foot from this day until the Day of judgment.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ «لَا يُقْتَلُ قُرَشِيٌّ صَبْرًا بَعْدَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Muṭīʿ \u003e Muṭīʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُطِيعٍ عَنْ مُطِيعٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2432

chapter.englishTitle: A Quraishi is not killed patiently

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he mentioned something similar to it. Abu Muhammad said, "Interpret that as meaning that a Quraishi should not be killed for disbelief, meaning that a Quraishi would not be considered a disbeliever after that day. As for in battle, they should be killed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and he mentioned something similar to it. Abu Muhammad said, "Interpret that as meaning that a Quraishi should not be killed for disbelief, meaning that a Quraishi would not be considered a disbeliever after that day. As for in battle, they should be killed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «فَسَّرُوا ذَلِكَ أَنْ لَا يُقْتَلَ قُرَشِيٌّ عَلَى الْكُفْرِ يَعْنِي لَا يَكُونُ هَذَا أَنْ يَكْفُرَ قُرَشِيٌّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ فَأَمَّا فِي الْقَوَدِ فَيُقْتَلُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Muṭīʿ \u003e Muṭīʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُطِيعٍ سَمِعْتُ مُطِيعًا يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2433

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ لَا يُؤْخَذُ أَحَدٌ بِجِنَايَةِ غَيْرِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: No one shall be punished for the crime of another

hadiths.englishRaw: "I entered the city with my son, and we did not see the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. So, I went to him and the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, came out wearing two green garments. When I saw him, I recognized him by his description, so I approached him. He asked, 'Who is this with you?' I said, 'My son, by the Lord of the Kaaba.' He asked, 'Is he your son?' I said, 'I testify to it.' He said, 'Indeed, your son does not harm you, nor do you harm him.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I entered the city with my son, and we did not see the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. So, I went to him and the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, came out wearing two green garments. When I saw him, I recognized him by his description, so I approached him. He asked, 'Who is this with you?' I said, 'My son, by the Lord of the Kaaba.' He asked, 'Is he your son?' I said, 'I testify to it.' He said, 'Indeed, your son does not harm you, nor do you harm him.'   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَدِمْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ وَمَعِيَ ابْنٌ لِي وَلَمْ نَكُنْ رَأَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَعَلَيْهِ ثَوْبَانِ أَخْضَرَانِ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُهُ عَرَفْتُهُ بِالصِّفَةِ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ «مَنْ هَذَا الَّذِي مَعَكَ؟» قُلْتُ ابْنِي وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ «ابْنُكَ؟» فَقُلْتُ أَشْهَدُ بِهِ قَالَ «فَإِنَّ ابْنَكَ هَذَا لَا يَجْنِي عَلَيْكَ وَلَا تَجْنِي عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yūnus b. Muḥammad \u003e Jarīr / Ibn Ḥāzim \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Iyād b. Laqīṭ \u003e Abū Rimthah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَازِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنِي إِيَادُ بْنُ لَقِيطٍ عَنْ أَبِي رِمْثَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2434

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ لَا يُؤْخَذُ أَحَدٌ بِجِنَايَةِ غَيْرِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: No one shall be punished for the crime of another

hadiths.englishRaw: I went to the Prophet ﷺ with my father. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then asked my father: Is this your son? He replied: Yes, by the Lord of the Ka'bah. He again said: Is it true? He said: I bear witness to it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then smiled for my resemblance with my father, and for the fact that my father took an oath upon me. He then said: He will not bring evil on you, nor will you bring evil on him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited the verse: "No bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I went to the Prophet ﷺ with my father. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then asked my father: Is this your son? He replied: Yes, by the Lord of the Ka'bah. He again said: Is it true? He said: I bear witness to it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then smiled for my resemblance with my father, and for the fact that my father took an oath upon me. He then said: He will not bring evil on you, nor will you bring evil on him. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recited the verse: "No bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: انْطَلَقْتُ مَعَ أَبِي نَحْوَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ لِأَبِي «ابْنُكَ هَذَا؟» فَقَالَ إِي وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ قَالَ «حَقًّا؟» قَالَ «حَقًّا أَشْهَدُ بِهِ» قَالَ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ضَاحِكًا مِنْ ثَبَتِ شَبَهِي فِي أَبِي وَمِنْ حَلِفِ أَبِي عَلَيَّ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ ابْنَكَ هَذَا لَا يَجْنِي عَلَيْكَ وَلَا تَجْنِي عَلَيْهِ» قَالَ وَقَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ {«وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَى»} [الأنعام 164]   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Iyād \u003e Iyād \u003e Abū Rimthah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِيَادٌ عَنْ أَبِي رِمْثَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2435

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ الْأَعْمَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: Jihad in the path of Allah is the best of deeds.

hadiths.englishRaw: “A group of us Companions of the Messenger of Allah sat talking, and we said: ‘If we knew which deed was most beloved to Alllah then we would do it.’ So Allah, Most High, revealed: Whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth glorifies Allah. And He is Almighty, the All-Wise. O you who believe! Why do you say that which you do not do?” Abdullah bin Salam said: “So the Messenger of Allah recited it to us.” Abu Salamah (one of the narrators) said: “So Ibn Salam recited it to us.” Yahya (one of the narrators) said: “So Abu Salamah narrated it to us.” Ibn Kathir said: “So Al-Awza’i recited it to us.” Abdullah said: “So Ibn Kathir recited it to us.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: “A group of us Companions of the Messenger of Allah sat talking, and we said: ‘If we knew which deed was most beloved to Alllah then we would do it.’ So Allah, Most High, revealed: Whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth glorifies Allah. And He is Almighty, the All-Wise. O you who believe! Why do you say that which you do not do?” Abdullah bin Salam said: “So the Messenger of Allah recited it to us.” Abu Salamah (one of the narrators) said: “So Ibn Salam recited it to us.” Yahya (one of the narrators) said: “So Abu Salamah narrated it to us.” Ibn Kathir said: “So Al-Awza’i recited it to us.” Abdullah said: “So Ibn Kathir recited it to us.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَعَدْنَا نَفَرٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَتَذَاكَرْنَا فَقُلْنَا لَوْ نَعْلَمُ أَيَّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَحَبَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى لَعَمِلْنَاهُ؟ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {«سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّماَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا»} [الصف 2] حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَرَأَهَا عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ فَقَرَأَهَا عَلَيْنَا ابْنُ سَلَامٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى فَقَرَأَهَا عَلَيْنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ وَقَرَأَهَا عَلَيْنَا يَحْيَى وَقَرَأَهَا عَلَيْنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ وَقَرَأَهَا عَلَيْنَا مُحَمَّدٌ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Salām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2436

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Jihad

hadiths.englishRaw: Allah has undertaken to provide for one who leaves his home (only) to fight for His cause and to affirm the truth of His word; Allah will either admit him to Paradise or will bring him back home from where he had come out, with his reward and booty.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Allah has undertaken to provide for one who leaves his home (only) to fight for His cause and to affirm the truth of His word; Allah will either admit him to Paradise or will bring him back home from where he had come out, with his reward and booty.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تَكَفَّلَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ خَرَجَ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ لَا يُخْرِجُهُ إِلَّا جِهَادٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَتَصْدِيقُ بِكَلِمَاتِهِ أَنْ يُدْخِلَهُ الْجَنَّةَ أَوْ يَرُدَّهُ إِلَى مَسْكَنِهِ الَّذِي خَرَجَ مِنْهُ مَعَ مَا نَالَ مِنْ أَجْرٍ أَوْ غَنِيمَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2437

chapter.englishTitle: Which type of jihad is the best?

hadiths.englishRaw: “I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, which Jihad is best?’ He said: ‘(That of a man) whose blood is shed and his horse is wounded.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, which Jihad is best?’ He said: ‘(That of a man) whose blood is shed and his horse is wounded.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُّ الْجِهَادِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «مَنْ عُقِرَ جَوَادُهُ وَأُهْرِيقَ دَمُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Mālik b. Mighwal \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2438

chapter.englishTitle: Which deeds are the best?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Which is the best deed?" He said, "To believe in Allah and His Apostle." He was then asked, "Which is the next (in goodness)?" He said, "To participate in Jihad in Allah's Cause." He was then asked, "Which is the next?" He said, "To perform Hajj-Mabrur. "    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Which is the best deed?" He said, "To believe in Allah and His Apostle." He was then asked, "Which is the next (in goodness)?" He said, "To participate in Jihad in Allah's Cause." He was then asked, "Which is the next?" He said, "To perform Hajj-Mabrur. "    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَيُّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «إِيمَانٌ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ» قَالَ قِيلَ ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ «ثُمَّ الْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ» قِيلَ ثُمَّ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ «ثُمَّ حَجٌّ مَبْرُورٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Ibn al-Musayyab \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2439

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَاتَلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فُوَاقَ نَاقَةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: Who fought in the cause of Allah over a camel

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever fights in the cause of Allah and endures as much as the milking of a camel, Paradise is guaranteed for him, as much as the quantity of its milk for the one who milks it."   – Good Chain
