hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever fights in the cause of Allah and endures as much as the milking of a camel, Paradise is guaranteed for him, as much as the quantity of its milk for the one who milks it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ قَاتَلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فُوَاقَ نَاقَةٍ وَجَبَتْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةُ وَهُوَ قَدْرُ مَا يدُرُّ حَلَبَهَا لِمَنْ حَلَبَهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e Baqiyyah \u003e Baḥīr \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān \u003e Mālik b. Yakhāmir \u003e Muʿādh b. Jabal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ عَنْ بَحِيرٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ يَخَامِرَ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2440

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ أَفْضَلُ النَّاسِ رَجُلٌ مُمْسِكٌ بِرَأْسِ فَرَسِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The best people are those who hold onto the reins of their horse...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Shall I not tell you of the best of the people in status?" We said: "Yes. O Messenger of Allah!" He said: "A man who rides his horse in the cause of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, until he dies or is killed. Shall I not tell you of the one who comes after him (in status)?" We said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah!" He said; "A man who withdraws to a mountain pass and establishes Salah, and pays Zakah, and keeps away from the evil of people. Shall I not tell you of the worst of people?" We said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah!" He said: "The one who asks for the sake of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, but does not give (when he is asked) for His sake,"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Shall I not tell you of the best of the people in status?" We said: "Yes. O Messenger of Allah!" He said: "A man who rides his horse in the cause of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, until he dies or is killed. Shall I not tell you of the one who comes after him (in status)?" We said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah!" He said; "A man who withdraws to a mountain pass and establishes Salah, and pays Zakah, and keeps away from the evil of people. Shall I not tell you of the worst of people?" We said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah!" He said: "The one who asks for the sake of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, but does not give (when he is asked) for His sake,"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ خَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَهُمْ جُلُوسٌ فَقَالَ «أَلَا أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِخَيْرِ النَّاسِ مَنْزِلَةً؟» قُلْنَا بَلَى قَالَ رَجُلٌ مُمْسِكٌ بِرَأْسِ فَرَسِهِ أَوْ قَالَ فَرَسٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ أَوْ يُقْتَلَ قَالَ فَأُخْبِرُكُمْ بِالَّذِي يَلِيهِ فَقُلْنَا نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «امْرُؤٌ مُعْتَزِلٌ فِي شِعْبٍ يُقِيمُ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتِي الزَّكَاةَ وَيَعْتَزِلُ شُرُورَ النَّاسِ» قَالَ «فَأُخْبِرُكُمْ بِشَرِّ النَّاسِ مَنْزِلَةً؟» فَقُلْنَا نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «الَّذِي يُسْأَلُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَلَا يُعْطِي بِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿĀṣim b. ʿAlī \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e Saʿīd b. Khālid \u003e Ismāʿīl b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Dhiʾb \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2441

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ مَقَامِ الرَّجُلِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of the Position of a Man in the Path of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The position of a man in the row (of soldiers) in the cause of Allah is better than sixty years of worship by a man.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The position of a man in the row (of soldiers) in the cause of Allah is better than sixty years of worship by a man.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَقَامُ الرَّجُلِ فِي الصَّفِّ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ عِبَادَةِ الرَّجُلِ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ayyūb \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2442

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ الْغُبَارِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the excellence of dust in the way of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "Whoever dirties his feet in the path of Allah, Allah will forbid him from the Fire."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him) said, "Whoever dirties his feet in the path of Allah, Allah will forbid him from the Fire."
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنِ اغْبَرَّتْ قَدَمَاهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ»
hadiths.chain: al-Qāsim b. Kathīr \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Shurayḥ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Sulaymān \u003e Mālik b. ʿAbdullāh Mar \u003e Ḥabīb b. Maslamah or Ḥabīb Mar \u003e Mālik / Yaqūd Faras Yamshī \u003e Alā Tarkab Ḥamalak Allāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ شُرَيْحٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ أَنَّ مَالِكَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَرَّ عَلَى حَبِيبِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ أَوْ حَبِيبٌ مَرَّ عَلَى مَالِكٍ وَهُوَ يَقُودُ فَرَسًا يَمْشِي فَقَالَ أَلا تَرْكَبُ حَمَلَكَ اللَّهُ؟ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2443

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْغَدْوَةِ وَالرَّوْحَةِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ
chapter.englishTitle: Al-Ghadwah and Al-Rawhah in the path of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: “Going out in the morning in the cause of Allah, or in the evening, is more virtuous than the world and what is in it.”     – Sound
hadiths.body: “Going out in the morning in the cause of Allah, or in the evening, is more virtuous than the world and what is in it.”     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَغَدْوَةٌ فِي سبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2444

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ صَامَ يَوْمًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever fasts for a day in the cause of Allah.

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "There is no servant who fasts a day seeking the face of Allah except that Allah will distance his face from the Fire by a distance equivalent to seventy autumns."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "There is no servant who fasts a day seeking the face of Allah except that Allah will distance his face from the Fire by a distance equivalent to seventy autumns."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَصُومُ يَوْمًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا بَاعَدَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ وَجْهِهِ وَبَيْنَ النَّارِ سَبْعِينَ خَرِيفًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Suhayl b. Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Abū ʿAyyāsh \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2445

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي الَّذِي يَسْهَرُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ حَارِسًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the one who remains awake in the path of Allah as a guard

hadiths.englishRaw: He (saw) was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a battle when he heard him say one night, "The Fire is forbidden for an eye that stayed awake in the cause of Allah, and the Fire is forbidden for an eye that shed tears out of fear of Allah." He said, "And the third type, I have forgotten it." Abu Shuraih said, "I have heard someone say that it means, 'The Fire is forbidden for an eye that turned away from what Allah has prohibited, or an eye that shed tears in the cause of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: He (saw) was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a battle when he heard him say one night, "The Fire is forbidden for an eye that stayed awake in the cause of Allah, and the Fire is forbidden for an eye that shed tears out of fear of Allah." He said, "And the third type, I have forgotten it." Abu Shuraih said, "I have heard someone say that it means, 'The Fire is forbidden for an eye that turned away from what Allah has prohibited, or an eye that shed tears in the cause of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي غَزْوَةٍ فَسَمِعَهُ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ «حُرِّمَتِ النَّارُ عَلَى عَيْنٍ سَهِرَتْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَحُرِّمَتِ النَّارُ عَلَى عَيْنٍ دَمَعَتْ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ» قَالَ وَقَالَ الثَّالِثَةَ فَنَسِيتُهَا قَالَ أَبُو شُرَيْحٍ سَمِعْتُ مَنْ يَقُولُ ذَاكَ «حُرِّمَتِ النَّارُ عَلَى عَيْنٍ غَضَّتْ عَنْ مَحَارِمِ اللَّهِ أَوْ عَيْنٍ فُقِئَتْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Qāsim b. Kathīr \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Shurayḥ \u003e Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ Muḥammad b. Sumayr \u003e Abū ʿAlī al-Hamdānī \u003e Abū Rayḥānah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ شُرَيْحٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي الصَّبَّاحِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي رَيْحَانَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2446
hadiths.englishRaw: It is (offered) in the way of Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: For this you will have seven hundred she-camels on the Day of Judgment all of which will be muzzled.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is (offered) in the way of Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: For this you will have seven hundred she-camels on the Day of Judgment all of which will be muzzled.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَكَ بِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ سَبْعُ مِائَةِ نَاقَةٍ كُلُّهَا مَخْطُومَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmir \u003e Jarīr \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī \u003e Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī \u003e Jāʾ a man Bināqah Makhṭūmah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمِر حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِنَاقَةٍ مَخْطُومَةٍ فَقَالَ هَذِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2447

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ أَنْفَقَ زَوْجَيْنِ مِنْ مَالِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever spends from his wealth for the sake of Allah, [Surah Al-...

hadiths.englishRaw: I met Abu Dhar while he was driving his camel or leading it by its neck. I said, "Abu Dhar, what is the matter with you?" He said, "My livelihood." I asked him again, "What is the matter with you?" He said, "My livelihood." I asked him to narrate to me a hadith that he had heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'No Muslim spends two coins in the way of Allah except that a curtain from Paradise will be drawn for him.'" Abu Muhammad said, "It could be two dirhams, two hundred dirhams, two slaves, or two mounts."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I met Abu Dhar while he was driving his camel or leading it by its neck. I said, "Abu Dhar, what is the matter with you?" He said, "My livelihood." I asked him again, "What is the matter with you?" He said, "My livelihood." I asked him to narrate to me a hadith that he had heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . He said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'No Muslim spends two coins in the way of Allah except that a curtain from Paradise will be drawn for him.'" Abu Muhammad said, "It could be two dirhams, two hundred dirhams, two slaves, or two mounts."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَقِيتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ وَهُوَ يَسُوقُ جَمَلًا لَهُ أَوْ يَقُودُهُ فِي عُنُقِهِ قِرْبَةٌ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ مَالُكَ قَالَ لِي عَمَلِي فَقُلْتُ مَالُكَ قَالَ لِي عَمَلِي قُلْتُ حَدِّثْنِي حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ أَنْفَقَ زَوْجَيْنِ مِنْ مَالٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا ابْتَدَرَتْهُ حَجَبَةُ الْجَنَّةِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «هُوَ دِرْهَمَيْنِ أَوْ أَمَتَيْنِ أَوْ عَبْدَيْنِ أَوْ دَابَّتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Ṣaʿṣaʿah b. Muʿāwiyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ صَعْصَعَةَ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2448

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ الرَّمْيِ وَالْأَمْرِ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtues of archery and commanding it

hadiths.englishRaw: He recited this verse: "And prepare against them whatever power you can and horses tied at the frontier" [Surah Al-Anfal 60]. Surely, the power lies in hurling.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He recited this verse: "And prepare against them whatever power you can and horses tied at the frontier" [Surah Al-Anfal 60]. Surely, the power lies in hurling.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ تَلَا هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ {وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ} [الأنفال 60] أَلَا إِنَّ الْقُوَّةَ الرَّمْيُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd al-Muqriʾ \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Ayyūb \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū al-Khayr Marthad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2449

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ الرَّمْيِ وَالْأَمْرِ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtues of archery and commanding it

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah Almighty admits the three who die in the same battle by a single arrow into Paradise. He is the Creator of it, and He counts the good that they did, the one who provided it, and the one who shot it."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah Almighty admits the three who die in the same battle by a single arrow into Paradise. He is the Creator of it, and He counts the good that they did, the one who provided it, and the one who shot it."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ اللَّهَ ﷻ يُدْخِلُ الثَّلَاثَةَ بِالسَّهْمِ الْوَاحِدِ الْجَنَّةَ صَانِعَهُ يَحْتَسِبُ فِي صَنْعَتِهِ الْخَيْرَ وَالْمُمِدَّ بِهِ وَالرَّامِيَ بِهِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Sallām \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Zayd al-Azraq \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الْأَزْرَقِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2450

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ مَنْ جُرِحَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ جُرْحًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the Virtue of those Injured in the Path of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'There is no person who is wounded in the cause of Allah, Almighty and Exalted, except that Allah, Almighty and Exalted, will send him on the Day of Resurrection and his wound will emit the fragrance of musk and its color will be the color of blood.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'There is no person who is wounded in the cause of Allah, Almighty and Exalted, except that Allah, Almighty and Exalted, will send him on the Day of Resurrection and his wound will emit the fragrance of musk and its color will be the color of blood.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: َرَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا مِنْ مَجْرُوحٍ يُجْرَحُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ إِلَّا بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ ﷻ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَجُرْحُهُ يَدْمَى الرِّيحُ رِيحُ الْمِسْكِ وَاللَّوْنُ لَوْنُ الدَّمِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAmmī Mūsá b. Yasār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي مُوسَى بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2451

chapter.englishTitle: Who has asked Allah for martyrdom?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: If anyone asks Allah for martyrdom sincerely, Allah will make him reach the ranks of martyrs even if he died on his bed.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: If anyone asks Allah for martyrdom sincerely, Allah will make him reach the ranks of martyrs even if he died on his bed.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ سَأَلَ اللَّهَ الشَّهَادَةَ صَادِقًا مِنْ قَلْبِهِ بَلَّغَهُ اللَّهُ مَنَازِلَ الشُّهَدَاءِ وَإِنْ مَاتَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Qāsim b. Kathīr \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Shurayḥ \u003e Sahl b. Abū Umāmah b. Sahl b. Ḥunayf from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ شُرَيْحٍ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَهْلَ بْنَ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2452

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the martyr

hadiths.englishRaw: “The martyr does not feel anything more when he is killed than one of you feels if he is pinched (by a bug).”     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “The martyr does not feel anything more when he is killed than one of you feels if he is pinched (by a bug).”     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا يَجِدُ الشَّهِيدُ مِنْ أَلَمِ الْقَتْلِ إِلَّا كَمَا يَجِدُ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنْ أَلَمِ الْقَرْصَةِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Rifāʿī \u003e Ṣafwān b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e al-Qaʿqāʿ b. Ḥakīm \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2453

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا يَتَمَنَّى الشَّهِيدُ مِنَ الرَّجْعَةِ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا
chapter.englishTitle: What does the martyr wish for when returning to the world?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no soul that enters Paradise and wishes that it could return to you, even if it had all of the world and everything in it, except for the martyr. Indeed, the martyr wishes that he could be killed and brought back to life repeatedly due to what he has seen of the rewards."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no soul that enters Paradise and wishes that it could return to you, even if it had all of the world and everything in it, except for the martyr. Indeed, the martyr wishes that he could be killed and brought back to life repeatedly due to what he has seen of the rewards."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ تَمُوتُ فَتَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ فَتَوَدُّ أَنَّهَا رَجَعَتْ إِلَيْكُمْ وَلَهَا الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا إِلَّا الشَّهِيدَ فَإِنَّهُ يَوَدُّ أَنَّهُ قُتِلَ كَذَا مَرَّةً لِمَا رَأَى مِنَ الثَّوَابِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿAlī al-Ḥanafī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2454

chapter.englishTitle: The Souls of the Martyrs

hadiths.englishRaw: "Regarding the souls of the martyrs, if it were not for Abdullah, no one would have informed us. He said that the souls of the martyrs are with Allah on the Day of Judgment in the bodies of green birds, with lanterns hanging from the throne, freely roaming in the gardens of paradise as they please. Then they return to their lanterns, and their Lord honors them and asks, 'Do you have any need? Is there anything you desire?' They respond, 'No, except that we want to return to the world and be killed again.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Regarding the souls of the martyrs, if it were not for Abdullah, no one would have informed us. He said that the souls of the martyrs are with Allah on the Day of Judgment in the bodies of green birds, with lanterns hanging from the throne, freely roaming in the gardens of paradise as they please. Then they return to their lanterns, and their Lord honors them and asks, 'Do you have any need? Is there anything you desire?' They respond, 'No, except that we want to return to the world and be killed again.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَرْوَاحُ الشُّهَدَاءِ وَلَوْلَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَمْ يُحَدِّثْنَا أَحَدٌ قَالَ أَرْوَاحُ الشُّهَدَاءِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِي حَوَاصِلِ طَيْرٍ خُضْرٍ لَهَا قَنَادِيلُ مُعَلَّقَةٌ بِالْعَرْشِ تَسْرَحُ فِي أَيِّ الْجَنَّةِ شَاءُوا ثُمَّ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى قَنَادِيلِهَا فَيُشْرِفُ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ فَيَقُولُ أَلَكُمْ حَاجَةٌ؟ تُرِيدُونَ شَيْئًا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ لَا إِلَّا أَنْ نَرْجِعَ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا فَنُقْتَلَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Murrah \u003e Masrūq \u003e Saʾalnā ʿAbdullāh \u003e Arwāḥ al-Shuhadāʾ And Lawlā ʿAbdullāh Lam Yuḥaddithnā Aḥad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ قَالَ سَأَلْنَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2455

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي صِفَةِ الْقَتْلَى فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Status of Martyrs in the Path of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The martyrs are three: one who fought with his life and wealth in the way of Allah, and fought until he was killed. The Prophet ﷺ said about him, 'He is the praised martyr in the tent of Allah, beneath His throne. The Prophets do not surpass him except by the degree of prophethood.' And there is a believer who mixed good deeds with bad ones, and fought with his life and wealth in the way of Allah, and fought until he was killed." The Prophet ﷺ said about him, "There is a garment that will wash away his sins. Indeed, the sword erases sins, and he enters Paradise through any door of Paradise he wishes." And there is a hypocrite who fought with his life and wealth, and when he met the enemy, he fought until he was killed. The Prophet ﷺ said about him, "He is in the Fire. Indeed, the sword does not erase hypocrisy." Abdullah said, "It is said about a garment when it is washed, it is squeezed."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The martyrs are three: one who fought with his life and wealth in the way of Allah, and fought until he was killed. The Prophet ﷺ said about him, 'He is the praised martyr in the tent of Allah, beneath His throne. The Prophets do not surpass him except by the degree of prophethood.' And there is a believer who mixed good deeds with bad ones, and fought with his life and wealth in the way of Allah, and fought until he was killed." The Prophet ﷺ said about him, "There is a garment that will wash away his sins. Indeed, the sword erases sins, and he enters Paradise through any door of Paradise he wishes." And there is a hypocrite who fought with his life and wealth, and when he met the enemy, he fought until he was killed. The Prophet ﷺ said about him, "He is in the Fire. Indeed, the sword does not erase hypocrisy." Abdullah said, "It is said about a garment when it is washed, it is squeezed."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْقَتْلَى ثَلَاثَةٌ مُؤْمِنٌ جَاهَدَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِذَا لَقِيَ الْعَدُوَّ قَاتَلَ حَتَّى قُتِلَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِيهِ «فَذَلِكَ الشَّهِيدُ الْمُمْتَحَنُ فِي خَيْمَةِ اللَّهِ تَحْتَ عَرْشِهِ لَا يَفْضُلُهُ النَّبِيُّونَ إِلَّا بِدَرَجَةِ النُّبُوَّةِ وَمُؤْمِنٌ خَلَطَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَآخَرَ سَيِّئًا جَاهَدَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ إِذَا لَقِيَ الْعَدُوَّ قَاتَلَ حَتَّى يُقْتَلَ» قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «فِيهِ مُمَصْمِصَةٌ مَحَتْ ذُنُوبَهُ وَخَطَايَاهُ إِنَّ السَّيْفَ مَحَّاءٌ لِلْخَطَايَا وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أَيِّ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ شَاءَ وَمُنَافِقٌ جَاهَدَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَمَالِهِ فَإِذَا لَقِيَ الْعَدُوَّ قَاتَلَ حَتَّى يُقْتَلَ فَذَاكَ فِي النَّارِ إِنَّ السَّيْفَ لَا يَمْحُو النِّفَاقَ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ يُقَالُ لِلثَّوْبِ إِذَا غُسِلَ مُصْمِصَ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى هُوَ الصَّدَفِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي الْمُثَنَّى الْأُمْلُوكِيِّ عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ عَبْدٍ السُّلَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2456

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ قَاتَلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ صَابِرًا مُحْتَسِبًا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever fights in the cause of Allah with patience and expectati...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and delivered a sermon in which he praised and glorified Allah. Then he mentioned Jihad and said that there is nothing superior to it except for obligatory acts of worship. A man stood up and asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what do you think about someone who is killed in the cause of Allah? Will that erase his sins?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Yes, if he was patient, seeking reward from Allah, and not retreating from the battlefield, except for a debt. Indeed, it will be taken from him, as Gabriel ﷺ informed me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood up and delivered a sermon in which he praised and glorified Allah. Then he mentioned Jihad and said that there is nothing superior to it except for obligatory acts of worship. A man stood up and asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what do you think about someone who is killed in the cause of Allah? Will that erase his sins?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Yes, if he was patient, seeking reward from Allah, and not retreating from the battlefield, except for a debt. Indeed, it will be taken from him, as Gabriel ﷺ informed me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَامَ فَخَطَبَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الْجِهَادَ فَلَمْ يَدَعْ شَيْئًا أَفْضَلَ مِنْهُ إِلَّا الْفَرَائِضَ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ مَنْ قُتِلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَهَلْ ذَلِكَ مُكَفِّرٌ عَنْهُ خَطَايَاهُ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَعَمْ إِذَا قُتِلَ صَابِرًا مُحْتَسِبًا مُقْبِلًا غَيْرَ مُدْبِرٍ إِلَّا الدَّيْنَ فَإِنَّهُ مَأْخُوذٌ بِهِ كَمَا زَعَمَ لِي جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Maqburī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2457

chapter.englishTitle: What counts as martyrs

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The plague is a martyrdom, drowning is a martyrdom, participating in a battle is a martyrdom, and childbirth and what a woman faces during childbirth are also martyrdom."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The plague is a martyrdom, drowning is a martyrdom, participating in a battle is a martyrdom, and childbirth and what a woman faces during childbirth are also martyrdom."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الطَّاعُونُ شَهَادَةٌ وَالْغَرَقُ شَهَادَةٌ وَالْغَزْوُ شَهَادَةٌ وَالْبَطْنُ وَالنُّفَسَاءُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sulaymān \u003e al-Taymī \u003e Abū ʿUthmān \u003e ʿĀmir b. Mālik \u003e Ṣafwān b. Umayyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ التَّيْمِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2458

chapter.englishTitle: What counts as martyrs

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Being killed in the way of Allah is martyrdom, and dying due to a widespread disease is martyrdom, and death due to a stomach disease is martyrdom, and a woman being killed by her child is also martyrdom."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Being killed in the way of Allah is martyrdom, and dying due to a widespread disease is martyrdom, and death due to a stomach disease is martyrdom, and a woman being killed by her child is also martyrdom."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْقَتْلُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ شَهَادَةٌ وَالطَّاعُونُ شَهَادَةٌ وَالْبَطْنُ شَهَادَةٌ وَالْمَرْأَةُ يَقْتُلُهَا وَلَدُهَا جُمْعًا شَهَادَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Abū Bakr b. Ḥafṣ \u003e Shuraḥbīl b. al-Simṭ \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ السِّمْطِ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2459

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَا أَصَابَ أَصْحَابَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي مَغَازِيهِمْ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What the Prophet's companions encountered in their battles from ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "We used to go on military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with no food except for dates and the leaves of Hurbah, to the extent that one of us would place his hand on his stomach like a sheep because of hunger. Then, the Banu Asad became strong and they started to oppress me. I felt weak and my work was lost."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We used to go on military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with no food except for dates and the leaves of Hurbah, to the extent that one of us would place his hand on his stomach like a sheep because of hunger. Then, the Banu Asad became strong and they started to oppress me. I felt weak and my work was lost."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا نَغْزُو مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَا لَنَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا هَذَا السَّمُرُ وَوَرَقُ الْحُبْلَةِ حَتَّى إِنَّ أَحَدَنَا لَيَضَعُ كَمَا تَضَعُ الشَّاةُ مَا لَهُ خِلْطٌ ثُمَّ أَصْبَحَتْ بَنُو أَسَدٍ يُعَزِّرُونِي لَقَدْ خِبْتُ إِذَنْ وَضَلَّ عَمَلِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e Qays \u003e Saʿd b. Abū Waqqāṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ قَيْسٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2460

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ مَنْ غَزَا يَنْوِي شَيْئًا فَلَهُ مَا نَوَى
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever intends to do something will have what they intended

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever fights in the cause of Allah intending only to get an 'Iqal, he will have what he intended."     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever fights in the cause of Allah intending only to get an 'Iqal, he will have what he intended."     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ غَزَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ لَا يَنْوِي فِي غَزَاتِهِ إِلَّا عِقَالًا فَلَهُ مَا نَوَى»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Jabalah b. ʿAṭiyyah \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Walīd b. ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا جَبَلَةُ بْنُ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2461

chapter.englishTitle: The Invasion of Ghazwan

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: Fighting is of two kinds: The one who seeks Allah's favour, obeys the leader, gives the property he values, treats his associates gently and avoids doing mischief, will have the reward for all the time whether he is asleep or awake; but the one who fights in a boasting spirit, for the sake of display and to gain a reputation, who disobeys the leader and does mischief in the earth will not return credit or without blame.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: Fighting is of two kinds: The one who seeks Allah's favour, obeys the leader, gives the property he values, treats his associates gently and avoids doing mischief, will have the reward for all the time whether he is asleep or awake; but the one who fights in a boasting spirit, for the sake of display and to gain a reputation, who disobeys the leader and does mischief in the earth will not return credit or without blame.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْغَزْوُ غَزْوَانِ فَأَمَّا مَنْ غَزَا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ وَأَطَاعَ الْإِمَامَ وَأَنْفَقَ الْكَرِيمَةَ وَيَاسَرَ الشَّرِيكَ وَاجْتَنَبَ الْفَسَادَ فَإِنَّ نَوْمَهُ وَنُبْهَهُ أَجْرٌ كُلُّهُ وَأَمَّا مَنْ غَزَا فَخْرًا وَرِيَاءً وَسُمْعَةً وَعَصَى الْإِمَامَ وَأَفْسَدَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَرْجِعُ بِالْكَفَافِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e Baqiyyah b. al-Walīd \u003e Baḥīr b. Saʿd \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān \u003e Abū Baḥriyyah \u003e Muʿādh b. Jabal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ بَحِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَحْرِيَّةَ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2462

chapter.englishTitle: Whoever dies without fighting

hadiths.englishRaw: “Whoever does not fight, or equip a fighter, or stay behind to look after a fighter’s family, Allah will strike him with a calamity before the Day of Resurrection.”    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “Whoever does not fight, or equip a fighter, or stay behind to look after a fighter’s family, Allah will strike him with a calamity before the Day of Resurrection.”    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ لَمْ يَغْزُ أَوْ يُجَهِّزْ غَازِيًا أَوْ يَخْلُفْ غَازِيًا فِي أَهْلِهِ بِخَيْرٍ أَصَابَهُ اللَّهُ بِقَارِعَةٍ قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd b. Muslim \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith \u003e al-Qāsim Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Umāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2463

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ مَنْ جَهَّزَ غَازِيًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the Virtue of the One Who Prepared a Warrior

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: 'Whoever prepares a mujahid for the sake of Allah or supports his family, Allah will write for him the same reward as the mujahid, except that nothing will be reduced from the reward of the mujahid.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: 'Whoever prepares a mujahid for the sake of Allah or supports his family, Allah will write for him the same reward as the mujahid, except that nothing will be reduced from the reward of the mujahid.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ جَهَّزَ غَازِيًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ خَلَفَهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ مِثْلَ أَجْرِهِ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَا يَنْقُصُ مِنْ أَجْرِ الْغَازِي شَيْئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Zayd b. Khālid al-Juhanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2464

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ الْعُذْرِ فِي التَّخَلُّفِ عَنِ الْجِهَادِ
chapter.englishTitle: The excuse for neglecting jihad.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Al-Bara'a saying when this verse was revealed {Not equal are those believers remaining [at home] - other than the disabled - and the mujahideen [who strive and fight] in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives. Allah has preferred the mujahideen through their wealth and their lives over those who remain [behind], by degrees.} [Quran 4:95], the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called Zaid and he brought a shoulder blade, then the Prophet ﷺ wrote it down. Ibn Umm Maktum, who was blind, complained about its harm, so the verse was revealed {Not equal are those believers remaining [at home] - other than the disabled - and the mujahideen [who strive and fight] in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives except for the disabled, Allah has preferred the mujahideen through their wealth and their lives over those who remain [behind].} [Quran 4:95].
hadiths.body: I heard Al-Bara'a saying when this verse was revealed {Not equal are those believers remaining [at home] - other than the disabled - and the mujahideen [who strive and fight] in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives. Allah has preferred the mujahideen through their wealth and their lives over those who remain [behind], by degrees.} [Quran 4:95], the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called Zaid and he brought a shoulder blade, then the Prophet ﷺ wrote it down. Ibn Umm Maktum, who was blind, complained about its harm, so the verse was revealed {Not equal are those believers remaining [at home] - other than the disabled - and the mujahideen [who strive and fight] in the cause of Allah with their wealth and their lives except for the disabled, Allah has preferred the mujahideen through their wealth and their lives over those who remain [behind].} [Quran 4:95].
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ يَقُولُ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ {لَا يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ} [النساء 95] دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ زَيْدًا فَجَاءَ بِكَتِفٍ فَكَتَبَهَا وَشَكَا ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ ضَرَارَتَهُ فَنَزَلَتْ {لَا يَسْتَوِي الْقَاعِدُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ غَيْرُ أُولِي الضَّرَرِ} [النساء 95]
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Barāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2465

chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Sea Raiders

hadiths.englishRaw: "One day, the Prophet (pbuh) was at her house and woke up laughing. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what made you laugh?' He said, 'I saw a group of people from my Ummah riding on the back of this sea, like kings on thrones.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them.' He said, 'You are one of them.' Then he fell asleep again and woke up laughing. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what made you laugh?' He said, 'I saw a group of people from my Ummah riding on the back of this sea, like kings on thrones.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them.' He said, 'You are one of them.' Then he fell asleep again and woke up laughing. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what made you laugh?' He said, 'I saw a group of people from my Ummah riding on the back of this sea, like kings on thrones.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them.' He said, 'You are among the predecessors.' Ubada bin Samit then married her and went on a naval expedition. He took her along, and when they arrived, there was a female camel brought close to her for her to ride. The camel kicked her, breaking her neck, and she died."
hadiths.body: "One day, the Prophet (pbuh) was at her house and woke up laughing. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what made you laugh?' He said, 'I saw a group of people from my Ummah riding on the back of this sea, like kings on thrones.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them.' He said, 'You are one of them.' Then he fell asleep again and woke up laughing. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what made you laugh?' He said, 'I saw a group of people from my Ummah riding on the back of this sea, like kings on thrones.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them.' He said, 'You are one of them.' Then he fell asleep again and woke up laughing. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what made you laugh?' He said, 'I saw a group of people from my Ummah riding on the back of this sea, like kings on thrones.' I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, ask Allah to make me one of them.' He said, 'You are among the predecessors.' Ubada bin Samit then married her and went on a naval expedition. He took her along, and when they arrived, there was a female camel brought close to her for her to ride. The camel kicked her, breaking her neck, and she died."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ فِي بَيْتِهَا يَوْمًا فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَضْحَكَكَ؟ قَالَ «أُرِيتُ قَوْمًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَرْكَبُونَ ظَهْرَ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ كَالْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الْأَسِرَّةِ» قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ قَالَ «أَنْتِ مِنْهُمْ» ثُمَّ نَامَ أَيْضًا فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَضْحَكَكَ؟ قَالَ «أُرِيتُ قَوْمًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَرْكَبُونَ ظهر هَذَا الْبَحْرَ كَالْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الْأَسِرَّةِ» قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ قَالَ «أَنْتِ مِنْهُمْ» ثُمَّ نَامَ أَيْضًا فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَضْحَكَكَ؟ قَالَ «أُرِيتُ قَوْمًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَرْكَبُونَ هَذَا الْبَحْرَ كَالْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الْأَسِرَّةِ» قلت يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ قَالَ أَنْتِ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ قَالَ فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ فَغَزَا فِي الْبَحْرِ فَحَمَلَهَا مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا قَدِمُوا قُرِّبَتْ لَهَا بَغْلَةٌ لِتَرْكَبَهَا فَصَرَعَتْهَا فَدُقَّتْ عُنُقُهَا فَمَاتَتْ
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá b. Ḥabbān \u003e Anas b. Mālik \u003e Um Ḥarām b. Milḥān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتُ مِلْحَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2466

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النِّسَاءِ يَغْزُونَ مَعَ الرِّجَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: In women, they invade with men

hadiths.englishRaw: “I fought alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in seven campaigns, looking after their goods, making food for them, tending the wounded and looking after the sick.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I fought alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in seven campaigns, looking after their goods, making food for them, tending the wounded and looking after the sick.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «غَزَوْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ أُدَاوِي الْجَرِيحَ أَوِ الْجَرْحَى وَأَصْنَعُ لَهُمُ الطَّعَامَ وَأَخْلُفُهُمْ فِي رِحَالِهِمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿĀṣim b. Yūsuf \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e Hishām \u003e Ḥafṣah \u003e Um ʿAṭiyyah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2467

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي خُرُوجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مَعَ بَعْضِ نِسَائِهِ فِي الْغَزْوِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Prophet's ﷺ departure with some of his wives during the batt...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out, he would shake the lots between his wives. The lot fell upon Aisha and Hafsah, so they all went out with him together."   – Sound
hadiths.body: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went out, he would shake the lots between his wives. The lot fell upon Aisha and Hafsah, so they all went out with him together."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا خَرَجَ أَقْرَعَ بَيْنَ نِسَائِهِ فَطَارَتِ الْقُرْعَةُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ وَحَفْصَةَ فَخَرَجَتَا مَعَهُ جَمِيعًا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ayman \u003e Ibn Abū Mulaykah \u003e al-Qāsim b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2468

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فَضْلِ مَنْ رَابَطَ يَوْمًا وَلَيْلَةً
chapter.englishTitle: The Excellence of Those Who Connect Day and Night

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard ʿUthman ؓ say on the minbar: O people, I concealed from you a hadeeth that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for fear that you would scatter away from me, then I thought that I should tell it to you, and let each one choose for himself what he thinks is best. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ʿGuarding the border for one day for the sake of Allah is better than a thousand other days doing other deeds.ʿ    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I heard ʿUthman ؓ say on the minbar: O people, I concealed from you a hadeeth that I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for fear that you would scatter away from me, then I thought that I should tell it to you, and let each one choose for himself what he thinks is best. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ʿGuarding the border for one day for the sake of Allah is better than a thousand other days doing other deeds.ʿ    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ عُثْمَانَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ إِنِّي كُنْتُ كَتَمْتُكُمْ حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَرَاهِيَةَ تَفَرُّقِكُمْ عَنِّي ثُمَّ بَدَا لِي أَنْ أُحَدِّثَكُمُوهُ لِيَخْتَارَ امْرُؤٌ لِنَفْسِهِ مَا بَدَا لَهُ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «رِبَاطُ يَوْمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ يَوْمٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْمَنَازِلِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Abū ʿAqīl Zuhrah b. Maʿbad \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ a freed slave of ʿUthmān \u003e ʿUthmān \u003e al-Minbar /
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ زُهْرَةُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ مَوْلَى عُثْمَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2469

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ فِي فَضْلِ مَنْ مَاتَ مُرَابِطًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the Virtue of Those Who Died as Martyrs

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Every deceased person is sealed upon his actions, except for the one who is stationed in the path of Allah, for his actions continue to be recorded for him until he is resurrected."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Every deceased person is sealed upon his actions, except for the one who is stationed in the path of Allah, for his actions continue to be recorded for him until he is resurrected."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «كُلُّ مَيِّتٍ يُخْتَمُ عَلَى عَمَلِهِ إِلَّا الْمُرَابِطَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُجْرَى لَهُ عَمَلُهُ حَتَّى يُبْعَثَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ibn Lahīʿah \u003e Mishraḥ \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ عَنْ مِشْرَحٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2470

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فَضْلِ الْخَيْلِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Horses in the Path of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Great good is attached to the forelock of the horses until the Day of Judgment.
hadiths.body: Great good is attached to the forelock of the horses until the Day of Judgment.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ بِنَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ الْأَجْرُ وَالْمَغْنَمُ
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e ʿUrwah al-Bāriqī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2471

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فَضْلِ الْخَيْلِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of Horses in the Path of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Great good is attached to the forelock of the horses until the Day of Judgment.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Great good is attached to the forelock of the horses until the Day of Judgment.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْخَيْلُ مَعْقُودٌ فِي نَوَاصِيهَا الْخَيْرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ الْأَجْرُ وَالْمَغْنَمُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ḥuṣayn And ʿAbd Allāh b. Abū al-Safar \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿUrwah al-Bāriqī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ الْبَارِقِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2472

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنَ الْخَيْلِ وَمَا يُكْرَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: What is preferred from horses and what is disliked

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah, I want to buy a horse. Which one should I buy?" He said, "Buy the bay horse with a white blaze on its right hand or from the grey horse with a mark on its forehead. It will serve you well and be obedient."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah, I want to buy a horse. Which one should I buy?" He said, "Buy the bay horse with a white blaze on its right hand or from the grey horse with a mark on its forehead. It will serve you well and be obedient."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشْتَرِيَ فَرَسًا فَأَيُّهَا أَشْتَرِي؟ قَالَ «اشْتَرِ أَدْهَمَ أَرْثَمَ مُحَجَّلَ طَلْقَ الْيَدِ الْيُمْنَى أَوْ مِنَ الْكُمْتِ عَلَى هَذِهِ الشِّيَةِ تَغْنَمْ وَتَسْلَمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Dimashqī \u003e al-Walīd \u003e Ibn Lahīʿah \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e ʿUlay b. Rabāḥ \u003e Abū Qatādah al-Anṣārī \u003e a man
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ عُلَيِّ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2473

chapter.englishTitle: In the race

hadiths.englishRaw: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a race of the horses which had been especially prepared for the purpose from Hafya' to Thaniyyat al-Wada' (the latter being the winning post), and of those which had not been trained from Thaniyya to the mosque of Banu Zuraiq, and Ibn Umar was among those who took part in this race.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a race of the horses which had been especially prepared for the purpose from Hafya' to Thaniyyat al-Wada' (the latter being the winning post), and of those which had not been trained from Thaniyya to the mosque of Banu Zuraiq, and Ibn Umar was among those who took part in this race.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُسَابِقُ بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ الْمُضَمَّرَةِ مِنَ الْحَفْيَاءِ إِلَى الثَّنِيَّةِ وَالَّتِي لَمْ تُضَمَّرْ مِنَ الثَّنِيَّةِ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ وَأَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ فِيمَنْ سَابَقَ بِهَا»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2474

chapter.englishTitle: In the horse racing

hadiths.englishRaw: We said, "If we meet Anas bin Malik, let's ask him if they used to gamble during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." So we went to him while he was in his palace in the corner and asked him. We said to him, "O Abu Hamzah, did you used to gamble during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to gamble?" He said, "Yes, indeed. I swear by Allah, he used to gamble and he once placed a bet on a horse called Sabhah, and it outran the people, so he was pleased with that." Abdullah said, "He means he was amazed by it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: We said, "If we meet Anas bin Malik, let's ask him if they used to gamble during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ." So we went to him while he was in his palace in the corner and asked him. We said to him, "O Abu Hamzah, did you used to gamble during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ? Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to gamble?" He said, "Yes, indeed. I swear by Allah, he used to gamble and he once placed a bet on a horse called Sabhah, and it outran the people, so he was pleased with that." Abdullah said, "He means he was amazed by it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْنَا لَوْ مِلْنَا إِلَى أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ أَكَانُوا يُرَاهِنُونَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قَالَ فَأَتَيْنَاهُ وَهُوَ فِي قَصْرِهِ فِي الزَّاوِيَةِ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ أَكُنْتُمْ تُرَاهِنُونَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُرَاهِنُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ لَقَدْ رَاهَنَ وَاللَّهِ عَلَى فَرَسٍ لَهُ يُقَالُ لَهُ سَبْحَةُ فَسَبَقَ النَّاسَ فَأنْهَشَّ لِذَلِكَ وَأَعْجَبَهُ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أنْهَشّهُ يَعْنِي أَعْجَبَهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Saʿīd b. Zayd \u003e al-Zubayr b. al-Khirrīt \u003e Abū Labīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ الْخِرِّيتِ عَنْ أَبِي لَبِيدٍ قَالَ أُجْرِيَتِ الْخَيْلُ فِي زَمَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ وَالْحَكَمُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ عَلَى الْبَصْرَةِ فَأَتَيْنَا الرِّهَانَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَتِ الْخَيْلُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2475

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي جِهَادِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِاللِّسَانِ وَالْيَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Jihad of the polytheists with the tongue and the hand.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: Use your property, your persons any your tongues in striving against the polytheists.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: Use your property, your persons any your tongues in striving against the polytheists.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «جَاهِدُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَأَنْفُسِكُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2476

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ يُقَاتِلُونَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ
chapter.englishTitle: A group from this nation continues to fight for the truth.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to be triumphant over the people until the Command of Allah overtakes them while they are still triumphant.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to be triumphant over the people until the Command of Allah overtakes them while they are still triumphant.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَزَالُ قَوْمٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى النَّاسِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ ظَاهِرُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid \u003e Qays b. Abū Ḥāzim \u003e al-Mughīrah b. Shuʿbah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2477

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ يُقَاتِلُونَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ
chapter.englishTitle: A group from this nation continues to fight for the truth.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There will always be people from my Ummah (nation) who will continue to be apparent upon the truth."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There will always be people from my Ummah (nation) who will continue to be apparent upon the truth."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَزَالُ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Bashhār \u003e Abū Dāwud al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Buraydah \u003e Sulaymān b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb \u003e Samiʿtuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2478

chapter.englishTitle: In the Battle of the Kharijites.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'There will be people among my Ummah (nation) after me who will recite the Qur'an, but it will not go any deeper than their throats. They will pass through Islam like an arrow passing through its target, then they will never return to it. They are the most evil of mankind and of all creation.' " 'Abdullah bin Samit said: "I mentioned to Rafi' bin 'Amr, the brother of Hakam bin 'Amr Ghifari and he said: 'I also heard that from the Messenger of Allah.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'There will be people among my Ummah (nation) after me who will recite the Qur'an, but it will not go any deeper than their throats. They will pass through Islam like an arrow passing through its target, then they will never return to it. They are the most evil of mankind and of all creation.' " 'Abdullah bin Samit said: "I mentioned to Rafi' bin 'Amr, the brother of Hakam bin 'Amr Ghifari and he said: 'I also heard that from the Messenger of Allah.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ مِنْ بَعْدِي مِنْ أُمَّتِي قَوْمًا يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ لَا يُجَاوِزُ حَلَاقِيمَهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الدِّينِ كَمَا يَخْرُجُ السَّهْمُ مِنَ الرَّمِيَّةِ ثُمَّ لَا يَعُودُونَ فِيهِ هُمْ شَرُّ الْخَلْقِ وَالْخَلِيقَةِ» قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ فَلَقِيتُ رَافِعًا أَخَا الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْغِفَارِيِّ فَحَدَّثْتُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ رَافِعٌ وَأَنَا أَيْضًا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah b. Qaʿnab \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Ibn al-Mughīrah \u003e Ḥumayd b. Hilāl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2479

chapter.englishTitle: Bless the senility of my nation

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "O Allah, bless my Ummah (nation) in their early morning." Whenever the Prophet ﷺ sent out a military expedition, he would send them out in the early morning. This man (mentioned in the narration) was a merchant, and he used to send out his servants in the early morning, so his wealth increased.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "O Allah, bless my Ummah (nation) in their early morning." Whenever the Prophet ﷺ sent out a military expedition, he would send them out in the early morning. This man (mentioned in the narration) was a merchant, and he used to send out his servants in the early morning, so his wealth increased.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِأُمَّتِي فِي بُكُورِهَا» وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا بَعَثَ سَرِيَّةً بَعَثَهَا مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ قَالَ وكَانَ هَذَا الرَّجُلُ رَجُلًا تَاجِرًا فَكَانَ يَبْعَثُ غِلْمَانَهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ فَكَثُرَ مَالُهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e ʿUmārah b. Ḥadīd \u003e Ṣakhr al-Ghāmidī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ صَخْرٍ الْغَامِدِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2480

chapter.englishTitle: On Thursday's Departure...

hadiths.englishRaw: It was rarely that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out on a journey on any day but on a Thursday.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was rarely that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out on a journey on any day but on a Thursday.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَقَلَّمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَخْرُجُ إِذَا أَرَادَ سَفَرًا إِلَّا يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Kaʿb from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2481

chapter.englishTitle: In the Goodness of Companionship

hadiths.englishRaw: "The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The companion who is the best to Allah is the one who is best to his companion. And the neighbor that is the best to Allah is the one that is best to his neighbor."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «خَيْرُ الْأَصْحَابِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرُهُمْ لِصَاحِبِهِ وَخَيْرُ الْجِيرَانِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرُهُمْ لِجَارِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah And Ibn Lahīʿah \u003e Shuraḥbīl b. Sharīk \u003e Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Ḥubulī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr b. al-ʿĀṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ وَابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُرَحْبِيلُ بْنُ شَرِيكٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2482

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي خَيْرِ الْأَصْحَابِ وَالسَّرَايَا وَالْجُيُوشِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the company of the best friends, palaces, and armies

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of companions are four, and the best of armies are four thousand, and the best of fortresses are four hundred. And if the number does not exceed twelve thousand, they should remain patient and truthful, for they will prevail despite their small number."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of companions are four, and the best of armies are four thousand, and the best of fortresses are four hundred. And if the number does not exceed twelve thousand, they should remain patient and truthful, for they will prevail despite their small number."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «خَيْرُ الْأَصْحَابِ أَرْبَعَةٌ وَخَيْرُ الْجُيُوشِ أَرْبَعَةُ آلَافٍ وَخَيْرُ السَّرَايَا أَرْبَعُ مِائَةٍ وَمَا بَلَغَ اثْنَي عَشَرَ أَلْفًا فَصَبَرُوا وَصَدَقُوا فَغُلِبُوا مِنْ قِلَّةٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Ḥibbān b. ʿAlī \u003e Yūnus And ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ يُونُسَ وَعُقَيْلٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2483

chapter.englishTitle: The Imam's Advice on Strategies

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic text is: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would send a man on a military expedition, he would advise him to fear Allah privately for himself and for those who are with him from the Muslims. He would say, 'Fight in the name of Allah and for the cause of Allah. Fight against those who disbelieve in Allah. Do not deceive, cheat, mutilate, or kill children.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic text is: "When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would send a man on a military expedition, he would advise him to fear Allah privately for himself and for those who are with him from the Muslims. He would say, 'Fight in the name of Allah and for the cause of Allah. Fight against those who disbelieve in Allah. Do not deceive, cheat, mutilate, or kill children.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَمَّرَ رَجُلًا عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ أَوْصَاهُ فِي خَاصَّةِ نَفْسِهِ بِتَقْوَى اللَّهِ وَبِمَنْ مَعَهُ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ خَيْرًا وَقَالَ «اغْزُوا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ قَاتِلُوا مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللَّهِ اغْزُوا وَلَا تَغْدِرُوا وَلَا تَغُلُّوا وَلَا تُمَثِّلُوا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا وَلِيدًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Marthad \u003e Sulaymān b. Buraydah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2484

chapter.englishTitle: Do not wish to meet the enemy.

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not long for meeting your enemy, and ask Allah for safety (from all sorts of evil)." (See Hadith No. 266, Vol. 4)    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not long for meeting your enemy, and ask Allah for safety (from all sorts of evil)." (See Hadith No. 266, Vol. 4)    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَتَمَنَّوْا لِقَاءَ الْعَدُوِّ وَاسْأََلُوا اللَّهَ الْعَافِيَةَ فَإِنْ لَقِيتُمُوهُمْ فَاثْبُتُوا وَأَكْثِرُوا ذِكْرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ أَجْلَبُوا وَضَجُّوا فَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالصَّمْتِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ziyād \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2485

chapter.englishTitle: In the Supplication during Battle

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to make supplication during the days of Hunayn: "O Allah, with You I seek to achieve, with You I seek to be successful, and with You I fight."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to make supplication during the days of Hunayn: "O Allah, with You I seek to achieve, with You I seek to be successful, and with You I fight."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَدْعُو أَيَّامَ حُنَيْنٍ «اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أُحَاوِلُ وَبِكَ أُصَاوِلُ وَبِكَ أُقَاتِلُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Thābit \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e Ṣuhayb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2486

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الدَّعْوَةِ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ قَبْلَ الْقِتَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the invitation to Islam before the battle

hadiths.englishRaw: “Whenever he appointed a man to lead a military detachment, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would advise him especially to fear Allah and treat the Muslims with him well. He ﷺ said: ‘Fight in the Name of Allah and in the cause of Allah. Fight those how disbelieve in Allah. Fight but do not be treacherous, do not steal from the spoils of war, do not mutilate and do not kill children. When you meet your enemy from among the polytheists, call them to one of three things. Whichever of them they respond to, accept it from them and refrain from fighting them. Invite them to accept Islam, and if they respond then accept it from them and refrain from fighting them. Then invite them to leave their land and move to the land of the polytheists. Tell them that if they do that, then they will have the same rights and duties as the polytheists. If they refuse, then tell them that they will be like the Muslim Bedouins (who live in the desert), subject to the same rulings of Allah as the believers. But they will have no share of Fay’* or war spoils, unless they fight alongside the Muslims. If they refuse to enter Islam, then ask them to pay the Poll-tax. If they do that, then accept it from them and refrain from fighting them. But if they refuse, then seek the help of Allah against them and fight them. If you lay siege to them and they want you to give them the protection of Allah and your Prophet, do not give them the protection of Allah and your Prophet, rather give them your protection and the protection of your father and your Companions, for if you violate your protection and the protection of your fathers, that is easier than violating the protection of Allah and the protection of His Messenger. If you lay siege to them and they want you to let them come out with a promise of the judgement of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, do not offer them a promise of the judgement of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, rather offer them your judgement, because you do not know if you will actually pass (the same as) Allah’s judgement regarding them or not.’” Another chain reports a similar hadith.     – Sound Chain
