If you lay siege to them and they want you to give them the protection of Allah and your Prophet, do not give them the protection of Allah and your Prophet, rather give them your protection and the protection of your father and your Companions, for if you violate your protection and the protection of your fathers, that is easier than violating the protection of Allah and the protection of His Messenger. If you lay siege to them and they want you to let them come out with a promise of the judgement of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, do not offer them a promise of the judgement of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, rather offer them your judgement, because you do not know if you will actually pass (the same as) Allah’s judgement regarding them or not.’” Another chain reports a similar hadith.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَّرَ رَجُلًا عَلَى سَرِيَّةٍ أَوْصَاهُ «إِذَا لَقِيتَ عَدُوَّكَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ فَادْعُهُمْ إِلَى إِحْدَى ثَلَاثِ خِلَالٍ أَوْ ثَلَاثِ خِصَالٍ فَأَيَّتُهُمْ مَا أَجَابُوكَ إِلَيْهَا فَاقْبَلْ مِنْهُمْ وَكُفَّ عَنْهُمْ ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ فَإِنْ هُمْ أَجَابُوكَ فَاقْبَلْ مِنْهُمْ وَكُفَّ عَنْهُمْ ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى التَّحَوُّلِ مِنْ دَارِهِمْ إِلَى دَارِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ إِنْ هُمْ فَعَلُوا أَنَّ لَهُمْ مَا لِلْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا عَلَى الْمُهَاجِرِينَ فَإِنْ هُمْ أَبَوْا فَأَخْبِرْهُمْ أَنَّهُمْ يَكُونُونَ كَأَعْرَابِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يَجْرِي عَلَيْهِمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ الَّذِي يَجْرِي عَلَى الْمُسلمين وَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْفَيْءِ وَالْغَنِيمَةِ نَصِيبٌ إِلَّا أَنْ يُجَاهِدُوا مَعَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَإِنْ هُمْ أَبَوْا أَنْ يَدْخُلُوا فِي الْإِسْلَامِ فَسَلْهُمْ إِعْطَاءَ الْجِزْيَةِ فَإِنْ فَعَلُوا فَاقْبَلْ مِنْهُمْ وَكُفَّ عَنْهُمْ فَإِنْ هُمْ أَبَوْا فَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَقَاتِلْهُمْ وَإِنْ حَاصَرْتَ أَهْلَ حِصْنٍ فَإِنْ أَرَادُوكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ لَهُمْ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَذِمَّةَ نَبِيِّهِ فَلَا تَجْعَلْ لَهُمْ ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَلَا ذِمَّةَ نَبِيِّهِ وَلَكِنِ اجْعَلْ لَهُمْ ذِمَّتَكَ وَذِمَّةَ أَبِيكَ وَذِمَّةَ أَصْحَابِكَ فَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ تُخْفِرُوا ذِمَّتَكُمْ وَذِمَّةَ آبَائِكُمْ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنْ أَنْ تُخْفِرُوا ذِمَّةَ اللَّهِ وَذِمَّةَ رَسُولِهِ وَإِنْ حَاصَرْتَ حِصْنًا فَأَرَادُوكَ أَنْ يَنْزِلُوا عَلَى حُكْمِ اللَّهِ فَلَا تُنْزِلْهُمْ عَلَى حُكْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَكِنْ أَنْزِلْهُمْ عَلَى حُكْمِكَ فَإِنَّكَ لَا تَدْرِي أَتُصِيبُ حُكْمَ اللَّهِ فِيهِمْ أَمْ لَا ثُمَّ اقْضِ فِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Marthad \u003e Sulaymān b. Buraydah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2487

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الدَّعْوَةِ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ قَبْلَ الْقِتَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the invitation to Islam before the battle

hadiths.englishRaw: "About the Prophet ﷺ , the same as him."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "About the Prophet ﷺ , the same as him."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAlqamah Faḥaddatht Bih Muqātil b. Ḥayyān \u003e Muslim b. Hayṣam \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Muqarrin
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ عَلْقَمَةُ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ مُقَاتِلَ بْنَ حَيَّانَ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُسْلِمُ بْنُ هَيْصَمٍ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2488

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الدَّعْوَةِ إِلَى الْإِسْلَامِ قَبْلَ الْقِتَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the invitation to Islam before the battle

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah Sufyan said, "I have not heard from Ibn Abi Najeeh regarding the meaning of this hadith."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah Sufyan said, "I have not heard from Ibn Abi Najeeh regarding the meaning of this hadith."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا قَاتَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَوْمًا حَتَّى دَعَاهُمْ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ سُفْيَانُ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ مِنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ يَعْنِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2489

chapter.englishTitle: The capture of the enemy

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to change his position during the Fajr prayer and he used to listen. If he heard the Adhan, he would stop, and if he didn't hear the Adhan, he would continue.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to change his position during the Fajr prayer and he used to listen. If he heard the Adhan, he would stop, and if he didn't hear the Adhan, he would continue.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يُغِيرُ عِنْدَ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَكَانَ يَسْتَمِعُ فَإِنْ سَمِعَ أَذَانًا أَمْسَكَ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ أَذَانًا أَغَارَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2490
hadiths.englishRaw: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as part of a delegation from Thaqif. I was in the lower part of the dome where there was no one except the Prophet ﷺ sleeping. Then a man came to him and woke him up, saying, "Go and kill him." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Is he not a witness that there is no god but Allah?" Shu'bah said, "And I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." The man said, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said, "I have been ordered to fight people until they testify that there is no god but Allah. Once they say it, their lives and wealth become inviolable unless it is in accordance with Islamic law." He said, "And he is the one who killed Abu Mas'ud." He said, "And he did not die until he had killed the best man in Ta'if."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as part of a delegation from Thaqif. I was in the lower part of the dome where there was no one except the Prophet ﷺ sleeping. Then a man came to him and woke him up, saying, "Go and kill him." The Prophet ﷺ said, "Is he not a witness that there is no god but Allah?" Shu'bah said, "And I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah." The man said, "Yes." The Prophet ﷺ said, "I have been ordered to fight people until they testify that there is no god but Allah. Once they say it, their lives and wealth become inviolable unless it is in accordance with Islamic law." He said, "And he is the one who killed Abu Mas'ud." He said, "And he did not die until he had killed the best man in Ta'if."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي وَفْدِ ثَقِيفٍ قَالَ وَكُنْتُ فِي أَسْفَلِ الْقُبَّةِ لَيْسَ فِيهَا أَحَدٌ إِلَّا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ نَائِمٌ إِذْ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَسَارَّهُ فَقَالَ اذْهَبْ فَاقْتُلْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَلَيْسَ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ؟» قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ بَلَى قَالَ إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُقَاتِلَ النَّاسَ حَتَّى يَقُولُوا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَإِذَا قَالُوهَا حَرُمَتْ عَلَيَّ دِمَاؤُهُمْ وَأَمْوَالُهُمْ إِلَّا بِحَقِّهَا قَالَ وَهُوَ الَّذِي قَتَلَ أَبَا مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ وَمَا مَاتَ حَتَّى قَتَلَ خَيْرَ إِنْسَانٍ بِالطَّائِفِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Sālim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَوْسَ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْسٍ الثَّقَفِيَّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2491

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا يَحِلُّ دَمُ رَجُلٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
chapter.englishTitle: It is not permissible to shed the blood of a man who attests tha...

hadiths.englishRaw: The blood of a Muslim man who testifies that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah should not be lawfully shed but only for one of three reasons: married fornicator, soul for soul, and one who deserts his religion separating himself from the community.
hadiths.body: The blood of a Muslim man who testifies that there is no god but Allah and that I am the Messenger of Allah should not be lawfully shed but only for one of three reasons: married fornicator, soul for soul, and one who deserts his religion separating himself from the community.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا يَحِلُّ دَمُ رَجُلٍ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِلَّا إِحْدَى ثَلَاثَةِ نَفَرٍ النَّفْسُ بِالنَّفْسِ وَالثَّيِّبُ الزَّانِي وَالتَّارِكُ لِدِينِهِ الْمُفَارِقُ لِلْجَمَاعَةِ
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Murrah \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2492

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي بَيَانِ قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ الصَّلَاةُ جَامِعَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: The comprehensive statement of the Prophet regarding prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent the army of the commanders and said: "Depart and stay for as long as Allah wills." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ascended the pulpit and commanded for the congregational prayer to be announced.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent the army of the commanders and said: "Depart and stay for as long as Allah wills." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ascended the pulpit and commanded for the congregational prayer to be announced.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَعَثَ جَيْشَ الْأُمَرَاءِ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقُوا فَلَبِثُوا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ صَعِدَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمِنْبَرَ فَأَمَرَ فَنُودِيَ الصَّلَاةُ جَامِعَةٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e al-Aswad b. Shaybān \u003e Khālid b. Sumayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ شَيْبَانَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ سُمَيْرٍ قَالَ قَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَبَاحٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ وَكَانَتِ الْأَنْصَارُ تُفَقِّهُهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قَتَادَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2493

chapter.englishTitle: The trusted advisor

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The advisor is trustworthy."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The advisor is trustworthy."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْمُسْتَشَارُ مُؤْتَمَنٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī \u003e Abū Masʿūd al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2494

chapter.englishTitle: In war, there is deception.

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to delegate other battles when he intended to go for a particular battle."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given sentence is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to delegate other battles when he intended to go for a particular battle."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا أَرَادَ غَزْوَةً وَرَّى بِغَيْرِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Ḥizāmī \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Kaʿb b. Mālik \u003e Kaʿb b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2495

chapter.englishTitle: The slogan

hadiths.englishRaw: I confronted a man and killed him, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rewarded me by giving me what the man had taken. Our motto with Khalid bin Al-Walid was "kill."
hadiths.body: I confronted a man and killed him, then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ rewarded me by giving me what the man had taken. Our motto with Khalid bin Al-Walid was "kill."
hadiths.arabic: بَارَزْتُ رَجُلًا فَقَتَلْتُهُ فَنَفَّلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَلَبَهُ فَكَانَ شِعَارُنَا مَعَ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ أَمِتْ يَعْنِي اقْتُلْ
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wakīʿ \u003e Abū ʿUmays \u003e Iyās b. Salamah b. al-Akwaʿ from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ عَنْ أَبِي عُمَيْسٍ عَنْ إِيَاسِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْأَكْوَعِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2496

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the saying of the Prophet ﷺ, the faces shone.

hadiths.englishRaw: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the Battle of Hunayn, and we were in a hot and intense day. So, we descended under the shade of the trees and he mentioned a story. Then, he took a handful of soil and struck their faces and said, "The faces were humiliated. Allah has granted victory to the polytheists." Ya'la then said: "His sons told me that their fathers said, 'There was not a single one of us left except that his eyes and mouth were filled with dust.'"   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in the Battle of Hunayn, and we were in a hot and intense day. So, we descended under the shade of the trees and he mentioned a story. Then, he took a handful of soil and struck their faces and said, "The faces were humiliated. Allah has granted victory to the polytheists." Ya'la then said: "His sons told me that their fathers said, 'There was not a single one of us left except that his eyes and mouth were filled with dust.'"   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي غَزْوَةِ حُنَيْنٍ فَكُنَّا فِي يَوْمٍ قَائِظٍ شَدِيدِ الْحَرِّ فَنَزَلْنَا تَحْتَ ظِلَالِ الشَّجَرِ فَذَكَرَ الْقِصَّةَ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ تُرَابٍ قَالَ فَحَدَّثَنِي الَّذِي هُوَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنِّي أَنَّهُ ضَرَبَ بِهِ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَقَالَ «شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوهُ فَهَزَمَ اللَّهُ الْمُشْرِكِينَ» قَالَ يَعْلَى فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبْنَاؤُهُمْ أَنَّ أَبَاءَهُمْ قَالُوا فَمَا بَقِيَ مِنَّا أَحَدٌ إِلَّا امْتَلَأَتْ عَيْنَاهُ وَفَمُهُ تُرَابًا   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl And ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yasār Abū Hammām \u003e Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Fihrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ وَعَفَّانُ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَبِي هَمَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْفِهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2497

chapter.englishTitle: In the marketplace of the Prophet (PBUH)

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us while we were in a gathering, "Give me the oath (Pledge of allegiance for: (1) Not to join anything in worship along with Allah, (2) Not to steal, (3) Not to commit illegal sexual intercourse, (4) Not to kill your children, (5) Not to accuse an innocent person (to spread such an accusation among people), (6) Not to be disobedient (when ordered) to do good deeds. The Prophet ﷺ added: Whoever amongst you fulfill his pledge, his reward will be with Allah, and whoever commits any of those sins and receives the legal punishment in this world for that sin, then that punishment will be an expiation for that sin, and whoever commits any of those sins and Allah does not expose him, then it is up to Allah if He wishes He will punish him or if He wishes, He will forgive him." So we gave the Pledge for that. (See Hadith No. 17, Vol. 1)    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us while we were in a gathering, "Give me the oath (Pledge of allegiance for: (1) Not to join anything in worship along with Allah, (2) Not to steal, (3) Not to commit illegal sexual intercourse, (4) Not to kill your children, (5) Not to accuse an innocent person (to spread such an accusation among people), (6) Not to be disobedient (when ordered) to do good deeds. The Prophet ﷺ added: Whoever amongst you fulfill his pledge, his reward will be with Allah, and whoever commits any of those sins and receives the legal punishment in this world for that sin, then that punishment will be an expiation for that sin, and whoever commits any of those sins and Allah does not expose him, then it is up to Allah if He wishes He will punish him or if He wishes, He will forgive him." So we gave the Pledge for that. (See Hadith No. 17, Vol. 1)    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ مَعَهُ فِي مَجْلِسٍ «بَايِعُونِي عَلَى أَنْ لَا تُشْرِكُوا بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَلَا تَسْرِقُوا وَلَا تَزْنُوا وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ وَلَا تَأْتُوا بِبُهْتَانٍ تَفْتَرُونَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَأَرْجُلِكُمْ فَمَنْ وَفَى مِنْكُمْ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَسَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فَأَمْرُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ عَاقَبَهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ عَفَا عَنْهُ وَمَنْ أَصَابَ شَيْئًا فَعُوقِبَ بِهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَهُ» قَالَ فَبَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Idrīs \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2498

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي بَيْعَتِهِ أَنْ لَا يَفِرُّوا
chapter.englishTitle: In his pledge that they do not flee.

hadiths.englishRaw: We were one thousand and four hundred on the Day of Hudaibiya. We swore fealty to hiin (the Holy Prophet) and 'Umar was holding the latter's hand (when he was sitting) under the tree (called) Samura (to administer the oath to the Companions). The narrator added: We took oath to the effect that we would not flee (from the battlefield if there was an encounter with the Meccans), but we did not take oath to fight to death.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We were one thousand and four hundred on the Day of Hudaibiya. We swore fealty to hiin (the Holy Prophet) and 'Umar was holding the latter's hand (when he was sitting) under the tree (called) Samura (to administer the oath to the Companions). The narrator added: We took oath to the effect that we would not flee (from the battlefield if there was an encounter with the Meccans), but we did not take oath to fight to death.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنَّا يَوْمَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ أَلْفًا وَأَرْبَعَ مِائَةٍ فَبَايَعْنَاهُ وَعُمَرُ آخِذٌ بِيَدِهِ تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ وَهِيَ سَمُرَةٌ وَقَالَ «بَايَعْنَاهُ عَلَى أَنْ لَا نَفِرَّ وَلَمْ نُبَايِعْهُ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2499

chapter.englishTitle: In the Trench's Excavation

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was carrying the earth with us on the Day of Ahzab and the whiteness of his belly had been covered with earth. (While engaged in this toil) he was reciting: By God, if Thou hadst not guided us We would have neither been guided aright nor practised charity, Nor offered prayers. Descend on us peace and tranquillity. Behold I these people (the Meccans) refused to follow us. According to another version, he recited: The chieftains (of the tribes) refused to follow us When they contemplated mischief, we rejected it. And with this (verse) he would raise his voice.
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was carrying the earth with us on the Day of Ahzab and the whiteness of his belly had been covered with earth. (While engaged in this toil) he was reciting: By God, if Thou hadst not guided us We would have neither been guided aright nor practised charity, Nor offered prayers. Descend on us peace and tranquillity. Behold I these people (the Meccans) refused to follow us. According to another version, he recited: The chieftains (of the tribes) refused to follow us When they contemplated mischief, we rejected it. And with this (verse) he would raise his voice.
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْقُلُ مَعَنَا التُّرَابَ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ وَقَدْ وَارَى التُّرَابُ بَيَاضَ إِبِطَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ «اللَّهُمَّ لَوْلَا أَنْتَ مَا اهْتَدَيْنَا وَلَا تَصَدَّقْنَا وَلَا صَلَّيْنَا فَأَنْزِلَنَّ سَكِينَةً عَلَيْنَا وَثَبِّتِ الْأَقْدَامَ إِنْ لَاقَيْنَا إِنَّ الْأُلَى قَدْ بَغَوْا عَلَيْنَا وَإِنْ أَرَادُوا فِتْنَةً أَبَيْنَا» وَيَرْفَعُ بِهَا صَوْتَهُ
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Barāʾ b. ʿĀzib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2500

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: كَيْفَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ مَكَّةَ
chapter.englishTitle: How did the Prophet ﷺ enter Mecca?

hadiths.englishRaw: In the year of the conquest of Mecca the Prophet ﷺ entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: In the year of the conquest of Mecca the Prophet ﷺ entered Mecca, wearing a helmet on his head.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ مَكَّةَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ وَعَلَى رَأْسِهِ مِغْفَرٌ فَلَمَّا نَزَعَهُ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا ابْنُ خَطَلٍ مُتَعَلِّقٌ بِأَسْتَارِ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اقْتُلُوهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Khālid b. Ḥāzim \u003e Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2501

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَبِيعَةِ سَيْفِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Graveyard of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: "The sword of the Prophet ﷺ was made of silver."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The sword of the Prophet ﷺ was made of silver."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ قَبِيعَةُ سَيْفِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Jarīr b. Ḥāzim \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2502

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ إِذَا ظَهَرَ عَلَى قَوْمٍ أَقَامَ بِالْعَرْصَةِ ثَلَاثَةً
chapter.englishTitle: That the Prophet, ﷺ , used to establish a three-day truce when ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When the Prophet ﷺ overtook a people he would stay at the outskirts of their city for three nights."
hadiths.body: "When the Prophet ﷺ overtook a people he would stay at the outskirts of their city for three nights."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «كَانَ إِذَا ظَهَرَ عَلَى قَوْمٍ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُقِيمَ بِعَرْصَتِهِمْ ثَلَاثًا»
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Muʿādh b. Muʿādh \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas \u003e Abū Ṭalḥah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2503

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي تَحْرِيقِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Section 23

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ burnt the date-palms of Bani An-Nadir.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ burnt the date-palms of Bani An-Nadir.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «حَرَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2504

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ التَّعْذِيبِ بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of torture with Allah's punishment

hadiths.englishRaw: We sent the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a military expedition, and he said, "If you capture so-and-so and so-and-so, burn them with fire." The next day, he sent for us and said, "I had commanded you to burn these two men, but then I realized that no one should be tortured with fire except Allah. So, if you capture them, kill them."   – Sound
hadiths.body: We sent the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in a military expedition, and he said, "If you capture so-and-so and so-and-so, burn them with fire." The next day, he sent for us and said, "I had commanded you to burn these two men, but then I realized that no one should be tortured with fire except Allah. So, if you capture them, kill them."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي سَرِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ «إِنْ ظَفِرْتُمْ بِفُلَانٍ وَفُلَانٍ فَحَرِّقُوهُمَا بِالنَّارِ» حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ الْغَدُ بَعَثَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَالَ «إِنِّي كُنْتُ أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِتَحْرِيقِ هَذَيْنِ الرَّجُلَيْنِ ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يُعَذِّبَ بِالنَّارِ إِلَّا اللَّهُ فَإِنْ ظَفِرْتُمْ بِهِمَا فَاقْتُلُوهُمَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar b. Abān \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥīm b. Sulaymān \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Bukayr b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ashaj \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Dawsī \u003e Abū Hurayrah al-Dawsī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ الدَّوْسِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ الدَّوْسِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2505

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ قَتْلِ النِّسَاءِ، وَالصِّبْيَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: In Prohibition of Killing Women and Children.

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Abd Allaah bin (mas’ud) said “A woman was found slain in one of the battles of the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ. The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ forbade to kill women and children.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: ‘Abd Allaah bin (mas’ud) said “A woman was found slain in one of the battles of the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ. The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ forbade to kill women and children.     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: وُجِدَ فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ امْرَأَةٌ مَقْتُولَةٌ «فَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ قَتْلِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibn ʿUmar b. Ḥafṣ b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2506

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ قَتْلِ النِّسَاءِ، وَالصِّبْيَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: In Prohibition of Killing Women and Children.

hadiths.englishRaw: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on expeditions and defeated the polytheists. The people were quick to kill until they killed the young. When the Prophet ﷺ came to know about this, he said, 'What is the matter with people that they killed the young? Verily, the killing of young children should not be done, not even three of them.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We went out with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on expeditions and defeated the polytheists. The people were quick to kill until they killed the young. When the Prophet ﷺ came to know about this, he said, 'What is the matter with people that they killed the young? Verily, the killing of young children should not be done, not even three of them.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي غَزَاةٍ فَظَفِرَنَا بِالْمُشْرِكِينَ فَأَسْرَعَ النَّاسُ فِي الْقَتْلِ حَتَّى قَتَلُوا الذُّرِّيَّةَ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ ذَهَبَ بِهُمُ الْقَتْلُ حَتَّى قَتَلُوا الذُّرِّيَّةَ؟ أَلَا لَا تُقْتَلَنَّ ذُرِّيَّةٌ ثَلَاثًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿĀṣim b. Yūsuf \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e Yūnus b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e al-Aswad b. Sarīʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2507

chapter.englishTitle: When should the boy be killed?

hadiths.englishRaw: "We were presented to the Prophet ﷺ that day, and he announced that whoever grows hair shall be killed, and whoever does not shall be left alone. I was among those who did not grow hair, so they did not kill me. This happened on the day of Qurayzah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "We were presented to the Prophet ﷺ that day, and he announced that whoever grows hair shall be killed, and whoever does not shall be left alone. I was among those who did not grow hair, so they did not kill me. This happened on the day of Qurayzah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «عُرِضْنَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَمَنْ أَنْبَتَ الشَّعْرَ قُتِلَ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُنْبِتْ تُرِكَ فَكُنْتُ أَنَا مِمَّنْ لَمْ يُنْبِتِ الشَّعْرَ فَلَمْ يَقْتُلُونِي» يَعْنِي يَوْمَ قُرَيْظَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e ʿAṭiyyah al-Quraẓī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَطِيَّةَ الْقُرَظِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2508

chapter.englishTitle: In the liberation of the prisoner

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Visit the sick and feed the hungry."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Visit the sick and feed the hungry."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «فُكُّوا الْعَانِيَ وَأَطْعِمُوا الْجَائِعَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2509

chapter.englishTitle: In the defense of the captives

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ compensated a man with two men.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ compensated a man with two men.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَادَى رَجُلًا بِرَجُلَيْنِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Muhallab \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2510

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الْغَنِيمَةِ لَا تَحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ قَبْلَنَا
chapter.englishTitle: The booty does not belong to anyone before us.

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Prophet ﷺ said: I have been given five things that no Prophet before me was given: I was sent to the red and the black, the earth has been made for me a place of worship and purification, the spoils of war have been made lawful for me, and they were not made lawful for anyone before me, and I have been given victory through awe for a distance of one month's journey, and I have been granted the opportunity to ask for intercession for my Ummah, and it will be accessible for anyone from among you, by the will of Allah the Exalted, as long as they do not ascribe any partners to Allah in worship."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Prophet ﷺ said: I have been given five things that no Prophet before me was given: I was sent to the red and the black, the earth has been made for me a place of worship and purification, the spoils of war have been made lawful for me, and they were not made lawful for anyone before me, and I have been given victory through awe for a distance of one month's journey, and I have been granted the opportunity to ask for intercession for my Ummah, and it will be accessible for anyone from among you, by the will of Allah the Exalted, as long as they do not ascribe any partners to Allah in worship."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ أُعْطِيتُ خَمْسًا لَمْ يُعْطَهُنَّ نَبِيٌّ قَبْلِي بُعِثْتُ إِلَى الْأَحْمَرِ وَالْأَسْوَدِ وَجُعِلَتْ لِيَ الْأَرْضُ مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا وَأُحِلَّتْ لِيَ الْغَنَائِمُ وَلَمْ تَحِلَّ لِأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي وَنُصِرْتُ بِالرُّعْبِ شَهْرًا يُرْعَبُ مِنِّي الْعَدُوُّ مَسِيرَةَ شَهْرٍ وَقِيلَ لِي سَلْ تُعْطَهْ فَاخْتَبَأْتُ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لِأُمَّتِي وَهِيَ نَائِلَةٌ مِنْكُمْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى مَنْ لَمْ يُشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥammād \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Mujāhid \u003e ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2511

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قِسْمَةِ الْغَنَائِمِ فِي بِلَادِ الْعَدُوِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Division of Spoils in Enemy Lands

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ distributed the spoils of the Battle of Hunayn among the soldiers". Abdullah (the narrator) said, "Abdullah ibn Masood said this in the chain of narrators."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ distributed the spoils of the Battle of Hunayn among the soldiers". Abdullah (the narrator) said, "Abdullah ibn Masood said this in the chain of narrators."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ غَنَائِمَ حُنَيْنٍ بِالْجِعْرَانَةِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ فِي الْإِسْنَادِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Abū Wāʾil
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2512

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قِسْمَةِ الْغَنَائِمِ كَيْفَ تُقَسَّمُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the division of spoils, how is it divided?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I witnessed the conquest of Khaybar with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the polytheists were defeated. We seized their belongings, and the people hastily took whatever they found from their spoils. The pots were not distributed until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered it. So the pots were provided, and then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ divided them among us. For every ten individuals, he allocated a sheep. The people of so-and-so had nine individuals with them, and I was alone. So I turned towards them, and we became ten with one sheep amongst us." Abdullah said, "It has reached me that your companion (referring to the Messenger of Allah) has said about Qais bin Muslim, 'He did not keep it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I witnessed the conquest of Khaybar with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and the polytheists were defeated. We seized their belongings, and the people hastily took whatever they found from their spoils. The pots were not distributed until the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered it. So the pots were provided, and then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ divided them among us. For every ten individuals, he allocated a sheep. The people of so-and-so had nine individuals with them, and I was alone. So I turned towards them, and we became ten with one sheep amongst us." Abdullah said, "It has reached me that your companion (referring to the Messenger of Allah) has said about Qais bin Muslim, 'He did not keep it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «شَهِدْتُ فَتْحَ خَيْبَرَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَانْهَزَمَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ فَوَقَعْنَا فِي رِحَالِهِمْ فَابْتَدَرَ النَّاسُ مَا وَجَدُوا مِنْ جَزُورٍ» قَالَ «فَلَمْ يَكُنْ ذَلِكَ بِأَسْرَعَ مِنْ أَنْ فَارَتْ الْقُدُورُ» فَأَمَرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأُكْفِئَتْ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَسَمَ بَيْنَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَجَعَلَ لِكُلِّ عَشَرَةٍ شَاةً قَالَ وَكَانَ بَنُو فُلَانٍ مَعَهُ تِسْعَةً وَكُنْتُ وَحْدِي فَالْتَفَتُّ إِلَيْهِمْ فَكُنَّا عَشَرَةً بَيْنَنَا شَاةٌ قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ صَاحِبَكُمْ يَقُولُ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ كَأَنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَحْفَظْهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar al-Raqqī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Zayd \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ زَيْدٍ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2513

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قِسْمَةِ الْغَنَائِمِ كَيْفَ تُقَسَّمُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the division of spoils, how is it divided?

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ , narrating similar to it, he said: "So I made myself close to them". Abu Muhammad Al-Sawab said: "According to me, what Zakariya said in the chain of narration."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ , narrating similar to it, he said: "So I made myself close to them". Abu Muhammad Al-Sawab said: "According to me, what Zakariya said in the chain of narration."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَحْوَهُ قَالَ فَأُلِّفْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الصَّوَابُ عِنْدِي مَا قَالَ زَكَرِيَّا فِي الْإِسْنَادِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Zayd \u003e Ibn Abū Unaysah \u003e Qays b. Muslim \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ زَيْدٍ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2514

chapter.englishTitle: The share of relatives.

hadiths.englishRaw: About the arrow of the close relative that Allah mentioned, and indeed, we used to see that the close relatives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were the most deserving of that. However, our people disagreed with us on this.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the arrow of the close relative that Allah mentioned, and indeed, we used to see that the close relatives of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ were the most deserving of that. However, our people disagreed with us on this.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سهْمِ ذِي الْقُرْبَى الَّذِي ذَكَرَهُ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّا كُنَّا نَرَى أَنَّ قَرَابَةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ هُمْ فَأَبَى ذَلِكَ عَلَيْنَا قَوْمُنَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Jarīr b. Ḥāzim \u003e Qays b. Saʿd \u003e Yazīd b. Hurmuz \u003e Katab Najdah Ban ʿĀmir \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Yasʾaluh \u003e Ashyāʾ Fakatab Ilayh Innak Saʾalt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ هُرْمُزَ قَالَ كَتَبَ نَجْدَةُ بَنُ عَامِرٍ إِلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ إِنَّكَ سَأَلْتَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2515

chapter.englishTitle: In the realm of horses

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ distributed the war spoils on the Day of Khaibar, giving three shares to the horseman, two shares for the horse, and one share for the man.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Ibn ‘Umar that the Prophet ﷺ distributed the war spoils on the Day of Khaibar, giving three shares to the horseman, two shares for the horse, and one share for the man.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَسْهَمَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ لِلْفَارِسِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَسْهُمٍ وَلِلرَّاجِلِ سَهْمًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Muḥammad b. Khāzim Abū Muʿāwiyah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَازِمٍ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2516

chapter.englishTitle: In the realm of horses

hadiths.englishRaw: From the son of Umar, similar to him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the son of Umar, similar to him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2517

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يَقْدَمُ بَعْدَ الْفَتْحِ هَلْ يُسْهَمُ لَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Does contributing to the one who comes after victory help him?

hadiths.englishRaw: "I never witnessed any spoils of war with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, except that he would assign a share for me, except for the day of Khaybar. It was specifically for the people of Hudaybiyyah. Both Abu Musa and Abu Huraira went between Hudaybiyyah and Khaybar."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I never witnessed any spoils of war with the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, except that he would assign a share for me, except for the day of Khaybar. It was specifically for the people of Hudaybiyyah. Both Abu Musa and Abu Huraira went between Hudaybiyyah and Khaybar."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَغْنَمًا إِلَّا قَسَمَ لِي إِلَّا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ فَإِنَّهَا كَانَتْ لِأَهْلِ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ خَاصَّةً وَكَانَ أَبُو مُوسَى وَأَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ جَاءَا بَيْنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ وَخَيْبَرَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAlī b. Zayd \u003e ʿAmmār b. Abū ʿAmmār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2518

chapter.englishTitle: In the arrows of slaves and boys

hadiths.englishRaw: "I witnessed the battle of Khaybar while I was a slave. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me from his spoils of war and also gave me a sword, saying, 'Take hold of this.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I witnessed the battle of Khaybar while I was a slave. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ gave me from his spoils of war and also gave me a sword, saying, 'Take hold of this.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: شَهِدْتُ خَيْبَرَ وَأَنَا عَبْدٌ مَمْلُوكٌ فَأَعْطَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ خُرْثِيِّ الْمَتَاعِ وَأَعْطَانِي سَيْفًا فَقَالَ «تَقَلَّدْ بِهَذَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Khalīl \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e Muḥammad b. Zayd \u003e ʿUmayr a freed slave of Ibn al-Laḥm \u003e Shahidt Khaybar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْماَعِيلُ بْنُ خَلِيلٍ أَنْبَأَنَا حَفْصٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عُمَيْرٍ مَوْلَى آبِي اللَّحْمِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2519

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْمَغَانِمِ حَتَّى تُقْسَمَ
chapter.englishTitle: In prohibiting the sale of spoils until they are distributed

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet, peace be upon him, it is forbidden to sell arrows until they are divided.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet, peace be upon him, it is forbidden to sell arrows until they are divided.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ تُبَاعَ السِّهَامُ حَتَّى تُقْسَمَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ḥumyad \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd b. Jābir \u003e al-Qāsim And Makḥūl \u003e Abū Umāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمْيَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ وَمَكْحُولٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2520

chapter.englishTitle: In the repentance of the nation

hadiths.englishRaw: "I do not rule over you except by what I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he stood among us on the day of Khaybar, when we conquered it. He said, 'Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not take anything from the spoils until he clears it.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I do not rule over you except by what I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he stood among us on the day of Khaybar, when we conquered it. He said, 'Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not take anything from the spoils until he clears it.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنِّي لَا أَقُومُ فِيكُمْ إِلَّا بِمَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَامَ فِينَا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ حِينَ افْتَتَحْنَاهَا فَقَالَ «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلَا يَأْتِي شَيْئًا مِنَ السَّبْيِ حَتَّى يَسْتَبْرِئَهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū Marzūq a freed slave of Litujīb \u003e Ḥanash al-Ṣanʿānī \u003e Ghazawnā al-Maghrib And ʿAlaynā Rūwayfiʿ b. Thābit al-Anṣārī Fāftataḥnā Qaryah Yuqāl Lahā Jarbah Faqām Fīnā Rūwayfiʿ b. Thābit al-Anṣārī Khaṭīb \u003e Innī Lā Aqūm Fīkum Illā Bimā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْزُوقٍ مَوْلًى لِتُجِيبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حَنَشٌ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ قَالَ غَزَوْنَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَعَلَيْنَا رُوَيْفِعُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ فَافْتَتَحْنَا قَرْيَةً يُقَالُ لَهَا جَرْبَةُ فَقَامَ فِينَا رُوَيْفِعُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ خَطِيبًا فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2521

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ وَطْءِ الْحَبَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: In Prohibition of Sleeping with the Rope

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Al Darda said “The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ was in a battle. He saw a woman who was nearing the time when she was to deliver a child. “He said “Perhaps the master has intercourse with her.”. They(the people) said “Yes”. He said “I am inclined to invoke a curse on him which will enter his grave with him. How can he make it (the child) an heir when it is not lawful for him? How can he take it into his service when that is not lawful for him?”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Al Darda said “The Apostle of Allaah ﷺ was in a battle. He saw a woman who was nearing the time when she was to deliver a child. “He said “Perhaps the master has intercourse with her.”. They(the people) said “Yes”. He said “I am inclined to invoke a curse on him which will enter his grave with him. How can he make it (the child) an heir when it is not lawful for him? How can he take it into his service when that is not lawful for him?”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ رَأَى امْرَأَةً مُجِحَّةً يَعْنِي حُبْلَى عَلَى بَابُ فُسْطَاطٍ فَقَالَ «لَعَلَّهُ قَدْ أَلَمَّ بِهَا؟» قَالُوا نَعَمْ قَالَ «لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَلْعَنَهُ لَعْنَةً تَدْخُلُ مَعَهُ قَبْرَهُ كَيْفَ يُوَرِّثُهُ وَهُوَ لَا يَحِلُّ لَهُ وَكَيْفَ يَسْتَخْدِمُهُ وَهُوَ لَا يَحِلُّ لَهُ؟»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Asad b. Mūsá \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yazīd b. Khumayr Abū ʿUmar al-Shāmī al-Hamdānī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Jubayr b. Nufayr from his father \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَسَدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُمَيْرٍ أَبِي عُمَرَ الشَّامِيِّ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2522

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ التَّفْرِيقِ، بَيْنَ الْوَالِدَةِ وَوَلَدِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of separation between a mother and her child

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Ayoub was in an army, and the children and their mothers were separated, so he saw them crying. He started returning the child to their mother and saying, "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever separates a mother from her child, Allah will separate him from his loved ones on the Day of Resurrection.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Ayoub was in an army, and the children and their mothers were separated, so he saw them crying. He started returning the child to their mother and saying, "Verily, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever separates a mother from her child, Allah will separate him from his loved ones on the Day of Resurrection.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ كَانَ فِي جَيْشٍ فَفُرِّقَ بَيْنَ الصِّبْيَانِ وَبَيْنَ أُمَّهَاتِهِمْ فَرَآهُمْ يَبْكُونَ فَجَعَلَ يَرُدُّ الصَّبِيَّ إِلَى أُمِّهِ وَيَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ فَرَّقَ بَيْنَ الْوَالِدَةِ وَوَلَدِهَا فَرَّقَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْأَحِبَّاءِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Qāsim b. Kathīr \u003e al-Layth b. Saʿd Qirāʾah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Junādah \u003e Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Ḥubuli
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قِرَاءَةً عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جُنَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِىِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2523

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْحَرْبِيِّ إِذَا قَدِمَ مُسْلِمًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the military, when a Muslim arrives

hadiths.englishRaw: I took the cousin of Al-Mughira ibn Shu'ba and presented her to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ asked about his cousin, so he said, "O Saqr, when people embrace Islam, they protect their wealth and lives, so give her back to them." They were from the tribe of Bani Sulaym and they embraced Islam, so they came to him and asked him about this. He called me and said, "O Saqr, when people embrace Islam, they protect their wealth and lives, so give her back to them." So I returned her to them.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I took the cousin of Al-Mughira ibn Shu'ba and presented her to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ . The Prophet ﷺ asked about his cousin, so he said, "O Saqr, when people embrace Islam, they protect their wealth and lives, so give her back to them." They were from the tribe of Bani Sulaym and they embraced Islam, so they came to him and asked him about this. He called me and said, "O Saqr, when people embrace Islam, they protect their wealth and lives, so give her back to them." So I returned her to them.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخَذْتُ عَمَّةَ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ فَقَدِمْتُ بِهَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَمَّتَهُ فَقَالَ «يَا صَخْرُ إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا أَحْرَزُوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَدِمَاءَهُمْ فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ» وَكَانَ مَاءٌ لِبَنِي سُلَيْمٍ فَأَسْلَمُوا فَأَتَوْهُ فَسَأَلُوهُ ذَلِكَ فَدَعَانِي فَقَالَ «يَا صَخْرُ إِنَّ الْقَوْمَ إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا أَحْرَزُوا أَمْوَالَهُمْ وَدِمَاءَهُمْ فَادْفَعْهُ إِلَيْهِمْ» فَدَفَعْتُهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Abān b. ʿAbdullāh al-Bajalī \u003e ʿUthmān b. Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Ṣakhr b. al-ʿAylah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَجَلِيُّ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ صَخْرِ بْنِ الْعَيْلَةِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2524

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي أَنَّ النَّفْلَ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the second part towards the Imam

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a military expedition in which Ibn Umar participated, and they seized a large number of camels. Their share was twelve or eleven camels, and they distributed them one by one.   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent a military expedition in which Ibn Umar participated, and they seized a large number of camels. Their share was twelve or eleven camels, and they distributed them one by one.   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَرِيَّةً فِيهَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَغَنِمُوا إِبِلًا كَثِيرَةً فَكَانَتْ سُهْمَانُهُمُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا أَوْ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا وَنُفِّلُوا بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ābin ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابِنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2525

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي أَنْ يُنَفَّلَ فِي الْبَدْأَةِ الرُّبُعُ وَفِي الرَّجْعَةِ الثُّلُثُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the beginning, the quarter is to be spent, and in the return,...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform voluntary prayers when he camped in the enemy's land, and when he returned, he would lead the people in performing the voluntary prayers."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to perform voluntary prayers when he camped in the enemy's land, and when he returned, he would lead the people in performing the voluntary prayers."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَغَارَ فِي أَرْضِ الْعَدُوِّ نَفَّلَ الرُّبُعَ وَإِذَا أَقْبَلَ رَاجِعًا وَكَلَّ النَّاسُ نَفَّلَ الثُّلُثَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAyyāsh \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e Abū Sallām \u003e Abū Umāmah al-Bāhilī \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2526

chapter.englishTitle: After sunset in Nafal

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Habib bin Maslamah that the Prophet ﷺ awarded one third (of the spoils of war) after the one fifth (had been taken).    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Habib bin Maslamah that the Prophet ﷺ awarded one third (of the spoils of war) after the one fifth (had been taken).    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَفَّلَ الثُّلُثَ بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yazīd b. Yazīd b. Jābir \u003e Makḥūl \u003e Ziyād b. a neighboriyah \u003e Ḥabīb b. Maslamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2527

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَتَلَ قَتِيلًا فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever kills a person, it is as if he has killed all mankind

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever kills a disbeliever, his spoils will be for him." So Abu Talhah killed twenty of them that day and took their possessions.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever kills a disbeliever, his spoils will be for him." So Abu Talhah killed twenty of them that day and took their possessions.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ قَتَلَ كَافِرًا فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ» فَقَتَلَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَوْمَئِذٍ عِشْرِينَ وَأَخَذَ أَسْلَابَهُمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2528

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَتَلَ قَتِيلًا فَلَهُ سَلَبُهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever kills a person, it is as if he has killed all mankind

hadiths.englishRaw: “I fought a man and killed him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ awarded me his spoils.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I fought a man and killed him, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ awarded me his spoils.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «بَارَزْتُ رَجُلًا فَقَتَلْتُهُ فَنَفَّلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَلَبَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Kathīr b. Aflaḥ \u003e ʿUmar b. Kathīr \u003e Abū Muḥammad a freed slave of Abū Qatādah \u003e Abū Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ ابْنِ كَثِيرِ بْنِ أَفْلَحَ هُوَ عُمَرُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2529

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي كَرَاهِيَةِ الْأَنْفَالِ وَقَالَ ﷺ لِيَرُدّهُ قَوِيُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى ضَعِيفِهِمْ
chapter.englishTitle: In the abhorrence of Anfal and he ﷺ said to return it, the str...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to dislike spoils of war (Anfal), and he would say, "Let the strong Muslims defend the weak ones."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to dislike spoils of war (Anfal), and he would say, "Let the strong Muslims defend the weak ones."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ الْأَنْفَالَ وَيَقُولُ «لِيَرُدَّ قَوِيُّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَلَى ضَعِيفِهِمْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAyyāsh \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e Abū Sallām \u003e Abū Umāmah al-Bāhilī \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2530

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: أَدُّوا الْخِيَاطَ وَالْمَخِيطَ
chapter.englishTitle: What came that he said: "Pay the tailor and the seamstress"?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to say, "Pay the tailor and the one being tailored, and beware of cheating in trade, for verily it is a disgrace for its people on the Day of Resurrection."
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to say, "Pay the tailor and the one being tailored, and beware of cheating in trade, for verily it is a disgrace for its people on the Day of Resurrection."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ «أَدُّوا الْخِيَاطَ وَالْمَخِيطَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالْغُلُولَ فَإِنَّهُ عَارٌ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Fazārī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAyyāsh \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e Abū Sallām \u003e Abū Umāmah al-Bāhilī \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2531

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ عَنْ رُكُوبِ الدَّابَّةِ مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ وَلُبْسِ الثَّوْبِ مِنْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of riding an animal from the spoils and wearing clot...

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, I will not enforce upon you anything except what I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he addressed us on the day of the Battle of Khaybar. He said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not ride any animal used by Muslims until he has commented upon it, or he said: until it has been tamed." Abu Muhammad said, "I doubt that this could be interpreted as it is." And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not wear a garment taken from the spoils of war until he has purified it.
hadiths.body: Indeed, I will not enforce upon you anything except what I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he addressed us on the day of the Battle of Khaybar. He said, "Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not ride any animal used by Muslims until he has commented upon it, or he said: until it has been tamed." Abu Muhammad said, "I doubt that this could be interpreted as it is." And whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not wear a garment taken from the spoils of war until he has purified it.
hadiths.arabic: إِنِّي لَا أَقُومُ فِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَامَ فِينَا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ حِينَ افْتَتَحْنَاهَا مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلَا يَرْكَبَنَّ دَابَّةً مِنْ فَيْءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ حَتَّى إِذَا أَجْحَفَهَا أَوْ قَالَ أَعْجَفَهَا قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد أَنَا أَشُكُّ فِيهِ رَدَّهَا وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلَا يَلْبَسْ ثَوْبًا مِنْ فَيْءِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ حَتَّى إِذَا أَخْلَقَهُ رَدَّهُ فِيهِ
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Yazīd \u003e Ibn Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū Marzūq a freed slave of Litujīb \u003e Ḥanash al-Ṣanʿānī \u003e Ghazawnā al-Maghrib And ʿAlaynā Rūwayfiʿ b. Thābit al-Anṣārī Fāftataḥnā Qaryah Yuqāl Lahā Jarbah Faqām Fīnā Rūwayfiʿ b. Thābit al-Anṣārī Khaṭīb \u003e Innī Lā Aqūm Fīkum Illā Mā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْزُوقٍ مَوْلًى لِتُجِيبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حَنَشٌ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ قَالَ غَزَوْنَا الْمَغْرِبَ وَعَلَيْنَا رُوَيْفِعُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ فَافْتَتَحْنَا قَرْيَةً يُقَالُ لَهَا جَرْبَةُ فَقَامَ فِينَا رُوَيْفِعُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ خَطِيبًا فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2532

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي الْغُلُولِ مِنَ الشِّدَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: What came in the narrative of intensity

hadiths.englishRaw: A person was killed on the day of Khaybar, and they said, "So-and-so is a martyr," until they mentioned a man. They said, "So-and-so is a martyr." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No, indeed I saw him in Hell, wearing a cloak or a coarse garment." Then he said to me, "O Ibn Al-Khattab, get up and announce among the people that no one will enter Paradise except the believers." So I stood up and called out to the people.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: A person was killed on the day of Khaybar, and they said, "So-and-so is a martyr," until they mentioned a man. They said, "So-and-so is a martyr." Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No, indeed I saw him in Hell, wearing a cloak or a coarse garment." Then he said to me, "O Ibn Al-Khattab, get up and announce among the people that no one will enter Paradise except the believers." So I stood up and called out to the people.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُتِلَ نَفَرٌ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ فَقَالُوا فُلَانٌ شَهِيدٌ حَتَّى ذَكَرُوا رَجُلًا فَقَالُوا فُلَانٌ شَهِيدٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «كَلَّا إِنِّي رَأَيْتُهُ فِي النَّارِ فِي عَبَاءَةٍ أَوْ فِي بُرْدَةٍ غَلَّهَا» ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ قُمْ فَنَادِ فِي النَّاسِ أَنَّهُ لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ فَقُمْتُ فَنَادَيْتُ فِي النَّاسِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e ʿIkrimah b. ʿAmmār \u003e Abū Zumayl \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو زُمَيْلٍ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2533

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْغَالِّ إِذَا جَاءَ بِمَا غَلَّ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the rare event when he brings what he exaggerated with.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There shall be no plundering, enslaving, or pillaging. And whoever enslaves someone will bring what they have enslaved on the Day of Judgment." [Surah Al-Imran 161]. Abu Muhammad said: "Al-Islaal is theft."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There shall be no plundering, enslaving, or pillaging. And whoever enslaves someone will bring what they have enslaved on the Day of Judgment." [Surah Al-Imran 161]. Abu Muhammad said: "Al-Islaal is theft."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا نَهْبَ وَلَا إِغْلَالَ وَلَا إِسْلَالَ {وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ} [آل عمران 161] قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الْإِسْلَالُ السَّرِقَةُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥātim al-Muktib \u003e al-Qāsim b. Mālik \u003e Kathīr b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr b. ʿAwf al-Muzanī from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْمُكْتِبُ حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ حَدَّثَنِي كَثِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ الْمُزَنِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2534

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي أَنْ لَا تُقْطَعَ الْأَيْدِي فِي الْغَزْوِ
chapter.englishTitle: That hands should not be cut off in war.

hadiths.englishRaw: Junadah ibn AbuUmayyah said: We were with Busr ibn Artat on the sea (on an expedition). A thief called Misdar who had stolen a bukhti she-camel was brought. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Hands are not to be cut off during a warlike expedition. Had it not been so, I would have cut it off.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Junadah ibn AbuUmayyah said: We were with Busr ibn Artat on the sea (on an expedition). A thief called Misdar who had stolen a bukhti she-camel was brought. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: Hands are not to be cut off during a warlike expedition. Had it not been so, I would have cut it off.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَا تُقْطَعُ الْأَيْدِي فِي الْغَزْوِ» لَقَطَعْتُهَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. ʿUmar al-Zahrānī \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn Lahīʿah \u003e ʿAyyāsh b. ʿAbbās \u003e Shīwaym b. Baytān \u003e Junādah b. Abū Umayyah \u003e Lawlā Annī \u003e Ibn Arṭāh \u003e Qad
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَيَّاشُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ شِيَيْمِ بْنِ بَيْتَانَ عَنْ جُنَادَةَ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ قَالَ لَوْلَا أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَرْطَاةَ يَقُولُ قَدْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2535

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْعَامِلِ إِذَا أَصَابَ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ شَيْئًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the worker, when something happens to him from his work

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ employed an employee (to collect Zakat). The employee returned after completing his job and said, "O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! This (amount of Zakat) is for you, and this (other amount) was given to me as a present." The Prophet ﷺ said to him, "Why didn't you stay at your father's or mother's house and see if you would be given presents or not?" Then Messenger of Allah ﷺ got up in the evening after the prayer, and having testified that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and praised and glorified Allah as He deserved, he said, "Now then ! What about an employee whom we employ and then he comes and says, 'This amount (of Zakat) is for you, and this (amount) was given to me as a present'? Why didn't he stay at the house of his father and mother to see if he would be given presents or not? By Him in Whose Hand Muhammad's soul is, none of you will steal anything of it (i.e. Zakat) but will bring it by carrying it over his neck on the Day of Resurrection. If it has been a camel, he will bring it (over his neck) while it will be grunting, and if it has been a cow, he will bring it (over his neck), while it will be mooing; and if it has been a sheep, he will bring it (over his neck) while it will be bleeding." The Prophet ﷺ added, "I have preached you (Allah's Message)." Abu Humaid said, "Then Messenger of Allah ﷺ raised his hands so high that we saw the whiteness of his armpits."
