hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥaq \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Shimāsah \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَقَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شِمَاسَةَ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2593

chapter.englishTitle: In the option and the guarantee

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: The contractual obligation of a slave is three days.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: The contractual obligation of a slave is three days.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «عُهْدَةُ الرَّقِيقِ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abān b. Yazīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2594

chapter.englishTitle: In the option and the guarantee

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The period of observation for a slave is three days, and Qatadah explained it as follows: If a fault is found within these three days, the slave can be returned without evidence, but if the fault is discovered after three days, the slave cannot be returned except with evidence."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The period of observation for a slave is three days, and Qatadah explained it as follows: If a fault is found within these three days, the slave can be returned without evidence, but if the fault is discovered after three days, the slave cannot be returned except with evidence."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عُهْدَةُ الرَّقِيقِ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ فَفَسَّرَهُ قَتَادَةُ «إِنْ وَجَدَ فِي الثَّلَاثِ عَيْبًا رَدَّهُ بِغَيْرِ بَيِّنَةٍ وَإِنْ وَجَدَهُ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثٍ لَمْ يَرُدَّهُ إِلَّا بِبَيِّنَةٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ هَمَّامٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2595

chapter.englishTitle: In the gatherings.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever buys a pregnant ewe or a pregnant sheep, then he has the option of three days. If he returns it, he returns with it a sa'a of food, not to be returned with something inferior."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever buys a pregnant ewe or a pregnant sheep, then he has the option of three days. If he returns it, he returns with it a sa'a of food, not to be returned with something inferior."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنِ اشْتَرَى شَاةً مُصَرَّاةً أَوْ لَقْحَةً مُصَرَّاةً فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَإِنْ رَدَّهَا رَدَّ مَعَهَا صَاعًا مِنْ طَعَامٍ لَا سَمْرَاءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Minhāl \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Hishām \u003e Ibn Ḥassān \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ هُوَ ابْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2596

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of Selling Fraud

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Gharar transactions. "    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade Gharar transactions. "    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Yaḥyá al-Qaṭṭān \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2597

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلَاحُهَا
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling fruits until they ripen

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of fruits till they were clearly in good condition, forbidding it both to the seller and to the buyer.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the sale of fruits till they were clearly in good condition, forbidding it both to the seller and to the buyer.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الثِّمَارِ حَتَّى يَبْدُوَ صَلَاحُهَا نَهَى الْبَائِعَ وَالْمُشْتَرِيَ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2598

chapter.englishTitle: In the pandemic

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: If you were to sell dried dates to your brother and they were smitten by blight, it will not be allowable for you to take your brother's property unjustly.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: If you were to sell dried dates to your brother and they were smitten by blight, it will not be allowable for you to take your brother's property unjustly.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ ابْتَاعَ ثَمَرَةً فَأَصَابَتْهُ جَائِحَةٌ فَلَا يَأْخُذَنَّ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا بِمَ تَأْخُذُ مَالَ أَخِيكَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ؟»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2599

chapter.englishTitle: In the arena and the battlefield

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited muhaqalah and muzabanah." Abdullah said, "Muhaqalah is the selling of crops for crops, and they say that Ibn Muzayyab also said the same."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited muhaqalah and muzabanah." Abdullah said, "Muhaqalah is the selling of crops for crops, and they say that Ibn Muzayyab also said the same."
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ الْمُحَاقَلَةُ بَيْعُ الزَّرْعِ بِالْبُرِّ وَقَالُوا كَذَلِكَ يَقُولُ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ
hadiths.chain: [Chain 1] ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr [Chain 2] Yaḥyá \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ح وحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2600

chapter.englishTitle: In the deserts

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah granted a concession allowing 'Araya sales for fresh dates and for dried dates, but he did not allow anything other than that."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah granted a concession allowing 'Araya sales for fresh dates and for dried dates, but he did not allow anything other than that."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَيْعِ الْعَرَايَا بِالتَّمْرِ وَالرُّطَبِ وَلَمْ يُرَخِّصْ فِي غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sālim \u003e Ibn ʿUmar \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2601

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: في النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ قَبْلَ الْقَبْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling food before taking possession

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who buys foodstuff should not sell it till he has received it."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "He who buys foodstuff should not sell it till he has received it."    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ ابْتَاعَ طَعَامًا فَلَا يَبِعْهُ حَتَّى يَقْبِضَهُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2602

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ شَرْطَيْنِ فِي بَيْعٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of two conditions in a sale

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah prohibited lending on the condition of a sale, or to have two conditions in one transaction, or to profit from what you do not posses.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah prohibited lending on the condition of a sale, or to have two conditions in one transaction, or to profit from what you do not posses.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ سَلَفٍ وَبَيْعٍ وَعَنْ شَرْطَيْنِ فِي بَيْعٍ وَعَنْ رِبْحِ مَا لَمْ يُضْمَنْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥusayn al-Muʿallim \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2603

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِيمَنْ بَاعَ عَبْدًا وَلَهُ مَالٌ
chapter.englishTitle: Who sold a slave while having wealth

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever buys a slave without specifying his price, then he has nothing (i.e. no rights) over him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever buys a slave without specifying his price, then he has nothing (i.e. no rights) over him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنِ اشْتَرَى عَبْدًا وَلَمْ يَشْتَرِطْ مَالَهُ فَلَا شَيْءَ لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Sālim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2604

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْمُنَابَذَةِ وَالْمُلَامَسَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of avoidance and contact

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the two types of transactions and the wearing of two garments at the same time. He forbade the transaction of al-munabadhah (where one throws an item to another and vice versa) and al-mulamashah (where one touches the garment of another). Abdullah al-Munabadhah said, 'This person throws to that person and that person throws to this person.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'This was practiced during the time of ignorance (pre-Islamic era).'"
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the two types of transactions and the wearing of two garments at the same time. He forbade the transaction of al-munabadhah (where one throws an item to another and vice versa) and al-mulamashah (where one touches the garment of another). Abdullah al-Munabadhah said, 'This person throws to that person and that person throws to this person.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'This was practiced during the time of ignorance (pre-Islamic era).'"
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعَتَيْنِ وَعَنْ لِبْسَتَيْنِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْمُنَابَذَةِ وَالْمُلَامَسَةِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ الْمُنَابَذَةُ يَرْمِي هَذَا إِلَى ذَاكَ وَيَرْمِي ذَاكَ إِلَى هَذَا قَالَ «كَانَ هَذَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yazīd \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2605

chapter.englishTitle: In the sale of gravel

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a transaction determined by throwing stones, and the type which involves some uncertainty.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade a transaction determined by throwing stones, and the type which involves some uncertainty.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ وَعَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَصَاةِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «إِذَا رَمَى بِحَصًا وَجَبَ الْبَيْعُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2606

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَيَوَانِ بِالْحَيَوَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling an animal for an animal

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the selling of animals for animals, as it is forbidden. Then Hasan forgot this hadith and did not mention it, then Hasan forgot this hadith as well."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited the selling of animals for animals, as it is forbidden. Then Hasan forgot this hadith and did not mention it, then Hasan forgot this hadith as well."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْحَيَوَانِ بِالْحَيَوَانِ نَسِيئَةً» ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَ نَسِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ جَعْفَرٌ ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْحَسَنَ نَسِيَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir And Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Samurah b. Jundub
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ وَجَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2607

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الرُّخْصَةِ فِي اسْتِقْرَاضِ الْحَيَوَانِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the license for animal borrowing.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ borrowed a young camel, and when the camels of the sadaqah (alms) came to him, he ordered me to pay the man his young camel. I said: I find only an excellent camel in its seventh year. So the Prophet ﷺ said: Give it to him, for the best person is he who discharges his debt in the best manner.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ borrowed a young camel, and when the camels of the sadaqah (alms) came to him, he ordered me to pay the man his young camel. I said: I find only an excellent camel in its seventh year. So the Prophet ﷺ said: Give it to him, for the best person is he who discharges his debt in the best manner.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ اسْتَسْلَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَكْرًا فَجَاءَتْ إِبِلٌ مِنْ إِبِلِ الصَّدَقَةِ قَالَ أَبُو رَافِعٍ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَقْضِيَ الرَّجُلَ بَكْرَهُ فَقُلْتُ لَمْ أَجِدْ فِي الْإِبِلِ إِلَّا جَمَلًا خِيَارًا رَبَاعِيًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَعْطِهِ إِيَّاهُ فَإِنَّ خَيْرَ النَّاسِ أَحْسَنُهُمْ قَضَاءً» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ هَذَا يُقَوِّي قَوْلَ مَنْ يَقُولُ الْحَيَوَانُ بِالْحَيَوَانِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik \u003e Zayd b. Aslam \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَالِكٍ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2608

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ تَلَقِّي الْبُيُوعِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of accepting sales

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Do and whoever meets any of them and buys from him the vendor has the choice of annulling the transaction when he comes to the marketplace."'     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Do and whoever meets any of them and buys from him the vendor has the choice of annulling the transaction when he comes to the marketplace."'     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَلَقَّوْا الْجَلَبَ مَنْ تَلَقَّاهُ فَاشْتَرَى مِنْهُ شَيْئًا فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِذَا دَخَلَ السُّوقَ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Minhāl \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2609

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا يَبِعُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: He does not sell his brother's sale

hadiths.englishRaw: One amongst you should not enter into a transaction when another is bargaining.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: One amongst you should not enter into a transaction when another is bargaining.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَبِيعُ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ وَلَا تَلَقَّوْا السِّلَعَ حَتَّى يُهْبَطَ بِهَا الْأَسْوَاقَ وَلَا تَنَاجَشُوا»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2610

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling a dog for a price

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ forbade the utilization of the price of a dog, the earnings of prostitute and the earnings of a foreteller.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ forbade the utilization of the price of a dog, the earnings of prostitute and the earnings of a foreteller.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «حُلْوَانُ الْكَاهِنِ مَا يُعْطَى عَلَى كَهَانَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2611

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling alcohol

hadiths.englishRaw: When the last verses of Surat al-Baqarah were revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and recited them to us and siad: Trading in wine has been forbidden.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the last verses of Surat al-Baqarah were revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and recited them to us and siad: Trading in wine has been forbidden.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَمَّا نَزَلَتِ الْآيَةُ فِي آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ فِي الرِّبَا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَتَلَاهُنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ ثُمَّ حَرَّمَ التِّجَارَةَ فِي الْخَمْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Muslim \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2612

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling alcohol

hadiths.englishRaw: When the last verses of Surat al-Baqarah were revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and recited them to us and siad: Trading in wine has been forbidden.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the last verses of Surat al-Baqarah were revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ came out and recited them to us and siad: Trading in wine has been forbidden.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَمَّا نَزَلَتِ الْآيَاتُ مِنْ أَوَاخِرِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَتَلَاهُنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ ثُمَّ نَهَى عَنِ التِّجَارَةِ فِي الْخَمْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Jarīr \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Abū al-Ḍuḥá \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2613

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْخَمْرِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling alcohol

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Its tanning makes it pure."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Its tanning makes it pure."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «دِبَاغُهَا طَهُورُهَا»
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Yazīd \u003e al-Qaʿqāʿ b. Ḥakīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. And ʿLah \u003e Saʾalt Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Julūd al-Maytah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَعْلَةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ؟ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2614

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling loyalty.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ forbade the selling of the Wala' (of slaves) or giving it as a present.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ forbade the selling of the Wala' (of slaves) or giving it as a present.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «الْأَمْرُ عَلَى هَذَا لَا يُبَاعُ وَلَا يُوهَبُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2615

chapter.englishTitle: In the sale of the well-arranged

hadiths.englishRaw: "Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called for him and he sold him." Jabir said, "And he only died in the first year." It was asked, "Do you say this about Abdullah?" He said, "Some people say so."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ called for him and he sold him." Jabir said, "And he only died in the first year." It was asked, "Do you say this about Abdullah?" He said, "Some people say so."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فَدَعَا بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَبَاعَهُ» قَالَ جَابِرٌ وَإِنَّمَا مَاتَ عَامَ أَوَّلَ قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ قَوْمٌ يَقُولُونَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh al-Anṣārī \u003e Aʿtaq a man Minnā ʿAbd Lah \u003e Dubur
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ قَالَ أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ مِنَّا عَبْدًا لَهُ عَنْ دُبُرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2616

chapter.englishTitle: In the sale of mothers of children

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "If a man's slave woman gives birth to a child from him, she becomes free from slavery after her master's death or after he divorces her."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "If a man's slave woman gives birth to a child from him, she becomes free from slavery after her master's death or after he divorces her."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا وَلَدَتْ أَمَةُ الرَّجُلِ مِنْهُ فَهِيَ مُعْتَقَةٌ عَنْ دُبُرٍ مِنْهُ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e Ḥusayn b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbbās \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2617

chapter.englishTitle: In the heart of the city and its extent.

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Allah bestow your blessings on their measures, bless their Mudd and Sa." The Prophet ﷺ meant the people of Medina.
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Allah bestow your blessings on their measures, bless their Mudd and Sa." The Prophet ﷺ meant the people of Medina.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ الله ﷺ قَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مِكْيَالِهِمْ وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي صَاعِهِمْ وَمُدِّهِمْ» يَعْنِي الْمَدِينَةَ
hadiths.chain: Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥanafī al-Madanī \u003e Mālik \u003e Isḥāq b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ الْمَدَنِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2618

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ إِلَّا مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling food unless it is of equal value

hadiths.englishRaw: "I had a container of dates with me for the Prophet ﷺ, but I found a better quality of dates, twice as much for the same price, so I bought them. Then I went to the Prophet ﷺ and he asked me, 'Where did you get these, O Bilal?' I replied, 'I bought a container of dates for the same price as what we had.' He said, 'Return it and bring back the dates we had.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I had a container of dates with me for the Prophet ﷺ, but I found a better quality of dates, twice as much for the same price, so I bought them. Then I went to the Prophet ﷺ and he asked me, 'Where did you get these, O Bilal?' I replied, 'I bought a container of dates for the same price as what we had.' He said, 'Return it and bring back the dates we had.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ عِنْدِي مُدُّ تَمْرٍ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَوَجَدْتُ أَطْيَبَ مِنْهُ صَاعًا بِصَاعَيْنِ فَاشْتَرَيْتُ مِنْهُ فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «مِنْ أَيْنَ لَكَ هَذَا يَا بِلَالُ؟» قُلْتُ اشْتَرَيْتُ صَاعًا بِصَاعَيْنِ قَالَ «رُدَّهُ وَرُدَّ عَلَيْنَا تَمْرَنَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Masrūq \u003e Bilāl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحاَقَ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ بِلَالٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2619

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الطَّعَامِ إِلَّا مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling food unless it is of equal value

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent the brother of the tribe of Bani Adi Al-Ansari as governor of Khaibar. Then the man returned, bringing Janib (a good kind of date). Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him, "Are all the dates of Khaibar like that?" He replied, "No, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! We take one Sa' of these (good) dates for two Sas of mixed dates." Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "Do not do so. You should either take one Sa of this (kind) for one Sa' of the other; or sell one kind and then buy with its price the other kind (of dates), and you should do the same in weighing."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent the brother of the tribe of Bani Adi Al-Ansari as governor of Khaibar. Then the man returned, bringing Janib (a good kind of date). Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked him, "Are all the dates of Khaibar like that?" He replied, "No, by Allah, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ! We take one Sa' of these (good) dates for two Sas of mixed dates." Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said, "Do not do so. You should either take one Sa of this (kind) for one Sa' of the other; or sell one kind and then buy with its price the other kind (of dates), and you should do the same in weighing."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ وَأَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَعَثَ أَخَا بَنِي عَدِيٍّ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ فَاسْتَعْمَلَهُ عَلَى خَيْبَرَ فَقَدِمَ بِتَمْرٍ جَنِيبٍ قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ يَعْنِي جَيِّدًا فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَكُلُّ تَمْرِ خَيْبَرَ هَكَذَا؟» قَالَ لَا وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لَنَشْتَرِي الصَّاعَ بِالصَّاعَيْنِ مِنَ الْجَمْعِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَفْعَلُوا وَلَكِنْ مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ أَوْ بِيعُوا هَذَا وَاشْتَرُوا بِثَمَنِهِ مِنْ هَذَا وَكَذَلِكَ الْمِيزَانُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Ibn Bilāl \u003e ʿAbd al-Majīd b. Suhayl b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī And ʾAbā Hurayrah Ḥaddathāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ بِلَالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ بْنِ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ يُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2620

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of exchange

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Gold is exchanged for gold, silver for silver, dates for dates, wheat for wheat, and barley for barley. There should be equal amounts and no excess."   – Sound
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Gold is exchanged for gold, silver for silver, dates for dates, wheat for wheat, and barley for barley. There should be equal amounts and no excess."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «الذَّهَبُ بِالذَّهَبِ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ وَالْفِضَّةُ بِالْفِضَّةِ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ وَالتَّمْرُ بِالتَّمْرِ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ وَالْبُرُّ بِالْبُرِّ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ وَالشَّعِيرُ بِالشَّعِيرِ هَاءَ وَهَاءَ وَلَا فَضْلَ بَيْنَهُمَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Mālik b. Aws b. al-Ḥadathān al-Naṣrī \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ النَّصْرِيِّ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2621

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of exchange

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ prohibited selling gold for gold, silver for silver, wheat for wheat, dates for dates, barley for barley, and salt for salt, except in equal amounts and at the same time. Whoever adds more or asks for more has practiced usury.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ prohibited selling gold for gold, silver for silver, wheat for wheat, dates for dates, barley for barley, and salt for salt, except in equal amounts and at the same time. Whoever adds more or asks for more has practiced usury.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الذَّهَبِ بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ بِالْفِضَّةِ وَالْبُرِّ بِالْبُرِّ وَالتَّمْرِ بِالتَّمْرِ وَالشَّعِيرِ بِالشَّعِيرِ وَالْمِلْحِ بِالْمِلْحِ إِلَّا مِثْلًا بِمِثْلٍ سَوَاءً بِسَوَاءٍ فَمَنْ زَادَ أَوِ ازْدَادَ فَقَدْ أَرْبَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Ashʿath al-Ṣanʿānī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ قَالَ قَامَ أُنَاسٌ فِي إِمَارَةِ مُعَاوِيَةَ يَبِيعُونَ آنِيَةَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ إِلَى الْعَطَاءِ فَقَامَ عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2622

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا رِبَا إِلَّا فِي النَّسِيئَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: There is no interest except in a loan.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, riba (usury) is only in debt." Abdullah said, "Its meaning is one dirham exchanged for two dirhams."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, riba (usury) is only in debt." Abdullah said, "Its meaning is one dirham exchanged for two dirhams."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا الرِّبَا فِي الدَّيْنِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «مَعْنَاهُ دِرْهَمٌ بِدِرْهَمَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Yazīd \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2623

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الرُّخْصَةِ فِي اقْتِضَاءِ الْوَرِقِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ
chapter.englishTitle: License in the Extraction of Gold Paper.

hadiths.englishRaw: I used to sell camels at al-Baqi for dinars and take dirhams for them, and sell for dirhams and take dinars for them. I would take these for these and give these for these. I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was in the house of Hafsah. I said: Messenger of Allah , take it easy, I shall ask you (a question): I sell camels at al-Baqi'. I sell (them) for dinars and take dirhams and I sell for dirhams and take dinars. I take these for these, and give these for these. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said: There is no harm in taking them at the current rate so long as you do not separate leaving something to be settled.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: I used to sell camels at al-Baqi for dinars and take dirhams for them, and sell for dirhams and take dinars for them. I would take these for these and give these for these. I went to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ who was in the house of Hafsah. I said: Messenger of Allah , take it easy, I shall ask you (a question): I sell camels at al-Baqi'. I sell (them) for dinars and take dirhams and I sell for dirhams and take dinars. I take these for these, and give these for these. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then said: There is no harm in taking them at the current rate so long as you do not separate leaving something to be settled.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ أَبِيعُ الْإِبِلَ بِالْبَقِيعِ فَأَبِيعُ بِالدَّنَانِيرِ وَآخُذُ الدَّرَاهِمَ وَأَبِيعُ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ وَآخُذُ الدَّنَانِيرَ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ أَقْبِضُ فَأَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ رُوَيْدَكَ أَسْأَلُكَ إِنِّي أَبِيعُ الْإِبِلَ بِالْبَقِيعِ فَأَبِيعُ بِالدَّنَانِيرِ وَآخُذُ الدَّرَاهِمَ وَأَبِيعُ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ وَآخُذُ الدَّنَانِيرَ قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ بِسِعْرِ يَوْمِكَ مَا لَمْ تَفْتَرِقَا وَبَيْنَكُمَا شَيْءٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2624

chapter.englishTitle: In pledge

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah died when his shield was in pledge with a Jew for thirty Sa's of barley for his family     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah died when his shield was in pledge with a Jew for thirty Sa's of barley for his family     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَإِنَّ دِرْعَهُ لَمَرْهُونَةٌ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ بِثَلَاثِينَ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2625

chapter.englishTitle: In the past

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived in Medina while they were exchanging fruits for two or three years. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Exchange fruits based on a known measure and weight." Sufyan used to mention it for a while "until Abdullah ibn Kathir doubted it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ arrived in Medina while they were exchanging fruits for two or three years. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Exchange fruits based on a known measure and weight." Sufyan used to mention it for a while "until Abdullah ibn Kathir doubted it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ وَهُمْ يُسْلِفُونَ فِي الثِّمَارِ فِي سَنَتَيْنِ وَثَلَاثٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَسْلِِفُوا فِي الثِّمَارِ فِي كَيْلٍ مَعْلُومٍ وَوَزْنٍ مَعْلُومٍ» وَقَدْ كَانَ سُفْيَانُ يَذْكُرُهُ زَمَانًا «إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ ثُمَّ شَكَّكَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Kathīr \u003e Abū al-Minhāl \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2626

chapter.englishTitle: In the beauty of fate

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ weighed out some dirhams and balanced them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ weighed out some dirhams and balanced them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «وَزَنَ لَهُ دَرَاهِمَ فَأَرْجَحَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥārib \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَارِبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2627

chapter.englishTitle: The preference in weight

hadiths.englishRaw: I and the slave girl, Makhrama, brought some dates from Bahrain to Makkah. Then the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, came and walked towards us. He either asked for or bought some trousers from us, and then he weighed them with a balance and said to the one weighing, "Weigh and make it heavier." When he walked away, they said, "This is the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: I and the slave girl, Makhrama, brought some dates from Bahrain to Makkah. Then the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, came and walked towards us. He either asked for or bought some trousers from us, and then he weighed them with a balance and said to the one weighing, "Weigh and make it heavier." When he walked away, they said, "This is the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَلَبْتُ أَنَا وَمَخْرَمَةُ الْعَبْدِيُّ بَزًّا مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَأَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَمْشِي فَسَاوَمَنَا بِسَرَاوِيلَ أَوِ اشْتَرَى مِنَّا سَرَاوِيلَ وَثَمَّ وَزَّانٌ يَزِنُ بِالْأَجْرِ فَقَالَ لِلْوَزَّانِ «زِنْ وَأَرْجِحْ» فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ يَمْشِي قَالُوا هَذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e Sūwayd b. Qays \u003e Jalabt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2628

chapter.englishTitle: In the shadow of the rich, there is injustice.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Delay in payment (of debt) by a rich man is injunctive, but when one of you is referred to a wealthy man, he should accept the reference.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Delay in payment (of debt) by a rich man is injunctive, but when one of you is referred to a wealthy man, he should accept the reference.    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَطْلُ الْغَنِيِّ ظُلْمٌ وَإِذَا أُتْبِعَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى مَلِيءٍ فَلْيَتْبَعْ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2629

chapter.englishTitle: In anticipation of the needy

hadiths.englishRaw: he demanded payment owed by Ibn Abi Hadrad in the mosque. Their voices became so loud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard them when he was in his house. He came out and called Ka'b who said: “Here I am, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!” He said: “Waive this much of your loan,” and gestured with his hand to indicate half. He said: “I will do that,” and he said: “Get up and repay it.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: he demanded payment owed by Ibn Abi Hadrad in the mosque. Their voices became so loud that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard them when he was in his house. He came out and called Ka'b who said: “Here I am, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ!” He said: “Waive this much of your loan,” and gestured with his hand to indicate half. He said: “I will do that,” and he said: “Get up and repay it.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ تَقَاضَى مِنَ ابْنِ أَبِي حَدْرَدٍ دَيْنًا كَانَ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَارْتَفَعَتْ أَصْوَاتُهُمَا حَتَّى سَمِعَهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِمَا فَنَادَى «يَا كَعْبُ» قَالَ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ «ضَعْ مِنْ دَيْنِكَ فَأَوْمَأَ إِلَيْهِ أَيِ الشَّطْرَ» قَالَ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ قَالَ «قُمْ فَاقْضِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Kaʿb from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2630

chapter.englishTitle: Who looks at the disabled person

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Whoever provides relief or alleviates the difficulty of a debtor, Allah will shade him in His shade on the day when there is no shade except His shade." He then spit in his hand and said, "Go, it is for you and your opponent," and he mentioned that the person was a debtor.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "Whoever provides relief or alleviates the difficulty of a debtor, Allah will shade him in His shade on the day when there is no shade except His shade." He then spit in his hand and said, "Go, it is for you and your opponent," and he mentioned that the person was a debtor.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ أَنْظَرَ مُعْسِرًا أَوْ وَضَعَ عَنْهُ أَظَلَّهُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلُّهُ» قَالَ فَبَزَقَ فِي صَحِيفَتِهِ فَقَالَ «اذْهَبْ فَهِيَ لَكَ لِغَرِيمِهِ وَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مُعْسِرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Ribʿī \u003e Abū al-Yasar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي الْيَسَرِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2631

chapter.englishTitle: Who looks at the disabled person

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Whoever relieves his brother of a burden or forgives his debt, Allah will relieve him of a burden on the Day of Resurrection."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, "Whoever relieves his brother of a burden or forgives his debt, Allah will relieve him of a burden on the Day of Resurrection."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ غَرِيمِهِ أَوْ مَحَا عَنْهُ كَانَ فِي ظِلِّ الْعَرْشِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān b. Muslim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū Jaʿfar al-Khaṭmī \u003e Muḥammad b. Kaʿb al-Quraẓī \u003e Abū Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الْخَطْمِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2632

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابٌ: فِي الْمُفْلِسِ إِذَا وُجِدَ الْمَتَاعُ عِنْدَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In case of finding wealth with the bankrupt

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever finds his wealth in the possession of a bankrupt person or with a man who has become bankrupt, he is more entitled to it than anyone else."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever finds his wealth in the possession of a bankrupt person or with a man who has become bankrupt, he is more entitled to it than anyone else."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مَالَهُ بِعَيْنِهِ عِنْدَ إِنْسَانٍ قَدْ أَفْلَسَ أَوْ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ قَدْ أَفْلَسَ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Bakr b. Muḥammad \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Ḥārith b. Hishām \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2633

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّشْدِيدِ فِي الدَّيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is meant by strictness in religion?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The believer's soul is suspended until his debt is paid."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The believer's soul is suspended until his debt is paid."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَفْسُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مُعَلَّقَةٌ مَا كَانَ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿUmar b. Abū Salamah from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2634

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّشْدِيدِ فِي الدَّيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is meant by strictness in religion?

hadiths.englishRaw: “Anyone whose soul leaves his body and he is free of three things, will enter Paradise: Arrogance, stealing from the spoils of war, and debt.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Anyone whose soul leaves his body and he is free of three things, will enter Paradise: Arrogance, stealing from the spoils of war, and debt.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ فَارَقَ الرُّوحُ الْجَسَدَ وَهُوَ بَرِيءٌ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ وَالْغُلُولِ وَالدَّيْنِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Raqāshī \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Maʿdān b. Abū Ṭalḥah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2635

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى مَنْ مَاتَ وَعَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In prayer for the one who has died while still owing a debt.

hadiths.englishRaw: a man was brought to the Prophet for him to offer the funeral prayer, and he said: "Pray for your companion, for he owes a debt." Abu Qatadah said: " I will pay it." The Prophet said: "In full?" He said: "In full." So he prayed for him     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: a man was brought to the Prophet for him to offer the funeral prayer, and he said: "Pray for your companion, for he owes a debt." Abu Qatadah said: " I will pay it." The Prophet said: "In full?" He said: "In full." So he prayed for him     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِرَجُلٍ لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «صَلُّوا عَلَى صَاحِبِكُمْ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ دَيْنًا» قَالَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ هُوَ عَلَيَّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «بِالْوَفَاءِ؟» قَالَ بِالْوَفَاءِ قَالَ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir And ʾAbū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿUthmān b. ʿAbdullāh b. Mawhab \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Qatādah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ وَأَبُو الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2636

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the license is the prayer upon him

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "By Him in whose hand is my soul, there is no believer on earth but that I am the closest of all people to him. So, whoever abandons a debt or leaves his family to be wasted, then I shall intercede for him, for I am his guardian. And whoever leaves behind wealth, it belongs to his relatives." Abdullah said, "Leaving behind wealth meaning children." And he (the Prophet) said, "So I shall intercede for him, meaning to pray for him and ask Allah to fulfill his needs."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "By Him in whose hand is my soul, there is no believer on earth but that I am the closest of all people to him. So, whoever abandons a debt or leaves his family to be wasted, then I shall intercede for him, for I am his guardian. And whoever leaves behind wealth, it belongs to his relatives." Abdullah said, "Leaving behind wealth meaning children." And he (the Prophet) said, "So I shall intercede for him, meaning to pray for him and ask Allah to fulfill his needs."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مُؤْمِنٌ إِلَّا وَأَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِهِ فَمَنْ تَرَكَ دَيْنًا أَوْ ضَيَاعًا فَلْأُدْعَ لَهُ فَأَنَا مَوْلَاهُ وَمَنْ تَرَكَ مَالًا فَلِعَصَبَتِهِ مَنْ كَانَ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ ضَيَاعًا يَعْنِي عِيَالًا وَقَالَ فَلْأُدْعَ لَهُ يَعْنِي ادْعُونِي لَهُ أَقْضِ عَنْهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū al-Zinād \u003e al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2637

chapter.englishTitle: In debt, there are meanings.

hadiths.englishRaw: “Allah will be the borrower until he pays off his debt, so long as it (the loan) is not for something that Allah dislikes.”    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “Allah will be the borrower until he pays off his debt, so long as it (the loan) is not for something that Allah dislikes.”    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الدَّائِنِ حَتَّى يُقْضَى دَيْنُهُ مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيمَا يَكْرَهُ اللَّهُ» قَالَ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ يَقُولُ لِخَازِنِهِ «اذْهَبْ فَخُذْ لِي بِدَيْنٍ فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَبِيتَ لَيْلَةً إِلَّا وَاللَّهُ مَعِي بَعْدَمَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. al-Mundhir al-Ḥizāmī \u003e Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Abū Fudayk \u003e Saʿīd b. Sufyān a freed slave of al-Aslamiyyīn \u003e Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِزَامِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ مَوْلَى الْأَسْلَمِيِّينَ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2638

chapter.englishTitle: In Arabic, the given heading "فِي الْعَارِيَّةُ مُؤَدَّاةٌ" tran...

hadiths.englishRaw: “The hand that takes is responsible for what it has taken until it returns it.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: “The hand that takes is responsible for what it has taken until it returns it.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَى الْيَدِ مَا أَخَذَتْ حَتَّى تُؤَدِّيَهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Minhāl \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū ʿArūbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Samurah b. Jundub
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدُبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2639

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي أَدَاءِ الْأَمَانَةِ وَاجْتِنَابِ الْخِيَانَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the performance of trust and avoidance of betrayal

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Fulfill the trust for the one who entrusted you, and do not cheat the one who cheated you."    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: That the Prophet ﷺ said: "Fulfill the trust for the one who entrusted you, and do not cheat the one who cheated you."    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَدِّ الْأَمَانَةَ إِلَى مَنِ ائْتَمَنَكَ وَلَا تَخُنْ مَنْ خَانَكَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Ṭalq b. Ghannām \u003e Sharīk And Qays \u003e Abū Ḥaṣīn \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا طَلْقُ بْنُ غَنَّامٍ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ وَقَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2640

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ كَسَرَ شَيْئًا فَعَلَيْهِ مِثْلُهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever breaks something, must replace it.

hadiths.englishRaw: Some of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ presented him with a dish containing fish while he was in the house of one of his wives. The dish broke and the Prophet ﷺ took a piece of the fish and placed it on a tray, saying, "Eat, your mother's sins have been forgiven." He then waited until a new dish arrived, took it, and gave it to the owner of the broken dish. Abdullah said, "This is what we say about it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Some of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ presented him with a dish containing fish while he was in the house of one of his wives. The dish broke and the Prophet ﷺ took a piece of the fish and placed it on a tray, saying, "Eat, your mother's sins have been forgiven." He then waited until a new dish arrived, took it, and gave it to the owner of the broken dish. Abdullah said, "This is what we say about it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَهْدَى بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ إِلَيْهِ قَصْعَةً فِيهَا ثَرِيدٌ وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِ بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ فَضَرَبَتِ الْقَصْعَةَ فَانْكَسَرَتْ فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَأْخُذُ الثَّرِيدَ فَيَرُدُّهُ فِي الصَّحْفَةِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ «كُلُوا غَارَتْ أُمُّكُمْ» ثُمَّ انْتَظَرَ حَتَّى جَاءَتْ قَصْعَةٌ صَحِيحَةٌ فَأَخَذَهَا فَأَعْطَاهَا صَاحِبَةَ الْقَصْعَةِ الْمَكْسُورَةِ قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «نَقُولُ بِهَذَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2641

chapter.englishTitle: In the scene

hadiths.englishRaw: "He introduced her for a year, and if she becomes well-known, then that's it. If not, she is yours." But she did not become well-known, so he met her with it in the following year during the season and mentioned it to him. Umar said, "She is yours, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered us to do that." He replied, "I don't need it." Umar took it and placed it in the treasury.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "He introduced her for a year, and if she becomes well-known, then that's it. If not, she is yours." But she did not become well-known, so he met her with it in the following year during the season and mentioned it to him. Umar said, "She is yours, for the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ordered us to do that." He replied, "I don't need it." Umar took it and placed it in the treasury.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً فَإِنْ عُرِفَتْ فَذَاكَ وَإِلَّا فَهِيَ لَكَ» فَلَمْ تُعْرَفْ فَلَقِيَهُ بِهَا فِي الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ فِي الْمَوْسِمِ فَذَكَرَهَا لَهُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ «هِيَ لَكَ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَنَا بِذَلِكَ» قَالَ لَا حَاجَةَ لِي بِهَا فَقَبَضَهَا عُمَرُ فَجَعَلَهَا فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e al-Walīd b. Kathīr \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو وَعَاصِمٍ ابْنَيْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ الثَّقَفِيِّ أَنَّ سُفْيَانَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَجَدَ عَيْبَةً فَأَتَى بِهَا عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2642

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ لُقَطَةِ الْحَاجِّ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of picking up the Hajj token (pebble)

hadiths.englishRaw: "It was the year when Mecca was conquered, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood and said, 'Indeed, Allah prevented the people of Mecca from the elephant, and He sent His Messenger ﷺ and the believers against them. Behold, Mecca was not made lawful for anyone before me, and it will not be made lawful for anyone after me. Indeed, this hour of mine is sacred, its sanctity is not to be violated, its trees should not be cut, and its fallen leaves should not be picked up, except by one who calls out (to inform people about the lost items)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It was the year when Mecca was conquered, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ stood and said, 'Indeed, Allah prevented the people of Mecca from the elephant, and He sent His Messenger ﷺ and the believers against them. Behold, Mecca was not made lawful for anyone before me, and it will not be made lawful for anyone after me. Indeed, this hour of mine is sacred, its sanctity is not to be violated, its trees should not be cut, and its fallen leaves should not be picked up, except by one who calls out (to inform people about the lost items)."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ عَامَ فُتِحَتْ مَكَّةُ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَسَ عَنْ مَكَّةَ الْفِيلَ وَسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلَا وَإِنَّهَا لَمْ تَحِلَّ لِأَحَدٍ قَبْلِي وَلَا تَحِلُّ لِأَحَدٍ بَعْدِي أَلَا وَإِنَّهَا سَاعَتِي هَذِهِ حَرَامٌ لَا يُخْتَلَى خَلَاهَا وَلَا يُعْضَدُ شَجَرُهَا وَلَا تُلْتَقَطُ سَاقِطَتُهَا إِلَّا لِمُنْشِدٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muʿādh b. Hāniʾ from Ahl al-Baṣrah \u003e Ḥarb b. Shaddād \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2643

chapter.englishTitle: In the error / mistake

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The lost animal of the Muslim may lead to the burning flame of Hell.' ”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The lost animal of the Muslim may lead to the burning flame of Hell.' ”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Shikhhīr \u003e Abū Muslim \u003e al-a neighborūd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ الْجَارُودِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2644

chapter.englishTitle: In the error / mistake

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The lost property of a Muslim is the burning of the fire, the lost property of a Muslim is the burning of the fire, the lost property of a Muslim is the burning of the fire; do not approach it." A man asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what if we find it?" He said, "Announce it and do not hide it or conceal it, and if its owner comes, then return it to him; otherwise, it belongs to Allah, and He gives it to whoever He wills."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The lost property of a Muslim is the burning of the fire, the lost property of a Muslim is the burning of the fire, the lost property of a Muslim is the burning of the fire; do not approach it." A man asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what if we find it?" He said, "Announce it and do not hide it or conceal it, and if its owner comes, then return it to him; otherwise, it belongs to Allah, and He gives it to whoever He wills."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ ضَالَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَقُ النَّارِ لَا تَقْرَبَنَّهَا» قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اللُّقَطَةُ نَجِدُهَا قَالَ «أَنْشِدْهَا وَلَا تَكْتُمْ وَلَا تُغَيِّبْ وَإِنْ جَاءَ رَبُّهَا فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا فَمَالُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Abū Muslim al-Jadhmī \u003e al-a neighborūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ الْجَذْمِيِّ عَنْ الْجَارُودِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2645

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِيمَنِ اقْتَطَعَ مَالَ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ بِيَمِينِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who is entitled to take the money of a Muslim with his right han...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "Whoever seizes the wealth of a Muslim unlawfully by means of his (false) oath, Allah makes the Fire required for him, Paradise unlawful for him." A man said to him: "O Messenger of Allah, even if it is something small?" He said: "Even if it is a twig of an Arak tree."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah [SAW] said: "Whoever seizes the wealth of a Muslim unlawfully by means of his (false) oath, Allah makes the Fire required for him, Paradise unlawful for him." A man said to him: "O Messenger of Allah, even if it is something small?" He said: "Even if it is a twig of an Arak tree."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنِ اقْتَطَعَ حَقَّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ بِيَمِينِهِ فَقَدْ أَوْجَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ النَّارَ وَحَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ» فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ شَيْئًا يَسِيرًا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «وَإِنْ قَضِيبًا مِنْ أَرَاكٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Yaʿqūb al-Kūfī \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Maʿbad b. Kaʿb al-Salamī \u003e Akhīh ʿAbdullāh b. Kaʿb \u003e Abū Umāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الْكُوفِيُّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ السَّلَمِيِّ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2646

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِيمَنِ اقْتَطَعَ مَالَ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ بِيَمِينِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who is entitled to take the money of a Muslim with his right han...

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he mentioned something similar.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , so he mentioned something similar.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e al-Walīd b. Kathīr \u003e Muḥammad b. Kaʿb b. Mālik \u003e Akhāh ʿAbdullāh b. Kaʿb b. Mālik \u003e Abū Umāmah al-Ḥārithī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَخَاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ الْحَارِثِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2647

chapter.englishTitle: In the realm of falsehood

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ as saying: There are three to whom Allah will not speak and at whom He will not look on the Day of Resurrection, and whom He will not declare pure, and they will have a painful punishment. I asked: Who are they, Messenger of Allah, they are losers and disappointed ? He repeated it three times. I asked: Who are they. Messenger of Allah, they are losers and disappointed ? He replied: The one who wears a trailing robe, the one who takes account of what he gives, and the one who produces a ready sale of a commodity by false swearing.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ as saying: There are three to whom Allah will not speak and at whom He will not look on the Day of Resurrection, and whom He will not declare pure, and they will have a painful punishment. I asked: Who are they, Messenger of Allah, they are losers and disappointed ? He repeated it three times. I asked: Who are they. Messenger of Allah, they are losers and disappointed ? He replied: The one who wears a trailing robe, the one who takes account of what he gives, and the one who produces a ready sale of a commodity by false swearing.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «ثَلَاثَةٌ لَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ» فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ هُمْ خَابُوا وَخَسِرُوا؟ فَأَعَادَهَا فَقُلْتُ مَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَ «الْمُسْبِلُ وَالْمَنَّانُ وَالْمُنَفِّقُ سِلْعَتَهُ بِالْحَلِفِ كَاذِبًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd And Ḥajjāj \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mudrik \u003e Abū Zurʿah \u003e Kharashah b. al-Ḥur \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ وَحَجَّاجٌ قَالَا ثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُدْرِكٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ خَرَشَةَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2648

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ أَخَذَ شِبْرًا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who took a handful of soil from the ground

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Whoever oppresses even a handspan on earth, his neck will be encircled with it from seventy lands."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Whoever oppresses even a handspan on earth, his neck will be encircled with it from seventy lands."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ ظَلَمَ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ شِبْرًا فَإِنَّهُ يُطَوَّقُهُ مِنْ سَبْعِ أَرَضِينَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Ṭalḥah b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAwf \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Sahl \u003e Saʿīd b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ حَدَّثَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ سَهْلٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2649

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ أَحْيَا أَرْضًا مَيْتَةً فَهِيَ لَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever gives life to a dead land, it belongs to them.

hadiths.englishRaw: He informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever revives a dead land, for him is a reward in it, and whatever is eaten by a wild animal from it, for him is a charity." Abu Muhammad Al-Afia said, "This includes birds and others."
hadiths.body: He informed him that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever revives a dead land, for him is a reward in it, and whatever is eaten by a wild animal from it, for him is a charity." Abu Muhammad Al-Afia said, "This includes birds and others."
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَحْيَا أَرْضًا مَيْتَةً فَلَهُ فِيهَا أَجْرٌ وَمَا أَكَلَتِ الْعَافِيَةُ مِنْهَا فَلَهُ فِيهَا صَدَقَةٌ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الْعَافِيَةُ الطَّيْرُ وَغَيْرُ ذَلِكَ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Rāfiʿ \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2650

chapter.englishTitle: In the deserts

hadiths.englishRaw: That he asked for a salt flat called the Ma'rib Dam to be given to him, and it was given to him. Then Aqra bin Habis At-Tamimi came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I used to come to the salt flat during the Ignorance period and it was in a land in which there was no water, and whoever came to it took from it. It was (plentiful) like flowing water.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked Abyad bin Hammal to give back his share of the salt flat. He said: “I give it to you on the basis that you make it charity given by me.” The Messenger of Allah said: “It is a charity from you, and it is like flowing water, whoever comes to it may take from it.”(One of the narrators) Faraj said: “That is how it is today, whoever comes to it takes from it.” He said: “The Prophet ﷺ gave him land and palm trees in Jurf Murad instead, when he took back the salt flat from him.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: That he asked for a salt flat called the Ma'rib Dam to be given to him, and it was given to him. Then Aqra bin Habis At-Tamimi came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: “O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, I used to come to the salt flat during the Ignorance period and it was in a land in which there was no water, and whoever came to it took from it. It was (plentiful) like flowing water.” So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked Abyad bin Hammal to give back his share of the salt flat. He said: “I give it to you on the basis that you make it charity given by me.” The Messenger of Allah said: “It is a charity from you, and it is like flowing water, whoever comes to it may take from it.”(One of the narrators) Faraj said: “That is how it is today, whoever comes to it takes from it.” He said: “The Prophet ﷺ gave him land and palm trees in Jurf Murad instead, when he took back the salt flat from him.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ اسْتَقْطَعَ الْمِلْحَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ مِلْحُ سدِّ ِمَأْرِبَ فَأَقْطَعَهُ ثُمَّ إِنَّ الْأَقْرَعَ بْنَ حَابِسٍ التَّمِيمِيَّ قَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ وَرَدْتُ الْمِلْحَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَهُوَ بِأَرْضٍ لَيْسَ بِهَا مَاءٌ وَمَنْ وَرَدَهُ أَخَذَهُ وَهُوَ مِثْلُ مَاءِ الْعِدِّ فَاسْتَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ الْأَبْيَضَ فِي قَطِيعَتِهِ فِي الْمِلْحِ فَقُلْتُ قَدْ أَقَلْتُهُ عَلَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهُ مِنِّي صَدَقَةً فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «هُوَ مِنْكَ صَدَقَةٌ وَهُوَ مِثْلُ مَاءِ الْعِدِّ مَنْ وَرَدَهُ أَخَذَهُ» قَالَ وَقَطَعَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَرْضًا وَنَخْلًا َكَذَا بِالْجَوْفِ جَوْفِ مُرَادٍ مَكَانَهُ حِينَ أَقَالَهُ مِنْهُ قَالَ الْفَرَجُ فَهُوَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَنْ وَرَدَهُ أَخَذَهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr al-Ḥumaydī \u003e al-Faraj b. Saʿīd b. ʿAlqamah b. Saʿīd b. Abyaḍ b. Ḥammāl al-Sabāʾī al-Maʾribī \u003e ʿAmmī Thābit b. Saʿīd b. Abyaḍ \u003e Abāh Saʿīd b. Abyaḍ \u003e Abyaḍ b. Ḥammāl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ الْحُمَيْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْفَرَجُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ السَّبَائِيُّ الْمَأْرِبِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي ثَابِتُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبْيَضَ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ أَبْيَضَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2651

chapter.englishTitle: In the deserts

hadiths.englishRaw: It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed a piece of land. He said, "Send Muawiyah with me." He said, "Give it to him." Yahya narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us, Gündar narrated to us about this narration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ distributed a piece of land. He said, "Send Muawiyah with me." He said, "Give it to him." Yahya narrated to us, Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us, Gündar narrated to us about this narration.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَقْطَعَهُ أَرْضًا قَالَ فَأَرْسَلَ مَعِي مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ «أَعْطِهَا إِيَّاهُ» قَالَ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Bashhār \u003e Ghundar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Wāʾil from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2652

chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of planting.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad entered upon me in a garden and said, "O Um Mubashir, is the one who planted this Muslim or non-Muslim?" I replied, "Muslim." He said, "There is no Muslim who plants something and then a human, animal, or bird eats from it, except that it is considered a charity for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad entered upon me in a garden and said, "O Um Mubashir, is the one who planted this Muslim or non-Muslim?" I replied, "Muslim." He said, "There is no Muslim who plants something and then a human, animal, or bird eats from it, except that it is considered a charity for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَ عَلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي حَائِطٍ لِي فَقَالَ «يَا أُمَّ مُبَشِّرٍ أَمُسْلِمٌ غَرَسَ هَذَا أَمْ كَافِرٌ؟» قُلْتُ مُسْلِمٌ فَقَالَ «مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَغْرِسُ غَرْسًا فَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ إِنْسَانٌ أَوْ دَابَّةٌ أَوْ طَيْرٌ إِلَّا كَانَتْ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād \u003e Sulaymān al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Um Mubashhir Āmraʾah Zayd b. Ḥārithah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الْأَعْمَشُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ مُبَشِّرٍ امْرَأَةُ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2653

chapter.englishTitle: In the fever

hadiths.englishRaw: He asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for giving him some land which had arak trees growing in it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There is no (permission for) protecting a land which has arak trees growing in it. He said: These arak trees are within the boundaries of my field. The Prophet ﷺ said: There is no (permission for) protecting a land which has arak trees growing in it. The narrator Faraj said: By the phrase 'within the boundaries of my field' he meant the land which had crop growing in it and was surrounded on four sides.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: He asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ for giving him some land which had arak trees growing in it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There is no (permission for) protecting a land which has arak trees growing in it. He said: These arak trees are within the boundaries of my field. The Prophet ﷺ said: There is no (permission for) protecting a land which has arak trees growing in it. The narrator Faraj said: By the phrase 'within the boundaries of my field' he meant the land which had crop growing in it and was surrounded on four sides.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ حِمَى الْأَرَاكِ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا حِمَى فِي الْأَرَاكِ» فَقَالَ أَرَاكَةٌ فِي حِظَارِي؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَا حِمَى فِي الْأَرَاكِ» قَالَ فَرَجٌ يَعْنِي أَبْيَضُ بِحِظَارِي الْأَرْضَ الَّتِي فِيهَا الزَّرْعُ الْمُحَاطُ عَلَيْهَا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr \u003e al-Faraj b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAmmī Thābit b. Saʿīd \u003e Abīh Saʿīd from his grandfather Abyaḍ b. Ḥammāl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَنَا الْفَرَجُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمِّي ثَابِتُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ جَدِّهِ أَبْيَضَ بْنِ حَمَّالٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2654

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْمَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of selling water

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Iyas ibn Abd Al-Muzanni, one of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ, saying, "Do not sell water, for I heard the Prophet ﷺ forbidding the selling of water." Amru ibn Dinar said, "We do not know which water he means?" He replied, "He means the flowing water or the extracted water."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Iyas ibn Abd Al-Muzanni, one of the companions of the Prophet ﷺ, saying, "Do not sell water, for I heard the Prophet ﷺ forbidding the selling of water." Amru ibn Dinar said, "We do not know which water he means?" He replied, "He means the flowing water or the extracted water."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ إِيَاسَ بْنَ عَبْدٍ الْمُزَنِيَّ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ لَا تَبِيعُوا الْمَاءَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «يَنْهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْمَاءِ» وَقَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ لَا نَدْرِي أَيَّ مَاءٍ؟ قَالَ يَقُولُ لَا أَدْرِي مَاءً جَارِيًا أَوِ الْمَاءَ الْمُسْتَقَى؟   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Ibn ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Abū al-Minhāl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2655

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي لَا يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In what is not permissible to be prohibited

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ , he came to the Prophet ﷺ and sought permission from him, so he entered between him and his shirt and Uthman held it. He asked, "What is the thing that its prohibition is not permissible?" He (the Prophet) said, "Salt and water." He (Uthman) asked, "What is the thing that its prohibition is not permissible?" He (the Prophet) said, "If you do good, it is good for you." He (Uthman) asked, "What is the thing that its prohibition is not permissible?" He (the Prophet) said, "If you do good, it is good for you." And he repeated it until he reached salt and water. Abdullah was asked, "Do you believe in it?" So he nodded with his head.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ , he came to the Prophet ﷺ and sought permission from him, so he entered between him and his shirt and Uthman held it. He asked, "What is the thing that its prohibition is not permissible?" He (the Prophet) said, "Salt and water." He (Uthman) asked, "What is the thing that its prohibition is not permissible?" He (the Prophet) said, "If you do good, it is good for you." He (Uthman) asked, "What is the thing that its prohibition is not permissible?" He (the Prophet) said, "If you do good, it is good for you." And he repeated it until he reached salt and water. Abdullah was asked, "Do you believe in it?" So he nodded with his head.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَاسْتَأْذَنَهُ فَدَخَلَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ قَمِيصِهِ وَقَدْ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ فَالْتَزَمَهُ فَقَالَ مَا الشَّيْءُ الَّذِي لَا يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ؟ فَقَالَ «الْمِلْحُ وَالْمَاءُ» قَالَ مَا الشَّيْءُ الَّذِي لَا يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ؟ قَالَ «إِنْ تَفْعَلِ الْخَيْرَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ» قَالَ مَا الشَّيْءُ الَّذِي لَا يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ؟ قَالَ «إِنْ تَفْعَلِ الْخَيْرَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ» وَانْتَهَى إِلَى الْمِلْحِ وَالْمَاءِ قِيلَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ فَأَوْمَأَ بِرَأْسِهِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Kahmas \u003e Sayyār a man from Fazārah from his father \u003e Buhaysah from her father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسٌ عَنْ سَيَّارٍ رَجُلٍ مِنْ فَزَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ بُهَيْسَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2656

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَامَلَ خَيْبَرَ
chapter.englishTitle: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ has dealt with Khaybar.

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered into a contract with the people of Khaibar for one half of the fruits or crops yielded.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered into a contract with the people of Khaibar for one half of the fruits or crops yielded.     – Sound Chain
