hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَامَلَ خَيْبَرَ بِشَطْرِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا مِنْ ثَمَرَةٍ أَوْ زَرْعٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2657

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of surveillance

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from reporting two or three acts of doing or holding back a portion and a half, and something of small measurement. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us, "Whoever owns land, let him cultivate it, and if he dislikes cultivating it, let him give it to his brother. And if he dislikes giving it to his brother, then let him leave it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from reporting two or three acts of doing or holding back a portion and a half, and something of small measurement. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to us, "Whoever owns land, let him cultivate it, and if he dislikes cultivating it, let him give it to his brother. And if he dislikes giving it to his brother, then let him leave it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَنْهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الْخِبْرِ بَسَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثٍ عَلَى الثُّلُثِ وَالشَّطْرِ وَشَيْءٍ مَنْ تِبْنٍ فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَحْرُثْهَا فَإِنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَحْرُثَهَا فَلْيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ فَإِنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَمْنَحَهَا أَخَاهُ فَلْيَدَعْهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Ḥasan \u003e Zakariyyā b. Isḥaq \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ إِسْحَقَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا يَقُولُ كُنَّا نُخَابِرُ قَبْلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2658

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ فِي الثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبْعِ
chapter.englishTitle: In Prohibition of Cultivating in One-Third and One-Fourth

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited farming," he said to Abdullah, "Do you say it?" Abdullah said, "I do not say the first."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited farming," he said to Abdullah, "Do you say it?" Abdullah said, "I do not say the first."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ» قَالَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ تَقُولُ بِهِ؟ قَالَ «لَا أَقُولُ بِالْأَوَّلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Abū Isḥaq al-Shaybānī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Saʾalt ʿAbdullāh b. Maʿqil \u003e al-Muzāraʿah \u003e Thābit b. al-Ḍaḥḥāk al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَقَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَعْقِلٍ عَنِ الْمُزَارَعَةِ فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ثَابِتُ بْنُ الضَّحَّاكِ الْأَنْصَارِيُّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2659

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْأَرْضِ سِنِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of selling land for years

hadiths.englishRaw: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding the selling (renting of) uncultivated land for two years or three.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbidding the selling (renting of) uncultivated land for two years or three.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْأَرْضِ الْبَيْضَاءِ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلَاثًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2660

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الرُّخْصَةِ فِي كِرَاءِ الْأَرْضِ بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the license for renting land with gold and silver

hadiths.englishRaw: "We used to cultivate the land during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, using the crops and water that were available on it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from doing so, but later allowed us or gave us permission to cultivate it using gold and silver."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "We used to cultivate the land during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, using the crops and water that were available on it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from doing so, but later allowed us or gave us permission to cultivate it using gold and silver."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنَّا نُكْرِي الْأَرْضَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِمَا عَلَى السَّوَاقِي مِنَ الزَّرْعِ وَبِمَا سَعِدَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ مِنْهَا «فَنَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ذَلِكَ وَأَذِنَ لَنَا أَوْ قَالَ رَخَّصَ لَنَا فِي أَنْ نُكْرِيَهَا بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْوَرِقِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Yazīd b. Hārūn Nbʾnā Ibrāhīm b. Saʿd \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿIkrimah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Ḥārith b. Hishām \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Labībah \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Saʿd b. Abū Waqqāṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحاَقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أنبأنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَبِيبَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2661

chapter.englishTitle: In the harvest

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When you wash (while performing ablution), take (use) the toothstick (miswak) and leave a third (of the mouth unwashed). But if you do not use the toothstick, then leave a quarter (of the mouth unwashed)."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "When you wash (while performing ablution), take (use) the toothstick (miswak) and leave a third (of the mouth unwashed). But if you do not use the toothstick, then leave a quarter (of the mouth unwashed)."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِذَا خَرَصْتُمْ فَخُذُوا وَدَعُوا دَعُوا الثُّلُثَ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَدَعُوا الثُّلُثَ فَدَعُوا الرُّبُعَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Khubayb b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Masʿūd b. Niyār al-Anṣārī \u003e Jāʾ Sahl b. Abū Ḥathmah \u003e Majlisinā Faḥaddath
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَسْعُودِ بْنِ نِيَارٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ جَاءَ سَهْلُ بْنُ أَبِي حَثْمَةَ إِلَى مَجْلِسِنَا فَحَدَّثَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2662

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ كَسْبِ الْأَمَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of enslaving people

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade earnings of slave-girls.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade earnings of slave-girls.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ كَسْبِ الْإِمَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. Juḥādah \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُحَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2663

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ كَسْبِ الْحَجَّامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of earning as a cupping therapist

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: The earnings of a cupper are impure, the price paid for a dog is impure, and the hire paid to a prostitute is impure.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: The earnings of a cupper are impure, the price paid for a dog is impure, and the hire paid to a prostitute is impure.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «كَسْبُ الْحَجَّامِ خَبِيثٌ وَمَهْرُ الْبَغِيِّ خَبِيثٌ وَثَمَنُ الْكَلْبِ خَبِيثٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbdullāh b. Qāriẓ \u003e al-Sāʾib b. Yazīd \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَارِظٍ أَنَّ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَافِعَ بْنَ خَدِيجٍ حَدَّثَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2664

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الرُّخْصَةِ فِي كَسْبِ الْحَجَّامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the license, in the occupation of cupping

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the sentence "أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «حَجَمَهُ أَبُو طَيْبَةَ وَأَمَرَ لَهُ بِصَاعَيْنِ مِنْ طَعَامٍ»" into English is: "It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Hajj and ordered him to give him two Sa' of food".   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the sentence "أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «حَجَمَهُ أَبُو طَيْبَةَ وَأَمَرَ لَهُ بِصَاعَيْنِ مِنْ طَعَامٍ»" into English is: "It is narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ performed Hajj and ordered him to give him two Sa' of food".   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «حَجَمَهُ أَبُو طَيْبَةَ وَأَمَرَ لَهُ بِصَاعَيْنِ مِنْ طَعَامٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd al-Ṭawīl \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا حُمَيْدٌ الطَّوِيلُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2665

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ عَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: In prohibiting the insult of the stallion

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade (taking hire for) a stallion's covering.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade (taking hire for) a stallion's covering.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ثَمَنِ عَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn Fuḍayl \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2666

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ عَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ
chapter.englishTitle: In prohibiting the insult of the stallion

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abu Hurairah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the mating of a male donkey and the fee for a (female) prostitute."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "Abu Hurairah, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade the mating of a male donkey and the fee for a (female) prostitute."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ عَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ وَأَجْرِ الْمُومِسَةِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Qāsim b. al-Faḍl from my father \u003e al-Mahrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي عَنْ الْمَهْرِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2667

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِيمَنْ بَاعَ دَارًا فَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ ثَمَنَهَا فِي مِثْلِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever sells a house without setting its price at its equivalent

hadiths.englishRaw: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Whoever among you sells a house or property, it is recommended that he does not receive the blessing of it except if he puts it in a similar replacement.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Whoever among you sells a house or property, it is recommended that he does not receive the blessing of it except if he puts it in a similar replacement.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ بَاعَ مِنْكُمْ دَارًا أَوْ عَقَارًا فإنه قَمِنٌ أَنْ لَا يُبَارَكَ لَهُ إِلَّا أَنْ يَجْعَلَهُ فِي مِثْلِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e Ibn Ibrāhīm b. Muhājir \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e ʿAmr b. Ḥurayth \u003e Akhīh Saʿīd b. Ḥurayth And Kānat Lah Ṣuḥbah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْماَعِيلُ هُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ حُرَيْثٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2668

chapter.englishTitle: In the Harem of the Well

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Messenger of Allah, may the peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, he said, "Whoever digs a well, no one should dig around it for forty cubits in order to give way to his livestock."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Messenger of Allah, may the peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, he said, "Whoever digs a well, no one should dig around it for forty cubits in order to give way to his livestock."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنِ احْتَفَرَ بِئْرًا فَلَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَحْفِرَ حَوْلَهُ أَرْبَعِينَ ذِرَاعًا عَطَنًا لِمَاشِيَتِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿArʿarah b. al-Birind al-Sāmī \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Muslim \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَرْعَرَةُ بْنُ الْبِرِنْدِ السَّامِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْماَعِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2669

chapter.englishTitle: In the intercession

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ concerning intercession when their paths are the same? He said, "It will be considered and even if its owner is absent."
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ concerning intercession when their paths are the same? He said, "It will be considered and even if its owner is absent."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي الشُّفْعَةِ إِذَا كَانَ طَرِيقُهُمَا وَاحِدًا؟ قَالَ «يُنْظَرُ بِهَا وَإِنْ كَانَ صَاحِبُهَا غَائِبًا»
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2670

chapter.englishTitle: In the intercession

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ruled that pre-emption is to be given in everything that is shared in which the division is not clear, whether it is a house or a garden. It is not permissible to sell it before informing one's partner, who may take it or leave it, as he wishes. He (the share-owner) sells it without informing him, and then he has more right to it."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ruled that pre-emption is to be given in everything that is shared in which the division is not clear, whether it is a house or a garden. It is not permissible to sell it before informing one's partner, who may take it or leave it, as he wishes. He (the share-owner) sells it without informing him, and then he has more right to it."
hadiths.arabic: قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالشُّفْعَةِ فِي كُلِّ شِرْكٍ لَمْ يُقْسَمْ رَبْعَةٍ أَوْ حَائِطٍ لَا يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَتَّى يُؤْذِنَ شَرِيكَهُ فَإِنْ شَاءَ أَخَذَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَ فَإِنْ بَاعَ وَلَمْ يُؤْذِنْهُ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2671

chapter.englishTitle: Three Permissions

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari sought permission from Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, three times, but he was not granted permission. So he returned and said, "What made you come back?" Abu Musa replied, "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'If someone seeks permission three times and is not granted it, then let them return.' So Umar said, 'Bring someone to testify with you or I will do something [harsh].' Abu Sa'eed said, 'Umar called me while I was in the mosque, fearing Umar's anger towards me. He stood up and said, 'I swear by Allah, among you there is a man who heard this from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, except that he did not testify to it.' I lifted my head and said, 'Let me inform Umar that I am with you on this.' Others also said the same, and Abu Musa's problem was resolved."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari sought permission from Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, three times, but he was not granted permission. So he returned and said, "What made you come back?" Abu Musa replied, "I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying, 'If someone seeks permission three times and is not granted it, then let them return.' So Umar said, 'Bring someone to testify with you or I will do something [harsh].' Abu Sa'eed said, 'Umar called me while I was in the mosque, fearing Umar's anger towards me. He stood up and said, 'I swear by Allah, among you there is a man who heard this from the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, except that he did not testify to it.' I lifted my head and said, 'Let me inform Umar that I am with you on this.' Others also said the same, and Abu Musa's problem was resolved."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيَّ اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى عُمَرَ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ فَرَجَعَ فَقَالَ مَا رَجَعَكَ؟ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَ الْمُسْتَأْذِنُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَهُ وَإِلَّا فَلْيَرْجِعْ فَقَالَ لَتَأْتِيَنَّ بِمَنْ يَشْهَدُ مَعَكَ أَوْ لَأَفْعَلَنَّ وَلَأَفْعَلَنَّ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ وأَتَانَا وَأَنَا فِي قَوْمٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَهُوَ فَزِعٌ مِنْ وَعِيدِ عُمَرَ إِيَّاهُ فَقَامَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُ اللَّهَ مِنْكُمْ رَجُلًا سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَّا شَهِدَ لِي بِهِ قَالَ فَرَفَعْتُ رَأْسِي فَقُلْتُ أَخْبِرْهُ أَنِّي مَعَكَ عَلَى هَذَا وَقَالَ ذَاكَ آخَرُونَ فَسُرِّيَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Dāwud \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2672

chapter.englishTitle: How is the request for permission?

hadiths.englishRaw: I came to the messenger of Allah ﷺ and knocked on his door. He asked, "Who is it?" and I replied, "It is me." He questioned, "Me? Me?" and disliked that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I came to the messenger of Allah ﷺ and knocked on his door. He asked, "Who is it?" and I replied, "It is me." He questioned, "Me? Me?" and disliked that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَضَرَبْتُ بَابَهُ فَقَالَ «مَنْ ذَا؟» فَقُلْتُ أَنَا فقَالَ «أَنَا؟ أَنَا؟» فَكَرِهَ ذَاكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2673

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ أَنْ يَطْرُقَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of a man visiting his family at night

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ forbade a man from visiting his family at night or spying on them, or seeking their faults. Sufyan said regarding his statement "or seeking their faults", I do not know the meaning of this, it was said by Muharib or something that is in the Hadith.
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ forbade a man from visiting his family at night or spying on them, or seeking their faults. Sufyan said regarding his statement "or seeking their faults", I do not know the meaning of this, it was said by Muharib or something that is in the Hadith.
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ يَطْرُقَ الرَّجُلُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلًا أَوْ يُخَوِّنَهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسَ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ» قَالَ سُفْيَانُ قَوْلُهُ أَوْ يُخَوِّنَهُمْ أَوْ يَلْتَمِسَ عَثَرَاتِهِمْ مَا أَدْرِي شَيْءٌ قَالَهُ مُحَارِبٌ أَوْ شَيْءٌ هُوَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥārib b. Dithār \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَارِبَ بْنَ دِثَارٍ يَذْكُرُ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2674

chapter.englishTitle: In the spreading of peace

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina, the people gathered around and said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has arrived." I went out among those who went out, and when I saw his face, I recognized that his face is not the face of a liar. The first thing I heard him say was, "O people, spread peace, feed the hungry, maintain family ties, and pray while the people are asleep. You shall enter Paradise in peace."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Prophet ﷺ arrived in Medina, the people gathered around and said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ has arrived." I went out among those who went out, and when I saw his face, I recognized that his face is not the face of a liar. The first thing I heard him say was, "O people, spread peace, feed the hungry, maintain family ties, and pray while the people are asleep. You shall enter Paradise in peace."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَدِينَةَ اسْتَشْرَفَهُ النَّاسُ فَقَالُوا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فَخَرَجْتُ فِيمَنْ خَرَجَ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ وَجْهَهُ عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ وَجْهَهُ لَيْسَ بِوَجْهِ كَذَّابٍ فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَا سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ وَأَطْعِمُوا الطَّعَامَ وَصِلُوا الْأَرْحَامَ وَصَلُّوا وَالنَّاسُ نِيَامٌ تَدْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِسَلَامٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAwf \u003e Zurārah b. Awfá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Salām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2675

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي حَقِّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ
chapter.englishTitle: Regarding the rights of a Muslim upon another Muslim

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Muslim has the right to six acts of kindness from his fellow Muslim: he should greet him with salam when he meets him; he should say ‘Yarhamukallah (may Allah have mercy on you) when he sneezes; he should visit him when he is sick; he should respond to him when he invites him; he should attend his funeral when he dies, he should love for him what he loves for himself; and he should be sincere towards him when he is not present.ʿ It was narrated from Abu Ishaq from al-Harith... and he narrated a similar report with the same isnad.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “The Muslim has the right to six acts of kindness from his fellow Muslim: he should greet him with salam when he meets him; he should say ‘Yarhamukallah (may Allah have mercy on you) when he sneezes; he should visit him when he is sick; he should respond to him when he invites him; he should attend his funeral when he dies, he should love for him what he loves for himself; and he should be sincere towards him when he is not present.ʿ It was narrated from Abu Ishaq from al-Harith... and he narrated a similar report with the same isnad.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِلْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ سِتٌّ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِ إِذَا لَقِيَهُ وَيُشَمِّتُهُ إِذَا عَطَسَ وَيَعُودُهُ إِذَا مَرِضَ وَيُجِيبُهُ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَشْهَدُهُ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ وَيُحِبُّ لَهُ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ وَيَنْصَحُ لَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2676

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي تَسْلِيمِ الرَّاكِبِ عَلَى الْمَاشِي
chapter.englishTitle: The delivery of the passenger on foot.

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The horseman gives Salam to the walking person, the walking person to the one standing and the few to the many."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The horseman gives Salam to the walking person, the walking person to the one standing and the few to the many."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا عَلِيٍّ الْجَنْبِيَّ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «يُسَلِّمُ الرَّاكِبُ عَلَى الْمَاشِي وَالْقَائِمُ عَلَى الْقَاعِدِ وَالْقَلِيلُ عَلَى الْكَثِيرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah \u003e Abū Hāniʾ al-Khawlānī \u003e Abū ʿAlī al-Janbī \u003e Faḍālah b. ʿUbayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو هَانِئٍ الْخَوْلَانِيُّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2677

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي رَدِّ السَّلَامِ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ
chapter.englishTitle: In responding to the peace of the People of the Book

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed when a Jew gives Salam to one of you, then he is only saying: 'As-Samu 'Alaikum' (Death be upon you) so say: "Alaik (And upon you).'"    – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed when a Jew gives Salam to one of you, then he is only saying: 'As-Samu 'Alaikum' (Death be upon you) so say: "Alaik (And upon you).'"    – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ إِذَا سَلَّمَ أَحَدُهُمْ فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ السَّامُ عَلَيْكَ قُلْ عَلَيْكَ   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2678

chapter.englishTitle: In delivering to the boys.

hadiths.englishRaw: I was walking with Thibit al-Bunani that he happened to pass by children and he greeted them. And Thibit reported that he walked with Anas and he happened to pass by children and he greeted them. and Anas reported that he walked with Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon. him) and he happened, to pass by children and he greeted them.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I was walking with Thibit al-Bunani that he happened to pass by children and he greeted them. And Thibit reported that he walked with Anas and he happened to pass by children and he greeted them. and Anas reported that he walked with Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon. him) and he happened, to pass by children and he greeted them.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ فَمَرَّ بِصِبْيَانٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَحَدَّثَ ثَابِتٌ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ أَنَسٍ فَمَرَّ بِصِبْيَانٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَحَدَّثَ أَنَسٌ أَنَّهُ «كَانَ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَمَرَّ بِصِبْيَانٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Sayyār
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَيَّارٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2679

chapter.englishTitle: In handing over responsibility to women

hadiths.englishRaw: She was among a group of women that the Prophet ﷺ passed by and greeted.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: She was among a group of women that the Prophet ﷺ passed by and greeted.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا بَيْنَا هِيَ فِي نِسْوَةٍ مَرَّ عَلَيْهِنَّ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِنَّ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah \u003e Ibn Abū Ḥusayn \u003e Shahr \u003e Asmāʾ b. Yazīd b. al-Sakan Iḥdá Nisāʾ Banī ʿAbd al-Ashhal
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنِي شَهْرٌ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ السَّكَنِ إِحْدَى نِسَاءِ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْأَشْهَلِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2680
hadiths.englishRaw: 'A'isha, here is Gabriel offering you greetings. She said: 1 made a reply: Let there be peace and blessings of Allah upon him, and added: He sees what I do not see.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: 'A'isha, here is Gabriel offering you greetings. She said: 1 made a reply: Let there be peace and blessings of Allah upon him, and added: He sees what I do not see.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَا عَائِشُ هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكِ السَّلَامَ» قَالَتْ وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ قَالَتْ وَهُوَ يَرَى مَا لَا أَرَى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2681

chapter.englishTitle: In Returning Peace

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ prayed, and I came to him after he finished his prayer. I was the first to greet him with the greeting of Islam. He said, "Peace and mercy of Allah be upon you. Who are you?" I said, "I am from the tribe of Ghifar." He took hold of my hand and I thought to myself that I disliked being affiliated with Ghifar.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ prayed, and I came to him after he finished his prayer. I was the first to greet him with the greeting of Islam. He said, "Peace and mercy of Allah be upon you. Who are you?" I said, "I am from the tribe of Ghifar." He took hold of my hand and I thought to myself that I disliked being affiliated with Ghifar.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَتَيْتُهُ حِينَ قَضَى صَلَاتَهُ فَكُنْتُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ حَيَّا بِتَحِيَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِ قَالَ «عَلَيْكَ السَّلَامُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ؟» قَالَ قُلْتُ مِنْ غِفَارٍ قَالَ فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ قُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي كَرِهَ أَنِّي انْتَمَيْتُ إِلَى غِفَارٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Ibn al-Mughīrah \u003e Ḥumayd b. Hilāl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2682

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of delivery and response.

hadiths.englishRaw: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: Peace be upon you! He responded to his salutation. He then sat down. The Prophet ﷺ said: Ten. Another man came and said: Peace and Allah's mercy be upon you! He responded to his salutation when he sat down. He said: Twenty. Another man came and said: Peace and Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you! He responded to him and said when he sat down: and blessings be upon you! He responded to him and said when he sat down: Thirty.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and said: Peace be upon you! He responded to his salutation. He then sat down. The Prophet ﷺ said: Ten. Another man came and said: Peace and Allah's mercy be upon you! He responded to his salutation when he sat down. He said: Twenty. Another man came and said: Peace and Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you! He responded to him and said when he sat down: and blessings be upon you! He responded to him and said when he sat down: Thirty.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ «عَشْرٌ» ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ فََقَالَ «عِشْرُونَ» ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَ «ثَلَاثُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e Jaʿfar b. Sulaymān \u003e ʿAwf \u003e Abū Rajāʾ \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَوْفٍ عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2683

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا سُلِّمَ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ
chapter.englishTitle: If a person is greeted while urinating

hadiths.englishRaw: It was narrated from Al-Muhajir bin Qunfudh that he greeted the Prophet ﷺ with Salam while he was urinating, and he did not return the greeting until he had performed Wudu'. When he had performed Wudu' he returned the greeting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was narrated from Al-Muhajir bin Qunfudh that he greeted the Prophet ﷺ with Salam while he was urinating, and he did not return the greeting until he had performed Wudu'. When he had performed Wudu' he returned the greeting.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ «سَلَّمَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يَبُولُ فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامَ حَتَّى تَوَضَّأَ فَلَمَّا تَوَضَّأَ رَدَّهُ عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Muʿādh b. Hishām from my father \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e al-Ḥuḍayn \u003e al-Muhājir b. Qunfudh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ الْحُضَيْنِ عَنْ الْمُهَاجِرِ بْنِ قُنْفُذٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2684

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الدُّخُولِ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of entering upon women

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not enter upon women." It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, not even the daughter-in-law?" He said, "The daughter-in-law is death." Yahya said, "He means the proximity of the husband."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not enter upon women." It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, not even the daughter-in-law?" He said, "The daughter-in-law is death." Yahya said, "He means the proximity of the husband."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَدْخُلُوا عَلَى النِّسَاءِ» قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَمْوُ قَالَ الْحَمْوُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ يَحْيَى الْحَمْوُ يَعْنِي قَرَابَةَ الزَّوْجِ
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Bisṭām \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū al-Khayr \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2685

chapter.englishTitle: In the sudden glance

hadiths.englishRaw: Jarir said I asked the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ about an accidental glance (on a woman). He ﷺ said “Turn your eyes away.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Jarir said I asked the Apostle of Allaah ﷺ about an accidental glance (on a woman). He ﷺ said “Turn your eyes away.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ عَنْ نَظْرَةِ الْفَجْأَةِ؟ فَقَالَ «اصْرِفْ بَصَرَكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf And ʾAbūnuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yūnus \u003e ʿAmr b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Zurʿah b. ʿAmr b. Jarīr \u003e Jarīr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ وَأَبُونُعَيْمٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ جَرِيرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2686

chapter.englishTitle: In Women's Tails

hadiths.englishRaw: About Umm Salama, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , she said that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about the length of a woman's dress. He replied, "It should be a hand-span." So, I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, then will their feet be exposed?" He said, "No, it should hang below that." Abdullah Al-Nas said that people said this hadith was narrated by Nafi' from Sulaiman bin Yasar.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About Umm Salama, the wife of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , she said that the Prophet ﷺ was asked about the length of a woman's dress. He replied, "It should be a hand-span." So, I asked, "O Messenger of Allah, then will their feet be exposed?" He said, "No, it should hang below that." Abdullah Al-Nas said that people said this hadith was narrated by Nafi' from Sulaiman bin Yasar.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَتْ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَنْ ذَيْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ فَقَالَ «شِبْرًا» فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِذَنْ تَبْدُوَ أَقْدَامُهُنَّ؟ قَالَ «قَدْرَ ذِرَاعٍ لَا يَزِدْنَ عَلَيْهِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Khālid \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ṣafiyyah b. Abū ʿUbayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحاَقَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2687

chapter.englishTitle: In the disapproval of showing ornamentation

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] addressed us and said: 'O women, do you not have any silver to wear for adornment? For there is no woman among you who wears gold and shows it, but she will be punished because of it.'"    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah [SAW] addressed us and said: 'O women, do you not have any silver to wear for adornment? For there is no woman among you who wears gold and shows it, but she will be punished because of it.'"    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «يَا مَعْشَرَ النِّسَاءِ أَمَا لَكُنَّ فِي الْفِضَّةِ مَا تَحَلَّيْنَ بِهِ؟ أَمَا إِنَّهُ لَيْسَتْ مِنْكُنَّ امْرَأَةٌ تَحَلَّى الذَّهَبَ فَتُظْهِرَهُ إِلَّا عُذِّبَتْ بِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ribʿī b. Ḥirāsh \u003e Āmraʾatih \u003e Ukht Liḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنِي رِبْعِيُّ بْنُ حِرَاشٍ عَنْ امْرَأَتِهِ عَنْ أُخْتٍ لِحُذَيْفَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2688

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الطِّيبِ إِذَا خَرَجَتْ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Prohibition of Fragrance When It is Emitting

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Abu Musa: 'Any woman who perfumes herself and then goes out to be detected by her scent, she is an adulteress, and every eye is adulterous.' And Abu Asim said: 'Some of our companions narrates this hadith with raising it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From Abu Musa: 'Any woman who perfumes herself and then goes out to be detected by her scent, she is an adulteress, and every eye is adulterous.' And Abu Asim said: 'Some of our companions narrates this hadith with raising it.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى «أَيُّمَا امْرَأَةٍ اسْتَعْطَرَتْ ثُمَّ خَرَجَتْ لِيُوجَدَ رِيحُهَا فَهِيَ زَانِيَةٌ وَكُلُّ عَيْنٍ زَانِيَةٌ» وَقَالَ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ يَرْفَعُهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Thābit b. ʿUmārah \u003e Ghunaym b. Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ عَنْ غُنَيْمِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2689

chapter.englishTitle: In the connector and the definite article

hadiths.englishRaw: ʿAbdullah (bin Masud) said. "Allah curses those ladies who practice tattooing and those who get themselves tattooed, and those ladies who remove the hair from their faces and those who make artificial spaces between their teeth in order to look more beautiful whereby they change Allah's creation." His saying reached a lady from Bani Asd called Um Yaqub who came (to ʿAbdullah) and said, "I have come to know that you have cursed such-and-such (ladies)?" He replied, "Why should I not curse these whom Messenger of Allah ﷺ has cursed and who are (cursed) in Allah's Book!" Um Yaqub said, "I have read the whole Qur'an, but I did not find in it what you say." He said, "Verily, if you have read it (i.e. the Qur'an), you have found it. Didn't you read: 'And whatsoever the Apostle gives you take it and whatsoever he forbids you, you abstain (from it). (59.7) She replied, "Yes, I did," He said, "Verily, Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade such things." "She said, "But I see your wife doing these things?" He said, "Go and watch her." She went and watched her but could not see anything in support of her statement. On that he said, "If my wife was as you thought, I would not keep her in my company."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ʿAbdullah (bin Masud) said. "Allah curses those ladies who practice tattooing and those who get themselves tattooed, and those ladies who remove the hair from their faces and those who make artificial spaces between their teeth in order to look more beautiful whereby they change Allah's creation." His saying reached a lady from Bani Asd called Um Yaqub who came (to ʿAbdullah) and said, "I have come to know that you have cursed such-and-such (ladies)?" He replied, "Why should I not curse these whom Messenger of Allah ﷺ has cursed and who are (cursed) in Allah's Book!" Um Yaqub said, "I have read the whole Qur'an, but I did not find in it what you say." He said, "Verily, if you have read it (i.e. the Qur'an), you have found it. Didn't you read: 'And whatsoever the Apostle gives you take it and whatsoever he forbids you, you abstain (from it). (59.7) She replied, "Yes, I did," He said, "Verily, Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade such things." "She said, "But I see your wife doing these things?" He said, "Go and watch her." She went and watched her but could not see anything in support of her statement. On that he said, "If my wife was as you thought, I would not keep her in my company."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ» فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا أُمُّ يَعْقُوبَ فَجَاءَتْ فَقَالَتْ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ لَعَنْتَ كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ؟ فَقَالَ وَمَا لِي لَا أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَتْ لَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ مَا بَيْنَ اللَّوْحَيْنِ فَمَا وَجَدْتُ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ قَالَ لَئِنْ كُنْتِ قَرَأْتِيهِ لَقَدْ وَجَدْتِيهِ أَمَا قَرَأْتِ {مَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ} [الحشر 7]؟ فَقَالَتْ بَلَى قَالَ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ نَهَى عَنْهُ فَقَالَتْ فَإِنِّي أَرَى أَهْلَكَ يَفْعَلُونَهُ؟ قَالَ فَادْخُلِي فَانْظُرِي فَدَخَلَتْ فَنَظَرَتْ فَلَمْ تَرَ مِنْ حَاجَتِهَا شَيْئًا فَقَالَ لَوْ كَانَتْ كَذَلِكِ مَا جَامَعْتُهَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2690

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ مُكَامَعَةِ الرَّجُلِ الرَّجُلَ، وَالْمَرْأَةِ الْمَرْأَةَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of men mingling with men, and women mingling ...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Abu Rayhana, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid ten things: mutual rubbing between two men in one garment without anything between them, mutual rubbing between two women in one garment without anything between them, plucking the hair, tattooing, shaving the head partially, riding on wild lions, and taking one's slave as a wife using the thighs. Abdullah Abu 'Amir, their sheikh, said, 'Mutual rubbing refers to sexual intercourse.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Rayhana, the companion of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , saying, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to forbid ten things: mutual rubbing between two men in one garment without anything between them, mutual rubbing between two women in one garment without anything between them, plucking the hair, tattooing, shaving the head partially, riding on wild lions, and taking one's slave as a wife using the thighs. Abdullah Abu 'Amir, their sheikh, said, 'Mutual rubbing refers to sexual intercourse.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَيْحَانَةَ صَاحِبَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَى عَنْ عَشْرِ خِصَالٍ مُكَامَعَةِ الرَّجُلِ الرَّجُلَ فِي شِعَارٍ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْءٌ وَمُكَامَعَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْمَرْأَةَ فِي شِعَارٍ وَاحِدٍ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْءٌ وَالنَّتْفِ وَالْوَشْمِ وَالنُّهْبَةِ وَرُكُوبِ النُّمُورِ وَاتِّخَاذِ الدِّيبَاجِ هَا هُنَا عَلَى الْعَاتِقَيْنِ وَفِي أَسْفَلِ الثِّيَابِ قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ أَبُو عَامِرٍ شَيْخٌ لَهُمْ وَالْمُكَامَعَةُ الْمُضَاجَعَةُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Zayd b. Ḥubāb \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ayyūb al-Ḥaḍramī \u003e ʿAyyāsh b. ʿAbbās al-Ḥimyarī \u003e Abū al-Ḥuṣayn al-Ḥajrī \u003e Abū ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ حُبَابِ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ أَخْبَرَنِي عَيَّاشُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ الْحِمْيَرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الْحُصَيْنِ الْحَجْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2691

chapter.englishTitle: Cursing of the effeminate men and the masculine women

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ cursed effeminate men among the men and masculinized women among the women and said, 'Expel them from your homes.' The Prophet ﷺ expelled certain individuals and `Umar expelled others.' Abdullah said, 'I am uncertain.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ cursed effeminate men among the men and masculinized women among the women and said, 'Expel them from your homes.' The Prophet ﷺ expelled certain individuals and `Umar expelled others.' Abdullah said, 'I am uncertain.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ لَعَنَ الْمُخَنَّثِينَ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالْمُتَرَجِّلَاتِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ وَقَالَ «أَخْرِجُوهُمْ مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمْ» قَالَ «فَأَخْرَجَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فُلَانًا وَأَخْرَجَ عُمَرُ فُلَانًا أَوْ فُلَانَةَ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «فَأَشُكُّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn And Wahb b. Jarīr \u003e Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَوَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2692

chapter.englishTitle: In reality, the thigh is a private part

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat with us and my thigh was exposed, so he said, "Cover your thigh, for surely the thigh is an 'awrah."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sat with us and my thigh was exposed, so he said, "Cover your thigh, for surely the thigh is an 'awrah."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَلَسَ عِنْدَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَفَخِذِي مُنْكَشِفَةٌ فَقَالَ «خَمِّرْ عَلَيْكَ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الْفَخِذَ عَوْرَةٌ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik \u003e Abū al-Naḍr \u003e Zurʿah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنْبَأَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَكَانَ مِن أَصْحَابِ الصُّفَّةِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2693

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ دُخُولِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَمَّامَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of women entering the restroom

hadiths.englishRaw: "Perhaps you are among those (women) who enter bathhouses? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Any woman who takes off her clothes anywhere but in her husband's house, has torn the screen between her and Allah.'"     – Sound
hadiths.body: "Perhaps you are among those (women) who enter bathhouses? I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Any woman who takes off her clothes anywhere but in her husband's house, has torn the screen between her and Allah.'"     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ نِسْوَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ حِمْصٍ يَسْتَفْتِينَهَا فَقَالَتْ لَعَلَّكُنَّ مِنَ النِّسْوَةِ اللَّاتِي يَدْخُلْنَ الْحَمَّامَاتِ؟ قُلْنَ نَعَمْ قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَا مِنَ امْرَأَةٍ تَضَعُ ثِيَابَهَا فِي غَيْرِ بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا إِلَّا هَتَكَتْ مَا بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ اللَّهِ ﷻ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2694

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ دُخُولِ الْمَرْأَةِ الْحَمَّامَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of women entering the restroom

hadiths.englishRaw: About Aisha, this hadith.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Aisha, this hadith.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Muḥammad \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Sālim \u003e Abū al-Malīḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمَلِيحِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2695

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا يُقِيمَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: None of you should avoid inviting his brother from his session

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A person should not push his brother out of his place and then sit in it, rather you should make room and expand."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A person should not push his brother out of his place and then sit in it, rather you should make room and expand."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا يُقِيمُ الرَّجُلُ يَعْنِي أَخَاهُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ يَقْعُدُ فِيهِ وَلَكِنْ تَفَسَّحُوا وَتَوَسَّعُوا
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Bishr b. al-Mufaḍḍal \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2696

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا قَامَ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: If he gets up from his seat and then returns to it, he is more e...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If one of you stands up or a man from his gathering and then returns to it, he has more right to it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If one of you stands up or a man from his gathering and then returns to it, he has more right to it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا قَامَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَوِ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ مَجْلِسِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ بِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Suhayl from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2697

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنِ الْجُلُوسِ فِي الطُّرُقَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of sitting in the streets

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a group of sitting Ansar (companions from Al-Madinah) and said, 'If you are unwilling to do anything, then guide people towards the right path, spread peace, and assist the oppressed.' Shu'bah said, 'Abu Ishaq did not hear this narration from Al-Bara'.'   – Sound
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ passed by a group of sitting Ansar (companions from Al-Madinah) and said, 'If you are unwilling to do anything, then guide people towards the right path, spread peace, and assist the oppressed.' Shu'bah said, 'Abu Ishaq did not hear this narration from Al-Bara'.'   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَرَّ بِنَاسٍ جُلُوسٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا بُدَّ فَاعِلِينَ فَاهْدُوا السَّبِيلَ وَأَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ وَأَعِينُوا الْمَظْلُومَ» قَالَ شُعْبَةُ «لَمْ يَسْمَعْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ مِنَ الْبَرَاءِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Barāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2698

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي وَضْعِ إِحْدَى الرِّجْلَيْنِ عَلَى الْأُخْرَى
chapter.englishTitle: In the position of one foot on top of the other

hadiths.englishRaw: 'Abbad b. Tamim reported from his uncle that he saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ lying in the mosque and placing his one foot upon the other.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: 'Abbad b. Tamim reported from his uncle that he saw Messenger of Allah ﷺ lying in the mosque and placing his one foot upon the other.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مُسْتَلْقِيًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَاضِعًا إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الْأُخْرَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abū Khalaf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAbbād b. Tamīm \u003e ʿAmmih
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ تَمِيمٍ عَنْ عَمِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2699

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ صَاحِبِهِمَا
chapter.englishTitle: Two people do not have a secret conversation without their compa...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When you are three, two should not converse (privately) to the exclusion of their companion, because that makes him sad."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When you are three, two should not converse (privately) to the exclusion of their companion, because that makes him sad."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِذَا كُنْتُمْ ثَلَاثَةً فَلَا يَتَنَاجَى اثْنَانِ دُونَ صَاحِبِهِمَا فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ يُحْزِنُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2700

chapter.englishTitle: The Atonement of the Assembly

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ intended to get up from the assembly he used to say in the last. Glory be to Thee. O Allah, and I begin with praise of Thee, I testify that there is no god but Thou; I ask Thy pardon, and return to Thee in repentance. The man asked: Messenger of Allah! you utter the words now which you did not do in the past? He replied: (This is an) atonement for what takes place in the assembly.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ intended to get up from the assembly he used to say in the last. Glory be to Thee. O Allah, and I begin with praise of Thee, I testify that there is no god but Thou; I ask Thy pardon, and return to Thee in repentance. The man asked: Messenger of Allah! you utter the words now which you did not do in the past? He replied: (This is an) atonement for what takes place in the assembly.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَمَّا كَانَ بِأَخَرَةٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا جَلَسَ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَقُومَ قَالَ «سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ» فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَتَقُولُ الْآنَ كَلَامًا مَا كُنْتَ تَقُولُهُ فِيمَا خَلَا فَقَالَ «هَذَا كَفَّارَةٌ لِمَا يَكُونُ فِي الْمَجَالِسِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e Ḥajjāj / Ibn Dīnār \u003e Abū Hāshim \u003e Rufayʿ Abū al-ʿĀliyah \u003e Abū Barzah al-Aslamī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ دِينَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ رُفَيْعٍ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2701

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا عَطَسَ الرَّجُلُ مَا يَقُولُ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man sneezes, what does he say?

hadiths.englishRaw: ʿIf one of you sneezes, let him say: Praise be to Allah in all situations. Let others say to him; May Allah have mercy on you. And let him say May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.” I said to him: Is it from Abu Ayyoob? He said: ʿAli ؓ .     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: ʿIf one of you sneezes, let him say: Praise be to Allah in all situations. Let others say to him; May Allah have mercy on you. And let him say May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.” I said to him: Is it from Abu Ayyoob? He said: ʿAli ؓ .     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ الْعَاطِسُ يَقُولُ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ وَيَقُولُ الَّذِي يُشَمِّتُهُ يَرْحَمُكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e Akhīh ʿĪsá \u003e Abīh ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e Abū Ayyūb al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ أَخِيهِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2702

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا لَمْ يَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ لمْ يُشَمِّتْهُ
chapter.englishTitle: If he does not praise Allah, he will not be exalted.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Two men sneezed in he presence of the Prophet ﷺ and he replied (said: YarhamukAllah; may Allah have mercy on you') to one and not to the other. It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, two men sneezed in your presence and you replied to one and not to the other?' He said: "'This one praised Allah(said Al-Hamdulillah fter sneezing) but that one did not.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Two men sneezed in he presence of the Prophet ﷺ and he replied (said: YarhamukAllah; may Allah have mercy on you') to one and not to the other. It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, two men sneezed in your presence and you replied to one and not to the other?' He said: "'This one praised Allah(said Al-Hamdulillah fter sneezing) but that one did not.'"     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَطَسَ رَجُلَانِ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَشَمَّتَ أَحَدَهُمَا وَلَمْ يُشَمِّتِ الْآخَرَ فَقِيلَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ شَمَّتَّ هَذَا وَلَمْ تُشَمِّتِ الْآخَرَ؟ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ هَذَا حَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمْ يَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «سُلَيْمَانُ هُوَ التَّيْمِيُّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2703

chapter.englishTitle: How many times does the sneezer get mocked?

hadiths.englishRaw: when a man sneezed beside the prophet (May peace be upon him), he said to him : Allah have mercy on you, but when he sneezed again, he said : The man has a cold in the head.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: when a man sneezed beside the prophet (May peace be upon him), he said to him : Allah have mercy on you, but when he sneezed again, he said : The man has a cold in the head.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَطَسَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ» ثُمَّ عَطَسَ أُخْرَى فَقَالَ «الرَّجُلُ مَزْكُومٌ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAmmār \u003e Iyās b. Salamah from my father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2704

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of images

hadiths.englishRaw: "Aisha, we had a garment with pictures on it, so I placed it in front of the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying. He forbade me from doing so, or she said he disliked it. She said I then made it into cushions."
hadiths.body: "Aisha, we had a garment with pictures on it, so I placed it in front of the Prophet ﷺ while he was praying. He forbade me from doing so, or she said he disliked it. She said I then made it into cushions."
hadiths.arabic: عَائِشَةُ كَانَ لَنَا ثَوْبٌ فِيهِ تَصَاوِيرُ فَجَعَلْتُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَنَهَانِي أَوْ قَالَتْ فَكَرِهَهُ قَالَتْ فَجَعَلْتُهُ وَسَائِدَ
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2705

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا تَدْخُلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ تَصَاوِيرُ
chapter.englishTitle: Do not enter a house where there are pictures, angels.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “The angels do not enter a house in which there is a dog or an image.”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ الْمَلَكَ لَا يَدْخُلُ بَيْتًا فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَلَا صُورَةٌ وَلَا جُنُبٌ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād \u003e ʿUmārah b. al-Qaʿqāʿ \u003e al-Ḥārith al-ʿUklī \u003e Abū Zurʿah b. ʿAmr b. Jarīr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Nujay \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَارَةُ بْنُ الْقَعْقَاعِ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَارِثُ الْعُكْلِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُجَيٍّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2706

chapter.englishTitle: In Family Expenses

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "When a Muslim spends on his family with the intention of charity, it is considered as a charity for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "When a Muslim spends on his family with the intention of charity, it is considered as a charity for him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْمُسْلِمُ إِذَا أَنَفْقَ نَفَقَةً عَلَى أَهْلِهِ وَهُوَ يَحْتَسِبُهَا فَهِيَ لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAdī b. Thābit \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Abū Masʿūd al-Badrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ أَخْبَرَنِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْبَدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2707

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الدَّابَّةِ يَرْكَبُ عَلَيْهَا ثَلَاثَةٌ
chapter.englishTitle: Three people ride on the animal

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to carry me and Al-Hasan or Al-Husain (his grandsons) on his shoulders, and he would say, "And I see him (the Prophet) saying, 'Al-Hasan, carry me between his hands and Al-Husain behind him until we reach Madinah while riding on the animal that the Prophet ﷺ used to ride on."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation is: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to carry me and Al-Hasan or Al-Husain (his grandsons) on his shoulders, and he would say, "And I see him (the Prophet) saying, 'Al-Hasan, carry me between his hands and Al-Husain behind him until we reach Madinah while riding on the animal that the Prophet ﷺ used to ride on."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا قَفَلَ تُلُقِّيَ بِي وَبِالْحَسَنِ أَوْ بِالْحُسَيْنِ قَالَ وَأُرَاهُ قَالَ الْحَسَنَ فَحَمَلَنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَالْحَسَنَ وَرَاءَهُ حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ وَنَحْنُ عَلَى الدَّابَّةِ الَّتِي عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Thābit b. Yazīd \u003e ʿĀṣim al-Aḥwal \u003e Muwarriq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الْأَحْوَلُ عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2708

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي صَاحِبُ الدَّابَّةِ أَحَقُّ بِصَدْرِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: In animals, the owner's chest is the most deserving.

hadiths.englishRaw: I am with a people for whom I am not their leader, so a man by the name of Abdullah bin Hanzalah bin Al-Ghasil said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'A person is entitled to the area occupied by his mount and the space his bed takes up, and to offer Salah in his provision container.'" At that moment, Qais bin Sa`d was present and said, "O so-and-so, stand up and lead them in prayer."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I am with a people for whom I am not their leader, so a man by the name of Abdullah bin Hanzalah bin Al-Ghasil said, "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'A person is entitled to the area occupied by his mount and the space his bed takes up, and to offer Salah in his provision container.'" At that moment, Qais bin Sa`d was present and said, "O so-and-so, stand up and lead them in prayer."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَكُنْ لِأُصَلِّيَ بِقَوْمٍ لَسْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِأَمِيرٍ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ لَيْسَ بِدُونِهِ يُقَالُ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حَنْظَلَةَ بْنِ الْغَسِيلِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الرَّجُلُ أَحَقُّ بِصَدْرِ دَابَّتِهِ وَصَدْرِ فِرَاشِهِ وَأَنْ يَؤُمَّ فِي رَحْلِهِ» فقَالَ َ قَيْسُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عِنْدَ ذَاكَ يَا فُلَانُ لِمَوْلًى لَهُ قُمْ فَصَلِّ لَهُمْ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Sulaymān \u003e Isḥāq b. Yaḥyá b. Ṭalḥah \u003e al-Musayyab b. Rāfiʿ And Maʿbad b. Khālid \u003e ʿAbd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ وَمَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْخَطْمِيِّ وَكَانَ أَمِيرًا عَلَى الْكُوفَةِ قَالَ أَتَيْنَا قَيْسَ بْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَأَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنِ لِلصَّلَاةِ وَقُلْنَا لِقَيْسٍ قُمْ فَصَلِّ لَنَا فَقَالَ لَمْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2709

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ أَنَّ عَلَى كُلِّ ذِرْوَةِ بَعِيرٍ شَيْطَانًا
chapter.englishTitle: What belongs to every mountain goat?

hadiths.englishRaw: And his father accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "I heard my father saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'On the top of every camel, there is a devil. So when you mount it, mention the name of Allah and do not neglect your needs.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: And his father accompanied the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, "I heard my father saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'On the top of every camel, there is a devil. So when you mount it, mention the name of Allah and do not neglect your needs.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَدْ صَحِبَ أَبُوهُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَى ذِرْوَةِ كُلِّ بَعِيرٍ شَيْطَانٌ فَإِذَا رَكِبْتُمُوهَا فَسَمُّوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُقَصِّرُوا عَنْ حَاجَاتِكُمْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd \u003e Muḥammad b. Ḥamzah b. ʿAmr al-Aslamī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْأَسْلَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2710

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ أَنْ تُتَّخَذَ الدَّوَابُّ كَرَاسِيَّ
chapter.englishTitle: In Prohibition of Animals Being Used as Chairs

hadiths.englishRaw: From his father, who was one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, it was narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Ride these animals gently and do not make them chairs."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: From his father, who was one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, it was narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Ride these animals gently and do not make them chairs."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «ارْكَبُوا هَذِهِ الدَّوَابَّ سَالِمَةً وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوهَا كَرَاسِيَّ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Shabābah b. Sawwār \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Sahl b. Muʿādh b. Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2711

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ أَنْ تُتَّخَذَ الدَّوَابُّ كَرَاسِيَّ
chapter.englishTitle: In Prohibition of Animals Being Used as Chairs

hadiths.englishRaw: "He contradicts youthfulness in something."
hadiths.body: "He contradicts youthfulness in something."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ يُخَالِفُ شَبَابَةَ فِي شَيْءٍ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth Illā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنْ اللَّيْثِ إِلَّا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2712

chapter.englishTitle: Travel is a piece of punishment.

hadiths.englishRaw: Travelling is a tortuous experience. It deprives a person of his sleep. his food and drink. When one of you has accomplished his purpose, he should hasten his return to his family.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: Travelling is a tortuous experience. It deprives a person of his sleep. his food and drink. When one of you has accomplished his purpose, he should hasten his return to his family.     – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «السَّفَرُ قِطْعَةٌ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ يَمْنَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ نَوْمَهُ وَطَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ فَإِذَا قَضَى أَحَدُكُمْ نَهْمَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهِ فَلْيُعَجِّلِ الرَّجْعَةَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Khālid b. Makhlad \u003e Mālik \u003e Sumay \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ سُمَيٍّ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2713

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا وَدَّعَ رَجُلًا
chapter.englishTitle: What to say when bidding farewell to a man

hadiths.englishRaw: A man came to the Prophet and said, "O Prophet of Allah, I intend to travel." The Prophet asked him, "When?" The man replied, "Tomorrow, if Allah wills." The Prophet said to him, "May Allah protect and shelter you. May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sins, and guide you towards goodness wherever you go or wherever you turn." Sa'id had doubt in one of these two words.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: A man came to the Prophet and said, "O Prophet of Allah, I intend to travel." The Prophet asked him, "When?" The man replied, "Tomorrow, if Allah wills." The Prophet said to him, "May Allah protect and shelter you. May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sins, and guide you towards goodness wherever you go or wherever you turn." Sa'id had doubt in one of these two words.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرِيدُ السَّفَرَ فَقَالَ لَهُ «مَتَى؟» قَالَ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ قَالَ فَأَتَاهُ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ «فِي حِفْظِ اللَّهِ وَفِي كَنَفِهِ زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ لَكَ ذَنْبَكَ وَوَجَّهَكَ لِلْخَيْرِ أَيْنَمَا تَوَخَّيْتَ أَوْ أَيْنَمَا تَوَجَّهْتَ» شَكَّ سَعِيدٌ فِي إِحْدَى الْكَلِمَتَيْنِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Kaʿb Abū al-Ḥasan al-ʿAbdī \u003e Mūsá b. Maysarah al-ʿAbdī \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي كَعْبٍ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْعَبْدِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ الْعَبْدِيُّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2714

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الدُّعَاءِ إِذَا سَافَرَ وَإِذَا قَدِمَ
chapter.englishTitle: In supplication when traveling and when arriving.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say” – and (one of the narrators) ‘Abdur-Rahim said: “he used to seek refuge” – “when he traveled: ‘Allahumma inni a’udhu bika min wa’tha’is-safar, wa ka’abatil-munqalab, wal-hawri ba’dal-kawr, wa da’watil-mazlum, wa su’il-manzari fil-ahli wal-mal (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the hardships of travel and the sorrows of return, from decrease after increase, from the prayer of the one who has been wronged, and seeing some calamity befall my family or wealth).’” (One of the narrators) Abu Mu’awiyah added: “And when he returned he said likewise.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to say” – and (one of the narrators) ‘Abdur-Rahim said: “he used to seek refuge” – “when he traveled: ‘Allahumma inni a’udhu bika min wa’tha’is-safar, wa ka’abatil-munqalab, wal-hawri ba’dal-kawr, wa da’watil-mazlum, wa su’il-manzari fil-ahli wal-mal (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the hardships of travel and the sorrows of return, from decrease after increase, from the prayer of the one who has been wronged, and seeing some calamity befall my family or wealth).’” (One of the narrators) Abu Mu’awiyah added: “And when he returned he said likewise.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا سَافَرَ قَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ وَالْحَوْرِ بَعْدَ الْكَوْرِ وَدَعْوَةِ الْمَظْلُومِ وَسُوءِ الْمَنْظَرِ فِي الْأَهْلِ وَالْمَالِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e al-Aḥwal \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Sarjis
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ هُوَ الْأَحْوَلُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2715

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الدُّعَاءِ إِذَا سَافَرَ وَإِذَا قَدِمَ
chapter.englishTitle: In supplication when traveling and when arriving.

hadiths.englishRaw: When the Prophet ﷺ wanted to travel, when he mounted his riding camel, he would say the Takbir three times and say: Glory is to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we were not able to do it. And, surely, to our Lord are we returning (Subḥān alladhī sakh-khara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn). Then he would say: “O Allah, I ask You in this journey of mine from the righteousness and piety and actions that which you are pleased with. O Allah, ease for us the path, and make near for us the distance of the land. O Allah, You are the companion in the journey, and the caretaker for the family. O Allah, accompany us in our journey, and take care of our families (Allāhumma innī as’aluka fī safarī hādhā minal-birri wat-taqwā, wa minal-ʿamali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin ʿalainal-masīra, waṭwi ʿannā buʿdal-arḍ. Allāhumma antaṣ-ṣāḥibu fis safari wal-khalīfatu fil-ahli. Allāhumma aṣḥabnā fī safarinā wakhlufnā fī ahlinā).” And when he would return to his family, he would say: “(We are) Returning, if Allah wills, repenting, worshipping, and to our Lord directing the praise (Ā’ibūna in shā’ Allāh, tā’ibūna ʿābidūna lirabbinā hāmidūn).”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When the Prophet ﷺ wanted to travel, when he mounted his riding camel, he would say the Takbir three times and say: Glory is to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we were not able to do it. And, surely, to our Lord are we returning (Subḥān alladhī sakh-khara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahū muqrinīn. Wa innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn). Then he would say: “O Allah, I ask You in this journey of mine from the righteousness and piety and actions that which you are pleased with. O Allah, ease for us the path, and make near for us the distance of the land. O Allah, You are the companion in the journey, and the caretaker for the family. O Allah, accompany us in our journey, and take care of our families (Allāhumma innī as’aluka fī safarī hādhā minal-birri wat-taqwā, wa minal-ʿamali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin ʿalainal-masīra, waṭwi ʿannā buʿdal-arḍ. Allāhumma antaṣ-ṣāḥibu fis safari wal-khalīfatu fil-ahli. Allāhumma aṣḥabnā fī safarinā wakhlufnā fī ahlinā).” And when he would return to his family, he would say: “(We are) Returning, if Allah wills, repenting, worshipping, and to our Lord directing the praise (Ā’ibūna in shā’ Allāh, tā’ibūna ʿābidūna lirabbinā hāmidūn).”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا سَافَرَ فَرَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ كَبَّرَ ثَلَاثًا وَيَقُولُ {سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ} [الزخرف 14] اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِي هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا السَّفَرَ وَاطْوِ لَنَا بُعْدَ الْأَرْضِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ اصْحَبْنَا فِي سَفَرِنَا وَاخْلُفْنَا فِي أَهْلِنَا بِخَيْرٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e ʿAlī b. ʿAbdullāh al-Bāriqī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَارِقِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2716

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الصُّعُودِ وَالْهُبُوطِ
chapter.englishTitle: What to say when ascending and descending

hadiths.englishRaw: We used to say "Allahu Akbar" when we ascended and "Subhanallah" when we descended.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We used to say "Allahu Akbar" when we ascended and "Subhanallah" when we descended.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّا إِذَا صَعِدْنَا كَبَّرْنَا وَإِذَا هَبَطْنَا سَبَّحْنَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Zubayd \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e Sālim \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2717

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of the bell

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The she-camel that has a bell is not accompanied by angels."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The she-camel that has a bell is not accompanied by angels."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْعِيرُ الَّتِي فِيهَا الْجَرَسُ لَا تَصْحَبُهَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Sālim \u003e Abū al-Jarrāḥ a freed slave of Am Ḥabībah \u003e Um Ḥabībah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَرَّاحِ مَوْلَى أَمِّ حَبِيبَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2718

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of the bell

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: The angels do not go with a travelling company in which there is a bell.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: The angels do not go with a travelling company in which there is a bell.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا تَصْحَبُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ رِفْقَةً فِيهَا كَلْبٌ أَوْ جَرَسٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Suhayl b. Abū Ṣāliḥ from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلُ بْنُ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2719

chapter.englishTitle: Prohibition of cursing animals

hadiths.englishRaw: ‘Imran bin Hussain said “The Prophet ﷺ was on a journey. He heard a curse. He asked “What is this? They (the people) said “This is so and so (a woman) who cursed her riding beast. The Prophet ﷺ said “Remove the saddle from it, for it is accursed. So, they removed (the saddle) from it. ‘Imran said “As if I am looking at it a grey she Camel.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ‘Imran bin Hussain said “The Prophet ﷺ was on a journey. He heard a curse. He asked “What is this? They (the people) said “This is so and so (a woman) who cursed her riding beast. The Prophet ﷺ said “Remove the saddle from it, for it is accursed. So, they removed (the saddle) from it. ‘Imran said “As if I am looking at it a grey she Camel.”     – Sound Chain
