hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ فَسَمِعَ لَعْنَةً فَقَالَ «مَا هَذَا؟» قَالُوا فُلَانَةُ لَعَنَتْ رَاحِلَتَهَا فَقَالَ «ضَعُوا عَنْهَا فَإِنَّهَا مَلْعُونَةٌ» قَالَ فَوَضَعُوا عَنْهَا قَالَ عِمْرَانُ «كَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا نَاقَةً وَرْقَاءَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Muhallab \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2720

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِلَّا وَمَعَهَا مَحْرَمٌ
chapter.englishTitle: A woman should not travel unless accompanied by a mahram.

hadiths.englishRaw: “No woman should travel the distance of three days or more, unless she is with her father, brother, son, husband or a Mahram.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “No woman should travel the distance of three days or more, unless she is with her father, brother, son, husband or a Mahram.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تُسَافِرِ الْمَرْأَةُ سَفَرًا ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَصَاعِدًا إِلَّا وَمَعَهَا أَبُوهَا أَوْ أَخُوهَا أَوْ زَوْجُهَا أَوْ ذُو مَحْرَمٍ مِنْهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2721

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِنَّ الْوَاحِدَ فِي السَّفَرِ شَيْطَانٌ
chapter.englishTitle: Indeed, the one traveling is a devil.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "If people knew the benefits of being alone, no traveler would ever feel lonely during the night."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "If people knew the benefits of being alone, no traveler would ever feel lonely during the night."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَا فِي الْوَحْدَةِ لَمْ يَسْرِ رَاكِبٌ بِلَيْلٍ وَحْدَهُ أَبَدًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Haytham b. Jamīl \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Muḥammad al-ʿUmarī from his father \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ جَمِيلٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْعُمَرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2722

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا
chapter.englishTitle: What does he say when he arrives at a house?

hadiths.englishRaw: “If anyone of you, when he stops to camp (while on a journey), says A’udhu bi kalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq (I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of that which He has created), then nothing will harm him in that place until he moves on.”
hadiths.body: “If anyone of you, when he stops to camp (while on a journey), says A’udhu bi kalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq (I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of that which He has created), then nothing will harm him in that place until he moves on.”
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْهُ
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Isḥāq And ʿAffān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAjlān \u003e Yaʿqūb b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ashaj \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Saʿd b. Mālik \u003e Khawlah b. Ḥakīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ وَعَفَّانُ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ حَكِيمٍ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2723

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ إِذَا نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the two prostrations, when one descends from a position

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to, when he stayed at a place, not depart from it until he offered two Rak'ahs (units of prayer) or bid farewell to the place by offering two Rak'ahs. Abdullah said: "Uthman bin Sa'd was weak."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to, when he stayed at a place, not depart from it until he offered two Rak'ahs (units of prayer) or bid farewell to the place by offering two Rak'ahs. Abdullah said: "Uthman bin Sa'd was weak."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «كَانَ إِذَا نَزَلَ مَنْزِلًا لَمْ يَرْتَحِلْ مِنْهُ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ يُوَدِّعَ الْمَنْزِلَ بِرَكْعَتَيْنِ» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «عُثْمَانُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ ضَعِيفٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿUthmān b. Saʿd \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2724

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنَ السَّفَرِ
chapter.englishTitle: What does he say when he returns from travel?

hadiths.englishRaw: That whenever the Prophet ﷺ would return from a trip, he would say: “(We are) Returning, repenting, worshipping, and to our Lord directing the praise (Ā’ibūna tā’būna ʿābidūna lirabbinā ḥāmidūn).”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That whenever the Prophet ﷺ would return from a trip, he would say: “(We are) Returning, repenting, worshipping, and to our Lord directing the praise (Ā’ibūna tā’būna ʿābidūna lirabbinā ḥāmidūn).”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا رَجَعَ مِنْ سَفَرِهِ قَالَ «آيِبُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e ʿAlī b. ʿAbdullāh al-Bāriqī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَارِقِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2725

chapter.englishTitle: The Prayer Before Sleep

hadiths.englishRaw: When you go to bed during night, you should say:" O Allah, I surrender myself to Thee and entrust my affair to Thee, with hope in Thee and fear of Thee. There is no resort and no deliverer (from hardship but Thou). I affirm my faith in the Book which Thou revealed and in the Messengers whom Thou sent." If you die in this state you would die on Fitra, and Ibn Bashshdr did not make a mention of" night" in this hadith.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: When you go to bed during night, you should say:" O Allah, I surrender myself to Thee and entrust my affair to Thee, with hope in Thee and fear of Thee. There is no resort and no deliverer (from hardship but Thou). I affirm my faith in the Book which Thou revealed and in the Messengers whom Thou sent." If you die in this state you would die on Fitra, and Ibn Bashshdr did not make a mention of" night" in this hadith.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَ رَجُلًا إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ «اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَى مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ فَإِنْ مَاتَ مَاتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Barāʾ b. ʿĀzib
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2726

chapter.englishTitle: The Prayer Before Sleep

hadiths.englishRaw: when any of you goes to his bed, he should dust his bedding with the inner extremity of his lower garment, for he does not know what has come on it since he left it. He should then lie down on his right side and say: In Thy name, my mercy on it, but if Thou lettest it go, guard it with that which Thou guardest Thy upright servants.
hadiths.body: when any of you goes to his bed, he should dust his bedding with the inner extremity of his lower garment, for he does not know what has come on it since he left it. He should then lie down on his right side and say: In Thy name, my mercy on it, but if Thou lettest it go, guard it with that which Thou guardest Thy upright servants.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَوَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْ فِرَاشَهُ بِدَاخِلَةِ إِزَارِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَدْرِي مَا خَلَفَهُ فِيهِ وَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Saʿīd al-Maqburī \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2727

chapter.englishTitle: In the remembrance (tasbih) at bedtime

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us one night and put his foot between me and Fatimah, and he taught us what to say when we went to bed. Thirty-three tasbeehah, thirty-three tahmeedah and thirty-four takbeerah. ʿAli ؓ said: I never omitted it after that. A man said to him: Not even on the night of Siffeen? said: Not even on the night of Siffeen.
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ came to us one night and put his foot between me and Fatimah, and he taught us what to say when we went to bed. Thirty-three tasbeehah, thirty-three tahmeedah and thirty-four takbeerah. ʿAli ؓ said: I never omitted it after that. A man said to him: Not even on the night of Siffeen? said: Not even on the night of Siffeen.
hadiths.arabic: أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى وَضَعَ قَدَمَهُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ فَاطِمَةَ فَعَلَّمَنَا مَا نَقُولُ إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا ثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ تَسْبِيحَةً وَثَلَاثًا وَثَلَاثِينَ تَحْمِيدَةً وَأَرْبَعًا وَثَلَاثِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً قَالَ عَلِيٌّ «فَمَا تَرَكْتُهَا بَعْدُ» فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ وَلَا لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ؟ قَالَ «وَلَا لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ»
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-ʿAwwām b. Ḥawshab \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْعَوَّامُ بْنُ حَوْشَبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2728

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا انْتَبَهَ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What does he say when he wakes up from his sleep?

hadiths.englishRaw: when the prophet (May peace be upon him) lay down on his bed (at night), he would say: O Allah! In Thy name I die and live. When he awoke, he said: praise be to Allah who has given us life after causing us to die and to whom we shall be resurrected.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: when the prophet (May peace be upon him) lay down on his bed (at night), he would say: O Allah! In Thy name I die and live. When he awoke, he said: praise be to Allah who has given us life after causing us to die and to whom we shall be resurrected.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَالَ «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Ribʿī b. Ḥirāsh \u003e Ḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2729

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا انْتَبَهَ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What does he say when he wakes up from his sleep?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever wakes up in the night and says, ‘None has the right to be worshiped but Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs the Dominion, and to Him is the praise, and He has power over all things. And Glory is to Allah, and all the praise is to Allah, and ‘None has the right to be worshiped but Allah, and Allah is the greatest, and there is no might nor power except by Allah (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shai'in qadīr. Wa subḥān Allah, walḥamdulillāh, wa lā ilāha illallāh, wa Allāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.)’ – then he said: ‘O my Lord, forgive me (Rabbighfirlī)’ – or he said – ‘then he supplicates, he shall be responded to. So he makes a firm determination, then performs Wudu', then he performs Salat, his Salat shall be accepted.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever wakes up in the night and says, ‘None has the right to be worshiped but Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs the Dominion, and to Him is the praise, and He has power over all things. And Glory is to Allah, and all the praise is to Allah, and ‘None has the right to be worshiped but Allah, and Allah is the greatest, and there is no might nor power except by Allah (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shai'in qadīr. Wa subḥān Allah, walḥamdulillāh, wa lā ilāha illallāh, wa Allāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.)’ – then he said: ‘O my Lord, forgive me (Rabbighfirlī)’ – or he said – ‘then he supplicates, he shall be responded to. So he makes a firm determination, then performs Wudu', then he performs Salat, his Salat shall be accepted.”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ تَعَارَّ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَقَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي أَوْ قَالَ ثُمَّ دَعَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ فَإِنْ عَزَمَ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى تُقُبِّلَتْ صَلَاتُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Ḥizāmī \u003e al-Walīd b. Muslim \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿUmayr b. Hāniʾ al-ʿAnsī \u003e Junādah b. Abū Umayyah \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحِزَامِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَيْرُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ الْعَنْسِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جُنَادَةُ بْنُ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2730

chapter.englishTitle: What does he say when he wakes up?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet ﷺ used to say when he woke up in the morning, 'We have reached the morning on the natural disposition of Islam, the word of sincerity, and the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , and the way of our father Abraham, who was a monotheist and a Muslim.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Prophet ﷺ used to say when he woke up in the morning, 'We have reached the morning on the natural disposition of Islam, the word of sincerity, and the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ , and the way of our father Abraham, who was a monotheist and a Muslim.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ «أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَدِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ وَمِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abzá from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبْزَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2731

chapter.englishTitle: What does he say when he wakes up?

hadiths.englishRaw: “Abu Bakr said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, command me with something that I may say when I reach morning and evening.’ He said: ‘Say: “O Allah Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek refuge from You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk (Allāhumma ʿālimal-ghaibi wash-shahādati fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shai’in wa malīkahu, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa min sharrish-shaiṭāni washirkihi).’” He said: ‘Say it when you reach morning, and evening, and when you go to bed.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Abu Bakr said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, command me with something that I may say when I reach morning and evening.’ He said: ‘Say: “O Allah Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except You, I seek refuge from You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Shaitan and his Shirk (Allāhumma ʿālimal-ghaibi wash-shahādati fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, rabba kulli shai’in wa malīkahu, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā anta, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa min sharrish-shaiṭāni washirkihi).’” He said: ‘Say it when you reach morning, and evening, and when you go to bed.’”    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مُرْنِي بِشَيْءٍ أَقُولُهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتُ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتُ قَالَ قُلْ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ قَالَ «قُلْهُ إِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ وَإِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ وَإِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2732

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا لَبِسَ ثَوْبًا
chapter.englishTitle: What does he say when he wears a robe?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever wears a garment and says, 'Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this and provided it for me without any effort or power on my part,' his previous sins will be forgiven."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever wears a garment and says, 'Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this and provided it for me without any effort or power on my part,' his previous sins will be forgiven."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ لَبِسَ ثَوْبًا فَقَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd al-Muqriʾ \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Abū Ayyūb \u003e Abū Marḥūm \u003e Sahl b. Muʿādh b. Anas from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْمُقْرِئُ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْحُومٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2733

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ
chapter.englishTitle: What to say when entering and when leaving the mosque

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When anyone of you enters the mosque, let him send peace upon the prophet, then let him say: "Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatika (O Allah, open to me the gates of Your mercy)." And when he leaves, let him say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlika. (O Allah, I ask of you from Your bounty)."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When anyone of you enters the mosque, let him send peace upon the prophet, then let him say: "Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatika (O Allah, open to me the gates of Your mercy)." And when he leaves, let him say: "Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlika. (O Allah, I ask of you from Your bounty)."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا دَخَلَ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَإِذَا خَرَجَ فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Sulaymān / Ibn Bilāl \u003e Rabīʿah \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Ḥumayd or Abū Usayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلَالٍ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ أَوْ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2734

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا دَخَلَ السُّوقَ
chapter.englishTitle: What does he say when he enters the market?

hadiths.englishRaw: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever enters the marketplace and says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Allah, Alone, without partner, to Him belongs the dominion, and to Him is all the praise, He gives life and causes death, He is Living and does not die, in His Hand is the good, and He has power over all things, (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, yuḥyī wa yumītu, wa huwa ḥayyun lā yamūtu, biyadihil-khairu, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr)’ Allah shall record a million good deeds for him, wipe a million evil deeds away from him, and raise a million ranks for him.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Whoever enters the marketplace and says: ‘There is none worthy of worship except Allah, Alone, without partner, to Him belongs the dominion, and to Him is all the praise, He gives life and causes death, He is Living and does not die, in His Hand is the good, and He has power over all things, (Lā ilāha illallāh, waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu, yuḥyī wa yumītu, wa huwa ḥayyun lā yamūtu, biyadihil-khairu, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr)’ Allah shall record a million good deeds for him, wipe a million evil deeds away from him, and raise a million ranks for him.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ دَخَلَ السُّوقَ فَقَالَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ حَسَنَةٍ وَمَحَا عَنْهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ سَيِّئَةٍ وَرَفَعَ لَهُ أَلْفَ أَلْفِ دَرَجَةٍ قَالَ فَقَدِمْتُ خُرَاسَانَ فَلَقِيتُ قُتَيْبَةَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُكَ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَحَدَّثْتُهُ فَكَانَ يَرْكَبُ فِي مَوْكِبِهِ فَيَأْتِي السُّوقَ فَيَقُومُ فَيَقُولُهَا ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Azhar b. Sinān \u003e Muḥammad b. Wāsiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ وَاسِعٍ قَالَ قَدِمْتُ مَكَّةَ فَلَقِيتُ بِهَا أَخِي سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2735

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي، وَلَا تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي
chapter.englishTitle: Call yourselves by my name, and do not hide behind my title.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Call yourselves by my name but do not call yourselves by my Kunyah."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Call yourselves by my name but do not call yourselves by my Kunyah."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلَا تََكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2736

chapter.englishTitle: In the beauty of names

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: On the Day of Resurrection you will be called by your names and by your father's names, so give yourselves good names.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: On the Day of Resurrection you will be called by your names and by your father's names, so give yourselves good names.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّكُمْ تُدْعَوْنَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِأَسْمَائِكُمْ وَأَسْمَاءِ آبَائِكُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا أَسْمَاءَكُمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān b. Muslim \u003e Hushaym \u003e Dāwud b. ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Zakariyyā al-Khuzāʿī \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَنْبَأَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّا الْخُزَاعِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2737

chapter.englishTitle: Preferred Names

hadiths.englishRaw: Your names which are dearest to Allah are ‘Abd Allah and ‘Abd al-Rahman.
hadiths.body: Your names which are dearest to Allah are ‘Abd Allah and ‘Abd al-Rahman.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَحَبُّ الْأَسْمَاءِ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e ʿAbayd Allāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2738

chapter.englishTitle: What is disliked among names.

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Prophet ﷺ forbade us from naming our servants with four names: Aflah, Nafi', Rabah, and Yasir.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That the Prophet ﷺ forbade us from naming our servants with four names: Aflah, Nafi', Rabah, and Yasir.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ نُسَمِّيَ أَرِقَّاءَنَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَسْمَاءٍ أَفْلَحُ وَنَافِعٌ وَرَبَاحٌ وَيَسَارٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e Muʿtamir \u003e al-Rukayn from his father \u003e Samurah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ الرُّكَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2739

chapter.englishTitle: In changing names

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said that she was called "Al-'Asiyah," and the Prophet ﷺ named her "Jamila."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said that she was called "Al-'Asiyah," and the Prophet ﷺ named her "Jamila."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ لَهَا عَاصِيَةُ فَسَمَّاهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ جَمِيلَةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibn Salamah \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ «أَنَّ أُمَّ عَاصِمٍ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2740

chapter.englishTitle: In changing names

hadiths.englishRaw: "The name of Zainab was Barrah, but the Prophet ﷺ renamed her Zainab."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The name of Zainab was Barrah, but the Prophet ﷺ renamed her Zainab."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ اسْمُ زَيْنَبَ بَرَّةَ فَسَمَّاهَا النَّبِيُّ ﷺ زَيْنَبَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Maymūnah \u003e Abū Rāfiʿ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2741

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ أَنْ يَقُولَ: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَشَاءَ فُلَانٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of saying: "Whatever Allah wills and whatever...

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man from the polytheists said to a Muslim man: 'What a noble people you are, if only you did not say 'whatever Allah wills and whatever Muhammad wills.' Then, the Prophet ﷺ heard and said: 'Do not say 'whatever Allah wills and whatever Muhammad wills,' instead say 'whatever Allah wills,' and then add 'and whatever Muhammad wills.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A man from the polytheists said to a Muslim man: 'What a noble people you are, if only you did not say 'whatever Allah wills and whatever Muhammad wills.' Then, the Prophet ﷺ heard and said: 'Do not say 'whatever Allah wills and whatever Muhammad wills,' instead say 'whatever Allah wills,' and then add 'and whatever Muhammad wills.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ نِعْمَ الْقَوْمُ أَنْتُمْ لَوْلَا أَنَّكُمْ تَقُولُونَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَشَاءَ مُحَمَّدٌ فَسَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَا تَقُولُوا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَشَاءَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَلَكِنْ قُولُوا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ شَاءَ مُحَمَّدٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Ribʿī b. Ḥirāsh \u003e al-Ṭufayl Akhī ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ عَنْ الطُّفَيْلِ أَخِي عَائِشَةَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2742

chapter.englishTitle: Not said to the grape: generosity

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not say that only the vineyard wall is generous, for the true generosity is found in a Muslim man."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not say that only the vineyard wall is generous, for the true generosity is found in a Muslim man."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَقُولُوا لِحَائِطِ الْعِنَبِ الْكَرْمُ إِنَّمَا الْكَرْمُ الرَّجُلُ الْمُسْلِمُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Ṣāliḥ b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Aʿraj \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2743

chapter.englishTitle: In playfulness

hadiths.englishRaw: There was a boy who would drive the Prophet's ﷺ camels. He said, "O Anjasha, drive slowly with the camels."   – Sound
hadiths.body: There was a boy who would drive the Prophet's ﷺ camels. He said, "O Anjasha, drive slowly with the camels."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ غُلَامٌ يَسُوقُ بِأَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «يَا أَنْجَشَةُ رُوَيْدًا سَوْقَكَ بِالْقَوَارِيرِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2744

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يَكْذِبُ لِيُضْحِكَ بِهِ الْقَوْمَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the one who lies to make people laugh

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Woe to him who tells things, speaking falsely, to make people laugh thereby. Woe to him! Woe to him!.    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: Woe to him who tells things, speaking falsely, to make people laugh thereby. Woe to him! Woe to him!.    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «وَيْلٌ لِلَّذِي يُحَدِّثُ فَيَكْذِبُ لِيُضْحِكَ بِهِ الْقَوْمَ وَيْلٌ لَهُ وَيْلٌ لَهُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Bahz b. Ḥakīm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَخْبَرَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2745

chapter.englishTitle: In poetry

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said that Umayyah ibn Abi Salt composed two poems about me. In the first, he described me as a man with a bull at his right foot and an eagle at his left, and a lion watching over him. The Prophet ﷺ said, "He spoke the truth." In the second poem, Umayyah described how the sun rises every night with a reddish hue that turns pink in the morning. Again, the Prophet ﷺ said, "He spoke the truth." Then someone said, "But his verses only bring us punishment and whipping." The Prophet ﷺ still said, "He spoke the truth."
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said that Umayyah ibn Abi Salt composed two poems about me. In the first, he described me as a man with a bull at his right foot and an eagle at his left, and a lion watching over him. The Prophet ﷺ said, "He spoke the truth." In the second poem, Umayyah described how the sun rises every night with a reddish hue that turns pink in the morning. Again, the Prophet ﷺ said, "He spoke the truth." Then someone said, "But his verses only bring us punishment and whipping." The Prophet ﷺ still said, "He spoke the truth."
hadiths.arabic: صدق النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أُمَيَّةَ بْنَ أَبِي الصَّلْتِ فِي بَيْتَيْنِ مِنَ شِعْرِهِ فَقَالَ [البحر الطويل] رَجُلٌ وَثَوْرٌ تَحْتَ رِجْلِ يَمِينِهِ وَالنَّسْرُ لِلْأُخْرَى وَلَيْثٌ مُرْصَدُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «صَدَقَ» قَالَ وَالشَّمْسُ تَطْلُعُ كُلَّ آخِرِ لَيْلَةٍ حَمْرَاءَ يُصْبِحُ لَوْنُهَا يَتَوَرَّدُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «صَدَقَ» فقَالَ قائل تَأْبَى فَمَا تَطْلُعُ لَنَا فِي رِسْلِهَا إِلَّا مُعَذَّبَةً وَإِلَّا تُجْلَدُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «صَدَقَ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbdah b. Sulaymān \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Yaʿqūb b. ʿUtbah \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2746

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ حِكْمَةً
chapter.englishTitle: In poetry lies wisdom

hadiths.englishRaw: In poetry there is wisdom.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: In poetry there is wisdom.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ مِنَ الشِّعْرِ حِكْمَةً»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ziyād \u003e Ibn Saʿd \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Hishām \u003e Marwān b. al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Aswad b. ʿAbd Yaghūth \u003e Ubay b. Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ زِيَادٍ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعْدٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ يَغُوثَ عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2747

chapter.englishTitle: That the belly of one of you is filled

hadiths.englishRaw: from his father that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is better that one of you fill his insides with puss than to fill it with poetry."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: from his father that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "It is better that one of you fill his insides with puss than to fill it with poetry."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَأَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ جَوْفُ أَحَدِكُمْ قَيْحًا أَوْ دَمًا خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ أَنْ يَمْتَلِئَ شِعْرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ḥanẓalah \u003e Sālim \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2748

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا، يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever Allah intends good for, He grants him understanding of t...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When Allah wills good for a person, He causes him to understand the religion.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'When Allah wills good for a person, He causes him to understand the religion.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Sulaymān \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd b. Abū Hind from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2749

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي الصِّحَّةِ وَالْفَرَاغِ
chapter.englishTitle: What came in health and leisure

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard Ibn ‘Abbas saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Two blessings which many people squander: Good health and free time.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard Ibn ‘Abbas saying that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: ‘Two blessings which many people squander: Good health and free time.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ الصِّحَّةَ وَالْفَرَاغَ نِعْمَتَانِ مِنْ نِعَمِ اللَّهِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Makkī b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ibn Saʿīd \u003e Abāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2750

chapter.englishTitle: In the preservation of hearing

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Whoever listens to the conversations of a people while they dislike him, it is poured into his ear."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said, "Whoever listens to the conversations of a people while they dislike him, it is poured into his ear."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنِ اسْتَمَعَ إِلَى حَدِيثِ قَوْمٍ وَهُمْ لَهُ كَارِهُونَ صُبَّ فِي أُذُنِهِ الْآنُكُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid / Ibn ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2751

chapter.englishTitle: In the preservation of hearing

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: “Do not follow one glance with another; you may be allowed the first but not the second.ʿ     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: “Do not follow one glance with another; you may be allowed the first but not the second.ʿ     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تُتْبِعِ النَّظْرَةَ النَّظْرَةَ فَإِنَّ الْأُولَى لَكَ وَالْآخِرَةَ عَلَيْكَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Salamah b. Abū al-Ṭufayl \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2752

chapter.englishTitle: In the preservation of the tongue

hadiths.englishRaw: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, tell me about an action in Islam that I will not have to seek anyone's help for." He said, "Fear Allah and be upright." I said, "Then what?" He pointed to his tongue and said.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, tell me about an action in Islam that I will not have to seek anyone's help for." He said, "Fear Allah and be upright." I said, "Then what?" He pointed to his tongue and said.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي بِعَمَلٍ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ لَا أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ أَحَدًا قَالَ «اتَّقِ اللَّهَ ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ» قَالَ قُلْتُ ثُمَّ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ؟ قَالَ فَأَشَارَ إِلَى لِسَانِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Sufyān from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2753

chapter.englishTitle: In the preservation of the tongue

hadiths.englishRaw: “I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, tell me of something that I can adhere to.’ He said: ‘Say: “Allah is my Lord,” then stand straight (adhere steadfastly to Islam).’ He said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, what is the thing that you fear most for me?’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took hold of his own tongue, then he said: ‘This.’”     – Sound
hadiths.body: “I said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, tell me of something that I can adhere to.’ He said: ‘Say: “Allah is my Lord,” then stand straight (adhere steadfastly to Islam).’ He said: ‘O Messenger of Allah, what is the thing that you fear most for me?’ The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took hold of his own tongue, then he said: ‘This.’”     – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مُرْنِي بِأَمْرٍ أَعْتَصِمُ بِهِ قَالَ «قُلْ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقِمْ» قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مَا أَكْثَرُ مَا تَخَوَّفُ عَلَيَّ؟ قَالَ فَأَخَذَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِلِسَانِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ «هَذَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ibrāhīm / Ibn Ismāʿīl b. Mujammiʿ \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Muʿādh \u003e Sufyān b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُجَمِّعٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2754

chapter.englishTitle: In the preservation of the tongue

hadiths.englishRaw: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, whose Islam is most virtuous?' He said: 'The one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, whose Islam is most virtuous?' He said: 'The one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُّ الْإِسْلَامِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Mālik b. Mighwal \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2755

chapter.englishTitle: In silence

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever is silent, he is saved."    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever is silent, he is saved."    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ صَمَتَ نَجَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUqbah \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Ḥubulī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr b. al-ʿĀṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2756

chapter.englishTitle: In Gheebah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: Messenger of Allah! What is back-biting? He replied: It is saying something about your brother which he would dislike. He was asked again: Tell me how the matter stands if what I say about my brother is true? He replied: If what you say of him is true, you have slandered him, and if what you say of him is not true, you have reviled him.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked: Messenger of Allah! What is back-biting? He replied: It is saying something about your brother which he would dislike. He was asked again: Tell me how the matter stands if what I say about my brother is true? He replied: If what you say of him is true, you have slandered him, and if what you say of him is not true, you have reviled him.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قِيلَ لَهُ مَا الْغِيبَةُ؟ قَالَ «ذِكْرُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ» قِيلَ وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي أَخِي مَا أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ «فَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ فَقَدِ اغْتَبْتَهُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ فَقَدْ بَهَتَّهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2757

chapter.englishTitle: In lying

hadiths.englishRaw: That Abdullah narrates Hadiths to the Prophet ﷺ who said: "Verily, the worst of narrators are those who narrate lies. Neither seriousness nor joking is permissible in lying. And a man promises his son, but does not fulfill it. Verily, truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. And lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire. It is said that the truthful person is truthful and righteous, and it is said that the liar is a liar and wicked. Indeed, a person will continue to be truthful until he is recorded with Allah as truthful, and he will lie until he is recorded with Allah as a liar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That Abdullah narrates Hadiths to the Prophet ﷺ who said: "Verily, the worst of narrators are those who narrate lies. Neither seriousness nor joking is permissible in lying. And a man promises his son, but does not fulfill it. Verily, truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. And lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire. It is said that the truthful person is truthful and righteous, and it is said that the liar is a liar and wicked. Indeed, a person will continue to be truthful until he is recorded with Allah as truthful, and he will lie until he is recorded with Allah as a liar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ إِنَّ شَرَّ الرَّوَايَا رَوَايَا الْكَذِبِ وَلَا يَصْلُحُ مِنَ الْكَذِبِ جِدٌّ وَلَا هَزْلٌ وَلَا يَعِدُ الرَّجُلُ ابْنَهُ ثُمَّ لَا يُنْجِزُ لَهُ إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ وَإِنَّ الْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ وَإِنَّهُ يُقَالُ لِلصَّادِقِ صَدَقَ وَبَرَّ وَيُقَالُ لِلْكَاذِبِ كَذَبَ وَفَجَرَ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَصْدُقُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ صِدِّيقًا وَيَكْذِبُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَذَّابًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Jarīr \u003e Idrīs al-Awdī \u003e Abū Isḥaq \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ إِدْرِيسَ الْأَوْدِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَقَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2758

chapter.englishTitle: In the preservation of the hand

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue and hands. And a Muhajir (emigrant) is the one who gives up (abandons) all what Allah has forbidden."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue and hands. And a Muhajir (emigrant) is the one who gives up (abandons) all what Allah has forbidden."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2759

chapter.englishTitle: In the goodness of food

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O you people! Indeed Allah is Tayyib (good) and he does not accept but what is good. And indeed Allah ordered the believers with what He ordered the Messengers. He ﷺ said: 'O you Messengers! Eat of the good things and do righteous deeds. Verily I am well acquainted with what you do (23:51).' And He said: 'O you who believe! Eat from the good things We have provided you (2:172).' He said: "And he mentioned a man: 'Who is undertaking a long journey, whose hair is dishevelled and he is covered with dust. He raises his hands to the heavens and says: "O Lord! O Lord!" Yet his food is from the unlawful, his drink is from the unlawful, his clothing is from the unlawful, and he was nourished by the unlawful. So how can that be accepted?'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "O you people! Indeed Allah is Tayyib (good) and he does not accept but what is good. And indeed Allah ordered the believers with what He ordered the Messengers. He ﷺ said: 'O you Messengers! Eat of the good things and do righteous deeds. Verily I am well acquainted with what you do (23:51).' And He said: 'O you who believe! Eat from the good things We have provided you (2:172).' He said: "And he mentioned a man: 'Who is undertaking a long journey, whose hair is dishevelled and he is covered with dust. He raises his hands to the heavens and says: "O Lord! O Lord!" Yet his food is from the unlawful, his drink is from the unlawful, his clothing is from the unlawful, and he was nourished by the unlawful. So how can that be accepted?'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ طَيِّبٌ لَا يَقْبَلُ إِلَّا الطَّيِّبَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ بِمَا أَمَرَ بِهِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ قَالَ {يَا أَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوا مِنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَاعْمَلُوا صَالِحًا إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ} [المؤمنون 51] وَقَالَ {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُلُوا مِنْ طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِلَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ} [البقرة 172] قَالَ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الرَّجُلَ يُطِيلُ السَّفَرَ أَشْعَثَ أَغْبَرَ يَمُدُّ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ وَمَطْعَمُهُ حَرَامٌ وَمَلْبَسُهُ حَرَامٌ وَمَشْرَبُهُ حَرَامٌ وَغُذِّيَ بِالْحَرَامِ فَأَنَّى يُسْتَجَابُ لِذَلِكَ؟   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Fuḍayl b. Marzūq \u003e ʿAdī b. Thābit \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ مَرْزُوقٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2760

chapter.englishTitle: What is enough from the world

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is sufficient for one of you to have a servant and a means of transportation from this worldly life."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "It is sufficient for one of you to have a servant and a means of transportation from this worldly life."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَكْفِي أَحَدَكُمْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا خَادِمٌ وَمَرْكَبٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mawalah \u003e Buraydah al-Aslamī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوَلَةَ عَنْ بُرَيْدَةَ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2761

chapter.englishTitle: In the Departure of the Righteous

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The righteous ones will depart first, while the rest will remain like the remnants of barley."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The righteous ones will depart first, while the rest will remain like the remnants of barley."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَذْهَبُ الصَّالِحُونَ أَسْلَافًا وَيَبْقَى حُثَالَةٌ كَحُثَالَةِ الشَّعِيرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Manṣūr \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Bayān \u003e Ibn Bishr al-Aḥmasī \u003e Qays \u003e Mirdās al-Aslamī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ بَيَانٍ هُوَ ابْنُ بِشْرٍ الْأَحْمَسِيُّ عَنْ قَيْسٍ عَنْ مِرْدَاسٍ الْأَسْلَمِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2762

chapter.englishTitle: In Maintaining Fasting

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of Sa'id Al-Maqburi, from Abu Huraira, from the Prophet ﷺ who said, "How many are the people who fast, but gain nothing from their fast except hunger and thirst, and how many are the people who stand in prayer, but gain nothing from their standing except sleeplessness."   – Sound
hadiths.body: On the authority of Sa'id Al-Maqburi, from Abu Huraira, from the Prophet ﷺ who said, "How many are the people who fast, but gain nothing from their fast except hunger and thirst, and how many are the people who stand in prayer, but gain nothing from their standing except sleeplessness."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ عَ نْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «كَمْ مِنْ صَائِمٍ لَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ صِيَامِهِ إِلَّا الظَّمَأُ وَكَمْ مِنْ قَائِمٍ لَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْ قِيَامِهِ إِلَّا السَّهَرُ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū al-Zinād \u003e ʿAmr b. Abū ʿAmr \u003e Saʿīd al-Maqburī ʿ n Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2763

chapter.englishTitle: In the preservation of prayer

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ that he mentioned prayer one day and said, "Whoever safeguards it, it will be a light, evidence, and salvation for him on the Day of Judgment. And whoever does not safeguard it, it will not be a light, nor salvation, nor evidence for him. He will be with Qarun, Pharaoh, Haman, and Ubay ibn Khalaf on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ that he mentioned prayer one day and said, "Whoever safeguards it, it will be a light, evidence, and salvation for him on the Day of Judgment. And whoever does not safeguard it, it will not be a light, nor salvation, nor evidence for him. He will be with Qarun, Pharaoh, Haman, and Ubay ibn Khalaf on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ الصَّلَاةَ يَوْمًا فَقَالَ «مَنْ حَافَظَ عَلَيْهَا كَانَتْ لَهُ نُورًا وَبُرْهَانًا وَنَجَاةً مِنَ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُحَافِظْ عَلَيْهَا لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ نُورًا وَلَا نَجَاةً وَلَا بُرْهَانًا وَكَانَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ قَارُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَانَ وَأُبَيِّ بْنِ خَلَفٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Abū Ayyūb \u003e Kaʿb b. ʿAlqamah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي كَعْبُ بْنُ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ هِلَالٍ الصَّدَفِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2764

chapter.englishTitle: In the Night Vigil

hadiths.englishRaw: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to encourage to perform the night prayer until he said, "Even if it is only one Rak'ah."   – Sound
hadiths.body: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to encourage to perform the night prayer until he said, "Even if it is only one Rak'ah."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَرْغَبُ فِي قِيَامِ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى قَالَ «وَلَوْ رَكْعَةً»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e Ḥusayn b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbbās \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2765

chapter.englishTitle: In repentance

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was harsh in the way I spoke to my family, but not to others. I mentioned that to the Prophet (saas) and he said: 'Why don't you ask for forgiveness? Ask Allah to forgive you, seventy times each day.'"     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "I was harsh in the way I spoke to my family, but not to others. I mentioned that to the Prophet (saas) and he said: 'Why don't you ask for forgiveness? Ask Allah to forgive you, seventy times each day.'"     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ فِي لِسَانِي ذَرَبٌ عَلَى أَهْلِي وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَعْدوُهُمْ إِلَى غَيْرِهِمْ فَسَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ «أَيْنَ أَنْتَ مِنَ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ؟ إِنِّي لَأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿUbayd b. ʿAmr Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e Ḥudhayfah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2766

chapter.englishTitle: In the fear of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , that he recited, "He is the owner of piety and forgiveness" [Al-Muddathir 56]. He said: "Your Lord says: I am the owner of piety, so whoever fears Me, I am worthy to forgive him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , that he recited, "He is the owner of piety and forgiveness" [Al-Muddathir 56]. He said: "Your Lord says: I am the owner of piety, so whoever fears Me, I am worthy to forgive him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَرَأَ {هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَى وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ} [المدثر 56] قَالَ قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ أَنَا أَهْلٌ أَنْ أُتَّقَى فَمَنِ اتَّقَانِي فَأَنَا أَهْلٌ أَنْ أَغْفِرَ لَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Salm b. Qutaybah \u003e Suhayl al-Quṭaʿī \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ سَلْمِ بْنِ قُتَيْبَةَ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ الْقُطَعِيِّ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2767

chapter.englishTitle: In the fear of Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, I know a verse that if people adhere to it, it would be sufficient for them. It is when their appointed term arrives, they are to either retain them according to acceptable terms or separate them according to acceptable terms and bring forth witnesses from among your men of justice. And establish the testimony for Allah. That is advised for whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, I know a verse that if people adhere to it, it would be sufficient for them. It is when their appointed term arrives, they are to either retain them according to acceptable terms or separate them according to acceptable terms and bring forth witnesses from among your men of justice. And establish the testimony for Allah. That is advised for whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنِّي لَأَعْلَمُ آيَةً لَوْ أَخَذَ بِهَا النَّاسُ لَكَفَتْهُمْ {فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ ذَلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْأخِرِ وَمَنْ يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا}
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Muʿtamir \u003e Kahmas b. al-Ḥasan \u003e Abū al-Salīl \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ كَهْمَسِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِي السَّلِيلِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2768

chapter.englishTitle: In the humiliations

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: ‘O ‘Aishah, beware of (evil) deeds that are regarded as insignificant, for they have a pursuer from Allah. (i.e. accountability).”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me: ‘O ‘Aishah, beware of (evil) deeds that are regarded as insignificant, for they have a pursuer from Allah. (i.e. accountability).”     – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَا عَائِشُ إِيَّاكِ وَمُحَقَّرَاتِ الذُّنُوبِ فَإِنَّ لَهَا مِنَ اللَّهِ طَالِبًا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Manṣūr b. Salamah \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Muslim b. Bānak \u003e ʿĀmir b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr \u003e ʿAwf b. al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ بَانَكَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2769

chapter.englishTitle: In Repentance

hadiths.englishRaw: “Every son of Adam commits sin, and the best of those who commit sin are those who repent.’”    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “Every son of Adam commits sin, and the best of those who commit sin are those who repent.’”    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «كُلُّ بَنِي آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlī b. Masʿadah al-Bāhilī \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ الْبَاهِلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2770

chapter.englishTitle: Allah is most pleased with the repentance of His servant

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man traveled in a barren land. He sat under a tree with his mount and provisions. He fell asleep, and when he woke up, he found his mount gone. He climbed a hill and saw nothing. He climbed another hill and saw nothing. He climbed another hill and saw nothing." He said: "Then, he turned around and saw his mount coming towards him, carrying its saddle. He felt more joy with it than if Allah had given him a repenting servant."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "A man traveled in a barren land. He sat under a tree with his mount and provisions. He fell asleep, and when he woke up, he found his mount gone. He climbed a hill and saw nothing. He climbed another hill and saw nothing. He climbed another hill and saw nothing." He said: "Then, he turned around and saw his mount coming towards him, carrying its saddle. He felt more joy with it than if Allah had given him a repenting servant."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «سَافَرَ رَجُلٌ فِي أَرْضٍ تَنُوفَةٍ» فَقَالَ «تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ وَمَعَهُ رَاحِلَتُهُ عَلَيْهَا زَادُهُ وَطَعَامُهُ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَقَدْ ذَهَبَتْ رَاحِلَتُهُ فَعَلَا شَرَفًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ عَلَا شَرَفًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ عَلَا شَرَفًا فَلَمْ يَرَ شَيْئًا» قَالَ «فَالْتَفَتَ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِهَا تَجُرُّ خِطَامَهَا فَمَا هُوَ بِأَشَدَّ فَرَحًا بِهَا مِنَ اللَّهِ بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ إِذَا تَابَ إِلَيْهِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Naḍr b. Shumayl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ibn Bashīr \u003e Samiʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ هُوَ ابْنُ بَشِيرٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2771

chapter.englishTitle: In Hope and Destiny

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew a square for us, then drew a line through the middle of it, and drew lines around it. He drew a line outside the square and said, "This person represents the middle line, and this circle encloses it. These lines represent the qualities. If one's line deviates, the others will correct it. And this hope is for the outside line."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew a square for us, then drew a line through the middle of it, and drew lines around it. He drew a line outside the square and said, "This person represents the middle line, and this circle encloses it. These lines represent the qualities. If one's line deviates, the others will correct it. And this hope is for the outside line."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَطَّ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ خَطًّا مُرَبَّعًا ثُمَّ خَطَّ وَسَطَهُ خَطًّا ثُمَّ خَطَّ حَوْلَهُ خُطُوطًا وَخَطَّ خَطًّا خَارِجًا مِنَ الْخَطِّ فَقَالَ «هَذَا الْإِنْسَانُ لِلْخَطِّ الْأَوْسَطِ وَهَذَا الْأَجَلُ مُحِيطٌ بِهِ وَهَذِهِ الْأَعْرَاضُ لِلْخُطُوطِ فَإِذَا أَخْطَأَهُ وَاحِدٌ نَهَشَهُ الْآخَرُ وَهَذَا الْأَمَلُ لِلْخَطِّ الْخَارِجِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Musaddad \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Sufyān from his father \u003e Abū Yaʿlá \u003e al-Rabīʿ b. Khuthaym \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي يَعْلَى عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2772

chapter.englishTitle: Two hungry wolves.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Two wolves free among sheep are no more destructive to them than a man's desire for wealth and honor is to his religion."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Two wolves free among sheep are no more destructive to them than a man's desire for wealth and honor is to his religion."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا ذِئْبَانِ جَائِعَانِ أُرْسِلَا فِي غَنَمٍ بِأَفْسَدَ لَهَا مِنْ حِرْصِ الْمَرْءِ عَلَى الْمَالِ وَالشَّرَفِ لِدِينِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Saʿd b. Zurārah \u003e Ibn Kaʿb b. Mālik from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2773

chapter.englishTitle: In having good thoughts about Allah.

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , Allah, the Most Blessed and Exalted, said: "I am as my servant thinks of me. So let him think of me as he wishes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , Allah, the Most Blessed and Exalted, said: "I am as my servant thinks of me. So let him think of me as he wishes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي فَلْيَظُنَّ بِي مَا شَاءَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak \u003e Hishām b. al-Ghāz \u003e Ḥayyān Abū al-Naḍr \u003e Wāthilah b. al-Asqaʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ الْغَازِ عَنْ حَيَّانَ أَبِي النَّضْرِ عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الْأَسْقَعِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2774

chapter.englishTitle: And warn your closest relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said, when the Verse: 'And warn your tribe (O Muhammad) of near kindred.' was revealed: 'O Quraish! Buy your souls from your Lord; I cannot avail you anything before Allah. O Banu 'Abdul-Muttalib! I cannot avail you anything before Allah. O 'Abbas bin 'Abdul-Muttalib! I cannot avail you anything before Allah. O Safiyyah, paternal aunt of the Messenger of Allah! I cannot avail you anything before Allah. O Fatimah bint Muhammad! Ask me for whatever you want, I cannot avail you anything before Allah.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said, when the Verse: 'And warn your tribe (O Muhammad) of near kindred.' was revealed: 'O Quraish! Buy your souls from your Lord; I cannot avail you anything before Allah. O Banu 'Abdul-Muttalib! I cannot avail you anything before Allah. O 'Abbas bin 'Abdul-Muttalib! I cannot avail you anything before Allah. O Safiyyah, paternal aunt of the Messenger of Allah! I cannot avail you anything before Allah. O Fatimah bint Muhammad! Ask me for whatever you want, I cannot avail you anything before Allah.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَامَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ حِينَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى {وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ} [الشعراء 214] فَقَالَ «يَا مَعْشَرَ قُرَيْشٍ اشْتَرُوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا يَا بَنِي عَبْدِ مَنَافٍ لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا يَا عَبَّاسُ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمُطَلِّبِ لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا يَا صَفِيَّةُ عَمَّةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا يَا فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ سَلِينِي مَا شِئْتِ لَا أُغْنِي عَنْكِ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʾAbū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2775

chapter.englishTitle: One's work does not save any of you.

hadiths.englishRaw: Observe moderation in deeds (and if it is not possible, try to be near moderation) and understand that none amongst you can attain salvation because of his deeds alone. They said: Messenger of Allah, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that Allah should wrap me in His Mercy and Grace.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Observe moderation in deeds (and if it is not possible, try to be near moderation) and understand that none amongst you can attain salvation because of his deeds alone. They said: Messenger of Allah, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that Allah should wrap me in His Mercy and Grace.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «قَارِبُوا وَسَدِّدُوا وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ لَنْ يُنْجِيَهُ عَمَلُهُ» قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَنْتَ؟ قَالَ «وَلَا أَنَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2776

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا وَمَعَهُ قَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Every one of you has a companion from the jinn with him.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is not one of you except that he has a companion from the jinn and a companion from the angels." They asked: "Even you?" He replied: "Yes, even me. But Allah has aided me against him, so he has submitted." Abu Muhammad said: "Among the people is someone who says, 'I have submitted' but he means, 'I have given up'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "There is not one of you except that he has a companion from the jinn and a companion from the angels." They asked: "Even you?" He replied: "Yes, even me. But Allah has aided me against him, so he has submitted." Abu Muhammad said: "Among the people is someone who says, 'I have submitted' but he means, 'I have given up'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا وَمَعَهُ قَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَقَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ» قَالُوا وَإِيَّاكَ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَإِيَّايَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ فَأَسْلَمُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد مِنَ النَّاسِ مَنْ يَقُولُ أَسْلَمَ اسْتَسْلَمَ يَقُولُ ذَلَّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd from his father \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2777

chapter.englishTitle: If you only knew what I know

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "If you knew that which I know, you would laugh little and weep much."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "If you knew that which I know, you would laugh little and weep much."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أَعْلَمُ لَضَحِكْتُمْ قَلِيلًا وَلَبَكَيْتُمْ كَثِيرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Mūsá b. Anas \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2778

chapter.englishTitle: If you only knew what I know

hadiths.englishRaw: A similar tradition has also been narrated by Anas from the Prophet ﷺ through a different chain of narrators.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A similar tradition has also been narrated by Anas from the Prophet ﷺ through a different chain of narrators.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِمِثْلِ هَذَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2779

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي هَوَانِ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: In the degradation of the world, upon Allah the Almighty

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ passed by a hollowed stump that its people had brought out. He said, "Do you think this is easy on its people?" They replied, "Yes." He said, "By Allah, the world is easier on Allah than this is on its people."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ passed by a hollowed stump that its people had brought out. He said, "Do you think this is easy on its people?" They replied, "Yes." He said, "By Allah, the world is easier on Allah than this is on its people."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مَرَّ بِسَخْلَةٍ جَرْبَاءَ قَدْ أَخْرَجَهَا أَهْلُهَا قَالَ «تُرَوْنَ هَذِهِ هَيِّنَةً عَلَى أَهْلِهَا؟» قَالُوا نَعَمْ قَالَ «وَاللَّهِ لَلدُّنْيَا أَهْوَنُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ هَذِهِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū al-Muhazzim \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَزِّمِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2780

chapter.englishTitle: Which actions are best?

hadiths.englishRaw: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ , "Which deeds are the best?" He replied, "Belief in Allah and striving in the cause of Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man asked the Prophet ﷺ , "Which deeds are the best?" He replied, "Belief in Allah and striving in the cause of Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ أَيُّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «إِيمَانٌ بِاللَّهِ وَجِهَادٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e Abū al-Murāwiḥ \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُرَاوِحِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2781

chapter.englishTitle: Which actions are best?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of deeds in the sight of Allah is to have faith without any doubt." Abu Muhammad Abu Jafar said, "A man from the Ansar said."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The best of deeds in the sight of Allah is to have faith without any doubt." Abu Muhammad Abu Jafar said, "A man from the Ansar said."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَفْضَلُ الْأَعْمَالِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ إِيمَانٌ لَا شَكَّ فِيهِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Jaʿfar \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2782

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what h...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2783

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what h...

hadiths.englishRaw: None of you is a believer until I am dearer to him than his child, his father, and the whole of mankind.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: None of you is a believer until I am dearer to him than his child, his father, and the whole of mankind.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وَالِدِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn And Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ وَهَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2784

chapter.englishTitle: Which of the believers is better?

hadiths.englishRaw: "O Messenger of Allah! Which of the people is the best?" He said: "He whose life is long and his deeds are good." He said: "Then which of the people is the worst?" He said: "He whose life is long and his deeds are bad."    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "O Messenger of Allah! Which of the people is the best?" He said: "He whose life is long and his deeds are good." He said: "Then which of the people is the worst?" He said: "He whose life is long and his deeds are bad."    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَيُّ النَّاسِ خَيْرٌ؟ قَالَ «مَنْ طَالَ عُمُرُهُ وَحَسُنَ عَمَلُهُ» قَالَ فَأَيُّ النَّاسِ شَرٌّ؟ قَالَ «مَنْ طَالَ عُمُرُهُ وَسَاءَ عَمَلُهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e ʿAlī b. Zayd b. Judʿān \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Bakrah \u003e Abū Bakrah \u003e a man
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ جُدْعَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2785

chapter.englishTitle: Which of the believers is better?

hadiths.englishRaw: "An Ali ibn Zaid with his Isnad (chain of narrators) similar to it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "An Ali ibn Zaid with his Isnad (chain of narrators) similar to it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ بِإِسْنَادِهِ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2786

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ آخِرِ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the last of this nation

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to Abu Jumah, a man from the Companions, "Tell us a hadith that you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He said, "Yes, I will narrate to you a good hadith. We had a meal with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah was also with us. Abu Ubaidah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , 'Is anyone better than us? We believed in you and fought alongside you.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, 'Yes, there will be people who come after you, who believe in me even though they have not seen me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to Abu Jumah, a man from the Companions, "Tell us a hadith that you heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ ." He said, "Yes, I will narrate to you a good hadith. We had a meal with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , and Abu Ubaidah ibn al-Jarrah was also with us. Abu Ubaidah asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , 'Is anyone better than us?
