We believed in you and fought alongside you.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, 'Yes, there will be people who come after you, who believe in me even though they have not seen me.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جُمُعَةَ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الصَّحَابَةِ حَدِّثْنَا حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ نَعَمْ أُحَدِّثُكَ حَدِيثًا جَيِّدًا تَغَدَّيْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَمَعَنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَّا؟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَجَاهَدْنَا مَعَكَ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ قَوْمٌ يَكُونُونَ مِنْ بَعْدِكُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِي وَلَمْ يَرَوْنِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Asīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Khālid b. Durayk \u003e Ibn Muḥayrīz \u003e Liʾabī Jumuʿah a man from al-Ṣaḥābah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَسِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ دُرَيْكٍ عَنْ ابْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2787

chapter.englishTitle: In the covenant of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: "It is not right for any one of you to say: 'I have forgotten such and such a verse.' Rather, he has been caused to forget. Study the Qur'an, for it escapes from the heart of man faster than a camel escapes from its fetter. "    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: "It is not right for any one of you to say: 'I have forgotten such and such a verse.' Rather, he has been caused to forget. Study the Qur'an, for it escapes from the heart of man faster than a camel escapes from its fetter. "    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ بِئْسَمَا لِأَحَدِكُمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ نَسِيتُ آيَةَ كَيْتَ وَكَيْتَ بَلْ هُوَ نُسِّيَ فَاسْتَذْكِرُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ أَسْرَعُ تَفَصِّيًا مِنْ صُدُورِ الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النَّعَمِ مِنْ عُقُلِهَا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbd al-Majīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2788

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ أَنْ يَقُولَ: أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى
chapter.englishTitle: No one should say: "I am better than Yunus bin Matta.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None of you should say that I am superior to Yunus bin Matta."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None of you should say that I am superior to Yunus bin Matta."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَا يَقُولَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿyam \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعْيَمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2789

chapter.englishTitle: Every Muslim has a charity

hadiths.englishRaw: "Every Muslim must give charity." It was said: "What if he cannot find (anything to give)? "He said: "Let him work with his hands and benefit himself and give in charity." It was said: "What if he cannot do that?" He said: "Let him help someone who is in desperate need." It was said: "What if he cannot do that?" He said: "Let him enjoin good." It was said: "What if he cannot do that? He said: "Let him refrain from doing evil, for that is an act of charity."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Every Muslim must give charity." It was said: "What if he cannot find (anything to give)? "He said: "Let him work with his hands and benefit himself and give in charity." It was said: "What if he cannot do that?" He said: "Let him help someone who is in desperate need." It was said: "What if he cannot do that?" He said: "Let him enjoin good." It was said: "What if he cannot do that? He said: "Let him refrain from doing evil, for that is an act of charity."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ صَدَقَةٌ» قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَوْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ؟ قَالَ «يَعْتَمِلُ بِيَدَيْهِ فَيَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ وَيَتَصَدَّقُ» قَالُوا أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ؟ قَالَ «يُعِينُ ذَا الْحَاجَةِ الْمَلْهُوفَ» قَالُوا أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ؟ قَالَ «يَأْمُرُ بِالْخَيْرِ» قَالُوا أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ؟ قَالَ «يُمْسِكُ عَنِ الشَّرِّ فَإِنَّهَا لَهُ صَدَقَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar al-Madāʾinī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Burdah from his father \u003e Abū Mūsá al-Ashʿarī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمَدَائِنِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2790

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ رَاءَى رَاءَى اللَّهُ بِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Whoever saw, Allah repays him for it.

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Whoever stands in a place of showing off and fame, Allah will expose him on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Whoever stands in a place of showing off and fame, Allah will expose him on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَنْ قَامَ مَقَامَ رِيَاءٍ وَسُمْعَةٍ رَاءَى اللَّهُ بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَسَمَّعَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah \u003e Abū Ṣakhr \u003e Makḥūl \u003e Abū Hind al-Dārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مَكْحُولًا يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هِنْدٍ الدَّارِيُّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2791

chapter.englishTitle: The example of the believer is like the example of a seed.

hadiths.englishRaw: Ka'b reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ said that the similitude of a believer is that of a standing crop in a field which is shaken by wind and then it comes to its original position but it stands at its roots. The similitude of a non-believer is that of a cypress tree which stands on its roots and nothing shakes it but it is uprooted (with) one (violent stroke).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ka'b reported that Messenger of Allah ﷺ said that the similitude of a believer is that of a standing crop in a field which is shaken by wind and then it comes to its original position but it stands at its roots. The similitude of a non-believer is that of a cypress tree which stands on its roots and nothing shakes it but it is uprooted (with) one (violent stroke).     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ مَثَلُ الْخَامَةِ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ تُفَيِّئُهَا الرِّيَاحُ تُعَدِّلُهَا مَرَّةً وَتُضْجِعُهَا أُخْرَى حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ الْمَوْتُ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَمَثَلِ الْأَرْزَةِ الْمُجْذِيَةِ عَلَى أَصْلِهَا لَا يُصِيبُهَا شَيْءٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ انْجِعَافُهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الْخَامَةُ الضَّعِيفُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Kaʿb \u003e Abīh Kaʿb b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2792

chapter.englishTitle: The world is green and sweet.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I asked the Messenger of Allah and he gave me, then I asked him and he gave me, then I asked him and he gave me. Then he said: This wealth is attractive and sweet. Whoever takes it without insisting, it will be blessed for him, and whoever takes it with avarice, it will not be blessed for him. He is like one who eats and is not satisfied. And the upper hand is better than the lower hand."'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I asked the Messenger of Allah and he gave me, then I asked him and he gave me, then I asked him and he gave me. Then he said: This wealth is attractive and sweet. Whoever takes it without insisting, it will be blessed for him, and whoever takes it with avarice, it will not be blessed for him. He is like one who eats and is not satisfied. And the upper hand is better than the lower hand."'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَعْطَانِي ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَأَعْطَانِي ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَأَعْطَانِي ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَا حَكِيمُ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَالَ خَضِرٌ حُلْوٌ فَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِسَخَاوَةِ نَفْسٍ بُورِكَ لَهُ فِيهِ وَمَنْ أَخَذَهُ بِإِشْرَافِ نَفْسٍ لَمْ يُبَارَكْ لَهُ فِيهِ وَكَانَ كَالَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَلَا يَشْبَعُ وَالْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʿUrwh b. al-Zubayr \u003e Ḥakīm b. Ḥizām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَعُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ حَكِيمَ بْنَ حِزَامٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2793

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَرِهَ لَكُمْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ
chapter.englishTitle: Indeed, Allah has disapproved of your gossipping

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited disrespecting daughters and disobeying mothers, and he also prohibited preventing others from giving and receiving, spreading gossip and excessive questioning, and squandering wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prohibited disrespecting daughters and disobeying mothers, and he also prohibited preventing others from giving and receiving, spreading gossip and excessive questioning, and squandering wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ وَأْدِ الْبَنَاتِ وَعُقُوقِ الْأُمَّهَاتِ وَعَنْ مَنْعٍ وَهَاتِ وَعَنْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ وَكَثْرَةِ السُّؤَالِ وَإِضَاعَةِ الْمَالِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr al-Raqqī \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e And Rrād a freed slave of al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الرَّقِّيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ وَرَّادٍ مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2794

chapter.englishTitle: In the misguided Imams

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said, "I fear only for my nation the misleading leaders."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said, "I fear only for my nation the misleading leaders."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّمَا أَخَافُ عَلَى أُمَّتِي الْأَئِمَّةَ الْمُضِلِّينَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū Asmāʾ \u003e Thawbān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2795

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: انْصُرْ أَخَاكَ ظَالِمًا أَوْ مَظْلُومًا
chapter.englishTitle: Support your brother, whether he is an oppressor or oppressed.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let a man help his brother, whether he is an oppressor or is oppressed. If he is the oppressor, he should prevent him from doing wrong, as this will be a support for him. If he is oppressed, he should help him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Let a man help his brother, whether he is an oppressor or is oppressed. If he is the oppressor, he should prevent him from doing wrong, as this will be a support for him. If he is oppressed, he should help him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لِيَنْصُرِ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ ظَالِمًا أَوْ مَظْلُومًا فَإِنْ كَانَ ظَالِمًا فَلْيَنْهَهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَهُ نُصْرَةٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ مَظْلُومًا فَلْيَنْصُرْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2796

chapter.englishTitle: Religion is advice

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Religion is sincerity (An-Nasihah).' They said: 'To whom, O Messenger of Allah? He said: 'To Allah, to His Book, to His Messenger, to the imams of the Muslims and to their common folk"'    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Religion is sincerity (An-Nasihah).' They said: 'To whom, O Messenger of Allah? He said: 'To Allah, to His Book, to His Messenger, to the imams of the Muslims and to their common folk"'    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ» قَالَ قُلْنَا لِمَنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Hishām b. Saʿd \u003e Zayd b. Aslam And Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ وَنَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2797

chapter.englishTitle: Indeed, Islam began as something strange

hadiths.englishRaw: “Islam began as something strange and will go back to being strange, so glad tidings to the strangers.” It was said: “Who are the strangers?’ He said: “Strangers who have left their families and tribes.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “Islam began as something strange and will go back to being strange, so glad tidings to the strangers.” It was said: “Who are the strangers?’ He said: “Strangers who have left their families and tribes.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ الْإِسْلَامَ بَدَأَ غَرِيبًا وَسَيَعُودُ غَرِيبًا أَظُنُّ حَفْصًا قَالَ فَطُوبَى لِلْغُرَبَاءِ» قِيلَ وَمَنِ الْغُرَبَاءُ؟ قَالَ «النُّزَّاعُ مِنَ الْقَبَائِلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2798

chapter.englishTitle: In the love of meeting Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Who-ever loves to meet Allah, Allah (too) loves to meet him and who-ever hates to meet Allah, Allah (too) hates to meet him". ʿAisha, or some of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ said, "But we dislike death." He said: It is not like this, but it is meant that when the time of the death of a believer approaches, he receives the good news of Allah's pleasure with him and His blessings upon him, and so at that time nothing is dearer to him than what is in front of him. He therefore loves the meeting with Allah, and Allah (too) loves the meeting with him. But when the time of the death of a disbeliever approaches, he receives the evil news of Allah's torment and His Requital, whereupon nothing is more hateful to him than what is before him. Therefore, he hates the meeting with Allah, and Allah too, hates the meeting with him."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Who-ever loves to meet Allah, Allah (too) loves to meet him and who-ever hates to meet Allah, Allah (too) hates to meet him". ʿAisha, or some of the wives of the Prophet ﷺ said, "But we dislike death." He said: It is not like this, but it is meant that when the time of the death of a believer approaches, he receives the good news of Allah's pleasure with him and His blessings upon him, and so at that time nothing is dearer to him than what is in front of him. He therefore loves the meeting with Allah, and Allah (too) loves the meeting with him. But when the time of the death of a disbeliever approaches, he receives the evil news of Allah's torment and His Requital, whereupon nothing is more hateful to him than what is before him. Therefore, he hates the meeting with Allah, and Allah too, hates the meeting with him."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ أَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ وَمَنْ كَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ كَرِهَ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ» فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ أَوْ بَعْضُ أَزْوَاجِهِ إِنَّا لَنَكْرَهُ الْمَوْتَ قَالَ «لَيْسَ ذَلِكَ وَلَكِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ بُشِّرَ بِرِضْوَانِ اللَّهِ وَكَرَامَتِهِ فَلَيْسَ شَيْءٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا أَمَامَهُ فَأَحَبَّ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ وَأَحَبَّ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ وَإِنَّ الْكَافِرَ إِذَا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ بُشِّرَ بِعَذَابِ اللَّهِ وَعُقُوبَتِهِ فَلَيْسَ شَيْءٌ أَكْرَهَ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا أَمَامَهُ فَكَرِهَ لِقَاءَ اللَّهِ وَكَرِهَ اللَّهُ لِقَاءَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas \u003e ʿUbādah b. al-Ṣāmit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2799

chapter.englishTitle: Amongst the Believers in Allah

hadiths.englishRaw: Verily. Allah would say on the Day of Resurrection: Where are those who have mutual love for My Glory's sake? Today I shall shelter them in My shadow when there is no other shadow but the shadow of Mine.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Verily. Allah would say on the Day of Resurrection: Where are those who have mutual love for My Glory's sake? Today I shall shelter them in My shadow when there is no other shadow but the shadow of Mine.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَيْنَ الْمُتَحَابُّونَ بِجَلَالِي؟ الْيَوْمَ أُظِلُّهُمْ فِي ظِلِّي يَوْمَ لَا ظِلَّ إِلَّا ظِلِّي   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Maʿmar \u003e Abū al-Ḥubāb Saʿīd b. Yasār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2800

chapter.englishTitle: No one of you wishes for death.

hadiths.englishRaw: "None of you should wish for death. Either he is a doer of good, so perhaps he may do more good, or he is an evildoer but perhaps he will give up his evil ways."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "None of you should wish for death. Either he is a doer of good, so perhaps he may do more good, or he is an evildoer but perhaps he will give up his evil ways."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ لَا يَتَمَنَّ أَحَدُكُمُ الْمَوْتَ إِمَّا مُحْسِنًا فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَزْدَادَ إِحْسَانًا وَإِمَّا مُسِيئًا فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَسْتَعْتِبَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū ʿUbayd a freed slave of ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAwf \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَخْبَرَنِي شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2801

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ كَهَاتَيْنِ»
chapter.englishTitle: In the saying of the Prophet ﷺ: "I have been sent and the Hour i...

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ said, "I was sent as a Messenger and the Hour is like these two," and Wahb gestured with his index and middle fingers.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ said, "I was sent as a Messenger and the Hour is like these two," and Wahb gestured with his index and middle fingers.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «بُعِثْتُ أَنَا وَالسَّاعَةُ كَهَاتَيْنِ» وَأَشَارَ وَهْبٌ بِالسَّبَّاحَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: And Hb b. Jarīr \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū al-Tayyāḥ \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2802

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «أَنْتُمْ آخِرُ الْأُمَمِ»
chapter.englishTitle: In the statement of the Prophet ﷺ : "You are the last of the na...

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘You complete seventy nations, of which you are the best and dearest to Allah.’”    – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: ‘You complete seventy nations, of which you are the best and dearest to Allah.’”    – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «إِنَّكُمْ وَفَّيْتُمْ سَبْعِينَ أُمَّةً أَنْتُمْ آخِرُهَا وَأَكْرَمُهَا عَلَى اللَّهِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Naḍr b. Shumayl \u003e Bahz b. Ḥakīm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2803

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtue of the Companions of Badr

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet (pbuh) said, "Where is so-and-so?" A man among them winked at him, so he said, "Indeed, he is here." Then the Prophet (pbuh) said, "Didn't he participate in the Battle of Badr?" They replied, "Yes." He then said, "Perhaps Allah looked favorably upon the people of Badr and said, 'Do as you please, for I have forgiven you.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet (pbuh) said, "Where is so-and-so?" A man among them winked at him, so he said, "Indeed, he is here." Then the Prophet (pbuh) said, "Didn't he participate in the Battle of Badr?" They replied, "Yes." He then said, "Perhaps Allah looked favorably upon the people of Badr and said, 'Do as you please, for I have forgiven you.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَيْنَ فُلَانٌ؟» فَغَمَزَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ وَإِنَّهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «أَلَيْسَ قَدْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا؟» قَالُوا بَلَى قَالَ فَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ اطَّلَعَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ فَقَالَ اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ فَقَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَكُمْ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2804

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: النَّهْيِ أَنْ يَقُولَ: مُطِرْنَا بِنَوْءِ كَذَا وَكَذَا
chapter.englishTitle: The prohibition of saying: "We have been rained upon by the will...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If Allah were to withhold rain from my nation for ten years and then send it down, a group from my nation would become disbelievers. They would say, 'It is due to the efforts of a fortunate individual.' It would be said to them, 'That individual is like a shining star known as Ad-Dabaran.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "If Allah were to withhold rain from my nation for ten years and then send it down, a group from my nation would become disbelievers. They would say, 'It is due to the efforts of a fortunate individual.' It would be said to them, 'That individual is like a shining star known as Ad-Dabaran.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لَوْ حَبَسَ اللَّهُ الْقَطْرَ عَنْ أُمَّتِي عَشْرَ سِنِينَ ثُمَّ أُنْزَلَهُ لَأَصْبَحَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي بِهَا كَافِرِينَ يَقُولُونَ هُوَ بِنَوْءِ مِجْدَحٍ يقَالَ الْمِجْدَحُ كَوْكَبٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ الدَّبَرَانُ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e ʿAttāb b. Ḥunayn \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عَتَّابِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2805

chapter.englishTitle: The reward of a good deed is ten times its likeness.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "A good deed is rewarded ten times its like."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "A good deed is rewarded ten times its like."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «الْحَسَنَةُ بِعَشْرِ أَمْثَالِهَا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Wāṣil a freed slave of Abū ʿUyaynah \u003e Bashhār b. Abū Sayf \u003e al-Walīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e ʿIyāḍ b. Ghuṭayf \u003e Ataynā Abū ʿUbaydah b. al-Jarrāḥ Naʿūduh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ وَاصِلٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ بَشَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي سَيْفٍ عَنْ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ غُطَيْفٍ قَالَ أَتَيْنَا أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ نَعُودُهُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2806

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا قِيلَ فِي ذِي الْوَجْهَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What was said about the two-faced person

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever has two-faced in this worldly life will have two tongues of fire on the Day of Judgment."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ said, "Whoever has two-faced in this worldly life will have two tongues of fire on the Day of Judgment."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ كَانَ ذَا وَجْهَيْنِ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَانَ لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لِسَانَانِ مِنْ نَارٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Rukayn \u003e Nuʿaym b. Ḥanẓalah \u003e Sharīk And Rubbamā \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Ḥanẓalah \u003e ʿAmmār
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ الرُّكَيْنِ عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ قَالَ شَرِيكٌ وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2807

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ لَعَنْتُهُ أَوْ سَبَبْتُهُ»
chapter.englishTitle: In the saying of the Prophet ﷺ , "Whichever man I have cursed o...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Allah, I am only a human, so whoever among the Muslims I have cursed or insulted or beaten, make it a means of prayer and mercy and closeness for him to You on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "O Allah, I am only a human, so whoever among the Muslims I have cursed or insulted or beaten, make it a means of prayer and mercy and closeness for him to You on the Day of Judgment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ فَأَيُّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ لَعَنْتُهُ أَوْ شَتَمْتُهُ أَوْ جَلَدْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْهَا لَهُ صَلَاةً وَرَحْمَةً وَقُرْبَةً تُقَرِّبُهُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Ziyād \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2808

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ لَعَنْتُهُ أَوْ سَبَبْتُهُ»
chapter.englishTitle: In the saying of the Prophet ﷺ , "Whichever man I have cursed o...

hadiths.englishRaw: This is a statement from the Prophet ﷺ : "There is no example like him except that he has 'zakat' (charity) and 'rahmah' (mercy) in him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This is a statement from the Prophet ﷺ : "There is no example like him except that he has 'zakat' (charity) and 'rahmah' (mercy) in him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِثْلَهُ إِلَّا أَنَّ فِيهِ «زَكَاةً وَرَحْمَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Numayr from his father \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2809

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «لَوْ أَنَّ لِي مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ ذَهَبًا»
chapter.englishTitle: In the saying of the Prophet ﷺ , "If I had the equivalent of Uh...

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "It does not please me that the mountain of Uhud be made of gold for me, but I die with only a dinar or half a dinar, except for debts to others."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "It does not please me that the mountain of Uhud be made of gold for me, but I die with only a dinar or half a dinar, except for debts to others."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنَّ جَبَلَ أُحُدٍ لِي ذَهَبًا أَمُوتُ يَوْمَ أَمُوتُ عِنْدِي دِينَارٌ أَوْ نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ إِلَّا لِغَرِيمٍ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Sūwayd b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُوَيْدَ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2810

chapter.englishTitle: In the epidemic.

hadiths.englishRaw: "You used to bring matters that are more meticulous in your eyes than hair. We used to count them during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from the destructive things." Then, it was mentioned to Muhammad ibn Sirin, and he said, "He spoke the truth, and I see the folds of the garment because of that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "You used to bring matters that are more meticulous in your eyes than hair. We used to count them during the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, from the destructive things." Then, it was mentioned to Muhammad ibn Sirin, and he said, "He spoke the truth, and I see the folds of the garment because of that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ أُمُورًا هِيَ أَدَقُّ فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ مِنَ الشَّعْرِ كُنَّا نَعُدُّهَا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْمُوبِقَاتِ» فَذُكِرَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي ابْنَ سِيرِينَ فَقَالَ «صَدَقَ فَأَرَى جَرَّ الْإِزَارِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Faḍl And Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibn Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Ḥumayd b. Hilāl \u003e ʿUbādah b. Qurṭ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ قُرْطٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2811

chapter.englishTitle: The fever from the breath of hell

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Fever is from the breath of Hellfire, so cool it down with water."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Fever is from the breath of Hellfire, so cool it down with water."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ أَوْ مِنْ فَوْرِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَبْرِدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān from his father \u003e ʿAbāyah b. Rifāʿah \u003e Rāfiʿ b. Khadīj
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2812

chapter.englishTitle: In English, it translates to: Disease as an Atonement.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no Muslim who is afflicted with a trial in his body except that Allah orders the angels who protect him to write for my servant, in every day and night, the same amount of good deeds that he used to do when he was not restricted in his movement."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no Muslim who is afflicted with a trial in his body except that Allah orders the angels who protect him to write for my servant, in every day and night, the same amount of good deeds that he used to do when he was not restricted in his movement."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يُصَابُ بِبَلَاءٍ فِي جَسَدِهِ إِلَّا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْحَفَظَةَ الَّذِينَ يَحْفَظُونَهُ فَقَالَ اكْتُبُوا لِعَبْدِي فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ مِثْلَ مَا كَانَ يَعْمَلُ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ مَا كَانَ مَحْبُوسًا فِي وِثَاقِي   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Marthad \u003e al-Qāsim b. Mukhaymirah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُخَيْمِرَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2813

chapter.englishTitle: The Patient's Fee

hadiths.englishRaw: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was having a bad cold, so I placed my hand on him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, indeed you have a severe cold." He replied, "Indeed, I have a cold just like two of you have." I said, "Is that because you will have double the reward?" He said, "Yes, for no Muslim is afflicted with any harm, whether it be an illness or something else, except that his sins are expiated as leaves fall from a tree."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was having a bad cold, so I placed my hand on him and said, "O Messenger of Allah, indeed you have a severe cold." He replied, "Indeed, I have a cold just like two of you have." I said, "Is that because you will have double the reward?" He said, "Yes, for no Muslim is afflicted with any harm, whether it be an illness or something else, except that his sins are expiated as leaves fall from a tree."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَهُوَ يُوعَكُ فَوَضَعْتُ يَدِي عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَتُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا فَقَالَ «إِنِّي أُوعَكُ كَمَا يُوعَكُ رَجُلَانِ مِنْكُمْ» قَالَ قُلْتُ ذَلِكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ أَجْرَيْنِ؟ قَالَ «أَجَلْ وَمَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى مَرَضٌ فَمَا سِوَاهُ إِلَّا حُطَّ عَنْهُ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ كَمَا تَحُطُّ الشَّجَرَةُ وَرَقَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm al-Taymī \u003e al-Ḥārith b. Sūwayd \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2814

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Sending Blessings Upon the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone invokes blessings on me once, Allah will bless him ten times.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: If anyone invokes blessings on me once, Allah will bless him ten times.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar al-Madanī \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2815

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Sending Blessings Upon the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ came one day while people could see joy on his face. It was said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, we can see joy on your face that we have never seen before." He replied, "Yes, indeed. An angel came to me and said, 'O Muhammad, your Lord says, "Does it please you that no one from your Ummah prays upon you except that I pray upon them tenfold, and no one salutes you except that I salute them tenfold?"' I said, 'Yes, indeed.'"
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ came one day while people could see joy on his face. It was said to him, "O Messenger of Allah, we can see joy on your face that we have never seen before." He replied, "Yes, indeed. An angel came to me and said, 'O Muhammad, your Lord says, "Does it please you that no one from your Ummah prays upon you except that I pray upon them tenfold, and no one salutes you except that I salute them tenfold?"' I said, 'Yes, indeed.'"
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَوْمًا وَهُوَ يُرَى الْبِشْرُ فِي وَجْهِهِ فَقِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا نَرَى فِي وَجْهِكَ بِشْرًا لَمْ نَكُنْ نَرَاهُ؟ قَالَ أَجَلْ إِنَّ مَلَكًا أَتَانِي فَقَالَ لِي يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقُولُ لَكَ أَمَا يُرْضِيكَ أَنْ لَا يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِكَ إِلَّا صَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا وَلَا يُسَلِّمَ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ عَشْرًا؟ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلَى
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Sulaymān a freed slave of al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Ṭalḥah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ مَوْلَى الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2816

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ
chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Sending Blessings Upon the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Allah (SWT) has angels who travel around on Earth conveying to me the Salams of my Ummah.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Allah (SWT) has angels who travel around on Earth conveying to me the Salams of my Ummah.'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَلَائِكَةً سَيَّاحِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يُبَلِّغُونِي عَنْ أُمَّتِي السَّلَامَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Zādhān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ زَاذَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2817

chapter.englishTitle: In the names of the Prophet ﷺ

hadiths.englishRaw: I am Muhammad and I am Ahmad, and I am al-Mahi (the obliterator) by whom unbelief would be obliterated, and I am Hashir (the gatherer) at whose feet mankind will be gathered, and I am 'Aqib (the last to come) after whom there will be no Prophet.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I am Muhammad and I am Ahmad, and I am al-Mahi (the obliterator) by whom unbelief would be obliterated, and I am Hashir (the gatherer) at whose feet mankind will be gathered, and I am 'Aqib (the last to come) after whom there will be no Prophet.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ إِنَّ لِي أَسْمَاءً أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَنَا أَحْمَدُ وَأَنَا الْمَاحِي الَّذِي يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِيَ الْكُفْرَ وَأَنَا الْحَاشِرُ الَّذِي يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى عَقِبِي وَأَنَا الْعَاقِبُ وَالْعَاقِبُ الَّذِي لَيْسَ بَعْدَهُ أَحَدٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Muḥammad b. Jubayr b. Muṭʿim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2818

chapter.englishTitle: Translate the following heading into English: "فِي السُّحْتِ?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "O Ka'b ibn 'Ujrah, surely flesh grown from unlawful sources will not enter Paradise."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "O Ka'b ibn 'Ujrah, surely flesh grown from unlawful sources will not enter Paradise."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ عُجْرَةَ إِنَّهُ لَنْ يَدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ لَحْمٌ نَبَتَ مِنْ سُحْتٍ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUthmān b. Khuthaym \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Sābiṭ \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2819

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الْمُؤْمِنِ يُؤْجَرُ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The believer is rewarded in everything

hadiths.englishRaw: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sitting, he laughed and said, "Will you not ask me what I am laughing at?" They asked, "What made you laugh?" He said, "I am amazed at the affair of a believer; all of his matters are good for him. If something good befalls him, he thanks Allah, which is good for him. And if something bad befalls him, he observes patience, which is also good for him. This is not the case for any person except a believer."
hadiths.body: While the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was sitting, he laughed and said, "Will you not ask me what I am laughing at?" They asked, "What made you laugh?" He said, "I am amazed at the affair of a believer; all of his matters are good for him. If something good befalls him, he thanks Allah, which is good for him. And if something bad befalls him, he observes patience, which is also good for him. This is not the case for any person except a believer."
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَالِسٌ إِذْ ضَحِكَ فَقَالَ «أَلَا تَسْأَلُونِي مِمَّا أَضْحَكُ؟» فَقَالُوا مِمَّ تَضْحَكُ؟ قَالَ عَجَبًا مِنْ أَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ كُلُّهُ لَهُ خَيْرٌ إِنْ أَصَابَهُ مَا يُحِبُّ حَمِدَ اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَكَانَ لَهُ خَيْرٌ وَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ مَا يَكْرَهُ فَصَبَرَ كَانَ لَهُ خَيْرٌ وَلَيْسَ كُلُّ أَحَدٍ أَمْرُهُ لَهُ خَيْرٌ إِلَّا الْمُؤْمِنَ
hadiths.chain: Abū Ḥātim al-Baṣrī \u003e Rawḥ Bin Aslam al-Baṣrī \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e Ṣuhayb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ هُوَ رَوْحُ بِنُ أَسْلَمَ الْبَصْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ أَنْبَأَنَا ثَابِتٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ صُهَيْبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2820

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَوْ كَانَ لِابْنِ آدَمَ وَادِيَانِ مِنْ مَالٍ
chapter.englishTitle: If the son of Adam had two valleys of wealth

hadiths.englishRaw: I hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I do not know whether something is being revealed to him or he is saying something; and he says, "If the son of Adam had a valley full of wealth, he would seek to have a second one, and nothing can fill the belly of the son of Adam except dust. Allah accepts the repentance of those who repent."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and I do not know whether something is being revealed to him or he is saying something; and he says, "If the son of Adam had a valley full of wealth, he would seek to have a second one, and nothing can fill the belly of the son of Adam except dust. Allah accepts the repentance of those who repent."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَسْمَعُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَا أَدْرِي أَشَيْءٌ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْ شَيْءٌ يَقُولُهُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ «لَوْ كَانَ لِابْنِ آدَمَ وَادِيَانِ مِنْ مَالٍ لَابْتَغَى إِلَيْهِمَا ثَالِثًا وَلَا يَمْلَأُ جَوْفَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلَّا التُّرَابُ وَيَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَى مَنْ تَابَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2821

chapter.englishTitle: In the prohibition of stories

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one should speak except a leader or someone in authority or a disputant." I said to Amr ibn Shuayb, "We used to hear someone affected (by a speech)." He said, "This is what I heard."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "No one should speak except a leader or someone in authority or a disputant." I said to Amr ibn Shuayb, "We used to hear someone affected (by a speech)." He said, "This is what I heard."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَقُصُّ إِلَّا أَمِيرٌ أَوْ مَأْمُورٌ أَوْ مُرَاءٍ» قُلْتُ لِعَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ مُتَكَلِّفٌ فَقَالَ هَذَا مَا سَمِعْتُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2822

chapter.englishTitle: In the license in the story

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "To sit in a gathering like this is dearer to me than freeing four slaves." I said, "Which gathering do you mean?" He said, "The gathering in which a man sits and narrates the virtues of his companions." Abu Muhammad (Muslim scholar) said, "The man from the Companions of Badr who was meant by the Prophet ﷺ is Ali."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: He heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, "To sit in a gathering like this is dearer to me than freeing four slaves." I said, "Which gathering do you mean?" He said, "The gathering in which a man sits and narrates the virtues of his companions." Abu Muhammad (Muslim scholar) said, "The man from the Companions of Badr who was meant by the Prophet ﷺ is Ali."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَأَنْ أَقْعُدَ فِي مِثْلِ هَذَا الْمَجْلِسِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُعْتِقَ أَرْبَعَ رِقَابٍ» قَالَ قُلْتُ أَنَا أَيَّ مَجْلِسٍ يَعْنِي؟ قَالَ كَانَ حِينَئِذٍ يَقُصُّ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ بَدْرٍ هُوَ عَلِيٌّ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Bukayr \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. Maysarah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كُرْدُوسًا وَكَانَ قَاصًّا يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2823

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَا يُلْدَغُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مِنْ جُحْرٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: The believer is not bitten from the same hole twice.

hadiths.englishRaw: “The believer should not be stung from the same hole twice.”    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: “The believer should not be stung from the same hole twice.”    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يُلْدَغُ الْمُؤْمِنُ مِنْ جُحْرٍ وَاحِدٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُقَيْلٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2824

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الشَّيْطَانِ يَجْرِي مِنَ ابْنِ آدَمَ مَجْرَى الدَّمِ
chapter.englishTitle: The Devil runs through the blood of the son of Adam

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not enter into private matters, for surely Satan runs through the human being like the flowing of blood." They asked, "And you also?" He said, "Yes, but Allah has helped me against him, so I have submitted."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Do not enter into private matters, for surely Satan runs through the human being like the flowing of blood." They asked, "And you also?" He said, "Yes, but Allah has helped me against him, so I have submitted."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا تَدْخُلُوا عَلَى الْمُغِيبَاتِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَجْرِي مِنَ ابْنِ آدَمَ كَمَجْرَى الدَّمِ» قَالُوا وَمِنْكَ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ فَأَسْلَمُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Mujālid \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e Jābir \u003e And Rubbamā Sakat \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ مُجَالِدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ وَرُبَّمَا سَكَتَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2825

chapter.englishTitle: In the greatest trials

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Who among the people experiences the most severe affliction?" He said, "The prophets, then the best, then the best. A man is tested according to his religious commitment, so if he is firm in his religion, his trials increase, and if he is weak in his religion, they are lightened for him. The affliction will continue for a servant until he walks on the earth with no sin to his account."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Who among the people experiences the most severe affliction?" He said, "The prophets, then the best, then the best. A man is tested according to his religious commitment, so if he is firm in his religion, his trials increase, and if he is weak in his religion, they are lightened for him. The affliction will continue for a servant until he walks on the earth with no sin to his account."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَشَدُّ بَلَاءً؟ قَالَ «الْأَنْبِيَاءُ ثُمَّ الْأَمْثَلُ فَالْأَمْثَلُ يُبْتَلَى الرَّجُلُ عَلَى حَسَبِ دِينِهِ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِي دِينِهِ صَلَابَةٌ زِيدَ صَلَابَةً وَإِنْ كَانَ فِي دِينِهِ رِقَّةٌ خُفِّفَ عَنْهُ وَلَا يَزَالُ الْبَلَاءُ بِالْعَبْدِ حَتَّى يَمْشِيَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مَا لَهُ خَطِيئَةٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Muṣʿab b. Saʿd \u003e Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2826

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «لَا تُطْرُونِي»
chapter.englishTitle: In the saying of the Prophet ﷺ: "Do not exceed limits with me

hadiths.englishRaw: ʿDo not praise me as the Christians praised 'Eesa bin Maryam عليه السلام. I am no more than the slave of Allah and His Messenger.ʿ     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: ʿDo not praise me as the Christians praised 'Eesa bin Maryam عليه السلام. I am no more than the slave of Allah and His Messenger.ʿ     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لَا تُطْرُونِي كَمَا تُطْرِي النَّصَارَى عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَلَكِنْ قُولُوا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Mālik \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2827

chapter.englishTitle: Verily, Allah has a hundred mercies.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Allah created mercy in one hundred parts and He retained with Him ninety-nine parts, and He has sent down upon the earth one part, and it is because of this one part that there is mutual love among the creation so much so that the animal lifts up its hoof from its young one, fearing that it might harm it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: Allah created mercy in one hundred parts and He retained with Him ninety-nine parts, and He has sent down upon the earth one part, and it is because of this one part that there is mutual love among the creation so much so that the animal lifts up its hoof from its young one, fearing that it might harm it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ «جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَةَ مِائَةَ جُزْءٍ فَأَمْسَكَ عِنْدَهُ تِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ وَأَنْزَلَ فِي الْأَرْضِ جُزْءًا وَاحِدًا فَمِنْ ذَلِكَ الْجُزْءِ يَتَرَاحَمُ الْخَلْقُ حَتَّى تَرْفَعَ الْفَرَسُ حَافِرَهَا عَنْ وَلَدِهَا خَشْيَةَ أَنْ تُصِيبَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2828

chapter.englishTitle: Who is concerned with goodness?

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , in what he narrates from his Lord, the Most High, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, your Lord is merciful. Whoever intends to perform a good deed but does not do it, a good deed will be recorded for him. And if he performs it, then ten to seven hundred times its reward will be recorded for him, and even more. And whoever intends to commit an evil deed but does not do it, a good deed will be recorded for him. And if he commits it, a single evil deed will be recorded for him, or it may be erased. And no one is destroyed except by the will of Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Messenger of Allah ﷺ , in what he narrates from his Lord, the Most High, he said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, your Lord is merciful. Whoever intends to perform a good deed but does not do it, a good deed will be recorded for him. And if he performs it, then ten to seven hundred times its reward will be recorded for him, and even more. And whoever intends to commit an evil deed but does not do it, a good deed will be recorded for him. And if he commits it, a single evil deed will be recorded for him, or it may be erased. And no one is destroyed except by the will of Allah."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِيمَا يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ ﷻ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ رَحِيمٌ مَنْ هَمَّ بِحَسَنَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةً فَإِنْ عَمِلَهَا كتِبَتْ لَهُ عَشْرًا إِلَى سَبْعِمِائَةٍ ضِعْفٍ إِلَى أَضْعَافٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَمَنْ هَمَّ بِسَيِّئَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا كُتِبَتْ لَهُ حَسَنَةً فَإِنْ عَمِلَهَا كُتِبَتْ وَاحِدَةً أَوْ يَمْحُوهَا وَلَا يَهْلِكُ عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا هَالِكٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Jaʿfar b. Sulaymān \u003e al-Jaʿd Abū ʿUthmān \u003e Abū Rajāʾ al-ʿUṭāridī \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا الْجَعْدُ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيَّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2829

chapter.englishTitle: A person is with the one they love.

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah! A man loves some people, but he cannot do work like their work. He replied; Yes, Abu Dharr, will be with those whom you love. Abu Dharr then repeated it. The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) also repeated it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah! A man loves some people, but he cannot do work like their work. He replied; Yes, Abu Dharr, will be with those whom you love. Abu Dharr then repeated it. The Messenger of Allah (May peace be upon him) also repeated it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ يُحِبُّ الْقَوْمَ ولَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ مِثْلَ عَمَلِهِمْ؟ قَالَ «أَنْتَ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ» قُلْتُ فَإِنِّي أُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ قَالَ «أَنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. Sulaymān \u003e Sulaymān b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ḥumayd b. Hilāl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ṣāmit \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2830

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا تَقَرَّبَ الْعَبْدُ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: When the servant approaches Allah the Almighty

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ from his Lord, he said: "O son of Adam, as long as you call upon Me and put your hope in Me, I will forgive you for whatever sins you have and I do not care. O son of Adam, if your sins were to reach the clouds of the sky and then you seek My forgiveness, I will forgive you and I do not care."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ from his Lord, he said: "O son of Adam, as long as you call upon Me and put your hope in Me, I will forgive you for whatever sins you have and I do not care. O son of Adam, if your sins were to reach the clouds of the sky and then you seek My forgiveness, I will forgive you and I do not care."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ قَالَ «يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ إِنَّكَ مَا دَعَوْتَنِي وَرَجَوْتَنِي غَفَرْتُ لَكَ عَلَي مَا كَانَ فِيكَ ابْنَ آدَمَ إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَلْقَانِي بِقُرَابِ الْأَرْضِ خَطَايَا لَقِيتُكَ بِقُرَابِهَا مَغْفِرَةً بَعْدَ أَنْ لَا تُشْرِكَ بِي شَيْئًا ابْنَ آدَمَ إِنَّكَ إِنْ تُذْنِبْ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ ذَنْبُكَ عَنَانَ السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ تَسْتَغْفِرُنِي أَغْفِرْ لَكَ وَلَا أُبَالِي»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Mahdī \u003e Ghaylān \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e Maʿdī Karib \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيٌّ حَدَّثَنَا غَيْلَانُ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ عَنْ مَعْدِي كَرِبَ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2831

chapter.englishTitle: In righteousness and sin.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ about virtue and vice. He said: Virtue is a kind disposition and vice is what rankles in your heart and that you disapprove that people should come to know of it.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I asked Messenger of Allah ﷺ about virtue and vice. He said: Virtue is a kind disposition and vice is what rankles in your heart and that you disapprove that people should come to know of it.     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ البر وَالْإِثْمِ فَقَالَ «الْبِرُّ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ وَالْإِثْمُ مَا حَاكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ وَكَرِهْتَ أَنْ يَعْلَمَهُ النَّاسُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e Ṣafwān \u003e Ibn ʿAmr \u003e Yaḥyá b. Jābir al-Qāḍī \u003e al-Nawwās b. Samʿān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ جَابِرٍ الْقَاضِي عَنْ النَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2832

chapter.englishTitle: In righteousness and sin.

hadiths.englishRaw: I asked the Prophet ﷺ, so he mentioned it in a similar way.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I asked the Prophet ﷺ, so he mentioned it in a similar way.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَذَكَرَ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Maʿn b. ʿĪsá \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Jubayr b. Nufayr from his father \u003e al-Nawwās b. Samʿān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ مَعْنِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ النَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2833

chapter.englishTitle: In good manners.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Fear Allah wherever you are, and follow up a bad deed with a good deed, as it will erase it, and treat people with good manners."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Fear Allah wherever you are, and follow up a bad deed with a good deed, as it will erase it, and treat people with good manners."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ḥabīb b. Abū Thābit \u003e Maymūn b. Abū Shabīb \u003e Abū Dhar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ أَبِي شَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2834

chapter.englishTitle: In good manners.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: The most perfect believer in respect of faith is he who is best of them in manners.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: The most perfect believer in respect of faith is he who is best of them in manners.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Abū Ayyūb \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAjlān \u003e al-Qaʿqāʿ b. Ḥakīm \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ الْقَعْقَاعِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2835

chapter.englishTitle: In kindness

hadiths.englishRaw: Allah is gentle, likes gentleness, and gives for gentleness what he does not give for harshness.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Allah is gentle, likes gentleness, and gives for gentleness what he does not give for harshness.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ وَيُعْطِي عَلَيْهِ مَا لَا يُعْطِي عَلَى الْعُنْفِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibn Salamah \u003e Yūnus And Ḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mughaffal
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ يُونُسَ وَحُمَيْدٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2836

chapter.englishTitle: In kindness

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah loves gentleness in all matters."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, Allah loves gentleness in all matters."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿUrwah \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2837

chapter.englishTitle: Whoever lost his sight and remained patient

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever causes the separation of his loved ones but remains patient and seeks reward, I guarantee him nothing less than Paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever causes the separation of his loved ones but remains patient and seeks reward, I guarantee him nothing less than Paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ أَذْهَبْتُ حَبِيبَتَيْهِ فَصَبَرَ وَاحْتَسَبَ لَمْ أَرْضَ لَهُ بِثَوَابٍ دُونَ الْجَنَّةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad al-Karmānī \u003e Jarīr \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْكَرْمَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2838

chapter.englishTitle: Injustice among the subjects

hadiths.englishRaw: Ubaidullah b Ziyad visited Ma'qil b. Yasir al-Muzani in his last iliness. Ma'qil said (to him): I am narrating to you a tradition I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. If I knew that I am to survive this illness. I would, not narrate it to you. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: If God appointed anyone ruler over a people and he died while he was still treacherous to his people, God would forbid his entry into Paradise.
hadiths.body: Ubaidullah b Ziyad visited Ma'qil b. Yasir al-Muzani in his last iliness. Ma'qil said (to him): I am narrating to you a tradition I heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. If I knew that I am to survive this illness. I would, not narrate it to you. I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: If God appointed anyone ruler over a people and he died while he was still treacherous to his people, God would forbid his entry into Paradise.
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ مَعْقِلٌ إِنِّي مُحَدِّثُكَ بِحَدِيثٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَوْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ لِي حَيَاةً ما حَدَّثْتُكَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَسْتَرْعِيهِ اللَّهُ رَعِيَّةً يَمُوتُ يَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَهُوَ غَاشٌّ لِرَعِيَّتِهِ إِلَّا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Abū al-Ashhab Jaʿfar b. Ḥayyān \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَشْهَبِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ أَنَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ زِيَادٍ عَادَ مَعْقِلَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2839

chapter.englishTitle: In obedience and commitment to the congregation

hadiths.englishRaw: The best of your rulers are those whom you love and who love you, upon whom you invoke God's blessings and who invoke His blessing upon you. And the worst of your rulers are those whom you hate and who hate you, who curse you and whom you curse. (Those present) said: Shouldn't we overthrow them at this? He said: No, as long as they establish prayer among you. No, as long as they establish prayer among you. Mind you! One who has a governor appointed over him and he finds that the governor indulges in an act of disobedience to God, he should condemn the governor's act, in disobedience to God, but should not withdraw himself from his obedience. Ibn Jabir said: Ruzaiq narrated to me this hadith. I asked him: Abu Miqdam, have you heard it from Muslim b. Qaraza or did he describe it to you and he heard it from 'Auf (b. Malik) and he transmitted this tradition of Messenger of Allah ﷺ? Upon this Ruzaiq sat upon his knees and facing the Qibla said: By Allah, besides Whom there is no other God, I heard it from Muslim b. Qaraza and he said that te had heard it from Auf (b. Malik) and he said that he had heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The best of your rulers are those whom you love and who love you, upon whom you invoke God's blessings and who invoke His blessing upon you. And the worst of your rulers are those whom you hate and who hate you, who curse you and whom you curse. (Those present) said: Shouldn't we overthrow them at this? He said: No, as long as they establish prayer among you. No, as long as they establish prayer among you. Mind you! One who has a governor appointed over him and he finds that the governor indulges in an act of disobedience to God, he should condemn the governor's act, in disobedience to God, but should not withdraw himself from his obedience. Ibn Jabir said: Ruzaiq narrated to me this hadith. I asked him: Abu Miqdam, have you heard it from Muslim b. Qaraza or did he describe it to you and he heard it from 'Auf (b. Malik) and he transmitted this tradition of Messenger of Allah ﷺ? Upon this Ruzaiq sat upon his knees and facing the Qibla said: By Allah, besides Whom there is no other God, I heard it from Muslim b. Qaraza and he said that te had heard it from Auf (b. Malik) and he said that he had heard it from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «خِيَارُ أَئِمَّتِكُمُ الَّذِينَ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَكُمْ وَتُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَشِرَارُ أَئِمَّتِكُمْ الَّذِينَ تُبْغِضُونَهُمْ وَيُبْغِضُونَكُمْ وَتَلْعَنُونَهُمْ وَيَلْعَنُونَكُمْ» قُلْنَا أَفَلَا نُنَابِذُهُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ؟ قَالَ «لَا مَا أَقَامُوا فِيكُمُ الصَّلَاةَ أَلَا مَنْ وُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَالٍ فَرَآهُ يَأْتِي شَيْئًا مِنْ مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ فَلْيَكْرَهْ مَا يَأْتِي مِنْ مَعْصِيَةِ اللَّهِ وَلَا يَنْزِعَنَّ يَدًا مِنْ طَاعَةٍ» قَالَ ابْنُ جَابِرٍ فَقُلْتُ آللَّهِ يَا أَبَا الْمِقْدَامِ آلله أَسَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ قَرَظَةَ؟ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ وَجَثَا عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ فَقَالَ اللَّه لَسَمِعْتُ هَذَا مِنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ قَرَظَةَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَمِّي عَوْفَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd b. Muslim \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd b. Jābir \u003e Zurayq b. Ḥayyān a freed slave of Banī Fazārah \u003e Muslim b. Qaraẓah al-Ashjaʿī \u003e ʿAwf b. Mālik al-Ashjaʿī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنْبَأَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زُرَيْقُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ مَوْلَى بَنِي فَزَارَةَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُسْلِمَ بْنَ قَرَظَةَ الْأَشْجَعِيَّ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَوْفَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الْأَشْجَعِيَّ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2840

chapter.englishTitle: Inflating the Images

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: The trumpet (sur) which will be blown.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: The trumpet (sur) which will be blown.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَنِ الصُّورِ فَقَالَ «قَرْنٌ يُنْفَخُ فِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Sulaymān al-Taymī \u003e Aslam al-ʿIjlī \u003e Bishr b. Shaghāf \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَسْلَمَ الْعِجْلِيِّ عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ شَغَافٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2841

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي شَأْنِ السَّاعَةِ وَنُزُولِ الرَّبِّ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning the Hour and the Descent of the Most High Lord

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Allah will hold the whole earth, and roll all the heavens up in His Right Hand, and then He will say, 'I am the King; where are the kings of the earth?"'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "Allah will hold the whole earth, and roll all the heavens up in His Right Hand, and then He will say, 'I am the King; where are the kings of the earth?"'    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ يَقْبِضُ اللَّهُ الْأَرْضَ وَيَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ بِيَمِينِهِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَنَا الْمَلِكُ أَيْنَ مُلُوكُ الْأَرْضِ؟   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2842

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي شَأْنِ السَّاعَةِ وَنُزُولِ الرَّبِّ تَعَالَى
chapter.englishTitle: Concerning the Hour and the Descent of the Most High Lord

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said: It was asked, "What is the praised station?" He replied, "That is the day when Allah, the Most High, descends to His throne, which will be narrow for Him as a new saddle is narrow for the one who mounts it. It will be as wide as the space between the heavens and the earth. You will be brought barefoot, naked, and uncircumcised. Ibrahim will be the first one to be clothed and he will say, 'O Allah, dress my close ones.' Then two white, oval-shaped garments from the garments of Paradise will be brought, and I will be clothed in them. Then I will stand to the right of Allah at a station that the earlier and later generations will envy."
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said: It was asked, "What is the praised station?" He replied, "That is the day when Allah, the Most High, descends to His throne, which will be narrow for Him as a new saddle is narrow for the one who mounts it. It will be as wide as the space between the heavens and the earth. You will be brought barefoot, naked, and uncircumcised. Ibrahim will be the first one to be clothed and he will say, 'O Allah, dress my close ones.' Then two white, oval-shaped garments from the garments of Paradise will be brought, and I will be clothed in them. Then I will stand to the right of Allah at a station that the earlier and later generations will envy."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ قِيلَ لَهُ مَا الْمَقَامُ الْمَحْمُودُ؟ قَالَ ذَاكَ يَوْمٌ يَنْزِلُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَلَى كُرْسِيِّهِ يَئِطُّ كَمَا يَئِطُّ الرَّحْلُ الْجَدِيدُ مِنْ تَضَايُقِهِ بِهِ وَهُوَ كَسَعَةِ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَيُجَاءُ بِكُمْ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلًا فَيَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُكْسَى إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى اكْسُوا خَلِيلِي فَيُؤْتَى بِرَيْطَتَيْنِ بَيْضَاوَيْنِ مِنْ رِيَاطِ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ أُكْسَى عَلَى أثْرِهِ ثُمَّ أَقُومُ عَنْ يَمِينِ اللَّهِ مَقَامًا يَغْبِطُنِي الْأَوَّلُونَ وَالْآخِرُونَ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Faḍl \u003e al-Ṣaʿq b. Ḥazn \u003e ʿAlī b. al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿUthmān b. ʿUmayr \u003e Abū Wāʾil \u003e Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا الصَّعْقُ بْنُ حَزْنٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2843

chapter.englishTitle: Looking towards Allah Exalted.

hadiths.englishRaw: "People asked the Prophet ﷺ, 'Will we see our Lord on the Day of Judgment?' The Prophet ﷺ replied, 'Do you have any difficulty in seeing the moon on a clear night when there are no clouds obscuring it?' They replied, 'No, O Messenger of Allah.' He then asked, 'Do you have any difficulty in seeing the sun when there are no clouds covering it?' They again replied, 'No.' He then said, 'Likewise, you will see Him in the same way.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "People asked the Prophet ﷺ, 'Will we see our Lord on the Day of Judgment?' The Prophet ﷺ replied, 'Do you have any difficulty in seeing the moon on a clear night when there are no clouds obscuring it?' They replied, 'No, O Messenger of Allah.' He then asked, 'Do you have any difficulty in seeing the sun when there are no clouds covering it?' They again replied, 'No.' He then said, 'Likewise, you will see Him in the same way.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّاسَ قَالُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ هل نَرَى رَبَّنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «هَلْ تُمَارُونَ فِي رُؤْيَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ لَيْسَ دُونَهُ سَحَابٌ؟» قَالُوا لَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ «فَهَلْ تُمَارُونَ فِي الشَّمْسِ لَيْسَ دُونَهَا سَحَابٌ؟» قَالُوا لَا قَالَ «فَإِنَّكُمْ تَرَوْنَهُ كَذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Yamān al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb b. Abū Ḥamzah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib And ʿAṭāʾ b. Yazīd al-Laythī \u003e Abū Hurayrah Akhbarahumā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَعَطَاءُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيُّ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ أَخْبَرَهُمَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2844

chapter.englishTitle: In the manner of gathering

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon and said, "O people, indeed you will be gathered barefoot, naked and uncircumcised before Allah, the Most High." Then he recited the verse, "Just as We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it." (Surah Al-Anbiya, 21:104)   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivered a sermon and said, "O people, indeed you will be gathered barefoot, naked and uncircumcised before Allah, the Most High." Then he recited the verse, "Just as We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it." (Surah Al-Anbiya, 21:104)   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقَالَ «يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّكُمْ تُحْشَرُونَ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلًا» ثُمَّ قَرَأَ {كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ} [الأنبياء 104]   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Mughīrah b. al-Nuʿmān \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2845

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي سُجُودِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: During the prostration of believers on the Day of Resurrection

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: When Allah gathers the servants in one plain, a caller will call on them so that every people will follow what they used to worship. So every people will follow what they used to worship, and only the people who were following falsehood would be left. Then, He will come to them and ask, "What happened to the people? Why did they leave you behind here?" They will reply, "We are waiting for our Lord." He will say, "Do you know Him?" They will reply, "Once He reveals Himself to us, we will recognize Him." Then, He will uncover His shin, and they will prostrate before Him. And that is the saying of Allah Almighty: "On the Day when the shin will be uncovered and they will be called to prostration but they will not be able." (Qur'an 68:42) Every hypocrite will remain unable to prostrate, and then he will be driven towards Hell.
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: When Allah gathers the servants in one plain, a caller will call on them so that every people will follow what they used to worship. So every people will follow what they used to worship, and only the people who were following falsehood would be left. Then, He will come to them and ask, "What happened to the people? Why did they leave you behind here?" They will reply, "We are waiting for our Lord." He will say, "Do you know Him?" They will reply, "Once He reveals Himself to us, we will recognize Him." Then, He will uncover His shin, and they will prostrate before Him. And that is the saying of Allah Almighty: "On the Day when the shin will be uncovered and they will be called to prostration but they will not be able." (Qur'an 68:42) Every hypocrite will remain unable to prostrate, and then he will be driven towards Hell.
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ إِذَا جَمَعَ اللَّهُ الْعِبَادَ فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ نَادَى مُنَادٍ لِيَلْحَقْ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ فَيَلْحَقُ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ وَيَبْقَى النَّاسُ عَلَى حَالِهِمْ فَيَأْتِيهِمْ فَيَقُولُ مَا بَالُ النَّاسِ ذَهَبُوا وَأَنْتُمْ هَا هُنَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ نَنْتَظِرُ إِلَهَنَا فَيَقُولُ هَلْ تَعْرِفُونَهُ؟ فَيَقُولُونَ إِذَا تَعَرَّفَ إِلَيْنَا عَرَفْنَاهُ فَيَكْشِفُ لَهُمْ عَنْ سَاقِهِ فَيَقَعُونَ سُجُودًا فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى {يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ} [القلم 42] يَبْقَى كُلُّ مُنَافِقٍ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ ثُمَّ يَقُودُهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Bazzāz \u003e Yūnus b. Bukayr \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e Saʿīd b. Yasār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْبَزَّازُ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2846

chapter.englishTitle: In intercession

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When Allah gathers the former and the latter, and he finishes judging between them, the believers will say, 'Our Lord has judged between us, so who will intercede for us with our Lord?' They will say, 'Go to Adam, for Allah created him with His own hands and spoke to him.' They will go to Adam and say, 'O Adam, you are the father of mankind, Allah created you with His own hands and spoke to you. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Adam will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember his sin and will feel embarrassed therewith. He will say, 'Go to Noah, for he is the first Messenger that Allah sent to the people of the earth.'
