They will go to Noah and say, 'O Noah, you are the first Messenger that Allah sent to the people of the earth, and Allah named you a thankful servant. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Noah will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember his appeal to his Lord to do something he had no knowledge of. He will feel embarrassed therewith and will say, 'Go to the Khalil of Allah, Abraham, for he is the Prophet and Allah spoke directly to him.' They will go to Abraham and say, 'O Abraham, you are the Prophet of Allah and His Khalil. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Abraham will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember how he lied three times. He will feel embarrassed therewith and will say, 'Go to Moses, for he is Allah's servant and His Messenger, and Allah spoke to him and gave him the Torah.' They will go to Moses and say, 'O Moses, you are Allah's Messenger, and Allah blessed you with His direct speech. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Moses will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember how he killed a person unintentionally and will feel embarrassed therewith, and he will say, 'Go to Jesus, for he is a servant and Messenger of Allah and His Word which He bestowed on Mary and a spirit created by Him.' They will go to Jesus and say, 'O Jesus, you are the Messenger of Allah and His Word which He bestowed on Mary and a spirit created by Him. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Jesus will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember how he asked his Lord for something he had no knowledge of and will feel embarrassed therewith and will say, 'Go to Muhammad, a servant to whom Allah has forgiven all his mistakes, past and future.' They will come to me, and I will go to ask permission from my Lord, and I will be allowed to enter into His presence. When I see Him, I will fall down in prostration before Him, and He will leave me thus, as long as He will. Then I will be addressed, 'Raise your head. Ask, and your request will be granted; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' I will raise my head and say, 'O Lord, my followers! My followers!' Allah will say, 'Go and take out of Hell (Fire) all those who have faith in their hearts, equal to the weight of a grain of barley.' I will go and do so and return to praise Him with the same praises, and fall down (prostrate) before Him. Then I will be addressed, 'Raise your head. Ask, and your request will be granted; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' I will say, 'O Lord, my followers! My followers!' It will be said, 'Go and take out of Hell (Fire) all those who have faith in their hearts, equal to the weight of a small ant or a mustard seed.' I will go and do so and return to praise Him with the same praises, and fall down (prostrate) before Him. Then I will be addressed, 'Raise your head. Ask, and your request will be granted. Intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' I will say, 'O Lord, my followers!' Then Allah will say, 'Go and take out (all) those in whose hearts there is faith even to the lightest, lightest mustard seed. (Take them) out of the Fire.' I will go and do so."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, "When Allah gathers the former and the latter, and he finishes judging between them, the believers will say, 'Our Lord has judged between us, so who will intercede for us with our Lord?' They will say, 'Go to Adam, for Allah created him with His own hands and spoke to him.' They will go to Adam and say, 'O Adam, you are the father of mankind, Allah created you with His own hands and spoke to you. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Adam will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember his sin and will feel embarrassed therewith. He will say, 'Go to Noah, for he is the first Messenger that Allah sent to the people of the earth.' They will go to Noah and say, 'O Noah, you are the first Messenger that Allah sent to the people of the earth, and Allah named you a thankful servant. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Noah will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember his appeal to his Lord to do something he had no knowledge of. He will feel embarrassed therewith and will say, 'Go to the Khalil of Allah, Abraham, for he is the Prophet and Allah spoke directly to him.' They will go to Abraham and say, 'O Abraham, you are the Prophet of Allah and His Khalil. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Abraham will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember how he lied three times. He will feel embarrassed therewith and will say, 'Go to Moses, for he is Allah's servant and His Messenger, and Allah spoke to him and gave him the Torah.' They will go to Moses and say, 'O Moses, you are Allah's Messenger, and Allah blessed you with His direct speech. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Moses will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember how he killed a person unintentionally and will feel embarrassed therewith, and he will say, 'Go to Jesus, for he is a servant and Messenger of Allah and His Word which He bestowed on Mary and a spirit created by Him.' They will go to Jesus and say, 'O Jesus, you are the Messenger of Allah and His Word which He bestowed on Mary and a spirit created by Him. Can you intercede for us with your Lord?' Jesus will say, 'I am not fit for this task.' He will remember how he asked his Lord for something he had no knowledge of and will feel embarrassed therewith and will say, 'Go to Muhammad, a servant to whom Allah has forgiven all his mistakes, past and future.' They will come to me, and I will go to ask permission from my Lord, and I will be allowed to enter into His presence. When I see Him, I will fall down in prostration before Him, and He will leave me thus, as long as He will. Then I will be addressed, 'Raise your head. Ask, and your request will be granted; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' I will raise my head and say, 'O Lord, my followers! My followers!' Allah will say, 'Go and take out of Hell (Fire) all those who have faith in their hearts, equal to the weight of a grain of barley.' I will go and do so and return to praise Him with the same praises, and fall down (prostrate) before Him. Then I will be addressed, 'Raise your head. Ask, and your request will be granted; intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' I will say, 'O Lord, my followers! My followers!' It will be said, 'Go and take out of Hell (Fire) all those who have faith in their hearts, equal to the weight of a small ant or a mustard seed.' I will go and do so and return to praise Him with the same praises, and fall down (prostrate) before Him. Then I will be addressed, 'Raise your head. Ask, and your request will be granted. Intercede, and your intercession will be accepted.' I will say, 'O Lord, my followers!' Then Allah will say, 'Go and take out (all) those in whose hearts there is faith even to the lightest, lightest mustard seed. (Take them) out of the Fire.' I will go and do so."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ إِذَا جَمَعَ اللَّهُ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ فَقَضَى بَيْنَهُمْ وَفَرَغَ مِنَ الْقَضَاءِ قَالَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ قَدْ قَضَى بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا فَمَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا؟ فَيَقُولُونَ انْطَلِقُوا إِلَى آدَمَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَهُ بِيَدِهِ وَكَلَّمَهُ فَيَأْتُونَهُ فَيَقُولُونَ قُمْ فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّنَا فَيَقُولُ آدَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِنُوحٍ فَيَأْتُونَ نُوحًا فَيَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَيَأْتُونَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فَيَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَى مُوسَى فَيَأْتُونَ مُوسَى فَيَدُلُّهُمْ عَلَى عِيسَى فَيَأْتُونَ عِيسَى فَيَقُولُ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ قَالَ فَيَأْتُونِي فَيَأْذَنُ اللَّهُ ﷻ لِي أَنْ أَقُومَ إِلَيْهِ فَيَثُورُ مَجْلِسِي أَطْيَبَ رِيحٍ شَمَّهَا أَحَدٌ قَطُّ حَتَّى آتِيَ رَبِّي فَيُشَفِّعَنِي وَيَجْعَلَ لِي نُورًا مِنْ شَعْرِ رَأْسِي إِلَى ظُفْرِ قَدَمِي فَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ لِإِبْلِيسَ قَدْ وَجَدَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ مَنْ يَشْفَعُ لَهُمْ فَقُمْ أَنْتَ فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا إِلَى رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ أَضْلَلْتَنَا قَالَ فَيَقُومُ فَيَثُورُ مَجْلِسُهُ أَنْتَنَ رِيحٍ شَمَّهَا أَحَدٌ قَطُّ ثُمَّ يَعْظُمُ لِجَهَنَّمَ فَيَقُولُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ {وَقَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ لَمَّا قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَعَدَكُمْ وَعْدَ الْحَقِّ وَوَعَدْتُكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُكُمْ} [إبراهيم 22] إِلَى آخِرِ الْآيَةِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ziyād \u003e Dukhayn al-Ḥajrī \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir al-Juhanī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنَا دُخَيْنٌ الْحَجْرِيُّ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2847

chapter.englishTitle: Every Prophet has a mission.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There is for every apostle a prayer, and I intend (if Allah so willed) that I would reserve my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: There is for every apostle a prayer, and I intend (if Allah so willed) that I would reserve my prayer for the intercession of my Ummah on the Day of Resurrection.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ دَعْوَةٌ وَأُرِيدُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنْ أَخْتَبِئَ دَعْوَتِي شَفَاعَةً لِأُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2848

chapter.englishTitle: Every Prophet has a mission.

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Dawud said “I heard Muhammad bin Isa narrating this tradition who said Mu’tamar narrated it to us. And he (Mu’tamar) said “ I heard Al Hakam bin Aban narrating this tradition. He did not mention the name of Ibn ‘Abbas. Abu Dawud said “Al Hussain bin Huraith wrote to me saying “Al Fadl bin Musa narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Dawud said “I heard Muhammad bin Isa narrating this tradition who said Mu’tamar narrated it to us. And he (Mu’tamar) said “ I heard Al Hakam bin Aban narrating this tradition. He did not mention the name of Ibn ‘Abbas. Abu Dawud said “Al Hussain bin Huraith wrote to me saying “Al Fadl bin Musa narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas to the same effect from the Prophet ﷺ.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAmr b. Abū Sufyān b. Asīd b. a neighboriyah Mithl Dhalik \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَسِيدِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2849

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: «يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ»
chapter.englishTitle: Seventy thousand from my nation will enter Paradise without bein...

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Seventy thousand from my Ummah will enter Paradise without any reckoning." Ukasha said, "O Messenger of Allah, supplicate to Allah to include me among them." The Prophet ﷺ supplicated, "O Allah, make him among them." Another person then requested the Prophet ﷺ to supplicate for him, but the Prophet ﷺ said, "Ukasha has surpassed you in this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Seventy thousand from my Ummah will enter Paradise without any reckoning." Ukasha said, "O Messenger of Allah, supplicate to Allah to include me among them." The Prophet ﷺ supplicated, "O Allah, make him among them." Another person then requested the Prophet ﷺ to supplicate for him, but the Prophet ﷺ said, "Ukasha has surpassed you in this."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ «يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ» فَقَالَ عُكَّاشَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ فَدَعَا فَقَالَ آخَرُ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لِي فَقَالَ «سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Muḥammad b. Ziyād \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2850

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ بِشَفَاعَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا»
chapter.englishTitle: In the saying of the Prophet ﷺ "Seventy thousand will enter Para...

hadiths.englishRaw: “More than (the members of the tribe of) Banu Tamim will enter Paradise through the intercession of a man from among my nation.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, besides you?” He said: “Besides me.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “More than (the members of the tribe of) Banu Tamim will enter Paradise through the intercession of a man from among my nation.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, besides you?” He said: “Besides me.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «لَيَدْخُلَنَّ الْجَنَّةَ بِشَفَاعَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي أَكْثَرُ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ» قَالُوا سِوَاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ «سِوَايَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Khālid \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Shaqīq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū al-Jadʿāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَدْعَاءِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2851

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ}
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Allah the Exalted: {The Day when the earth will...

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to Aisha, the mother of the believers, "What do you think about the saying of Allah, the Most High: 'On the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they will come forth before Allah, the One, the Prevailing' (Quran 14:48)? Where will the people be on that day?" She said, "I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that and he said, 'They will be on the Sirat.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to Aisha, the mother of the believers, "What do you think about the saying of Allah, the Most High: 'On the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they will come forth before Allah, the One, the Prevailing' (Quran 14:48)? Where will the people be on that day?" She said, "I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about that and he said, 'They will be on the Sirat.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِعَائِشَةَ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَرَأَيْتِ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى {يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ الْأَرْضُ غَيْرَ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَوَاتُ وَبَرَزُوا لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ} أَيْنَ النَّاسُ يَوْمَئِذٍ؟ قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «عَلَى الصِّرَاطِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Dāwud \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Masrūq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2852

chapter.englishTitle: In the depths of the fire

hadiths.englishRaw: "I asked Murrah Al-Hamdani about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Sublime is He: There is not one of you but will pass over it (19:71). So he narrated to me that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated to him saying: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The people will pass over the Fire, then they avert it based upon their deeds. The first of them (would pass over it) like a flash of lightening, then like the wind, then like a fleeing horse, then like a rider fleeing on a mount, then like a man fleeing, then like one walking."     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I asked Murrah Al-Hamdani about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Sublime is He: There is not one of you but will pass over it (19:71). So he narrated to me that 'Abdullah bin Mas'ud narrated to him saying: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The people will pass over the Fire, then they avert it based upon their deeds. The first of them (would pass over it) like a flash of lightening, then like the wind, then like a fleeing horse, then like a rider fleeing on a mount, then like a man fleeing, then like one walking."     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ {وَإِنْ مِنْكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا كَانَ عَلَى رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا} [مريم 71] فَحَدَّثَنِي أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ حَدَّثَهُمْ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَرِدُ النَّاسُ النَّارَ ثُمَّ يَصْدُرُونَ عَنْهَا بِأَعْمَالِهِمْ فَأَوَّلُهُمْ كَلَمْحِ الْبَرْقِ ثُمَّ كَالرِّيحِ ثُمَّ كَحُضْرِ الْفَرَسِ ثُمَّ كَالرَّاكِبِ فِي رَحْلِهِ ثُمَّ كَشَدِّ الرَّجُلِ ثُمَّ كَمَشْيِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e al-Suddī \u003e Saʾalt Murrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ السُّدِّيِّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ مُرَّةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2853

chapter.englishTitle: In the act of slaughter

hadiths.englishRaw: "Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said: Death will appear in the form of a dusty black-colored ram and will be stood between Paradise and Hell. It will be said to the people of Paradise, 'Do you recognize this?' They will look and say, 'Yes, it is death.' It will be said to the people of Hell, 'Do you recognize this?' They will look and say, 'Yes, it is death.' Then it will be announced that relief has come. It will be slaughtered and it will be said, 'Eternal life, with no more death.'   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said: Death will appear in the form of a dusty black-colored ram and will be stood between Paradise and Hell. It will be said to the people of Paradise, 'Do you recognize this?' They will look and say, 'Yes, it is death.' It will be said to the people of Hell, 'Do you recognize this?' They will look and say, 'Yes, it is death.' Then it will be announced that relief has come. It will be slaughtered and it will be said, 'Eternal life, with no more death.'   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ يُؤْتَى بِالْمَوْتِ كَكَبْشٍ أَغْبَرَ فَيُوقَفُ بَيْنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ فَيُقَالُ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ فَيَشْرَئِبُّونَ وَيَنْظُرُونَ وَيُقَالُ يَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ فَيَشْرَئِبُّونَ وَيَنْظُرُونَ وَيَرَوْنَ أَنْ قَدْ جَاءَ الْفَرَجُ فَيُذْبَحُ وَيُقَالُ خُلُودٌ لَا مَوْتَ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2854

chapter.englishTitle: In the warning of the fire

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivering a sermon and he said, "I have warned you against the Hellfire, I have warned you against the Hellfire, I have warned you against the Hellfire!" He kept repeating this statement so much that if I were in his place, I would have heard it as well as the people in the market until the garment that was on his feet fell off."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ delivering a sermon and he said, "I have warned you against the Hellfire, I have warned you against the Hellfire, I have warned you against the Hellfire!" He kept repeating this statement so much that if I were in his place, I would have heard it as well as the people in the market until the garment that was on his feet fell off."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ «أَنْذَرْتُكُمُ النَّارَ أَنْذَرْتُكُمُ النَّارَ أَنْذَرْتُكُمُ النَّارَ» فَمَا زَالَ يَقُولُهَا حَتَّى لَوْ كَانَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا لَسَمِعَهُ أَهْلُ السُّوقِ حَتَّى سَقَطَتْ خَمِيصَةٌ كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Simāk \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Bashīr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2855

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِيمَنْ قَالَ: إِذَا مُتُّ فَأَحْرِقُونِي بِالنَّارِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said, "If I die, burn me with fire"?

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "There was a servant among the servants of Allah who did not have any religion towards Allah. He lived until his old age, and there remained some time of his life. He realized that he did not produce any good deeds for Allah. So, he called his children and asked them, "What do you know about me?" They replied, "The best thing about you, O our father." He said, "I never leave any wealth with any of you except that I take it back from him, or you would do as I command you to do." He took a covenant from them and swore by his Lord that when he dies, they should burn him with fire until his body turns to ashes, then they should crush the ashes and scatter them in the wind." He did exactly as he instructed them. By the Lord of Muhammad, when he died, Allah brought him back in a better form than he had ever been. He was presented before his Lord, who asked him, "What made you enter the fire?" He replied, "I feared You, O Lord." Allah said, "Indeed, I have forgiven you, for I have heard your sincere repentance." Abu Muhammad (the narrator) commented, "He repented and turned to Allah sincerely."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying: "There was a servant among the servants of Allah who did not have any religion towards Allah. He lived until his old age, and there remained some time of his life. He realized that he did not produce any good deeds for Allah. So, he called his children and asked them, "What do you know about me?" They replied, "The best thing about you, O our father." He said, "I never leave any wealth with any of you except that I take it back from him, or you would do as I command you to do." He took a covenant from them and swore by his Lord that when he dies, they should burn him with fire until his body turns to ashes, then they should crush the ashes and scatter them in the wind." He did exactly as he instructed them. By the Lord of Muhammad, when he died, Allah brought him back in a better form than he had ever been. He was presented before his Lord, who asked him, "What made you enter the fire?" He replied, "I feared You, O Lord." Allah said, "Indeed, I have forgiven you, for I have heard your sincere repentance." Abu Muhammad (the narrator) commented, "He repented and turned to Allah sincerely."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ كَانَ عَبْدٌ مِنْ عِبَادِ اللَّهِ وَكَانَ لَا يَدِينُ لِلَّهِ دِينًا وَإِنَّهُ لَبِثَ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ مِنْهُ عُمُرٌ وَبَقِيَ عُمُرٌ فَعَلِمَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْتَئِرْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرًا فَدَعَا بَنِيهِ فَقَالَ أَيُّ أَبٍ تَعْلَمُونِي؟ قَالُوا خَيْرُهُ يَا أَبَانَا قَالَ فَإِنِّي لَا أَدَعُ عِنْدَ أَحَدٍ مِنْكُمْ مَالًا هُوَ مِنِّي إِلَّا أَخَذْتُهُ أَوْ لَتَفْعَلُنَّ مَا آمُرُكُمْ قَالَ فَأَخَذَ مِنْهُمْ مِيثَاقًا وَرَبِّي قَالَ أَمَّا أَنَا إِذَا مُتُّ فَخُذُونِي فَأَحْرِقُونِي بِالنَّارِ حَتَّى إِذَا كُنْتُ حُمَمًا فَدُقُّونِي ثُمَّ اذْرُونِي فِي الرِّيحِ قَالَ فَفَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَرَبِّ مُحَمَّدٍ حِينَ مَاتَ فَجِيءَ بِهِ أَحْسَنَ مَا كَانَ قَطُّ فَعُرِضَ عَلَى رَبِّهِ فَقَالَ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى النَّارِ؟ قَالَ خَشْيَتُكَ يَا رَبِّ قَالَ إِنِّي أَسْمَعُكَ لَرَاهِبًا قَالَ «فَتِيبَ عَلَيْهِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد يَبْتَئِرُ يَدَّخِرُ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-Naḍr b. Shumayl \u003e Bahz b. Ḥakīm from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2856

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّارَ فِي هِرَّةٍ
chapter.englishTitle: A woman entered the fire with a cat

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A woman entered the Hellfire because of a cat. It was said to her, 'Did you not feed it or give it water? And did you not let it eat from the scraps of the earth?   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A woman entered the Hellfire because of a cat. It was said to her, 'Did you not feed it or give it water? And did you not let it eat from the scraps of the earth?   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ دَخَلَتِ امْرَأَةٌ النَّارَ فِي هِرَّةٍ فَقِيلَ لَا أَنْتِ أَطْعَمْتِيهَا وَسَقَيْتِيهَا وَلَا أَنْتِ أَرْسَلْتِيهَا فَتَأْكُلَ مِنْ خَشَاشِ الْأَرْضِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Mālik \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَنْبَأَنَا مَالِكٌ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2857

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي شِدَّةِ عَذَابِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the severity of the punishment of the people of Hellfire

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Ninety-nine dragons will be set loose upon the disbeliever in his grave, devouring and biting him until the Day of Judgment. Even if one drop of these dragons' breath fell in the world, nothing green would ever grow again."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Ninety-nine dragons will be set loose upon the disbeliever in his grave, devouring and biting him until the Day of Judgment. Even if one drop of these dragons' breath fell in the world, nothing green would ever grow again."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يُسَلَّطُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِ فِي قَبْرِهِ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ تِنِّينًا تَنْهَشُهُ وَتَلْدَغُهُ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ وَلَوْ أَنَّ تِنِّينًا مِنْهَا نَفَخَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَا أَنْبَتَتْ خَضْرَاءَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Ayyūb b. Miqlāṣ a freed slave of Abū Hurayrah And Kunyatuh Abū Yaḥyá \u003e Darrāj Abū al-Samḥ \u003e Abū al-Haytham \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مِقْلَاصٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَكُنْيَتُهُ أَبُو يَحْيَى قَالَ سَمِعْتُ دَرَّاجًا أَبَا السَّمْحِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْهَيْثَمِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2858

chapter.englishTitle: In the valleys of Hell

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Verily, in Hellfire there is a valley called Habhab, wherein every tyrant will reside." So, beware of being among them.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Verily, in Hellfire there is a valley called Habhab, wherein every tyrant will reside." So, beware of being among them.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ فِي جَهَنَّمَ وَادِيًا يُقَالُ لَهُ هَبْهَبُ يَسْكُنُهُ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ» فَإِيَّاكَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنْهُمْ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Azhar b. Sinān \u003e Muḥammad b. Wāsiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَزْهَرُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ وَاسِعٍ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى بِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ أَبَاكَ حَدَّثَنِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2859

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُخْرِجُ اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّارِ بِرَحْمَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah takes out of the fire with His mercy

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "As for the people of the Fire, they will never die in the Fire. And as for some people from the people, the Fire will touch them according to the extent of their sins, so they will be burnt in it until when they become charcoal, they will be given permission for intercession. Then they will come out of the Fire as small pieces that will be scattered on the rivers of Paradise. The people of Paradise will be commanded: 'Pour water over them.'" He ﷺ said: "So they will pour water over them, and their flesh will grow back just as the seed grows in the flooded land."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "As for the people of the Fire, they will never die in the Fire. And as for some people from the people, the Fire will touch them according to the extent of their sins, so they will be burnt in it until when they become charcoal, they will be given permission for intercession. Then they will come out of the Fire as small pieces that will be scattered on the rivers of Paradise. The people of Paradise will be commanded: 'Pour water over them.'" He ﷺ said: "So they will pour water over them, and their flesh will grow back just as the seed grows in the flooded land."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَمَّا أَهْلُ النَّارِ الَّذِينَ هُمْ أَهْلُ النَّارِ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يَمُوتُونَ فِي النَّارِ وَأَمَّا نَاسٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَإِنَّ النَّارَ تُصِيبُهُمْ عَلَى قَدْرِ ذُنُوبِهِمْ فَيُحْرَقُونَ فِيهَا حَتَّى إِذَا صَارُوا فَحْمًا أُذِنَ فِي الشَّفَاعَةِ فَيَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ النَّارِ ضَبَائِرَ ضَبَائِرَ فَيُنْثَرُونَ عَلَى أَنْهَارِ الْجَنَّةِ فَيُقَالُ لِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ أَفِِيضُوا عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الْمَاءِ» قَالَ «فَيُفِيضُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَتَنْبُتُ لُحُومُهُمْ كَمَا تَنْبُتُ الْحِبَّةُ فِي حَمِيلِ السَّيْلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Saʿīd b. Yazīd Abū Maslamah \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2860

chapter.englishTitle: At the gates of paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ who said, "Paradise has eight gates."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ who said, "Paradise has eight gates."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لِلْجَنَّةِ ثَمَانِيَةُ أَبْوَابٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Hishām \u003e Sharīk
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ الثَّقَفِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي صَادِقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2861

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ يَدْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ لَا يَبُأسُ
chapter.englishTitle: Who enters paradise will not be distressed.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever enters Jannah (Paradise) will enjoy, and there will be no hardship for him. His garments will never wear out, and his youth will never fade. And he will have in Jannah that which no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no human heart has ever imagined.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever enters Jannah (Paradise) will enjoy, and there will be no hardship for him. His garments will never wear out, and his youth will never fade. And he will have in Jannah that which no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no human heart has ever imagined.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ يَنْعَمُ لَا يَبْؤُسُ لَا تَبْلَى ثِيَابُهُ وَلَا يَفْنَى شَبَابُهُ وَلَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Rāfiʿ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2862

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: لَمَوْضِعُ سَوْطٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا
chapter.englishTitle: The place of a whip in paradise is better than the world and eve...

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "The place of the whip of one of you in Paradise is better than the world and everything in it. And recite, if you wish, 'Every soul will taste death, and you will only be given your [full] compensation on the Day of Resurrection. So he who is drawn away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has attained [his desire]. And what is the life of this world except the enjoyment of delusion.'" [Quran 3:185]
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "The place of the whip of one of you in Paradise is better than the world and everything in it. And recite, if you wish, 'Every soul will taste death, and you will only be given your [full] compensation on the Day of Resurrection. So he who is drawn away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has attained [his desire]. And what is the life of this world except the enjoyment of delusion.'" [Quran 3:185]
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ لَمَوْضِعُ سَوْطِ أَحَدِكُمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا وَاقْرَؤوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ {كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ وَإِنَّمَا تُوَفَّوْنَ أُجُورَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَمَنْ زُحْزِحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ} [آل عمران 185] الْآيَةَ
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn Anbaʾnā Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأْنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2863
hadiths.englishRaw: "He heard Abu Huraira say, 'O Messenger of Allah, what is Jannah (Paradise) built of?' He said, 'Bricks made of gold and bricks made of silver, its mortar is made of musk, its stones are made of sapphire and pearls, and its soil is saffron. Whoever enters it will live there forever, enjoying eternal youth, and their garments will never wear out or become old.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "He heard Abu Huraira say, 'O Messenger of Allah, what is Jannah (Paradise) built of?' He said, 'Bricks made of gold and bricks made of silver, its mortar is made of musk, its stones are made of sapphire and pearls, and its soil is saffron. Whoever enters it will live there forever, enjoying eternal youth, and their garments will never wear out or become old.'"   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الْجَنَّةُ مَا بِنَاؤُهَا؟ قَالَ «لَبِنَةٌ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَلَبِنَةٌ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ مِلَاطُهَا الْمِسْكُ الْأَذْفَرُ وَحَصْبَاؤُهَا الْيَاقُوتُ وَاللُّؤْلُؤُ وَتُرَابُهَا الزَّعْفَرَانُ مَنْ يَدْخُلْهَا يَخْلُدْ فِيهَا يَنْعَمُ لَا يَبْؤُسُ لَا يَفْنَى شَبَابُهُمْ وَلَا تَبْلَى ثِيَابُهُمْ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Saʿdān al-Juhanī \u003e Abū Mujāhid \u003e Abū Mudillah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ الْجُهَنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي مُجَاهِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُدِلَّةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2864

chapter.englishTitle: In the Gardens of Paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The gardens of al-Firdaus are four, two of gold, adorned with their jewelry, utensils, and all that is within them, and two of silver, adorned with their jewelry, utensils, and all that is within them. There is nothing between the people and being able to see their Lord except for the garment of pride upon their faces in the gardens of Eden. And these rivers flow from the gardens of Eden in al-Jawbah, then they ascend after rivers." Abdullah said, "Al-Jawbah is something that the earth cannot contain."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The gardens of al-Firdaus are four, two of gold, adorned with their jewelry, utensils, and all that is within them, and two of silver, adorned with their jewelry, utensils, and all that is within them. There is nothing between the people and being able to see their Lord except for the garment of pride upon their faces in the gardens of Eden. And these rivers flow from the gardens of Eden in al-Jawbah, then they ascend after rivers." Abdullah said, "Al-Jawbah is something that the earth cannot contain."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَنَّاتُ الْفِرْدَوْسِ أَرْبَعٌ ثِنْتَانِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ حِلْيَتُهُمَا وَآنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا وَثِنْتَانِ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ حِلْيَتُهُمَا وَآنِيَتُهُمَا وَمَا فِيهِمَا وَلَيْسَ بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا رِدَاءُ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ وَهَذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَشْخُبُ مِنْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ فِي جَوْبَةٍ ثُمَّ تَصْعَدُ بَعْدُ أَنْهَارًا قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ جَوْبَةٌ مَا يُجَابُ عَنْهُ الْأَرْضُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Abū Qudāmah \u003e Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh b. Qays from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قُدَامَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2865

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي أَوَّلِ زُمْرَةٍ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the First Group, They Enter Paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, the first group from my Ummah to enter Paradise will be like the full moon on a clear night, then those who follow them will be like the brightest star in the sky." Ukashah stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me among them." The Prophet ﷺ said, "O Allah, make him among them." Then another man stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me among them." The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Ukashah has surpassed you in that."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, the first group from my Ummah to enter Paradise will be like the full moon on a clear night, then those who follow them will be like the brightest star in the sky." Ukashah stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me among them." The Prophet ﷺ said, "O Allah, make him among them." Then another man stood up and said, "O Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah to make me among them." The Prophet ﷺ replied, "Ukashah has surpassed you in that."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ أَوَّلَ زُمْرَةٍ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ عَلَى أَحْسَنِ كَوْكَبٍ إِضَاءَةً فِي السَّمَاءِ» فَقَامَ عُكَّاشَةُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ «اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ مِنْهُمْ» ثُمَّ قَامَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ «سَبَقَكَ بِهَا عُكَّاشَةُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2866

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُقَالُ لِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ إِذَا دَخَلُوهَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is said to the people of Paradise when they enter it

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the Prophet ﷺ: {And it will be said, "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."} [Al-A'raf 43] He said, 'Be glad, so as not to be saddened. Be generous, so as not to be stingy. Age gracefully, so as not to be weakened. And live eternally, so as not to die.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "From the Prophet ﷺ: {And it will be said, "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."} [Al-A'raf 43] He said, 'Be glad, so as not to be saddened. Be generous, so as not to be stingy. Age gracefully, so as not to be weakened. And live eternally, so as not to die.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ {وَنُودُوا أَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ} [الأعراف 43] قَالَ نُودُوا أن صِحُّوا فَلَا تَسْقَمُوا وَانْعَمُوا فَلَا تَبْأسُوا وَشِبُّوا فَلَا تَهْرَمُوا وَاخْلُدُوا فَلَا تَمُوتُوا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbayd b. Yaʿīsh \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ādam \u003e Ḥamzah b. Ḥabīb \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Aghar \u003e Abū Hurayrah And ʾAbī Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْأَغَرِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَأَبِي سَعِيدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2867

chapter.englishTitle: In the People of Paradise and its Delights

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, a man from the people of Paradise will be given the strength of a hundred men in eating, drinking, intercourse, and desire." A man from the Jews then said, "Will he still have the need to eat and drink?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Sweat will pour from his skin, and when his stomach is full, it will be sealed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, a man from the people of Paradise will be given the strength of a hundred men in eating, drinking, intercourse, and desire." A man from the Jews then said, "Will he still have the need to eat and drink?" The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied, "Sweat will pour from his skin, and when his stomach is full, it will be sealed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ لَيُعْطَى قُوَّةَ مِائَةِ رَجُلٍ فِي الْأَكْلِ وَالشُّرْبِ وَالْجِمَاعِ وَالشَّهْوَةِ» فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ إِنَّ الَّذِي يَأْكُلُ وَيَشْرَبُ تَكُونُ مِنْهُ الْحَاجَةُ؟ فَقَالَ «يَفِيضُ مِنْ جِلْدِهِ عَرَقٌ فَإِذَا بَطْنُهُ قَدْ ضَمَرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Thumāmah b. ʿUqbah al-Muḥallimī \u003e Zayd b. Arqam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ الْمُحَلِّمِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ أَرْقَمَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2868

chapter.englishTitle: In the People of Paradise and its Delights

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The people of Jannah (Paradise) are young, hairless, and pure, with kohl that never fades and youth that never diminishes."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The people of Jannah (Paradise) are young, hairless, and pure, with kohl that never fades and youth that never diminishes."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ شَبَابٌ جُرْدٌ مُرْدٌ كُحْلٌ لَا تَبْلَى ثِيَابُهُمْ وَلَا يَفْنَى شَبَابُهُمْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd al-Rifāʿī \u003e Muʿādh Yʿanī Ibn Hishām from his father \u003e ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرِّفَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ يْعَنِي ابْنَ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2869

chapter.englishTitle: In the People of Paradise and its Delights

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ, he said: Yes, the people of Paradise do not urinate, defecate, or pass gas. This will be replaced with a discharge that they eat and drink from, and it inspires them to recite the glorification and praise of Allah as naturally as breathing.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ, he said: Yes, the people of Paradise do not urinate, defecate, or pass gas. This will be replaced with a discharge that they eat and drink from, and it inspires them to recite the glorification and praise of Allah as naturally as breathing.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ؟ قَالَ نَعَمْ «أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ لَا يَبُولُونَ وَلَا يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلَا يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَيَكُونُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُمْ جُشَاءً يَأْكُلُونَ وَيَشْرَبُونَ وَيُلْهَمُونَ التَّسْبِيحَ وَالْحَمْدَ كَمَا يُلْهَمُونَ النَّفَسَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir Qīl Liʾabī ʿĀṣim
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا قِيلَ لِأَبِي عَاصِمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2870

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لِعِبَادِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ
chapter.englishTitle: What Allah has prepared for His righteous servants

hadiths.englishRaw: “Allah says: ‘I have prepared for My righteous slaves that which no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and it has never crossed the mind of man.’”
hadiths.body: “Allah says: ‘I have prepared for My righteous slaves that which no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and it has never crossed the mind of man.’”
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ ﷻ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لَا عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلَا أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلَا خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ {فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ} [السجدة 17]
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2871

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي أَدْنَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the lowest level of Jannah, there is a dwelling.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, the lowest rank of the people of Paradise is the one who desires something from Allah, and it will be said to him, 'You have that and its equivalent along with it, except that you will have much more.' It will be said to him, 'That is yours and its equivalent along with it.' Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'It will be said to him, 'That is yours and ten times its equivalent.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Indeed, the lowest rank of the people of Paradise is the one who desires something from Allah, and it will be said to him, 'You have that and its equivalent along with it, except that you will have much more.' It will be said to him, 'That is yours and its equivalent along with it.' Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'It will be said to him, 'That is yours and ten times its equivalent.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ أَدْنَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلًا مَنْ يَتَمَنَّى عَلَى اللَّهِ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ لَكَ ذَاكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ يُلَقَّى سِوَى كَذَا وَكَذَا فَيُقَالُ لَهُ ذَاكَ لَكَ وَمِثْلُهُ مَعَهُ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ ذَاكَ وَعَشْرَةُ أَمْثَالِهِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2872

chapter.englishTitle: In the rooms of paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, "The people of Paradise will indeed see the dwellers of the chambers, just as you see a shining star in the sky."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said, "The people of Paradise will indeed see the dwellers of the chambers, just as you see a shining star in the sky."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لَيَتَرَاءَوْنَ أَهْلَ الْغُرَفِ كَمَا تَرَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ الدُّرِّيَّ فِي السَّمَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Abū Ḥāzim \u003e Sahl b. Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2873

chapter.englishTitle: In the rooms of paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "The morning star is visible in the eastern and western horizon."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "The morning star is visible in the eastern and western horizon."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «الْكَوْكَبُ الدُّرِّيُّ فِي الْأُفُقِ الشَّرْقِيُّ وَالْغَرْبِيُّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Ḥāzim Faḥaddatht Bihadhā al-Ḥadīth al-Nuʿmān b. Abū ʿAyyāsh Faḥaddathanī \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ فَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2874

chapter.englishTitle: In the characteristics of the Houri-eyed

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no one in Paradise except that he has two wives. He will see the lobe of their legs from behind seventy garments, with no impurity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "There is no one in Paradise except that he has two wives. He will see the lobe of their legs from behind seventy garments, with no impurity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا لَهُ زَوْجَتَانِ إِنَّهُ لَيَرَى مُخَّ سَاقِهِمَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ سَبْعِينَ حُلَّةً مَا فِيهَا مِنْ عَزَبٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Minhāl \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Hishām al-Qurdūsī \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمِنْهَالِ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الْقُرْدُوسِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2875

chapter.englishTitle: In the tents of paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr b. Abu Musa b. Qais who, on the authority of his father, reported the Apostle ﷺ to have said that there would be a tent made of a pearl whose height towards the sky would be sixty miles. In each corner, there would be a family of the believer, out of sight for the others.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr b. Abu Musa b. Qais who, on the authority of his father, reported the Apostle ﷺ to have said that there would be a tent made of a pearl whose height towards the sky would be sixty miles. In each corner, there would be a family of the believer, out of sight for the others.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْخَيْمَةُ دُرَّةٌ مُجَوَّفَةٌ طُولُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ سِتُّونَ مِيلًا فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا أَهْلٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ لَا يَرَاهُمُ الْآخَرُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hammām \u003e Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh b. Qays from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2876

chapter.englishTitle: In the son of the people of Jannah

hadiths.englishRaw: "The believer, when he desires a child in Paradise, he shall be carried (in pregnancy), born, and complete his aging in an hour as he desires." The people of knowledge disagreed concerning this, so some of them said that in Paradise there is intercourse but no births. It has been reported like this from Tawus, Mujahid and Ibrahim AnNakha'i. Muhammad said: "Concerning the Hadith of the Prophet SAW: 'When the believer desires a child in Paradise, it shall be in an hour as he desires' Ishaq bin Ibrahim said: 'But he will not desire." Muhammad said: "And it has been reported from Abu Razin Al- 'Uqaili from the Prophet SAW that he said: 'Indeed the people of Paradise shall not have children therein."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The believer, when he desires a child in Paradise, he shall be carried (in pregnancy), born, and complete his aging in an hour as he desires." The people of knowledge disagreed concerning this, so some of them said that in Paradise there is intercourse but no births. It has been reported like this from Tawus, Mujahid and Ibrahim AnNakha'i. Muhammad said: "Concerning the Hadith of the Prophet SAW: 'When the believer desires a child in Paradise, it shall be in an hour as he desires' Ishaq bin Ibrahim said: 'But he will not desire." Muhammad said: "And it has been reported from Abu Razin Al- 'Uqaili from the Prophet SAW that he said: 'Indeed the people of Paradise shall not have children therein."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ إِذَا اشْتَهَى الْوَلَدَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ كَانَ حَمْلُهُ وَوَضْعُهُ وَسِنُّهُ فِي سَاعَةٍ كَمَا اشْتَهَى»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yazīd And al-Qawārīrī \u003e Muʿādh b. Hishām from his father \u003e ʿĀmir al-Aḥwal \u003e Abū al-Ṣiddīq al-Nājī \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ وَالْقَوَارِيرِيُّ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَامِرٍ الْأَحْوَلِ عَنْ أَبِي الصِّدِّيقِ النَّاجِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2877

chapter.englishTitle: In the Ranks of the People of Paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: "The people of Paradise are a hundred and twenty rows, eighty of them are from this nation, and forty are from the rest of the nations."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The people of Paradise are a hundred and twenty rows, eighty of them are from this nation, and forty are from the rest of the nations."     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ عِشْرُونَ وَمِائَةُ صَفٍّ ثَمَانُونَ مِنْهَا أُمَّتِي وَأَرْبَعُونَ سَائِرُ النَّاسِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Hishām \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Marthad \u003e Sulaymān b. Buraydah \u003e Urāh from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ قَالَ أُرَاهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2878

chapter.englishTitle: In the rivers of paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given text is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Verily, in Paradise, there is a sea of milk, a sea of honey, and a sea of wine, and then the rivers branch out from them.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given text is: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Verily, in Paradise, there is a sea of milk, a sea of honey, and a sea of wine, and then the rivers branch out from them.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ بَحْرَ اللَّبَنِ وَبَحْرَ الْعَسَلِ وَبَحْرَ الْخَمْرِ ثُمَّ تَشَقَّقُ مِنْهُ الْأَنْهَارُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Ḥakīm b. Muʿāwiyah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْجُرَيْرِيُّ عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2879

chapter.englishTitle: In Al-Kawthar

hadiths.englishRaw: “Kauthar is a river in Paradise whose banks are of gold and its bed is of rubies and pearls. Its soil is more fragrant than musk, its water is sweeter than honey and whiter than snow.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: “Kauthar is a river in Paradise whose banks are of gold and its bed is of rubies and pearls. Its soil is more fragrant than musk, its water is sweeter than honey and whiter than snow.”     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «هُوَ نَهْرٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ حَافَّتَاهُ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ يَجْرِي عَلَى الدُّرِّ وَالْيَاقُوتِ تُرْبَتُهُ أَطْيَبُ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ وَطَعْمُهُ أَحْلَى مِنَ الْعَسَلِ وَمَاؤُهُ أَشَدُّ بَيَاضًا مِنَ الثَّلْجِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib \u003e Muḥārib b. Dithār \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar \u003e Lammā Nazalat Innā Aʿṭaynāk al-Kawthar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2880

chapter.englishTitle: In the trees of Paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "In Paradise there is a tree which is so big that a rider can travel in its shade for one hundred years without passing it; and if you wish, you can recite: 'In shade long extended.' 56.30.
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "In Paradise there is a tree which is so big that a rider can travel in its shade for one hundred years without passing it; and if you wish, you can recite: 'In shade long extended.' 56.30.
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لَا يَقْطَعُهَا وَاقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ {وَظِلٍّ مَمْدُودٍ} [الواقعة 30]
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2881

chapter.englishTitle: In the trees of Paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Indeed, in Paradise, there is a tree under the shade of which a rider can travel for a hundred years without it being cut down. It is the tree of eternity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Indeed, in Paradise, there is a tree under the shade of which a rider can travel for a hundred years without it being cut down. It is the tree of eternity."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً» يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لَا يَقْطَعُهَا هِيَ شَجَرَةُ الْخُلْدِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad b. ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū al-Ḍaḥḥāk \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي الضَّحَّاكِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2882

chapter.englishTitle: In the 'Ajwah

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "The Ajwah date is from paradise and it is a remedy for poisoning."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, "The Ajwah date is from paradise and it is a remedy for poisoning."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْعَجْوَةُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَهِيَ شِفَاءٌ مِنَ السُّمِّ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿAbbād \u003e Ibn Manṣūr \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبَّادٌ هُوَ ابْنُ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ شَهْرَ بْنَ حَوْشَبٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2883

chapter.englishTitle: In the market of Paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Verily, in Paradise, there is a market." They asked, "What is it?" He replied, "It is fields of musk, from which they emerge and gather in it. Then Allah sends a breeze upon them, which enters their homes. Their families say to them, 'You have certainly been increased in beauty after us.' And they say to their families, 'Likewise.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Narrated by the Prophet ﷺ , he said: "Verily, in Paradise, there is a market." They asked, "What is it?" He replied, "It is fields of musk, from which they emerge and gather in it. Then Allah sends a breeze upon them, which enters their homes. Their families say to them, 'You have certainly been increased in beauty after us.' And they say to their families, 'Likewise.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَسُوقًا» قَالُوا وَمَا هِيَ؟ قَالَ كُثْبَانٌ مِنْ مِسْكٍ يَخْرُجُونَ إِلَيْهَا فَيَجْتَمِعُونَ فِيهَا فَيَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا فَتُدْخِلُهُمْ بُيُوتَهُمْ فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ أَهْلُوهُمْ لَقَدِ ازْدَدْتُمْ بَعْدَنَا حُسْنًا وَيَقُولُونَ لِأَهْلِيهِمْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2884

chapter.englishTitle: In the market of Paradise

hadiths.englishRaw: The above-mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The above-mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-Jabbār \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2885

chapter.englishTitle: The paradise is surrounded by dislikes

hadiths.englishRaw: The Paradise is surrounded by hardships and the Hell-Fire is surrounded by temptations.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Paradise is surrounded by hardships and the Hell-Fire is surrounded by temptations.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «حُفَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ بِالْمَكَارِهِ وَحُفَّتِ النَّارُ بِالشَّهَوَاتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2886

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي دُخُولِ الْفُقَرَاءِ الْجَنَّةَ قَبْلَ الْأَغْنِيَاءِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the entry of the poor into Paradise before the rich

hadiths.englishRaw: While I was sitting in the mosque, a group of poor immigrants was sitting together. Then, the Prophet ﷺ entered and sat with them. I stood up and approached them. The Prophet ﷺ said to them, "Let the poor immigrants be glad for what will bring joy to their faces, for they will enter Paradise forty years before the rich." Abdullah bin Amr (may Allah be pleased with him) said, "Indeed, I saw their faces shining. I wished to be among them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: While I was sitting in the mosque, a group of poor immigrants was sitting together. Then, the Prophet ﷺ entered and sat with them. I stood up and approached them. The Prophet ﷺ said to them, "Let the poor immigrants be glad for what will bring joy to their faces, for they will enter Paradise forty years before the rich." Abdullah bin Amr (may Allah be pleased with him) said, "Indeed, I saw their faces shining. I wished to be among them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: بَيْنَا أَنَا قَاعِدٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَحَلْقَةٌ مِنْ فُقَرَاءِ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ قُعُودٌ إِذْ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فَقَعَدَ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقُمْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لَهُمْ «لِيُبْشِرْ فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ بِمَا يَسُرُّ وُجُوهَهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ قَبْلَ الْأَغْنِيَاءِ بِأَرْبَعِينَ عَامًا» قَالَ فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ أَلْوَانَهُمْ أَسْفَرَتْ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو حَتَّى تَمَنَّيْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مَعَهُمْ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Muʿāwiyah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Jubayr \u003e Abīh Jubayr b. Nufayr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Baynā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2887

chapter.englishTitle: In the midst of hell itself.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The Fire made a complaint before the Lord saying." O Lord, some parts of mine have consumed the others." So it was allowed to take two exhalations, one exhalation in winter and the other exhalation in summer. That is why you find extreme heat (in summer) and extreme cold (in winter).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The Fire made a complaint before the Lord saying." O Lord, some parts of mine have consumed the others." So it was allowed to take two exhalations, one exhalation in winter and the other exhalation in summer. That is why you find extreme heat (in summer) and extreme cold (in winter).    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ اشْتَكَتِ النَّارُ إِلَى رَبِّهَا فَقَالَتْ يا رَبِّ أَكَلَ بَعْضِي بَعْضًا فَأَذِنَ الله تبارك وتعالى لَهَا بِنَفَسَيْنِ نَفَسٍ فِي الشِّتَاءِ وَنَفَسٍ فِي الصَّيْفِ فَهُوَ أَشَدُّ مَا تَجِدُونَ مِنَ الْحَرِّ وَأَشَدُّ مَا تَجِدُونَ مِنَ الزَّمْهَرِيرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Shuʿayb \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah \u003e Samiʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2888

chapter.englishTitle: In the midst of hell itself.

hadiths.englishRaw: The above-mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The above-mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِنَحْوِهِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim b. Bahdalah \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ بَهْدَلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2889

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ «نَارُكُمْ هَذِهِ جُزْءٌ مِنْ كَذَا جُزْءًا»
chapter.englishTitle: In the saying of the Prophet ﷺ "Your fire is a portion of such a...

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, your fire (of this world) is a part of seventy parts of the Hellfire."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, your fire (of this world) is a part of seventy parts of the Hellfire."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ نَارَكُمْ هَذِهِ جُزْءٌ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنْ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e al-Hajarī \u003e Abū ʿIyāḍ \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا الْهَجَرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عِيَاضٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2890

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي أَهْوَنِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا
chapter.englishTitle: In the Hellfire, the punishment of the least severe

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The person who suffers the least punishment is the one who has two sandals and his brain boils from them."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "The person who suffers the least punishment is the one who has two sandals and his brain boils from them."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَهْوَنُ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا مَنْ لَهُ نَعْلَانِ يَغْلِي مِنْهُمَا دِمَاغُهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān from his father \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2891

chapter.englishTitle: His saying, exalted be He: "Is there any more?" [Quran 36:30]

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The inhabitants of Hell will be thrown into it and it will say, 'Is there any more? Is there any more?' three times until their Lord, exalted be He, comes to it and puts His foot on it, and then it will shrink back and say, 'Enough, enough, enough.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: The inhabitants of Hell will be thrown into it and it will say, 'Is there any more? Is there any more?' three times until their Lord, exalted be He, comes to it and puts His foot on it, and then it will shrink back and say, 'Enough, enough, enough.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ أَهْلُهَا وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ ثَلَاثًا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهَا رَبُّهَا تعالى فَيَضَعَ قَدَمَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَتَنْزَوِي وَتَقُولُ قَطْ قَطْ قَطْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿAmmār b. Abū ʿAmmār \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2892

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: "Omar Ibn Al Khattab said, 'Learn the obligations, melodies, and traditions just as you learn the Quran.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Omar Ibn Al Khattab said, 'Learn the obligations, melodies, and traditions just as you learn the Quran.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ «تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ وَاللَّحْنَ وَالسُّنَنَ كَمَا تَعَلَّمُونَ الْقُرْآنَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Muwarriq al-ʿIjlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ مُوَرِّقٍ الْعِجْلِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2893

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the Arabic phrase "عُمَرُ «تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ دِينِكُمْ»" into English is: "Omar said, 'Learn the obligations, for they are part of your religion.'"
hadiths.body: The translation of the Arabic phrase "عُمَرُ «تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ دِينِكُمْ»" into English is: "Omar said, 'Learn the obligations, for they are part of your religion.'"
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ «تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ دِينِكُمْ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2894

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Shihab said, "If Uthman and Zaid were to perish in some time, the knowledge of inheritance would also perish. Indeed, a time has come upon people and no one knows it except for these two."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Shihab said, "If Uthman and Zaid were to perish in some time, the knowledge of inheritance would also perish. Indeed, a time has come upon people and no one knows it except for these two."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: ابْنُ شِهَابٍ «لَوْ هَلَكَ عُثْمَانُ وَزَيْدٌ فِي بَعْضِ الزَّمَانِ لَهَلَكَ عِلْمُ الْفَرَائِضِ لَقَدْ أَتَى عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ وَمَا يَعْلَمُهَا غَيْرُهُمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Yūsuf al-Mājishūn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ الْمَاجِشُونُ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2895

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah said, 'Learn the Quran and the religious obligations, for soon a person may become in need of knowledge that he once knew or be surrounded by a people who are ignorant.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah said, 'Learn the Quran and the religious obligations, for soon a person may become in need of knowledge that he once knew or be surrounded by a people who are ignorant.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «تَعَلَّمُوا الْقُرْآنَ وَالْفَرَائِضَ فَإِنَّهُ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَفْتَقِرَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى عِلْمٍ كَانَ يَعْلَمُهُ أَوْ يَبْقَى فِي قَوْمٍ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e ʿAbdullāh Taʿallamūā al-Qurān And al-Farāʾiḍ Faʾinnah Yūshik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2896

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abu Musa: Whoever knows the Quran but does not know the obligatory duties, his example is like a lighthouse without a light or without any essence."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Abu Musa: Whoever knows the Quran but does not know the obligatory duties, his example is like a lighthouse without a light or without any essence."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو مُوسَى «مَنْ عَلِمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَلَمْ يَعْلَمِ الْفَرَائِضَ فَإِنَّ مَثَلَهُ مَثَلُ الْبُرْنُسِ لَا وَجْهَ لَهُ أَوْ لَيْسَ لَهُ وَجْهٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ziyād b. Abū Muslim \u003e Abū al-Khalīl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2897

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to Alqamah, "I don't know what to ask you about." He said, "Have your neighbors died?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I said to Alqamah, "I don't know what to ask you about." He said, "Have your neighbors died?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِعَلْقَمَةَ مَا أَدْرِي مَا أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْهُ قَالَ «أَمِتْ جِيرَانَكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Liʿalqamah Mā Adrī Mā Asʾaluk ʿAnh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2898

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: Learn the obligations, divorce, and pilgrimage, for they are part of your religion.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Learn the obligations, divorce, and pilgrimage, for they are part of your religion.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَعَلَّمُوا الْفَرَائِضَ وَالطَّلَاقَ وَالْحَجَّ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ دِينِكُمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Muḥammad b. Ṭalḥah \u003e al-Qāsim b. al-Walīd al-Hamdānī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2899

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: "They used to have a desire to teach the Quran, religious obligations, and rituals."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "They used to have a desire to teach the Quran, religious obligations, and rituals."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانُوا يُرَغِّبُونَ فِي تَعْلِيمِ الْقُرْآنِ وَالْفَرَائِضِ وَالْمَنَاسِكِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Kathīr \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2900

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever reads the Quran, let him learn the obligations, for if he meets an Arab, and the Arab asks, 'Do you read the Quran?' If he says 'Yes,' then he asks, 'Do you fulfill the obligations?' If he says 'Yes,' then it is something additional and good. But if he says 'No,' then the Arab asks, 'What is your superiority over me, O emigrant?'"
hadiths.body: "Whoever reads the Quran, let him learn the obligations, for if he meets an Arab, and the Arab asks, 'Do you read the Quran?' If he says 'Yes,' then he asks, 'Do you fulfill the obligations?' If he says 'Yes,' then it is something additional and good. But if he says 'No,' then the Arab asks, 'What is your superiority over me, O emigrant?'"
hadiths.arabic: مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فَلْيَتَعَلَّمِ الْفَرَائِضَ فَإِنْ لَقِيَهُ أَعْرَابِيٌّ قَالَ يَا مُهَاجِرُ أَتَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ؟ فَإِنْ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ تَفْرِضُ؟ فَإِنْ قَالَ نَعَمْ فَهُوَ زِيَادَةٌ وَخَيْرٌ وَإِنْ قَالَ لَا قَالَ فَمَا فَضْلُكَ عَلَيَّ يَا مُهَاجِرُ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū ʿUbaydah \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Man Qaraʾ al-Qurān Falyataʿallam al-Farāʾiḍ Faʾin Laqiyah Aʿrābī \u003e Yā Muhājir Ataqraʾ al-Qurān Faʾin \u003e Naʿam \u003e Tafriḍ Faʾin \u003e Naʿam Fahū Ziyādah And Khayr Waʾin \u003e Lā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2901

chapter.englishTitle: In the teaching of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: We asked Masruq, "Did Aisha used to perform the obligatory duties well?" He replied, "By the One besides whom there is no God, I have seen the senior companions of Muhammad asking her about the obligatory duties."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: We asked Masruq, "Did Aisha used to perform the obligatory duties well?" He replied, "By the One besides whom there is no God, I have seen the senior companions of Muhammad asking her about the obligatory duties."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْنَا مَسْرُوقًا كَانَتْ عَائِشَةُ تُحْسِنُ الْفَرَائِضَ؟ قَالَ «وَالَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ الْأَكَابِرَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ يَسْأَلُونَهَا عَنِ الْفَرَائِضِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Muslim \u003e Saʾalnā Masrūq Kānat ʿĀʾishah Tuḥsin al-Farāʾiḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2902

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who Claims Paternity Other Than His Father?

hadiths.englishRaw: "This is the branch of the first person who threw an arrow in the way of Allah, and this is the rope of the fortress of Taif to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Indeed, they both mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father, knowing that he is not his father, Paradise is forbidden for him.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "This is the branch of the first person who threw an arrow in the way of Allah, and this is the rope of the fortress of Taif to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Indeed, they both mentioned that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever claims to belong to someone other than his father, knowing that he is not his father, Paradise is forbidden for him.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: شُعْبَةُ هَذَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ رَمَى بِسَهْمٍ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَهَذَا تَدَلَّى حِصْنِ الطَّائِفِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ غَيْرُ أَبِيهِ فَالْجَنَّةُ عَلَيْهِ حَرَامٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Abū ʿUthmān \u003e Saʿd b. Abū Waqqāṣ \u003e Abū Bakrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ وَعَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2903

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who Claims Paternity Other Than His Father?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Claiming lineage that is not recognized is disbelief in Allah, and disavowing lineage is disbelief in Allah even if it is true."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Claiming lineage that is not recognized is disbelief in Allah, and disavowing lineage is disbelief in Allah even if it is true."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُفْرٌ بِاللَّهِ ادِّعَاءٌ إِلَى نَسَبٍ لَا يُعْرَفُ وَكُفْرٌ بِاللَّهِ تَبَرُّؤٌ مِنْ نَسَبٍ وَإِنْ دَقَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Murrah \u003e Abū Maʿmar \u003e Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2904

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ
