chapter.englishTitle: Who Claims Paternity Other Than His Father?

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibn Mas'ood, a saying from him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibn Mas'ood, a saying from him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ نَحْوًا مِنْهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Zakariyyā Abū Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Wāʾil
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا أَبِي يَحْيَى قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ يُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2905

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who Claims Paternity Other Than His Father?

hadiths.englishRaw: I came to the Prophet ﷺ to pledge allegiance to him, but when I arrived, he had passed away, and Abu Bakr was standing in his place. He praised and cried for a long time, then he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Disbelief is to deny one's lineage, even if it is known, and to claim a lineage that is unknown.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I came to the Prophet ﷺ to pledge allegiance to him, but when I arrived, he had passed away, and Abu Bakr was standing in his place. He praised and cried for a long time, then he said, "I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying, 'Disbelief is to deny one's lineage, even if it is known, and to claim a lineage that is unknown.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ لِأُبَايِعَهُ فَجِئْتُ وَقَدْ قُبِضَ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ قَائِمٌ فِي مَقَامِهِ فَأَطَالَ الثَّنَاءَ وَأَكْثَرَ الْبُكَاءَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «كُفْرٌ بِاللَّهِ انْتِفَاءٌ مِنْ نَسَبٍ وَإِنْ دَقَّ وَادِّعَاءُ نَسَبٍ لَا يُعْرَفُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Isḥāq b. Manṣūr al-Salūlī \u003e Jaʿfar al-Aḥmar \u003e al-Sarī b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Qays b. Abū Ḥāzim
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ السَّلُولِيُّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ الْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ السَّرِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2906

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنِ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ أَبِيهِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who Claims Paternity Other Than His Father?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever claims to have a relationship with someone other than his biological father, or supports those who are not his legal guardians, those who have freed him from slavery, then upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people, until the Day of Judgment. His expenditures and testimonies will not be accepted."   – Sound
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever claims to have a relationship with someone other than his biological father, or supports those who are not his legal guardians, those who have freed him from slavery, then upon him is the curse of Allah, the angels, and all people, until the Day of Judgment. His expenditures and testimonies will not be accepted."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ ادَّعَى إِلَى غَيْرِ وَالِدِهِ أَوْ تَوَلَّى غَيْرَ مَوَالِيهِ الَّذِينَ أَعْتَقُوهُ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ لَعْنَةَ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا يُقْبَلُ مِنْهُ صَرْفٌ وَلَا عَدْلٌ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Bahrām \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَهْرَامَ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2907

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah used to say that when he traveled with us on a path, we found it easy. He also said about a husband and parents that "the husband gets half and the mother gets one-third of what is remaining."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah used to say that when he traveled with us on a path, we found it easy. He also said about a husband and parents that "the husband gets half and the mother gets one-third of what is remaining."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ كَانَ عُمَرُ إِذَا سَلَكَ بِنَا طَرِيقًا وَجَدْنَاهُ سَهْلًا وَإِنَّهُ قَالَ فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ «لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2908

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: "Zaid bin Thabit divided it into four portions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Zaid bin Thabit divided it into four portions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَسَّمَهَا زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hammām \u003e Yazīd al-Rishk \u003e Saʾalt Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e a man Tarak Āmraʾatah And ʾAbawayh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ الرِّشْكُ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَأَبَوَيْهِ؟ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2909

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: "In a woman and two parents, the woman receives one-fourth and the mother receives one-third of what remains."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "In a woman and two parents, the woman receives one-fourth and the mother receives one-third of what remains."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ «لِلْمَرْأَةِ الرُّبُعُ وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Muhallab \u003e ʿUthmān b. ʿAffān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2910

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: He said to the woman: a quarter is one out of four, and for the mother is one-third of what remains as a share, and for the father are two shares.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He said to the woman: a quarter is one out of four, and for the mother is one-third of what remains as a share, and for the father are two shares.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الرُّبُعُ سَهْمٌ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ سَهْمٌ وَلِلْأَبِ سَهْمَانِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah \u003e Abū al-Muhallab \u003e ʿUthmān b. ʿAffān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2911

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: "Like the saying of Uthman."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Like the saying of Uthman."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: مِثْلَ قَوْلِ عُثْمَانَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿUmayr b. Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ الْحَارِثَ الْأَعْوَرَ عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2912

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: "He said about a woman who left her husband and parents, 'The husband gets half, and the mother gets one-third of what remains.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He said about a woman who left her husband and parents, 'The husband gets half, and the mother gets one-third of what remains.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي امْرَأَةٍ تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَأَبَوَيْهَا «لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Hishām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2913

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: From four parts for the woman, there remains a quarter, and for the mother, there remains a third of what is left, and what is left, belongs to the father.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: From four parts for the woman, there remains a quarter, and for the mother, there remains a third of what is left, and what is left, belongs to the father.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الرُّبُعُ وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأَبِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e ʿĀmir al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2914

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umar would say, 'When we would travel on a path, we followed it and found it easy. Indeed, he passed a ruling regarding a woman and both parents from four. So he gave the woman a quarter and the mother a third of what remained, and the father received two shares.'"   – Sound
hadiths.body: "Umar would say, 'When we would travel on a path, we followed it and found it easy. Indeed, he passed a ruling regarding a woman and both parents from four. So he gave the woman a quarter and the mother a third of what remained, and the father received two shares.'"   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ عُمَرُ «إِذَا سَلَكَ بِنَا طَرِيقًا اتَّبَعْنَاهُ فِيهِ وَجَدْنَاهُ سَهْلًا وَإِنَّهُ قَضَى فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ فَأَعْطَى الْمَرْأَةَ الرُّبُعَ وَالْأُمَّ ثُلُثَ مَا بَقِيَ وَالْأَبَ سَهْمَيْنِ»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash And Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ وَمَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2915

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: From Zaid ibn Thabit like that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Zaid ibn Thabit like that.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿĪsá \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عِيسَى عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2916

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to say, "Allah would not have shown me to prefer a mother over a father."
hadiths.body: He used to say, "Allah would not have shown me to prefer a mother over a father."
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ يَقُولُ مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيَرَانِي أَنْ أُفَضِّلَ أُمًّا عَلَى أَبٍ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān from his father \u003e al-Musayyab b. Rāfiʿ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2917

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: Zaid said, "You are a man who speaks his opinion, and I am a man who speaks my opinion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Zaid said, "You are a man who speaks his opinion, and I am a man who speaks my opinion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: زَيْدٌ «إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ رَجُلٌ تَقُولُ بِرَأْيِكَ وَأَنَا رَجُلٌ أَقُولُ بِرَأْيِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿIkrimah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ قَالَ أَرْسَلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ أَتَجِدُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ لِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ؟ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2918

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Ibn Abbas, they said about a husband and parents: 'The husband is entitled to half of the wealth, while the mother is entitled to one-third of the total wealth, and whatever is left belongs to the father.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "From Ibn Abbas, they said about a husband and parents: 'The husband is entitled to half of the wealth, while the mother is entitled to one-third of the total wealth, and whatever is left belongs to the father.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ «لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأَبِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e al-Shaʿbī And Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās Annahumā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ وَحَجَّاجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2919

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: "Two-thirds of all the wealth goes to a mother in the form of a woman and two parents, and to a wife and two parents."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: "Two-thirds of all the wealth goes to a mother in the form of a woman and two parents, and to a wife and two parents."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَفِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2920

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي زَوْجٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَامْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a husband, two parents, a woman, and two parents

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Abbas disobeyed the people of the Qibla regarding a woman and her two parents, and he allocated one-third of all the wealth to the mother.
hadiths.body: Ibn Abbas disobeyed the people of the Qibla regarding a woman and her two parents, and he allocated one-third of all the wealth to the mother.
hadiths.arabic: خَالَفَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَهْلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فِي امْرَأَةٍ وَأَبَوَيْنِ جَعَلَ لِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn Idrīs from his father \u003e al-Fuḍayl b. ʿAmr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2921

chapter.englishTitle: In a daughter and sister

hadiths.englishRaw: Mu'adh ibn Jabal decided in Yemen in favor of a girl and a sister, so he gave half to the girl and half to the sister.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Mu'adh ibn Jabal decided in Yemen in favor of a girl and a sister, so he gave half to the girl and half to the sister.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَضَى مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ بِالْيَمَنِ فِي بِنْتٍ وَأُخْتٍ فَأَعْطَى الْبِنْتَ النِّصْفَ وَالْأُخْتَ النِّصْفَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān al-Thawrī \u003e Ashʿath b. Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ \u003e al-Aswad b. Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2922

chapter.englishTitle: In a daughter and sister

hadiths.englishRaw: "You are my messenger to Abdullah ibn Uthbata, so inform him of that." And he was his judge in Kufa.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "You are my messenger to Abdullah ibn Uthbata, so inform him of that." And he was his judge in Kufa.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنْتَ رَسُولِي إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ فَأَخْبِرْهُ بِذَاكَ» وَكَانَ قَاضِيَهُ بِالْكُوفَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Aswad b. Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَنَّ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ كَانَ لَا يُوَرِّثُ الْأُخْتَ مِنَ الْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ مَعَ الْبِنْتِ حَتَّى حَدَّثَهُ الْأَسْوَدُ «أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ جَعَلَ لِلْبِنْتِ النِّصْفَ وَلِلْأُخْتِ النِّصْفَ» فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2923

chapter.englishTitle: In a daughter and sister

hadiths.englishRaw: "Half for his daughter and what is left for his sister."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Half for his daughter and what is left for his sister."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لِابْنَتِهِ النِّصْفُ وَلِأُخْتِهِ مَا بَقِيَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Bishr b. ʿUmar \u003e Saʾalt Ibn Abū al-Zinād \u003e a man Tarak b. And ʾUkht
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ بِنْتًا وَأُخْتًا؟ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2924

chapter.englishTitle: In the partnership

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, in terms of a wife, a mother, and siblings from the father and mother, and siblings from the mother? He said, "Umar, Abdullah, and Zaid used to share things." Umar said, "Their father only increased their closeness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, in terms of a wife, a mother, and siblings from the father and mother, and siblings from the mother? He said, "Umar, Abdullah, and Zaid used to share things." Umar said, "Their father only increased their closeness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي زَوْجٍ وَأُمٍّ وَإِخْوَةٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ وَإِخْوَةٍ لِأُمٍّ؟ قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَزَيْدٌ يُشَرِّكُونَ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ «لَمْ يَزِدْهُمُ الْأَبُ إِلَّا قُرْبًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr And al-Aʿmash
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ وَالْأَعْمَشِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2925

chapter.englishTitle: In the partnership

hadiths.englishRaw: "He did not associate partners with (God)."
hadiths.body: "He did not associate partners with (God)."
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُشَرِّكُ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2926

chapter.englishTitle: In the partnership

hadiths.englishRaw: That Uthman used to associate partners with Allah, and Ali did not associate partners with Allah.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That Uthman used to associate partners with Allah, and Ali did not associate partners with Allah.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ كَانَ يُشَرِّكُ وَعَلِيٌّ كَانَ لَا يُشَرِّكُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Sulaymān al-Taymī \u003e Abū Mijlaz
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2927

chapter.englishTitle: In the partnership

hadiths.englishRaw: Zaid used to associate partners with God.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Zaid used to associate partners with God.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ زَيْدًا كَانَ يُشَرِّكُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Dhakwān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ ابْنِ ذَكْوَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2928

chapter.englishTitle: In the partnership

hadiths.englishRaw: "It used to associate (partners with Allah)."
hadiths.body: "It used to associate (partners with Allah)."
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُشَرِّكُ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr \u003e Shurayḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2929

chapter.englishTitle: In the partnership

hadiths.englishRaw: "In idolatry, the father did not bring them closer."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "In idolatry, the father did not bring them closer."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي الْمُشَرَّكَةِ «لَمْ يَزِدْهُمُ الْأَبُ إِلَّا قُرْبًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e al-Ḥajjāj \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Saʿīd b. Fayrūz from his father \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ الْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ فَيْرُوزَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2930

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي ابْنَيْ عَمٍّ: أَحَدُهُمَا زَوْجٌ وَالْآخَرُ أَخٌ لِأُمٍّ
chapter.englishTitle: In my paternal cousin's sons: one of them is a husband and the o...

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah came concerning the obligation of the half-brothers from the mother's side. He said that all the property belongs to his brother, his mother's son, so he distributed it to him according to the share of a full brother from the father's side and the mother's side. When Ali arrived, I asked him about it and informed him of Abdullah's statement. He said, "May Allah have mercy on him. If he was a jurist, then perhaps I would have increased his share beyond what Allah had prescribed for him, which is one-sixth. Then he would have divided it among them like a man from among them."
hadiths.body: Abdullah came concerning the obligation of the half-brothers from the mother's side. He said that all the property belongs to his brother, his mother's son, so he distributed it to him according to the share of a full brother from the father's side and the mother's side. When Ali arrived, I asked him about it and informed him of Abdullah's statement. He said, "May Allah have mercy on him. If he was a jurist, then perhaps I would have increased his share beyond what Allah had prescribed for him, which is one-sixth. Then he would have divided it among them like a man from among them."
hadiths.arabic: أُتِيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فِي فَرِيضَةِ بَنِي عَمٍّ أَحَدُهُمْ أَخٌ لِأُمٍّ فَقَالَ الْمَالُ أَجْمَعُ لِأَخِيهِ لِأُمِّهِ فَأَنْزَلَهُ بِحِسَابِ أَوْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَخِ مِنَ الْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ عَلِيٌّ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهَا وَأَخْبَرْتُهُ بِقَوْلِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ يَرْحَمُهُ اللَّهُ إِنْ كَانَ لَفَقِيهًا أَمَّا أَنَا فَلَمْ أَكُنْ لِأَزِيدَهُ عَلَى مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ سَهْمٌ السُّدُسُ ثُمَّ يُقَاسِمُهُمْ كَرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith al-Aʿwar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ الْأَعْوَرِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2931

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي ابْنَيْ عَمٍّ: أَحَدُهُمَا زَوْجٌ وَالْآخَرُ أَخٌ لِأُمٍّ
chapter.englishTitle: In my paternal cousin's sons: one of them is a husband and the o...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali said, "If he was a scholar, even if it were me, I would have given him one-sixth and what is left would be between them."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Ali said, "If he was a scholar, even if it were me, I would have given him one-sixth and what is left would be between them."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَلِيٌّ «إِنْ كَانَ لَفَقِيهًا وَلَوْ كُنْتُ أَنَا أَعْطَيْتُهُ السُّدُسَ وَمَا بَقِيَ كَانَ بَيْنَهُمْ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ فِي ابْنَيْ عَمٍّ أَحَدُهُمَا أَخٌ لِأُمٍّ فَقِيلَ لِعَلِيٍّ إِنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ كَانَ يُعْطِيهِ الْمَالَ كُلَّهُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2932

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي بِنْتٍ وَابْنَةِ ابْنٍ، وَأُخْتٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ
chapter.englishTitle: In a daughter and a son of a son, and a sister of a father and a...

hadiths.englishRaw: “A man came to Abu Musa Al-Ash’ari and Salman bin Rabi’ah Al-Bahili and asked them about (the shares of) a daughter, a son’s daughter, a sister through one’s father and mother. They said: ‘The daughter gets one half, and what is left goes to the sister. Go to Ibn Mas’ud, for he will concur with what we say.’ So the man went to Ibn Mas’ud, and told him what they had said. ‘Abdullah said: ‘I will go astray and will not be guided (if I say that I agree); but I will judge as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ judged. The daughter gets one half, and the son’s daughter gets one- sixth. That makes two thirds. And what is left goes to the sister.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “A man came to Abu Musa Al-Ash’ari and Salman bin Rabi’ah Al-Bahili and asked them about (the shares of) a daughter, a son’s daughter, a sister through one’s father and mother. They said: ‘The daughter gets one half, and what is left goes to the sister. Go to Ibn Mas’ud, for he will concur with what we say.’ So the man went to Ibn Mas’ud, and told him what they had said. ‘Abdullah said: ‘I will go astray and will not be guided (if I say that I agree); but I will judge as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ judged. The daughter gets one half, and the son’s daughter gets one- sixth. That makes two thirds. And what is left goes to the sister.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَقَدْ ضَلَلْتُ إِذًا وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُهْتَدِينَ وَإِنِّي أَقْضِي بِمَا قَضَى بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لِلِابْنَةِ النِّصْفُ وَلِابْنَةِ الِابْنِ السُّدُسُ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأُخْتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān al-Thawrī \u003e Abū Qays al-Awdī \u003e Huzayl b. Shuraḥbīl \u003e Jāʾ a man \u003e Abū Mūsá al-Ashʿarī \u003e Salmān b. Rabīʿah Fasaʾalahumā \u003e b. And b. Ibn Waʾukht Liʾum Waʾab \u003e Liliāb.ah al-Niṣf Wamā Baqī Falilʾukht Waʾt Ibn Masʿūd Faʾinnah Sayutābiʿunā Fajāʾ al-a man \u003e ʿAbdullāh Fasaʾalah \u003e Dhalik \u003e Laqad Ḍalalt Idh Wamā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي قَيْسٍ الْأَوْدِيِّ عَنْ هُزَيْلِ بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى أَبِي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيِّ وَإِلَى سَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ فَسَأَلَهُمَا عَنْ بِنْتٍ وَبِنْتِ ابْنٍ وَأُخْتٍ لِأُمٍّ وَأَبٍ فَقَالَا لِلِابْنَةِ النِّصْفُ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأُخْتِ وَأْتِ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَإِنَّهُ سَيُتَابِعُنَا فَجَاءَ الرَّجُلُ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2933

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْإِخْوَةِ وَالْأَخَوَاتِ وَالْوَلَدِ، وَوَلَدِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: In brothers, sisters and children, and descendants of descendant...

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to say about sisters from the same father and mother, brothers, and sisters from the same father, that two-thirds of the inheritance should be given to them. As for the remaining portion, it belongs to the males and not the females. A thief came to the city and heard Zaid's statement in it, and he admired it. Some of his companions said to him, "Would you abandon the statement of Abdullah?" He replied, "I came to the city and found Zaid ibn Thabit from the knowledgeable people. Ahmad said, so I asked Abu Shihab, "And how did Zaid say about it?" He said, "He divided it among them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He used to say about sisters from the same father and mother, brothers, and sisters from the same father, that two-thirds of the inheritance should be given to them. As for the remaining portion, it belongs to the males and not the females. A thief came to the city and heard Zaid's statement in it, and he admired it. Some of his companions said to him, "Would you abandon the statement of Abdullah?" He replied, "I came to the city and found Zaid ibn Thabit from the knowledgeable people. Ahmad said, so I asked Abu Shihab, "And how did Zaid say about it?" He said, "He divided it among them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي أَخَوَاتٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ وَإِخْوَةٍ وَأَخَوَاتٍ لِأَبٍ لِلْأَخَوَاتِ لِلْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَانِ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلذُّكُورِ دُونَ الْإِنَاثِ فَقَدِمَ مَسْرُوقٌ الْمَدِينَةَ فَسَمِعَ قَوْلَ زَيْدٍ فِيهَا فَأَعْجَبَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ أَتَتْرُكُ قَوْلَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَوَجَدْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ مِنَ الرَّاسِخِينَ فِي الْعِلْمِ قَالَ أَحْمَدُ فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي شِهَابٍ وَكَيْفَ قَالَ زَيْدٌ فِيهَا؟ قَالَ «شَرَّكَ بَيْنَهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Muslim \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2934

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْإِخْوَةِ وَالْأَخَوَاتِ وَالْوَلَدِ، وَوَلَدِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: In brothers, sisters and children, and descendants of descendant...

hadiths.englishRaw: "In a family of a father and mother, and brothers and sisters of the father, he used to give the sisters from the father and mother two-thirds, and the remaining portion was for the males and not the females." So a wise person said, Zayd ibn Thabit said, "This is a practice from the time of ignorance, that men would inherit more than women, even though their sisters are the ones taking care of them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "In a family of a father and mother, and brothers and sisters of the father, he used to give the sisters from the father and mother two-thirds, and the remaining portion was for the males and not the females." So a wise person said, Zayd ibn Thabit said, "This is a practice from the time of ignorance, that men would inherit more than women, even though their sisters are the ones taking care of them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي أَخَوَاتٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ وَإِخْوَةٍ وَأَخَوَاتٍ لِأَبٍ «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُعْطِي الْأَخَوَاتِ مِنَ الْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَيْنِ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلذُّكُورِ دُونَ الْإِنَاثِ» فَقَالَ حَكِيمٌ قَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ «هَذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ أَنْ يَرِثَ الرِّجَالُ دُونَ النِّسَاءِ إِنَّ إِخْوَتَهُنَّ قَدْ رُدُّوا عَلَيْهِنَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e Dhakarnā ʿInd Ḥakīm b. Jābir \u003e Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ ذَكَرْنَا عِنْدَ حَكِيمِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2935

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْإِخْوَةِ وَالْأَخَوَاتِ وَالْوَلَدِ، وَوَلَدِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: In brothers, sisters and children, and descendants of descendant...

hadiths.englishRaw: She used to divide between two daughters, a granddaughter, and a great-grandson, giving the two daughters two-thirds and keeping the remaining portion for herself.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: She used to divide between two daughters, a granddaughter, and a great-grandson, giving the two daughters two-thirds and keeping the remaining portion for herself.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تُشَرِّكُ بَيْنَ ابْنَتَيْنِ وَابْنَةِ ابْنٍ وَابْنِ ابْنٍ تُعْطِي الِابْنَتَيْنِ الثُّلُثَيْنِ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَشَرِكتُهُمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Maʿbad b. Khālid \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2936

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْإِخْوَةِ وَالْأَخَوَاتِ وَالْوَلَدِ، وَوَلَدِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: In brothers, sisters and children, and descendants of descendant...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Mas'ud used to say about a daughter, the daughters of a son, and the sons of a son, "If the division between them is less than one sixth, he gave them one sixth, and if it is more than one sixth, he gave them one sixth."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Mas'ud used to say about a daughter, the daughters of a son, and the sons of a son, "If the division between them is less than one sixth, he gave them one sixth, and if it is more than one sixth, he gave them one sixth."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي بِنْتٍ وَبَنَاتِ ابْنٍ وَابْنِ ابْنٍ «إِنْ كَانَتِ الْمُقَاسَمَةُ بَيْنَهُمْ أَقَلَّ مِنَ السُّدُسِ أَعْطَاهُمُ السُّدُسَ وَإِنْ كَانَ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ السُّدُسِ أَعْطَاهُمُ السُّدُسَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Abū Sahl \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2937

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْإِخْوَةِ وَالْأَخَوَاتِ وَالْوَلَدِ، وَوَلَدِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: In brothers, sisters and children, and descendants of descendant...

hadiths.englishRaw: Does anyone of them have a stronger proof than Abdullah? He said, "No, but I have seen Zaid ibn Thabit and the people of Madinah associating in marriage with two daughters, a granddaughter, a grandson, and two sisters."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Does anyone of them have a stronger proof than Abdullah? He said, "No, but I have seen Zaid ibn Thabit and the people of Madinah associating in marriage with two daughters, a granddaughter, a grandson, and two sisters."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ عَلْقَمَةُ هَلْ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَثْبَتُ مِنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ؟ فَقَالَ لَا وَلَكِنِّي «رَأَيْتُ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ وَأَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ يُشَرِّكُونَ فِي ابْنَتَيْنِ وَبِنْتِ ابْنٍ وَابْنِ ابْنٍ وَأُخْتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Masrūq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُشَرِّكُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2938

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْإِخْوَةِ وَالْأَخَوَاتِ وَالْوَلَدِ، وَوَلَدِ الْوَلَدِ
chapter.englishTitle: In brothers, sisters and children, and descendants of descendant...

hadiths.englishRaw: About Shurayh, he said: "Regarding a woman who left her husband, mother, and sister to live with her father, mother, and sister from her father's side, and her brothers from her mother's side, he divided her inheritance into six shares. Then he increased it until it reached ten shares. The husband receives half of the inheritance (three shares), the sister from the father and mother each receive half of the inheritance (three shares), the mother receives one-sixth of the inheritance, the brothers from the mother receive two-thirds of the inheritance, and the sister from the father receives one share, to complete the two thirds."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Shurayh, he said: "Regarding a woman who left her husband, mother, and sister to live with her father, mother, and sister from her father's side, and her brothers from her mother's side, he divided her inheritance into six shares. Then he increased it until it reached ten shares. The husband receives half of the inheritance (three shares), the sister from the father and mother each receive half of the inheritance (three shares), the mother receives one-sixth of the inheritance, the brothers from the mother receive two-thirds of the inheritance, and the sister from the father receives one share, to complete the two thirds."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ «فِي امْرَأَةٍ تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَأُمَّهَا وَأُخْتَهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَأُمِّهَا وَأُخْتَهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَإِخْوَتَهَا لِأُمِّهَا جَعَلَهَا مِنْ سِتَّةٍ ثُمَّ رَفَعَهَا فَبَلَغَتْ عَشَرَةً لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَسْهُمٍ وَلِلْأُخْتِ مِنَ الْأَبِ وَالْأُمِّ النِّصْفُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَسْهُمٍ وَلِلْأُمِّ السُّدُسُ سَهْمٌ وَلِلْإِخْوَةِ مِنَ الْأُمِّ الثُّلُثُ سَهْمَانِ وَلِلْأُخْتِ مِنَ الْأَبِ سَهْمٌ تَكْمِلَةُ الثُّلُثَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2939

chapter.englishTitle: In the Mamluks and the People of the Book

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali and Zaid used to not be hindered by the disbelievers or the slaves, and they would not inherit anything from them. Abdullah, on the other hand, would be hindered by the disbelievers and the slaves, and he would not inherit anything from them.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ali and Zaid used to not be hindered by the disbelievers or the slaves, and they would not inherit anything from them. Abdullah, on the other hand, would be hindered by the disbelievers and the slaves, and he would not inherit anything from them.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا وَزَيْدًا «كَانَا لَا يَحْجُبَانِ بِالْكُفَّارِ وَلَا بِالْمَمْلُوكِينَ وَلَا يُوَرِّثَانِهِمْ شَيْئًا» وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «يَحْجُبُ بِالْكُفَّارِ وَبِالْمَمْلُوكِينَ وَلَا يُوَرِّثُهُمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2940

chapter.englishTitle: In the Mamluks and the People of the Book

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali and Zaid said, "The slaves and the people of the Book do not wear the hijab or inherit." And Abdullah said, "They wear the hijab and do not inherit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ali and Zaid said, "The slaves and the people of the Book do not wear the hijab or inherit." And Abdullah said, "They wear the hijab and do not inherit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا وَزَيْدًا قَالَا «الْمَمْلُوكُونَ وَأَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا يَحْجُبُونَ وَلَا يَرِثُونَ» وَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «يَحْجُبُونَ وَلَا يَرِثُونَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlī And Zayd \u003e al-Mamlūkūn Waʾahl al-Kitāb Lā Yaḥjubūn Walā Yarithūn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2941

chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "Al-Jaddi

hadiths.englishRaw: That Omar wrote the inheritance of his grandfather until, when it was criticized, he called for it and erased it, then he said, "You will see your opinion about it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That Omar wrote the inheritance of his grandfather until, when it was criticized, he called for it and erased it, then he said, "You will see your opinion about it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عُمَرَ كَانَ كَتَبَ مِيرَاثَ الْجَدِّ حَتَّى إِذَا طُعِنَ دَعَا بِهِ فَمَحَاهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ «سَتَرَوْنَ رَأْيَكُمْ فِيهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Saʿīd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ سَعِيدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2942

chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "Al-Jaddi

hadiths.englishRaw: "I manage eighty different cases in seriousness."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I manage eighty different cases in seriousness."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنِّي لَأَحْفَظُ فِي الْجَدِّ ثَمَانِينَ قَضِيَّةً مُخْتَلِفَةً»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd \u003e Ashʿath \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Liʿabīdah Ḥaddithnī \u003e al-Jad
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ أَنْبَأَنَا أَشْعَثُ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعَبِيدَةَ حَدِّثْنِي عَنِ الْجَدِّ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2943

chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "Al-Jaddi

hadiths.englishRaw: "If there is no seriousness in it, then give it to me."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "If there is no seriousness in it, then give it to me."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهَا جَدٌّ فَهَاتِهَا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū Ghassān \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْخَارِفِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ فَرِيضَةٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2944

chapter.englishTitle: Translation: "Al-Jaddi

hadiths.englishRaw: "If he wants to leap into the flames of Hell, let him settle matters between the grandfather and the brothers."
hadiths.body: "If he wants to leap into the flames of Hell, let him settle matters between the grandfather and the brothers."
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يَتَقَحَّمَ جَرَاثِيمَ جَهَنَّمَ فَلْيَقْضِ بَيْنَ الْجَدِّ وَالْإِخْوَةِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ayyūb al-Sakhtiyānī \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr \u003e a man from Murād \u003e ʿAlī \u003e Man Sarrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ مُرَادٍ سَمِعَ عَلِيًّا يَقُولُ «مَنْ سَرَّهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2945

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Abu Sa'id al-Khudri"
hadiths.body: "From Abu Sa'id al-Khudri"
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Khālid \u003e Abū Naḍrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2946

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: "That Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq made determination his father."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "That Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq made determination his father."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿIkrimah
hadiths.chainArabic: ح وَعَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2947

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq was known for his fatherly seriousness.
hadiths.body: Abu Bakr Al-Siddiq was known for his fatherly seriousness.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ «جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Sulaymān al-Shaybānī \u003e Kurdūs \u003e Abū Burdah \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ كُرْدُوسٍ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2948

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: "That Abu Bakr made his grandfather a father."
hadiths.body: "That Abu Bakr made his grandfather a father."
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا»
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e al-Shaybānī \u003e Abū Burdah b. Abū Mūsá \u003e Kurdūs \u003e Abū Mūsá
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى عَنْ كُرْدُوسٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2949

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Bakr used to consider his grandfather as a father.
hadiths.body: Abu Bakr used to consider his grandfather as a father.
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ «كَانَ يَجْعَلُ الْجَدَّ أَبًا»
hadiths.chain: al-Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Abū Burdah \u003e Marwān \u003e ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2950

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Bakr used to consider his grandfather as (his own) father.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Bakr used to consider his grandfather as (his own) father.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَانَ يَجْعَلُ الْجَدَّ أَبًا   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh And Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2951

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, a grandfather does not hold the same position as a father in your eyes, and you do not deny." He (the interrogator) said, "I said, even if you were (the father), you would not deny." Marwan said, "I bear witness regarding Uthman bin Affan that he testified regarding Abu Bakr that he made the grandfather (as) a father when there is no father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, a grandfather does not hold the same position as a father in your eyes, and you do not deny." He (the interrogator) said, "I said, even if you were (the father), you would not deny." Marwan said, "I bear witness regarding Uthman bin Affan that he testified regarding Abu Bakr that he made the grandfather (as) a father when there is no father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ الْجَدَّ لَا يُنَزَّلُ فِيكُمْ مَنْزِلَةَ الْأَبِ وَأَنْتَ لَا تُنْكِرُ؟ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَلَوْ كُنْتَ أَنْتَ لَمْ تُنْكِرْ قَالَ مَرْوَانُ فَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ أَنَّهُ شَهِدَ عَلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ «أَنَّهُ جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ دُونَهُ أَبٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Abū Burdah \u003e Laqīt Marwān b. al-Ḥakam Bi-al-Madīnah \u003e Yā Ibn Abū Mūsá Alam Ukhbar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ قَالَ لَقِيتُ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَبِي مُوسَى أَلَمْ أُخْبَرْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2952

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: That Abu Bakr "used to consider his grandfather as a father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That Abu Bakr "used to consider his grandfather as a father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ «كَانَ يَجْعَلُ الْجَدَّ أَبًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Aswad b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ أََنْبَأَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ وَعَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2953

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If I were to take anyone as my intimate friend, I would have taken Abu Bakr as my intimate friend. However, the brotherhood of Islam is superior." This means that Abu Bakr was made a father, which means a grandfather.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "If I were to take anyone as my intimate friend, I would have taken Abu Bakr as my intimate friend. However, the brotherhood of Islam is superior." This means that Abu Bakr was made a father, which means a grandfather.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَوْ كُنْتُ مُتَّخِذًا أَحَدًا خَلِيلًا لَاتَّخَذْتُهُ خَلِيلًا وَلَكِنْ أُخُوَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ أَفْضَلُ» يَعْنِي «أَبَا بَكْرٍ جَعَلَهُ أَبًا» يَعْنِي الْجَدَّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ayyūb \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e Jaʿalah al--Adhī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ جَعَلَهُ الَّذِي

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2954

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Bakr made his grandfather a father.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Bakr made his grandfather a father.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Ibn Abū Mulaykah \u003e Ibn al-Zubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2955

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr regarding the grandfather

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, the grandfather's tradition has passed and indeed Abu Bakr made the grandfather a father, but people have chosen."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, the grandfather's tradition has passed and indeed Abu Bakr made the grandfather a father, but people have chosen."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ الْجَدَّ قَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُهُ وَإِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا وَلَكِنَّ النَّاسَ تَخَيَّرُوا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e In al-Jad Qad Maḍat Sunnatuh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أََنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2956
hadiths.englishRaw: "The first caliph to inherit in Islam is Umar."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "The first caliph to inherit in Islam is Umar."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ أَوَّلَ جَدٍّ وَرِثَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ عُمَرُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2957
hadiths.englishRaw: The first instance of inheritance in Islam was when Umar inherited his wealth. Ali and Zaid came to him and said, "That is not for you. You are just like one of the two brothers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The first instance of inheritance in Islam was when Umar inherited his wealth. Ali and Zaid came to him and said, "That is not for you. You are just like one of the two brothers."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ جَدٍّ وَرِثَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ عُمَرُ فَأَخَذَ مَالَهُ فَأَتَاهُ عَلِيٌّ وَزَيْدٌ فَقَالَا «لَيْسَ لَكَ ذَاكَ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ كَأَحَدِ الْأَخَوَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2958
hadiths.englishRaw: Umar used to share with his brother and two siblings, and when they increased, he gave him one-third, and he gave him one-sixth with the child.
hadiths.body: Umar used to share with his brother and two siblings, and when they increased, he gave him one-third, and he gave him one-sixth with the child.
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ عُمَرُ يُقَاسِمُ بِالْجَدِّ مَعَ الْأَخِ وَالْأَخَوَيْنِ فَإِذَا زَادُوا أَعْطَاهُ الثُّلُثَ وَكَانَ يُعْطِيهِ مَعَ الْوَلَدِ السُّدُسَ»
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e ʿĪsá al-Ḥannāṭ \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ عِيسَى الْحَنَّاطِ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2959
hadiths.englishRaw: "I had seen an opinion in my grandfather, so if you see that you should follow it, then follow it." Uthman said to him, "If we follow your opinion, it is indeed guidance, and if we follow the opinion of the sheikh, then he is truly knowledgeable."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "I had seen an opinion in my grandfather, so if you see that you should follow it, then follow it." Uthman said to him, "If we follow your opinion, it is indeed guidance, and if we follow the opinion of the sheikh, then he is truly knowledgeable."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنِّي كُنْتُ رَأَيْتُ فِي الْجَدِّ رَأْيًا فَإِنْ رَأَيْتُمْ أَنْ تَتَّبِعُوهُ فَاتَّبِعُوهُ» فَقَالَ لَهُ عُثْمَانُ إِنْ نَتَّبِعْ رَأْيَكَ فَإِنَّهُ رَشَدٌ وَإِنْ نَتَّبِعْ رَأْيَ الشَّيْخِ فَلَنِعْمَ ذُو الرَّأْيِ كَانَ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah from his father \u003e Marwān b. al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb Lammā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ لَمَّا طُعِنَ اسْتَشَارَهُمْ فِي الْجَدِّ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2960

chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali about seriousness

hadiths.englishRaw: "To give importance to seriousness and not to give it to anyone afterwards."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "To give importance to seriousness and not to give it to anyone afterwards."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنْ أَعْطِ الْجَدَّ سُدُسًا وَلَا تُعْطِهِ أَحَدًا بَعْدَهُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e al-Shaybānī \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Katab Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e ʿAlī And Ibn ʿAbbās Bi-al-Baṣrah Innī Utīt Bijad And Sittah Ikhwah Fakatab Ilayh ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ كَتَبَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ وَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِالْبَصْرَةِ إِنِّي أُتِيتُ بِجَدٍّ وَسِتَّةِ إِخْوَةٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ عَلِيٌّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2961

chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali about seriousness

hadiths.englishRaw: It seems that Al-Sha'bi means Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated it from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It seems that Al-Sha'bi means Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated it from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَأَنَّهُ يَعْنِي عَلِيًّا رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ الشَّعْبِيُّ يَرْوِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e Ismāʿīl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي سِتَّةِ إِخْوَةٍ وَجَدٍّ قَالَ «أَعْطِ الْجَدَّ السُّدُسَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2962

chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali about seriousness

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali used to consider seriousness as a sixth sense.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Ali used to consider seriousness as a sixth sense.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا «كَانَ يَجْعَلُ الْجَدَّ أَخًا مَتََى يَكُونَ سَادِسًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2963

chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali about seriousness

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ali used to distribute the share of the grandfather among the brothers equally."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Ali used to distribute the share of the grandfather among the brothers equally."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا «كَانَ يُشَرِّكُ الْجَدَّ مَعَ الْإِخْوَةِ إِلَى السُّدُسِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2964

chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali about seriousness

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ali used to mediate between the grandparents and siblings until he becomes the sixth."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Ali used to mediate between the grandparents and siblings until he becomes the sixth."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ عَلِيٌّ يُشَرِّكُ بَيْنَ الْجَدِّ وَالْإِخْوَةِ حَتَّى يَكُونَ سَادِسًا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Hāshim b. al-Qāsim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2965

chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali about seriousness

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ali used to share the inheritance equally among his six siblings. He would give each person their rightful share, and he would not grant an inheritance to a brother from the mother's side along with a paternal grandfather, nor to a sister from the mother's side. The grandfather's share would not exceed one-sixth even if there were other heirs. He would not divide the inheritance with a paternal brother along with a brother from the mother's side and mother. If there was a sister from the father's side, a sister from the mother's side, and a brother from the father's side, he would give the sister half and divide the other half equally between the grandfather and the brother. If they were brothers and sisters, he would share with them equally up to one-sixth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Ali used to share the inheritance equally among his six siblings. He would give each person their rightful share, and he would not grant an inheritance to a brother from the mother's side along with a paternal grandfather, nor to a sister from the mother's side. The grandfather's share would not exceed one-sixth even if there were other heirs. He would not divide the inheritance with a paternal brother along with a brother from the mother's side and mother. If there was a sister from the father's side, a sister from the mother's side, and a brother from the father's side, he would give the sister half and divide the other half equally between the grandfather and the brother. If they were brothers and sisters, he would share with them equally up to one-sixth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ عَلِيٌّ يُشَرِّكُ الْجَدَّ إِلَى سِتَّةٍ مَعَ الْإِخْوَةِ يُعْطِي كُلَّ صَاحِبِ فَرِيضَةٍ فَرِيضَتَهُ وَلَا يُوَرِّثُ أَخًا لِأُمٍّ مَعَ جَدٍّ وَلَا أُخْتًا لِأُمٍّ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْجَدَّ مَعَ الْوَلَدِ عَلَى السُّدُسِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ غَيْرُهُ وَلَا يُقَاسِمُ بِأَخٍ لِأَبٍ مَعَ أَخٍ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ وَإِذَا كَانَتْ أُخْتٌ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ وَأَخٌ لِأَبٍ أَعْطَى الْأُخْتَ النِّصْفَ وَالنِّصْفَ الْآخَرَ بَيْنَ الْجَدِّ وَالْأَخِ نِصْفَيْنِ وَإِذَا كَانُوا إِخْوَةً وَأَخَوَاتٍ شَرَّكَهُمْ مَعَ الْجَدِّ إِلَى السُّدُسِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2966

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ibn Abbas regarding Al-Jad.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Who is your oldest father?" So I said, "I am Adam." He said, "Have you not heard the saying of Allah the Almighty, 'O Children of Adam' (Surah Al-A'raf 26)."
hadiths.body: "Who is your oldest father?" So I said, "I am Adam." He said, "Have you not heard the saying of Allah the Almighty, 'O Children of Adam' (Surah Al-A'raf 26)."
hadiths.arabic: «أَيُّ أَبٍ لَكَ أَكْبَرُ؟» فَقُلْتُ أَنَا آدَمُ قَالَ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ إِلَى قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى {يَا بَنِي آدَمَ} [الأعراف 26]
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-ʿAbsī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Khālid \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Maʿqil \u003e Suʾil Ibn ʿAbbās \u003e al-Jad \u003e Ay Ab Lak Akbar Faqult \u003e Ādam \u003e Alam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الْعَبْسِيِّ هُوَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْقِلٍ قَالَ سُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الْجَدِّ؟ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2967

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ibn Abbas regarding Al-Jad.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I wish that both I and those who disagree with me in seriousness would curse each other, so which of us is worse in speech."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I wish that both I and those who disagree with me in seriousness would curse each other, so which of us is worse in speech."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَوَدِدْتُ أَنِّي وَالَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَنِي فِي الْجَدِّ تَلَاعَنَّا أَيُّنَا أَسْوَأُ قَوْلًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Sumayʿ \u003e a man \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ سُمَيْعٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2968

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ibn Abbas regarding Al-Jad.

hadiths.englishRaw: "He made his grandfather his father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He made his grandfather his father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ أَبًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ibn Ṭāwus from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2969

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فِي الْجَدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ibn Mas'ood about Al-Jadd.

hadiths.englishRaw: Do I have any sisters? I said no. He said that the husband's share is a half and the mother's share is a third. He said, "So I tried my best to answer me and he did not answer me except by that." Ibrahim and 'Amir and 'Abdul-Rahman ibn 'Abdullah said, "No one has ever come with a obligation more confusing than the obligation you came with." He said, "So I came to 'Ubaidah As-Salmani and it was said that no one in Kufa knows more about a obligation than 'Ubaidah and Al-Harith Al-A'war. 'Ubaidah used to sit in the mosque, and when Shurayh came with an obligation that had a difficulty, he would refer it to 'Ubaidah, and he would give a ruling. So I asked him and he said, "If you want, I can tell you about the obligation of Abdullah ibn Mas'ood in this matter. He said, "For the husband, there are three shares, half for the wife, a third for the mother, and a sixth of the remaining capital for the father-in-law." Abu Ishaq said, "The father-in-law is the grandfather."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Do I have any sisters? I said no. He said that the husband's share is a half and the mother's share is a third. He said, "So I tried my best to answer me and he did not answer me except by that." Ibrahim and 'Amir and 'Abdul-Rahman ibn 'Abdullah said, "No one has ever come with a obligation more confusing than the obligation you came with." He said, "So I came to 'Ubaidah As-Salmani and it was said that no one in Kufa knows more about a obligation than 'Ubaidah and Al-Harith Al-A'war. 'Ubaidah used to sit in the mosque, and when Shurayh came with an obligation that had a difficulty, he would refer it to 'Ubaidah, and he would give a ruling. So I asked him and he said, "If you want, I can tell you about the obligation of Abdullah ibn Mas'ood in this matter. He said, "For the husband, there are three shares, half for the wife, a third for the mother, and a sixth of the remaining capital for the father-in-law." Abu Ishaq said, "The father-in-law is the grandfather."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِي هَلْ مِنْ أُخْتٍ؟ قُلْتُ لَا قَالَ لِلْبَعْلِ الشَّطْرُ وَلِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثُ قَالَ فَجَهِدْتُ عَلَى أَنْ يُجِيبَنِي فَلَمْ يُجِبْنِي إِلَّا بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَعَامِرٌ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَا جَاءَ أَحَدٌ بِفَرِيضَةٍ أَعْضَلَ مِنْ فَرِيضَةٍ جِئْتَ بِهَا قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُ عَبِيدَةَ السَّلْمَانِيَّ وَكَانَ يُقَالُ لَيْسَ بِالْكُوفَةِ أَحَدٌ أَعْلَمَ بِفَرِيضَةٍ مِنْ عَبِيدَةَ وَالْحَارِثِ الْأَعْوَرِ وَكَانَ عَبِيدَةُ يَجْلِسُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَإِذَا وَرَدَتْ عَلَى شُرَيْحٍ فَرِيضَةٌ فِيهَا جَدٌّ رَفَعَهُمْ إِلَى عَبِيدَةَ فَفَرَضَ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ نَبَّأْتُكُمْ بِفَرِيضَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فِي هَذَا «جَعَلَ لِلزَّوْجِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَسْهُمٍ النِّصْفَ وَلِلْأُمِّ ثُلُثُ مَا بَقِيَ السُّدُسُ مِنْ رَأْسِ الْمَالِ وَلِلْأَخِ سَهْمٌ وَلِلْجَدِّ سَهْمٌ» قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ «الْجَدُّ أَبُو الْأَبِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū Isḥāq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى شُرَيْحٍ وَعِنْدَهُ عَامِرٌ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي فَرِيضَةِ امْرَأَةٍ مِنَّا الْعَالِيَةِ تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَأُمَّهَا وَأَخَاهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَجَدَّهَا فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2970

chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Zaid about the grandfather.

hadiths.englishRaw: Zaid used to divide the grandfather's inheritance equally among the siblings, according to one-third.   – Weak
hadiths.body: Zaid used to divide the grandfather's inheritance equally among the siblings, according to one-third.   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ زَيْدًا «كَانَ يُشَرِّكُ الْجَدَّ مَعَ الْإِخْوَةِ إِلَى الثُّلُثِ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2971

chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Zaid about the grandfather.

hadiths.englishRaw: "It was the case that he would share with his brothers the work with great effort, up to one-third, and then he would not diminish it."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "It was the case that he would share with his brothers the work with great effort, up to one-third, and then he would not diminish it."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُقَاسِمُ بِالْجَدِّ مَعَ الْإِخْوَةِ إِلَى الثُّلُثِ ثُمَّ لَا يُنْقِصُهُ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUmar b. Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth from my father \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2972

chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Zaid about the grandfather.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Amir said, 'Take from the matter of the ancestors what the people have agreed upon.'" Abu Muhammad said, meaning the statement of Zaid.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Amir said, 'Take from the matter of the ancestors what the people have agreed upon.'" Abu Muhammad said, meaning the statement of Zaid.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَامِرٌ «خُذْ مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَدِّ مَا اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ يَعْنِي قَوْلَ زَيْدٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e ʿĪsá b. Yūnus \u003e Ismāʿīl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2973

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الْأَكْدَرِيَّةِ: زَوْجٌ، وَأُخْتٌ لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ، وَجَدٌّ، وَأُمٌّ
chapter.englishTitle: Alexandria: Husband, sister to a father and mother, grandfather,...

hadiths.englishRaw: He made them twenty-seven for the mother, six for the wife, nine for the husband, eight for the grandfather, and four for the sister.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He made them twenty-seven for the mother, six for the wife, nine for the husband, eight for the grandfather, and four for the sister.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَعَلَهَا مِنْ سَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ لِلْأُمِّ سِتَّةٌ وَلِلزَّوْجِ تِسْعَةٌ وَلِلْجَدِّ ثَمَانِيَةٌ وَلِلْأُخْتِ أَرْبَعَةٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هَمَّامٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ أَنَّ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ فِي أُخْتٍ وَأُمٍّ وَزَوْجٍ وَجَدٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2974

chapter.englishTitle: In the neighborhoods

hadiths.englishRaw: "The first grandmother who was fed in Islam is either a mother or her living son."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The first grandmother who was fed in Islam is either a mother or her living son."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ أَوَّلَ جَدَّةٍ أُطْعِمَتْ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ سَهْمًا أَمُّ أَبٍ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2975

chapter.englishTitle: In the neighborhoods

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the Arabic phrase أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «أَطْعَمَ جَدَّةً سُدُسًا» into English is "Indeed, the Prophet peace be upon him fed a group with one-sixth of the amount."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the Arabic phrase أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «أَطْعَمَ جَدَّةً سُدُسًا» into English is "Indeed, the Prophet peace be upon him fed a group with one-sixth of the amount."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «أَطْعَمَ جَدَّةً سُدُسًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e Layth \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2976

chapter.englishTitle: In the neighborhoods

hadiths.englishRaw: It means: "Umar inherited a grandmother with her son."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It means: "Umar inherited a grandmother with her son."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عُمَرَ «وَرَّثَ جَدَّةً مَعَ ابْنِهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Maysarah \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2977

chapter.englishTitle: In the neighborhoods

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ fed three granaries with one-sixth of their crops." I asked Ibrahim, "Who are they?" He said, "Your paternal grandmother is one of them, and your maternal grandmother is the other."
hadiths.body: "The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ fed three granaries with one-sixth of their crops." I asked Ibrahim, "Who are they?" He said, "Your paternal grandmother is one of them, and your maternal grandmother is the other."
hadiths.arabic: «أَطْعَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلَاثَ جَدَّاتٍ سُدُسًا» قَالَ قُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ مَنْ هُنَّهْ؟ قَالَ جَدَّتَاكَ مِنْ قِبَلِ أَبِيكَ وَجَدَّتُكَ مِنْ قِبَلِ أُمِّكَ
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr b. al-Muʿtamir \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْصُورُ بْنُ الْمُعْتَمِرِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2978

chapter.englishTitle: In the neighborhoods

hadiths.englishRaw: "The grandmother and her son are alive."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The grandmother and her son are alive."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَرِثُ الْجَدَّةُ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Yazīd b. Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنِي الْحَسَنُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2979

chapter.englishTitle: In the neighborhoods

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not inherit the son of his mother's mother, whom she does not give birth to, so how will she inherit?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not inherit the son of his mother's mother, whom she does not give birth to, so how will she inherit?"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَرِثُ أُمُّ أَبِ الْأُمِّ ابْنُهَا الَّذِي تُدْلِي بِهِ لَا يَرِثُ فَكَيْفَ تَرِثُ هِيَ؟»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Dāwud \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2980

chapter.englishTitle: In the neighborhoods

hadiths.englishRaw: "The grandmother and her son are alive."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The grandmother and her son are alive."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَرِثُ الْجَدَّةُ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Maʿmar \u003e Ismāʿīl Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Salamah b. ʿAlqamah \u003e Ḥumayd b. Hilāl \u003e Abū al-Dahmāʾ \u003e ʿImrān b. Ḥuṣayn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلَالٍ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّهْمَاءِ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2981

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ فِي الْجَدَّاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Abu Bakr As-Siddiq about genealogy

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Bakr's grandmother, the mother of his father or the mother of his mother, came to him and said, "My son's son or my daughter's son has passed away and I was informed that I have a share. What is it for me?" Abu Bakr replied, "I did not hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying anything about this, but I will ask the people." After performing the Dhuhr prayer, Abu Bakr asked, "Which one of you heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying something about the grandmother?" Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah replied, "I heard him saying, 'He gave her one-sixth.'" Abu Bakr asked, "Does anyone else know this except you?" Muhammad bin Muslimah said, "Yes, he is truthful." So Abu Bakr gave her one-sixth. Then another woman with a similar case came to Umar and said, "I do not know what I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about this, but I will ask the people." They informed her with the narration of Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah and Muhammad bin Muslimah. Umar said, "If any one of you had a share by herself, she should have one-sixth, but if both of you share together, then it is between you."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Bakr's grandmother, the mother of his father or the mother of his mother, came to him and said, "My son's son or my daughter's son has passed away and I was informed that I have a share. What is it for me?" Abu Bakr replied, "I did not hear the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying anything about this, but I will ask the people." After performing the Dhuhr prayer, Abu Bakr asked, "Which one of you heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ saying something about the grandmother?" Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah replied, "I heard him saying, 'He gave her one-sixth.'" Abu Bakr asked, "Does anyone else know this except you?" Muhammad bin Muslimah said, "Yes, he is truthful." So Abu Bakr gave her one-sixth. Then another woman with a similar case came to Umar and said, "I do not know what I have heard from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about this, but I will ask the people." They informed her with the narration of Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah and Muhammad bin Muslimah. Umar said, "If any one of you had a share by herself, she should have one-sixth, but if both of you share together, then it is between you."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَتْ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ جَدَّةٌ أُمُّ أَبٍ أَوْ أُمُّ أُمٍّ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ ابْنَ ابْنِي أَوِ ابْنَ ابْنَتِي تُوُفِّيَ وَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ لِي نَصِيبًا فَمَا لِي؟ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ مَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فِيهَا شَيْئًا وَسَأَسْأَلُ النَّاسَ فَلَمَّا صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ فقَالَ أَيُّكُمْ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فِي الْجَدَّةِ شَيْئًا؟ فَقَالَ الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ أَنَا قَالَ مَاذَا؟ قَالَ «أَعْطَاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ سُدُسًا» قَالَ أَيَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ؟ فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ صَدَقَ فَأَعْطَاهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ السُّدُسَ فَجَاءَتْ إِلَى عُمَرَ مِثْلُهَا فَقَالَ مَا أَدْرِي مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِيهَا شَيْئًا وَسَأَسْأَلُ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثُوهُ بِحَدِيثِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ «أَيُّكُمَا خَلَتْ بِهِ فَلَهَا السُّدُسُ فَإِنِ اجْتَمَعْتُمَا فَهُوَ بَيْنَكُمَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2982

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ فِي الْجَدَّاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali and Zaid about the grandmothers

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali and Zaid said, "When the grandmothers are equal, the inheritance is distributed among three grandmothers: the grandmother of his father, the grandmother of his mother, and the grandmother of his father's mother. If one of them is closer, then the relatives of the deceased have the right to inherit.”   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ali and Zaid said, "When the grandmothers are equal, the inheritance is distributed among three grandmothers: the grandmother of his father, the grandmother of his mother, and the grandmother of his father's mother. If one of them is closer, then the relatives of the deceased have the right to inherit.”   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ قَالَا «إِذَا كَانَتِ الْجَدَّاتُ سَوَاءً وَرِثَ ثَلَاثُ جَدَّاتٍ جَدَّتَا أَبِيهِ أُمُّ أُمِّهِ وَأُمُّ أَبِيهِ وَجَدَّةُ أُمِّهِ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ إِحَدَاهُنَّ أَقْرَبَ فَالسَّهْمُ لِذَوِي الْقُرْبَى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAlī And Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2983

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ فِي الْجَدَّاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali and Zaid about the grandmothers

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ali and Zaid, "They used to not inherit the grandmother, mother of the father, along with the father."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About Ali and Zaid, "They used to not inherit the grandmother, mother of the father, along with the father."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ «أَنَّهُمَا كَانَا لَا يُوَرِّثَانِ الْجَدَّةَ أُمَّ الْأَبِ مَعَ الْأَبِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2984
