chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ فِي الْجَدَّاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: The saying of Ali and Zaid about the grandmothers

hadiths.englishRaw: That Uthman used to not inherit the grandmother and her son while they are alive.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: That Uthman used to not inherit the grandmother and her son while they are alive.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ «كَانَ لَا يُوَرِّثُ الْجَدَّةَ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2985

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فِي الْجَدَّاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Ibn Mas'ud about grandparents

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, grandmothers do not have inheritance, they are merely a provision that we provide. And grandmothers are the closest and farthest among them are equal."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, grandmothers do not have inheritance, they are merely a provision that we provide. And grandmothers are the closest and farthest among them are equal."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ الْجَدَّاتِ لَيْسَ لَهُنَّ مِيرَاثٌ إِنَّمَا هِيَ طُعْمَةٌ أُطْعِمْنَهَا وَالْجَدَّاتُ أَقْرَبُهُنَّ وَأَبْعَدُهُنَّ سَوَاءٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2986

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فِي الْجَدَّاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: The statement of Ibn Mas'ud about grandparents

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah inherits the grandmother and her son is alive."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah inherits the grandmother and her son is alive."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «تَرِثُ الْجَدَّةُ وَابْنُهَا حَيٌّ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2987

chapter.englishTitle: A stolen saying in traditions

hadiths.englishRaw: Four grandmothers arrived, competing for the position of stolen. He canceled either the mother or the father of the mother, and inherited three: his paternal grandmother, his maternal grandmother, and his paternal grandfather's mother.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Four grandmothers arrived, competing for the position of stolen. He canceled either the mother or the father of the mother, and inherited three: his paternal grandmother, his maternal grandmother, and his paternal grandfather's mother.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: جِئْنَ أَرْبَعُ جَدَّاتٍ يَتَسَاوَقْنَ إِلَى مَسْرُوقٍ فَأَلْغَى أَمَّ أَبِي الْأُمِّ وَوَرَّثَ ثَلَاثًا جَدَّتَيْ أَبِيهِ أُمَّ أُمِّهِ وَأُمَّ أَبِيهِ وَجَدَّةَ أُمِّهِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2988

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَزَيْدٍ فِي الرَّدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Statement of Ali, Abdullah, and Zaid in response to...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The half and the sixth and what remains is an odd number on the girl."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The half and the sixth and what remains is an odd number on the girl."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «النِّصْفُ وَالسُّدُسُ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَرَدٌّ عَلَى الْبِنْتِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي ابْنَةٍ وَابْنَةِ ابْنٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2989

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَزَيْدٍ فِي الرَّدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Statement of Ali, Abdullah, and Zaid in response to...

hadiths.englishRaw: "It came to pass that there were two brothers from one mother and father. He gave one-third of the wealth to the brothers from the mother, and the rest of the wealth to the mother. And he said, 'The mother is a tie for those who have no family tie.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It came to pass that there were two brothers from one mother and father. He gave one-third of the wealth to the brothers from the mother, and the rest of the wealth to the mother. And he said, 'The mother is a tie for those who have no family tie.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ فِي إِخْوَةٍ لِأُمٍّ وَأُمٍّ فَأَعْطَى الْإِخْوَةَ مِنَ الْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَ وَالْأُمَّ سَائِرَ الْمَالِ وَقَالَ «الْأُمُّ عَصَبَةُ مَنْ لَا عَصَبَةَ لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Jarīr \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAlqamah \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2990

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَزَيْدٍ فِي الرَّدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Statement of Ali, Abdullah, and Zaid in response to...

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man who died and left his daughter with no known heir; he said, "She inherits all his wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man who died and left his daughter with no known heir; he said, "She inherits all his wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ لَا يُعْلَمُ وَارِثٌ غَيْرُهَا قَالَ «لَهَا الْمَالُ كُلُّهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan from his father \u003e Saʾalt al-Shaʿbī \u003e a man Māt And Tarak Āb.atah Lā Yuʿlam Wārith Ghayruhā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2991

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَزَيْدٍ فِي الرَّدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Statement of Ali, Abdullah, and Zaid in response to...

hadiths.englishRaw: That Ibn Mas'ood used to not respond to a brother of his mother when his mother was present, nor to a grandmother when she was accompanied by someone other than her, nor to the daughter of a son with the daughter of a step-son, nor to a woman and her husband. And Ali used to respond to everyone with a question, except for a woman and her husband.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: That Ibn Mas'ood used to not respond to a brother of his mother when his mother was present, nor to a grandmother when she was accompanied by someone other than her, nor to the daughter of a son with the daughter of a step-son, nor to a woman and her husband. And Ali used to respond to everyone with a question, except for a woman and her husband.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ «كَانَ لَا يَرُدُّ عَلَى أَخٍ لِأُمٍّ مَعَ أُمٍّ وَلَا عَلَى جَدَّةٍ إِذَا كَانَ مَعَهَا غَيْرُهَا مِمَّنْ لَهُ فَرِيضَةٌ وَلَا عَلَى ابْنَةِ ابْنٍ مَعَ ابْنَةِ الصُّلْبِ وَلَا عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ وَزَوْجٍ» وَكَانَ عَلِيٌّ يَرُدُّ عَلَى كُلِّ ذِي سَهْمٍ إِلَّا الْمَرْأَةَ وَالزَّوْجَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥammad b. Sālim \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2992

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: قَوْلِ عَلِيٍّ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَزَيْدٍ فِي الرَّدِّ
chapter.englishTitle: Statement of Ali, Abdullah, and Zaid in response to...

hadiths.englishRaw: "And it was given to a daughter or sister, so he gave her half and left what remained in the treasury." Yazid bin Harun narrated from Muhammad bin Salim, from Ash-Sha'bi, from Kharijah.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "And it was given to a daughter or sister, so he gave her half and left what remained in the treasury." Yazid bin Harun narrated from Muhammad bin Salim, from Ash-Sha'bi, from Kharijah.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ فِي ابْنَةٍ أَوْ أُخْتٍ فَأَعْطَاهَا النِّصْفَ وَجَعَلَ مَا بَقِيَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ» وقَالَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ خَارِجَةَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥammad b. Sālim \u003e Khārijah b. Zayd \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2993

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "His inheritance is for his mother."
hadiths.body: "His inheritance is for his mother."
hadiths.arabic: «مِيرَاثُهُ لِأُمِّهِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Abū Maʿshar \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2994

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "To his mother and her family"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "To his mother and her family"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لِأُمِّهِ وَأَهْلِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muʿādh b. Hāniʾ \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Ṭahmān \u003e a man Saʾal ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Rabāḥ \u003e And Lad al-Mutalāʿinayn Liman Mīrāthuh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ عَنْ وَلَدِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ لِمَنْ مِيرَاثُهُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2995

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Mas'ood said to his brother Al-Sudus, "Take what is left, and what remains is for the mother."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Mas'ood said to his brother Al-Sudus, "Take what is left, and what remains is for the mother."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: وقَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ «لِأَخِيهِ السُّدُسُ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأُمِّ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e Abū Sahl \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ «تَرَكَ أَخَاهُ لِأُمِّهِ وَأُمَّهُ لِأَخِيهِ السُّدُسُ وَلِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ عَلَيْهِمَا فَيَصِيرُ لِلْأَخِ الثُّلُثُ وَلِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَانِ»

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2996

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The money is for the nephew."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The money is for the nephew."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمَالُ لِابْنِ الْأَخِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e Abū Sahl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ أَبِي سَهْلٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ تَرَكَ ابْنَ أَخٍ وَجَدًّا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2997

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Zaid ibn Thabit regarding the inheritance of the accursed son, "One-third for his mother and two-thirds for the treasury."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About Zaid ibn Thabit regarding the inheritance of the accursed son, "One-third for his mother and two-thirds for the treasury."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ فِي مِيرَاثِ ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ «لِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثَانِ لِبَيْتِ الْمَالِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Sālim b. Nūḥ \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿĀmir \u003e Qatādah \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2998

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: From Al-Hasan: "One third (of the wealth) for his mother and the remainder for the clan of his mother."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: From Al-Hasan: "One third (of the wealth) for his mother and the remainder for the clan of his mother."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ «لِأُمِّهِ الثُّلُثُ وَبَقِيَّةُ الْمَالِ لِعَصَبَةِ أُمِّهِ»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Sālim b. Nūḥ \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿĀmir \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Mīrāthuh Liʾummih Taʿqil \u003e h ʿAṣabah Ummih Wqāl Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ «مِيرَاثُهُ لِأُمِّهِ تَعْقِلُ عَنْهُ عَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ» وقَالَ قَتَادَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 2999

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali and Ibn Mas'ood said about the cursed child, "He left his grandmother and brothers to his mother. The grandmother receives one third, while the brothers receive two thirds." Zaid ibn Thabit said, "The grandmother receives one sixth, and the brothers receive one third for the mother, and whatever remains goes to the treasury."
hadiths.body: Ali and Ibn Mas'ood said about the cursed child, "He left his grandmother and brothers to his mother. The grandmother receives one third, while the brothers receive two thirds." Zaid ibn Thabit said, "The grandmother receives one sixth, and the brothers receive one third for the mother, and whatever remains goes to the treasury."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا وَابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَا فِي وَلَدِ الْمُلَاعَنَةٍ تَرَكَ جَدَّتَهُ وَإِخْوَتَهُ لِأُمِّهِ قَالَ «لِلْجَدَّةِ الثُّلُثُ وَلِلْإِخْوَةِ الثُّلُثَانِ» وقَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ «لِلْجَدَّةِ السُّدُسُ وَلِلْإِخْوَةِ لِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثُ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِبَيْتِ الْمَالِ»
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿAlī And Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَنَا قَتَادَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3000

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "His mother inherits it" means the son of the cursed.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "His mother inherits it" means the son of the cursed.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَرِثُهُ أُمُّهُ» يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Yūnus And Ḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ وَحُمَيدٌ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3001

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "That Al-Nakha'i and Al-Sha'bi said, 'His mother inherits him.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "That Al-Nakha'i and Al-Sha'bi said, 'His mother inherits him.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّخَعِيَّ وَالشَّعْبِيَّ قَالَا «تَرِثُهُ أُمُّهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ḥajjāj \u003e al-Nakhaʿī And al-Shhaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3002

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: I wrote to a brother of mine from the Banu Zurayq tribe, asking him who decided the fate of the cursed son. He wrote back to me saying that the Prophet ﷺ decided that his mother should have the same status as his own mother and father. Sufyan said, "All the wealth belongs to the mother, she has the same status as his mother and father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I wrote to a brother of mine from the Banu Zurayq tribe, asking him who decided the fate of the cursed son. He wrote back to me saying that the Prophet ﷺ decided that his mother should have the same status as his own mother and father. Sufyan said, "All the wealth belongs to the mother, she has the same status as his mother and father."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَخٍ لِي مِنْ بَنِي زُرَيْقٍ أَسْأَلُهُ لِمَنْ قَضَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ؟ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «قَضَى بِهِ لِأُمِّهِ هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ أُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ» وقَالَ سُفْيَانُ «الْمَالُ كُلُّهُ لِلْأُمِّ هِيَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ أَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3003

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "One third belongs to his mother and the rest is for his mother's family."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "One third belongs to his mother and the rest is for his mother's family."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الثُّلُثُ لِأُمِّهِ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِعَصَبَةِ أُمِّهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ تَرَكَ أُمَّهُ وَعَصَبَةَ أُمِّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3004

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ali and Abdullah regarding the son of Al-Mula'anah, they said, "His lineage traces back to his mother."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About Ali and Abdullah regarding the son of Al-Mula'anah, they said, "His lineage traces back to his mother."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ قَالَا «عَصَبَتُهُ عَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ عَامِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3005

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to say, "The inheritance of the cursed child belongs to his mother." I asked, "What if he has a sibling from his mother?" He replied, "He will have one-sixth."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: He used to say, "The inheritance of the cursed child belongs to his mother." I asked, "What if he has a sibling from his mother?" He replied, "He will have one-sixth."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «مِيرَاثُ وَلَدِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ لِأُمِّهِ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانَ لَهُ أَخٌ مِنْ أُمِّهِ؟ قَالَ «لَهُ السُّدُسُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ḥalabī Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Muʿtamir \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الْحَلَبِيُّ مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3006

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The cursed son inherits his mother's share from him, and all of that is in the treasury."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The cursed son inherits his mother's share from him, and all of that is in the treasury."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «وَلَدُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ لِأُمِّهِ تَرِثُ فَرِيضَتَهَا مِنْهُ وَسَائِرُ ذَلِكَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3007

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "If they curse each other, they will be separated and not come together, and the child's mother is called the son of so-and-so, his lineage is attributed to her and she inherits him, and whoever calls him for adultery is punished."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If they curse each other, they will be separated and not come together, and the child's mother is called the son of so-and-so, his lineage is attributed to her and she inherits him, and whoever calls him for adultery is punished."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِذَا تَلَاعَنَا فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلَمْ يَجْتَمِعَا وَدُعِيَ الْوَلَدُ لِأُمِّهِ يُقَالُ ابْنُ فُلَانَةَ هِيَ عَصَبَتُهُ يَرِثُهَا وَتَرِثُهُ وَمَنْ دَعَاهُ لِزِنْيَةٍ جُلِدَ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUbaydah \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3008

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "In the cursed boy, it is said that his mother's tribe will inherit from him while they remain unaware of him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "In the cursed boy, it is said that his mother's tribe will inherit from him while they remain unaware of him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي وَلَدِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ «أَنَّهُ تَرِثُهُ عَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ وَهُمْ يَعْقِلُونَ عَنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muʿādh b. Hāniʾ \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Ṭahmān \u003e al-Shaybānī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا الشَّيْبَانِيُّ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3009

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibn Abbas, regarding the child of a cursed woman, he is the one who has no father. "His mother and his brothers from his mother shall inherit him, and his mother's clan shall inherit him. But If someone throws him, his thrower shall be punished by being thrown himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibn Abbas, regarding the child of a cursed woman, he is the one who has no father. "His mother and his brothers from his mother shall inherit him, and his mother's clan shall inherit him. But If someone throws him, his thrower shall be punished by being thrown himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي وَلَدِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ هُوَ الَّذِي لَا أَبَ لَهُ «تَرِثُهُ أُمُّهُ وَإِخْوَتُهُ مِنْ أُمِّهِ وَعَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ فَإِنْ قَذَفَهُ قَاذِفٌ جُلِدَ قَاذِفُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿAzrah \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَزْرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3010

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: "He made him the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as a means for his mother to protect her from the hardships she encountered, and for his brothers from his mother. Mak'houl said, 'If the mother dies and leaves behind her son, and then her son also passes away, the inheritance of her son will go entirely to his brothers from his mother because it belonged to their mother and their grandfather. And the father's share will be one-sixth of his son's son, and the grandfather only inherits in this specific case because he is the father of the mother. And the brothers from the mother inherit their mother's inheritance, while the grandfather inherits his daughter's son because he was designated for her. Therefore, the wealth that belongs to the child is inherited by the heirs of the mother, and it is safeguarded by the grandfather alone if there is no one else."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "He made him the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as a means for his mother to protect her from the hardships she encountered, and for his brothers from his mother. Mak'houl said, 'If the mother dies and leaves behind her son, and then her son also passes away, the inheritance of her son will go entirely to his brothers from his mother because it belonged to their mother and their grandfather. And the father's share will be one-sixth of his son's son, and the grandfather only inherits in this specific case because he is the father of the mother. And the brothers from the mother inherit their mother's inheritance, while the grandfather inherits his daughter's son because he was designated for her. Therefore, the wealth that belongs to the child is inherited by the heirs of the mother, and it is safeguarded by the grandfather alone if there is no one else."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «جَعَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِأُمِّهِ فِي سَبَبِهِ لِمَا لَقِيَتْ مِنَ الْبَلَاءِ وَلِإِخْوَتِهِ مِنْ أُمِّهِ» وقَالَ مَكْحُولٌ «فَإِنْ مَاتَتِ الْأُمُّ وَتَرَكَتِ ابْنَهَا ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ ابْنُهَا الَّذِي جُعِلَ لَهَا كَانَ مِيرَاثُهُ لِإِخْوَتِهِ مِنْ أُمِّهِ كُلُّهُ لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ لِأُمِّهِمْ وَجَدِّهِمْ وَكَانَ لِأَبِيهَا السُّدُسُ مِنَ ابْنِ ابْنَتِهِ وَلَيْسَ يَرِثُ الْجَدُّ إِلَّا فِي هَذِهِ الْمَنْزِلَةِ لِأَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ أَبُ الْأُمِّ وَإِنَّمَا وَرِثَ الْإِخْوَةُ مِنَ الْأُمِّ أُمَّهُمْ وَوَرِثَ الْجَدُّ ابْنَتَهُ لِأَنَّهُ جُعِلَ لَهَا فَالْمَالُ الَّذِي لِلْوَلَدِ لِوَرَثَةِ الْأُمِّ وَهُوَ يُحْرِزُهُ الْجَدُّ وَحْدَهُ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ غَيْرُهُ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e al-Nuʿmān \u003e Makḥūl \u003e Suʾil \u003e Mīrāth And Lad al-Mulāʿanah Liman
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ مِيرَاثِ وَلَدِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ لِمَنْ هُوَ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3011

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the cursed son.

hadiths.englishRaw: A group of people disputed over the son of the accursed, Ali, so his tribe came seeking his inheritance. He said, "Indeed, his father disowned him, so you have no share in his inheritance." Thus, he decreed his inheritance to his mother and made her tribe his heirs.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: A group of people disputed over the son of the accursed, Ali, so his tribe came seeking his inheritance. He said, "Indeed, his father disowned him, so you have no share in his inheritance." Thus, he decreed his inheritance to his mother and made her tribe his heirs.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ قَوْمًا اخْتَصَمُوا إِلَى عَلِيٍّ ؓ فِي وَلَدِ الْمُتَلَاعِنَيْنِ فَجَاءَ عَصَبَةُ أَبِيهِ يَطْلُبُونَ مِيرَاثَهُ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ أَبَاهُ كَانَ تَبَرَّأَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ لَكُمْ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ شَيْءٌ» فَقَضَى بِمِيرَاثِهِ لِأُمِّهِ وَجَعَلَهَا عَصَبَتَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Bukayr \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Ṭahmān \u003e Simāk b. Ḥarb \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلَاءِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3012

chapter.englishTitle: In the legacy of the hijra

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ali, regarding a man, he will have what a man has and what a woman has. Which of the two will inherit? He replied, "He will inherit from both."
hadiths.body: About Ali, regarding a man, he will have what a man has and what a woman has. Which of the two will inherit? He replied, "He will inherit from both."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ مَا لِلرَّجُلِ وَمَا لِلْمَرْأَةِ مِنْ أَيِّهِمَا يُوَرَّثُ؟ فَقَالَ «مِنْ أَيِّهِمَا بَالَ»
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْأَعْلَى أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ يُحَدِّثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3013

chapter.englishTitle: In the legacy of the hijra

hadiths.englishRaw: "It is inherited by its successor."
hadiths.body: "It is inherited by its successor."
hadiths.arabic: «يُوَرَّثُ مِنْ قِبَلِ مَبَالِهِ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Hushaym \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Shibāk \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ شِبَاكٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ فِي الْخُنْثَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3014

chapter.englishTitle: In the legacy of the hijra

hadiths.englishRaw: About a newborn who was born without being male or female, he does not have what belongs to the male nor does he have what belongs to the female. He excretes from his genital area similar to the appearance of urine and feces. When asked about his inheritance, he responded, "Half of the share of the male and half of the share of the female."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About a newborn who was born without being male or female, he does not have what belongs to the male nor does he have what belongs to the female. He excretes from his genital area similar to the appearance of urine and feces. When asked about his inheritance, he responded, "Half of the share of the male and half of the share of the female."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مَوْلُودٍ وُلِدَ وَلَيْسَ بِذَكَرٍ وَلَا أُنْثَى لَيْسَ لَهُ مَا لِلذَّكَرِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مَا لِلْأُنْثَى يُخْرِجُ مِنْ سُرَّتِهِ كَهَيْئَةِ الْبَوْلِ وَالْغَائِطِ سُئِلَ عَنْ مِيرَاثِهِ فَقَالَ «نِصْفُ حَظِّ الذَّكَرِ وَنِصْفُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Abū Hāniʾ \u003e Suʾil ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هَانِئٍ قَالَ سُئِلَ عَامِرٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3015

chapter.englishTitle: Al-kalalati

hadiths.englishRaw: "I will give my opinion on it, and if it is correct, then it is from Allah, and if it is incorrect, then it is from me and from Satan. I do not see anything left for the parent and child. When Umar was appointed, he said, 'I am too shy to contradict something that Abu Bakr said.'"
hadiths.body: "I will give my opinion on it, and if it is correct, then it is from Allah, and if it is incorrect, then it is from me and from Satan. I do not see anything left for the parent and child. When Umar was appointed, he said, 'I am too shy to contradict something that Abu Bakr said.'"
hadiths.arabic: إِنِّي سَأَقُولُ فِيهَا بِرَأْيِي فَإِنْ كَانَ صَوَابًا فَمِنَ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ خَطَأً فَمِنِّي وَمِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ أُرَاهُ مَا خَلَا الْوَالِدَ وَالْوَلَدَ فَلَمَّا اسْتُخْلِفَ عُمَرُ قَالَ «إِنِّي لَأَسْتَحْيِي اللَّهَ أَنْ أَرُدَّ شَيْئًا قَالَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ»
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Suʾil Abū Bakr \u003e al-Kalālah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ سُئِلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنِ الْكَلَالَةِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3016

chapter.englishTitle: Al-kalalati

hadiths.englishRaw: He said, "Nothing troubled the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as much as poverty troubled them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He said, "Nothing troubled the companions of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ as much as poverty troubled them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ «مَا أَعْضَلَ بِأَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَيْءٌ مَا أَعْضَلَتْ بِهِمُ الْكَلَالَةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Abū Ayyūb \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Marthad b. ʿAbdullāh al-Yazanī \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir al-Juhanī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيِّ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3017

chapter.englishTitle: Al-kalalati

hadiths.englishRaw: Al-Kalalah includes the father and the son.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Al-Kalalah includes the father and the son.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: الْكَلَالَةُ مَا خَلَا الْوَالِدَ وَالْوَلَدَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Muḥammad \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3018

chapter.englishTitle: Al-kalalati

hadiths.englishRaw: "He used to recite this verse: 'And if a man dies and leaves behind him a female relative, his wife shall have the right of inheritance.' [Quran 4:12] or a woman who has a brother or a sister, Saad said to his mother..."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He used to recite this verse: 'And if a man dies and leaves behind him a female relative, his wife shall have the right of inheritance.' [Quran 4:12] or a woman who has a brother or a sister, Saad said to his mother..."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ {وَإِنْ كَانَ رَجُلٌ يُورَثُ كَلَالَةً} [النساء 12] أَوِ امْرَأَةٌ وَلَهُ أَخٌ أَوْ أُخْتٌ قَالَ سَعْدٌ لِأُمٍّ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ \u003e al-Qāsim b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يَعْلَى بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ سَعْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3019

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Close Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: He informed him that Umar ibn Al-Khattab sought someone to inherit the son of Ad-Dahdah but did not find an heir, so he transferred the wealth of Ad-Dahdah's son to the uncles of Ad-Dahdah's son.
hadiths.body: He informed him that Umar ibn Al-Khattab sought someone to inherit the son of Ad-Dahdah but did not find an heir, so he transferred the wealth of Ad-Dahdah's son to the uncles of Ad-Dahdah's son.
hadiths.arabic: أَخْبَرَهُ «أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ الْتَمَسَ مَنْ يَرِثُ ابْنَ الدَّحْدَاحَةِ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ وَارِثًا فَدَفَعَ مَالَ ابْنِ الدَّحْدَاحَةِ إِلَى أَخْوَالِ ابْنِ الدَّحْدَاحَةِ»
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah \u003e Abū al-Aswad Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Nawfal \u003e ʿĀṣim b. ʿUmar b. Qatādah al-Anṣārī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَسْوَدِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3020

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Close Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: ʿAllah and His Messenger are the guardians of the one who has no guardian, and the maternal uncle is the heir of the one who has no heir.”
hadiths.body: ʿAllah and His Messenger are the guardians of the one who has no guardian, and the maternal uncle is the heir of the one who has no heir.”
hadiths.arabic: «اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ مَوْلَى مَنْ لَا مَوْلَى لَهُ وَالْخَالُ وَارِثُ مَنْ لَا وَارِثَ لَهُ»
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAmr b. Muslim \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e ʿĀʾishah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3021

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Close Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umar came to an aunt and an uncle, so he gave two-thirds to his aunt and one-third to his uncle."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "Umar came to an aunt and an uncle, so he gave two-thirds to his aunt and one-third to his uncle."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أُتِيَ عُمَرُ فِي عَمٍّ لِأُمٍّ وَخَالَةٍ فَأَعْطَى الْعَمَّ لِلْأُمِّ الثُّلُثَيْنِ وَأَعْطَى الْخَالَةَ الثُّلُثَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Firās \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Ziyād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ فِرَاسٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ زِيَادٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3022

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Close Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "Omar ibn Al-Khattab gave one third to his paternal aunt and two thirds to his maternal aunt."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Omar ibn Al-Khattab gave one third to his paternal aunt and two thirds to his maternal aunt."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ أَعْطَى الْخَالَةَ الثُّلُثَ وَالْعَمَّةَ الثُّلُثَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3023

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Close Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "About this."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "About this."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ هَذَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Ḥasan b. ʿAmr \u003e Ghālib b. ʿAbbād \u003e Qays b. Ḥabtar al-Nahshalī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عَبَّادٍ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ حَبْتَرٍ النَّهْشَلِيِّ قَالَ أُتِيَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ فِي خَالَةٍ وَعَمَّةٍ فَقَامَ شَيْخٌ فَقَالَ «شَهِدْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ أَعْطَى الْخَالَةَ الثُّلُثَ وَالْعَمَّةَ الثُّلُثَيْنِ» قَالَ فَهَمَّ أَنْ يَكْتُبَ بِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَيْنَ زَيْدٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3024

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Close Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "The aunt is in the position of the mother, and the uncle is in the position of the father, and the niece is in the position of the sibling, and every relative is in the position of the womb, by which he asserts his rights if he is not an inheritor with close kinship."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The aunt is in the position of the mother, and the uncle is in the position of the father, and the niece is in the position of the sibling, and every relative is in the position of the womb, by which he asserts his rights if he is not an inheritor with close kinship."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْخَالَةُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأُمِّ وَالْعَمَّةُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَبِ وَبِنْتُ الْأَخِ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَخِ وَكُلُّ ذي رَحِمٍ بِمَنْزِلَةِ رَحِمِهِ الَّتِي يُدْلِي بِهَا إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ وَارِثٌ ذُو قَرَابَةٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muḥammad b. Sālim \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3025

chapter.englishTitle: Al-'Asabati

hadiths.englishRaw: "That Umar spent in the people of Ta'oon Amawas, that when they were equal before the father, the children of the mother were more entitled, and when some of them were closer to each other through a father, they were more entitled to the wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That Umar spent in the people of Ta'oon Amawas, that when they were equal before the father, the children of the mother were more entitled, and when some of them were closer to each other through a father, they were more entitled to the wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ عُمَرَ قَضَى فِي أَهْلِ طَاعُونِ عَمَوَاسَ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا كَانُوا مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأَبِ سَوَاءً فَبَنُو الْأُمِّ أَحَقُّ وَإِذَا كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَقْرَبَ مِنْ بَعْضٍ بِأَبٍ فَهُمْ أَحَقُّ بِالْمَالِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah \u003e al-Ḍaḥḥāk b. Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3026

chapter.englishTitle: Al-'Asabati

hadiths.englishRaw: Salim, a slave of Abu Hudhayfah, was injured on the day of Yamamah and his inheritance reached two hundred dirhams. Umar said, "Hold it for his mother until she reaches her last days."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: Salim, a slave of Abu Hudhayfah, was injured on the day of Yamamah and his inheritance reached two hundred dirhams. Umar said, "Hold it for his mother until she reaches her last days."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: أُصِيبَ سَالِمٌ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ يَوْمَ الْيَمَامَةِ فَبَلَغَ مِيرَاثُهُ مِائَتَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ «احْبِسُوهَا عَلَى أُمِّهِ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَ عَلَى آخِرِهَا»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Shaybānī \u003e ʿUbayd b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Shaddād b. al-Hād
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادِ بْنِ الْهَادِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3027

chapter.englishTitle: Al-'Asabati

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the sons from the same mother inherit from one another, but not sons from different mothers. A man inherits from his full brother from the same father and mother, but not his brothers from his father.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ ruled that the sons from the same mother inherit from one another, but not sons from different mothers. A man inherits from his full brother from the same father and mother, but not his brothers from his father.”     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْإِخْوَةُ مِنَ الْأُمِّ يَتَوَارَثُونَ دُونَ بَنِي الْعَلَّاتِ يَرِثُ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ لِأَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ دُونَ أَخِيهِ لِأَبِيهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3028

chapter.englishTitle: Al-'Asabati

hadiths.englishRaw: Muhammad bin Ja'far narrated to us, from Shu'bah, from Amr bin Murrah who said: "I asked Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah: 'Did you remember anything from Abdullah?' He said, 'No'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Muhammad bin Ja'far narrated to us, from Shu'bah, from Amr bin Murrah who said: "I asked Abu Ubaidah bin Abdullah: 'Did you remember anything from Abdullah?' He said, 'No'"    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. Sālim \u003e Liāb. ʿUmar Araʾayt a man Tarak Ibn Āb.atih Ayarithuh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِابْنِ عُمَرَ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا تَرَكَ ابْنَ ابْنَتِهِ أَيَرِثُهُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3029

chapter.englishTitle: Al-'Asabati

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah said, "A mother is a family for those who have no family, and a sister is a family for those who have no family."
hadiths.body: Abdullah said, "A mother is a family for those who have no family, and a sister is a family for those who have no family."
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «الْأُمُّ عَصَبَةُ مَنْ لَا عَصَبَةَ لَهُ وَالْأُخْتُ عَصَبَةُ مَنْ لَا عَصَبَةَ لَهُ»
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْأَعْمَشُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3030

chapter.englishTitle: Al-'Asabati

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Give the Fara'id (the shares of the inheritance that are prescribed in the Qur'an) to those who are entitled to receive it. Then whatever remains, should be given to the closest male relative of the deceased ."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Give the Fara'id (the shares of the inheritance that are prescribed in the Qur'an) to those who are entitled to receive it. Then whatever remains, should be given to the closest male relative of the deceased ."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «أَلْحِقُوا الْفَرَائِضَ بِأَهْلِهَا فَمَا بَقِيَ فَهُوَ لِأَوْلَى رَجُلٍ ذَكَرٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ibn Ṭāwus from his father \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3031

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: "The closest people to inherit it are from her own religion."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "The closest people to inherit it are from her own religion."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَرِثُهَا أَقْرَبُ النَّاسِ إِلَيْهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ دِينِهَا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Ashʿath \u003e ʿAmmah Lah Tuwuffiyat Yahūdiyyah Bi-al-Yaman Fadhakar Dhalik Liʿumar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْأَشْعَثِ أَنَّ عَمَّةً لَهُ تُوُفِّيَتْ يَهُودِيَّةً بِالْيَمَنِ فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3032

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: "The followers of her religion inherit it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The followers of her religion inherit it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَهْلُ دِينِهَا يَرِثُونَهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Qays b. Muslim \u003e Ṭāriq b. Shihāb \u003e Mātat ʿAmmah al-Ashʿath b. Qays And Hī Yahūdiyyah Faʾatá ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ مَاتَتْ عَمَّةُ الْأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ وَهِيَ يَهُودِيَّةٌ فَأَتَى عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3033

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: Umar ibn Al-Khattab said, "Those who associate partners with God, we do not inherit from them nor do they inherit from us."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: Umar ibn Al-Khattab said, "Those who associate partners with God, we do not inherit from them nor do they inherit from us."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ «أَهْلُ الشِّرْكِ لَا نَرِثُهُمْ وَلَا يَرِثُونَا»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3034

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ , as well as Abu Bakr and Umar, said, "People of two different religions cannot inherit from each other."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ , as well as Abu Bakr and Umar, said, "People of two different religions cannot inherit from each other."
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ قَالُوا «لَا يَتَوَارَثُ أَهْلُ دِينَيْنِ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e ʿĪsá al-Ḥannāṭ \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ عِيسَى الْحَنَّاطِ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3035

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: "The people of two religions do not inherit from each other."
hadiths.body: "The people of two religions do not inherit from each other."
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَتَوَارَثُ أَهْلُ مِلَّتَيْنِ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3036

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: "We do not inherit from the people of the Book, and they do not inherit from us, except when a man's servant or his slave dies."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "We do not inherit from the people of the Book, and they do not inherit from us, except when a man's servant or his slave dies."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا نَرِثُ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ وَلَا يَرِثُونَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَمُوتَ لِلرَّجُلِ عَبْدُهُ أَوْ أَمَتُهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Jābir \u003e Lā Narith Ahl al-Kitāb And Lā Yarithūnā Illā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3037

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The people of the Book do not inherit from us, and we do not inherit from them. Only a man can inherit from his slave or his servant."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The people of the Book do not inherit from us, and we do not inherit from them. Only a man can inherit from his slave or his servant."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا نَرِثُ أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ وَلَا يَرِثُونَا إِلَّا الرَّجُلُ يَرِثُ عَبْدَهُ أَوْ أَمَتَهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3038

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: "Muaawiyah used to inherit from Muslim but does not inherit the disbeliever from the Muslim," Masrooq said. "And whatever happened in Islam, the decree is dearer to me than it." Abu Muhammad was asked, "Do you say this?" He said, "No."
hadiths.body: "Muaawiyah used to inherit from Muslim but does not inherit the disbeliever from the Muslim," Masrooq said. "And whatever happened in Islam, the decree is dearer to me than it." Abu Muhammad was asked, "Do you say this?" He said, "No."
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ مُعَاوِيَةُ يُوَرِّثُ الْمُسْلِمَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِ وَلَا يُوَرِّثُ الْكَافِرَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِ» قَالَ قَالَ مَسْرُوقٌ «وَمَا حَدَثَ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ قَضَاءٌ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْهُ» قِيلَ لِأَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ «تَقُولُ بِهَذَا؟» قَالَ «لَا»
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Dāwud \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Masrūq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3039

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: "The age that nobody inherits is closer to the people than the followers of its religion; two religions do not inherit each other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The age that nobody inherits is closer to the people than the followers of its religion; two religions do not inherit each other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ «لَيْسَ ذَاكَ لَكَ يَرِثُهَا أَقْرَبُ النَّاسِ مِنْهَا مِنْ أَهْلِ دِينِهَا لَا يَتَوَارَثُ مِلَّتَانِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ أَنَّ الْمُعْزِلَةَ بِنْتَ الْحَارِثِ تُوُفِّيَتْ بِالْيَمَنِ وَهِيَ يَهُودِيَّةٌ فَرَكِبَ الْأَشْعَثُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ وَكَانَتْ عَمَّتَهُ إِلَى عُمَرَ فِي مِيرَاثِهَا فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3040

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umar ibn Al-Khattab said: 'Two different religions cannot be inherited, and one cannot be hidden from those who do not inherit.'"
hadiths.body: "Umar ibn Al-Khattab said: 'Two different religions cannot be inherited, and one cannot be hidden from those who do not inherit.'"
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ «لَا يَتَوَارَثُ مِلَّتَانِ شَتَّى وَلَا يَحْجُبُ مَنْ لَا يَرِثُ»
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Anas b. Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3041

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: the Prophet ﷺ said, "A Muslim cannot be the heir of a disbeliever, nor can a disbeliever be the heir of a Muslim."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ said, "A Muslim cannot be the heir of a disbeliever, nor can a disbeliever be the heir of a Muslim."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ وَلَا الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Naṣr b. ʿAlī \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAlī b. Ḥusayn \u003e ʿAmr b. ʿUthmān \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3042

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a person dies, their rights are obligated to be given to their rightful heirs, and nothing should be given to anyone who converts to Islam or is freed from slavery before the inheritance is divided."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "When a person dies, their rights are obligated to be given to their rightful heirs, and nothing should be given to anyone who converts to Islam or is freed from slavery before the inheritance is divided."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا مَاتَ الْمَيِّتُ وَجَبَتِ الْحُقُوقُ لِأَهْلِهَا وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ لِمَنْ أَسْلَمَ أَوْ أُعْتِقَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْسَمَ الْمِيرَاثُ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Abū Maʿshar \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3043

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: the Prophet ﷺ said, "A Muslim cannot be the heir of a disbeliever, nor can a disbeliever be the heir of a Muslim."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: the Prophet ﷺ said, "A Muslim cannot be the heir of a disbeliever, nor can a disbeliever be the heir of a Muslim."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ وَلَا الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿĪsá \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAlī b. Ḥusayn \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3044

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي مِيرَاثِ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَأَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of polytheists and Muslims

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ as saying: A Muslim may not inherit from an infidel nor an infidel from a Muslim.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ as saying: A Muslim may not inherit from an infidel nor an infidel from a Muslim.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَا يَرِثُ الْمُسْلِمُ الْكَافِرَ وَلَا الْكَافِرُ الْمُسْلِمَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAlī b. Ḥusayn \u003e ʿAmr b. ʿUthmān \u003e Usāmah b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3045

chapter.englishTitle: The Offices

hadiths.englishRaw: "The offices do not have any inheritance left from their correspondence."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The offices do not have any inheritance left from their correspondence."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَيْسَ لِلْمُكَاتَبِ مِيرَاثٌ مَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3046

chapter.englishTitle: The Offices

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man named Ata who has sons, some of whom he has freed half of, some he has freed a third of, and some he has freed a fourth of. He said, "They do not inherit until they are freed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man named Ata who has sons, some of whom he has freed half of, some he has freed a third of, and some he has freed a fourth of. He said, "They do not inherit until they are freed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي رَجُلٍ لَهُ بَنُونَ قَدْ أَعْتَقَ مِنْ بَعْضِهِمُ النِّصْفَ وَمِنْ بَعْضِهِمُ الثُّلُثَ وَمِنْ بَعْضٍ الرُّبُعَ قَالَ «لَا يَرِثُونَ حَتَّى يُعْتَقُوا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3047

chapter.englishTitle: The Offices

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, there was a man who bought his son when he was sick. He said, "If he recovers before one-third of his life has passed, he will inherit, but if death befalls him before that, he will not inherit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, there was a man who bought his son when he was sick. He said, "If he recovers before one-third of his life has passed, he will inherit, but if death befalls him before that, he will not inherit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي رَجُلٍ اشْتَرَى ابْنَهُ فِي مَرَضِهِ قَالَ «إِنْ خَرَجَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ وَرِثَهُ وَإِنْ وَقَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ السِّعَايَةُ لَمْ يَرِثْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar al-Raqqī And Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar \u003e Ḥammād
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3048

chapter.englishTitle: The Offices

hadiths.englishRaw: "The limit of a servant is until he is set free."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The limit of a servant is until he is set free."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «حَدُّ الْمُكَاتَبِ حَدُّ الْمَمْلُوكِ حَتَّى يُعْتَقَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan from his father \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3049

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The master is a brother in faith, and a blessing, and the most deserving of people to inherit from him is the closest to him in freeing slaves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "The master is a brother in faith, and a blessing, and the most deserving of people to inherit from him is the closest to him in freeing slaves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «الْمَوْلَى أَخٌ فِي الدِّينِ وَنِعْمَةٌ وَأَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِمِيرَاثِهِ أَقْرَبُهُمْ مِنَ الْمُعْتِقِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3050

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Sha'bi regarding a man who freed a slave, then the master and the slave died, and the emancipator left behind his father and son. They said, "The wealth belongs to the son."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Sha'bi regarding a man who freed a slave, then the master and the slave died, and the emancipator left behind his father and son. They said, "The wealth belongs to the son."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ مَمْلُوكًا ثُمَّ مَاتَ الْمَوْلَى وَالْمَمْلُوكُ وَتَرَكَ الْمُعْتِقُ أَبَاهُ وَابْنَهُ قَالَا «الْمَالُ لِلِابْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Hushaym \u003e Manṣūr \u003e al-Ḥasan And Muḥammad b. Sālim
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3051

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: "The loyalty is to the grandson."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The loyalty is to the grandson."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْوَلَاءُ لِابْنِ الِابْنِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbbād \u003e ʿUmar b. ʿĀmir \u003e Qatādah \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادٌ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ فِي رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ أَبَاهُ وَابْنَ ابْنِهِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3052

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: That a woman freed a slave and then she passed away, leaving behind her son and brother. Then her master passed away as well. So the son of the woman and her brother came to the Prophet ﷺ regarding their inheritance. The Prophet ﷺ said, "His inheritance belongs to the son of the woman." The brother then asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what if she owed someone a debt?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "You are responsible for it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: That a woman freed a slave and then she passed away, leaving behind her son and brother. Then her master passed away as well. So the son of the woman and her brother came to the Prophet ﷺ regarding their inheritance. The Prophet ﷺ said, "His inheritance belongs to the son of the woman." The brother then asked, "O Messenger of Allah, what if she owed someone a debt?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "You are responsible for it."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ امْرَأَةً أَعْتَقَتْ عَبْدًا لَهَا ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَتْ وَتَرَكَتِ ابْنَهَا وَأَخَاهَا ثُمَّ تُوُفِّيَ مَوْلَاهَا فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ ﷺ ابْنُ الْمَرْأَةِ وَأَخُوهَا فِي ميراثه فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «مِيرَاثُهُ لِابْنِ الْمَرْأَةِ» فَقَالَ أَخُوهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوْ أَنَّهُ جَرَّ جَرِيرَةً عَلَى مَنْ كَانَتْ؟ قَالَ «عَلَيْكَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Muʿammar \u003e Khuṣayf \u003e Ziyād b. Abū Maryam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا مُعَمَّرٌ حَدَّثَنَا خُصَيْفٌ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3053

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man who freed a slave and then the man died and the master died, leaving the freed slave with his father and son. The freed slave said, "To his father belongs such and such, and what remains belongs to his son."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man who freed a slave and then the man died and the master died, leaving the freed slave with his father and son. The freed slave said, "To his father belongs such and such, and what remains belongs to his son."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ مَمْلُوكًا لَهُ فَمَاتَ وَمَاتَ الْمَوْلَى وَتَرَكَ الْمُعْتِقُ أَبَاهُ وَابْنَهُ فَقَالَ «لِأَبِيهِ كَذَا وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِابْنِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Hushaym \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Saʾalt Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَخْبَرَنَا مُغِيرَةُ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3054

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the judge and Hammad saying, "He is for the son."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the judge and Hammad saying, "He is for the son."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ الْحَكَمَ وَحَمَّادًا يَقُولَانِ «هُوَ لِلِابْنِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Hushaym \u003e Shuʿbah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3055

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: It is narrated that the Prophet ﷺ went to Al-Baqi' and saw a man being sold. He approached him and bargained for him, then left him. Another man saw him and bought him, then set him free. He brought him to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "I have bought this man and set him free. What do you see in him?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "He is your brother and your freed slave." He asked, "What do you see in his companionship?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "If you show him gratitude, it is better for him and worse for you, and if you show him ingratitude, it is better for you and worse for him." He asked, "What do you see in his wealth?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "If he dies and leaves no heirs, then you are his inheritor."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: It is narrated that the Prophet ﷺ went to Al-Baqi' and saw a man being sold. He approached him and bargained for him, then left him. Another man saw him and bought him, then set him free. He brought him to the Prophet ﷺ and said, "I have bought this man and set him free. What do you see in him?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "He is your brother and your freed slave." He asked, "What do you see in his companionship?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "If you show him gratitude, it is better for him and worse for you, and if you show him ingratitude, it is better for you and worse for him." He asked, "What do you see in his wealth?" The Prophet ﷺ said, "If he dies and leaves no heirs, then you are his inheritor."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ خَرَجَ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَرَأَى رَجُلًا يُبَاعُ فَأَتَاهُ فَسَاوَمَ بِهِ ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ فَرَآهُ رَجُلٌ فَاشْتَرَاهُ فَأَعْتَقَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ إِنِّي اشْتَرَيْتُ هَذَا فَأَعْتَقْتُهُ فَمَا تَرَى فِيهِ؟ فَقَالَ «هُوَ أَخُوكَ وَمَوْلَاكَ» قَالَ مَا تَرَى فِي صُحْبَتِهِ؟ فَقَالَ «إِنْ شَكَرَكَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَهُ وَشَرٌّ لَكَ وَإِنْ كَفَرَكَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ وَشَرٌّ لَهُ» قَالَ مَا تَرَى فِي مَالِهِ؟ قَالَ «إِنْ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ عَصَبَةً فَأَنْتَ وَارِثُهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3056

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: That the daughter of Hamza freed a slave owned by her, but he died and left behind his daughter and his slave woman, the daughter of Hamza. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then divided his inheritance between his daughter and the daughter of Hamza equally into two parts.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: That the daughter of Hamza freed a slave owned by her, but he died and left behind his daughter and his slave woman, the daughter of Hamza. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ then divided his inheritance between his daughter and the daughter of Hamza equally into two parts.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ ابْنَةَ حَمْزَةَ أَعْتَقَتْ عَبْدًا لَهَا فَمَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ وَمَوْلَاتَهُ بِنْتَ حَمْزَةَ «فَقَسَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِيرَاثَهُ بَيْنَ ابْنَتِهِ وَمَوْلَاتِهِ بِنْتِ حَمْزَةَ نِصْفَيْنِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥakam And Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Shaddād
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَشْعَثُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ وَسَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3057

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: "I presented my case to Ali regarding a father who passed away without leaving anyone but me and his master. So, Ali gave me half, and he gave his master half."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I presented my case to Ali regarding a father who passed away without leaving anyone but me and his master. So, Ali gave me half, and he gave his master half."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَاضَيْتُ إِلَى عَلِيٍّ فِي أَبٍ مَاتَ لَمْ يَدَعْ أَحَدًا غَيْرِي وَمَوْلَاهُ فَأَعْطَانِي النِّصْفَ وَأَعْطَى مَوْلَاهُ النِّصْفَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e al-Shaybānī \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Shamūs al-Kindiyyah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ شَمُوسَ الْكِنْدِيَّةِ قَالَتْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3058

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: "It was brought to him a daughter and a slave, so he gave half to the daughter and half to the slave." The judge said, "This is the share of the slave that he inherited from his master."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "It was brought to him a daughter and a slave, so he gave half to the daughter and half to the slave." The judge said, "This is the share of the slave that he inherited from his master."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ أُتِيَ بِابْنَةٍ وَمَوْلًى فَأَعْطَى الِابْنَةَ النِّصْفَ وَالْمَوْلَى النِّصْفَ» قَالَ الْحَكَمُ «فَمَنْزِلِي هَذَا نَصِيبُ الْمَوْلَى الَّذِي وَرِثَهُ عَنْ مَوْلَاهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Abū al-Kanūd \u003e ʿAlī \u003e Utī Biāb.ah And a freed slave of Faʾaʿṭá al-Iāb.ah al-Niṣf Wa-al-a freed slave of al-Niṣf \u003e al-Ḥakam Famanzilī Hadhā Naṣīb al-a freed slave of al--Adhī Warithah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي الْكَنُودِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3059

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: "He died and left behind his daughter and his followers, so Ali gave his daughter half and his followers half."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He died and left behind his daughter and his followers, so Ali gave his daughter half and his followers half."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ وَمَوَالِيَهُ فَأَعْطَى عَلِيٌّ ابْنَتَهُ النِّصْفَ وَمَوَالِيَهُ النِّصْفَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Mudlij
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُدْلِجٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3060

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: "That her father died, so Ali became half for her and half for his followers."
hadiths.body: "That her father died, so Ali became half for her and half for his followers."
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ أَبَاهَا مَاتَ فَجَعَلَ عَلِيٌّ لَهَا النِّصْفَ وَلِمَوَالِيهِ النِّصْفَ»
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e al-Shaybānī \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e al-Shammūs
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَنْ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ الشَّمُّوسِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3061

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: About two sisters, one of them bought their father and then set him free. After he died, he said, "Both of them have two-thirds of their inheritance specified in the Book of Allah, and whatever is left belongs to the one who set him free."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About two sisters, one of them bought their father and then set him free. After he died, he said, "Both of them have two-thirds of their inheritance specified in the Book of Allah, and whatever is left belongs to the one who set him free."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أُخْتَيْنِ اشْتَرَتْ إِحْدَاهُمَا أَبَاهَا فَأَعْتَقَتْهُ ثُمَّ مَاتَ قَالَ «لَهُمَا الثُّلُثَانِ فَرِيضَتُهُمَا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْمُعْتِقَةِ دُونَ الْأُخْرَى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e Ashʿath \u003e Jahm b. Dīnār \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Suʾil \u003e Ukhtayn Āshtarat Iḥdāhumā Abāhā Faʾaʿtaqath Thum Māt
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ عَنْ جَهْمِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3062

chapter.englishTitle: Al-Walaa'

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Sha'bi's opinion about a woman who freed her father, and the father died, leaving behind four daughters. One of them said, "They are not entitled to anything but two-thirds, while she is included among them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Sha'bi's opinion about a woman who freed her father, and the father died, leaving behind four daughters. One of them said, "They are not entitled to anything but two-thirds, while she is included among them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي امْرَأَةٍ أَعْتَقَتْ أَبَاهَا فَمَاتَ الْأَبُ وَتَرَكَ أَرْبَعَ بَنَاتٍ هِيَ إِحْدَاهُنَّ قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَّةٌ لَهُنَّ الثُّلُثَانِ وَهِيَ مَعَهُنَّ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e al-Ashʿath
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3063

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِيمَنْ أَعْطَى ذَوِي الْأَرْحَامِ دُونَ الْمَوَالِي
chapter.englishTitle: In whom have the relatives not given except the guardians?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ali spent a quarter on his wife and half on his daughter, then he gave the rest to his daughter."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Ali spent a quarter on his wife and half on his daughter, then he gave the rest to his daughter."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَضَى عَلِيٌّ لِامْرَأَتِهِ الثُّمُنَ وَلِابْنَتِهِ النِّصْفَ ثُمَّ رَدَّ الْبَقِيَّةَ عَلَى ابْنَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Ḥayyān b. Salmān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ حَيَّانَ بْنِ سَلْمَانَ قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ فَجَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ فَرِيضَةِ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ ابْنَتَهُ وَامْرَأَتَهُ فقَالَ أَنَا أُنْبِئُكَ قَضَاءَ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَسْبِي قَضَاءُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3064

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِيمَنْ أَعْطَى ذَوِي الْأَرْحَامِ دُونَ الْمَوَالِي
chapter.englishTitle: In whom have the relatives not given except the guardians?

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the given Arabic phrase into English is: "Indeed, a close relative of Ibrahim passed away and left behind wealth, so I said to Ibrahim. He said, 'Indeed, she has a relative.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the given Arabic phrase into English is: "Indeed, a close relative of Ibrahim passed away and left behind wealth, so I said to Ibrahim. He said, 'Indeed, she has a relative.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ مَوْلَاةً لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ تُوُفِّيَتْ وَتَرَكَتْ مَالًا فَقُلْتُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ لَهَا ذَا قَرَابَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū al-Haytham \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Mawlāh Liʾibrāhīm Tuwuffiyat And Tarakat Māl \u003e Liʾibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ أَبِي الْهَيْثَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3065

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: "And I think he mentioned that Abdullah also said that they said, 'Loyalty belongs to the elders,' meaning that loyalty is closer to a father or mother."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "And I think he mentioned that Abdullah also said that they said, 'Loyalty belongs to the elders,' meaning that loyalty is closer to a father or mother."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَأَحْسَبُهُ قَدْ ذَكَرَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ أَيْضًا أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا «الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ» يَعْنُونَ بِالْكُبْرِ مَا كَانَ أَقْرَبَ بِأَبٍ أَوْ أُمٍّ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿUmar And ʿAlī Wazayd
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عُمَرَ وَعَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3066

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: "It died and left her nephew to his father and mother, and her nephew to his father. Omar wrote, 'Indeed, loyalty is to the elder.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "It died and left her nephew to his father and mother, and her nephew to his father. Omar wrote, 'Indeed, loyalty is to the elder.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهَا مَاتَتْ وَتَرَكَتِ ابْنَ أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَأُمِّهَا وَابْنَ أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا فَكَتَبَ عُمَرُ «إِنَّ الْوَلَاءَ لِلْكُبْرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd \u003e Ashʿath \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ قَالَ كُتِبَ إِلَى عُمَرَ فِي شَأْنِ فُكَيْهَةَ بِنْتِ سَمْعَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3067

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah and Shurayh said, "for the inheritors."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah and Shurayh said, "for the inheritors."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَشُرَيْحٌ «لِلْوَرَثَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e al-Shaybānī \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAlī And Zayd \u003e al-Walāʾ Lilkubr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا وَزَيْدًا قَالَا «الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ»

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3068

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umar, Abdullah, Ali, and Zaid have spent their lives in loyalty to the elderly."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Umar, Abdullah, Ali, and Zaid have spent their lives in loyalty to the elderly."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَضَى عُمَرُ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَعَلِيٌّ وَزَيْدٌ لِلْكُبْرِ بِالْوَلَاءِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3069

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: Fukayhah, the daughter of Samaan, passed away and left her nephew to his father and her nephew's children to their father and mother. So Umar inherited the children of her brother to their father.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Fukayhah, the daughter of Samaan, passed away and left her nephew to his father and her nephew's children to their father and mother. So Umar inherited the children of her brother to their father.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: تُوُفِّيَتْ فُكَيْهَةُ بِنْتُ سَمْعَانَ وَتَرَكَتِ ابْنَ أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَبَنِي بَنِي أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا وَأُمِّهَا «فَوَرَّثَ عُمَرُ بَنِي أَخِيهَا لِأَبِيهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e Ashʿath \u003e Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3070

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: From Umar, Ali, and Zaid, they said, "Loyalty belongs to the older ones."   – Weak Chain
