hadiths.body: From Umar, Ali, and Zaid, they said, "Loyalty belongs to the older ones."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عُمَرَ وَعَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا «الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām b. Ḥarb \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3071

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, he had two brothers who were slaves, and their father had freed them. One of them died and left behind a child named Ali, while the other one was named Zaid and Abdullah. They used to say, "Loyalty belongs to the eldest."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, he had two brothers who were slaves, and their father had freed them. One of them died and left behind a child named Ali, while the other one was named Zaid and Abdullah. They used to say, "Loyalty belongs to the eldest."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي أَخَوَيْنِ وَرِثَا مَوْلًى كَانَ أَعْتَقَهُ أَبُوهُمَا فَمَاتَ أَحَدُهُمَا وَتَرَكَ وَلَدًا قَالَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ وَزَيْدٌ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَقُولُونَ «الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3072

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: Umar and Ali, loyalty to the elder.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Umar and Ali, loyalty to the elder.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ وَعَلِيٌّ «الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Maṭar al-Warrāq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَطَرًا الْوَرَّاقَ يَقُولُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3073

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The loyalty belongs to the arrogance."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The loyalty belongs to the arrogance."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Rawḥ \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ And Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn Ṭāwus from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ رَوْحٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ وَابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3074

chapter.englishTitle: Loyalty to the elders.

hadiths.englishRaw: "The loyalty is to the seniors."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The loyalty is to the seniors."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3075

chapter.englishTitle: In the man who supports the man

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the man who supports another man, they said: "He is among the Muslims." Sufyan said: "And that's what we say as well."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the man who supports another man, they said: "He is among the Muslims." Sufyan said: "And that's what we say as well."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوَالِي الرَّجُلَ قَالَا «هُوَ بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ» قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَكَذَلِكَ نَقُولُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e al-Shaʿbī And Sufyān \u003e Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ وَسُفْيَانُ عَنْ يُونُسَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3076

chapter.englishTitle: In the man who supports the man

hadiths.englishRaw: “I heard Tamim Ad- Dari say: ‘I said: O Messenger of Allah, what is the Sunnah concerning a man from among the People of the Book who becomes a Muslim at the hands of another man?’ He said: ‘He is the closest of all people to him in life and in death.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I heard Tamim Ad- Dari say: ‘I said: O Messenger of Allah, what is the Sunnah concerning a man from among the People of the Book who becomes a Muslim at the hands of another man?’ He said: ‘He is the closest of all people to him in life and in death.’”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ تَمِيمًا الدَّارِيَّ يَقُولُ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا السُّنَّةُ فِي الرَّجُلِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكُفْرِ يُسْلِمُ عَلَى يَدَيْ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «هُوَ أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِمَحْيَاهُ وَمَمَاتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Mawhab \u003e Tamīm al-Dārī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3077

chapter.englishTitle: In the man who supports the man

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man from the people of As-Sawad, whenever he converted to Islam under the guidance of a man, he said, "He understands him and inherits from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man from the people of As-Sawad, whenever he converted to Islam under the guidance of a man, he said, "He understands him and inherits from him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّوَادِ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَى يَدَيْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ «يَعْقِلُ عَنْهُ وَيَرِثُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Suʾil
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ سُئِلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3078

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَرِثُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: 'Indeed, a woman inherits from the blood money of her ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The woman inherits from the blood money of her husband in intentional and accidental homicides."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The woman inherits from the blood money of her husband in intentional and accidental homicides."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تَرِثُ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا فِي الْعَمْدِ وَالْخَطَإِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3079

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَرِثُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: 'Indeed, a woman inherits from the blood money of her ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The compensation for obligations set by Allah Almighty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The compensation for obligations set by Allah Almighty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الدِّيَةُ عَلَى فَرَائِضِ اللَّهِ ﷻ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3080

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَرِثُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: 'Indeed, a woman inherits from the blood money of her ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The dia is the path to inheritance."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The dia is the path to inheritance."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الدِّيَةُ سَبِيلُهَا سَبِيلُ الْمِيرَاثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3081

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَرِثُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: 'Indeed, a woman inherits from the blood money of her ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "That the brothers inherit from the mother from the estate."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "That the brothers inherit from the mother from the estate."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنْ يُوَرَّثَ الْإِخْوَةُ مِنَ الْأُمِّ مِنَ الدِّيَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥumayd And Dāwd b. Abū Hind ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz Katab
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ وَدَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ كَتَبَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3082

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَرِثُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: 'Indeed, a woman inherits from the blood money of her ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The intellect is an inheritance among the heirs of the deceased according to the book of God and His obligations."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The intellect is an inheritance among the heirs of the deceased according to the book of God and His obligations."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْعَقْلُ مِيرَاثٌ بَيْنَ وَرَثَةِ الْقَتِيلِ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَفَرَائِضِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3083

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَرِثُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: 'Indeed, a woman inherits from the blood money of her ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "He has indeed wronged the one who did not leave an inheritance for his siblings from the mother's wealth."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "He has indeed wronged the one who did not leave an inheritance for his siblings from the mother's wealth."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «لَقَدْ ظَلَمَ مَنْ لَمْ يُوَرِّثِ الْإِخْوَةَ مِنَ الْأُمِّ مِنَ الدِّيَةِ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār \u003e Baʿḍ And Lad Ibn al-Ḥanafiyyah \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ وَلَدِ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3084

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَرِثُ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: 'Indeed, a woman inherits from the blood money of her ...

hadiths.englishRaw: Umar, Ali, and Zaid said, "Diyyah (blood money) is inherited just as wealth, its mistakes and intentional acts are inherited."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Umar, Ali, and Zaid said, "Diyyah (blood money) is inherited just as wealth, its mistakes and intentional acts are inherited."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عُمَرَ وَعَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ قَالُوا «الدِّيَةُ تُورَثُ كَمَا يُورَثُ الْمَالُ خَطَؤُهُ وَعَمْدُهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Khālid \u003e Ibn Sālim \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ سَالِمٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3085

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "He does not inherit"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Ali did not inherit brothers from his mother, nor his wife, nor did any woman inherit anything from the compensation. Abdullah said, 'Some people insert a man between Ismail and 'Amir.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Ali did not inherit brothers from his mother, nor his wife, nor did any woman inherit anything from the compensation. Abdullah said, 'Some people insert a man between Ismail and 'Amir.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ عَلِيٌّ لَا يُوَرِّثُ الْإِخْوَةَ مِنَ الْأُمِّ وَلَا الزَّوْجَ وَلَا الْمَرْأَةَ مِنَ الدِّيَةِ شَيْئًا» قَالَ عَبْد اللَّهِ «بَعْضُهُمْ يُدْخِلُ بَيْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَعَامِرٍ رَجُلًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3086

chapter.englishTitle: Who said: "He does not inherit"?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Brothers do not inherit from their mother from the dowry."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Brothers do not inherit from their mother from the dowry."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تُوَرَّثُ الْإِخْوَةُ مِنَ الْأُمِّ مِنَ الدِّيَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ziyād al-Aʿlam \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ زِيَادٍ الْأَعْلَمِ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3087

chapter.englishTitle: The legacy of the victims

hadiths.englishRaw: "All people inherit the death of their blind in destruction or drowning, as they do not inherit it from their living relatives."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "All people inherit the death of their blind in destruction or drowning, as they do not inherit it from their living relatives."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُلُّ قَوْمٍ مُتَوَارِثِينَ عَمِيَ مَوْتُهُمْ فِي هَدْمٍ أَوْ غَرَقٍ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يَتَوَارَثُونَ يَرِثُهُمُ الْأَحْيَاءُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ibn Abū al-Zinād from his father \u003e Khārijah b. Zayd \u003e Zayd b. Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3088

chapter.englishTitle: The legacy of the victims

hadiths.englishRaw: The following translation is as follows: "The dead do not inherit from each other, but the living inherit from the dead."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The following translation is as follows: "The dead do not inherit from each other, but the living inherit from the dead."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْأَمْوَاتُ بَعْضُهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ وَيُوَرَّثُ الْأَحْيَاءُ مِنَ الْأَمْوَاتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá b. ʿAtīq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَتِيقٍ قَالَ قَرَأْتُ فِي بَعْضِ كُتُبِ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فِي الْقَوْمِ يَقَعُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْبَيْتُ لا يُدْرَى أَيُّهُمَا مَاتَ قَبْلُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3089

chapter.englishTitle: The legacy of the victims

hadiths.englishRaw: "That Umm Kulthum and her son Zaid died on the same day, and their mourning processions met on the road, yet neither one of them inherited from the other. And that the people of Harrah did not inherit from each other, and the people of Siffin did not inherit from each other."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "That Umm Kulthum and her son Zaid died on the same day, and their mourning processions met on the road, yet neither one of them inherited from the other. And that the people of Harrah did not inherit from each other, and the people of Siffin did not inherit from each other."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ أُمَّ كُلْثُومٍ وَابْنَهَا زَيْدًا مَاتَا فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ فَالْتَقَتِ الصَّائِحَتَانِ فِي الطَّرِيقِ فَلَمْ يَرِثْ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مِنْ صَاحِبِهِ وَأَنَّ أَهْلَ الْحَرَّةِ لَمْ يَتَوَارَثُوا وَأَنَّ أَهْلَ صِفِّينَ لَمْ يَتَوَارَثُوا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Nuʿaym b. Ḥammād \u003e ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Muḥammad \u003e Jaʿfar from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3090

chapter.englishTitle: The legacy of the victims

hadiths.englishRaw: "A house in Sham fell upon a group, and Umar distributed some of it among them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "A house in Sham fell upon a group, and Umar distributed some of it among them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ بَيْتًا فِي الشَّامِ وَقَعَ عَلَى قَوْمٍ فَوَرَّثَ عُمَرُ بَعْضَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ibn Abū Laylá \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3091

chapter.englishTitle: The legacy of the victims

hadiths.englishRaw: "He inherited two brothers who were killed in the Battle of Siffin, one of them by the other."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He inherited two brothers who were killed in the Battle of Siffin, one of them by the other."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ وَرَّثَ أَخَوَيْنِ قُتِلَا بِصِفِّينَ أَحَدَهُمَا مِنَ الْآخَرِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ḥurays from his father \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ حُرَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3092

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man died and left behind his maternal aunt and paternal aunt, so he gave half of the share to the maternal aunt and half of the share to the paternal aunt."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "A man died and left behind his maternal aunt and paternal aunt, so he gave half of the share to the maternal aunt and half of the share to the paternal aunt."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَجُلًا هَلَكَ وَتَرَكَ عَمَّتَهُ وَخَالَتَهُ فَأَعْطَى عُمَرُ الْعَمَّةَ نَصِيبَ الْأَخِ وَأَعْطَى الْخَالَةَ نَصِيبَ الْأُخْتِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh al-Muzanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا حُمَيْدٌ عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3093

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever shows mercy, shall be shown mercy by the same mercy with which they show it."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "Whoever shows mercy, shall be shown mercy by the same mercy with which they show it."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ أَدْلَى بِرَحِمٍ أُعْطِيَ بِرَحِمِهِ الَّتِي يُدْلِي بِهَا»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3094

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Al-Sha'bi's opinion on a man who abandoned his aunt and cousin, he said, "The wealth belongs to the cousin's daughter."   – Weak
hadiths.body: Regarding Al-Sha'bi's opinion on a man who abandoned his aunt and cousin, he said, "The wealth belongs to the cousin's daughter."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ عَمَّتَهُ وَابْنَةَ أَخِيهِ قَالَ «الْمَالُ لِابْنَةِ أَخِيهِ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e Abū Isḥāq al-Shaybānī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3095

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "The murderer will not inherit."     – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The murderer will not inherit."     – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «الْخَالُ وَارِثٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e Layth \u003e Muḥammad b. al-Munkadir \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3096

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "To inherit a patrimonial legacy."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "To inherit a patrimonial legacy."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُوَرِّثَا خَالًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e ʿUbaydah \u003e Ibrāhīm n ʿUmar And ʿAbd Allāh Raʾayā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أن عُمَرَ وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ «رَأَيَا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3097

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "The money belongs to the niece."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The money belongs to the niece."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمَالُ لِابْنَةِ الْأَخِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e Sulaymān Abū Isḥāq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي عَمَّةٍ وَبِنْتِ أَخٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3098

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "To the aunt."   – Weak
hadiths.body: "To the aunt."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: «لِلْعَمَّةِ»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Baʿḍihim \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ أَنْبَأَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ بَعْضِهِمْ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3099

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "Give the money to the daughter of the brother."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Give the money to the daughter of the brother."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَعْطِي الْمَالَ لِابْنَةِ الْأَخِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Shaybānī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي بِنْتِ أَخٍ وَعَمَّةٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3100

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding a stolen property in a man who died and has no heir except for his brother's daughter and his uncle, he said, "The uncle is entitled to his sister's share, and the daughter of the brother is entitled to her father's share."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding a stolen property in a man who died and has no heir except for his brother's daughter and his uncle, he said, "The uncle is entitled to his sister's share, and the daughter of the brother is entitled to her father's share."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ فِي رَجُلٍ تُوُفِّيَ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ وَارِثٌ إِلَّا ابْنَةُ أَخِيهِ وَخَالُهُ قَالَ «لِلْخَالِ نَصِيبُ أُخْتِهِ وَلِابْنَةِ الْأَخِ نَصِيبُ أَبِيهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ عَامِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3101

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to treat his aunt as a mother when she wasn't a mother, and his uncle as a father when he wasn't a father.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He used to treat his aunt as a mother when she wasn't a mother, and his uncle as a father when he wasn't a father.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ مَسْرُوقٌ يُنَزِّلُ الْعَمَّةَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَبِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ أَبٌ وَالْخَالَةَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأُمِّ إِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ أُمٌّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Yūnus \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3102

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Aasim ibn Adi, "Do you know if you have any lineage among you?" He replied, "I don't know, O Messenger of Allah." So, the Prophet ﷺ called his nephew and gave him his inheritance.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to Aasim ibn Adi, "Do you know if you have any lineage among you?" He replied, "I don't know, O Messenger of Allah." So, the Prophet ﷺ called his nephew and gave him his inheritance.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِعَاصِمِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ «هَلْ تَعْلَمُونَ لَهُ فِيكُمْ نَسَبًا؟» قَالَ مَا نَعْرِفُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَدَعَا ابْنَ أُخْتِهِ فَأَعْطَاهُ مِيرَاثَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e Muḥammad b. Ḥabbān Nasabah from his father from his uncle Wāsiʿ b. Ḥabbān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ نَسَبَهُ إِلَى جَدِّهِ عَنْ عَمِّهِ وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ قَالَ تُوُفِّيَ ابْنُ الدَّحْدَاحَةِ وَكَانَ أَتِيًّا وَهُوَ الَّذِي لَا يُعْرَفُ لَهُ أَصْلٌ فَكَانَ فِي بَنِي الْعَجْلَانِ وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ عَقِبًا فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3103

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: "He gave his uncle money."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He gave his uncle money."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ أَعْطَى خَالًا الْمَالَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUmar b. Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth from my father \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3104

chapter.englishTitle: In English: "Inheritance of Relatives

hadiths.englishRaw: About a woman or man who died and left behind a paternal aunt and paternal aunt, they said he has no heir or relative other than them, so they said, "Abdullah ibn Mas'ud used to treat the paternal aunt like his own mother and treat the paternal aunt like his own sister."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About a woman or man who died and left behind a paternal aunt and paternal aunt, they said he has no heir or relative other than them, so they said, "Abdullah ibn Mas'ud used to treat the paternal aunt like his own mother and treat the paternal aunt like his own sister."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ أَوْ رَجُلٍ تُوُفِّيَ وَتَرَكَ خَالَةً وَعَمَّةً قال لَيْسَ لَهُ وَارِثٌ وَلَا رَحِمٌ غَيْرُهُمَا فَقَالَ «كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ يُنَزِّلُ الْخَالَةَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ أُمِّهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ الْعَمَّةَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ أَخِيهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Abū Hāniʾ \u003e Suʾil ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هَانِئٍ قَالَ سُئِلَ عَامِرٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3105

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: About al-Hasan, regarding a man who admitted to owing a thousand dirhams to one person and another person provided evidence of a thousand dirhams, and the deceased left behind a thousand dirhams. He said, "The money should be divided equally between the two, unless the deceased was bankrupt, then his claim cannot be accepted."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About al-Hasan, regarding a man who admitted to owing a thousand dirhams to one person and another person provided evidence of a thousand dirhams, and the deceased left behind a thousand dirhams. He said, "The money should be divided equally between the two, unless the deceased was bankrupt, then his claim cannot be accepted."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي رَجُلٍ اعْتَرَفَ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ لِرَجُلٍ وَأَقَامَ آخَرُ بَيِّنَةً بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ وَتَرَكَ الْمَيِّتُ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ فَقَالَ «الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَيْنِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ مُفْلِسًا فَلَا يَجُوزُ إِقْرَارُهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3106

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: I said to a partner, "How did you mention in the two brothers that one of them claims to be a brother?" He said, "He enters into his share." I asked, "Who mentioned it?" He said, "Jabir reported from Aamir from Ali."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I said to a partner, "How did you mention in the two brothers that one of them claims to be a brother?" He said, "He enters into his share." I asked, "Who mentioned it?" He said, "Jabir reported from Aamir from Ali."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ لِشَرِيكٍ كَيْفَ ذَكَرْتَ فِي الْأَخَوَيْنِ يَدَّعِي أَحَدُهُمَا أَخًا؟ قَالَ «يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِ فِي نَصِيبِهِ» قُلْتُ مَنْ ذَكَرَهُ؟ قَالَ جَابِرٌ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3107

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: Concerning Ibrahim and his brothers, some of them claim brotherhood while others deny it. He said, "He will enter with them in the position of a slave who has a share among brothers, so one of them will free his portion." He said, and 'Amir, the judge, and their companions say, "He will not enter except in the share that he acknowledged."
hadiths.body: Concerning Ibrahim and his brothers, some of them claim brotherhood while others deny it. He said, "He will enter with them in the position of a slave who has a share among brothers, so one of them will free his portion." He said, and 'Amir, the judge, and their companions say, "He will not enter except in the share that he acknowledged."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي الْإِخْوَةِ يَدَّعِي بَعْضُهُمُ الْأَخَ وَيُنْكِرُ الْآخَرُونَ قَالَ «يَدْخُلُ مَعَهُمْ بِمَنْزِلَةِ عَبْدٍ يَكُونُ بَيْنَ الْإِخْوَةِ فَيَعْتِقَ أَحَدُهُمْ نَصِيبَهُ» قَالَ وَكَانَ عَامِرٌ وَالْحَكَمُ وَأَصْحَابُهُمَا يَقُولُونَ «لَا يَدْخُلُ إِلَّا فِي نَصِيبِ الَّذِي اعْتَرَفَ بِهِ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Muḥammad al-Muḥāribī \u003e al-Aʿmash
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3108

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: If they are brothers, does one of them claim brotherhood while the other denies it? Ibn Abi Layla said: "It is divided into six parts: three for the one who does not claim, two for the claimant, and one for the one being claimed."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: If they are brothers, does one of them claim brotherhood while the other denies it? Ibn Abi Layla said: "It is divided into six parts: three for the one who does not claim, two for the claimant, and one for the one being claimed."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِذَا كَانَا أَخَوَيْنِ فَادَّعَى أَحَدُهُمَا أَخًا وَأَنْكَرَهُ الْآخَرُ؟ قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى يَقُولُ هِيَ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ لِلَّذِي لَمْ يَدَّعِ ثَلَاثَةٌ وَلِلْمُدَّعِي سَهْمَانِ وَلِلْمُدَّعَى سَهْمٌ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr \u003e Wakīʿ \u003e Idhā Kānā Akhawayn Fāddaʿá Aḥaduhumā Akh Waʾankarah al-Ākhar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ وَكِيعٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3109

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: About Hammad concerning a man who has three sons. Hammad said: "two-thirds of the property should go to the youngest son." The middle son said: "I agree." And the eldest son said: "I do not agree." Hammad said: "She comes from nine (shares), so he (the youngest son) gets his share and the share of the one who agreed." And Hammad said: "The arrow is returned to all of them." And 'Amir said: "The one who returned it only returned it to himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Hammad concerning a man who has three sons. Hammad said: "two-thirds of the property should go to the youngest son." The middle son said: "I agree." And the eldest son said: "I do not agree." Hammad said: "She comes from nine (shares), so he (the youngest son) gets his share and the share of the one who agreed." And Hammad said: "The arrow is returned to all of them." And 'Amir said: "The one who returned it only returned it to himself."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ لَهُ ثَلَاثَةُ بَنِينَ فَقَالَ ثُلُثِي لِأَصْغَرِ بَنِيَّ فَقَالَ الْأَوْسَطُ أَنَا أُجِيزُ وَقَالَ الْأَكْبَرُ أَنَا لَا أُجِيزُ قَالَ «هِيَ مِنْ تِسْعَةٍ يُخْرِجُ ثُلُثَهُ فَلَهُ سَهْمُهُ وَسَهْمُ الَّذِي أَجَازَ» وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ «يَرُدُّ السَّهْمَ عَلَيْهِمْ جَمِيعًا» وَقَالَ عَامِرٌ «الَّذِي رَدَّ إِنَّمَا رَدَّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yūnus b. Muḥammad \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3110

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: "It is his brother."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "It is his brother."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ أَخُوهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ādam \u003e Sharīk \u003e Khālid \u003e Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ فِي رَجُلٍ أَقَرَّ بِأَخٍ قَالَ «بَيِّنَتُهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3111

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Harith al-Ukli, regarding a man who confessed upon his death to having a thousand dirhams as investment and a thousand dirhams as debt, and he did not leave behind anything except a thousand dirhams. He said, "Begin with the debt, for if there is any remaining, it will be an increase for the owner of the investment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Harith al-Ukli, regarding a man who confessed upon his death to having a thousand dirhams as investment and a thousand dirhams as debt, and he did not leave behind anything except a thousand dirhams. He said, "Begin with the debt, for if there is any remaining, it will be an increase for the owner of the investment."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَارِثِ الْعُكْلِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ أَقَرَّ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ بِأَلْفِ دِرْهَمٍ مُضَارَبَةً وَأَلْفٍ دَيْنًا وَلَمْ يَدَعْ إِلَّا أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ قَالَ «يُبْدَأُ بِالدَّيْنِ فَإِنْ فَضَلَ فَضْلٌ كَانَ لِصَاحِبِ الْمُضَارَبَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3112

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Shaabi (a famous poet) regarding a man who died leaving behind three hundred dirhams and three sons, a man came claiming one hundred dirhams from the deceased. One of the sons confirmed his claim and said the amount should be paid to him from their portion. Then Al-Shaabi said, "I do not see that an inheritance can be distributed until the debt is settled."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Shaabi (a famous poet) regarding a man who died leaving behind three hundred dirhams and three sons, a man came claiming one hundred dirhams from the deceased. One of the sons confirmed his claim and said the amount should be paid to him from their portion. Then Al-Shaabi said, "I do not see that an inheritance can be distributed until the debt is settled."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ وَثَلَاثَةَ بَنِينَ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَدَّعِي مِائَةَ دِرْهَمٍ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ فَأَقَرَّ لَهُ أَحَدُهُمْ قَالَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالْحِصَّةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ «مَا أُرَى أَنْ يَكُونَ مِيرَاثًا حَتَّى يُقْضَى الدَّيْنُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e Muṭarrif
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3113

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Hasan, there was a man who died leaving behind two sons and two thousand dirhams. The two sons divided the two thousand dirhams equally between themselves. Then, one of the sons disappeared. A man came and claimed a thousand dirhams from the deceased. He said to take all that is in the witness's hand and he was told to follow his absent brother and take half of what is in his hand.   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Hasan, there was a man who died leaving behind two sons and two thousand dirhams. The two sons divided the two thousand dirhams equally between themselves. Then, one of the sons disappeared. A man came and claimed a thousand dirhams from the deceased. He said to take all that is in the witness's hand and he was told to follow his absent brother and take half of what is in his hand.   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي رَجُلٍ هَلَكَ وَتَرَكَ ابْنَيْنِ وَتَرَكَ أَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ فَاقْتَسَمَا الْأَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ وَغَابَ أَحَدُ الِابْنَيْنِ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَاسْتَحَقَّ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ أَلْفَ دِرْهَمٍ قَالَ يَأْخُذُ جَمِيعَ مَا فِي يَدِ الشَّاهِدِ وَيُقَالُ لَهُ اتَّبِعْ أَخَاكَ الْغَائِبَ فَخُذْ نِصْفَ مَا فِي يَدِهِ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Khaythamah Muṣʿab b. Saʿīd al-Ḥarrānī \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e al-Ashʿath
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ مُصْعَبُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْحَرَّانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3114

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: "If some of the heirs acknowledge a debt, they are responsible for their share."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If some of the heirs acknowledge a debt, they are responsible for their share."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَقَرَّ بَعْضُ الْوَرَثَةِ بِدَيْنٍ فَهُوَ عَلَيْهِ بِحِصَّتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ziyād al-Aʿlam \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ زِيَادٍ الْأَعْلَمِ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3115

chapter.englishTitle: In claiming and denying

hadiths.englishRaw: "If two of the heirs bear witness to a debt, it is considered a part of the total wealth if they are competent." And Al-Sha'bi said, "They should take their share."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If two of the heirs bear witness to a debt, it is considered a part of the total wealth if they are competent." And Al-Sha'bi said, "They should take their share."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا شَهِدَ اثْنَانِ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ بِدَيْنٍ فَهُوَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ إِذَا كَانُوا عُدُولًا» وَقَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ «عَلَيْهِمَا فِي نَصِيبِهِمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū Hāshim \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3116

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the apostate

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Mas'ud used to inherit the belongings of those who apostatized if they were killed.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ibn Mas'ud used to inherit the belongings of those who apostatized if they were killed.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ يُوَرِّثُ أَهْلَ الْمُرْتَدِّ إِذَا قُتِلَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Thābit b. al-Walīd b. Jumayʿ from my father \u003e al-Qāsim b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ جُمَيْعٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3117

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the apostate

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali ibn Abi Talib decreed that the inheritance of someone who apostatizes shall be given to his Muslim heirs.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ali ibn Abi Talib decreed that the inheritance of someone who apostatizes shall be given to his Muslim heirs.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ «جَعَلَ مِيرَاثَ الْمُرْتَدِّ لِوَرَثَتِهِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3118

chapter.englishTitle: In the inheritance of the apostate

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali decided in favor of the apostate's family in their inheritance from the Muslims.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ali decided in favor of the apostate's family in their inheritance from the Muslims.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ عَلِيًّا قَضَى فِي مِيرَاثِ الْمُرْتَدِّ لِأَهْلِهِ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ḥajjāj \u003e al-Ḥakam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3119

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a man intentionally kills his brother, he does not inherit from his brother's inheritance nor from his brother's blood money. However, if he kills his brother accidentally, he inherits from his brother's inheritance and does not inherit from his brother's blood money." He said, "And Ata used to say that."
hadiths.body: "If a man intentionally kills his brother, he does not inherit from his brother's inheritance nor from his brother's blood money. However, if he kills his brother accidentally, he inherits from his brother's inheritance and does not inherit from his brother's blood money." He said, "And Ata used to say that."
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا قَتَلَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ عَمْدًا لَمْ يُوَرَّثْ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ وَلَا مِنْ دِيَتِهِ فَإِذَا قَتَلَهُ خَطَأً وُرِّثَ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ وَلَمْ يُوَرَّثْ مِنْ دِيَتِهِ» قَالَ وَكَانَ عَطَاءٌ يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Ibn ʿAmr \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm \u003e al-Ḥakam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3120

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: A man threw a stone at his mother and killed her. He then sought his inheritance from his brothers, but they told him, "You have no share in the inheritance." They went to Ali and he imposed on him the blood money and excluded him from the inheritance.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: A man threw a stone at his mother and killed her. He then sought his inheritance from his brothers, but they told him, "You have no share in the inheritance." They went to Ali and he imposed on him the blood money and excluded him from the inheritance.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: رَمَى رَجُلٌ أُمَّهُ بِحَجَرٍ فَقَتَلَهَا فَطَلَبَ مِيرَاثَهُ مِنْ إِخْوَتِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ إِخْوَتُهُ لَا مِيرَاثَ لَكَ فَارْتَفَعُوا إِلَى عَلِيٍّ فَجَعَلَ عَلَيْهِ الدِّيَةَ وَأَخْرَجَهُ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Qatādah \u003e Khilās \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ خِلَاسٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3121

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: "It is prohibited for him to inherit from his mind and others."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It is prohibited for him to inherit from his mind and others."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ يُمْنَعُ مِيرَاثَهُ مِنَ الْعَقْلِ وَغَيْرِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e al-Ḥasan b. al-Ḥur \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e al-a man Idhā Qatal Āmraʾatah Khaṭaʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْحُرِّ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ «أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا قَتَلَ امْرَأَتَهُ خَطَأً

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3122

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: "The killer inherits nothing from the killed."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The killer inherits nothing from the killed."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَرِثُ الْقَاتِلُ مِنَ الْمَقْتُولِ شَيْئًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth \u003e Mujāhid \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3123

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: About Qatadah, regarding a man who accused his wife of adultery and brought witnesses, hence she was stoned to death. Qatadah said, "He inherits her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Qatadah, regarding a man who accused his wife of adultery and brought witnesses, hence she was stoned to death. Qatadah said, "He inherits her."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ قَتَادَةَ فِي رَجُلٍ قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَجَاءَ بِشُهُودٍ فَرُجِمَتْ؟ قَالَ «يَرِثُهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3124

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: About Hammad, concerning a man who was whipped with the prescribed punishment, I see him dead. Did Abu Nu'man doubt it? He said, "They inherited each other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Hammad, concerning a man who was whipped with the prescribed punishment, I see him dead. Did Abu Nu'man doubt it? He said, "They inherited each other."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ حَمَّادٍ فِي رَجُلٍ جُلِدَ الْحَدَّ أَرَاهُ مَاتَ شَكَّ أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ ؟ قَالَ «يَتَوَارَثَانِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3125

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: "The killer neither inherits nor conceals."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The killer neither inherits nor conceals."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْقَاتِلُ لَا يَرِثُ وَلَا يَحْجُبُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Muḥammad b. Sālim \u003e ʿĀmir \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3126

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: "The killer does not inherit."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The killer does not inherit."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْقَاتِلُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ḥasan \u003e Layth \u003e Abū ʿAmr al-ʿAbdī \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الْعَبْدِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3127

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: "Age does not inherit a killer, whether intentional or accidental."
hadiths.body: "Age does not inherit a killer, whether intentional or accidental."
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ «لَا يَرِثُ قَاتِلٌ خَطَأً وَلَا عَمْدًا»
hadiths.chain: Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3128

chapter.englishTitle: In English: The Legacy of the Assassin

hadiths.englishRaw: "The killer does not inherit."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The killer does not inherit."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَرِثُ الْقَاتِلُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth \u003e Ṭāwus \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3129

chapter.englishTitle: The obligations of the Magi-

hadiths.englishRaw: "If two genealogies merge, the inheritance goes to the older one," meaning the Magi.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If two genealogies merge, the inheritance goes to the older one," meaning the Magi.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ نَسَبَانِ وُرِّثَ بِأَكْبَرِهِمَا» يَعْنِي الْمَجُوسَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbd al-Aʿlá \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْأَعْلَى عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3130

chapter.englishTitle: The obligations of the Magi-

hadiths.englishRaw: "He inherits from the side that is eligible, and doesn't inherit from the side that is not eligible."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He inherits from the side that is eligible, and doesn't inherit from the side that is not eligible."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَرِثُ مِنَ الْجَانِبِ الَّذِي يَصْلُحُ وَلَا يَرِثُ مِنَ الْجَانِبِ الَّذِي لَا يَصْلُحُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥammād b. Abū Sulaymān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3131

chapter.englishTitle: The obligations of the Magi-

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali and Ibn Mas'ood said about the Magians, "When they convert to Islam, they will inherit from both sides of their family."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ali and Ibn Mas'ood said about the Magians, "When they convert to Islam, they will inherit from both sides of their family."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا وَابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَا فِي الْمَجُوسِ «إِذَا أَسْلَمُوا يَرِثُونَ مِنَ الْقَرَابَتَيْنِ جَمِيعًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Sufyān al-Thawrī \u003e a man \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAlī And Ibn Masʿūd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3132

chapter.englishTitle: In the Inheritance of the Prisoner

hadiths.englishRaw: "It inherits him and he inherits her."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "It inherits him and he inherits her."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهَا تَرِثُهُ وَيَرِثُهَا»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Ibn Abū al-Zinād from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فِي امْرَأَةِ الْأَسِيرِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3133

chapter.englishTitle: In the Inheritance of the Prisoner

hadiths.englishRaw: "He is allowed to make his will as long as he remains within his religion and does not change his religion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He is allowed to make his will as long as he remains within his religion and does not change his religion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أُجِيزُ لَهُ وَصِيَّتَهُ مَا دَامَ عَلَى دِينِهِ لَمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ عَنْ دِينِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Faḍl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar \u003e Isḥāq b. Rāshid
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنِي مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فِي الْأَسِيرِ يُوصِي قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3134

chapter.englishTitle: In the Inheritance of the Prisoner

hadiths.englishRaw: "The prisoner is inherited when he is in the hands of the enemy."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The prisoner is inherited when he is in the hands of the enemy."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يُوَرَّثُ الْأَسِيرُ إِذَا كَانَ فِي أَيْدِي الْعَدُوِّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Dāwud \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Shurayḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3135

chapter.englishTitle: In the Inheritance of the Prisoner

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim heard saying, "The captive will inherit."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim heard saying, "The captive will inherit."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ يَقُولُ «يُوَرَّثُ الْأَسِيرُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad \u003e Sufyān \u003e Man \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3136

chapter.englishTitle: In the Inheritance of the Prisoner

hadiths.englishRaw: "He did not bequeath the captive."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He did not bequeath the captive."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُوَرِّثُ الْأَسِيرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Dāwud \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3137

chapter.englishTitle: In the heritage of al-Hameel

hadiths.englishRaw: That the pregnant woman should not be inherited except with clear evidence, and if it comes in her defect, then it is invalid.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: That the pregnant woman should not be inherited except with clear evidence, and if it comes in her defect, then it is invalid.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ لَا يُوَرِّثَ الْحَمِيلَ إِلَّا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَإِنْ جَاءَتْ بِهِ فِي خِرَقِهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e Katab ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb \u003e Shurayḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ «كَتَبَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِلَى شُرَيْحٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3138

chapter.englishTitle: In the heritage of al-Hameel

hadiths.englishRaw: "Inherit the pregnant one."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Inherit the pregnant one."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «وَرِّثِ الْحَمِيلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3139

chapter.englishTitle: In the heritage of al-Hameel

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the statement of Damrah, Al-Fudayl bin Fadalah, Ibn Abi Awf, Rashed, and Atiyah, they said, "Mules cannot inherit."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the statement of Damrah, Al-Fudayl bin Fadalah, Ibn Abi Awf, Rashed, and Atiyah, they said, "Mules cannot inherit."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ وَالْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ فَضَالَةَ وَابْنِ أَبِي عَوْفٍ وَرَاشِدٍ وَعَطِيَّةَ قَالُوا «لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْحُمَلَاءُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Saʿīd from Banī Umayyah \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Maryam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ مِنْ بَنِي أُمَيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3140

chapter.englishTitle: In the heritage of al-Hameel

hadiths.englishRaw: It was mentioned to him that someone said regarding Al-Hamīl, so he disapproved of that and said, "The Muhajirun and the Ansar have inherited their lineage from the pre-Islamic era."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It was mentioned to him that someone said regarding Al-Hamīl, so he disapproved of that and said, "The Muhajirun and the Ansar have inherited their lineage from the pre-Islamic era."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: ذُكِرَ عِنْدَهُ قَوْلُ مَنْ يَقُولُ فِي الْحَمِيلِ فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ وَقَالَ «قَدْ تَوَارَثَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ وَالْأَنْصَارُ بِنَسَبِهِمُ الَّذِي كَانَ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Dhukir ʿIndah Qawl Man
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3141

chapter.englishTitle: In the heritage of al-Hameel

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Hasan and Ibn Seerin, they said, "The pregnant woman is not inherited except with clear evidence."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Hasan and Ibn Seerin, they said, "The pregnant woman is not inherited except with clear evidence."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ وَابْنِ سِيرِينَ قَالَا «لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْحَمِيلُ إِلَّا بِبَيِّنَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan And Ibn Sīrīn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3142

chapter.englishTitle: In the heritage of al-Hameel

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman did not inherit the pregnant woman."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Abu Bakr, Umar, and Uthman did not inherit the pregnant woman."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَمْ يَكُنْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَعُثْمَانُ يُوَرِّثُونَ الْحَمِيلَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr \u003e Jarīr \u003e Layth \u003e Ḥammād \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3143

chapter.englishTitle: In the heritage of al-Hameel

hadiths.englishRaw: "A woman from the Mujarib tribe wore a cloak that belonged to her brother from the Jaliib tribe. Abdullah bin Uthba inherited it from his sister."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A woman from the Mujarib tribe wore a cloak that belonged to her brother from the Jaliib tribe. Abdullah bin Uthba inherited it from his sister."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَقَرَّتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ مُحَارِبٍ جَلِيبَةٌ بِنَسَبٍ أَخٍ لَهَا جَلِيبٍ فَوَرَّثَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ مِنْ أُخْتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥīm al-Muḥāribī \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e Ashʿath b. Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ عَنْ زَائِدَةَ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3144

chapter.englishTitle: In the heritage of al-Hameel

hadiths.englishRaw: "At the departure of this world, I am the guardian of so-and-so. He said, 'His inheritance shall be returned to the one who claims to be his guardian at the time of departure from this world, except if they present clear evidence. If not, then his statement shall be rejected, and his inheritance shall be returned to what the evidence supports.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "At the departure of this world, I am the guardian of so-and-so. He said, 'His inheritance shall be returned to the one who claims to be his guardian at the time of departure from this world, except if they present clear evidence. If not, then his statement shall be rejected, and his inheritance shall be returned to what the evidence supports.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عِنْدَ فِرَاقِ الدُّنْيَا أَنَا مَوْلَى فُلَانٍ قَالَ «يُرَدُّ مِيرَاثَهُ لِمَنْ سَمَّى أَنَّهُ مَوْلَاهُ عِنْدَ فِرَاقِ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتُوا عَلَيْهِ بِبَيِّنَةٍ بِغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ يَرُدُّونَ بِهِ قَوْلَهُ فَيُرَدُّ مِيرَاثُهُ إِلَى مَا قَامَتْ بِهِ الْبَيِّنَةُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e a man \u003e ʿInd Firāq al-Dunyā \u003e a freed slave of Fulān \u003e Yurad Mīrāthah Liman Sammá \u003e Mawlāh ʿInd Firāq al-Dunyā Illā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3145

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Ali and Abdullah, they said, "The child of adultery is considered like the son of condemnation."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Ali and Abdullah, they said, "The child of adultery is considered like the son of condemnation."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَا «وَلَدُ الزِّنَا بِمَنْزِلَةِ ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e Muḥammad b. Sālim \u003e al-Shaʿbī \u003e ʿAlī And ʿAbd Allāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3146

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "A child of adultery is not inherited by the one who claims him, nor is he inherited by the biological offspring."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A child of adultery is not inherited by the one who claims him, nor is he inherited by the biological offspring."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ وَلَدَ الزِّنَا لَا يَرِثُهُ الَّذِي يَدَّعِيهِ وَلَا يَرِثُهُ الْمَوْلُودُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e al-Ḥasan b. al-Ḥur \u003e al-Ḥakam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْحُرِّ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3147

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "It was considered that the child of adultery does not inherit, even if claimed by a man."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.body: "It was considered that the child of adultery does not inherit, even if claimed by a man."   – Strong Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُوَرِّثُ وَلَدَ الزِّنَا وَإِنْ ادَّعَاهُ الرَّجُلُ»   – إسناده قوي
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Rawḥ \u003e Muḥammad b. Abū Ḥafṣah \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿAlī b. Ḥusayn
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3148

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whichever man comes to a boy, claiming to be his son and that he had illicit relations with his mother, and no one else claims that boy, then he will inherit him." Bukayr said, "I asked Urwah about this and he said it is like the saying of Sulayman ibn Yasar." Urwah also said, "We have received information that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The child belongs to the one who slept on the bed, and the stoning is for the adulterer.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whichever man comes to a boy, claiming to be his son and that he had illicit relations with his mother, and no one else claims that boy, then he will inherit him." Bukayr said, "I asked Urwah about this and he said it is like the saying of Sulayman ibn Yasar." Urwah also said, "We have received information that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'The child belongs to the one who slept on the bed, and the stoning is for the adulterer.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ أَتَى إِلَى غُلَامٍ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ ابْنٌ لَهُ وَأَنَّهُ زَنَى بِأُمِّهِ وَلَمْ يَدَّعِ ذَلِكَ الْغُلَامَ أَحَدٌ فَهُوَ يَرِثُهُ» قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ وَسَأَلْتُ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَقَالَ عُرْوَةُ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ وَلِلْعَاهِرِ الْحَجَرُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Bakr b. Muḍar \u003e ʿAmr / Ibn al-Ḥārith \u003e Bukayr \u003e Sulaymān b. Yasār \u003e Ayyumā a man Atá \u003e Ghulām Yazʿum \u003e Ibn Lah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3149

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "The son of a cursed person is like the son of adultery, inheriting from his mother and his mother's inheritors inherit from him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The son of a cursed person is like the son of adultery, inheriting from his mother and his mother's inheritors inherit from him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ابْنُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ مِثْلُ وَلَدِ الزِّنَا تَرِثُهُ أُمُّهُ وَوَرَثَتُهُ وَرَثَةُ أُمِّهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghiyāth \u003e ʿAmr \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3150

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "The child of adultery does not inherit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The child of adultery does not inherit."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يُوَرَّثُ وَلَدُ الزِّنَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3151

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "They inherit from their mothers, and if she gives birth to twins and dies, the sixth inherits."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "They inherit from their mothers, and if she gives birth to twins and dies, the sixth inherits."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَتَوَارَثُونَ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأُمَّهَاتِ وَإِنْ وَلَدَتْ تَوْأَمًا فَمَاتَ وَرِثَ السُّدُسَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar or Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ أَوْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ فِي أَوْلَادِ الزِّنَا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3152

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "The child of adultery does not inherit, only the one who has not established paternity or who is owned by his mother through marriage or purchase inherits."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The child of adultery does not inherit, only the one who has not established paternity or who is owned by his mother through marriage or purchase inherits."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَرِثُ وَلَدُ الزِّنَا إِنَّمَا يَرِثُ مَنْ لَمْ يُقَمْ عَلَى أَبِيهِ الْحَدُّ أَوْ تُمْلَكُ أُمُّهُ بِنِكَاحٍ أَوْ شِرَاءٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Hushaym \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Shibāk \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ شِبَاكٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3153

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Hasan in regard to a man who divorces a woman and then marries her, he said, "There is no harm except if she is pregnant, as the child will not follow him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Hasan in regard to a man who divorces a woman and then marries her, he said, "There is no harm except if she is pregnant, as the child will not follow him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَفْجُرُ بِالْمَرْأَةِ ثُمَّ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا قَالَ «لَا بَأْسَ إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ حُبْلَى فَإِنَّ الْوَلَدَ لَا يَلْحَقُهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Mūsá b. Muḥammad al-Anṣārī \u003e Ismāʿīl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3154

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ decided regarding one who was treated as a member of a family after the death of his father, to whom he was attributed when the heirs said he was one of them, that if he was the child of a slave-woman whom the father owned when he had intercourse with her, he was included among those who sought his inclusion, but received none of the inheritance which was previously divided; he, however, received his portion of the inheritance which had not already been divided; but if the father to whom he was attributed had disowned him, he was not joined to the heirs. If he was a child of a slave-woman whom the father did not possess or of a free woman with whom he had illicit intercourse, he was not joined to the heirs and did not inherit even if the one to whom he was attributed is the one who claimed paternity, since he was a child of fornication whether his mother was free or a slave.     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ decided regarding one who was treated as a member of a family after the death of his father, to whom he was attributed when the heirs said he was one of them, that if he was the child of a slave-woman whom the father owned when he had intercourse with her, he was included among those who sought his inclusion, but received none of the inheritance which was previously divided; he, however, received his portion of the inheritance which had not already been divided; but if the father to whom he was attributed had disowned him, he was not joined to the heirs. If he was a child of a slave-woman whom the father did not possess or of a free woman with whom he had illicit intercourse, he was not joined to the heirs and did not inherit even if the one to whom he was attributed is the one who claimed paternity, since he was a child of fornication whether his mother was free or a slave.     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أن رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «قَضَى أَنَّ كُلِّ مُسْتَلْحَقٍ اسْتُلْحِقَ بَعْدَ أَبِيهِ الَّذِي يُدْعَى لَهُ ادَّعَاهُ وَرَثَتُهُ بَعْدَهُ فَقَضَى إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَمَةٍ يَمْلِكُهَا يَوْمَ يَطَؤُهَا فَقَدْ لَحِقَ بِمَنِ اسْتَلْحَقَهُ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ فيمَّا قُسِمَ قَبْلَهُ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ شَيْءٌ وَمَا أَدْرَكَ مِنْ مِيرَاثٍ لَمْ يُقْسَمْ فَلَهُ نَصِيبُهُ وَلَا يَلْحَقُ إِذَا كَانَ الَّذِي يُدْعَى لَهُ أَنْكَرَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَمَةٍ لَا يَمْلِكُهَا أَوْ حُرَّةٍ عَاهَرَهَا فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَلْحَقُ وَلَا يَرِثُ وَإِنْ كَانَ الَّذِي يُدْعَى لَهُ هُوَ ادَّعَاهُ فهُوَ وَلَدُ زِنَا لِأَهْلِ أُمِّهِ مَنْ كَانُوا حُرَّةً أَوْ أَمَةً»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Zayd b. Yaḥyá \u003e Muḥammad b. Rāshid \u003e Sulaymān b. Mūsá \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb from his father from his grandfather
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3155

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not buy it, do not eat its price, and do not use it."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not buy it, do not eat its price, and do not use it."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَبِعْهُ وَلَا تَأْكُلْ ثَمَنَهُ وَاسْتَخْدِمْهُ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e ʿUmayr b. Yazīd \u003e Saʾalt al-Shaʿbī \u003e Mamlūk Lī And Lad Zin
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ عَنْ مَمْلُوكٍ لِي وَلَدُ زِنًا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3156

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: And I heard Malik say, "He said that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: And I heard Malik say, "He said that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَسَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا «يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʿīd \u003e al-Zuhrī Suʾil \u003e And Lad Zinā Yamūt
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ سُئِلَ عَنْ وَلَدِ زِنَا يَمُوتُ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ ابْنَ عَرَبِيَّةٍ وَرِثَتْ أُمُّهُ الثُّلُثَ وَجُعِلَ بَقِيَّةُ مَالِهِ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ وَإِنْ كَانَ ابْنَ مَوْلَاةٍ وَرِثَتْ أُمُّهُ الثُّلُثَ وَوَرِثَ مَوَالِيهَا الَّذِينَ أَعْتَقُوهَا مَا بَقِيَ» قَالَ مَرْوَانُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3157

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ decreed that the inheritance of the cursed individual's son should all go to his mother due to the hardships she endured.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ decreed that the inheritance of the cursed individual's son should all go to his mother due to the hardships she endured.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «قَضَى بِمِيرَاثِ ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ لِأُمِّهِ كُلِّهِ لِمَا لَقِيَتْ فِيهِ مِنَ الْعَنَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e al-Haytham b. Ḥumayd \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. al-Ḥārith \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3158

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Children Born out of Wedlock

hadiths.englishRaw: "He said concerning the child of adultery to his mother's guardians: 'Take him, as you inherit him and understand him, and he will not inherit you.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He said concerning the child of adultery to his mother's guardians: 'Take him, as you inherit him and understand him, and he will not inherit you.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي وَلَدِ الزِّنَا لِأَوْلِيَاءِ أُمِّهِ «خُذُوهُ إْنَكُمْ تَرِثُونَهُ وَتَعْقِلُونَهُ وَلَا يَرِثُكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Mūsá b. Muḥammad al-Anṣārī \u003e al-Ḥārith b. Ḥaṣīrah \u003e Zayd b. Wahb \u003e ʿAlī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَارِثُ بْنُ حَصِيرَةَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3159

chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah said: "The generous person puts his money wherever he wants." Abdullah bin Yazid said: Shu'ba said: "I have not heard this from Salamah except from me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah said: "The generous person puts his money wherever he wants." Abdullah bin Yazid said: Shu'ba said: "I have not heard this from Salamah except from me."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «السَّائِبَةُ يَضَعُ مَالَهُ حَيْثُ شَاءَ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ «لَمْ يَسْمَعْ هَذَا مِنْ سَلَمَةَ أَحَدٌ غَيْرِي»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym And ʿAbd Allāh b. Yazīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Salamah b. Kuhayl \u003e Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī \u003e ʿAbdullāh al-Sāʾibah Yaḍaʿ Mālah Ḥayth Shāʾ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Shuʿbah Lam
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3160

chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: "Every ancient thing is loose."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Every ancient thing is loose."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُلُّ عَتِيقٍ سَائِبَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Ḥātim b. And Rdān \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan Suʾil \u003e Mīrāth al-Sāʾibah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ وَرْدَانَ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ سُئِلَ عَنْ مِيرَاثِ السَّائِبَةِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3161

chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the phrase "عُمَرُ «الصَّدَقَةُ وَالسَّائِبَةُ لِيَوْمِهِمَا أَوْ لِوَقْتِهِمَا»" from Arabic to English is: "The age/an entire lifetime of 'sadaqah' (charity) and 'sā'ibah' (letting loose animals for grazing) is for their day or their time."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the phrase "عُمَرُ «الصَّدَقَةُ وَالسَّائِبَةُ لِيَوْمِهِمَا أَوْ لِوَقْتِهِمَا»" from Arabic to English is: "The age/an entire lifetime of 'sadaqah' (charity) and 'sā'ibah' (letting loose animals for grazing) is for their day or their time."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ «الصَّدَقَةُ وَالسَّائِبَةُ لِيَوْمِهِمَا أَوْ لِوَقْتِهِمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Sulaymān \u003e Abū ʿUthmān
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3162

chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: "He whom I have set free."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He whom I have set free."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لِلَّذِي أَعْتَقَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e Suʾil ʿĀmir \u003e al-Mamlūk Yuʿtaq Sāʾibah Liman And Lāʾuh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا قَالَ سُئِلَ عَامِرٌ عَنْ الْمَمْلُوكِ يُعْتَقُ سَائِبَةً لِمَنْ وَلَاؤُهُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3163

chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: "Mawlā died during the time of Uthman without having a heir, so he commanded for his wealth to be entered into the treasury."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Mawlā died during the time of Uthman without having a heir, so he commanded for his wealth to be entered into the treasury."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَاتَ مَوْلًى عَلَى عَهْدِ عُثْمَانَ َلَيْسَ لَهُ وَالٍ فَأَمَرَ بِمَالِهِ فَأُدْخِلَ بَيْتَ الْمَالِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Ḥātim al-Baṣrī \u003e Rawḥ b. Aslam \u003e Bishr b. al-Mufaḍḍal \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Isḥāq from his father \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ الْبَصْرِيُّ هُوَ رَوْحُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3164

chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: About stolen property in a man who died and had no inheritor, he said, "His wealth is where he directed it. If he did not direct it, then it is in the treasury."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About stolen property in a man who died and had no inheritor, he said, "His wealth is where he directed it. If he did not direct it, then it is in the treasury."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَوْلَى عَتَاقَةٍ قَالَ «مَالُهُ حَيْثُ أَوْصَى بِهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ أَوْصَى فَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَالِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3165

chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the statement of Damarah and Rashid ibn Saad and others about the freed slave, they said, "Certainly, his loyalty belongs to the one who freed him. His separation is only from slavery, not from loyalty."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the statement of Damarah and Rashid ibn Saad and others about the freed slave, they said, "Certainly, his loyalty belongs to the one who freed him. His separation is only from slavery, not from loyalty."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ وَرَاشِدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ وَغَيْرِهِمَا قَالُوا فِيمَنْ أُعْتِقَ سَائِبَةً «إِنَّ وَلَاءَهُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَهُ إِنَّمَا سَيَّبَهُ مِنَ الرِّقِّ وَلَمْ يُسَيِّبْهُ مِنَ الْوَلَاءِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Saʿīd b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Bakr b. Abū Maryam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3166

chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim and al-Sha'bi said, "There is no harm in selling abandoned goods and gifts."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim and al-Sha'bi said, "There is no harm in selling abandoned goods and gifts."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَالشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَا «لَا بَأْسَ بِبَيْعِ وَلَاءِ السَّائِبَةِ وَهِبَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Bakr b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Abū Dāwud \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm And al-Shhaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْصُورٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3167
