chapter.englishTitle: The Inheritance of the Wanderer

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man emancipated a runaway boy and then came to Abdullah and said, 'I have emancipated a runaway boy for myself, and this is his belonging.' He said, 'It is yours.' He said, 'I have no need for it.' He said, 'Put it, as there are many inheritors here.'"
hadiths.body: "A man emancipated a runaway boy and then came to Abdullah and said, 'I have emancipated a runaway boy for myself, and this is his belonging.' He said, 'It is yours.' He said, 'I have no need for it.' He said, 'Put it, as there are many inheritors here.'"
hadiths.arabic: أَعْتَقَ رَجُلٌ غُلَامًا سَائِبَةً فَأَتَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّي أَعْتَقْتُ غُلَامًا لِي سَائِبَةً وَهَذِهِ تَرِكَتُهُ قَالَ «هِيَ لَكَ» قَالَ لَا حَاجَةَ لِي فِيهَا قَالَ «فَضَعْهَا فَإِنَّ هَاهُنَا وَارِثًا كَثِيرًا»
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e Aʿtaq a man Ghulām Sāʾibah Faʾatá ʿAbdullāh \u003e Innī Aʿtaqt Ghulām Lī Sāʾibah And Hadhih Tarikatuh \u003e Hī Lak \u003e Lā Ḥājah Lī Fīhā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3168

chapter.englishTitle: The inheritance of the boy

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a boy begins to talk, he inherits and is prayed for."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "When a boy begins to talk, he inherits and is prayed for."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ الصَّبِيُّ وُرِّثَ وَصُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْأَشْعَثُ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3169

chapter.englishTitle: The inheritance of the boy

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a boy receives an inheritance and is inherited and prayers are offered for him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If a boy receives an inheritance and is inherited and prayers are offered for him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ الصَّبِيُّ وَرِثَ وَوُرِثَ وَصُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3170

chapter.englishTitle: The inheritance of the boy

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no newborn except that it is slapped and cries at the time of Satan's influence, except for Jesus son of Mary, peace be upon him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no newborn except that it is slapped and cries at the time of Satan's influence, except for Jesus son of Mary, peace be upon him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَيْسَ مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ إِلَّا اسْتَهَلَّ وَاسْتِهْلَالُهُ بِعَصْرِ الشَّيْطَانِ بَطْنَهُ فَيَصِيحُ إِلَّا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Mālik b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Simāk \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3171

chapter.englishTitle: The inheritance of the boy

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A newborn does not inherit until he or she cries out and even if born alive."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A newborn does not inherit until he or she cries out and even if born alive."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَا يَرِثُ الْمَوْلُودُ حَتَّى يَسْتَهِلَّ صَارِخًا وَإِنْ وَقَعَ حَيًّا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Ibn Ḥamzah \u003e Zayd b. Wāqid \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى هُوَ ابْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3172

chapter.englishTitle: The inheritance of the boy

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a newborn baby arrives, pray for them and inherit (the good qualities)."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "When a newborn baby arrives, pray for them and inherit (the good qualities)."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ الْمَوْلُودُ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَوُرِثَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3173

chapter.englishTitle: The inheritance of the boy

hadiths.englishRaw: "I see the sneeze as a sign of good luck."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I see the sneeze as a sign of good luck."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَرَى الْعُطَاسَ اسْتِهْلَالًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad \u003e Maʿn \u003e Ibn Abū Dhiʾb \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3174

chapter.englishTitle: The inheritance of the boy

hadiths.englishRaw: The newborn is not inherited until they become capable, and no funeral prayer is performed for them until they become capable. Once they become capable, the funeral prayer is performed for them, they are inherited, and the dowry is fulfilled.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The newborn is not inherited until they become capable, and no funeral prayer is performed for them until they become capable. Once they become capable, the funeral prayer is performed for them, they are inherited, and the dowry is fulfilled.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يُوَرَّثُ الْمَوْلُودُ حَتَّى يَسْتَهِلَّ وَلَا يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يَسْتَهِلَّ فَإِذَا اسْتَهَلَّ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَوُرِّثَ وَكُمِّلَتِ الدِّيَةُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3175

chapter.englishTitle: The inheritance of the boy

hadiths.englishRaw: "He is not offered prayers and a newborn is not offered prayers until he starts crying."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "He is not offered prayers and a newborn is not offered prayers until he starts crying."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَلَا يُصَلَّى عَلَى مَوْلُودٍ حَتَّى يَسْتَهِلَّ صَارِخًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb And Saʾalnāh \u003e al-Saqṭ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ وَسَأَلْنَاهُ عَنِ السَّقْطِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3176

chapter.englishTitle: In the loyalty of the offices

hadiths.englishRaw: If one of the two desks bought the other, this one is from its master, and this one is from its master, so the sale is for the first (desk). The people of the town say loyalty is to the seller's master, and they say this purchase is only for the desks, so loyalty is to their master.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: If one of the two desks bought the other, this one is from its master, and this one is from its master, so the sale is for the first (desk). The people of the town say loyalty is to the seller's master, and they say this purchase is only for the desks, so loyalty is to their master.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِذَا ابْتَاعَ الْمُكَاتَبَانِ أَحَدُهُمَا الْآخَرَ هَذَا هَذَا مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ وَهَذَا هَذَا مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ فَالْبَيْعُ لِلْأَوَّلِ وَيَقُولُ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ الْوَلَاءُ لِسَيِّدِ الْبَائِعِ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّمَا ابْتَاعَ هَذَا مَا عَلَى الْمُكَاتَبِ فَالْوَلَاءُ لِلسَّيِّدِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Maʿmar \u003e Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3177

chapter.englishTitle: In the summer, the servant gets married.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whichever free man marries a slave woman, he has half-freed himself, and whichever slave marries a free woman, he has half-freed himself." Abu Muhammad said, meaning the offspring.
hadiths.body: "Whichever free man marries a slave woman, he has half-freed himself, and whichever slave marries a free woman, he has half-freed himself." Abu Muhammad said, meaning the offspring.
hadiths.arabic: «أَيُّمَا حُرٍّ تَزَوَّجَ أَمَةً فَقَدْ أَرَقَّ نِصْفَهُ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ يَتَزَوَّجُ حُرَّةً فَقَدْ أَعْتَقَ نِصْفَهُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد يَعْنِي الْوَلَدَ
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Saʿīd \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ سَعِيدٍ أَنَّ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3178

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Loyalty.

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the commoner's situation when a man marries a woman and then divorces her, and they have a child together? He said, "If she is a free woman, the financial responsibility is upon her mother. And if she is a slave, meaning a young child, then it is upon his guardians."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the commoner's situation when a man marries a woman and then divorces her, and they have a child together? He said, "If she is a free woman, the financial responsibility is upon her mother. And if she is a slave, meaning a young child, then it is upon his guardians."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي الْعَبْدِ يَتَزَوَّجُ الْمَرْأَةَ ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقُهَا وَلَهُ مِنْهَا وَلَدٌ؟ قَالَ إِنْ كَانَتْ حُرَّةً فَالنَّفَقَةُ عَلَى أُمِّهِ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَبْدًا يَعْنِي الصَّبِيَّ فَعَلَى مَوَالِيهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e al-Shaybānī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3179

chapter.englishTitle: Inheritance of Loyalty.

hadiths.englishRaw: From Ibrahim, they both said, "His loyalty is to whoever begins with freeing a slave for the first time."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Ibrahim, they both said, "His loyalty is to whoever begins with freeing a slave for the first time."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا «وَلَاؤُهُ لِمَنْ بَدَأَ بِالْعِتْقِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: [Chain 1] Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Hushaym \u003e Zakariyyā \u003e ʿĀmir [Chain 2] Jarīr \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Umā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ عَامِرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3180

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْعَبْدِ يَكُونُ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ فَيَعْتِقُ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the servant, there is a division between two men, one of whom...

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibrahim said, "If there is an obligation, it belongs to him, and if the servant seeks help, the obligation is between them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ibrahim said, "If there is an obligation, it belongs to him, and if the servant seeks help, the obligation is between them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَنَّهُمَا قَالَا «إِنْ ضَمِنَ كَانَ الْوَلَاءُ لَهُ وَإِنْ اسْتَسْعَى الْعَبْدُ كَانَ الْوَلَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: [Chain 1] Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Hushaym \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan [Chain 2] Abān b. Taghlib \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Umā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَنْبَأَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ح وحَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3181

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْعَبْدِ يَكُونُ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ فَيَعْتِقُ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the servant, there is a division between two men, one of whom...

hadiths.englishRaw: About 'Amir, there was a slave between two men. One of them emancipated his share, so he said, "Complete his emancipation. If he does not have property, the slave should be sold for half of a fair price, and the right to manumit is for the one who emancipated him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About 'Amir, there was a slave between two men. One of them emancipated his share, so he said, "Complete his emancipation. If he does not have property, the slave should be sold for half of a fair price, and the right to manumit is for the one who emancipated him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَامِرٍ فِي عَبْدٍ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَعْتَقَ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ فَقَالَ «يُتَمَّمُ عِتْقُهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ اسْتُسْعِيَ الْعَبْدُ فِي النِّصْفِ بِقِيمَةِ عَدْلٍ وَالْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá And ʾAbū Nuʿaym \u003e Zakariyyā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى وَأَبُو نُعَيْمٍ قَالَا حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3182

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْعَبْدِ يَكُونُ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ فَيَعْتِقُ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the servant, there is a division between two men, one of whom...

hadiths.englishRaw: About his father, in a dispute between two men, one of them set free his portion and the other held onto it. He said, "His inheritance is between them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About his father, in a dispute between two men, one of them set free his portion and the other held onto it. He said, "His inheritance is between them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِيهِ فِي عَبْدٍ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ أَعْتَقَ أَحَدَهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ وَأَمْسَكَهُ الْآخَرُ قَالَ «مِيرَاثُهُ بَيْنَهُمَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hārūn b. Muʿāwiyah \u003e Abū Sufyān al-Maʿmarī \u003e Maʿmar \u003e Ibn Ṭāwus
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ الْمَعْمَرِيِّ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3183

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الْعَبْدِ يَكُونُ بَيْنَ رَجُلَيْنِ فَيَعْتِقُ أَحَدُهُمَا نَصِيبَهُ
chapter.englishTitle: In the servant, there is a division between two men, one of whom...

hadiths.englishRaw: And Qatadah said, "It belongs to the one who sets free, and its price is on him, and the people of Kufa say it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: And Qatadah said, "It belongs to the one who sets free, and its price is on him, and the people of Kufa say it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ قَتَادَةُ «هُوَ لِلْمُعْتِقِ كُلُّهُ وَثَمَنُهُ عَلَيْهِ وَيَقُولُهُ أَهْلُ الْكُوفَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Hārūn \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Maʿmar \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Mīrāthuh Lilladhī Amsakah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ «مِيرَاثُهُ لِلَّذِي أَمْسَكَهُ»

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3184

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man named Ata, he dies and leaves behind belongings and sons and daughters. Will there be any allegiance for women? He said, "Women inherit from what he had written and allegiance belongs to men, not women, except what they have written or freed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man named Ata, he dies and leaves behind belongings and sons and daughters. Will there be any allegiance for women? He said, "Women inherit from what he had written and allegiance belongs to men, not women, except what they have written or freed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَيَتْرُكُ مُكَاتَبًا وَلَهُ بَنُونَ وَبَنَاتٌ أَيَكُونُ لِلنِّسَاءِ مِنَ الْوَلَاءِ شَيْءٌ؟ قَالَ «تَرِثُ النِّسَاءُ مِمَّا عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ وَيَكُونُ الْوَلَاءُ لِلرِّجَالِ دُونَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا كَاتَبْنَ أَوْ أَعْتَقْنَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá b. ʿUbayd \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3185

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Women do not inherit from loyalty except what they have been set free from or what has been set free for those they have set free."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Women do not inherit from loyalty except what they have been set free from or what has been set free for those they have set free."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَرِثُ النِّسَاءُ مِنَ الْوَلَاءِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقْنَ أَوْ أَعْتَقَ مَنْ أَعْتَقْنَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e Layth \u003e Ṭāwus
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3186

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man died and left behind some property. Then, the properties were sold and he left some money. Ibn Al-Musayyib and Abu Salamah Ibn Abdul Rahman distributed what remained from his properties among the men and women of his relatives as their inheritance. And whatever money was left after his will, it belonged to the men of his relatives from the men of his family, excluding the women."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A man died and left behind some property. Then, the properties were sold and he left some money. Ibn Al-Musayyib and Abu Salamah Ibn Abdul Rahman distributed what remained from his properties among the men and women of his relatives as their inheritance. And whatever money was left after his will, it belonged to the men of his relatives from the men of his family, excluding the women."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تُوُفِّيَ رَجُلٌ وَتَرَكَ مُكَاتَبًا ثُمَّ مَاتَ الْمُكَاتَبُ وَتَرَكَ مَالًا فَجَعَلَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ بَيْنَ بَنِي مَوْلَاهُ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ عَلَى مِيرَاثِهِمْ وَمَا فَضَلَ مِنَ الْمَالِ بَعْدَ كِتَابَتِهِ فَلِلرِّجَالِ مِنْهُمْ مِنْ بَنِي مَوْلَاهُ دُونَ النِّسَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Abū Sufyān \u003e Maʿmar \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3187

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: About Umar, Ali, and Zaid, they said: "The allegiance belongs to the elders, and they do not inherit women's allegiance except what they have emancipated or written."
hadiths.body: About Umar, Ali, and Zaid, they said: "The allegiance belongs to the elders, and they do not inherit women's allegiance except what they have emancipated or written."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عُمَرَ وَعَلِيٍّ وَزَيْدٍ أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا «الْوَلَاءُ لِلْكُبْرِ وَلَا يُوَرِّثُونَ النِّسَاءَ مِنَ الْوَلَاءِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقْنَ أَوْ كَاتَبْنَ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām b. Ḥarb \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3188

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Abu Qilabah"
hadiths.body: "From Abu Qilabah"
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Khālid
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ خَالِدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3189

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib."
hadiths.body: "About Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ
hadiths.chain: Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī
hadiths.chainArabic: ح وحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3190

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of Sulaiman bin Yassar, they said: "Women do not inherit from their husbands except what they have been freed or written for."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: On the authority of Sulaiman bin Yassar, they said: "Women do not inherit from their husbands except what they have been freed or written for."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ أَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا «لَا تَرِثُ النِّسَاءُ مِنَ الْوَلَاءِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقْنَ أَوْ كَاتَبْنَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: his father
hadiths.chainArabic: ح وحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3191

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: Women do not inherit from loyalty except what they have freed or what has been freed by the one they freed, except for the cursed ones. Indeed, she inherits from the one who freed her son, from whom the father has been excluded.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Women do not inherit from loyalty except what they have freed or what has been freed by the one they freed, except for the cursed ones. Indeed, she inherits from the one who freed her son, from whom the father has been excluded.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا تَرِثُ النِّسَاءُ مِنَ الْوَلَاءِ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقْنَ أَوْ أَعْتَقَ مَنْ أَعْتَقْنَ إِلَّا الْمُلَاعَنَةُ فَإِنَّهَا تَرِثُ مَنْ أَعْتَقَ ابْنُهَا الَّذِي انْتَفَى مِنْهُ أَبُوهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Muʿādh \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ الْأَشْعَثَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3192

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "It was inherited by the followers of Umar rather than the daughters of Umar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It was inherited by the followers of Umar rather than the daughters of Umar."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَرِثُ مَوَالِيَ عُمَرَ دُونَ بَنَاتِ عُمَرَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn Wahb \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e Sālim from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3193

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Abu Qilabah regarding a woman who died and left behind her children, so they inherited her wealth and belongings. Then her children died. He said, 'The rights return to the family of the woman.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From Abu Qilabah regarding a woman who died and left behind her children, so they inherited her wealth and belongings. Then her children died. He said, 'The rights return to the family of the woman.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ فِي امْرَأَةٍ مَاتَتْ وَتَرَكَتْ بَنِيهَا فَوَرِثُوهَا مَالًا وَمَوَالِيَ ثُمَّ مَاتَ بَنُوهَا قَالَ «يَرْجِعُ الْوَلَاءُ إِلَى عَصَبَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Khālid al-Ḥadhhāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3194

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man who wrote a slave, then died and left behind male and female children. He said, "The males should have more (rights) than the females."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man who wrote a slave, then died and left behind male and female children. He said, "The males should have more (rights) than the females."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَاتَبَ عَبْدًا لَهُ ثُمَّ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ وَلَدًا رِجَالًا وَنِسَاءً قَالَ «لِلذُّكُورِ دُونَ الْإِنَاثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Saʾalt Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3195

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: He used to say about a woman who died and left a slave: "The loyalty belongs to her children, so when they die, it will return to her family."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He used to say about a woman who died and left a slave: "The loyalty belongs to her children, so when they die, it will return to her family."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي امْرَأَةٍ مَاتَتْ وَتَرَكَتْ مَوْلًى قَالَ «الْوَلَاءُ لِبَنِيهَا فَإِذَا مَاتُوا رَجَعَ إِلَى عَصَبَتِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3196

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Women have no authority except what they themselves have freed in their own individuality."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Women have no authority except what they themselves have freed in their own individuality."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَيْسَ لِلنِّسَاءِ مِنَ الْوَلَاءِ شَيْءٌ إِلَّا مَا أَعْتَقَتْ هِيَ فِي نَفْسِهَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3197

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do Omar's daughters have any share from his inheritance?" He said, "I don't see anything for them, and if you want to give them something, you can give it to them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do Omar's daughters have any share from his inheritance?" He said, "I don't see anything for them, and if you want to give them something, you can give it to them."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: هَلْ لِبَنَاتِ عُمَرَ مِنْ مِيرَاثِهِ شَيْءٌ؟ قَالَ «مَا أَرَى لَهُنَّ شَيْئًا وَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَهُنَّ أَعْطَيْتَهُنَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Māt a freed slave of Liʿumar Fasaʾal Ibn ʿUmar Zayd b. Thābit \u003e Hal Libanāt ʿUmar from Mīrāthih Shayʾ \u003e Mā Ará Lahun Shayʾ And ʾIn Shiʾt
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ مَاتَ مَوْلًى لِعُمَرَ فَسَأَلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ زَيْدَ بْنَ ثَابِتٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3198

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: "He who attains heritage gains loyalty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He who attains heritage gains loyalty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يُحْرِزُ الْوَلَاءَ مَنْ يُحْرِزُ الْمِيرَاثَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Usāmah \u003e Hishām from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3199

chapter.englishTitle: What is the entitlement of women?

hadiths.englishRaw: Uthman said, "Go, by the One in whose hand is the soul of whomever you wish." Abu Bakr then entrusted Abdul Rahman ibn Amr ibn Hazm.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Uthman said, "Go, by the One in whose hand is the soul of whomever you wish." Abu Bakr then entrusted Abdul Rahman ibn Amr ibn Hazm.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: لَهُ عُثْمَانُ «اذْهَبْ فَوَالِ مَنْ شِئْتَ» قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَوَالَى عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Abū Khālid \u003e Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Bakr b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm \u003e Āmraʾah from Muḥārib And Habat Walāʾ ʿAbdihā Linafsih Faʾaʿtaqath Fawahab Walāʾ Nafsih Liʿabd al-Raḥman b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm Wamātat Fakhāṣamat al-Mawālī \u003e ʿUthmān Fadaʿā ʿUthmān al-Bayyinah \u003e Mā \u003e Faʾatá al-Bayyinah \u003e Lah ʿUthmān Ādhhab Fawāl Man Shiʾt
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ مُحَارِبٍ وَهَبَتْ وَلَاءَ عَبْدِهَا لِنَفْسِهِ فَأَعْتَقَتْهُ فَوَهَبَ وَلَاءَ نَفْسِهِ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ وَمَاتَتْ فَخَاصَمَتْ الْمَوَالِي إِلَى عُثْمَانَ فَدَعَا عُثْمَانُ الْبَيِّنَةَ عَلَى مَا قَالَ قَالَ فَأَتَى الْبَيِّنَةُ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3200

chapter.englishTitle: The Sale of Allegiance

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling or giving away the right to inheritance by a manumitted slave.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade selling or giving away the right to inheritance by a manumitted slave.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3201

chapter.englishTitle: The Sale of Allegiance

hadiths.englishRaw: All the persons depend upon Abdullah b. Dinar in regard to this hadith.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: All the persons depend upon Abdullah b. Dinar in regard to this hadith.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ «نَهَى عَنْ بَيْعِ الْوَلَاءِ وَعَنْ هِبَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3202

chapter.englishTitle: The Sale of Allegiance

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Ibn Abbas say, "Allegiance cannot be bought nor given as a gift, rather allegiance is for the one who frees others."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Ibn Abbas say, "Allegiance cannot be bought nor given as a gift, rather allegiance is for the one who frees others."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ «لَا يُبَاعُ الْوَلَاءُ وَلَا يُوهَبُ وَالْوَلَاءُ لِمَنْ أَعْتَقَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3203

chapter.englishTitle: The Sale of Allegiance

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah, loyalty is like flesh, it cannot be bought or gifted."
hadiths.body: "Abdullah, loyalty is like flesh, it cannot be bought or gifted."
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «الْوَلَاءُ لُحْمَةٌ كَلُحْمَةِ النَّسَبِ لَا يُبَاعُ وَلَا يُوهَبُ»
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Abū Maʿshar \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3204

chapter.englishTitle: The Sale of Allegiance

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Al-Hasan and Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib, they despised selling loyalty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From Al-Hasan and Sa'id ibn Al-Musayyib, they despised selling loyalty."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ «أَنَّهُمَا كَرِهَا بَيْعَ الْوَلَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3205

chapter.englishTitle: The Sale of Allegiance

hadiths.englishRaw: Ibn Abbas, loyalty cannot be sold, meaning it cannot be consumed by the enslavement of a person twice.
hadiths.body: Ibn Abbas, loyalty cannot be sold, meaning it cannot be consumed by the enslavement of a person twice.
hadiths.arabic: ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ لَا يُبَاعُ الْوَلَاءُ أَيُؤْكَلُ بِرَقَبَةِ رَجُلٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e Ibn Idrīs \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3206

chapter.englishTitle: In the matter of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: "The obligations are six, we do not neglect any of them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The obligations are six, we do not neglect any of them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْفَرَائِضُ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ لَا نُعِيلُهَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3207

chapter.englishTitle: In the matter of obligations

hadiths.englishRaw: "This makes me a guilty person while I consider him an immoral person. He reveals complaints and conceals all other matters. So the man said to him, 'What do you say about two daughters, parents, and a husband?' He replied, 'The husband is entitled to one-fourth of all the wealth, and the parents are entitled to one-sixth each, and what remains is for the two daughters.' So what have you deprived me of?' The man said, 'I have not deprived you, it is Allah who has deprived you. He has deprived you of two-thirds for the daughters, one-sixth for the parents, and one-fourth for the husband. So it is a duty from seven and a half, and your family's duty.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "This makes me a guilty person while I consider him an immoral person. He reveals complaints and conceals all other matters. So the man said to him, 'What do you say about two daughters, parents, and a husband?' He replied, 'The husband is entitled to one-fourth of all the wealth, and the parents are entitled to one-sixth each, and what remains is for the two daughters.' So what have you deprived me of?' The man said, 'I have not deprived you, it is Allah who has deprived you. He has deprived you of two-thirds for the daughters, one-sixth for the parents, and one-fourth for the husband. So it is a duty from seven and a half, and your family's duty.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: هَذَا يَخَالُنِي امْرَءاً جَائِرًا وَأَنَا أخَالُهُ امْرَءاً فَاجِرًا يُظْهِرُ الشَّكْوَى وَيَكْتُمُ قَضَاءً سَائِرًا فَقَالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي بِنْتَيْنِ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَزَوْجٍ؟ فَقَالَ «لِلزَّوْجِ الرُّبُعُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ وَلِلْأَبَوَيْنِ السُّدُسَانِ وَمَا بَقِيَ فَلِلِابْنَتَيْنِ» فَلِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ نَقَصْتَنِي؟ قَالَ «لَيْسَ أَنَا نَقَصْتُكَ اللَّهُ نَقَصَكَ لِلِابْنَتَيْنِ الثُّلُثَانِ وَلِلْأَبَوَيْنِ السُّدُسَانِ وَلِلزَّوْجِ الرُّبُعُ فَهِيَ مِنْ سَبْعَةٍ وَنِصْفٍ فَرِيضَةً فَرِيضَتُكَ عَائِلَةٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿImrān \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Maysarah b. Shurayḥ \u003e Shurayḥ b. al-Ḥārith
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ قَالَ اخْتُصِمَ إِلَى شُرَيْحٍ فِي بِنْتَيْنِ وَأَبَوَيْنِ وَزَوْجٍ فَقَضَى فِيهَا فَأَقْبَلَ الزَّوْجُ يَشْكُوهُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ رَبَاحٍ فَأَخَذَهُ وَبَعَثَ إِلَى شُرَيْحٍ فَقَالَ مَا تقُولُ في هَذَا؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3208

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Ali, Umar, and Zaid, they said, "A parent carries the responsibility of their child."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Ali, Umar, and Zaid, they said, "A parent carries the responsibility of their child."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ وَعُمَرَ وَزَيْدٍ قَالُوا «الْوَالِدُ يَجُرُّ وَلَاءَ وَلَدِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3209

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: "Aljad du yajurru alwala’a" translates to "Generosity leads to loyalty" in English.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Aljad du yajurru alwala’a" translates to "Generosity leads to loyalty" in English.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْجَدُّ يَجُرُّ الْوَلَاءَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Ashʿath \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3210

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: "The parent cherishes the loyalty of his child."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The parent cherishes the loyalty of his child."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْوَالِدُ يَجُرُّ وَلَاءَ وَلَدِهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Ashʿath \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Shurayḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3211

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: About Amr, who was a slave, he died while having a free father and children from a free woman. To whom does the custody of his child belong? He said, "To the allies of the grandfather."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Amr, who was a slave, he died while having a free father and children from a free woman. To whom does the custody of his child belong? He said, "To the allies of the grandfather."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَامِرٍ فِي مَمْلُوكٍ تُوُفِّيَ وَلَهُ أَبٌ حُرٌّ وَلَهُ بَنُونَ مِنَ امْرَأَةٍ حُرَّةٍ لِمَنْ وَلَاءُ وَلَدِهِ؟ قَالَ «لِمَوَالِي الْجَدِّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zakariyyā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3212

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, in offices, he died, and he completed half of his work, and he has a son from a free woman. He said, "I can only see his child's obligations dragging him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, in offices, he died, and he completed half of his work, and he has a son from a free woman. He said, "I can only see his child's obligations dragging him."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي مُكَاتَبٍ مَاتَ وَقَدْ أَدَّى نِصْفَ مُكَاتَبَتِهِ وَلَهُ وَلَدٌ مِنَ امْرَأَةٍ حُرَّةٍ قَالَ «مَا أُرَاهُ إِلَّا قَدْ جَرَّ وَلَاءَ وَلَدِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Mughīrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3213

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a slave married a free woman and then she gave birth to free children, and then he was freed after that, the loyalty returned to the family of their father." So, Shurayh took hold of it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When a slave married a free woman and then she gave birth to free children, and then he was freed after that, the loyalty returned to the family of their father." So, Shurayh took hold of it.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ الْمَمْلُوكُ الْحُرَّةَ فَوَلَدَتْ أَوْلَادًا أَحْرَارًا ثُمَّ عُتِقَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ رَجَعَ الْوَلَاءُ لِمَوَالِي أَبِيهِمْ» فَأَخَذَ بِهِ شُرَيْحٌ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ كَانَ شُرَيْحٌ لَا يَرْجِعُ عَنْ قَضَاءٍ يَقْضِي بِهِ فَحَدَّثَهُ الْأَسْوَدُ أَنَّ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3214

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: During the Mamluk era, a free person (usually a slave) would be under the authority of their master. "If a child is freed, they are considered to be free because their mother is freed. When the father is freed, the child follows their status."
hadiths.body: During the Mamluk era, a free person (usually a slave) would be under the authority of their master. "If a child is freed, they are considered to be free because their mother is freed. When the father is freed, the child follows their status."
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ فِي الْمَمْلُوكِ يَكُونُ تَحْتَهُ الْحُرَّةُ «يُعْتَقُ الْوَلَدُ بِعِتْقِ أُمِّهِ فَإِذَا عُتِقَ الْأَبُ جَرَّ الْوَلَاءَ»
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3215

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: "As for what she gave birth to while he was a slave, their allegiance is to her family members who were the recipients of her grace. And as for what she gave birth to while he was a free man, their allegiance is to his family members who were the recipients of his grace."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "As for what she gave birth to while he was a slave, their allegiance is to her family members who were the recipients of her grace. And as for what she gave birth to while he was a free man, their allegiance is to his family members who were the recipients of his grace."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَمَّا مَا وَلَدَتْ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ عَبْدٌ فَوَلَاؤُهُمْ لِأَهْلِ نِعْمَتِهَا وَمَا وَلَدَتْ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ حُرٌّ فَوَلَاؤُهُمْ لِأَهْلِ نِعْمَتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e Kathīr b. Shinẓīr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ شِنْظِيرٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ فِي الْحُرَّةِ تَحْتَ الْعَبْدِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3216

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a free woman serves under a slave and bears a child for him, then the child is to be freed along with its mother, and their loyalty and guardianship belongs to the mother's freedmen. But if the father is freed, the loyalty is transferred to the freedmen of his father."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: "If a free woman serves under a slave and bears a child for him, then the child is to be freed along with its mother, and their loyalty and guardianship belongs to the mother's freedmen. But if the father is freed, the loyalty is transferred to the freedmen of his father."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ «إِذَا كَانَتِ الْحُرَّةُ تَحْتَ الْمَمْلُوكِ فَوَلَدَتْ لَهُ غُلَامًا فَإِنَّهُ يُعْتَقُ بِعِتْقِ أُمِّهِ وَوَلَاؤُهُ لِمَوَالِي أُمِّهِ فَإِذَا أُعْتِقَ الْأَبُ جَرَّ الْوَلَاءَ إِلَى مَوَالِي أَبِيهِ»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3217

chapter.englishTitle: Jari al-walaa

hadiths.englishRaw: "That is my lord, so they both went to Uthman and he ruled in favor of al-Hurqi."
hadiths.body: "That is my lord, so they both went to Uthman and he ruled in favor of al-Hurqi."
hadiths.arabic: ذَاكَ مَوْلَايَ فَاخْتَصَمَا إِلَى عُثْمَانَ فَقَضَى بِهِ لِلْحُرَقِيِّ
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e Muḥammad b. Salamah \u003e Ibn Isḥāq \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ كَانَتْ أُمِّي مَوْلَاةً لِلْحُرَقَةِ وَكَانَ أَبِي يَعْقُوبُ مُكَاتَبًا لِمَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ النَّصْرِيِّ ثُمَّ إِنَّ أَبِي أَدَّى كِتَابَتَهُ فَدَخَلَ الْحُرَقِيُّ عَلَى عُثْمَانَ فسَأَلَ لي الْحَقَّ يَعْنِي الْعَطَاءَ وَعِنْدَهُ مَالِكُ بْنُ أَوْسٍ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3218

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَلَا يَدَعُ عَصَبَةً
chapter.englishTitle: The man dies and does not leave a faction

hadiths.englishRaw: "They divided his inheritance among those who used to share with them in giving." "So his inheritance was divided among those who used to take part in charitable donations with him in his lifetime."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "They divided his inheritance among those who used to share with them in giving." "So his inheritance was divided among those who used to take part in charitable donations with him in his lifetime."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنْ قسِمُوا مِيرَاثَهُ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مَعَهُمُ الْعَطَاءَ» فَقُسِمَ مِيرَاثُهُ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ يَأْخُذُ مَعَهُمُ الْعَطَاءَ فِي عِرَافَتِهِ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah \u003e Sahm b. Yazīd al-Ḥamrāwī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْمُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الْحَمْرَاوِيُّ أن رَجُلًا تُوُفِّيَ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ وَارِثٌ فَكُتِبَ فِيهِ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَهُوَ خَلِيفَةٌ فَكَتَبَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3219

chapter.englishTitle: Who recommended the will

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: It is the duty of a Muslim man who has something which is to be given as bequest not to have it for two nights without having his will written regarding it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ as saying: It is the duty of a Muslim man who has something which is to be given as bequest not to have it for two nights without having his will written regarding it.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَا حَقُّ امْرِئٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَبِيتُ لَيْلَتَيْنِ وَلَهُ شَيْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ إِلَّا وَوَصِيَّتُهُ مَكْتُوبَةٌ عِنْدَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUbayd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3220

chapter.englishTitle: Who recommended the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "The believer does not eat until his stomach is completely full, and his conscience remains under his control."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The believer does not eat until his stomach is completely full, and his conscience remains under his control."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُؤْمِنُ لَا يَأْكُلُ فِي كُلِّ بطنه وَلَا تَزَالُ وَصِيَّتُهُ تَحْتَ جَنْبِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Abū al-Ashhab \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْأَشْهَبِ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3221

chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said that when a person advises, his advice is complete for what he has lost from his charity. Abu Muhammad said, and others said, Qasim ibn Amr said.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: It is said that when a person advises, his advice is complete for what he has lost from his charity. Abu Muhammad said, and others said, Qasim ibn Amr said.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ كَانتَ وَصِيَّتُهُ تَمَامًا لِمَا ضَيَّعَ مِنْ زَكَاتِهِ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e al-Qāsim b. ʿUmar \u003e Lī Thumāmah b. Ḥazn Mā Faʿal Abūk \u003e Māt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ قَالَ لِي ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ حَزْنٍ «مَا فَعَلَ أَبُوكَ؟» قُلْتُ مَاتَ قَالَ فَهَلْ أَوْصَى؟ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3222

chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said that whoever gives a will (testament) but does not act upon it or fulfill it, will receive reward like if they had donated it during their lifetime.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said that whoever gives a will (testament) but does not act upon it or fulfill it, will receive reward like if they had donated it during their lifetime.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ مَنْ أَوْصَى بِوَصِيَّةٍ فَلَمْ يَجُرْ وَلَمْ يَحِفْ كَانَ لَهُ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ مِثْلُ مَا إنْ لَوْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ فِي حَيَاتِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3223

chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "According to his way, he is the best guide for those who seek guidance. And if you retaliate, retaliate with an equivalent of what you were harmed with. But if you are patient, it is better for those who are patient. And be patient, and your patience is not except through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress from what they conspire. Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good."
hadiths.body: "According to his way, he is the best guide for those who seek guidance. And if you retaliate, retaliate with an equivalent of what you were harmed with. But if you are patient, it is better for those who are patient. And be patient, and your patience is not except through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress from what they conspire. Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good."
hadiths.arabic: عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُمْ بِهِ وَلَئِنْ صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّابِرينَ وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ إِنَّ اللهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا وَالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ}
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Yūnus \u003e Abū Qazaʿah \u003e Qīl Liharim b. Ḥayyān Awṣinā \u003e Ūṣīkum Bi-al-Āyāt al-Awākhir from Sūrah al-Naḥl And Qaraʾ Ibn Ḥayyān Ādʿ \u003e Sabīl Rabbik Bi-al-Ḥikmah Wa-al-Mawʿiẓah al-Ḥasanah Wajādilhum Bi-al--Atī Hī Aḥsan In Rabbak \u003e Aʿlam Biman Ḍal \u003e Sabīlih Wahū Aʿlam Bi-al-Muhtadīn
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي قَزَعَةَ قَالَ قِيلَ لِهَرِمِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ أَوْصِنا قَالَ «أُوصِيكُمْ بِالْآيَاتِ الْأَوَاخِرِ مِنْ سُورَةِ النَّحْلِ» وَقَرَأَ ابْنُ حَيَّانَ {ادْعُ إِلَى سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ وَجَادِلْهُمْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3224

chapter.englishTitle: Who has not been advised

hadiths.englishRaw: “I said to Abdullah bin Abu Awfa: 'Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ make a will concerning anything?' He said: 'No.' I said: 'How come he told the Muslims to make wills?' He said: 'He enjoined (them to adhere to) the book of Allah (SWT).” Malik said: “Talhah bin Musarrif said: 'Huzail bin Shurahbil said: “Abu Bakr was granted leadership according to the will of Messenger of Allah ﷺ?” (Rather) Abu Bakr wished that the found a covenant (in that regard) from Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he could fetter his nose with a (camel's) nose ring.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: “I said to Abdullah bin Abu Awfa: 'Did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ make a will concerning anything?' He said: 'No.' I said: 'How come he told the Muslims to make wills?' He said: 'He enjoined (them to adhere to) the book of Allah (SWT).” Malik said: “Talhah bin Musarrif said: 'Huzail bin Shurahbil said: “Abu Bakr was granted leadership according to the will of Messenger of Allah ﷺ?” (Rather) Abu Bakr wished that the found a covenant (in that regard) from Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he could fetter his nose with a (camel's) nose ring.”     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى أَوْصَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ قَالَ لَا قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ كُتِبَ عَلَى النَّاسِ الْوَصِيَّةُ أو أُمِرُوا بِالْوَصِيَّةِ؟ فَقَالَ «أَوْصَى بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ ﷻ» وقَالَ هُزَيْلُ بْنُ شُرَحْبِيلَ «أَبُو بَكْرٍ كَانَ يَتَأَمَّرُ عَلَى وَصِيِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ؟ وَدَّ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنَّهُ وَجَدَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَهْدًا فَخَزَمَ أَنْفَهُ بِخِزَامَةٍ ذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e Mālik b. Mighwal \u003e Ṭalḥah b. Muṣarrif al-Yāmī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ الْيَامِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3225

chapter.englishTitle: Who has not been advised

hadiths.englishRaw: "About Qatadah, it is written that when death approaches you, it is obligatory upon the God-conscious individuals to leave a will for their parents and close relatives, according to the custom of good deeds. This is a right upon the righteous individuals." [Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 180]. The phrase "Al-khayr (the good) referred to wealth of one thousand or more (dirhams) and beyond."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "About Qatadah, it is written that when death approaches you, it is obligatory upon the God-conscious individuals to leave a will for their parents and close relatives, according to the custom of good deeds. This is a right upon the righteous individuals." [Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 180]. The phrase "Al-khayr (the good) referred to wealth of one thousand or more (dirhams) and beyond."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ قَتَادَةَ {كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ إِن تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ} [البقرة 180] قَالَ الْخَيْرُ الْمَالُ كَانَ يُقَالُ أَلْفًا فَمَا فَوْقَ ذَلِكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd \u003e Hammām
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3226

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالْكَلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended in a will regarding the testimony and speaki...

hadiths.englishRaw: "And fear Allah and reconcile the differences between yourselves and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you are believers." And He commanded them with what He commanded His sons Ibrahim and Ya'qub: "O my sons, indeed Allah has chosen for you the religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims." [Al-Baqarah 132] And He advised them not to desire to be allies of the Ansar and their brothers in faith, and that chastity and truthfulness are better and more cautious than adultery and lying, if it happens in my illness before I change my will. Then he mentioned his need.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "And fear Allah and reconcile the differences between yourselves and obey Allah and His Messenger, if you are believers." And He commanded them with what He commanded His sons Ibrahim and Ya'qub: "O my sons, indeed Allah has chosen for you the religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims." [Al-Baqarah 132] And He advised them not to desire to be allies of the Ansar and their brothers in faith, and that chastity and truthfulness are better and more cautious than adultery and lying, if it happens in my illness before I change my will. Then he mentioned his need.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ {اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِكُمْ وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ} وَأَوْصَاهُمْ بِمَا أَوْصَى بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بَنِيهِ وَيَعْقُوبُ {يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ} [البقرة 132] وَأَوْصَاهُمْ أَنْ لَا يَرْغَبُوا أَنْ يَكُونُوا مَوَالِيَ الْأَنْصَارِ وَإِخْوَانَهُمْ فِي الدِّينِ وَأَنَّ الْعِفَّةَ وَالصِّدْقَ خَيْرٌ وَأَتْقَى مِنَ الزِّنَا وَالْكَذِبِ إِنْ حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ فِي مَرَضِي هَذَا قَبْلَ أَنْ أُغَيِّرَ وَصِيَّتِي هَذِهِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ حَاجَتَهُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn \u003e Awṣá Dhikr Mā Awṣá Bih or Hadhā Dhikr Mā Awṣá Bih Muḥammad b. Abū ʿAmrah Banīh And ʾAhl Baytih
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ أَنَّهُ أَوْصَى ذِكْرُ مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ أَوْ هَذَا ذِكْرُ مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ بَنِيهِ وَأَهْلَ بَيْتِهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3227

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالْكَلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended in a will regarding the testimony and speaki...

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no god but Allah, alone without partner, and Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. And that the Hour is coming without a doubt, and that Allah will raise those who are in the graves, and He commanded those who are left behind from their families to be mindful of Allah and to reconcile between themselves, and to obey Allah and His Messenger if they are believers. And He commanded them with what He commanded his offspring, Ibrahim and Ya'qub, 'O my sons! Indeed, Allah has chosen for you the religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims.' And He commanded if something happens to him from his suffering, the need he has such and such."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no god but Allah, alone without partner, and Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. And that the Hour is coming without a doubt, and that Allah will raise those who are in the graves, and He commanded those who are left behind from their families to be mindful of Allah and to reconcile between themselves, and to obey Allah and His Messenger if they are believers. And He commanded them with what He commanded his offspring, Ibrahim and Ya'qub, 'O my sons! Indeed, Allah has chosen for you the religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims.' And He commanded if something happens to him from his suffering, the need he has such and such."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَنْ فِي الْقُبُورِ وَأَوْصَى مَنْ تَرَكَ بَعْدَهُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ أَنْ يَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَيُصْلِحُوا ذَاتَ بَيْنِهِمْ وَأَنْ يُطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ إِنْ كَانُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَوْصَاهُمْ بِمَا أَوْصَى بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بَنِيهِ وَيَعْقُوبُ {يَا بَنِيَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى لَكُمُ الدِّينَ فَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنْتُمْ مُسْلِمُونَ} [البقرة 132] وَأَوْصَى إِنْ حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ مِنْ وَجَعِهِ هَذَا أَنَّ حَاجَتَهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Hishām b. Ḥassān \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Anas \u003e Hakadhā Kānūā Yūṣūn Hadhā Mā Awṣá Bih Fulān b. Fulān \u003e Yashhad \u003e Lā Ilah Illā Allāh And Ḥdah Lā Sharīk Lah \u003e Muḥammad ʿAbduh Warasūluh \u003e al-Sāʿah Ātiyah Lā Rayb Fīhā
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ هَكَذَا كَانُوا يُوصُونَ هَذَا مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ فُلَانُ بْنُ فُلَانٍ أَنَّهُ يَشْهَدُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3228

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالْكَلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended in a will regarding the testimony and speaki...

hadiths.englishRaw: We bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. He believes in Allah and disbelieves in all false deities. By Allah's will, he will live, die, and be resurrected. He advises regarding what Allah has provided and what he has left behind. If something happens to him, it is as described. If nothing changes from what is stated in this will.
hadiths.body: We bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. He believes in Allah and disbelieves in all false deities. By Allah's will, he will live, die, and be resurrected. He advises regarding what Allah has provided and what he has left behind. If something happens to him, it is as described. If nothing changes from what is stated in this will.
hadiths.arabic: تَشَهُّدُ هَذَا مَا شَهِدَ بِهِ نَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَيُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَيَكْفُرُ بِالطَّاغُوتِ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَحْيَا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ وَيَمُوتُ وَيُبْعَثُ وَأَوْصَى فِيمَا رَزَقَهُ اللَّهُ فِيمَا تَرَكَ إِنْ حَدَثَ بِهِ حَدَثٌ وَهُوَ كَذَا وَكَذَا إِنْ لَمْ يُغَيِّرْ شَيْئًا مِمَّا فِي هَذِهِ الْوَصِيَّةِ
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd \u003e Ḥafṣ b. Ghaylān \u003e Makḥūl Ḥīn Awṣá \u003e Tashahhud Hadhā Mā Shahid Bih Nashhad \u003e Lā Ilah Illā Allāh And Ḥdah Lā Sharīk Lah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ أَخْبَرَنَا الْوَلِيدُ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غَيْلَانَ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ حِينَ أَوْصَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3229

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالْكَلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended in a will regarding the testimony and speaki...

hadiths.englishRaw: "This is the will of my father Al-Darda."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "This is the will of my father Al-Darda."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «هَذِهِ وَصِيَّةُ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam \u003e al-Walīd \u003e Ibn Thawbān from his father \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ ثَوْبَانَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3230

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ بِالْوَصِيَّةِ مِنَ التَّشَهُّدِ وَالْكَلَامِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is recommended in a will regarding the testimony and speaki...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The following is the testament of Rabee' bin Khuthaym, in the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. This is what Rabee' bin Khuthaym has advised, and I bear witness to Allah, who suffices as a witness and rewarder for His righteous servants. Verily, I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as a prophet. Indeed, I command myself and those who obey me to worship Allah among the worshippers, to praise Him among those who praise Him, and to sincerely advise the Muslim community."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The following is the testament of Rabee' bin Khuthaym, in the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate. This is what Rabee' bin Khuthaym has advised, and I bear witness to Allah, who suffices as a witness and rewarder for His righteous servants. Verily, I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as a prophet. Indeed, I command myself and those who obey me to worship Allah among the worshippers, to praise Him among those who praise Him, and to sincerely advise the Muslim community."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَتَبَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ وَصِيَّتَهُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ هَذَا مَا أَوْصَى بِهِ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ وَأَشْهَدَ اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ وَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا وَجَازِيًا لِعِبَادِهِ الصَّالِحِينَ وَمُثِيبًا فَإِنِّي رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا وَإِنِّي آمُرُ نَفْسِي وَمَنْ أَطَاعَنِي أَنْ نَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ فِي الْعَابِدِينَ وَنَحْمَدَهُ فِي الْحَامِدِينَ وَأَنْ نَنْصَحَ لِجَمَاعَةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Abū Ḥayyān al-Taymī from his father \u003e Katab al-Rabīʿ b. Khuthaym And Ṣiyyatah Bism Allāh al-Raḥman al-Raḥīm Hadhā Mā Awṣá Bih al-Rabīʿ b. Khuthaym Waʾashhad Allāh ʿAlayh Wakafá Bi-al-Lah Shahīd Wajāzī Liʿibādih al-Ṣāliḥīn Wamuthīb Faʾinnī Raḍīt Bi-al-Lah Rab Wabiālʾislām Dīn Wabimuḥammad ﷺ Nabī Waʾinnī Āmur Nafsī Waman Aṭāʿanī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ التَّيْمِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3231

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ الْوَصِيَّةَ فِي الْمَالِ الْقَلِيلِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has not seen the will in the little money

hadiths.englishRaw: Ali entered the room of a patient and they mentioned the will to him. Ali said, "Allah said, 'If you leave something good' (Al-Baqarah 2:180), and I do not consider that he left something good." Hammad said, "So I memorized that he left more than seven hundred things."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Ali entered the room of a patient and they mentioned the will to him. Ali said, "Allah said, 'If you leave something good' (Al-Baqarah 2:180), and I do not consider that he left something good." Hammad said, "So I memorized that he left more than seven hundred things."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ عَلِيًّا دَخَلَ عَلَى مَرِيضٍ فَذَكَرُوا لَهُ الْوَصِيَّةَ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ قَالَ اللَّهُ {إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا} [البقرة 180] وَلَا أُرَاهُ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا قَالَ حَمَّادٌ «فَحَفِظْتُ أَنَّهُ تَرَكَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِ مِائَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Hishām from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3232

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ الْوَصِيَّةَ فِي الْمَالِ الْقَلِيلِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has not seen the will in the little money

hadiths.englishRaw: "If you do not leave wealth, leave it for your children."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If you do not leave wealth, leave it for your children."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا لَمْ تَدَعْ مَالًا فَدَعْ مَالَكَ لِوَلَدِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kunāsah \u003e Hishām from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كُنَاسَةَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ يَعُودُهُ فَقَالَ أُوصِي؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3233

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: In that which recommends more than a third

hadiths.englishRaw: About Ibrahim, there was a man who made a will, and the heirs were witnesses, so he said, "It is not permissible." Abu Muhammad said, meaning if they deny afterwards.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Ibrahim, there was a man who made a will, and the heirs were witnesses, so he said, "It is not permissible." Abu Muhammad said, meaning if they deny afterwards.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى وَالْوَرَثَةُ شُهُودٌ مُقِرُّونَ فَقَالَ «لَا يَجُوزُ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد يَعْنِي إِذَا أَنْكَرُوا بَعْدُ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Zayd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3234

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: In that which recommends more than a third

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the guardians, they allow the will, but when he dies, they do not allow it? They said, "It is not permissible."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the guardians, they allow the will, but when he dies, they do not allow it? They said, "It is not permissible."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْأَوْلِيَاءِ يُجِيزُونَ الْوَصِيَّةَ فَإِذَا مَاتَ لَمْ يُجِيزُوا؟ قَالَا «لَا يَجُوزُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Saʾalt al-Ḥakam And Ḥammād \u003e al-Awliyāʾ Yujīzūn al-Waṣiyyah Faʾidhā Māt Lam Yujīzūā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الْحَكَمَ وَحَمَّادًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3235

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: In that which recommends more than a third

hadiths.englishRaw: "Concerning a shurayh (a stipulation) in a man's will that recommends more than two-thirds of his wealth, he said: If the heirs approve it, we will grant it. And if the heirs reject it, we still have the choice when they remove their hands from the grave."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Concerning a shurayh (a stipulation) in a man's will that recommends more than two-thirds of his wealth, he said: If the heirs approve it, we will grant it. And if the heirs reject it, we still have the choice when they remove their hands from the grave."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثُلُثِهِ قَالَ إِنْ أَجَازَتْهُ الْوَرَثَةُ أَجَزْنَاهُ وَإِنْ قَالَتِ الْوَرَثَةُ أَجَزْنَاهُ فَهُمْ بِالْخِيَارِ إِذَا نَفَضُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ مِنَ الْقَبْرِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ عَنْ عَامِرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3236

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: In that which recommends more than a third

hadiths.englishRaw: "To appoint more than one third (of the wealth) as an inheritance, so they agreed with him (authorizer) and then they went back on it after he died. Abdullah was asked about that, and he said, 'This revocation is not permissible.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "To appoint more than one third (of the wealth) as an inheritance, so they agreed with him (authorizer) and then they went back on it after he died. Abdullah was asked about that, and he said, 'This revocation is not permissible.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنْ يُوصِيَ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ فَأَذِنُوا لَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعُوا فِيهِ بَعْدَ مَا مَاتَ فَسُئِلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «هَذَا التَّكَرُّهُ لَا يَجُوزُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e al-Masʿūdī \u003e Abū ʿAwn \u003e al-Qāsim \u003e a man Āstaʾdhan And Rathatah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَنَّ رَجُلًا اسْتَأْذَنَ وَرَثَتَهُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3237

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: In that which recommends more than a third

hadiths.englishRaw: Concerning the man the will is advised to allocate more than one-third, will the heirs be satisfied? He said, "It is permissible." Abu Muhammad said, "We permitted it during his lifetime."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Concerning the man the will is advised to allocate more than one-third, will the heirs be satisfied? He said, "It is permissible." Abu Muhammad said, "We permitted it during his lifetime."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ فَرَضِيَ الْوَرَثَةُ؟ قَالَ «هُوَ جَائِزٌ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد أَجَزْنَاهُ يَعْنِي فِي الْحَيَاةِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Hishām
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3238

chapter.englishTitle: The Will Regarding One Third

hadiths.englishRaw: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ visited him while he was in Makkah and he had only one daughter. So, I said to him, "I only have one daughter, should I bequeath all of my wealth?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "No." I asked, "Should I bequeath half of it?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "No." I asked, "Should I bequeath one-third of it?" He replied, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ visited him while he was in Makkah and he had only one daughter. So, I said to him, "I only have one daughter, should I bequeath all of my wealth?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "No." I asked, "Should I bequeath half of it?" The Prophet ﷺ replied, "No." I asked, "Should I bequeath one-third of it?" He replied, "Yes."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ بِمَكَّةَ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ إِلَّا ابْنَةٌ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ لِي إِلَّا ابْنَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَأُوصِي بِمَالِي كُلِّهِ؟ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَا» قُلْتُ فَأُوصِي بِالنِّصْفِ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَا» قَالَ فَأُوصِي بِالثُّلُثِ؟ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Yūnus b. Jubayr \u003e Muḥammad b. Saʿd from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3239

chapter.englishTitle: The Will Regarding One Third

hadiths.englishRaw: "I complained to the Prophet ﷺ during the Farewell Pilgrimage, until at one point he came to visit me. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I only see myself suffering and I possess a lot of wealth, and my daughter will inherit from me. Should I give all my wealth in charity?' He said, 'No.' I said, 'Then half of it?' He replied, 'No.' I asked, 'Then a third?' He said, 'A third and even a third is a lot. Indeed, if you leave your inheritors wealthy, it is better than leaving them destitute, begging people with their hands. And every expenditure you make, Allah will reward you for it, even the morsel you put in your wife's mouth.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "I complained to the Prophet ﷺ during the Farewell Pilgrimage, until at one point he came to visit me. I said, 'O Messenger of Allah, I only see myself suffering and I possess a lot of wealth, and my daughter will inherit from me. Should I give all my wealth in charity?' He said, 'No.' I said, 'Then half of it?' He replied, 'No.' I asked, 'Then a third?' He said, 'A third and even a third is a lot. Indeed, if you leave your inheritors wealthy, it is better than leaving them destitute, begging people with their hands. And every expenditure you make, Allah will reward you for it, even the morsel you put in your wife's mouth.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: اشْتَكَيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ حَتَّى إِذَا أُدْنِفْتُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَعُودُنِي فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أُرَانِي إِلَّا أُلِمَّ بِي وَأَنَا ذُو مَالٍ كَثِيرٍ وَإِنَّمَا يَرِثُنِي ابْنَةٌ لِي أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِمَالِي كُلِّهِ؟ قَالَ «لَا» قُلْتُ فَنِصْفِهِ قَالَ «لَا» قُلْتُ فَالثُّلُثِ؟ قَالَ «الثُّلُثُ وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَتْرُكْ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَتْرُكَهُمْ فُقَرَاءَ يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَإِنَّكَ لَا تُنْفِقُ نَفَقَةً إِلَّا آجَرَكَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا حَتَّى مَا تَجْعَلُ فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. Isḥāq \u003e al-Zuhrī \u003e ʿĀmir b. Saʿd from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3240

chapter.englishTitle: Less than one-third of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "My will is what the scholars of Basra agreed upon." So, I asked and they agreed on one/fifth.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "My will is what the scholars of Basra agreed upon." So, I asked and they agreed on one/fifth.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «وَصِيَّتِي مَا اتَّفَقَ عَلَيْهِ فُقَهَاءُ أَهْلِ الْبَصْرَةِ» فَسَأَلْتُ فَاتَّفَقُوا عَلَى الْخُمُسِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Isḥāq b. Sūwayd \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. Ziyād \u003e Abāh Ziyād b. Maṭar Awṣá
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ زِيَادَ بْنَ مَطَرٍ أَوْصَى فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3241

chapter.englishTitle: Less than one-third of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "Pay the tithe."
hadiths.body: "Pay the tithe."
hadiths.arabic: «أَوْصِ بِالْعُشْرِ»
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Isḥāq b. Sūwayd \u003e al-ʿAlāʾ b. Ziyād \u003e a man Saʾal ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb \u003e In Wārithī Kalālah Faʾūṣī Bi-al-Nniṣf \u003e Lā \u003e And al-Thhuluth \u003e Lā \u003e Wa-al-Rrubuʿ \u003e Lā \u003e Wa-al-Khumus \u003e Lā Ḥattá Ṣār \u003e al-ʿUshr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ الْعَلَاءِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ وَارِثِي كَلَالَةٌ أفَأُوصِي بِالنِّصْفِ؟ قَالَ «لَا» قَالَ فَالثُّلُثِ؟ قَالَ «لَا» قَالَ فَالرُّبُعِ؟ قَالَ «لَا» قَالَ فَالْخُمُسِ؟ قَالَ «لَا» حَتَّى صَارَ إِلَى الْعُشْرِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3242

chapter.englishTitle: Less than one-third of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "They used to impose taxes at a rate of one-fifth and one-fourth, and the one-third was the highest tax. Abu Muhammad said that by 'al-jamih' [the highest tax], it means a spirited horse."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "They used to impose taxes at a rate of one-fifth and one-fourth, and the one-third was the highest tax. Abu Muhammad said that by 'al-jamih' [the highest tax], it means a spirited horse."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّمَا كَانُوا يُوصُونَ بِالْخُمُسِ وَالرُّبُعِ وَكَانَ الثُّلُثُ مُنْتَهَى الْجَامِحِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد يَعْنِي بِالْجَامِحِ الْفَرَسَ الْجَمُوحَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3243

chapter.englishTitle: Less than one-third of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "I would not have accepted the will of a man who has a son who insists on one-third."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "I would not have accepted the will of a man who has a son who insists on one-third."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا كُنْتُ لِأَقْبَلَ وَصِيَّةَ رَجُلٍ لَهُ وَلَدٌ يُوصِي بِالثُّلُثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e Bakr \u003e Awṣayt \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ بَكْرٍ قَالَ أَوْصَيْتُ إِلَى حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3244

chapter.englishTitle: Less than one-third of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "The third is effort, and it is permissible."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The third is effort, and it is permissible."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الثُّلُثُ جَهْدٌ وَهُوَ جَائِزٌ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Hishām \u003e Muḥammad b. Sīrīn \u003e Shurayḥ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3245

chapter.englishTitle: Less than one-third of the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "The sixth was more beloved to them than the third."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The sixth was more beloved to them than the third."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ السُّدُسُ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3246

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَجُوزُ لِلْوَصِيِّ وَمَا لَا يَجُوزُ
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible for the guardian and what is not permissible

hadiths.englishRaw: "The guardian is trustworthy in what I have entrusted him with."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The guardian is trustworthy in what I have entrusted him with."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْوَصِيُّ أَمِينٌ فِيمَا أُوصِيَ إِلَيْهِ بِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Sharīk \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3247

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَجُوزُ لِلْوَصِيِّ وَمَا لَا يَجُوزُ
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible for the guardian and what is not permissible

hadiths.englishRaw: "The power of the guardian is permissible in everything except in the act of buying, and when someone sells, it is not considered valid." This is the opinion of Yahya ibn Hamza.   – Sound Chain
