hadiths.body: "The power of the guardian is permissible in everything except in the act of buying, and when someone sells, it is not considered valid." This is the opinion of Yahya ibn Hamza.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَمْرُ الْوَصِيِّ جَائِزٌ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا فِي الِابْتِيَاعِ وَإِذَا بَاعَ بَيْعًا لَمْ يُقِلْ» وَهُوَ رَأْيُ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Abū Wahb \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي وَهْبٍ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3248

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَجُوزُ لِلْوَصِيِّ وَمَا لَا يَجُوزُ
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible for the guardian and what is not permissible

hadiths.englishRaw: "The guardian is trustworthy in everything except in granting freedom, as he must establish loyalty."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The guardian is trustworthy in everything except in granting freedom, as he must establish loyalty."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْوَصِيُّ أَمِينٌ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِلَّا فِي الْعِتْقِ فَإِنَّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُقِيمَ الْوَلَاءَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3249

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَجُوزُ لِلْوَصِيِّ وَمَا لَا يَجُوزُ
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible for the guardian and what is not permissible

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Ibrahim, "In the wealth of the orphan, the guardian works when entrusted to a man."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Ibrahim, "In the wealth of the orphan, the guardian works when entrusted to a man."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ «فِي مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ يَعْمَلُ بِهِ الْوَصِيُّ إِذَا أَوْصَى إِلَى الرَّجُلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3250

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَجُوزُ لِلْوَصِيِّ وَمَا لَا يَجُوزُ
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible for the guardian and what is not permissible

hadiths.englishRaw: "The guardian of the orphan shall take his right through intercession, and the absent one shall also be interceded for."
hadiths.body: "The guardian of the orphan shall take his right through intercession, and the absent one shall also be interceded for."
hadiths.arabic: «وَصِيُّ الْيَتِيمِ يَأْخُذُ لَهُ بِالشُّفْعَةِ وَالْغَائِبُ عَلَى شُفْعَتِهِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Ṣalt \u003e Mūsá b. Muḥammad \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّلْتِ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3251

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَجُوزُ لِلْوَصِيِّ وَمَا لَا يَجُوزُ
chapter.englishTitle: What is permissible for the guardian and what is not permissible

hadiths.englishRaw: "So he laid down his words and turned to his father Qilabah and said, 'What are you saying?' He said, 'Answer the boy's request to give him his land.' He said, 'Then our wealth will be destroyed?' He said, 'You are the one who destroyed it.'"
hadiths.body: "So he laid down his words and turned to his father Qilabah and said, 'What are you saying?' He said, 'Answer the boy's request to give him his land.' He said, 'Then our wealth will be destroyed?' He said, 'You are the one who destroyed it.'"
hadiths.arabic: فَأَضْجَعَ فِي الْقَوْلِ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَى أَبِي قِلَابَةَ فَقَالَ مَا تَقُولُ؟ فَقَالَ «رُدَّ عَلَى الْغُلَامِ أَرْضَهُ» قَالَ إِذًا يَهْلِكُ مَالُنَا قَالَ «أَنْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e ʿIkrimah \u003e Shaykh from Ahl Dimashq
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ شَيْخٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ دِمَشْقَ قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ وَعِنْدَهُ سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ وأَبُو قِلَابَةَ إِذْ دَخَلَ غُلَامٌ فَقَالَ أَرْضُنَا بِمَكَانِ كَذَا وَكَذَا بَاعَكُمُ الْوَصِيُّ وَنَحْنُ أَطْفَالٌ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَى سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ فَقَالَ مَا تَقُولُ؟ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3252
hadiths.englishRaw: From Hassan concerning a man who bequeathed half of his wealth to one person and a third of his wealth to another person, he said: They should both give a third of their inheritance as charity. One person should give it from his half and the other person should give it from his third.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Hassan concerning a man who bequeathed half of his wealth to one person and a third of his wealth to another person, he said: They should both give a third of their inheritance as charity. One person should give it from his half and the other person should give it from his third.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى لِرَجُلٍ بِنِصْفِ مَالِهِ وَلِآخَرَ بِثُلُثِ مَالِهِ قَالَ يَضْرِبَانِ بِذَلِكَ فِي الثُّلُثِ هَذَا بِالنِّصْفِ وَهَذَا بِالثُّلُثِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ashʿath
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3253

chapter.englishTitle: Repealing the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "The owner of the will changes it as he wishes, except for emancipation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The owner of the will changes it as he wishes, except for emancipation."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يُغَيِّرُ صَاحِبُ الْوَصِيَّةِ مِنْهَا مَا شَاءَ غَيْرَ الْعَتَاقَةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Zāʾidah \u003e al-Shaybānī \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3254

chapter.englishTitle: Repealing the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "The man can state whatever he desires in his will, and the execution of the will is the responsibility of its executor."
hadiths.body: "The man can state whatever he desires in his will, and the execution of the will is the responsibility of its executor."
hadiths.arabic: «يُحْدِثُ الرَّجُلُ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ مَا شَاءَ وَمِلَاكُ الْوَصِيَّةِ آخِرُهَا»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Rabīʿah \u003e ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3255

chapter.englishTitle: Repealing the will

hadiths.englishRaw: That his father had freed a slave for him during his illness, then he felt that he should revoke them and free others instead. He said, "So they disputed with me before Abdul Malik ibn Marwan." He (Abdul Malik) approved freeing the others and invalidated the freeing of the first ones.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: That his father had freed a slave for him during his illness, then he felt that he should revoke them and free others instead. He said, "So they disputed with me before Abdul Malik ibn Marwan." He (Abdul Malik) approved freeing the others and invalidated the freeing of the first ones.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَعْتَقَ رَقِيقًا لَهُ فِي مَرَضِهِ ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ أَنْ يَرُدَّهُمْ وَيُعْتِقَ غَيْرَهُمْ قَالَ فَخَاصَمُونِي إِلَى عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ «فَأَجَازَ عِتْقَ الْآخِرِينَ وَأَبْطَلَ عِتْقَ الْأَوَّلِينَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e ʿAmr b. Dīnār
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي قَتَادَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3256

chapter.englishTitle: Repealing the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "Umar said, 'A man can include whatever he wishes in his will, and the last part of the will belongs to the executor.' Abu Muhammad said, 'Hammam did not hear this from Umar, and between them is Qatadah.'"   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: "Umar said, 'A man can include whatever he wishes in his will, and the last part of the will belongs to the executor.' Abu Muhammad said, 'Hammam did not hear this from Umar, and between them is Qatadah.'"   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ «يُحْدِثُ الرَّجُلُ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ مَا شَاءَ وَمِلَاكُ الْوَصِيَّةِ آخِرُهَا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «هَمَّامٌ لَمْ يَسْمَعْ مِنْ عَمْرٍو وَبَيْنَهُمَا قَتَادَةُ»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Sahl b. Ḥammād \u003e Hammām \u003e ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Rabīʿah \u003e al-Sharīd b. Sūwayd \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ عَنْ الشَّرِيدِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3257

chapter.englishTitle: Repealing the will

hadiths.englishRaw: "Regarding Al-Zuhri's statement about a man, he recommends a will and then recommends another. He said, 'These are two valid options for his wealth.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Regarding Al-Zuhri's statement about a man, he recommends a will and then recommends another. He said, 'These are two valid options for his wealth.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الزُّهْرِيِّ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِوَصِيَّةٍ ثُمَّ يُوصِي بِأُخْرَى قَالَ «هُمَا جَائِزَتَانِ فِي مَالِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3258

chapter.englishTitle: Repealing the will

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of "عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ «مِلَاكُ الْوَصِيَّةِ آخِرُهَا»" into English is: "Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the angel of the will, the last of them."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of "عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ «مِلَاكُ الْوَصِيَّةِ آخِرُهَا»" into English is: "Umar ibn Al-Khattab, the angel of the will, the last of them."   – Weak, Disconnected Chain
hadiths.arabic: عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ «مِلَاكُ الْوَصِيَّةِ آخِرُهَا»   – ضعيف منقطع
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Maʿmar \u003e Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3259

chapter.englishTitle: In the accused's will

hadiths.englishRaw: "If the judge accuses the guardian, he does not remove him, but appoints someone else with him." This is the view of Al-Awza'i.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If the judge accuses the guardian, he does not remove him, but appoints someone else with him." This is the view of Al-Awza'i.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا اتَّهَمَ الْقَاضِي الْوَصِيَّ لَمْ يَعْزِلْهُ وَلَكِنْ يُوَكِّلُ مَعَهُ غَيْرَهُ» وَهُوَ رَأْيُ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e al-Walīd \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e Yaḥyá
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ يَحْيَى قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3260

chapter.englishTitle: The Testament of the Patient

hadiths.englishRaw: "The sale, purchase, and marriage of a sick person is permissible, but it does not fall under the category of one-third."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The sale, purchase, and marriage of a sick person is permissible, but it does not fall under the category of one-third."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يَجُوزُ بَيْعُ الْمَرِيضِ وَشِرَاؤُهُ وَنِكَاحُهُ وَلَا يَكُونُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Shaybānī \u003e ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3261

chapter.englishTitle: The Testament of the Patient

hadiths.englishRaw: "What the patient dislikes about his illness in terms of buying or selling, it is valued at one-third of fairness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "What the patient dislikes about his illness in terms of buying or selling, it is valued at one-third of fairness."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا حَابَى بِهِ الْمَرِيضُ فِي مَرَضِهِ مِنْ بَيْعٍ أَوْ شِرَاءٍ فَهُوَ فِي ثُلُثِهِ قِيمَةُ عَدْلٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e al-Ḥārith al-ʿUklī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ الْحَارِثِ الْعُكْلِيِّ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3262

chapter.englishTitle: The Testament of the Patient

hadiths.englishRaw: A woman from our family gave while she was pregnant, and Al-Qasim was asked, and he said, "It is from all of the wealth." Yahya said, "And we say when labor pains strike her, whatever she gives is from one-third."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A woman from our family gave while she was pregnant, and Al-Qasim was asked, and he said, "It is from all of the wealth." Yahya said, "And we say when labor pains strike her, whatever she gives is from one-third."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَعْطَتْ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ أَهْلِنَا وَهِيَ حَامِلٌ فَسُئِلَ الْقَاسِمُ فَقَالَ «هُوَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ» قَالَ يَحْيَى وَنَحْنُ نَقُولُ إِذَا ضَرَبَهَا الْمَخَاضُ فَمَا أَعْطَتْهُ فَمِنَ الثُّلُثِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Yaḥyá Hw Ibn Saʿīd \u003e Aʿṭat Āmraʾah from Ahlinā And Hī Ḥāmil Fasuʾil al-Qāsim \u003e from Jamīʿ al-Māl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى هو ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3263

chapter.englishTitle: The Testament of the Patient

hadiths.englishRaw: "If I enter the house of so-and-so with my servant, my servant will become free. And if he enters it while he is sick, he said, 'He will be freed from one-third (of his obligation), and if he enters in good health, he will be freed from all obligations.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If I enter the house of so-and-so with my servant, my servant will become free. And if he enters it while he is sick, he said, 'He will be freed from one-third (of his obligation), and if he enters in good health, he will be freed from all obligations.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: لِغُلَامِهِ إِنْ دَخَلْتُ دَارَ فُلَانٍ فَغُلَامِي حُرٌّ ثُمَّ دَخَلَهَا وَهُوَ مَرِيضٌ قَالَ «يُعْتَقُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ وَإِنْ دَخَلَ فِي صِحَّتِهِ عُتِقَ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي رَجُلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3264

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِيمَنْ رَدَّ عَلَى الْوَرَثَةِ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who is responsible for responding to the inheritance of the one-...

hadiths.englishRaw: "If the heirs have needs, I do not see any harm in returning to them from the third share." Yahya said, "So I mentioned that to Al-Awza'i and he was amazed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If the heirs have needs, I do not see any harm in returning to them from the third share." Yahya said, "So I mentioned that to Al-Awza'i and he was amazed."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا كَانَ الْوَرَثَةُ مَحَاوِيجَ فَلَا أَرَى بَأْسًا أَنْ يُرَدَّ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ» قَالَ يَحْيَى «فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلْأَوْزَاعِيِّ فَأَعْجَبَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e al-Nuʿmān b. al-Mundhir \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أخبرنا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنَا النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3265

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا شَهِدَ اثْنَانِ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: If two of the heirs witness it

hadiths.englishRaw: From Ibrahim, they said, "When two witnesses testify from the heirs, it is permissible for all of them, and when one witness testifies, it is in his share according to his portion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From Ibrahim, they said, "When two witnesses testify from the heirs, it is permissible for all of them, and when one witness testifies, it is in his share according to his portion."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَا «إِذَا شَهِدَ شَاهِدَانِ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ جَازَ عَلَى جَمِيعِهِمْ وَإِذَا شَهِدَ وَاحِدٌ فَفِي نَصِيبِهِ بِحِصَّتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: [Chain 1] Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Hushaym \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan [Chain 2] Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ ح وأَخْبَرَنَا مُغِيرَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3266

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا شَهِدَ اثْنَانِ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: If two of the heirs witness it

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard Al Shabi say, "If a man from the inheritors testifies, then he shall have his share in his portion." Then he said, "After that, in all of his share."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard Al Shabi say, "If a man from the inheritors testifies, then he shall have his share in his portion." Then he said, "After that, in all of his share."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الشَّعْبِيَّ يَقُولُ «إِذَا شَهِدَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْوَرَثَةِ فَفِي نَصِيبِهِ بِحِصَّتِهِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي جَمِيعِ حِصَّتِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Hushaym \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا مُطَرِّفٌ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3267

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يَكُونُ مِنَ الْوَصِيَّةِ فِي الْعَيْنِ وَالدَّيْنِ
chapter.englishTitle: What is included in the will regarding property and debt

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a person bequeaths one-third or one-fourth, it corresponds to the eye and the debt. And if he bequeaths fifty or sixty out of one hundred, it corresponds to the eye until the third is reached."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a person bequeaths one-third or one-fourth, it corresponds to the eye and the debt. And if he bequeaths fifty or sixty out of one hundred, it corresponds to the eye until the third is reached."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ بِالثُّلُثِ وَالرُّبُعِ فَفِي الْعَيْنِ وَالدَّيْنِ وَإِذَا أَوْصَى بِخَمْسِينَ أَوْ سِتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ فَفِي الْعَيْنِ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ الثُّلُثَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Abū Shihāb ʿAbd Rabbih b. Nāfiʿ \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَبْدُ رَبِّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3268

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ أَحَبَّ الْوَصِيَّةَ وَمَنْ كَرِهَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who Loves Wills and Who Hates Them

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A person is more entitled to one-third of his wealth to allocate it to whichever cause he wishes."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "A person is more entitled to one-third of his wealth to allocate it to whichever cause he wishes."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «الْمَرْءُ أَحَقُّ بِثُلُثِ مَالِهِ يَضَعُهُ فِي أَيِّ مَالِهِ شَاءَ»
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Sulaymān b. Bilāl \u003e Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbdullāh b. Qusayṭ
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُسَيْطٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3269

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ أَحَبَّ الْوَصِيَّةَ وَمَنْ كَرِهَ
chapter.englishTitle: Who Loves Wills and Who Hates Them

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man who donated money in the way of Allah, Abu Darda said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The example of the person who gives charity at the time of his death or frees a slave is like the one who gives a gift after being satisfied with his meal."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: About a man who donated money in the way of Allah, Abu Darda said that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "The example of the person who gives charity at the time of his death or frees a slave is like the one who gives a gift after being satisfied with his meal."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ جَعَلَ دَرَاهِمَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَتَصَدَّقُ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ أَوْ يُعْتِقُ كَالَّذِي يُهْدِي بَعْدَمَا شَبِعَ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad b. ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū Ḥabībah \u003e Saʾalt Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي حَبِيبَةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3270

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُبْدَأُ بِهِ مِنَ الْوَصَايَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be started with from the commandments

hadiths.englishRaw: Concerning the matter of a man, Hassan advises certain things, including setting slaves free, and goes beyond one-third? He said, "It begins with freeing slaves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Concerning the matter of a man, Hassan advises certain things, including setting slaves free, and goes beyond one-third? He said, "It begins with freeing slaves."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِأَشْيَاءَ ومنهَا الْعِتْقُ فَيُجَاوِزُ الثُّلُثَ؟ قَالَ «يُبْدَأُ بِالْعِتْقِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3271

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُبْدَأُ بِهِ مِنَ الْوَصَايَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be started with from the commandments

hadiths.englishRaw: "In the lessons"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "In the lessons"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «بِالْحِصَصِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Muḥammad
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3272

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُبْدَأُ بِهِ مِنَ الْوَصَايَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be started with from the commandments

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever makes a will or emancipates [slaves], the beneficiaries of his will and the freed ones shall both benefit. Ata' said, 'The people of Madinah precede us in emancipating slaves.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever makes a will or emancipates [slaves], the beneficiaries of his will and the freed ones shall both benefit. Ata' said, 'The people of Madinah precede us in emancipating slaves.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ أَوْصَى أَوْ أَعْتَقَ فَكَانَ فِي وَصِيَّتِهِ عَوْلٌ دَخَلَ الْعَوْلُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْعَتَاقَةِ وَأَهْلِ الْوَصِيَّةِ» قَالَ عَطَاءٌ «إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ غَلَبُونَا يَبْدَءُونَ بِالْعَتَاقَةِ قَبْلُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥasan b. Bishr \u003e al-Muʿāfá \u003e ʿUthmān b. al-Aswad \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعَافَى عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3273

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُبْدَأُ بِهِ مِنَ الْوَصَايَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be started with from the commandments

hadiths.englishRaw: "In lessons"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "In lessons"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «بِالْحِصَصِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ قَالَ قَالَ عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي بِعِتْقٍ وَغَيْرِهِ فَيَزِيدُ عَلَى الثُّلُثِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3274

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُبْدَأُ بِهِ مِنَ الْوَصَايَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be started with from the commandments

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Al-Hasan's statement about a person who bequeaths more than a third and also has a slave to emancipate, he said, "Emancipation should be prioritized."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Al-Hasan's statement about a person who bequeaths more than a third and also has a slave to emancipate, he said, "Emancipation should be prioritized."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ وَفِيهِ عِتْقٌ؟ قَالَ «يُبْدَأُ بِالْعِتْقِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Kathīr b. Shinẓīr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ شِنْظِيرٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3275

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَا يُبْدَأُ بِهِ مِنَ الْوَصَايَا
chapter.englishTitle: What is to be started with from the commandments

hadiths.englishRaw: "The giving of gifts should precede the will."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The giving of gifts should precede the will."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يُبْدَأُ بِالْعَتَاقَةِ قَبْلَ الْوَصِيَّةِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3276

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي لِبَنِي فُلَانٍ بِسَهْمٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In whom does he advise the sons of Fulan with a share of his wea...

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Hasan, regarding a man giving advice to the family of so-and-so, he said, "Their rich and their poor, their males and their females are equal."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Hasan, regarding a man giving advice to the family of so-and-so, he said, "Their rich and their poor, their males and their females are equal."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي رَجُلِ يُوصِي لِبَنِي فُلَانٍ قَالَ «غَنِيُّهُمْ وَفَقِيرُهُمْ وَذَكَرُهُمْ وَأُنْثَاهُمْ سَوَاءٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3277

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي لِبَنِي فُلَانٍ بِسَهْمٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In whom does he advise the sons of Fulan with a share of his wea...

hadiths.englishRaw: "When he left a will for the people of so-and-so, male and female are equal in it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "When he left a will for the people of so-and-so, male and female are equal in it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَوْصَى لِبَنِي فُلَانٍ فَالذَّكَرُ وَالْأُنْثَى فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e ʿAmr \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3278

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الَّذِي يُوصِي لِبَنِي فُلَانٍ بِسَهْمٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In whom does he advise the sons of Fulan with a share of his wea...

hadiths.englishRaw: The obligation is considered fulfilled, so whoever's arrows fall within its range, he is given the target's arrow as one of its own.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: The obligation is considered fulfilled, so whoever's arrows fall within its range, he is given the target's arrow as one of its own.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تُحْسَبُ الْفَرِيضَةُ فَمَا بَلَغَ سِهَامَهَا أُعْطِيَ الْمُوصَى لَهُ سَهْمًا كَأَحَدِهَا»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zāʾidah b. Mūsá al-Hamdānī \u003e Yasār b. Abū Karib \u003e Ātī Atá Shurayḥ Fasaʾalah \u003e a man Awṣá Bisahm from Mālih
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ بْنُ مُوسَى الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي يَسَارُ بْنُ أَبِي كَرِبٍ أَنَّ آتِيًا أَتَى شُرَيْحًا فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِسَهْمٍ مِنْ مَالِهِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3279

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا تَصَدَّقَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَعْضِ وَرَثَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man gives charity to some of his inheritors

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a man gives charity to some of his heirs and he is in good health, then more than half of it should be returned to the third. And if he gives half, that is permissible for him." Sa'id said, "The judges of the people of Damascus used to judge by that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a man gives charity to some of his heirs and he is in good health, then more than half of it should be returned to the third. And if he gives half, that is permissible for him." Sa'id said, "The judges of the people of Damascus used to judge by that."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا تَصَدَّقَ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَعْضِ وَرَثَتِهِ وَهُوَ صَحِيحٌ بِأَكْثَرَ مِنَ النِّصْفِ رُدَّ إِلَى الثُّلُثِ وَإِذَا أَعْطَى النِّصْفَ جَازَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ» قَالَ سَعِيدٌ «وَكَانَ قُضَاةُ أَهْلِ دِمَشْقَ يَقْضُونَ بِذَلِكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Marwān b. Muḥammad \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3280

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ الْكَفَنُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said that the burial shroud is made from all types of wealth?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The shroud is made of all possessions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The shroud is made of all possessions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْكَفَنُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. Abū Shaybah \u003e Ḥafṣ \u003e Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3281

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ الْكَفَنُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said that the burial shroud is made from all types of wealth?

hadiths.englishRaw: About al-Hasan regarding a man who died and left behind a value of two thousand dirhams, and he has the same amount or more. He said, "He should be buried from the money, and his debt should not be paid."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About al-Hasan regarding a man who died and left behind a value of two thousand dirhams, and he has the same amount or more. He said, "He should be buried from the money, and his debt should not be paid."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الْحَسَنِ فِي رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَتَرَكَ قِيمَةَ أَلْفَيْ دِرْهَمٍ وَعَلَيْهِ مِثْلُهَا أَوْ أَكْثَرُ قَالَ «يُكَفَّنُ مِنْهَا وَلَا يُعْطَى دَيْنُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Muʿādh \u003e Ashʿath
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3282

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ الْكَفَنُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said that the burial shroud is made from all types of wealth?

hadiths.englishRaw: "It starts with the burial shroud, then the debt, and then the will."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "It starts with the burial shroud, then the debt, and then the will."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «يُبْدَأُ بِالْكَفَنِ ثُمَّ الدَّيْنِ ثُمَّ الْوَصِيَّةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān ʿAmman \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3283

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ الْكَفَنُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said that the burial shroud is made from all types of wealth?

hadiths.englishRaw: "She is buried with her wealth, the husband has no share"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "She is buried with her wealth, the husband has no share"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «تُكَفَّنُ مِنْ مَالِهَا لَيْسَ عَلَى الزَّوْجِ شَيْءٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Firās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ فِرَاسٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَمُوتُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3284

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ الْكَفَنُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said that the burial shroud is made from all types of wealth?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The grains and shroud are from the head of wealth."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The grains and shroud are from the head of wealth."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْحَنُوطُ وَالْكَفَنُ مِنْ رَأْسِ الْمَالِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Mughīrah \u003e Ibn al-Mubārak \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e ʿAṭāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3285

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ الْكَفَنُ مِنْ جَمِيعِ الْمَالِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said that the burial shroud is made from all types of wealth?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The shroud is made from the midst of wealth, so it is shrouded according to what he used to wear in his lifetime, then the debts are paid off, and then the remaining third is distributed."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The shroud is made from the midst of wealth, so it is shrouded according to what he used to wear in his lifetime, then the debts are paid off, and then the remaining third is distributed."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْكَفَنُ مِنْ وَسَطِ الْمَالِ فيُكَفَّنُ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا كَانَ يَلْبَسُ فِي حَيَاتِهِ ثُمَّ يُخْرَجُ الدَّيْنُ ثُمَّ الثُّلُثُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿUyaynah \u003e ʿAlī b. Mushir \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3286

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man advises another man while he is absent

hadiths.englishRaw: "He used to say: If a man gives a testament to another man while he is absent, then he should accept his testament. But if he is present, then it is his choice whether he accepts it or not."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He used to say: If a man gives a testament to another man while he is absent, then he should accept his testament. But if he is present, then it is his choice whether he accepts it or not."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ فَلْيَقْبَلْ وَصِيَّتَهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ حَاضِرًا فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ قَبِلَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Hushaym \u003e Manṣūr \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ أَنْبَأَنَا مَنْصُورٌ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3287

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man advises another man while he is absent

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding the man who is recommended to another man, they said, "We choose for him to accept."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding the man who is recommended to another man, they said, "We choose for him to accept."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي إِلَى الرَّجُلِ قَالَا «نَخْتَارُ أَنْ يَقْبَلَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ṣāliḥ b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Saʾalt al-Ḥasan And Muḥammad \u003e al-a man Yūṣī \u003e al-a man \u003e Nakhtār
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ الْحَسَنَ وَمُحَمَّدًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3288

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man advises another man while he is absent

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a man entrusts something to another man while he is absent, and when he comes back, if he wishes, he can accept it. If he accepts it, he cannot refuse it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "When a man entrusts something to another man while he is absent, and when he comes back, if he wishes, he can accept it. If he accepts it, he cannot refuse it."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ فَإِذَا قَدِمَ فَإِنْ شَاءَ قَبِلَ فَإِذَا قَبِلَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ أَنْ يَرُدَّهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Asʿad \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَسْعَدَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3289

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ
chapter.englishTitle: When a man advises another man while he is absent

hadiths.englishRaw: "If one man recommends another man, and the will is presented to him while he is absent, and he accepts it, he will not be able to go back on his word."
hadiths.body: "If one man recommends another man, and the will is presented to him while he is absent, and he accepts it, he will not be able to go back on his word."
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ إِلَى الرَّجُلِ فَعُرِضَتْ عَلَيْهِ الْوَصِيَّةُ وَكَانَ غَائِبًا فَقَبِلَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ»
hadiths.chain: al-Waḍḍāḥ b. Yaḥyá \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَضَّاحُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3290

chapter.englishTitle: The will of the deceased

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a man gives instructions to someone while he is absent and he is dead and unaware, it is binding."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a man gives instructions to someone while he is absent and he is dead and unaware, it is binding."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ لِإِنْسَانٍ وَهُوَ غَائِبٌ وَكَانَ مَيِّتًا وَهُوَ لَا يَدْرِي فَهِيَ رَاجِعَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Saʿīd \u003e Abū Maʿshar \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْشَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3291

chapter.englishTitle: The Will for the Servant

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a servant bequeaths a third of his wealth, a fourth of his wealth, or a fifth of his wealth, then it is considered as his entry into emancipation from that wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a servant bequeaths a third of his wealth, a fourth of his wealth, or a fifth of his wealth, then it is considered as his entry into emancipation from that wealth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَوْصَى لِعَبْدِهِ ثُلُثَ مَالِهِ رُبُعَ مَالِهِ خُمُسَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ مِنْ مَالِهِ دَخَلَتْهُ عَتَاقَةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3292

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ مَالَهُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes to distribute his wealth at death

hadiths.englishRaw: It is said that a man's wealth is deprived of its blessings during his lifetime, but when he is near death, he gathers provisions for the dawn.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: It is said that a man's wealth is deprived of its blessings during his lifetime, but when he is near death, he gathers provisions for the dawn.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: يُقَالُ إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيُحْرَمُ بَرَكَةَ مَالِهِ فِي حَيَاتِهِ فَإِذَا كَانَ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ تَزَوَّدَ بِفَجْرَةٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e Qays
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ قَيْسٍ قَالَ كَانَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3293

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ مَالَهُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who dislikes to distribute his wealth at death

hadiths.englishRaw: Abdullah Al Murran said, "Moderation is important in life, but extravagance is evident at the time of death." Abu Muhammad added, "It is said that there is moderation in life and moderation at the time of death."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Abdullah Al Murran said, "Moderation is important in life, but extravagance is evident at the time of death." Abu Muhammad added, "It is said that there is moderation in life and moderation at the time of death."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ الْمُرَّانِ الْإِمْسَاكُ فِي الْحَيَاةِ وَالتَّبْذِيرُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «يُقَالُ مُرٌّ فِي الْحَيَاةِ وَمُرٌّ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Zubayd \u003e Ḥuṣayn \u003e Ibrāhīm al-Taymī from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُبَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُصَيْنٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3294

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ بَعْضِ الْوَرَثَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The man recommends an equal share for some of the heirs.

hadiths.englishRaw: "If a man bequeaths to another an amount equal to his son's share, he shall not have his own share completed until it is diminished."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "If a man bequeaths to another an amount equal to his son's share, he shall not have his own share completed until it is diminished."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ لِآخَرَ بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ ابْنِهِ فَلَا يَتِمُّ لَهُ مِثْلُ نَصِيبِهِ حَتَّى يَنْقُصَ مِنْهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3295

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ بَعْضِ الْوَرَثَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The man recommends an equal share for some of the heirs.

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Al-Sha'bi's statement about a man who had three sons and he appointed a man to receive an equal share as one of them if they were four, Al-Sha'bi said, "He shall be given one-fifth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Al-Sha'bi's statement about a man who had three sons and he appointed a man to receive an equal share as one of them if they were four, Al-Sha'bi said, "He shall be given one-fifth."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ كَانَ لَهُ ثَلَاثَةُ بَنِينَ فَأَوْصَى لِرَجُلٍ مِثْلَ نَصِيبِ أَحَدِهِمْ لَوْ كَانُوا أَرْبَعَةً قَالَ الشَّعْبِيُّ «يُعْطَى الْخُمُسَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3296

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ بَعْضِ الْوَرَثَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The man recommends an equal share for some of the heirs.

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man who left behind two sons and he advised to give an equal share to one of them if they were three, he said, "Advise to give a quarter."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man who left behind two sons and he advised to give an equal share to one of them if they were three, he said, "Advise to give a quarter."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ ابْنَيْنِ وَأَوْصَى بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ أَحَدِهِمْ لَوْ كَانُوا ثَلَاثَةً قَالَ «أَوْصَى بِالرُّبُعِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. ʿĪsá \u003e Yazīd b. Zurayʿ \u003e Dāwud b. Abū Hind \u003e Saʾalnā ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ قَالَ سَأَلْنَا عَامِرًا

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3297

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ بَعْضِ الْوَرَثَةِ
chapter.englishTitle: The man recommends an equal share for some of the heirs.

hadiths.englishRaw: In a man who specified a share similar to that of some of the heirs, he said, "It is not permissible, even if it is less than a third." Abu Muhammad said, "It is good."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: In a man who specified a share similar to that of some of the heirs, he said, "It is not permissible, even if it is less than a third." Abu Muhammad said, "It is good."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى بِمِثْلِ نَصِيبِ بَعْضِ الْوَرَثَةِ قَالَ «لَا يَجُوزُ وَإِنْ كَانَ أَقَلَّ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «هُوَ حَسَنٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Abū ʿAwānah \u003e Mughīrah \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3298

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي بِغَلَّةِ عَبْدِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the man, the recommendation of his servant is entrusted to hi...

hadiths.englishRaw: Regarding Sha'biyy on a man who left a dirham as a will for his slave's debt, and the debt amounts to six dirhams, he said, "He will receive one-sixth of it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Regarding Sha'biyy on a man who left a dirham as a will for his slave's debt, and the debt amounts to six dirhams, he said, "He will receive one-sixth of it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى فِي غَلَّةِ عَبْدِهِ بِدِرْهَمٍ وَغَلَّتُهُ سِتَّةٌ قَالَ «لَهُ سُدُسُهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Ibn Abū al-Safar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا قَبِيصَةُ أََنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3299

chapter.englishTitle: The will for the heir.

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Sufyan saying, "If I assign one hundred Dirhams to an heir and to a non-heir, I think it is better to nullify both."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Sufyan saying, "If I assign one hundred Dirhams to an heir and to a non-heir, I think it is better to nullify both."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَقَرَّ لِوَارِثٍ وَلِغَيْرِ وَارِثٍ بِمِئَةِ دِرْهَمٍ قَالَ أَرَى أَنْ أُبْطِلَهُمَا جَمِيعًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Qabīṣah \u003e Sufyān \u003e Idhā Aqar Liwārith And Lighayr Wārith Bimiʾah Dirham \u003e Ará
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا قَبِيصَةُ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3300

chapter.englishTitle: The will for the heir.

hadiths.englishRaw: And Al-Hasan said, "The most deserving of what is permitted to him is on his deathbed, the first day of the Hereafter, and the last day of the worldly life."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: And Al-Hasan said, "The most deserving of what is permitted to him is on his deathbed, the first day of the Hereafter, and the last day of the worldly life."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ «أَحَقُّ مَا جَازَ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ أَوَّلَ يَوْمٍ مِنْ أَيَّامِ الْآخِرَةِ وَآخِرَ يَوْمٍ مِنْ أَيَّامِ الدُّنْيَا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Ibn Sīrīn \u003e Shurayḥ \u003e Lā Yajūz Iqrār Liwārith
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ شُرَيْحٍ قَالَ «لَا يَجُوزُ إِقْرَارٌ لِوَارِثٍ» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3301

chapter.englishTitle: The will for the heir.

hadiths.englishRaw: "It is not permissible for an heir to make a will."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "It is not permissible for an heir to make a will."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا يَجُوزُ لِوَارِثٍ وَصِيَّةٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿAwn \u003e Khālid \u003e Khālid \u003e Abū Qilābah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَوْنٍ أََنْبَأََنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3302

chapter.englishTitle: The will for the heir.

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man nicknamed Abu Thabit made a will to his wife before his death, stating that she has four hundred dirhams from her dowry as her entitlement, which Al-Hasan approved."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A man nicknamed Abu Thabit made a will to his wife before his death, stating that she has four hundred dirhams from her dowry as her entitlement, which Al-Hasan approved."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّ رَجُلًا يُكْنَى أَبَا ثَابِتٍ أَقَرَّ لِامْرَأَتِهِ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ أَنَّ لَهَا عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ مِنْ صَدَاقِهَا فَأَجَازَهُ الْحَسَنُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e a man Yukná Abū Thābit Aqar Liāmraʾatih ʿInd Mawtih
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3303

chapter.englishTitle: The will for the heir.

hadiths.englishRaw: "I was riding behind the Prophet ﷺ on his camel, and it was hobbling with its hooves. I could hear his saliva dripping between my shoulders. I heard him say, 'Indeed, Allah has given every rightful person their rights, so it is not permissible to leave a will for an inheritor.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "I was riding behind the Prophet ﷺ on his camel, and it was hobbling with its hooves. I could hear his saliva dripping between my shoulders. I heard him say, 'Indeed, Allah has given every rightful person their rights, so it is not permissible to leave a will for an inheritor.'"   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ تَحْتَ نَاقَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَهِيَ تَقْصَعُ بِجِرَّتِهَا وَلُعَابُهَا يَنُوصُ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيَّ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ «أَلَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَعْطَى كُلَّ ذِي حَقٍّ حَقَّهُ فَلَا يَجُوزُ وَصِيَّةٌ لِوَارِثٍ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hishām al-Dastuwāʾī \u003e Qatādah \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ghanm \u003e ʿAmr b. Khārijah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتُوَائِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ غَنْمٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَارِجَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3304

chapter.englishTitle: The will for the heir.

hadiths.englishRaw: "When death approaches one of you, and if he leaves behind wealth, he should make a will (wasiyyah) to his parents and near relatives, according to what is reasonable. This is an obligation upon the righteous. Then it was abrogated in Surah An-Nisa, and the parents were given a clearly defined share, and to each one of his inheriting relatives a predetermined share, and to the deceased's relatives who are not heirs, a will has been ordained, so that it may benefit those who do not have an inheriting heir and others." [Al-Baqarah 180]   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When death approaches one of you, and if he leaves behind wealth, he should make a will (wasiyyah) to his parents and near relatives, according to what is reasonable. This is an obligation upon the righteous. Then it was abrogated in Surah An-Nisa, and the parents were given a clearly defined share, and to each one of his inheriting relatives a predetermined share, and to the deceased's relatives who are not heirs, a will has been ordained, so that it may benefit those who do not have an inheriting heir and others." [Al-Baqarah 180]   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: {إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ} [البقرة 180] بِالْمَعْرُوفِ حقًا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ أَمَرَ أَنْ يُوصِيَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ وَأَقَارِبِهِ ثُمَّ نُسِخَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ فَجَعَلَ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ نَصِيبًا مَعْلُومًا وَأَلْحَقَ لِكُلِّ ذِي مِيرَاثٍ نَصِيبَهُ مِنْهُ وَلَيْسَتْ لَهُمْ وَصِيَّةٌ فَصَارَتِ الْوَصِيَّةُ لِمَنْ لَا يَرِثُ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ وَغَيْرِهِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e Idhā Ḥaḍar Aḥadakum al-Mawt
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أََنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3305

chapter.englishTitle: The will for the heir.

hadiths.englishRaw: The custom (in old days) was that the property of the deceased would be inherited by his offspring; as for the parents (of the deceased), they would inherit by the will of the deceased. Then Allah cancelled from that custom whatever He wished and fixed for the male double the amount inherited by the female, and for each parent a sixth (of the whole legacy) and for the wife an eighth or a fourth and for the husband a half or a fourth.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The custom (in old days) was that the property of the deceased would be inherited by his offspring; as for the parents (of the deceased), they would inherit by the will of the deceased. Then Allah cancelled from that custom whatever He wished and fixed for the male double the amount inherited by the female, and for each parent a sixth (of the whole legacy) and for the wife an eighth or a fourth and for the husband a half or a fourth.    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ الْمَالُ لِلْوَلَدِ وَكَانَتِ الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ فَنَسَخَ اللَّهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَا أَحَبَّ فَجَعَلَ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلَ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ وَجَعَلَ لِلْأَبَوَيْنِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا السُّدُسَ وَالثُّلُثَ وَجَعَلَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الثُّمُنَ وَالرُّبُعَ وَلِلزَّوْجِ الشَّطْرَ وَالرُّبُعَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf \u003e And Rqāʾ \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ \u003e ʿAṭāʾ \u003e Ibn ʿAbbās
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3306

chapter.englishTitle: The will for the heir.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Qur'anic verse goes: "(It is prescribed when death approaches any of you), if he leaves any goods, that he may bequest to parents and next to kin." The bequest was made in this way until the verse of inheritance repealed it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Qur'anic verse goes: "(It is prescribed when death approaches any of you), if he leaves any goods, that he may bequest to parents and next to kin." The bequest was made in this way until the verse of inheritance repealed it.     – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ وَالْحَسَنِ {إِنْ تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ} [البقرة 180] «فكَانَتِ الْوَصِيَّةُ كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى نَسَخَتْهَا آيَةُ الْمِيرَاثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Abū Tumaylah \u003e al-Ḥusayn b. Wāqid \u003e Yazīd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تُمَيْلَةَ عَنْ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ عَنْ يَزِيدَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3307

chapter.englishTitle: The Will for the Wealthy

hadiths.englishRaw: About a man who left a will, and he had a wealthy brother. Should he leave a will for him? He said, "Yes, even if his wealth is twenty thousand (dirhams)." Then he said, "And if his wealth is one hundred thousand, surely his richness will not prevent him from giving his brother his rights."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: About a man who left a will, and he had a wealthy brother. Should he leave a will for him? He said, "Yes, even if his wealth is twenty thousand (dirhams)." Then he said, "And if his wealth is one hundred thousand, surely his richness will not prevent him from giving his brother his rights."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَوْصَى وَلَهُ أَخٌ مُوسِرٌ أَيُوصِي لَهُ؟ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَإِنْ كَانَ رَبَّ عِشْرِينَ أَلْفًا» ثُمَّ قَالَ «وَإِنْ كَانَ رَبَّ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ فَإِنَّ غِنَاهُ لَا يَمْنَعُهُ الْحَقَّ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan Suʾil \u003e a man Awṣá And Lah Akh Mūsir Ayūṣī Lah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ سُئِلَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3308

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي لِفُلَانٍ فَإِذا مَاتَ فَلِفُلَانٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The man instructs for [someone] and when he dies, it is for [tha...

hadiths.englishRaw: My sword is for so-and-so, and if so-and-so dies, it goes to so-and-so. If so-and-so dies, it goes to so-and-so. And if so-and-so dies, then it will return to me. They said, "It belongs to the first person." He said, and Humaid bin AbdulRahman said, "It should be signed as he said."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: My sword is for so-and-so, and if so-and-so dies, it goes to so-and-so. If so-and-so dies, it goes to so-and-so. And if so-and-so dies, then it will return to me. They said, "It belongs to the first person." He said, and Humaid bin AbdulRahman said, "It should be signed as he said."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَيْفِي لِفُلَانٍ فَإِنْ مَاتَ فُلَانٌ فَلِفُلَانٍ فَإِنْ مَاتَ فُلَانٌ فَمَرْجِعُهُ إِلَيَّ قَالَا «هُوَ لِلْأَوَّلِ» قَالَ وَقَالَ حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ «يُمْضَى كَمَا قَالَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ فِي رَجُلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3309

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي لِفُلَانٍ فَإِذا مَاتَ فَلِفُلَانٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The man instructs for [someone] and when he dies, it is for [tha...

hadiths.englishRaw: In the man, he gives the man the gift, and he says, "It is yours." So, when he dies, he (is succeeded) by so-and-so, and when so-and-so dies, (he is succeeded) by so-and-so, and when so-and-so dies, his (successor) will be me. He said, "The tradition will continue as he said, even if they are a hundred."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: In the man, he gives the man the gift, and he says, "It is yours." So, when he dies, he (is succeeded) by so-and-so, and when so-and-so dies, (he is succeeded) by so-and-so, and when so-and-so dies, his (successor) will be me. He said, "The tradition will continue as he said, even if they are a hundred."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُعْطِي الرَّجُلَ الْعَطَاءَ فَيَقُولُ هُوَ لَكَ فَإِذَا مُتَّ فَلِفُلَانٍ فَإِذَا مَاتَ فُلَانٌ فَلِفُلَانٍ وَإِذَا مَاتَ فُلَانٌ فَمَرْجِعُهُ إِلَيَّ قَالَ «يُمْضَى كَمَا قَالَ وَإِنْ كَانُوا مِائَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Hishām b. ʿUrwah \u003e ʿUrwah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3310

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي لِغَيْرِ قَرَابَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a man, he recommends for others outside his relatives.

hadiths.englishRaw: So we said, "Indeed, Al-Hasan says, 'I will retaliate against the closest ones.'" But he denied that and said a harsh statement.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: So we said, "Indeed, Al-Hasan says, 'I will retaliate against the closest ones.'" But he denied that and said a harsh statement.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فَقُلْنَا إِنَّ الْحَسَنَ يَقُولُ «يُرَدُّ عَلَى الْأَقْرَبِينَ» فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ وَقَالَ قَوْلًا شَدِيدًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Shaybah b. Hishām al-Rāsibī And Kathīr b. Maʿdān \u003e Saʾalnā Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ الرَّاسِبِيُّ وَكَثِيرُ بْنُ مَعْدَانَ قَالَا سَأَلْنَا سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي فِي غَيْرِ قَرَابَتِهِ فَقَالَ سَالِمٌ «هِيَ حَيْثُ جَعَلَهَا» قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3311

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُوصِي لِغَيْرِ قَرَابَتِهِ
chapter.englishTitle: In a man, he recommends for others outside his relatives.

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a man gives bequests to his relatives, he should ensure fairness between male and female relatives."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "When a man gives bequests to his relatives, he should ensure fairness between male and female relatives."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِذَا أَوْصَى الرَّجُلُ فِي قَرَابَتِهِ فَهُوَ لِأَقْرَبِهِمْ بِبَطْنٍ الذَّكَرُ وَالْأُنْثَى فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Shihāb \u003e ʿAmr \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3312

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا قَالَ: أَحَدُ غُلَامَيَّ حُرٌّ، ثُمَّ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يُبَيِّنْ
chapter.englishTitle: If he says: One of my two slaves is free, then he dies without c...

hadiths.englishRaw: One of the two boys was a free child, then he died without clarifying. He said, "The inheritors are to be freed in his place, whoever they choose."   – Weak
hadiths.body: One of the two boys was a free child, then he died without clarifying. He said, "The inheritors are to be freed in his place, whoever they choose."   – Weak
hadiths.arabic: أَحَدُ غُلَامَيَّ حُرٌّ ثُمَّ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يُبَيِّنْ قَالَ «الْوَرَثَةُ بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ يُعْتِقُونَ أَيَّهُمَا أَحَبُّوا»   – ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Muṭarrif
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3313

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا أَوْصَى بِالْعِتْقِ فِي مَرَضِهِ ثُمَّ بَرَأَ
chapter.englishTitle: If he made a bequest for manumission during his illness then he ...

hadiths.englishRaw: "In his illness, so-and-so and so-and-so, and my servant Fulan is a free man, and he did not say if something happened to me, then he is innocent. He said, 'he is a slave.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "In his illness, so-and-so and so-and-so, and my servant Fulan is a free man, and he did not say if something happened to me, then he is innocent. He said, 'he is a slave.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: فِي مَرَضِهِ لِفُلَانٍ كَذَا وَلِفُلَانٍ كَذَا وَعَبْدِي فُلَانٌ حُرٌّ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ إِنْ حَدَثَ بِي حَدَثٌ فَبَرَأَ قَالَ «هُوَ مَمْلُوكٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e a man
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3314

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا أَعْتَقَ غُلَامَهُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُ
chapter.englishTitle: If he frees his slave before his death and has no other wealth.

hadiths.englishRaw: About Al-Sha'bi concerning a man who freed his slave upon his death and he had no one else, but he had a debt. Al-Sha'bi said, "He strives for the poor in his cost."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: About Al-Sha'bi concerning a man who freed his slave upon his death and he had no one else, but he had a debt. Al-Sha'bi said, "He strives for the poor in his cost."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ الشَّعْبِيِّ فِي رَجُلٍ أَعْتَقَ غُلَامَهُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ غَيْرُهُ وَعَلَيْهِ دَيْنٌ قَالَ «يَسْعَى لِلْغُرَمَاءِ فِي ثَمَنِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Muṭarrif
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3315

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: إِذَا أَعْتَقَ غُلَامَهُ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُ
chapter.englishTitle: If he frees his slave before his death and has no other wealth.

hadiths.englishRaw: A man bought a slave for nine hundred dirhams, then set him free without paying the price of the slave or leaving anything. Ali said, "The slave should work to pay off his price."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man bought a slave for nine hundred dirhams, then set him free without paying the price of the slave or leaving anything. Ali said, "The slave should work to pay off his price."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلًا اشْتَرَى عَبْدًا بِتِسْعِ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ فَأَعْتَقَهُ وَلَمْ يَقْضِ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ «يَسْعَى الْعَبْدُ فِي ثَمَنِهِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Hammām \u003e Qatādah \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3316

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: The planner is one-third of the solution?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The planner is from the third."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The planner is from the third."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Manṣūr b. Salamah \u003e Sharīk \u003e al-Ashʿath \u003e Nāfiʿ \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ الْأَشْعَثِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3317

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: The planner is one-third of the solution?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The planner is from the third."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "The planner is from the third."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Manṣūr b. Salamah \u003e Sharīk \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ شَرِيكٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3318

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: The planner is one-third of the solution?

hadiths.englishRaw: "From behind the third part."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From behind the third part."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ دُبُرٍ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Kathīr \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e al-Muʿtaq
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ «الْمُعْتَقُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3319

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: The planner is one-third of the solution?

hadiths.englishRaw: "From a female bear and her cubs, one-third each."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From a female bear and her cubs, one-third each."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ دُبُرٍ وَوَلَدُهَا مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Ḥumayd \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e al-Muʿtaqah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ «الْمُعْتَقَةُ

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3320

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: الْمُدَبَّرُ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who said: The planner is one-third of the solution?

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the back of the third."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "From the back of the third."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ دُبُرٍ مِنَ الثُّلُثِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e al-Muʿtaq
