So he will continue to ascend as long as he recites, whether in a measured tone or melodiously."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ «تَعَلَّمُوا سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ فَإِنَّ أَخْذَهَا بَرَكَةٌ وَتَرْكَهَا حَسْرَةٌ وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُهَا الْبَطَلَةُ» ثُمَّ سَكَتَ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ قَالَ تَعَلَّمُوا سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ وَآلِ عِمْرَانَ فَإِنَّهُمَا الزَّهْرَاوَانِ وَإِنَّهُمَا تُظِلَّانِ صَاحِبَهُمَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَأَنَّهُمَا غَمَامَتَانِ أَوْ غَيَايَتَانِ أَوْ فِرْقَانِ مِنْ طَيْرٍ صَوَافَّ وَإِنَّ الْقُرْآنَ يَلْقَى صَاحِبَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حِينَ يَنْشَقُّ عَنْهُ الْقَبْرُ كَالرَّجُلِ الشَّاحِبِ فَيَقُولُ لَهُ هَلْ تَعْرِفُنِي؟ فَيَقُولُ مَا أَعْرِفُكَ فَيَقُولُ أَنَا صَاحِبُكَ الْقُرْآنُ الَّذِي أَظْمَأْتُكَ فِي الْهَوَاجِرِ وَأَسْهَرْتُ لَيْلَكَ وَإِنَّ كُلَّ تَاجِرٍ مِنْ وَرَاءِ تِجَارَتِهِ وَإِنَّكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ وَرَاءِ كُلِّ تِجَارَةٍ فَيُعْطَى الْمُلْكَ بِيَمِينِهِ وَالْخُلْدَ بِشِمَالِهِ وَيُوضَعُ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ تَاجُ الْوَقَارِ وَيُكْسَى وَالِدَاهُ حُلَّتَيْنِ لَا يُقَوَّمُ لَهُمَا الدُّنْيَا فَيَقُولَانِ بِمَ كُسِينَا هَذَا؟ فيُقَالُ لَهُمَا بِأَخْذِ وَلَدِكُمَا الْقُرْآنَ ثُمَّ يُقَالُ لَهُ اقْرَأْ وَاصْعَدْ فِي دَرَجِ الْجَنَّةِ وَغُرَفِهَا فَهُوَ فِي صُعُودٍ مَا دَامَ يَقْرَأُ هَذًّا كَانَ أَوْ تَرْتِيلًا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Bashīr \u003e Ibn al-Muhājir \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Buraydah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرٌ هُوَ ابْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3434

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3435

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ وَآلِ عِمْرَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Virtue of Surah Al-Baqarah and Surah Al-Imran

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard Abu Umamah saying, "I saw in a dream that people were walking in a long, steep mountain fissure, and on top of the mountain were two green trees that were calling out, 'Is there anyone among you who can recite Surah Al-Baqarah? Is there anyone among you who can recite Surah Al-Imran?' When a man said yes, the two trees came close to him until they reached his neck, and they passed through the mountain." Abu Muhammad said, "The 'neck' refers to the branches of the trees."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He heard Abu Umamah saying, "I saw in a dream that people were walking in a long, steep mountain fissure, and on top of the mountain were two green trees that were calling out, 'Is there anyone among you who can recite Surah Al-Baqarah? Is there anyone among you who can recite Surah Al-Imran?' When a man said yes, the two trees came close to him until they reached his neck, and they passed through the mountain." Abu Muhammad said, "The 'neck' refers to the branches of the trees."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ يَقُولُ إِنَّ أَخًا لَكُمْ أُرِيَ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنَّ النَّاسَ يَسْلُكُونَ فِي صَدْعِ جَبَلٍ وَعْرٍ طَوِيلٍ وَعَلَى رَأْسِ الْجَبَلِ شَجَرَتَانِ خَضْرَاوَانِ تَهْتِفَانِ هَلْ فِيكُمْ مَنْ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ؟ هَلْ فِيكُمْ مَنْ يَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ؟ فَإِذَا قَالَ الرَّجُلُ نَعَمْ دَنَتَا بِأَعْذَاقِهِمَا حَتَّى يَتَعَلَّقَ بِهِمَا فَتَخْطِرَانِ بِهِ الْجَبَلَ قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد الْأَعْذَاقُ الْأَغْصَانُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Muʿāwiyah \u003e Abū Yaḥyá Sulaym b. ʿĀmir \u003e Abū Umāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى سُلَيْمِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3435

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3436

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ وَآلِ عِمْرَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Virtue of Surah Al-Baqarah and Surah Al-Imran

hadiths.englishRaw: A man read at the house of Abdullah Al-Baqara and Al-Imran, then he said, "I have read two surahs in which is the greatest name of Allah. When invoked with it, he answers, and when asked with it, he gives."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: A man read at the house of Abdullah Al-Baqara and Al-Imran, then he said, "I have read two surahs in which is the greatest name of Allah. When invoked with it, he answers, and when asked with it, he gives."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قرأ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَقَرَةَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ فَقَالَ «قَرَأْتَ سُورَتَيْنِ فِيهِمَا اسْمُ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمُ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيَ بِهِ أَجَابَ وَإِذَا سُئِلَ بِهِ أَعْطَى»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Jaʿfar al-Raqqī \u003e ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAmr \u003e Zayd \u003e Jābir \u003e Abū al-Ḍuḥá \u003e Masrūq \u003e ʿAbdullāh \u003e Qrʾ a man ʿInd ʿAbdullāh al-Baqarah Wāl ʿImrān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3436

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3437

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ وَآلِ عِمْرَانَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Virtue of Surah Al-Baqarah and Surah Al-Imran

hadiths.englishRaw: Whoever recites Al-Baqarah and Al-Imran, they will come on the Day of Judgment, saying, "Our Lord, there is no way against Him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Whoever recites Al-Baqarah and Al-Imran, they will come on the Day of Judgment, saying, "Our Lord, there is no way against Him."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: مَنْ قَرَأَ الْبَقَرَةَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ جَاءَتَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَقُولَانِ رَبَّنَا لَا سَبِيلَ عَلَيْهِ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām b. Ḥarb \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū ʿAṭṭāf \u003e Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنْ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَطَّافٍ عَنْ كَعْبٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3437

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3438

chapter.englishTitle: In the glory of the family of Imran

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Muhammad is a decorative ink.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Muhammad is a decorative ink.   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَبُو مُحَمَّد مُحَبِّرَةٌ مُزَيِّنَةٌ   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Sulaym b. Ḥanẓalah al-Bakrī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd Man Qaraʾ Āl ʿImrān Fahū Ghanī And al-Nnisāʾ Muḥabbirah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ الْبَكْرِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ «مَنْ قَرَأَ آلَ عِمْرَانَ فَهُوَ غَنِيٌّ وَالنِّسَاءُ مُحَبِّرَةٌ» قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3438

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3439

chapter.englishTitle: In the glory of the family of Imran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites the last verses of Surah Al-Imran in one night, will be rewarded as if he had prayed the whole night."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites the last verses of Surah Al-Imran in one night, will be rewarded as if he had prayed the whole night."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ آخِرَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كُتِبَ لَهُ قِيَامُ لَيْلَةٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ibn Lahīʿah \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū al-Khayr \u003e ʿUthmān b. ʿAffān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ ابْنِ لَهِيعَةَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3439

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3440

chapter.englishTitle: In the glory of the family of Imran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites Surah Al-'Imran on the day of Friday, the angels send blessings upon him until the night."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites Surah Al-'Imran on the day of Friday, the angels send blessings upon him until the night."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Ṣadaqah b. Khālid \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Makḥūl
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3440

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3441

chapter.englishTitle: In the glory of the family of Imran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah performs Surah Al-Imran, a treasure of conduct, in the late night."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah performs Surah Al-Imran, a treasure of conduct, in the late night."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «نِعْمَ كَنْزُ الصُّعْلُوكِ سُورَةُ آلِ عِمْرَانَ يَقُومُ بِهَا فِي آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Qāsim b. Sallām Abū ʿUbayd \u003e ʿUbaydullāh al-Ashjaʿī \u003e Misʿar \u003e Jābir Qabl \u003e Yaqaʿ Fīmā And Qaʿ Fīh \u003e al-Shaʿbī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ سَلَّامٍ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الْأَشْجَعِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي مِسْعَرٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقَعَ فِيمَا وَقَعَ فِيهِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3441

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3442

chapter.englishTitle: In the glory of the family of Imran

hadiths.englishRaw: "So he took refuge in a valley called Maganna, a valley where no one walks except that they are afflicted by insanity. And on the edge of the valley, there were two monks. When it became evening, one of them said to his companion, 'By Allah, that man is doomed.' He then began reciting Surah Al-Imran. They both recited a beneficial Surah in the hope that he might be saved. He then said, 'So he woke up safe and sound.' Abu Muhammad said, 'Abu As-Salil is Durayb ibn Nuqayr,' and it is also said that he is Ibn Nuqayr.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "So he took refuge in a valley called Maganna, a valley where no one walks except that they are afflicted by insanity. And on the edge of the valley, there were two monks. When it became evening, one of them said to his companion, 'By Allah, that man is doomed.' He then began reciting Surah Al-Imran. They both recited a beneficial Surah in the hope that he might be saved. He then said, 'So he woke up safe and sound.' Abu Muhammad said, 'Abu As-Salil is Durayb ibn Nuqayr,' and it is also said that he is Ibn Nuqayr.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: فَأَوَى إِلَى وَادِي مَجَنَّةٍ وَادٍ لَا يَمْشِِي فِيهِ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا أَصَابَتْهُ جِنَّةٌ وَعَلَى شَفِيرِ الْوَادِي رَاهِبَانِ فَلَمَّا أَمْسَى قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ هَلَكَ وَاللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ قَالَ فَافْتَتَحَ سُورَةَ آلِ عِمْرَانَ قَالَا فَقَرَأَ سُورَةً طَيِّبَةً لَعَلَّهُ سَيَنْجُو قَالَ «فَأَصْبَحَ سَلِيمًا» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «أَبُو السَّلِيلِ ضُرَيْبُ بْنُ نُقَيْرٍ» ويقال ابن نقير   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām \u003e al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū al-Salīl \u003e Aṣāb a man Dam
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ عَنْ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي السَّلِيلِ قَالَ «أَصَابَ رَجُلٌ دَمًا» قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3442

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3443

chapter.englishTitle: The virtues of cattle and chapters

hadiths.englishRaw: "Abdullah, 'the seven long ones are like the Torah, and the hundred and ten are like the Gospel, and the seventy are like the Psalms, and the rest of the Quran is a bonus."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Abdullah, 'the seven long ones are like the Torah, and the hundred and ten are like the Gospel, and the seventy are like the Psalms, and the rest of the Quran is a bonus."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ «السَّبْعُ الطُّوَلُ مِثْلُ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْمِئِينَ مِثْلُ الْإِنْجِيلِ وَالْمَثَانِي مِثْلُ الزَّبُورِ وَسَائِرُ الْقُرْآنِ بَعْدُ فَضْلٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muʿādh b. Hāniʾ \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Ṭahmān \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e al-Musayyab b. Rāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هَانِئٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ عَنْ الْمُسَيَّبِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ قَالَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3443

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3444

chapter.englishTitle: The virtues of cattle and chapters

hadiths.englishRaw: "The livestock are among the obligations of the Quran."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "The livestock are among the obligations of the Quran."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْأَنْعَامُ مِنْ نَوَاجِبِ الْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Khalīfah \u003e ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ عَنْ عُمَرَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3444

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3445

chapter.englishTitle: The virtues of cattle and chapters

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Opening of the Quran is Al-'An'am, and its completion is Hud."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Opening of the Quran is Al-'An'am, and its completion is Hud."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فَاتِحَةُ التَّوْرَاةِ الْأَنْعَامُ وَخَاتِمَتُهَا هُودٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hammām \u003e Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Rabāḥ \u003e Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَعْبًا قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3445

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3446

chapter.englishTitle: The virtues of cattle and chapters

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Recite Surah Hud on Fridays.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Indeed, the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Recite Surah Hud on Fridays.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ «اقْرَءُوا سُورَةَ هُودٍ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Hammām \u003e Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Rabāḥ \u003e Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا هَمَّامٌ عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ كَعْبٍ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3446

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3447

chapter.englishTitle: The virtues of cattle and chapters

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Read Surah Hud on the day of Friday."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Read Surah Hud on the day of Friday."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اقْرَءُوا سُورَةَ هُودٍ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Hammām \u003e Abū ʿImrān al-Jawnī \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Rabāḥ \u003e Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ كَعْبٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3447

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3448

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Surah Al-Kahf.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever reads ten verses from Surah Al-Kahf will not fear the Dajjal."
hadiths.body: "Whoever reads ten verses from Surah Al-Kahf will not fear the Dajjal."
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنَ الْكَهْفِ لَمْ يَخَفِ الدَّجَّالَ»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَتْنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3448

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3449

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Surah Al-Kahf.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever reads the last verse of Surat Al-Kahf for an hour, intending to stand up for prayer during the night, will be able to do so." 'Abdullah said, "We tested it and found it to be true."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever reads the last verse of Surat Al-Kahf for an hour, intending to stand up for prayer during the night, will be able to do so." 'Abdullah said, "We tested it and found it to be true."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ آخِرَ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ لِسَاعَةٍ يُرِيدُ يَقُومُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ قَامَهَا» قَالَ عَبْدَةُ «فَجَرَّبْنَاهُ فَوَجَدْنَاهُ كَذَلِكَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Kathīr \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e Zir b. Ḥubaysh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدَةَ عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3449

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3450

chapter.englishTitle: The Virtues of Surah Al-Kahf.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites Surah Al-Kahf on the night of Friday, a light will shine for him from among his own light until the next Friday."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites Surah Al-Kahf on the night of Friday, a light will shine for him from among his own light until the next Friday."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْكَهْفِ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَضَاءَ لَهُ مِنَ النُّورِ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Hushaym \u003e Abū Hāshim \u003e Abū Mijlaz \u003e Qays b. ʿUbād \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هَاشِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ عُبَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3450

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3451

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةِ وَتَبَارَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Surah as-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk

hadiths.englishRaw: Read Surah Al-Munjia (that brings salvation), which is the ALIF-LAAM-MEEM TANZEEL. It has reached me that there was a man who used to recite it and not recite anything else, and he was full of sins. Its wings spread over him and it said, "O Lord, forgive him, for he used to recite me abundantly." So the Lord accepted this intercession for him and said, "Write for him a good deed for every sin and raise his rank."
hadiths.body: Read Surah Al-Munjia (that brings salvation), which is the ALIF-LAAM-MEEM TANZEEL. It has reached me that there was a man who used to recite it and not recite anything else, and he was full of sins. Its wings spread over him and it said, "O Lord, forgive him, for he used to recite me abundantly." So the Lord accepted this intercession for him and said, "Write for him a good deed for every sin and raise his rank."
hadiths.arabic: اقْرَءُوا الْمُنَجِّيَةَ وَهِيَ الم تَنْزِيلُ فَإِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَانَ يَقْرَؤُهَا مَا يَقْرَأُ شَيْئًا غَيْرَهَا وَكَانَ كَثِيرَ الْخَطَايَا فَنَشَرَتْ جَنَاحَهَا عَلَيْهِ وَقَالَتْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يُكْثِرُ قِرَاءَتِي فَشَفَّعَهَا الرَّبُّ فِيهِ وَقَالَ اكْتُبُوا لَهُ بِكُلِّ خَطِيئَةٍ حَسَنَةً وَارْفَعُوا لَهُ دَرَجَةً
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e ʿAbdah \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān \u003e Āqraʾūā al-Munajjiyah And Hī al-m Tanzīl Faʾinnah Balaghanī
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3451

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3452

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةِ وَتَبَارَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Surah as-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites Surah As-Sajdah and blessed is He in whose hand is the sovereignty and He is over all things competent, for him were written seventy virtues, and he was pardoned seventy sins, and he will be raised by it seventy degrees."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites Surah As-Sajdah and blessed is He in whose hand is the sovereignty and He is over all things competent, for him were written seventy virtues, and he was pardoned seventy sins, and he will be raised by it seventy degrees."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةَ وََ تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ كُتِبَ لَهُ سَبْعُونَ حَسَنَةً وَحُطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا سَبْعُونَ سَيِّئَةً وَرُفِعَ لَهُ بِهَا سَبْعُونَ دَرَجَةً»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Ḍamrah \u003e Kaʿb
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ عَنْ كَعْبٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3452

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3453

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةِ وَتَبَارَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Surah as-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk

hadiths.englishRaw: Verily, the recitation of the Qur'an is without doubt from the Lord of all worlds. It pleads on behalf of its companion in the grave, saying, "O Allah, if I am from Your book, then intercede for me through it. And if I am not from Your book, then remove me from it." Indeed, it is like a bird that spreads its wings over the grave of its companion, and so it intercedes for him and protects him from the punishment of the grave. And blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is capable of all things. Similarly, the one who recites these verses becomes immortal and does not sleep until he recites them.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Verily, the recitation of the Qur'an is without doubt from the Lord of all worlds. It pleads on behalf of its companion in the grave, saying, "O Allah, if I am from Your book, then intercede for me through it. And if I am not from Your book, then remove me from it." Indeed, it is like a bird that spreads its wings over the grave of its companion, and so it intercedes for him and protects him from the punishment of the grave. And blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is capable of all things. Similarly, the one who recites these verses becomes immortal and does not sleep until he recites them.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ الم تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ تُجَادِلُ عَنْ صَاحِبِهَا فِي الْقَبْرِ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتُ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيهِ وَإِنْ لَمْ أَكُنْ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ فَامْحُنِي عَنْهُ وَإِنَّهَا تَكُونُ كَالطَّيْرِ تَجْعَلُ جَنَاحَهَا عَلَيْهِ فَيُشْفَعُ لَهُ فَتَمْنَعُهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَفِي تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ مِثْلَهُ فَكَانَ خَالِدٌ لَا يَبِيتُ حَتَّى يَقْرَأَ بِهِمَا   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Khālid ʿĀmir b. Jashīb And Baḥīr b. Saʿd Yuḥaddithān \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا خَالِدٍ عَامِرَ بْنَ جَشِيبٍ وَبَحِيرَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ يُحَدِّثَانِ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ مَعْدَانَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3453

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3454

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةِ وَتَبَارَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Surah as-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ used to not sleep until he recited Al-Mulk (chapter of the Quran) and Al-Waqi'ah (chapter of the Quran).   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ used to not sleep until he recited Al-Mulk (chapter of the Quran) and Al-Waqi'ah (chapter of the Quran).   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ «لَا يَنَامُ حَتَّى يَقْرَأَ الم وَتَبَارَكَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sufyān \u003e Layth \u003e Abū al-Zubayr \u003e Jābir
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3454

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3455

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةِ وَتَبَارَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Surah as-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk

hadiths.englishRaw: "They were distinguished above every other Surah in the Quran by sixty rewards."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "They were distinguished above every other Surah in the Quran by sixty rewards."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فُضِّلَتَا عَلَى كُلِّ سُورَةٍ فِي الْقُرْآنِ بِسِتِّينَ حَسَنَةً»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Muʿtamir \u003e Layth \u003e Ṭāwus
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3455

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3456

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ تَنْزِيلُ السَّجْدَةِ وَتَبَارَكَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Surah as-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard once someone saying, "A man came to his grave, and I came from beside his grave, and there was a Surah from the Quran that had thirty verses arguing on his behalf." He continued saying, "So, Masruq and I looked, and we did not find in the Quran a surah with thirty verses except for Surah Tabarak."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard once someone saying, "A man came to his grave, and I came from beside his grave, and there was a Surah from the Quran that had thirty verses arguing on his behalf." He continued saying, "So, Masruq and I looked, and we did not find in the Quran a surah with thirty verses except for Surah Tabarak."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ مُرَّةَ يَقُولُ «أُتِيَ رَجُلٌ فِي قَبْرِهِ فَأُتِيَ من جَانِبُ قَبْرِهِ فَجَعَلَتْ سُورَةٌ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ثَلَاثُونَ آيَةً تُجَادِلُ عَنْهُ» حَتَّى قَالَ «فَنَظَرْنَا أَنَا وَمَسْرُوقٌ فَلَمْ نَجِدْ فِي الْقُرْآنِ سُورَةً ثَلَاثِينَ آيَةً إِلَّا تَبَارَكَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ḥajjāj b. Minhāl \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e ʿAmr b. Murrah \u003e Murrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3456

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3457

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ سُورَةِ طه وَيس
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Surah Taha and Surah Yaseen

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, recited Taha and Ya Seen before He created the heavens and the earth by a thousand years. So, when the angels heard the Quran, they said, 'Good tidings for a nation upon which this descends, and good tidings for wombs that carry this, and good tidings for tongues that speak with this.'"
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, recited Taha and Ya Seen before He created the heavens and the earth by a thousand years. So, when the angels heard the Quran, they said, 'Good tidings for a nation upon which this descends, and good tidings for wombs that carry this, and good tidings for tongues that speak with this.'"
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَرَأَ طه وْ يس قَبْلَ أَنْ يَخْلُقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِأَلْفِ عَامٍ فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ الْقُرْآنَ قَالَتْ طُوبَى لِأُمَّةٍ يَنْزِلُ هَذَا عَلَيْهَا وَطُوبَى لِأَجْوَافٍ تَحْمِلُ هَذَا وَطُوبَى لِأَلْسِنَةٍ تَتَكَلَّمُ بِهَذَا
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. al-Mundhir \u003e Ibrāhīm b. al-Muhājir b. al-Mismār \u003e ʿUmar b. Ḥafṣ b. Dhakwān \u003e a freed slave of al-Ḥuraqah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ بْنِ الْمِسْمَارِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَفْصِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ عَنْ مَوْلَى الْحُرَقَةِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3457

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3458

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Yasin

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites Surah Yasin in a night, seeking the face of Allah or the pleasure of Allah, will be forgiven." And he said, "It has reached me that it equals the entire Quran."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites Surah Yasin in a night, seeking the face of Allah or the pleasure of Allah, will be forgiven." And he said, "It has reached me that it equals the entire Quran."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ يس فِي لَيْلَةٍ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ أَوْ مَرْضَاةِ اللَّهِ غُفِرَ لَهُ» وَقَالَ «بَلَغَنِي أَنَّهَا تَعْدِلُ الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd Mūsá b. Khālid \u003e Muʿtamir from his father \u003e Balaghanī \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ مُوسَى بْنُ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3458

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3459

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Yasin

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, everything has a heart, and the heart of the Quran is Surah Yaseen. Whoever recites it, it is as if he has recited the Quran ten times."
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Verily, everything has a heart, and the heart of the Quran is Surah Yaseen. Whoever recites it, it is as if he has recited the Quran ten times."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «إِنَّ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَلْبًا وَإِنَّ قَلْبَ الْقُرْآنِ يس مَنْ قَرَأَهَا فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e al-Ḥasan b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Hārūn Abū Muḥammad \u003e Muqātil b. Ḥayyān \u003e Qatādah \u003e Anas
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُقَاتِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3459

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3460

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Yasin

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever recites Surah Yasin during the night seeking the face of Allah, his sins will be forgiven in that night."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever recites Surah Yasin during the night seeking the face of Allah, his sins will be forgiven in that night."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ قَرَأَ يس فِي لَيْلَةٍ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ اللَّهِ غُفِرَ لَهُ فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ from my father \u003e Ziyād b. Khaythamah \u003e Muḥammad b. Juḥādah \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ خَيْثَمَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُحَادَةَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3460

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3461

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Yasin

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Surah Yaseen in the morning, his needs will be fulfilled."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Surah Yaseen in the morning, his needs will be fulfilled."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ قَرَأَ يس فِي صَدْرِ النَّهَارِ قُضِيَتْ حَوَائِجُهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: al-Walīd b. Shujāʿ from my father \u003e Ziyād b. Khaythamah \u003e Muḥammad b. Juḥādah \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Abū Rabāḥ \u003e Balaghanī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ خَيْثَمَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُحَادَةَ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ قَالَ بَلَغَنِي
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3461

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3462

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of Yasin

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of the phrase is: Ibn Abbas said, "Whoever recites Surah Yasin in the morning will be given ease throughout his day, and whoever recites it in the evening will be given ease throughout his night."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of the phrase is: Ibn Abbas said, "Whoever recites Surah Yasin in the morning will be given ease throughout his day, and whoever recites it in the evening will be given ease throughout his night."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ «مَنْ قَرَأَ يس حِينَ يُصْبِحُ أُعْطِيَ يُسْرَ يَوْمِهِ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَمَنْ قَرَأَهَا فِي صَدْرِ لَيْلِهِ أُعْطِيَ يُسْرَ لَيْلَتِهِ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. Zurārah \u003e ʿAbd al-Wahhāb \u003e Rāshid Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥimmānī \u003e Shahr b. Ḥawshab
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ حَدَّثَنَا رَاشِدٌ أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ الْحِمَّانِيُّ عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ قَالَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3462

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3463

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ حم الدُّخَانِ وَالْحَوَامِيمِ وَالْمُسَبِّحَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the inhalation of smoke and incense burners and...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites Surah Ad-Dukhan on the night of Friday with faith and belief in it, shall be forgiven."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites Surah Ad-Dukhan on the night of Friday with faith and belief in it, shall be forgiven."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ مَنْ قَرَأَ حم الدُّخَانَ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِيمَانًا وَتَصْدِيقًا بِهَا أَصْبَحَ مَغْفُورًا لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ukhbirt
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ «أُخْبِرْتُ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3463

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3464

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ حم الدُّخَانِ وَالْحَوَامِيمِ وَالْمُسَبِّحَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the inhalation of smoke and incense burners and...

hadiths.englishRaw: "The one who recites Surah Al-Kahf on the night of Friday, his sins are forgiven and he is married to the beautiful maidens of paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The one who recites Surah Al-Kahf on the night of Friday, his sins are forgiven and he is married to the beautiful maidens of paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ حم فِي لَيْلَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ أَصْبَحَ مَغْفُورًا لَهُ وَزُوِّجَ مِنَ الْحُورِ الْعِينِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Mubārak \u003e Ṣadaqah b. Khālid \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith \u003e Abū Rāfiʿ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3464

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3465

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ حم الدُّخَانِ وَالْحَوَامِيمِ وَالْمُسَبِّحَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the inhalation of smoke and incense burners and...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Be the hummingbirds that name the brides."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Be the hummingbirds that name the brides."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كُنَّ الْحَوَامِيمُ يُسَمَّيْنَ الْعَرَائِسَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Misʿar \u003e Saʿd b. Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3465

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3466

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ حم الدُّخَانِ وَالْحَوَامِيمِ وَالْمُسَبِّحَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the inhalation of smoke and incense burners and...

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites three verses from the end of Surat Al-Hashr (Chapter 59) in the morning and dies on that day, he will be blessed with the seal of the martyrs. And if he recites them in the evening and dies on that night, he will also be blessed with the seal of the martyrs."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites three verses from the end of Surat Al-Hashr (Chapter 59) in the morning and dies on that day, he will be blessed with the seal of the martyrs. And if he recites them in the evening and dies on that night, he will also be blessed with the seal of the martyrs."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ ثَلَاثَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْحَشْرِ إِذَا أَصْبَحَ فَمَاتَ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ ذَلِكَ طُبِعَ بِطَابَعِ الشُّهَدَاءِ وَإِنْ قَرَأَ إِذَا أَمْسَى فَمَاتَ مِنْ لَيْلَتِهِ طُبِعَ بِطَابَعِ الشُّهَدَاءِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. ʿĀmir \u003e Hishām \u003e al-Ḥasan
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ عَنْ هِشَامٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3466

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3467

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ حم الدُّخَانِ وَالْحَوَامِيمِ وَالْمُسَبِّحَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the inhalation of smoke and incense burners and...

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ , he used to recite the tasbihat (glorifications) before sleep and say, "Verily, in them is a verse equal to a thousand verses."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ , he used to recite the tasbihat (glorifications) before sleep and say, "Verily, in them is a verse equal to a thousand verses."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقْرَأُ الْمُسَبِّحَاتِ عِنْدَ النَّوْمِ وَيَقُولُ «إِنَّ فِيهِنَّ آيَةً تَعْدِلُ أَلْفَ آيَةٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Maʿn \u003e Muʿāwiyah b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e Baḥīr b. Saʿd \u003e Khālid b. Maʿdān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ مَعْنٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ بَحِيرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3467

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3468

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ حم الدُّخَانِ وَالْحَوَامِيمِ وَالْمُسَبِّحَاتِ
chapter.englishTitle: In the virtue of the inhalation of smoke and incense burners and...

hadiths.englishRaw: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says three times when he gets up in the morning: 'A'udhu Billahis-Sami Al-'Alim Min Ash-Shaitanir-Rajim' and he recites three Ayat from the end of Surah Al-Hashr - Allah appoints seventy-thousand angels who say Salat upon him until the evening. If he dies on that day, he dies a martyr, and whoever reaches the evening, he holds the same status."     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: that the Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever says three times when he gets up in the morning: 'A'udhu Billahis-Sami Al-'Alim Min Ash-Shaitanir-Rajim' and he recites three Ayat from the end of Surah Al-Hashr - Allah appoints seventy-thousand angels who say Salat upon him until the evening. If he dies on that day, he dies a martyr, and whoever reaches the evening, he holds the same status."     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ قَالَ حِينَ يُصْبِحُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَثَلَاثَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ آخِرِ سُورَةِ الْحَشْرِ وَكَّلَ اللَّهُ بِهِ سَبْعِينَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَإِنْ قَالَهَا مَسَاءً فَمِثْلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Faraj al-Baghdādī \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Zubayr \u003e Khālid b. Ṭahmān Abū al-ʿAlāʾ al-Khaffāf \u003e Nāfiʿ b. Abū Nāfiʿ \u003e Maʿqil b. Yasār
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَرَجِ الْبَغْدَادِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ أَبُو الْعَلَاءِ الْخَفَّافُ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعُ بْنُ أَبِي نَافِعٍ عَنْ مَعْقِلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3468

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3469

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Favor of Saying, 'O Disbelievers'

hadiths.englishRaw: A man named Ziyad came to Kufa, and I heard him say that he was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey. He said, "My knee would touch or come into contact with his knee." Then he heard a man reciting, "Say, O disbelievers" (Quran 109:1), and he said, "He is free from polytheism." And he heard another man reciting, "Say, He is Allah, the One" (Quran 112:1), and he said, "He will be forgiven."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: A man named Ziyad came to Kufa, and I heard him say that he was with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey. He said, "My knee would touch or come into contact with his knee." Then he heard a man reciting, "Say, O disbelievers" (Quran 109:1), and he said, "He is free from polytheism." And he heard another man reciting, "Say, He is Allah, the One" (Quran 112:1), and he said, "He will be forgiven."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ زَمَنَ زِيَادٍ إِلَى الْكُوفَةِ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي مَسِيرٍ لَهُ قَالَ وَرُكْبَتِي تُصِيبُ أَوْ تَمَسُّ رُكْبَتَهُ فَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقْرَأُ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ قَالَ «بَرِئَ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ» وَسَمِعَ رَجُلًا يَقْرَأُ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ قَالَ «غُفِرَ لَهُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Zayd Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e Abū al-Ḥasan Muhājir \u003e Jāʾ a man Zaman Ziyād \u003e al-Kūfah Fasamiʿtuh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زَيْدٍ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُهَاجِرٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3469

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3470

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ
chapter.englishTitle: In the Favor of Saying, 'O Disbelievers'

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There will come a time when something will come to you.' He said, 'I came to you to teach me something to say before I sleep.' He said, 'When you go to your bed, recite Surah Al-Kafirun (Chapter 109) and then sleep upon its completion, for it is a disavowal of polytheism.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There will come a time when something will come to you.' He said, 'I came to you to teach me something to say before I sleep.' He said, 'When you go to your bed, recite Surah Al-Kafirun (Chapter 109) and then sleep upon its completion, for it is a disavowal of polytheism.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَجِيءٌ مَا جَاءَ بِكَ» قَالَ جِئْتُ لِتُعَلِّمَنِي شَيْئًا أَقُولُهُ عِنْدَ مَنَامِي قَالَ «فَإِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَاقْرَأْ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ ثُمَّ نَمْ عَلَى خَاتِمَتِهَا فَإِنَّهَا بَرَاءَةٌ مِنَ الشِّرْكِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Zuhayr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Farwah b. Nawfal from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ فَرْوَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3470

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3471

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Indeed, Allah has divided the Quran into three parts, and He made 'Say, He is Allah, the One' as one-third of the Quran."
hadiths.body: "Indeed, Allah has divided the Quran into three parts, and He made 'Say, He is Allah, the One' as one-third of the Quran."
hadiths.arabic: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَزَّأَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى ثَلَاثَةِ أَجْزَاءٍ فَجَعَلَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ»
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e Ṣafwān \u003e Iyās al-Bikālī \u003e Nawf al-Bikālī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا صَفْوَانُ حَدَّثَنَا إِيَاسٌ الْبِكَالِيُّ عَنْ نَوْفٍ الْبِكَالِيِّ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3471

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3472

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard Sa'id bin al-Musayyib saying that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Surah Al-Ikhlas (Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad) ten times, a palace will be built for him in Jannah. And whoever recites it twenty times, two palaces will be built for him in Jannah. And whoever recites it thirty times, three palaces will be built for him in Jannah." Umar bin al-Khattab said: "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, then we will have plenty of palaces." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied: "Allah is greater than that." Abu Muhammad (a narrator) said: "Abu Aqil Zuhrah bin Ma'bad claimed that he was one of the Abdal."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: He heard Sa'id bin al-Musayyib saying that the Prophet of Allah ﷺ said: "Whoever recites Surah Al-Ikhlas (Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad) ten times, a palace will be built for him in Jannah. And whoever recites it twenty times, two palaces will be built for him in Jannah. And whoever recites it thirty times, three palaces will be built for him in Jannah." Umar bin al-Khattab said: "By Allah, O Messenger of Allah, then we will have plenty of palaces." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ replied: "Allah is greater than that." Abu Muhammad (a narrator) said: "Abu Aqil Zuhrah bin Ma'bad claimed that he was one of the Abdal."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيِّبِ يَقُولُ إِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ قَرَأَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ عَشْرَ مَرَّاتٍ بُنِيَ لَهُ بِهَا قَصْرٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ قَرَأهاَ عِشْرِينَ مَرَّةً بُنِيَ لَهُ بِهَا قَصْرَانِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَمَنْ قَرَأَهَا ثَلَاثِينَ مَرَّةً بُنِيَ لَهُ بِهَا ثَلَاثَةُ قُصُورٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ» فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِذَنْ لَنَكْثُرَنَّ قُصُورُنَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «اللَّهُ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «أَبُو عَقِيلٍ زُهْرَةُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ وَزَعَمُوا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْأَبْدَالِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah \u003e Abū ʿAqīl \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib \u003e In Nabī Allāh ﷺ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو عَقِيلٍ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3472

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3473

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: "He used to, when he recited a Surah, follow it with saying 'Say: He is Allah, the One.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He used to, when he recited a Surah, follow it with saying 'Say: He is Allah, the One.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا قَرَأَ سُورَةً فَخَتَمَهَا أَتْبَعَهَا بِقُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e ʿUtbah b. Ḍamrah b. Ḥabīb from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3473

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3474

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Can any one of you not recite one-third of the Quran in a single night?" They said, "We are unable and weak to do that." So he said, "Verily, Allah has divided the Quran into three parts, and He made Surah Al-Ikhlas (Chapter 112) equal to one third of the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Can any one of you not recite one-third of the Quran in a single night?" They said, "We are unable and weak to do that." So he said, "Verily, Allah has divided the Quran into three parts, and He made Surah Al-Ikhlas (Chapter 112) equal to one third of the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ؟» قَالُوا نَحْنُ أَعْجَزُ وَأَضْعَفُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَزَّأَ الْقُرْآنَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَجْزَاءٍ فَجَعَلَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muslim b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Abān b. Yazīd al-ʿAṭṭār \u003e Qatādah \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Maʿdān b. Abū Ṭalḥah \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الْعَطَّارِ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3474

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3475

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Huraira used to say, "Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, that is equivalent to one-third of the Quran."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Huraira used to say, "Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, that is equivalent to one-third of the Quran."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ كَانَ يَقُولُ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Ismāʿīl b. Mujammiʿ \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُجَمِّعٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَنَّ حُمَيْدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ حَدَّثَهُ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3475

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3476

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Qul Huwa Allahu ahad [Say: He is Allah, (the) One] is equivalent to one third of the Quran."     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Qul Huwa Allahu ahad [Say: He is Allah, (the) One] is equivalent to one third of the Quran."     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ تَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: al-Muʿallá b. Asad \u003e Sallām b. Abū Muṭīʿ \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Zir \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ عَنْ سَلَّامِ بْنِ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ زِرٍّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3476

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3477

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: "From Abdullah, similar to him."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "From Abdullah, similar to him."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مِثْلَهُ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. ʿĀṣim \u003e Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Zir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ زِرٍّ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3477

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3478

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: "By Allah, I truly love this Surah. Say: He is Allah, the One." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Your love for it will enter you into Paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "By Allah, I truly love this Surah. Say: He is Allah, the One." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Your love for it will enter you into Paradise."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأُحِبُّ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «حُبُّكَ إِيَّاهَا أَدْخَلَكَ الْجَنَّةَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Mubārak b. Faḍālah \u003e Thābit \u003e Anas \u003e a man
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا مُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ عَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3478

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3479

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the meaning of the phrase "Say: He is Allah, the One." He replied, "It is equivalent to one-third of the Quran, or it is equal to it in value."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about the meaning of the phrase "Say: He is Allah, the One." He replied, "It is equivalent to one-third of the Quran, or it is equal to it in value."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سُئِلَ عَنْ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ فَقَالَ «ثُلُثُ الْقُرْآنِ أَوْ تَعْدِلُهُ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Maslamah \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. Muslim \u003e Muḥammad b. Shihāb \u003e Ḥumayd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman from his mother
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أُمِّهِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3479

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3480

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do you not see what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has brought?" She said, "Perhaps it is some good that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has brought to us, so what is it?" He said, "He said to us, 'Can any of you recite one-third of the Quran in one night?' " She said, "We were afraid that he would ask us to do something we were not capable of, so we did not ask him for anything until he repeated it three times. Then he said, 'Is it not true that one of you can recite 'Say, He is Allah, [who is] One' and 'Allah, the Eternal Refuge'?' "   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Do you not see what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has brought?" She said, "Perhaps it is some good that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ has brought to us, so what is it?" He said, "He said to us, 'Can any of you recite one-third of the Quran in one night?' " She said, "We were afraid that he would ask us to do something we were not capable of, so we did not ask him for anything until he repeated it three times. Then he said, 'Is it not true that one of you can recite 'Say, He is Allah, [who is] One' and 'Allah, the Eternal Refuge'?' "   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَلَا تَرَيْنَ إِلَى مَا جَاءَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَتْ رُبَّ خَيْرٍ قَدْ أَتَانَا بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَمَا هُوَ؟ قَالَ قَالَ لَنَا «أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ فِي لَيْلَةٍ؟» قَالَ فَأَشْفَقْنَا أَنْ يُزِيدَنَا عَلَى أَمْرٍ نَعْجِزُ عَنْهُ فَلَمْ نَرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِ شَيْئًا حَتَّى قَالَهَا ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ «أَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh b. Mūsá \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Hilāl \u003e al-Rabīʿ b. Khuthaym \u003e ʿAmr b. Maymūn \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Abū Laylá \u003e Āmraʾah from al-Anṣār \u003e Abū Ayyūb \u003e Atāhā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ هِلَالٍ عَنْ الرَّبِيعِ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى عَنْ امْرَأَةٍ مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ قَالَ أَتَاهَا فَقَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3480

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3481

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فِي فَضْلِ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
chapter.englishTitle: In the favor of Say: He is Allah, the One.

hadiths.englishRaw: The messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said, "Whoever recites Surah Al-Ikhlas (Chapter 112 of the Quran) fifty times, Allah will forgive his sins of fifty years."
hadiths.body: The messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said, "Whoever recites Surah Al-Ikhlas (Chapter 112 of the Quran) fifty times, Allah will forgive his sins of fifty years."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَنْ قَرَأَ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ خَمْسِينَ مَرَّةً غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ذُنُوبَ خَمْسِينَ سَنَةً»
hadiths.chain: Naṣr b. ʿAlī \u003e Nūḥ b. Qays \u003e Muḥammad Abū Rajāʾ \u003e Um Kathīr al-Anṣāriyyah \u003e Anas b. Mālik
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ نُوحِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ عَنْ أُمِّ كَثِيرٍ الْأَنْصَارِيَّةِ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3481

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3482

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtues of the two Surah Al-Muawwadhatain

hadiths.englishRaw: He heard Uqbah ibn Amir saying, "I held onto the foot of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, teach me Surah Hud and Surah Yusuf.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, 'O Uqbah, you will never recite a Surah from the Qur'an that is more beloved to Allah and more comprehensive before Him than Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-Falaq (Surah Al-Falaq).' Yazid said, 'Abu Imran used to not leave it. He would continue reciting it in the Maghrib prayer.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: He heard Uqbah ibn Amir saying, "I held onto the foot of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, teach me Surah Hud and Surah Yusuf.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to me, 'O Uqbah, you will never recite a Surah from the Qur'an that is more beloved to Allah and more comprehensive before Him than Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-Falaq (Surah Al-Falaq).' Yazid said, 'Abu Imran used to not leave it. He would continue reciting it in the Maghrib prayer.'"   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ يَقُولُ تَعَلَّقْتُ بِقَدَمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَقْرِئْنِي سُورَةَ هُودٍ وَسُورَةَ يُوسُفَ فَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَا عُقْبَةُ إِنَّكَ لَنْ تَقْرَأَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ سُورَةً أَحَبَّ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا أَبْلَغَ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ» قَالَ يَزِيدُ «فَلَمْ يَكُنْ أَبُو عِمْرَانَ يَدَعُهَا كَانَ لَا يَزَالُ يَقْرَؤُهَا فِي صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd \u003e Ḥaywah And Ibn Lahīʿah \u003e Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb \u003e Abū ʿImrān \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ وَابْنُ لَهِيعَةَ قَالَا سَمِعْنَا يَزِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عِمْرَانَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3482

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3483

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtues of the two Surah Al-Muawwadhatain

hadiths.englishRaw: I walked with the Prophet ﷺ , and he said to me, "Say, 'O Uqbah.'" So I asked, "What should I say?" He remained silent for a while and then said, "O Uqbah, say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.'" I recited it until I reached its end, and at that moment the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None has ever sought refuge in anything similar to it, neither a questioner nor one seeking refuge."   – Sound
hadiths.body: I walked with the Prophet ﷺ , and he said to me, "Say, 'O Uqbah.'" So I asked, "What should I say?" He remained silent for a while and then said, "O Uqbah, say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak.'" I recited it until I reached its end, and at that moment the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "None has ever sought refuge in anything similar to it, neither a questioner nor one seeking refuge."   – Sound
hadiths.arabic: مَشَيْتُ مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ لِي «قُلْ يَا عُقْبَةُ» فَقُلْتُ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ عَنِّي ثُمَّ قَالَ «يَا عُقْبَةُ قُلْ» فَقُلْتُ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ أَقُولُ؟ قَالَ «قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ» فَقَرَأْتُهَا حَتَّى جِئْتُ عَلَى آخِرِهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ «مَا سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ وَلَا اسْتَعَاذَ مُسْتَعِيذٌ بِمِثْلِهَا»   – صحيح
hadiths.chain: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh \u003e Layth \u003e Ibn ʿAjlān \u003e Saʿīd b. Abū Saʿīd al-Maqburī \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ عَنْ ابْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ أَنَّ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3483

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3484

chapter.englishTitle: In the virtues of the two Surah Al-Muawwadhatain

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, verses have been revealed upon me that I have not seen before or that have not been seen similar to them." He refers to the last two chapters of the Quran, Al-Falaq and An-Nas.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Indeed, verses have been revealed upon me that I have not seen before or that have not been seen similar to them." He refers to the last two chapters of the Quran, Al-Falaq and An-Nas.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَقَدْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيَّ آيَاتٌ لَمْ أَرَ أَوْ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلَهُنَّ» يَعْنِي الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yaʿlá \u003e Ismāʿīl \u003e Ibn Abū Khālid \u003e Qays \u003e ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ هُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ قَيْسٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3484

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3485

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فَضْلِ مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of those who recite ten verses

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites ten verses in one night will not be counted among the inattentive."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites ten verses in one night will not be counted among the inattentive."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: [Chain 1] Yaḥyá b. Bisṭām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith \u003e al-Qāsim Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Tamīm al-Dārī [Chain 2] ʿUthmān b. Muslim \u003e al-ʿAbbās b. Maymūn \u003e Tamīm al-Dārī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3485

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3486

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فَضْلِ مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of those who recite ten verses

hadiths.englishRaw: Tamim al-Dari and Fadalah ibn ‘Ubaydah said: "Whoever recites ten verses in one night will be counted among the devout."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Tamim al-Dari and Fadalah ibn ‘Ubaydah said: "Whoever recites ten verses in one night will be counted among the devout."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ وَفَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَا «مَنْ قَرَأَ بِعَشْرِ آيَاتٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Bisṭām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith \u003e al-Qāsim Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Tamīm al-Dārī And Faḍālah b. ʿUbayd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَمْزَةَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3486

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3487

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فَضْلِ مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of those who recite ten verses

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites ten verses will not be written among the heedless."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites ten verses will not be written among the heedless."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ بِعَشْرِ آيَاتٍ لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Ismāʿīl b. Abān \u003e Abū Ūways \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUqbah \u003e Muḥammad b. Kaʿb al-Quraẓī \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبَانَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُوَيْسٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ الْقُرَظِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3487

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3488

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: فَضْلِ مَنْ قَرَأَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ
chapter.englishTitle: The virtue of those who recite ten verses

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites ten verses in a night, will not be counted among the heedless."
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites ten verses in a night, will not be counted among the heedless."
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِعَشْرِ آيَاتٍ لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ»
hadiths.chain: Mālik b. Ismāʿīl \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Mughīrah b. ʿAbdullāh al-Jadalī \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَدَلِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3488

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3489

chapter.englishTitle: Whoever recites fifty verses

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites fifty verses in a night will not be recorded among the unaware."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites fifty verses in a night will not be recorded among the unaware."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِخَمْسِينَ آيَةً لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Fiṭr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3489

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3490

chapter.englishTitle: Whoever recites fifty verses

hadiths.englishRaw: "On the authority of Tamim Ad-Dari and Fadalah ibn 'Ubayd, they said: 'Whoever recites fifty verses in one night will be recorded among the memorizers.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "On the authority of Tamim Ad-Dari and Fadalah ibn 'Ubayd, they said: 'Whoever recites fifty verses in one night will be recorded among the memorizers.'"   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ وَفَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَا «مَنْ قَرَأَ خَمْسِينَ آيَةً فِي لَيْلَةٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الْحَافِظِينَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Bisṭām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith \u003e al-Qāsim Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Tamīm al-Dārī And Faḍālah b. ʿUbayd

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3496

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites a hundred verses in a night will be written among the devout."   – Sound Chain

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Abu Umamah saying, "Whoever recites one hundred verses will not be counted among the heedless."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Umamah saying, "Whoever recites one hundred verses will not be counted among the heedless."   – Sound Chain

hadiths.body: I heard Abu Umamah saying, "Whoever recites two hundred verses, it will be written for them as being one of the devout."   – Sound Chain

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3499

chapter.englishTitle: Who read two hundred verses?

hadiths.englishRaw: From Salim, the brother of Umm Ad-Darda, from Umm Ad-Darda, from Abu Ad-Darda, from the Prophet ﷺ who said: "Whoever recites two hundred verses in one night will be recorded among the devout."
hadiths.body: From Salim, the brother of Umm Ad-Darda, from Umm Ad-Darda, from Abu Ad-Darda, from the Prophet ﷺ who said: "Whoever recites two hundred verses in one night will be recorded among the devout."
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَخِي أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي اللَّهِ عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ قَرَأَ مِائَتَيْ آيَةٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ»
