hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ يُحَنَّسَ مَوْلَى الزُّبَيْرِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3499

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3500

chapter.englishTitle: Who read two hundred verses?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever reads ten verses in a night will not be recorded among the heedless, and whoever reads one hundred verses in a night will be recorded among the obedient, and whoever reads two hundred verses will be recorded among the successful."
hadiths.body: "Whoever reads ten verses in a night will not be recorded among the heedless, and whoever reads one hundred verses in a night will be recorded among the obedient, and whoever reads two hundred verses will be recorded among the successful."
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ وَمَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ وَمَنْ قَرَأَ بِمِائَتَيْ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الْفَائِزِينَ»
hadiths.chain: Abū Ghassān \u003e Isrāʾīl \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e al-Mughīrah b. ʿAbdullāh al-Jadalī \u003e Ibn ʿUmar
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَدَلِيِّ عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3500

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3501

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَرَأَ مِنْ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ إِلَى الْأَلْفِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has read from one hundred verses to one thousand verses?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites ten verses in one night will be recorded among the faithful, and whoever recites a hundred verses will be recorded among the devout, and whoever recites from five hundred to a thousand verses will rise in the morning with a measure of reward." It was asked, "What is the measure?" He said, "A container full of musk as large as the size of a bull, made of gold."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites ten verses in one night will be recorded among the faithful, and whoever recites a hundred verses will be recorded among the devout, and whoever recites from five hundred to a thousand verses will rise in the morning with a measure of reward." It was asked, "What is the measure?" He said, "A container full of musk as large as the size of a bull, made of gold."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الذَّاكِرِينَ وَمَنْ قَرَأَ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ وَمَنْ قَرَأَ بِخَمْسِ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ إِلَى الْأَلْفِ أَصْبَحَ وَلَهُ قِنْطَارٌ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ» قِيلَ وَمَا الْقِنْطَارُ؟ قَالَ «مِلْءُ مَسْكِ الثَّوْرِ ذَهَبًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Saʿīd al-Jurayrī \u003e Abū Naḍrah \u003e Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3501

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3502

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَرَأَ مِنْ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ إِلَى الْأَلْفِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has read from one hundred verses to one thousand verses?

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever recites one hundred verses in one night, the Qur'an will not argue with him on that night. And whoever recites two hundred verses in one night, Qunut will be written for him that night. And whoever recites five hundred verses in one night, he will receive a Qintar in the Hereafter." They said, "And what is the Qintar?" He said, "Twelve thousand."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet of Allah ﷺ said, "Whoever recites one hundred verses in one night, the Qur'an will not argue with him on that night. And whoever recites two hundred verses in one night, Qunut will be written for him that night. And whoever recites five hundred verses in one night, he will receive a Qintar in the Hereafter." They said, "And what is the Qintar?" He said, "Twelve thousand."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مِائَةَ آيَةٍ لَمْ يُحَاجَّهُ الْقُرْآنُ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةَ وَمَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مِائَتَيْ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ لَهُ قُنُوتُ لَيْلَةٍ وَمَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ خَمْسَ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ إِلَى الْأَلْفِ أَصْبَحَ وَلَهُ قِنْطَارٌ فِي الْآخِرَةِ» قَالُوا وَمَا الْقِنْطَارُ؟ قَالَ «اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Nuʿmān \u003e Wuhayb \u003e Yūnus \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e Nabī Allāh ﷺ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3502

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3503

chapter.arabicTitle: بَابُ: مَنْ قَرَأَ مِنْ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ إِلَى الْأَلْفِ
chapter.englishTitle: Who has read from one hundred verses to one thousand verses?

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever recites three hundred verses in one night, a Qur'anic hafiz book will be written for him, and whoever recites seven hundred verses, I do not know what Abu Nuaym said about it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever recites three hundred verses in one night, a Qur'anic hafiz book will be written for him, and whoever recites seven hundred verses, I do not know what Abu Nuaym said about it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ لَهُ قِنْطَارٌ وَمَنْ قَرَأَ سَبْعَ مِائَةِ آيَةٍ» لَا أَدْرِي أَيَّ شَيْءٍ قَالَ فِيهَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Fiṭr \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا فِطْرٌ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3503

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3504

chapter.englishTitle: Who read a thousand verses

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard Abu Umamah say, "Whoever recites a thousand verses will have a Qintar worth of reward written for him, and the weight of a Qirat from that Qintar will not be sufficient to compensate for your worldly possessions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard Abu Umamah say, "Whoever recites a thousand verses will have a Qintar worth of reward written for him, and the weight of a Qirat from that Qintar will not be sufficient to compensate for your worldly possessions."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ يَقُولُ مَنْ قَرَأَ أَلْفَ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ لَهُ قِنْطَارٌ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ وَالْقِيرَاطُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الْقِنْطَارِ لَا تَفِي بِهِ دُنْيَاكُمْ يَقُولُ لَا تَعْدِلُهُ دُنْيَاكُمْ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: al-Ḥakam b. Nāfiʿ \u003e Ḥarīz \u003e Ḥabīb b. ʿUbayd \u003e Abū Umāmah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَنْبَأَنَا حَرِيزٌ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3504

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3505

chapter.englishTitle: Who read a thousand verses

hadiths.englishRaw: Tameem Al-Dari and Fadalah Ibn Ubayd said, "Whoever recites a thousand verses in one night, a treasury will be written for him and a qirat from that treasury is better than the world and everything in it, and he will earn as much reward as Allah wills."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Tameem Al-Dari and Fadalah Ibn Ubayd said, "Whoever recites a thousand verses in one night, a treasury will be written for him and a qirat from that treasury is better than the world and everything in it, and he will earn as much reward as Allah wills."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ وَفَضَالَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ قَالَا «مَنْ قَرَأَ أَلْفَ آيَةٍ فِي لَيْلَةٍ كُتِبَ لَهُ قِنْطَارٌ وَالْقِيرَاطُ مِنَ الْقِنْطَارِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا وَاكْتَسَبَ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Yaḥyá b. Bisṭām \u003e Yaḥyá b. Ḥamzah \u003e Yaḥyá b. al-Ḥārith \u003e al-Qāsim Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Tamīm al-Dārī And Faḍālah b. ʿUbayd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بِسْطَامَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3505

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3506

chapter.englishTitle: Who read a thousand verses

hadiths.englishRaw: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Whoever recites a thousand verses, a treasure of rewards will be written for him, and within it is a portion equal to the size of Mount Uhud."
hadiths.body: On the authority of the Prophet ﷺ , he said, "Whoever recites a thousand verses, a treasure of rewards will be written for him, and within it is a portion equal to the size of Mount Uhud."
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «مَنْ قَرَأَ أَلْفَ آيَةٍ كُتِبَ لَهُ قِنْطَارٌ مِنَ الْأَجْرِ الْقِيرَاطُ مِنْهُ مِثْلُ التَّلِّ الْعَظِيمِ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. al-Qāsim \u003e Mūsá b. ʿUbaydah \u003e Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm \u003e Yuḥannas a freed slave of al-Zubayr \u003e Sālim Akhī Um al-Dardāʾ \u003e Um al-Dardāʾ \u003e Abū al-Dardāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ يُحَنَّسَ مَوْلَى الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ سَالِمٍ أَخِي أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3506

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3507

chapter.englishTitle: What is the weight of the quintal?

hadiths.englishRaw: "They will gather for the fierce battle, and at that time they will come with eighty banners, under each of which will be twelve thousand troops."    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: "They will gather for the fierce battle, and at that time they will come with eighty banners, under each of which will be twelve thousand troops."    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفًا   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: ʿAbd al-Ṣamad b. ʿAbd al-Wārith \u003e Abān al-ʿAṭṭār And Ḥammād b. Salamah \u003e ʿĀṣim \u003e Abū Ṣāliḥ \u003e Abū Hurayrah \u003e al-Qinṭār
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ الْعَطَّارُ وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ الْقِنْطَارُ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3507

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3508

chapter.englishTitle: What is the weight of the quintal?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The bag is filled with musk, a burgundy-colored bull."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "The bag is filled with musk, a burgundy-colored bull."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: الْقِنْطَارُ مِلْءُ مَسْكِ ثَوْرٍ ذَهَبًا   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Abū al-Ashhab \u003e Abū Naḍrah al-ʿAbdī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي الْأَشْهَبِ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ الْعَبْدِيِّ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3508

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3509

chapter.englishTitle: What is the weight of the quintal?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The quantity is forty thousand."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The quantity is forty thousand."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْقِنْطَارُ أَرْبَعُونَ أَلْفًا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Hushaym \u003e ʿAlī b. Zayd \u003e Saʿīd b. al-Musayyib
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3509

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3510

chapter.englishTitle: What is the weight of the quintal?

hadiths.englishRaw: "They will gather for the fierce battle, and at that time they will come with eighty banners, under each of which will be twelve thousand troops."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "They will gather for the fierce battle, and at that time they will come with eighty banners, under each of which will be twelve thousand troops."    – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: اثْنَا عَشَرَ أَلْفًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Mubārak \u003e al-Ḥasan \u003e al-Qinṭār Diyah Aḥadikum
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ عَنْ مُبَارَكٍ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ قَالَ «الْقِنْطَارُ دِيَةُ أَحَدِكُمُ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3510

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3511

chapter.englishTitle: What is the weight of the quintal?

hadiths.englishRaw: The translation of "الْقِنْطَارُ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ" into English is "The pack is seventy thousand dinars."   – Good Chain
hadiths.body: The translation of "الْقِنْطَارُ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ" into English is "The pack is seventy thousand dinars."   – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: الْقِنْطَارُ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ دِينَارٍ   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Muslim \u003e al-Zanjī \u003e Ibn Abū Najīḥ \u003e Mujāhid
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ هُوَ الزَّنْجِيُّ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3511

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3512

chapter.englishTitle: What is the weight of the quintal?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The bale is one thousand and two hundred kilograms."
hadiths.body: "The bale is one thousand and two hundred kilograms."
hadiths.arabic: «الْقِنْطَارُ أَلْفُ أُوقِيَّةٍ وَمِائَتَا أُوقِيَّةٍ»
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq \u003e Abū Bakr \u003e Abū Ḥaṣīn \u003e Sālim b. Abū al-Jaʿd \u003e Muʿādh b. Jabal
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3512

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3513

chapter.englishTitle: What is the weight of the quintal?

hadiths.englishRaw: "The sack weighs seventy thousand mithqals."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The sack weighs seventy thousand mithqals."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «الْقِنْطَارُ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مِثْقَالٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū Nuʿaym \u003e Sharīk \u003e Layth \u003e Mujāhid
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3513

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3514

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever witnesses the opening of the Qur'an, it is as if they witnessed a victory in the cause of Allah. And whoever witnesses its completion, it is as if they witnessed the distribution of spoils."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever witnesses the opening of the Qur'an, it is as if they witnessed a victory in the cause of Allah. And whoever witnesses its completion, it is as if they witnessed the distribution of spoils."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ شَهِدَ الْقُرْآنَ حِينَ يُفْتَحُ فَكَأَنَّمَا شَهِدَ فَتْحًا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَمَنْ شَهِدَ خَتْمَهُ حِينَ يُخْتَمُ فَكَأَنَّمَا شَهِدَ الْغَنَائِمَ حِينَ تُقْسَمُ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ṣāliḥ al-Murrī \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Abū Qilābah Rafaʿah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ الْمُرِّيُّ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ رَفَعَهُ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3514

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3515

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: A man used to read in the mosque of the city, and Ibn Abbas has placed guards on him. When the day of his completion came, he stood up and transformed towards him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: A man used to read in the mosque of the city, and Ibn Abbas has placed guards on him. When the day of his completion came, he stood up and transformed towards him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ رَجُلٌ يَقْرَأُ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ قَدْ وَضَعَ عَلَيْهِ الرَّصَدَ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ خَتْمِهِ قَامَ فَتَحَوَّلَ إِلَيْهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ṣāliḥ al-Murrī \u003e Qatādah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ الْمُرِّيُّ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3515

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3516

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "When Anas ibn Malik used to recover from illness, he would spend the night reciting the Quran until morning. Then, he would gather his family and complete the recitation with them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "When Anas ibn Malik used to recover from illness, he would spend the night reciting the Quran until morning. Then, he would gather his family and complete the recitation with them."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ إِذَا أَشْفَى عَلَى خَتْمِ الْقُرْآنِ بِاللَّيْلِ بَقَّى مِنْهُ شَيْئًا حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ فَيَجْمَعَ أَهْلَهُ فَيَخْتِمَهُ مَعَهُمْ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ṣāliḥ \u003e Thābit al-Bunānī
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3516

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3517

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Anas used to gather his children and household when he completed reading the Quran and then he would pray for them.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: Anas used to gather his children and household when he completed reading the Quran and then he would pray for them.   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانَ أَنَسٌ إِذَا خَتَمَ الْقُرْآنَ جَمَعَ وَلَدَهُ وَأَهْلَ بَيْتِهِ فَدَعَا لَهُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAffān \u003e Jaʿfar b. Sulaymān \u003e Thābit
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3517

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3518

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a person finishes reciting the Quran during the day, the angels pray for him until evening, and if he finishes during the night, the angels pray for him until morning."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When a person finishes reciting the Quran during the day, the angels pray for him until evening, and if he finishes during the night, the angels pray for him until morning."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا خَتَمَ الرَّجُلُ الْقُرْآنَ بِنَهَارٍ صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَإِنْ فَرَغَ مِنْهُ لَيْلًا صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Mughīrah \u003e al-Awzāʿī \u003e ʿAbdah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا الْأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3518

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3519

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Which deeds are the best?" He said, "The state of migratory horsemen." It was asked, "What is the state of migratory horsemen?" He said, "One who recites the Quran from the beginning to the end and from the end to the beginning, every time he finishes, he starts again."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Which deeds are the best?" He said, "The state of migratory horsemen." It was asked, "What is the state of migratory horsemen?" He said, "One who recites the Quran from the beginning to the end and from the end to the beginning, every time he finishes, he starts again."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ سُئِلَ أَيُّ الْعَمَلِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ «الْحَالُّ الْمُرْتَحِلُ» قِيلَ وَمَا الْحَالُّ الْمُرْتَحِلُ؟ قَالَ «صَاحِبُ الْقُرْآنِ يَضْرِبُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ الْقُرْآنِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ وَمِنْ آخِرِهِ إِلَى أَوَّلِهِ كُلَّمَا حَلَّ ارْتَحَلَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Isḥāq b. ʿĪsá \u003e Ṣāliḥ al-Murrī \u003e Qatādah \u003e Zurārah b. Awfá
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَنْ صَالِحٍ الْمُرِّيِّ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3519

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3520

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "When a man recites the Quran during the day, the angels pray for him until evening, and if he recites it at night, the angels pray for him until morning." Sulaiman said, "I have seen our companions prefer to complete it at the beginning of the day and at the beginning of the night."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "When a man recites the Quran during the day, the angels pray for him until evening, and if he recites it at night, the angels pray for him until morning." Sulaiman said, "I have seen our companions prefer to complete it at the beginning of the day and at the beginning of the night."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا قَرَأَ الرَّجُلُ الْقُرْآنَ نَهَارًا صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ وَإِنْ قَرَأَهُ لَيْلًا صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ» قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ «فَرَأَيْتُ أَصْحَابَنَا يُعْجِبُهُمْ أَنْ يَخْتِمُوهُ أَوَّلَ النَّهَارِ وَأَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Ibrāhīm b. Mūsá \u003e Jarīr \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنْ جَرِيرٍ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3520

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3521

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "There is no mention of Solomon in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "There is no mention of Solomon in it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِيهِ قَوْلُ سُلَيْمَانَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Yūsuf al-Firyābī \u003e Sufyān \u003e al-Aʿmash \u003e Ibrāhīm \u003e Illā
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الْفِرْيَابِيُّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ «مِثْلَهُ إِلَّا
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3521

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3522

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "From the bottom of his heart, he had a wish, either in this world or in the hereafter."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "From the bottom of his heart, he had a wish, either in this world or in the hereafter."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنْ ظَهْرِ قَلْبِهِ كَانَتْ لَهُ دَعْوَةٌ فِي الدُّنْيَا أَوْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Farwah b. Abū al-Maghrāʾ \u003e al-Qāsim b. Mālik al-Muzanī \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Isḥāq \u003e Muḥārib b. Dithār \u003e Man Qaraʾ al-Qurān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا فَرْوَةُ بْنُ أَبِي الْمَغْرَاءِ عَنْ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الْمُزَنِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ قَالَ «مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3522

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3523

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The other person said, "He was forgiven."
hadiths.body: The other person said, "He was forgiven."
hadiths.arabic: وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ «غُفِرَ لَهُ»
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbd al-Salām \u003e Yazīd b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman \u003e Ṭalḥah And ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Aswad
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلَامِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ قَالَا «مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ لَيْلًا أَوْ نَهَارًا صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ»
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3523

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3524

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Whoever reads the Quran and then supplicates, four thousand angels will pray for his supplication."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Whoever reads the Quran and then supplicates, four thousand angels will pray for his supplication."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ ثُمَّ دَعَا أَمَّنَ عَلَى دُعَائِهِ أَرْبَعَةُ آلَافِ مَلَكٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAmr b. Ḥammād \u003e Qazaʿah b. Sūwayd \u003e Ḥumayd al-Aʿraj
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا قَزَعَةُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3524

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3525

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "So they made supplications."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "So they made supplications."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «فَدَعَوْا بِدَعَوَاتٍ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Saʿīd b. al-Rabīʿ \u003e Shuʿbah \u003e al-Ḥakam \u003e Baʿath Ilay Mujāhid \u003e Innamā Daʿawnāk Annā Aradnā \u003e Nakhtim al-Qurān And ʾInnah Balaghanā \u003e al-Duʿāʾ Yustajāb ʿInd Khatm al-Qurān
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ بَعَثَ إِلَيَّ مُجَاهِدٌ قَالَ إِنَّمَا دَعَوْنَاكَ أَنَّا أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَخْتِمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَإِنَّهُ بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ الدُّعَاءَ يُسْتَجَابُ عِنْدَ خَتْمِ الْقُرْآنِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3525

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3526

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "If the completion of the Quran coincides with the beginning of the night, the angels pray upon it until morning, and if its completion coincides with the end of the night, the angels pray upon it until evening. Perhaps something may remain for one of us, so the angels delay it until evening or morning." Abu Muhammad said, "This is good news from Saad."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "If the completion of the Quran coincides with the beginning of the night, the angels pray upon it until morning, and if its completion coincides with the end of the night, the angels pray upon it until evening. Perhaps something may remain for one of us, so the angels delay it until evening or morning." Abu Muhammad said, "This is good news from Saad."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «إِذَا وَافَقَ خَتْمُ الْقُرْآنِ أَوَّلَ اللَّيْلِ صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ وَإِنْ وَافَقَ خَتْمُهُ آخِرَ اللَّيْلِ صَلَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ فَرُبَّمَا بَقِيَ عَلَى أَحَدِنَا الشَّيْءُ فَيُؤَخِّرَهُ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ أَوْ يُصْبِحَ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد «هَذَا حَسَنٌ عَنْ سَعْدٍ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Ḥumayd \u003e Hārūn \u003e ʿAnbasah \u003e Layth \u003e Ṭalḥah b. Muṣarrif \u003e Muṣʿab b. Saʿd \u003e Saʿd
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ مُصَرِّفٍ عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سَعْدٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3526

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3527

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Campaign of the Quran is the distinguished ones from the people of Paradise."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "The Campaign of the Quran is the distinguished ones from the people of Paradise."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «حَمَلَةُ الْقُرْآنِ عُرَفَاءُ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Mujāhid b. Mūsá \u003e Maʿn \u003e Ibrāhīm b. Muhājir b. Mismār from my cousin Bukayr b. Mismār \u003e Ṣafwān b. Sulaym \u003e ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُهَاجِرِ بْنِ مِسْمَارٍ ابْنِ أَخِي بُكَيْرِ بْنِ مِسْمَارٍ حَدَّثَنِي صَفْوَانُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3527

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3528

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "He used to complete the recitation of the Quran every two nights."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "He used to complete the recitation of the Quran every two nights."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَخْتِمُ الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّ لَيْلَتَيْنِ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e ʿAbd al-Malik \u003e Saʿīd b. Jubayr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3528

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3529

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, in how long should I complete the recitation of the Quran?" He said, "Complete it in a month." I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in twenty-five days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in twenty days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in fifteen days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in ten days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in five days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "No."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, in how long should I complete the recitation of the Quran?" He said, "Complete it in a month." I said, "O Messenger of Allah, I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in twenty-five days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in twenty days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in fifteen days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in ten days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "Complete it in five days." I said, "I am capable of doing more." He said, "No."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِي كَمْ أَخْتِمُ الْقُرْآنَ؟ قَالَ «اخْتِمْهُ فِي شَهْرٍ» قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَا أُطِيقُ قَالَ «اخْتِمْهُ فِي خَمْسٍ وَعِشْرِينَ» قُلْتُ إِنِّي أُطِيقُ قَالَ «اخْتِمْهُ فِي عِشْرِينَ» قُلْتُ إِنِّي أُطِيقُ قَالَ «اخْتِمْهُ فِي خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ» قُلْتُ إِنِّي أُطِيقُ قَالَ «اخْتِمْهُ فِي عَشْرٍ» قُلْتُ إِنِّي أُطِيقُ قَالَ «اخْتِمْهُ فِي خَمْسٍ» قُلْتُ إِنِّي أُطِيقُ قَالَ «لَا»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad \u003e Jarīr \u003e Muṭarrif \u003e Abū Isḥāq \u003e Abū Burdah \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3529

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3530

chapter.englishTitle: In the completion of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me not to recite the Quran in less than three days."
hadiths.body: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded me not to recite the Quran in less than three days."
hadiths.arabic: «أَمَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنْ لَا أَقْرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فِي أَقَلَّ مِنْ ثَلَاثٍ»
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿUqbah b. Khālid \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Ziyād \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Rāfiʿ \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAmr
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ رَافِعٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3530

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3531

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He is not one of us who does not find contentment in the Quran." Ibn Uyaynah said, "He means that he is self-sufficient." Abu Muhammad said, "People say, 'Ubaidullah ibn Abi Nahik'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "He is not one of us who does not find contentment in the Quran." Ibn Uyaynah said, "He means that he is self-sufficient." Abu Muhammad said, "People say, 'Ubaidullah ibn Abi Nahik'."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ «لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَغَنَّ بِالْقُرْآنِ» قال ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ يَسْتَغْنِي قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد النَّاسُ يَقُولُونَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Abū al-Walīd al-Ṭayālisī \u003e Layth b. Saʿd \u003e Ibn Abū Mulaykah \u003e Ibn Abū Nahīk \u003e Saʿd b. Abū Waqqāṣ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ عَنْ ابْنِ أَبِي نَهِيكٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3531

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3532

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Who among the people has the best voice for reciting the Quran and the best recitation?" He replied, "The one whose recitation when you hear it, you feel that he fears Allah." Tawus said, "And he had a clear voice as well."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ was asked, "Who among the people has the best voice for reciting the Quran and the best recitation?" He replied, "The one whose recitation when you hear it, you feel that he fears Allah." Tawus said, "And he had a clear voice as well."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَيُّ النَّاسِ أَحْسَنُ صَوْتًا لِلْقُرْآنِ وَأَحْسَنُ قِرَاءَةً؟ قَالَ «مَنْ إِذَا سَمِعْتَهُ يَقْرَأُ أُرِيتَ أَنَّهُ يَخْشَى اللَّهَ» قَالَ طَاوُسٌ «وَكَانَ طَلْقٌ كَذَلِكَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Misʿar \u003e ʿAbd al-Karīm \u003e Ṭāwus
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ أَنْبَأَنَا مِسْعَرٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3532

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3533

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah does not listen to a prophet as He listens to a prophet who recites the Qur'an in a pleasant tone." The companion of the sub-narrator (Abu Salama) said, "It means, reciting it aloud."
hadiths.body: Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, "Allah does not listen to a prophet as He listens to a prophet who recites the Qur'an in a pleasant tone." The companion of the sub-narrator (Abu Salama) said, "It means, reciting it aloud."
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «لَمْ يَأْذَنِ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ مَا أَذِنَ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ» قَالَ صَاحِبٌ لَهُ أَرَادَ يَجْهَرُ بِهِ
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e ʿUqayl \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3533

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3534

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: God has not listened to anything as He listens to a Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet voice.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: God has not listened to anything as He listens to a Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet voice.    – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ كَمَا أَذِنَ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3534

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3535

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, used to say to Abu Musa, who had a beautiful voice reciting the Quran, "Indeed, this has been given to you from the psalms of the family of David."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, used to say to Abu Musa, who had a beautiful voice reciting the Quran, "Indeed, this has been given to you from the psalms of the family of David."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ لِأَبِي مُوسَى وَكَانَ حَسَنَ الصَّوْتِ بِالْقُرْآنِ «لَقَدْ أُوتِيَ هَذَا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3535

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3536

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Remind us, our Lord, O Moses' father!" So he reads it with him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Remind us, our Lord, O Moses' father!" So he reads it with him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «ذَكِّرْنَا رَبَّنَا يَا أَبَا مُوسَى» فَيَقْرَأُ عِنْدَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣāliḥ \u003e al-Layth \u003e Yūnus \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah Ayḍ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَالِحٍ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ أَيْضًا أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ كَانَ إِذَا رَأَى أَبَا مُوسَى قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3536

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3537

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "Do not let anyone of you place one foot over the other, indulging in singing and claiming to recite Surah Al-Baqarah. Indeed, Shaytan flees from a house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited, just as a yellowish hue disappears from the inner parts of a house when exposed to the Book of Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: "Do not let anyone of you place one foot over the other, indulging in singing and claiming to recite Surah Al-Baqarah. Indeed, Shaytan flees from a house in which Surah Al-Baqarah is recited, just as a yellowish hue disappears from the inner parts of a house when exposed to the Book of Allah."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: «لَا أُلْفِيَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ يَضَعُ إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ عَلَى الْأُخْرَى يَتَغَنَّى وَيَدَعُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ سُورَةَ الْبَقَرَةِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَفِرُّ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ يُقْرَأُ فِيهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ وَإِنَّ أَصْفَرَ الْبُيُوتِ الْجَوْفُ يَصْفَرُ مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Jaʿfar b. ʿAwn \u003e Ibrāhīm al-Hajarī \u003e Abū al-Aḥwaṣ \u003e ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ عَوْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْهَجَرِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3537

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3538

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Salama al-Baydhaq arrived in the city, and he stood to pray with them. It was said to Salim, "If you had come and heard his recitation." When he reached the door of the mosque, he heard his recitation and returned, saying, "Such a melodious recitation, such a melodious recitation."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Salama al-Baydhaq arrived in the city, and he stood to pray with them. It was said to Salim, "If you had come and heard his recitation." When he reached the door of the mosque, he heard his recitation and returned, saying, "Such a melodious recitation, such a melodious recitation."   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَدِمَ سَلَمَةُ الْبَيْذَقُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَقَامَ يُصَلِّي بِهِمْ فَقِيلَ لِسَالِمٍ لَوْ جِئْتَ فَسَمِعْتَ قِرَاءَتَهُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بِبَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ سَمِعَ قِرَاءَتَهُ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ «غِنَاءٌ غِنَاءٌ»   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Sulaymān b. Ḥarb \u003e Ḥammād b. Zayd \u003e Ayyūb \u003e Baʿḍ Āl Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ آلِ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3538

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3539

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Abu Musa used to come to Umar and Umar would say to him, "Remind us of our Lord." So Abu Musa would recite (the Quran) in front of him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.body: Abu Musa used to come to Umar and Umar would say to him, "Remind us of our Lord." So Abu Musa would recite (the Quran) in front of him.   – Weak Chain
hadiths.arabic: أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى كَانَ يَأْتِي عُمَرَ فَيَقُولُ لَهُ عُمَرُ «ذَكِّرْنَا رَبَّنَا» فَيَقْرَأُ عِنْدَهُ   – إسناده ضعيف
hadiths.chain: Abū ʿĀṣim \u003e Ibn Jurayj \u003e Ibn Shihāb \u003e Abū Salamah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنْ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3539

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3540

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: Allah has not heard anything (more pleasing) than listening to the Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet loud voice.    – Good Chain
hadiths.body: Allah has not heard anything (more pleasing) than listening to the Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet loud voice.    – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «مَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لِشَيْءٍ كَأَذَنِهِ لِنَبِيٍّ يَتَغَنَّى بِالْقُرْآنِ يَجْهَرُ بِهِ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad \u003e Ibn ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ هُوَ ابْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3540

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3541

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Abu Musa has indeed been given a flute from the flutes of the family of David."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: The Prophet ﷺ said, "Abu Musa has indeed been given a flute from the flutes of the family of David."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «لَقَدْ أُوتِيَ أَبُو مُوسَى مِزْمَارًا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar \u003e Mālik b. Mighwal \u003e Ibn Buraydah from his father
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ مِغْوَلٍ عَنْ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3541

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3542

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the mosque and heard a man reciting Qur’an. He asked: ‘Who is this?’ It was said: ‘(He is) ‘Abdullah bin Qais.’ He said: ‘He has been given (sweet melodious voice) from the Mazamir of the family of Dawud.’”     – Good Chain
hadiths.body: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ entered the mosque and heard a man reciting Qur’an. He asked: ‘Who is this?’ It was said: ‘(He is) ‘Abdullah bin Qais.’ He said: ‘He has been given (sweet melodious voice) from the Mazamir of the family of Dawud.’”     – Good Chain
hadiths.arabic: دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَمِعَ قِرَاءَةَ رَجُلٍ فَقَالَ «مَنْ هَذَا؟» قِيلَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ قَيْسٍ قَالَ «لَقَدْ أُوتِيَ هَذَا مِزْمَارًا مِنْ مَزَامِيرِ آلِ دَاوُدَ»   – إسناده حسن
hadiths.chain: Yazīd b. Hārūn \u003e Muḥammad b. ʿAmr \u003e Abū Salamah \u003e Abū Hurayrah
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3542

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3543

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "Adorn the Quran with your voices."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: From the Prophet ﷺ, he said: "Adorn the Quran with your voices."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ «زَيِّنُوا الْقُرْآنَ بِأَصْوَاتِكُمْ»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿUbaydullāh \u003e Sufyān \u003e Manṣūr \u003e Ṭalḥah \u003e ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. ʿAwsajah \u003e al-Barāʾ
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْسَجَةَ عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3543

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3544

chapter.englishTitle: The Recitation of the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying: "Beautify the Quran with your voices, for indeed a beautiful voice enhances the beauty of the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, saying: "Beautify the Quran with your voices, for indeed a beautiful voice enhances the beauty of the Quran."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ «حَسِّنُوا الْقُرْآنَ بِأَصْوَاتِكُمْ فَإِنَّ الصَّوْتَ الْحَسَنَ يَزِيدُ الْقُرْآنَ حُسْنًا»   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: Muḥammad b. Bakr \u003e Ṣadaqah b. Abū ʿImrān \u003e ʿAlqamah b. Marthad \u003e Zādhān Abū ʿUmar \u003e al-Barāʾ b. ʿĀzib
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ عَنْ زَاذَانَ أَبِي عُمَرَ عَنْ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3544

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3545

chapter.englishTitle: The Dislike of Melodies in the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "A man read a melody from these melodies in front of Anas, and Anas disliked it." Abu Muhammad said, and others said, "Ghurak ibn Abi al-Khidram read it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.body: "A man read a melody from these melodies in front of Anas, and Anas disliked it." Abu Muhammad said, and others said, "Ghurak ibn Abi al-Khidram read it."   – Sound Chain
hadiths.arabic: «قَرَأَ رَجُلٌ عِنْدَ أَنَسٍ بِلَحْنٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأَلْحَانِ فَكَرِهَ ذَلِكَ أَنَسٌ» قَالَ أَبُو مُحَمَّد وقَالَ غَيْرُهُ قَرَأَ غُورَكُ بْنُ أَبِي الْخِضْرِمِ   – إسناده صحيح
hadiths.chain: ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd \u003e ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs \u003e al-Aʿmash
hadiths.chainArabic: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ الْأَعْمَشِ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3545

hadiths.title: Sunan ad-Darimi 3546

chapter.englishTitle: The Dislike of Melodies in the Quran

hadiths.englishRaw: "They were seeing these melodies in the Quran as new."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.body: "They were seeing these melodies in the Quran as new."   – Fair Chain
hadiths.arabic: «كَانُوا يَرَوْنَ هَذِهِ الْأَلْحَانَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مُحْدَثَةً»   – إسناده جيد
hadiths.chain: al-ʿAbbās b. Sufyān \u003e Ibn ʿUlayyah \u003e Ibn ʿAwn \u003e Muḥammad
hadiths.chainArabic: حَدَّثَنَا الْعَبَّاسُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ عَنْ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ
references: Book of Virtues of the Quran, Hadith 3546
